name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
brief_description: A one-stop solution for multiple scholarships from Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentsRs. and UTs. Provides a common platform for application and disbursement via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: Multiple scholarships ranging from ₹10Rs. to ₹50Rs.+ per year; Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank accounts.
eligibility: Indian citizen; School or college student; Merit or income based eligibility depending on the specific scholarship.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships
brief_description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefits: ₹10Rs. per year for graduation; ₹20Rs. per year for post-graduation.
eligibility: Students in the top 20th percentile in Class 12; Pursuing regular higher education; Family income below ₹8 lakh per annum.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
brief_description: A flagship program to address the declining Child Sex Ratio and promote empowerment of girls through education and health.
benefits: Education support; Healthcare access; Community awareness programs and incentives for girl children.
eligibility: All girl children in India; Implemented through coordinated efforts in schools and community centers.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
brief_description: The world's largest health insurance/assurance scheme fully financed by the government. Provides cashless access to healthcare services.
benefits: ₹5 lakh health insurance coverage per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility: Based on economic criteria from Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC); Must be in the eligible beneficiary list.

name: Skill India Mission
brief_description: An initiative to empower the youth of the country with skill sets which make them more employable and more productive in their work environment.
benefits: Free skill training across various sectors; Industry-recognized certification; Job placement support.
eligibility: Indian youth; Minimum educational requirements vary by course.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
brief_description: For higher education students belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories in Karnataka. Provides financial assistance to cover education costs.
benefits: Fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance
eligibility: Karnataka residentRs. SC/ST/OBC studentsRs. Studying after Class 10

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities)
brief_description: For school students from Class 1 to 10 belonging to SC/ST/OBC or Minority communities in Karnataka.
benefits: Financial support for school education
eligibility: Students from Class 1-10Rs. Belonging to SC/ST/OBC/MinorityRs. Regular school attendance

name: Vidyasiri Scholarship
brief_description: Provides hostel and food support for backward class students pursuing post-matric education in Karnataka.
benefits: Free hostel + food allowance
eligibility: Backward class studentsRs. Post-matric educationRs. Income limit applicableRs. Must not have private hostel support

name: SSP Scholarship (State Scholarship Portal)
brief_description: Central platform for all scholarships in Karnataka. Facilitates Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to students.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to students
eligibility: SC/ST/OBC/Minority/EWS studentsRs. Aadhaar-linked bank accountRs. Online application mandatory

name: Sanchi Honnamma Scholarship
brief_description: Financial support for female students in Karnataka enrolled in higher education.
benefits: ₹2Rs. per year financial support
eligibility: Female students in KarnatakaRs. Must be enrolled in higher educationRs. Karnataka resident

name: Minority Scholarship (Karnataka)
brief_description: Fee reimbursement and maintenance support for students belonging to minority communities in Karnataka.
benefits: Fee reimbursement + maintenance support
eligibility: MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. JainRs. BuddhistRs. Parsi studentsRs. Income-based eligibilityRs. Academic performance required

name: Fee Reimbursement Scheme (Karnataka)
brief_description: Full or partial tuition fee coverage for professional courses for students in Karnataka.
benefits: Full/partial tuition fee coverage
eligibility: SC/ST/OBC/EWS studentsRs. Admission in recognized collegeRs. Income certificate required

name: Karnataka Labour Welfare Scholarship
brief_description: Financial assistance for children of registered labor workers in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹5Rs. – ₹20Rs. (varies by course)
eligibility: Children of registered labor workersRs. Parent must be registered workerRs. Academic performance required

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
brief_description: Merit-based support for Class 8 students in government schools.
benefits: ₹12Rs. per year
eligibility: Class 8 studentsRs. Government school studentsRs. Pass NMMS examRs. Income < ₹3.5 lakh

name: Deepika Student Scholarship Programme
brief_description: Financial support for girl students from government colleges for higher education in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹30Rs. per year for higher education
eligibility: Girls from government collegesRs. Must continue higher educationRs. Karnataka resident

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
brief_description: Monthly financial assistance to women head of the family in Karnataka to promote women empowerment.
benefits: ₹2Rs. per month to women head of the family
eligibility: Must be a woman head of householdRs. Resident of KarnatakaRs. Usually from BPL / lower-income familiesRs. Aadhaar-linked ration card

name: Gruha Jyoti Scheme
brief_description: Free electricity up to 200 units per month for domestic electricity connection holders in Karnataka.
benefits: Free electricity up to 200 units/month
eligibility: Karnataka residentRs. Domestic electricity connection holderRs. Consumption within average limit

name: Anna Bhagya Scheme
brief_description: Ensures food security by providing free food grains to BPL and Antyodaya ration card holders in Karnataka.
benefits: Free food grains (extra rice under PDS)
eligibility: BPL / Antyodaya ration card holdersRs. Registered in PDSRs. Aadhaar-linked ration card

name: Shakti Scheme
brief_description: Free bus travel for women residents of Karnataka in state-run buses (non-luxury).
benefits: Free bus travel in KSRTC buses for women
eligibility: Women residents of KarnatakaRs. Must show valid ID proofRs. Applicable in state-run buses

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
brief_description: Unemployment support for graduates and diploma holders in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹3Rs./month for graduatesRs. ₹1Rs./month for diploma holders
eligibility: Karnataka youth (graduates/diploma holders)Rs. UnemployedRs. Must register after education

name: Mathrushree Scheme
brief_description: Financial assistance to pregnant and lactating women in Karnataka to support maternal health.
benefits: ₹6Rs. financial assistance to pregnant women
eligibility: Pregnant/lactating womenRs. Karnataka residentsRs. Registration in health system required

name: Arogya Karnataka
brief_description: Healthcare scheme providing free or subsidized medical treatment for major surgeries and hospitalization to Karnataka residents.
benefits: Free or subsidized medical treatment
eligibility: All Karnataka residentsRs. Priority to BPL familiesRs. Aadhaar & health card required

name: Airavata Scheme
brief_description: Self-employment support for SC/ST youth in Karnataka through subsidies for vehicle purchase.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹5 lakh for vehicle purchase
eligibility: SC/ST youthRs. Age 21+Rs. Income < ₹5 lakh/yearRs. Must have driving license

name: Ganga Kalyana Scheme
brief_description: Agricultural support for small and marginal farmersRs. especially from SC/ST communitiesRs. through borewell drilling and irrigation support.
benefits: Borewell drilling + irrigation support
eligibility: Small & marginal farmersRs. SC/ST farmersRs. Must own agricultural land

name: Stand-Up India
brief_description: A scheme by Ministry of Finance for financing SC/ST and/or Women Entrepreneurs by facilitating bank loans for setting up a greenfield project enterprise in manufacturingRs. servicesRs. trading sector and activities allied to agriculture. The objective of this scheme is to facilitate bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. In case of non-individual enterprisesRs. at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either an SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur.
benefits:
1. Facilitation of composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital) between 10 Lakhs and 100 Lakhs. Rupay debit card to be issued for convenience of the borrower.
1. The web portal by SIDBI provides hand-holding support through a network of agencies engaged in trainingRs. skill developmentRs. mentoringRs. project report preparationRs. application fillingRs. work shed / utility support servicesRs. subsidy schemes etc.
eligibility:
- Finance is provided for Greenfield Enterprises.
- If the applicant is a maleRs. he must be from SC / ST category.
- The age of the applicant must be at least 18 years.
- The applicant must not be in default to any bank/financial institution.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
brief_description:
An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
**Premium:**
Rs.20/- per annum per member. The premium will be deducted from the account holders bank / Post office account through auto debit facility on or before 1st June of each annual coverage period under the scheme.
**Coverage Duration:**
Coverage under PMJJBY is valid for one year from 1st June to 31st May on payment of annual premium.
**Accident cover assurance termination:**
The accident cover of the member shall terminate / be restricted accordingly on any of the following events:
On attaining age 70 years (age nearer birth day).
Closure of account with the Bank or insufficiency of balance to keep the insurance in force.
In case a member is covered under PMSBY through more than one account and premium is received by insurance company inadvertentlyRs. insurance cover will be restricted to Rs. 2 lakh.
benefits:
1. On Death- the Nominee shall get Rs. 2 Lakhs.
1. Total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot- Subscriber shall get Rs. 2 Lakhs.
1. Total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot subscriber shall get Rs. 1 Lakh.
eligibility: Individual bank account holders of participating banks aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years (age nearer birthday) who give their consent to join / enable auto-debitRs. will be enrolled into the scheme.

name: Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists
brief_description:
The Scheme for Financial Assistance for Veteran ArtistsRs. earlier known as Scheme for Pension and Medical Aid to Artists was launched by the Ministry of Culture. The Scheme is meant for improving the financial and socio-economic status of the old artists and scholars who have contributed significantly in their specialized fields of artsRs. lettersRs. etc. in their active age or are still contributing in the field of artsRs. lettersRs. etc. but due to old ageRs. they have to lead a miserable life or are in penury condition.
Under the schemeRs. financial assistance from the Government may be given in the form of a monthly allowance. Such allowance given to the artists recommended under the center-state Quota will be shared by the Centre and State Government/UT Administration concerned.
**The following two types of cases/requests will be covered under the Scheme:**

1. Existing beneficiaries getting monthly artistes pension under the 1961 Scheme of Financial Assistance to Persons Distinguished in LettersRs. Arts and such other walks of life who may be in indigent circumstances as amended from time to time; and
1. Fresh cases of artistsRs. writersRs. etc. who are eligible for a grant/monthly financial assistance under the extant guidelines of the Scheme.

**Administration of the Scheme:**
The Scheme will be implemented by the Ministry with the support of all Zonal Cultural Centres and SCZCCRs. Nagpur will be the main coordinator. The Ministry reserves the right to modify the provisions of the Scheme at any time. In order to implement the Scheme in a better perspectiveRs. the Scheme Guidelines will be circulated widely through State Governments/UT Administrations along with sharing the data of beneficiaries of the Central Government with them.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a total allowance of 6000/- per month will be given to an eligible beneficiary.
1. In case of the death of a beneficiary getting an artist pensionRs. the financial assistance may be transferredRs. at the discretion of the Central GovernmentRs. in the name of the spouse of the beneficiary till life.

**Note 01:** The monthly allowance contributed by the State Government/UT Administration concerned shall be at least 500/- per month per beneficiary.
**Note 02:** The monthly allowance contributed by the Central Government shall not exceed 5500/- per month per beneficiary.
**Note 03:** Out of 6000/-Rs. the monthly contribution of allowance of the Central Government will be less than the extent of the monthly contribution of allowance being provided to the applicant by the State Government/UT Administration.
**Note 04:** If State Government is already providing 1000/- per month pension to an artiste recommended to get financial assistance from the Central Government under this SchemeRs. in that caseRs. the contribution of the Central Government would be only 5000/- per month.
**Note 05:** In respect of State Govt./UT Administration where there is no provision for an Artist's PensionRs. 6000/- per month will be paid as an Artist Pension by the Central Government.
**Note 06:** In case of the death of a beneficiaryRs. a request application should be received in the Ministry of Culture from the spouse along with the relevant documents within the period of one year from the date of death of the beneficiary artist. After the period of one yearRs. the claim for the transfer of pension in the name of the spouse will stand forfeited and no request in this regard shall be entertained.
eligibility:
1. To be eligible for assistance under the SchemeRs. a person's contribution to art and lettersRs. etc. must be of significance.
1. Traditional scholars who have made significant contributions in their fields would also be eligible notwithstanding the absence of any published works.
1. The personal income of the applicant (including the income of the spouse) must not exceed 4Rs./- per month or an annual income of 48Rs./-. [This excludes artiste pension assistance amount already getting by a beneficiary from the Government (i.e. concerned State Govt./UT Administration and/or Ministry of Culture)]
1. The applicant should not be less than 60 (sixty) years of age (This does not apply in the case of a spouse).
1. The applicant artiste is getting a pension of at least 500/- per month from the concerned State Government/UT Administration or is recommended by the Zonal Cultural CentresRs. Ministry of CultureRs. for the artists of their Members State where State Pension is not there.
1. The applicant artists should not be getting financial assistance under other Schemes of the Ministry viz. Repertory Grant etc.

name: Financial Assistance For The Marriage Of Daughters Of Poor Widows And Orphan Girls
brief_description:
The scheme of "Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Poor Widows and Orphan Girls" is the welfare scheme by the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi to provide financial assistance to poor widows for performing the marriage of their daughters (up to two daughters) and to provide financial assistance to the guardians including Homes/Institutions or foster parents of an orphan girl or an orphan girl for her marriage.
**Note:** This scheme was been transferred from the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Min. to Social Welfare Department from the financial year 2006-07.
benefits: The quantum of Assistance is one-time 30Rs./- up to two daughters only.
eligibility:
1. Financial assistance can be granted for performing marriage up to two daughters only.
1. Residence of a minimum of 5 years in Delhi before the date of application.
1. The income of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./-per year from all sources (including rentRs. interest/dividends on savings & investmentsRs. earnings from the farmRs. property sale proceedsRs. etc.) of the applicant.
1. Applicant should have an Aadhar number
1. The Applicant should have a single-operated Aadhaar-linked account with any bank in the NCT of Delhi only.
1. The applicant should not be in receipt of any assistance from the discretionary fund of the Lt. Governor or the Chief Minister of Delhi for the same purpose.
1. The girl whose marriage is to be solemnized should be major on the date of marriage i.e. above 18 years of age.
1. The application must be submitted within a period of sixty daysRs. before or after the date of the marriage being solemnized.

name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
brief_description: The scheme "Research Grant for In-Service Faculty Members" was introduced by the University Grants Commission (UGC)Rs. Department of Higher Education (DoHE). The objective of this research grant is to provide opportunities to regularly appointed faculty members of Universities/ Institutes/ Colleges (hereinafter Institutions) to pursue research in their area(s).
benefits:
**Tenure:** 2 years.
**Slots:** 200 or as may be decided by the Commission
***Financial Assistance:***

1. The quantum of support under the scheme is 10Rs..
1. The grant can be utilized for purchasing items like minor equipmentRs. consumablesRs. contingenciesRs. fieldworkRs. travelRs. etc.
1. The grant cannot be used for international travelRs. purchasing furniture itemsRs. or for appointing a project assistant or research fellow.
1. The quantum of funds under these heads can be decided by the recipient depending on his / her needs.
1. The items/equipment purchased from this grant shall be the property of the University.

***Release of Grants:***
The grant will be released in 3 installments to the university.

1. InitiallyRs. 50% of the grant will be released on receipt of the joining report ([Annexure-I](https://frg.ugc.ac.in/download/Guidelines-In%20service%20faculty.pdf)). 1. The next installment of 25% of the research grant shall be paid on submission of the utilization certificate ([_Annexure-II_](https://frg.ugc.ac.in/download/Guidelines-In%20service%20faculty.pdf)) of the first installment. 1. The final installment of 25% of the research grant shall be released on a reimbursement basis on submitting the claims and utilization certificate of the second installment.

HoweverRs. the tenure to utilize the whole grant shall be 2 years from the release of the first installment of the research grant.
eligibility:
(i) Faculty members regularly appointed and working in the following institutions are eligible to apply under the schemes:
(a) Universities (including constituent and affiliated colleges/institutions) are included under Section 2(f) of the UGC ActRs. 1956Rs. and have valid accreditation from NAAC.
(b) Deemed to be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 and having valid accreditation from NAAC.
(c) Institutions fully funded by Central or State Governments and empowered to award Degrees.
(d) Institutions of National Importance.
(ii) The age of the applicant should not be greater than 50 years. (Faculty above 50 years of age is not eligible to apply).
(iii) The applicant should have a minimum of 10 years of service left in the University from the date of submission of his / her application.
(iv) The applicant must have successfully supervised a Ph.D. dissertation of 5 full-time candidates
(v) The applicant must have successfully completed at least 2 sponsored research projects funded by national/international government or private agencies.

name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme For The Students Belonging To Scheduled Tribe For Studies In India
brief_description:
"Post Matric Scholarship Scheme For The Students Belonging To Scheduled Tribe For Studies In India" is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. for the students of Scheduled Tribe (ST) for studies in India. This scheme is for pursuing higher education starting from class XI to Post Graduation courses in India.
> **Objective of the scheme:**


- To enable eligible Scheduled Tribe students to undertake quality education from Post Matric to Post Graduate level by providing them financial assistance.
- To create an error free platform ensuring that the targeted beneficiaries receive scholarship on time.

Scholarship under the Scheme will be available to ST students for studies in India and will be directly transferred to the account of students.
> **Scope of the scheme:**

These scholarships are available for studies in India only and are awarded by the Government of the State/Union Territory Administration to which the applicant actually belongs i.e. were permanently settled.
benefits:
> **Stipend:** The student will be entitled to stipend as per rates listed below.

CoursesHostellersDay ScholarBachelorRs. Master DegreeRs. MPhil/PhD degree leading to DegreeRs. PG DiplomaRs. in professional courses in various streams Monthly: 1200 ; Annually: 12000Monthly: 500 ; Annually: 5500All non-professional recognized courses leading to a BachelorRs. Master DegreeRs. MPhil/PhD degree not covered under Group I in ArtsRs. Science and Commerce like BA/B.Sc/B.Com or MA/MSc/M.Com Monthly: 820 ; Annually: 8200Monthly: 530; Annually: 5300Vocational streamRs. ITI coursesRs. 3 year diploma courses in PolytechnicsRs. etc.Monthly: 570; Annually: 5700Monthly: 300; Annually: 3000All post-matriculation level non-degree courses for which entrance qualification is High School (Class X)Rs. e.g. senior secondary certificate (class XI and XII).Monthly: 380; Annually: 3800Monthly: 230; Annually: 2300
**Note 1:** It needs to be clarified that the stipend is a sort of incentive provided to a student for pursuing a particular course and in no way meant to provide for reimbursement of boarding and lodging charges like messRs. hostel or other similar charges. **Note 2:** Additional Disability Allowance: -In addition to stipend provided aboveRs. an additional Stipend of Rs. 800/-per month (Rs. 9600 annually) will be given to the Divyangjan student who is hosteller and Rs.600 (Rs 7200 annually) to Day scholar. The disability as defined under the relevant Disabilities Act has to be certified by competent medical authority of the State Govt./UT Administration. The provisions of Disability allowance will also apply to leprosy-cured and students having sickle cell Anemia or Thalassemia as notified by Ministry of Social Justice and empowerment **Note 3:** Under National fellowship & Scholarship for Higher Education of ST students Scheme [Top class Scholarship]Rs. MoTA is providing Scholarships to students for pursuing graduation and post-graduation courses in Top Class Institutes (currently 252) across India. To avoid duplicityRs. students pursuing courses in such Institutes will not be entitled for benefit under Post Matric Scholarship. Scholarship holder under this scheme can hold only one scholarship/stipend at a time. A centrally sponsored scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for students from scheduled tribes pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. > **Components of the Scheme:** The scholarship has two components: - Component 1: Payment of compulsory fees charged by educational institutions subject to the limit fixed by the concerned State. - Component 2: Payment of Maintenance amount varying from 230/- to 1200/- per monthRs. depending upon the course of study pursued by the student.
eligibility:
1. The scholarships are open to nationals of India. 1. These scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation post-secondary courses pursued in recognized institutions. 1. Only those candidates who belong to Scheduled Tribes so specified in relation to the State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (i.e. permanently settled) and who have passed the Matriculation or Higher Secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary EducationRs. will be eligible. 1. Students studying in Class XI of Higher Secondary Schools which have a continuous school course of 12th class will not be eligible. HoweverRs. in cases where the X class examination of such courses is treated as equivalent to Matriculation and students after passing the tenth class can join other coursesRs. such students will be treated as post-matric students and will be eligible for the award of scholarships. 1. Students pursuing post-graduate courses in medicine will be eligible if they are not allowed to practice during the period of their course. 1. Students who after failing or passing the undergraduate/post-graduate examinations in Arts/Science/Commerce join any recognized professional or technical certificate/diploma/degree courses will be awarded scholarships if otherwise eligible. No subsequent failure will be condoned except for courses in Group IRs. and no further change in the course will be allowed. 1. Students who pursue their studies through correspondence courses are also eligible. The term correspondence includes distant and continuing education. 1. Employed students who take leave without pay for the entire duration of the course and study as full-time students will be eligible for scholarships. 1. From the academic year 1980-81Rs. employed students whose income combined with the income of their parents/guardians does not exceed the maximum prescribed income ceiling are made eligible for post-matric scholarships to the extent of reimbursement of all compulsorily payable non-refundable fees. 1. All children of the same parents/guardians will be entitled to receive the benefits of the scheme. 1. A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend. 1. If awarded any other scholarship/stipendRs. the student can exercise his/her option for either of the two scholarships/stipendsRs. whichever is more beneficial to him/herRs. and should inform the awarding authority through the Head of the Institution about the option made. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this scheme from the date he/she accepts another scholarship/stipend. The student canRs. howeverRs. accept free lodging or a grant or Adhoc monetary help from the State Government or any other source for the purchase of booksRs. and equipment or for meeting the expenses on board and 1. lodging in addition to the scholarship amount paid under this scheme. > **Income Criteria:** Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents/guardians income from all sources does not exceed 2Rs./- per annum.
**NOTE 1:** So long as either of the parents (or husband in the case of a married unemployed girl student) is aliveRs. only the income of the parents/husbandRs. as the case may beRs. from all sources has to be taken into account and of no other member even though they may be earning. In the form of income declarationRs. income is to be declared on this basis. Only in the case where both the parents (or husband in the case of a married but unemployed girl student) have diedRs. the income of the guardian who is supporting the student in his/her studies is to be taken. Such students whose parental income is affected due to the unfortunate death of one of their earning parents and resultantly comes within the income ceiling prescribed under the scheme shall become eligible for the scholarshipRs. subject to their fulfilling other conditions of eligibilityRs. from the month in which such sad incidence takes place. Applications for scholarships from such students can be considered even after the lapse of the last date of receipt of applicationsRs. on compassionate grounds. **NOTE 2:** House rent allowance received by the parents of a student shall be exempted from the computation of income if the same has been permitted to be exempted for purpose of Income-tax. **NOTE 3:** Income certificate is required to be taken once only i.e. at the time of admission to courses that are continuing for more than one year. **NOTE 4:** The revised income ceilings account for Consumer Price Index for Industrial workers up to October 2009. The income Ceiling would be revised once every two years linking it with Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers for the month of October of the yearRs. preceding the year of revisionRs. and will be made effective from April.

name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
brief_description: The Ministry of External Affairs of the Govt. of India launched the first edition of its Internship Programme in 2022. The internship policy aims to take foreign policy closer to the people; bring in more focus on MEA; provide value to the interns; ensure better gender inclusivity and increase diversity in terms of qualificationsRs. domicileRs. and socio-economic status in the cohort of interns engaged by the MEA. During the course of the internshipRs. the Interns would be introduced to various aspects of the functioning of the MinistryRs. its attached officesRs. the public interface of the Ministry and its role in helping Indian citizensRs. as well as a possible visit one of the Missions abroadRs. subject to prevailing conditions.
eligibility:
1. The internship shall generally be open to Indian citizens with a minimum educational qualification of a graduate degree from a recognized university at the time of applying. 2. The internship shall also be open to student who is presently in the final year of their graduationRs. where an internship is a mandatory part of the final year curriculum. 3. The age of the candidate should not exceed 25 years as on 31 December of the year of internship.
**Note 1: Diversity:** In line with the goal of taking the Ministry and foreign policy closer to the people from all parts of the countryRs. the policy aims to ensure increased diversity amongst the group of interns with respect to genderRs. underprivileged sectionsRs. geographical domicileRs. and representation from both urban and rural areas.
**Note 2: Priority:** Candidates from districts under the Transformation of Aspirational Districts Programme (TADP) and those belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories shall be given priority at different stages in the selection process.

name: Skilled Youth Startup Scheme
brief_description:
The issue of employment creation has been a matter of great concern since long in Sikkim. The Government of Sikkim having pro-people attitude and the vision to reduce unemployment and create adequate self employment opportunities in the long run has formulated the Skilled Youth Start Up Scheme. The Scheme is intended to generate equitable entrepreneurial opportunities in rural as well as urban areas of the StateRs. particularly among the educated unemployed youth to become self employed by setting up Manufacturing/Service/Business/Cooperative/Agriculture & allied activities by availing loan (category wise) with back ended subsidy assistance from the State Government @ 50% for BPL and @ 35% for rest on financially viable/ bankable Projects cost.
> **Objectives****:** 1. To promote entrepreneurial qualities amongst the local unemployed youth and encourage them for setting up any commercially viable/ bankable business venture in any sector including Agriculture / Horticulture / Food Processing / Animal Husbandry / Handloom & Handicrafts / Retail / Tourism / Services / Manufacturing etc. in the State in tune with the State Government policies. 2. To generate equitable entrepreneurial opportunities in rural as well as urban areas of the State through the setting up of new self-employment ventures/projects by providing one-time non-refundable financial assistance of 50% / 35% with back-ended subsidy on project approval by the Bank/ PSU financial institution.
benefits:
1. Financial support through bank loans with back-ended subsidy of 35% or 50%. 1. Maximum admissible project cost varies by categoryRs. up to 20 lakhs. 1. Mandatory Entrepreneur Development Training (3 days) provided before loan disbursement. 1. Preference for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) with 50% subsidy eligibility. 1. Support for a wide range of sectors including: - DairyRs. poultryRs. piggeryRs. food processing. - Wood and bamboo crafts. - Homestays and tourism. - IT servicesRs. tailoringRs. coaching centers. - Automobile workshops and diagnostic centers.

Mountain cyclingRs. etc.10 lakhs7Rural Homestays 15 lakhs 8 IT & IT enabled services10 lakhs8IT & IT enabled services10 lakhs9Cutting and tailoring for Cooperative registered societies20 lakhs10Bakery & Restaurants **15 lakhs11Beauty Parlours/Boutique/Grocery/Manihari & other Retail shops 10 lakhs10 lakhs12Coaching Institute/Training Centre5 lakhs13Herbal Products Industry including Nurseries 10 lakhs10 lakhs14Paper bags/Paper plates 10 lakhs10 lakhs15Bamboo based Industry (Cane & Bamboo) 10 lakhs10 lakhs16Automobile Workshop Garage/Car spa 10 lakhs10 lakhs17Diagnostic Centres 20 lakhs20 lakhs18Film Industry/Film Auditorium (Minisize) excluding construction20 lakhs1919 Any Other Project which the Committee deems to be fit for funding Nominal funding
eligibility:
1. Applicant must possess a Certificate of Identification (COI) or Sikkim Subject Certificate / Residential Certificate (for urban areas).
1. Applicant must be unemployed and have completed at least Class V from a recognized school.
1. For technicalRs. manufacturingRs. or service-based projectsRs. the applicant should have a valid certificate from a recognized technical institute.
1. Applicant must be between 18 to 45 years of age at the time of application.
1. Only one member per family is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. Applicant&#39;s family income must not exceed 8 lakhs per annum.

name: Old Age Samman Allowance
brief_description: The scheme "Old Age Samman Allowance" is a social security scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme provides a pension of 3Rs./- per month to senior citizens (60 years or above) who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resources. The scheme targets the needy and poorer sections of societyRs. such as agricultural labourersRs. rural artisansRs. SCs/BCsRs. and small/marginal farmers. The scheme is implemented through the Zila Parishads. The pension is disbursed through the Panchayati Raj Institutions.
benefits: - Pension of 3Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be 60 years or above in age.
1. The applicant should be domiciled in and a resident of Haryana.
1. The income of the applicantRs. from all sourcesRs. including that of their spouseRs. should not exceed 3Rs./- per annum.

name: Udyogini Scheme
brief_description:
Started in the year 1997-1998 (and amended in the year 2004-2005)Rs. Udyogini is an innovative scheme sanctioned by the Government of Karnataka to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employmentRs. mainly through trade and the service sector. It also provides for a subsidy on loans from the Karnataka State Womens Development Corporations for undertaking business activities/ micro enterprises through banks and other financial institutions. Loans are disbursed through financial institutions like commercial banksRs. district cooperative banksRs. and Regional Rural Banks (RRBs).
In absence of a structured credit systemRs. women would take loans from private borrowers and end up paying a high rate of interest. HenceRs. there was felt a need to have in place formal channels of credit which are accessible to women. Profitable business activities are approved and supported under this scheme. They may be bookbinding and notebooks manufacturingRs. chalk and crayon manufactureRs. jamRs. jellyRs. pickles manufactureRs. papad manufactureRs. sareeRs. and embroidery workRs. printing and dyeing of clothesRs. and woolen weavingRs. amongst others. Udyogini gives adequate opportunities to such women to help them be self-employed.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The family income of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./- for women belonging to general and special categories. No limit on family income for widowed or disabled women. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 55 years for all categories. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka. 1. The applicant should not have defaulted on any past loan with any financial institution.
**Reservation / Preference / Priority** 1. Preference must be given to the extremely poorRs. destituteRs. widowRs. and physically challenged. 1. In additionRs. preference may be given to candidates who have undergone prior skill development training or vocational training conducted by any KSWDC or any other department. 1. About 10% of the allocated target has been earmarked to benefit applicants of members of World Bank-assisted Swashakthi or Stree Shakthi groups.

name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
brief_description:
Rajasthan Chief Ministers Relief Fund medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Ministers Relief Fund in Rajasthan. Dependents of untimely dead due to famineRs. floodsRs. excessive rainsRs. fires and accidental accidents help.
For treatment information - Assistance is accepted in recognized private hospitals from the major Government/ Chief Ministers Relief Fund of the state. 40% maximum amount of rs1.50 lakh in government hospitals and 30% maximum amount of Rs 90Rs. in recognized private hospitalsRs. whichever is lessRs. is accepted and sent to the concerned hospital.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be Non BPL
- The Annal Income of the Family should be greater than 2 LPA
- Not be listed in ABMGRSBY (Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana)

name: Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna
brief_description:
The Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "**Krishak Bakri Palan Yojna**" with the aim to increase income generation opportunities for economically weaker segments of the society as well as to increase meat production. Goat farming is a traditional occupation of economically weaker segments of the society (small and marginal farmersRs. mainly nomads and landless laborer's) in Himachal Pradesh. This species is considered to be major source of economic sustenance for these categories of people. Adaptability of goats to wide range of agro climatic conditions has rendered it suitable for poor farmers. Under this scheme it has been proposed to distribute units of 11 goats (10 females +1male)Rs. 5 goats (4 females +1 male) and 3 goats (2 females +1 male) of Beetal/Sirohi/Jamanapari/White Himalayan breeds on 60% subsidy.
**Objectives of this scheme:**

1. **Increase Income Generation:** The scheme aims to enhance income generation opportunities for economically weaker sections through goat farming. 1. **Boost Meat Production:** By providing high-quality goat breedsRs. the scheme aims to increase meat production in the state. 1. **Support Economically Disadvantaged Families:** The scheme offers a 60% subsidy on goat unitsRs. making it easier for financially weaker families to start goat farming. 1. **Promote Rural Development:** Encouraging goat farming contributes to the overall development of rural areas in Himachal Pradesh. 1. **Ensure Sustainable Livelihoods:** The scheme provides a sustainable livelihood to small farmers and landless laborersRs. reducing their economic vulnerability.
benefits: 1. **Financial Assistance:** Farmers receive goat units on a 60% subsidyRs. significantly reducing the initial investment required for goat farming.1. **Improved Livelihoods:** The scheme helps improve the livelihoods of small farmers by providing a steady source of income through goat farming.1. **Increased Meat Production:** By distributing high-quality goat breedsRs. the scheme boosts meat production in the stateRs. contributing to the local economy.1. **Sustainable Farming Practices:** The scheme promotes sustainable farming practicesRs. ensuring long-term economic benefits for farmers.1. **Empowerment of Marginalized Communities:** By targeting economically weaker sectionsRs. the scheme empowers marginalized communitiesRs. promoting social and economic inclusion.
eligibility:
1. Farmers belonging to all categories like general/SC/ST/BPL/Women and Landless persons of Himachal Pradesh are eligible.
1. Training/awareness in skills of goat husbandry is mandatory for all applicants. Concerned Senior Veterinary Officer will provide training to interested persons/applicants.
1. Training/awareness in skills of goat husbandry is mandatory for all applicants. Concerned Senior Veterinary Officer will provide training to interested persons/applicants.

**The preference will be given to:**

1. Unemployed SCRs. STRs. Women and General category persons. At least 30 percent beneficiaries should be women.
1. Families where no member is in Government job.
1. Persons with annual income not exceeding 2 lakh per annum.
1. Persons/farmers who have built their own goat sheds or built under MGNREGA.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana
brief_description:
**Details** Under the schemeRs. the government provides interest-free loans of up to Rs. 1 lakh to women entrepreneurs who wish to start a new business or expand their existing one. The loans are provided without any collateral securityRs. and the repayment period is up to five years. The scheme also provides training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to help them build their business acumen and enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship. The Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a great initiative to promote women's entrepreneurship and to empower them to become financially independent. over the scheme nameRs. launch dateRs. ministry/dept. nameRs. target beneficiaryRs. benefitsRs. etc.)
**Objectives:** The main objectives of the scheme are: 1. To promote women's entrepreneurship and provide them with financial assistance to start or expand their businesses. 1. To provide interest-free loans to women entrepreneurs to promote their business ventures. 1. To provide training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship. 1. To create employment opportunities for women in the state.
**Features of the Scheme:** 1. **Interest-Free Loans**: Under the schemeRs. women entrepreneurs can avail of interest-free loans of up to Rs. 1 lakh to start or expand their businesses. The loans are provided without any collateral security. 1. **Repayment Period**: The repayment period for the loan is up to 5 years. 1. **Training and Skill Development**: The scheme provides training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to help them build their business acumen and enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship.
- **Subsidy:** The government also provides a subsidy of 6% per annum to women entrepreneurs who repay their loans on time. - **No Processing Fee:** The scheme does not charge any processing fee for the loan application. - **No Income Limit:** There is no income limit for women entrepreneurs to apply for the scheme.
eligibility:

brief_description: The Haryana government has prepared a scheme to provide scholarship to the meritorious students of Scheduled CastesRs. Backward ClassesRs. NomadicRs. DNTsRs. Semi-NomadicRs. name: Aponar Apon Ghar
brief_description: "Aponar Apon Ghar" is a Home Loan Subsidy Scheme by the Finance DepartmentRs. Govt. of Assam. name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
brief_description: The scheme "Kanyashree Prakalpa" by the Department of Women Development and Social Welfare and Child Development (DWD)Rs. Government of West BengalRs. aims to improve the status and well-being of girlsRs. specifically those from socio-economically disadvantaged families. Through this schemeRs. Conditional Cash Transfers are provided to incentivise girls to continue their education for a longer period and disincentivise early marriage. > **Objectives:** 1. Incentivising girls to continue in education for a longer period of timeRs. and complete secondaryRs. higher secondaryRs. higher educationRs. or equivalent in technicalRs. vocationalRs. or sports streamsRs. thereby giving them a better footing in both the economic and social spheres. 1. Disincentivising marriage until at least the age of 18Rs. the legal age of marriageRs. thereby reducing the risks of early pregnanciesRs. associated risks of maternal and child mortalityRs. and other debilitating health conditionsRs. including those of malnutrition. 1. It was also decided that the Scheme should confer more than just monetary support; it should be a means of financial inclusion and a tool of empowerment for adolescent girls. The schemes' benefits are therefore paid directly to bank accounts in the girls' namesRs. leaving the decision of utilisation of the money in their hands. 1. To reinforce the positive impact of increased education and delayed marriagesRs. the scheme also works to enhance the social power and self-esteem of girls through a targeted behaviour change communication strategy. The communication strategy not only builds awareness of the schemeRs. but includes adolescent-friendly approaches like eventsRs. competitions and Kanyashree clubsRs. and the endorsement of strong women figures as role models to promote social and psychological empowerment.
benefits: Kanyashree Prakalpa offers two types of benefits: 1. **Annual Scholarship (K1):** A cash benefit of 1Rs./- is paid annually to the girls in the age group 13 to 18 years (studying in Class VIII equivalent or above for every year that they remain in educationRs. provided they are unmarried at the time.1. **One-Time Grant (K2):** A grant of 25Rs./- is paid after a girl turns 18Rs. provided that she was engaged in an academic or occupational pursuit and was unmarried.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal. 1. The applicant should be enrolled and regularly attending an educational institution. 1. The applicant should be unmarried. 1. The applicant should be from a family where the total income is not more than 1Rs./- per year. 1. The applicant for the Annual Scholarship (K1) should be between the ages of 13 and 18 years. 1. The applicant for the One-Time Grant (K2) should be between the ages of 18 and 19 years. 1. The applicant should have a bank account opened in their own nameRs. and the name on the application form must match the name on the bank account. 1. The educational institution that the applicant is studying in must be registered in West Bengal and recognized by the government.
> **Educational Institution Type Eligibility:****** The applicant will be eligible for Kanyashree's Annual Scholarship or the One-Time Grant if they are studying in any of the following: - In Class VIII or above in a schoolRs. madrassahRs. or equivalent open school course. - In a college or an equivalent open university course. - A Vocational Training CentreRs. Technical Training CentreRs. or Industrial Training Centre. - Girls enrolled in Sports Institutes may apply for the One-Time Grant; howeverRs. they cannot apply for the Annual Scholarship. > **Relaxations:** Girls who are specially-abled (with a disability of 40% or more)Rs. or are living in a Home registered under the Juvenile Justice ActRs. 2000Rs. or have lost both parentsRs. may apply for Kanyashree even if their family's income is more than 1Rs./- per year.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: The scheme Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) was started by the Department of Women & Child WelfareRs. Govt. of Sikkim in 2014. Under this schemeRs. a pension is provided to elderly citizens above the age of 60 years belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category and the beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of 1500/-Rs. 2000/- & 2500/- as per eligibility criteria.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of the state of Sikkim.
- The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years and above.
- The applicant should not have any source of income.
- The applicant should not be a recipient of salary/pension/family pension from Central Government / other State Governments.

**Note 01:** In case both the husband & wife are old age persons and are eligible for Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)Rs. only one member of the family shall be awarded the pension. In case of death of the pensionerRs. such pension shall be transferred to his/her spouseRs. if alive on surrender of the passbookRs. provided he/she has attained the age of 60 (sixty) years of age or more.
**Note 02:** Each beneficiary of the Pensions should submit "Life Certificate" in the prescribed format in the month of November every year failing which it will be presumed that the beneficiary is either died or migrated outside the State of Sikkim and the payment of pension shall be stopped forthwith without further notice.

name: Homes For Intellectually Impaired Persons

name: Post-Matric Scholarship To VJNT Students - Maharashtra
brief_description:
The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme namely Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT students vide G.R. No. EBC 1068/83567/57 dated 24.12.1970 in 1970. This scheme was started by the Government to encourage the student of the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) to undergo Post-Matric higher education.
Objective:
1. To encourage the VJNT students to undergo Post-Matric Courses.
2. Providing financial assistance for education.
3. Creating a passion for higher education.
4. Providing students the opportunity to go to the mainstream of education through education.
Under this schemeRs. benefits of Tuition FeesRs. Exam FeesRs. and Maintenance Allowance are paid to only VJNT category students. All the eligible VJNT students are paid maintenance allowance from 90 to 190 per month for hostellers and 150 to 425 per month for day scholar students.
eligibility:

1. Applicants should belong to the VJNT category.
1. Applicants must be residents of Maharashtra.

1. Maintenance allowance & exam fees are paid to the applicant if the applicant gets promoted to the next higher class.
1. If the applicant fails in a particular year then he will get the Tuition FeesRs. Exam FeesRs. and Maintenance allowance of that particular academic year but he/she will not get the benefit until he/she gets promoted to the next higher class.
1. Applicant should come through CAP round for only professional courses.
1. Only two children (i) any number of girl applicants allowed. ii) Boys applicant maximum 2 of the same parent) of the same parents will be eligible for the Scholarship.
1. 75 % attendance is mandatory for the current year.

1. Scholarships/freeship will continue until the applicant completes one course. Ex. - 11thRs. 12th Arts - B.A.Rs. M.A.Rs. M.Phil.Rs. P.H.D. IfRs. the applicant completed B.A and B.Ed. course and later after taking admission for M.A.Rs. for M.A. course he/she will not be allowed for scholarship/freeship. But after admission to M.B.A. after B.EdRs. it can be eligible for scholarship/freeship as it is a professional postgraduate course.
1. Applicant studying in particular professional/Non-Professional course and availing benefits of scholarship/freeship for that academic course and if he/she wants to change his existing Professional / Non-Professional course in between academic years he/she will not be eligible for freeship/scholarship for further course.

##### **Renewal Policy:**

- Applicants have to pass the previous year's examination.
- In the case of VJNTRs. if the applicant fails for a year then the applicant is not paid any reimbursement for that particular year.
- For Group A If an applicant pursuing the Group-A course fails in the examination for the 1st time the award may be renewed. For second & sub sequent failure in any classRs. the Applicant shall bear his / her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class.
- For Group BRs.CRs.DRs.E - he/she has to secure promotion to a higher class (For second & subsequent failure in any class the applicant shall bear his / her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class.)
- If due to any medical condition or due to any unforeseeable event the Applicant cannot appear in the annual examinationRs. the headmaster of the college can approve or certify that if the Applicant would have appeared in the annual examinationRs. he would have been able to pass the examination. This will be only allowed if the head of the institution is satisfied by the submission of medical proof or any other required sufficient proof that the Applicant presents to the college.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogayog Yojana-Special
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogayog Yojana-Special" by the Directorate of Information TechnologyRs. Government of TripuraRs. aims to digitally empower students and help them leverage the advantages of an interconnected world.
