"Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective is to award scholarships to school-going children of poorer OBC parents whose annual income is below double the poverty line.
> **Duration of Scholarship** The scholarships may be given to the students enrolled in class 1st or any subsequent class of the pre-matric stage in the case of day scholarsRs. and class 3rd or any subsequent class of the pre-matric stage in the case of hostlers. The scholarship will terminate at the end of class 10th. The duration of the scholarship in an academic year will be 10 months.
benefits:
> **Scholarship** 1. Hostellers: Class 3rd to 10th: 500/- per month for 10 months. 1. Day Scholars: Class 1st to 10th: 100/- per month for 10 months. > **Ad-Hoc Grant** 1. An ad-hoc grant of 500/- per student per annum to all students i.e. hostlers as well as day scholars will also be given.
The scholarship amount will be payable from the date of joining to the date of leaving the schoolRs. excluding the period of vacationRs. which will be about 10 months in a year except in the cases where the students enter late or leave early in the midst of academic year.
eligibility:
1. The scholarship award will be sanctioned in the case of students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. 1. The scholarship will be tenable only in such institutions and for such pre-matriculation coursesRs. which have been duly recognized by the concerned State Government and Union Territory Administrations. 1. Regular attendance records of not less than 60% in the previous year should be a pre-requisite for availing scholarship. 1. The scholar obtaining benefits under this scheme shall not be allowed to avail of benefits under any other pre-matric scholarship scheme.
**Reservation/ Relaxation/ Preference/ Priority** 1. 30% of the beneficiaries should be reserved for girl students. 1. At least 5% of students with disabilities should be covered by grants or scholarships.

name: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
brief_description:
Department of Science and Technology (DST) in association with the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) launched a Fellowship in the year 2017Rs. named Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship to recognizeRs. encourageRs. supportRs. and promote translational research in engineering by Indian Nationals working in public funded institutions in the countryRs. so as to transfer fundamental research output in viable technological products/devices/components/processes. In briefRs. the principal objective of the Fellowship is to achieve excellence in engineeringRs. innovationRs. and technology development. This fellowship scheme has been named after the late Dr. A. P. J. Abdul KalamRs. the former President of IndiaRs. who was a role model in Indian technology development and self-reliance. The scheme is being administered by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) and implemented by the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE).
> **Scope:**

All areas of engineeringRs. innovationRs. and technology are covered by this fellowship.
> **Duration:**


- The duration of the fellowship will be initially three yearsRs. extendable by up to two more years depending on the performance.
- The fellowship can be held for a maximum of 5 years.

> **Expected Outcome:**

This Fellowship is applicable for Translational Research Only leading to possible commercialized or deployable technology; pilot scale or field trial worthy technology; patent (filed/sold/commercialized); working model or prototype for demonstration and trial (in addition but not limited only to scientific publication).
> **Fellowship:**

A Maximum of 10 Fellowships will be awarded per year.
benefits:
1. The fellowship amount is 25Rs./- per month in addition to regular income.
1. A Research grant of 15.00 lakh per annum.
1. An Overhead of 1.00 lakh per annum to the host institute.

**Note:** The fellowship is taxable as per the IT rule of the Government of India.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is applicable to Indian nationals working in India in various capacities of engineering profession in publicly funded institutions.
1. The scheme is also applicable to Overseas Citizens of India working in permanent positions in publicly funded Institutions in India.
1. The applicant should possess adequate professional qualifications and hold at least a bachelors degree with a proven outstanding track record in innovation or technology development.
1. This applicant should have a minimum of five (5) years of service left in the parent organization as of the date of the award.
1. The applicant should not be holding any other fellowship and in the event of selectionRs. he/she will have to opt for only one of the fellowships.

name: Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme is a scheme by the Department of Information TechnologyRs. Electronics and CommunicationsRs. Government of GoaRs. for the Startups of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to identify technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa who are keen to further their expertise. The selected educators/fellows would be sent to Centres of Excellence within the country and abroad to undertake summer school and short term training programs to further their learning in their area of specialization.
benefits:
- A technology fellowship program will run to identify technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa who are keen to further their expertise in the following areas: Internet of ThingsRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. Machine LearningRs. Interaction DesignRs. Big Data AnalyticsRs. RoboticsRs. 3-D PrintingRs. Data ScienceRs. DronesRs. Virtual Reality/Augmented Reality/Merged RealityRs. Others (subject to approval from SPC).
- The selected educators/fellows would be sent to Centres of Excellence within the country and abroad to undertake **summer school and short-term training programs** to further their learning in their area of specialization.- The Department of IT will set up **Centres of Excellence/Advanced Maker Labs** in the technologies outlined aboveRs. in select technical educational institutes. Such selected educators/fellows will function as Master Trainers/Principal Mentors to students and student start-ups that would be incubated in such facilities.- The educators/fellowsRs. upon selectionRs. would receive an **educational grant of 10Rs. per year**Rs. for a period of five years.- The benefit of this scheme can be availed by up to ten educators/fellows per yearRs. with one person in each focus areaRs. who will be selected by the SPC as per its guidelines.
- In case such educators/fellows generate and get any business and value-driven patents registered in their area of specializationRs. either through individual research or in collaboration with studentsRs. such fellows shall be eligible to receive a **patent-specific grant of up to 15Rs.**Rs. subject to certification by the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC).
**NOTE:** Under no circumstance shall the benefits under this scheme be considered an entitlement. The SPC shall reserve the sole right to accept or reject applications.
eligibility: The applicant should be a technology educator in a technical educational institute in Goa.

name: Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of Singel Net/ Small Rampon Net and its accessories.
benefits: Subsidy to the extent of **50% of the actual cost limited to 50Rs./-** for the purchase of Singel Net/ Small Rampon Net and its accessoriesRs. after every five years.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The Fishermen should belong to the OBC (Kharvi) Community.
- The grandfather/grandmother of the fishermen should be resident(s) of Goa.
- The fishermen shall not possess registered fishing canoes or fishing trawlers.
- Only one household family member can avail of the benefit under this scheme.

name: Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students
brief_description: The scheme Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students was implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme is implemented as a sort of encouragement for the Scheduled Caste students who secure 65% or above marks in matriculation/SSLC Board of Examinations. The incentive is given with a view to enable the Scheduled Caste students who intend to pursue their Post-metric studiesRs. to meet the initial expenditure at the time of admission.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. a one-time cash award of 1Rs./- will be given to the Scheduled Caste students who secure 65% or above marks in matriculation/SSLC Board of Examinations.
eligibility:
1. All the students belonging to the Scheduled Caste who secured 65% and above marks in the 10th Standard/Matriculation/SSLC Board of Examination shall be eligible for the award.
1. The student should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence in the Union Territory of Puducherry for not less than five years.
1. The student should pursue his/her higher studies in a recognized university/college/institution.
1. The grant will be given irrespective of the income limit of the parent/guardian of the students and the age of the students.

name: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students
brief_description:
The scheme Grant of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students was implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. Under the schemeRs. the scholarship is provided to the girl students who belong to the Scheduled Caste Community and studying in I Standard to V Standard in both Government and Government recognized private educational institutions in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste Girls Students to pursue their studies in Primary Education. Because of this assistanceRs. the parents of those students may not lose any income that they would otherwise get by sending their girls to work.
benefits:
The scholarship shall be granted for 10 months in an academic year at the following rates:

1. Under this schemeRs. 1Rs./- per year to girl students studying from I to V Standard i.e. (100/- per month per girl student for 10 months in an academic year).

**Note 01:** The benefit of this scheme will be available only to bonafide students so long as they continue their studies satisfactorily in the recognized institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
**Note 02:** A student shall be deemed to be continuing her studies satisfactorily if she secures promotion to the next higher class annually.
eligibility:
1. All the Scheduled Caste Girls Students of the Union Territory of Puducherry are eligible for the scholarship.
1. The concession envisaged under the scheme will be granted to Scheduled Caste Girls Students who are native of the Union Territory of Puducherry or are residing in the Union Territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of not less than five years.
1. The concession will be granted to the Scheduled Caste Girls Students studying from I Standard to V Standard either in Government or private recognized educational institutions.
1. Annual income of the parent guardian shall not exceed 24000/-.

> **Other conditions for the scholarship:**


1. Students who are granted the scholarships will be allowed to retain them till they complete that primary education.
1. The scholarship will be cancelled for any misconduct on the part of the scholar.
1. If a candidate is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statementRs. her scholarship will be cancelled and the amount of scholarship paid will be recovered at the discretion of the Sanctioning Authority.

name: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe
brief_description: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. This Scheme has been introduced to grant financial assistance in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of an outboard motor of 2HP to 5 HP for the operation of the fishing canoe below 26 feet. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **For General Category**

50% subsidyRs. limited to 30Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

60% subsidyRs. limited to 36Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
**NOTE 1:** The financial assistance is provided for only 01 Outboard Motor for fitting to the fishing canoe of below 26 feet.
**NOTE 2:** The beneficiary can avail of the scheme every 5 years.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The applicant's Fishing Canoe should be registered with the Department of Captain of PortsRs. Government of Goa.

name: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa
brief_description: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme has been introduced to uplift the sizeable community of traditional FishermenRs. by providing them financial help in the form of a subsidy on the construction/ purchase of Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for fishing in inland waters of Goa. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **For General Category**

50% subsidyRs. limited to 30Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

60% subsidyRs. limited to 36Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
**NOTE:** The benefits can be availed after every 7 years against the replacement of the existing Canoe.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The Fishing Canoe should be registered with the Department of Captain of PortsRs. Government of Goa.

name: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
brief_description: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Under this schemeRs. Financial Assistance is provided to the fish vendors for the purchase of CratesRs. Weighing BalanceRs. Insulated BoxRs. GlovesRs. StoolsRs. Platforms to keep Fish/ Shed/ UmbrellaRs. ChoppersRs. and Other Equipment related to Fish VendorRs. so that the fish can be reached to the people in hygienic conditions. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **For General Category**

50% subsidyRs. limited to 10Rs. on a unit cost of 20Rs..
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

60% subsidyRs. limited to 12Rs. on a unit cost of 20Rs..
**NOTE:** The beneficiary can avail of the scheme once every three years.
eligibility: The applicant should be a Fish Vendor registered with the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories
brief_description: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Stake net is a traditional method of catching fish practiced by the fishermen residing near the bank of the river. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of stake nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **For General Category**

Subsidy of 50%Rs. limited to 30Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

Subsidy of 60%Rs. limited to 36Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
**NOTE:** The beneficiary can avail of the scheme every 3 years.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The applicant should have purchased a Stake Net and its Accessories.

name: Supply of Insulated Boxes
brief_description: Supply of Insulated Boxes is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost for the purchase of an insulated box of at least 50 liters capacity. The applications are accepted only in offline mode. Only the fisherman engaged in selling and marketing fishRs. fishing at sea with a canoeRs. and fishing at sea with a mechanized fishing vessel with up to 6-cylinder engines are eligible to apply to this scheme.
benefits:
> **For the Beneficiary Engaged in Selling/Marketing Fish**

One insulated box of 50 liters capacity will be entitled to a subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost limited to 1Rs./-.
> **For the Beneficiary Engaged in Fishing at Sea With a Canoe**

One insulated box of 100 liters and one box of 220 liters capacity and subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost limited to 7Rs./- respectively.
> **For the Beneficiary Engaged in Fishing at Sea With a Mechanized Fishing Vessel Upto 6 Cylinder Engine**

One insulated box of 220 liters and one insulated box of 400 liters capacity and subsidy to the extent of 75% of the cost limited to 15Rs./- respectively.
eligibility:
The applicant should be one of the following -

- A fisherman engaged in selling and marketing fish.
- A fisherman engaged in fishing at sea with a canoe.
- A fisherman engaged in fishing at sea with a mechanized fishing vessel with up to 6-cylinder engines.

name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen
brief_description: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance amounting to 50% is provided by the Government to eligible fishermen for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
- The support is extended up to 1Rs./- per lifejacket and 1Rs./- per lifebuoy.
- For Canoe Fitted With OBM: 05 Life Jackets and 01 Lifebuoy.
- For Mechanised Trawlers Engaged in Trawling Operations: 08 Life Jackets and 02 Lifebuoys.
- For Mechanised Trawlers Engaged in Purse Seining Operation: 25 Life Jackets and 04 Lifebuoys.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The applicant should possess one of the following: a Canoe Fitted With OBM; Mechanised Trawlers Engaged in Trawling or Purse Seining Operations.

name: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana
brief_description:
The BM-SSY is a significant step towards providing social security to the unorganised workers of West Bengal. The scheme has the potential to improve the lives of millions of workers and their families. The scheme covers all unorganized workersRs. including construction workersRs. transport workersRs. and self-employed workers. All wage earners that also includes self-employed person mentioned under Part A and Part B of the Schedule for the West Bengal Unorganized Sector Workers Welfare ActRs. 2007Rs.
Forty-six (46) unorganized industries as mentioned under Part A of the Schedule: 1. Automobile Repairing Garages (having less than 20 workers). 1. Bakery (having less than 20 workers) 1. Beedi Making 1. Boatman Service 1. Bone Mill 1. Book Binding. 1. Brassware 1. Cashew Processing 1. Ceramic 1. Cinema 1. Clinical Nursing Homes / Private Hospitals. 1. Coir Industry 1. Copy writing work in Court / Registration Office. . 1. Cottage / Village based Cottage Industry (Boatman serv.IceRs. Bangle MakingRs. Fire workRs. Chakki MillsRs. Kite & Kite sticks ManufacturingRs. Earthen pottery WorkRs. Paddy HuskingRs. Embroidery & Zari Chicon Works). 1. Dal Mill. 1. Decoration. 1. Foot Wear (LeatherRs. RubberRs. Plastic) 1. Forestry & Timber Operation 1. Garments Making 1. Hand-loom 1. Hosiery. 1. Hotel & Restaurant 1. LC.D.S.Rs. I.P.P.-VlII & C.U.D.P.-IlI. 1. Iron Foundry 1. Khadi 1. Lac Industry (having less than 20 workers) 1. Leather & Leather goods. 1. Linesman engaged in supply of Bakery Products. 1. Medical Plants other than Cinchona 1. Oil Mill. 1. Paper Board & Straw Board Manufacturing. 1. Plastic Industry. 1. Power Loom 1. Printing Press. 1. Rice Mill including Husking Mills 1. Rubber & Rubber Products 1. Saw Mill 1. Security Agencies. 1. Sericulture 1. Shops (having less than 20 workers) & Establishments (having less than 20 1. workers) 1. Silk Printing. 1. Slaughter House 1. Small Scale Engineering Units. 1. Small Scale Chemical Units 1. Tailoring Industries (having less than 20 workers). 1. Type Copying Work
Fifteen (15) self-employed person under occupation mentioned under Part B of the said Schedule: 1. Amins (Land Surveyors) 1. Ayah / Attendant engaged in Hospitals/Nursing Homes by the patients. 1. Barbers / Beauticians. 1. Carpenter. 1. Cobbler / Shoe Maker. 1. Cycle Rickshaw & Van Puller / Paddler 1. Domestic Servants. 1. Fishermen. 1. Gold Smithery & Silver Smithery. 1. Head-load Workers and Workers engaged in Loading & Unloading. 1. Idol Makers. 1. Railway Hawkers. 1. Street Hawkers including News Paper Hawker. 1. Waste Pickers 1. Workers of NGOs & person engaged in West Bengal Welfare Scheme run by the Government including Self-Employed Labor Organisers ( SLOs)
benefits:
1. **Provident Fund:** The State Government will pay 55/- ( 25/- + 30/-) including the beneficiary and State Grant) per month. On retirement or deathRs. the total amount along with interest is refunded.1. **Health And Family Welfare:**

- **Medical Expenses**



1. Beneficiaries and their family members receive financial assistance for hospitalization and outdoor treatment of ailments covered under WBHS 2008.
1. The maximum annual assistance is 20Rs./-.
1. Benefits include full coverage for clinical testsRs. medicineRs. and hospitalization.
1. In case of hospitalizationRs. the beneficiary receives compensation for loss of employment.



- **Surgical Expenses**



1. Beneficiaries and their family members receive financial assistance for any kind of surgery.
1. The maximum annual assistance is 60Rs./-.
1. Benefits include full coverage for clinical testsRs. medicineRs. and hospitalization.
1. In case of hospitalizationRs. the beneficiary receives compensation for loss of employment.



- **Additional Provisions**



1. For accidents requiring hospitalization for five or more daysRs. the beneficiary receives compensation for loss of employment.
1. Claims for medical expensesRs. surgical expensesRs. and accident-related loss of employment are admissible at government or empaneled hospitals.
1. Payment for loss of employment is applicable only to the registered beneficiaryRs. not to family members.
1. A financial year is considered a year for availing benefits.


1. **Death and Disability:** To provide social security to the nominees of the beneficiaries under the YojanaRs. the following benefit would be provided:-

- In cases of death of the beneficiary arising out of an accident : 2Rs./- only
- In cases of normal death of the beneficiary : 50Rs./- only : 50Rs./-
- In cases of minimum 40% disability of the beneficiary. The disability should be certified by a Government Hospital.
- In cases of total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot : 2Rs./-
- In cases of total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot : 1Rs./-


1. **Education**: Assistance for education will be provided in the following category as per scale given below:


- Class XI - 4Rs./- pa
- Class XII - 5Rs./- pa
- Under training at ITI - 6Rs./- pa
- UG (Arts/Science/Commerce) - 6Rs./- pa
- PG (Arts/Science/Commerce) - 10Rs./- pa
- Polytechnic - 10Rs./- pa
- Medical / Engineering - 30Rs./- pa
- Assistance for completion of UG education or equivalent Skill Development Studies @ 25000/- each for up to two daughters will be provided. This benefit will however be admissible if the daughter remains unmarried till completion of studies
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
1. Applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. Applicant family income should not exceed 6Rs. 500/- per month except construction & transport workers. For construction & transport workers family income has no upper limit.
1. The period for calculation of average family income will be 12 months prior to the month in which application is made.

name: Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana
brief_description:
Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana" for Construction Workers on 12 May 2022. Upon reaching 60 years of ageRs. construction workers&#39; membership automatically terminates. Construction workers who are about to retire from Board membership under the aforementioned provision will be provided with financial assistance to enhance their quality of life prior to retirement.
<br>
benefits: A lump sum assistance amount of 20Rs./- will be given to the eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Board as a construction worker for at least the last 03 years.
1. Workers must be between the ages of 59 and 60.

name: Green Business Scheme
brief_description:
The Green Business Scheme has been launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for activities that can tackle the impacts of climate change and also be income-generating. The income-generating activities that could mitigate the Green House effect or could be classified under adaptation initiativesRs. would be covered under the scheme.
> **Indicative schemes**

> Battery electric vehicle(E-rickshaw)Rs. Compressed air vehicleRs. Solar energy gadgetsRs. Poly houses.

> **Quantum of loan**

> 90% of the Unit cost with a maximum of Rs. 2 lac. Quantum of loan shallRs. howeverRs. be reduced to the extent of the amount of subsidy availableRs. if any.

> **Promoters contribution**

> 10% of the unit cost
benefits:
**Quantum of Assistance** National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) would provide need-based loans under the scheme as permissible under the NSFDC Term Loan Lending PolicyRs. promoter contributionRs. and after taking into consideration the margin money being provided by Special Central Assistance (SCA)Rs. subsidies provided by other government agenciesRs. and subsidies provided to below poverty line (BPL) beneficiaries under the Central-Sector Scheme of Special Central Assistance to the Special Component PlanRs. to the extent of 10Rs./- or 50% of the unit costRs. whichever is less. **Interest Rates** SchemeUnit CostMaximum Loan Limit up to 90% of unit CostInterest per AnnumInterest per AnnumSCA/CABeneficiaryGreen Business Scheme (GBS)Up to Rs. 7.50 LakhRs. 6.75 lakh2%4%Above Rs. 7.50 lakh & up to Rs. 15.00 lakhRs. 13.50 lakh3%6%Above Rs. 15.00 lakh & up to Rs. 30.00 lakhRs. 27.00 lakh4%7%*(1% Rebate from NSKFDC share of interest in case of Female Beneficiaries.)
> **Repayment** > The loan under the scheme shall be repaid in quarterly installmentsRs. within a maximum period of 10 years including moratorium period of 06 months. In additionRs. 120 days moratorium period is allowed to SCA for fund utilization.
eligibility: Safai KaramcharisRs. ScavengersRs. and their Dependents are eligible for the scheme.

name: Widow Pension-West Bengal
brief_description: In 2010Rs. the West Bengal state governmentRs. through the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare DepartmentRs. launched a compassionate initiative called the "Widow Pension" scheme. This program aims to provide financial support to widows facing economic hardship within the state.
benefits: - Financials assistance of 1Rs./- per Month through DBT mode to the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be widow girl/woman.
1. The beneficiary should attain the age of 60 years or more.
1. The beneficiary must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Bengal.
1. The beneficiary family income must not exceed 1Rs./- per month.
1. The beneficiary must not be maintained by any of her relative.
1. The beneficiary must have been a resident of West Bengal for at least ten years on the date of making the application.
1. Professional beggars and mendicants are not eligible for the pension.

name: Mukhya mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana
brief_description:
The Mukhya Mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana. the Department of MicroRs. Small & Medium EnterprisesRs. Madhya Pradesh government gives loans up to 50Rs. to 10Rs. for financial assistance to the sons and daughters of farmers to establish their businesses. economically weak farmers will be able to become self-reliant by setting up their businesses and their weak economic condition will not become a hindrance to their progress.
Under thisRs. 15% of the capital cost will be provided to the general categoryRs. and 20% of the capital cost will be provided to the BPL(Below Poverty Line) category. So that the citizens of the state will be inspired to establish their businesses. Through this schemeRs. the unemployment rate in the state will decline.
benefits:
> **For projects worth Rs 10 lakh or more:-** - For general class 15% (maximum 12Rs.) - For BPL category 20% (maximum 18Rs. 00Rs. 000) - For women entrepreneursRs. a 6% and male 5% interest subsidy - the guarantee fee will be payable at the prevailing rate for a maximum of 7 years.
> **For projects less than Rs 10 lakh:-** - 15% of the project cost (maximum 1Rs. ) for the general category. - BPL/ scheduled caste / scheduled 30% of the project cost (maximum 2Rs.) for Tribes / Other Backward Classes (except creamy layer) / Women / Minorities / Disabled.
> **Additional provisions-** - 30% of the project cost (maximum 3Rs.) to the liberated nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes. - Bhopal Gas victim family members are eligible for an additional 20% (maximum 1Rs.) on the project cost. - At the rate of 5% per annum of the capital cost for projects of 10Rs. or more and at the rate of 6 % per annum for women entrepreneursRs. for a maximum of 7 years. (Maximum 5Rs. per annum) - For projects less than 10Rs. 5% of the project cost per annum rate and 6% for women entrepreneurs At the rate of per annumRs. for a maximum of 7 years. (Maximum 25Rs. per annum)
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 45 years. - Educational qualification should be a minimum of 10th class. - The parents of the beneficiary should not have their agricultural land. - The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.

name: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
brief_description: The Amma two-wheeler working women scheme Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment provides a scheme to empower working women by enabling them to purchase women-friendly two-wheelers and to ease their commute to their enterprisesRs. places of employmentRs. and engagements with banks and community-based institutions. Ease of use is a key consideration and therefore the vehicle is gearless/auto-geared. The Differently Abled Mayavaill o retro-fitted three-wheeler scooters. Each year one lakh working women will benefit through this scheme.
benefits:
**The reservation under the Amma two-wheeler scheme is as follows:** - 21% of the scheme's allocation is reserved for women belonging to Scheduled Castes. - 1% of the schemes allocation is reserved for women belonging to Scheduled Tribes. - 4% of the schemes allocation is reserved for differently abled women (across all categories).
> **Subsidy:** A beneficiary under this scheme will be provided with a maximum subsidy of 50% of the cost of the vehicle or 25Rs./- whichever is lessRs. to purchase a brand new motorized gearless / auto-geared two-wheeler whose engine capacity should not exceed 125cc. The balance costRs. over and above the subsidy amountRs. has to be borne by the beneficiary through a bank/institutional loan or her funds.
> **Loan Facilities:** The beneficiary can buy the vehicle of her choice from her funds or by availing loans from Banks/Non-Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs) governed by the rules of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Reimbursement of subsidy to the beneficiary will be permitted in case the vehicle is purchased from her fundsRs. subject to the fulfillment of the other conditions specified for eligibility
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of and residing in Tamil Nadu. 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 40 years. 1. The applicant should know how to drive and possess a valid Two Wheeler / Learner License Registration (LLR) at the time of applying. 1. The annual income of the beneficiary should not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. Only woman and only one woman will be eligible to avail of the benefit in a family. 1. The applicant should have appeared for the class 8th examination (Passed/Failed). 1. Priority will be given to working women residing in remote placesRs. hilly regionsRs. women-headed householdsRs. deserted womenRs. destitute widowsRs. differently abled womenRs. Unmarried women aged above 35 yearsRs. Scheduled Caste/TribesRs. and Transgender.
> **Note** Saving clause: if the applicant has applied with a Learner License Registration(LLR) she should get a valid Two Wheeler Driving License before submitting the subsidy claim form. She should also attach a copy of the two Wheeler Driving License to the subsidy claim formRs. at the time of applying. FurtherRs. she should produce the original Driving License for official verificationRs. as and when needed.

name: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10thRs. 12th & Graduation.
benefits:
**Rate of scholarship on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in 10thRs. 12th & Graduation:**
ClassPercentage of marks obtainedAmount of Scholarship10th 75% & above5Rs./-10th60% & above4Rs./-10th50% & above3Rs./-10+275%5Rs./-10+260% & above4Rs./-10+250 % & above3Rs./-Graduation or equivalent (from recognized university)60% & above7Rs./- (one time)**Note:-** No further scholarship shall be granted thereafter.
eligibility:
1. The worker/beneficiary should be working in the EstablishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contribution towards labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
1. Any worker/beneficiary will be eligible to avail the benefit of the scheme only after 06 months of becoming the beneficiary member of the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board at least for the last six months.
1. The scholarship application will not be entertained on getting a compartment in any of the subjects.
1. In case a scholarship is granted to the children of the workers from any other institution then he will not be entitled to get a scholarship from the Board.
1. If any student who placed at 1stRs. 2ndRs. and 3rd place in National/International games/sports then he will be granted a scholarship without taking into consideration the percentage of marks.
1. The scholarship will be given upto two children of the worker.
1. The applicant should apply for a Scholarship within three months from the date of issue of the mark sheet of the student.

name: Widow Pension (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Widow Pension was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
benefits: Financial assistance of 1000/- per month in the form of pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
eligibility:
1. The deceased worker should have been working at the establishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contributions to the labour welfare fund should have been regularly received by the board.
1. The financial assistance will be given on the production of the death certificate issued by the competent authority along with self-declaration for not withdrawing pension from any other sources/office/factory.
1. The financial assistance will not be given to those beneficiaries who are covered under EPF.
1. The widow of a male construction worker would be eligible to avail the benefit of this scheme only if the male construction worker was a member of the Board for at least the last six months.
1. The widow should apply for the benefit of this scheme within one year.

name: Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidy for the Purchase of Wooden/Fiber Reinforced Plastic/Steel Mechanised Boats" is a Sub-Component under the Umbrella Scheme "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending subsidies for the procurement of wooden/fiber-reinforced plastic/steel mechanized boats.
benefits:
- 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of 7Rs. for a mechanized boat of overall length above 47 feet with nets linked with bank finance for the purchase of a new fishing vessel.
- 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of 11Rs. for a steel mechanized boat of overall length 45 to 54 feet with netsRs. linked with bank finance for the purchase of a new fishing vessel.
- 50% subsidy to a maximum of 2Rs. per boat for conversion/modernization of an existing mechanized fishing boat (unit cost 5Rs.).
- 50% subsidy to a maximum of 5Rs. for the modernization of an existing mechanized fishing boat with a size of 43 feet and above for tuna long lining (unit cost 10Rs.).

****The rate of subsidy may be fixed by the Government from time to time.***
eligibility:
- The applicant should either belong to the fishermen community or be one of those professionally engaged in fishing/fish trade occupation on a full-time basis/prospective entrepreneurs.
- The applicant must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of not less than five years at the time of applying for extending subsidies/ grants.
- The applicant must have been enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society and be above the age of 23 years and below 60 years.
- The applicant must not have been a recipient of Old Age PensionRs. issued by the department.
- The applicant should not be employed in Government/ Government Undertakings/Fishermen Co-operative Society.
- The applicant must not have any dues to be paid to the Department/Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of making the application.
- In the case of male applicantsRs. they should possess sea fishing experience in any mechanized boat for a minimum period of 5 years.
- In the case of women applicantsRs. they should possess sufficient fishing trade experience.
- In the case of entrepreneursRs. they should possess fishing trade experience.

name: Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle
brief_description: Launched in 2010Rs. the scheme "Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle" is a Sub-Scheme under the Umbrella Scheme "Puducherry Development of Shore Based FacilitiesRs. Ice PlantsRs. Service UnitRs. Infrastructural Facilities and Quick Transport Facilities" is a development scheme by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme aims to facilitate the quick transportation of fish catches from landing centers to marketing placesRs. thereby preventing/minimizing spoilage of fish. It provides a 50% subsidy for the procurement of specified vehicles.
benefits:
- 50% subsidy for the purchase of auto goods carrier up to 1-ton capacity (maximum subsidy of 75Rs.). - 50% subsidy for the purchase of a mini truck with 1-3 ton capacity (maximum subsidy of 1Rs.). - 50% subsidy for the purchase of a mini lorry with 3-5 ton capacity (maximum subsidy of 3Rs.). - 50% subsidy for the purchase of an insulated fish van with 5-10 ton capacity (maximum subsidy of 5Rs.). - 50% subsidy for the purchase of a moped with an insulated ice-box (maximum subsidy of 15Rs.). - 50% subsidy for the purchase of engine spares for boats (maximum subsidy of 2Rs. per boat per annum).
> **Mode of Disbursement** The subsidy amount will be released to the bank and credited to the account of the beneficiary for whom the loan amount was sanctioned by the bank.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to the fishermen's community and must be a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry by domicile or birth.
- The applicant's age should not be less than 18 years old or more than 50 years of age.
- The applicant should not have availed the benefit of a loan/subsidy under the scheme earlier for the purpose for which the subsidy is sought.
- The applicant should be a member of a Fishermen Cooperative Society and should not have any overdue with the society/department.
- The applicant should possess a driving license issued by the Transport Authority for driving a moped/auto goods carrier or transport vehicle.
- The applicant should not be employed in Government/Government undertakings/Societies either on a regular/part-time or temporary basis.

name: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows
brief_description: Launched in 2010Rs. the scheme Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of PondicherryRs. was introduced to provide financial assistance for the education of poor widows' children up to higher secondary or equivalent. Through this schemeRs. an annual amount ranging from 25 to 125 is given based on the student's standard.
benefits: Financial assistance ranging from 25 to 125 for the purchase of textbooksRs. notebooksRs. etc.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 3 years.
- The applicant should be a widow.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 24Rs..
- The child of the applicant should be a Student.
- The child of the applicant should have obtained not less than 50% marks in every class.

name: Balika Samrithi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Balika Samrithi Yojana by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Pondicherry was introduced to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food to the girl child. Through this schemeRs. assistance of 500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate is provided to lactating mothers. The target beneficiaries are girl children born on or after 15-8-97.
benefits: Assistance of 500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a girl child born on or after 15-8-97.
- The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 15Rs..
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 3 years.

name: Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels
brief_description: The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of PuducherryRs. provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to the Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.
benefits:
- Free Lodging.
- Free Boarding.
- Cash Payment in Lieu of 2 Pairs of Clothing.
- Conveyance Charges for 6 Times (3 Down and 3 Up) in a Year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for not less than 5 years.
1. For Other Economically Backward ClassesRs. the Income of the parent/guardian should not exceed 75Rs./-.
1. The Parent/Guardian of the applicant should not be living within a radius of 5 km from the hostel.

name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
brief_description: The scheme Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disability to maintain their minimum standard of living. The selection is periodical and depends on the availability of funds.
benefits:
- Disability Range - 40% to 65%: 2000/- per month.
- Disability Range - 66% to 85%: 2500/- per month.
- Disability Range - 86% to 100%: 3500/- per month.
- Age Range - 60 to 79 years: 2700/- per month.
- Age Range - 80 years and above: 3800/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The applicant should have an annual income not exceeding 75Rs./- per annum.
- For Orthopaedic/Deaf/Dumb/BlindRs. the disability of the applicant should be 40% and above.
- For the Mentally RetardedRs. the Intelligence Quotient (IQ) of the applicant should be below 69.

name: Supply of Invalid Carriages (Motorized Tri-cycles) to the Persons With Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme Supply of Invalid Carriages (Motorized Tri-cycles) to the Persons With Disabilities by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry is introduced to supply invalid carriages (motorised tricycles) free of cost to the differently abled persons who are engaged in gainful employment or who are pursuing higher / professional / technical education.
benefits: Invalid carriages (Motorized Tricycles) are provided free of cost to the persons with disabilities.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs./- per annum.
- The applicant should have a locomotor disability affecting lower limbs to a degree not less than 65%.
- The applicant should be certified by the Medical Authority that he/she is fit for operating the invalid carriage (motor tricycle).
- The applicant should not be in receipt of transport allowance for conveyance from the Department or any other source.
- The applicant should be in gainful employment or pursuing higher studies.

name: Supply of Prosthetic Appliances to Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme Supply of Prosthetic Appliances to Differently Abled Persons was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. In this schemeRs. prosthetic appliances are supplied to differently-abled persons free of cost to minimize the mobility challenges experienced by them.
benefits:
- Free Supply of Prosthetic Appliances Like CalipersRs. CrutchesRs. WheelchairsRs. TricyclesRs. Hearing AidsRs. Spectacles / Low Vision Aids Etc.

**NOTE:** The Appliances Are Provided Upon the Advice of the Specialist / Medical Officers Concerned Who Are Attached to the Government General Hospital of PuducherryRs. KaraikalRs. Mahe and Yanam.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs./-.
- The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.

name: Biju Patnaik Bravery Award
brief_description: The Biju Patnaik Bravery Award was launched by the Sports & Youth Services DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha to recognize spectacular acts of Bravery performed by the people of Odisha. The award was presented to commemorate the service of the late Biju PatnaikRs. the ex-Chief Minister of Odisha who had shown in his lifetime many acts of bravery that inspire the youth of India till today. The award shall be given annually for the most outstanding act of bravery.
benefits:
1. The award shall comprise of a cash award of 1Rs./-Rs. one silver medalRs. and a scroll.
1. The awardee shall be invited to receive the award in person. The awardee shall be given TA/DA at the rate of 1st Class Rail/Bus fare and arrangements for his/her stay at Bhubaneswar shall be made by the Department.

**Note 01:** Canvassing for the award in any form is prohibited.
**Note 02:** The award can also be given posthumously to the next of kin of the awardee.
**Note 03:** In case of involvement of more than one person in the selected act of braveryRs. the award money will be shared amongst all.
**Note 04:** It will not be binding on the Department of Sports & Y.S. to confer the award every year. In case of non-availability of suitable persons for the awardRs. the award shall not be conferred for the respective year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. Anybody who performs any spectacular act of bravery inside Odisha will be eligible to be considered for the Award. A resident of Odisha performing the spectacular act of bravery outside will also be eligible for this award.
1. The applicant should have rendered the act of bravery from 1st January to 31st December of the preceding year.
1. The applicant should not have been convicted of any criminal offence.
1. The award shall be given to a person only once in his lifetime.

> **Cancellation & Recovery:**


- The award shall be cancelled in case it is found that it has been obtained by fraudulent means.
- In the event of cancellation of the awardRs. the concerned person will be asked to refund the award (cashRs. silver medal and scroll) failing which steps shall be initiated to recover the involved cost from him alongwith simple interest @ 5% per annum.

name: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation
brief_description: The scheme "Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of PuducherryRs. provides scholarships to the students whose parents are engaged in unclean occupation (scavengerRs. Flayers & Tarner) to improve the status of the unprivileged society. The scheme provides scholarships irrespective of income and caste.
benefits: 1850/- per annum.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 10th.
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- Either or both the parents of the applicant should be engaged in unclean occupation (Scavenger/ Flayer/ Tarner).

name: Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste People Suffering From Prolonged Diseases was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to poor patients from Scheduled Castes who are suffering from prolonged illness and unable to earn their livelihood.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 500/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should have resided continuously in the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least five years.
- The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste.
- The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
- The annual income of the applicant should not be more than 2Rs./-.

name: Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
brief_description:
It is often seen that children of construction workers stay with their parents at the work site. Due to poverty and lack of resources of the parentsRs. such children are not able to take admission in any school or are not able to continue their education after taking admission. Realizing the need to start residential schools for such children of construction workersRs. a residential school scheme has been proposed. The objective of the scheme is to provide quality education to the children of registered construction workers in the age group of 6 to 14 years by providing them the facilities of primaryRs. junior high school and secondary education.
**Scope of the plan:** InitiallyRs. residential school scheme will be operated in districts EtawahRs. BhadohiRs. KannaujRs. MoradabadRs. FirozabadRs. LalitpurRs. BahraichRs. GhaziabadRs. KanpurRs. AzamgarhRs. Agra and Meerut. LaterRs. based on the experiences and needs gainedRs. this scheme will be expanded to other districts.
benefits:
1. Free residential education for all registered construction workers' sons/daughters.
1. Free accommodationRs. clothingRs. food and other facilities available.
eligibility:
1. Parent must be registered construction workers.
1. Child must be fall within the range of 6 to 14 years.

name: Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
brief_description: The sub-scheme Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.
benefits:
- Free Health Checkup and Free Medicines.
- Awareness Speech by Doctors.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be 60 years or above in age.
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.

name: Post Harvest Marketing Scheme
brief_description: The Post Harvest Marketing Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya for the creation of post harvest marketing infrastructure. Under the schemeRs. assistance is provided for evacuation facilities like pick-up trucks/ mini trucks/Tata mobile to the Farmers Groups/ Farmers Clubs/ SHG farmers Co-Operative Societies/ FIG/ FPOsRs. etc. for transportation of farm produce to the market.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Creation of infrastructural facilities for post harvest marketingRs. Grading Units etc.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If Any):**

**Sl. No.****Entitlement****Owantum of Assistance**1Evacuation facilities like pick-up trucks/ mini trucks/ Tata mobile to the Farmers Groups/ Farmers Clubs/ SHG farmers Co-Operative Societies/ FIG/ FPOs etc. for transportation of farm produce to the market.2Rs./- per Group or SHG. (50% Subsidy)2Village level Farmers training on Post Harvest Management.189/ day/farmer. (Daily allowance)
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
2. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
3. The applicant should possess owned or leased land of at least 0.2 hectares or more.

name: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial support to disabled children. The Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana aims to promote and facilitate inclusive education for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan). This scheme aims to ensure that individuals with disabilities have equal access to quality education and educational opportunities
benefits: > Financial assistance : 600/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should Be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. Disabled persons aged between 6 years to 18 years.
1. The applicant's percentage of disability is 40 or more.
1. The name should be mentioned on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal.

name: Aravanaippu Illam
brief_description: The scheme Aravanaippu Illam" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to take care of persons who are lacking basic needs & proper care in societyRs. and to maintain them in a safe living condition.
benefits:
- Free Shelter and Food.
- Free Supply of 4 Sets of Dresses and Other Daily Living Needs.
- Free Medical Treatment (Referred to Nearby PHC).
- Training in Korai & Coir Mat Weaving.
- Labour Charges of 20/- Per Mat for the Work of Mat Weaving as and When Carried Out.
- 5/- Per Day as Daily Pocket Money.
- Recreation Like RadioRs. TVRs. LibraryRs. Besides Local Trips to Places of Interest and Temples.
- Annual Tour to Places of Interest.
- Annual DayRs. Conducted Every Year in Order to Exhibit Their Talents and for Prize Distribution.

**NOTE:** Contact the authorities below in case of delay in disbursal of benefits:
Puducherry: The DirectorRs. Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Saradhambal NagarRs. EllaipillaichavadhyRs. Puducherry.
Karaikal: The CollectorRs. Karaikal.
Mahe/Yanam: The Regional AdministratorRs. Mahe/Yanam.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be lacking basic needs and proper care in society.
1. The applicant should be 20 years or above in age.
1. The applicant should not be suffering from communicable disease.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
brief_description: The scheme Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's WelfareRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the farmers from the Scheduled Caste Category are provided with a grant of 90% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessoriesRs. subject to a maximum of 60Rs./ per tubewell per individual.
benefits:
- 90% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessoriesRs. subject to a maximum of 60Rs./ per tubewell per individual.

**NOTE:** The subsidy amount shall be released through the Electronic Clearing System (ECS) if the applicant has undertaken the construction with his/her funds. In caseRs. he/she has availed himself/herself loan from the Nationalized Bank / Cooperative Bank towards the construction of the tubewellRs. the subsidy amount shall be remitted to the Bank against the loan account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from the Scheduled Caste Category.
- The applicant should be a farmer in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- The tubewell in which the submersible/centrifugal motor pump sets is going to be erect and should have been registered in Pondicherry Ground Water AuthorityRs. Puducherry.
- The applicant should hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell to be constructed and the applicant should have ownership of the land at least for 2 years and should have a clear ownership title deed in his/her name. The eligible land holding of 1.5 acres should be in favour of the applicant farmer or in favour of the spouse or favour of the member of a joint/undivided family.
- The farmers who have already availed themselves of the subsidy for the said purpose within 5 years are not entitled to any benefit under this scheme.
- The applicant should not convert the lands for a maximum period of 10 years from the date of construction of the tubewell/filter point to any purpose other than agriculture and should execute a bond accordingly.

name: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. In this schemeRs. a fixed sum 300/- per month shall be paid as Transport Allowance to the differently abled individuals.
benefits: 300/- per month shall be paid through Anganwadi Centres as Transport Allowance.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The applicant should have orthopaedic disability of 40% or above.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs./-.
- The applicant should not be in receipt of any other financial assistance for conveyance purpose from the department or any other source.
- The age of the applicant should be 5 years and above.
- The applicant should not have a formal education qualification.
- If the applicant possess a free bus passRs. then the same should be surrendered to the Directorate of Social Welfare.

name: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
brief_description: Chhe Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana Under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Government of Madhya Pradesh. To assist multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons above the age of six years who are unable to earn a living. At present there is no such provision; their parents and family members have to face a lot of difficulty in taking care of such disabled people. Giving 600/- per month as a grant-in-aid to such disabled people for their livelihood will help them meet their special needs and be a financial help.
benefits: > Cash Benefits- 600/- per month
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant should have a Certificate of 40 percent or more disability.
- The applicant's name should be mentioned on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal
- The applicant should have an age certificate for being above six years of age.

name: Maintenance of Horti Hubs
brief_description: The scheme Maintenance of Horti Hubs was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to procure good quality disease-free and commercially accepted varieties of the identified flowers & multiply and to serve as a demonstration cum training ground for those who are interested in Floriculture and who intend to make this as their means of livelihood.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**

Organizing demonstration cum training on hi-tech floriculture for farmers who are interested in floricultureRs. and renovation/repairing of old hubs.
> **Type of Assistance:**

Demonstration and Training
eligibility:
1. The applicants should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
1. The applicant/farmer should own or lease land of at least 0.2 hectares or more.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme-Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: Launched in the year 2009Rs. the scheme Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government. of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. financial support is provided to the widows of the state of Sikkim. A widow whose household is below the poverty line is eligible to get the benefits of the pension scheme. The beneficiary receives a monthly pension amount consists of the Central and State governments' share.
benefits: - The beneficiary will get a monthly pension of 600/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The application should be aged between 40 to 79 years.

name: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana (IMSUPY) is a scheme launched by the Rajasthan government to empower women entrepreneurs by providing them with financial assistance and support. The main objective of the scheme is to ecourage women to start their own businesses and become financially independent. Promote self-employment and reduce unemployment among women in Rajasthan. Support the growth of microRs. smallRs. and medium enterprises (MSMEs) led by women.
benefits:
> **Loan Limit** 1. Loan amount of 50Rs./- to individual women. 1. Loan amount of Rs 1Rs./- to self-help groups.
> **Margin Money** - A margin money of 25% of the sanctioned loan amount will be provided under the scheme. For women belonging to Scheduled Castes/TribesRs. Scheduled CastesRs. widowsRs. abandoned womenRs. victims of violence and disabled womenRs. the margin money will be 30% of the sanctioned loan amount. - **Note**: 1. The maximum limit of margin money will be 15Rs./-. 1. The applicant's own contribution (5% / 10% of the project proposal) will be considered for margin money. 1. Land value will not be included in the project proposal. The maximum limit of loan amount payable for construction of workshop/building will be up to 20% of the sanctioned amount of the project proposal. 1. The maximum limit of loan for business will be Rs. 10 lakh. Business refers to wholesale or retail purchase-sale of commercial products.
> **Promotion of collateral security free loans:** - As per the guidelines of the Reserve Bank of IndiaRs. collateral security will not be required for loans up to Rs. 10 lakh. Loans above Rs. 10 lakh can be linked with the Credit Guarantee Trust Fund for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE). The fee amount will be borne by the beneficiary. If the applicant voluntarily wants to give collateral security on the loanRs. they can do so.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or more.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan.
1. The women's self-help group or group of these groups (cluster/ federation) must be registered under any department of the state government and in case of cluster/federation of groupsRs. it will be necessary to be registered under the Cooperative Act as per the rules.

name: Nirman Shramik Auzaar Toolkit Sahayata Yojana
brief_description:
The NIRMAN SHRAMIK AUZAAR TOOLKIT SAHAYATA YOJANA is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers in the state for the purchase of essential tools and equipment required for their work.
> **Objectives** 1. To improve the working conditions and productivity of construction workers in Jharkhand. 1. To reduce the financial burden on construction workers for purchasing essential tools and equipment. 1. To promote the overall socio-economic development of construction workers in the state.
benefits: > Actual cost of purchasing tools/toolkit or 2Rs./-Rs. whichever is less
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of the Rajasthan state.
1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker for 3 years.
1. Amount payable only on purchasing tools/toolkits related to one's work or business.
1. The purchase of tools/toolkits will be done by the construction worker himself and the bill is required to be attached to the application.

name: Organic Manure Scheme
brief_description: The Organic Manure Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to provide hands-on training at the village level on the production of organic compost inputs such as compost for plant health management for sustainable agriculture.
benefits:
> **Type of assistance:**


- Training and awareness campaign in the production of organic composts.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: "Advanced Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
brief_description: The "Advanced Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme is introduced by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. to provide advanced training to individuals seeking to master exquisite craft skills. Through this schemeRs. candidates will be sponsored for training in other states where the craft is practised to its finest. The training program focuses on enhancing craft skillsRs. enabling participants to acquire advanced techniques and proficiency in their chosen craft.
benefits: - **Course Fee:** as Prescribed by the Training Institution.- **Stipend:** 2Rs./- Per Month Per Trainee.- **Accommodation Charges:** 500/- Per Month Per Trainee.- **Travelling Allowance:** Restricted to to-and-fro 2nd Class (Berth) Train Fare.- **Period of Training:** As Prescribed by the Training Unit/institution.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry or a continuous resident for the past three years.
- The applicant should possess the education qualification as required by the Training Unit/Institution.

name: Training in Coir Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Training in Coir Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of Puducherry aims to promote and develop Coir and Coir-based industries in the region. AdditionallyRs. it focuses on providing a 6-month training to the rural poor in producing coir products with the objective of generating employment.
benefits:
- Stipend of 1Rs. per month per trainee during the 6-month training period.
- An honorarium of 300 per month per trainee for the trainerRs. with a maximum of 3Rs. per month.
- Compensation for wastage of raw materials: 200 per month per traineeRs. with a maximum of 2Rs. per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a native of Puducherry Union Territory or a continuous resident for the past three years.
- The applicant should be between 18 to 35 years of age.
- The applicant should be literate.
- The applicant should not have already been trained through this scheme.

name: Supply of Agriculture Machineries Scheme
brief_description: The Supply of Agriculture Machineries Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya for the distribution and sale of Agriculture Machineries such as Power TillersRs. etc. to farmers at a subsidized rate.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Subsidy on Power tillersRs. ReapersRs. HarvestersRs. etc.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If Any):**


- 50% subsidy sale.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana" initiated by the Labor Department of Rajasthan aims to foster the integration of children of registered beneficiaries engaged in construction and other related works into the mainstream of development. Through this programRs. the government seeks to provide opportunities for the children of laborers and workers involved in construction activities to access education and skill developmentRs. thereby enhancing their prospects for a better future.
By facilitating the participation of these children in educational and skill-building programsRs. the scheme endeavors to break the cycle of intergenerational poverty prevalent among families engaged in manual labor. By empowering the youth with education and skillsRs. the government aims to equip them with the necessary tools to secure gainful employment opportunities and contribute meaningfully to the socio-economic development of Rajasthan. Through this holistic approachRs. the scheme not only addresses immediate educational needs but also endeavors to create a pathway for long-term socio-economic upliftment and empowerment of families involved in the construction sector in the state.
benefits:
1. On passing the preliminary examination of Indian Administrative Service 1Rs./-
1. On passing the preliminary examination of Rajasthan Administrative Service 50Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be registered construction workers who are continuously depositing contributions
1. The annual income of the applicant parents from all sources should not exceed 2Rs./-
1. Applicant who are already working in government services will not be given benefits.
1. The applicant must have passed the following preliminary competitive examination:-

1. Indian Administrative Service.
1. Rajasthan Administrative Service.

1. No benefit will be payable under this scheme for administrative examination of states other than Rajasthan state.
1. Incentive amount will be given maximum once only for Indian Administrative Service and Rajasthan Administrative ServiceRs. that isRs. if incentive amount has been given for competitive examination in the pastRs. then in the coming yearRs. incentive amount will be given again for passing the preliminary examination of the same competitive examination. But incentive amount will not be payable.
1. If any fact is found to be false in the information given by the beneficiary in the assistance application submitted under the schemeRs. then it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit the entire amount of assistance accepted under the scheme in one lump sum along with interest.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the differently able unemployed persons with 40% disability or more in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
benefits:
1. The quantum of Disability Allowance shall be 2500/- per month subject to eligibility.
1. The financial assistance sanction shall be payable to a disabled person till his/her death subject to the conditions.
1. Disability allowance shall become payable from the month following the one in which it is sanctioned.

**Note:** Assistance shall be stopped on the death of the disabled personRs. if the disabled person diesRs. before receiving assistance for a particular periodRs. the same shall lapse.
> **Mode of Payment:**


- Payment of allowance shall be made through Bank Account on a monthly basis.
eligibility:
1. Persons who are permanent residents of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for more than 10 years at the time of making the application.
1. A person of age 01 month or more and having 40% & above disability is eligible under the scheme.
1. There is no income ceiling to avail this allowance.
1. The applicant is neither in receipt of any other financial assistance/allowances nor employed anywhere.

> **Cancellation of Assistance:**


- The sanctioning authority i.e. Director (Social Welfare) shall have the right cancel to the sanction of assistance at any stage if it is found that it was sanctioned on a mistaken ground or false information tendered or the conditions under which the assistance was granted no longer exist.
- The assistance shall be stopped if the beneficiary gets employment.

name: Pension Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Pension Benefit was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. a pension shall be provided to the Building and Other Construction Workers who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board upon attaining the age of 55 years.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. the registered construction workerRs. who has completed 55 years of ageRs. is eligible for pension @ 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in building or other construction works and continue as such work for a continuous period of not less than five years.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered construction workerRs. who has completed 55 years of ageRs. is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The beneficiary must have made regular contributions to the welfare fund for at least 5 years.

name: Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme
brief_description: The Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the Scheme is to sponsor students for undergoing 4 years of Graduate/degree courses in Agriculture/Horticulture against State quota seats in different Agriculture Universities in the country.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Sponsorship of seatsRs. book grantsRs. and scholarships.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Monthly stipend @ 1Rs./-.
- Book grant @1Rs./- per academic year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/student should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. Students interested in pursuing a four-year degree course in Agriculture/Horticulture can apply under the scheme.
1. The studentsRs. general & OBC categoryRs. who should have passed 10+2 in the Science stream with 55% aggregate marks having PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Biology & English as compulsory subjects are eligible under the scheme.
1. The studentsRs. SC & ST categoryRs. who should have passed 10+2 in the Science stream with 45% aggregate marks having PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Biology & English as compulsory subjects are eligible under the scheme.
1. The applicant should also qualify for the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) All India Entrance Examinations for Admission (AIEEA) conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).

name: Free Medical Card for Media Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Free Medical Card for Media Persons" by the Department of Information & PublicityRs.
