Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to provide free medical facilities to press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. This will include free treatment in the Government hospitals /institutions of Puducherry with entitlement to A-Class Special Wards.
benefits:
Identification Cards/Certificates will be issued to the eligible media persons for availing the following facilities -

- Free medical facilities to the press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration.
- Free treatment in the Government hospitals /institutions of Puducherry with entitlement of 'A-Class' Special Wards. In the absence of such wardsRs. wards of the next lower category shall be provided.
- The free medical facility will also include hospital stoppagesRs. investigation chargesRs. etc.

**Time of Disbursal:** The Medical Card will be issued within a working day from the date of application.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
- The applicant should be a Press Correspondent.

name: Nirman Shramikon ke Liye Vyavsayik Rin Par Byaj ki Punarbharan Yojana
brief_description: The "Nirman Shramikon ke Liye Vyavsayik Rin Par Byaj ki Punarbharan Yojana" is a scheme designed to alleviate financial burdens for construction workers by assisting in the repayment of interest on commercial loans. Recognizing the challenges faced by individuals in the construction sectorRs. especially during economic downturnsRs. the scheme aims to ease the burden of high-interest ratesRs. which often weigh heavily on the shoulders of laborers. By providing support with interest repaymentsRs. the government not only relieves immediate financial pressure but also fosters an environment conducive to entrepreneurship and economic stability among the construction workforce. This initiative underscores the government's commitment to the welfare and prosperity of construction workersRs. recognizing their invaluable contributions to the nation's infrastructure and development. Through this schemeRs. the government aims to enhance the financial resilience of construction laborersRs. enabling them to pursue their entrepreneurial aspirations and secure a brighter future for themselves and their families.
benefits: > **The board will reimburse the interest payable on business loans up to 5Rs./-**
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be construction worker and registered with the board are regularly depositing contributions.
1. Applicant can utilities the loan amount only for own business work.
1. Application can not use loan amount for purchase of shop/plot/vehicle or household goods.
1. Applicant have to submit a certificate of intention to repay interest to the financial institution every year.
1. This scheme will be applicable only on the loan taken by one of the registered beneficiary's wife/husband at a time.
1. If any information provided in the application for assistance under the scheme by the beneficiary is found to be falseRs. the responsibility of depositing the entire sanctioned assistance amount along with interest in lump sum will be of the concerned beneficiary.

name: Disability Pension (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Disability Pension is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance in the form of a disability pension to a beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosis (T.B.)Rs. accidentsRs. etc. AdditionallyRs. the worker will be eligible for an ex-gratia payment based on the percentage of disability and subject to conditions as may fixed by the Board.
benefits:
1. The financial assistance of 150/- per month as disability pension shall be given to a beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosis (T.B.)Rs. accidentsRs. etc.
1. In addition to this pensionRs. the worker will also be eligible for an exgratia payment of not more than 5Rs./- depending upon the percentage of disability and subject to such conditions as may fixed by the Board.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in a building or other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
1. Registered construction workers who have become permanently disabled due to conditions such as paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosis (T.B.)Rs. accidentsRs. etc.Rs. are eligible to avail of the benefits under the scheme.

name: Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/Photojournalists
brief_description: "Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/photojournalists" was launched by the Department of Information and Cultural AffairsRs. Government of Tripura. The objective is to provide financial assistance in the form of a Pension to accredited Journalists/ Photojournalists aged 60 years and above. The application should be submitted to the Director of Information and Cultural Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Tripura.
benefits: Pension of 10Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be 18 years or older. 1. The applicant retired from the job as an accredited journalist/photojournalist in Tripura. 1. The applicant should have done 10 years of service in Tripura. 1. The applicant should not have received a pension from other sourcesRs. except under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF). 1. The beneficiary should be 60 years or older to receive the pension.

name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
brief_description:
For Implementation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme of "**Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan"** (RGSA) (2022-23 to 2025-26)Rs. the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR)Rs. seeks to engage Students enrolled/pursuing undergraduateRs. graduateRs. or postgraduate degree programs and 'Young Research Scholars' enrolled/pursuing Doctoral (Ph.D.) or post-doctoral degrees in given academic disciplines below from recognized/reputed University(s)/Institution(s) within India or abroad for short-term (maximum of 3 months only) through an Internship program. The engagement of 'Selected Candidates' as 'Interns' will work in various UnitsRs. CellsRs. and Programmes of different Divisions of MoPR under the Revamped RGSA Scheme for the period of FY 2022-23 to 2025-26. The **Internship Program** is specifically focusing on the Office set-up of MoPR. A detail list of intended domains/subject areas of research for which the Interns are invited and shall be engaged is enclosed in [**Annexure A**](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s316026d60ff9b54410b3435b403afd226/uploads/2023/09/202403121034313656.pdf) of detailed guidelines.
**Objectives of the Program**

1. To engage 'Students' and 'Research Scholars for tapping academic talentsRs. knowledgeRs. skillsRs. and techniques to be best utilized and associated with the MoPR's Policy and Action Research work for mutual benefits.
1. The 'Interns' shall have an opportunity to know and get in-hand experience on the Stier Local Self-governments and other Government functioningRs. policiesRs. schemesRs. development initiativesRs. and interventions for rural development in context to the socioeconomicRs. culturalRs. and political aspects.
1. The 'Interns' will have to provide relevant and logical inputsRs. suggestionsRs. and recommendations through Data AnalysisRs. Situational AnalysisRs. Empirical and Evidence-Based Research through Quantitative & Qualitative Data AnalysisRs. Desk ReviewsRs. and Policy Analysis at the 'Office setup of MoPR' for preparing Policy Briefs and Working Papers.
benefits:
1. The selected candidates will receive a certificate of completion.
1. The Internship ProgramRs. MoPR shall provide a flat rate/amount of Rs.7Rs./- per month as stipend to the InternRs. depending on the best applicants.
eligibility:
1. The applicants i.e.Rs. Students are enrolled/pursuing Undergraduate/Graduate/Postgraduate degree programme or Research Scholars enrolled/pursuing Doctoral (Ph.D.)/Post-Doctoral degree in recognised/reputed University(s)/Institution(s) or completed any of the mentioned course Rs. within last 2 years from India or Abroad are eligible to apply for the Internship Program.
1. The preferred academic disciplines of Public Policy StudiesRs. Social Policy StudiesRs. Development StudiesRs. EconomicsRs. Governance and Public Administration StudiesRs. Rural Development ManagementRs. Business AdministrationRs. Environment and Energy StudiesRs. Public Health StudiesRs. SociologyRs. Political ScienceRs. Social WorkRs. StatisticsRs. Data AnalysisRs. and other relevant Social SciencesRs. ManagementRs. and Engineering streams.
1. The duration of the Internship Program shall be at least 15 daysRs. but NOT exceeding six (6) months.
1. MoPR shall provide them working spaceRs. Internet facilityRs. library accessRs. and other necessary requirements for their assignment(s) and deliverables. Interns will be required to have their own laptop.
1. The candidates those who are not expecting any stipend/honorariumRs. may also join by the approval of DH of Program Division for Pro bono manner.

name: Assistance For Purchase of Aids/Appliances
brief_description: The "Assistance for Purchase of Aids/Appliances" scheme under the Social WelfareRs. Women & Child Development Chandigarh financial assistance is being provided to physically handicapped persons for the purchase of aids/appliances to increase their mobility in their day-to-day working. The applicant should be a resident of UTRs. Chandigarh to avail of benefits under the scheme. By providing support for their purchaseRs. the scheme empowers individuals to perform tasks and activities independentlyRs. thereby enhancing their self-esteem and overall well-being.
benefits: > **100% cost on purchase of artificial limbs/ aids/ appliances subject to a maximum of 40Rs./-**
eligibility:
1. Annual income of the applicant from all sources should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.
1. Applicant must be resident of UTRs. Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
1. Applicant's Disability should be to the extent of 40% and above.

name: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna -RS-CIT
brief_description:
Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna Started on 20-12-2020 under the Women and Child Development Department Rajasthan State Government is to make the girls and women of the state empower in the field of computers by providing free computer courses to them. As we all knowRs. in the present timesRs. the use of computers is increasing rapidly. In most of the departmentsRs. all the work in government and private companies is being done digitally. In such a situationRs. this decision of the Rajasthan government is very important for the girls and women of the state. According to this schemeRs. women get computer knowledge for free. By doing thisRs. they can become self-reliant and empoweredRs. thus their future will also be brightRs. this has been the main objective of the Rajasthan Government under the Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Kaushal Samvardhan Yojana.
> **Out of the allotted seatsRs. Scheduled Caste candidates will be selected on 18% seats and Scheduled Tribe candidates will be selected on 14% seats. In case of non-availability in the concerned categoryRs. it can be filled by others.**
benefits: > **Free basic computer training for women and girlsRs. general information about MS WordRs. MS ExcelRs. MS PowerPointRs. emailRs. etc. is given. Training will be given through RKCL ( Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited).**
eligibility:
1. The applicant is a native citizen of Rajasthan.
1. Only women of the state will be considered eligible for the scheme.
1. Only girls and women between the ages of 16 years to 40 years will be considered eligible for the scheme.
1. Widow/divorced/abandoned women suffering from violence be given priority.
1. The applicant trainees who have passed class 10th from a government school and are graduates.
1. The applicant Anganwadi worker must be a Graduate.

name: Skill Development Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Skill Development Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The Board is implementing this scheme by entering an MoU with M/s Labour Net Services Private Limited and M/s G&G Skill Developers Private LimitedRs. to provide training to the Construction Workers enrolled as beneficiaries in the Board. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: The Construction Workers are provided Skill Training free of cost.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.

name: Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance of 2Rs./- to the registered worker as a relief during a natural calamity/pandemic. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: 2Rs./- credited as Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Laxman Award/Rani Laxmi Bai Award was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttar Pradesh the sportspersons will be honoured by the state government with the Lakshman award for male sportsperson and Rani Lakshmi Bai award for a female sportsperson in 31 sports disciplines.
benefits: - This award recognizes sports personalities with a CitationRs. a Bronze statue of either Laxman or Rani Laxmi BaiRs. a ScrollRs. and a cash prize of 3Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The player must be a bonafide native of Uttar Pradesh. 1. The sportspersons for at least three consecutive times for the year 2020-21 (year 2018-19Rs. 2019-20 & 2020-21) must have been a member of the state senior team for the year 2021-22 (2019-20Rs. 2020-21 & 2021-22) participated in the National Games/National Senior Championship and also the medal earned by him in the year for which the award is recommended. 1. If a player has participated in the National Senior Championship and he/she will participate in the international competitions mentioned in the government order such as the Olympic GamesRs. World Championship/World Cup (held at an interval of 04 years) Asian GamesRs. Commonwealth GamesRs. Asian Championship and Commonwealth Championship (held 01 time in 04 years)Rs. SAF Games If he participatesRs. will also be considered eligible. 1. The player will have to give an affidavit along with his application that he has never been a participant in the consumption of drugs in any competition/championship or sports event nor has he been found guilty in this case. 1. The applicant shall also submit an oath that he has not been found guilty in any suit by the Hon'ble Court nor has he been found guilty in connection with sexual harassment 1. The players who have the above eligibility will be given the Laxman Award to the male player and Rani Laxmi Bai Award to women players included in 31 sports (SwimmingRs. ArcheryRs. AthleticsRs. BadmintonRs. BasketballRs. BoxingRs. Canoeing & KayakingRs. CyclingRs. Horse RidingRs. FencingRs. FootballRs. GymnasticsRs. HandballRs. HockeyRs. JudoRs. KabaddiRs. Kho - KhoRs. RowingRs. ShootingRs. Table TennisRs. Lan TennisRs. VolleyballRs. Weightlifting/Best physicsRs. WrestlingRs. TaekwondoRs. YachtingRs. GolfRs. CricketRs. Soft TennisRs. Karate and Wushu) by conferring Lakshman/Rani Lakshmi Bai Award to male/female sportsperson who bring laurels to the state and the country by achieving significant achievements in the respective sports. 1. One person will be rewarded only once. 1. The Government may cancel the name of any person from the list of awardee sportspersons and in that directionRs. such person shall be required to return the statue and inscription given to him. The cancellation will thus be final and no appeal can be made against it. 1. Any form of conveying (pleading) about a recommendation will disqualify that entry. 1. The players only participating in National Senior Championships/National Games will not be considered eligible for the award.

name: Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana
brief_description: The Rajasthan government has introduced the "Suraksha Laghu Evam Simaant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana" to uplift the lives of small and marginal farmers in the state. This initiative recognizes the significant contributions of these farmers to the agricultural sector and aims to provide them with much-needed social security during their golden years. By offering a monthly pension to eligible farmers aged 60 and aboveRs. the scheme seeks to alleviate financial worries and ensure a degree of economic independence for these individuals. This program serves as a critical step towards improving the overall well-being of small and marginal farmers in RajasthanRs. acknowledging their hard work and dedication to food production.
benefits:
1. To a pensioner below 75 years of age : 750/- per month
1. To pensioners aged 75 years and above : 1Rs./- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan State.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The female applicant's age should be more than 55 years and the male more than 58 years.

name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (PULWS)
brief_description: The "Funeral Assistance Scheme (PULWS)" is a Welfare Scheme for the Unorganized Workers in Puducherry by the "Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society"Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The Society extends 7Rs./- to the nominee of the deceased Unorganised Worker towards meeting the funeral expenses. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 7Rs./- to the nominee of the deceased member towards funeral expenses.
- The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a nominee of the deceased.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been an Unorganized Worker: Taxi and Auto DriversRs. Workers Employed in Shops & Catering EstablishmentsRs. CarpentersRs. Nathaswara VidwansRs. Hair DressersRs. TailorsRs. Cycle Rickshaw DriversRs. CobblersRs. WashermansRs. GoldsmithRs. BlacksmithRs. Brass Vessel MakersRs. SculptorsRs. Loading and Unloading WorkersRs. Tree ClimbersRs. Pottery WorkersRs. Coir WorkersRs. Toddy Neera TappersRs. Bullock Cart DriversRs. ThatchersRs. CooksRs. HawkersRs. News Paper VendorsRs. Workers Engaged in Bricks and Tiles ManufacturingRs. One HundredRs. Workers Engaged in Distribution of Liquid Petroleum Gas CylinderRs. Domestic WorkersRs. Light Music Instrument PlayersRs. Automobile Workshop Workers.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been enrolled with the Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been between 18 to 59 years of age.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been taking an Annual Subscription of 100/- every year.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been paying a Registration Fee of 25/-.

name: Government Working Womens Hostel
brief_description: The scheme "Government Working Womens Hostel" is an initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to safe accommodation and food facilities to working women who live far away from their families and belong to lower and middle-income groups. The women can stay 3 years in the hostel.
benefits:
- Affordable Monthly Rent: 300/- per month in Chennai and 200/- per month in other Districts.
- Safe accommodationRs. foodRs. and electricity charges on a dividing basis.
- The women can stay for 3 years in the hostel.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a working woman.
1. If the applicant is in ChennaiRs. the income of the applicant should not exceed 25000/- per month.
1. If the applicant is in a district other than ChennaiRs. the income of the applicant should not exceed 15000/- per month.

name: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Ilamani Award
brief_description: The "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Ilamani Award" is a state scheme launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance 4Rs./- and certificates of appreciation. The scheme is being implemented in all Districts of Tamil Nadu.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 4Rs./-.
- Certificate of Appreciation.
- A shawl worth 500/-.
- 5 eminent artists are awarded every year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years and below.

name: Krishi Yantra
brief_description:
The Krishi Yantra Scheme under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government has decided to start the Agricultural Machinery Subsidy Scheme for the convenience of farmers. In this schemeRs. if the farmer purchases farming equipment from an authorized dealerRs. then the state government gives a subsidy to the farmers which is 40% of the total price. Up to 50% subsidy is given to government farmers.
> **Payment of grant** 1. Physical verification of the instrument will be done by the Agriculture Supervisor/Assistant Agriculture Officer. 1. Purchase bill will have to be presented at the time of verification. 1. The grant will be paid online into the farmer's bank account.
benefits:
> **Grant Details :** Details of grant payable scheme-wise and category-wise of instruments

eligibility:
1. Own agricultural land in his/her own name.
1. In case of undivided familyRs. the applicant's name must be in the revenue record.
1. For tractor-operated agricultural implementsRs. the tractor must be registered in the applicant's name.
1. Not have received a grant for the same type of agricultural implement in the last three years.
1. Not have received a grant for more than 3 different types of agricultural implements in a financial year.

name: Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description:
The Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of battery-operated tricycle (e-rickshaw) vehicles to registered construction disabled workers.
**Objective:**
If a registered construction worker becomes disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction siteRs. the income of the construction worker ceases. So the construction worker is permanently financially unable to support the family. In such a situationRs. the use of three-wheelers is intended to help the construction workers as a source of income so that they can find other employment and support their families.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. a one-time subsidy will be available to the extent of 50% of the Ex-Showroom Price or 48Rs./- whichever is less.
1. The assistance will also be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time of the new Three-Wheeler. (RTO Tax and Road Tax would be reimbursed as well.)

**Note 01:** The cost of the motor vehicle tax amount of the new three-wheelerRs. fixed by the State Government and at the prevailing rate applicable to persons with disabilitiesRs. will be borne by the registered disabled construction worker here.
**Note 02:** This additional subsidy will be provided in addition to the subsidy available under the electric vehicle-related schemes of Government.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers should be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered construction workers who become disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction site will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should have purchased a lithium-ion battery-operated vehicle in his own name.
1. The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should hold a tri-cycle license to operate a tri-cycle.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be available once per registered construction disabled worker.

name: Walk In Tunnel
brief_description:
The Walk-In Tunnel under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government provides the benefit of a subsidy to the farmers with affordable and efficient structures that offer protection from adverse weather conditionsRs. pestsRs. and diseases. Walk In Tunnels are basically protected structures made from Pre-galvanized pipe and covered with UV Stabilized Plastic sheets. Generally Tunnels are used to give favorable controlled environments like temperatureRs. humidityRs. light intensityRs. ventilationRs. soil mediaRs. disease controlRs. irrigationRs. FertigationRs. and other agronomical practices throughout the season irrespective of the natural conditions outside. Walk In Tunnel has a variety of applicationsRs. the majority beingRs. the growing of vegetablesRs. floricultureRs. planting material acclimatizationRs. and fruit crop growing for the export market.
> **Important points** 1. The construction of Walk in Tunnel can be started only after the administrative approval/work order issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. Verification can be done by the committee formed after construction. 1. Payment of the grant amount directly into the bank account of the farmer or to the producer firm with the written consent of the farmer.
benefits:
1. 50 percent grant is payable for the area.
1. 800 square meters (maximum 5 units per beneficiary).
1. 400 square meters (maximum 10 units per beneficiary).
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a Farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

name: Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses (Swami Vivekanand Scholarship)
brief_description: The Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses scheme is administered by the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. a monthly stipend/scholarship will be given to Scheduled Caste Category students who are studying professional courses in Government or Private Industrial Training Institute (ITI).
benefits: Under the schemeRs. a monthly stipend of 400/- is given to the eligible student.
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
1. The student should be studying in professional course in a Government or Private Industrial Training Institute (ITI).
1. The annual family income of the student should be up to 6Rs./- (For Rural & Urban Areas).

name: Cash Grant in lieu of Sewing Machine
brief_description: "Cash Grant in lieu of Sewing Machine" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. 10Rs./- is provided to the Widows of Ex-servicemen for the purchase of a Sewing Machine. This scheme applies only to the Widows of the ESM registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- A Cash Grant of 10Rs./- is provided for the purchase of a Sewing Machine.
- The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility: - The applicant should be the Widow of an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen).- The applicant should be [registered](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure) with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The scope of this scheme will also apply to those ESM / living spouse/widows who are re-employed as regular / deemed to be regular in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Private Organizations and self-employed IT assesses.

name: Spectacle Grant (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Spectacle Grant" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. 2Rs./- to the Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen for the purchase of Spectacle. The members of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) are not eligible. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 2Rs./-Rs. for the purchase of Spectacle.
- The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)/Widow of an Ex-serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The applicant should not be a member of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).

name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
brief_description: The scheme "Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances" is a component of the Umbrella Scheme "National Handicrafts Development Programme (NHDP)" by the Ministry of TextilesRs. Govt. of India. The scheme is introduced to support the artisans during their old age. The scheme is designed to give a boost to the handicraft sector in India. Assistance of upto 8Rs./- per month is granted to the Artisans in Indigent Circumstances in the form of monthly allowance or lump sum grant or bothRs. through PFMS/DBT.
benefits: Assistance of upto 8Rs./- per month is granted in the form of a monthly allowance or lump sum grant or bothRs. disbursed via the Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/ Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a master craftsperson who is the recipient of the Shilp Guru Award/ National Award/ Merit Certificate/ State Award/ any other bigger award.
- The annual income of the artisan should not exceed 1Rs./- in the preceding financial year.
- The applicant should not be a recipient of similar financial assistance from any other source.
- The artisan should not be less than 60 years of age on the date of application. Age may be relaxed in the case of artisans with disabilitiesRs. subject to submission of the Certificate issued by the appropriate authority.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Maternity Assistance Scheme was launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to female workers and the wives of workers to cover expenses incurred for health check-upsRs. medicineRs. nutritious dietRs. etc.Rs. during the maternity period.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 10Rs./- is provided to female workers and the wives of workers to cover expenses incurred during the maternity period.
eligibility:
1. The workers who are working in the organized sector in the state of Gujarat will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The workers should have been working continuously with the Factory/Company/Organization for one year and his/her Labour Welfare Fund should have been deposited in the board.
1. Application has to be made within 1 (one) year from the date of delivery.
1. The benefit of this scheme is available to either female workers or the wives of workers for only one delivery.

**Note:** Assistance will not be provided if there is a change in the name of the pregnant woman mentioned in the birth certificate/document and the name of the pregnant woman mentioned in the bank passbook.

name: Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists
brief_description: "Scheme of Awarding Porkizhi to the Indigent Kalaimamani Awardee Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The artists who have already received the Kalaimamani Award and who are presently in indigent circumstances are awarded financial assistance of 15Rs./-. The scheme is implemented by the Tamil Nadu Eyal Isai Nataka Mandram Ponni.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should have received the Kalaimamani Award.
1. The applicant should be living under indigent circumstances.
1. The age of the applicant should be 58 years or above.
1. The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 12Rs./-.

name: Scheme of Extending Grants for the Publication of Rare Books on Arts
brief_description: The "Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. the grant is sanctioned to the writer for the publication of books that are considered rare for the development of arts. 60% of the total cost of the printing charges of 1000 copies or 15Rs./- whichever is less is sanctioned as a grant. he applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Manram.
benefits: 60% of the total cost of the printing charges of 1000 copies or 15Rs./- whichever is less is sanctioned as a grant. > **Number of Installments** The grant amount is disbursed in two instalments: - **First Installment:** 50% upon selection of the book by the Expert Committee. - **Second Installment:** 50% after the author submits 100 printed copies of the book along with an expenditure statement for verification. *This grant is not given for reprint.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Author/Writer.
1. The applicant should lack sufficient financial resources to cover the publishing expenses of the rare books.
1. The book should have been considered rare for the development of arts
1. The submitted book should not have been published before.

name: Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists
brief_description: The "Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme gives an opportunity to talented young artists to perform in cultural programmes organized by voluntary organizationsRs. thereby identifying talented youth in the field of Vocal MusicRs. BharathanatyamRs. and Instrumental Music. Remuneration in the range of 5Rs./- to 10Rs./- is paid to the artists for their performance.
benefits: Remuneration in the range of 5Rs./- to 10Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Tamil Nadu.
1. In the case of music artistRs. the age should be above 16 years and within 30 years.
1. In the case of Bharatanatyam artistRs. the age should be over 15 years and within 30 years.
1. The orchestra artists such as ghatamRs. ganjiraRs. muharshinghRs. konnakkol are also eligible to apply.
1. The artist should participate in any one of the following performances: VocalRs. BharatanatyamRs. KathakalakshepamRs. VeenaRs. Violin (solo) NadaswaramRs. FluteRs. JalatharangamRs. GottuvadhyamRs. ClarinetRs. GuitarRs. MandolinRs. Saxophone.

name: Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme
brief_description: "Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme" is an initiative launched by the Jammu & Kashmir State specifically aimed at empowering its young population. Recognizing the challenges faced by unemployed youthRs. this program offers financial assistance to help them embark on their journey towards self-employment. By providing subsidies and facilitating bank loansRs. Mumkin removes a significant financial barrier for aspiring young entrepreneursRs. allowing them to invest in small commercial vehicles and establish themselves within the transportation sector. This not only fosters self-reliance among Jammu & Kashmir's youth but also injects fresh energy and resources into the local economy.
benefits:
- Up to 80Rs. subsidy (or 10% of on-road priceRs. whichever is lower) per beneficiary from Mission Youth.
- Matching subsidy from the vehicle manufacturer (equal to Mission Youth's contribution).
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be domicile of Jammu and Kashmir.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 35 years.
1. Applicant must be unemployed.
1. Applicant must have commercial driving license

- In caseRs. renting a vehicle to someone else : Affidavit required to be submit with his/her commercial driving license

1. Applicant must not be received any financial assistance or subsidy from government organization for self employment.
1. Applicant can get the scheme benefit only at once.

name: Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to conduct health check-ups for male Shramyogis above 45 years of age and female Shram Yogis above 35 years of age who are working in the organized sector in the state of Gujarat. Only those workers (Shramyogi) whos Labour Welfare Fund has been paid regularly by their organization/unit for the last one year will be eligible.
benefits:
1. The scheme provides health check-ups for male Shramyogi above 45 years of age and female Shramyogi above 35 years of age working in the organized sector in the state of Gujarat.

**Note:** A fixed amount of 1950/- per worker for complete medical check-ups and 25% of this amount is 487.50 to be paid by the organization/company.
eligibility:
1. Only those workers (Shramyogis) whose Labour Welfare Fund has been regularly paid by their organization/unit for the last one year will be eligible.
1. The male Shram Yogis above 45 years of age and female Shram Yogis above 35 years of age working in the organized sector will be eligible to avail of the benefits under the scheme.
1. The benefit will be given once a year to the labourers.
1. The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board shall not be responsible for any side effects during/after physical examination.
1. After getting in-principle approval from the office hereRs. the medical examination has to be done within 30 days with the mutual agreement of the company and the hospital.

**Note 01:** The company willing to avail the benefits will have to upload the list (Excel Sheet) in the portal.
**Note 02:** Fees paid under this scheme will not be refunded.
**Note 03:** The final decision regarding the scheme will be with the Welfare Commissioner. The jurisdiction will be Ahmedabad.

name: Anti Bird Net
brief_description: The Anti-Bird Net SchemeRs. an initiative by the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan governmentRs. promotes protected cultivation practices among farmers by providing subsidies for installing low-cost plastic tunnels. The subsidy amount may be capped for each farmerRs. depending on the scheme's provisions and available funds. > **Important points** 1. The work can be started only after the administrative approval/work order is issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. After establishmentRs. verification can be done by the committee formed. 1. The grant amount can be paid directly into the farmer's bank account or to the producing firm based on the written consent of the farmer.
benefits: > **50 percent subsidy is payable for a maximum area of 5000 square meters.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must have ownership of cultivable landRs. his own fruit orchardRs. and an irrigation source.

name: Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers is implemented by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was launched in the year 1986. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the scheduled castes to purchase agricultural landRs. with a maximum limit of 2 acresRs. for self-cultivation. This initiative aims to enhance their incomeRs. particularly considering the dependence of many scheduled caste individuals on farm labour.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. Scheduled caste farmers are provided with financial assistance of 1Rs./- per acre to purchase agricultural land.
1. Assistance is provided up to 2Rs./- for a maximum of 2 acres to enable the purchase of agricultural land.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes Category.
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant must be an agricultural labourer.
1. The annual income limit will be 6Rs./- for rural areas and 6Rs./- for urban areas.
1. Excluding government assistanceRs. only the beneficiary who is able to purchase the land is eligible for the benefit.
1. Only one member of the family is eligible for the benefit.
1. Beneficiaries of land acquired with government assistance will be subject to non-sale for 15 years.
1. Under this schemeRs. assistance will be available for purchasing agricultural land from government or private individuals.

name: Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training
brief_description: The scheme Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training is administered by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was commenced in the year 1987 with the objective to provide financial assistance to bright Scheduled Castes Students who want to undergo training for commercial pilot license. Loan assistance is provided to all eligible Scheduled Castes candidates who are unable to afford training for a commercial pilot license due to poor economic conditions.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. a loan of 25 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to the eligible candidates.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category of Gujarat State.
1. A candidate seeking to undergo Commercial Pilot License Training must have passed Matriculation or Higher Secondary School Certificate or its equivalent examination and must possess all the academic and technical qualifications required by the institute in which the candidate intends to undergo training for admission to the Commercial Pilot License Training Course.
1. The country/abroad institution providing such training should have obtained the conditions laid down for the admission of the trainee and all the necessary documents for such training such as a medical certificateRs. fitness certificateRs. etc.
1. The institute in which the trainee receives his training abroad must be approved by the government of his country for imparting such training and the commercial pilot license obtained after such training must be accepted in that countryRs. after which the trainee must undergo a legal process of one year to get that license accepted in India.
1. The assistance will be sanctioned only after receiving the consent letter from the training institute for admission of the candidate; the trainee will have to submit the cost estimates for his training obtained from that institute.
1. If any of the relatives of the candidate desiring to undergo such training are living abroadRs. the trainees should not be sponsored for financial responsibility by them.
1. The applicant shall be free to repay the due amount earlier than the due date.
1. If the applicant uses this loan for any other purposeRs. the loan amount will be recovered from the date of repayment (together with penal interest).
1. The beneficiary has to furnish two valid sureties.

**Note 01:** After completion of training the beneficiary will have to render his services in India for a minimum period of five years. If they settle abroadRs. the entire amount of such assistance will have to be returned to the Government of Gujarat with interest. There will be no relaxation in this.
**Note 02:** The amount provided under this scheme will be limited to the amount actually required for training. The amount for training in India will include tuition fees and other incidental expenses. The decision of the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste Welfare in this matter shall be final.
**Note 03:** The amount of assistance will be paid at the rate of exchange fixed by the Reserve Bank of India while disbursing the amount under this scheme to the trainees who wish to undergo training abroad. And the allowances of the trainees will also have to be approved by the Reserve Bank. Loans can be sanctioned to the extent that the Reserve Bank approves tuition feesRs. subsistence allowance (for a maximum of six months)Rs. and allowance for start-up equipment.
**Note 04:** The trainee should actually start the training within one month from the date of disbursement of the loan amount. The training should be obtained from the institution and also a quarterly report by the trainee on the progress of his training submitted to the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. GandhinagarRs. Gujarat.
**Note 05:** If the applicant defaults in regular repayment of the loan sanctionedRs. a penal interest at the rate of 2.5% per annum will be charged against the outstanding installments. In case of default in payment of penalty installmentsRs. all costs and other costs of recovery of the sheet as well as the balance will be recovered from the Revenue together.
**Note 06:** Loan recovery will be started after one year from the date of disbursement of the loan to the beneficiary. The beneficiary will have to pay back the loan in 10 years with principal and interest in 2 yearsRs. total amount including interest in 12 years. AccordinglyRs. the monthly installment amount will be calculated and recovered.

name: Scheme for Small Business Owners of Scheduled Castes to Buy a Place of Business/Shop
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Small Business Owners of Scheduled Castes to Buy a Place of Business/Shop" was launched by the Director of Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of GujaratRs. in the year 1991. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of loans and subsidies is provided by banks to individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. This assistance is aimed at enabling them to purchase business premises or shops in urban areas for business development.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a maximum loan of 10 lakhs will be available to the beneficiary belonging to the scheduled caste category to buy a business premises/shop in the urban area. The beneficiary will bear interest up to 4%Rs. while any bank interest payable above 4% will be covered by the government as an interest subsidy for three years.
1. 15000/- is also given as subsidy assistance under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. There is no income limit.
1. Loan assistance is given to the beneficiary only for the purpose of shop or business at one place.
1. The subsidy will be paid after three months of shop opening.
1. The benefits of this scheme will be given first priority to educated unemployedRs. unemployed mill workersRs. persons with technical & professional experience and self-employed persons with qualifications.
1. Loans/assistance are also provided for shops/business premises allotted on long-term rent by the State Government or State Government owned Boards/CorporationsRs. Urban Development AuthoritiesRs. Local Self Government BodiesRs. or Gram/Nagar Panchayats. HoweverRs. the shop/business premises will have to be mortgaged to the government till the loan amount for the allotted shop/business premises is repaid.
1. If the applicant constructs on his own landRs. he will have to submit proof that the title of his land is clearedRs. and the land is' uncultivated '.
1. Applicants desirous of availing the benefit of this scheme have to provide security of a maximum of two local persons having immovable property equal to the full amount of the loan.

**Note 01:** The place of business/shop purchased with the loan assistance obtained under this scheme should be in accordance with the land rules and construction rules and if any defect is found in this regardRs. the amount of loan/assistance sanctioned will be recovered through revenue if necessary.
**Note 02:** The loan/assistance sanctioned to the applicant can be used only for the purpose for which it was sanctionedRs. failing which the entire sanctioned amount along with the penal interest will be recovered.
**Note 03:** The applicant shall be free to repay the loan installments and interest earlier than the due date.
**Note 04:** Any type of illegal activity shall not be allowed in the business place/shop purchased by obtaining a loan/assistance under this scheme.
**Note 05**: Loan and interest defaulters will be charged 2.5% more as penal interest and the outstanding loan amount can also be recovered as land revenue arrears.

name: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance to Industrial Workers/Employee for Purchase of Spectacles
brief_description: The "Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance to Industrial Workers/Employee for Purchase of Spectacles" by the Goa Labour Welfare BoardRs. Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. GoaRs. aims to provide financial aid to industrial workers/employees for acquiring spectacles. Through this schemeRs. assistance is extended to enhance the vision of eligible workers.
benefits:
- A financial assistance of up to 2Rs. is provided to cover the cost of the frame and lens of the spectacle (If the expenses exceed this amountRs. the worker/employee will have to bear the additional cost).
- Replacement of spectacles is allowed only after five years after the initial purchase. HoweverRs. if the lens power requires a changeRs. replacement can be done after one yearRs. with expenses not exceeding 400.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an industrial worker/employee covered under clause (C) of Section 2 of the GoaRs. Daman and Diu Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1986.
- The applicant should have completed one year of service in the industrial establishment on the date of applicationRs. including broken spells of service.
- The applicant should get their eyes tested in the State Hospitals or the Goa Medical College or by a qualified Optician.
- The applicant should obtain the lens (s) number for the spectacles.

name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Reimbursement of Tuition Fees to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM studying in Government-recognized Institutions are provided reimbursement of their tuition fees. The application should be submitted offline within three months from the date of completion of the education.
benefits:
> **Monthly Stipend (in ) According to the Level of Qualification**


- School: 1Rs..
- Military/Sainik Schools: 2Rs..
- School for Special Children: 2Rs..
- Diploma in Polytechnic: 800.
- NDA/IMA (National Defence Academy/Indian Military Academy): 2Rs..
- Bachelor Degree: 1Rs..
- Master Degree: 1Rs..
- Professional Course (MBBS/BE/BTech) (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery / Bachelor of Engineering / Bachelor of Technology): 2Rs..

****The rate listed above or the actual cost of the feeRs. whichever is lessRs. is reimbursed.***
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Ward of an Unemployed ESM / Ward of the Widow of an ESM.
- The applicant should be registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.
- The Ward should be studying in a Government-recognized Institution.
- The scheme is applicable for upto two wards of the Unemployed ESM / Widow of an ESM.

name: Death Benefit (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Death Benefit (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the nominee/dependant of the deceased worker is provided with financial assistance. The death should have either been natural or caused due to an accidentRs. during the course of employment. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 30Rs./-Rs. if the death was natural.
- Financial Assistance of 1Rs./-Rs. if the death was due to an accidentRs. during the course of employment.
eligibility:
- The deceased should have been a Worker.
- The deceased should have been between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The deceased should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker.
- The deceased should have been registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be the nominee/dependant of the deceased.
- The death of the worker should have either been natural or caused due to an accident during the course of employment.
- The nominee/dependant of the unregistered workers shall be eligible upon the production of a certificate from the builder or Inspector of the area stating that the deceased was a building worker.

name: Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship
brief_description: The Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship under the Higher Education Department of the Madhya Pradesh government is to support students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds in pursuing higher education. SpecificallyRs. it aims to alleviate financial constraints by covering tuition feesRs. maintenance allowancesRs. and other educational expenses. it aims to empower deserving students to excel academically and professionallyRs. fostering their socio-economic development and contributing to the overall advancement of society.
benefits:
1. Hostel students receive a subsistence allowance of 1Rs. per month.
1. Non-hostel residents are provided with a subsistence allowance of 650 per month.

> **Reimbursement of mandatory and non-refundable fees.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant Should be studying in graduate/post-graduate courses.
1. The maximum annual income of the guardian should be 2Rs./- for post-matric and 6Rs./- for top class.
1. The applicant has 40 percent or more disability.

name: Pension To Widows And Destitute Women-Chandigarh
brief_description:
The Pension to Widows And Destitute Women scheme under the Social WelfareRs. Women & Child Development Department of Chandigarh Goverment provides financial assistance to widows and destitute women to alleviate their economic hardship and provide a semblance of stability in their lives. This support often comes in the form of monthly stipends or welfare programs designed to meet their basic needsRs. including foodRs. shelterRs. and healthcare. By extending financial aidRs. governments or charitable organizations seek to empower these vulnerable individuals to become more self-reliant and regain their footing in society.
AdditionallyRs. such assistance may include access to vocational training or educational opportunities to enhance their skills and employabilityRs. fostering long-term independence. UltimatelyRs. these initiatives contribute to fostering social inclusion and reducing poverty among widows and destitute womenRs. ensuring they have the necessary support to rebuild their lives with dignity.
benefits: > **Pension Amount To Widows And Destitute Women - 1Rs./- per month**
eligibility:
1. The applicant women's age should be 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should be a resident of UTRs. Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-

name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons
brief_description: In recognition of the distinct considerations inherent in marriages where one partner is visually impairedRs. the "Marriage Assistance Scheme for Individuals Marrying Visually Impaired Persons" provides targeted financial assistance. This program aims to mitigate potential economic burdens associated with visual impairmentRs. such as the requirement for specialized equipment or additional support services. This intervention not only fosters a more inclusive social environment but also empowers couples to embark on their marital journey with greater financial stabilityRs. thus solidifying the foundation for a prosperous and fulfilling union. FurthermoreRs. the program serves as a testament to societal acceptance of diverse family structuresRs. celebrating the richness that such diversity brings to the community. By alleviating potential financial barriersRs. the scheme encourages the formation of strong and enduring relationships between individualsRs. irrespective of their visual abilities.
benefits:
1. Marriage assistance amount: 25Rs./- as

- 12Rs./- National Savings Certificate.
- 12Rs./- cheque/Demand Draft for marriage expenses.

1. Additional benefit if either spouse has a degree/diploma: Increased amount to 50Rs./-

- 25Rs./- National Savings Certificate.
- 25Rs./- cheque/Demand Draft.

1. Other Benefits:

- Certificate of appreciation.
- 8 gram gold coin for Tirumangalyam (a traditional South Indian symbol of marriage for women).
eligibility:
1. A normal person should marry a speech and visually impaired person. 1. The age of the couple (both) should be above 18 years.
> **Additional Eligibility:** 1. The normal person and visually impaired person individuals holding a degree or diploma are eligible to receive increased assistance.

name: Sant Surdas Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Sant Surdas Scheme" was launched by the Director Social DefenceRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. monthly financial assistance is provided to Persons with Disabilities aged between 0 and 17 yearsRs. who have a disability of more than 80% and are registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. a monthly assistance of 1Rs./- is paid to the beneficiary by the State Government through DBT.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should be 0 to 17 years age group.
1. Percentage of disability of 80 or more or those who cannot move even with help of artificial limbs independently.
1. The applicant should be registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list and BPL score is up to 20.
1. The benefit of this scheme is eligible to the disabled person of Gujarat living under the Below Poverty Line (disabled person included in the BPL from the Ministry of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of India for the rural area and the Ministry of Housing & Urban Poverty AlleviationRs. Government of India for the urban area) are eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The applicant should be possessing disability card issued by state government.

**Note:** The amount of assistance will be stopped when the applicant/beneficiary reached age of 18 years.

name: Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons
brief_description: The "Maintenance Allowance Scheme for Intellectually Disabled PersonsRs." implemented by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil NaduRs. addresses the distinct needs of this population group. This program offers a targeted form of monthly financial assistanceRs. ensuring greater financial security for those diagnosed with a significant intellectual disability. The scheme not only promotes their well-being but also fosters their increased participation within their communities. This initiative underscores the government's dedication to building a more inclusive societyRs. one where every individualRs. regardless of their intellectual abilitiesRs. has the opportunity to flourish. By providing this crucial supportRs. the program empowers intellectually disabled persons to achieve greater independence and lead more fulfilling lives.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 2Rs./- per month. **NOTE:** The allowance is sent through ECS to their accounts directly from the Treasury.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an intellectually disabled person.
1. The percentage of disability should be 40% and above.

name: Pension Benefit for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Pension Benefit for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. the registered workers of the board are provided with a pension benefit of 3000/- per month after completion of 60 years. An increase of 300/- shall be given for every completed year of membership beyond 5 years.
benefits:
- 3000/- per month after completion of 60 years.
- An increase of 300/- shall be given for every completed year of membership beyond five years.
eligibility: **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. **For Application** - The applicant should be working as a building worker for not less than one year. - The applicant should have completed 60 years of age.

name: Disability Pension for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Disability Pension for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. disability pension of 3000/- per month is provided to the permanently disabled members due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. T.B and accidents etc.
benefits: - 3Rs./- per month as disability pension to permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. T.B.Rs. accident etc. available from the date of registration.
eligibility: **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. **For Application** - The applicant should be permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. T.B.Rs. accident etc.

name: Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to the nominees/dependents of the members in case of natural death of the worker. This assistance is available for all construction workers working on the construction site.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to the nominees/dependents of the members in case of natural death of the worker.
eligibility: > **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. > **For Application** - The nominees/dependents who has lost any registered member/worker of the due to natural death.

name: Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to the nominees/dependents of the members in case the death is due to an accidentRs. during the course of employment.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to the nominees/dependents of the members in case the death is due to an accidentRs. during the course of employment.
eligibility:
> **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application** - The nominees/dependents who have lost any registered member/worker of the due to an accidental death.

name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category) is implemented by the Directorate of Animal HusbandryRs. AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is given to dairy farmers belonging to the General Caste category on purchase of electric powered chaff cutters. By using power driven chaff cutterRs. dairy farmers can reduce wastage of green and dry fodder which is economically important for their profitable dairy farming.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance up to 75% of the purchase cost of powered chaff cutter or 18Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. is given to beneficiaries belonging to General category.

**Note:** The amount of assistance will be deposited in bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the General Caste category.
1. The beneficiary should have a minimum of five (5) animals of his/her own.

name: Scheme of Personal Assistance Allowance to Differently Abled Persons with High Support Need
brief_description: The "Scheme of Personal Assistance Allowance to Differently Abled Persons with High Support Need" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a personal assistance allowance of 1Rs./- to differently abled persons who need assistance for their activities of daily living. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits:
Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month.
> **NOTE:** The amount sent through ECS directly to the beneficiarys bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a differently abled person.
1. The differently abled person wants high support needs.

name: Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
brief_description: The scheme Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SCSP) is implemented by the Directorate of Animal HusbandryRs. AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. the financial assistance is given to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries for construction of Cattle Shed for 2 animals.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of either 30Rs./- or 50% of the cost of the cattle shedRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries for the construction of a cattle shed for two animals.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The beneficiary should possess the necessary land to his or her name or he/she should borrowed land on rent either up to ten year (10) or for more than ten year as well as necessary animals.
1. Only those beneficiaries of scheduled castes keeping at least 2 (two) animals can only get the benefit of this scheme.

name: Early Intervention Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy in SRTC, Chennai and Tiruchirapalli Districts
brief_description: The "Early Intervention Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy in SRTCRs. Chennai and Tiruchirapalli Districts" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. stimulation training is given to the children affected with cerebral palsy in the age group of below 6 years. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - Early intervention provides stimulation training to the children.
eligibility:
1. The young child/infants should be affected with cerebral palsy.
1. The age of a young child/infant should be 6 years or below.

name: Dhobhi Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh introduced the "Dhobhi Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana" on January 10Rs. 2018Rs. through the "Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board." Under this schemeRs. the washerman is provided with materials worth Rs. 1Rs./-Rs. including electronic/coal ironRs. clothespinsRs. and a washing paddle (Thappi/Kutela).
benefits: - Provided materials worth 1Rs./-Rs. including electronic/coal ironRs. clothespinsRs. and a washing paddle (Thappi/Kutela).
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be registered Unorganized worker of State Social Security Board.
1. The applicant should be a Dhobhi.
1. Applicant age must be between 18 to 60 years.

name: Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Government Institute for the Mentally RetardedRs.Chennai' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. children with intellectual disability are given special educationRs. vocational trainingRs. foodRs. uniformsRs. boardingRs. medicineRs. and lodging facilities. The children are also imparted training in daily living skills.
benefits: **The children are also imparted training in daily living skills and below benefits are provided to children with intellectual disability :** - Special educationRs. - Vocational trainingRs. - FoodRs. - UniformsRs. - BoardingRs. - MedicineRs. - Lodging facilities.
eligibility:
1. The child should have an intellectual disability.
1. The age of the child should be between 4 to 18 years.

name: Multimedia Training - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Multimedia Training by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. One month multimedia training is given to locomotor and hearing impaired persons at the National Institute of Film Development CorporationRs. Regional centre in Chennai.
benefits: - Multimedia training is given to locomotor and hearing-impaired persons at the National Institute of Film Development CorporationRs. Regional centre in Chennai.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a hearing impaired and locomotor differently abled person.
1. The applicant should have passed the 8th standard.

name: Kanyadaan Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Kanyadaan Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance in the form of Kanyadaan to registered construction workers on the occasion of the marriage of their daughters. This assistance is available for up to three daughters of the worker.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. registered workers are being provided financial assistance of 51Rs./- as Kanyadaan on the marriage of their daughters.

**Note:** Financial assistance of 50Rs./- is also provided by the Board for arranging the marriage of the daughter of a registered workerRs. for which a separate online application is mandatory. HenceRs. 51Rs./- (Kanyadaan Scheme) + 50Rs./- on the marriage of the daughter of the beneficiary. Total financial assistance of 1Rs./- on the marriage of children (daughter) is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one years regular membership.
1. The registered member must have worked for 90 days as a Building and Other Construction Worker during the preceding twelve months.
1. The worker must have paid up-to-date contributions.
1. The benefit is payable upto the marriage of three daughters only.
1. The applicant should submit all the documents within one year after the marriage.
1. The applicant should not avail of this assistance from any other government department/board/corporation.

**Note 01:** The worker has to produce a work experience certificate duly verified by the prescribed authorities.
**Note 02:** The worker has to upload the Marriage Certificate of the daughter.
**Note 03:** The worker/applicant shall submit the undertaking prescribed by the Board.

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Nirman Shramik Sammaan Yojana (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Mahila Nirman Shramik Sammaan Yojana is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. registered female workersRs. who have a minimum of one years regular membershipRs. are being provided financial assistance of 5100/- for the purchase of SareeRs. SuitRs. SlippersRs. RaincoatRs. UmbrellaRs. Sanitary NapkinRs. and Kitchen utensilsRs. etc. This benefit is being given every year at the time of renewal of the membership.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. registered female workers are being provided financial assistance of 5100/- for the purchase of SareeRs. suitsRs. SlippersRs. raincoatsRs. UmbrellaRs. Sanitary Napkins and Kitchen UtensilsRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a woman engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered woman worker must have a minimum one-year regular membership.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be given to the registered female worker on renewal of her membership every year.

name: Mukhyamantri Shramik Aujaar Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh launched the "Mukhyamantri Shramik Aujaar Sahayata Yojana" on October 1Rs. 2010Rs. through the Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this schemeRs. 10Rs. tool kits are distributed annually to registered construction workersRs. including masonsRs. electriciansRs. plumbersRs. carpentersRs. portersRs. paintersRs. and othersRs. who have been registered with the board for a minimum of 90 days.
benefits: > **Tool kits can given free of cost to the registered construction worker.**
eligibility:
1. The Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The beneficiary should be a construction worker.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The age of the registered worker should not be less than 18 years.

name: Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism
brief_description: The "Early Intervention Centres for Children with Autism" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. Early intervention programme emphasizes attending to social stimuliRs. imitation skillsRs. language comprehension and usageRs. appropriate play skills etc.Rs. EIC centers have been established at SRTC-Chennai and other locationsRs. including RSRTC-TiruchirapalliRs. TirunelveliRs. KanniyakumariRs. ThanjavurRs. KancheepuramRs. ThiruvallurRs. SalemRs. NamakkalRs. MaduraiRs. ErodeRs. CoimbatoreRs. VelloreRs. ThuthukudiRs. VillupuramRs. VirudhunagarRs. CuddaloreRs. DindigulRs. and Thiruvannamalai. There is a need for early intervention to effectively combat the incidence of autism.
benefits: - Early intervention helps children with Autism by addressing social stimuliRs. imitation skillsRs. language comprehension and usageRs. and appropriate play skills.
eligibility:
1. A beneficiary child should be between 0-6 years old.

name: Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
