brief_description:
The "Scheme for Celebration of Birth/Death Anniversary of Eminent Personalities" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of SC / ST / OBC / MinoritiesRs. Government of NCT of Delhi. The scheme aims to assist in the organization of events for the Birth/Death anniversaries of prominent figures who have significantly contributed to social justice and the upliftment of weaker sections of society.
The programs that may be organized to celebrate the Birth/Death Anniversary of Dr. B.R. AmbedkarRs. Sant RavidasRs. and Maharishi Balmiki are indicated below as an illustration: 1. Appropriate Cultural Programmed. 1. A conference or symposium on themes like - Life & Work of the Great Saint. - Contribution of eminent personality to Social Justice. - Road map for building a society based on the principles of social justiceRs. equityRs. equality of opportunityRs. etc. - Other related subjects. 1. A quiz/debate/essay competition etc. on the life and work of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar for the promotion of social justiceRs. for its students. The winners to be given cash prize along with a book(s) on Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar.
benefits:
- Assistance for the arrangements of celebrations up to a maximum of 50Rs./- per occasionRs. for a maximum of two occasions in one year.

**Note:** Assistance for the celebration of Birth/Death Anniversaries of Dr. B.R. AmbedkarRs. Sant RavidasRs. and Maharishi Balmiki will be provided through empaneled agencies.
eligibility:
1. The NGOs should be registered under the Societies Registration Act.
1. The registered NGOs should have audited accounts.

name: Financial Assistance to Disabled Ex-Servicemen
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Disabled Ex-Servicemen" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month shall be granted only to those Disabled Ex-Servicemen who are bonafide residents of Haryana StateRs. irrespective of ageRs. who were discharged from the Armed Forces on medical groundsRs. and whose disability is not attributable to service.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month is given to the disabled ex-servicemenRs. with an annual increase of 400/- w.e.f. 01.11.2017 every year in November.

**Note:** The grant of financial assistance shall be payable to the disabled Ex-Servicemen from the first day of the following month in which case for grant of financial assistance is sanctioned by the competent sanctioning authority of Rajya Sainik Board and no arrear for the post-period prior to the date of sanction of the grant of financial assistance shall be paid.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be a disabled ex-serviceman.
1. The applicant should have been discharged from the Armed Forces on medical groundsRs. with a disability not attributable to military service.
1. The financial assistance is provided regardless of the applicant's age.
1. The applicant should not be receiving any type of financial assistance or pension from any source.

**Note 1:** The definition of Ex-Servicemen for the purpose of eligibility for financial assistance shall be effective as notified by the Ministry of Defence Government of India from time to time.
**Note 2:** Every applicant shall have to produce a certificate issued by the concerned District Social Welfare Officer to the effect that the applicant is not getting any financial assistance Pension from the District Social Welfare Department of Haryana.
**Note 3:** If any beneficiary receiving financial assistance under this schemeRs. after the sanction of financial assistance at any time is found getting old age pensionRs. financial assistance or maintenance allowance from any other Department of Haryana Govt. Beneficiary shall be permanently debarred from getting the financial assistance under this scheme run by this department
**Note 4:** Old eligible beneficiaries whose cases for grant of financial assistance have already been sanctioned prior to issue of these guidelines shall continue to get the financial assistance at enhanced rates and they need not apply afresh. HoweverRs. payment shall be discontinued with immediate effect to persons in civil employment.
**Note 5:** Payment of financial assistance to those beneficiaries shall be stopped immediately who fail to submit their survival verification proofs every year from the revenue authorities in the month of April. The SecretaryRs. Zila Sainik Board shall be personally responsible for any lapse in this regard.

name: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana" was launched by the Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to motivate girls towards educationRs. the scheme is being implemented to increase the interest of girls of scheduled tribes in the state towards education as well as to make them get education in more and more upcoming classes. Under this schemeRs. girls in Class 11th who have passed their 10th class examination will receive 3Rs./- per year as a monetary incentive.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. all girls belonging to Scheduled Tribes who have passed Class 10th and are entering Class 11th will receive an incentive amount of 3Rs./- per year.

**Note:** The incentive amount will be paid into the bank accounts of the girl students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The girl student should be a native/resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The applicant should be a regular student.
1. All girls who have passed Class 10th and are entering Class 11th are eligible for the scheme.

name: Financial Assistance to War Widows of Defence Forces
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to War Widows of Defence Forces" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month shall be granted to widows of Defence Force personnel (ArmyRs. NavyRs. and Air Force) who were killed in action during the declared wars of 1962Rs. 1965Rs. and 1971Rs. in addition to the family pension they are already receiving from the Government of India.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month is given to the widow of an ex-serviceman whose husband died in action during the declared wars of 1962Rs. 1965Rs. and 1971Rs. with an annual increase of 400/- w.e.f. 01.11.2017 every year in November.

**Note:** This financial assistance is provided in addition to the family pension already getting from the Government of India.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must be the widow of Defence Force personnel (ArmyRs. NavyRs. or Air Force) who was killed in action during the declared wars of 1962Rs. 1965Rs. or 1971.

name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
brief_description: The scheme "Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme" was launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. to motivate students from lower economic backgrounds and support them economically. Under this schemeRs. a cash award of 5Rs./- is given to the students who have obtained the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district. To be eligible for this benefitRs. the annual income of the student's parents must be less than 1Rs./-.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. students who achieve the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district will receive 5Rs./-.

**Note:** The scholarship is sent directly to the student's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student must have achieved the highest marks in their district in the Class 12 examination.
1. The student must have passed their Class 12 examination from a government school in Madhya Pradesh (Government Higher Secondary School).
1. The student's parents' income from all sources should be less than 1Rs./- per year.

name: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Pension for Women in Distress
brief_description: The scheme "Pension for Women in Distress" is a sub-component of the Integrated Social Security Scheme (IGSSS) implemented by the Social and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month is provided as a pension to destitute widowsRs. divorcedRs. or deserted women with no source of income.
benefits: **Amount of financial assistance/pension:** 1Rs./- per month per beneficiary
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Ladakh.
1. The applicant should be a distressed womanRs. such as a destituteRs. separatedRs. divorcedRs. or widow.
1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant's age should be between 40 and 79 years.
1. The applicant should have no source of income.

name: Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi
brief_description: The "Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi" was launched by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to provide facilities for residential and other facilities such as waterRs. reimbursement of electricity expenditureRs. scholarshipRs. etc. for scheduled caste students of Madhya Pradesh studying in higher institutions located in Delhi. Hostel facility will be limited only to scheduled castes and students of Madhya Pradesh studying in Delhi metropolis. This facility will be made available in hostels of various universities/colleges located in Delhi.
benefits:
Financial assistance is available for students from Madhya Pradesh who are pursuing higher education at institutions (universities and colleges) in Delhi. The assistance covers the following:

- **Monthly rent:** 1Rs./- per month - **Scholarship:** 500/- per month - **Water and electricity expenses:** 100/- per month - **One-time grant (at the time of admission):** 2Rs./-
**Note:** Payments are made into the bank accounts of the applicants.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a regular student currently enrolled in or admitted to an undergraduate (first year) or higher classRs. or professional course at a government or recognized institution located in Delhi.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.

name: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)
brief_description: The "State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)" schemeRs. launched by the Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students and improve their educational status. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10. To be eligibleRs. students must be natives of Madhya Pradesh and belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. There is no restriction on the annual family income of the students.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. scholarships will be provided to Scheduled Tribe students at the following rates:

- For Classes 9 to 10: 600/- per year for boys and 1Rs./- per year for girls.

**Note:** The scholarship amount will be transferred directly into the student's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should be studying in Class 9 or Class 10.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. There is no restriction on the students' annual family income.

**Note 1:** The students will be eligible for scholarships even if they fail for 1 year.
**Note 2:** Reapplication is not required for the renewal of the scholarship.

name: State Marriage Assistance Scheme
brief_description: "The 'State Marriage Assistance SchemeRs.' launched by the Department of Social and Tribal WelfareRs. UT LadakhRs. aims to provide one-time financial assistance of 50Rs./- to female beneficiaries from AAY or PHH ration cardholder families. AdditionallyRs. Divyangjan beneficiaries receive 1Rs./-. Applications can be submitted through the District or Tehsil Social Welfare Officer in Leh or Kargil."
benefits:
- One-time financial assistance of 50Rs./- shall be given to female beneficiaries.
- Financial assistance of 1Rs./- has been given to Divyangjan beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to Antodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration cardholder families.
1. The bride and bridegroom should be permanent residents of Ladakh
1. The bride should be above 18 years of age.
1. The bridegroom should be above 21 years of age.
1. The marriage should be the first marriage between the bride and the groom.
1. The divyangjan applicants with benchmark disabilities as defined in The Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016 are eligible.

name: Pratibha Yojana
brief_description: The "Pratibha Yojana" was launched by the Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh on 01.09.2016 to encourage talented students of the Scheduled Tribe Category for higher education. This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed national competitive examinations such as JEERs. NEETRs. CLATRs. AIIMSRs. & NDA and have taken admission in IITRs. NITRs. NLURs. MBBS (government colleges located in Madhya Pradesh)Rs. AIIMS or NDA.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. eligible students are provided with the following incentives:

- A financial assistance of 50Rs./- is provided to students whose annual parental income is up to 3Rs./-.
- A financial assistance of 25Rs./- is provided to students whose annual parental income exceeds 3Rs./-.

**Note:** The incentive amount is paid into the applicants bank account linked to Aadhaar.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.
1. The student should have qualified in any of the National Competitive Examinations such as JEERs. NEETRs. CLATRs. AIIMSRs. or NDA.
1. The applicant should have been admitted to one of the following institutions:


- IIT/NIT through JEE
- Government colleges in Madhya Pradesh for NEET (MBBS only)
- AIIMS
- NLU through CLAT
- NDA through UPSC

**Note 1:** The applicant's Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account.
**Note 2:** The applicant must have the receipt of admission to the institute.

name: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
brief_description: The "Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery'' scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance as medical expenses for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from CancerRs. Heart diseaseRs. Kidney diseaseRs. T.B.Rs. Eye diseaseRs. Leprosy and Nerve disease. For the operation of diseases in case of HeartRs. Kidney etc. the Board may sanction a higher amount.
benefits:
- **Quantum of Assistance:** Upto a maximum amount of 20Rs./- Per Annum.
**Note:** For the operation of diseases like HeartRs. Kidney etc. the Board may sanction a maximum amount of 60Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
- The member or his/ her dependents should suffer from Cancer/ Heart disease/ Kidney disease/ T.B./ Eye disease/ Leprosy/ Nerve disease.

name: Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana
brief_description:
The "Niji Talabon Ka Jirnoddhar Ki Yojana" was launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The scheme specifically allocates resources for extremely backward castesRs. scheduled castesRs. and scheduled tribesRs. ensuring inclusive growth and support for marginalized communities. Under the schemeRs. the target is to renovate 150.00 hectares of private ponds.
> ***Objectives:*** - **Increase Water Holding Capacity:** Enhance the water holding capacity of private ponds to boost fish productivity and production. - **Economic Benefits for Fish Farmers:** Provide benefits to private fish farmers through the expansion/renovation of their ponds.
> ***Model of Pond Restoration:*** - **Model-1:** Renovation of old private ponds (not renovated under any government scheme in the last five years).- **Model-2:** Renovation of private ponds constructed under government schemes (benefits payable after five years of construction).
benefits:
**Renovation of 150 hectares of private ponds with the following category-specific targets:** - Other category beneficiaries: 86 hectares - Extremely backward castes: 27 hectares - Scheduled castes: 30 hectares - Scheduled tribes: 7 hectares
**Subsidy Details:** - Unit cost: 6Rs./- per hectare. - Subsidy: 30% for other categoriesRs. 40% for extremely backward castes/scheduled castes/tribes. **NOTE:** Subsidy disbursement in two installments based on completion of work.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a fish farmer.
1. The applicant should be private pond owners or lessees.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Anusoochit Jaati Evam Anusoochit Janajati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana was launched by the SC and ST Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar aims to provide 1Rs./- per month to the students studying in Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe hostels. Under this schemeRs. the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students studying in hostels are given the facility of a cotRs. mattressRs. bed-sheetRs. table and chair for studyingRs. utensils for cooking and kitchenRs. etc. In this sequenceRs. to increase the facilities being provided to the students and make the students from the weaker sections of society aware of higher education increasing the rate of higher education and fulfilling the hostel-related needs of the students.
benefits: - **Grant of 1Rs./- per month.**
eligibility:
1. The student should be a resident of Bihar state.
1. The student belongs to the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe.
1. The student should be enrolled and reside in hostels following the departmental guidelines and instructions operated by the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare Department.
1. The student should be studying in a recognized course.
1. The student should be studying in a recognized educational institution.

name: Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker
brief_description: The Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Department Tripura launched the "Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker". Under rule 282 (Other Welfare Measures) of the Tripura State Building and Other Construction Workers (RE & CS) Rules 2001Rs. the scheme for funeral Assistance in case of the death of registered construction workers is made.
benefits:
- **A one-time grant of 10Rs./- is provided for the expenses of the funeral ceremony.**

**NOTE:** The amount of benefit payable by the BOARD shall be paid through DBT mode.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a nomineeRs. spouseRs. or dependent of the deceased registered worker.
1. The registered construction workers should not have any dues payable to the Board.

name: Research Scholarship for Disabled Students
brief_description:
The "Research Scholarship for Disabled Students" schemeRs. implemented by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. offers financial support for PhD research to differently-abled students. Eligible candidates receive 16Rs./- per monthRs. totaling 1Rs./- per yearRs. which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.
To qualifyRs. candidates should be natives of Madhya Pradesh and registered for PhD research at any recognized university in IndiaRs. following an interview with the Research Degree Committee. They must also hold a postgraduate degree with minimum qualifying marks as per University Grants Commission (UGC) guidelines. The scholarship is awarded to 10 students pursuing their research degrees each year.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. differently-abled students who are registered for PhD research at any university in India receive a monthly scholarship of 16Rs./-Rs. totaling 1Rs./- per year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a disabled student.
1. The applicant should be registered for PhD research work at any recognized university in IndiaRs. following an interview with the Research Degree Committee.
1. The applicant should have obtained minimum qualifying marks in their postgraduate degree as specified by the University Grants Commission.
1. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed 1Rs./-.
1. Every yearRs. 10 students are awarded scholarships for their PhD research.

name: Sanskrit Scholarship
brief_description: The "Sanskrit Scholarship" schemeRs. implemented by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to promote the Sanskrit language by providing financial assistance to students. Under this schemeRs. students studying Sanskrit at various levelsPost Graduate (M.A. Classic)Rs. AcharyaRs. Graduate (B.A. Classic)Rs. ShastriRs. Uttar MadhyamaRs. Purva MadhyamaRs. and Prathamain any government or aided non-government college receive a monthly scholarship of 300/- for 10 months. To be eligibleRs. students must be natives of Madhya Pradesh and have a family income not exceeding 54Rs./- per year. Selection of students is made within the prescribed quota limits.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. students studying Sanskrit at various levels will receive scholarships as follows:
**Sl. No.****Type of Scholarship****Amount Per month****Quota**1Post Graduate (M.A. Classic)300/-72Acharya300/-73Graduate (B.A. Classic)300/-114Shastri300/-185Uttar Madhyama300/-336Purva Madhyama300/-337Prathama300/-91**Note 1:** The amount is transferred directly to the applicant's bank account.
**Note 2:** The scholarship is provided for 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The students studying Sanskrit at various levelsPost Graduate (M.A. Classic)Rs. AcharyaRs. Graduate (B.A. Classic)Rs. ShastriRs. Uttar MadhyamaRs. Purva MadhyamaRs. and Prathamain any government or aided non-government college.
1. The annual family income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed 54Rs./-.
1. The applicant's Academic Qualifications should be one of the following:


- Post Graduate: 50% marks in degree examination.
- Acharya: 50% marks in Shastri or equivalent examination.
- Graduate: 50% marks in 10+2 or equivalent examination.
- Shastri: 45% marks in Purva Madhyama.
- Uttar Madhyama: 45% marks in Prathma or equivalent.
- Purva Madhyama: On the basis of merit in the 5th examination.

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme - Telangana
brief_description: The "Marriage Gift Scheme" is a welfare initiative implemented by the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (TB&OCWWB)Rs. LET&F (Labour) DepartmentRs. Telangana. The scheme provides financial assistance to registered women workersRs. as well as the wives and daughters of registered workersRs. to support them during and after pregnancy.
benefits:
> ***Financial Assistance:***


- A total amount of 30Rs./- per delivery is providedRs. limited to two deliveries.

> ***Payment Breakdown:***


- 10Rs./- is paid during the 7th month of pregnancy to compensate for wage loss during the later stages of pregnancy.- 20Rs./- is paid after the delivery.
eligibility:
> **For construction workers themselves (Women only)** 1. The construction worker should be registered under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The construction worker should be a woman. 1. The construction worker should have been registered for at least 12 months before the date of delivery. 1. The construction work can get this assistance only twice.
> **For wife/daughters of construction workers** 1. The construction workers should be registered under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The construction worker can receive the scheme benefits twice for up to two daughters. 1. The construction worker should have been registered for at least 12 months before the date of delivery. 1. If both parents are registered workersRs. only one parent is eligible for the scheme amount.

name: Hospitalisation Relief Scheme
brief_description: The "Hospitalisation Relief Scheme" was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to construction workers who suffer temporary disabilities due to accidents or diseases and are hospitalized for five or more days. The relief may be extended up to three months for severe or terminal conditions.
benefits: - **The relief amount is 300/- per dayRs. subject to a maximum of 4Rs./- per month.**
eligibility:
1. The worker must be a registered building and other construction worker with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker should be hospitalized for at least five days due to an accident or disease.

name: Tirth Barat Yojana
brief_description:
The "Tirth Barat Yojana" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh on 4th December 2012. The objective of this scheme is to provide government assistance for pilgrimage to the senior citizens (60 years & above) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs)Rs. who are residents of ChhattisgarhRs. to visit one or more of the various designated pilgrimage sites outside the stateRs. once in their lifetime.

- Under this schemeRs. 80% of the beneficiaries will be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) categoryRs. including cardholders of the Antyodaya and Chief Minister Food Grain Schemes. The remaining 20% will be senior citizens and disabled individuals above the poverty line who are not income taxpayers.
- Of the total beneficiariesRs. 25% will be from urban areasRs. while 75% will be from rural areas.
benefits:
- Under the schemeRs. the state government provides an opportunity for senior citizens (60 years and above) and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to visit one or more designated pilgrimage sites outside the state.
- This assistance is available once in their lifetime.

> **List of Pilgrimage Sites:**


1. UjjainRs. Omkareshwar
1. PuriRs. Bhubaneswar
1. HaridwarRs. Rishikesh
1. MathuraRs. Vrindavan
1. PrayagRs. Kashi
1. ShirdiRs. Shani ShingnapurRs. Trimbakeshwar
1. Vaishno DeviRs. Jammu
1. AmritsarRs. Golden Temple
1. TirupatiRs. MaduraiRs. Rameshwaram
1. Ajmer SharifRs. Fatehpur (Dargah of Chishti)
1. Baba Baidyanath Dham
1. DakshineswarRs. KalighatRs. Gangasagar
1. DwarkaRs. SomnathRs. Nageshwar
1. Sammed Shikharji
1. Shravanabelagola
1. Velankanni ChurchRs. Nagapattinam (Tamil Nadu)
1. GayaRs. Bodh GayaRs. SarnathRs. Nalanda
1. Kamakhya TempleRs. Navagraha TempleRs. Vashishtha Muni AshramRs. Umananda TempleRs. Shivaji TempleRs. Shankar Dev Kala Kshetra-Guwahati
1. Sabari MalaRs. GuruvayurRs. Ettumanoor Temple
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be either a senior citizen or a person with disabilities (including visual impairmentRs. deaf-muteRs. hearing impairmentRs. or locomotor disabilities).
1. Senior citizens should be 60 years of age or older.
1. Persons with disabilities must be 18 years of age or older.
1. The applicant should not have previously traveled under this scheme.
1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
1. The applicant should be physically and mentally able to travel.
1. The applicant should not be suffering from any infectious diseasesRs. such as tuberculosisRs. congestive cardiac or respiratory obstruction-related diseasesRs. coronary insufficiencyRs. coronary thrombosisRs. mental illnessRs. leprosyRs. etc.

> **Groups of Pilgrims:**


- The journey will be conducted only in groups. The above groups will be determined by the government or the authority/agency authorized by the government. The journey to any pilgrimage place will be started only when the minimum number of passengers determined by the government is available. Mere selection under the scheme will not oblige the government to arrange a journey for any person.

> **Restrictions on other persons traveling:**


- Only the person selected to travel under this scheme is permitted to go on the journey. They should not bring any additional person with themRs. even if that person is willing to cover the journey expenses. Only the selected individuals are allowed to travel in trains and vehiclesRs. and each seat/berth will be occupied by only one person.

> **Regarding additional expenses:**


- If anyoneRs. during the journeyRs. wants to avail of facilities in addition to the norms/facilities prescribed by the governmentRs. then he/she will have to pay for the same himself/herself.

> **Expectations from the pilgrims during the trip:**


- Pilgrims will not be able to carry any inflammable substance or intoxicating substance in any form.
- Pilgrims will not be able to take jewelry etc. with them.
- The pilgrims will behave as per the dignity of the pilgrimage so that the image of the state is not otherwise affected.
- Pilgrims will follow the instructions of their designated contact officer.

name: Marriage Gift Scheme - Telangana
brief_description: The "Marriage Gift Scheme" is a welfare initiative implemented by the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (TB&OCWWB)Rs. LET&F (Labour) DepartmentRs. Telangana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance as a marriage gift to unmarried registered women workers and the daughters of registered building and construction workers who have reached the age of 18 years.
benefits: - **Financial assistance : 30Rs./-.**
eligibility:
> **For construction workers themselves (Women only)** 1. Construction worker should be registered under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Construction worker should be a woman. 1. Construction worker should be unmarried.
> **For daughters of construction workers** 1. Construction workers (either one or both parents) should be registered under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. A construction worker can receive the scheme benefits for up to two daughters. 1. The daughter(s) should have completed 18 years of age at the time of application. 1. If both parents are registered workersRs. only one parent is eligible for the scheme amount.

name: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide full course feesRs. boarding and lodging assistance to the registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions such as ITIs /Polytechnic colleges etc.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- Full course fee for admission fee/ coaching fee.
- Full course fee for hostel boarding/ lodging.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The applicant should have acquired skill training from technical institutions such as ITIs /Polytechnic colleges etc.

name: Artificial Limbs and Assistive Devices Supply Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Artificial Limbs and Assistive Devices Supply Scheme" implemented by the Social Welfare Department of the Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to increase the mobility of persons with disabilities by reducing the impact of their disabilities. name: Pension Scheme (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. name: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana" was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. This scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to men and women aged 18 to 45 from the minority community by offering vocational skill training in various fields or by providing loans under the "[Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana](https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/marry)" through the Bihar State Minority Financial CorporationRs. PatnaRs. for self-employment. The training period under this scheme can extend up to 2 yearsRs. and both the training and funding aspects will be managed by the Bihar State Minorities Financial Corporation Limited.
***Major training institutes and courses covered under the scheme:***
Training will focus on vocational courses offered by or recognized by government or semi-government institutions such as NIOSRs. SIOSRs. AICTERs. State Government entitiesRs. or universities. These courses will be selected based on local employment demand or the potential for establishing a business.

benefits:
This scheme offers the following benefits:

Under this schemeRs. provide financial support to differently-abled students for purchasing essential items like books and uniforms. Students enrolled in both government and private schools are eligible to receive a monthly stipend.
benefits: - Upto Class 4th - 30/- per month per student (360/- per annum) - Class 5th to Class 7th - 40/- per month per student (480/- per annum) - Class 8th to Class 12th - 85/- per month per student (1020/- per annum)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be a disabled person. 1. The applicant should be a student enrolled in government or private school. 1. The applicant should be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

name: Savitribai Phule Self-Help Scheme
brief_description: The "Savitribai Phule Self-Help Scheme"Rs. managed by the District Intermediate Cooperative Development CommitteeRs. supports women entrepreneurs from the SC category in Madhya Pradesh by offering margin money assistance of up to 15Rs./- (50% of the project costRs. with a maximum project cost of 50Rs./-). This financial aid can help them start small businesses across various sectors.
benefits: - **Margin Money Assistance:** Provides financial support covering 50% of the project costRs. up to a maximum of 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a woman.
- The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
- The applicants age should be between 18 to 55 years.
- The applicant must be literate.
- The applicant should be currently unemployed.
- The applicant must fall under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
- The applicant should not have any outstanding defaults with any nationalized bankRs. cooperative bankRs. or other financial institution.

name: State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th (Scheduled Caste)
brief_description: Launched in 1966-67Rs. the "State Scholarship for Class 1st to 5th" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage Scheduled Caste students in the field of education and provide financial assistance. A regular student of a recognized institution receives a scholarship amount of 200 per yearRs. which is disbursed until 31st October for Scheduled Caste students.
benefits: Scholarship amount of 200/- per year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The student should be enrolled in Class 1 to 5 in a recognized educational institution.
1. The student should be a regular student of the institution.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement by the Labour DepartmentRs. offers financial assistance to unorganised transport workers or their nominees/dependents during times of distress caused by death or disability. The relief includes monetary compensation for accidental or natural deathRs. as well as graded benefits for permanent disabilities.
benefits: > **Relief on Death:** 1. **For accidental death:** 1Rs./-. 1. **For natural death:** 50Rs./-. > **Relief on Permanent Disability:** 1. **For loss of one handRs. one leg below the kneeRs. one eyeRs. or hearing capacity in one ear:** 25Rs./-. 1. **For loss of a thumb:** 9Rs./-. 1. **For loss of any other finger:** 4Rs./- 1. **Maximum relief for total disablement:** 50Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses. 1. The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. > **Note:** A nominee/ dependent of a beneficiary shall be entitled for the benefits in case of death.

name: Kanya Dhan Scheme for SC Students
brief_description: The scheme "Kanya Dhan Scheme for SC Students" by the Directorate of Higher EducationRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. an amount of 25Rs./- is provided to the girl students of the Scheduled Caste Communities once they pass the 12th standard board examination (or its equivalent examination). The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The scheme is being implemented by Chief Minister Scholarship PortalRs. Government of Goa.
benefits:
- An amount of ** 25Rs./-** is provided as a fixed deposit in the name of the girl child and the officer nominated by the government.
**NOTE:** The amount is disbursed to the beneficiaries after they pass the 12th standard board (or equivalent) examination.
eligibility:
**For Application** 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should have passed the 10th Standard of examination. 1. The applicant should have appeared in the 11th Standard of any stream (Science/Arts/Commerce/Vocational/ITI). 1. Upto 2 girl children of a family are entitled under this scheme.
**For Disbursal of Benefits** 1. The applicant should have passed the 12th standard examination in three attempts or within two years of the first attemptRs. whichever is earlier (otherwiseRs. the money shall be forfeited and credited to the Government Treasury).

name: Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)
brief_description: "Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)" was introduced by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support parents of children belonging to Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Classes for the education of their wards studying at the Pre-Matric stage. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to help improve participationRs. minimize dropout ratesRs. especially during the transition from primary to next level and elementary to secondary stageRs. enhance performanceRs. and increase chances of progressing to Post-matric education. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The scheme is being implemented by the Chief Minister Scholarship PortalRs. Government of Goa.
benefits:
**1. As per "Stipend under Saral Vidya Sahay Scheme"**
325/- per month for 11 months (3Rs./- per annum)
**2. As per "Meritorious Scholarship Scheme"**

- For Classes 5th to 6th: 900/- per annum
- For Classes 7th to 8th: 1Rs./- per annum
eligibility:
- The applicant should be studying in classes 5th to 8th on a full-time basis.


- The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste or Other Backward Class.
- The applicant's parent/guardian's annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: Launched on 1st April 2009Rs. the scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme" is a welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to disabled individuals living below the poverty lineRs. with pension amounts funded by the Government of India through the National Social Assistance Program (NSAP).
benefits: The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of 600/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a person with disability.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or more.
1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 79 years.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana
brief_description:
The Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana was initiated by the Department of WomenRs. Child DevelopmentRs. and Social SecurityRs. Government of Jharkhand. The objective of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana is to address negative perceptions about the birth of daughters in societyRs. issues like female foeticideRs. child marriageRs. low female child sex ratioRs. and the weak educational status of girls. The scheme has been approved across the entire state of Jharkhand to address these issues. The objectives of this scheme are as follows:
Objectives of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana: > (a) Women's empowerment > (b) Emphasis on girls education > (c) Eradication of the child marriage practice > (d) Support for the educational expenses of girls in higher classes to reduce school dropout rates and encourage them towards higher education. > (e) Assistance for adolescent girls' health and personal hygiene. > (f) Enable adolescent girls to make independent decisions regarding their lives.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. girls/adolescent girls will be provided with the following financial assistance:
**S. No.****Beneficiary Category****Amount of Financial Assistance**1Girls enrolled in Class 82Rs./-2Girls enrolled in Class 92Rs./-3Girls enrolled in Class 105Rs./-4Girls enrolled in Class 115Rs./-5Girls enrolled in Class 125Rs./-6One-time grant for girls aged 18-1920Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary will apply for the benefits under the schemeRs. and the beneficiary will be required to have the following eligibility till the date of application:


- This assistance shall be payable to the first two daughters of the mother.
- A self-declaration to this effect will be submitted by the mother of the beneficiaryRs. which will be required to be attached to the application.


2. Under this schemeRs. all eligible girls studying from class 12 in the Government/Scheduled TribesRs. Scheduled CastesRs. Minority and Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. Jharkhand supported/run by Women Child Development and Social Security DepartmentRs. Jharkhand/run under National Child Labour Project (NCLP)/managed by Jharkhand Government/aided by the schools will be covered.
3. The beneficiaries of the scheme will be those girl children whose


- Mother/father is not permanently employed in or retired from the Central Government/State Government/Central Public Sector Undertakings/State Public Sector Undertakings and is not in receipt of pension/family pension from these employers.
- Mother/father will not be an income taxpayer.
- The mother of the applicant will submit a self-declaration form to this effectRs. which will be necessary to attach to the application.


4. The beneficiary should be between 18 and 19 years of age at the time of application for the last installment.

name: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society For Interest Free Loan
brief_description: The "Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society For Interest Free Loan" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to offer an interest-free loan scheme to support citizens. This initiative enables eligible individuals to receive financial assistance of up to 45Rs./- without incurring any interest chargesRs. easing financial burdensRs. and promoting economic empowerment.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Loan up to 45Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** No interest.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a member of a Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.
- The beneficiary should be interested in availing loan from the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.

name: Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana - Jharkhand
brief_description: The "Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana" was launched by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training and Skill DevelopmentRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide industry-relevant skill development training for youth in JharkhandRs. aligning with NSQF standards. Implemented by JSDMS across all 24 districtsRs. it offers free training to enhance employability and self-employment opportunities. The scheme ensures quality training with a focus on marginalized communitiesRs. including SC/STRs. womenRs. PwDRs. and transgender individuals.
benefits:
- **Free Training:** Industry-alignedRs. high-quality skill development training at no cost.- **Holistic Development:** Includes soft skills and IT training for better employability.- **Essential Materials Provided:** UniformsRs. participant handbooksRs. and required tools for free.- **Financial Support:**



1. Rozgar Protsahan Bhatta 1Rs./month for boys and 1Rs./month for girlsRs. transgenderRs. and PwD for one year if unemployed after training.
1. 1Rs./month transport allowance for non-residential trainees.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant's age should be 18-35 years.
1. The applicant must belong to one of the priority groups (SC/STRs. womenRs. PwDRs. transgender).

name: Ved-Vyas Housing Construction Scheme
brief_description: The "Ved Vyas Housing Construction Scheme" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Animal Husbandry and Co-operativeRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to active and traditional fish farmers in Simdega district for building houses. The scheme prioritizes individuals particularly those living in kutcha or thatched housesRs. and ensures benefits for women and disabled applicants.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 1Rs./- for housing construction.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an active or traditional fish farmer.
1. The applicant should be living in kutcha or thatched houses.
1. The applicant's family belongs to the below poverty line.
1. The applicant must not have previously benefited from the departmental fishermen housing scheme or Indira Awas or equivalent housing scheme of the Central/State Government
1. The applicant must own land for house construction.

name: Scheme For Loan And Advances to the Beneficiary For Construction Of House
brief_description: The Scheme For Loan And Advances to the Beneficiary For Construction Of House was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. under the Labour Department of Tripura. This scheme offers registered construction workers a credit-linked interest subsidy for the construction of dwelling house.
benefits: 1. Credit-linked interest subsidy at 6.5% for eligible loans. 1. Loan amount up to 6 lakhRs. repayable over a maximum period of 20 years. > **Note:** Direct subsidy credited to the loan account to reduce financial burden.
eligibility: 1. The worker should be a registered active BOC worker under the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The worker must be a registered construction worker for at least 5 years. 1. The worker should have a minimum of 20 years before retirement. 1. The registered construction worker must not hold any pucca house in any part of the country. 1. The registered construction workers should have a minimum land area (30 Square meters) as per their income status for the construction of Houses. 1. The beneficiary family should not have availed of any central assistance under any housing scheme from the central/ state Government. 1. The worker's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The worker should belong to the economically weaker section (EWS) category.

name: Aawaas Sahayata
brief_description: Launched in 2016Rs. the "Aawaas Sahayata" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Department of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides housing assistance to tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometownsRs. who have passed 12th grade from a government or non-government collegeRs. or are regularly admitted to graduateRs. graduate diplomaRs. or technical paramedical coursesRs. and have not secured admission in a government hostel.
benefits: The scheme offers housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should have passed 12th grade from a Government or Non-Government college. 1. The student should be enrolled in a Graduate or Graduate Diploma course. 1. The student should be regularly admitted to a Technical or Paramedical course. 1. The student should not have secured admission to a Government hostel. 1. The student should be a tribal student pursuing higher education outside their hometown.

name: Block Level Institute for Rural Skill Acquisition (BIRSA)
brief_description: The Block Level Institute for Rural Skill Acquisition (BIRSA) is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana launched by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training and Skill DevelopmentRs. Jharkhand. It aims to provide freeRs. localized skill training to candidates designed for both general and reserved categoriesRs. the scheme focuses on mobilizing youth who prefer to train and work within their local areas. The program is non-residential and operates in 24 districts across 80 blocks in the first phase.
benefits: 1. **Localized Training:** Skill development centers set up at block levels ensure easy accessibility.1. **Free Materials:** Beneficiaries receive handbooks and essential materials at no cost.1. **Diverse Training Trades:** Candidates can choose trades based on interest with proper counseling.1. **Employment Opportunities:** Post-training support for jobs and self-employment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant's age should be 18-35 years and up to 50 years for SC/ST/OBC reserved categories.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
The Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar.
This component focuses on increasing the cultivation area of dragon fruit across 21 districts (BhojpurRs. GopalganjRs. JehanabadRs. SaranRs. SiwanRs. SupaulRs. AurangabadRs. BegusaraiRs. BhagalpurRs. GayaRs. KatiharRs. KishanganjRs. MungerRs. MuzaffarpurRs. NalandaRs. West ChamparanRs. PatnaRs. East ChamparanRs. PurniyanRs. Samastipur and Vaishali) in the state. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to ryot farmers for dragon fruit cultivation.
benefits:
&gt; **Financial Support:**



1. **First year:** 1Rs./- per hectare. 1. **Second year:** 60Rs./- per hectare. 1. **Third year:** 60Rs./- per hectare.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar. 1. The applicant should be a ryot farmer. 1. The applicant must be from any of the following districts: BhojpurRs. GopalganjRs. JehanabadRs. SaranRs. SiwanRs. SupaulRs. AurangabadRs. BegusaraiRs. BhagalpurRs. GayaRs. KatiharRs. KishanganjRs. MungerRs. MuzaffarpurRs. NalandaRs. West ChamparanRs. PatnaRs. East ChamparanRs. PurniyanRs. Samastipur and Vaishali. 1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha). 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:** - General Category: 78.56%. - Scheduled Castes: 20%. - Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%. - Women Participation: 30%. > **Note 2:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
brief_description: The "Sarvajan Pension Yojana" was launched by the Department of WomenRs. Child Development & Social SecurityRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month to elderly individualsRs. widowsRs. destitute womenRs. differently-abled personsRs. primitive tribesRs. and HIV/AIDS patients. The scheme eliminates previous age restrictions and targets inclusivity by guaranteeing pensions to all eligible citizens above the age of 60.
benefits:
- **A pension of 1Rs./- per month.**
> Note: Timely pension disbursal by the 5th of every month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicants should be elderlyRs. widowsRs. destitute womenRs. differently-abledRs. primitive tribes and people suffering from HIV/AIDS.
1. The senior citizen's age should be 60 years or above.
1. The destitute women's age should be 18 years or above
1. The differently-abled age should be 5 years or above.

name: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana
brief_description: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. is designed to offer agricultural input subsidies in areas affected by rising water levels in rivers such as the Ganga and Kosi. Assistance are provided for crop damage more than 33% caused by heavy rainfall and flooding.
benefits:
> **Subsidy Amounts per Hectare:**



1. Non-irrigated (year-dependent) crop areas: 8Rs./-.
1. Irrigated crop areas: 17Rs./-.
1. Perpetual/ perennial crops: 22Rs./-.


> **Minimum Subsidy Amounts to Farmers:**



1. Non-irrigated (year-dependent) crop areas: 1Rs./-.
1. Irrigated crop areas: 2Rs./-.
1. Perpetual/ perennial crops: 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should belong to the reported Panchayats of the identified blocks in the specified districts.
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
1. Applicant's bank account must be linked with the Aadhaar numberRs.

> Note: Farmers cultivating on others' land will be identified and verified as "actual cultivators" through joint certification by the Agriculture Coordinator and Farmer Advisor. This process ensures that only genuine cultivators receive subsidy benefits.

name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Total Permanent Disability
brief_description: The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana launched by the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 75Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state.
1. The applicant must work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years.

> **Note****:**



- Applicant&#39;s age will be calculated as of the 1st of July of any year.
- **Total Permanent Disability:** Total permanent disability means that due to an accidentRs. both the eyes or both hands or both legs of a worker or artisan become useless or one eyeRs. one hand and one leg become useless. Apart from thisRs. if both the eyes become useless due to paralysis or the brain stops workingRs. then it will also be considered as permanent disability.

name: Makhana Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
Makhana Vikas Yojona launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. is designed to boost the cultivation and productivity of Makhana in 10 designated districts of Bihar. It focuses on offering training to farmers and providing grants for traditional equipment used in Makhana cultivation and processing.
The scheme is to be implemented in 10 districts of the state under Schedule 1Rs. 2 and 3 of the approval orderRs. namelyRs. KatiharRs. PurniaRs. DarbhangaRs. MadhubaniRs. KishanganjRs. SupaulRs. ArariaRs. MadhepuraRs. Saharsa and Khagaria.
benefits: - **Training:** Workshops and training for farmers to adopt modern methods and improve productivity. - **Equipment Kits:** Grants of 75% of the cost (up to 16Rs./-) for traditional tools (i.e. AukaRs. GanjRs. KaraRs. KhainchiRs. ChalniRs. ChataiRs. AfraRs. and Thaapi used in Makhana cultivation).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should belong to any of the following districts of Bihar : KatiharRs. PurniaRs. MadhubaniRs. KishanganjRs. SupaulRs. ArariaRs. MadhepuraRs. SaharsaRs. Darbhanga and Khagaria.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha).
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

> **Note 1:**

**Beneficiary allocation:**

- Women Participation: 30%.

> **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.

> **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana
brief_description: The "Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana"Rs. launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide financial relief to domestic consumers with low energy consumption by subsidizing their electricity bills. The scheme benefits those whose monthly electricity consumption does not exceed 150 units. The subsidy is provided through the billing systemRs. ensuring easy access for eligible consumers. The scheme was earlier known as "Indira Graha Jyoti Yojana".
benefits:
- **Reduced Electricity Bills:** Consumers with a monthly consumption of up to 150 units receive a subsidized billRs. minimizing their energy expenses.
> **Note:** The benefit is automatically applied through the billing system for eligible consumers.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant must be a domestic consumer with a monthly electricity consumption of up to 150 units.
- The applicant must have an approved load of 1 kilowatt for their electricity connection.

name: Pay & Play Scheme
brief_description: The Pay & Play Scheme was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth AffairsRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide state-level players with training and practice opportunities at the Mega Sports ComplexRs. HotwarRs. Ranchi. The scheme includes 11 sports disciplines: athleticsRs. badmintonRs. lawn tennisRs. table tennisRs. shootingRs. gymnasticsRs. basketballRs. taekwondoRs. volleyballRs. wrestlingRs. and swimming.
benefits: - Training in 11 diverse sports disciplines: athleticsRs. badmintonRs. lawn tennisRs. table tennisRs. shootingRs. gymnasticsRs. basketballRs. taekwondoRs. volleyballRs. wrestlingRs. and swimming under professional supervision. - Free registration and membership for school students (up to Class 10th) with the principals recommendation.- Free registration and membership for international/national participants and medalists. - Athletics players enjoy 15 days of free access (non-repetitive).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a sportsperson.
1. The applicant should actively participate in state-level sports.
1. The students up to class 10th with a recommendation from the school principal and National/international participants or medalists are eligible to apply.

name: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The "Jharkhand State Backward Classes Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority and Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to enhance educational opportunities and participation among students belonging to backward classes in Jharkhand. It provides financial assistance to reduce dropout rates from classes 1st to 10th and promote equality in education.
benefits:
> **Financial assistance to cover educational expenses:** **S.NO****Class****Rate for Hostel (For 10 months)****Rate for Daylight (For 10 months)**11st to 5th1Rs./-1Rs./-26th to 8th2Rs./-2Rs./-39th to 10th4Rs./-4Rs./-

The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB). 1. The applicant should be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB). 1. The applicants membership with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.

name: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Rural)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Rural)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to disburse monthly pensions to widowsRs. irrespective of their age. To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of the districtRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible widows will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible widows on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible citizensRs. in the presence of SarpanchRs. Gram Panchayat Members and the Office Bearers of Village Organization.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be a local resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh.
- The applicant should be from a rural area.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
- The applicant should be a Widow.

_* The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Panchayat Secretary with the Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO)._

name: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to destitute elderly persons aged 65 years or above. To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of a district of Andhra PradeshRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals in the presence of Ward members and office bearers of DWCUA.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be from an urban area.
- The applicant should be a local resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
- The applicant should be 65 years of age or above.
- The applicant should be destitute (with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon).

_*The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Bill Collector with the Municipal Commissioner._

name: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students
brief_description: The scheme "Schemes for Welfare of School Children Belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students" was launched by the Government of Haryana during the financial year 2009-10. It aims to provide financial assistance to students from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support their education. Under this schemeRs. a monthly stipend is provided to students from BPL families studying in classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools.
benefits:
**A. For Girl Students:**

1. Class 1 to 5: 150/- per month
1. Class 6 to 8: 200/- per month
1. Class 9 to 12: 300/- per month
1. Class 11 to 12 **(Science Students only)**: 400/- per month
**A. For Boy Students:**

1. Class 1 to 5: 75/- per month
1. Class 6 to 8: 100/- per month
1. Class 9 to 12: 150/- per month
1. Class 11 to 12 **(Science Students only)**: 200/- per month
> **Mode of Disbursement:**

> Direct transfer to students' bank accounts.

> **Frequency of Disbursement:**

> Monthly basis.

> **Expected Time of Disbursement:**

> Funds to be transferred at the beginning of each quarter.

> **Validity:**

> Applicable for the duration of the academic session.

> Attendance criteria: Minimum 50% attendance required for next installment
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should be a student From Classes 1 to 12.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a Haryana Government school.
1. The applicant should maintain at least 50% attendance to continue receiving benefits.
1. The applicant should have an active bank account for stipend transfer.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II)
brief_description: The scheme Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II) was launched by Planning DepartmentRs. Haryana Government. The aim of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to residents of Haryana in case of accidental death or permanent disability occurred due to stray cattle/animal such as such as cowRs. bullRs. oxenRs. donkeyRs. dog biteRs. muleRs. nilgai and buffalo that roam freely. This scheme will provide assistance which would vary depending on the age of the person at the time of accidental death/permanent disability. The implementing agency for this scheme will be Haryana Parivar Suraksha Nyas (HPSN).
benefits:
The scheme provides financial assistance based on the age of the beneficiary at the time of accidental death or permanent disability:
**Sr. No.****Age****Assistance**1Upto 12 years 1 Lakh2Above 12 years and upto 18 years 2 Lakh3Above 18 years and upto 25 years 3 Lakh4Above 25 years and upto 40 years 5 Lakh5Above 40 years 2 Lakh**Mode of Disbursement:**
The assistance amount will be directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account registered in the Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) database or Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
eligibility:
The benefits of assistance under the scheme shall be made available to the beneficiary if:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
2. The applicant refers to either:
The beneficiary (in case of permanent disability)Rs. or
An eligible relative (in case of the beneficiarys death) applying for financial assistance.
3. The applicant should possess a Family ID/Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP) number.
4. The applicant should have suffered accidental death or permanent disability (70% or above) due to a stray cattle/animal bite (such as cowRs. bullRs. oxenRs. donkeyRs. dog biteRs. muleRs. nilgai and buffalo that roam freely.)
5. The claim should be filed within three months of the accident.
6. The scheme is effective from 24th May 2023Rs. as per the official gazette notification. Claims for deaths or permanent disabilities occurring before this date will not be entertained.
7. Financial assistance will be provided only for cases of death or permanent disability caused by stray cattle/animal/dog bites.
> **In case of deathRs. the assistance amount shall be paid**

1. In case Member of family is deceased then assistance will be given
Head of the Family (HOF) below the age of 60 years
In case HOF is above 60 years then eldest of the family member below the age of 60 years.
In case no elder family member/HOF is below 60 years then the family member immediate above the age of 60 years.
2. In case Head of Family is deceased then assistance will be given
Eldest of the family below the age of 60 years.
In case no elder family member is below the age of 60 years then the family member immediate above the age of 60 years.
3. In case no family member is alive after the death in the family then no assistance will be paid.
4. In case the alive family member are below the age of 18 years then the assistance will be paid only at the time of any member attaining the age above 18 years.
5. In case assistance is sanctioned by suppressing true information or making wrong claim or on the basis of wrong information given by the claimant in the claim form then the assistance amount would be recovered alongwith interest @ 12% per annum.

name: Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC
brief_description: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan aims to support meritorious scheduled caste (SC) students in pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to SC students enrolled in Ph.D. programs in Humanities and Social Sciences. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Residential Educational Institutions Society (RAJEDU).
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 25Rs./- is granted to selected candidates in three installments: - 10Rs./- in the first year - 10Rs./- in the second year - 5Rs./- in the third year **Scholarship Validity:****** Up to three years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must have completed a postgraduate degree from a recognized Indian university with a minimum of 55% marks. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a foreign university accredited by the respective country's authority. 1. The applicant's age must be below 35 years as of the application deadline. 1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The applicant should not be beneficiary of any other govt scholarship program. 1. The Ph.D. program must be in one of the following fields: - Sociology. - Public Administration. - Law. - Economics. - Political Science. - Anthropology.

name: Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession
brief_description: The "Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme provides an additional financial assistance of 500/- per month to children of individuals working in the cleaning or sanitation profession. This assistance is given to students already receiving a scholarship under the Post-Matric Scholarship SchemeRs. ensuring their continued education.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- This scheme provides 500/- per month as additional financial assistance to children of individuals working in the cleaning/sanitation profession.

**Note:** Assistance will be provided for a maximum of 10 months per year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be eligible for or currently receiving a scholarship under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme.
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. Other Backward Classes (OBC)Rs. Economically Backward Classes (EBC)Rs. or Extremely Backward Classes (EBC).
1. The applicant's parents or guardian should be engaged in the cleaning profession and belong to the scavenger class.
1. If the applicant's parent is not aliveRs. the guardian engaged in the cleaning profession and belonging to the scavenger class is eligible to apply.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
brief_description: The "Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students" scheme was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to promote higher and technical education among transgender individuals by providing financial assistance for their educational expenses. Under this schemeRs. transgender students receive a refund of their schoolRs. collegeRs. higherRs. or technical education fees.
benefits:
***Educational Fee Refund:***

- Full reimbursement of prescribed fees is provided for transgender students enrolled in schoolsRs. collegesRs. or technical institutes pursuing higher or technical education.

***Direct Bank Transfer:***

- The amount is credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account after verification.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a higher or technical course.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized schoolRs. collegeRs. or technical education institute in Rajasthan.
1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Educational Study Scheme
brief_description: The "Educational Study Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate professional courses by providing affordable education loans. The loan is available for courses accredited by the relevant councils and is applicable for students studying within Gujarat as well as in other states/UTs for select higher education institutions like IIMRs. IITRs. NIDRs. NIFTRs. IRMARs. and TISS. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** A loan of the total tuition fee of the entire course or 10Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided by the Corporation at a simple interest of 4%.
**Collateral:**


- For loans of total loan amount of 7Rs./- or less for the entire courseRs. a charge of one and a half times the loan amount will have to be registered on the beneficiary&#39;s own or relative&#39;s property.
- If the total loan amount for the entire course is more than 7Rs./-Rs. the immovable property of oneself or any other relative equal to that total amount will have to be mortgaged in favor of the Corporation.


**Loan repayment:**


- In case of total loan up to 5Rs./-Rs. the loan amount along with interest will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 5 (five) yearsRs. 1 year after completion of studies.
- In case of loan of more than 5Rs./-Rs. the loan amount along with interest will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 6 (six) yearsRs. starting 1 year after completion of studies.
- The loan amount being repaid will be credited first as interest.
- The borrower can repay the loan even before the specified time limit.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be from Gujarat 1. The applicant must belong to the unreserved category. 1. The applicant must have passed Standard 12 with 60% or more from any school in the state of Gujarat. 1. The annual family income limit for state educational loan schemes will remain at 6Rs./- or less.
**Note:** 1. Priority is given to widows and orphans when sanctioning loans under this scheme. 1. The loans of those who drop out mid-studies or fail to obtain a degree within the stipulated time frame will be subject to recovery at once and interest subsidy will not be available.

name: Kisan Parivahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Kisan Parivahan Yojana" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support farmers by providing financial aid for purchasing goods vehicles with a capacity of 600kg to 1500kg. This helps in easy and cost-effective transportation of harvested crops.
benefits: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance (For SmallRs. MarginalRs. WomenRs. SC/ST Farmers)****Standard of Assistance (For General/Other Farmers)**Medium-sized goods vehicles (capacity of 600kg to 1500 kg)35% of the total vehicle cost or 75Rs./-Rs. whichever is lower25% of the total vehicle cost or 50Rs./-Rs. whichever is lower> **Note:** - **Minimum Time Limit for Reclaiming Benefits:** 5 Years
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state.
- The applicant must purchase a medium-sized goods vehicle (600kg to 1500kg capacity) from an [authorized dealer](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_DealerDetails.aspx).

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Marriage Assistance Scheme" by the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial assistance for the marriage of a registered female worker herself (including one-time remarriage) and for up to two daughters of a registered worker.
