The scheme applies to the marriage of the female beneficiary herself or the legalRs. adoptedRs. or stepdaughter of a registered construction workerRs. provided that the bride is at least 18 years old at the time of marriage.
benefits:
- 55Rs./- Total Assistance
- 11Rs./- Cash Support
- 38Rs./- For Materials
- 6Rs./- For Mass Marriage Organizer
eligibility:
**For Registration**

- The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
- The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.

**For Application**

- The applicant should be a registered female worker or the daughter of a registered worker.
- The applicant should participate in the "Chief Minister Kanya Vivaah/Nikah Scheme".
- The bride should be at least 18 years old.
- The applicant should not have received similar assistance before.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender
brief_description:
The scheme "Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. with the aim of providing financial support for self-employment or business establishment to transgender individualsRs. promoting their economic independence.
Under the schemeRs. transgender persons aged between 21 and 50 years are eligible to take a loan from any nationalized or cooperative bank to set up their self-employment or business. The loan amount may be revised by the state government from time to time. The benefit of the scheme is available to a transgender person only once.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** 25% of the total business cost or 50Rs./- (whichever is lower) for self-employment/business establishment.- **Loan Support:** The beneficiary must secure a loan from a nationalized/cooperative bank to avail of the grant.- **One-Time Benefit:** The assistance is available only once per individual.
**Note:** The grant is disbursed only after the beneficiary starts the business and gets it verified by the lending agency.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a transgender person.
1. The applicant should be between 21 and 50 years of age.
1. The applicant should secure a loan from a nationalized/cooperative bank.
1. The gross annual income of applicant should not exceed 8Rs./-.
1. Each transgender individual can avail the benefits of this scheme only once.

name: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad
brief_description: Launched in 2020Rs. the scheme "Financial Assistance To SC Students For Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/MinoritiesRs. Government of NCT of Delhi aims to provide financial support to 100 selected Scheduled Caste (SC) students for pursuing Masters and Ph.D. programs abroad in specified fields such as EngineeringRs. Pure SciencesRs. and Humanities. The scheme offers up to 20Rs./- for Ph.D. and 10Rs./- for MastersRs. disbursed in installments. Eligible candidates must be below 30 yearsRs. have a family income under 8Rs. annuallyRs. and be bonafide residents of Delhi for at least five years. The scheme is implemented by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of Delhi.
benefits:
Financial assistance of 5Rs./- per annumRs. up to a maximum of 20Rs./- for Ph.D. (4 years) and 10Rs./- for Masters (2 years).
> **Funds are Disbursed in Installments**


- First installment after admission confirmation.
- Subsequent installments every six months/one year based on progress reports.

Covers tuition and living expenses at accredited foreign universities.
> **Conditions**


- Recipients must return to India after completion and stay for at least 5 years.
- Violations may require refund of the entire amount with 15% compound interest.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Delhi or a bonafide resident of Delhi for at least 5 years.
1. The applicant should be the only child eligible under this scheme.
1. Employed applicant should submit their application through their employer with a No Objection Certificate (NOC).
1. The applicant should not have already completed the same level of education (Masters/Ph.D.) in India or abroad.
1. Applicants for the Ph.D. Course should have secured at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in relevant Masters Degree.
1. Applicants for the Masters Degree Course should have secured at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a relevant Bachelors Degree.
1. The applicant should be below 30 years old as of the cutoff date.
1. The applicants total family income should not exceed 8Rs./- per annum.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgender
brief_description:
The scheme "Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgenders" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. to provide financial assistanceRs. skill trainingRs. and employment opportunities to transgender individualsRs. promoting their inclusion in society.
Under this schemeRs. vocational and technical training is provided to transgender persons through Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation (RSLDC)Rs. Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL)Rs. Jan Shikshan SansthanRs. Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs)Rs. or other training providers recognized by the State or Central Government. Transgender individuals can avail a maximum of two training programs under this scheme. The Social Justice and Empowerment Department implements the scheme in collaboration with recognized training institutes and organizations.
benefits:
***Skill Development:***

- Vocational/technical training will be provided to transgender persons through the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation (RSLDC)Rs. Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL)Rs. Jan Shikshan SansthanRs. Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs)Rs. or training providers recognized by the State or Central Government.

***Financial Assistance:***

- After receiving skill development trainingRs. each trainee will be given a lump sum amount of 5Rs./- per month for one course (for maximum three months and for two courses).
- Transgender persons can avail maximum 2 training programmes only.

***Training Fee Coverage:*********

- The state government reimburses the training fee directly to the training institutions.

***Employment Support and Certificate:***

- Upon completion of trainingRs. the beneficiary will receive a certificate and employment assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a transgender person.
1. The gross annual income of applicant should not exceed 8Rs./-.
1. A maximum of two training courses can be availed under this scheme.

**Note 1:** The applicant must meet the minimum age and educational qualification criteria set by the respective training institution.
**Note 2:** The State Government will reimburse the prescribed fees and other expenses to the training providing institute for the concerned programme.
**Note 3:** The fees will be made available directly to the concerned training institute after the transgender person is admitted to the respective programme.

name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme Bhavantar Bharpai YojanaRs. implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.
***Objectives:***

- To reduce the financial risk for farmers during periods of low market prices for vegetables and fruits by ensuring a protected price.
- To encourage diversification in agriculture by supporting horticultural farmers.

***Crops covered under the scheme:***

- 21 Crops: LadyfingerRs. ChilliRs. Bottle GourdRs. Bitter GourdRs. CabbageRs. RadishRs. TomatoRs. OnionRs. PotatoRs. CauliflowerRs. CarrotRs. PeasRs. CapsicumRs. BrinjalRs. TurmericRs. GarlicRs. MangoRs. KinnowRs. GuavaRs. LitchiRs. Plum
benefits:
1. To make vegetable growers risk free.
1. To fix protected price for the crops (LadyfingerRs. ChilliRs. Bottle GourdRs. Bitter GourdRs. CabbageRs. RadishRs. TomatoRs. OnionRs. PotatoRs. CauliflowerRs. CarrotRs. PeasRs. CapsicumRs. BrinjalRs. TurmericRs. GarlicRs. MangoRs. KinnowRs. GuavaRs. LitchiRs. Plum)
1. In case of selling of fruits/vegetables at lower prices in the market within the prescribed periodRs. the difference in price upto the protected price will be compensated by the Government to the registered farmers.

Note: The incentive amount will be released into the Aadhar linked bank account of the farmer.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a landownerRs. lesseeRs. or tenant farmer in Haryana.
1. The farmer should cultivate one of the 21 listed crops.

**Note 1:** Registration on the [Meri FasalRs. Mera Byora portal](https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period is mandatory.
**Note 2:** The land and crop details must be certified by the Horticulture Department.

name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Unmarried
brief_description:
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme: For Unmarried" is implemented by the Social JusticeRs. EmpowermentRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme came into effect on 1st JulyRs. 2023Rs. with the aim of providing Social Security to Unmarried Persons who are unable to sustain themselves from their own sources and are in need of financial assistance from the State.
Under this schemeRs. a monthly financial assistance of 2750/- is provided to an unmarried personRs. male as well as femaleRs. who has attained the age of 45 years and belongs to a family whose verified annual family income is upto 1Rs./-.
benefits:
1. The scheme provides monthly financial assistance of 2750/- to eligible beneficiaries.
1. The financial assistance will continue until the beneficiary turns 60 years old.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The financial assistance is disbursed through the Public Finance Management System (PFMS) directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

**Note:** The Bank will not permit the beneficiary to withdraw the benefits from outside the district in which he/she is registered.
**Frequency of Disbursement:**

- The assistance is provided on a monthly basis.

**Expected Time of Disbursement:**

- The beneficiary list is updated monthlyRs. and payments are processed accordingly.

> **Validity:**

> The assistance continues until the beneficiary turns 60 years oldRs. after which they may transition to the Old Age Samman Allowance Scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana or have been residing in the state for at least the last 15 years.
1. The applicant should be unmarriedRs. whether male or female.
1. The applicant should have attained the age of 45 years.
1. The applicant should belong to a family with a verified annual income of up to 1.80 lakh.
1. The applicant should possess a Family IDRs. as verification is based on data from the Haryana Parivar Pehchan Authority (HPPA).

**Other terms and Conditions:**

1. Any benefits received under the SchemeRs. by suppressing true information or making wrong claim or the condition for which the pension was granted no longer exists or the beneficiary got married after the grant of benefitRs. would be recovered as arrears of land revenue with @12% interest per annum.
1. Financial Assistance shall cease to be payable on the death of a beneficiary. HoweverRs. the amount of assistance will be paid for full month in which death of the beneficiary occurs (any date of the month) to the nominee.
1. Financial Assistance under this scheme shall not be liable to attachment under any court of law.
1. If a person is detected of having more than one bank account under the PFMSRs. all his bank accounts will be terminated. He/she would become ineligible to receive benefits under any Social Security Scheme of the State in future.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment
brief_description: The "Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support farmers by providing financial assistance to farmers for purchasing Sanedo (Mini Tractor) equipment. It is used for land preparationRs. sowingRs. inter-cultivationRs. sprayingRs. and transporting loads. "Sanedo" is an important equipment for farmers in the prevailing situation of labor shortageRs. with less effortRs. less costRs. and speedy completion of the most important farm equipment at the time of need.
benefits: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Sanedo agricultural equipmentAssistance of 25 % or 25Rs./- of total cost whichever is less; (Ride on Type Self Propelled Tool Bar) (Sanedo) or (Ride on Type Self Propelled Multipurpose Tool Bar)(Sanedo) tested by the Government of India approved testing centre and which has valid test report.once in 10 (ten) years
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a landholding farmer.
- The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state.

name: Free Supply of Text Books
brief_description: The scheme "Free Supply of Text Book" by the Department of Education (DoE)Rs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. aims to provide textbooks or cash in lieu of textbooks and writing material to students of Government and Aided SchoolsRs. ensuring equitable access to educational resources. The scheme offers financial assistance for purchasing textbooks and geometry boxesRs. with varying amounts based on class levels. Eligible beneficiaries include all students from Nursery to XII in Government and Aided SchoolsRs. irrespective of gender or income. The scheme is implemented by the Department of EducationRs. GNCT of Delhi.
benefits:
> **Cash Subsidy for Textbooks and Writing Materials**


- Class 1st to 5th: 550/- per annum.
- Class 6thRs. 7thRs. 11thRs. and 12th (Without Math): 800/- per annum.
- Class 8thRs. 11thRs. and 12th (With Math): 830/- per annum.
- Class 5th: 630/- per annum.
- Class 10th: 730/- per annum.

> **Additional Support**

Cash subsidy of 30/- per student for classes VIIIRs. IXRs. and XRs. and for students of classes XI and XII who opt for MathematicsRs. for purchasing a Geometry Box.
**Mode of Disbursement**

- For Cash Subsidies: The amount is transferred directly to the students/parents bank account.
- For Textbooks: The school distributes the books to eligible students.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be a student from Nursery to Class 12th.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a Government or Aided School in Delhi.
- The applicant should be attending classes regularly according to school norms.

name: Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen
brief_description: The "Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support fishermen by subsidizing the VAT on dieselRs. making fuel more affordable for their mechanized boats. This helps reduce the operational cost of fishermen using mechanized boats.
benefits: **Name of Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Diesel VAT assistancePer litre maximum assistance up to 15/-Assistance is available as per fixed diesel quota throughout the year
eligibility: - The applicant must be a registered diesel cardholder. - The applicant must own a mechanized fishing boat. - The boat should be less than 20 meters in length.

name: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana" was launched by the Backward and Extremely Backward Class Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students belonging to extremely backward classes. A one-time financial incentive is provided to students who have passed the 10th class (Matric) examination in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
benefits:
- A one-time scholarship of 10Rs./- is provided per student.

**Note:** Payment will be made via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the beneficiarys bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should belong to the Extremely Backward Class (BC-I) category.
1. The applicant should have passed the 10th class (Matric) examination in the first division from the Bihar School Examination BoardRs. Patna.

name: Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm
brief_description: The "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. provides financial assistance in the form of an interest subsidy to livestock farmers to take up animal husbandry as a sustainable business. The scheme benefits livestock farmers by reducing their financial burdenRs. thereby promoting large-scale dairy farming.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy:** Eligible farmers receive an interest subsidy of 12% on the unit cost fixed by NABARD or banks.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a livestock farmerRs. which includes agricultural laborersRs. small and marginal farmersRs. landless peopleRs. Maldhari (pastoralists)Rs. and educated unemployed individuals.
- The applicant should have taken a loan from a bank for dairy farming (1 to 20 milch animals).

> **Note:**


- Availability of the LandRs. livestock and water facilities with the Livestock Owners.
- As per the above schemeRs. the scheme of interest subsidy on establishment of units of 1 to 20 milch animals (cows and buffaloes) is also available for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes animal owners of the state.

name: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education" was introduced by the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Government of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. a scholarship of 15Rs./- per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemenRs. from the rank of Sepoy to HavildarRs. who are pursuing vocational and technical education and have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or from any other source. A maximum of 50 children can be granted this scholarship each yearRs. based on meritRs. from the Amalgamated Fund. The scheme came into effect from 1st July 2020.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- An scholarship of 15Rs./- per year per student.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- Scholarship is disbursed through online payment to the beneficiarys bank account.

**Note 1:** Only 50 students are selected each year based on merit.
**Note 2:** Scholarship will be payable in the passing year i.e. scholarship of first year will be payable in the second year. SimilarlyRs. scholarship of second year will be payable in the third year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or belowRs. or his widow/dependent.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a vocational or technical education course included in the [Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme](https://www.ksb.gov.in/writereaddata/DownLoad/List_of_Authorised_professional_degree_courses_under_PMSS.pdf) (PMSS). 1. The applicant should not be receiving benefits under the Prime Ministers Scholarship Scheme or any other scholarship scheme.
1. This scholarship is not admissible in cases of Battle Casualty/Disability and Physical Casualty (attributable cases)Rs. as in such casesRs. scholarships are already provided by the Army Headquarters.
1. The applicant must have passed the previous academic year successfully; failure to pass results in the discontinuation of the scholarship.
1. The scholarship will not be payable to more than two children of an ex-serviceman.

**Notes:**

- Once selectedRs. the scholarship will continue for the remaining duration of the courseRs. subject to annual renewal.
- In case of failure in any yearRs. the scholarship will be cancelled for the entire course.

name: Intensive Castration Scheme
brief_description: The "Intensive Castration Scheme" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support livestock owners and animal-rearing organizations in castrating male calves through the closed method (Burdizo Castrator) or open method (Surgical Method). Eligible beneficiaries receive a subsidy for male calf for the castration procedure. The program is implemented by District Veterinary Polyclinics.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount of 500/- subsidy per animal (male calf) for castration by close method (Burdizo Castrator)/open method (Surgical Method).
eligibility:
- The applicant must be an individual livestock owner or an animal-rearing organization (Gaushala/Panjarapol/others).
- The male calf must be castrated through the close or open method.

name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. is designed to support livestock owners during the critical post-parturition periodRs. one month after delivery. This time is crucial for the health of the mother cattle and the calf. Under the schemeRs. 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed is provided free of cost to livestock owners belonging to the Scheduled Caste Category.
benefits: **Name of Component****Standard of assistance****Remarks****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Concentrate Feed 150 kg BIS type II Concentrate feed per beneficiary100% assistanceEvery year
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste (SC) livestock owner.
1. The applicant must possess the following valid documents:

- Barcoded ration card.
- Government-approved photo ID (e.g.Rs. AadhaarRs. Voter ID).
- Caste certificate issued by a competent authority.
- Certificate of calving issued by a Government Livestock Inspector.
- Disability certificate from a competent authority (only if the applicant is disabled).

name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (General Category)
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (General Category)" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support livestock owners during the last trimester of cattle pregnancya critical period for both the animal and the calf. Through this schemeRs. 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed is provided free of cost to eligible beneficiaries to enhance milk yieldRs. extend the milking periodRs. and prevent health complications.
benefits: **Name of Component****Standard of assistance****Remarks****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Concentrate Feed 150 kg BIS type II Concentrate feed per beneficiary100% assistanceEvery year
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a livestock owner.
1. The applicant must belong to the General Category.
1. The animal/ cattle should be in the last trimester of pregnancy.

name: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
brief_description: The "BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School" scheme was launched by the BC & EBC Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. high schools are being run in all the 38 districts of the state with the objective of providing quality education with various modern facilities in a safe and natural environment for the educational and overall development of the girl students of backward class and extremely backward class.
benefits:
- Free enrolment
- Free accommodation
- Free food and sacks (as per menu)
- The amount for clothesRs. booksRs. medicineRs. cleaning etc. is paid to the girl students through DBT
- Laboratory with modern facilities
- Vocational trainingRs. skill developmentRs. horticulture etc
- Facility of quality study and guidance through Jananayak Library and Digital Study Centre.
- Free competitiveRs. and high quality books and study material.
- 24 hours of uninterrupted power supply.
- Science & Maths/Literature & Sociology Club.
- Career guidance and motivational sessions by experts from various fields.
- Educational tour programme for girl students in the state under Chief Ministers tour.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC).
1. The benefits under this scheme are available to girl students from Class 6 to Class 12.
1. Selection of girl students for Classes VIRs. VIIRs. VIIIRs. and IX will be based on an entrance examination.
1. The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians should not exceed 3Rs./-.
1. The applicants age limit for enrolment:


- 11-13 years for Class 6th- 12-14 years for Class 7th- 13-15 years for Class 8th- 14-16 years for Class 9th

name: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
brief_description: Launched in 2010Rs. the scheme "Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)" by the Department of Information and PublicityRs. Government of Goa aims to provide immediate financial assistance to needy journalists in indigent circumstances for various emergencies such as medical treatmentRs. marriage expensesRs. funeral costsRs. and self-employment ventures. The scheme offers benefits like financial aid up to 2Rs./per case and scholarships for journalists' wards. Eligible applicants must be journalists born or working in Goa for at least three years and registered with the Department of Information and Publicity. The scheme is implemented by a Sub-Committee constituted by the Government of GoaRs. which includes representatives from the Goa Union of Journalists and the Goa Editors Guild.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance and Purpose**


- Marriage of Daughter: Up to 2Rs./-
- Major/Minor Operation/Medical Treatment for Self or Family: Up to 2Rs./-
- Funeral Expenses of the Journalist: Up to 2Rs./-
- Travel/Incidental Expenses for Treatment: Up to 2Rs./-
- Medical Reimbursement for General Expenses: Up to 2Rs./-
- Scholarship/Incentives for Wards Pursuing Higher Education: Up to 2Rs./-
- Financial Assistance for Self-employment Ventures: Up to 2Rs./-
- House Repair/Construction Due to Natural Calamities: Up to 2Rs./-
- Lump-sum Grant on the Death of the Journalist to Next Kin: Up to 2Rs./-

_*All disbursements are made through cheques._
> **Conditions for Disbursement**


- Original bills and photocopies of hospital/institution documents must be submitted for medical claims.
- For super-specialty treatmentRs. bills must be submitted within three months.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a journalist.
- The applicant should have been born and brought up in Goa.
- The applicant should be working in a newspaper establishment in Goa for at least three years continuously.
- The applicant should be registered with the Department of Information and PublicityRs. Government of GoaRs. and renew registration by June 30th every year.
- The applicant should not be engaged in any other profession.

name: Merit Scholarship: Engineering University
brief_description: "Merit Scholarship: Engineering University" is a welfare scheme by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides 1000/- per month to eligible students for pursuing B.E. from a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh. The applicants can either be students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations with a minimum of 60% marksRs. or Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E. must have passed the final year examination of their diploma with a minimum of 60% marks.
benefits:
- For studying in the first year of the B.E. (Bachelor of Engineering) program: 1Rs./- per month.
- For students newly admitted to the second year of B.E. through lateral entry: 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be pursuing an engineering degree course. - Students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations with a minimum of 60% marks from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh will be eligible. - Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E. must have passed the final year examination of their diploma with a minimum of 60% marks will also be eligible.
**Other Conditions -** - Without special approval from the governmentRs. no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. HoweverRs. if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concessionRs. then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its durationRs. then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regardRs. only one concession can be given that any such studentRs. who is regularly studying in a recognized institution and is receiving any scholarshipRs. can be allowed to do part-time work.

name: Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
brief_description: "Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides 600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized polytechnic institutions in Chhattisgarh. Eligible applicants include (a) Students who have passed the 10th/12th class examination under the 10+2 system from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 60% marksRs. (b) Students newly admitted to the second year of the Diploma program who are ITI / 12th vocational certificate holders and have passed the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks.
benefits:
(a) For students newly admitted to the first year of the Diploma program: 600/- per month.
(b) For students admitted to the second year through lateral entry: 600/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognized polytechnic institution in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the qualifying examination. - Students who have passed the 10th/12th class examination under the 10+2 system from any recognized institution located in Chhattisgarh with a minimum of 60% marks will be eligible. - Students newly admitted to the second year of the Diploma program who are ITI / 12th vocational certificate holders must have passed the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks.
**Other Conditions -** - Without special approval from the governmentRs. no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. HoweverRs. if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concessionRs. then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its durationRs. then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regardRs. only one concession can be given that any such studentRs. who is regularly studying in a recognized institution and is receiving any scholarshipRs. can be allowed to do part-time work.

name: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana" was implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate levelRs. after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education RajasthanRs. Ajmer.
Students studying in Classes 10 and 12 in all government schoolsRs. recognized private schoolsRs. and Swami Vivekanand Model Schools in the stateRs. who have secured a minimum of 50% marks in Classes 9 and 11 respectivelyRs. are eligible to apply for the examination. Students selected through this examination will be entitled to the benefits provided under the scheme.
benefits:
**Type of Benefit: Scholarship and One-Time Incentive**
**Class at the time of application****No. of Selected Students & Basis of Selection Basis****Scholarship Rate (For a period of 10 Months)****One-Time Incentive (20 students in each)**Class 10th50 students (80% marks)1Rs./month (for Class 11-12)4Rs. for topperRs. 2Rs. each for othersClass 12th - Arts50 students (80% marks)2Rs./month (for UG & PG)4Rs. for topperRs. 2Rs. each for othersClass 12th - Commerce50 students (80% marks)2Rs./month (for UG & PG)4Rs. for topperRs. 2Rs. each for othersClass 12th - Science50 students (80% marks)2Rs./month (for UG & PG)4Rs. for topperRs. 2Rs. each for others**NOTE:**

- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiarys bank account.
- Monthly (for up to 10 months per academic year).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student currently enrolled in Class 10 or Class 12.
1. The student should be studying in a government schoolRs. a recognized private schoolRs. or a Swami Vivekanand Model School located in Rajasthan.
1. For Class 10 applicantsRs. a minimum of 50% marks should have been secured in Class 9. For Class 12 applicantsRs. at least 50% marks should have been obtained in Class 11.
1. The applicant should have appeared for and qualified in the State Talent Search Examination conducted by the Board of Secondary EducationRs. Rajasthan.
1. To be considered for selectionRs. the applicant should have scored a minimum of 80% marks in the Talent Search Examination.

name: Aapki Beti Yojana
brief_description: The "Aapki Beti Yojana" scheme was launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. to support girls in continuing their education in government schools from Class 1 to 12. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools who belong to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose one or both parents have passed away. For girls studying in Class 9 to 12Rs. the assistance is 2Rs./- per year. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Balika Shiksha Foundation.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


- 2Rs./- per annum for girl students in classes 1st to 8th.- 2Rs./- per annum for girl students in classes 9th to 12th.
> ***Mode of Disbursement:***


- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked with Jan Aadhaar of the family head or the girl child.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be studying in classes 1st to 12th.1. The applicants family should fall under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should have lost either one parent (single parent) or both parents.

name: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
brief_description: "The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme" by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. Government of GoaRs. aims to encourage young talents in photography and photojournalismRs. promote self-employmentRs. and provide a platform for local youths to exhibit their work. The scheme offers cash prizes of 20Rs./-Rs. 16Rs./-Rs. and 12Rs./- in each category. Benefits also include exhibitions for selected entries. Applicants born and residing in Goa for at least 15 years are given preference.
benefits:
- First prize: 20Rs./- in each category.
- Second prize: 16Rs./- in each category.
- Third prize: 12Rs./- in each category.
- Five consolation prizes: 2Rs./- each.
- Certificates are presented to the best entries.
- Judges' Honorarium: 5Rs./- each for three judges.
eligibility: Individuals who were born and residing in Goa for 15 years or more will be given preferenceRs. though the scheme does not bar others.

name: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole" launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. is designed to preserve and promote indigenous breeds of cows in GujaratRs. such as Gir and KankrejRs. which hold spiritualRs. scientificRs. and health value.
Objective: The world famous Gir and Kankarej cows of Gujarat state and other indigenous breeds have great importance in terms of spiritualRs. scientific and health. To preserve these is the main aim by increase the breeding of cows by encouraging gaushalas and panjarapol institutions that ideally keep cows. The scheme also aims to increase the consumption of Panchagavya products of Gir and Kankrej cows and make rearing of cows economically viable.
benefits: **Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Constituent Benefits**1. Water Fogger; 2. Mechanized Reaper Machine or Reaper Machine; 3. Chaff cutter 4. Drip irrigation; 5. 500 liters bulk milk cooling machine with generator; 6. Mini Tractor or Big Tractor/Hydraulic Trailer or Trailer; 7. Solar Gau Arc Machine/ Gau Arc Machine; 8. Milking machineAssistance upto 75% of the total expenditure incurred by the article up to a maximum of 4Rs./- to be paid.1 Year
eligibility: 1. Gaushalas and panjrapole registered under the Public Charity Act. 1. A Gaushala should have more than 50 cows of local origin. While Panjarapol must have more than 100 livestock. 1. At least 3 (three) acres of land on which the institution has to purchase/develop the development workRs. must be in the institution's own name or on a lease of 99 years. There is no maximum land limit.

name: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
brief_description: The scheme "Travel Grants To Goan Authors" is a state-level cultural scheme by the Kala AcademyRs. Department of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that regionRs. and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country as a nation.
benefits: The grant amount will be decided by Kala Academy with provision for an advance upto 75% of the total grant for a maximum of two Goan authors.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a writer.
- The applicant should be from Goa.

_*A copy of the rules and regulations is available at Kala Academy free of charge._

name: Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana
brief_description: The "Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana" was implemented by the Information and Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. to recognize and support the contributions of senior accredited journalists. Under this schemeRs. a monthly financial assistance of 15Rs./- is provided to full-time accredited journalists who are 60 years of age or older and have served continuously for at least 20 years in dailyRs. weeklyRs. fortnightly newspapersRs. independent publicationsRs. electronic mediaRs. or news agencies (including editorsRs. publishersRs. and owners).
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- Monthly Honorarium: 15Rs./- per month to the senior accredited journalists.
- In case of the journalist's deathRs. 50% of the amount is provided to the widow.

**Duration:**

- Paid for a maximum period of 5 yearsRs. subject to review.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- Direct Bank Transfer to the journalists savings account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a full-time accredited journalist.
1. The applicant must have continuously worked for at least 20 years in daily newspapersRs. weekly newspapersRs. fortnightly news publicationsRs. independent journalismRs. electronic mediaRs. or news agenciesRs. including roles such as editorRs. publisherRs. or owner of such media organizations.
1. Accredited journalists who have been regularly accredited with the Department of Information and Public RelationsRs. Rajasthan for at least 10 years will be eligible for this scheme.
1. The journalist should be 60 years of age or older as of the application date.
1. The applicant should not be receiving any salaryRs. pensionRs. or regular financial assistance from any newspaperRs. institutionRs. or any other regular assistance from the State Government.
1. The applicant must declare (via affidavit) that they do not fall under the category of an income tax payee.
1. The applicant should not have any criminal case registered against them.

**Note:** The honorarium will be given for an initial period of five years.

name: Bhajan Pakhawaj Workshops
brief_description: The scheme "Bhajan Pakhawaj Workshops" is a state-level cultural scheme by the Kala AcademyRs. Department of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to provide knowledge of appropriate and traditional Bhajan Singing and Pakhawaj playing to Bhajan performers through experts from the respective field. Applications are invited by announcement in local print and electronic media. Certificates are awarded to the participants. A Suitable Honorarium is paid to conductors of workshops.
benefits:
- Knowledge of appropriate and traditional Bhajan Singing and Pakhawaj playing is provided to the Bhajan performers through experts from the respective field.
- Certificates are awarded to the participants.
- A suitable Honorarium is paid to conductors of workshops.

_*The venue of the workshop is decided by Kala Academy._
eligibility:
**For Trainee:** The applicant should be a Bhajan performer.
**For Workshop Conductor:** The applicant should be an expert in traditional Bhajan Singing or Pakhawaj playing.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)" is a social welfare initiative by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and ChildrenRs. Government of Punjab. In this schemeRs. persons aged between 60 and 79 years receive a pension of 200/- per monthRs. while those aged 80 years and above receive 500/- per month. The scheme applies only to persons belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
benefits:
- 200/- monthRs. for persons aged 60 to 79 years.
- 500/- monthRs. for persons aged 80 years and above.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older.
1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" is implemented by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and ChildrenRs. Government of Punjab. Under this schemeRs. persons with disabilities aged 18 years and aboveRs. having a disability level of 80% or moreRs. are eligible to receive a pension of 300/- per month. After attaining the age of 80 yearsRs. the pension amount increases to 500/- per month. Dwarfs are also included as an eligible category under this scheme.
benefits:
- Pension is Rs. 300/- per month (age 18-79 year)
- Pension is Rs. 500/- per month (age 80 and above year)
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
1. The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more.
1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 80 years.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Punjab)
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)" is implemented by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and ChildrenRs. Government of Punjab. Under this schemeRs. widows aged 40 years and above receive a pension of 300/- per month. After attaining the age of 80 yearsRs. the pension amount increases to 500/- per month.
benefits:
- Pension of 300/- per month for widows aged 40 to 79 years.
- Pension of 500/- per month for widows aged 80 years and above.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
1. The applicant should be a widow.
1. The age of the applicant should be above 40 years in age.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

name: Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme" was launched by the Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Sikkim. It aims to provide financial support to traditional faith healers across the state. Under this schemeRs. traditional faith healers receive a monthly pension to recognize and support their cultural and social contributions. It covers a total of 1Rs. beneficiaries and seeks to preserve the traditional healing practices that are integral to the cultural heritage of Sikkim.
benefits: - A monthly pension of 1Rs./- is provided to traditional faith healers such as DhamiRs. JhakriRs. BijjuwaRs. BhungthingRs. MangpaRs. PhedengbaRs. PawRs. BaidangRs. JanapaRs. YebaRs. YemaRs. SambasRs. and Pheriwala.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Sikkim.
1. The applicant should be a traditional faith healer such as DhamiRs. JhakriRs. BijjuwaRs. BhungthingRs. MangpaRs. PhedengbaRs. PawRs. BaidangRs. JanapaRs. YebaRs. YemaRs. SambasRs. or Pheriwala.

name: Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition
brief_description: The "Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition"Rs. organised by the Kala Academy under the Department of ArtRs. Culture and MuseumsRs. Government of GoaRs. aims to promote singing talentRs. preserve and revive the tradition of Tiatr songsRs. and encourage both traditional and new compositions that reflect Goas rich Tiatr heritage. The competition is open to all Goan artists.
benefits:
- A common music band is provided by Kala Academy free of cost for practice and competition. - Each participant gets 150/- as travel and daily allowance. - Winners receive cash prizes in different categories.
**Solo Singing [Male & Female]:** 1st Prize: 2Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 1Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 1Rs./- **Duet Singing:** 1st Prize: 4Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 3Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 2Rs./- **Duo Singing:** 1st Prize: 4Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 3Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 2Rs./- **Trio Singing:** 1st Prize: 6Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 4Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 3Rs./- **Quartet [Group of 4]:** 1st Prize: 8Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 6Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 4Rs./- **Choral [Group Singing]:** 1st Prize: 8Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 6Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 4Rs./-
eligibility: The Competition is open to all Goan artists.

name: The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. Government of Goa aims to encourage journalists to exhibit their talents by publishing commendable news itemsRs. articlesRs. or reportsRs. thereby fostering mass awareness in society. The scheme provides recognition through awards and financial incentivesRs. with a cash prize of 10Rs./- per category. Eligible journalists must be affiliated with registered daily or weekly newspapers or private sector electronic media recognized by the Department. The scheme is implemented by the Director of Information & PublicityRs. GoaRs. and awards are conferred annually on National Press Day (16th November).
benefits:
- Each award includes a certificateRs. a mementoRs. and a cash prize of 10Rs./-.
- A total of seven awardsRs. amounting to 70Rs./-Rs. are distributed annually.
- Judges receive an honorarium of 2Rs./- each.
- Awards are conferred on National Press Day (16th November).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a journalist working in a registered daily or weekly newspaper published in EnglishRs. KonkaniRs. or MarathiRs. or private sector electronic media recognised by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. Government of Goa.
- The applicant's work (news itemsRs. articlesRs. or reports) must have been published during the previous calendar year.
- Nominations must be sponsored by the Editors of eligible publications.
- The nomination of the journalist can only be for the news items and articles published during the previous calendar year under one of the following categories:

a) Best Editor Award on National Integration and Communal Harmony.
b) Rural Reporting.
c) Reporting on Public Health and Hygiene.
d) Reporting with special reference to Women and Children/Social issues.
e) Sports Reporting.
f) Reporting on Art and Culture.
g) Photo Journalism (Best photograph of the year).

name: Laado Protsahan Yojana
brief_description:
The Scheme "Laado Protsahan Yojana" was launched on 1st August 2024 by the Department of Women EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this schemeRs. financial support is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.
> **Objectives:**


- Promote a positive mindset towards the birth of a girl child and ensure her holistic development.
- Eliminate gender discrimination in childcareRs. educationRs. and health.
- Promote institutional deliveries and reduce maternal mortality.
- Reduce infant mortality among girls and improve the child sex ratio.
- Ensure enrollment and retention of girls in schools.
- Encourage higher education for girls and reduce child marriage.
benefits:
> **Monetary Benefit:**


- **Total financial benefit of 1Rs./- disbursed in 7 installments:**

**Installment****Description****Amount ()**1Girl's birth in eligible medical institutions2500/-2Girl completes one year of age and all vaccinations2500/-3Girl's admission to Class 1st in a government/government-recognized private school4000/-4Girl's admission to Class 6th in a government/government-recognized private school5000/-5Girl's admission to Class 10th in a government/government-recognized private school 11000/-
6Girl's admission to Class 12th in a government/government-recognized private school25000/-7Girl passes graduation from government-recognized educational institutions and completes 21 years of age 1Rs./-
**Total Amount 1Rs.**> **Mode of Disbursement:**


1. A commitment letter of 1.50 lakh will be issued at the birth of a girl child.
1. The entire amount will be disbursed online through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in seven installments.
1. Until the girl attains adulthoodRs. the first six installments will be transferred to the bank account of her parents or guardianRs. and the seventh installment will be transferred to the girl's own bank account through DBT.

> **Notes:**


- If the benefit of any installment is not availed at any stage after the first two installments of the schemeRs. the eligible girl child may still be granted the next installmentRs. provided a valid and reasonable justification is given.
- There is no limit on the number of girl children eligible to receive the third and subsequent installments under the scheme. All girls who have already received the first two installments will be entitled to continue receiving benefits under the scheme.
- The Rajshree Yojana will be merged with the Laado Protsahan YojanaRs. and the remaining installments of the Rajshree Yojana will be provided under the Laado Protsahan Yojana as per eligibility.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a woman who is a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should deliver the girl child in a government medical institution or a private medical institution authorized under the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY).
1. The applicant should ensure full immunization of the child (for second installment).
1. The applicant's child should be enrolled in a recognized school or institution for subsequent installments.
1. The applicants daughter should graduate from a recognized higher education institution and attain the age of 21 to receive the final installment.

name: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
brief_description: The "Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to state agitators who do not fall under the category of those imprisoned for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State MovementRs. and who are not entitled to an agitational pension or any other government pensionRs. nor are employed in government service.
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 4Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an identified state agitatorRs. excluding those who were jailed for seven days or injured during the Uttarakhand state movement. 1. The applicant must not be entitled to an agitational pension or any other pension from a government source. 1. The applicant must not be employed in any government service.

name: Operation of Sports Hostels
brief_description: The scheme "Operation of Sports Hostels" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to encourage tribal students in Scheduled Areas to participate in sports and prepare them for national and international competitions. Under this schemeRs. tribal students from Class 6 to 12 are provided with free residential facilitiesRs. training in archery and athletics by skilled coachesRs. nutritious mealsRs. uniformsRs. and modern sports equipment. The scheme is implemented in the following District: BanswaraRs. DungarpurRs. SirohiRs. Udaipur & Pratapgarh.
benefits:
The following facilities are provided in the sports hostel:

- Free residential accommodation in sports hostels.
- Nutritious mealsRs. snacksRs. and special dietary arrangements as per approved pattern.
- Sports training with modern equipment by expert coaches (especially in archery and athletics).
- Free school uniforms and educational materials.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 6th to 12th.1. The applicant should not have any disability or suffering from any serious illness.
1. The applicants parents/guardians should not be income tax payers.
1. The applicant should not be a failed student in the last examination.

**Note:** Only those students who pass the selection test will be admitted to the sports hostel.

name: Organisation of Cultural Programs
brief_description: The scheme Organisation of Cultural Programs was introduced by the Department of Culture and EndowmentsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department of Culture for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairsRs. festivalsRs. regional celebrations within and outside the stateRs. as well as on the occasion of national festivals.
benefits: After the presentation of cultural programmes by groups/folk singers enlisted with the Culture Department on the occasion of traditional fairsRs. festivalsRs. celebrationsRs. and national festivals organized within or outside the stateRs. the following honorarium and allowances are payable: 1. Group Leader: Honorarium of 1Rs./- and travelling allowance of 500/-. 1. Other Artists: Honorarium of 800/- each and travelling allowance of 400/- each. 1. Folk Singers: - Category A: 7Rs./- as honorarium. - Category B: 4Rs./- as honorarium. - Travelling allowance: 300/- along with ordinary bus fare or second-class rail fare for the journey.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a cultural group or an artist registered with the Department of CultureRs. Uttarakhand.

name: ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship
brief_description: The Fellowship is aimed at promoting originalRs. socially relevantRs. and policy-focused research in the social sciences. The fellowship provides financial support through a monthly grant of 20Rs. and an annual contingency grant of 20Rs. for up to two yearsRs. with an initial award period of one yearRs. which is renewed for the second year subject to fulfilment of requisite criteria. It also offers institutional and short-term fellowships including a six-month short term fellowship for scholars nearing Ph.D. submission (minimum three years of completed PhD research) and a standalone contingency grant of 62Rs. for specific research needs. Applications are invited through ICSSRs website and social media platforms. Fellows are expected to pursue full-time researchRs. submit regular progress reportsRs. and provide a final submission that includes published workRs. a book-length thesisRs. and audited financial records. Given India's social science ecosystemRs. it seeks to promote research excellenceRs. evidence-based researchRs. and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.
benefits:
1) Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.20Rs. per month
2) Contingency Grant @ Rs.20Rs. per annum
eligibility:
1) Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2) Must be a full-time bonafide Ph.D. scholar in a social science discipline in a UGC-recognized universityRs. deemed-to-be universityRs. institute of national importanceRs. ICSSR Research InstituteRs. or college with approved Ph.D. programme.
3) The Ph.D. topic must have been confirmed by the DRC/authorised statutory body of the institution on or before the last date of call for applications.
4) Age must be below 40 years as on the last date of application.
5) Age relaxation of 5 years allowed for SC/ST/OBC-(NCL) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD).
6) Must have secured a minimum of 55% marks in post-graduationRs. with 5% relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC-(NCL)/PwD).

name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)
brief_description: The scheme "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)" is a housing scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) by offering financial aid up to 1Rs./- for house construction. This scheme also ensures that the Economically Weaker Sections receive support in securing shelter.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of up to 1Rs./- for house construction.
eligibility:
- Applicant must belong to the Economically Backward Class (EBC).
- Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- Applicant's family income should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.
- Applicant must own land or have been allotted land/house under a government poverty housing scheme.

name: Kailash Darshan Yatra
brief_description: Launched in 2001Rs. the scheme "Kailash Darshan Yatra" by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development BoardRs. Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the sacred Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage. The scheme offers one-time financial assistance to selected applicants who complete the yatra. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must be a selected pilgrim from Gujarat and submit proof of yatra completion within 90 days. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
One-time financial assistance is provided to the pilgrim for undertaking the Kailash Darshan Yatra.
**Validity:** Once in a lifetime per pilgrim.
_*The scheme guidelines do not specify the amount of the benefit; applicants should verify with the authorities._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a pilgrim from Gujarat.
- The applicant must have completed the Kailash Darshan Yatra.
- The applicant must apply within 90 days of yatra completion.
- The applicant must not have availed of the benefit before under this scheme.

name: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
brief_description: The scheme Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks is implemented by the Directorate of Sanskrit Education under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing free Sanskrit textbooks to students studying in Classes 1 to 12.
benefits: **Each student is provided annual financial assistance under the scheme as follows:** - Classes 1st to 5th: 250/- per student - Classes 6th to 8th: 400/- per student - Classes 9th to 10th: 600/- per student - Classes 11th to 12th: 700/- per student
eligibility: 1. The students studying in Classes 1 to 12 at Sanskrit schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Protection Against Domestic Violence
brief_description: The scheme "Protection Against Domestic Violence" by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to support women who are subjected to physicalRs. emotionalRs. verbalRs. sexualRs. or economic abuse within a domestic relationship. The scheme facilitates timely and confidential intervention by trained counselors and protection officers. Women victims can receive emotional and legal assistanceRs. mediationRs. and safety measuresRs. including shelter and medical aid where needed.
benefits: - **Counseling and Mediation Support:** Victims are provided with trained counselors for psychological support and help in mediation between the victim and the perpetrator if required.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.

name: Sero Positive Illness Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2009Rs. the scheme "Sero Positive Illness Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to support the education of children affected by or born into families impacted by Sero Positive illness. Through this schemeRs. financial scholarships and support for school uniformRs. booksRs. tuition feesRs. foodRs. and hostel expenses are provided to destitute and orphaned children across education levelsfrom primary school to postgraduate studies. The scheme is implemented by the DirectorRs. Social Security DepartmentRs. Gujarat StateRs. GandhinagarRs. and at the district levelRs. by the District Social Security Officer or District Child Protection Officer.
benefits: Level of Study Day Scholars HostellersStd. 1 to 5 500 (50/month for uniform) + 1Rs. annually-Std. 6 to 101Rs./- (100/month for uniform) + 1Rs. annually -Class 11-12 4Rs./- (400/month for fees and books for ten months)10Rs./- (Rs. 400/- per month for fees and books for ten months and 600/- per month for food and hostel charges)B.A./B.Com./B.Sc and equivalent degree courses 6Rs./- (600/- per month for fees and books for ten months)12Rs./- (600/- per month for fees and books for ten months and 600/- per month for food and hostel charges)degree courses like B.E.Rs. B.Tech.Rs. L.L.B.Rs. MBA and equivalent courses as well as Diploma courses in Medical and Ayurvedic and Homeopathic courses.10Rs./- (1Rs./- per month for fees and books for ten months)16Rs./- (1Rs./- per month for fees and books for ten months and 600/- per month for food and hostel charges)Postgraduate level courses like M.Sc./ M.Phil./ LLM./ M.Ed./ M.B.A. etc.10Rs./- (1Rs./- per month for fees and books for ten months)1Rs./- per month for books for ten months and 600/- per month for food and hostel charges)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a child affected by Sero Positive illness or should have one or both parents who are Sero Positive. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in any following standard: - Standard 1 to 5. - Standard 6 to 10. - Higher Secondary Class-11 and 12. - B.A./B.Com./B.AC. and equivalent degree courses. - Degree courses like B.E.Rs. B.Tech.Rs. LLB.Rs. MBA and equivalent courses as well as Diploma courses in Medical and Ayurvedic and Homeopathic courses. - Postgraduate level courses like M.Sc./ M.Phil./ LLM./ M.Ed./ M.B.A. etc.

name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2017Rs. the scheme "Sindhu Darshan Scheme" by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-LadakhRs. promoting cultural unity. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of 15Rs./- to eligible pilgrims and supports a maximum of 300 pilgrims per financial year. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must be a native of Gujarat and must submit proof of completing the yatra within 60 days of its conclusion. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board. The applications are accepted offline via a prescribed form available on the official website.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** One-time grant of 15Rs./- per pilgrim.
**Beneficiary Cap:** Limited to 300 pilgrims per financial year.
**Disbursement Condition:** Proof of yatra completion must be submitted within 60 days.
**Validity:** Once in a lifetime per pilgrim.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a native of Gujarat.
- The applicant must have completed the Sindhu Darshan Yatra.
- The applicant must submit the application within 60 days of completing the yatra.
- The applicant must not have availed the benefit before under this scheme.

name: Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme
brief_description: The "Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme" is a scheme under the "Celebration of Birth Anniversaries of Great saints Dr. B.R. AmbedkarRs. Guru RavidasRs. Maharishi Valmiki and Sant Kabir Dass Jayanti Scheme"Rs. implemented by the Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. To support their spiritual and cultural engagementRs. the scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travelRs. enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.
benefits: - Reimbursement of 1Rs./- or the actual cost of a second-class train ticket (to and fro) per personRs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided. **Note:** This facility will be given one time only. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** Reimbursement will be made after the journey on the submission of railway tickets. **Mode of Disbursement:** Payment will be made directly into the bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste. 1. This facility will be given one time only.

name: State Art Exhibition Competition
brief_description: The scheme "State Art Exhibition Competition" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to encourage and appreciate the creative pursuits of artistsRs. art studentsRs. and school children through state-level art exhibitions and competitions in disciplines like paintingRs. sculptureRs. graphic artsRs. applied artsRs. and visual arts. Participants are invited through public advertisements in newspapersRs. and entries are judged by expert panels. Winners receive cash prizesRs. certificatesRs. and an opportunity to exhibit their work at the Ravi Shankar Rawal Kala Bhavan. Prize-winning art institute students are also eligible for a monthly scholarship. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. 2 entries each from artists and students of art institutions and a maximum of 14 entries from classes 1 to 5 and 14 entries from classes 6 to 10 from a school are invited through the school in a prescribed format.
benefits: - **Artists Category:** 23 prizes totaling 1Rs./-. - **Art Institute Students Category:** 16 prizes totaling 48Rs./-. - **School Children Category:** 50 prizes totaling 25Rs./-. - **Scholarship:** Winning students in the art institution category are eligible for a monthly scholarship of 1Rs./-.
eligibility: - Artists/ art institute students and school children in Gujarat are eligible under this scheme. - Students should be studying in classes 1st to 10th in Gujarat.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana
brief_description: The Subsidy for Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme aims to promote ornamental fish farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as shedsRs. breeding unitsRs. and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish. The assistance will be provided to beneficiaries who own a minimum of 150 square meters of vacant land with an adequate fresh water facility.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: 8Rs./- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category applicant. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC)/Women beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should have at least 150 square meters of vacant land with adequate water supply. 1. The applicant should either own the land or possess a registered lease deed valid for at least 7 years.

name: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/DayRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day. The objective is to enhance the availability of high-quality and affordable feed for fish farmersRs. supporting the expansion of aquaculture in Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. under which the project is jointly funded by the Central and State Governments: 50% of the subsidy amount is contributed by the Central GovernmentRs. and 50% is provided by the State Government. Beneficiaries are expected to operate and maintain the plant independently and ensure the supply of feed to fishers at affordable prices.
benefits:
- The project cost is 650Rs./-

> **Subsidy Distribution :**


1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease of at least 10 years.
1. The applicant must be willing to operateRs. maintainRs. and manage the feed plant after its construction.
1. The applicant must ensure that the feed plant provides an affordable feed supply to fishers and fish farmers.
1. The applicant must submit a valid Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines.
1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate relevant to feed mill operation and maintenance.
1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from legal disputes and must provide a valid land title.

name: PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.
benefits: > The project cost for one unit is 25Rs./-. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category or women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The freshwater finfish hatchery should have a minimum capacity of 15 million fry per year per unit or 6.00 crore spawn per year per unit.
1. The hatchery should have a minimum area of 0.50 hectares.
1. The fish hatchery should be managed by qualified technical staff.
1. The applicant will ensure the supply of seed produced from the centrally assisted hatcheries to farmers at an affordable and reasonable price.
1. The fish hatchery will include a brooder pondRs. nursery pondsRs. rearing tanksRs. a small laboratoryRs. water and electric supplyRs. and required infrastructure facilities.
1. The cost of accreditation of the hatchery must be mandatorily included in the project estimates.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme.
1. The lease period or agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicantRs. having their own landRs. must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.

name: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2007Rs. the "Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme"Rs. implemented by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide quality yarn at subsidized rates to handloom weaversRs. ensuring affordability and improved product quality. The scheme offers freight reimbursement (18.5% based on yarn type and region) and a 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC-recognized depots. Eligible beneficiaries include handloom cooperativesRs. NGOsRs. and development centers. The scheme is implemented through District Industries Centers (DICs) and aims to sustain employment for economically weak weaversRs. especially from Scheduled Castes.
benefits:
**Yarn Purchase Subsidy** 15% subsidy on yarn bought from NHDC-recognized depots.
**Freight Reimbursement** - Non-Silk/Jute Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%Rs. Hills/Remote: 1.75%Rs. North-East: 3.00% - Silk Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%Rs. Hills/Remote: 1.25%Rs. North-East: 1.50% - Jute/Jute Blended Yarn: Plain Area: 7.00%Rs. Hills/Remote: 8.00%Rs. North-East: 8.50% _*Additional 2.5% depot operating charges._
**Disbursement Mode** 15% subsidy credited via RTGS/e-payment. Freight reimbursement is processed separately.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a handloom cooperative societyRs. NGORs. or development center.
- The applicant must purchase yarn from NHDC-recognized depots (e.g.Rs. Gujarat State Handloom & Handicrafts Development Corporation).

name: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana
brief_description: The "Live Fish Vending Center" Scheme was launched by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). It aims to promote hygienic fish vending and improve fish transportation and marketing infrastructure. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided for setting up a live fish vending centerRs. which may be a fixed centerRs. mobile unitRs. or a combination of both.
benefits: **Monetary Benefit:** - Financial assistance of 20Rs./- per unit for setting up a live fish vending center. - Subsidy of 40% of unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - Subsidy of 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a fisherman.
1. The applicant must have a valid Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra).
1. The applicant should be engaged in fishery-related activities.
1. The applicant must ensure proper operation and maintenance of the vending center.
1. The applicant will receive assistance for only one live fish vending center.
1. The government will not be responsible for any operational loss or damage.

name: Handicraft Mela Participation
brief_description: The scheme "Handicraft Mela Participation" by the Industrial Extension Cottage (iNDEXT-C)Rs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote traditional handicrafts by providing artisans and organizations with platforms to showcase and sell their products at state and national-level fairs. The scheme facilitates participation in designated melas (fairs) by covering logistical support and stall allocations. Eligible applicants include individual artisansRs. self-help groups (SHGs)Rs. and registered handicraft organizations. The scheme is implemented by Indext-C (Industrial Extension BureauRs. Gujarat)Rs. and applications are accepted offline through district offices or the Indext-C portal.
benefits:
**Stall Allocation:** Free or subsidized stalls at designated melas.
**Promotional Support:** Marketing and branding assistance for participants.
**Sales Platform:** Direct access to customers and bulk buyers.
**Logistical Aid:** Basic infrastructure (tablesRs. signage) provided at mela venues.
**Financial Incentives:** Priority for artisans from SC/ST/SEBC/EWS categories.
eligibility:
**For Individual Artisans** - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must possess a valid Artisan ID Card issued by Indext-C or a recognized authority. - The applicant must specialize in a traditional handicraft listed under the scheme (e.g.Rs. embroideryRs. potteryRs. woodwork).
**For Organizations/SHGs** - The applicant must be a registered cluster/cooperative society/NGO. - The applicant must have a minimum of 10 artisans affiliated with the organization. - The applicant must submit audit reports and registration certificates.
