name: Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and support the contributions of state-level sportspersons who have won medals in national-level sports events by offering them a financial pension after the age of 50 years. The scheme ensures dignified post-retirement sustenance for these individualsRs. thereby encouraging younger generations to pursue sports professionally. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** A Pension of 3Rs./- per month.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should be aged above 50 years at the time of application. - The applicant should have won medals in national-level sports competitions representing the state.

name: Term Loan Scheme (GMFDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Term Loan Scheme" is implemented by Gujarat Minorities Finance and Development Corporation (GMFDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the minority communities by providing financial assistance for agriculture and allied activitiesRs. small-scale businessesRs. craftsmanshipRs. transport sectorRs. traditional occupationsRs. and service-based businesses/trades. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipmentRs. raw materialsRs. or working capital.
benefits: 1. **Financial Assistance for Business:** Loans ranging from 1Rs./- to 20Rs./- are provided businesses/trades in various sectors listed below: - Agriculture and allied businessesRs. such as animal husbandryRs. fisheriesRs. etc. - Technical & Skilled self-employment businesses. - Service-oriented businesses such as provision storesRs. ready-made garment shopsRs. cyber cafesRs. cold drink parlorsRs. auto repairingRs. beauty parlorsRs. etc. - Handicraft businesses. - Transport sector. 1. **Interest Rates:** - For annual income up to 1Rs./- (rural) and 1Rs./- (urban)Rs. the interest rate is 6% per annum. - For families with annual income above 1Rs./- and up to 8Rs./-Rs. the interest rate is 8% for male beneficiaries and 6% for female beneficiaries. **3. Repayment:** The loan amount has to be repaid to the corporation in 60 equal installments over five yearsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a minority religious community (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. JainRs. BuddhistRs. ParsiRs. or Jewish) or a linguistic community (SindhiRs. MarathiRs. or Urdu) in the state of Gujarat. 1. The applicantRs. or any member of their familyRs. should not have obtained a loan from Gujarat Minority Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Gujarat Backwards Class Development CorporationRs. GandhinagarRs. including any other corporation/institution or bank of the Central or State Government. 1. The annual income of the applicant's family should be: - 98Rs./- for rural areas. - 1Rs./- for urban areas. - HoweverRs. families with income exceeding 1Rs./- and up to 8Rs./- are also eligibleRs. albeit with different interest rates. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years.

name: Educational Loan Scheme (GMFDC)
brief_description: The "Educational Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Minorities Finance and Development Corporation (GMFDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for all types of educationRs. including various technical and non-technical coursesRs. that help beneficiaries gain employment or enhance their job prospects. Under this schemeRs. low-interest loans are offered to eligible students from minority communities to pursue graduate and postgraduate courses in technicalRs. vocationalRs. professionalRs. and medical fieldsRs. either in India or abroad.
benefits: 1. For studies within IndiaRs. a maximum loan of 1Rs./- per year and up to 7Rs./- for a five-year course can be obtained. 1. For medical courses within IndiaRs. 2Rs./- for 1 year and 12Rs./- for 5 years can be obtained. 1. For abroad studiesRs. a maximum loan of 3Rs./- for 1 year and 15Rs./- for 5 years is provided. 1. The annual interest rate on this loan is 3%. **Note 1:** If the applicants annual family income is up to 98Rs. in rural areas or 1Rs. in urban areasRs. the loan is provided at a concessional interest rate of 3% per annum. **Note 2:** According to the National Corporation's Credit Line-2Rs. for families with an income of 1Rs./- up to 8Rs. the interest rate is 5% for female students and 8% for male students. **Note 3:** The loan and interest amount is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments within five years from the date of completion of studies or from the date of getting a jobRs. whichever is earlier. **Note 4:** Penalty interest at the rate of 2% is payable on delayed payments.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a minority religious community (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. JainRs. BuddhistRs. ParsiRs. and Jewish) or a linguistic community (SindhiRs. MarathiRs. Urdu) of Gujarat State. 1. The applicant or any family member should not have received a loan from Gujarat Minorities Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Gujarat Backward Class Development CorporationRs. GandhinagarRs. or any other central/state government corporation/institution or bank. 1. The annual income of the applicant's family should be: - 98Rs./- for rural areas. - 1Rs./- for urban areas. - HoweverRs. families with income exceeding 1Rs./- and up to 8Rs./- are also eligibleRs. albeit with different interest rates 5. The applicant's age should be between 16 and 32 years.

name: "Agricultural Income Tax Holiday" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
brief_description: Launched in 2020Rs. the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from CrushRs. TearRs. Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. through multiple implementing agenciesRs. including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
benefits: **Benefit Period:** 3 years of Agricultural Income Tax holiday. **Applicable Financial Years:** 2022-23 to 2024-25. **Condition:** Returns must be filed within the due date; if not filed on the due dateRs. interest and penalty will be applicable.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing CrushRs. TearRs. Curl TeaRs. Orthodox TeaRs. or Speciality tea including Green teaRs. Oolong TeaRs. White teaRs. Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam.

name: Handicraft Rebate Scheme
brief_description: The "Handicraft Rebate Scheme" launched by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support artisans and cooperatives by providing financial rebates on the sale of handicrafts. The scheme offers a 5% permanent rebate on retail sales and an additional 10% special rebate during festivals (totaling 1520% for women-led cooperatives). Implemented via the e-Kutir portalRs. it ensures transparency through an e-voucher system for toolkit distribution and rebate disbursement. The scheme targets industrial cooperativesRs. apex societiesRs. and women-led groupsRs. promoting market competitiveness and artisan welfare.
benefits: **Permanent Rebate:** - 5% on retail sales of handicraft. - 15% for women-led cooperatives. **Special Festival Rebate:** - Additional 10% (total 15% for general cooperativesRs. 20% for women-led groups) for 120 days during festivals. **Targeted Support:** - Enhanced rebates for Scheduled Castes/Tribes and BPL artisans.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a registered cooperative societyRs. apex institutionRs. or women-led group. - The applicant must produce handicrafts. - The applicant must obtain prior rebate certification from the Commissionerate.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class
brief_description: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to promote education among socially and educationally backwards students. Through this schemeRs. scholarships per annum are provided to boys and girls studying in Standards 1 to 10 in government and aided schools. The scheme is implemented by the DirectorRs. Developing Caste WelfareRs. GandhinagarRs. Gujarat.
benefits: 1. **For Boys (Std. 1 to 8):** 750/- scholarship.1. **For Boys (Std. 9 to 10):** 1000/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 1 to 5):** 500/- scholarship.1. **For Girls (Std. 6 to 10):** 1000/- scholarship.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be studying in Standard 1 to 10. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a Government or Aided Primary/Secondary School. 1. For applicants studying in Standard 1 to 8Rs. there is no family income limit. 1. For applicants studying in Standard 9 to 10Rs. the annual family income of the applicants family should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "Mahila Samriddhi Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower women entrepreneurs from the Thakor and Koli communities by providing access to micro-loans for self-employment. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans is provided to eligible women beneficiaries to help them set up small businesses or trades based on their skills.
benefits: - **Maximum Loan Amount:** Up to 60Rs./-.- **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** Up to 100% of the loan will be given for the proposed business/trade.- **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments (4 years) including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman from Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant should be between 21 to 50 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should have relevant technical skills and experience in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families with annual income up to 1Rs./-.

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Samriddhi Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to create a microfinance scheme for women of target groups and women entrepreneurs doing independent business to create self-employment for women of nomadic and denotified castes. Under this schemeRs. women beneficiaries will be able to pursue a business/occupation of their choice. Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Castes Development Corporation implement the scheme.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit will be up to 1Rs./-. 1. The interest rate will be 4% per annum. 1. Under this schemeRs. 100% loan of the business/occupation amount is provided. 1. The loan amount will consist of 95% National Corporation contributionRs. 5% State Government contribution and zero beneficiary contribution. > **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly instalmentsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a woman from a Nomadic or Denotified Caste. 1. The annual income limit of the family for income eligibility will be up to 3Rs./- with effect from 1/4/2018. At least 50 percent of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to 1Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a technical and skilled trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan.

name: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters
brief_description: The Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters is a scheme component under the Scheme for the Welfare of Scheduled Caste Families in the Fisheries SectorRs. launched by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their socio-economic status by promoting fish farming through subsidization of fishing contract costs in designated water bodies. Under this schemeRs. a subsidy of up to 50% of the actual auctioned amount of notified water bodies is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries to help them acquire fishing rights in such notified waters.
benefits: - 50% subsidy of the actual auctioned amount with maximum limit of 5Rs./- per auctionRs. whichever is less.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.

name: Pashupalan (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Pashupalan (GBCDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. owned by the Centre and the Gujarat GovernmentRs. aims to provide financial assistance for agriculture-related activities. Through this schemeRs. a low-interest loan amount is provided to support Pashu Palaks (Animal Rearers) in undertaking animal husbandry activities such as purchasing cows and buffaloes. The scheme's core objective is to offer financial aid at low-interest ratesRs. supporting eligible individuals from socially and educationally backwards classes.
benefits:
1. **Low-Interest Loan:** A loan is provided at an interest rate of 6 per cent per annum.1. **Maximum Loan Limit:** The maximum loan limit in this scheme is up to 1Rs./-.1. **Unit Cost Coverage:** 85 per cent of the unit cost will be loaned. - Out of this 85 per centRs. 85 per cent will be from the national corporation. - 10 per cent will be from the state government. - 5 per cent will be from the beneficiary's contribution.
> **Intended Use:** The loan is for agriculture-related activitiesRs. specifically animal husbandry (cow-buffalo). > **Repayment Terms:** This loan is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalmentsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be from a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.

name: Educational Loan Scheme (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Educational Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support for higher technical and professional education to students belonging to belonging to socially and educationally backward classes. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided at concessional interest rates to eligible students pursuing approved graduate and postgraduate professional & technical courses in fields such as engineeringRs. medicalRs. MBARs. MCARs. etc.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to 15Rs./-. 2. **The interest rate:** - 4% per annum for male students. - 3.5% per annum for female students. 3. **Loan Contribution Breakdown:** - 90% by the National Corporation. - 5% by the State Government. - 5% by the beneficiary. 4. **The loan amount will include the following:** - Admission fees and tuition fees - Accommodation and food expenses > **Validity:** This loan is to be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalmentsRs. including interest. The loan must be repaid within 6 months of completing the course or 1 month after getting a jobRs. whichever is earlier.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class. 1. The total annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The student must have secured admission through a recognized entrance examination conducted by the Central or State GovernmentRs. or through a selection processRs. with at least 50% marks in Class 12 or the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant should have secured admission in a recognized institution for one of the following courses: - MBA or its equivalent (recognized by AICTE) - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) or its equivalent (recognized by AICTE) - Graduate-level engineering courses conducted by IITs or other institutions (recognized by AICTE) - Medical or allied education such as AyurvedicRs. HomeopathyRs. UnaniRs. etc.Rs. from institutions recognized by the Medical Council of India - Diploma course in Hospitality Management recognized by the National Council of Hotel Management > **Note:** Priority will be given to applicants whose family income is up to 1Rs./- per annum.

name: Foreign Study Loan
brief_description: The scheme "Foreign Study Loan" implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational and Economical Development Corporation (GUEEDC)Rs. Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. provides financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories pursuing higher studies abroad. The scheme provides overseas study loans of up to 15Rs./- for specific coursesRs. including Bachelor of MedicineRs. Bachelor of SurgeryRs. post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma)Rs. post-graduation diplomaRs. and equivalent courses after Class 12th. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12 and belong to a family with an annual income of 6Rs./- or less. The loan carries simple interest at the rate of 4% per annum with repayment terms varying based on the loan amount.
benefits:
**Loan Amount:** Up to 15Rs./- for overseas study. **Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum. **Repayment Grace Period:** 1 year after completion of study before repayment begins. **Flexible Repayment:** Borrower can repay the loan before the stipulated time limit.
**Repayment Schedule** - For loans up to 5Rs./-: Equal monthly installments over 5 years. - For loans above 5Rs./-: Equal monthly installments over 6 years.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category. - The applicant must be pursuing higher studies abroad. - The applicant must be enrolled in Bachelor of MedicineRs. Bachelor of SurgeryRs. post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma)Rs. post-graduation diplomaRs. or equivalent courses after Class 12th. - The applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12th. - The applicant must belong to a family with an annual income of 6Rs./- or less.

name: Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to ensure the integrated development of horticulture in the state by providing financial support to farmers for activities such as post-harvest managementRs. farm mechanizationRs. crop processingRs. market linkageRs. and infrastructure development. The scheme enables support for exhibitionsRs. seminarsRs. krishimelasRs. stall rentalsRs. sea/air fridge subsidy for exportsRs. electricity subsidy for greenhouse and tissue culture labsRs. and assistance for hi-tech greenhouse/polyhouse/net house development.
benefits: - **Promotional Activities Support:** Provides assistance for publicationsRs. exhibitionsRs. competition seminarsRs. Krishi MelaRs. and stall rental payments related to horticultural crops. - **Farm Mechanization:** Offers support for farm mechanizationRs. including subsidies for power tillers and mini tractors. - **Processing Unit Establishment:** Facilitates the establishment of new distillation units for medicinal/aromatic crops and new processing units for cashew and other fruit crops. - **Export Subsidies:** Provides sea freight subsidy for the export of fruitsRs. vegetablesRs. flowersRs. and plantsRs. and air freight subsidy for the export of horticultural produce. - **Market Rate Control:** Supports Minimum Support Price (MSP) to horticultural crops for control of market rates. - **Utility Bill Subsidies:** Offers subsidy on electricity bills for Greenhouse and Tissue Culture Laboratory. - **Equipment Provision:** Aids in the provision of harvesting equipmentRs. processing equipmentRs. and crop protection equipment. - **Post-Harvest Management:** Provides subsidy on packing materials for Post-harvest management of horticultural produce. - **Protected Cultivation Infrastructure:** Supports the establishment of various structures including Hi-tech Greenhouse (Fan and Pad)Rs. PolyHouse (Naturally Ventilated)Rs. Net HouseRs. kaccha mandap of tomato/chili and other vegetable trellisesRs. Half-lined pedal for climber vegetablesRs. Lined pedal for climber vegetablesRs. and Plug Nursery. - **Irrigation Infrastructure:** Supports the establishment of Water storage tanks for Drip Irrigation.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer based in Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in horticultural activities eligible under the scheme. - The applicant must possess valid land ownership records such as 7/12 Certificate.

name: Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)
brief_description: The scheme "Vishesh KatanRs. Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)" by the Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog BoardRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. The scheme provides production incentive for spinning of yarn and weaving of Khadi with additional financial assistance ranging from 1/- per hank for general and Scheduled Caste spinners to 4/- per square meter for Scheduled Tribe weaversRs. along with weaving equipment aid of 1/- per square meter. The applicant must be Khadi spinners and weavers engaged in production activities. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog Board under Industries & Mines Department and applications are accepted as per the board's procedures.
benefits:
> **For Spinners** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional 1/- per hank for spinning of yarn. - Women and Scheduled Tribe Categories: Additional 1.5/- per hank for spinning of yarn. > **For Weavers** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional 3/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Scheduled Tribe Category: Additional 4/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Weaving Equipment Aid: 1/- per square meter weaving equipment aid.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - Production incentive based on actual spinning and weaving output. - Payment structure linked to per hank for spinning and per square meter for weaving. > **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Beneficiaries must be actively engaged in Khadi spinning and weaving activities. - Incentives are provided in addition to central government assistance. - Must maintain production records for verification purposes.
eligibility:
- The applicant must EITHER be Khadi spinners engaged in spinning of yarn activitiesRs. OR Khadi weavers engaged in weaving of Khadi activities. - The applicant must be provided production incentive for spinning of yarn/ weaving of Khadi.
> **Categories and Preferences** **General Category:** Eligible for standard assistance rates. **Scheduled Caste:** Eligible for standard assistance rates same as General category. **Women:** Eligible for enhanced assistance rates for spinning activities. **Scheduled Tribe:** Eligible for highest assistance rates for both spinning and weaving activities.

name: Sharodotsav Pandit Nandan Mehta: Plan for Conducting Classical Music Competition and Ceremony
brief_description: The scheme "Sharodotsav Pandit Nandan Mehta: Plan for Conducting Classical Music Competition and Ceremony" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to preserve and promote the rich heritage of classical music and percussion through a state-level competitive platform dedicated to the memory of the legendary percussionist Pt. Nandan Mehta. A three-day classical music and percussion competition is held every year on February 26Rs. the death anniversary of Pt. MehtaRs. where outstanding artists are recognized and awarded monetary prizes for their exceptional performances. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Sangeet Natak Academy.
benefits: - **First Prize:** 11Rs./-. - **Second Prize:** 8Rs./-. - **Third Prize:** 5Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be an individual participating in the classical music or percussion category.

name: "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme
brief_description: The scheme "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme by the Ministry of TextilesRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to develop and promote marketing channels in domestic and export markets in a holistic and integrated manner to bring greater visibility to the sector and ensure commensurate remuneration to weavers. The scheme provides Marketing Incentive calculated at 10% on average sales of handloom products of the last 3 years with maximum caps of 1Rs./- for state level organizations and 15Rs./- lakh for primary societiesRs. equally shared between State Government and Central Government except for National Level Handloom Organizations where entire assistance is borne by Government of India. The scheme is implemented by the Office of Development Commissioner (Handlooms) under Ministry of Textiles with applications accepted through prescribed proformas and State Government recommendations.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance Structure** - Marketing Incentive Rate: 10% on average sales of handloom products of the last 3 years. - State Level Organizations: Maximum 100.00 lakh (Central Government share). - Primary Level Organizations: Maximum 15.00 lakh (Central Government share). > **Category-wise Maximum Caps** - State Level Organizations (Handloom CorporationsRs. Apex Cooperative SocietiesRs. National Level Handloom Organizations): 1Rs./- Central Government share. - Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative SocietiesRs. Producer CompaniesRs. Self Help GroupsRs. Joint Liability GroupsRs. Federations and Other Eligible Handloom Entities: 15Rs./- Central Government share. > **Financial Assistance Sharing** - General Cases: 50:50 sharing between Government of India and State Government. - National Level Handloom Organizations/Societies: Entire assistance borne by Government of India. - Benefit Distribution: 10% benefits shared equally between Organizations and Member Weavers through Direct Benefit Transfer.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - Marketing Incentive will be given maximum for 3 years during the scheme period of 5 years. - Release through Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism. - Nodal Agency must release amount to eligible handloom agencies and their member weavers within 7 days of receipt. > **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Amount to be used towards activities that attract consumers to gear up overall sales of handloom goods. - Enable handloom agencies to adjust prices towards increasing cost competitivenessRs. improve designsRs. and invest in infrastructure. - State Government recommendation subject to matching contribution by concerned State Government. - Claims must be Goods and Services Tax compliant. - No similar incentive/rebate received under any other Central Government scheme.
eligibility: The applicant must be one of the following: - Handloom agencies including State level organizations such as Handloom CorporationsRs. Apex Cooperative Societies and National Level Handloom OrganizationsRs. Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative SocietiesRs. Producer CompaniesRs. Self Help GroupsRs. Joint Liability GroupsRs. Federations and Other eligible Handloom entities. - The applicant must have made the final transaction of product sale to the consumer. - The applicant must use Handloom Mark or India Handloom Brand for their handloom products. - The applicant must have average sales turnover of handloom products for the last 3 years for incentive calculation.

name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates
brief_description: The 'Full Time PhD Candidate' is a component of the scheme Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and ITRs. implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. It is an institutional schemeRs. where PhD seats are allocated to the institutions and the institutions enroll PhD candidates on these seats following their admission procedures. ***Objectives:*** - To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country. - Give thrust to R&DRs. create an innovative ecosystem and enhance Indias competitiveness in these knowledge intensive sectors. ***Salient Features:*** - 1000 Full Time PhD seats in the areas of ESDM & IT/ITES - One time support for selected 250 Full-time PhD candidates (50 candidates/year) for 6 months Visit to Labs Abroad - Support for International Conference up to Rs. 1.50 Lakh/ per Full Time PhD once under the support tenure - Contingency Research Grant @ Rs. 1.20 Lakh/ year per Full Time PhD
benefits: [***Financial Support for Full-time PhD candidates***](https://phd.dic.gov.in/guidelines/SOPFullTime.pdf)***:*** 1. **Fellowship:** 38Rs./- per month in 1st & 2nd year and @43Rs./- per month in 3rdRs. 4th and 5th years of PhD. (support till PhD completion or 5 years whichever is earlier). 1. **Reimbursement of Rent (RoR):** This component is linked with the fellowship of a PhD Candidate. The rate of RoR is 24%Rs. 16% & 8% (of fellowship) for XRs. Y & Z class cities/towns respectively. 1. **Institutional Overheads:** An amount of 25Rs./Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of PhD candidate to be given to the institution. The institutional overhead will be released after completion of required tenure by the respective candidate on pro-rata basis. 1. **Research Contingency Grant Support:** An amount of 1Rs./Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of the PhD candidate. 1. **Support to attend selected International Conferences** up to 1.5 Lakh per Full Time PhD candidate from 3rd year. 1. **One time support for selected 250 Full Time PhD candidates from 3rd year for 6 months Visit to Labs Abroad.** The support would be available to the selected Full Time PhD candidates with following guidelines: - During the visitRs. the Monthly Fellowship will be 1.50 Lakh. - The Travel/Visa expenses up to 1.50 Lakh is provided. - During this periodRs. the domestic Fellowship and Reimbursement of Rent (RoR) will be suspended.
eligibility:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Full Time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD SchemeRs. DICRs. MeitY. 1. The call for proposal for Full Time PhDseats is notified by PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/ 2. Proposals for allotment of Full Time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Full Time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. 3. The institutions with PhD seatsRs. allotted under the schemeRs. would conduct their admission process for enrolment of candidates on those seats. 4.**** Only the candidates enrolled/registered for PhD during the period of the scheme would be eligible to apply for the financial support. This scheme will be applicable for new PhD Scholars after notification of the scheme 5. Candidates already availing financial support from other government schemes are not eligible.
***Terms and Conditions for support*** 1. The support will be for additional PhD candidates taken up by an institution. No support would be provided for current levels of enrolment in the PhD programme at the institutions. Transfer from other scholarship schemes would not be permitted. 1. Only the candidates enrolled/registered for PhD during the period of the scheme would be eligible to apply for the financial support. This scheme will be applicable for new PhD Scholars after notification of the scheme. 1. The candidate would be eligible for Fellowship for the period during which the candidate is in good standingRs. and fulfills the requirements of the PhD successfully. The maximum period for which the support would be available for any Full-time candidate would be five years or till the completion of PhD whichever is earlier. 1. The participating Institution will ensure that a candidate receiving fellowship under this scheme is not receiving any financial support for PhD from any other scheme of Government of India/States etc. at the same timeRs. The candidates who have availed support for their PhD from any other scheme of Government of India/States etc. will be automatically be disqualified for support under this scheme. 1. The PhD seats allotted for a particular year should be utilized in the same academic year only as per the prescribed timelines. The unfilled seats would be automatically pulled back to the general pool of the scheme. 1. The institutionsRs. in the event of any drop-outRs. need to report it to PhD Cell/DIC immediately. The institutions cannot enroll a substitute candidate on their own. 1. The institution will be responsible for furnishing utilization certificates of the funds released to them based on the scheme parametersRs. and as per conditions of the sanctioned grant-in- aid.

name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Part Time PhD Candidates
brief_description: The Part Time PhD Candidate is a component of the scheme Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and ITRs. implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. The scheme aims at generating a total of 150 Part-time PhDs in emerging research areas of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years. ***Objectives:*** - To enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors in the country. - Give thrust to R&DRs. create an innovative ecosystem and enhance Indias competitiveness in these knowledge intensive sectors. Part-Time PhD seats are provisioned for professionals working at a reputed place/organisation. The seats are allotted to the institutions based on the assessment of the proposals of the instituteRs. research strengthRs. and the working places of the prospective applicants.
benefits: - Part-time PhD candidates will receive a one-time incentive of 3Rs./- upon successful completion of their PhD degree and reporting of the same to PhD Cell through their institution with PhD completion documents.
eligibility:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Part-time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD SchemeRs. DICRs. MeitY. <br> 1. The call for proposal for Part-time PhD seats will be notified by PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/. 2. Proposals for allotment of Part-time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Part-time PhD fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. <br> <br> - Part-time PhD seats are provisioned for professionals working at reputed places/organizations. - The selected candidates should not be availing any PhD Fellowship/scholarship from any other scheme of Central or State Government.
***Termination of the Support*** PhD CellRs. DICRs. MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ terminate the support for this component at any stageRs. including but not limited to: - Appropriate progress is not being made. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reasonRs. which is deemed appropriate by PhD CellRs. DICRs. MeitY.

name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships
brief_description: The Young Faculty Research Fellowship (YFRF) is a component of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and ITRs. implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to promote R&DRs. create an innovative ecosystemRs. and enhance Indias competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidatesRs. for an initial period of support of 2 yearsRs. extendible till 5th year based on performance review.
benefits: ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** 20Rs./- per monthRs. in addition to the regular salary - **Research Contingency Grant:** 5Rs./- per year for a maximum of 5 years - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institution. - Research Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipmentRs. consumables and domestic travel. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for YFRF. - The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - YFRFs are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution though which YFRF proposal was submitted. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignmentRs. and is tenable for a maximum period of 05 years. - The award will initially be for 2 years and further extendibleRs. based on performance review.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The applicant must have obtained PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of gradesRs. etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. 1. The applicant must have a regular position in the institute and should be engaged in research. 1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application. 1. YFRF under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career. 1. The applicant availing any other fellowship is not eligible to apply. 1. Proposals for allotment of YFRF are to be submitted through eligible institutions only. 1. Each institution in the proposal may submit up to three nominations for the award for each round of call for applications. ***Discontinuation of the Fellowship:*** 1. The performance of YFRF would be reviewed periodically as per the discretion of PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY. 1. A detailed performance assessment/review of award would be conducted annually and decision on continuation of YFRF would be taken accordingly. 1. If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowshipRs. the institution should inform Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme immediately. One month's notice is to be given to DIC through the institution before the date of discontinuation. 1. The implementing institution should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the fellow. The institution will ensure the submission of work report and other requisite documents from YFRF awardee. 1. PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ terminate the Fellowship at any stage because of reasons includingRs. but not limited to the following: - Appropriate progress is not being made. - The grant is not being utilized properly. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reasonRs. which is deemed appropriate by PhD CellRs. DICRs. MeitY.

name: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan" scheme was launched by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB)Rs. Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide a small measure of relief to war bereavedRs. war disabled and attributable peace time casualties(all ranks). Under this schemeRs. reimbursement of 50% of the interest on a home loan up to 1Rs. is provided for a maximum of five years.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the interest charged on the home loan.- **Loan Limit for Subsidy:** Up to 1Rs. (even if the loan amount is higher).- **Duration:** Maximum of 5 years or until loan repayment is completedRs. whichever is earlier.- **Applicable Loan Sources:** BanksRs. Government/Public Sector undertakingsRs. Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)Rs. General Insurance Corporation (GIC)Rs. and Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a war widowRs. war bereaved family memberRs. war disabled personnelRs. or attributable peacetime casualty (all ranks). 1. The applicant must have taken a home loan from a bankRs. government/public sector undertakingRs. LICRs. GICRs. or HUDCO. 1. The loan amount considered for subsidy must not exceed 1Rs. regardless of the actual loan amount.

name: Kishori Balika Yojana- Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to create awareness among adolescent girls aged 14 to 18 years about nutritionRs. healthRs. and life cycle issuesRs. and also provides supplementary nutrition for 300 days in a year.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. awareness is created among adolescent girls about nutritionRs. healthRs. and life cycle issues. They are also provided supplementary nutrition (fortified rice and wheat for 25 days each month) for 300 days in a year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an adolescent girl in the age group of 14 to 18 years. 1. The applicant must be residing in one of the aspirational districts of Uttarakhand- Haridwar or Udham Singh Nagar.

name: National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm: Planting Materials
brief_description: The scheme component "Planting Materials" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to enhance oil palm cultivation in Gujarat by providing subsidized planting materials to farmersRs. thereby reducing import dependency and promoting self-reliance in edible oil production. The assistance covers both locally sourced and imported seedlingsRs. including transportation costs for imported varieties.
benefits: - **For Locally Sourced Planting Materials.:** 20Rs./- per hectare - **For Imported Plants (including transportation cost):** 29Rs./- per hectare > **Note:** For imported seedlings (along with transportation cost) the assistance will be admissible as per the holding of land held by the farmer.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Nursery
brief_description: The scheme component "Nursery" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote oil palm cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance to farmers for establishing oil palm nurseries. This initiative seeks to increase domestic productionRs. thereby reducing the import of oil palm from abroad and strengthening the agricultural economy.
benefits: - **Subsidy:** 40Rs./- per nursery.- **Capacity:** 10 hectares for 1Rs. worth of saplings.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote sustainable and structured vegetable crop cultivation by extending financial assistance to eligible farmers for building kachhaRs. semi-puccaRs. and pucca trellis mandaps using materials like woodRs. bambooRs. GI wireRs. and plastic wire. This initiative not only supports effective vegetable cultivation techniques but also improves the productivity and longevity of vegetable crops grown on trellises.
benefits: > **Monetary Assistance:** - **General Farmers:** 50% of unit cost or 80Rs./- per hectare- **SC/ST Farmers:** 75% of unit cost or 1Rs./- per hectare- **Devipoojak Farmers:** 90% of cost or 46Rs./- per hectare > **Input Support:** - **Wood/Bamboo Supports:** 1Rs. units per hectare- **GI Wire (1218 gauge) or Plastic Wire:** 400 kg per hectare- **Recommended Plant Spacing:** 2.5 x 2.5 meters (approximate) > **Coverage Limit:** - **Maximum Area:** 2.00 hectares per Khata **Validity:** - **Assistance duration:** 3 years
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable cultivation. - The applicant should be willing to construct trellis mandaps.

name: Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3
brief_description: The scheme "Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to strengthen horticulture-based livelihoods and promote modern horticultural practices among tribal farmers through financial assistance for farm mechanizationRs. processing unitsRs. crop protectionRs. post-harvest managementRs. and export-related infrastructure. The scheme provides targeted subsidies on equipmentRs. unitsRs. and inputs to ensure sustainable horticultural growth in tribal areas.
benefits: > **Capacity Building & Promotion:** - Assistance for publication and promotional materials related to horticultural crops. - Financial support for organizing and participating in exhibitionsRs. competitionsRs. and seminars. - Subsidy for organizing or participating in Krishi Melas and payment for stall rentals. > **Farm Mechanization Support:** - Subsidy for purchase of power tillers and mini tractors to enhance horticultural productivity. - Financial aid for harvesting equipment and crop protection equipment. > **Processing & Value Addition:** - Support for establishment of new distillation units for medicinal and aromatic crops. - Subsidy for setting up new processing units for cashew and other fruit crops. - Assistance for processing equipment for value addition. > **Export Promotion:** - Sea fridge subsidy for export of fruitsRs. vegetablesRs. flowersRs. and plants. - Air fridge subsidy to promote export of horticultural produce. > **Price Stabilization:** - Minimum Support Price (MSP) assistance to ensure stable market prices for horticultural crops. > **Infrastructure & Utilities Support:** - Subsidy on electricity bills for operating greenhouses and tissue culture laboratories. - Support for hi-tech greenhouses (with fan and pad system). - Support for naturally ventilated polyhouses and net houses. > **Post-Harvest Management:** - Subsidy for packing materials used in post-harvest handling of horticultural produce. - Support for setting up kaccha mandaps for tomato/chilly and other vegetable marketing. - Construction of vegetable trellises and half-lined pedestrian paths for climbing vegetable crops.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be practicing horticulture in tribal areas.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes
brief_description: The Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to reduce school dropout rates and improve educational access among students belonging to Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes. Under this schemeRs. annual financial scholarships are provided to students from classes 1st to 10th studying in government and aided primary schoolsRs. ensuring they continue their education without financial hardship.
benefits: > **Scholarship Amounts:** - Boys (Class 1st to 8th): 750/- per annum- Boys (Class 9th to 10th): 1Rs./- per annum- Girls (Class 1st to 5th): 500/- per annum- Girls (Class 6th to 10th): 1Rs./- per annum
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to Notified Tribes or Denotified Tribes as recognized by the Government of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student and studying in standard 1st to 10th. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided primary or secondary school. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. There is no income limit for students from standard 1st to 8th. 1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./- for classes 9th to 10th.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure firstRs. secondRs. or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.
benefits: **At the university levelRs. students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positions in graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: 50Rs./- - 2nd Position: 30Rs./- - 3rd Position: 15Rs./- **Students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positions in post-graduation examinations are awarded:** - 1st Position: 75Rs./- - 2nd Position: 60Rs./- - 3rd Position: 30Rs./-
eligibility: 1. This scheme is applicable to the top three students who have obtained the highest marks at the university level after completing their courses in the ArtsRs. ScienceRs. and Commerce faculties at the graduate and post-graduate levels in the states Shridev Suman UniversityRs. Kumaon UniversityRs. Soban Singh Jeena UniversityRs. and their affiliated colleges. 1. Students who have obtained less than 60% marks will be ineligible under the scheme. 1. Students who have appeared in improvement examinations in graduation or post-graduationRs. backlog examinationsRs. or those who have dropped out in any year and then progressed to the next class will also be ineligible for the scheme.

name: Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education among girl students in the state by providing scholarships to those pursuing their first year of post-graduation in various government colleges across Uttarakhand.
benefits: A scholarship of 51Rs./- per student is given to 50 girl students enrolled in the first year of post-graduation at various government colleges across the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant (girl student) must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The girl student must be studying in a government college in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the first year of a postgraduate (PG) course. 1. The applicants family annual income from all sources should not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The girl student must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks in graduation.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil) Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure / Green manure seed (For mix in the soil)" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to help Adivasi farmers in Tribal Areas (TASP) and tribal cultivators outside these areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops. Through this schemeRs. subsidies are provided on various agricultural inputs such as high-yield variety seedsRs. hybrid seedsRs. and fertilizers. Farmers are also provided with plant protection equipmentRs. tarpaulinsRs. field demonstrationsRs. micronutrientsRs. water carrying pipelinesRs. and pump sets to increase their crop yield and improve their livelihoods. The scheme's benefits are provided to farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas.
benefits:
**SCHEDULE-IV and V under FCO 1985:-** 1. **Castor cake/Neem cake/ Liquid Fermented Organic Manure:** 75% of the purchase price or 9Rs./- per hectareRs. whichever is less. This assistance is for a maximum of two hectares per account. OR 1. **Green manuring (hemp/Ikkad seeds):** 75% of the purchase price or 3Rs./- per hectareRs. whichever is less. A total of 6Rs./- per personRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided for hemp (60 kg) or Ikkad (50 kg) seeds per hectare. This assistance is for a maximum of three hectares per account.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit for Castor cake/Neem cake/Liquid Fermented Organic Manure/Green manure seed is provided every year. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.

name: PMMSY: Three wheeler with Ice Box including e-rickshaws for fish vending - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Three-wheeler with Ice Box including e-rickshaws for fish vending"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish healthRs. uplift fishermenRs. and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnesRs. ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. SoRs. cold storage/ice plant modernisation is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
1. The unit cost is 3Rs./-. 40% assistance for the General categoryRs. i.e. 1Rs./- and 60% i.e. up to 1Rs./- for women and the ST/SC category. 1. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs. SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme 'Khiladi Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana' was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sports among talented youth aged 14 to 23 years from Uttarakhand by providing scholarships and financial assistance for sports equipment.

The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competitionRs. conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strengthRs. flexibilityRs. enduranceRs. speedRs. and coordinationRs. will be eligible for the sports scholarship. 1. Scholarships are awarded on a priority basis in the following sports: (1) AthleticsRs. (2) BadmintonRs. (3) BoxingRs. (4) TaekwondoRs. (5) KabaddiRs. (6) FootballRs. (7) VolleyballRs. (8) BasketballRs. (9) HockeyRs. (10) Table TennisRs. (11) KarateRs. and (12) Judo.

name: Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)
brief_description: The scheme "Funeral Assistance Scheme for Unorganized Workers (Except Construction Workers)"Rs. launched by the Gujarat Rural Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour & Employment Department Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to the heirs of deceased unorganized sector workers to help with funeral expenses and last ritesRs. addressing the financial burden faced by families during such distressing times. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of 10Rs./- to one heir of the deceased worker and is specifically designed for e-Shram card holders in the unorganized sector. The applicant must be an heir of an e-Shram card holder (except e-Nirman card holders and Scheduled Caste individuals) and must have an annual income within specified limits of 1Rs./- for rural areas and 1Rs./- for urban areas. The scheme is implemented by the Labour & Employment Department Government of Gujarat and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through designated government labour offices.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** 10Rs./- paid to one heir of the deceased unorganized workerRs. to assist with funeral expenses and last rites (funeral ceremonies).
eligibility:
- The applicant must be an heir of a deceased e-Shram card holder from the unorganized sector. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must apply within 3 (three) months from the date of death of the deceased worker. - The deceased worker must have between 16 to 70 years of age at the time of death. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding 1Rs./- (One Lakh Twenty Thousand Rupees)Rs. if residing in rural areas. - The applicant must have an annual income not exceeding 1Rs./- (One Lakh Fifty Thousand Rupees)Rs. if residing in urban areas. - Only one heir per deceased worker is eligible to receive the assistance.
> **Priority Order for Heirs** The legal heirs of the deceased shall be considered in the following order of priority: 1. Husband or Wife. 1. Children (Son/Daughter) - in absence of spouse. 1. Parents - in absence of spouse and children. 1. Grandchildren (Grandson/Granddaughter) - in absence of spouseRs. children and parents. 1. UnmarriedRs. widowed or abandoned sisters - in absence of spouseRs. childrenRs. parents and grandchildren. 1. Other heirs declared under Indian Succession ActRs. 1925 - in absence of all above categories.

name: Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman

name: PMMSY: Construction of Plant/Storage of Minimum 30 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Construction of Plant/Storage of Minimum 30 Tonne Capacity"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish healthRs. uplift fishermenRs. and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnesRs. ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
> **Construction of Ice Plant/Storage (minimum 30 tonne capacity):** 1. Unit cost is 120Rs./-. The amount of assistance for the beneficiary of general category will be 40% of the unit cost and for the beneficiary of women and ST/SC category the amount of assistance will be available at the rate of 60% of the unit cost. 1. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs. SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Saksham Scholarship
brief_description: The Saksham Scholarship is implemented by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.
benefits: Financial assistance of 50Rs./- per annum is provided for Graduate-level studies.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have at least 40% disability. 1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat

benefits:

eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. name: Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat
brief_description: The "Vidhya Sadhana Yojana" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to encourage Scheduled Tribe girls to continue education beyond class 8thRs. especially in remote areas where schools are located several kilometers away. Under this schemeRs. free bicycles are gifted to Scheduled Tribe girls studying in class 9thRs. enabling them to commute conveniently to schools.
benefits: - Free bicycles given to the scheduled tribal girl students as a gift.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th in a recognized school.1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Sri Ram Janmabhoomi Shabari Smriti Yatra Sahay Scheme" by the Industry and Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled tribes and tribal communities for pilgrimage to Sri Ram Janmabhoomi in AyodhyaRs. Uttar PradeshRs. in memory of "Maa Shabari" and to enable darshan of Lord Sri Ram. The scheme provides financial assistance of 5Rs./- per pilgrim and covers railway travel expenses through Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited arrangements. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat for twelve years or more and belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas BoardRs. Gandhinagar.
benefits: > ***Financial Assistance*** 5Rs./- per pilgrim as financial assistance towards travel expenses for pilgrimage to Sri Ram JanmabhoomiRs. Ayodhya. > ***Travel Arrangements*** - Travel arrangements through the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited. - Railway journey assistance and booking support. > ***Coverage Details*** - First 1Rs. scheduled tribe and tribal pilgrims will be eligible for the scheme benefits. - Benefits are available once per person per year for the pilgrimage to Sri Ram JanmabhoomiRs. Ayodhya. > ***Conditions*** - Pilgrims must complete the journey and submit proof of pilgrimage completion. - Travel must be undertaken within the approved timeframe after receiving permission. - Registration and prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board is mandatory. - Submission of travel documents and pilgrimage proof within one month of journey completion is required.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state for twelve years or more from the current age. - The applicant must belong to the scheduled tribe or tribal community category. - The applicant must be eligible for only one pilgrimage assistance per person per year to Sri Ram JanmabhoomiRs. Ayodhya. - The applicant must be above 12 years of age. - The applicant can include up to 8 family members in the group application. - The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Gujarat Pavitra Yatradham Vikas Board before undertaking the journey. ***Priority/Preference*** Priority will be given to the first 1Rs. registered applicants from the scheduled tribe and tribal communities.

name: AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana
brief_description: The AYUSH Health and Wellness Centre - Ayushman Bharat Yojana is implemented by the Ayush DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide accessibleRs. affordableRs. and holistic healthcare services based on AyurvedaRs. YogaRs. Unani and Homeopathy systems to people of all age groups.
benefits: A total of 300 AYUSH Health and Wellness Centres are operating in the state. At these centresRs. medicines are distributed according to the specific diseaseRs. and yoga and naturopathy treatments are provided as per the condition. - Counselling based on nature testing and seasonal routines- screening and diagnosis of non-communicable diseases such as diabetesRs. hypertensionRs. oral cancerRs. breast cancerRs. and cervical cancerRs. are conducted. - Medicinal plants are also distributed. - OPD charges have been fixed at 1.00 per person in rural areas and 2.00 per person in urban areas.
eligibility: - The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The beneficiary may belong to any age group. - The beneficiary must be registered at a government-recognized AyurvedicRs. UnaniRs. or Homeopathic dispensary or hospital.

name: Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded)
brief_description: The Sponsorship Scheme is implemented by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children up to the age of 18 years who are in need of care and protection. It is a centrally sponsored schemeRs. funded 90% by the Government of India.
benefits: Beneficiaries are provided assistance of 4Rs./- per month till the age of 18 yearsRs. directly deposited into their bank account.
eligibility: 1. The child/beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children up to 18 years of age belonging to families with an annual income of up to 72Rs./- in rural areas and 96Rs./- in urban areas. 1. Children who have lost both parents/guardians. 1. Children covered under the PM CARES schemeRs. children belonging to families that have lost their primary breadwinner. 1. Children in conflict with the law (CCL). 1. Child labor victimsRs. child trafficking victimsRs. children affected by child marriageRs. POCSO victimsRs. children registered on the Bal Swaraj PortalRs. as well as other children in need of care and protection.

name: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The "Higher Education Assistance Scheme" by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. Labour & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide encouragement to children of workers and reduce the financial burden of education by offering higher educational assistance to meritorious studentsRs. addressing the economic challenges faced by workers' families in pursuing quality education for their children. The scheme provides financial assistance of 20Rs./- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses and 10Rs./- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses for students who have passed Standard 12 board examination in the year 2024 with 70 percent or above percentile. The applicant must be a child of a worker whose parent is working in a factory or institution in Gujarat state and whose parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The application deadline is the last date of February of the respective year.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance for Medical Education** Direct Benefit Transfer of 20Rs./- for students securing admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery courses. > **Financial Assistance for Other Graduate Courses** Direct Benefit Transfer of 10Rs./- for students securing admission in any other graduate level courses.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a child of a worker employed in a factory or institution in Gujarat state. - The applicant must have passed 12th Standard board examination in the respective year. - The applicant must have secured 70% or above percentile in 12th Standard board examination. - The applicant must have secured admission in Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery or any other graduate level course. - The applicant must ensure that their parent is working in a factory or institution located in Gujarat state. - The applicant must ensure that their parent has been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund office for the last one year continuously. - The applicant must submit the application by the last date of February of the respective year. - The applicant must have completed 12th Standard examination specifically in the respective year.

name: Promotion of Tiatr Music
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Music" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage youth and others to learn to play blowing instrumentsRs. particularly Trumpet and SaxophoneRs. by providing them with financial assistance. The scheme provides financial support for tuition feesRs. a 50% subsidy on the cost of medium-priced blowing instruments such as SaxophoneRs. TrumpetRs. or ClarinetRs. and opportunities for advanced certification from institutions like Trinity College or Royal School of Music. It also offers music classes at the Tiatr Academy of Goa's Conference Hall and awards certificates upon successful course completion. The applicant must identify a suitable tutorRs. purchase a blowing instrumentRs. submit an undertaking to serve the tiatr stageRs. and undergo periodical tests. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the prescribed application form available at the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
benefits: - Reimbursement of tuition fees paid to the tutorRs. with the exact amount to be decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - A 50% subsidy (refund) on the cost of a blowing instrument (SaxophoneRs. TrumpetRs. or Clarinet)Rs. based on the value of a medium-priced instrument. - Appropriate financial support for students to register and get themselves certified by institutions such as Trinity College or Royal School of Music. - To cover tuition costs incurred for learning blowing instruments vital for Tiatr music. - To reduce the financial burden of purchasing an essential blowing instrumentRs. making learning more accessible. - To support the pursuit of advanced musical qualifications and professional certification. **Conditions:** _*The student must complete the full course._ _*The refund is subject to the availability of funds._ _*The chosen tutor should maintain a record of attendance for the students and submit it to the Tiatr Academy of Goa._ _*Students must undergo periodical tests to verify their performanceRs. and those unable to cope with the syllabus or found not serious may be terminated after evaluation._
eligibility: - The applicant must be any interested personRs. young or adultRs. free to avail the benefit of this scheme. - The applicant must identify a tutor having the credentials to teach him/her the blowing instrumentRs. which will be verified and accepted by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must serve the tiatr stage by playing in any tiatr band or musical group for at least one year after completion of the course.

name: Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Documentation And Research Assistantship Scheme" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage documentation and digitisation of valuable Tiatr-related materials such as manuscriptsRs. photosRs. handbillsRs. advertisementsRs. newspaper or magazine clippingsRs. video and audio recordings that are with Tiatr artistesRs. tiatr lovers and institutionsRs. addressing the high degree of risk that some of these materials may be lost to posterity if efforts are not undertaken to preserve and document them. The scheme provides assistance to possessors of Tiatr-related materials to organize and document their holdings.
benefits: - One-time Incentive: A reasonable amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be paid to the holder for converting materials into electronic formats. - Hourly Honorarium: Documentation assistants will be paid an honorarium on clock-hour basis as determined by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Reimbursement: Tiatr Academy of Goa will reimburse costs incurred towards conversion according to rates determined by it if services of other agencies become necessary. - Assistance provided to organize and document materials in holdings. - Copy of digitised material provided to the holder on Digital Versatile Disc or Pen-drive. - Professional documentation and preservation services. > ***Conditions*** _*The work done must be certified by the holder of the material._ _*Tiatr Academy of Goa will periodically review the work undertaken and accordingly extend or curtail the assistantship._ _*Holders must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation tasks._
eligibility: > ***For Material Holders*** - The applicant must be a possessor of materials related to Tiatr such as manuscriptsRs. photosRs. handbillsRs. advertisementsRs. newspaper or magazine clippingsRs. video and audio recordings. - The applicant must indicate willingness to permit and facilitate documentation and organization tasks. > ***For Documentation Assistants*** - The applicant must be willing to serve as Documentation Assistant. - The applicant must be capable of performing tasks including compilation and organisation of materialsRs. typing or word-processing of textual materialsRs. scanning and converting by Optical Character RecognitionRs. conversion of images by scanning or photographing with digital cameraRs. and converting video or audio recordings from analogue to digital format.

name: Maitri Prashikshan Karyakram - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
