brief_description: The scheme Maitri Prashikshan Karyakram is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance livestock productivity and improve artificial insemination services across the state through the training and capacity building of local youth.
benefits: - **In Hilly Districts:** 100/- per artificial inseminationRs. with a minimum target of 25 to 30 inseminations.- **In Plain Districts:** 100/- per artificial inseminationRs. with a minimum target of 50 to 60 inseminations.
eligibility: It is mandatory for registered Artificial Insemination workers to record all AI-related data on the Bharat Pashudhan App. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess a minimum educational qualification of High School. 1. The applicant must obtain a recommendation in the prescribed format from both the Local Veterinary Officer and the Chief Veterinary Officer.

name: Machhali Palan
brief_description: The scheme Machhali Palan is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to fishermen for repairingRs. reconstructingRs. and replacing damaged boats and nets due to disasters.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the following compensation is provided to fishermen for the repair or replacement of damaged boats and nets: - 6Rs./- for the repair of partially damaged boats - 3Rs./- for the repair of partially damaged nets - 15Rs./- for the repurchase of completely damaged boats - 4Rs./- for the repurchase of completely damaged nets An investment subsidy of 10Rs./- per hectare is provided for fish seed farms.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a fisherman from Uttarakhand. 1. Fishermen are provided assistance for the repair or replacement of damaged boats and for damaged or lost nets caused by natural disasters.

name: Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academys Annual Tiatr Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academys Annual Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage non-commercial dramatic troupes participating in Kala Academys yearly Tiatr Festival to produce Tiatrs of better quality. The scheme provides financial support for specific aspects of dramaRs. including DirectionRs. Stage SettingRs. Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instrumentsRs. Light EffectsRs. Background MusicRs. CostumesRs. Make-upRs. and Transport. It also features the video recording of the Tiatr for the Tiatr Academy of Goa LibraryRs. with a free Digital Versatile Disc copy provided to the institutionRs. and offers expertise through compulsory workshops in various Tiatr components.
benefits:
##### ***1. Financial Support*** - For improving aspects of Tiatr productionRs. including DirectionRs. Stage SettingRs. Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instrumentsRs. Light EffectsRs. Background MusicRs. CostumesRs. Make-upRs. and Transport. - The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Direct payment to the Institution based on submitted bills. ***Conditions*** _*The troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of its members; otherwiseRs. they will not be entitled to avail the benefits of this scheme._ _*The Tiatr must not contain any adverse remark in any formRs. either written or verbalRs. against any Government/Individual/InstitutionRs. etc.Rs. or anything against ones casteRs. creedRs. and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments; if proved soRs. Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made._ _*All advertisementsRs. oralRs. print or electronic mediaRs. banners/standeesRs. etc.Rs. must insert/publish and announce before the performance and during the interval that This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa._
##### ***2. Video Recording of Tiatr and Digital Versatile Disc Copy*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa will video record the said Tiatr for its Library and other uses. One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc will be given to the Institution free of cost. To preserve the presentation of Tiatr for future generations. - The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any mannerRs. but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc. *The videographer will be appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
##### ***3. Expertise and Workshops*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide expertise to the troupes in the different compartments of Tiatr (DirectionRs. Stage SettingRs. Live Band MusicRs. Light EffectsRs. Background MusicRs. CostumesRs. Make-upRs. Transport) by organizing workshops in those aspects. ***Conditions*** _*The troupe will have to compulsorily participate in these workshops by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a dramatic troupe. - The applicant must be participating in the Tiatr Competitions organized by Kala Academy. - The applicant must fulfill the conditions laid down in the scheme as per the format enclosed. - The applicant's Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee who will submit a report on whether the Tiatr is as per the format. - The applicant must ensure that one typed copy of the Tiatr script and one typed copy each of the lyrics of the songs are submitted to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form. - The applicant must ensure that handwritten copies of scripts and lyrics will not be accepted. - The applicant's TiatrRs. in any form either written or verbalRs. must not contain any adverse remarks against any Government/Individual/InstitutionRs. etc.Rs. or anything against ones casteRs. creedRs. and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody. - The applicant must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe.

name: Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Encouraging Production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage dramatic troupes and individuals to produce Khell-Tiatrs of better quality and preserve this folk musical drama. The scheme provides financial assistance to compensate for expenditures related to staging four showsRs. including the provision of an auditorium or hallRs. or financial aid for temporary village setupsRs. along with video filming and a free Digital Versatile Disc copy for the applicant. The applicant must adhere to traditional Khell-Tiatr formatRs. performance guidelinesRs. advertising requirementsRs. and submit detailed proposals with all required documentation in advance. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days prior to the proposed performance date.
benefits:
##### ***Financial Assistance for Staging Performances*** - Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for staging four shows. - Payment will be made directly to the applicant after a statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (with stamped receipts if the amount exceeds 5Rs./-) is submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. ##### ***Infrastructure Support*** - An auditorium or hall is provided to stage the programme. - For Village Programmes: Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for erecting a temporary pandal or stageRs. chairsRs. soundRs. etc. ##### ***Archival and Personal Use Video Documentation*** - The Khell-Tiatr will be video filmed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for its library and other uses. - One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) of the video-filmed Khell-Tiatr will be given to the applicant free of cost. - The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any mannerRs. but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc.
##### ***Conditions*** **Ongoing Compliance regarding Content** - There must not be any adverse remark made in any formRs. either written or verbalRs. against any GovernmentRs. IndividualRs. InstitutionRs. etc.Rs. or anything against ones casteRs. creedRs. and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody. - If proved soRs. Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made to the concerned. **Show Access Obligation** All shows must be presented to the public free of charge. **Advertising and Branding Obligation** In all advertisementsRs. whether oralRs. printRs. or electronic mediaRs. bannersRs. etc.Rs. the statement This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa must be insertedRs. publishedRs. or announced. **Guest of Honour Coordination** - The organizing dramatic troupe or individual will need to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance. - The President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) will serve as the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at the function.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a dramatic troupe or an individual producing Khell-Tiatrs. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should be a new or old script. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must conform to the traditional format of the Khell-Tiatr. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must be one in which just one-story flows from beginning to end with an interval of 10 to 15 minutes. - The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must have 12 to 14 cantos which are related to the theme of the play. - Out of these cantosRs. at least 7 must be of an interactive nature. - The band for the Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should include at least two blowing instrumentsRs. one keyboardRs. one bass guitarRs. and a drum set. - The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any formRs. either written or verbalRs. against any Government/Individual/InstitutionRs. etc. - The applicant must not have anything against ones casteRs. creedRs. and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.

name: Low Altitude Guide Course
brief_description: The scheme Low Altitude Guide Course is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train and certify youth from Uttarakhand as professional low altitude guides and provide them with skill development opportunities to strengthen their role in the states tourism sector.
benefits: The beneficiary will become a certified low-altitude guide upon completing the course.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant will be considered on a first-comeRs. first-served basis. > The total number of 761 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Enhancement of Spoken English Programme
brief_description: The scheme Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the spoken English skills of students of Classes 9 to 12 studying in all government schools across the districts of the state.
benefits: The programme was implemented for approximately 39Rs. students of Classes 9 to 12 across 109 government schools in all districts of the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of Classes 9 to 12 from one of the 109 selected government secondary schools in Uttarakhand.

name: Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to encourage interested artistes to improve their acting abilities through organized competitions related to Goan tiatr dramatic activityRs. addressing the need to develop theatrical skills among school students at primary and secondary levels. The scheme provides acting competitions in comedy and non-comedy categories with both monologue and dialogue formatsRs. along with cash prizes ranging from 2Rs./- to 5Rs./- and participation certificates for winners and best script writers. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Cash Prizes and Recognition*** - **Monologue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - 3Rs./-; 2nd Performance - 2Rs./-- **Best Script Writer:** 2Rs./-- **Dialogue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - 5Rs./-; 2nd Performance - 3Rs./-- **Best Script Writer:** 2Rs./-- **Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - 3Rs./-; 2nd Performance - 2Rs./-- **Best Script Writer:** 2Rs./-- **Dialogue (Non-Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - 5Rs./-; 2nd Performance - 3Rs./-- **Best Script Writer:** 2Rs./- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - Participation certificates awarded to all winners. - Transport charges remuneration paid to each participating school as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Development of acting abilities through structured competition and professional judging. ##### ***Conditions*** _*Minimum four entries required in each category for competition to be conducted in that particular category._ _*Performance duration must be between 4 to 7 minutes._ _*Scripts must not contain adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creed and religion._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a school student at primary school level or secondary school level. - The applicant must participate through their respective school. ##### ***Participation Rules*** - The applicant (one student of a school) can participate in each category. - The applicant must submit separate applications if participating in more than one category. - The applicant must ensure their performance is between 4 to 7 minutes duration. - The applicant must submit a typed copy of the script along with the application form. ##### ***Content Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure their script/performance does not contain any adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creed and religion. - The applicant must ensure their performance does not hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Competition Categories Available*** - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. ##### ***Judging Criteria*** Acting abilities are evaluated based on six specific criteria: - Delivery of dialogues - Facial expression - Reaction to others on the stage - Movement on the stage - Costumes - Overall impact ##### ***Performance Guidelines*** - Light effects and background music are not considered during judging. - Performances are limited to acting ability assessment only. - Professional judges with expertise in acting and direction conduct the evaluation.

name: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad
brief_description: The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing higher education abroad by reducing their financial burden. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries receive an interest subsidy on education loans with a maximum subsidy for three years.
benefits: - Interest subsidy of 6% per annum on loans taken through banks for foreign education. - Maximum subsidy of 1Rs. for 3 years. - Applicable on loans up to 25Rs..
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarats tribal areas. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission in a recognized foreign university for higher studies.

name: Amit Gautam Memorial Scholarship (B.Tech in Electronics Engineering 4th Year)
brief_description: The Amit Gautam Memorial Scholarship (B.Tech in Electronics Engineering - 4th Year) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support meritorious students pursuing a B.Tech in Electronics Engineering who are in their 4th year of study by providing a one-year scholarship.
benefits: The eligible student will receive 7Rs./- per year as a scholarship.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 4th year of the B.Tech (Electronics Engineering) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Hands-on Training and Exposure Visits under Experiential Learning
brief_description: The scheme Hands-on Training and Exposure Visits under Experiential Learning is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to enhance scientific understanding and practical skills among researchersRs. professorsRs. and students by providing one-week residential hands-on training and exposure visits in collaboration with reputed institutions.
benefits: Free residential one-week hands-on training (certificate programme) sessions are being organized on various subjects to provide practical knowledge to the researchersRs. professorsRs. and students of the state in collaboration with various institutionsRs. in which UG/PG studentsRs. researchersRs. and teachers from higher education institutions across all districts of the state are participating. Meals are also provided free of cost during this residential training.
eligibility: 1. Graduates/postgraduate studentsRs. researchersRs. and professors from all educational institutions (both government and private) across Uttarakhand are eligible to participate.

name: Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture" was launched by the Directorate of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and give opportunity to the young talents in the State to excel their talent to reach the highest possible standard/merit under the guidance of a renowned teacher/artist outside the State. The scheme provides financial support to students seeking to get basic or advanced education/training in any field of Art and CultureRs. such as musicRs. danceRs. theatreRs. fine artsRs. folk artsRs. or photography (fields of visual and performing art). The applications for this scheme are accepted when the Directorate of Art and Culture releases an advertisement/press note on local daily newspapers thereby inviting applications. The scheme shall remain in force up to 31st March 2027.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance is given to acquire basic or advanced education in any field of Art and Culture (like musicRs. danceRs. theatreRs. fine artsRs. folk artsRs. photographyRs. etc.) at StateRs. NationalRs. and International levels. - Maximum assistance up to 1Rs./- is provided for acquiring education outside Goa or the actual cost of the educationRs. whichever is less. - Maximum assistance up to 3Rs./- is provided for acquiring education outside India or the actual cost of the educationRs. whichever is less. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The committee may scrutinize and decide upon the quantum of assistanceRs. from case to caseRs. depending upon the nature of trainingRs. reputation of the Institution/GuruRs. and eligibility of the applicant. - The assistance shall be disbursed by the Director of Art and Culture only after obtaining Government approval for the names selected by the Sub-Committee. ##### ***Conditions*** - The student shall undergo training on full time or part time basis. - The student must maintain 75 % attendance for the total course period or for one year period of the course (whichever is less). This shall not be applicable where there are regular examinations recognized by the University or Board or Government. - The student can apply for assistance for a maximum of five years (initially for three years and upon review if showing progressRs. extended for two years). - A review report of the student shall be taken every six months. - The student shall be bound to present performance as and when asked by the Directorate of Art and Culture. - The scholarship amount shall be recovered if the student fails to maintain 75% attendance (where applicable). - The amount shall be recovered from the student if the course is not completed.
eligibility: - The applicant must intend to seek advanced education in any field of Art and CultureRs. such as musicRs. danceRs. theatreRs. fine artRs. folk artRs. photographyRs. etc. (fields of visual and performing art). - The applicant must seek this education outside Goa or outside India. - The applicant should have outlined knowledge about the art form in which the education is desired. - The applicant should be born in Goa. - The applicant must be residing in Goa for a substantial period or at least for the last fifteen years to the date of application. - The applicant shall not be above the age of thirty-five years. - The applicant must be the only student per family applying under this scheme per financial year. - The applicants annual family income must not cross the limit fixed by the Government from time to time. - If the applicant is receiving a grant or scholarship from any other Government or non-Government bodies for the trainingRs. the total amount raised from different sources must be less than the actual cost of the education. ##### ***Relaxation/Exception*** - The application to seek training outside Goa shall be considered for assistance in exceptional cases wherein not even the basic education is available in a particular field of art within Goa. - In rare casesRs. a second application in the same familyRs. but in a different stream of art to that of the firstRs. may be considered depending upon his/her contribution or merit. The decision regarding this exception is to be taken by the committee.

name: One-day Seminar on Vedic Mathematics
brief_description: The scheme One-day Seminar on Vedic Mathematics is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a common platform for officersRs. teachersRs. and students from universitiesRs. collegesRs. schoolsRs. and other departments to actively participate and gain knowledge about the simplified curriculum of Vedic Mathematics and its easy-to-apply methods.
benefits: Participants of the seminar will gain knowledge about the simplified course of Vedic Mathematics and learn its easy and practical methods.
eligibility: 1. OfficersRs. teachersRs. and students from universitiesRs. collegesRs. schoolsRs. and other departments are eligible to participate in the seminar.

name: Exhibition of Books on Tiatr, Its Song and Music
brief_description: The scheme "Exhibition of Books on TiatrRs. Its Song and Music" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to help Roman Script Konkani writers and publishers who face difficulties in marketing their books related to TiatrRs. its song and musicRs. while promoting Tiatr culture among enthusiasts. The scheme provides bulk purchase of books at 80% of the fixed rate and organizes book exhibitions to facilitate better market reach for publishers. The applicant must be a writer or publisher of books related to TiatrRs. its song and musicRs. and must submit 3 copies of their published book for evaluation. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy Goa through its appointed Recommendation Committee. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
**Book Purchase:** Tiatr Academy Goa will purchase books at 80% of the rate fixed as per Tiatr Academy Goa conditions. **Marketing Support:** Books are sold through book exhibitions organized by Tiatr Academy Goa and participation in exhibitions by various Book Houses and Institutions. **Promotional Platform:** Books receive exposure to Tiatr lovers and enthusiasts through organized exhibitions.
***Conditions*** _*Tiatr Academy Goa reserves the right to sell books at discounted rates during exhibitions._ _*Payment will be made only after Tiatr Academy Goa's final decision to purchase the books._ _*Books will be purchased on 'First-come-First' serve basis._ _*The final purchase decision remains at the discretion of Tiatr Academy Goa even after Committee recommendation._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a writer or publisher of books related to TiatrRs. its song and music. - The applicant should have published books in any script or language (not limited to Roman Konkani script).

name: Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)
brief_description: The scheme "Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)" was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive educational support to Scheduled Tribe students who cannot afford education due to weak economic conditionsRs. addressing the issue of children being forced into traditional occupations or other jobs to support their families instead of attending school. The scheme provides residential schooling facilities with complete boarding and lodging arrangementsRs. where tribal students receive free educationRs. hostel facilitiesRs. booksRs. foodRs. and items of daily necessity through 100% grant-in-aid to Non-Governmental Organizations operating these schools across standards 1st to 12th.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Grant to Ashramshalas*** A grant of 1Rs./- per month is provided to the Ashramshala for every enrolled child to cover all expenses related to educationRs. boardingRs. and lodging. _*The grant is provided on a monthly basis to the Ashramshalas for continuous support of enrolled students._ ##### ***Benefits Provided to Students*** - Free education without any tuition fees. - Free hostel facilities and accommodation. - Free books and educational materials. - Free food and meals. - Items of daily necessity free of cost. _*All benefits (educationRs. boardingRs. lodgingRs. foodRs. booksRs. and daily necessities) are provided continuously throughout the academic year._ ##### ***Conditions*** - The Ashramshala must maintain the minimum enrollment requirements as specified in the eligibility criteria. - The Ashramshala must continue to provide all stipulated facilities (educationRs. boardingRs. lodgingRs. foodRs. booksRs. and daily necessities) to the enrolled students. - The Ashramshala must comply with all regulations and guidelines set by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat.
eligibility: ##### ***For Ashramshalas (Educational Institutions)*** - The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 15 boys and 15 girls for the first time on inception. - The Ashramshala must enrol a minimum of 10 boys and 10 girls every year till 7th standard after the inception year. - The Ashramshala must be operated by a Non-Governmental Organization working in tribal areas. - The Ashramshala must be located within any district of Gujarat. - The Ashramshala must provide education for standards 1st to 8th (Ashramshala)Rs. standards 9th to 10th (Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala)Rs. or standards 11th to 12th (Uchchattar Uttar Buniyadi Ashramshala). ##### ***For Students (Beneficiaries)*** - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be seeking admission to an Ashramshala for education from standard 1st to standard 12th.

name: Establishment and Operation of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) Laboratories
brief_description: The scheme Establishment and Operation of STEM (ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. EngineeringRs. Mathematics) Laboratories is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to establish STEM laboratories in schools across Uttarakhand to provide students of classes 6 to 12 with hands-on scienceRs. technologyRs. engineeringRs. and mathematics learning opportunities and strengthen their practical understanding of scientific concepts.
benefits: Under thisRs. 41 STEM laboratories have been established across the state to strengthen practical science education for secondary and higher secondary level students and to provide hands-on learning activities for students of classes 6 to 12Rs. enabling them to conduct science-related experiments in these labs.
eligibility: 1. Students must be studying in classes 6 to degree level in a school in Uttarakhand. 1. Students from schools with a STEM laboratoryRs. as well as those from nearby schoolsRs. are eligible to use the STEM laboratories.

name: Empowering Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Communities Using Information And Communication Technology Tools
brief_description: The scheme "Empowering Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Communities Using Information And Communication Technology Tools" by the Department of Information TechnologyRs. Government of GoaRs. aims to provide Information Technology related trainings to the Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste communities free of cost. The scheme provides various job oriented Information Technology training courses. The key features and provisions offered include providing basic computer skills to local youthRs. housewivesRs. and other citizensRs. providing structural training programs depending on needsRs. and making at least one person in each family in the State Information Technology literate.
benefits: - **Free Information Technology Related Trainings:** The scheme provides Information Technology related trainings to the Schedule Tribe and Schedule Caste beneficiaries free of cost.- **Training Content:** The trainings cover basic computer skillsRs. various job oriented Information Technology training coursesRs. and structural training programmes depending on the needs of the community.- **Implementing Agency Funding:** M/s Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited (ITG) is nominated as the implementing agency and receives a Grant-in-Aid under the Tribal Sub Plan (TSP) and the Schedule Caste Sub Plan (SCSP) on a yearly basis for providing these free trainings.
eligibility: - The applicant must be of Goan Origin. - The applicant must belong to the Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Community. - The applicant must apply for courses offered under the Information Technology Knowledge Centers and available at the Information Technology training centers empanelled by M/s Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited (ITG).

name: Scheme To Provide Grant To The Institution(s)/Individual(s) For Long Term Project In The Field Of Art And Culture
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme To Provide Grant To The Institution(s)/Individual(s) For Long Term Project In The Field Of Art And Culture" was launched by the Directorate of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support to the institution(s)/individual(s) involved in long term projects in the field of Art and Culture. The scheme provides grants up to 80% of the total expenditure involvedRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./- per annum. It also aims to encourage young talents in the State to excel under guidance outside the State and provides financial support to students seeking basic or advanced education/training in Art and Culture by way of scholarships. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Art and Culture/Government. The applications for this scheme are accepted when the Sub-Committee is constituted and meets as and when required to consider applications.
benefits: - ***Financial Grant:*** Eligible institutions or individuals shall be entitled for a grant to the extent of 80% of the total expenditure involved.- ***Maximum Ceiling:*** The maximum financial grant limit provided under this scheme is 5Rs./- (Indian Rupees Five Lakhs) per annum.- ***Support for Talent and Education:*** The scheme encourages young talents in the State to excel their talent to reach the highest possible standard/merit under the guidance of a renowned teacher/artist outside the State.- ***Scholarships:*** Financial support is given to students seeking to get basic or advanced education/training in any field of Art and Culture by way of scholarships.- ***Disbursement Conditions:*** The actual financial grant received shall be decided by the Sub-Committee/Department of Art and Culture/Government. This decision is based on the nature and scope of the projectRs. the reputation of the institutionRs. and taking into consideration the overall impact on the society.- ***Fund Restriction:*** The Department/Government may restrict the number of institutions according to the availability of funds.- ***Disbursement:*** The amount is disbursed to the eligible institution(s)/individual(s) in the form of a chequeRs. after the Director of Art and Culture obtains Government approval based on the Sub-Committee's recommendations.
eligibility: ##### ***For Institutions*** - The applicant must be registered under the Societys Registration ActRs. 1860. - The applicant must be registered under the Indian Trust Act. - The applicant must be involved in a long term project in the field of Art and Culture. ##### ***For Individuals*** - The applicant must be from the Goan community. - The applicant must be a resident of Goa for 15 years or more. - The applicant must be involved in a long term project in the field of Art and Culture. - The applicant must have contributed at least 15 years in the relevant field.

name: Free Uniforms for Students
brief_description: Implemented by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. this state-sponsored initiative provides free uniforms to students of Classes 1 to 8 studying in government primary and middle schools. Launched on 1st July 2004Rs. the scheme aims to promote regular attendance and reduce dropout rates among schoolchildren. Under this schemeRs. each boy is provided with two pairs of uniforms valued at 600Rs. while each girl receives two pairs of stitched uniforms through the School Management Committee. The scheme extends its benefits to students across both rural and urban areas of the state.
benefits: - Each boy and girl student is provided 600/- for two sets of uniforms.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of a government primary or middle school in Madhya Pradesh. 1. Applicable for Classes 1 to 8. 1. Student must be enrolled before 15 August of the academic year.

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans component of the scheme offers financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The component provides a reimbursement of 50% of the annual interest amount payable by the eligible entity on loans taken for the construction of projects. This subsidy is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)Rs. which also monitors effective implementation and ensures sanctioning is completed within 90 days from the date of application. Applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.
benefits:
- Subsidy towards annual interest rate payable on loans. - The subsidy rate is 50% of the annual interest amount payable by the entity on loans taken for the construction of projects. - The entitlement per project shall not exceed an annual sum of 25Rs./- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs).
##### ***Period of Subsidy*** - Standard projects are eligible for 03 consecutive years from the date the loan was taken. - Projects constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities are eligible for 05 consecutive years from the date the loan was taken.
##### ***Subsidy Computation and Disbursal*** - The subsidy calculation will take into account the interest amount paid up to the end of the previous fiscal yearRs. for the claim submitted for the year or part of the year. - The subsidy calculation will be based on the actual interest amount incurredRs. as determined by the prevailing interest rate applicable to the concerned financial transaction. - The reimbursement shall not include penal interestRs. liquidated damagesRs. or similar charges paid to the financial institutions/banks.
##### ***Claim Submission*** - If an Entity fails to file the annual claim after the first yearRs. it may still submit the delayed claim in the following yearRs. provided it falls within the overall subsidy eligibility period specified in Table 7.1. - If interest cannot be claimed due to non-payment before filingRs. the unit shall be eligible to claim such interest subject to payment of the same in the subsequent year.
##### ***Loan Compliance*** - In case of default in payment of term loan (i.e.Rs. not paid as per schedule of repayment) reimbursement of interest shall be reduced to the extent of default. - Only the limit of original loan granted and not rescheduled loan shall be considered for interest reimbursement. - In case an Entity procures loans from multiple financial institutionsRs. the aggregate sum of interest paid across these loans shall qualify for subsidy considerationRs. provided the total claimed does not surpass the prescribed maximum allowable amount. - In case of more than one unit with a consolidated balance sheetRs. a certificate from a Chartered Accountant giving interest details unit-wise shall be submitted by the applicantRs. and the claim shall be made only for the eligible unit.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be applicable only for non-mega industries. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must have Permanent Account Number (PAN) and must regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses (loan availed) post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The applicant must provide minimum 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). - The applicant must have availed the loan as term loan and/or working capital loan for conducting business of the unit claiming the benefit. - The applicant must have procured the loan from a nationalized bankRs. scheduled private bankRs. Co-operative BankRs. Economic Development Corporation Limited (EDC Ltd.)Rs. or any Non-Banking Financial Institutions recognized by the Reserve Bank of India. - The applicant must ensure the relevant loan quantum for determining the subsidy is the aggregate amount borrowed for the construction of the projectRs. including the cost of land acquisition and all construction-related expenses. - The applicant must ensure the loan is not covered under the Modified Interest Rebate Scheme 2012Rs. or the interest paid is not under the Chief Minister Rojgar Yojana Scheme or any other employment generation scheme of the Government of India/Government of Goa.
##### ***Preference and Quantum Criteria*** - The benefit is subject to a first come first serve basisRs. contingent upon the availability of funds in a particular fiscal year. - The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls: - 60% or above Goan employment results in 100% of the benefits. - More than 40% but less than 60% Goan employment results in 80% of the benefits. - Less than 40% Goan employment results in ineligibility.
##### ***Project Category and Minimum Land Area Requirements*** _The project must be one of the following eight categoriesRs. subject to the minimum land area specified:_ **Logistics Park (Multi-modal/Integrated)Rs. Inland Container Depot (ICD)Rs. Container Freight Stations (CFS)** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1 Acre - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 1 Acre. **Air Freight Stations (AFS)** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1Rs. square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 1Rs. square meters. **WarehousesRs. Truck Terminals** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 1Rs. square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 500 square meters. **Cold Chain UnitRs. Testing Facilities** - Standard Minimum Land Area: 200 square meters - Backward Talukas/SC/ST/Women Minimum Land Area: 100 square meters.

name: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for Construction/Installation of Vermi-Compost Units
brief_description: The scheme Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Vermi-compost Units" component of the scheme aims to convert available on-field and farm waste material into chemical-free farm resources as farm input for organic farming through vermicomposting processes. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
benefits: - Construction/Installation of Vermi-compost unit would be provided 75% subsidy limited to Rs.1Rs./- per cu.mt for Vermi-compost units for all categories of farmers. - The Standard cost for Vermi-compost unit would be Rs. 2600/- per cubic meter which includes 90% cost on construction/installation including mason cost and 10% will be the cost of earthwormsRs. etc. - The unit can have one or more pits with or without internal chambers and has to be above ground levelRs. of bricksRs. laterite stonesRs. cement blocksRs. shahabadi/kadappa or RCC cement ringsRs. having a cement floor with proper water outletRs. with clean internal side walls and a proper ant proofing and should be protected from sunRs. rain and from attack of birdsRs. lizards and rodents feeding on earthworms. - The portable Vermi-composting unit of HDPE material i.e.Vermi-bed or Vermi composting bins of 100 litre and above laid on prepared hard surface free from sharp objectsRs. and protected as aboveRs. maximum of 3 units would also be considered for subsidy @ 90% subsidy on the standard cost fixed and maximum amount of Rs 7Rs./- per farmer.
eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme.

name: Training/Capacity Building Programmes/Research work on Remote Sensing and GIS Applications
brief_description: The scheme Training/Capacity Building Programmes/Research work on Remote Sensing and GIS Applications is implemented by the Uttarakhand Space Application Centre (USAC) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to strengthen scientific and technical capacity of researchersRs. studentsRs. and government personnel in the field of Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (GIS) applications by providing trainingRs. conducting capacity-building programmesRs. and supporting research initiatives.
benefits: - Researchers are selected for scientific research projects funded by the Central and State Governments and trained in Remote Sensing and GIS applications. The training is provided free of cost. Selected researchers (JRFs/SRFs/Project Scientists) receive stipends (including HRA) as per the regulations of the respective funding organizations. Researchers are required to make their own arrangements for food and accommodation. - The program also offers training in Remote Sensing and GIS applications to postgraduate students in their final semester/year of study at various universities across the stateRs. as well as to undergraduate students through internships. The training is free of costRs. and students are expected to arrange their own food and accommodation during the training period. - Capacity-building programs in Remote Sensing and GIS are organized periodically for various line departments based on their requirements. No participation fees are charged from these departments. Boarding and lodging during these programs are arranged by the concerned departments with the support of U-SAC. - Workshops on Geographic Information Systems are also organized periodically in degree colleges and schools across the stateRs. as per requests and requirementsRs. to motivate students towards space technology. U-SAC provides free one-day training sessions along with complimentary meals and transportation; howeverRs. accommodation is not provided.
eligibility: The following are eligible to participate in the Training and Capacity Building Programme: 1. Students who have passed a Postgraduate degree (preferably in the Science stream) with First Division from any recognized university in India. 1. Final semester/year postgraduate students (preferably from the Science stream) of any recognized university (privateRs. stateRs. or central) in India. 1. Personnel from the Central Government and various line departments of the State Government. 1. Graduate and higher-level students from governmentRs. privateRs. and central universities or colleges within the state.

name: Compensation for Crop Damage Caused by Wildlife (in Revenue and Forest Villages)
brief_description: The "Compensation for Crop Damage Caused by Wildlife (in Revenue and Forest Villages)" scheme is launched by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to farmers whose crops are damaged by wild animals in both revenue and forest villages.
benefits: **Financial Benefits** - Compensation is provided to farmers whose crops are damaged by wild animals. - Loss assessment is conducted as per Madhya Pradesh Revenue Book CircularRs. Volume 6Rs. Clause 4. - The compensation amount depends on the extent of damage assessed by the designated authority. **Mode of Disbursement** - Payment is made through e-payment directly into the farmers bank account. **Expected Time of Disbursement** - Compensation is provided within 30 working days from the date of loss assessment.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a farmer whose crops have been damaged. - The damage must be caused by wild animals and not by domestic or stray animals.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Pandemics" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists who have lost the source of income due to the pandemic. The scheme provides relief in the form of financial assistance amounting to a minimum of 5Rs./- (lumpsum) up to a maximum of 10Rs./- (lumpsum) to eligible artists affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline at the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Sanskruti BhavanRs. PattoRs. PanajiRs. Goa.
benefits: - One-time financial assistance in the range of 5Rs./- to 10Rs./- (lumpsum) per eligible artistRs. as decided by the committee. - Released in the Bank Account (Nationalized Bank) of the artist. The disbursement is done in the form of Electronic Clearing Service mode.
eligibility: - The artist must be a resident of Goa. - The artist must be above 18 years of age. - The artist must have lost the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19. - The individual income of the artist (from all the sources) must not exceed 1Rs./- per annum. - The artist should be working and contributing in the field of art and culture fieldsRs. i.e. Music/Dance/Drama/Tiatr/ Folk/Kir tan/Bhajan/Painting/Sculpture/Literature/Cantarists/Sahittik/Poets/Photographers/traditional Handicraft etc. - Artists should be in need of such financial assistance as contemplated in the scheme. - The artist should solely be dependent on the art related activities/programmes. - The artist shall not be a Government employee or an employee of Autonomous bodiesRs. Corporations nor pensioner of any organization.

name: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana" was launched by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support for talented tribal students to encourage and empower them to take up admissions for undergraduate professional courses in reputed institutions in Goa as well as outside Goa. The scheme provides financial assistanceRs. in the form of a ScholarshipRs. proportionate to the fees paid by Scheduled Tribe students at the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) level in order to take offline coaching assistance through reputed institutions for preparation for the All India Common Competitive exams such as the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and Joint Entrance Examination (JEE).
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance for coaching fees for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) courseRs. subject to a maximum limit of 3Rs./- (Rupees three lakhs only). - Financial assistance for coaching fees for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) courseRs. subject to a maximum limit of 3Rs./- (Rupees three lakhs only). - 100% of coaching fees shall be reimbursed to students whose family income is up to 8Rs./- (Rupees eight lakhs) per annum. - 75% of coaching fees shall be reimbursed to students whose family income is above 8Rs./- (Rupees eight lakhs) per annumRs. subject to the maximum limit. - If the course fee exceeds the admissible amountRs. the student has to arrange for the remaining funds from his/her own sources. ##### ***Disbursement*** - **Duration:** The benefit under the scheme shall be given for two years.- **Mode of Payment:** The course fee shall be released directly into the bank account of the students in two instalments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.- **Frequency:** Instalments are paid during the two-year course upon submission of fee receipts (First Installment in the XIth Standard and Second Installment in the XIIth Standard).- **Advance Claim:** If selected students have already paid registrationRs. admissionRs. or tuition fees in advance to the coaching institute for booking seatsRs. they are eligible to claim such fees under the schemeRs. subject to the maximum benefit amount. ##### ***Conditions*** - The applicant must submit the passing marksheet of the XIth standard; failing thisRs. the scholarship will not be awarded for the XIIth standard. - The student shall attend at least 90% of the classes. - If the student remains absent for more than 15 days without any valid reason or leaves the coaching midwayRs. the entire amount released to the student shall be recovered. - If the student opts out in the 2nd year (i.e.Rs. in the XIIth standard)Rs. the student shall refund the full amount released under the scheme within 30 days. - If any student furnishes any false information/documents and it is established as falseRs. action shall be initiated for recovery of the amount releasedRs. with 15% compound interest thereon.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe Community of Goa. - The applicant must have scored at least 65% in the Secondary School Certificate Examination (SSCE) Board Examination. - The applicant must be a regularRs. full-time student studying in a Higher Secondary School. - The Higher Secondary School must be recognised by the Central/State Goa Board of Higher Secondary Education. - The applicant must apply for the benefit under the scheme in the XIth standard only. - The Coaching institute through which the student desires to take admission must be a registered body or run by any organisation registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860/Companies ActRs. 2014Rs. or any other relevant Act of the State. - The applicant must be precluded from availing benefits under any other coaching scheme of the Centre or the State Government. - The applicant must provide a declaration to the effect that they are not availing benefits under any other coaching scheme of the Centre or the State Government.
##### ***Selection Criteria (Post-Application)*** - Selection shall be strictly done by drawing a merit list. - The merit list shall be drawn up for each course from the marks secured at the Goa Board/Central Board Secondary School Certificate Examination (SSCE) Examination among eligible students. - In case of two candidates having the same score for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) courseRs. the score in the Science subject followed by the Mathematics subject shall be considered to decide the order of merit. - In case of two candidates having the same score for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) courseRs. the score in the Mathematics subject followed by the Science subject shall be considered to decide the order of merit. - If students have secured equal marks in both the primary deciding subjectsRs. then the score in English shall be considered for deciding the order of merit. - A waitlist of students beyond 150 for each course shall be drawn up. - If there are vacant slots after drawing the merit listRs. candidates shall be selected from those students who have applied for the other courseRs. subject to a maximum total of 300 students seats.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana" was launched by the Public Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide free treatment and surgery to children aged 0 to 15 years who are suffering from identified heart diseases. The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from 25Rs./- to 1Rs./- for treatmentRs. covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals and ensuring the process is governed by the Madhya Pradesh Public Services Guarantee ActRs. 2010.
benefits: - Financial assistance ranging from 25Rs./- to 1Rs./- per case for treatment. - Provision of free treatment/surgery for 07 identified heart diseases in children. - The sanctioned amount is transferred to the account of the concerned medical institution via Cheque or E-Payment (e-transfer). - The benefit delivery period is stipulated as 20 working days. ***Conditions*** - Treatment must be confined to the approved package amount. - Hospitals must not demand any additional fee from the patient for treatment beyond the sanctioned amount. - The beneficiary or hospital must submit a detailed expenditure report/utilization certificate for the funds spent on the patient's treatment. - A duplicate or photocopy of the discharge ticket issued after the patient's recovery must be provided.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a member of an Economically Weaker Family or a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant must ensure their name is recorded in the family roster and they hold a ration card. - The intended beneficiary (child) must be aged 0 to 15 years. - The intended beneficiary (child) must be suffering from one of the identified heart diseases.

name: Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cowsRs. improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely SahiwalRs. GirRs. Red SindhiRs. Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy UnitRs. to promote self employment in the Dairy SectorRs. and to boost the milk production in the State and to make the State self sufficient. The scheme provides subsidy on the cost of the animalRs. where the unit cost is limited to 70Rs./- per animalRs. which is expected to yield 2Rs. liters of milk per lactation for the purpose of subsidy release. Beneficiaries can purchase cross bred cowsRs. improved she buffaloesRs. and indigenous breed cows (SahiwalRs. GirRs. Red SindhiRs. RathiRs. and Tharparkar) in one or more phases. The applications for this scheme are accepted through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer in a prescribed application formRs. along with a non-refundable processing fee.
benefits: ##### ***Subsidy for Milch Animals*** - For the purchase of 1 to 10 animalsRs. the subsidy is 90% of the unit cost (up to 63Rs./-) per animalRs. based on a unit cost of 70Rs./-. - For applicants who were issued orders previously under the Infrastructure Component of Kamdhenu Scheme (Sudharit) Amended 2021 or whose orders lapsed due to the Lumpy Skin Disease outbreak: 1. Purchases of 1 to 10 animals receive 90% subsidy (up to 63Rs./-). 1. Purchases of 11 to 20 animals receive 75% subsidy (up to 52Rs./-). 1. Purchases of 21 to 100 animals receive 50% subsidy (up to 35Rs./-). ##### ***Transportation Incentive*** Incentives towards transportation of animals are reimbursed at the rate of 2Rs./- per animal or the actual cost of transportationRs. whichever is less. ##### ***Insurance Premium Reimbursement*** The Department will reimburse the Comprehensive Insurance Policy premium up to a maximum of 16Rs./- per animal. ##### ***Infrastructure Financial Assistance*** - A subsidy of 80% of the construction cost is provided for a cattle shed unit of 10 milch animals. - The construction cost is calculated at 6Rs./- per square meter for a shed area of 5.4 square meters per animalRs. totaling 3Rs./- for a 54 square meter shed. - The maximum infrastructure subsidy provided is 2Rs./-. - Infrastructure subsidy release is linked to the number of milch animals purchased (minimum 50% of the unit strength @ 25Rs./- per animal). ##### ***Disbursal*** - The eligible subsidy shall be credited to the Bank account of the beneficiary through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS) of the concerned financing institution. - Incentives towards transportation shall be reimbursed to the beneficiarys Bank account through ECS along with the subsidy amount. - Infrastructure subsidy shall be released after the purchase of animals. - The insurance premium amount (maximum of 16Rs./- per animal) shall be reimbursed directly to the financing institution along with the subsidy amount. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - The animals purchased under the scheme must not be disposed off for a minimum period of 312 years (42 months). - The beneficiary must ensure the animals are compulsorily insured by the financial institution and the beneficiary within 7 days of their arrival in the farm. - The beneficiary must properly maintain the animals in good healthRs. ensuring proper arrangements for shelterRs. feedRs. and fodderRs. and maintaining proper records of milkRs. etc. - The Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme Infrastructure Unit must not be closed down for a period of 5 years from the date of subsidy release. - In case of default in maintaining the animals for 312 yearsRs. the Government shall recover the subsidy amount paidRs. Insurance premiumRs. and transportation cost on a pro-rata basis. - If the animal dies within one month of purchaseRs. the beneficiary must report it in writing to the Area Officer within 24 hours. - The farmer must produce a letter from the financing institution having an Electronic Clearance System (ECS)Rs. willing to finance him for the purchase of milch animals or for the Infrastructure Component of the scheme.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Goa for at least 15 years. - The applicant must possess a pucca cattle shed with cement flooring for housing the animals proposed to be reared. - The applicant must undertake to strictly stall feed the animals and not allow open grazing except in open paddock surrounding the cattle shed. - The applicant must have knowledge or experience in Cattle or Buffaloes farming or trained by the Department. - New applicants must compulsorily undergo dairy training as decided by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services (AH & VS) at the designated training centre. - The applicant must have the cattle shed constructed on their own land. - The applicant must ensure only one cowshed is permitted under one survey number having area of less than 400 square meters. - The applicant must be a member of the Local Dairy Society/Bachat Gat/Self help groupsRs. unless they are interested in branding their dairy products without membership of local milk unions. - The applicant must obtain prior written permission well in advance from the Department before undertaking purchases through a registered dealer. - If the applicant's spouse is a Government employeeRs. the applicant must submit a declaration on their behalf stating the Department of the spouseRs. designationRs. place of postingRs. and mobile number. - If the applicant has more than 25 cattleRs. the applicant (owner of the cattle shed) must apply for and produce the consent of the Goa State Pollution Control Board. ##### ***Criteria Specific to Previous Beneficiaries/Lapsed Orders*** - The applicant (Farmer or their family) who had availed the benefit of animal purchase under the earlier Kamdhenu Scheme but has not exceeded the purchase of more than 10 milch animals is eligible to avail the benefit of the scheme for remaining milch animals. - Applicants whose sanctioned orders lapsed after August 2Rs. 2022 due to the Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) outbreak must submit a request letter for revalidation and can purchase animals after revalidation of their earlier order within 6 months of the issue of the order of revalidation. - The applicant desiring revalidation of a lapsed order must apply within one month after the publication of the Gazette. ##### ***Criteria Specific to Infrastructure Component*** - The applicant must ensure the cattle shed is not constructed in a low lying areaRs. near river banksRs. or large sources of water which are prone to water logging and flooding due to heavy rainfall. - The applicant must ensure the cattle shed is not constructed in areas prone to water scarcity. - The applicant must ensure the cattle shed is constructed on own land having clear title in the name of the applicant on Form I & XIV document or Sale Deed document. - The applicant must submit an Approved cattle shed plan from a Government Authorized Engineer/Architect. - The applicant must have a License from the Panchayat/Municipality for the construction of the cattle shed. - The applicant must obtain Town and Country Planning (TCP) clearance for the construction of the cattle shed. ##### ***Preference/Priority/Conditions for Multiple Applicants*** - If multiple applicants are permitted to avail the scheme in the same survey numberRs. the share of undivided land/area must be more than 400 square meters. - If multiple applicants apply on the same survey numberRs. the No Objection Certificate (NOC) of co-applicants must be obtained. - The applicant must ensure the distance between the two cattle sheds is not less than 5 meters on all sidesRs. and each cow shed must have an individual drainage system and roofing.

name: ST Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
brief_description: Under this schemeRs. Scheduled Tribe girl students studying in Class 11 receive financial support from the Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure that girls from SC communities continue their education without financial barriers. Applications are accepted online through the Shiksha PortalRs. and the eligible amount is directly transferred to the students account after verification.
benefits: Eligible SC girl students of Class 11 receive an annual financial incentive of 3Rs./-Rs. credited directly to their bank account
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a girl student belonging to the Scheduled Caste category of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student must be continuously studying in Class 11 at a recognized institution. 1. The annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./- 1. A verified copy of the permanent caste certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue) is required. 1. A self-declaration certificate stating that the parent/guardian is not an income tax payer must be submitted. 1. An income certificate or salary certificate issued by a competent authority must be provided.

name: Saral Bijli Bill Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Saral Bijli Bill Scheme launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to ensure electricity accessibility to registered labourers and construction workers by providing free domestic connections and a fixed electricity bill of 200/- per month.
benefits: - **Free Electricity Connection:** Eligible registered labourers and construction workers receive free domestic electricity connections without any connection charge. - **Fixed Monthly Electricity Bill:** The beneficiary is required to pay only 200 per month for electricity consumption.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a registered labourer under the Mukhyamantri Mazdoor Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana2018. - The applicant should be a registered construction worker. - The applicant should have a domestic electricity connection or intend to obtain one under this scheme.

name: Scheme for Persons with Benchmark Disability Requiring High Support
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Persons with Benchmark Disability Requiring High Support" was launched by the Department for Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote economic self-reliance among persons with benchmark disabilities requiring high support by granting suitable financial assistance and ensuring proper utilization for their independent living and well-being. The scheme provides financial assistance of 40Rs./- (Rupees forty thousand only) as a one-time payment for purchasing assistive technologiesRs. aids/appliancesRs. personal care assistance servicesRs. or educational/vocational training support. The scheme is implemented by the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting them to the Director of the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with the required documents.
benefits: Financial Assistance (one-time payment) of 40Rs./- for the following purposes: - Assistive technologies and required aids/appliances. - Personal care assistance services. - Educational or vocational training support. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The scheme can be availed once every five yearsRs. subject to reassessment of eligibility._ - _Funds will be recovered if they are found to be misused or used for purposes other than those specified in the scheme._ - _Beneficiaries may be required to participate in periodic audits by providing necessary documentation._ - _In cases of misuse or non-complianceRs. the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities may disqualify the beneficiary from future assistance under the scheme._
eligibility: - The applicant must satisfy the following conditions to apply for financial assistance under this scheme. - The applicant must be a bona fide resident of the State of Goa by birthRs. by marriageRs. or through continuous domicile of at least fifteen years. - The applicant must be a person with a benchmark disability requiring high support. - The applicant must possess a certificate issued by the Medical Board notified by the State Government under Section 38 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. - The applicant must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category as per the Government of India or the State Governments notified criteria. - The applicant must not be receiving similar financial assistance from other Government or Non-Government sources for the same purpose. - The applicant must submit a self-declaration confirming that they are not receiving similar assistance from other sources. ***Relaxation*** Exceptions to the residence requirement may be allowed for certain special cases (e.g.Rs. persons married into Goa).

name: Registration for Crop Procurement
brief_description: The Registration for Crop Procurement scheme was launched by the Department of FoodRs. Civil SuppliesRs. and Consumer ProtectionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure that farmers in the state receive a fair and remunerative price for their crops by facilitating government procurementRs. allowing landholding farmers to register for selling their produce at government-designated procurement centers at the Minimum Support Price (MSP). A plan has been made to cover the entire Madhya Pradesh through the e-Uparjan ApplicationRs. through which the grains (wheatRs. paddyRs. sorghumRs. milletRs. gramRs. lentilsRs. mustardRs. etc.) of all the districts of the state are monitored.
benefits: - Enables farmers to sell their produce at government-approved procurement centers. - Ensures fair pricing through the Minimum Support Price (MSP) announced by the government. - Provides a transparent and digital platform for registration and sale. - Payment for the procured crop is made directly to the farmers bank account through online transfer.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be a landholding farmer. - The applicant should intend to sell their crop at a government-designated procurement center.

name: Sanitary Napkin Distribution - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Sanitary Napkin Distribution is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote menstrual hygiene and prevent reproductive tract infections among adolescent girls aged 10 to 19 years in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. to prevent reproductive tract infections and inculcate menstrual hygiene habitsRs. sanitary napkins are provided to adolescent girls by ASHA workers at a nominal cost of 6/-.
eligibility: 1. All girls aged between 10 to 19 years residing in Uttarakhand are eligible under this scheme.

name: Raah-Veer Yojana
brief_description: The Raah-Veer Yojana was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. It aims to encourage the general public to help road accident victims during emergencies and save innocent lives during the critical Golden Hour by rewarding citizens who voluntarily take accident victims to a hospital for treatment. The scheme promotes civic responsibility and compassion among citizens by recognizing their bravery and humanitarian actions. > **Scheme Implementation** It is implemented by the Office of the Transport CommissionerRs. BhopalRs. Madhya PradeshRs. under the supervision of the State and District-Level Evaluation Committees and monitored by the Home Department.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits** - Provides a cash reward of 25Rs. to individuals (Rah-Veers) who save the life of an accident victim by taking them to a hospital within the Golden Hour. - Selected Rah-Veers may be nominated for national-level awards by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH). - The MoRTH Evaluation Committee selects the top 10 Rah-Veers nationwideRs. each awarded 1Rs. a certificateRs. and a trophy at the National Road Safety Mission (NRSM) in New Delhi. - Each individual can be awarded a maximum of 5 times per year under this scheme. **Mode of Disbursement** - The payment is made online directly to the beneficiarys bank account through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). **Frequency of Disbursement** - One-time per eligible instanceRs. up to a maximum of 5 instances per year. **Expected Time of Disbursement** - The payment is processed within 1 month after the District Evaluation Committees approval.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be any individual (citizen or resident) who voluntarily assists a road accident victim in a motor vehicle-related accident. 1. The applicant must have helped the victim reach a hospital within the Golden HourRs. ensuring the victims survival.

name: Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana was launched by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the safe health and well-being of mothers and newborns by encouraging institutional deliveries and ensuring that mothers stay in government hospitals for at least 48 hours after childbirth.
benefits: For ensuring the safe health of both mother and childRs. an incentive amount of 2000/- is provided to all eligible mothers who stay in the government hospital for at least 48 hours after delivery.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman who has delivered her child in a government hospital within the state of Uttarakhand.

name: Immunization Programme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Immunization Programme is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. This initiative aims to protect every child from preventableRs. life-threatening diseases by providing free and timely vaccination as per the National Immunization Schedule.
benefits: To protect children from various life-threatening diseasesRs. free vaccinations are provided under the Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) as per the prescribed schedule below: ***National Immunization Schedule:*** **Vaccine****Dose****Vaccination Age**BCG1 doseAt birthRs. Upto one yearOPV5 dosesAt birthRs. 6 weekRs. 10 weekRs. 14 week & 16-23 monthsFIPV3 doses6 weekRs. 14 weekRs. & 9 monthHepatitis-B1 doseAt birthPentavalent3 doses6 weekRs. 10 weekRs. 14 weekRVV3 doses 6 weekRs. 10 weekRs. 14 weekPCV3 doses6 weekRs. 10 weekRs. 14 weekMR2 doses9 month & 16-23 monthJE(In endemic districts only)2 doses9 month & 16-23 monthDPT2 doses16-23 month & 5-6 yearTd2 doses10 yearRs. 16 year
eligibility: 1. All children of Uttarakhand aged 016 years who require vaccination are eligible under the scheme.

name: Hybrid Chilli Production Program
brief_description: The scheme Hybrid Chilli Production Program launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance and inputs for hybrid chilli cultivation to Scheduled Caste farmersRs. thereby enhancing crop qualityRs. productivityRs. and farmers income.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Under the schemeRs. financial assistance ranging from 1Rs./- to 7Rs./- is provided per beneficiary. - **Free Distribution of Inputs:** Beneficiaries are provided seedsRs. seed treatment chemicalsRs. organic and chemical fertilizersRs. and insecticidal medicines free of cost.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. - The applicant must belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana was introduced by the Cooperative DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmersRs. especially womenRs. in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand.
benefits: - Packed silage and complete mixed animal feed are prepared by blending nutrients with green maize and are made available to cattle rearers in the remote rural and hilly areas of Uttarakhand at the rate of 2.75 per kg. - Under the schemeRs. a 75% subsidy is provided on the selling price of silageRs. which is 9.00 per kgRs. and the State Government also provides financial assistance of 3.00 per kg towards expenses such as loadingRs. transportationRs. and handling. As a resultRs. silage is made available to beneficiaries at a subsidized rate of 2.75 per kg.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be residing in a hilly area of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a woman engaged in livestock farming. 1. The scheme is applicable only in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand.

name: Award of Cash Incentive to the Toppers at Regional Level and Students Scoring Centum in the Subjects Involving Theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
brief_description: The scheme "Award of Cash Incentive to the Toppers at Regional Level and Students Scoring Centum in the Subjects Involving Theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry" was launched by the Department of School EducationRs. Puducherry. The quantum of Award ranges from 10Rs./- up to 20Rs./- for top ranks depending on the positionRs. and 5Rs./- per subject for centum scores.
