benefits: - For students securing top three ranks at the regional level in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools: 1st Rank: 20Rs./-; 2nd Rank: 15Rs./-; 3rd Rank: 10Rs./-. - For students scoring centum in the subjects involving theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Higher Secondary Course Examinations: 5Rs./- per subject. - **Mode of Disbursement:** The award will be given through Direct Benefit Transfer or by Demand Draft.- **Frequency:** The award is disbursed to the eligible beneficiaries every year.- **Tie-Breaker Condition:** In the event of more than one student getting equal marksRs. the concerned full prize amount will be distributed to each of them in full. This distribution includes the marks secured by way of revaluation at a later date as prescribed by the concerned Board.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a resident of the Union territory of PuducherryRs. by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years. - The applicant must be a student appearing in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools. - The applicant must have passed the qualifying examination in the first attempt. - The applicant's marks from consecutive attempts must not be taken into account.

name: District Plan: Inter-Village Road Construction Scheme on Contributory Basis
brief_description: The scheme Inter-Village Road Construction Scheme on Contributory Basis is a sub-component of the District PlanRs. implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar IndustryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to facilitate the easy and timely transportation of sugarcane from farms to purchasing centers and sugar mills by improving inter-village road connectivity in sugarcane-growing areas.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. efforts are made to facilitate the transportation of sugarcane from farms to purchasing centers for farmers and to ensure the supply of fresh sugarcane to sugar mills. Of the total expenditure on the selected routesRs. 75% is borne through a government grantRs. while the remaining 25% is contributed by the beneficiary institutions.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiaries of the scheme shall be farmersRs. sugarcane societiesRs. and sugar mills involved in the transportation of sugarcane within Uttarakhand.

name: Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
brief_description: The scheme Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under Department of EnergyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the adoption of rooftop solar energy among domestic consumers in Uttarakhand by providing financial support and enabling them to generate cleanRs. renewable electricityRs. reduce their electricity bills through net metering.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries are provided financial support by the State Government at the rate of 17Rs./- per kW for plants with capacities ranging from 1 kW to 3 kWRs. and a fixed grant of 51Rs./- for plants with capacities from 3 kW to 10 kW. - The electricity generated from the installed rooftop solar power plants will be credited to the consumers electricity bill by UPCL through net metering.
eligibility: 1. All domestic electricity consumers across Uttarakhand who have applied on the MNRE national portal ([https://solarrooftop.gov.i](https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in/)n) under the "Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme" and whose Central Financial Assistance (CFA) for the installation of the solar plant has been approved or released are eligible.

name: Various Training and Support Schemes of Kisan Vigyan Kendra - Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry
brief_description: The Various Training and Support Schemes of Kisan Vigyan Kendra is implemented by the Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to enhance the knowledgeRs. skillsRs. and productivity of farmers in Uttarakhand by providing them with the latest technical training in agricultureRs. horticultureRs. and forestry.
benefits: Kisan Vigyan Kendra provides farmers with the latest technical training in agricultureRs. forestryRs. and horticultureRs. along with improved seeds and plant varieties.
eligibility: 1. All farmers in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive the benefits.

name: Tea Development Programme in the Hilly Districts of Uttarakhand - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
brief_description: The scheme Tea Development Programme in the Hilly Districts of Uttarakhand is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tea Development Board under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote tea cultivation in the mountainous regions of UttarakhandRs. providing sustainable employmentRs. optimal utilization of barren and unused landRs. and economic upliftment of local farmers.
benefits: - Due to large-scale migration of local people in the mountainous areas of UttarakhandRs. most of the farmers land remains unused or barrenRs. which can be put to good use through tea development programmes. - The Tea Development SchemeRs. run by the BoardRs. is an employment-oriented initiative under which the Board provides year-round employment to tea garden cultivators and workers for seven years after the plantation is established. Once the plantations produce sufficient quantities of green leavesRs. farmers can earn a livelihood by selling them. - At presentRs. in the hilly areasRs. fruitsRs. vegetablesRs. and crops are being damaged by domestic and wild animalsRs. whereas tea plants are not harmed by such animals. - Due to the lack of adequate irrigation facilities in the hilly areasRs. traditional farming is adversely affectedRs. whereas tea gardens require irrigation only at the initial stageRs. and adverse weather does not have any significant impact on the tea gardens. - Once plantedRs. tea plants can produce for up to 100 years under proper care. Hailstorms only negatively affect tea production for about a week. - There is a risk of landslides due to indiscriminate cutting of forestsRs. disastersRs. and heavy rainfallRs. whereas areas with tea plantations are not prone to landslides; thusRs. tea gardens help prevent soil erosion and landslides. - Tea plantation is an environmentally friendly and completely pollution-free industry. - In tea gardensRs. local peopleRs. especially rural womenRs. get employment in their own area. - The tea industry can become a strong pillar for the economic foundation of local farmers. - Tea is the most widely consumed beverage in the worldRs. ensuring consistent demandRs. which makes its marketing relatively easy. - On averageRs. 15Rs. tea plants are planted per hectareRs. which also helps prevent soil erosion. - CurrentlyRs. the Board has developed tea gardens by leasing land from 4Rs. farmers over an area of 1Rs. hectares in 30 development blocks across 9 districts. - At presentRs. 3Rs. workers are employed under the Board every monthRs. of which 2Rs. are women.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have his own measured land available. 1. Within the identified areaRs. at least 60 hectares of land should be available for tea plantation within a radius of 20 km. 1. There should be adequate availability of water around the identified land for setting up tea plant nursery at the initial stage.

name: Grant For Oru Kala Pooja
brief_description: The scheme "Grant For Oru Kala Pooja" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The primary aim is to help these temples meet the ongoing expenses towards the performance of Oru Kala Pooja. The scheme offers 20Rs./- per annum per temple for Oru Kala Pooja. AdditionallyRs. assistance of 1Rs./- and 500/- per annum per temple is granted for Current Consumption Charges and Water Consumption ChargesRs. respectivelyRs. upon producing paid bills. The concerned temple authority must apply using the prescribed format along with specific documents.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 20Rs./- per annum per temple for meeting expenses towards the performance of Oru Kala Pooja. - Financial assistance of 1Rs./- per annum per temple for meeting expenses towards Current Consumption Charges. - Financial assistance of 500/- per annum per temple for meeting expenses towards Water Consumption Charges. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Financial assistance shall be sanctioned within three months time. - Sanction is dependent upon the availability of funds. - Assistance for Current Consumption Charges and Water Consumption Charges is granted on the production of bills paid by the temple authority. ##### ***Conditions for Availment/Continuation of Benefits*** - _The grant of financial assistance sanctioned must be utilized strictly for the purpose for which it is sanctioned._ - _The temple authority must produce the Original Vouchers for having utilized the amount towards the performance of Oru Kala Pooja._ - _The temple authority must provide an Utilization Certificate for having fully utilized the amount for the purpose sought._ - _Any portion of the amount which remains unspent or unutilized shall be duly surrendered to the CommissionerRs. Hindu Religious InstitutionsRs. Puducherry._ - _The Government reserves the power to call for the accounts of the temple for the amount sanctioned._ - _The accounts relating to the financial assistance sanctioned are subject to audit by the Directorate of Accounts & TreasuriesRs. Puducherry or any other competent authority._
eligibility: - The applicant must be the concerned temple authority. - The temple must be situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry. - The temple must have poor resources.

name: Tourist Guide Certification Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Tourist Guide Certification Scheme was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to increase the number of certified tourists guides in GoaRs. thereby generating employment opportunities for Goan youth and improving the quality of tourist facilitation services in the State. It provides (i) reimbursement of the fee paid by Goan participants for the Incredible India Tourist Facilitator (Basic) Certification Programme of the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of IndiaRs. and (ii) sponsorship of the cost of an Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum developed by the Department of TourismRs. Goa. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Reimbursement of Fees*** - Reimbursement of the fee paid by the participant for the Incredible India Tourist Facilitator (Basic) Certification Programme (IITF Basic) conducted by the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of India. - SC/ST category candidates are already exempted from payment of registration fees under the IITF programme and therefore are not eligible for reimbursement under this scheme. ##### ***Sponsored Training*** - Sponsorship of the Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum developed by the Department of TourismRs. GoaRs. covering local historyRs. heritageRs. cultureRs. tourist destinationsRs. soft skillsRs. and etiquette. ##### ***Certification*** - On completion of the Advanced Tourist Guide CurriculumRs. the Department of Tourism awards a Tourist Guide Certificate. ##### ***Optional Language Specialisation*** - Participants may optionally pursue Foreign Language Courses after certification at their own cost. ##### ***Special Provisions*** - Existing tourist guides registered with the Department of Tourism as on the date of notification may register for the Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum at no cost. - Examination fee of 500 for the IITF Basic course shall be borne by the candidate.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a person of Goan domicile. - The applicant must be between 18 and 40 years of age. - The applicant must have passed 10 + 2 (or equivalent) examination from any recognised board in India. - The applicant must have successfully completed the IITF (Basic) Certification Programme of the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of India. - The applicant must not belong to SC/ST category for claiming reimbursement (as these categories are already fee-exempt under IITF). - The applicant must register with the Department of TourismRs. Goa after completion of the Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum to be recognised as a certified guide. - Existing tourist guides registered with DOT before the publication of this scheme are eligible only for the sponsored Advanced Tourist Guide Curriculum.

name: Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the cultivation and expansion of aromatic plant species across the state by providing financial assistance to farmers.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. the maximum grant limit for any individual farmer shall be 1.00 lakh or the grant amount admissible for the cultivation of up to 2 hectares of land (based on the survival rate of plants)Rs. whichever is less. - The grant is provided for the cultivation of nine selected aromatic cropsRs. namely aromatic grasses (lemongrassRs. citronellaRs. palmarosaRs. khusRs. etc.)Rs. damask roseRs. mint (except Japanese mint)Rs. geraniumRs. black cuminRs. rosemaryRs. bay leafRs. timurRs. and sandalwoodRs. undertaken by the farmer at his or her own expense.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a farmer. - The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. - The nine selected species eligible for the grant must have been cultivated by the farmer at their own expense.

name: Financial Assistance For Renovation And Special Repair Works To Hindu Religious Institutions Situated In Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Renovation and Special Repair Works to Hindu Religious Institutions situated in Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend one-time financial assistance to Hindu religious institutions that are not under the direct purview of the Department of Hindu Religious Institutions but are situated in Adi-Dravidar Colonies or Economically Weaker Section Areas for renovation and special repair works. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline in a prescribed application form.
benefits: One-time financial assistance to the tune of 2Rs./- per temple towards the purchase of building materials for renovation and special repair works.
eligibility: - The applicant must be the concerned temple authority. - The applicant must represent a temple that is not coming under the purview of the Department of Hindu Religious Institutions. - The applicant must represent a temple situated in Adi-Dravidar colonies or Economically Weaker Section Areas.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkars Yatra Scheme to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkars life in India
brief_description: The scheme Dr. B.R. Ambedkars Yatra Scheme to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkars life in India was launched by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes WelfareRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes people for visiting historical places located in India connected with the life of Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar. The scheme provides comprehensive financial assistanceRs. as the total amount of expenses are fully borne by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Organizing a tour for a group of about 50 participants every year to four memorial places: Janam Bhoomi (MhowRs. Madhya Pradesh)Rs. Deeksha Bhoomi (NagpurRs. Maharashtra)Rs. Mahaparinivaran Bhoomi (Delhi)Rs. and Chaitya Bhoomi (Mumbai). - The total amount of expenses are fully borne by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department. - The participants are entitled to free boarding and lodgingRs. including all meals. - No charges shall be levied from the participants in connection with the conduct of the tour. - All expenses like entrance feeRs. admission feeRs. etc.Rs. could be borne by the Department. ##### ***Conditions*** - The Department should not bear the personal expenses incurred by the participants. - The participant must abide by the rules/instructions laid down during the tour. - The participant must repay the expensesRs. with interest in case of any misrepresentation or suppression of facts furnished. - The participant must be well aware that they shall be stepped down anywhere during the tour in case of any discrepancy.
eligibility: - The applicant must be of the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe community recognized by the Union territory of Puducherry. - The applicant must belong to this Union Territory by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than 5 years. - The applicant must not be less than 18 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be more than 50 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must be free from any contagious/communicable diseases. - Only one person per family can participate in a year. - The applicant must not have previously participated in the tour programme in his/her lifetime. - The applicant must not be a person who is availing assistance under prolonged disease. - The total annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 2Rs./-. ##### ***Priority*** - Applicants shall be selected by seniority in age on a first come first served basis. - The number of participants for each region shall be decided by the UT of Puducherry from time to time based on the ratio of the applications received: _Puducherry - 32; Karaikal - 12; Yanam - 4; Mahe - 2 (If no application is receivedRs. may be considered for Puducherry region)._

name: Uttarakhand Mega Industrial and Investment Policy - 2021
brief_description: The Mega Industrial and Investment Policy - 2021 is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote large-scale industrial development and investment in the state of Uttarakhand by creating a favourable business environmentRs. encouraging capital investmentRs. and generating employment opportunities.
benefits: ***Classification of Projects Based on Fixed Capital Investment:*** - **Large Projects** 50 crore to 75 crore. - **Mega Projects** Projects with a capital investment of more than 75 crore and up to 200 crore. - **Ultra Mega Projects** Projects with a capital investment of more than 200 crore and up to 400 crore in plant and machinery. - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** Projects with a capital investment of more than 400 crore in plant and machinery. ***Financial Incentives:*** Rebate/concession on prevailing land rates in SIIDCUL Industrial Areas (for manufacturing industries only): - **Large Projects** 15% - **Mega Projects** 25% - **Ultra Mega Projects** 30% - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** 30% **Interest Subsidy:** Reimbursement assistance on interest for term loans taken from banks for 5 years: - **Large Projects** 7%Rs. maximum 25 lakh per annum - **Mega Projects** 7%Rs. maximum 35 lakh per annum - **Ultra Mega Projects** 7%Rs. maximum 50 lakh per annum - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** 7%Rs. maximum 75 lakh per annum **SGST Reimbursement (for manufacturing enterprises only):** Reimbursement of net SGST for 5 years after adjustment of Input Tax Credit (ITC) on B2C sale of self-manufactured goods/items: - **Large Projects** 30% - **Mega Projects / Ultra Mega Projects / Super Ultra Mega Projects** 50% **Electricity Bill Reimbursement Assistance (for manufacturing enterprises only):** To support productionRs. electricity reimbursement assistance will be provided at 1.00 per unit in the electricity billRs. from the date of issuance for the next 5 years: - **Large Projects** 50 lakh per annum - **Mega Projects** 75 lakh per annum - **Ultra Mega Projects** 1 crore per annum - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** 1.50 crore per annum **Reimbursement of Electricity Duty:** 100% reimbursement. **Reimbursement of Stamp Duty:** 50% reimbursement of stamp duty charges payable during the execution of land purchase deed and lease deed. **Reimbursement of Registration Fee:** Registration of Land Purchase Deed/Lease Deed at the rate of 999 per 1Rs.. **Subsidy on ETP:** Capital subsidy of 30%Rs. maximum 50 lakh for setting up an ETP plant. **Payroll Assistance to Encourage Large-Scale Employment Generation:** Payroll assistance will be provided based on the minimum limit for regular employment: - **Large Projects** 50 employees - **Mega Projects** 100 employees - **Ultra Mega Projects** 200 employees - **Super Ultra Mega Projects** 400 employees Payroll assistance will be given as a subsidy for the next 5 years at the rate of 500/- per month per employee for additional employees employed beyond the specified limit. For women employeesRs. this rate will be 700/- per month per employee.
eligibility: 1. Any person who wishes to invest in Uttarakhand under the "Mega Industry and Investment Policy" is eligible.

name: Veerjyoti Puraskars
brief_description: The scheme "Veerjyoti Puraskars" was launched by the Directorate of Women and Child Development (DW&CD)Rs. Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the exceptional bravery and fight for dignity demonstrated by women and girls in the State of Goa against atrocitiesRs. violenceRs. and harassment. The scheme provides an award consisting of a cash prize of 20Rs./- and a scroll/citation to two selected persons annually. The applicant must be a woman or girl who has shown exceptional bravery and fought for respect and dignity in society in the State of Goa. The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Officer in the Directorate of Women and Child Development.
benefits: - A cash prize of 20Rs./- is provided to each selected awardee. - A scroll/citation is provided to each selected awardee. - The award is conferred on Republic DayRs. which is the 26th of JanuaryRs. every year. - The award is restricted to only two persons annually.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a woman or girl. - The applicant must have shown exceptional bravery and courage. - The applicant must have acted against any type of atrocitiesRs. violenceRs. and/or harassment against themselves or against any other woman or girl. - The actions must have taken place at homeRs. in the workplaceRs. or anywhere in the public domain. - The applicant must have fought for their respect and dignity in society.

name: Craft & Gear (Unit: Boats of Appropriate Sizes Including Nets, Fish & Ice Holding Boxes, Etc.)
brief_description: The scheme Craft & Gear (Unit: Boats of Appropriate Sizes Including NetsRs. Fish & Ice Holding BoxesRs. Etc.) was introduced by the Directorate of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to uplift the sizeable community of traditional Fishermen by providing them financial help in the form of a subsidy for carrying out fishing activities in inland waters of Goa. The subsidy amount shall be disbursed directly into the applicants bank account.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance/Subsidy*** - Financial assistance is provided for the purchase or construction of New Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic or wooden canoes below 26 feetRs. including netsRs. accessoriesRs. and insulated fish and ice holding boxes. - For the General CategoryRs. financial assistance is up to 40% of the unit costRs. limited to 40Rs./-. - For Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribesRs. WomenRs. and their Co-operativesRs. financial assistance is up to 60% of the unit costRs. limited to 60Rs./-. - The unit cost considered for the Craft & Gear (Unit: Boats of appropriate sizes including netsRs. fish & ice holding boxes etc.) is 1Rs./-. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The subsidy amount shall be disbursed in favor of the applicant in his or her Bank account. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The fishing canoe must be registered under the Captain of Ports Department._ - _The nets and its accessories purchased through the scheme must be duly registered with the Directorate of Fisheries under the GoaRs. Daman and Diu Fisheries RulesRs. 1981._ - _The beneficiary shall not sellRs. mortgageRs. or transfer the Fishing canoeRs. netsRs. accessoriesRs. or insulated ice holding boxes purchased through the scheme for a period of five years from the date of its purchase._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a fisherman. - The applicant must possess the No Objection Certificate issued by the Directorate of Fisheries for the purchase or construction of a wooden or Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic Fishing Craft of below 26 feetRs. including fishing net and ice holding boxes. - The applicant must produce the original Goods and Services Tax bill from the authorized dealer towards the purchase or construction of the new canoeRs. gill net and its accessoriesRs. and insulated fish and ice holding box to claim the subsidy. - The applicant must not be a fishing trawler owner. - The applicant must not be a defaulter of the Department. **Reservation/Priority:** Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribesRs. WomenRs. and their Co-operatives are eligible for a higher rate of assistance (60% of unit costRs. limited to 60Rs./-). **Relaxation:** The Government is empowered to relax all or any of the clauses provided in this scheme if found deemed fitRs. for reasons to be recorded.

name: Incentives To Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Incentives To Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme" was launched by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)Rs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage consumption through local purchases and encourage economies of ancillary unitsRs. local MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) as also traders including those in Horticulture business/Food Processing. The scheme provides reimbursement to the extent of 2% of the cost of local purchases consumed by the eligible unitRs. up to a maximum of 5Rs./- per yearRs. and the unit may avail benefit for five consecutive years from the date of first application. The applications for this scheme are accepted annuallyRs. requiring the unit to apply in the specified format after the closure of every financial year.
benefits: - Reimbursement to the extent of 2% of the cost of local purchases consumed by the eligible unit. - The maximum reimbursement is limited to 5Rs./- per year. ##### ***Intended Use/Definition of Purchase*** - The local purchases mean every industrial inputRs. including consumablesRs. purchased from Goa (whether manufactured in Goa or not) except service. - The value excluding Goods and Services Tax (GST) shall be considered for the calculation. ##### ***Frequency and Validity*** - The unit may avail benefit under this scheme for five consecutive years from the date of the first application. ##### ***Benefit Disbursement*** - The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation. - No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued in case allocation is exceeded. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The applicant shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilisation of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._ - _The applicant shall time to time or as and when required submit to the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce all the necessary reportsRs. information and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)._ - _If it is found that the information and documents submitted are incorrectRs. or the financial incentive was obtained by misrepresenting facts or submitting furnishing false informationRs. the Government of Goa/Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce shall revoke the subsidy._ - _The applicant shall pay back to the government the financial incentives receivedRs. or the same shall be recoverable as arrears of land revenue under the provisions of the Land Revenue Code 1968 and/or the GoaRs. DamanRs. Diu Public (Recovery & Dues) Act 1986._ - _In the event of breach of any of the terms and conditions of this DeclarationRs. the Government shall be entitled to recover the said financial incentives as arrears of land revenue under the provisions of the Land Revenue Code 1968 and/or the GoaRs. DamanRs. Diu Public (Recovery & Dues) Act 1986._
eligibility: - The industrial unit must be under the whiteRs. greenRs. or orange category. - The industrial unit must be a micro/small or medium manufacturing unit. - The applicant must purchase a minimum 50% (in value) of its raw material/ component/ tools etc. (input requirement for production) from local sources/ manufacturers. - The applicant must be registered under the Umbrella Scheme (Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme). - The applicant must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa.

name: Map Simplification Process
brief_description: The Map Simplification Process is implemented by the Haridwar - Roorkee Development Authority under Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify and expedite the approval of residential and commercial property maps through an efficient online system.
benefits: Approval of residential maps is being provided within 15 daysRs. and approval of commercial maps within 30 days.
eligibility: 1. All landowners in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Self-Help Group - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Self-Help Group is an initiative under the Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)Rs. implemented by the Nagar Nigam Dehradun under the Department of Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to empower urban poor women in Uttarakhand by promoting the formation of self-help groupsRs. improving their livelihoodsRs. and supporting them in income-generating and self-employment activities through financial incentivesRs. bank loansRs. and government subsidies.
benefits: - In urban local body areasRs. urban poor women are provided with benefits under the scheme. - A one-time amount of 10Rs./- is given to each group as an incentive by the Government of India. - Through bank loansRs. various activities are carried out by the groups to improve womens livelihoods. - To encourage groups to adopt self-employmentRs. subsidies are provided by both the Government of India and the State Government.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a woman. 1. To form a Self-Help GroupRs. the beneficiary must belong to an urban body. 1. The beneficiary must have an Aadhaar card & one passport-size photograph. 1. The annual income of the beneficiary's family must be less than 3.00 lakh.

name: Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship" was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide a one-time incentive of 10Rs./- each to the students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) or Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate (HSSLC) during the current yearRs. so that they are motivated to continue their further education. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: The benefit is a one-time incentive of 10Rs./- each.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community. - The applicant must have passed one of the following examinations - (a) High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) examinations from the Board of Secondary Education (SEBA) or an equivalent educational board recognized by the Government of Assam during the current year. (b) The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate (HSSLC) examinations in any stream from the Assam Higher Secondary Education Council (AHSEC) or an equivalent educational board recognized by the Government of Assam during the current year. - The applicant's family income must not exceed 5Rs./- per annum. ****The applicant applying for this incentive scheme shall also be eligible for the normal Post-Matric ScholarshipRs. Financial Assistance for Higher StudiesRs. and Financial Assistance for Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM)/General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM)/Technical CoursesRs. if eligibleRs. in the same year.***

name: Providing Model Maps for Residential Construction
brief_description: The Providing Model Maps for Residential Construction is implemented by the Haridwar - Roorkee Development Authority under Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide landowners in Haridwar district with model maps for residential construction according to the size of their plots.
benefits: Model maps for residential construction are provided to all landowners across Haridwar district.
eligibility: 1. All landowners in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017
brief_description: The Employment Subsidy SchemeRs. 2017 was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create an environment conducive for attracting investment in the State of Goa and to incentivise existing units to be competitive while giving boost to local employment. The scheme provides a proportional subsidy based on the percentage of Goan manpower employedRs. ranging from 60% to 100%. The applicant must be a MicroRs. SmallRs. MediumRs. or Large manufacturing industryRs. or a Hinterland Eco tourism projectRs. and must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the application for at least one claim to the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC).
benefits: - Reimbursement shall be restricted to 7Rs./- per Goan employee per month. - The total subsidy for MicroRs. SmallRs. Medium enterprises and eco-tourism projects shall not exceed 25Rs./- per annumRs. on a pro rata basis depending on the date of production. - The total subsidy for Large enterprises shall not exceed 50Rs./- per annumRs. on a pro rata basis depending on the date of production. - Subsidy is calculated based on the ratio of percentage of Goan employmentRs. which provides a proportional increase from 60% benefit for 60% Goan employeesRs. up to 100% benefit for 80% and above Goan employees. ##### ***Benefit Disbursal*** - For MicroRs. SmallRs. Medium enterprises and eco-tourism projectsRs. the total wages paid to Goan employees shall be restricted to 50% before applying the reimbursement ratio. - For Large enterprisesRs. the total wages paid to Goan employees shall be restricted to 25% before applying the reimbursement ratio. - The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation. - The period of grant of subsidy shall not exceed seven years. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The enterprise must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilisation of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._ - _The enterprise must submit all necessary reportsRs. informationRs. and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC) from time to time or as and when required._
eligibility: - The applicant must be classified as a MicroRs. SmallRs. MediumRs. or Large manufacturing industry. - The applicant must be listed under the white categoryRs. green categoryRs. or orange category. - The applicant must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. - The applicant must ensure the employees counted for the percentage calculation are employed on the enterprises payroll continuously during the claim year. - The applicant must ensure the Goan employees considered for subsidy calculation are up to 60 years of age. - The applicant must ensure the Goan employees considered for subsidy calculation are paid a gross salary of more than 8Rs./- per month. - The applicant must ensure that the relations defined under section 56 of the Income Tax ActRs. 1961Rs. are not counted as employees for the purpose of this scheme. - The applicant must not have availed of the Chief Ministers Rojgar Yojana (CMRY) Scheme or any other employment generation scheme of the Government of India or the Government of Goa. - The applicant must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information TechnologyRs. Government of Goa. - The applicant must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa. - The applicant must submit the application for at least one claim to the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC) during the scheme's validity (up to September 30Rs. 2022). ##### ***Eligibility for Hinterland Eco-Tourism Projects*** - The applicant must be a project of Hinterland Eco tourism in lesser developed talukas. - The applicant must be registered with/recognised by the Department of Tourism/Goa Investment Promotion Board (IPB)/Town & Country Planning/Planning & Development Authority (PDA)/Eco Sensitive Zone Authority.

name: Greenhouse Construction
brief_description: The scheme Greenhouse Construction is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote protected cultivation of vegetables and flowers by encouraging farmers to adopt greenhouse technology through substantial financial assistance and supportRs. thereby increasing productivityRs. improving crop qualityRs. and enhancing farmers income.
benefits: To promote vegetable and flower cultivation inside greenhousesRs. 50% to 80% of the total cost is provided as assistance for fan and pad systemsRs. naturally ventilated polyhousesRs. and planting materials. The details are given below: - For protected cultivation of flowers and vegetablesRs. 50% of the total cost is provided for fan and pad systems or naturally ventilated polyhouses. - Planting material for vegetables and flowers (seedsRs. flower bulbs and plants) is provided with a 50% subsidy. - For greenhouse constructionRs. 50% of the total cost is provided for fan and pad system polyhouses and tubular structure polyhouses. - A 50% subsidy is provided for installing anti-hail nets. **Under the State SectorRs. an additional 25% subsidy is provided as the State shareRs. making the total subsidy 75%.** **Plastic mulching:** To retain moisture and promote microflora around the rootsRs. 50% of the total cost is provided for covering the land with plastic sheets. **Arrangement of planting material for protected cultivation:** Planting materials under polyhouse cultivation (flower and vegetable seeds) are provided at a 50% subsidy. If the farmer purchases them from outside agencies (other than the department)Rs. 50% of the cost is reimbursed. Support for greenhouse construction is available for an area of up to 4Rs. sq. meters or 500 sq. meters as per the guidelines issued by the Government of India and the State Government. For a 500 sq. meter polyhouseRs. the State Government provides an additional 30% subsidyRs. allowing the farmer to receive a total subsidy of 80%.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. This support is not provided to applicants working in a group.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
brief_description: The scheme "Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes" was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among the Scheduled Caste population by providing concessional finance to themRs. focusing on innovation and growth technologies. The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from 10Rs./- to 15Rs./-Rs. which can be provided through debt/convertible instruments at 4% per annum (3.75% per annum for Scheduled Caste women/disabled entrepreneurs) or through equity investment with a return of 8% per annum or valuationRs. whichever is higher at exit. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: ##### ***Size of Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance available ranges from 10Rs./- (minimum) to 15Rs./- (maximum). - Aggregate financial assistance must not exceed two times the current net worth of the Company. ##### ***Funding Tenure*** - The maximum tenure for financial assistance is up to 10 yearsRs. including the moratorium period in the case of debentures. - In the case of equityRs. the decision for exit would be taken on a case-to-case basisRs. with a maximum tenure up to 10 years. ##### ***Returns/Coupons/Interest Rate*** - For debt/convertible instrumentsRs. the interest/coupon rate is 4% per annum. - For Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs and disabled entrepreneurs accessing debt/convertible instrumentsRs. the interest/coupon rate is 3.75% per annum. - In equity investmentRs. the return at the time of exit by way of buybackRs. strategic investmentRs. or Initial Public Offering (IPO) shall be 8% per annum or as per the valuationRs. whichever is higher. ##### ***Working Capital Gap Funding*** - The fund offers working capital gap fundingRs. where a maximum of 20% of the total financial assistance should be earmarked for this purpose for the next 10 years. - The quantum of such assistance shall be approved by the Investment Committee as per the requirement of the projectRs. on a case-to-case basis. ##### ***Technology Business Incubator (TBI) Funding*** - Innovative ideas selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) may receive funding to cover the cost of operation and maintenance. - This funding is subject to a ceiling of 10Rs./- on an average per year for a period of three yearsRs. subject to satisfactory progress. ##### ***Moratorium Period for Principal Redemption*** - In the case of debenturesRs. the moratorium period for the redemption of the principal is on a case-to-case basisRs. but not more than 36 months from the date of investment in the Company. ##### ***Cost Bearing for Documentation*** - The fees for the Valuer and the Lawyer for conducting valuation and title search of the property(ies) shall be borne by the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) for the first time. ##### ***Disbursement*** - For financial assistance up to 5Rs./-Rs. investment shall be funded maximum up to 75% of the project costRs. and the balance 25% must be funded by the promoters or through Government subsidy under various schemes. - For financial assistance above 5Rs./-Rs. investment shall be funded maximum up to 50% of the project cost. - For financial assistance above 5Rs./-Rs. at least 25% of the project cost shall be funded by promoters or through Government subsidy under various schemesRs. and the balance 25% can be funded either by promotersRs. a bankRs. or any other Financial Institution. - For companies with sanctioned assistance of above 5Rs./-Rs. the money released by the Trust/Fund Manager would be in proportion to the loan tranche/promoters contribution released by a Bank/department of Government of IndiaRs. except in cases supported under the Innovative ideas category selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs). - The investment disbursement shall be made in tranches. - The disbursement shall be made post execution of the complete legal documents. - Disbursement is subject to the completion of the sanctioned termsRs. pre-disbursement conditionsRs. and the successful completion of Valuation and Title Search Report (TSR). ##### ***Conditions*** - _Interest/Coupon payment shall commence from the date of investment in the Company._ - _Interest payments will be made quarterly by the company to Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)._ - _The shareholding of Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs (at least 51%) has to be maintained till the assistance under this fund is present in the company._ - _If working capital assistance is extended to existing beneficiariesRs. the account must be standard._ - _If working capital assistance is extended to existing beneficiariesRs. the beneficiary company should have applied to nationalized/private/cooperative Banks for working capital assistance._ - _In cases where Government subsidy is availableRs. the promoters will have to contribute at least 15% of the project cost._ - _If any modification is requested by the Company/Promoters for change in the property after the first valuation/title searchRs. the fees for the Valuer and Lawyer shall be borne by the Company/Promoters._
eligibility:
The projects/units being set up in manufacturingRs. services and allied sectorRs. including start-ups and units being incubated in the technology business incubatorsRs. ensuring asset creation out of the funds deployed in the unit shall be considered.
##### ***For Companies Applying for Assistance up to 50Rs./-*** Companies having: a. at least 51% shareholding by Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs for the past 6 months with management control OR; b. a new Company provided that the new Company is a successor entity of a Proprietary Firm or Partnership Firm or One Person Company (OPC) or Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) or any other establishment incorporated under any law in force with sound business model which has been in operation for over 6 monthsRs. and the predecessor entity had at least 51% shareholding of the Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs with management control.
##### ***For Companies Applying for Assistance above 50Rs./-*** Companies having: a. at least 51% shareholding by Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs for the past 12 months with management control OR; b. a new Company provided that the new Company is a successor entity of a Proprietary Firm or Partnership Firm or One Person Company (OPC) or Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) or any other establishment incorporated under any law in force with sound business model which has been in operation for over 12 monthsRs. and the predecessor entity had at least 51% shareholding of the Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs with management control.
##### ***For Technology Oriented Innovative Projects*** A. Innovative ideas selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) for incubation funding to cover the cost of operation and maintenance subject to a ceiling of 10Rs./- on an average per year for a period of three years subject to satisfactory progress. B. New Companies having at least 51% shareholding by first time Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs who have been working in technology oriented innovative projects: i. with the support of incubation centers at IITsRs. NITsRs. Premier Business SchoolsRs. UniversitiesRs. InstitutionsRs. Medical CollegesRs. NSTEDB under Department of Science & Technology (DST) or supported by corporateRs. with good potential of commercialization and project is at implementation stage; and/or; ii. without the support of Incubations centers but are having patent/copyrights with good potential of commercialization and project is at implementation stage. iii. Projects sanctioned by departments of Government of India after due appraisal.
- Documentary proofs of being SC will have to be submitted by the Entrepreneur at the time of submitting the proposals. - Documentary proofs / certificate from the incubation centers/corporates or documents w.r.t patent/ copyrights in the name of SC entrepreneur need to be submitted at the time of submitting the proposal. - Sanction letter of department of Government of India. - E-documents will also be accepted.
For Companies with sanctioned assistance of above 5Rs./-Rs. the money released by the Trust/Fund Manager would be in proportion to the loan tranche released by Bank/department of Govt of IndiaRs. except in the cases being supported under Innovative ideas category selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) as mentioned at point A above.

name: Short Term Financial Assistance To Good Borrowers
brief_description: The scheme Short Term Financial Assistance To Good Borrowers was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to meet short term financial requirementsRs. such as fund needs for executing specific ordersRs. addressing seasonal increases in fund requirementsRs. or fulfilling firm export orders. The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from a minimum of 5Rs./- to a maximum of 50Rs./-. The applicant must be an existing Medium Scale Industry or Small Scale Industry unit classified as A or B CategoryRs. or an existing Good Borrower who has repaid 30% of the Principal amount. The scheme is implemented by PIPDIC. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - The minimum loan limit available is 5Rs./-. - The maximum loan limit available is 50Rs./-. - The intended use of the funds is to meet short term financial requirements. This includes meeting the requirements of executing specific ordersRs. seasonal increase in fund requirementsRs. and firm export orders. ##### ***Disbursement*** 100% of the loan amount shall be released immediately after completion of documentation and fulfilling the other norms of the Corporation. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The loan repayment period for amounts up to 10Rs./- is 12 months._ - _The loan repayment period for amounts above 10Rs./- up to 25Rs./- is 18 months._ - _The loan repayment period for amounts above 25Rs./- up to 50Rs./- is 24 months._ - _The applicant must offer collateral security for a value of 150% of the term loan._ - _If the applicant is a non-assisted unitRs. the quantum of loan will be decided based on the merits of the individual case and the security offered._
eligibility: - Existing units of MSI and SSI classified as A and B Category. - Existing Good Borrowers who have repaid 30% of the Principal amount. Units assisted by other financial institutions / Banks. Group concerns of the Clients of the CorporationRs. with an excellent track record of 4 years and operating on Profitable lines.

name: Scheme for Cottage and Village Industries (Composite Loan Scheme)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Cottage and Village Industries (Composite Loan Scheme)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance of both term loan and/or working capital loan to new or existing micro enterprise projects. The scheme provides assistance for acquiring fixed assetsRs. specifically for the purchase of new machinery/equipment and to meet the working capital requirement. The scheme is implemented by PIPDIC. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance (Term Loan and/or Working Capital Loan) up to a maximum of 25Rs./- per unit. - Loan proceeds may be used for assistance for fixed assets and/or working capital. - Loan proceeds may be considered for the purchase of new machinery/equipment and to meet the working capital requirement. - The maximum repayment period is 8 yearsRs. including a moratorium period of maximum 1 year. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) required for loans under this scheme up to 25Rs./- is 3:1. - Term loans and working capital loans up to 25Rs./- are charged an interest rate of 10% (Ten per cent) per annum. - A concessional rate of interestRs. 0.5% (zero point five per cent) less than the normal rateRs. is charged for units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. or Differently Abled persons. ##### ***Conditions*** - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property shall be offeredRs. apart from the mortgage/hypothecation of proposed fixed assets._ - _The value of immovable property situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry offered as security must be not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property is situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. its value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount if it includes land with a building._ - _If the immovable property offered outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only landRs. its value must be not less than 200% of the loan amount._ - _For units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. or Differently Abled personsRs. the value of the property to be offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% (Fifty per cent) of the loan amount._ - _The valuation of properties offered as security shall be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers/valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation._
eligibility: 1. The promoter shall be a resident of Puducherry. 2. The applicant must belong to one of the following sectors - - Artisans Village and Cottage Industries sector. - Small Industries in the tiny sector. - Micro Enterprises projects. 3. The loan application purpose must be for assistance for fixed assets and/or working capital. 4. The cost of machinery must have a ceiling of 25Rs./- per unit.

name: Equipment Refinance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Equipment Refinance Scheme was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the well performing SSI units for the purchase of identifiable items of equipment / machinery for diversification / modernization / expansion / replacement and also balancing equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - A need-based loan limit of up to 90Rs./- is available. - Interest Rates: For loans up to 25Rs./-Rs. the interest rate is 10% per annum. For loans above 25Rs./- and up to 50Rs./-Rs. the interest rate is 11% per annum. For loans above 50Rs./-Rs. the interest rate is 12% per annum. - A concessional rate of interest of 0.5% less than the normal rate is charged for units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. or Differently abled persons.
eligibility: - The applicant must own a well performing Small Scale Industrial unit. - The unit must have been in operation for the last four years. - The unit must have earned profit during the preceding two financial years. - The unit must have declared dividend during the preceding two financial years. - The applicant must not have defaulted to any Institution or bank. - The scheme objective must be the purchase of identifiable items of equipment or machinery for diversification/modernization/expansion/replacement or for balancing equipment.

name: Nishadraj Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The Nishadraj Scholarship Scheme was launched by the Fisheries Welfare and Fisheries Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to support the higher education of children belonging to fisher families working in the Federation reservoirs. Under this schemeRs. scholarships for technical and non-technical courses are provided to meritorious students from fisher households to help them continue professional and academic studies.
benefits: - Scholarship up to 20Rs. or the actual expenditure (whichever is lower) for technical courses such as MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. CLAT-based Law coursesRs. and equivalent technical programs. - Scholarship up to 10Rs. or the actual expenditure (whichever is lower) for non-technical courses such as B.A.Rs. B.Sc.Rs. B.Com.Rs. B.C.A.Rs. B.F.F.C.Rs. B.Sc. AgricultureRs. LawRs. and similar parallel courses. > **NOTE:** Scholarship amount is transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a child of a fisher family working in the federations reservoirs. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student must belong to GeneralRs. Other Backward Classes (OBC)Rs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Minority communitiesRs. or Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized technical course (MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. CLAT-based LawRs. etc.) or a non-technical course (B.A.Rs. B.Com.Rs. B.Sc.Rs. AgricultureRs. etc.). 1. The applicant should be pursuing higher education at the time of application.

name: 108, Emergency Ambulance Service - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The 108 Emergency Ambulance Service is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide immediate medical assistance during emergencies by ensuring quick patient transportation to hospitals and offering essential first aid.
benefits: - In any type of medical emergencyRs. patients are transported to the hospital and provided with first aid facilities. - The benefits of this service are being provided to the residents of the state through 272 ambulances.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The benefit is provided to accident victims and individuals requiring emergency services.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Old Age Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to help elderly persons meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to senior citizens (both husband and wife) in the state who are 60 years of age or above.
benefits: A pension of 1Rs./- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above. 1. The applicants family monthly income must not exceed 4Rs./- or the applicant must belong to the BPL category. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other pension.

name: Sanitary Napkin Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Sanitary Napkin Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide sanitary napkins to adolescent girls and women at subsidized rates through Anganwadi centres across the state.
benefits: - Sanitary napkins are distributed to adolescent girls/women at a cost of 6/-.
eligibility: All adolescent girls and women are eligible to purchase sanitary napkins at subsidized rates from Anganwadi centres.

name: Dwarf Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Dwarf Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals suffering from dwarfism to help them meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to persons above 21 years of age whose height is less than 4 feet.
benefits: A pension of 1Rs./- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 21 years of age. 1. The applicants height must be less than 4 feet. 1. There is no income limit for eligibility under the scheme.

name: Maulana Azad Education Finance Foundation Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Maulana Azad Education Finance Foundation Scheme was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide interest-free loans to students from minority communities for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. students from minority communities are provided interest-free loans of up to 5 lakh for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. ParsiRs. BuddhistRs. or Jain). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 35 years. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 12. 1. The applicant must be studying in or have taken admission to a university/college/institute recognized by the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. or any other competent authority. 1. The annual family income of the applicant from all sources should not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. The beneficiary availing the loan must repay it within 3 years after the completion of education or upon gaining employmentRs. whichever is earlier.

name: Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the dependents of ex-servicemen pursuing EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. or Ph.D. courses.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** - 12Rs./- per year for Engineering students - 15Rs./- per year for Medical students - 10Rs./- per year for PhD students
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a dependent of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a course in EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. or Ph.D. from a recognized institution. **Note:** It is mandatory that the applicant's correct name is mentioned both in the bank account and the discharge book.

name: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak" is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free textbooks to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in government and government-aided schoolsRs. as well as recognized madrasas that follow the state government curriculum.
benefits: Every yearRs. in accordance with the guidelines of the Directorate of Elementary and Secondary EducationRs. free textbooks are provided to all students from Classes 1 to 8 in government schoolsRs. government-aided schoolsRs. and recognized madrasas following the state government curriculum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student from Classes 1 to 8. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided schoolRs. or a recognized madrasa that follows the Uttarakhand state government curriculum.

name: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities
brief_description: The scheme Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount to individuals belonging to minority communities who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand. The grant is available when a loan of 1 lakh to 10 lakh is taken for starting self-employment activities.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. a grant is provided for self-employment. On taking a loan of 1 lakh to 10 lakhRs. a grant of 25% of the loan amount is givenRs. with a minimum grant of 25Rs./- and a maximum of 2Rs./-. - The benefit of the scheme is available only on taking a loanRs. in which 60% of the project cost is provided as a loanRs. 25% as grant/subsidy by the departmentRs. and 15% as contribution by the applicant. - Interest on the loan will be charged according to the current prevailing rates of the bank.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. ParsiRs. BuddhistRs. or Jain). 1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The annual family income from all sources should not exceed 2Rs./-Rs. or the applicant should be a member of a BPL family.

name: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sports among talented children aged 8 to 14 years in Uttarakhand by providing monthly scholarships.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. players aged 8 to 14 years are selected every year on the basis of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT). - From each districtRs. 150 boys and 150 girls are selected (25 boys and 25 girls from each age group: 89 yearsRs. 910 yearsRs. 1011 yearsRs. 1112 yearsRs. 1213 yearsRs. and 1314 years). - Each selected player is awarded a scholarship of 1Rs./- per month for one year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 8 and 14 years of age. 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competitionRs. conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strengthRs. flexibilityRs. enduranceRs. speedRs. and coordinationRs. will be eligible for the sports scholarship.

name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa has been launched by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide free and safe transport for pregnant women and newborn babies (0 -1 year) to and from the hospitalRs. with services easily accessible by calling 102.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. pregnant women are provided free transportation from the hospital to their homes along with their newborns after delivery. AdditionallyRs. pregnant are also provided free to-and-fro transportation from home to the hospital for ultrasound services. These facilities are being provided across the state through 128 vehicles.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a newborn baby aged 0 to 1 year.

name: Uchcha Shiksha Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Uchcha Shiksha Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education among meritorious students by providing financial support to regular undergraduate and postgraduate students in government colleges and state universities of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. scholarships ranging from a minimum of 1Rs./- to a maximum of 60Rs./- are awarded to students who secure firstRs. secondRs. and third positions in each faculty at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
eligibility: 1. The student must be studying in a Government College or State University campus of Uttarakhand. 1. At each college/campus level (per faculty): **Undergraduate Students:** 1. **First-year students:** Monthly scholarships of 3Rs./-Rs. 2Rs./-Rs. and 1Rs./- will be awarded to students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positionsRs. respectivelyRs. based on a minimum of 80% marks or equivalent grade in the 12th examination. 1. **Second- and third-year students:** Monthly scholarships of 3Rs./-Rs. 2Rs./-Rs. and 1Rs./- will be awarded to students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positionsRs. respectivelyRs. based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the previous years examination. 1. **Graduation-level examination toppers:** Students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positions based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination will be awarded a lump-sum scholarship of 35Rs./-Rs. 25Rs./-Rs. and 20Rs./-Rs. respectively. **Postgraduate Students:** 1. **Second-year students:** Students securing firstRs. secondRs. and third positions based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination will be awarded monthly scholarships of 5Rs./-Rs. 3Rs./-Rs. and 2Rs./-Rs. respectively. 1. Final-year or one-year course students: Students must have secured a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination. FirstRs. secondRs. and third position holders will receive a one-time scholarship of 60Rs./-Rs. 35Rs./-Rs. and 25Rs./-Rs. respectively. **Merit-based Scholarships:** 1. 10% of students from each faculty of each college/university campus securing a minimum of 75% marks and having at least 75% attendance in the firstRs. secondRs. and third years of graduation (as applicable) will be awarded a scholarship of 1Rs./- per month. **Additional Notes:** 1. Marks obtained after improvement tests will not be considered for scholarship calculation. 1. The academic session is calculated from July 1 to June 30.

name: Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Needy Student Fund (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student)
brief_description: The Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Needy Student Fund (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to needy students pursuing the B.Sc. Agriculture course in their final year of studyRs. based on their genuine financial needRs. thereby helping to reduce their economic burden and support the continuation of their education.
benefits: **Amount of Assistance:** 25Rs./- per year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student in need of financial support to continue their education. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the final year of the B.Sc. Agriculture course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The financial assistance is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State
brief_description: The "Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State" scheme is implemented by the Basic Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 1 to 8 by offering free education and essential learning materialsRs. including booksRs. shoe-bagsRs. and mealsRs. across all government and non-government schools in the state.
benefits: After admission in all Government and Non-Government schools of the stateRs. children from Class 1 to 8 receive free educationRs. mealsRs. booksRs. and shoe-bags.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant (child) must be 6 years old to get admission in Class 1. 1. The applicant (student) must be currently registered in Anganwadi Bal Vatika to be eligible for admission to Class 1.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme - On Completion of 60 Years (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Old Age Pension Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to registered construction workers who have attained the age of 60 years.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 1Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.

name: Scholarship on Merit Basis
brief_description: The scheme Scholarship on Merit Basis is implemented by Uttarakhand Sanskrit UniversityRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate studies at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University by awarding scholarships to those who secure the highest marks in the relevant courseRs. classRs. or subject.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have secured the highest marks in the relevant courseRs. classRs. or subject.

name: Cash Prize to Players and their Coaches for Winning Medals in National and International Competitions
brief_description: The scheme Cash Prize to Players and Their Coaches for Winning Medals in National and International Competitions was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize and honor players and their coaches from the state who have achieved remarkable success and won medals at the national and international level in the field of sports.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. athletes who achieve significant success at the national and international levelsRs. along with their coachesRs. are awarded cash prizes. - There is a provision to award prize money ranging from a minimum of 10Rs./- to a maximum of 2 crore. - Detailed information about the awards is available on the department's website: [https://sports.uk.gov.in](https://sports.uk.gov.in/).
eligibility: 1. Players and their coaches from Uttarakhand who have achieved remarkable success at the national and international levels in the field of sports are eligible.

name: Adventure Training for Youth
brief_description: The "Adventure Training for Youth" scheme was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and Prantiy Rakshak dal (PRD)Rs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to empower the youth of Uttarakhand by providing free adventure training programs that develop their skills and capabilities through various adventure activities.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. free training is provided to the youth of the state in various adventure-based activities such as White Water River Rafting Guide TrainingRs. Disaster Management and Disaster Rescue OperationsRs. First AidRs. Burma BridgeRs. TrekkingRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a male or female. 1. The applicant must be between 15 to 30 years of age as on 1st MarchRs. 2023. 1. The applicant must have passed at least class 8th.1. The applicant must be physically fit to undergo adventure training. 1. The applicant must not be suffering from Heart diseaseRs. AsthmaRs. EpilepsyRs. or have rods implanted in arms or legs. 1. The applicant will be given preference if they belong to volunteer of PARDRs. member of NSSRs. NCCRs. member/official of Yuvak or Mahila Mangal Dal.

name: Girl Education Promotion (Bicycle Scheme)
brief_description: The scheme "Girl Education Promotion (Bicycle Scheme)" is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote girls education in the state by providing financial assistance to Class 9 girl students for purchasing bicycles.
benefits: - Each eligible girl student in class 9 receives 2Rs./-. - The benefit includes a bicycle for plain areas and an FD (Fixed Deposit) worth 2Rs./- for hilly areas.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a girl student studying in Class 9. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government or government-aided non-government secondary school under the Uttarakhand Board.

name: Incentive Scheme for Marrying a Disabled Young Man/Woman
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive Scheme for Marrying a Disabled Young Man/Woman" has been implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals with 40% or more disability when they marry a non-disabled personRs. or when both partners have disabilities.
benefits: On marriageRs. the couple is given 25Rs./- as incentive.
eligibility: 1. The applicant couple should be residents of Uttarakhand or have been domiciled in the state for at least five years. 1. The couple must be citizens of India. 1. The couple should not be income tax payers. 1. Neither partner should have a living spouse at the time of marriage. 1. No member of the couple should have been convicted in any criminal case. 1. The benefit is provided when a person with 40% or more disability marries a non-disabled personRs. or when both partners have disabilities. 1. At the time of marriageRs. the groom should be between 21 and 45 years of age. 1. At the time of marriageRs. the bride should be between 18 and 45 years of age. 1. The marriage should be conducted in accordance with prevailing social customs and traditions or be legally registered.

name: Special Incentive Scheme for Women of Tharu, Boksa and Other Tribes (For Training and Marketing)
brief_description: The Special Incentive Scheme for Women of TharuRs. Boksa and Other Tribes (For Training and Marketing) is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to empower tribal women artisans through specialized training and marketing opportunities and ensures the provision of financial assistance for travelRs. logisticsRs. and stall rent for participating artisans.
benefits: ***Training Incentives:*** - Training is provided in various crafts based on market demandRs. along with popular crafts traditionally practiced by TharuRs. BoxaRs. and other tribal women. - The duration of the training program is two monthsRs. with a maximum of 25 training days per month.
