Each participant undergoes 5 hours of training per dayRs. making a total of 250 training hours for the entire program. ***Marketing Promotions:*** - Artisans are given priority participation in traditional fairsRs. exhibitionsRs. and district-level handloom exhibitions organized at the district level. - For marketing promotionRs. the Government of India and the State Government provide space for the display and sale of products created by artisans during various programsRs. exhibitionsRs. and India International Trade Fairs organized from time to time within the state and across the country. - The minimum travel fare for women participating in these exhibitions/fairsRs. maximum freight of 1Rs./- per artisan for transporting their productsRs. and stall rent are all borne by the State Government.
eligibility: 1. Women artisans belonging to the TharuRs. BoksaRs. and other tribes engaged in the craft sector in Uttarakhand will be eligible for training and marketing support.

name: Assistance to Handloom Artisans - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Assistance to Handloom Artisans is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to disaster-affected handloom artisans for the repair or repurchase of damaged toolsRs. equipmentRs. raw materialsRs. and finished products.
benefits: **Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided to disaster-affected artisans:** - **For the repurchase of damaged tools and equipment:** 5Rs./- per artisan for the repurchase of tools. - **For damage to raw materials or products under production or finished:** 5Rs./- per artisan for raw materials.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a disaster-affected artisan.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana has been implemented by the Uttarakhand Khadi and Village Industries Board under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing new enterprises or upgrading existing small-scale units.
benefits: The maximum project cost for manufacturing sector enterprises is 25 lakhRs. and for service and business sector enterprisesRs. it is 10 lakhRs. which is financed through banks. - 25% subsidy for Category-A districts (manufacturing sector maximum 6.25 lakh; service sector maximum 2.50 lakh) - 20% subsidy for Category-B and B+ districts (manufacturing sector maximum 5 lakh; service sector maximum 2 lakh) - 15% subsidy for Category-C and D districts (manufacturing sector maximum 3.75 lakh; service sector maximum 1.50 lakh) > **Note:** Classification of districts category wise is attached at [Annexure-1](https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf). (Page No. 157)
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme. 1. Under the schemeRs. financing is available for industrialRs. serviceRs. and business sectors. It is also available for projects related to apple cultivationRs. orchidsRs. animal husbandryRs. and agriculture activities. 1. The applicant or entity must not be a defaulter of any bankRs. nationalized bankRs. financial institutionRs. or cooperative bank/institution. 1. The applicant must hold an account with the financing bank in the concerned area.

name: Nishulk Swasthya Jaanch Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Nishulk Swasthya Jaanch Yojana is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure accessibleRs. affordable and quality healthcare services for all citizens of Uttarakhand by providing free diagnostic tests across government healthcare facilities.
benefits: Free diagnostic tests are provided at district hospitalsRs. sub-district hospitalsRs. community health centresRs. urban primary health centresRs. and primary health centres. Under the schemeRs. a total of 266 tests are available completely free of charge.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary can avail free health check-ups after registering at any government hospital in the state.

name: Special Financial Assistance Scheme for Meritorious Students of the State for Preparation of Competitive Examinations
brief_description: The scheme 'Special Financial Assistance Scheme for Meritorious Students of the State for Preparation of Competitive Examinations' was launched by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students who have cleared the preliminary examination conducted by the State or Union Public Service Commission for Group 'A' and 'B' servicesRs. or the written examination for the Armed Forces (e.g.Rs. NDARs. CDSRs. OTARs. Indian Naval AcademyRs. Indian Air Force AcademyRs. etc.).
benefits: A one-time grant of 50Rs./- per candidate is provided to eligible candidate.
eligibility: 1. The 100 candidates who qualify in the preliminary examination of Group A and B conducted by the State Public Service Commission. 1. The candidates must have passed the preliminary examination for Group 'A' or 'B'Rs. or the written examination for the Armed Forces (such as NDARs. CDSRs. OTARs. Indian Naval AcademyRs. Indian Air Force AcademyRs. etc.) conducted by the Union Public Service Commission. 1. The candidate must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The candidate must have passed Graduate/Postgraduate examinationsRs. or the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the above servicesRs. from recognized educational institutions (regular/open) located in the State of Uttarakhand. 1. The total annual family income of the candidate from all sources should not exceed 5 lakh. 1. The candidate should not have availed the benefit of any other equivalent scheme of the State or Central Government. 1. A candidate who is engaged in any job/business/professionRs. or whose spouse is engaged in any job/business/professionRs. will not be eligible for the benefit.

name: Training Programme for Entrepreneurship Development in Biotechnology
brief_description: The scheme Training Programme for Entrepreneurship Development in Biotechnology is implemented by the Uttarakhand Council for Biotechnology under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train youth in biotechnology and develop entrepreneurial skills by providing technical knowledgeRs. mentorshipRs. and guidance to help them initiate biotech startups.
benefits: Under this training programmeRs. training and technical information are provided to the youth of the state to promote entrepreneurship development and support them in establishing startups in the field of biotechnologyRs. along with guidance as per their specific needs.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student or researcher at the graduateRs. postgraduateRs. or Ph.D. level in BiotechnologyRs. MicrobiologyRs. Molecular BiologyRs. Genetic BiologyRs. Environmental BiologyRs. or related subjects.

name: State Fisheries Input Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "State Fisheries Input Scheme" was launched by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to aims to enhance the productivity and income of fish farmers by providing financial support in the form of subsidies on essential fishery inputs such as hand netsRs. hapaRs. netsRs. mini kitsRs. etc.
benefits: Fish farmers who are already engaged in fish farming are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost of essential fishery inputs such as fish feedRs. medicinesRs. etc. - A subsidy of 1 quintal of fish feed is provided for a 100 square meter pondRs. and 6 quintals of fish feed for ponds ranging from 500 to 2000 square meters. - A grant of 7 quintals of fish feed is provided for RAS/Biofloc systems. - A subsidy of 10 quintals of fish feed is provided for trout farming. - A 50% subsidy is provided on the total market rate cost of essential input materials for fisheries such as hand netsRs. hapasRs. netsRs. and minikits. - A 50% subsidy is admissible for one hand net/hapa/net and one minikit per fish farmer.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be currently engaged in fish farming. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste categoryRs. including GeneralRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. Other Backward Class (OBC)Rs. or be a woman.

name: Science Communication and Popularization
brief_description: The scheme Science Communication and Popularization is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote scientific thinking and awareness among citizens by providing support and funding to educational institutionsRs. R&D organizationsRs. and NGOs to organize science communication activities.
benefits: Popularization of Science is one of the key programs initiated by the Council to promote scientific temper among the citizens of UttarakhandRs. particularly the youth. A number of activities are conducted under this program. The Council provides financial assistance for organizing various events such as seminarsRs. workshopsRs. and conferences. It also organizes popular lectures and celebrates National Science Day.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an educationalRs. researchRs. or development organizationRs. or an NGO based in Uttarakhand.

name: Aromatic Awareness Programme - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Aromatic Awareness Programme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to raise awareness about aromatic plants and their benefitsRs. and to provide guidance on cultivation practices suitable to different agricultural climates.
benefits: - To spread information about aromatic plants and the benefits of their cultivation to the general public. - To provide information about crops according to the agricultural climate.
eligibility: 1. Any interested individual who is a resident of Uttarakhand can avail the benefits of the programme.

name: Very Dense Apple Plantation Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Very Dense Apple Plantation Scheme is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote intensive apple cultivation among farmers by establishing modern orchards with high-yielding varieties and providing financial assistance through a 60% subsidy on saplingsRs. thereby enhancing productivity and increasing farmers income.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. farmers will be provided with a 60% subsidy for establishing orchards of the latest apple varieties. The subsidy is structured as follows: 900 saplings per acre (12.36 lakh) for M-9Rs. 540 saplings per acre (7.86 lakh) for MM-111Rs. and 440 saplings per acre (3.34 lakh) for seedlings. The subsidy will be calculated on a pro-rata basis according to the number of very dense apple orchards and saplings actually established by the applicant.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. For setting up very dense/seedling apple plantationsRs. the minimum area of 2 Nali (0.04 ha) and the maximum area of 100 Nali (2 ha) will be eligible per beneficiary or group.

name: Establishment of Vermicompost Units
brief_description: The scheme Establishment of Vermicompost Units is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable agriculture and organic farming by providing financial assistance for setting up vermicompost units to farmers and women self-help groups.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. a subsidy of 75% of the costRs. up to 33Rs./- per unitRs. is provided for setting up vermicompost units (including pit construction and provision of earthworms).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The applicant must have either their own land or land on lease. 1. All women members of self-help groups are also eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.

name: Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization
brief_description: The "Refinance Scheme for Technology Development and Modernization" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist Sole ProprietorshipsRs. PartnershipsRs. Co-operative SocietiesRs. Private and Public Limited Companies for meeting the expenditure on purchase of capital equipmentRs. acquisition of technical know-howRs. and the upgradation of process technology and products. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: The assistance under the scheme would be available for meeting the expenditure on the following: - Purchase of capital equipmentRs. need based civil works and acquisition of additional land. - Acquisition of technical know-howRs. designRs. drawing and fashion forecast where relevant to specific product group. - Upgradation of process technology and products with trust on quality improvement comparable with acceptable domestic international standards. _*The project outlay must not exceed 1Rs./-._ _*The preliminary and pre-operative expenses shall not be covered as a part of the cost of the project._
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the following - - Sole Proprietorships - Partnerships - Co-operative Societies - Private Limited Companies - Public Limited Companies

name: Scheme for Acquisition of Equipment and Others
brief_description: The "Scheme for Acquisition of Equipment & Others" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist organizations in the small-scale sector in acquiring essential infrastructure and technology upgrades. The scheme provides need-based financial assistance for in-house quality control facilitiesRs. DG setsRs. pollution control equipmentRs. computers and related accessoriesRs. and equipment for indigenization or import substitution. The applications are accepted online.
benefits: ##### ***Loan Quantum*** - For Manufacturing and Installation of Renewable Energy/Energy Saving Systems: 5Rs./- per Product. - For In-House Quality Control Facilities: Need-based. - For DG Sets: Need-based. - For Pollution Control Equipment: Need-based. - For Computers and Related Accessories: Need-based. - For Indigenization/Import Substitution: Need-based.
eligibility: The applicant must be an organization in the small-scale sector.

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition
brief_description: The Maternal Nutrition scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state. AdditionallyRs. essential services such as antenatal care (ANC) check-ups during Mamata DiwasRs. immunisationRs. and IFA and calcium supplementation are also provided. The scheme has been implemented for a five-year periodRs. commencing from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28.
benefits: - **Take Home Ration:** Chikki/ladoo(s) and eggs are provided to pregnant women and lactating mothers under Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP). AdditionallyRs. the following nutrient-rich products would be provided under this scheme in addition to their existing entitlements. **Sl. No****Type of Take Home Ration****Monthly Quantity**1Til Ladoo500 gram (25 pieces of 20 gram each)2Paushtik Bhel750 gram3Roasted Chana1.5 kg4Dates500 gram - Consumption of IFARs. calcium and deworming tablets would also be monitored by the Anganwadi Workers (AWW) and ASHA. Nutrition and health counseling will also be effectively provided at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) and at the household level during home visits. - **Daily Ration cost:** 15.50/- per beneficiary/day for 150 days during pregnancy and 150 days during lactation.- **Date of delivery:** All items to be delivered to the beneficiaries at the AWC on the 1st of every month.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother registered and residing within the service area of the concerned Anganwadi Centre (AWC).

name: Aama Kuni Pilaa
brief_description: The scheme Aama Kuni Pilaa has been launched by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to focus on early stimulation and responsive parenting in the best interest of each child from 0-3 years. As the name "Aama Kuni Pilaa suggestsRs. the unconditional care and affection of parentsRs. grandparents and caregivers for the children is the driving force for the conceptualisation of this unique initiative. Early experiences with motherRs. father and grandparents shape lifelong learning and development of childrenRs. because of rapid brain development. 80% of the brain develops by three yearsRs. and stimulating experiences with caregivers strengthen the neural connectionsRs. promoting the holistic development of the child. > **Objectives:** The scheme envisages promoting parent-ledRs. home-basedRs. joyful child-friendly learning by creating an early stimulating environment at the household level. It aims at: - Building capacities by engaging parents and caregivers on responsive parenting messages using different platforms. - Skill building of ICDS officials/ caregivers on importance of early yearsRs. play and learning activities for children. - Sensitizing the parentsRs. care givers and the entire community on importance of early years. Involvement of father & male care givers through Men-streaming. - Engaging young children with low cost contextual and child friendly toys by the parents & caregivers. - Facilitating loveRs. talkRs. touch & play through toysRs. lullabiesRs. stories and interactive talk and activity with children below three years by the Anganwadi worker. - Equity outreach through appropriate parent & caregiver friendly IPCRs. IEC/ SBC materials.
benefits: ***The key components of the scheme are as listed below:*** **Sl. No.****Components****Unit Cost****Specifications****Usage****Point of Distribution****Procurement by**1Kuni Calendar for children (0-3 years)1.53/- per calendar/month/childSize: 11.5" x 17" Paper: 220 gsm art paper Print: Multi colour single sideTo be used at household level by the families of children (0 - 3 year)One Calendar for each family having children (0 - 3 year)District2Aama Kuni Pilaa Toy Kit340/- (per AWC)[As per Catalogue](https://wcd.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/21.%2026179_ECCE-Aama%20Kuni%20Pilaa.pdf.pdf)AWC level To be supplied to each AWCDistrict3Mo Bikash Patra (Child Assessment Card)NA-To be used at household level by the families of children (0- 3 year)One Card for each family having children (0-3 years)AWC4Aama Kuni Pilaa Flip BookNA-AWC level To be supplied to each AWC.District5Sukhada Lalana Palana handbookNA-AWC level To be given to AWCs.District**Note: The components mentioned above have been planned for 5 years. HoweverRs. for current financial year i.e. 2023-24Rs. funds shall be transferred for Activity-1 i.e Kuni Calendar which is to be printed and distributed for three months i.e. for JanuaryRs. February & MarchRs. 2024 and Activity-2 i.e. Aama Kuni Pilaa Toy Kit.** ***A. Kuni Calendar:*** This is a calendar with pictorial demonstration of age and development specific stimulating activities facilitating different development components such as psycho-socialRs. physical & motorRs. languageRs. creative & aesthetic aspects. The Calendar is categorized for three age groups i.e. for less than one yearRs. 1-2 years & 2-3. It shall be distributed each month by the AWW to the concerned parents during Ankur Diwas to ensure timely accessibility. The AWW would sensitise the parents and caregivers so that they can engage with their children and monitor its cognitive and physical development. ***B. Toy Kit:*** Funds for preparing toys at Anganwadi centres shall be released under Aama Kuni Pilaa scheme. DSWOsRs. shall share the guidelines and funds to CDPOsRs. who shall then transfer the same to the AWWs to prepare low cost and child friendly toys for under three childrenRs. in coordination with parents and community. The AWW would undertake due discussions with Matru Committee/ Jaanch committee/ parents to create awareness amongst them about the scheme and its benefits and also to keep them involved. A copy of the toy catalogue attached at [Annexure-A](https://wcd.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/21.%2026179_ECCE-Aama%20Kuni%20Pilaa.pdf.pdf) to this guideline may be referred to while developing the Toy Kit guidelines at District level. Operation modalities and budget break up for toy preparation is attached at [Annexure-B](https://wcd.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/21.%2026179_ECCE-Aama%20Kuni%20Pilaa.pdf.pdf) for your reference. ***C. Training:*** State level training on Aama Kuni Pilaa shall be organized at HETCRs. Bhubaneswar wherein all AlsRs. retired officials such as CDPOs/ DSWOs and Freelancers shall be trained. ThereafterRs. the trained State Level resource personnel shall conduct physical training at district level. District level trainings for the CDPOsRs. LSs & AWWs shall be organized at AWW and Helper Training Centres of the District.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged 0 to 3 yearsRs. residing in Odisha. 1. All children in the 03 years age group who are enrolled in the Poshan Tracker shall be considered as the targeted beneficiaries under this scheme.

name: Udhyan Card
brief_description: The Udhyan Card is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to create a unified identification system for farmers engaged in horticulture activitiesRs. enabling them to access all horticulture-related schemes and benefits provided by the Government of Uttarakhand.
benefits: The Udhyan Card is mandatory to avail the benefits of all schemes of the Department of Horticulture.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer who wishes to undertake horticulture activities. 1. The applicant must have their own or leased land.

name: Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana
brief_description:
The Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana has been launched in 201213 by the Government of Himachal Pradesh in honour of the late astronaut Kalpana Chawla. The scheme has been implemented by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh.
The scheme has been introduced to provide financial assistance to girl students from economically weaker sectionsRs. enabling them to pursue higher education without financial burden. It has been made applicable to eligible girl students who are permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh and are studying in recognized institutions within the stateRs. with the objective of helping them achieve their career goals and become self-reliant.
benefits: - The scholarship provides 18Rs. per annumRs. which will be directly credited to the beneficiarys bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant must be a girl.
1. The applicant must be a regular student of 10+2Rs. academicRs. professional or technical course in Science/Arts/Commerce stream.
1. The institution where the applicant is admitted must be a Government / Government Aided / Private School affiliated with the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education.
1. The scholarship is available for higher education coursesRs. including undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. and professional courses.
1. The scholarship will be given strictly on 10+2 merit declared by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School EducationRs. Dharamshala.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation Of Infrastructure And Installation Of Permanent Facility/ Acquisition Of Equipment/Tents And Facilities To Establish Adventure Tourism, Water Tourism, Water Sports, Cruise/House Boat, Navigation Infrastructure, Amusement Park, Water Park, Sound And Light Show, Laser Show, Camping (Including Tents)
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation Of Infrastructure And Installation Of Permanent Facility/ Acquisition Of Equipment/Tents And Facilities To Establish Adventure TourismRs. Water TourismRs. Water SportsRs. Cruise/House BoatRs. Navigation InfrastructureRs. Amusement ParkRs. Water ParkRs. Sound And Light ShowRs. Laser ShowRs. Camping (Including Tents)" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% on the fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 3Rs./-Rs. for projects involving the installation of permanent facilities such as platformsRs. jettiesRs. equipmentRs. parking sitesRs. electricity facilitiesRs. and water supply. The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 5Rs./- as approved by the department to be eligible for this scheme. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism BoardRs. and applications are accepted through the state's investment portal.
benefits: - **Capital Subsidy:** The beneficiary is entitled to a subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment.- **Maximum Ceiling:** The maximum subsidy amount provided is 3Rs./-.- **Qualifying Expenditure:** The subsidy covers the installation of permanent facilities/infrastructureRs. which includes creating/installing platformsRs. jettiesRs. equipmentRs. parking sitesRs. electricity facilitiesRs. water supplyRs. and public amenities.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private investor or entity establishing a tourism project. - The applicant must establish a project in the categories of Adventure TourismRs. Water TourismRs. Water SportsRs. Cruise/House boatRs. Navigation infrastructureRs. Amusement ParkRs. Water ParkRs. Sound and Light showRs. Laser showRs. or Camping (including tents). - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 5Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy 2025. - The applicant must submit the application for the capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation.

name: Scheme for Construction of Marriage Hall/ Community Hall/ Convention Centre/ Commercial Godown
brief_description: The "Scheme for Construction of Marriage Hall/ Community Hall/ Convention Centre/ Commercial Godown" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist ProprietaryRs. Partnership and Limited Companies for the Construction of buildingRs. interior design/decoration and acquisition of capital goods/requirement etc. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** 2Rs./-. **Repayment:** 8 years excluding moratorium period of 2 years. Collateral security to an extent of 100% of loan amount including the value of commercial complex site.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to ProprietaryRs. Partnership and Limited Companies.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Training Kit - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Training Kit is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe (ST) fishermen by enhancing their skills and access to equipment. Under this schemeRs. training kits containing fishing and net-weaving equipment are provided to Scheduled Tribe trainees upon completion of training. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: 1. Scheduled Tribe trainees are given a training kit worth 2Rs./- after completing three months of training. 1. The kit includes cast netsRs. gill nets with seekers and floatsRs. nylon twineRs. cotton ropesRs. plastic ropesRs. and net-weaving equipment. **Training Kit:** The kit is provided after the successful completion of a three-month training program. **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefits for this component can be reclaimed only once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private unitsRs. etc.Rs. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.

name: Sweekruti: Pre & Post Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Pre & Post Matric Scholarship" is a component of the Sweekruti schemeRs. implemented by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The objective of the component is to provide financial assistance to Transgender students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships are available to transgender students of Odisha for studies in India only and are awarded where the applicant is studying.
benefits: **Category****Rate/ Per Month**Pre-Matric (From Std. V to X) 1Rs./-Post-Matric (From Std. XI-XII)1Rs./-General Graduate/ Post Graduate Courses2Rs./-Professional Degrees/ Diplomas/ Certificates2Rs./-Open University/ Non-formal Courses3Rs./-
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Odisha.
- The applicant must be a transgender person.
- The applicant must be a regular student at a recognized educational institution.
- The applicants family income should not exceed 2Rs./- per annum.
- The applicant must not be receiving financial assistance from any other State or Central Government scheme.

name: Investment Promotion Assistance To Setup Large/Mega/Ultra-Mega Tourism Projects
brief_description: The scheme "Investment Promotion Assistance to Setup Large/Mega/Ultra-Mega Tourism Projects" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of substantial tourism infrastructure by providing financial incentives based on capital investment and employment generation. The scheme provides investment promotion assistance ranging from 30% of the capital investment up to a maximum ceiling of 90Rs./- depending on the project category (LargeRs. MegaRs. or Ultra-mega). The applicant must be a private investor or legal entity willing to invest a minimum of 10Rs./- and ensure specific employment numbers for residents of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Madhya Pradesh Government's Invest Portal.
benefits: ##### ***Large Projects*** The beneficiary will receive Investment Promotion Assistance of 30% on capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 15Rs./-. ##### ***Mega Projects*** The beneficiary will receive Investment Promotion Assistance of 30% on capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 30Rs./-. ##### ***Ultra-mega Projects*** The beneficiary will receive Investment Promotion Assistance of 30% on capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 90Rs./-. ##### ***Disbursement Schedule*** The assistance is disbursed over four years in the following percentage of the total approved assistance amount: - First Year: 10%. - Second Year: 10%. - Third Year: 5%. - Fourth Year: 5%. ##### ***Heritage Projects*** For Heritage HotelsRs. the mandatory requirements for investment and employment are reduced to 50% of the limits set for LargeRs. MegaRs. and Ultra-mega categoriesRs. while they remain eligible for the benefits associated with those categories. ##### ***SC/ST Entrepreneurs*** Applicants belonging to SC/ST categories with 100% ownership are entitled to an additional 5% capital investment subsidy. ##### ***Phase-wise Incentives*** Projects are entitled to get phase-wise incentives provided the first phase is completed in 2 yearsRs. the second phase in 3 yearsRs. and the last phase in 5 years. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The unit claiming Investment Promotion Assistance shall not be entitled to capital subsidy under any other category of the policy._ - _The beneficiary must maintain the minimum employment of residents of M.P. as prescribed for their category._ - _The beneficiary must complete the project phases within the approved implementation timeline to receive phase-wise grants._ - _If the unit executes the entire project in one goRs. capital expenditure incurred up to a maximum of 05 years prior to the commencement of the unit is considered valid for the grant calculation._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private entityRs. such as a public/private limited companyRs. partnership firmRs. proprietary concernRs. or other legal entity. - The applicant must fulfill the criteria for one of the following categories to be eligible for assistance: - **Large Project:** The applicant must make a minimum capital expenditure of 10Rs./- or more and generate employment for a minimum of 50 residents of M.P.- **Mega Project:** The applicant must make a minimum capital expenditure of 50Rs./- or more and generate employment for a minimum of 100 residents of M.P.- **Ultra-mega Project:** The applicant must make a minimum capital expenditure of 100Rs./- or more and generate employment for a minimum of 200 residents of M.P.- The applicant must ensure that the employment provided meets the condition of being for residents of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must not be claiming Capital Subsidy under any other clause of the Tourism Policy if applying for this Investment Promotion Assistance. - The applicant must execute the project within the stipulated timelines (2 years for phase 1Rs. 3 years for phase 2Rs. and 5 years for the final phase) to avail phase-wise incentives. - The applicant setting up Heritage Hotels must meet at least 50% of the minimum investment and employment conditions specified for the LargeRs. MegaRs. or Ultra-mega categories.

name: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Pre & Post-Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Pre & Post-Matric Scholarship" is a component of the Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons schemeRs. implemented by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the Cured Leprosy children and children of Cured Leprosy Persons studying at pre- and post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships are for studies in India only and are awarded where the applicant is studying.
benefits:

name: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana" has been implemented by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Govt. of Odisha. In this schemeRs. 30Rs./- per student is transferred directly to the bank accounts of 15Rs. meritorious +2 students through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for the purchase of a laptop. The allocation earmarked to SC & ST students in a particular stream is bifurcated between SC and ST as per the ratio 16.25:22.5Rs. which is also the reservation ratio in employment in the State. The scheme is applicable to students from the CHSE Board and Upshastri Students passing from Shree Jagannath Sanskrit UniversityRs. Puri.
benefits: 1. An amount of 30Rs./- per student is transferred directly to the bank accounts of 15Rs. meritorious +2 students through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for the purchase of laptop.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident/domiciliary of the state of Odisha. 1. The application must be a +2 Passout from the Council of Higher Secondary EducationRs. Odisha. 1. The students clearing the Upshastri Exam from Shree Jagannath Sanskrit UniversityRs. PuriRs. are also eligible.

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level
brief_description:
The scheme Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level was started by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. Under the schemeRs. the scholarships will be awarded to students who are pursuing Diploma level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architectural Assistantship or any other equivalent courses as approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE).
> **Number of Scholarship:**

Total number of scholarships for Diploma Courses will be 75 Number.
benefits:
1. The value of scholarship for Diploma level courses is 200/- per month for all categories of students.

**Note:** For Diploma students 100% scholarships shall be awarded to the SCRs. STRs. and Girls students.
eligibility:
1. Only those students shall be eligible for the award of scholarships who are Bonafide Himachali and ward of Himachal Pradesh Government employees.
1. The scholarships will be awarded to the students who are pursuing Diploma level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architectural Assistantship or any other equivalent courses as approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE).
1. The scholarship shall be awarded only if the total income of parents or guardians from all the sources is not more than 36000/- per annum.

**Note 01:** The scholarship shall be awarded on the basis of (i) Poverty-cum-Brilliance and (ii) Brilliance.
**Note 02:** The scholarship shall be awarded strictly according to merit to be determined with reference to (i) Income of parents or guardian and (ii) Marks obtained in the Examination/Class by virtue of which a candidate is eligible for admission provided the students has Secured at least 60% of marks in the said exam. This condition will however not be applicable to the SC and ST Students as their merit will be judged amongst themselves.
**Note 03:** The students who become eligible for scholarships on the basis of poverty-cum-brilliance shall first be awarded scholarships. After their list is exhaustedRs. the remaining scholarships shall be awarded on the basis of brilliance.
**Note 04:** The scholarship shall be tenable for the full course from the date of joining for the duration of the course and shall be awarded/renewed on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory progress of the student and continued good conduct.
**Note 05:** The recommendation of the Principal or other authorized officer of the institute where the student is studying will be necessary for the award/renewal of the scholarship. If the student fails in a university examination in the Polytechnic examination or any examinations or tests while undergoing the course which prevents him/her from being promoted to the next higher classRs. the scholarship shall be discontinued. HoweverRs. two failures will not result in an extension in the total period of the course.
**Note 06:** The students who are not awarded scholarships from the date of joining of courses i.e. in the first year can also be considered for award of scholarships in subsequent years in case numbers of scholarships are available due to dropoutsRs. failure or otherwiseRs. in particular year shall not be exceeded. These scholarships shall be awarded on the basis of the performance of the previous annual examination they have passed in the Engineering course. Other conditions of award of fresh/renewal of scholarshipRs. will remain operative as at present in vogue.

name: Award For Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya In The HSSLC Examination (Science Stream)
brief_description:
The Award for Meritorious Students of Meghalaya (HSSLC Science Stream) is an initiative by the State Education Department designed to honour tribal students who achieve top rankings in their districts. The scheme is dedicated to fostering a scientific temper and a competitive spiritRs. while simultaneously encouraging a passion for Mathematics and Science from an early age. By highlighting the practical importance of these subjects in everyday lifeRs. the government aims to inspire the next generation of local innovators.
**Methodology**: 1. The award will be based on the merit of students in the current HSSLC Examination (Science Stream) mainly from schools/colleges of the different districts of the state. 1. It is a one-time award meant only for tribal students of Meghalaya i.e.Rs. who possess the Schedule tribe certificate of Meghalaya. 1. The number of awardees will be selected district wise i.e.Rs. 20 (twenty) awardees from East Khasi Hills district and 6 (six) awardees each from the remaining 10 (ten) districts. 1. The list of awardees will be furnished by the Controller of Examinations MBOSE Tura after the declaration of the current HSSLC Examination (Science). 1. DERT will inform the concerned Principal of the school/colleges to intimate the concerned students for submission of necessary documents to DERTRs. Shillong. 1. The screening of all necessary documents will be done immediately by DERTRs. Shillong. 1. The final Selection of awardees will be done by DERT after screening the documents of the students. 1. In case there are no awardees entitled to the award in any districtRs. the award will be diverted to the students who are top among the students on the waiting list. 1. After verification of the required documents of all awardeesRs. the award amounting to 10Rs./- (Rupees Ten Thousand) only per awardee will be transferred through NEFT to the account of the awardees and the certificate will be sent by post to the awardees residential address
benefits: > The award of 10Rs./- per awardee along with a certificate.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a tribal student belonging to the KhasiRs. JaintiaRs. GaroRs. KochRs. or Hajong tribes of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have passed the current HSSLC Examination from the Science stream. 1. The applicant should have secured 60% or above aggregate marks in the examination.

brief_description: The scheme Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students was started by the Department of EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. Under the schemeRs. the Scholarship is given to the top 1000 meritorious students of Other Backward Classes (OBC) declared as such in the result of the Matric Examination conducted by the H.P. Board of School EducationRs. DharamshalaRs. strictly on a merit basis to students studying in a recognized (including Professional/Technical) institution within or outside the State. 1. The student should belong to the Other Backward Classes Category declared as such by the Himachal Government.
1. The scholarship will be given in case the eligible students take admission to any professional/technical course after matricRs. in a recognized Institution within or outside the state.

**Note 01:** The scholarship is limited for a maximum of two successive years after matric.
**Note 02:** The renewal in 2nd year of the course will be subject to satisfactory performance in 1st year of the course.

For the educational upliftment of such PH studentsRs. Social Justice Department has initiated this scheme which provides financial assistance for the purchase of uniforms and study materials.

name: Educational Assistance For Children Of Victims Of Crime
brief_description:
The scheme Educational Assistance for Children of Victims of Crime was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. In order to strengthen the victim support services in the StateRs. the Government of Kerala has launched this scheme which provides educational assistance for children of survivors (victims) of crime. The dependents of survivors (victims) including children find it difficult to continue their studies due to financial constraints since the family has to meet the treatment expenses.
Survivors (Victims) of crime are defined as those who suffer out of a crime and for no fault of their own. Being a survivor (victim) of a crime can be a shocking and harrowing experience. The trauma of victimization can have a devastating impact on crime survivors (victims) and their loved ones; especially children. The survivors (victims) and their families go through tremendous stress and suffer financiallyRs. sociallyRs. and psychologically.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the following financial assistance will be given to the eligible applicant:

**Sl. No.****Classes/Courses****Amount of Assistance**1Children studying in classes 1 to 53000/- per year2Children studying in classes 6 to 105000/- per year3Higher Secondary7500/- per year4Graduate students10Rs./- per year5PG/M.Phil course students15Rs./- per year**Note:** The amount will be transferred to the joint account of the child and the current parent.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The children/dependents of survivors (victims) of crime are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The combined annual income of the families should be less than 1Rs./-.
1. The children pursuing a degree and higher education courses in government and aided institutions and admitted to merit seats in unaided institutions are eligible for financial assistance in courses from the degree level onwards.

**Note:** If granted for one yearRs. the amount can be granted in subsequent years if the head of the school or college or the head of the newly joined institution certifies that the child will continue his education.

name: State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)
brief_description:
The scheme State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII) was launched by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. The Directorate of Educational Research & Training MeghalayaRs. Shillong is implementing this scheme for tribal students of Meghalaya studying in class VIII every year in all the Sub Divisional School Education Office (SDSEO) of the State.
The scheme is meant only for tribal students of Meghalaya who belong to KhasiRs. JaintiaRs. GaroRs. Koch and Hajong. Those who satisfy the criteria and are eligible to appear in the said Exam Selection of students for the scholarship will be given SDSEO-wise as per their merit in the said Examination. The number of awardees is 40 (forty) from SDSEO ShillongRs. East Khasi HillsRs. and 20 (twenty) awardees from the remaining 14 (fourteen) SDSEOs.
> **Objectives:**

The main objectives of the scheme are to identify bright and talented students from amongst the tribal students of Meghalaya who are studying in class VIII through a competitive examination and to give them financial assistance in the form of a talent incentive award for developing and nurturing their talent.
benefits:
1. The incentives award in the form of financial assistance of 600/- per month per awardee for twelve months for two years from Class IX-X will be provided.

**Note:** The amount of the scholarship will be directly transferred to the awardees bank account through NEFT/RTGS.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a tribal student of Meghalaya and belong to the KhasiRs. JaintiaRs. GaroRs. Koch and Hajong Communities.
1. The student should be studying in Class VIII in any type of school in Meghalaya.
1. The student should secure at least 50 marks in the aggregate in Mathematics and Science in Class VII.
1. The student should be continuing their studies in any recognized secondary school in Meghalaya.

brief_description: The Scheme Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAIRs. NSNISRs. name: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme" Pratibha Kiran Scholarship"Rs. under the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial assistance to girls from urban areas to pursue higher education. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of 10 months. name: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
brief_description:
The scheme Post Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates has been initiated to provide opportunities to the deprived sections of the societyRs. viz. the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) for undertaking postgraduate level studies in Professional subjects like Engineering & TechnologyRs. ManagementRs. Pharmacy etc. in recognized Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges.
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to 1000 SC/ST candidates to pursue postgraduate level studies in Professional courses.
benefits:
1. The tenure of the award is for two/three years depending upon the tenure of the postgraduate course and not for an extended period of studyRs. if any.
1. Candidates selected for the award of PG scholarships (under ME/M.Tech.) shall be provided a Scholarship @ 7800/-per month for the duration of the PG Scholarship.
1. For other coursesRs. the amount of scholarship will be paid @4500/- per month.
1. No contingency is payable to the students selected under the scheme with effect from the selection year 2017-18.
1. The scholarship shall be payable to the awardee from the date of joining the Post Graduate 1 year course during the selection year.
eligibility:
1. The students should belong to the SC/ST category.
1. The candidate must have obtained a Graduate degree in the relevant subject and obtained admission at the Postgraduate level for regular full-time courses in any of the Professional subjects in a recognized University/Institution/College.
1. Only students pursuing the first year of a postgraduate course during the current academic year are eligible to apply.
1. For the purpose of award of the scholarship to students who are pursuing professional courses in the following Institutions/ Colleges/Universities:


- Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under section 2(f) & and 12(B) of UGC Act.
- Deemed to be Universities included under Section 3 of the UGC ActRs. 1956Rs. and eligible to receive grants-in-aid from UGC.
- Universities/Institutions/College funded by Central/State Government.
- Institutes of National Importance.

**Note 01:** Courses which require approval from the Regulatory Council i.e. Medical Council of India (MCI)Rs. Dental Council of India (DCI)Rs. Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)Rs. Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)Rs. NCTISRs. NCTE Bar Council of India (BCI)Rs. All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)Rs. Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs. INCRs. Forensic Regulatory & Development Authority of India are considered professional courses.
**Note 02:** M.A.Rs. M.Sc.Rs. M.Com.Rs. MSW and Mass Communication and Journalism degree are accepted as Non-professional courses.
> **Renewals:**


1. Scholarship granted under the scheme will be kept renewed during the period of first-year Post-Graduate courses subject to good conduct and maintenance of prescribed attendance.
1. The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of an annual progress report to be granted by the administrative head of the University/ Institution/ College. (E.g. Registrar of a University/Director of the Institution/ Principal of the College or any other officer designated by them).
1. Students failing to get promoted to the next class/level would forfeit the scholarship.
1. Change in the course of study will not be permitted.
1. The awardees of previous years will continue to follow the UGC pattern of assistance through the designated bank branches of Canara Bank.

> **Cancellation of Award:** The scholarship of a student may be cancelled in any of the following cases:-


1. Failure of the awardee to pass the first year of the Post-Graduate course in first division or equivalent CGPA score.
1. Discontinuation of studies due to personal reasons.
1. The candidate is later found ineligible on account of false information provided in the online application or incorrect bank details.

name: CM's Jibon Anuprerana Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "CM's Jibon Anuprerana Scheme" by the SkillRs. Employment & Entrepreneurship DepartmentRs. (i) The Scholarship will be provided to the Medal winners of National games and participants in recognized international sporting events recognized by the World University ServiceRs. International Olympic CommitteeRs. and Olympic Committee of Asia (OCA) who have taken admitted to the Universities/Colleges/Institutions as indicated below:

- Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC ActRs. 1956.
- Deemed to be Universities under section 3 of the UGC ActRs. 1956 which are eligible to receive grants
- in aid from UGC.
- Universities/Institutions/Colleges funded by Central/ State Govt.
- Institutes of National Importance.

(ii) In the subsequent years this scholarship shall depend on their subsequent sports performance.

name: NITI Internship Scheme
brief_description:
An Internship Scheme named "**NITI Internship Scheme**" seeks to engage students pursuing Under Graduate / Graduate / Post Graduate Degrees or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/ Institution within India or abroadRs. as "**interns**". These 'interns" shall be given exposure to various Verticals/ Divisions/Units within NITI Aayog and would be expected to supplement the process of analysis within NITI Aayog through empirical collection and collation of in-house and other information. The internship will be on unpaid basis. This will allow short term exposure of "selected candidates" with the different Verticals/Divisions/Units of NITI AayogRs. Government of India as 'Interns". Following are the domains/areas for which Internship is invited:-

1. Agriculture
1. Data Management and Analysis
1. Economics
1. Education/Human Resources Development
1. Energy Sector
1. Foreign Trade / Commerce
1. Governance
1. Health Rs. NutritionRs. Women & Child Development
1. Industry
1. Infrastructure connectivity
1. Mass Communications and Social Media
1. Mining Sector
1. Natural ResourcesRs. Environment & Forests
1. Programme Monitoring and Evaluation
1. Project appraisal and management.
1. Public Finances/Budget
1. Public Private Partnership
1. Rural Development and SDGs
1. Science and Technology
1. Skill Development & Employment
1. Social justice and empowerment
1. Sports and Youth development.
1. Tourism and culture
1. Urbanization / smart city.
1. Water Resources.

The period of Internship shall be at least six weeks but not exceeding six months. Interns will be required to have their own laptops. NITI Aayog shall provide them working spaceRs. internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads.
**Objectives**
The Scheme has the following objectives:

1. To allow young academic talent to be associated with the NITI Aayog's work for mutual benefit.
1. The "intern" shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in Government of India and contribute to the Policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysisRs. briefing reportsRs. policy papersRs. etc.
benefits:
1. **Experience Certificate/Internship Completion Certificate:** A certificate regarding successful completion of Internship shall be issued by the Adviser of the concerned Subject Division 1. Allows young academic talent to be associated with the NITI Aayog's work for mutual benefit.
1. Opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Developmental Policy issues in Government of India and contribute to the Policy formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysisRs. briefing reportsRs. policy papersRs. etc.

**NOTE:** Interns not completing the requisite period will not be issued any certificate.
eligibility:
Bonafide students of any recognized University/Institution within India or abroadRs. fulfilling following conditions are eligible to apply for the internship:-

1. Under-graduate studentsRs. having completed/appeared in the term end exams of second year/4th semester of the bachelor degree course and secured not less than 85% or equivalent marks in 12th class. 1. Graduate students having completed/ appeared in the term end exams of first year/2nd semester of their post graduate programme or pursuing research/PhD and secured not less than 70% or equivalent marks in Graduation.
1. The students who have appeared in the final exam or just completed Graduation/PG and waiting for admission for higher studies may also be considered for internship provided that:-


- they have secured 70% or more cumulative marks in all the years/semesters of their graduation/post-graduation till the date of application.
- The period between the month of declaration of result of final exam and the desired month of internship should not exceed six months e.g. if the result is declared in the month of June then he/she can apply for the internship beginning till the month of December.

**NOTES:**

1. The candidates need to apply 2 months in advance for the internshipRs. and the application will be valid for the desired month only.
1. While doing the internshipRs. the student must have an attendance of 75% to successfully complete the internship.
1. The time between the declaration of final exam results and the month of starting the internship should not be more than 6 monthsRs. this is applicable only to those who are applying after completing their studies.
1. The selected applicant has to produce original mark sheets and NOC from the college/institution at the time of joiningRs. failing which his/her candidature shall be cancelled.

name: Merit Cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme
brief_description:
**Detailed** Delhi Government wants to enhance access to high-quality higher education for meritorious economically disadvantaged sections of society. Many meritorious students from this section find it hard to bear the full tuition feeRs. though the better off sections of society do not face this difficulty. To ease the burden on such meritorious studentsRs. the Delhi Govt. proposes a Merit cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme for providing tuition fee reimbursement under the aegis of Delhi Higher Education Aid TrustRs. with the aim to enhance greater access to high-quality higher education for meritorious Students from econ0mically disadvantaged sections of the society. Many students from this section who find it hard to bear the full tuition fee will benefit immensely from the Scheme.
The Scheme is to extend financial assistance to the meritorious and needy students pursuing higher education in the NCT of Delhi. Under this Scheme the Delhi Higher Education Trust through the Directorate of Higher Education (DHE)Rs. GNCTD will fully or partially reimburse the tuition fee paid by the students. The extent of reimbursement will be (i)100% tuition fee of the meritorious students belonging to economically weaker section i.e. wards of parent/s who are beneficiaries and possess relevant cards issued under the National Food Security Security Scheme. (ii) 50%of the tuition fee to meritorious students having annual family income up to 2.50 Lakh and not covered under the National Food Security Scheme. (iii) 25% reimbursement of tuition fee to meritorious students having annual income above 2.50 Lakh but below 6 Lakh. It is anticipated that the Scheme will lead to the participation of meritorious economically weaker sections of society in gaining access to quality higher education of which they were deprived till now due to financial constraints. It will also help attract meritorious students to Delhi State Universities.
benefits:
**Benefits**

- The extent of reimbursement will be


1. 100% tuition fee of the meritorious students belonging to economically weaker section i.e. wards of parent/s who are beneficiaries and possess relevant cards issued under the National Food Security Scheme
1. 50% of the tuition fee to meritorious students having annual family income.
eligibility:
The eligibility criteria for applying under this scheme shall be as follows: (1) The student should have been enrolled on an undergraduate programme in any of the Delhi State Public Universities or colleges/ institutes affiliated with Delhi State Public Universities. (2) The student should fulfil the income/ economic and academic performance criteria as specified for each category mentioned below
Eligibility (Gross Annual Family Income of Student from all Sources)Qualifying Aggregate Percentage (Marks in All Subjects)Percentage of Financial AssistanceCategory 1: Beneficiary under National Food Security Scheme & possess the Card issued under the Scheme60%100%Category 2: Not covered under category 1 but whose family income is up to 2.50 Lakh p.a.60%50%Category 3: Family income above 2.50 Lakh p.a.but not exceeding 6 Lakh p.a60%25%
A relaxation of 5% in the qualifying aggregate percentage of marks will be allowed to SC/ST Category students.

name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Unorganized Workers
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Unorganized Workers" is a Pension Scheme launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Unorganized Workers (home-based workersRs. self-employed workers or a wage workers) in the unorganized sector.
benefits: - A pension amount of 2Rs./- per month. > **Mode of Disbursal:** The sanctioned grant will be transferred directly to the individual bank account of the applicant. > **Beneficiary List:** The list of beneficiaries will be made available on the [official website](https://socialwelfare.tripura.gov.in/) of the Social Welfare & Social Education DepartmentRs. Govt. of Tripura.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. 1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./-. 1. The age of the applicant should be 55 years and above (except for Greha Sahayika). 1. In the case of Greha Shahayika (Female Domestic Worker)Rs. the age of the applicant should be between 23 to 59 years. 1. If the family has children in the age group of 6 to 14 yearsRs. those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura.
**NOTE:** The assistance under this scheme will be stopped immediately in the following cases: 1. Death of Beneficiary. 2. Fulfillment of any exclusion criteria during the lifetime of a beneficiary: - Remarriage of a widow. - A member of the family of the beneficiary getting a Government Job. - The annual family income of the beneficiary exceeding 1Rs./-Rs. etc.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
brief_description: The Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance scheme has been launched by the Department of CultureRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs. Under this schemeRs. one-time ex-gratia financial support is provided to the lawful heir to help the family cope with financial hardship after the death of the artist or litterateur.
benefits: - One-time ex-gratia financial assistance of up to 1Rs. paid to the legal heir of the deceased artist or litterateur. > **NOTE:** - Preference is given to the spouse of the deceased. - Assistance may continue to other dependents until marriageRs. employmentRs. or attainment of 21 years of ageRs. whichever is earlier.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be the legal heir or dependent of the deceased artist or litterateur. 1. The deceased should have been an artist or litterateur of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed 10Rs./-. 1. The familys monthly income should not exceed 20Rs./-. 1. Families of government employees are not eligible.

name: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana" has been implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers EmpowermentRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to extend financial assistance to the children of the beneficiaries under CM-KISAN for pursuing Professional/ Technical courses. It will lead to better access to Higher Education for children of Small & Marginal farmers (SF/MF) and Landless Agricultural households (LAH). Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana will support SF/MF & LAH in empowering their families. > **Key Features:** In order to ensure proper higher education of their childrenRs. support will be provided in the form of Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana. The scholarship will be given purely on a merit basis to those who are studying professional/technical courses like Medical and Engineering. Agriculture & AlliedRs. NursingRs. DiplomaRs. and different trades in ITI in GovernmentRs. Private InstitutionsRs. and Premier Institutions.
benefits: > **Scholarship Support:** 1. Scholarship is provided to students pursuing eligible professionalRs. technicalRs. diplomaRs. postgraduateRs. and doctoral courses. 1. The scholarship is awarded purely on a merit basis. > **Course-Based Financial Assistance:** 1. For the students of Government InstitutionsRs. the tuition feesRs. annual feesRs. one-time feesRs. hostel chargesRs. and any other fees deposited by the student in the colleges/universities/institutions except the caution money/ any other refundable money as admissible shall be released to the concerned student account. 1. Scholarship amount for the students studying in Private Institutes of the State shall be released to the student as per the course fee structure enclosed in [Annexure-1](https://agri.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-03/6728a6c09079e1730717376_0.pdf). > **Premier Institutions Support:** 1. For students admitted to premier institutions such as National Institute of Technology (NIT)Rs. Indian Institute of Technology(NIT)Rs. Indian Institute of Management (IIM)Rs. All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)Rs. Indian Council of Agricultural Research institutions (ICAR)( Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI)Rs. Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI)Rs. Central Institute of Fisheries Education (CIFE)Rs. and National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI)Rs. the scholarship is limited to the lower of actual recommended fees or 1Rs./-. > **Hostel and Mess Charges:** 1. 1Rs./- per month for Under GraduateRs. Post GraduateRs. Ph.D.Rs. and Premier Institution students for 10 months. 1. 1Rs./- per month for DiplomaRs. PolytechnicRs. and Industrial Training Institute students for 10 months.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the State of Odisha. 1. The applicant should be a child of an eligible beneficiary under the CM-KISAN schemeRs. including both componentsRs. namely Support to Farmers for Cultivation and Livelihood Support to Landless Agricultural Households. 1. The applicants parent must be eligible under CM-KISANRs. which will be verified during the students application process at the Chief District Agriculture Officer (CDAO) level. 1. The applicant must have obtained admission on a merit basis in a Government Institution or Private Institution having an AISHE code (All India Survey on Higher Education) of the StateRs. or in a Premier Government InstitutionRs. whether located inside or outside the State. 1. The applicant must have taken admission in any of the following Subjects and courses: - Professional or Technical Undergraduate courses such as M.B.B.S.Rs. B.D.S.Rs. B.H.M.S.Rs. B.A.M.S.Rs. B.PharmRs. B.Sc. (Nursing)Rs. Post Basic B.Sc. NursingRs. B.Sc. (Hons) AgricultureRs. Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal HusbandryRs. B.Sc. (Hons) HorticultureRs. B.Sc. (Hons) ForestryRs. B.Sc. (Fisheries Science)Rs. B.Sc. (Community Science)Rs. B.Tech (Agricultural Engineering)Rs. B.Tech/B.E.Rs. B.B.A.Rs. B.C.A.Rs. and other equivalent courses offered by Government Institutions and Private Institutions having an AISHE code (All India Survey on Higher Education) of the State are covered under the Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana. OR - Professional or Technical Postgraduate courses such as M.TechRs. M.Sc. (Agriculture)Rs. M.Sc. (Forestry)Rs. Postgraduate courses in Medical ScienceRs. M.B.A.Rs. M.C.A.Rs. M.PharmRs. and other equivalent courses forming part of a Masters programme are also included. The maximum duration of scholarship support shall be 2 years for Postgraduate courses and 4 years for Ph.D. courses. Ph.D. courses must be related to the eligible postgraduate courses and must be pursued only in Government Institutions located within the State. OR - Diploma courses such as Diploma in PharmacyRs. Diploma in Medical Laboratory TechnologyRs. Diploma in Medical Radiography TechnologyRs. Ophthalmic Assistance or Surgical Ophthalmic AssistanceRs. General Nursing and MidwiferyRs. Auxiliary Nurse MidwiferyRs. Psychiatric NursingRs. and other equivalent medical courses recommended by the Directorate of Medical Education and TrainingRs. as well as courses offered by Polytechnic and Agricultural Polytechnic InstitutionsRs. are also included under the Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana. 1. The applicant admitted to self-financing courses in Government or Private Institutions shall be eligible for the scholarship only as per the capped fee structure. 1. The applicant should not be in receipt of any other scholarship. If the applicant is already availing another scholarshipRs. he or she must shift from the existing scholarship scheme to the Krishi Vidya Nidhi YojanaRs. if they so choose. Only one scholarship can be availed. 1. The applicant should apply for only one professional course under this scheme. 1. The applicant should not avail more than one scholarship for similar courses. 1. The applicant should not be admitted to a Private Institution located outside the State.

name: Scheduled Tribe Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Scheduled Tribe Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11)" has been implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their educationRs. including tuition fees and other academic expenses.
benefits: ***The total scholarship amount determined by the districts = Educational Allowance + Tuition Fee.*** ***Group 1:*** BachelorsRs. Masters DegreeRs. M.Phil/Ph.D. DegreeRs. PG DiplomaRs. Professional Courses in various streams- - **Hostellers:** 1Rs./- per month; (12Rs./- per annum) - **Day Scholars:** 550/- monthly; (5Rs./- per annum) ***Group 2:*** For all non-professional recognized courses that lead to GraduateRs. M.Phil/Ph.D. degreesRs. and which do not fall under ArtsRs. Science and Commerce groupRs. such as: BA/BSc/B.Com or MA/MSc/M.Com: - **Hostellers:** 820/- monthly; (8Rs./- per annum) - **Day Scholar:** 530/- monthly; (5Rs./- per annum) ***Group 3:*** For professional streamsRs. ITI coursesRs. 3-year diploma courses in polytechnicRs. etc.: - **Hostellers:** 570/- monthly; (5Rs./- per annum) - **Day Scholars:** 300/- monthly; (3Rs./- per annum) ***Group 4:*** All post-matric level non-degree courses for which the entry qualification is high school (10th)Rs. for exampleRs. Senior Secondary Certificate (Class 11 and 12) - **Hostellers:** 380/- monthly; (3Rs./- per annum) - **Day Scholars:** 230/- monthly; (2Rs./- per annum)
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school/educational institution in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 11 or higher level course. 1. The applicant must possess valid documentsRs. such as Caste CertificateRs. Residence CertificateRs. Bank PassbookRs. AadhaarRs. PhotographRs. Educational Qualification CertificatesRs. and Income Certificate. 1. The total annual income of the parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed 2.5 lakh. 1. The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.

name: Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8) has been implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students to support their education from Class 1st to Class 8th.
benefits: ***Rate of Scholarship:*** - Class 1 to 5: 600/- - Class 6 to 8: 960/-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must possess a valid caste certificate. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be studying in a Class 1 to 8. 1. The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class. 1. The applicant should not be receiving benefits under any other government scholarship scheme. 1. There is no income limit for this scholarship.

name: Sukhatme National Award in Statistics
brief_description: The scheme Sukhatme National Award in Statistics has been implemented by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme ImplementationRs. Government of India. It aims to recognise outstanding contributions made by individuals in terms of high-quality research workRs. to improve the system of official statistics in generalRs. and to develop innovative methods for addressing challenges encountered in sample surveysRs. data management systemsRs. and data integrationRs. in particular. Through this schemeRs. national-level recognition in the form of a citationRs. shawlRs. and memento is provided to eligible Indian statisticians for lifetime contribution or young achiever excellence. > **Ceremony Details**: - The award will be presented on Statistics DayRs. i.e. on 29th June every yearRs. with an award in each of the two categories being given in alternate years. - At this ceremonyRs. citations highlighting the work of the awardee would be read out. - Awardee may also be requested to take a session highlighting the significance of their work.
benefits: 1. Citation signed by Honble Minister of Statistics & Programme Implementation. 1. Besides the aboveRs. a Shawl and a Memento shall be given to the awardee. > **No. of Awardees:** - One for the Sukhatme National Award in Statistics for Lifetime Contribution in the Field of Statistics. - One for the C.R. Rao National Award in Statistics for Young Statisticians. - _(Note: Among the two categories of the National Award in StatisticsRs. only one award shall be conferred each year on an alternate basis.)_
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an Indian National without distinction of raceRs. occupationRs. position and gender. 1. The applicant should be at least 45 years of age as on 31st December of the financial year in which the award is announcedRs. and is eligible to apply for the said award. 1. The applicant should not be an official involved in the selection process of the awardees. 1. The applicants family members should also not be part of the selection process of the awardees.

name: Study in India Programme
brief_description: The scheme Study in India Programme has been launched by the Ministry of Education under the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to position India as a global education destination by providing international students with a single centralized digital platformRs. access to quality institutionsRs. and end-to-end admission and visa support for pursuing higher education in India. > **Scheme Implementation** The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education in coordination with the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs through the Study in India portal.
benefits: **Single Centralized Admission Platform:****** - One portal for registrationRs. course searchRs. application submissionRs. visa and FRRO processes. **Access to Quality Institutions:** - Admission to NAAC-accreditedRs. NIRF-rankedRs. autonomousRs. and globally ranked institutions. **Unique Study in India Student ID** - Mandatory unique ID generated at registration. - Required for admission and visa issuance. **Wide Range of Courses** - Access to 8Rs.+ courses including EngineeringRs. ManagementRs. ScienceRs. HumanitiesRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. MedicineRs. YogaRs. Buddhist StudiesRs. and Vocational Courses. - Ability to apply to multiple institutions simultaneously and receive multiple offer letters. **Financial Assistance through Institutes** - Tuition fee waivers ranging from 10% to 100%Rs. subject to institute discretion. - No direct scholarship is provided by the Study in India Programme. **Visa and Immigration Support** - Assistance through coordination with Indian Embassies and High Commissions. **247 Student Support** - Continuous support through toll-free contact centerRs. emailRs. and social media.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a foreign national seeking admission in India. 1. The applicant should have completed the required qualifying education as per course norms. 1. The applicant should apply through the Study in India portal. 1. The applicant should possess a valid passport. 1. The applicant should meet academic and language requirements of the chosen institution. 1. Indian nationals are not eligible under the Study in India Programme. 1. Admissions outside the Study in India portal are not covered.

name: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
brief_description:
