"Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)" is an Education Loan Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Implementing Agency The Scheme will be implemented by the Nodal Bank as per the MoU between the Banks and the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.
Scope The scheme provides interest subsidy to the students belonging to the OBCs and EBCs on the interest payable for the period of the moratorium for the Education Loans for overseas studies to pursue approved courses of studies abroad at MastersRs. M.Phil. and PhD level.
Objective To award interest subsidies to meritorious students belonging to the Other Backward Classes and Economically Backward Classes to provide them with better opportunities for higher education abroad and enhance their employability.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. interest payable by the students availing the education loans of the IBA for the period of moratorium (i.e. course periodRs. plus one year or six months after getting a jobRs. whichever is earlier) as prescribed under the Education Loan Scheme of the IBARs. shall be borne by the Government of India. 1. For a studentRs. the eligible loan component shall be the actual loan taken subject to a maximum of 20Rs. for the purpose of an Interest subsidy claim. **NOTE 1:** After the period of moratorium is overRs. the interest on the outstanding loan amount shall be paid by the studentRs. in accordance with the existing Educational Loan Scheme as may be amended from time to time. **NOTE 2:** The candidate will bear the Principal instalments and interest beyond the moratorium period.
> **Release of Funds** The funds will be released to the applicants on a first-come-first-served basisRs. subject to a maximum amount to be worked out every year based on the total budget made available that yearRs. under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The student should have secured admission in the approved course at MastersRs. M.Phil or PhD levels abroad for the [listed courses](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Guidelines%20ISEL%20Scheme%20(wef%2001%20Oct%202017).pdf).1. The applicant should have availed loan from a scheduled bank under the Education Loan Scheme of the Indian Banks Association (IBA) for the purpose. 1. The total income of the applicant (from all sources) shall not exceed 8Rs. per annum.
> **Reservation/ Relaxation/ Preference/ Priority** Out of the total outlay in a yearRs. a minimum of 50% amount will be earmarked for Interest Subsidy to the girl candidates.

name: Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)
brief_description:
The 'Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)' schemeRs. administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. provides financial assistance to deserving Other Backward Classes (OBC) students. Eligibility is extended to those who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSSLC examination. The scheme's objective is to motivate and encourage OBC students to pursue higher educationRs. thereby fostering their academic parity with the broader population through a substantial incentive. Assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation. An incentive of up to 10Rs./- will be disbursed to students as approved by the Selection Committee.
***The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.*** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
benefits: A financial incentive of upto 10Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed 5Rs./-. _*In instances where multiple applicants achieve an identical percentage in the HSSLC examinationRs. preference will be given to those with a higher percentage in the HSLC examination._

name: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Khadi Vikas Yojana" is an umbrella scheme under "Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" and has been implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)Rs. Ministry of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)Rs. Governemnt of India. It aims to support Khadi institutions and artisans by providing financial assistanceRs. infrastructure developmentRs. interest subsidyRs. and marketing support. The scheme offers subsidies on Khadi productionRs. reduces the interest burden on bank loansRs. facilitates the construction of worksheds for artisansRs. strengthens existing weak Khadi institutionsRs. and enhances marketing infrastructureRs. including the renovation and modernization of sales outlets. AdditionallyRs. the scheme supports quality assurance initiativesRs. exhibitionsRs. science and technology interventionsRs. and the establishment of Centres of Excellence for Khadi
benefits: ***Assistance provided under different components of Scheme:*** ***Modified Market Development Assistance (MMDA):*** - Subsidy @ 35% on Prime Cost for Cotton/MuslinRs. Wool and Polyvastra and @ 20% on Prime Cost for Silk Khadi ***Interest Subsidy Eligibility Certificate Scheme (ISEC):*** - Khadi Institution is required to pay only 4% interest rate. The difference between the actual Interest charged by the Bank and 4% is borne by the KVIC as Interest Subsidy. ***Work-shed Scheme for Khadi Artisans:*** - Individual workshed (20 Sq. mtrs): 1Rs./- or 75% of the cost of workshed including toilet (90% for NER)Rs. whichever is less. - Group workshed (10 Sq. mtrs per artisans): 80Rs. or 75% of the cost of the workshed including toilet (90% for NER)Rs. whichever is less. ***Strengthening Infrastructure of Existing Weak Khadi Institutions and Assistance for Marketing Infrastructure:*** - Financial assistance for revival of khadi institution with ceiling limit of 15.00 lakh(Capital Expenditure +working fund). - Financial assistance under Marketing Infrastructure for renovation of departmental sales outlets of KVIC /KVIB and institutional sales with the ceiling limit of 25.00 lakh. **Other Components:** - Centre of Excellence for Khadi - Khadi Quality Assurance - Marketing(Exhibition) - Science & Technology (S&T)
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card or government-issued ID. 1. One person per family is eligible under the scheme. 1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose. 1. Preference is given to SC/STRs. womenRs. unemployed youthRs. and BPL category applicants. 1. The beneficiaries may be identified by KVICRs. KVIBsRs. NGOsRs. DICsRs. FPOsRs. or Khadi Institutions.

name: Banglar Yuba Sathi
brief_description: The scheme Banglar Yuba Sathi by the Department of Youth Services & SportsRs. Government of West Bengal aims to support educated unemployed youth by providing 1Rs./- per month through direct bank transfer for up to 5 year or till they get employment or enroll in any other schemeRs. whichever is earlier.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per month. - **Mode of Disbursement:** Financial Assistance under the scheme will be credited by Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) to an AADHAR Linked Bank Account held solely by the eligible unemployed youth. - **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit is disbursed monthly or at regular intervals. - **Validity of Benefit:** The benefit is valid for a maximum period of 5 yearsRs. subject to continued eligibility or till employment or enrollment in any other schemeRs. whichever is earlier.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. - The applicant must be aged between 21 and 40 years as on 01.04.2026. - The applicant must be unemployed. - The applicant must have passed the Madhyamik or equivalent examination. > **Notes:** - **Yearly verification of live status of the beneficiary of the scheme:** Once a yearRs. the status of the beneficiaryRs. whether alive or not will be verified. - **Stopping or withholding of financial assistance:** The Government mayRs. after giving the beneficiary of the scheme an opportunity of being heardRs. stop or withhold financial assistance if: 1. The Financial Assistance has been found to be sanctioned on mistaken grounds. 1. The eligibility condition for the granting of financial assistance no longer exists.

name: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)
brief_description: The **Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS Meghalaya)** schemeRs. under the Department of Sports and Youth AffairsRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. provides financial assistance to registered youth organisations and eligible individual youth to carry out activities that promote youth development. The scheme is designed to strengthen networkingRs. collaborationRs. and meaningful community-level engagement. **Targeted Stakeholders** **Financial assistance is extended to the following entities and individuals:** 1. Societies and Cooperatives 1. Voluntary and Not-for-Profit Organisations 1. Youth Clubs and Associations 1. Socio-Cultural Clubs 1. Alumni Associations 1. Community-level Youth Institutions or Groups 1. Individuals selected for competitions or events with valid proof of participation
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of up to INR 1.00 lakh per financial year may be sanctioned to eligible youth organisations or individuals. 1. Up to 10% of the total applications may receive a higher amount of financial support.
eligibility: **For Youth Organisations** 1. The organisation should be a registered societyRs. trustRs. charitable organisationRs. Section 8 companyRs. or not-for-profit entity under the Societies Registration Act of 1860 for at least 3 months. 1. The organisation should maintain financial accounts with a clear framework for effective and transparent management. 1. The organisation should have primary beneficiaries under the age of 35 and be open to all citizens of the state without distinction of religionRs. raceRs. casteRs. or language. 1. The organisation should have at least 50% of registered members under the age of 35 as of the application date. 1. The organisation should not be blacklisted or barred by any government or private entity and should have no pending or ongoing litigation related to misconductRs. misappropriation of fundsRs. or sexual harassment. **For Individuals** 1. The applicant should be a citizen of Meghalaya and under the age of 35 as of the application date. 1. The applicant should have a bank account in their name (single or joint account). 1. The applicant should be able to provide proof of selection for the competition or event for which the grant is being requested.

name: A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops
brief_description: "A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support farmers by providing 90% subsidy on the cost of planting materials like grafted/tissue culture saplings and seedlings for various fruit crops.
benefits:
- Farmers receive up to 90% financial assistance on the cost of planting materials. > **Pre-fixed assistance rates per hectare for different crops:**
Fruit Assistance Mango32Rs./haSapota (Chiku)22Rs./haPomegranate20Rs./haGuava16Rs./haAonla (Indian Gooseberry)5Rs./haMandarin / Orange5Rs./haBer2Rs./haCoconut13Rs./ha
> **Note:** - Only saplings costing up to 250/- per unit are eligible for subsidy. - **For fruit crops and cuttings:** Planting material will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- **For coconut crops:** seedlings prepared from seeds will have to be purchased from nurseries accredited by NHB/Agricultural University/Horticulture Department.- **For tissue culture:** Planting material (planting) will have to be purchased from tissue labs approved/accredited by DBTRs. GNFCRs. GSFCRs. Tissue Labs of Agricultural UniversityRs. Government Public Institutions like
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must purchase planting materials from approved/accredited sources.

name: Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya
brief_description: The scheme "Awarding of Laptops to Meritorious Students of Meghalaya " has been implemented by the Directorate of Information Technology & CommunicationsRs. Government of Meghalaya aims to award laptops to meritorious students who passed the Board Examination of MBOSE SSLCRs. MBOSE HSSLCRs. ICSERs. ISC and CBSE X & XII. Through this schemeRs. laptops are provided to eligible meritorious students who have secured marks equal to or more than the last student in the published list.
benefits: - The eligible student will be awarded a laptop.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must have studied in the State of Meghalaya; or the applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya who studied outside the State. 1. The applicant must have topped in the respective Annual School Board Examinations in a particular year. 1. The applicant must have passed the examinations conducted only by: - Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBOSE); - Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE); - Central Board for School Education (CBSE). 1. The applicant must have appeared in Class X or Class XII Annual Board Examinations of the above-mentioned Boards/Council. 1. The applicant of Class X of CBSE Board shall be selected as per [Section 3 II (a)](https://ditmeghalaya.gov.in/pdf/9.Policy%20for%20awarding%20Laptops%20to%20meritorious%20students%20of%20the%20State%20of%20Meghalaya.pdf).1. For Class XIIRs. the applicant should have topped in any streamRs. namely ArtsRs. Commerce or Science. > **Subject-Specific Eligibility (MBOSE Only):** 1. For Class X (MBOSE)Rs. the applicant who is a subject topper in MathematicsRs. Science or Computer Application shall also be eligible for the award. 1. For Class XII (MBOSE)Rs. the applicant who is a subject topper in PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. MathematicsRs. Computer Application or Biology shall also be eligible for the award. 1. The applicant whose name appears as an MBOSE top ranker as well as a subject topper (in one or more subjects) shall be eligible for only one award in a particular year. 1. HoweverRs. in recognition of such achievementRs. the applicant shall be awarded a Laptop of configuration higher than those of other awardees.

name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
brief_description:
The scheme "Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The HSFDC is a Company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly Government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India.
Under this schemeRs. the loan is provided to woman Safai Karamchari and their dependent daughters for projects with a maximum project cost of up to 2Rs./- for small and petty trade/businessesRs. and various other income-generating activities such as beauty parlorsRs. boutiquesRs. cosmetic shopsRs. bangle shopRs. etc.
benefits:
**Project Cost Ceiling:** - The Corporation (HSFDC)Rs. in collaboration with NSKFDCRs. provides loans of up to 2Rs./- per beneficiary/unit for small and petty trade/business and various income-generating activities. **Margin Money:** - The Corporation provides margin money @ 10% of the project cost. **Subsidy:** - The corporation provides a subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum subsidy amount is 10Rs./-). **Note:** The subsidy is only provided to the beneficiary below the poverty line. > **Interest criteria for the loan amount recoverable by HSFDC:** **Upto Amount ()****Interest % P.A.****Penal Interest % P.A**.2Rs./-54
**Interest Starts on****Penalty Start After****Principal Recovery Starts After****Installment Starts After** **Installment Period**Same day30 days120 days120 days30 days
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be a female.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The applicant should be either a woman Safai Karamchari or a dependent daughter of Safai Karamchari.

**Note 1:** Permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged inRs. or employed for any sanitation work and includes his/her dependents.
**Note 2:** The applicant shall have to produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari from the Head of the Government Departments (i.e. SchoolRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry having rank not less than Gazetted Officer)Rs. elected members of Municipal Body/ Corporation and Pradhan of Gram PanchayatsRs. Local Revenue Officer or an Officer of Local Municipal OfficeRs. or Cantonment Executive Officer of the Cantonment or an officer of the Railways not below the rank of gazette officer.

name: Prime Tourism Vehicle Scheme-Meghalaya
brief_description: The **PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme**Rs. implemented by the Tourism Department under the Chief Ministers CM-ELEVATE Program of the PlanningRs. Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. aims to boost tourism in the state by providing 50% financial assistance for the purchase of adventure tourism vehicles. The scheme also offers easy credit through partner banksRs. training for operatorsRs. and government-funded GPS and branding supportRs. thereby enabling entrepreneurs and entities to enhance tourist transport services and promote economic growth.
benefits: 1. 50% of on-road vehicle cost supported (5% by the entrepreneurRs. 45% by the Government of Meghalaya) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty (cost borne by GovernmentRs. one-time) 1. Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government (first time only) 1. Mandatory capacity building and training programs under Meghalaya Tourist Operator Program (MTOTP) by the Tourism Department 1. Support from PRIME Tourism Vehicle Cell for promotionRs. grievance redressalRs. and training 1. Eligibility for multiple vehicle typesRs. including 817 seater luxury busesRs. 4x4 vehiclesRs. and MPVs for tourism and adventure tourism
eligibility: **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license. 1. The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. **Registered Entities** 1. The applicant should be a recognised and registered tour operatorRs. tourism societyRs. or similar entity based in Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have experience in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should be associated with the adventure tourism sector if applying for a 4x4 vehicle. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. 1. The applicant should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration CertificateRs. as applicable. **Unregistered Entities** 1. The applicant should be an unregistered entity such as a village organizationRs. self-help groupRs. or traditional community based in Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be involved in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should provide certification from the Block Development Officer (BDO) to support involvement in the tourism sector. 1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under the first phase of the PRIME Tourism Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution.

name: Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University
brief_description: The "Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University" launched by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide monthly financial assistance to eligible Under Graduate students at Junagadh Agricultural University. The objective is to attract the bright and talented students to seek admission in various faculties of P.G. levelRs. it is necessary to provide financial assistance.
benefits: - **Masters degree students:** 2Rs./- per month for 2 years. - **Ph.D. degree students:** 3Rs./- per month for 3 years.
eligibility: - Applicant must be domiciled in Gujarat. - Applicant must have obtained a minimum first-class or equivalent grade/OGPA in UG (for Masters) or Masters (for Ph.D.). - Applicant must be newly admitted (fresh) to the Postgraduate program at JAU. - Applicant must have a basic degree in Agriculture or allied sciences.

name: Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to offer financial support to farmers across Gujarat for constructing vegetable trellises (mandaps) using wooden/bamboo supports and GI/plastic wires.
benefits: > **Raw Mandap (Tomato/Chilli and other vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidyRs. up to 26Rs./ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidyRs. up to 39Rs./ha. > **Semi-ripe Mandap (Vine vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidyRs. up to 40Rs./ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidyRs. up to 60Rs./ha. > **Ripe Mandap (Vine vegetables):** - General Farmers: 50% subsidyRs. up to 80Rs./ha. - SC/ST Farmers: 75% subsidyRs. up to 1Rs./ha. > **Other Support Details:** - Maximum area eligible: 2 hectares per farmer. - Construction material: 1600 wooden/bamboo poles per hectareRs. 400 kg GI wire (12-18 gauge) or plastic wire. - Recommended spacing: 2.50 x 2.50 meters.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be residing in Gujarat.

name: Passenger Auto Rickshaw Loan Scheme (DAADC)
brief_description: The "Passenger Auto Rickshaw Loan Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance in the form of loans to Scheduled Caste individuals from Antyodaya families to purchase passenger auto rickshawsRs. enabling them to generate sustainable income through transport services. The scheme is being implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation.
benefits: - Financial assistance in the form of a loan.
eligibility: - The Applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community. - The Applicant must be from an Antyodaya family. - The Applicants family income must not exceed 3Rs./- per annum.

name: Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC) implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to offers financial support to candidates from the Unreserved category in the form of loan of up to 25Rs./- at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum to undergo training for obtaining a Commercial Pilot License (CPL). The objective of the scheme is to support meritorious students who aspire to build a career in aviation but face financial constraints.
benefits: - **Loan Assistance:** Up to 25Rs./- at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum.
eligibility:
- Applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.


- Applicant must belong to the Unreserved (General) category.
- Applicant must have passed HSC (12th standard).
- Applicant must have secured admission to a recognized commercial pilot training institute.

name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9
brief_description: The "Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme offers free bicycles to girls enrolled in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aided schoolsRs. facilitating easier access to education and encouraging regular school attendance. This physical aid helps in improving educational participation and empowering female students from economically weaker backgrounds.
benefits: - Free bicycle provided to each eligible girl student.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must be a female student.
- The applicant must be studying in Class 9.
- The applicant must be enrolled in a government or grant-in-aided school in Gujarat.
- The applicant must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS).
- The applicant's family income must not exceed 6Rs. per annum.

name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare
brief_description: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial aid of up to 1Rs./- to eligible beneficiaries from the socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC)Rs. economically backward classes (EBC)Rs. and nomadic exempted castes (NEC) for constructing new houses. The scheme prioritizes Below Poverty Line (BPL) householdsRs. most backward classesRs. and nomadic communities.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 1Rs./- for house construction.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC)/ Economically Backward Class (EBC) or Nomadic Exempted Caste. - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must have a total annual family income not exceeding 6Rs./-. - The applicant must have legal ownership of land or a valid allotment order for the construction of a house.

name: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Swayam Saksham Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to inculcate the spirit of self-reliance among socially and educationally backward class youth who have received vocational or professional training. Under this schemeRs. low-interest loans are provided to educated unemployed youth for setting up self-employment ventures like clinicsRs. law officesRs. engineering unitsRs. and more. The initiative focuses on empowering beneficiaries to start independent businesses with financial assistanceRs. promoting economic inclusion and entrepreneurship.
benefits: **Loan Amount:** - Up to 5Rs./- per applicant. **Interest Rate:** - 6% per annum. **Loan Share:** Under the schemeRs. the loan will be distributed in a unit cost ratio where- - 85% will be covered by a national corporation - 10% by State Government - 5% contribution by the beneficiary **Repayment Terms:** - This loan will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicant should be unemployed but professionally educated (e.g.Rs. doctorRs. engineerRs. lawyerRs. CARs. etc.). 1. The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should have completed a professional course (degree or diploma). 1. The applicant should intend to start a professional business such as clinicsRs. nursing homesRs. physiotherapy clinicsRs. biomedical labsRs. legal officesRs. medical storesRs. architect officesRs. engineering unitsRs. C.A. officesRs. etc.

name: Uniform Assistance for Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying Standard 1st to 8th
brief_description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying Standard 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote education and reduce the economic burden of students from the Socially and Educationally Backward Class by providing them with uniform assistance. The scheme ensures that eligible students from classes 1 to 8 studying in government and aided primary schools receive 900/- to cover the cost of three sets of school uniforms.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 900/- is provided to each eligible student for the purchase of three pairs of school uniforms.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should belong to the state of Gujarat.
- The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided primary school.
- The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class under the minority category.

name: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support students belonging to Nomadic Tribes and De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT) categories in accessing quality education in self-financed colleges by reducing the financial burden. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 50Rs./- is provided to cover tuition feesRs. registration chargesRs. education feesRs. and other scholarship-related expenses for students enrolled in self-financed colleges. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. and seeks to empower NT/DNT students with improved access to higher education opportunities.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 50Rs./- for tuition feeRs. registration feeRs. education feeRs. and other scholarship-related charges.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the NT/DNT (Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes) category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a self-financed college in Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination. 1. The applicants individual and family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. The Institute must be certified by the government.

name: Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief_description: The scheme Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from economically weaker sections pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of 400 per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding 6Rs./-.
benefits: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of 400/- is given to socially and economically backward class students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Economically Weaker Section category. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicants individual and family income should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.

name: Tuition Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)
brief_description: The scheme "Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)" by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to support meritorious students from the unreserved category pursuing science in Classes 11 and 12 by providing them annual tuition fee assistance. This scheme ensures that students who scored 70% or more in their Class 10 board examination receive 15Rs. through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to pursue science education. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational & Economic Development Corporation.
benefits: - **Monetary Assistance:** 15Rs./- per academic year is provided as tuition assistance to each eligible student.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the unreserved category.
- The applicant must be studying in Class 11th or Class 12th in the science stream.
- The applicant must have secured 70% or more marks (from total marks in all subjects) in Class 10.
- The applicants family income must not exceed 6Rs. annually.
- The applicant must apply in the same academic year.
- The institution should be registered under a valid Act (such as Trust ActRs. Companies ActRs. etc.)Rs. with at least 3 years of experience in Class 11-12 science tuition.
- The institution should have filed IT returns for the past 3 yearsRs. including income from tuition classesRs.
- The institution should have a mandatory GST.

name: Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to economically empower women from Thakor and Koli castes through self-employment opportunities via Self Help Groups (SHGs). Under this schemeRs. eligible members of SHGs receive a loan at low interest to start or expand small-scale businesses/enterprises.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** Up to 60Rs./- for eligible small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** 95% of the project/business cost is covered; 5% contribution is to be made by the beneficiary.- **Repayment Term:** 48 equal monthly installments (4 years)Rs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a member of a Self Help Group (SHG). 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant's age should be at least 21 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should have relevant experience in the proposed trade/business field. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan allocation is reserved for those with family income up to 1Rs./-.

name: Coaching Assistance for Pre-preparation for Competitive Exams of ALL INDIA level like IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU and IELTS, TOFEL, GRE for going Foreign
brief_description: The scheme "Coaching Assistance for Pre-Preparation for Competitive Exams of All India Level like IIMRs. CEPTRs. NIFTRs. NLU and IELTSRs. TOEFLRs. GRE for Going Foreign" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to financially support SEBC and economically backward students preparing for national-level and international entrance exams. Under this schemeRs. eligible candidates receive up to 20Rs./- or the actual tuition fee paidRs. whichever is lowerRs. as assistance for coaching fees.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** - 20Rs./- or actual coaching fee paid (whichever is lower) for pre-preparation of one competitive exam (IIMRs. CEPTRs. NIFTRs. NLURs. IELTSRs. TOEFLRs. GRE) **Mode of Disbursement:** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to trainees bank account.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the SEBC or Economically Backward Class category. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 10 or Class 12 (SSC or HSC). 1. The applicant must be preparing for one of the eligible competitive exams (IIMRs. CEPTRs. NIFTRs. NLURs. IELTSRs. TOEFLRs. GRE). 1. The applicant must have paid tuition/coaching fees for the exam preparation. 1. The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Term Loan Scheme (GSKVN)
brief_description: The "Term Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to uplift safai kamdars (scavengers) and their dependents by providing financial assistance in the form of term loans to help them take up various trades or professions for self-employment. The scheme also aims to integrate them into the mainstream society by enabling them to move away from the traditionalRs. inhumanRs. and hazardous occupation of manual scavenging and lead a life of dignity. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries are eligible to receive term loans ranging from 1Rs. to 15Rs. to start income-generating self-employment activities or projects. The scheme is implemented with the support of the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)Rs. New DelhiRs. in collaboration with the State GovernmentRs. through the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam.
benefits: ***Loan Amount:***__ - loans from 1Rs./- to 15Rs./- are provided at an interest rate of 6% for various businesses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a scavenger/sanitation worker or a dependent of one. 1. The applicant should be willing to use the loan for starting income-generating self-employment activities or projects.

name: Loan for Small Businesses (DAADC)
brief_description: The "Loan for Small Businesses" scheme is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals belonging to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families by providing financial assistance for starting small businesses or self-employment ventures. Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries are provided a loan of up to 1Rs. at a concessional interest rate.
benefits: **Loan Amount:** - Up to 1Rs./- ***Interest Rate***_:_ - 4% per annum ***Loan Tenure:***__ - 60 months (5 years) ***Guarantors Required:***__ - Two guarantors ***State Government Contribution:*** - 100% (no beneficiary share required) ***Approximate Installment Amount:*** - 2Rs./- per month (maximum)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should belong to an Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) family. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should intend to start or expand a small business or occupation. 1. The applicant should be able to provide two guarantors.

name: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (DAADC)
brief_description: The "Mahila Samruddhi Yojana" is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and financial independence among women from the Antyodaya SamajRs. especially from Scheduled Castes. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided at a concessional interest rate to eligible women for starting small-scale businesses.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** 50Rs./- provided to eligible women for starting micro or small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** 6% per annum.- **State Government Contribution:** 95% of the loan amountRs. i.e.Rs. 47Rs./-Rs. is borne by the state.- **Beneficiary Contribution:** 5% of the loan amountRs. i.e.Rs. 2Rs./-.- **Possible Monthly Installment Amount:** 1Rs./- per month.- **Duration:** 36 Months (3 years)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should belong to the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) family or be from the economically backward class. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should be planning to start a self-employment venture or micro-enterprise.

name: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
brief_description: The Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Government Adarsh Residential Schools (SC) scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste (SC) students in standards 9th to 12th. Under this schemeRs. eligible SC students receive free boardingRs. lodgingRs. textbooksRs. uniformsRs. mealsRs. and additional support services to enhance academic participation.
benefits: **Free Services Provided:** - Board and lodgingRs. mealsRs. textbooksRs. uniformsRs. and water - Study materialsRs. midday mealsRs. and other academic support - Ration cardRs. PH identity cardRs. and other entitlementsRs. as applicable
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be currently studying in standard 9th to 12th in a recognized institution.1. The applicant must have passed the previous annual exam with at least 50% marks (or a government-sanctioned exemption). > **NOTE:** Returning students must have passed with at least a second class with 50% to be considered for re-admission.

name: Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to support meritorious students in their pursuit of higher education. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 18Rs./- will be given to the eligible students per year for two successive years after matric. Every yearRs. 2000 scholarships are awarded to excellent students from the general category.
benefits: A scholarship of 18Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The student should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant should be a Student. 3. The applicant should have passed Class 10th. 4. The applicant should have come in merit (in top 2000). 5. The applicant should be from the general category. 6. The applicant should be enrolled in Class 11th or any professional/technical course in a recognized institute.

name: Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan
brief_description: The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide complete financial relief to students through 100% interest subsidy on education loans for the entire moratorium period. This includes the study period and 1 additional year after course completion.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy Assistance:** 100% interest subsidy on education loans up to 10Rs./- for the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Higher Secondary Certificate) with at least 60 percentile. 1. The applicant must have taken an education loan from a recognized bank for pursuing higher education in India or abroad. 1. The applicant must have a family income not exceeding 6Rs./- per year.

name: Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme
brief_description: The **Meghalaya Sericulture and Weaving Scheme**Rs. implemented by the Department of Textiles under the PlanningRs. Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department of the Government of MeghalayaRs. is a credit-linked scheme that provides up to 75% financial assistance on the total project cost to support entrepreneurs and collectives in starting sericulture and weaving activities. The scheme focuses mainly on Eri silkRs. a traditional and exclusive fabric of MeghalayaRs. and also supports Muga silk due to the states favorable climate. It aims to promote the silk industry by helping set up grainages for producing Disease-Free Layings (DFL)Rs. spinning or reeling and natural dyeing unitsRs. and weaving unitsRs. thereby unlocking entrepreneurial potential and placing Meghalaya yarn and fabric on the international silk map.
benefits: 1. 75% of project cost supported by Government of Meghalaya as upfront margin money (5% by entrepreneurRs. 20% as bank loan) 2. Credit linkage through partnered banks State Bank of India (SBI) and Indian Bank 3. Guidance in application process through implementing agencies 4. Support in project realization and facilitation for unit setup under CM-ELEVATE framework 5. Training and capacity building for entrepreneurs to successfully operate grainageRs. spinningRs. reelingRs. dyeingRs. and weaving units 6. Financial assistance applicable for multiple unit typesRs. including Eri SpinningRs. Muga ReelingRs. WeavingRs. and Grainage (with or without infrastructure support) 7. One-time infrastructure support (500 sq ft/1000 sq ft shed) for eligible applicantsRs. as per selected option 8. Equipment cost coverage for spinningRs. reelingRs. weavingRs. dyeingRs. and grainage operations as per model estimates
eligibility: **For Collectives (Registered & Unregistered Entities):** 1. The collective must be based in the village where the program is being implemented. 1. The registered entity must have at least 10 members. 1. The collective must have prior experience in spinning and weavingRs. with a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom Officer stating that at least 5 members are spinnersRs. reelersRs. or weaversRs. or valid Handloom ID cards for at least 5 weavers issued by the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The collective should employ a minimum of 5 spinners or weaversRs. supported by an undertaking. 1. The collective applying for Grainage must have staff with a minimum educational qualification of 10th pass and a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Office confirming at least 2 years of experience in the production of layings. 1. The collective must have an active bank account and submit bank statements for the last 6 months. 1. The collective must have been operating for at least two years. 1. The collective must possess landRs. either self-owned or leasedRs. verified by the competent authority. **For Individuals:** 1. The individual must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The individual must have completed training in spinning or weavingRs. supported by a certificate from a registered training providerRs. a bonafide certificate from the District Sericulture Officer/District Handloom OfficerRs. or a valid Handloom ID issued by the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The individual applying for Grainage must have a minimum educational qualification of 10th pass and at least 2 years of experience in the production of layingsRs. certified by the District Sericulture Office. 1. The individual must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The individual must not be a credit defaulter from any bank.

name: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)
brief_description: The scheme "Loan for Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide students belonging to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.) with financial assistance for higher education abroad. The scheme provides a maximum loan of 15Rs./- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) for higher studies in foreign countries. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the official website [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/).
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - A maximum Foreign Study Loan of 15Rs./- is provided for higher education abroad. - The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%. - The loan covers costs such as air ticketsRs. registration feesRs. tuition feesRs. education feesRs. hostel feesRs. booksRs. and other expenses associated with the first year of the course abroad. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - The full loan amount of 15Rs./- will be disbursed to the student in a single installment. - The money will be deposited into the student's bank account after the submission of the original registered mortgage deed. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - After the sanction order is receivedRs. the student's parent or guardian must obtain the prescribed mortgage deed form from the District Office. - The property presented by the student's parent/guardian or the guarantor must be registered as a mortgage in favor of the government. - The loan repayment must begin one year after the completion of the student's study. - The loan must be repaid in monthly or quarterly installments. - The principal loan amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 10 years. - The interest amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 2 years. - The student must ensure all required documentation is completed within the prescribed time limit.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.). - The applicant's family annual income must be less than 10Rs./- (Rupees Ten Lakh). - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in 12th standard. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks if they belong to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT)Rs. More BackwardRs. or Extremely Backward categories. - The applicant must be pursuing higher education abroad. - The applicant must be pursuing a DiplomaRs. GraduateRs. Post GraduateRs. Post Graduate DiplomaRs. Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)Rs. or higher-level courses in any field. - The course must be for a minimum duration of 1 (one) academic year or moreRs. or at least two semesters. - The applicant must apply before traveling abroad or within six months of arriving abroad. - The applicant must submit one solvent guarantor.

name: Financial Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot
brief_description: The "Financial Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support students from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) in obtaining Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training through financial assistance. Under this schemeRs. a loan is offered at a concessional interest rate to eligible students who meet the educational and institutional requirements for CPL training.
benefits: **Loan Amount:****** - Up to 25Rs. for Commercial Pilot License training. **Interest Rate:****** - 4% simple interest per annum. **Penal Interest:** - 2.5% additional interest for late or defaulted payments. **Repayment Period:** - Principal: To be repaid within 10 years from the date of disbursement. - Interest: To be paid within 2 yearsRs. making the total repayment duration 12 years. > **NOTE:** Loan recovery will begin one year after the loan is disbursed to the student.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The applicant must have passed MatriculationRs. Higher SecondaryRs. Indian School CertificateRs. or an equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must meet all academicRs. technicalRs. and other criteria as specified by the training institution. 1. The applicant must provide one solvent guarantor. 1. The applicant or their guardian must own property to mortgage in favor of the government.

name: Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW) Scheme
brief_description: The "Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW)" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to promote social welfare and support financially weaker sections through community marriages. Under this schemeRs. an incentive amount is given to newly married couples belonging to socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward classes. AdditionallyRs. 3Rs. per couple (up to 75Rs.) is provided to the organizing institution.
benefits: **Monetary Incentive to Couples:** - 12Rs. is provided to each newly married couple from socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward classes. **Support to Organizing Institutions:** - 3Rs. per couple is granted to the organizing institutionRs. up to a maximum of 75Rs. per event.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a newly married female. 1. The applicant should belong to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) or Economically Backward Class. 1. The applicants annual individual income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Financial Assistance to Helpless Artists
brief_description: The Financial Assistance to Helpless Artists scheme was launched by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial security to artists who are agedRs. physically disabledRs. and living in extreme poverty. Under this schemeRs. monthly financial assistance is provided to artists and their dependents who are physically disabledRs. above 60 years of ageRs. have a monthly income of less than 600Rs. and are unable to sustain themselves due to age or disability.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to artists to help them sustain themselves in old age or in case of disability.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an artist who has made significant contributions in the field of art and literature. 1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above. 1. The applicant must have a monthly income of less than 600/- (7Rs./- annually). 1. The applicant must be physically disabled. 1. The applicant must be in poor economic condition.

name: Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course
brief_description: The scheme Assistance to Women for Trainer and Coaches Training Course by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote and enhance the participation of women in sports through structured academic training by supporting them financially for pursuing diploma courses in sports. It seeks to enable women to take up professional training to become certified coaches and trainersRs. thereby boosting employment opportunities and representation in the sports sector. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Eligible female candidates receive financial support to enroll in recognized diploma courses in sports to become trainers or coaches.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a diploma course in sports from a recognized university or institution such as the Sports Authority of India.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences
brief_description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide grants to registered institutions for organizing events such as seminarsRs. dialoguesRs. conventionsRs. workshopsRs. and literary festivals. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Sahitya AcademyRs. and financial assistance is disbursed based on actual expensesRs. subject to a maximum limit. Institutions must comply with language usage normsRs. use appropriate branding and logosRs. and submit reports and financial documentation after event completion. Events can be state-levelRs. nationalRs. or internationalRs. and must involve recognized speakersRs. literary scholarsRs. and culturally relevant topics.
benefits: > **Funding Assistance for Institutions:** - Up to 50Rs./- or 75% of the actual expenditureRs. whichever is lowerRs. is provided for organizing approved literary or educational events. > **Honorarium for Speakers:** - An honorarium of up to 2Rs./- per speaker can be paid to invited speakers participating in the event. > **Note:** - Any honorarium amount exceeding 2Rs./- will not be reimbursed by the Gujarat Sahitya Academy and must be borne by the organizing institution. - Events must be reported with billsRs. photosRs. invitation cardsRs. and video recordings.
eligibility: 1. A registered literary or educational institution shall be eligible. 1. Only 2 programs can organize per year by the institution. 1. The program must be related to literatureRs. educationRs. or cultural discourse. 1. The institution must use the Gujarati language in all materials (alongside any other language). 1. The event must clearly acknowledge Gujarat Sahitya Academy through logos and name placement. 1. The program must involve a minimum 5 speakers. 1. All payments above 5Rs./- must be made through banking channels only (RTGS/NEFT/Cheque).

name: Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste
brief_description: The scheme "Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste Youth" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to foster the overall developmentphysicalRs. mentalRs. and spiritualof youth 1435 years)belonging to the Scheduled Castes through structured yogasana and personality development programs. Each camp runs for 7 days and selects 50 beneficiaries per district from across Gujarat. The initiative serves to empower socially disadvantaged youth and enhance their self-esteemRs. disciplineRs. and holistic well-being. The scheme is implemented by the District Youth Development Officers across all districts of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Training:** The selected Scheduled Caste youth will receive 7 days of training focused on personality development and yogasana.
eligibility: - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be between the age of 14 to 35 years.

name: Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence
brief_description:
The scheme Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE) was launched by the Science and Engineering Research BoardRs. Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India which aims to facilitate the mobility of faculty members working in a regular capacity in State Universities / Colleges and in private Academic Institutions to carry out research work in an established public-funded central institution such as IITsRs. IIScRs. IISERSRs. National Institutions (NITsRs. CSIRRs. ICARRs. ICMR labs and other central institutions) and Central UniversitiesRs. located preferably nearer to the institution where the faculty member is working. Research work will be carried out in such a manner to ensure that the PI continues to work in the host institute as well as his / her parent institute on mutually agreed terms between the PI and Mentor.
**Areas Covered under the scheme:**
The scheme covers areas under Life SciencesRs. Physical SciencesRs. Chemical SciencesRs. Engineering SciencesRs. Earth and Atmospheric SciencesRs. and Mathematical SciencesRs. including interdisciplinary areas.
> **Duration of Support:**

The duration of support is three years.
benefits:
1. Research fellowship of 60Rs./- per year (in addition to the researchers own salary) will be provided subject to completion of a minimum of 90 days of research work per year in the host institution.
1. Research grant of 5 lakhs per annum (50% each to host and parent institution) and overheads (as per SERB norms) will be provided.
eligibility:
1. Indian citizens residing in India holding a Ph.D. degree in Science/Engineering or MS/MD in Medicine are eligible to apply.
1. The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in State Universities/ Colleges and private Academic Institutions.
1. Applicant should not hold any ongoing research projects or any fellowship at the time of submission of application.
1. The upper age limit for the award is 45 years at the time of the submission of the application. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.
1. Mentor should be at the level of Associate Professor/Scientist ERs. or higher level.
1. Only one candidate will be allowed to work with a mentor at any given point of time.

name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
brief_description:
The Raman-Charpak Fellowship Programme is in honour of two Nobel Laureates in PhysicsRs. Prof C.V. RamanRs. Indian Nobel Laureate (1930) and Prof Georges CharpakRs. French Nobel Laureate (1992). The Fellowship was launched during the State visit of the President of France to India in February 2013. The aim is to facilitate the exchange of doctoral students between the two countriesRs. in order to broaden the scope and depth of future engagements in ScienceRs. Technology and Innovation.
This programme implemented by the Indo-French Centre for Promotion of Advanced Research/ Centre Franco-Indien pour la Promotion de la Recherche Avancee (IFCPAR/CEFIPRA) aims at improving the doctoral skills of Indian and French students by providing them with an opportunity to carry out part of their research work in a University / Research & Development Institute based in France or India respectively. This programme is now also open to French Master StudentsRs. who wish to spend some time in India following their curriculum. It aims at improving the Master's skills of French students by providing them an opportunity to carry out internship work in a University/Research Institute based in India.
> **Target Group:**

This fellowship programme is dedicated to highly qualified PhD students registered in an Indian or French Research Institute/University and Master Students from France. The programme offers them an excellent opportunity to carry out a part of their respective PhD/Masters research project in each other countries and to further establish professional relationshipsRs. promote new S&T cooperationRs. and experience another cultural context.
> **Duration of Fellowship:**

The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months.
> **Areas covered under the Fellowship:**

Atmospheric Sciences
Earth Sciences and Environmental Sciences
Materials Sciences
Physical Sciences
Chemical Sciences
Engineering Sciences
Biological Sciences
Life and Medical Sciences
Mathematical and Computational Sciences
benefits:
1. To and fro air ticket in economy class between India and France.
1. Insurance coverage (travel & health) wherever is required & Carte de Sejour (if any).
1. Any administrative costs for Visa and Registration (if any).
1. Support for attending conferences/seminars/workshops during the stay.

> **Value of Fellowship for Indian Fellow:**


1. Fellowship Support of 1500 Euros per month for daily expensesRs. local travelRs. accommodation charges plus Social Security charges.

> **Value of Fellowship for French Fellow:**


1. Fellowship support 40Rs./- per month for daily expensesRs. local travelRs. etc. plus accommodation charges not exceeding 45Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. Applicants from India must be Indian citizens residing in India and have registered for a PhD in a recognized university or research institution in India.
1. Applicants from France must be residing in France and have registered for a PhD/Masters Degree in a recognized university or research institution in France.
1. Maximum age 30 years as of 1st April of the call year.
1. Students once supported by CEFIPRA and students who have a permanent position in institutions/universities are not eligible.
1. Pre-authorization or prior consent from his/her Institute/University to apply for a foreign fellowship program.

name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
brief_description: The scheme "Promoting Innovations In IndividualsRs. Start-Ups And MicroRs. Small And Medium Enterprises (PRISM)" was launched by the Department of Scientific and Industrial ResearchRs. Ministry of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to promote innovations in individualsRs. start-ups and microRs. small and medium enterprises. The scheme provides support for Individual Innovator Proposals under Phase-IRs. Category IIRs. focusing on Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer. Key features include comparatively more rigorous demonstrability of original idea/invention/know-how in the form of working prototype/processes and its testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR). The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres (TOCICs) or directly to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research.
benefits:
***The maximum support under Category II is 20Rs./- or 90% of the approved project costRs. whichever is lower. The approved project cost must be more than 5Rs./- and up to 35Rs./-.***
##### ***Eligible Components for Support*** - Research and Development/Design Engineering/Consultancy charges. - Rental charges for laboratory/workshop facilities. - Essential equipment that cannot be taken on rent (reasons for purchase must be given). - Raw material/spares/consumables cost. - Fabrication/synthesis charges. - Manpower cost of technical assistantsRs. not exceeding 20% of the approved project cost. - Testing and trials. - Travel costRs. not exceeding 5% of the approved project cost. - Patent filing (actual fee paid to the patent office). - Process know-how development. - Proposals involving scientifically characterizing or testing the efficacy and toxicity of herbal formulations. ##### ***Exclusions from Support*** - Innovators salary. - Rental expenses for use of own facilities. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The first release is based on milestones/deliverables projected in the project proposals and as recommended by the PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC). - Subsequent releases are based on the assessment of the progress of the project by the Project Review Committee (PRC). ##### ***Conditions*** - The applicant has to sign "Terms & Conditions" prior to the actual release of grants-in-aid. - The approved projects will be monitored by the TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre/other network partnersRs. including technical expert(s). - The TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres will be periodically reporting project status to the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research at an interval of 3 months. - The Project Review CommitteesRs. consisting of external expertsRs. will meet at least once in nine months to review the progress of the project. - For student innovatorsRs. the institution will be responsible for final completion of the project in case the Innovator leaves the Institute/Organization without completion of the project.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an Indian Citizen. - The applicant must have an innovative idea or an invention. - The applicant must propose a project where the project cost is more than 5Rs./- and up to 35Rs./-. - The applicant must ensure the project duration does not exceed 24 months. - The applicant must ensure the proposal involves the fabrication of a working model/process know-how/testing and trial/patenting/technology transfer. - The applicant must ensure the proposal does not involve only software development. - The applicant must ensure the proposal is not for basic scientific research having no immediate commercial implications. ##### ***Specific Conditions*** - **Students:** The applicant must provide a `No Objection Certificate from the head of their institution on the institutions letterhead.- **Students:** The applicant must ensure the commitment from the institution that the project will be taken to its logical conclusion by the student/concerned faculty.- **Individuals Working in Organizations:** The applicant must furnish a `No Objection Certificate from their employer. ##### ***Desirable Criteria (Preference)*** - The proposals should preferably be in the following focus sectors: Green TechnologyRs. Clean EnergyRs. Industrially utilizable smart materialsRs. Waste to wealthRs. Affordable healthcareRs. Water & sewage managementRs. or any other technology or knowledge-intensive area. - Preference: Student innovators making it to the final of any competition are eligibleRs. but they should take the project as a full-time activity after graduation to ensure their studies are not adversely affected. - The applicant should ensure the proposal is submitted through the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation CentreRs. even if scoutedRs. documentedRs. and mentored by other agenciesRs. and must include evaluation by the assisting agency.

name: One District One Product (ODOP) Awards
brief_description: The One District One Product Awards (here in afterRs. the 'Award') have been instituted by the **Department for the Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)Rs. Ministry of Commerce and IndustryRs. Government of IndiaRs.** to acknowledge the extraordinary work done by States/ UTsRs. DistrictsRs. and Indian Missions AbroadRs. for the economic development of the State and contribute towards the realization of the Honble Prime Ministers vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. **No. of Awardees** There will be total 38 awards under 5 heads (States/UTsRs. DistrictsRs. Indian Missions AbroadRs. E-Commerce platforms and Central Ministries/Departments) - 9 Awards for States/UTs - 12 Awards for Districts - 15 Awards for Indian Missions Abroad - 1 Award for E-Commerce platforms - 1 Award for Central Ministries/Departments - The above division is tentative and subject to change.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. each awardee will receive a commemorative trophy and certificate recognizing excellence in their respective award category. The award will reflect the recipients unique contribution to promoting One District One Product (ODOP) and will be customized according to the specific category.
eligibility: 1. All States/ UTsRs. DistrictsRs. Indian Missions AbroadRs. E-Commerce platformsRs. and Central Ministries/departments are eligible for the award. 1. The applications will be considered valid for the progress achieved in the promotion of the identified product from the respective district identified under DPIITs ODOP initiative only. The [list of products ](https://static.investindia.gov.in/s3fs-public/2025-07/v31_odop_product_list_20250702.pdf)identified under the initiative can be accessed.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
brief_description: The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar under Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs.Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of IndiaRs. recognizes and honors scientists and technical personnel who have made outstanding contributions in agricultureRs. agricultural educationRs. extensionRs. and allied sciences. This includes the development of new processesRs. productsRs. toolsRs. technologiesRs. and innovative practices that enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in India. **Fields Covered:** **The awards are categorized under three main streamsRs. each covering the following four fields:** 1. Crops & Horticultural Sciences 1. Natural Resources Management & Agricultural Engineering 1. Animal & Fisheries Sciences 1. Social Sciences **Award Categories & Number of Awardees:** 1. Innovation & Technology in Agriculture & Allied Sciences 4 awardees 1. Research in Agriculture & Allied Sciences 4 awardees 1. Outstanding Interdisciplinary Team Research in AgricultureRs. Agricultural EducationRs. Extension & Allied Sciences 1 awardee 1. Outstanding Woman Scientist in AgricultureRs. Agricultural EducationRs. Extension & Allied Sciences 1 awardee 1. Outstanding Young Scientist in Agriculture & Allied Sciences 4 awardees
benefits: i. In the Award CeremonyRs. the Awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate) signed by the Hon'ble Union Minister (Agriculture & Farmers Welfare) & PresidentRs. ICAR. A commemorative brochureRs. containing the citation and photograph of the awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony. ii. The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony due to personal reasons (including indispositionRs. preoccupationRs. etc.) shall be deemed to have been conferred. No other person (including the spouse/next of kin) should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awardee except in posthumous cases.
eligibility: **General Conditions:** 1. The applicant should be an Indian scientist working in agriculture or allied fields in ICAR institutesRs. public agricultural institutionsRs. or Krishi Vigyan KendrasRs. and must have made significant contributions in India. 1. The applicant should have work (researchRs. innovationRs. or extension) that shows clear and proven impact on societyRs. economyRs. or environmentRs. supported by the Head of the Institution. 1. The applicant can apply at any stage of their careerRs. as no minimum service period is required. 1. The applicant should submit only one application for a particular contribution in a yearRs. and the application will be valid only for that year. 1. The applicant should have a clean service recordRs. with no pending enquiry or major punishment in the last five years. 1. The applicant should apply under only one category and cannot be considered for multiple categories. **Category-wise Conditions:** 1. The applicant can apply individually or as part of a team (maximum five members) for innovation and research awardsRs. and must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for interdisciplinary research should be part of a team of at least three members from different disciplinesRs. and the team leader must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for the women scientist category should be a woman working in agriculture or allied fieldsRs. and must be below 60 years of age. 1. The applicant applying for the young scientist category should have a doctoral degreeRs. hold a regular positionRs. and must be below 45 years of age.

name: Police Medal for Meritorious Service
brief_description: The Police Medal for Meritorious Service (PM) scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. under Police-I Division. The scheme aims to recognize consistent meritorious serviceRs. professional excellenceRs. and dedication to duty among police and allied forces. Under this schemeRs. medalsRs. official recognitionRs. and service distinction are provided to eligible personnel serving in policeRs. CAPFsRs. CPOsRs. and other public safety organizations.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits** - Award of Police Medal for Meritorious Service. - National recognition and prestige. - Entry of award in official service records. - Enhanced career prospects and credibility. - Recognition of long-term service excellence. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical medal and citation conferred by the competent authority. - Awarded annually on national occasions.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a serving police officer or personnel of CAPFs/CPOs. 1. The applicant should have a clean service record without major penalties. 1. The applicant should demonstrate meritorious and consistent service. 1. The applicant should have a minimum service of 18 years. 1. The applicant should have ACRs available for the last 10 years. 1. The applicant should have at least 8 Very Good or above ACRs; at least 1 should be Outstanding. 1. The applicant should not have any average ACR during the review period. 1. The applicant should have at least 1 ACR after the Non-Initiation Certificate (NIC) period (if applicable). 1. The applicant should not have more than 1 missing ACR. 1. The applicant should ensure the last year ACR is available. 1. The applicant should be physically fit and fall under SHAPE 1 category; relaxation to SHAPE 2 may be given in exceptional cases. 1. The applicant should not have more than 3 nominations (for Group A officers). 1. The applicant should not have adverse vigilance or disciplinary issues.

name: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme
brief_description:
The Lokpal of India launched The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme. The interns will get an opportunity to understand anti-corruption mechanismsRs. including the Lokpal and Lokayuktas ActRs. 2013Rs. and Indias commitment under the United Nations Convention Against Corruption and related frameworks. They will also learn about the impact of corruption on governance and contribute innovative ideas to strengthen transparencyRs. accountabilityRs. and effective functioning of institutions like the Lokpal and other vigilance bodies.
> **Duration:** The period of internship shall be up to 3 months.
> **Attendance:** The interns will have to attend the office on all working days.
benefits: - A stipend of 10Rs./- per month. - The Lokpal of India gives a certificate to the interns completing the internship successfully. - The Lokpal of India provides working spaceRs. internetRs. and other appropriate facilities to the interns.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an institution affiliated with a recognized university within India. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a regular undergraduate or postgraduate degree course in the field of lawRs. political scienceRs. public administrationRs. public policyRs. managementRs. economicsRs. or human rights. 1. The applicant must have secured at least 75% or equivalent marks in the 12th class.1. The undergraduate student must have completed at least two years of study in the undergraduate course. 1. The undergraduate student must have a minimum aggregate of % or equivalent marks in years completed till the date of application. 1. The postgraduate students must have a minimum aggregate of 55% or equivalent in the graduation course. 1. The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship.

name: Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold
