brief_description: The Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers" scheme has been implemented by the MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal. The objective of the scheme is to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.
benefits: - An amount of 1000/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
- The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above.
- The applicant should be a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.
- The applicant should have worked for at least 10 years under the cooperative society on the date of making the application.
- The applicant should not have any source of income.
- The applicant should not be in a position to earn his/her livelihood.
- The applicant should be permanently incapacitated for work due to physical or mental infirmity.
- The applicant should not have any relation who can maintain him/her.
- The applicant should not have availed any pension from the State Government or Government of India.

**Note:**

- Provided that the State Government may relax the condition regarding residence where the condition causes undue hardship.

name: National Award to Teachers (For Excellence in Vocational Training and Entrepreneurship Development)
brief_description: The objective of the National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship DevelopmentRs. under the Ministry of Skill Development and EntrepreneurshipRs. Government of IndiaRs. is to honor excellence among facultyRs. trainersRs. and master trainers in long-term and short-term training as well as entrepreneurship developmentRs. who have achieved outstanding performance and set benchmarks for others to emulate. **No. of Awardees** **A total of sixteen awards will be conferred each year. There shall be five award categories as per the details below:** 1. Category I: Best Skill Trainers Long Term Training (09 Awards) 1. Sub Category (i): Best Skill Trainer in top 5 trades under CTS in ITIs - 05 1. Sub Category (ii): Best Skill Trainer in remaining engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (iii): Best Skill Trainer in remaining non-engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (iv): Best Skill Trainer Divyang trades - 01 1. Sub Category (v): Best Skill Trainer New Age Courses - 01 1. Category II: Best Skill Trainers Short Term Training (03 Awards) 1. Category III: Best Master Trainers - Long Term Training (02 Awards) 1. Sub Category (i): Best Master Trainer in Engineering trades - 01 1. Sub Category (ii):Best Master Trainer in Non-Engineering trades - 01 1. Category IV: Best Master Trainers - Short Term Training (01 Award) 1. Category V: Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development (01 Award)
benefits: **Each awardee shall be presented with:** - A Medal - A Certificate - Cash Prize of 50Rs./-
eligibility: **Category I & III: Best Skill Trainers and Master Trainers Long-Term Training** 1. The applicant should be engaged as a trainer or master trainer on a regular basis. 1. The applicant should have at least five years of full-time experience at CTS and/or CITSRs. as applicable. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years. **Category II & IV: Best Skill Trainers and Master Trainers Short-Term Training** 1. The applicant should be engaged as a trainer or master trainer on a regular basis. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should be a registered trainer on Skill India Digital Hub from a government institution with valid certification (at least up to October 2025) and delivering/have delivered short-term training programs. 1. The applicant should be a certified trainer/master trainer from an awarding body with valid certification (at least up to October 2025) and delivering/have delivered short-term training programs. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years. 1. The applicant should apply under only one category. **Category V: Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development** 1. The applicant should be a regular faculty member engaged in teaching entrepreneurship development programs/courses in a University/College/Institution recognized by UGC/AICTE or institutes established by an Act of Parliament. 1. The applicant should be engaged on a regular basis in the implementation of entrepreneurship development programs in Central or State Government institutionsRs. including autonomous institutions. 1. The applicant should have at least five years of full-time experience. 1. The applicant should not be above 55 years of age on the last date of receiving applications. 1. The applicant should not have received any category of the Kaushalacharya Award or National Award for Excellence in Vocational Training & Entrepreneurship Development in previous years.

name: Padma Awards
brief_description: The Padma Awards has been launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. Under this schemeRs. civilian honours in the form of Padma VibhushanRs. Padma BhushanRs. and Padma Shri are provided to individuals for their outstanding contributions. The awards emphasize excellence combined with public service across disciplines such as artRs. scienceRs. literatureRs. sportsRs. medicineRs. and social work.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits** - Conferment of Padma VibhushanRs. Padma BhushanRs. or Padma Shri. - Sanad (Certificate) signed by the President of India. - Medallion along with a miniature replica for ceremonial use. - National recognition and prestige. - Publication of awardees name in the Gazette of India. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical conferment of certificate and medallion at Rashtrapati Bhavan. - Announced annually on 26th January (Republic Day). - Presentation ceremony is usually held in March or April.
eligibility: 1. The applicant can be any person without distinction of raceRs. occupationRs. positionRs. or gender. 1. The applicant should have rendered distinguished or exceptional service in any field. 1. The applicant should demonstrate excellence plusRs. meaning excellence combined with public service. 1. The applicant may belong to fields such as ArtRs. Social WorkRs. Public AffairsRs. Science & EngineeringRs. Trade & IndustryRs. MedicineRs. Literature & EducationRs. Civil ServiceRs. SportsRs. or others. 1. The applicant should not be a serving Government employee; howeverRs. doctors and scientists are exempted. 1. The applicant may be considered posthumously only in rare and highly deserving cases within 1 year of demise. 1. The applicant should have a minimum gap of 5 years for receiving a higher category award. 1. The applicant should not misuse the award as a title.

name: Halpati Housing Scheme
brief_description: The Halpati Housing Scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Halpati (TalaviyaRs. Nayaka) families belonging to Scheduled Tribes for building safe and sustainable housing. Under this schemeRs. monetary aid is provided in phases directly into the bank accounts of the Halpati beneficiaries residing in South Gujarat districts such as SuratRs. TapiRs. ValsadRs. NavsariRs. NarmadaRs. BharuchRs. ChhotaudepurRs. and Vadodara.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 1Rs. provided for construction of housing.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Halpati (TalaviyaRs. Nayaka) casteRs. which is recognized under Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant should be a resident of South Gujarat districts: SuratRs. TapiRs. ValsadRs. NavsariRs. NarmadaRs. BharuchRs. ChhotaudepurRs. or Vadodara. 1. The applicant should be a resident of rural areas within the specified districts.

name: Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme
brief_description: The Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme is a component of the CM-ELEVATE Program under the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to promote alternative tourism models and encourage rural and eco-tourism by supporting motorcaravan (campervan)based travel experiences. It provides 50% financial support on the project cost and facilitates credit access through partner banksRs. enabling entrepreneurs to purchase and operate motorcaravans across the state. Through this initiativeRs. the government seeks to create new tourism opportunitiesRs. support local entrepreneurshipRs. and enhance sustainable travel experiences in Meghalaya.
benefits: **Down Payment/Margin Money Support:** Total down payment will be 50% of the price of the vehicle. Of this: 1. 5% of the caravan price is to be paid by the entrepreneur to the bank. 1. 45% of the caravan price will be paid by the Government of Meghalaya to the entrepreneur through the bank. **EMI Support:** 1. To reduce the operational cost burden in the first yearRs. the Government of Meghalaya will pay 5% of the vehicle costRs. distributed equally over twelve monthsRs. as EMI co-payment. **Additional Support** 1. Vehicles will be installed with GPS devices with a 5-year warrantyRs. the cost of which will be borne by the government (one-time only). 1. Branding cost of the vehicle will be borne by the entrepreneur and included in the total project cost. **Maximum Government Support:** 1. Maximum support will be 50% of the project cost or 25Rs. whichever is lower. 1. Vehicle permit costs will be borne by the entrepreneur.
eligibility: **Individuals** 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must hold a valid driving license. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The applicant shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Registered Entities:** 1. The entity must be a recognized and registered tourism operator or tourism society with the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The entity must provide an Incorporation Certificate or registration certificateRs. whichever is applicable. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **For Unregistered Entities:** 1. The entity can be any unregistered organization such as village organizationsRs. self-help groupsRs. or traditional communities based in Meghalaya. 1. The entity must be actively involved in the tourism sector. 1. The entity must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the tourism service sector. 1. The entity shall not be a credit defaulter at any financial institution.

name: Agro Tourism Villa Scheme
brief_description: The Agro Tourism Villa Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister's Elevate Program launched under the Tourism Department of the Government of Meghalaya. The program aims to employRs. engageRs. and empower the youth of Meghalaya by promoting entrepreneurship and providing easy access to credit through the onboarding of various banks as financial partners. To meet the rising demand and promote high-value tourismRs. the Meghalaya government is investing in luxury tourist facilities and infrastructure. HoweverRs. there is a need to further enhance accommodation facilities to meet the expectations of high-value tourists while preserving the state's heritage.
benefits: 1. 35% of total project cost supported (5% by entrepreneurRs. 25% as front-ended subsidyRs. 10% as EMI copayment by Government of Meghalayasemi_colon max project cost 1.5 CrRs. max subsidy 52.5 lakh). 1. Loan up to 95% of project cost with a 15-year repayment term and 18-month moratorium Government-funded villa design consultancy blending ethnic aesthetics with modern comfortRs. tailored to location. 1. Priority allocation in scenic rural/agricultural/tourist clusters to boost visibility and occupancy. 1. Training in hospitality and bookkeeping with reputed institutes/hotels in Meghalaya. 1. RegularRs. monitoringRs. and need-based training during the initial yearsRs. with a dedicated app/dashboard for progress tracking.
eligibility: **Individuals should:** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The applicant should apply only for new projects sanctioned under the scheme. 1. The applicant should own the land for the project and possess valid land documentsRs. or the applicant should have a notarized lease agreement for a minimum period of 15 years. **Registered Entities should:** 1. The entity should be a registered societyRs. cooperativeRs. or similar organization involved in tourism-related activities. 1. The entity should be legally registered with the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity should provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration CertificateRs. whichever is applicable. 1. The entity should not be a defaulter at any financial institution. 1. The entity should hold land ownership for the project site or have a valid lease certified by competent authorities.

name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
brief_description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee" is a Sub-Component of the Scheme "Integrated Coffee Development Project During the Medium Term Framework (MTF) Period: Development Support to Stakeholders" by the Coffee BoardRs. Department of CommerceRs. Ministry of Commerce and Industry. This scheme aims to facilitate afforestation in the Jhum lands and help settle the tribals on a permanent footing.
benefits:
**Unit Cost:** 1Rs./per hectare. **Scale of Subsidy:** 50% of the Unit CostRs. i.e.Rs. 50Rs./per hectare.
**Release of Subsidy:** In two installments - 1st installment: 60% of the unit cost - 2nd installment: 40% of the unit cost
> **Procedure for Payment of Subsidy to the Grower** The Joint Director (Extn.) / Deputy Director (Extn.) after confirming the admissibility of the claim will release the 1st and 2nd installments of the eligible subsidy amountRs. as the case may beRs. to the grower's bank account **EFT/RTGS/NEFT**.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a tribal grower.
1. The applicant's area should be suitable for coffee cultivation as per the opinion of the Coffee Board's officers.
1. The applicant should procure the seed material from the Coffee Board only.

name: Scheme For Grant Of Rewards To The Children Of Salt Labourers
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Grant of Rewards to the Children of Salt Labourers was launched by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)Rs. Ministry of Commerce and Industry in the year 1985. InitiallyRs. the scheme known as Scheme for grant of rewards to the children of labourers working in Salt Industry (CRS) was initiated for granting 20 rewards to the children of the salt workers to enable them to meet the initial expenses either partly or wholly for purchase of booksRs. stationeriesRs. etc.Rs. on admission to recognized institutes for higher studies.
Since 2011-12 the numbers of rewards are 3500 with a financial implication of 45.00 Lakh. Under the schemeRs. the financial assistance will be given as 1000/- for the students of classes VI to VIIIRs. 1500/- for classes IX to XRs. and 2000/- for classes XI to XII with the proviso that awards for girl child be reserved to a minimum of 50% allocation per state. In the absence of female students in a particular Salt Factory/StateRs. the reward could be given to the available eligible male students in each category of other Salt Factory/State.
benefits:
1. The rewards shall be granted once in each academic year to the meritorious children of salt workers to enable the students to meet the initial expenses either partly or wholly for the purchase of booksRs. stationeryRs. etc. on admission to a recognized InstituteRs. recognized by the State/Central Government.
1. The rewards shall be granted to the students of the salt workers in cashRs. to be paid in one lump sum at the commencement of the academic year at the rates given below:

**Student/Classes****Rewards in an academic year**Students of classes VI to VIII1000/-Students of classes IX to X1500/-Students of classes XI to XII 2000/-
eligibility:
1. The children of only those salt workers who have put in a minimum of one year of continuous service in any of the salt works & passing from a recognized Government School are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. A child of a salt worker should be studying in Class VI to XII.
1. A child of a salt worker to be eligible for a reward should have passed the examination in the first attempt.

**Note 01:** Preference will be givenRs. other things being equal to the SC/ST/BC/Backward area applicants if applicants are both from either of these categories and the general category.
**Note 02:** The awards for girl children be reserved to a minimum of 50% allocation per state. In the absence of female students in a particular Salt Factory/StateRs. the reward could be given to the available eligible male students in each category of other Salt Factory/State.

name: Women Scientist Scheme-A
brief_description: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineeringRs. preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employmentRs. to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession. This scheme will provide a research grant for a well-defined project proposal for a period of maximum three years. This grant will cover the fellowship of the applicant and cost of small equipmentRs. contingenciesRs. travelRs. consumablesRs. etc. Institutional overhead charges will be extra. The support is available in 5 disciplines under WOS-A namelyRs. i) Physical & Mathematical Sciences (PMS)Rs. ii) Chemical Sciences (CS)Rs. iii) Life Sciences (LS)Rs. iv) Earth & Atmospheric Sciences (EAS)Rs. and v) Engineering Technology (ET). The scheme plays pivotal role in gender mainstreaming as it not only prevents brain drain from S&T system but also train and retain women in the system. The scheme initially offers opportunity to work as bench-level scientists and ultimately open new avenues for permanent position in Science & Technology.
benefits: 1. 55Rs./- pm (and HRA as applicable) for Ph.D. or equivalent (total project cost not exceeding 30 lakh) 1. 40Rs./- pm (and HRA as applicable) for M.Phil./MTech or equivalent (total project cost not exceeding 25 lakh) 1. 31Rs./- pm (and HRA as applicable) for M.Sc. or equivalent (total project cost not exceeding 20 lakh) > This grant will cover the fellowship of the applicant and cost of small equipmentsRs. contingenciesRs. travelRs. consumablesRs. etc. > The benefits are provided for a period of maximum three years. > The payment of the scholarship will be through DBT.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a FEMALE. 1. The applicant must either be unemployed or in a position other than regular/permanent position. 1. The age of the applicant must be between 27 and 57 years (5 year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and physically challenged candidates) 1. The applicant must hold either of the following Minimum essential qualification - - Minimum Post Graduate degreeRs. equivalent to M.Sc. in Basic or Applied Sciences or B.Tech. or MBBS or other equivalent professional qualifications. - M.Phil/M.Tech/M.Pharm/M.VSc or equivalent qualifications. - Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences.

name: Womens Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovation
brief_description: A new programme Women's Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovations (WIDUSHI) is started by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) under its umbrella scheme Women in Science and Engineering-KIRAN (WISE-KIRAN) for senior women scientists to harness their knowledge and potential for the betterment of Science and Society. WIDUSHI programme aims to encourage and support senior women scientists to conduct research in interdisciplinary areas of Science and Technology.
benefits: > **Category A:** - **Fellowship (Principal Investigator):** 75Rs./- per month - **Research Assistant:** 1 position provided - **Research Grant:** 5Rs. per year - **Institutional Overhead Charges:** 1Rs./- per annum > **Category B:** - **Fellowship (Principal Investigator):** 85Rs./- per month - **Research Assistant:** 1 position provided - **Research Grant:** 5Rs. per year - **Institutional Overhead Charges:** 1Rs./- per annum
eligibility: > **Category A: The following are the primary eligibility criteria-** 1. **Employment:** Women Scientists who are permanent employees but retiring in a year or already retired/superannuated from government academic/research institutions. 1. **Age:** 57-62 years 1. **Qualification:** Women Scientists having Ph.D. in Basic/Applied Sciences or equivalent degree. 1. **Research Experience:** Minimum 2 R&D projects as Principal Investigator with excellent track record. 1. **Publications:** Minimum 20 research publications with impact factor. > **Category B: The following are the primary eligibility criteria-** 1. **Employment:** Women who are not permanent employees in any institution but working temporarily and have completed 2 independent research projects as Principal Investigator. 1. **Age:** 45-62 years 1. **Qualification:** Women Scientists having Ph.D. in Basic/Applied Sciences or equivalent degree. 1. **Research Experience:** Minimum 2 R&D projects as Principal Investigator with excellent track record. 1. **Publications:** Minimum 10 research publications with impact factor. > **Proposals are invited from senior women scientists in the following scientific disciplines:** 1. Physical & Mathematical Sciences 1. Chemical Sciences 1. Life Sciences 1. Earth & Atmospheric Sciences 1. Engineering & Technology 1. S&T-based Societal Research > **Co-Investigator (Co-I):** 'WIDUSHI' fellow should choose a permanent faculty as Co-I (male/female) of the project for academic and administrative support in project implementation. The service of Co-I has to be due for a period not less than the proposed period of the WIDUSHI project. The Co-I is not eligible for any separate grants under the programme.

name: Mobility Scheme
brief_description:
The Mobility Scheme was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriageRs. transfer of husband to any other location within the countryRs. attending ailing parentsRs. and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.
benefits: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration. - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation. - **Research Grant:** 5Rs./- per annum is provided for consumablesRs. contingenciesRs. travelRs. and minor equipment. - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for this award. This award will not be available for renewal after completion of 5 years duration.
eligibility: - Woman scientists/academicians working at permanent position in any Government Institution/R&D Lab/University and willing to resign from their permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and after completion of the tenure return back to the parent organization. - The new place should be located beyond 500 Km from present city. - Upper age limit is 50 years to apply.

name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
brief_description:
A scholarship scheme by the University Grants Commission for Girl students who are admitted in the first year of PG courses in any designated university or a postgraduate collegeRs. and happen to be the only girl child in the family. The amount of fellowship is 36Rs./- p.a. for the full duration of a PG course. The scheme has been introduced with an aim to compensate direct costs of girl education at all levelsRs. especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their families.
The objectives of the proposed scheme are: a) To support the postgraduate education of single girl children in postgraduate courses only. b) To recognize the value of observance of the small family norms.
The candidates are required to apply online on National Scholarship Portal after initiation of the application process and notice to be published on the UGC website. 3Rs. fresh scholarships will be awarded every year and will be paid on DBT mode on annual basis.
benefits:
> **Nature of Assistance Available Under the Scheme** Amount of fellowship: 36Rs./- per annum for a period of two years only i.e. full duration of a PG course. 3Rs. fresh scholarships will be awarded every year and will be paid on DBT mode on annual basis.
> ***Note*** No other additional grant will be payable in lieu of hostel charges and medical chargesRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant must be the only girl child in the family. 1. Girl students without having any brothers or the girl student who are twin daughters/ fraternal daughters may also apply 1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 30 years at the time of admission in the first year of PG 1. course. 1. The applicant must have taken admission to regularRs. full-time first-year master's degree courses in any designated university or a postgraduate college. 1. The candidate should be pursuing a non-professional course and be taking regular classes from a recognized institution. 1. The applicant must not be pursuing education through distance education mode. 1. This scholarship is available to PG-I year students only.

name: Post Matric Scholarship To Scheduled Tribe Students Of Nagaland
brief_description: The Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) has launched the Post Matric Scholarship To Scheduled Tribe Students Of Nagalandscheme for providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state. The student must be studying or getting admission to the post-matric class (class 11thRs. 12Rs. UGRs. PG Degree).Post-matric Scholarship for ST Scholarship is awarded to the students of the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of India. The objective of the ST scholarship is to provide financial assistance to these students to complete their studies at the college level.
benefits: 1. To provide social security provisions to the students of post-metric classes. 1. Students will be able to pursue studies. 1. To provide financial assistance to these students to complete their studies at the college level. 1. Providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state.
eligibility: - The applicant should be pursuing post-matric studies (above Class X) and belong to the Scheduled Tribe of Nagaland. - The applicant should have parents/guardians annual income not exceeding 2.50 lakh from all sources. - The applicant should be studying in an institution with a valid AISHE/UDISE code. - The applicant should not be a repeater (students who failed in the last examination are not eligible). - The applicant should not have availed this scholarship at the same stage of education in a different stream or subject. - The applicant should not have a study break of more than two years. - The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme. - The applicant should not be employed in any Government or Semi-Government establishment. - The applicant should be pursuing a Diploma or Certificate course of at least two years durationRs. if applicableRs. and must fulfil all the above criteria. - The applicant should be studying under NIOSRs. if applicableRs. and must fulfil the above criteria and have passed Class 10 with EnglishRs. Alternative English/MILRs. ScienceRs. MathematicsRs. and Social Science for Class 11 or 12 level courses.

name: National Savings Time Deposit (TD)
brief_description: The National Savings Time Deposit (TD) SchemeRs. operated by the Department of Posts under the Ministry of CommunicationsRs. offers an interest rate ranging from 6.9% to 7.5% per annum. The minimum deposit required to open an account is 1000Rs. and deposits can be made in multiples of 100. There is no maximum limit on the amount that can be invested in this scheme.
benefits: Interest payableRs. RatesRs. Periodicity etc.Minimum Amount for opening of account and maximum balance that can be retained6.9% to 7.5%Minimum INR 1000/- and in multiples of 100. No maximum limit.**Interest Rates** Interest rates From 01.01.2024 to 31.03.2024 - 1 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 6.9% - 2 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 7.0% - 3 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 7.1% - 5 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 7.5% **Deposits** - Four categories of the TD Accounts are available i.e.Rs.-year TDRs. 2-year TDRs. 3-year TD and 5-year TD. - Account can be opened with minimum of 1000 and in multiple of 100. - No maximum limit for investment. - Interest shall be compounded quarterly and payable annually. - No additional interest shall be payable on the amount of interest that has become due for payment but not withdrawn by the account holder. - The annual interest may be credited either to the Post Office Savings Account or Bank Account of the customer if mandate (standing instruction/ ECS mandate) is given in writing. - The investment under 5-year TD qualifies for the benefit of section 80C of Income Tax ActRs. 1961
eligibility: 1. The individual must be a resident citizen of India. 1. The individual may open an account as a single adult. 1. The guardian may open an account on behalf of a minor. 1. The guardian may open an account on behalf of a person of unsound mind (Authorised Account). 1. The minor who has attained the age of 10 years may also open and operate the account. 1. The individual Joint Account (up to three adults) (Joint A or Joint B) - Joint A typeRs. to be operated by all the depositors or the surviving depositors jointly. - Joint B typeRs. to be operated by any of the depositors or the surviving depositors separately Note:Any number of accounts can be opened in individuals name or jointly with another Note: Upon reaching the age of 18 yearsRs. account holders must submit a new Account Opening Form (AOF) and fresh KYC documents at their Post Office to convert their minor account into to an adult account Note: Accounts can also be opened through e-Banking or Mobile Banking facility. It is to be noted that Post Office Savings Account is a prerequisite for availing internet banking facility (Please [Click ](https://ebanking.indiapost.gov.in/corp/AuthenticationController?FORMSGROUP_ID__=AuthenticationFG&__START_TRAN_FLAG__=Y&__FG_BUTTONS__=LOAD&ACTION.LOAD=Y&AuthenticationFG.LOGIN_FLAG=1&BANK_ID=DOP)here or visit www[dot]ebanking[dot]indiapost[dot]gov[dot]in)

name: Financial Assistance for Tagore Cultural Complexes (TCC)
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Tagore Cultural Complexes (TCC) scheme by the Ministry of CultureRs. Government of India. The revised version of the schemeRs. earlier known as the Tagore Cultural Complexes schemeRs. has been included as a component under the Scheme of Financial Assistance for Creation of Cultural Infrastructure for its continuation beyond the 12th Five-Year Plan. This scheme aims to foster and coordinate cultural activities across States and Union Territories in fields such as musicRs. dramaRs. danceRs. literatureRs. and fine arts. It promotes cultural unity in the country and provides avenues for creative expression and learningRs. especially for the younger generation. The cultural complexes developed under this scheme function as centres of excellence in various art formsRs. equipped with infrastructure for stage performancesRs. exhibitionsRs. seminarsRs. literary eventsRs. and film screenings. These complexes are designed to go beyond the original Tagore Auditorium concept by encouraging multi-dimensional creativity and cultural expression.
benefits: **Nature and Extent of Financial Assistance** 1. Financial assistance under the scheme component for any project will normally be up to a maximum of 15 crores. In extremely rare casesRs. of outstanding merit and relevanceRs. the financial assistance can go up to 50 croresRs. but then each such individual case of Central assistance beyond 15 crores will be subjected to the usual appraisal/ approval mechanism prescribed for new Plan schemes. 1. The maximum amount of Central financial assistance which may be given under this scheme component would be 60% of the total approved project cost subject to the maximum financial ceiling as mentioned in para 5.1 above except in case of projects in North Eastern Region(NER). The remaining amount of 40% of the total approved project cost will be borne by the recipient State Govt./UT Admin./NGO or concerned organization. Cost of land will not be included in matching share. Developed land with approach road will be made available by the concerned State GovernmentRs. free of costRs. unless the organization has land of its ownership. 1. In case of projects in North Eastern Region (NER) [comprises States of Arunachal PradeshRs. AssamRs. ManipurRs. MeghalayaRs. MizoramRs. NagalandRs. Sikkim and Tripura] the maximum amount of Central financial assistance would be 90% of the total approved project cost subject to the maximum financial ceiling as mentioned in para 5.1 above. The remaining amount of 10% of the total approved project cost will be borne by the recipient State Govt./NGO or concerned organization. Cost of land will not be included in matching share. Developed land with approach road will be made available by the concerned State GovernmentRs. free of costRs. unless the organization has land of its ownership. 1. All recurring expenditure will be met by the State Government/ UT Admin. or concerned organization. 1. 0.5% of project cost may be released for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) on the recommendations of Sub-Committee and National Appraisal Committee (NAC).
eligibility: 1. The organization must be registered as a society under the Registration of Societies Act (XXI of 1860) or under a similar ActRs. or as a Trust or Not-for-Profit Company for at least three years. 1. The organizations charter must be primarily devoted to the preservationRs. propagationRs. and promotion of Indian arts and culture. 1. The organization must have a predominantly cultural profile and should have been actively working in fields such as danceRs. dramaRs. theatreRs. musicRs. fine artsRs. IndologyRs. and literature for at least three years. 1. The organization must be well established and recognized for doing meaningful work in its field of activity. 1. The organization must have gained a localRs. regionalRs. or national identity and reputation/standing. 1. The organization must be capable of setting up and operating the project effectively. 1. The organization must be able to arrange 40% of the project cost (for Non-North Eastern Region projects) or 10% (for North Eastern Region projects) as its matching share. 1. The organization must be capable of meeting the recurring costs of the project. 1. The organization must have been inspected and recommended by an appropriate agency of the Central Government or the concerned State Government/UT Administration.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Power Tiller
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: Power Tiller" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing a power tillerRs. with up to 90% of the cost covered through a loan. This initiative aims to support agricultural productivity by making essential farming equipment more accessible. The interest rate on the loan ranges from 11% to 12.25%.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 90% of the cost of a power tiller. - **Interest Rate:** 11% to 12.25% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in agricultural activities. - The beneficiary should be interested in availing of a loan for purchasing power tiller. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for purchasing power tiller.

name: Special Incentive to ST (P)/OBC/MOBC Meritorious Students
brief_description: The scheme "Special Incentive to ST (P)/OBC/MOBC Meritorious Students" by the Directorate of Welfare of Plains Tribes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from Scheduled Tribes (Plains)Rs. Other Backward ClassesRs. and More Other Backward Classes communities in Assam. The scheme offers monetary grants to students who achieve high academic marks in MatriculationRs. 10+2Rs. GraduationRs. or Post Graduation examinations. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must belong to the ST (P)/OBC/MOBC community and meet the specified percentage criteria for their respective educational level. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plains Tribes and Backward ClassesRs. Assam. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed formats advertised in print and electronic media.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance** - 10Rs./- for students passing Matriculation (Class X) with 80% or above. - 15Rs./- for students passing 10+2 with 75% or above. - 20Rs./- for Graduation students with 70% or above. - 25Rs./- for Post Graduation students with 65% or above.
> **Disbursement Conditions** - Benefits are granted on a first-comeRs. first-served basisRs. subject to fund availability. - The Selection Committee may lower cut-off marks if insufficient applications are received. - Financial assistance is transferred to the bank accounts of selected beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (Plain) / Other Backward Class / More Other Backward Class community of Assam.
2. The applicant must qualify as one of the following:

- Secured 80% or above in Matriculation (Class 10th).
- Secured 75% or above in 10+2 examination.
- Secured 70% or above in Graduation.
- Secured 65% or above in Post Graduation.

_*The applicant cannot claim the benefit as a right; approval depends on fund availability and Selection Committee discretion._

name: Agnipath Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "AGNIPATH" has been implemented by the Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of IndiaRs. and aims to recruit youth into the Armed Forces for a short-term service while enabling a youthfulRs. technologically adeptRs. and dynamic military force. Through this schemeRs. an attractive financial packageRs. skill developmentRs. and military training are provided to patriotic and motivated youth willing to serve the nation. The scheme is implemented by the Indian Armed Forces (Indian ArmyRs. Indian NavyRs. and Indian Air Force). AGNIPATH allows selected candidatesRs. known as AgniveersRs. to serve for a period of four years under respective Service Acts. It is designed to enhance the youthful profile of the Armed Forces and bring in individuals aligned with modern technological trends. The scheme also aims to develop disciplinedRs. skilledRs. and motivated individuals who can contribute to nation-building after their service tenure. It further ensures a balance between experienced personnel and young recruits in the Armed Forces.
benefits: Agniveers will be given an attractive customized monthly package along with Risk and Hardship allowances as applicable in the three services. On completion of the engagement period of four yearsRs. Agniveers will be paid a one-time SevaNidhi package which shall comprise their contribution including accrued interest thereon and a matching contribution from the Government equal to the accumulated amount of their contribution including interest as indicated below: **Year****Customized Package (Monthly)** [All figures in (Monthly Contribution)]**In-Hand (70%)** [All figures in (Monthly Contribution)]**Contribution to Agniveer Corpus Fund (30%)** [All figures in (Monthly Contribution)]**Contribution to corpus fund by GoI** [All figures in (Monthly Contribution)]1st Year30000/-21000/-9000/-9000/-2nd Year33000/-23100/-9900/-99003rd Year36500/-25580/-10950/-109504th Year40000/-28000/-12000/-12000/-**Total contribution in Agniveer Corpus Fund after four years****5.02 Lakh****5.02 Lakh**Exit After 4 Year**11.71 Lakh as SevaNidhi Package** (IncludingRs. interest accumulated on the above amount as per the applicable interest rates would also be paid)> **Note 01:** The Seva Nidhi will be exempt from Income Tax. > **Note 02:** There shall be no entitlement to gratuity and pensionary benefits. > **Note 03:** Agniveers will be provided non-contributory Life Insurance Cover of 48 lakh for the duration of their engagement period in the Indian Armed Forces.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. For the 2022 intakeRs. the age of the applicant should be between 17.5 to 23 years. For the subsequent intakesRs. the age of the applicant should be between 17.5 to 21 years. 1. The applicant must fulfil the educational qualifications and physical and medical standards set by the Indian Army / Indian Navy / Indian Air Force. > **Note 01:** The Agniveers will be enrolled in the Forces under respective Service Acts for a period of four years. They would form a distinct rank in the Armed ForcesRs. different from any other existing ranks. > **Note 02:** Upon the completion of four years of serviceRs. based on organizational requirements and policies promulgated by the Armed Forces from time to timeRs. Agniveers will be offered an opportunity to apply for permanent enrolment in the Armed Forces. > **Note 03:** The applications for permanent enrolment will be considered in a centralized manner based on objective criteria including performance during their four-year engagement period and up to 25% of each specific batch of Agniveers will be enrolled in the regular cadre of the Armed Forces. The selection will be the exclusive jurisdiction of the Armed Forces. > **Note 04:** Agniveers will meet the medical eligibility conditions laid down for enrolment in the armed forces as applicable to respective categories/trades. > **Note 05:** The educational qualification for Agniveers will remain as in vogue for enrollment in various categories.

name: Pradhan Mantri Virasat ka Samvardhan
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan (PM VIKAS) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs which converges five erstwhile schemes viz. Seekho Aur KamaoRs. Nai ManzilRs. Nai Roshni and USTTAD & Hamari Dharohar schemes and focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minority communities (MuslimsRs. ChristiansRs. SikhsRs. BuddhistsRs. JainsRs. and Parsis) through the following: i. Skilling and Training (Non-traditional and traditional) ii. Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship iii. Education (through National Institute of Open Schooling) iv. Infrastructure Development (through Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram) **Scheme Objectives**: The initiative aims to empower minority communities through targeted skill trainingRs. formal education via open schoolingRs. and improved livelihood opportunities. It promotes the preservation cultural heritage and traditional arts and crafts. Women from minority communities are empowered through leadership and entrepreneurship support. Market and credit linkages are provided to enhance employability and enterprise. **Salient Features:** 1) Aims at holistic development of minority communities through skillingRs. educationRs. entrepreneurshipRs. and cultural heritage preservation. 2) Merges five earlier schemes: Seekho aur KamaoRs. USTTADRs. Hamari DharoharRs. Nai RoshniRs. and Nai Manzil. 3) Focuses on traditional and modern skill trainingRs. womens leadershipRs. education for school dropoutsRs. and infrastructure development. 4) Special emphasis on womenRs. youthRs. and persons with disabilities from six notified minority communities. 5) Provides financial supportRs. market linkagesRs. and credit access through convergence with other government schemes. 6) 100% central funding for trainingRs. educationRs. and entrepreneurship; infrastructure support via Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) on a cost-sharing basis. **Target Beneficiaries:** 1) Indian nationals belonging to the six notified minority communities: MuslimsRs. ChristiansRs. SikhsRs. BuddhistsRs. JainsRs. and Parsis with following: a. Minority individuals aged 1445 years for skilling and education; 1845 years for women leadership and entrepreneurship. b. Women beneficiaries: Minimum 33% in skillingRs. 50% in educationRs. and 100% in women leadership and entrepreneurship component. c. Persons with Disabilities (PwDs): 3% reservation across all components. 2) Up to 25% non-minority (EWS) candidates may be included in Traditional Skilling and 15% in other components to promote inter-community solidarity. **Benefits:** 1) Provides skill development in both traditional crafts and modern sectors to enhance employability of minority youth. 2) Empowers minority women through leadership and entrepreneurship trainingRs. including support to start enterprises. 3) Offers bridge education for school dropouts to complete classes 8thRs. 10thRs. and 12th via open schooling. 4) Facilitates access to creditRs. market linkagesRs. and e-commerce platforms for artisans and entrepreneurs. 5) Promotes preservation and promotion of traditional artsRs. craftsRs. and cultural heritage. 6) Ensures inclusive development by converging with other government schemes and leveraging existing infrastructure.
benefits: 1) Skill training (both traditional and modern). 2) Education support (8th stdRs. 10th std. and 12th std.). 3) Leadership and entrepreneurship support for women. 4) Stipend support to trainees.
eligibility: - The Age of the applicant should be 14 to 45 years for skilling and education component and 18 to 45 years for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship Component - 33% of total seats in Skilling and Training componentRs. 50% of total seats in Education component and 100% of total seats in Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component are earmarked for women. - The education qualification for Skilling and Training component would be as per NSQF norms and Education component would be as per NIOS norms. Candidates with aptitude and leadership qualities will be selected for Women Leadership and Entrepreneurship component.

name: Pension Scheme to Widow- DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme Pension Scheme to Widow is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows aged between 18-59 years. This scheme offers 1Rs./- per month to help them meet their basic needs. Eligible beneficiaries should be domiciles of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & DiuRs. with an annual income not exceeding 1.5 lakh. The pension is discontinued if the widow remarries or enters a live-in relationship. AdditionallyRs. beneficiaries should not be receiving financial assistance under any other widow pension scheme. This initiative ensures essential financial support to widowsRs. helping them lead a dignified life.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. widows receive financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month.

**Note:** The mode of fund transfer shall be Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be a widow. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 59 years of age. 1. The benefit will be discontinued if the applicant remarries or enters a live-in relationship. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 1.5 lakh. 1. The applicant should not be receiving financial assistance under any other widow pension scheme.
**Special/General Conditions:** In case of non-availability of age proof the beneficiary shall be referred to Medical Board (Government Hospital) of the concerned district for verification of age. After attaining age of 60 yearsRs. the beneficiary shall be transferred to the Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen).

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Scheme" was launched in February 2009 by the Ministry of Rural DevelopmentRs. headed by the central governmentRs. to support disabled people in our country. This schemeRs. introduced under the National Social Assistance Program provides a monthly pension to disabled people for the prosperity of their lives. Any disabled person whose age is more than 18 yearsRs. and with a disability of 80% or more belonging to the poverty line can apply for this scheme.
benefits: - A pension of 300/- per month is provided to Divyangjan between 18-79 years. - A pension of 500/- per month will be provided to Divyangjan aged 80 years and above.
eligibility: 1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years and above. 1. The applicant should be a resident of India. 1. The applicant should be a physically or mentally disabled person. 1. The applicants disability should be more than 80%. 1. Dwarfs are also eligible for this scheme. 1. The applicant should belong to the below poverty line.

name: Market Development Assistance
brief_description: The scheme "Market Development Assistance" was launched by the Ministry of Chemicals & FertilizersRs. Department of FertilizersRs. and the scheme aims to promote organic fertilizers produced at plants under the umbrella Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative covering various Bio-Gas and Compressed Bio-Gas support schemes. The scheme provides Market Development Assistance at 1Rs./- per Metric Tonne for the sale of Fermented Organic ManureRs. Liquid Fermented Organic ManureRs. and enriched Phosphate Rich Organic ManureRs. along with gap funding for research from a corpus of 3Rs./-. The applicant must register their manufacturing units on the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan portal and market the fertilizers in conformity with the Fertilizer Control Order specifications.
benefits: - Market Development Assistance of 1Rs./- per Metric Tonne is provided for the sale of Fermented Organic ManureRs. Liquid Fermented Organic ManureRs. and enriched Phosphate Rich Organic Manure. - A corpus of 3Rs./- is available for research gap fundingRs. to be utilized only by Central and State Research Institutes or non-private fertilizer cooperatives. - The total budget outlay for the scheme is 14Rs./- for three years from Financial Year 2023-24 to Financial Year 2025-26. ##### ***Disbursal*** - Assistance is provided only for the quantity sold through Point of Sale machines. - Assistance claims must be generated through the Integrated Fertilizer Management System portal using Direct Benefit Transfer. - Claims must be submitted within two months of the sale of the organic fertilizers. ##### ***Conditions*** - Marketing entities must print the Maximum Retail Price along with applicable Market Development Assistance on the bags clearly. - Any State subsidy provided on the organic fertilizers must be passed on to the farmers in terms of a lower Maximum Retail Price. - Each bag must display its constituents as given in the Fertilizer Control OrderRs. the marketing entities' namesRs. the manufacturer's nameRs. and shelf-life. - Marketing entities must ensure that any sale above the printed net Maximum Retail Price is avoidedRs. as it is punishable under the Essential Commodities Act.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a manufacturing-cum-marketing entityRs. a Compressed Bio-Gas operatorRs. a Bio-gas operatorRs. a marketerRs. or a distributor under the umbrella Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative. - The applicant must be a Fertilizer Marketing Company marketing their organic fertilizers. - The applicant must produce organic fertilizers at Bio-Gas or Compressed Bio-Gas plants established under the umbrella Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative. - The applicant must ensure the Bio-Gas or Compressed Bio-Gas plants are supported under initiatives like the Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation schemeRs. the Waste to Energy programmeRs. or the Swachh Bharat Mission. - The applicant must register the Bio-Gas or Compressed Bio-Gas units with the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan portal of the Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation as a pre-requisite condition. - The applicant must market Fermented Organic ManureRs. Liquid Fermented Organic ManureRs. or enriched Phosphate Rich Organic Manure. - The applicant must market the organic fertilizers in packed form. - The applicant must ensure the organic fertilizers conform to the specifications mentioned in the Fertilizer Control OrderRs. 1985. - The applicant must undergo quality testing at Government notified laboratories or National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories accredited private laboratories. ##### ***Relaxations*** - The applicant may market the fertilizers in bulk or loose form on an experimental basis subject to necessary notifications by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare. - Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies may be engaged as aggregators by the Fertilizers Marketing Companies or manufacturersRs. wherever feasible. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain records of a permanent nature in continuity year after year. - The applicant must make all permanent records available to the Department of Fertilizers or the Fertilizer Flying Squad for audit and verification.

name: National Post Doctoral Fellowship
brief_description:
The National Post Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF) was launched by the Science and Engineering Research BoardRs. Government of India to identify motivated young researchers and provide them support for doing research in frontier areas of science and engineering. The fellows will work under a mentorRs. and it is hoped that this training will provide them with a platform to develop as independent researchers.
> **Duration of fellowship:**


- The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment and is tenable for a period of 2 years.
benefits:
**The fellows will be entitled to receive the grants as given below:**
**Sl. No.****Budget Head****Amount**1Fellowship55Rs./- per month (consolidated) and 35Rs./- per month for candidates who have submitted the thesis but degree not awarded2Research Grant2Rs./- per annum3Overheads1Rs./- per annum**Note 01:** Research grants can be used for minor equipmentRs. consumablesRs. contingenciesRs. and domestic travel. There is no provision for providing research personnel support under this scheme. The Fellow is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the fellowship.
**Note 02:** The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Governmental source during the tenure of the fellowship.
**Note 03:** The fellows must seek the consent of SERB if he/she intends to be away from the implementing institute (except for field work related to the project) continuously for a period of more than eight weeks.
> **Leave:**

SERB PDFs are entitled to leave as per the rules of the host institution. Participation in scientific workshops held in India or abroad will be treated as on duty. Maternity leave as per the Govt. of India instructions issued from time to time would be available to female candidates in all categories.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen.
1. The applicant must have obtained PhD/M.D/M.S degree from a recognized University. Those who have submitted their PhD/M.D/M.S. thesis and are awaiting the award of the degree are also eligible to apply. HoweverRs. such candidatesRs. if selectedRs. will be offered a lower fellowship amount till they qualify for the eligible degree.
1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 35 years at the time of the submission of the applicationRs. age will be calculated by taking the date of closure of the respective call. Age relaxation of 5 (five) years will be given to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged & Women candidates.
1. NPDF can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career.
1. The mentor must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India. Should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering.
1. A mentor shall not have more than two SERB NPDF fellows at any given time.

**Note 01:** The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized academic institutionsRs. national laboratoriesRs. and other recognized R&D institutions. The host institution should provide the necessary administrative and infrastructural support.
**Note 02:** The fellows will not be allowed to work with the Ph.D. guide/co-guide. It is also normally not availed at the same Department/institution where the candidates have earned their PhD/M.S./M.D degree.

name: Right To Information Fellowship
brief_description: The Department of Personnel and Training (DOPT)Rs. Ministry of PersonnelRs. Public Grievances and PensionsRs. Government of IndiaRs. is the nodal Ministry for the Right to Information Act. The primary goal of the "Right to Information Fellowship" scheme is to contribute towards more accountable and transparent government and it has several components including programmes for awareness generationRs. training and e-governance initiatives for RTI for achieving the purpose. Under this schemeRs. DOPT proposes to offer 4(Four) short-term fellowships to researchers from the field of media / Civil Society professionals / RTI Trainers to conduct field-based research on themes relating to RTI. It is hoped that the research output will enhance the understanding of the status of the implementation of the actRs. including its successesRs. constraints in its implementation and how those are being / could be overcome and what more needs to be done to help achieve the objectives of the Act.
benefits: > **Stipend** - A stipend of 50Rs./- per month for three months. (subject to tax deduction at source) > **Additional Grant** - 50Rs./- for booksRs. research materialRs. travelRs. printingRs. production of creativesRs. etc.Rs. sanctioned on the basis of the research proposal and released on production of actual bills.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a professional in the field of journalism (newspaper/ magazine/ radio/ TV)Rs. Civil Society and research and training in the field of RTI.
1. The applicant should be between 25 and 40 years of age.
1. The applicant should have proven credentials in his / her professional area.
1. The applicant should have some prior experience of work relating to the Right to Information.
1. The applicant should have an aptitude for research.

name: Biotechnology Research Innovation And Entrepreneurship Development (Bio-RIDE)
brief_description: The scheme "Biotechnology Research Innovation And Entrepreneurship Development (Bio-RIDE)" was launched by the Department of BiotechnologyRs. Ministry of Science and Technology. The scheme aims to propel the nation toward sustainable green growth and a robust bioeconomy. The scheme provides comprehensive support including seed fundingRs. incubation supportRs. extramural research grantsRs. and substantial financial assistance to establish shared infrastructure like bio-artificial intelligence hubsRs. biofoundriesRs. and biomanufacturing hubs. The applicant must be a legally registered entity in India possessing demonstrated prior experience in the applied areas of bio-services or high-performance biomanufacturing. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Biotechnology and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance CouncilRs. and the applications for this scheme are accepted primarily through periodic national calls on their official digital portals.
benefits:
- The scheme has a total proposed financial outlay of 91Rs./- for the period spanning from 2021-22 to 2025-26. - Startups receive seed fundingRs. incubation supportRs. and dedicated mentorship to nurture a thriving ecosystem for bio-entrepreneurs. - ResearchersRs. institutionsRs. and universities receive extramural funding and direct grants for cutting-edge research and development in modern biology. - Financial assistance of up to 50Rs./- is provided for the setting up of Bio-Artificial Intelligence Hubs. - Financial assistance of up to 65Rs./- is provided for the setting up of Biofoundries. - Financial assistance of up to 75Rs./- is provided for the setting up of Biomanufacturing Hubs. - Coordinating hubs are eligible to propose an annual budget of up to 50Rs./- to comprehensively cover the operational costs of collaborating projects. - Academic institutions receive funding through grant-in-aid mechanisms for mission mode projects as per the extramural research guidelines of the Department of Biotechnology. - StartupsRs. small and medium enterprisesRs. and industries seeking funding beyond 50Rs./- receive financial assistance through co-funding combined with royalty sharing or equity financing. - Private universitiesRs. non-governmental organizationsRs. trustsRs. and foundations receive capital support but are required to share 25% of the total capital investment cost. - Incubators or companies established by the Central Government or private universities receive funding with a mandatory co-funding requirement of a minimum of 30% of the total project cost. - Incubators or companies established by the State Government receive funding with a mandatory co-funding requirement of a minimum of 50% of the total project cost.
##### ***Conditions*** - StartupsRs. small and medium enterprisesRs. and industry applicants must contribute a minimum of 30% of the total project cost in cashRs. strictly excluding land and construction costs. - Joint industry-academia projects require the involved industry partner to share a minimum of 30% of the cost attributed to the industry component. - Beneficiaries opting for the royalty-sharing model must pay a 5% royalty on the net sales of the developed product until the paid royalty equals the disbursed financial assistance. - Beneficiaries opting for equity financing must agree to the government taking an equity stake through convertible notes that get compulsorily converted at the valuation of the first investment round of 10Rs./- or more within five yearsRs. or mandatorily at the end of the fifth year at a 20% discount of the latest valuation. - The applicant must successfully implement a clearly defined sustainability business plan to ensure continuous operations after the government support period is over. - In the event of project foreclosureRs. the beneficiary must completely refund the disbursed amount within 30 days from the date of foreclosure. - In the event of project termination due to non-complianceRs. the beneficiary must completely refund the disbursed amount along with a 12% interest within 30 days from the date of termination.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a legal entityRs. either for-profit or not-for-profit. - The applicant must be officially registered in India with the respective taxation and other administrative authorities. - The applicant must have tangible prior experience in the applied functional area of bio-services or biomanufacturing. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any Central Government. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any State Government. - The applicant must not be blacklisted by any Public Sector Undertaking of the Government of India. - The applicant must ensure that major promoters or the legal entity are not involved in any major litigation that may impact the delivery of assigned projects. - The applicant must strictly adhere to the data protectionRs. confidentialityRs. and conflict of interest policies laid down by the Department of Biotechnology and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council. - The applicantRs. if applying as a startupRs. small and medium enterpriseRs. or industryRs. must have a minimum of 51% of its stake owned and controlled by resident Indian citizens. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** - The applicant should preferably demonstrate proven expertiseRs. operational experienceRs. and access to pre-existing infrastructure. - The applicant should ideally have already secured the necessary regulatory clearances for their innovation or be close to obtaining them.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: Karnataka (Ha.) and other States
brief_description: Under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom implemented by the Spices Board India during the 15th Finance Commission period (202122 to 202526)Rs. assistance is provided for Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting in Karnataka and other states to motivate growers to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseasedRs. oldRs. and senile plantationsRs. as well as to promote area expansionRs. in accordance with the modalities and scheme guidelines approved by the Competent Authority.
benefits: 1. 33.33% of cost of cultivation of subject to a maximum of 75Rs./- per Ha for General Category and 75% of cost of cultivation 1Rs./- per Ha for SC/ST payable in two annual installments of 37Rs./- and 84Rs./- each year respectively. 1. Individual registered cardamom growers having a land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha. 1. Minimum area to be replanted under the programme is 0.10 Ha in a continuous block and the maximum area is limited to 2 Ha per beneficiary per year and a maximum of 8 Ha. in block year of 5 years from 2021-2026.The plant population is minimum 3000 Nos. per ha for closer planting [pure crop] and 1500 Nos in intercropped plantations. 1. Replanting cycle is considered as 8 years and a second time benefit for the same area replanted by a beneficiary will be available only on completion of 8 years except on exclusive circumstances like natural calamitiesRs. devastating pest and disease attacks as jointly certified by a committee constituted by Board.
eligibility: 1. The applicants from Karnataka and other states having potential areas suitable for Small Cardamom cultivation are eligible to apply under the scheme. 1. The applicants undertaking replanting/new planting as a pure crop using suckers will be given preferenceRs. subject to final inspection and recommendation by the designated officials.

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
brief_description: INSPIRE Fellowship is one of the components of INSPIRE scheme implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST)Rs. Government of India to strengthen the Science and Technology base of the country. This Component focuses on attracting students to pursue doctoral degrees in basic and applied sciences including engineeringRs. medicineRs. agricultureRs. veterinaryRs. pharmacyRs. etc. after either masters degree in science/engineering or a bachelor/ masters degree in Medicine.
benefits: > **Duration** The fellowship shall be tenable for a maximum period of five years from INSPIRE Fellowship Effective Date or completion of the Ph.D. program (i.e. up to the date of successful Ph.D. viva-voce)Rs. whichever is earlier. > **HRA** HRA to the Fellows shall also be applicable as per GoI norms depending upon the location of the Host Institute. > **Contingency Expenditure** Expenditure of contingency grant would be governed as per host institution norms. The limit of the contingency grant is 20Rs./annum. The unspent balance of the contingency grant at the end of a year shall be adjusted to the next year with a maximum ceiling of 20Rs.. > **Internship** INSPIRE Fellow shall be allowed for availing of a short-term Research Internship at any national or international Laboratory/ University/ Institute up to a maximum period of 18 months either in one or multiple slots during 5 years tenure of Fellowship. > **Upgradation of Fellowship from JRF to SRF** The up-gradation of Fellowship from Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) would normally be considered after the completion of two (2) years of INSPIRE Fellowship. HoweverRs. it can be considered after completion of one year as JRF if INSPIRE Fellow has an acceptance of at least one research paper (as a 1st Author) in any international peer-reviewed journal from the Ph.D. work carried out at the respective Host Institute. > **Mode and Cycle of Payment** The fellowship grant shall be transferred through PFMS to the students host institutes ZBSA Bank Account in the Bank of Maharashtra following CNA (Central Nodal Agency) Model. Host the institute shall transfer monthly fellowship to students bank accounts following the host institute norms.
eligibility: 1. 1st Rank Holders in any recognized University and academic Institutions (Excluding Autonomous Colleges) in India in Post-Graduate (PG) level examination in Basic/Applied Sciences including EngineeringRs. PharmacyRs. Agricultural SciencesRs. and Veterinary Sciences. 1. 1st Rank Holders at the Graduate/Post-graduate Level Examination in Medicine only conducted by a University/ Institution in India. 1. 1st Rank should be obtained in university in basic/applied science subject course/program having a batch size of a minimum of 07 students with a minimum aggregate of 70% marks (or CGPA equivalent) for the entire course/ program. **OR** 1. INSPIRE Scholars who have secured a minimum of 70% marks (or CGPA equivalent) in aggregate at M.Sc. integrated M.S. / M.Sc. **Note 1:** Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria for the INSPIRE Fellowship will not guarantee the final offer of fellowship. **Note 2:** Subject Expert Committee (SEC) will finally recommend the applications for the award of INSPIRE Fellowship considering the academic meritRs. research proposalRs. supervisors research credentials and host institutionRs. etc. parameters on a competitive basis. **Note 3:** This Fellowship shall be available only for pursuing a full-time Ph.D. program in any recognized University / Institution/ R&D Laboratory in the country. > **Post-Selection Eligibility Criteria for Continuation of the Fellowship** 1. Keep DST updated regarding the Research progress made during fellowship tenure. 1. INSPIRE Fellow shall not take any paid or unpaid assignment other than related to his/her approved research program. HoweverRs. if requiredRs. the fellow may assist the host institute in its academic activities as per Ph.D. program guidelines governed by the Host InstitutionRs. provided such assignments shall not hamper the progress of the research work of the fellow. 1. Once the INSPIRE Fellow joins the FellowshipRs. he/she shall complete the research work within the 5 years tenure of the fellowship to achieve the approved objectives of the research problem. 1. The INSPIRE Fellow must acknowledge the support provided by DST in all the publication(s)/patent(s) and Ph.D. Thesis. 1. Soft copy of the Ph.D. thesis published research papers and patent details if any shall be submitted in a USB storage device to the INSPIRE Programme Division of DST by speed post. 1. DST needs to be informed about any disciplinary action taken by the University against INSPIRE Fellow.

name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The Ministry of Tourism launched the Marketing Development Assistance (MDA) Scheme under the Overseas Promotion & Publicity (OPP) Scheme. The scheme aims to provide financial support to tourism service providers approved by the Ministry of TourismRs. Govt. of India or the respective State Government / Union Territory (UT) Administration for undertaking promotion and marketing of India in the overseas markets. > **Objectives****:** - To motivate stakeholders to promote tourism to the country from the overseas markets. - To enhance the visibility of the brand Incredible India in the overseas markets. - To augment foreign tourist arrivals to the country.
benefits:
**For Tourism Service Providers** Financial support for study toursRs. and participation in travel shows/exhibitions/road shows in overseas markets (organized by the Ministry of Tourism) will be provided up to a maximum of 3Rs./- per case/tour. **Sr. No.** **Particulars** **Extent of Support** 1Economy class airfare for travel between India to another country and from there to a group of countries by air/rail.90%2Cost of built-up/furnished stallRs. electricity and water chargesRs. participation feeRs. etc.Rs. at travel fair/exhibitions held overseas.90%3Lodging expenses on overseas tour Max. 5 nights with an upper ceiling of room rate at 10Rs./- per night.
**For Tourism Departments of State Governments / UT Administrations** Financial support for participation in overseas travel shows and exhibitions will be provided as follows: **Sr. No.** **Particulars** **Extent of Support**1. Cost of built-up/furnished stallRs. electricity and water chargesRs. participation feeRs. etc.Rs. at travel fair/exhibitions held overseas.Overall ceiling of 3Rs./-. 2. SinceRs. the representatives of State Govts and UTs are provided TA/DA by the States/UTsRs. the provisions of financial assistance towards international air fare and lodging are not applicable to them.
**For Tourism Service Providers /Tourism Departments of State Governments / UT Administrations** Financial support for online promotion of tourism destinations and products in overseas marketsRs. including digital content creationRs. will cover 50% of the total costRs. up to 1Rs./- per financial yearRs. subject to actuals.
eligibility: - The tourism service providers should be travel agentsRs. inbound tour operatorsRs. tourist transport operatorsRs. classified hotelsRs. classified bed & breakfast unitsRs. classified home staysRs. classified motelsRs. guest houses & tented accommodation unitsRs. standalone restaurantsRs. convention centersRs. and online aggregatorsRs. sales toursRs. participation in travel fairs/exhibitions and road shows (organized by Ministry of Tourism)Rs. online promotion of tourism destinations and productsRs. tour packages in the overseas marketsRs. including content creation/production of digital promotional brochures/leaflets etc. - The tourism service providers should be approved by the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of IndiaRs. or the concerned State / Union Territory Tourism Department. - The approved tourism service providers should show a minimum fee of 1.00 crore 2.00 crore in any of the preceding two years i.e. 2018-19 or 2019-20Rs. the number of tours may be limited to a maximum of two in one financial year. - The approved tourism service providers should show a minimum fee of 2.00 crore and above in one of the preceding two years i.e. 2018-19 or 2019-20Rs. the number of tours may be limited to a maximum of three in one financial year. - Tourism departments of State Governments / UT Administrations are also eligible to avail benefits under the Scheme. HoweverRs. the above eligibility conditions do not apply to them.

name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme
brief_description:
The Biotechnology Ignition Grant Scheme (BIG) is a flagship scheme of the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC)Rs. (a not-for-profit Section 8Rs. Schedule BRs. Public Sector EnterpriseRs. set up by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT)Rs. Government of India)Rs. which recognizes and invests in innovative ideas in the biotech sector. The ideas should have clear potential to translate into commercial products/technologies. BIG supports individual entrepreneurs/ start-ups from ideation to Proof of Concept (PoC).
> **Purpose of the BIG scheme:**


- Supports ideation to Proof of Concept
- Nurtures entrepreneurship to enable translation of ideas into commercially viable products/ technologies to address unmet need
- Enables Biotech Startup Ecosystem in the country to become globally competitive

> **Types of projects supported:**

BIG scheme supports innovation under HealthcareRs. LifesciencesRs. DiagnosticsRs. Medical DevicesRs. DrugsRs. VaccinesRs. Drug Formulations and delivery systemsRs. Industrial BiotechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Secondary agricultureRs. Waste ManagementRs. SanitationRs. Clean EnergyRs. and related areas.
**The project proposals can be submitted in any of the following seven categories:**

- Devices & Diagnostics
- Drugs including drug delivery
- Industrial Biotechnology including Secondary Agriculture
- Agriculture
- Biosimilars & Stem Cells
- Vaccines
- Bioinformatics & facilities

BIRAC encourages proposals involving integration of Biotech with applied sciences that may include EngineeringRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. Internet of ThingsRs. SensorsRs. Big Data AnalyticsRs. Cloud ComputingRs. Machine LearningRs. AutomationRs. RoboticsRs. and related disciplines to potentially facilitate transforming healthcareRs. life sciencesRs. agricultureRs. secondary agricultureRs. and other bio-based industry/ markets.
> **Types of projects not supported:**


- Basic/exploratory research projects
- Projects having a low element of novelty
- Projects involving systematic clinical trialsRs. field trials or late-stage validation/certification of the technology.

**Note:** BIG grant is not a research fellowship and cannot be used to support PhD or any other academic research.
> **Project Duration:**

The funding is provided for a period of up to 18 months. The project is implemented in a milestone-based manner.
benefits:
Support provided to grantees under the scheme:
1. Under the BIG schemeRs. BIRAC provides a grant-in-aid of up to INR 50 lakhs (approx. USD 75Rs.) for a period of 18 months.
2. BIG Partners and BIRAC provide continuous mentoring support to the granteesRs. including but not limited to the following:
Technical Mentoring (Connect with Technical Experts)
IP Support
Legal Support
Networking and Outreach
Trainings
Regulatory Advice
Business Mentoring
Connect with Investors
Any other assistance on a case basis
eligibility:
> **Eligibility criteria for an Individual:**

1. The individual applicant should be an Indian citizen.
