brief_description: A health scheme by Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for financially poor patients to defray a part of the expenditure on Hospitalization/treatment in Government HospitalsRs.for life threatening diseases covered under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)Rs. in cases where free medical facilities are not available. Only those having annual family income up to Rs.1.25Rs./- and below are eligible for financial assistance from Health Ministers Discretionary Grant (HMDG). Under this schemeRs. Financial assistance is provided towards treatment in Government hospitals including super specialty Government hospitals / institutes.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must not be an employee of either Central or State Govt.
1. The applicant must have been Hospitalized / Undergoing Treatment in a Government Hospital (including super specialty Government hospitals / institutes).
1. The Total Annual Family Income of the applicant must not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.

name: National Scheme Of Welfare Of Fishermen
brief_description:
The National Scheme of Welfare of Fishermen is a centrally sponsored scheme that provides financial assistance to fishermen. They can use these for constructing houses and community halls for both recreation and work purposes. FurtherRs. through the amount availed under this schemeRs. fishermen can install tube wells.
**Objectives-**
1. Provide fishermen with basic amenities such as housingRs. community hallsRs. tube well for drinking water. 1. Ensure Financial And Social Securities Of Fishermen And Their Families. 1. Upgrade The Standard Of Living Of Fishermen. 1. Educate And Train Fishermen In Advanced Technical Technologies So That They Can Learn Scientific Ways Of Fishing.
eligibility:
**Eligibility Criteria for Inland Fishermen**
1. Fishermen living in coastal areas and with whom the respective States and Union Territories have officially licensed are eligible for this scheme. 1. The age of fishermen must be below 60 years old. 1. Applicant fishermen must belong to the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category. 1. They must be engaged in full-time activities inland.
**Eligibility Criteria for Marine Fishermen**
All marine fishermen who operate under StateRs. Union TerritoriesRs. and FISHCOPFED are eligible for this government scheme for fishermen. HoweverRs. there are other eligibility parameters marine fishermen must fulfill. These include -
1. Their respective States and Union Territories must officially license marine fishermen. 1. They must involve themselves in full-time activities at sea. 1. They must be a member of the Welfare Society or Federation or Cooperative Society. 1. Please note that the fishermen under FISHCOPFED can avail of funds available under the insurance component only.

name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
brief_description:
A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for Single Girl Child for research in Social Sciences with an aim to compensate for direct costs of higher educationRs. especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their family.
**The objectives of the proposed scheme are:**

1. To support the higher education of single girl child in Social Sciences.
1. To recognize the value of observance of the small family norms.
1. To recognize the norm of single girl child in society.
1. To propagate the concept of single girl child norm.
1. Promoting single girls in society.

The girl students who are admitted to Ph. D. programs in Social Sciences in Universities/Colleges/Institutes and happen to be the only girl child in the family without having any brother or sister. The girl student who is twin daughters/fraternal daughter may also apply for fellowship under the aforesaid scheme.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance**

The financial assistance available under the scheme is as follows:
1. Fellowship @ 25Rs./- per month for the Initial two years; @ 28Rs./- per month for the remaining tenure.
2. Contingency @ 10Rs./- per annum for initial two years; @ 20Rs./- per annum for remaining tenure.
3. Escort Reader Assistance @ 2Rs./- per month in case of PWD candidates.
> **Slots**

The number of slots for the fellowship may be decided every year on the basis of eligible applications
complete in all respectsRs. received through online mode.
> **Tenure**

The tenure of the fellowship is for five years and will be effective from 1st April of the selection year or the actual date of joining under the fellowship in the University/College/InstituteRs. whichever is later. Fellowship will be granted up to the date of submission of Ph.D. Thesis or 5 years of tenure whichever is earlier. No extension is permissible beyond the total period of five yearsRs. and the fellow ceases to be a UGC research fellow immediately after the expiry of the due date.
> **HRA**

Suitable single-seated hostel accommodation may be provided to the candidates in the institutions. In such casesRs. the fellow is eligible to draw only hostel fees excluding messRs. electricityRs. water chargesRs. etc. A certificate to this effect is to be furnished through the Registrar/Director/Principal. HRA is not permissible for those candidates who are staying in Hostel accommodation.
In case of non-availability of hostel accommodationRs. the fellow may be provided with single accommodation by the host institution. In such casesRs. the rent paid by the fellow on an actual basis may be reimbursed subject to the ceiling of HRA as per Govt. of India norms.
If the fellow makes her own arrangements of accommodationRs. she may be entitled to draw HRA as per the categorization of cities by the Govt. of India.
**Note:** In all the above casesRs. the fellow will submit a relevant certificate ([Annexure-VI](https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/1555717_guidelines-SWAMI-Vivekananda.pdf)) through the concerned University/College/Institute to the identified Agency for settling the claim.
> **Medical**

No separate/fixed medical assistance is provided. HoweverRs. the fellow may avail of the medical facilities available in the Universities/Colleges/Institutes.
> **Leave**

1. Leave for a maximum period of 30 days in a year in addition to the public holidays that may be taken by the candidate. HoweverRs. they are not entitled to any other vacationRs. such as summerRs. winterRs. and pooja vacations.
2. Maternity leave as per the Govt. of India norms issued from time to time would be available at full rates of the fellowship once during the tenure of their award.
3. Academic leave (without fellowship and other emoluments) shall be permissible only for one year throughout the tenure (for any kind of academic/teaching assignment/foreign visit in connection with research work). The period of leave without fellowship will be counted towards the tenure. Expenditure on foreign visits in connection to research work cannot be claimed by UGC
**Note:** All kinds of leave should be approved at the level of the University/College/Institute.
eligibility:
1. Any single girl child of her parents pursuing a Ph.D. in Social Sciences in Universities/Colleges/ Institutes is eligible to apply under the scheme. In a familyRs. if one son and one daughter are available then the girl child will not be considered for fellowship under the scheme.
2. The scheme is applicable to such a single girl child who has registered herself in regularRs. full-time Ph. D. program in Social Sciences in Indian Universities/Colleges/Institutes as indicated below:

- Universities/Colleges/Institutes included under section 2(f) and 12(b) of UGC ActRs. 1956.
- Deemed to be Universities under section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 which are eligible to receive grants in aid from UGC.
- Universities/Colleges/Institutes funded by Central/ State Govt.
- Institutes of National Importance.

3. Admission to Ph.D. Course in Distance education mode is not covered under the scheme.
4. Girl students up to the age of 40 years for the general category and 45 years for the reserved categories i.e. SC/ST/OBC and PWD (Persons with Disabilities) as on the last date of submission of online application are eligible.
5. Transgender candidates are eligible to apply under the scheme as per the norms.

name: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Women In Distress
brief_description:
Launched in 1995Rs. ISSS (Integrated Social Security Scheme) is a State Sponsored Scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir where financial assistance is provided to Old Age PersonsRs. WidowsRs. DivorceesRs. Women in DistressRs. TransgendersRs. and Physically Handicapped Persons. The scheme is funded through Plan and Non-Plan on the basis of a 50:50 sharing pattern.
The scheme has the following components - a) Pension for Old Age Person b) Pension for Women in Distress c) Pension for Physically Challenged Person d) Pension to Transgenders
Under the "Women in Distress" component of ISSSRs. a pension of 1Rs. per pensioner per month is deposited directly into their Bank Account through DBT mode. The aim of the scheme is to provide monthly financial assistance to destitute widows/divorced/deserted women with no source of income.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a destitute widow/divorced/deserted woman.
1. The income of the applicant should be less than 75Rs./- per annum or the applicant should be from the "Below Poverty Line (BPL)" Category.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 40 and 79 years.

name: Krishonnati Yojana - Sub Mission On Seed And Planting Material (SMSP)
brief_description:
The scheme "Sub Mission on Seed and Planting Material (SMSP)" is a centrally sponsored scheme under the umbrella scheme of "Green Revolution Krishonnati Yojana".
"Green Revolution Krishonnati Yojana" is an Umbrella Scheme for the agriculture sector that has been implemented since 2016-17 by clubbing several schemes/missions under one umbrella scheme. The Umbrella scheme comprises 11 Schemes/Missions. These schemes look to develop the agriculture and allied sector holistically and scientifically to increase the income of farmers by enhancing productionRs. productivityRs. and better returns on produce.
The Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) aims to increase the production of certified / quality seedRs. increase SRRRs. upgrade the quality of farm-saved seedsRs. strengthen the seed multiplication chainRs. promote new technologies and methodologies in seed productionRs. processingRs. testingRs. etc.Rs. to strengthen and modernizing infrastructure for seed productionRs. storageRs. certificationRs. and qualityRs. etc.
**Objectives of SMSP -** 1. Increasing production of certified/ quality seed 1. Increasing Seed Replacement rate (SRR) more particularly to achieve higher SRR in crops like paddyRs. gramRs. groundnutRs. cottonRs. etc. as recommended by the Consultative Group of the Ministry of Agriculture 1. Upgrading the quality of farm-saved seeds with a specific objective to cover 60Rs. villages and produce 100 lakh quintals of seed each year through farmers' participatory seed production. 1. Creation of Seed Infrastructure facilities in the Public Sector. 1. Encouraging seed treatmentRs. particularly for farm-saved seed. 1. Strengthening the seed multiplication chain through assistance to the public and private sectors. 1. Popularizing new varieties to encourage varietal replacement. 1. Promoting new technologies and methodologies in seed productionRs. processingRs. testingRs. etc. 1. Strengthening and modernizing infrastructure for seed productionRs. storageRs. certificationRs. and quality control particularly to ensure compliance with the provisions of the Seeds Bill 2004/ISTA standardsRs. and OECD certification. 1. Facilitating the movement of seed from India in international trade and increasing its share to 10% by 2020 as envisaged in the new policy on seed development. 1. Assisting and supporting public and private seed-producing organizations in the seed sector and encouraging partnerships. 1. Ensuring availability of seed in contingent situations. 1. Facilitating the dissemination of seed-related information through informationRs. educationRs. and communication. 1. To provide an effective system for the protection of plant varietiesRs. the rights of farmers as well as plant breeders and to encourage the development of new varieties of plantsRs. through PPVFRA.
**Components of SMSP -** 1. Strengthening for Seed Quality Control 2. Strengthening of Grow Out Test(GOT) facilities 3. Support to seed certification agencies 4. Seed Village Programme 5. Certified seed production through seed villages 6. Seed Processing Facilities 7. Seed Storage Facilities 8. Transport subsidy on the movement of Seed to North Eastern States etc. 9. National Seed Reserve 10. Application of Biotechnology in agriculture 11. Public Private Partnership in the seed sector 12. Assistance for boosting seed production in the Private Sector 13. Support to Sub-Mission Director and Survey / Studies 14. Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers Rights Authority (PPVFRA)
eligibility: The applicant must be a Small or Marginal Farmer.

name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T. And S.B.C. Girl Students Studying In 5th To 7th Standard
brief_description: Savitribai Phule Scholarship is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. The scheme was introduced 12th January 1996. The scheme was further amended in 29th October 1996 to include S.B.C. Students. The objective of the scheme is to encourage the enrollment and to decrease the dropout ratio of Girl Students of Maharashtra from Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) and Special Backward Classes (SBC)Rs. studying in Class 5th to Class 7th. The beneficiary is provided 60/- per monthRs. i.e. 600/- for ten months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a girl.
1. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant must belong to Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) or Special Backward Classes (SBC) Category.
1. The applicant must be studying in Class 5th to Class 7th.
1. The applicant must be studying in a Government Recognized School.

name: Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana
brief_description:
The "**Mukhyamantri Baristha Bunakar and Karigara Sahayata Yojana**" is a welfare scheme initiated by the HandloomsRs. Textiles and Handicrafts DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to elderly individuals involved in weaving and craft workRs. who may face economic difficulties.
**Objective:-**

1. To provide social security to the baristha bunakar and karigar of the state & to ensure them a decent level of living.
1. To enable him/her free from additional financial burden due to illnessRs. injuryRs. need for careRs. unemployment & other unforeseen expensesRs. etc.
1. To take care of old age and other consequences resulting therefrom.

**Note:** The Directorate of TextilesRs. Odisha and Directorate of HandicraftsRs. Odisha shall be the implementing agency of this scheme.
benefits: The financial assistance for weavers & ancillary workers /handicraft artisan shall be as follows: **S.No****Category****Age of the Beneficiary****Quantum of Assistance (in Rs.)**1FemaleMore than 40 years to less than 80 years20002MaleMore than 50 years to less than 80 years20003Both Female & Male80 years or more2500
eligibility:
1. He/ She must be a permanent resident/domicile of Odisha.
1. Weavers & Ancillary Workers and Handicraft Artisans to be eligible for assistance under the scheme should be 40 years & above in case of female and 50 years & above in case of male.
1. His/ Her name must be in the final list of weavers & ancillary workers and artisans as per the latest survey. The National awardeesRs. Stale awardeesRs. Kalakruti awardeesRs. Tantakruti Awardees including Design/ Merit certificate awardees in Handloom & Handicraft sectors will also be eligible irrespective of their names placed in the above survey listRs. if they are otherwise eligible. The beneficiaries out of above survey list may be screened further by HT&H Department officials in the district or other such officer as would be appointed by the District Collector.
1. Only one member of the family shall be eligible to get the assistance under this Scheme irrespective of the number of family members fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
1. The annual income of the family should not exceed Rs. 1Rs./- (Rupees One Lakh) The Income Certificate issued by Concerned Tahasildar/ Additional Tahasildar or any other competent authority of Revenue Department is acceptable.
1. Govt. employeesRs. lncome Tax payersRs. Retired Govt. employees of Govt. of India and/or any State Government will not be eligible to get the assistance from the scheme.
1. A Handloom weaver/ Ancillary worker/ Handicraft Artisan wilt not be eligible if he/ she is availing similar benefits under any other scheme of the State Government like Madhubabu Pension YojanaRs. Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata YojanaRs. etc.Rs. and any other scheme of Government of India.
1. A Handloom weaver/ Ancillary worker/ Handicraft Artisan will not be eligible if he/ she has been convicted of any criminal offence.
1. Financial Assistance under this scheme to a beneficiary shall be effective from the date of approval of District Level Selection Committee.

name: Mukhyamantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana
brief_description: "Mukhyarrantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana" (MBJY) is a scheme under the Chief Minister's Special Package for Handloom weavers. The scheme aims to improve working conditions and productivity for weavers by providing necessary illuminationRs. ensuring smooth operation during electricity issuesRs. reducing physical strainRs. and increasing earning potential.
benefits: - **Free Tube Lights:** Distribution of 20-watt tube lights free of cost to beneficiaries. - **Inverter Purchase Assistance:** 17Rs./- is given in two installments for purchasing inverters (1st installment of 10Rs./- for purchase of equipment and 2nd installment of 7Rs./ - after purchase of equipment). - **Free Fans:** 35-watt fans given to beneficiaries at no cost. - **Interest-Free Loan:** Up to 5Rs. loan available with no interest rate charged.
eligibility:
- He/ She must be a bonafide weaver/ full-time ancillary worker.
- He/ She is a permanent resident/ domicile of Odisha.
- The family income from all sources does not exceed 3Rs. 00Rs./- per annum.
- At least 50% income of the family should be from weaving activities.
- He or she should purchase the lighting unit from a GST-registered dealer with a valid TIN.
- Where more than one member of a family is found eligibleRs. only one of them will be entitled to benefit under this scheme

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
brief_description: "Lakshmir Bhandar" Scheme is a flagship program launched by the West Bengal Government in February 2021Rs. to provide financial assistance to women from economically weaker sections of society. For the empowerment of women in the age group of 25-60 years and enrolled in Swasthya SathiRs. 1Rs./- every month to women SC/ST households and 1Rs./- per month to other beneficiaries are provided. The scheme aims to empower women and make them financially independent by providing them with a one-time grant to buy essential goods and services.
benefits:
- For women from Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes households: 1Rs./- per month
- For women from other category: 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 25 - 60 years.
1. The household of the applicant should be enrolled under the "Swasthyasathi" scheme.
1. The applicant should not be a government employee in permanent employment/ retired government employee of Central/ State GovernmentRs. Statutory BodiesRs. Government UndertakingsRs. PanchayatsRs. Municipal Corporations/ MunicipalitiesRs. Local BodiesRs. teaching and non-teaching employees of Government aided Educational InstitutionsRs. etc. receiving regular salary/ pension.

name: Pension To The Disabled Person
brief_description:
The Pension to the Disabled Person scheme under the Social WelfareRs. Women & Child Development Chandigarh is Disability pension to a disabled person granted to Physically Handicapped persons. A person who is disabled to the extent of 40% and is resident of Union Territory of Chandigarh and fulfills the income criteria i.e.Rs. family income does not exceed 1.50 lacs per annum. is eligible for a grant of pension.
Everyone deserves to live with dignity and respectRs. regardless of their abilities. Offering a pension to disabled persons recognizes their inherent value and ensures they are not left to live in poverty or dependence.
benefits: - The pension payable to each person shall be 1000/- per annum to those persons having 40% to 70% of disability. - 2000/-per annum to those persons having more than 70% of disability.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's disability must be to the extent of 40% or above then they will be eligible to avail the benefit of same.
1. The applicant must be a resident of UT Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed 1.50 lacs annually.

name: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
brief_description:
**Objective** The main objective of the mission is to double the farm incomeRs. in unison with the vision of Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi. **CMSGUY: The Way Ahead** At the current rate of growthRs. it will take about 80 years to double the farm income in Assam. Normal interventions by the Government in this regard would not be adequate to address the problem. Under CMSGUY there is a proposal to initiate massive investments in rural areas for complete rural empowerment in a period of five years in a focused and concerted manner to realize the dream of doubling the farm income.
This is sought to be achieved through a 'saturation model' by covering each revenue village through focused interventions in 1. Direct economic activitiesRs. 1. Logistic support including market linkagesRs. and 1. Community support.
Above focused interventions are aimed at in nine critical areas and related sub-missions are: 1. Fishery MissionRs. 1. Milk MissionRs. 1. Organic MissionRs. 1. Land Management and Conservation MissionRs. 1. SericultureRs. Khadi and Cottage Industry MissionRs. 1. Road and Broadband connectivityRs. 1. Semi-ProcessingRs. Processing and Market LinkagesRs. 1. "Youth-Yoga-Sports" Mission and 1. e-Gram Mission by developing Village Knowledge Centres by strengthening traditional Namghar and other community institutions
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The benefit of this scheme will be provided to any group of 8 to 10 members who are actual adult farmers of the same village
1. The group of farmers must have a common bank account and will apply jointly with the signatures of each member on the application form preferably along with particulars of land and crops cultivated
1. The applicant group should not have more than one member from one family

name: Niramaya Scheme
brief_description:
The Department of Health & Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named "**NIRAMAYA**" - a free medicine distribution scheme. The aim of this scheme is to provide quality essential medicines for all kinds of diseases to patients visiting government health facilities at free of cost. The scheme was launched on 01.05.2015 with an assurance to provide 720 medicines listed in the Emergency Drugs List at all the Government run hospitals and medical colleges free of cost to the patients. It started with 150 drugs in the list while the list has been updated to 570 numbers recently. The government also announced to set up of 1102 drug distribution centers (DDCs) which will cover 1234 primary health centers (PHCs)Rs. 383 Community Health Centers (CHCs)Rs. 32 District Headquarters Hospitals (DHHs)Rs. 22 sub-divisional hospitals and 3 medical colleges. This scheme is managed by the Odisha State Medical Corporation Ltd. (OSMC).
**Key Features of the scheme:**

1. **Healthcare Coverage:** The scheme provides coverage for a wide range of health servicesRs. including preventiveRs. diagnosticRs. and treatment services. It focuses on ensuring that people have access to essential medical care. 1. **Financial Support:** It may include financial support for medical treatmentsRs. which helps reduce out-of-pocket expenses for individuals and families. 1. **Integrated Services:** The scheme integrates various health services to offer a more holistic approach to health care. This might include primary health careRs. secondary and tertiary careRs. and sometimes even specialized treatments. 1. **Quality Improvement:** Scheme aims to enhance the quality of health services by setting standards and improving the infrastructure of healthcare facilities. 1. **Public Awareness:** The scheme often includes components for educating the public about health issuesRs. preventive measuresRs. and the available health services. 1. **Collaboration:** It may involve collaboration with private healthcare providersRs. NGOsRs. and other stakeholders to broaden the reach and effectiveness of the scheme.
benefits: 1. **Cashless Medicinal Drugs:** This scheme provides free medicines treatment to the beneficiaries of the scheme. This means that they can avail of medical drugs without having to pay any cash upfront. 1. **No Age Limit:** The scheme has no age limitRs. and anyone can avail of the benefits of the schemeRs. including senior citizens. 1. **Easy Enrollment:** The enrollment process for the scheme is simple and hassle-freeRs. and anyone can enroll in the scheme by submitting the required documents. 1. **Increased Access:** Ensures that more people have access to necessary health services. 1. **Reduced Financial Burden:** Helps in alleviating the financial burden on families for medical treatments. 1. **Enhanced Health Outcomes:** By improving the quality of care and ensuring timely treatmentRs. the scheme contributes to better health outcomes.
eligibility: 1. Patients who have done registration in the Govt. Hospitals are eligible to get free medicines under "Niramaya". 1. Beneficiaries must be residents of Odisha.

name: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
brief_description:
The Reimbursement of Expenditure Incurred on Visa for Employment Abroad to Construction Workers is a scheme implemented in the state of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to construction workers who are seeking employment abroad. Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers in Rajasthan who have secured employment in foreign countries are eligible for reimbursement of expenses incurred on obtaining the necessary visa and related documentation.
To be eligible for this schemeRs. the construction worker must be registered with the Construction Workers Welfare Board in Rajasthan and provide proof of employment in a foreign country. The aim of this scheme is to reduce the financial burden on construction workers who are seeking employment abroad by providing financial support for expenses related to obtaining visasRs. which can often be a significant expense. This scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and support them in their efforts to secure employment opportunities abroad.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan State. 2.Applicant should be registered as Construction Worker under labor laws.
Other Conditions 1. For getting contract employment abroadRs. it is necessary to take permission for migration from the office of Protectors of Emigrants (POE) under the Migrant ActRs. 1983. 2. Registration of the recruiting agency under the Overseas Act or a valid permit from the POE office is necessary. 3. Reimbursement of visa amount under the above scheme will be payable on the beneficiary passport having a minimum validity of 6 months including valid visa. 4. Under the schemeRs. the benefit of assistance amount will be payable to the beneficiary only once. 5. During scrutiny of application and documentsRs. if any facts found to be false resulting in the cancellation of eligibilityRs. it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit all the assistance amount sanctioned under the scheme along with interest. 6. The benefit of this scheme will be payable only if the beneficiary is employed abroadRs. is in the building and other construction works.

name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
brief_description:
The Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC) in Dehradun offers scholarships to deserving cadetsRs. including those from Mizoram. The scholarships are awarded based on the cadet's performance in academicsRs. extracurricular activitiesRs. and conduct. There are several scholarships available for RIMC cadets from MizoramRs. including: Merit Scholarship: This scholarship is awarded to cadets who perform exceptionally well in academics and other activities. The scholarship amount ranges from Rs. 10Rs. to Rs. 25Rs..
Financial Assistance: Cadets who come from economically weaker sections of society can apply for financial assistance. The amount of assistance provided depends on the cadet's financial situation.
Sports Scholarship: Cadets who excel in sports can apply for this scholarship. The scholarship amount ranges from Rs. 5Rs. to Rs. 15Rs..
Special Scholarship: This scholarship is awarded to cadets who face exceptional circumstancesRs. such as a medical condition or the loss of a parent. The amount of the scholarship depends on the situation.
To apply for these scholarshipsRs. cadets must meet the eligibility criteria and submit the required documents. The application process usually starts in the month of JanuaryRs. and the scholarships are awarded in April/May.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance: The scholarships provide financial assistance to cadets from economically weaker sections of society. This helps them to pursue their education and training at RIMC without any financial burden.
- Accommodation: Cadets are provided with free accommodation and food during their stay at RIMC. This ensures that they can focus on their studies and training without worrying about their basic needs.
- Medical Care: The RIMC website mentions that cadets receive free medical careRs. including regular health check-ups and treatment for any illness or injury.
- Career Opportunities: RIMC prepares cadets for a career in the Indian Armed Forces. The training and education they receive at RIMC help them to build a strong foundation for their future careers.
- Recognition: The scholarships awarded to cadets are a recognition of their academic and extracurricular achievements. This boosts their confidence and encourages them to work harder.
eligibility:
- Scholarship will be admissible to Mizo students permanently residing in the state of Mizoram studying at RIMCRs. Dehradun.
- Student should not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme.
- Scholarship for studying in any class will be available for only one year and renewable as per Rules/Condition.
- If after the award of scholarship the cadet is found medically unfit in any way which according to the appropriate medical authorityRs. renders him unfit for his entry into the NDARs. the scholarship awarded shall be discontinued from the date the cadet is declared unfit

name: Bidya Lakshmi Loan
brief_description: Launched in 2016-17Rs. the scheme "Bidya Lakshmi" by the Finance (Audit & Fund) DepartmentRs. Government of Assam aims to provide higher education loans for the children of regular State Government employees in Assam under the Uecha Siksha Hitoishona Achani (USHA) for Karmachari. The scheme offers loans ranging from 5Rs./- to 10Rs./- at an interest rate of 4%Rs. with additional benefits for employees under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS). Eligible courses include professional and technical programs in India and abroadRs. such as EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. ManagementRs. and Doctorate programs. The scheme is implemented by the State Bank of India (SBI)Rs. with designated branches across all districts and civil sub-divisions.
benefits:
- The State Government provides a loan of 5Rs./- to 10Rs./- at an interest rate of 4%.
- Employees with an annual salary income exceeding 4Rs./- can avail up to 10Rs./- at 4% interest after State Government interest subvention.
- Employees with annual income up to 4Rs./- are eligible under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)Rs. with 100% subsidy during the moratorium period (course period plus one year). Post-moratoriumRs. the effective interest rate is 4%.
- Loans can be used for course feesRs. booksRs. computersRs. educational equipmentRs. and travel expenses (for studies abroad).
- No collateral security or third-party guarantee is required for loans up to 10Rs./-.
- Life insurance policy option available to cover the loan amount.
- Tax rebate under Section 80(E) of the Indian Income Tax Act.

> **Mode of Disbursement**

The loan amount is transferred directly to the educational institutions account (not to the parent/student). It covers Tuition feesRs. booksRs. computersRs. equipmentRs. and travel (for abroad studies). The amount is disbursed in lump sum or installmentsRs. as per the institutions fee structure.
> **Frequency of Disbursement**

Interest is charged monthlyRs. and subsidy amounts are credited back to the individual account upon claim clearance.
> **Conditions for Disbursement**

The utilization certificate must be submitted at the end of the financial year.
eligibility:
> **For the Parent**


- The parent should be a regularRs. in-service State Government Employee of Assam.
- The parent should have at least 5 years of residual pensionable service.
- The employees with annual income exceeding 4Rs./- can avail up to 10Rs./-.
- The employees with annual income up to 4Rs./- are eligible under CLSS.
- The employee must have a salary account with check-off facility (for EMI deductions).
- The employee must be a co-borrower in the loan application. The employees name must be included in the loan application alongside the child (the student).

> **For the Child**


- The child must be admitted to a technical/higher educational institution recognized by UGC (University Grants Commission)/ AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)/ Government-approved colleges/universities in Assam or anywhere in India/ Premier institutions (for studies abroad).


- The child must be pursuing one of the following approved courses:

**In India:** EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. AgricultureRs. VeterinaryRs. LawRs. DentalRs. ManagementRs. Computer ScienceRs. Chartered Accountancy (CA)Rs. Cost and Management Accountancy (ICWA)Rs. Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)Rs. Master of Computer Applications (MCA)Rs. Master of Science (MS)Rs. Graduation in professional/technical coursesRs. Doctorate (PhD).
**Abroad:** Courses conducted by premier institutions like CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management AccountantsRs. London) or CPA (Certified Public AccountantRs. USA).

- The child must be a co-borrower in the loan application. The childs name must be included in the loan application alongside the parent (government employee).

name: Self Employment Scheme
brief_description:
**Detailed** - Under this schemeRs. Subsidies will be provided to the religious minority communities with the help of Nationalized / Scheduled banks to start or improve a small-scale handicraft industryRs. service sectorRs. and agro-based activities. - People belonging to State Religious Minority Communities are covered under this scheme. (State Religious Minority Communities consist of People belonging to MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. and Jain Communities). - Subsidy will be 33% of the unit cost or a maximum of Rs. 1.00 Lakh.
**The beneficiaries will be selected by the below Selection Panel.** 1. MLA of the concerned Assembly Constituency Chairman 1. Member of the Legislative Council who is a permanent resident in that Taluk - Vice-Chairman 1. Concerned Taluk Tahsildar Member 1. Executive Officer of concerned Taluk Panchayat-Member 1. The District Lead Bank Manager Member 1. District Joint DirectorRs. CommerceRs. and Industry Member 1. Concerned Districts Deputy DirectorRs. Women and Child Welfare Department Member 1. Concerned District ManagerRs. Karnataka Minority Development Corporation- Member Secretary.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. Applicants must belong to the State Religious Minority Community.
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the State.
1. The age limit of the applicant is between 18 to 55 years.
1. Family annual income from all sources should not be more than Rs.81Rs./- in a rural areas and Rs. 1Rs. in urban areas.
1. No member of the applicant's family shall be an employee of the State/Central/ Government PSU.
1. Applicants should not have availed of a loan in KMDC earlier.

name: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women
brief_description: "Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years as this group is not getting benefits under the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme. In ManipurRs. there are many widows of this age group due to the armed conflict and HIV/AIDS. ThereforeRs. this scheme is indispensable for such widows to prevent difficulties and hardships to bear the daily need for survival. Widows who are domiciled in Manipur and have been residing in Manipur for more than 5 years continuously preceding the date of application are eligible under the scheme. This is a State Sponsored Scheme and only the citizens who are domiciled in the State of Manipur can apply for this scheme. The application should be submitted through the respective District Social Welfare Officer.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Manipur.
1. The applicant should be a Widow.
1. The age of applicant should be between 18-40 years.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

name: Tailoring Training To Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Widows/Destitute Women/Girls
brief_description: The aim of the scheme is to enable Scheduled Caste Widows/girls/destitute women for self-employment. A stipend of 600/- P.M. and raw material costing 300/- per month per trainee is given to a trainee for getting training from the nearest Kalyan Kendar run by this department. After completion of one year courseRs. each widow/ girl/ destitute women are given a new sewing machine free of cost to earn her livelihood. 20 girls/ widows/ destitute women from SC community and 5 from BC community are given training in each community centre.
benefits:
- 600/- stipend per month.
- 300/- per month for raw materials.
- 1 sewing machine.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
2. The applicant should be a widowRs. destitute womanRs. or girl.
3. The applicant's age should be between 14 and 45 years.
4. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Backward Class category.
5. The applicant's annual family income should be less than 2.5 lakhs.

name: Arunachal Pradesh State Stipend Scheme
brief_description: The Arunachal Pradesh State Stipend Scheme was launched by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Arunachal Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. monthly stipends and book grants are provided to ST students to help them complete recognized courses without financial hindrance. > **Objective** - The object of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students of Arunachal Pradesh so as to enable them to pursue various courses of higher studies approved by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. > **Approved Courses List** - BA / B.Com / B.P.Ed - B.Sc. - MA / M.Com / LL.B. / M.P.Ed / LL.M / MPMC / M.Ed - M.Sc. - M.Phil - Ph.D - B.Sc. (Agriculture / Horticulture / Forestry / Fishery / BE / B.VSc) - MBBS - BDS / BHMS / BAMS - Diploma (Engineering) / X-Ray Technician / Ophthalmic Assistant - B.Pharma / B.Sc. (Nursing) - D.Pharma - Laboratory Technician / ECG Technician - BCA - MCA - BBA - MBA - PGDM (Communication) - IT & HM (Diploma) - BFA - MFA - B.Ed - CA (Chartered Accountancy) - M.Tech
benefits:
**Tangible Benefits:**

- Monthly Stipend for the duration of the course (except vacation periods).
- Initial Book Grant for the first year.
- Subsequent Book Grant for the following years.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- For students within Arunachal Pradesh: Disbursed by the Head of Institution.
- For students outside Arunachal Pradesh: Disbursed via Demand Draft by the Sanctioning Authority to Heads of Institutions.

**Frequency of Disbursement:**

- MonthlyRs. except for vacation periods.
- Begins from the month of admission (if before the 20th of the month)Rs. otherwise from the following month.

**Conditions for Benefit:**

- Continued only on satisfactory academic progress and good conduct.
- Stipend will be withheld or canceled for misconductRs. poor attendance (<75%)Rs. or unsatisfactory progress.
- Not valid for dual/subsidiary courses (e.g.Rs. LLB with MA)Rs. correspondenceRs. or distance education.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a scheduled tribe (ST) of Arunachal PradeshRs. as notified by the central or state government.
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant must not be in full-time employment.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a higher and technical education.
1. The applicant who has failed in the same class previously and was then re-admitted to a different course or stream at the same level of study is not eligible.
1. The applicant must not be under any disciplinary action.
1. The applicant must maintain at least 75% attendance each month.
1. The applicant enrolled in correspondence or distance education programs is not eligible for the stipend.
1. The applicant must be enrolled in an institution recognized by the State or Central regulatory bodiesRs. such as UGCRs. AICTERs. MCIRs. DCIRs. BCIRs. CCHRs. etc.

**NOTE:**

- If a girl student fails in a classRs. she may be allowed to receive the stipend once more for the same classRs. in the following yearRs. with a specific recommendation from the Head of the Institution.

name: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
brief_description: The "Pension to Widows and Destitute Women" scheme was introduced by the Government of Haryana in the financial year 1980-81. The aim of the scheme is to provide social security to women who cannot sustain themselves and need financial assistance. Under this schemeRs. widows and destitute women aged 18 years and above are eligible for a pension if they are domiciles of Haryana and have been residing in the state for at least one year at the time of application submission.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. a pension of 2Rs./- per month is given to widows and destitute women.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
2. The applicant should meet one of the following conditions:
Be a widow.
Be a destitute woman without a husbandRs. parentsRs. or children.
Be a destitute woman due to desertion or the physical/mental incapacity of her husband (for married women) or parents (for other women).
3. The applicant should be 18 years of age or older.
4. The applicant's annual income from all sources should be less than 2Rs./-.

name: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana
brief_description: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of 1Rs. to the bank account of the registered beneficiaries/members of the boardRs. for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should be a registered Construction Worker (Nirmaan Shramik) or a Member of the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.
1. The applicant should not already have availed of the benefits of this scheme.

name: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana
brief_description:
**Detailed**
Under the Sardar Patel Awas YojanaRs. the government provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for the construction of their own house. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Housing Board (GHB) and Gujarat Urban Development Mission (GUDM) in urban areasRs. and by Gujarat Rural Housing Corporation (GRHC) in rural areas.
Sardar Patel Awas Yojana is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections and low-income groups of the society. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for the construction of their own houseRs. and is implemented by Gujarat Housing Board and Gujarat Urban Development Mission in urban areasRs. and by Gujarat Rural Housing Corporation in rural areas. The scheme aims to improve the living standards of the underprivileged sections of society by providing them with their own homes.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. This scheme of the State Govt. being poor-oriented the persons registered Below the Poverty Line in rural areas may avail the benefit of the scheme.
1. A person who has no plot or house may avail the benefit of the scheme.
1. The applicant should not have taken benefit of any other housing scheme.
1. The applicant who has a maximum of half a hectare of irrigated land or a maximum of one hectare of unrelated land may also avail advantage of the scheme.
1. If husband and wife live together and if there is a plot or house in the name of the husband or wife and living in the same village for the last five yearsRs. either of them may avail the benefit of the scheme.
1. If a beneficiary is a native of the village he should hold a card Below the Poverty Line of that village such person should obtain a certificate from the Sarpanch of his native village that this beneficiary has not taken advantage of Sardar Patel Awas Yojana in our village. A certificate should be produced that there is no house in his name or in the name of his wife in his native place and they should fall in the definition of B.P.L.
1. Benefit under Sardar Patel Awas Yojana is available to the villager living Below Poverty Line only once.

name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
brief_description: "Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Manipur. In this schemeRs. the Students with Disability (SwD) who are a domicile of the State of ManipurRs. and are studying in Class 1st and above are awarded with scholarship of upto 8Rs./-. The student must be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Govt. of Manipur. The amount of the scholarhip shall be disbursed directly into the bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (PwD). 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be a domicile of the State of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st and above. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Govt. of Manipur. 1. The applicant should not be availing scholarship under any other similar scheme from any source.

name: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The purpose of this scheme is to encourage registered beneficiaries employed in building and other construction works and their children to participate in international sports. This scheme will be effective on those employed in the Labour Department building and other construction workers who are registered as beneficiaries in the board under Section-12 of the The Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) ActRs. 1996Rs. and are depositing their contributions regularly. This scheme will be effective in the entire state of Rajasthan.
benefits:
The incentive amount under this scheme for International level sports competition to the eligible beneficiary or his children will be given as follows: -

- Participating in the competition- 2Rs./-
- On receiving the Bronze medal- 5Rs./-
- On receiving the Silver medal- 8Rs./-
- On receiving the Gold medal- 11Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan State.
1. For this schemeRs. those construction workers will be eligibleRs. who are registered as labour under labour law.
1. Those building and other construction workers will be eligible who are registered as beneficiaries in the board under Section-12 of The Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) ActRs. 1996 and are depositing their contribution regularly.
1. In addition to the aboveRs. unmarried sons and daughters of construction workers will also be eligible for assistance under the scheme.

**Other Terms & Conditions:**

- The provisions of the scheme will not be applicable to any online gaming / betting-related competition.
- Declaration of invalidity of Sportsperson or withdrawal of medals won by the participant due to doping or any valid reason stipulated by the organising committee no incentives will be payable under the scheme.
- During scrutiny of the application and documentsRs. if any facts are found to be false resulting in the cancellation of eligibilityRs. it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit all the assistance amount sanctioned under the scheme along with interest.

name: Incentive For The Simple Marriage
brief_description:
The Simple Marriage scheme is a government initiative by the Social Welfare Department of Karnataka that offers incentives to couples belonging to the SC community who opt for a simple marriage ceremony. The scheme aims to promote the concept of simple marriages and provide financial assistance to eligible couples.
Under this schemeRs. the Social Welfare Department of Karnataka will provide incentives to Simple Married Couples belonging to the SC Community who have submitted their applications within 1 year of marriage. Only couples who got married on or after 11-08-2015 are eligible for the incentiveRs. which is set at Rs. 50Rs..00.
To be eligible for the schemeRs. the applicant must be a resident of Karnataka stateRs. belong to the SC communityRs. and have a family income from all sources that does not exceed Rs. 2 lakhs per annum. It is important to note that the scheme is applicable within 1 year of marriage
eligibility:
1. Karnataka State Resident: The applicant must be a resident of Karnataka state.
1. SC Community: The applicant must belong to the SC community.
1. Family Income: The family income from all sources should not exceed Rs. 2 lakhs per annum.
1. Time Limit: The scheme is applicable only within 1 year of the marriage.

name: Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme
brief_description: The Govt. of Sikkim launched a scheme named Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme (SUWPS) in 2013 for unmarried women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Sikkim. Under this schemeRs. the unmarried women of BPL families in the age group 45-59 years without any source of income are eligible for payment of 2Rs. as a monthly pension. This scheme is 100% State Innovative Scheme and the unmarried woman should not have been covered by any other existing pension schemes of the State or Central government.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the state of Sikkim.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The applicant should be unmarried.
1. The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should be in the 45-59 years age group.
1. The applicant should not have any source of income.

name: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance to Disabled for Self Employment" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to facilitate the self-employment of unemployed disabled persons. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities for self-employmentRs. small-scale businessRs. and agro-based project. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (Visually HandicappedRs. Low VisionRs. Hearing ImpairedRs. Orthopedically HandicappedRs. etc).
1. The percentage of the disability should be 40% or above.
1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 50 years age group.
1. The annual income of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./-.

name: Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana
brief_description:
Labour and ESI DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha has introduced a scheme "**Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana (NSPGY)**" to meet the housing needs of the building and other construction workers in rural areasRs. registered under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (OB&OCWWB)Rs. who play a pivotal role in the construction of individual and community assets and do not have their own pucca house.
**Objective:**

1. The scheme's objective is to provide pucca houses to Building workers & other construction workers in rural areas registered under the Odisha Building Workers' Welfare Board.
1. A pucca house means that it should be able to withstand normal wear and tear due to usage and natural forces including climatic conditions.

**Key Features:**

1. NSPGY is a scheme purely funded by the OB&OCVVWB with an annual budgetary outlay to be decided by the Board for each financial yearRs. which is subject to revision from time to time.
1. The dwelling unit under NSPGY will be sanctioned preferably in the name of the woman head of the household.
1. No contractor shall be involved in the construction of houses under NSPGY.
1. The fund under the scheme shall be credited to the beneficiary's account from the bank account maintained at the state level by PR & DW Department through Public Financial Management System (PFMS). No other form of payment to the beneficiaries will be made under the scheme.
1. The minimum carpet area of the house should be 25 square meters including a hygienic cooking space and excluding toilet. The roof material will mandatorily be of RCC or any other material of equivalent strength approved by PR&DW Department. Innovation in housing typologiesRs. designRs. building materialsRs. and construction should be encouraged.

**Timelines:**

1. The houses under this scheme will be ordinarily completed within 12 months from the credit of 1st installment in her/his account.
1. Beneficiaries constructing a bigger house must be advised to first complete the core house with a carpet area of at least 25 square meters and go for extension subsequently.

**Note:**

1. Any beneficiary allotted with a house under this scheme whose house has fully collapsed/washed away/fully damaged due to landslide/elephant menace/earthquake/flood/fire accident or cycloneRs. will be eligible to get another house under this scheme.
1. The funds for this scheme will be released by the OB&OCWW Board and the execution/implementation of the scheme will be carried out by the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department.
benefits:
1. The unit cost under NSPGY for new construction of dwelling houses is 1Rs./- for Non-IAP districts and 1Rs./- for IAP districts.
1. The beneficiary of NSPGY will get a wage component for 90 person days and 95 person days in Non-IAP and IAP districts respectively under MGNREGSRs. which can be revised by the government from time to time.
1. The beneficiary of NSPGY will avail 12Rs. for IHHL under MGNREGS/SBM(G).
1. In additionRs. the beneficiaries are entitled to convergence for potable drinking water supply systemRs. electrification under Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDU GJY)/BGJYRs. wages for land development under MGNREGSRs. social security under AABY/RSBYRs. etc. as per extant guidelines.
1. The beneficiary will avail of incentives for early completion of the house as follows:-


- For completion of the house and IHHL within 4 months of receipt of 1st installmentRs. an incentive of 20Rs./- will be paid to the beneficiary.
- For completion of the house and IHHL within 6 months of receipt of 1st installmentRs. an incentive of 10Rs./- will be paid to the beneficiary. Govt. may revise the incentive amount from time to time.

The amount/unit cost will be released in Instalments and will be linked to the level of construction reached. At presentRs. the release of installments will be as follows:
**Installment****Level****IAP (Amount in Rupees)****Non-IAP (Amount in Rupees)**1st InstallmentOn issuance of a work order20000200002nd InstallmentOn completion of the plinth35000300003rd InstallmentOn completion of up to roof level45000400004th InstallmentAfter completion of the house in all respects including the sanitary latrine and beneficiary starts living in the house.3000030000Total1Rs.**Note:**

1. The amount/unit cost can be revised by the State Government from time to time at par with Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana (BPGY).
1. The unit assistance for the construction of IHHL can be revised by the Government from time to time.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Odisha.
1. The applicant should not have a pucca house.
1. The applicant must be engaged as a 'building worker' in building or other construction work as defined U/s. 2(1)(d) of the Building & Other Construction Workers' (RE&CS) ActRs. 1996 and Notification No.5654 dated 27.06.2009 and No.5985 dated 28.07.2014 of the Labour & ESI Deptt.Rs. Govt. of Odisha for not less than 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should not be engaged in any building or other construction work to which the provisions of the Factories ActRs. 1948Rs. or the Mines ActRs. 1952 apply.
1. The applicant should be completed 18 years of ageRs. but not completed 60 years of age.
1. The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
1. The construction worker should not enroll in any other district of Odisha or any other State of the country as a beneficiary in any Welfare Board.
1. The applicant must be registered with the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board under the Building and Other Construction Workers (RE&CS) Act.

name: Krushi Mahotsav
brief_description:
**Detailed**
Some of the key features of the Krishi Mahotsav Yojana Gujarat are:

1. **Soil Health Card**: The government provides soil health cards to farmers to help them understand the nutrient status of their soil and take appropriate measures to improve soil fertility. 1. **Subsidized Inputs**: The government provides subsidies on various agricultural inputs such as seedsRs. fertilizersRs. and pesticides to encourage farmers to use quality inputs and increase their crop yields. 1. **Training and Extension Services:** The government provides training and extension services to farmers to help them adopt modern and scientific farming practices and improve their productivity. 1. **Agricultural Infrastructure Development**: The government invests in the development of agricultural infrastructure such as irrigation facilitiesRs. rural roadsRs. and markets to improve farmers' access to inputs and markets. 1. **Crop Insurance:** The government provides crop insurance to farmers to protect them from crop losses due to natural calamitiesRs. pestsRs. and diseases. 1. **Financial Assistance**: The government provides financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of farm machinery and equipmentRs. as well as for the development of farm infrastructure. 1. The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana Gujarat is implemented through various activities and programs such as farmer meetingsRs. soil testingRs. crop demonstrationsRs. and training programs. The government also encourages farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices such as organic farming and use of renewable energy sources.
1. The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana Gujarat has played a significant role in transforming the agricultural landscape of the state and has improved the livelihoods of farmers by increasing their crop yields and incomes.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. All farmers and Female farmers of the state.
1. The scheme is available to all farmers in the state of Gujarat.
1. There are no restrictions based on casteRs. religionRs. or gender.
1. Farmers who are interested in learning about the latest agricultural practices and improving their crop yields are encouraged to participate.

name: Atal Sneh Yojana
brief_description: **Detailed** Atal Sneh Yojana in Gujarat is the scheme that has launched on the 25th of December 2016 on the occasion of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayees ninety-second birthday. The scheme is launched by the Chief Minister of GujaratRs. Mr. Vijay Rupani. The scheme will look forward to a healthy child after their birth. It was decided at the Gandhinagar Civil Hospital and it will look upon the children up to two months after their birth. After focusing on the health of the children and covering some major diseases the government has now shifted its focus to core issues. BasicallyRs. the Atal Sneh Yojana will replace the decades-old Annual School Program which was being carried out by the health and education departments. For this new schemeRs. newborn children will be screened specifically to look for health defects and improve them. This is being launched wide across Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. the newborn kids will be screened and given treatment immediately if there is any illness found. It will be carried out for two long months. **Objectives** 1. Through this schemeRs. children can be provided with better health. Better health will lead to avoiding malnutritionRs. disordersRs. and diseases. 1. Around seven percent of newly born babies every year are suffering from certain disorders and that has created a serious issue in the international platform. So by preventing such troubleRs. the country can be in a better position in international health conferences. 1. With such schemesRs. the government is also looking for a stronger young generation and this young generation would lead to having a stronger nation. **some of the dire diseases kids suffer from** 1. The children suffer from some very grave diseases such as complicated birth defects such as Downs syndromeRs. congenital deafnessRs. club footRs. neural tube defectRs. etc. 1. These are not all. There are some diseasesRs. which are there present in the dormant state within the genes. By checking the kids at their tender ageRs. the doctors will be able to better treat them. 1. The Chief Minister of the state launched that all of the diseases that are detected at the maternity homes by the government will be taken care of by the government. <br>
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. All Newborn children are eligible.
1. Age should be up to two months after their birth.

name: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
brief_description: The "Special Education and Vocational Training through Government Institutions" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (Visually ImpairedRs. Hearing ImpairedRs. Orthopedically HandicappedRs. etc).
1. The percentage of disability should be 40% and above.
1. For Special EducationRs. the age of the applicant should be between 6 to 18 years.
1. For Vocational EducationRs. the age of the applicant should be 18 years and above.

name: Financial Assistance For Aids And Appliances For Disabled Persons
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance for Aids and Appliances for Disabled Persons" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to provide assistance to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) for the purchase of aids and appliances as per their age group and the type of disability. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (Visually HandicappedRs. Low VisionRs. Hearing ImpairedRs. Orthopedically HandicappedRs. etc).
1. The percentage of the disability should be 40% or above.
1. For financial assistance of 100% of the cost of the aids and appliancesRs. the monthly income of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./-.
1. For financial assistance of 50% of the cost of the aids and appliancesRs. the monthly income of the applicant should be between 1Rs./- to 2Rs./-.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
brief_description:
**Details** Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana is implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department. The Revenue Department is responsible for the implementation of the schemeRs. including the verification of crop damage and the disbursal of compensation to eligible farmers. The Agriculture and Co-operation Department provides technical assistance and support for the implementation of the scheme to ensure that farmers receive timely and adequate relief in case of crop damage due to natural calamities.
**Key Points** 1. The main objective behind launching this scheme is to provide financial assistance to farmers of Gujarat in case of crop loss. 1. Financial Assistance will only be provided to farmers if Crop Loss is due to natural calamities. 1. No premium will have to pay by the farmers to get themselves registered under Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana. 1. Financial Assistance will only be paid up to a maximum of 4 Hectares of Agricultural Land. 1. Eligible Farmers can apply by visiting their nearest E Gram Centre to avail the benefit of financial assistance in case of crop loss.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Gujarat state.
1. The applicant must have availed of a loan for agricultural purposes from a cooperative institution or a bank.
1. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as droughtRs. floodRs. or earthquake.
1. The applicant must possess the land for agricultural purposes in his/her name or have the right to cultivate such land.
1. The land should be surveyed by the Revenue Department of Gujarat and should have a record of rights.
1. The crop loss should be certified by the Revenue Department of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have insured the crop under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana or any other crop insurance scheme recognized by the Government of Gujarat.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: Launched in the year 2014Rs. the scheme Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme by the Department of Women & Child WelfareRs. Govt. of Sikkim. Under this schemeRs. financial support is provided to the poor widows of the state of Sikkim. A widow whose household is below the poverty line is eligible to get the benefits of the pension scheme. The beneficiary receives a monthly pension of 2000/- and the pension amount consists of the Central and State governments' share.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Sikkim. 1. The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should have attained the age of 21 years and above. 1. The applicant should not have any source of income i.e. applicant should not be a recipient of salary / pension / family pension from Central Government / other State Governments. 1. The applicant should have opened the Bank Account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.
**Note 1:** If the beneficiary remarriedRs. the pension shall be ceased to be drawn from the date of her re-marriage.

name: Odisha State Treatment Fund
brief_description: The Department of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named The "**Odisha State Treatment Fund"** scheme which aims to provide financial assistance to the poor patients who are suffering from life threatening disorders & diseasesRs. for treatment of their major ailments. The fund is managed by an autonomous society known as Odisha State Treatment Fund Society. The Society is registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860. The financial assistance will be released to the Medical Institutions in which treatment has been/is being given to the patients. The eligible patients will be provided assistance for treatment in specific life threatening diseases as mentioned at **Annexure D** in the detailed guidelines**.**
benefits:
1. OSTF will be a top up to RSBY. The patient will be covered under RSBY at the first assistance and where the amount of assistance required exceeds the limit of RSBYRs. the patient will be provided assistance under OSTF.
1. Treatment cost so approved shall be within the upper limit of Rs.3.00 lakh (Rupees three lakh only).
1. The sanction of District Head Quarters Hospitals shall be limited to Rs.30Rs./- per case. Where the quantum of assistance exceeds Rs.30Rs./- CDMO with the approval of the Collector-cum-District Magistrate concerned can sanction up to Rs.50Rs./-.
1. For assistance over and above Rs.3.00 lakhRs. approval of the Honble Chief MinisterRs. Odisha needs to be obtained.
eligibility:
1. It is applicable to persons below the poverty lineRs. person with annual family income not exceeding Rs.40Rs./- in rural area and Rs.60Rs./- in urban areas. Either BPL card / AAY card or annual income certificate issued by concerned Tahasildar will be accepted for determining the eligibility.
1. Rastriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) card holder is also eligible under this scheme.
1. An unknown accident victimRs. patients duly referred from registered destitute home / orphanage / mental asylum / Child care Institutions are also eligible for assistance under the scheme subject to citing sufficient reason thereof for recommending the patient under the scheme.
1. Assistance will be available only to patients undergoing treatment as in-patient in any of the Govt./Empanelled private hospitals. However this will not restrict : Cancer patients from getting chemo in Govt. Day Care Centre without being formally admitted & Patients who have undergone kidney transplantation at Govt. Hospitals from getting post-operative care including supply of free medicines and investigation up to 6 months from the date discharge.

name: The Post-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes Students
brief_description: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribes Students" by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. and the Government of Mizoram aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students pursuing post-matriculation education. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to ST students enrolled in recognized professionalRs. technicalRs. non-professionalRs. and non-technical coursesRs. including correspondenceRs. distanceRs. and continuing education. The scheme is implemented by the Mizoram Scholarship BoardRs. Government of Mizoram. It ensures that students can pursue higher education without financial constraints. The assistance supports education at various levels and promotes educational advancement among Scheduled Tribes. The funding is shared in a 90:10 ratio between the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Mizoram State Government.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance for post-matric education. 1. Support for ST students pursuing recognized professionalRs. technicalRs. non-professionalRs. non-technicalRs. and correspondence courses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes community. 1. The applicant should be permanently settled in the state of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be pursuing studies from Class XI up to a Post-Doctoral Fellowship. 1. The applicants parents/guardians income from all sources should not exceed 2Rs. (Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand only) per annum.

name: Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme
brief_description: **Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme** is a scheme under the Social Welfare and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial help to widowsRs. abandoned womenRs. and unmarried women shall be entitled to receive pension for a sum of Rs.1Rs./-per month. The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of these women who are unable to support themselves financially.
benefits:
1. Financial assistance of Rs.1Rs./- per month to eligible widowsRs. deserted womenRs. and unmarried women.
1. The pension amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
1. It helps improve the standard of living of eligible women and reduces their financial burden.
1. Provides a sense of security and support to eligible women.
eligibility: 1. Applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. Applicant must be a widowRs. deserted womanRs. or unmarried woman. 1. Applicant's annual income should not exceed Rs. 35Rs..

name: Unemployment Allowance
brief_description: The main objective of the Chhattisgarh Berozgari Bhatta Yojana is to provide financial assistance to the unemployed youth of the state till they get employment.
eligibility:
**Conditions of qualification** 1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 years to 35 years as on 01 April of the year in which the application is made. 1. The applicant must have passed the minimum Higher Secondary (12th) examination from a recognized board. 1. Should be registered in any District Employment and Self-Employment Guidance Center of Chhattisgarh and his employment registration should be at least two years old with higher secondary or above qualification as on April 01 of the year of application. 1. The applicant should not have any source of income of his own and the annual income of the applicant's family from all sources should not exceed Rs.2Rs./-.
**Conditions of disqualification** 1. If more than one member of a family fulfills the conditions of eligibility for unemployment allowanceRs. only one member of the family will be approved for unemployment allowance. In such a situationRs. unemployment allowance will be approved to that member whose age is more. In case of equality of ageRs. the member who got registered first in the employment office will be eligible for unemployment allowance. In case both the age and date of employment registration are sameRs. the member who has higher educational qualification will be eligible. 1. If any member of the applicant's family is employed in any category of job other than Class-IV or Group-D in any Central or State Government organization or local bodyRs. such applicant will be ineligible for unemployment allowance. 1. If the applicant is offered self-employment or any job in government or private sectorRs. but the applicant does not accept the offerRs. then such applicant will be ineligible for unemployment allowance. 1. Family members of former and present MinistersRs. State Ministers and former or present Members of Parliament or State LegislaturesRs. former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations and former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats shall be ineligible for unemployment allowance. 1. The family members of pensioners who receive monthly pension of Rs.10Rs. or more will be ineligible for unemployment allowance. 1. The family members of those families who have paid income tax in the previous assessment year will be ineligible for unemployment allowance. 1. Family members of other professionals such as engineersRs. doctorsRs. lawyersRs. chartered accountants and architects registered with professional bodies shall be ineligible for unemployment allowance.

name: Chief Ministers Yuva Kaushal Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Chief Ministers Yuva Kaushal Yojana (CM YKY) has been launched in the state of Arunachal Pradesh with effect from 1 April 2018 to provide high-end training to youth across the country. The programme is fully funded under the state plan with a specific focus on providing job linked high end training programme to the youth. The objective of the scheme is to provide high-end training to the youth across the state to enable them to find jobs in the private sector. **Important Features:** There are 2 categories of training provided under CM YKY: 1. Training within the state by inviting reputed Vocation Training Providers and providing them with suitable incentives. 2. Training outside the State by identifying high-end reputed Vocational Training Providers and courses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant should have a minimum qualification of class X.

name: Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme
brief_description: The Cluster Nutritional Kitchen Garden Scheme (CNKGS) aims to empower marginal farmers and the general public by promoting the cultivation of vegetables and the rearing of livestock within their own households. The scheme seeks to enhance self-sufficiency and improve nutritional requirements by enabling individuals to grow their own fresh and healthy produce. This initiative will be implemented at the district level under the guidance of the respective MLAs (Members of Legislative Assembly) and Deputy Commissioners.
eligibility:
- Resident of Arunachal Pradesh: Applicants must be permanent residents of Arunachal PradeshRs. possessing valid residential proof such as ration cardRs. electricity billRs. or driving license.
- Marginal Farmers: The scheme is open to marginal farmers who own or lease small areas of agricultural land suitable for kitchen gardening. Land ownership documents or lease agreements may be required as proof.
