- General Public: Individuals from the general public who are interested in establishing a kitchen garden and meet the eligibility criteria are also eligible to apply for the scheme.
- Availability of Space: Applicants must have sufficient space within their premises to establish a kitchen garden. Adequate land or open space is necessary for growing vegetables and rearing livestock.
- Commitment and Capability: Eligible individuals should demonstrate the commitment and capability to maintain and sustain the kitchen garden. This includes dedicating time and effort for regular careRs. wateringRs. and management of the garden.

name: Advance For Purchase Or Construction Of House (APB&OCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Advance for Purchase or Construction of House was started by the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB). The state government has formulated this scheme to implement through the APB&OCWWB in which the board can sanction/ grant an amount for the outright purchase of a house or for the construction of a house to the eligible building and construction workers.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. cash assistance of 1.00 lakh is to be given to the registered workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant must be employed in the Building and Other Construction works.
3. The applicant should be registered with Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
4. The applicant should be an active registered worker with a membership for at least 5 years.
5. The applicant should have at least 15 years of service before superannuation/ retirement.
6. The applicant must be able to repay the principal amount of the loan with a minimum interest rate or with interest in equal installments as may be fixed by the board.

name: Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana
brief_description:
1. Constructions on the private sector of farmers (where paddy has been cultivated in the year 2020 and paddy has been sold to the government)Rs. the land of forest rights holdersRs. revenue land of government departmentsRs. Joint Forest Management Committee and Gram PanchayatsRs. non- To encourage commercial/industrial plantation of timber species.
1. Reducing the adverse effects of climate change by improving the environment.
1. To increase the income of farmers through tree plantation.
1. By promoting tree plantation on private and community landRs. by increasing the production of woodRs. gradually reducing the import of wood and by reducing the biotic pressure on the wood available in the forestsRs. keeping the forests safe.
1. Controlling floodsRs. drought etc. by promoting tree plantation and raising the water level of the land.
1. Fulfilment of wood requirements of 6 industriesRs. employment generation on a large scaleRs. G.D.P. increase in
eligibility:
1. All the farmers of Chhattisgarh state who have sold paddy to the government after cultivating paddy in the year 2020.

1. All Gram Panchayats and Joint Forest Management Committees who want to plant trees in revenue land with the amount available with them.

name: Arun Pig Development Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Arun Pig Development Scheme was launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Veterinary & Dairy DevelopmentRs. Government of Arunachal Pradesh in the financial year 2019-20 with a focus on pig rearing. Among the livestock speciesRs. the pig finds an important place as it is being reared by socio-economically weaker sections of the society especially in the states like Arunachal Pradesh where most of people prefer non-veg cuisines with special attractions for Pork. The pig as compared to other livestock species has a great potential to contribute to a faster economic return to the farmersRs. because of certain inherent traits like high fecundityRs. better-feed conversion efficiencyRs. early maturityRs. and short generation interval. Pig farming also requires small investments in buildings and equipment.
**Objective**

- Genetic improvement of the indigenous pigs of Arunachal Pradesh for productivity enhancement by crossbreeding with the exotic breed(s) to a desired level of combination of exotic and local inheritanceRs.
- Improvement of indigenous pig rearing by the rural people by selective breedingRs.
- Livelihood earning
- Maintenance of well-planned crossbred animals at farmers field
- Expansion of piggery husbandry and support mechanism to propagate pig rearing in rural areas
- Ensure that the breeds introducedRs. and crossbreds produced and propagated in the state are adapted to local environmental conditions and emerging climatic challengesRs.
- Strengthen support mechanisms and development of the sector in respect of feedingRs. housingRs. and health care besides value addition and marketing of the product with value chain development.
- Scientific rearing and motivation of farmers for integrated piggery farming.

**Important Features**

- Seeing the low interest of the actual grass root level farmer for the credit link schemes and their poor success rateRs. a new venture for piggery development in the state through direct intervention by the Department of AHV&DDRs. GoAP in terms of upgradation of genetic resourcesRs. and other peripheralsRs. a new and innovative scheme is proposed for Budget Announcement 2019-20 for sustainable development and poverty alleviation of Farmers through Pig Rearing in potential districts of Arunachal Pradesh.
- Livelihood earningRs. improvement of indigenous pig rearing by the rural people by selective breeding along with maintenance of well-planned crossbred animals at farmers fields.
- Expansion of piggery husbandry and support mechanism to propagate pig rearing in rural areas.
- Ensure that the breeds introducedRs. and crossbreds produced and propagated in the state are adapted to local environmental conditions and emerging climatic challenges.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. Pig-rearing individual farmers/ Self Help Groups (SHGs)Rs. ones identified by the District Pig Development Committee are eligible to apply under the scheme.
3. Preference would be given to women and genuinely poor farmers.

name: Mamata Scheme
brief_description:
In order to improve the process in curbing the high rate of mortality and infant mortality rateRs. the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named "**MAMATA**" - a conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme in 2011.
**Aim of the scheme:**

1. Contribute in reducing the maternal and infant mortality.
1. Improve the health and nutrition status of pregnant and lactating mother and their infants.

**Objectives of the scheme:**

1. To provide partial wage loss compensation for the pregnant and nursing mothers with the aim to provide complete rest before and after the child birth.
1. Increase in utilization of child health services especially immunization.
1. Improve mother and child care practices.
benefits:
- Rs.3Rs. shall be given during the third trimester of the pregnancy of the mother till delivery on completing the following 5 conditions:


1. Pregnancy registered at AWC/Mini AWC
1. Received at least 2 antenatal checkup (ANC)
1. Received IFA and calcium tablets.
1. Received at least 1 TT vaccination (out of optimal 2)
1. Received at least 1 counselling session at AWC/Village Health/ Home Visit.

The first 4 conditions shall be verified from MCP Card. On completing the above requirements first instalment shall be released.

- Rs.2Rs. shall be after completion of 10 months after delivery on fulfilment of following conditions:


1. Child birth is registered at AWC or HSC.
1. Child has received BCG vaccination.
1. Child has received Pentavalent 1 & 2 & 3 vaccinations.
1. Child has received Polio 1 & 2 & 3 vaccinations.
1. Child has received Rotavirus 1 & 2 & 3 vaccinations.
1. Child has received Measles vaccine before attaining 1 year of age.
1. Child has received Vitamin-A first dose before attaining 1 year of age
1. Mother has attended at least six Growth Monitoring and IYCF counselling sessions after delivery till 9 months
1. Child has been exclusively breastfed for first six months (self-certification by the beneficiary)
1. Child has been introduced to complementary food on completion of six months of age (self- certification by the beneficiary)
1. Child is being fed age-appropriate complementary feeding and continuing (self- certification by the beneficiary)

**Note:** OverallRs. Rs.5Rs. in two instalments as incentive is provided to mothers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
1. The scheme is primarily aimed at pregnant women.
1. Pregnant & Lactating women of 19 years of age and above for the first two live birthsRs. except all Government/Public Sector Undertakings (Central and State) employees and their wives will be covered.

name: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony
brief_description:
The scheme "Financial Assistance to the Child Victims of Violence under the National Foundation for Communal Harmony (NFCH)" is Financial Assistance by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir. It was registered on the 19th Feb 1992 under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860 with the main objective of providing financial assistance for the physical & psychological rehabilitation of child victims of communalRs. casteRs. ethnic & terrorist violence with special reference to their careRs. education & trainingRs. besides promoting communal harmonyRs. fraternityRs. and national integration. The applicant shall approach the concerned District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) for submission of the application. This scheme is 100% Sponsored by the Union Territory of Jammu & KashmirRs. and only the permanent residents of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir can apply for this scheme.
> **Objectives:** 1. To provide assistance to the children of families affected by c communalRs. casteRs. ethnicRs. and any other form of violence or clashes with fracture social harmony. The assistance is particularly aimed at their education and/or vocational training. 1. To assist in the physical and psychological rehabilitation and assimilation into the mainstream of society of the children of families affected by communalRs. casteRs. ethnicRs. and any other form of violence or clashes with fractured social harmony.
benefits:
> **General Education:** 1. Children in Class A & B cities receive 800/- per month until they reach the age of 18 years. 1. Children in other places receive 750/- per month until they reach the age of 18 years.
> **Training / Vocational Education:** 1. 150/- per month per child in addition to assistance for general education.
> **Group Personal Accident Insurance for Child Victims:** 1. Death: 25Rs./- 1. Loss of 2 limbs or one limb and one eye: 25Rs./-. 1. 100% permanent disablement other than those mentioned above: 25Rs./-. 1. Reimbursement of medical expenses incurred by a child for treatment in a hospital or nursing home and as an indoor patient for an injury sustained in an accident (based upon a medical certificate from the consulting doctor): 500/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a child less than 18 years of age. In exceptional casesRs. it can be extended up to the age of 21 years.
1. The applicant should be an Orphan or Destitute.
1. The applicant's main bread earner should have either been killed or permanently incapacitated in communalRs. casteRs. ethnicRs. or terrorist violence.
1.
The applicant's family should be 'Below Poverty Line' (BPL).
1. The applicant should not be receiving any assistance on a regular basis from any other source.

**NOTE:** The one-time financial assistance provided by the State Government / Union Territory Administration for such a victim is not considered 'another source of assistance' for this purpose.

name: Endeavour To Empower-Skill Development
brief_description:
Mission Youth is mandated to enhance the employability of youth in emerging market Job Markets through targeted market-driven skilling programmes. The objective of the scheme is to sponsor market-driven skill development training for the youth of J&K to facilitate 1. Enhancement of Employability & Marketability of Youth in high potential / emerging Job Markets. 1. Establishment of Independent Livelihood avenues for youth in various economic sectors. 1. Development of a resource pool of skilled youth that can be used for the positive economic transformation of J&K. 1. Promotion of the concept of "Be Vocal for Local".
**Mode of Training** Mission YouthRs. under this programmeRs. envisions partnering with all associated Government Departments/Agencies to bring moresynergy and efficacy in skilling efforts of the Government. The private market players shall also be endeavored to partner with Mission Youth to complement the Government efforts towardsyouth empowerment and employability. The mode of skill development trainings shall be collaborative and all-inclusive in natureRs. involving all market players from the Public and Private sectors.
**Training Partners** The following types of organizations/Institutions will be eligible to partner with Mission YouthRs. J&K and receive financial backing under the initiative: 1. All organizations/Institutes in the Government sector engaged in skill development trainingRs. including J&K Skill Development MissionRs. J&K EDIRs. KVIBRs. and any other such organizations/Institutes. 1. Organizations/Institutes in Private Sector engaged in skill development training; 1. TrustsRs. CompaniesRs. Partnership FirmsRs. or Societies registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. of 1860 and engaged in skill development training. 1. Any other organization/agency duly registered under relevant statutes.
benefits: - The trainings are given in focus sectors at TourismRs. ITRs. handicraftsRs. RetailRs. AgricultureRs. constructionRs. and other focus sectors of Jammu & Kashmir.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidhyarti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana" by the state government of Madhya Pradesh aims to ensure that the students who have secured 70% or more marks in the 12th examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education or 85% or more marks in the 12th board examination conducted by CBSE/ICSE and are residents of Madhya Pradesh and their father/guardian's annual income is less than 8Rs./-Rs. the state government will bear the tuition fee of such students under the Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana on getting admission in the following graduate level education courses. Under the schemeRs. as expenditure fee for graduation levelRs. only the admission fee and the actual fee (excluding mess fee and caution money)Rs. which has been determined by the Fee Regulatory Committee or M.P. Private University Regulatory Commission or the Government of India/State Government will be paid.
benefits: **1. General Coverage:** - Only the admission fee and the actual fee (excluding mess fee and caution money)Rs. as determined by the Fee Regulatory Committee or Madhya Pradesh Private University Regulatory Commission or the Government of India/State GovernmentRs. will be paid as an expenditure fee for graduation level. **2. For Engineering Studies (after securing a rank within 1Rs. in the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains exam):** - Full fees on admission to a government engineering college. - 1Rs./- on admission to a grant-in-aid/private engineering collegeRs. or the actual tuition feeRs. whichever is less. **3. For Medical Studies (after securing admission through National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET)):** - Tuition fee for admission in the MBBS/BDS course of Central or State Government Medical/Dental College. - Tuition fee for admission in the MBBS course of a private medical college situated in Madhya Pradesh. - Tuition fee for the MBBS course in Government of India institutionsRs. where admission is obtained on the basis of an examination conducted by the institution itself. **4. For Law Studies (after securing admission through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) or self-conducted examination):** - Tuition fee for admission in National Law Universities and Delhi University. **5. For Other Graduate and Integrated Postgraduate Programs:** - Tuition fees for admission in graduation programsRs. integrated post-graduation programsRs. and dual degree courses (which include a bachelor's degree along with a master's degree) run in all universities/institutions of the Government of India. - Tuition fee for admission in all courses run in all government and aided colleges/universities of the state government. - Tuition fee for diploma courses of polytechnic colleges (in which admission is obtained on the basis of the 12th examination).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 2. The annual income of the applicant's father/guardian must be less than 8Rs./-. 3. The applicant must have secured 70% or more marks in the 12th examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education from the academic session 2018-19 onwards. 4. The applicant must have secured 85% or more marks in the 12th examination conducted by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) or the Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE). 5. The applicant who obtained the specified marks in the 12th examinations prior to 2016 will also be eligible. 6. **For Engineering Studies:** [**Course List**](https://medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in/MedhaviChhatra/Public/CoursesAndInstitutes.aspx) - The applicant should have obtained a rank within 1Rs./- in the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains exam. - The applicant should have gained admission to any government or private engineering college on this basis. If an engineering college provides admission based on a separate entrance examinationRs. and the student holds a JEE Mains rank within 1Rs./-Rs. the applicant is also eligible. 7. **For Medical Studies:** [**Course List**](https://medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in/MedhaviChhatra/Public/CoursesAndInstitutes.aspx) - The applicant should have obtained admission based on the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) into an MBBS/BDS course of a Central or State Government Medical/Dental College. - The applicant should have also obtained admission into an MBBS course of a private medical college situated in Madhya Pradesh. Applicants who have obtained admission to MBBS courses in Government of India institutions based on examinations conducted by the institutions themselves will also be eligible. 8. **For Law Studies:** [**Course List**](https://medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in/MedhaviChhatra/Public/CoursesAndInstitutes.aspx) - The applicant should have obtained admission after the twelfth class to National Law Universities (NLU) and Delhi University through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) or through an examination conducted by the university itself. 9. **For Other Graduate and Integrated Postgraduate Programs:** [**Course List**](https://medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in/MedhaviChhatra/Public/CoursesAndInstitutes.aspx) - The applicant should have obtained admission to a Graduation ProgramRs. an Integrated Post Graduation ProgramRs. or a Dual Degree Course (which includes a Master's degree along with a Bachelor's degree) operated in any university/institution of the Government of India. 10. The applicant should have obtained admission to any course operated in all government and grant-in-aid colleges/universities of the state government. 11. The applicant must have obtained admission to diploma courses in polytechnic colleges (where admission is based on the 12th examination).

name: Swanirbhar Naari
brief_description:
Swanirbhar Naari is a state flagship scheme implemented by the Directorate of Handloom & TextilesRs. AssamRs. to support indigenous weavers and promote their traditional hand-woven items. The scheme ensures direct procurement from weavers without the involvement of middlemenRs. thereby providing them fair market access and improved remuneration for their craftsmanship.
Under the schemeRs. a dedicated online portal (swanirbharnaari.assam.gov.in) is used for the registration of eligible weavers. The weavers are required to undergo physical field verification by departmental officialsRs. and their registration is mapped with their Aadhaar number. The scheme encourages the weavers to acquire various certifications and provides quality training to upgrade their skills through Handloom Training Centres and Institutes. To enhance productivity and qualityRs. modern technology is integrated into the traditional weaving process.
benefits:
- Empowerment of indigenous weavers by eliminating middlemen and ensuring fair market access.
- Improved remuneration for the weavers through direct procurement and online payments.
- Skill upgradation and training opportunities through Handloom Training Centres and Institutes.
- Integration of modern technology to enhance the patternRs. qualityRs. and productivity of hand-woven items.
- Facilitation of certifications to validate the craftsmanship of the weavers.
- Increased market visibility and sales opportunities through showrooms and e-marketing platforms.
- Preservation and promotion of traditional hand-woven heritage of Assam.
eligibility:
1. The weaver must be a resident of Assam.
1. The weaver must have at least one handloom in their household.
1. The weaver must have a valid bank account with Core Banking Solution (CBS).
1. The weaver should possess a valid yarn passbook issued by the Directorate of Handloom & TextilesRs. Assam (if available).
1. Indigenous weavers from Assam and intended weavers are allowed to registerRs. subject to physical verification by concerned Inspectors of Handloom and TextileRs. Assam.

name: Nationwide Artificial Insemination Programme
brief_description:
The Madhya Pradesh government has launched a nationwide Artificial Insemination (AI) programme to improve the reproductive health of livestock and enhance the productivity of livestock. The programme is being implemented with the help of the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Dairying and FisheriesRs. the Government of India and the National Dairy Development Board.
Through this programmeRs. AI technicians will be trained at the district level and AI services will be provided to the farmers. The programme will focus on the use of quality semen and improved scientific techniques for better reproductive performance. The programme also aims to reduce the cost of artificial insemination for the farmers. The programme is expected to help the farmers to improve their income and the overall economic condition of the state
benefits:
1. Increased fertility rate: The programme will help to increase the fertility rate by providing access to artificial insemination services. This will help to improve the fertility rate of cowsRs. buffaloesRs. goats and sheep in the state.
1. Improved quality of livestock: The programme will help to improve the quality of livestock through the use of improved semen from superior bulls. This will help to improve the production of milk and meat as well as the quality of the animals.
1. Improved animal health: Artificial insemination will help to improve the health of animals by reducing the spread of diseases. This will help to reduce the number of deaths of animals due to disease.
1. Increased production: The programme will help to increase the production of milk and meatRs. which will help to improve the economic status of farmers.
eligibility:
1. The livestock owner should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have valid livestock registration documents.
1. The applicant should have the required infrastructure to undertake AI operations.
1. The applicant should not belong to any of the scheduled castes and tribes.
1. The applicant should have the required knowledge and skill to undertake AI operations.
1. The applicant should not have any prior criminal record.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Tribe Women
brief_description: The scheme Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Tribe Women was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State. Under the schemeRs. each beneficiary should purchase 10 female goats and 1 male goat and the beneficiary has to contribute 50% of the unit cost for foodRs. waterRs. fodderRs. residenceRs. and concentrate expenses.
benefits:
1. 50% Subsidy on Unit Cost or Maximum 45Rs./-.
1. Benefit of the scheme will be available once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a Scheduled Tribe (ST) woman. 1. The benefit has provided to only one person per family. 1. Priority will be given if the applicant is: - A Scheduled Tribe widowRs. or - An abandoned woman.
> **Note 01:** The beneficiary has to purchase goats unit within 90 days of pre-approval of the online application. If the beneficiary fails to establish the goat unit within the time limit or proves disabled then the approval order given to the beneficiary will be cancelled and the approval order will be given to the beneficiary who is next in the waiting list.
> **Note 02:** The beneficiary has to note the record of milk production and has to give the register and information during the visit of the department technical officer.

name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit For Divyang People
brief_description:
The scheme Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit for Divyang People was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to provide employmentRs. nutritious diet and to raise the income of Divyang People of the society of Gujarat State. Under this schemeRs. the beneficiary will be given 40 R.I.R birds unit along with poultry feed and a subsidy will be given 90% of the cost of the scheme (maximum 7200/- in form birds and poultry feed).
**Terms and conditions of the scheme:-**

- Eligible applications will be sanctioned by Regional Joint Director.
- As and when birds get infectedRs. they should be given treatment immediately.
- As and when the Government officer visits the farm the beneficiary will have to show income and expenditure statement.
- In normal casesRs. the unit will have to maintain for two years.
- In all terms and conditionsRs. the final authority will be the Director of Animal HusbandryRs. Gujarat StateRs. Gandhinagar.
benefits:
1. The beneficiary will be given 40 R.I.R birds unit along with poultry feed.
2. The subsidy will be given 90% of the unit cost of the scheme (maximum 7200/- in the form of birds and poultry feed).
3. Under the schemeRs. the birds will be given vaccination regularly.
eligibility:
1. The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of Divyang people of the society of Gujarat State.
1. The beneficiary will have to provide income proof along with the application.
1. Females and beneficiaries below poverty line will be given priority.
1. The beneficiary should have taken poultry-keeping training.
1. The beneficiary will have to manage to keep the birds safe during night hours.

name: Ashirwad
brief_description: There are many members of the economically disadvantaged part of society who are unable to plan their daughters weddings owing to their precarious financial situation. And they deal with several issues relating to this. The Punjab Ashirwad plan has been introduced by the Punjab government by keeping such a situation in mind. Girls from economically disadvantaged parts of society will get financial aid under this program. so that they wont have to worry about any financial obligations when planning their daughters wedding. The scheme aims not only to help girls but also to encourage such families who are raising girls and want to marry them.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 51Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. Girl should be 18 years old or above.
1. Annual income of the family from all sources does not exceed 32Rs./-.
1. Parents/Guardians of the girl should be domiciled in Punjab State.
1. The application can be given before the fixed date of marriage or after the 30 days of the marriage by the applicant for getting financial assistance.
1. The amount of Ashirwad is limited up to two girls of the concerned family under the scheme.
1. Financial assistance is given to Scheduled Castes/Christian girlsRs. Backward Classes/CastesRs. Economically weaker sections girlsRs. daughters of widows of any caste at the time of their marriageRs. and Scheduled Castes widows/divorcees at the time of their re-marriage.

name: Young Interns Program
brief_description:
The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship programRs. envisaged by the Government of RajasthanRs. for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programsRs. schemes and projects of the government departments. The program is mutually beneficial to the government as well as the interns: 1. **The Government** is benefitted by infusing novelty and innovation in the project implementation and service delivery system through the youthful and courageous ideas & techniques of the young interns. 1. **The Interns** are benefitted by attaining knowledge of project implementation and the ecosystem of the government functionalities.
> **Objectives** 1. To empower the young brains to attain awareness and knowledge about various government programs and services and about various interventions between governmentRs. service providersRs. recipients and peripheral agencies such as mediaRs. civil society etc. 1. To strengthen their research and evaluation skills in the field of public administration and development services. 1. To generate interest amongst the youth towards the entire service delivery ecosystem of the public services. 1. To get independent critical analysis of government programs and for seeking suggestions for corrective measures. 1. To augment innovations from the young minds to enhance the outreach and impact of government schemes & programs.
> **Deployment** For FY 2023-24Rs. the following arrangements for the deployment of 300 young interns may be executed: 1. Interns to be deployed at each Divisional HQ: 3 each (7x3=21) 1. Interns to be deployed at each District HQ: 2 each (26x2=52) 1. Interns to be deployed at the Department level for specific to the schemes/projects/programs: 227 (300-21-52=227)
> **Duration** 1. The internship is of **one-year duration.** **NOTE 1:** After the end of the first yearRs. if the mentor/nodal officer feels and recommends the extension in the internship duration on the basis of the performance of the internRs. the duration of the internship may be increased by one more year with six months at a time. **NOTE 2:** In no circumstancesRs. the duration of the internship shall be more than two years.
benefits:
> **Stipend** 30Rs./- per month.
> **Laptop Connectivity and Mobility Support** 2500/- shall be paid to each intern per month.
> **Leaves** Every intern will be eligible for one casual leave every month on an accrual basis. Such leaves shall be provided in a cumulative manner i.e. 12 leaves for the entire year (from January to December).
eligibility:
> **General** 1. The age of the applicant should be between 21 years and 30 years. 1. The applicant should have excellent communication/presentation/intrapersonal skills/soft skills. 1. The applicant should have good Knowledge of English as well as Hindi language (ReadingRs. SpeakingRs. Writing and Understanding) 1. The applicant should have well-versed ICT skills and knowledge of MS Office and other similar programs on alternative platforms. 1. It is mandatory for all the interns to have their own Laptop and data card/internet facility.
> **Education Specific** 1. The applicant should have a post-graduate qualification with a minimum of 60% marks or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 in any stream from a recognized university. 1. The graduate applicant of Engineering/Medical/Law/CA/CS Streams from a recognized University with a minimum 60% mark or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 shall also be eligible for this internship.
> **Reservation / Preference / Priority** 1. The applicant with working experience in the field of his/her choice of department shall be given priority.
**NOTE 1:** Any other additional educational and/or technical qualifications and experience shall be as per the special requirements submitted by the concerned department/district collector/divisional HQRs. if any. **NOTE 2:** In case of any disputeRs. the decision of the Secretary-in-charge ofRs. Statistics Department will be binding and final.

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
brief_description:
The scheme "Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)" is a component of the Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE)Rs. which is a flagship programme of the Department of Science and Technology (DST)Rs. under the Ministry of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to attract students to study basic and natural Science subjects at undergraduate and postgraduate levels and pursue research as a career by providing scholarships to interested and deserving students. Under the SHE componentRs. 12Rs. scholarships (From the SHE-2017 batch onwards)Rs. each valued at 80Rs./- are announced annually to students pursuing Bachelor and Masters level courses in Basic and Natural Science areas.
> **Tenure** 1. Selected candidates will be supported for a maximum period of five yearsRs. starting from the 1st year B.Sc.Rs. B.S.Rs. Int. M.Sc./Int.M.S. or until the completion of the courseRs. whichever is earlier. 1. Continuation of the scholarship for the selected candidates is based on good academic performance in the examinations conducted by the University and upon the recommendation by the Head of the Institution.
The following subjects under Basic and Natural Sciences are within the scope of INSPIRE Scholarship for pursuing B.Sc./B.S./Int. M.Sc./Int. M.S. courses: (1) Physics (2) Chemistry (3) Mathematics (4) Biology (5) Statistics (6) Geology (7) Astrophysics (8) Astronomy (9) Electronics (10) Botany (11) Zoology (12) Biochemistry (13) Anthropology (14) Microbiology (15) Geophysics (16) Geochemistry (17) Atmospheric Sciences & (18) Oceanic Sciences. Courses other than these subjects such as EngineeringRs. MedicineRs. Military ScienceRs. Defence StudiesRs. AgricultureRs. PsychologyRs. Seed TechnologyRs. Home ScienceRs. GeographyRs. EconomicsRs. Education (including B.Sc.-B.Ed. dual degree course)Rs. BiotechnologyRs. Computer ScienceRs. Computer ApplicationsRs. BioinformaticsRs. InstrumentationRs. Information TechnologyRs. Physical EducationRs. courses in Distance Education mode at Open Universities and other professional courses etc. are NOT supported.
benefits:
1. The scholarship is valued at 80Rs./- per annum.
1. Each candidate will receive an annual scholarship @ 5000/- per month with a total value of 60Rs./-.
1. All the SHE scholars are required to undertake summer research projects under an active researcher in any recognized research centre across India.
1. A summertime Mentorship grant of 20Rs./- will be paid every year.
1. The scholarship will be transferred to the scholars State Bank of India (SBI) bank account directly through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.
eligibility:
(a) Meritorious Students with aggregate marks within the top 1% of their Class XII examination of any State/ Central Education Board in India are eligible. In additionRs. the student must be pursuing courses in Natural and Basic Sciences at the B.Sc.Rs. B.S.Rs. and Int.M.Sc./M.S. level.
**OR**
(b) Those students who have secured ranks in the JEE of IITRs. AIPMT (within the top 10000 ranks)Rs. and are presently pursuing Natural and Basic Science courses in India at the B.Sc.Rs. B.S.Rs. Int. M.Sc./M.S. level.
**OR**
(c) Students with aggregate marks within the top 1% of their Class XII examination of any State/ Central Education Board in India and pursuing Integrated M.S. courses in Natural and Basic Sciences at IISERsRs. NISER and Department of Atomic Energy Centre for the Basic SciencesRs.University of Mumbai and Visva-BharatiRs. Shanti Niketan.
**OR**
(d) Students who have been selected under Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY) and pursuing Bachelor/Master level courses in Natural Sciences.
**OR**
(e) National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) scholarsRs. Jagadish Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS) scholars and International Olympiad medallists pursuing Bachelor/ Master level courses in Natural Sciences are also eligible.

name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Weaker Section
brief_description: The scheme Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Weaker Section was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers by scientific poultry farming training. Under this schemeRs. the beneficiary will be given a maximum 2000 (direct in bank account) stipend for six days of training and a poultry training certificate after completion of training.
benefits:
1. The beneficiary will be given maximum 2000 (direct in bank account) stipend for six days training. (Considering 300/- per dayRs. 1800/- for 6 days as daily allowance and 200/- as to & fro transport fare with the maximum total stipend 2000/-)
1. Beneficiary will be given poultry training certificate after completion of training.
eligibility:
1. The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of economically weaker sections people of the society of Gujarat State.
1. The beneficiary will have to provide income proof along with the application.
1. Females and beneficiaries Below Poverty Line will be given priority.

name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojna
brief_description:
Bihar State Crop Assistance Scheme has been started by the State Government of Bihar to protect the crops of farmers cultivating in Bihar from natural calamities such as floodsRs. droughtRs. etc. Is. Under this Bihar State Crop Assistance SchemeRs. if there is any damage to the farming of farmers due to any natural calamityRs. then they will be provided financial assistance by the Government of Bihar under the Bihar State Crop Assistance Scheme.
- Covered crop:

1. Aghani paddy crop: is notified in all gram panchayats of a total of 527 (except NavgachiaRs. BihpurRs. GopalpurRs. NarayanpurRs. IsmailpurRs. Rangrachowk and Kharik circles of Bhagalpur) in 38 districts of the state.
1. Bhadai - Maize crop: is notified in all gram panchayats of a total of 534 of 38 districts of the state.
1. The soybean crop is notified as a district-level crop for BegusaraiRs. SamastipurRs. and Khagaria districts.

Clauses (1) and (2) are also notified in the Nagar Panchayat and Nagar Parishad located in the concerned district.
benefits:
1. In case of a reduction in the actual yield rate by 20% as compared to the threshold yield rateRs. total assistance of Rs. 15Rs. is estimated at the rate of Rs. 7Rs. per hectare up to a maximum of two (02) hectares.
1. In the event of more than a 20% reduction in the actual yield rate as compared to the threshold yield rateRs. total assistance of Rs. 20Rs. is estimated at the rate of Rs. 10Rs. per hectare up to a maximum of two (02) hectares.
eligibility:
1. All such farmers cultivate their own land.
1. All such farmers cultivate the land of others.
1. Such farmers do farming on their own land as well as on the land of others.

name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Caste
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Caste was started by the Dept. of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. the small and poor farmers of the Scheduled Caste category of Gujarat State can purchase 1 to 20 animals as per their need and capacity to maintain. The eligible beneficiary can get an interest subsidy @ 12 % interest on a bank loan amount for 5 years if he/she has obtained a loan for setting up the unit in the current financial year 2023-24 through a nationalized bank or a financial institution approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
It also provides good-quality organic manure for improving crop fertility & crop yields. Dung is also used as fuel for domestic purposes. The surplus fodder agricultural by-products are utilized by animals & converted into value-added products viz. MilkRs. MeatRs. etc.
benefits:
1. The beneficiary can purchase 1 to 20 Milch animals (Any dairy animal cow & buffalo) at a subsidized rate as per their need and capacity to maintain.
1. The beneficiary can get an interest subsidy up to a maximum of 12% on the unit cost of the animal or the unit loan advanced by the bank for the purchase of the animalRs. whichever is lowerRs. will be available for a period of five years.

**Note 01:** The amount of interest subvention will be deposited in the beneficiary's loan account in the form of a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in installments. There will be no cash assistance for any of the beneficiaries.
**Note 02:** The interest calculated on the actual interestRs. subject to a maximum of 12% interestRs. whichever is lessRs. shall be payable under the said scheme at the rate fixed by the State Government on the price of the animal or on the interest paid by the bank on the animalRs. whichever is less.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Gujarat State.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category only.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be available to the small and poor farmers of Gujarat State.
1. The applicant will be eligible for assistance only if he has obtained a loan for setting up the unit in the current financial year 2023-24 through a nationalized bank or a financial institution approved by the Reserve Bank of India.

**Note 01:** The land should be owned by a member of the family or a beneficiary of the scheme.
**Note 02:** The grant made under this Act may not be used for any other purpose and shall be paid annually.
**Note 03:** The scheme shall provide for the establishment of a unit of livestock (cows and buffaloes) by obtaining a certificate from the Animal Husbandry Authority.

name: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
brief_description:
The Rajasthan government aims to provide educational opportunities to students belonging to Schedule Tribe studentRs. specifically those studying in grades 6 to 8.
This program targets students from Schedule Tribe whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers and not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from centralRs. state / public sources.
benefits:
- For Schedule Caste Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month.
- For Schedule Caste Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The student who is studying as a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. Municipalities and schools recognized by the Department of Education.
1. Students whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers when they are not alive.
1. The student who is not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from centralRs. state / public sources.
1. The student who has not failed in the lower class in the last session. If he fails in any year's examinationRs. his scholarship will be stoppedRs. but if he fails in the same class in the next
1. If he passes the examinationRs. he will be eligible for the scholarship in the new class from the next session. For thisRs. the student will have to apply for a new scholarship again.
1. Students who are not living in hostels are run or aided by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.

name: Coaching Schemes For Sc/st/obc (non-creamy Layer) & Minority Students For Universities
brief_description:
Coaching schemes for students belonging to SC (Scheduled Caste)Rs. ST (Scheduled Tribe)Rs. OBC (Other Backward Classes) (non-creamy layer)Rs. and minority communities are implemented to provide them with equal opportunities and support in pursuing higher education. These schemes aim to bridge the educational gap and enhance the competitiveness of these students. The Commission has been providing separate assistance to the universities - For remedial coaching at UG and PG levels. - Coaching for entry into services. - Coaching for NET to Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Minority Candidates. The Commission has decided to merge this scheme with the General Developmental Assistance scheme of the universities and assistance for this component will be over and above the ceiling of General Developmental Assistance.
**Objective Of The Scheme** **I. REMEDIAL COACHING FOR SC/ST/OBC (NON-CREAMY LAYER) & MINORITY COMMUNITY STUDENTS** Remedial Coaching is to be organized at the Undergraduate and /or Postgraduate level with objectives to: - Improve the academic skills and linguistic proficiency of the students in various subjects. - To raise their level of comprehension of basic subjects to provide a stronger foundation for further academic work. - To strengthen their knowledgeRs. skillsRs. and attitudes in such subjectsRs. where quantitative and qualitative techniques and laboratory activities are involvedRs. so thatRs. the necessary guidance and training provided under the program may enable the students to come up to the level necessary for pursuing higher studies efficiently and to reduce their failure and dropout rate. - To provide career guidance and psychological counseling for capacity building to those who are in need of such counseling.
**II. COACHING CLASSES FOR ENTRY INTO SERVICES FOR SC/ST/OBC (NON-CREAMY LAYER) AND MINORITY COMMUNITY STUDENTS** Coaching scheme for entry into services is to be organized with objectives to: - Prepare students to gain useful employment in Group ARs. B and C in Central servicesRs. State servicesRs. and equivalent positions in the private sector. - To orient students for particular examinations conducted for selection to services such as IASRs. State Public ServicesRs. Bank recruitmentRs. etc. - To focus on the specific requirements of a particular competitive examination. The University may develop Employment Information Cell for providing information about various competitive examinations in the area of their operation.
**III. COACHING FOR NATIONAL ELIGIBILITY TEST OR STATE ELIGIBILITY TEST FOR SC/ST/OBC (NON-CREAMY LAYER) & MINORITY COMMUNITY STUDENTS** The main objective of the scheme is to prepare Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Minority Communities candidates for appearing in NET or SET so that a sufficient number of candidates becomes available for selection as Lecturers in the university system.
benefits:
The institutions can apply for one or more components of the scheme according to the number of enrolment of Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)Rs. and Minorities Communities Students. IfRs. the number of students in a particular class is moreRs. additional section(s) may be included. Financial assistance is available for the following items:
Non-recurring items: A one-time grant up to Rs. 5.0 lakhs for each scheme during the XII Plan period for the following items: 1. Books and Journals 2. Audio-visual and teaching/ learning aid material 3. Computers with Printer 4. Photocopier 5. Generator or Inverter
Recurring Items: Rs.7.00 lakhs for universities for each scheme per annum for expenditure on the following items: 1. Honorarium to the Coordinator of the schemes @Rs. 2000/- per month 2. Remuneration to teachers and scholars* 3. Part-time staff with computer knowledge (on a contract basis) @ 6Rs./- p.m. 4. Part-time Peon/Attendant.@ Rs.1000/- p.m 5. Contingency - Rs 50Rs./- per annum
Remuneration at the rate of Rs. 300/- per hour per subject to the teachers and Rs.200 /- per hour to postgraduate students/ Research Scholars could be paid for theory classes and Rs.150/-per hour respectively for practicals. GenerallyRs. a faculty member should not teach for more than 2 hours a day. HoweverRs. in exceptional cases where an eminent educationist is invited for a Special lectureRs. the remuneration @ Rs.500/- per hour and admissible T.A. could be paid with the approval of the Head of the Institution. The payment of remuneration to the participating teachersRs. PG studentsRs. and research scholars may be paid regularly every month without waiting for the pending grant from the UGC. The final amount of grant to be allocated would depend upon the number of schemesRs. the number of students enrolled for the schemes in the proposalRs. and the decision of the Committee appointed for serving the applicants for these schemes.
eligibility:
- Financial assistance under the scheme is available to such universities and colleges which come within the purview of Section 2(f) and are fit to receive central assistance under Section 12(B) of the UGC ActRs. 1956.
- Institutions having a sufficient number of Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Minority Communities students will be considered for financial assistance.
- General candidates holding BPL Cards (Below Poverty Line) issued by the Central Government /State Government may also be allowed for such coaching classes.
- The percentage of OBC (non-creamy layer) and poor general candidates may be increased up to 40% if a sufficient number of Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Minority Communities students are not available.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Social Security Scheme For Poor Families - 2012
brief_description:
The scheme Rajiv Gandhi Social Security Scheme for Poor Families - 2012 was started by the Department of Revenue and Disaster ManagementRs. Union Territory of Puducherry on 25.03.2011. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to all the below Poverty Line Family members in the Union Territory of Puducherry in the age group of 18-60 yearsRs. in the event of natural and unnatural deathRs. partial total disabilityRs. and permanent total disability due to accidents.
A beneficiary under this scheme is not eligible to avail any other benefit in a scheme (if any) operated by the Government of India / Government of Puducherry / Local Bodies of Puducherry Government to cease/misuse the double claim at present time or in the future under any circumstance.
**Definitions:**

- **Member** shall mean all persons in the age group of 1860 years in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) familyRs. whose annual family income is not more than 75Rs./-. - **Partial Total Disability** shall mean a disability that is less than 40 %. - **Permanent Total Disability** shall mean a disability that is more than 40%.
benefits:
**The following financial assistance is provided to the members covered under this scheme:**
Natural death30Rs./-Unnatural death75Rs./-Permanent Total Disability (PTD) due to an accident75Rs./-Partial Permanent Total Disability due to accident37Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The deceased/disabled person for whom the claim is made shall be a member of the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The age of the applicant/member should be between 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
1. The annual family income of the applicant shall not be more than 75Rs./-.

**Note 01:** A beneficiary under this scheme is not eligible to avail any other benefit in a scheme (if any) operated by the Government of India/ Government of Puducherry/Local Bodies of Puducherry Government to cease/misuse the double claim at the present time or in future under any circumstance.
**Note 02;** In case the financial assistance has been sanctioned on the basis of false/wrong information given by the beneficiary/member/ any official of the GovernmentRs. the entire amount paid is liable to be recovered under the Pondicherry Revenue Recovery Act. The individual is also liable to be prosecuted for deliberately furnishing false/wrong information.

name: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITIs
brief_description:
The scheme Scholarship to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Government ITIs was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward ClassesRs. Government of Haryana in the year 2017-18. This scheme is implemented through Skill Development and Industrial Training DepartmentRs. Haryana. The funds will be provided by this department to Skill Development and Industrial Training DepartmentRs. Haryana according to their requirement.
The objective of the scheme is to promote the interest of skill development training in Scheduled Castes youths and to enable them for self-employment and get jobs in Private & Government Sectors. The scheme is 100% funded by the State Government of Haryana.
benefits:
1. The scholarship of 200/- per month will be given to the student of Scheduled Caste in each academic year.
2. Under the schemeRs. 15/- per month as tuition fee will be reimbursed.
**Note 01:** No scholarship will be given to failed students.
**Note 02:** The scholarship will be given in two installments in each academic year. The first installment (50% amount) will be given after taking admission to Government ITIs and the second installment (Remaining 50% of the amount) will be given subject to fulfillment of attendance criteria for appearing in the examination.
**Note 03:** The payment of the scholarship will be made to students through their Aadhaar-linked bank account instead of cash payment.
eligibility:
1. The Scholarship will be given to all Scheduled Castes students who are studying in Government ITI's situated in Haryana State.
1. The students should belong to the Scheduled Castes of Haryana.
1. The student should be a resident of Haryana State.

**Note:** The students taking benefits of this scheme will not be eligible to get benefits under any other State/Central Scheme.

name: Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed
brief_description:
The basic objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the students of the Saharia region for B.Ed training so that the tribal students of the Saharia region can keep their participation in the government service.
In this schemeRs. hostel feesRs. scholarships (stipends)Rs. tuition feesRs. and stationery are given to these students. Provision has been made to give financial assistance in the form of The benefit of the scheme will be payable only for 10 months.
benefits: Saharia tribe students who are taking regular B.Ed training are given Rs.30Rs. in the first year and Rs.30Rs. in the second year. Details are given below : 1. Rs. 26Rs./- for college fees and purchase of books. 1. Rs. 32Rs./- for house rent and food. 1. Rs. 2Rs./- for clothes.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The student should belong to Saharia classRs. a tribe of the Baran district of Rajasthan.
1. The student should be a regular trainee in the government / non-government BEd training institute.
1. The student's mother/father/guardian/guardian should not be a taxpayer.
1. The student who is studying while living in the hostel is run by the government. They will not be entitled to benefit under the said scheme.
1. Students should have a Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar.

name: Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana was launched by the Department of Industrial Policy and Investment PromotionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st August 2014. The objective of the scheme is to provide low-cost equipment and/or working capital to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category beneficiaries of Scheduled Castes. The benefit of the scheme will be given for the establishment of new industries/businesses etc. **Implementation of the scheme:** The nodal agency for the implementation of the scheme will be the Managing DirectorRs. MP State Cooperative Scheduled Caste Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. BhopalRs. and the Chief Executive Officer/Executive Officer of the scheme through the District Endeavour Cooperative Development Committees. Appropriate financial provision for the scheme will be made by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department in its departmental budgetRs. and accordingly the physical and financial targets will be decided by the District-wise Managing DirectorRs. Madhya Pradesh State Cooperative Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Bhopal. **Financial Flows:** After disbursement of the loan and establishment of the unitRs. the amount of margin money assistance and interest subsidy will be claimed by the bank branch on the project cost to the Chief Executive Officer/Executive OfficerRs. District Antyavasayi Sahakari Vikas Samiti limitedRs. district-related. **Miscellaneous:** - Bank means all nationalized banksRs. cooperative banksRs. and regional rural development banks. - Criminal action can be taken against the beneficiary for wrong/misleading information or for receiving assistance in the wrong way. - In case of default in repayment/payment of loan/interest by the beneficiaryRs. the assistance given earlier under the scheme will be recoverable like arrears of land revenue and in the said situation the assistance given in the future will also not be payable. - Managing DirectorRs. Madhya Pradesh State Cooperative Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Bhopal will be competent for interpretation/amendment of the scheme. **Definitions:** - The sum of capital cost and working capital is the project cost. - The facility provided by the government in the form of the contribution of the beneficiary in the establishment of the project is called margin money assistance. - 6 months after starting the ventureRs. the initial suspension of the debt recovery proceedings (called moratorium).
benefits:
1. The maximum cost of the project under this scheme will be 50000/-.
1. Under this schemeRs. the margin money assistance at 50% of the project cost (maximum 15Rs./-) will be payable by the government to the beneficiary.
1. The minimum period of the initial moratorium will be 6 months and after the initial moratoriumRs. the loan repayment will be in 5 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a member of the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 55 years as of the date of application.
1. The applicant should not be a defaulter/insolvent defaulter of any nationalized bank/financial institution/cooperative bank.
1. If a person is receiving assistance under any government entrepreneur/self-employment schemeRs. he will not be eligible under this scheme.
1. The applicant will be eligible for assistance under this scheme only once.

**Note 01:** The working area of the scheme will be the entire Madhya Pradesh (that isRs. the benefit of the scheme will be given only to those enterprises which are established within the Madhya Pradesh limits).
**Note 02:** The scheme will be for the industry/service business sector.

name: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
brief_description:
The Rajasthan government aims to provide educational opportunities to students belonging to Schedule Caste studentRs. specifically those studying in grades 6 to 8.
This program targets students from Schedule caste whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers and not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from centralRs. state / public sources.
benefits:
- For Schedule Caste Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month.
- For Schedule Caste Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The student should study as a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. Municipalities and schools recognized by the Department of Education.
1. Student guardians should not be income taxpayers in case of parent(s) are not alive.
1. The students who are not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from centralRs. state / public sources.
1. The student who has not failed in the lower class in the last session. If he fails in the examination of any yearRs. his scholarship will be stoppedRs. but if he passes the same class in the next examinationRs. he will be eligible for scholarship in the new class from the next session. For thisRs. the student will have to apply for a new scholarship again.

name: Marriage Assistance
brief_description: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Marriage Assistance" with a sum of Rs.10Rs./- for both male and female is given as Marriage Assistance to employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.
benefits: A sum of Rs.10Rs./- for both male and female is given as Marriage Assistance to employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.
eligibility:
1. Should have contributed to Labour Welfare Fund.
1. Employees monthly salary not exceeding Rs.25Rs./- (Basic pay + DA).

name: Assistance For Delivery / Miscarriage Of Pregnancy / Termination Of Pregnancy To Female Differently Abled Person
brief_description: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Assistance for Delivery/ Miscarriage of Pregnancy/ Termination of Pregnancy to Female Differently Abled Person with a sum of 6Rs./- @ 1Rs./- per month for delivery and 3Rs./- for miscarriage/termination of pregnancy is given to female differently abled person.
benefits: A sum of Rs.6Rs./- @ Rs.1Rs./- per month for delivery and Rs.3Rs. for miscarriage/termination of pregnancy is given to a female differently abled person.
eligibility: - Differently abled person holding identity card issued by the welfare board for the differently abled.

name: Internship Policy Of The Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board
brief_description:
The Internship Policy of the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board intends to provide practical training experience (in summer/ winter etc.) to the students studying in various hospitality / tourism-related schools in Madhya Pradesh or outside the state. The training will be conducted under the supervision of the unit head/ departmental head. The trainees will be paid a stipend as per the norms of the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board.
> **Duration** **Summer Training:** 3 Months (May to July) **Winter Training:** 3 Months (October to December)
> **Placement & Number of Seats** **Name of the Course:** MBA/BBA/BA/B.COM (Tourism) **Place of Training:** Head Office and Market **Seats Available:** 10 - summerRs. 10 - winter
**Name of the Course:** B.Sc. in Hotel Management/ Certificate/ Diploma in Food ProductionRs. F&B Service/ Front Office/ Housekeeping/ Hotel Operations **Place of Training:** The residency/resorts/hotels of MPTDC or in selected private hotels/resorts **Seats Available:** 25 - summerRs. 25 - winter
**Name of the Course:** PG Diploma In Forest Management **Place of Training:** MPTDC Units near forest/water bodies/ selected private hotels/ under various projects under a responsible tourism **Seats Available:** 10 - summerRs. 10 - winter
**Name of the Course:** Other courses like PhotographyRs. Digital MarketingRs. Adventure SportsRs. BiodiversityRs. Tour OperatingRs. etc **Place of Training:** MP Tourism BoardRs. Head Office **Seats Available:** 10 or as per need
benefits:
> **Stipend** **Courses:** Post Graduate Diploma In Forestry Management **Period:** As per the Requirement **Stipend (per Trainee):** 5Rs./month
**Courses:** B.Sc (in Hotel Management )from IHM or SIHM / MBA/BBA/BA/B.COM (Tourism) **Period:** As per the Requirement **Stipend (per Trainee):** 2Rs./month
**Courses:** Certificate/Diploma/PG Diploma in Food ProductionRs. F&B ServiceRs. Housekeeping/ hotel operations from Food Craft Institutes & IGNOU **Period:** As per the Requirement **Stipend (per Trainee):** 1Rs./month
> **Certificate** On successful completion of the internship trainingRs. the MP Tourism Board will issue a certificate and inform the respective training institution.
**NOTE 1:** Apart from the aboveRs. on the requirements of any specific trainingRs. the stipend will be decided by the management. **NOTE 2:** All the stipends will be transferred to the bank account of the candidate through NEFT/RTGS. **NOTE 3:** No travelling expenses will be paid for reaching/ returning to the allotted training place. **NOTE 4:** No accommodation and food will be provided to interns.
eligibility:
**The applicant should be studying in one of the following institutes -** 1. Institute of Hotel Management. 1. Food Craft Institutes affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh. 1. Institutes of Travel and Tourism affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh. 1. Indian Institute of Forest Management. 1. Any other institute permitted by the management of the MP Tourism Board.
**The applicant should be enrolled in one of the following courses/programs -** 1. MBA/BBA/BA (Tourism) / B.Com. (Tourism) 1. B.Sc. in Hotel Management. 1. Diploma/ Certificate in Food Production/ Food & Beverage Service/ Front Office/ Housekeeping. 1. PG Diploma in Forest Management/ Hotel Operations. 1. Any other tourism-related Courses like PhotographyRs. Digital MarketingRs. AdvertisingRs. Adventure sportsRs. Bio-diversityRs. Tour Operators Courses etc.

name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
brief_description:
> Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) is an autonomous body under the Ministry of External Affairs
The Internship Policy of the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) provides an excellent opportunity for budding scholars to familiarise themselves with the role of soft power in foreign policy formulation in the Government of India. These Interns shall be given exposure to various Sections with ICCR and would be expected to supplement the process of analysis in various fields including creative writingRs. cultural mappingRs. technology upgradation in EGITRs. creating a module for performing and visual artRs. historical cultural linkages of India with other countries and the use of Social Media in Cultural Diplomacy. It aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation and putting into practice the knowledge acquired in the classrooms.
> **Intake** A maximum of 15 interns will be engaged by ICCR during the course of a year.
> **Location** The interns will be placed at ICCRRs. New Delhi and its Regional Offices in MumbaiRs. PuneRs. KolkataRs. GuwahatiRs. Ahmadabad and Hyderabad.
> **Duration** Each intern will be engaged for a maximum period of four months.
> **Duties & Responsibilities** Interns will be assigned specific topics of work by the concerned Sectional Head and may be required to conduct researchRs. write reportsRs. analyze evolving developments or carry out any other task entrusted to them by the Sectional Heads.
benefits:
> **Honorarium** An honorarium of 10Rs./- per month will be paid to each intern.
> **Air Fare** The cost of one-time to and fro air travel is subject to a ceiling of the prevailing economy class airfare between the State capital and DelhiRs. from the domicile State or from the college/ university of the selected candidates will be provided. **NOTE:** The interns would be responsible for their board and lodging in DelhiRs. MumbaiRs. PuneRs. KolkataRs. GuwahatiRs. Ahmadabad and Hyderabad.
> **Logistics Support** Necessary logistic support will be provided to the intern taking into account the functional requirements.
> **Certificate** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internships and on submission of their Report/ Paper and its evaluation by the Head of the concerned Division.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be a graduate in Humanities/ Mass Communication/ Journalism/ Designing/ Anthropology/ History/ Art/ Archaeology Science/ Languages/ Museology/ Fine Arts. 1. The age of the applicant should be less than or equal to 25 years as of 31st December of the year of the Internship. 1. Post Graduate / Research Students and Foreign Language Students are also eligible. 1. The applicant should have an excellent academic track record. 1. The applicant should preferably be from any recognized University in India.
> **Reservation / Preference / Priority** Research scholars with formal backgrounds in International Relations and Soft Power Projection will be given preference depending upon the requirement of ICCR. The candidates with the highest marks are most likely to be called for Personal Interview.

name: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. The objective of the scheme is to provide annual financial assistance of 8Rs./- to 20Rs./- to the children of registered workers from Class I to DiplomaRs. GraduationRs. and Post-GraduationRs. etc. The children of the workers with outstanding performance in the Class 10th examinations would also be encouraged and a one-time incentive of 21Rs./- to 51Rs./- would be given according to their obtained marks.
benefits:
1**.** The class-wise amount given under the scheme is as follows: **Sl. No.****Category Name****Amount to be paid**1Elementary Education (1st to 8th grade)8000/- per annum 2Secondary Education (9th to 12th Class)/ITI Course10Rs./- per annum 3Higher education (first year to final year of bachelor's degree)15Rs./- per annum4Postgraduate (from first year to final year of Master's degree)20Rs./- per annum
2. The children of the workers with outstanding performance in the Class 10th examinations would also be encouraged and a one-time incentive would be given according to their obtained marks as under: Sl. No.Percentage of Marks Obtained in Class 10th ExaminationOne-time Incentive 190% or More 51Rs./- 280% to 89% 41Rs./- 370% to 79% 31Rs./- 460% to 69% 21Rs./-
3. All the educational expenditure on account of study in engineering in private & government institutionsRs. medical and technical educationRs. managementRs. and other professional courses would also be borne by the Board. 4. The hostel expenditure up to a maximum 1Rs./- would be borne by the Board.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one-year regular membership.
1. The children of registered workers studying in Class-I to Postgraduate are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. Only those students who are studying in any institution/school/college of Haryana state will be eligible for this financial assistance.
1. The students who are self-employed or employed will not be eligible for benefits under this scheme.

**Note 01:** Financial assistance will not be given again for the same class in case of failure of the student.
**Note 02:** It is mandatory to upload the certificate issued by the head of the school/institution that the student is continuing regular studies in the school/institution.
**Note 03:** The financial assistance for pursuing professional courses shall be paid directly to the Government Institutions except for the reimbursement of admission fees.
**Note 04:** The claim application of the students studying in private institutions shall be verified by any one of the officers i.e. Deputy Labour CommissionersRs. Assistant Labour CommissionerRs. TehsildarsRs. Naib Tehsildars DEEOsRs. DEOsRs. BEEOsRs. and BEOs.
**Note 05:** The financial assistance for education will be given up to three children only i.e. three female or two male children.

name: Maintenance Allowance To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In Professional Courses And Living In Hostel Attached To Professional Colleges
brief_description:
The government of Maharashtra introduced the scheme to complete the education of V.J.N.T and S.B.C students who are students of professional courses such as MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. Animal HusbandryRs. etc.
Professional courses are divided into ARs. BRs. and C categories and accordinglyRs. maintenance allowance is given to the students through the concerned Principal of the college. For 4 to 5 years course (MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. AgricultureRs. etc.) Rs. 700/- per monthRs. for 2 to 3 years course (Engineering Dip.Rs. M.B.ARs. M.S.WRs. etc.) Rs. 500/- and for 2 years and lesser duration courses (B.Ed.Rs. D.Ed.) Rs. 500/- per month for 10 months as maintenance allowance in addition to other Government Scholarships.
benefits:
1. Professional courses are divided into ARs. BRs. and C categories and accordinglyRs. maintenance allowance is given to the students through the concerned Principal of the college.
1. For 4 to 5 years course (MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. AgricultureRs. etc.) Rs. 700/- per monthRs. for 2 to 3 years course (Engineering Dip.Rs. M.B.ARs. M.S.WRs. etc.) Rs. 500/- and for 2 years and lesser duration courses (B.Ed.Rs. D.Ed.) Rs. 500/- per month for 10 months as maintenance allowance in addition to other Government Scholarships.
eligibility:
1. Students should belong to VJNT or SBC category.
1. Students should be studying in professional courses such as MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. Animal HusbandryRs. etc.
1. Students should submit an Application form for admission in Govt. Hostel.
