name: Internship Programme Of The Department Of Expenditure
brief_description:
The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure aims to familiarize willing and eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and Graduates pursuing post-Graduation/ post-Graduates pursuing Research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Government. The internship is neither a job nor any such assurance for a job in the Department of Expenditure.
> **Duration** The duration of the internship will be from two to six months at different points in time during the financial year.
> **Declaration of Secrecy** Interns will be required to furnish to the Department a declaration of secrecy before reporting for the Internship.
> **Logistics Support** Interns will be provided with the necessary logistics support i.e. office space and a computer with an internet facility.
> **Placement** The interns would be attached with one of the DS/Director level officers in the different Divisions of the Department of Expenditure keeping in view the areas of interest expressed by the candidates and as per the preference of that Division.
benefits:
> **Remuneration** Token Remuneration @ ** 10Rs./- per month** per internRs. payable on satisfactory completion of their internships and on submission of their Report / Paper.
> **Certificate of Internship** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internship and on submission of their Report/Paper and its evaluation by the DS/Director level officer in the concerned Division.
eligibility:
Indian national pursuing postgraduation Research Courses in Economics/Finance/Management and in the 4th and 5th year of 5-year integrated Course in Law/any other professional course from Universities/Institutions of National and International repute are eligible to apply for the internship provided -

- Students pursuing post-graduate courses should have obtained a first-class Graduate degree.
- Research Scholars Pursuing courses in Economics/Finance/ManagementRs. should have obtained at least 50% marks in Post-Graduation.
- Students in the af a 5h year of the 5 year integrated Law course should have obtained at least 80% marks in their 12th Class examination.

name: Sindhu Dharshan Yatra Scheme 2016
brief_description: The scheme Sindhu Dharshan Yatra Scheme 2016 was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016. Under the schemeRs. the government of Haryana provides financial assistance to the pilgrims of the State of Haryana. The financial assistance will be provided up to the extent of 10Rs./- or 50% of the actual expenditure per person whichever is less. This scheme will be commenced w.e.f. 1st April 2016 and financial assistance will be provided to those applicants who complete the Yatra after this date.
benefits:
1. The financial assistance will be provided up to the extent of 10Rs./- or 50% of the actual expenditure per person whichever is less.
1. Financial assistance shall be provided to a maximum of 50 (fifty) numbers of pilgrims.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Haryana State.
1. The applicant/pilgrim should complete the Yatra through the State Govt./Central Govt./Society and the completion certificate in this regard must be submitted by the State/Central Govt./Society.
1. The financial assistance shall be given only once to a pilgrim.

name: Snehayanam Scheme For Mothers Of Persons With Special Needs
brief_description:
The scheme Snehayanam Scheme for Mothers of Persons with Special Needs was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. Electric Auto Rickshaws will be provided free of cost to mothers of persons with disabilities who suffer financially. This scheme would provide a means of livelihood for such beneficiaries. During the initial phase of the schemeRs. 2 beneficiaries from each district will be selected for this scheme.
The task of caring for and providing rehabilitation support for persons with autismRs. cerebral palsyRs. mental retardationRs. and multiple disabilities can be stressful and daunting for parentsRs. especially mothers. Such persons with disabilities (PwDs) coming under the purview of the National Trust Act 1999 always require special care and attention since they cannot perform their day-to-day activities without someone elses assistance. Sometimes taking care of such PwDs can be quite challenging for widowed or divorced mothers with no other source of permanent income.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. Electric Auto Rickshaws will be provided free of cost to mothers of persons with disabilities who suffer financially.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. Widowed/legally divorced/ wives abandoned by husbands are eligible to apply under this scheme.
1. The mothers of PwDs covered under the National Trust Act (NTA) will be eligible to apply under this scheme.
1. The applicants should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category and do not have a source of steady income.
1. The beneficiaries must possess a valid 3-wheeler license.
1. The age limit of the applicant has to be 55 years or below.

**Note 01:** The tax and insurance for the vehicles will have to be borne by the beneficiary.
**Note 02:** The vehicle must be registered solely in the name of the beneficiary and the vehicle ownership cannot be transferred or sold.

name: RAKSHAK PURASKARS Award
brief_description: The Directorate of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of GoaRs. has instituted the RAKSHAK PURASKARS Award. The awards are being conferred from the year 2015 onwards and presented on Independence Day i.e. 15th August. The awards are conferred to two persons every year. The awards are conferred to the individuals who have shown exceptional courageRs. especially in adverse circumstances in coming to aidRs. protecting or helping beyond the call of duty and assisting in dealing with the victims of any type of violenceRs. attack or harassment against women and girls at homeRs. in the workplace and everywhere in the public domain and has shown their respect and dignity to women in society within the State of Goa. The Award aims to spread the message to encourage and motivate all to bestow respect and dignity to women in society in the State of Goa.
benefits: The recipients of the awarded are given a scroll/citation and cash prize of 20Rs./- each.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have shown exceptional courageRs. especially in adverse circumstances or otherwise in coming to aidRs. protecting or helping beyond the call of dutyRs. the victims or in dealing with the victims of any type of violenceRs. attackRs. or harassment against women and girls at homeRs. in the workplace and everywhere in the public domain and has shown their respect and dignity to women in society in the State of Goa.
1. The applicant can be a person from any walk of lifeRs. whether they are Police OfficersRs. DoctorsRs. LawyersRs. Public ProsecutorsRs. Social WorkersRs. TeachersRs. Tourist GuidesRs. LifeguardsRs. BusRs. Taxi or Auto DriversRs. etc.
1. The applicant should have a resident of Goa for the last 05 yrs as of 1st January of the respective year OR has worked in the State for at least two years shall be considered.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other award in the same field during the same year.
1. The applicant should be above 25 years of age as of 1st January of the respective year.

name: Shreshtam Scheme For Ensuring Participation Of PwDs In Arts & Sports
brief_description:
The scheme Shreshtam Scheme for Ensuring Participation of PwDs in Arts & Sports was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The Government of Kerala has started the scheme to ensure equal opportunities for PwDs in sports and recreation activities equally along with others without discrimination. Under the schemeRs. support will be provided to persons with disabilities who have showcased special talent and expertise in arts and sporting activities.
The objective of the scheme is to ensure accessRs. inclusionRs. and effective participation of persons with disabilities in the field of arts and sports. This scheme will enable such promising talents to undergo specialized training in State/National Academies/Centres which will help them to increase their potential and competence level. This scheme will encourage and mainstream Persons with Disabilities to accomplish great achievements and help them to be self-sufficient.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a maximum amount of 10Rs./- will be provided to each beneficiary who has showcased their talents in State/ National level championships.

**Note:** The amount will be provided to a total of 10 beneficiaries from each district of Kerala.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The participants who have showcased their talents in arts and sporting activities in State/ National level championships will be eligible to apply.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (PwD) having 40% or more disability.
1. The annual family income of the applicant should be below 1Rs./-.
1. The applicant should be undergoing training from State/National Academies/Centers.

name: Scheme For Providing Assistive Devices To Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Providing Assistive Devices to Differently Abled Persons was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. the Government of Kerala provides assistive devices to differently-abled persons for improving their quality of life in terms of mobilityRs. communicationRs. and for performing their daily activities. There is a wide range of assistive devices available to meet the needs of persons with disabilities like Joy stick operated Wheel chairRs. Smart Phone with screen ReaderRs. Daisy PlayerRs. CP Wheel ChairRs. Talking CalculatorRs. etc. Due to mobility impairment Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) encounter many barriers to education while travellingRs. earning a jobRs. etc. ThereforeRs. by use of these Aids & assistive devicesRs. Persons with Disabilities become independent and their participation in society increases.
benefits:
Under the schemeRs. the following assistive devices will be provided to differently-abled persons:

1. Joy stick-operated Wheelchair
1. Smart Phone with Screen Reader
1. Daisy Player
1. CP Wheel Chair
1. Talking CalculatorRs. etc.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
- Disabled persons with 40% or more disability are eligible to apply under the scheme.
- The combined annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./-.
- The Medical Board should certify that the applicant is capable to use the assistive device.

name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
brief_description: The "Griha Aadhar Scheme" is one of the flagship programmes of the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to address the problem of spiralling prices and to provide support to the housewives/homemakers from the middleRs. lower middle and poor sections of societyRs. to maintain a reasonable standard of living for their families. Under this schemeRs. a monthly disbursement of an amount as prescribed under the scheme will be provided every month directly to the hands of the housewives/homemakers to achieve the objective.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a married woman.
1. The applicant should be above the age of 18 years.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
1. The gross income of the husband and wifeRs. taken together should not exceed 3Rs./- per annum.
1. A widow with a minor child who is in receipt of benefits under the Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS) rolled out by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa shall be eligible for benefits under this scheme.

name: Atal Asra Yojana
brief_description: "Atal Asra Yojana" by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa provides financial assistance of up to 3Rs. to individuals from Scheduled Tribes communities for construction/ re-construction and repairs of the house.
benefits:
1. Financial Assistance of 3Rs. for the construction of a new house/re-construction of the existing house.
1. Financial Assistance of 1Rs. for the repair of the existing house.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an individual from the Scheduled Tribes community of the State of Goa.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than or equal to 3Rs..

name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana
brief_description: "Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana" by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa provides grants of financial assistance for the performance of funeral and religious ceremonies of Scheduled Tribe (ST) families. The financial assistance under the scheme is up to 20Rs./- or the actual cost whichever is less. The deceased or the applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe Family.
benefits: The financial assistance under the scheme is up to 20Rs./- or the actual cost whichever is less.
eligibility:
1. The deceased or the applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe Family. 1. The annual family income of the deceased or the applicant shall not exceed 3Rs..
> **Special Case** If the applicant is not from Scheduled TribeRs. and the deceased is from Scheduled TribeRs. then the applicant should establish the first relationship with the deceased person. The claim may be made within 12 months from the occurrence of death in the family of kin.

name: Swasraya Scheme For Parents/Mothers Of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons
brief_description:
The scheme Swasraya Scheme for Parents/Mothers of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to find self-employmentRs. whose husbands have died/abandonedRs. and who have to take care of their sons/children with severe physical and mental challenges.
Parents of severely mentally retarded and differently-abled persons require emotional strength and flexibility. Older parents can find themselves overwhelmed by various medicalRs. caregivingRs. and financial responsibilities. Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded (PH/MR) persons always need special care and attention since they cannot perform their day-to-day activities without someone elses assistance. Sometimes it can be quite challenging for older parents in BPL familiesRs. especially mothersRs. who have to take care of household tasks and work apart from taking care of MR persons.
Looking after such a Mentally challenged/PH person is expensive. These expenses can arise from medical equipment and suppliesRs. medical careRs. caregiving expensesRs. specialized transportationRs. etc. Even though an amount of 600/- is being provided as Aswasakiranam Pension to caregivers (family members) of bedridden PH/MR personsRs. it cannot cover the expenses completely. Single mothers face tremendous challenges. OftenRs. a custodial parent must fulfill the roles of primary provider and caregiver without the benefit of a partner. It is a difficult task under the best of circumstances.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance of 35Rs./- will be provided to women of BPL families to find self-employmentRs. whose husbands have died/abandonedRs. and who have to take care of their sons/children with severe physical and mental challenges.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The parents (mothers) with children having 70% or more disability / mental retardation are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. Single/Unwed mothers/Wives abandoned by husbands/Legally divorced women/Separated women are eligible to apply under this scheme.
1. Close relatives (women- as mentioned in the above category) who act as caretakers of severely disabled/mentally challenged patients can also apply.

**Note 01:** Mothers of severely disabled/mentally challenged bedridden patients will be given priority.
**Note 02:** Beneficiaries of the Aswasakiranam Scheme can also apply under the scheme.

name: Scholarship For Transgender Students
brief_description:
The scheme Scholarship for Transgender Students was launched by the Social Justice DepartmentRs. Government of Kerala for providing scholarships to Transgender students from 7th standard onwards studying in State Government/ Government aided/ Self Financing schools.
The Transgender community faces many problems such as fearRs. shameRs. social discriminationRs. depressionRs. suicidal tendenciesRs. and social stigma. They are unable to live a dignified lifeRs. once their gender status is revealed. Steps must be taken to create public awareness so that Transgender feel that they are a part of society and are not treated as untouchables. As an effort to bring marginalized Transgender communities to the mainstream of societyRs. Social Justice Department has initiated this scheme.
benefits:
**Financial assistance is being provided to Transgender students on the following basis:**

1. For Transgender students from 7th std. to 10th std.: 1000/- per month for 10 months
1. For Transgender students studying in Plus One & Plus Two: 1500/- per month for 10 months
1. For Transgender students pursuing DiplomaRs. DegreeRs. Post-GraduationRs. or Professional courses: 2000/- per month for 10 months
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be Transgender.
2. Applicant should be a resident of Kerala.
3. Applicant should be a student and studying in State Government/ Government aided/ Self Financing schools/colleges.
4. The applicant should be studying in 7th Class to Diploma/Degree/PG Level.
5. There is no income limit.

name: Old Age And Destitute Pension
brief_description:
The Government of Puducherry introduced Old Age And Destitute Pension Scheme to extend a helping hand by way of monthly financial assistance to Old Age Persons/Widows/ Deserted Women/ Unmarried Women and Enuches so that they could defray some petty personal expenses without depending on others.
> Amount of assistance


- 1500/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age less than 60 years.
- 2000/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age between 60 years and 79 years.
- 3000/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age 80 years and above.
benefits:
- 1500/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age less than 60 years.
- 2000/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age between 60 years and 79 years.
- 3000/- per month for Old Age PersonsRs. Destitute womenRs. WidowsRs. and Transgender with age 80 years and above.
eligibility:
1. Old Age both men and Women above fifty-five years.
1. Widows above 18 years of age.
1. Deserted Women consecutively deserted for the past seven years.
1. Unmarried Women above 40 years.
1. Transgender above 21 years.

name: Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana
brief_description: "Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana" started by the Madhya Pradesh government is going to prove to be a very useful scheme for the disabled people of the state because the state government will provide financial assistance amount for the people who are differently abled. This scheme has been started to encourage disabled people to marriage and to ensure social rehabilitation of disabled people.
benefits:
1. In the case of a disabled youth marrying a normal girl and in the case of a disabled girl marrying a normal youthRs. the incentive amount is Rs. 2Rs./-
1. In case of disability of both the young man and the womanRs. jointly Rs. 1Rs./- incentive amount is provided.
eligibility:
1. The Applicants should have a disability of 40% or more.
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The minimum age of male applicants should be 21 years and female applicants should be 18 years.
1. The marriage should have been solemnized by religious custom/ social custom or legally prescribed by the competent court.
1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
1. In order to get the benefitsRs. one of the disabled couples will have to apply within a period of one year after the completion of the marriageRs. otherwiseRs. they will not be eligible to get the benefits.

name: Development of Industrie-Training Scheme
brief_description:
The Government of Puducherry introduced the Scheme Development Of Industries-Training Scheme for the candidates to develop their skills to enable them to start their own ventures or to get suitable employment opportunity by sponsoring to selected short term trades offered by the Training Institution situated in the neighboring states of India.
Under the schemeRs. training is given with stipend in various trades to the educated unemployed youths to create more employment opportunities or to start own venture.
To motivate entrepreneurship among the youth of Union territory of Puducherry.
> Period of Training: One year.
benefits:
**The pattern of assistance:**

- For Trainees-Stipend

(i) SSLC/ITI/H.S.C. Rs.1Rs. /- per month.
(ii) Graduate in Arts and Science/ Diploma in Engineering or equivalent Rs. 2Rs. /- per month.
(iii) Degree in Engineering & PG Rs.3Rs. /- per month (the stipend will be paid based on the minimum qualification fixed for the trades concerned).
To the Training Institutions :

- For Industries

Towards wastage of raw material Rs.300 /-per trainee per month.
eligibility:
- Residence should be the native of Puducherry Union Territory (or) should have a continuous residence of 3 years in the U.T. of Puducherry.
- Proof: Birth certificate/Education certificate/Residence certificate.
- Already trained candidates in various Govt. Schemes are not eligible to apply.

name: Medhavi Chhatr/Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: Chhattisgarh "Medhaavee Chhaatr/ Chhaatra Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana" has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh and operated by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh. Benefits will be provided to applicants studying in 10thRs. 12thRs. graduationRs. post graduationRs. and some selected courses.
benefits: **Class wise details****Annual Incentive Amount (For Boy Students)****Annual Incentive Amount (For Girl Students)**For Class 10th & 12th 5Rs./- 5Rs./-All Graduate Courses 7Rs./- 7Rs./-All Post Graduate Courses 10Rs./- 10Rs./-All vocational education and professional education 12Rs./- 12Rs./-By Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education. For the boys and girls who are in the top ten of merit in the state level examination of class 10th and 12th held 1Rs./- 1Rs./-Government ITIRs. IITRs. EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. LawRs. DentalRs. and Nursing. For the students taking admission in the college (This facility will also be provided to the children of the beneficiaries taking admission in the above streams in non-government institutions at the rate applicable in the government institution)The admission fee of each academic sessionRs. all academic feesRs. expenses incurred on hostel accommodation and food will be reimbursed by the Board and every year Rs 2000 will be paid separately by the Board for copy-books and stationery.The admission fee of each academic sessionRs. all academic feesRs. expenses incurred on hostel accommodation and food will be reimbursed by the Board and every year Rs 2000 will be paid separately by the Board for copy-books and stationery.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. First two children from a family
1. Factory worker should be registered.
1. Those children who score more than 75 percent marks will get the benefit of the scheme.
1. Beneficiaries will be eligible for the benefits of this scheme after 90 days of registration.

name: Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
brief_description: "Chhattisgarh Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" has been started by the Chhattisgarh Government and manage/run by the ChhattisgarhRs. Labor Department.
benefits: - To the registered beneficiariesRs. medical assistance of 20Rs./- or the actual expenditure incurred on the treatmentRs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. It is mandatory for construction workers to be registered in any district.
1. Must have completed 90 days as a laborer in the board.

name: Merit Based Award and Recognition Of High Performance In The Board Exams Of SSC And HSSC In The State Of Goa
brief_description: The Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa is implementing a scheme titled Merit-Based Award and Recognition of High Performance in the Board exams of SSC and HSSC in the state of Goa for Scheduled Tribe Students. The objective of this scheme is to motivate students by giving Merit Based Award on the benchmark of performance and to provide financial incentives to high-performing students who are economically weak. Any Scheduled Caste student who has passed Class 10th and Class 12thRs. securing 50% and above marks will be given a financial award. The scheme aims to increase the representation of the ST Community in the High-Rank holders are very few in the Class 10th and Class 12th.
benefits:
> **Felicitation of Rank Holders Students -** 1. 20Rs./- to the First Five Rank Holders (separately for all the streams of ScienceRs. CommerceRs. Arts and Vocational). 1. A certificate of Appreciation will be given at the time of felicitation in the public function.
> **Merit-Based Awards -** 1. 5Rs. awarded to the students who have scored 50% to 59.99% marks. 1. 8Rs./- awarded to the students who have scored 60% to 60.99% marks. 1. 10Rs./- awarded to the students who have scored 70% to 74.99% marks. 1. 15Rs./- awarded to the students who have scored 75% & above marks.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) in the State of Goa.
1. The applicant should have secured 50% or above marks in the SSC/ HSSC Board exams.
1. (For Merit Based Award) The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than 5Rs./-.

name: Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Goa Tribals Employment Generation Programme Scheme" by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of GoaRs. is for educated unemployed individuals in the 18-45 years age group who are members of the tribal communities of Goa. The scheme provides a subsidy of 40% on the total loan amount i.e. 95% of the project cost. The loan is provided for activities such as Micro and Small Manufacturing EnterprisesRs. Service EnterprisesRs. and Trade Enterprises. The beneficiary is also provided with compulsory entrepreneurship training of up to 7 days.
> **Collateral** 1. **For Loan Amount Upto 2Rs.:** Personal guarantee of the applicant and spouse/parent/relative.1. **For Loan Amount between 2Rs. to 6Rs.:** One or more third-party guarantorsRs. depending upon the loan amount. Such a guarantor could be an employee of State Government/ Government Corporations/Aided Institutions/ Companies of repute or a person owning an unencumbered immovable property in GoaRs. of commensurate value.1. **For Loan Amount Above 6Rs.:** Notarised copy of ownership documents of the unencumbered immovable property owned by the guarantor/sRs. commensurate to the loan amount to be provided. The guarantor should not be a defaulter with any financial institution/bank.
> **Recovery** In case of default in repayment of the loanRs. the amount is to be recovered as arrears of land revenue or under the Public Money Recovery ActRs. DRT or any other relevant Act and rules thereof.
> **Service Charges for EDC** 50Rs./- for 1Rs. of subvention for disbursement to beneficiaries and 1%Rs. out of the interest @ 2% per annum recovered from the beneficiaries.
benefits:
**Type of Activity:** Micro & Small Manufacturing Enterprises **Maximum Project Cost ( in Lakh):** 25 **Maximum Working Capital Limit:** 35%
**Type of Activity:** Service Enterprises **Maximum Project Cost ( in Lakh):** 15 **Maximum Working Capital Limit:** 80%
**Type of Activity:** Trade Enterprises **Maximum Project Cost ( in Lakh):** 15 **Maximum Working Capital Limit:** 80% (100% in case of agricultural produce)
**Subsidy Applicable on Loan Amount:** 40% **Promoters Contribution:** 5%. **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum **Penal Interest:** NIL **Repayment Schedule:** Repayable in 60 to 120 EMIs (As per discretion of GTEGP-TFC). **Moratorium Period:** 3 to 6 months (At the discretion of GTEGP-TFC). **Security:** The first charge of mortgage/hypothecation of fixed assets (buildingRs. furnitureRs. machineryRs. etc.) and/or current assets (trading goodsRs. raw materialRs. etc.)
**Training** Compulsory entrepreneurship training of up to 7 days within six months from the date of sanction.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be Unemployed.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 45 years.
1. The applicant should have passed Class 4th (relaxable for deserving cases).
1. The applicant should be a Member of the Tribal Community notified by the Government of Goa.
1. The applicant should not be a defaulter to any bankRs. financial institutionRs. etc.
1. The applicant should have been a permanent resident of Goa for at least 15 years.
1. The eligible activities are Micro and small manufacturing enterprisesRs. Service enterprisesRs. and Trade Enterprises.
1. The non-eligible activities are Farming activitiesRs. tobacco products and red-category industries.

name: Kala Gaurav Puraskar
brief_description:
"Kala Gaurav Puraskar" by the Directorate of Art and CultureRs. Government of GoaRs. is presented to artists working in the field of Art and Culture who have given outstanding contributions in their respective fields of art. Such artists need to be felicitated and their substantial contribution needs to be recognized.
> **Objectives** 1. To give State recognition to those artists who have given substantial contributions in the field of Art and Culture. 1. To felicitate the artists for their lifetime achievements in the field of Art and Culture. 1. To recognize and appreciate the age-old talent of the artists.
benefits:
1. The awardee shall be felicitated with a shawlRs. shrifalRs. a certificate of appreciation and a financial purse to the extent of 25Rs./- per individual.
1. Every year maximum of 30 cases shall be considered as per the availability of funds.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an individual artist.
1. The applicant should be 60 years of age.
1. The applicant should have given a substantial contribution in his/her respective field of art.
1. The applicant should have contributed in his/her respective field of art in Goa for a minimum of 10 years out of his/her entire career as a practising artist.

name: Fee Waiver Scheme For SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education
brief_description: "Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education" is a Fee Waiver Scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. This Scheme is framed in order to provide free access to every SC/ST studentRs. to the institutions of higher learning. It shall be the endeavour of the Government to see that no eligible SC/ST students are deprived of higher education for want of resources. The Scheme is operated by Directorate of Higher Education for the students pursuing the courses of General Education and by Directorate of Technical Education for students pursuing Technical Education at the degree and post graduate level.
benefits:
1. A full waiver of the fees supposed to have been paid by them in the institutions where they have sought admissions.
1. The amount fee waiver shall consist of Tuition feesRs. Library feesRs. Laboratory fees and Development feesRs. if any.

**NOTE:** All other charges and fees would be borne by the concerned student.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have been born in Goa or resident of Goa for at least last fifteen years.
1. The applicant should have passed his/her qualifying examination from any of the institutions located in Goa.
1. The applicant should belong to the SC/ST Community of Goa.
1. The applicant should be enrolled for the First Year of their Degree/PG Courses.

name: Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance for Maternity Assistance.
benefits:
- Female employees will receive a financial assistance of 4Rs. in the third month of pregnancy and 2Rs. in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
- Male employees will receive a financial assistance of 3Rs. as paternity leave after the birth of the child.
eligibility:
1. Applicant(Male or Female) must be registered worker.
1. Benefits will be provided only for two children.

name: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme named "Scheme of Free Coaching for SCsRs. OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme" is an Education Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective of the Scheme is to provide coaching of good quality for economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Other Backward Classes (OBCs) candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations for obtaining appropriate jobs in the Public/Private Sector and/or for securing admission in reputed technical and professional higher education institutions. The Scheme will be implemented by the Ministry with the assistance of Dr Ambedkar Foundation (DAF) through Central Universities empanelled under the Scheme.
> **Category-wise Ratio of Candidates** 1. 3500 students will be selected under this scheme annually. 1. Maximum Limit: - A total of 100 students per Central University can be admitted (excluding PM CARES beneficiaries). 1. Category-Wise Ratio: - The SC:OBC ratio must be maintained at 70:30. 1. Minimum SC Representation: - The percentage of SC students must not fall below 70%. - In case of non-availability of sufficient SC candidatesRs. Dr. Ambedkar Foundation (DAF) may relax the ratio. - HoweverRs. SC representation cannot be reduced below 50% under any circumstances. 1. Reservation for Female Candidates: - 30% of the slots under each category (SC and OBC) are reserved for female candidates. 1. Relaxation for Female Quota: - If adequate female candidates are not available in any categoryRs. male candidates from the same category will be considered to fill the reserved slots 1. All willing/eligible beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme would be admitted by the Central University irrespective of crossing the 100 slots allotted.
benefits: 1. **Stipend** - 4Rs. per month (up to a maximum of 12 months) 1. **Interview Incentive** - 15Rs. for students who clear the mains stage of Central/State Civil Services (Class I & II) 1. **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** - All financial benefits (stipend & fees) are transferred directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account 1. **Course Fee Coverage are as follows:** **Course****Maximum Total Course Fee in Rupees****Minimum and maximum duration of course in months**Civil Services Exam by UPSC/SPSCs75Rs./-12 monthsSSC/RRB40Rs./-6 months - 9 monthsBanking/Insurance/ PSU/CLAT50Rs./-6 months - 9 monthsJEE/NEET75Rs./-9 months - 12 monthsIES75Rs./-9 months - 12 monthsCAT /CMAT50Rs./-6 months - 9 monthsGRE/GMAT/SAT/ IELTS/TOFEL35Rs./-3 months - 6 monthsCA-CPT/GATE75Rs./-9 months - 12 monthsCPL Courses30Rs./-6 months - 9 monthsNDA/CDS20Rs./-3 months - 4 months
eligibility:
> **For students belonging to SCs and OBCs Category:** 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste or Other Backward Class. 1. The total annual family income of the applicant (from all sources) should be 8Rs./- or less. 1. For the competitive exams for which the qualifying exam is class 12thRs. the candidate should have passed class 12th or be studying in class 12th as of the date of receiving the benefit under the scheme. 1. FurtherRs. in case of competitive exams for which the qualifying exam is Undergraduate levelRs. the candidate should have completed the undergraduate level course or studying in the final year of the undergraduate course concerned at the time of receiving the benefit under the scheme shall be eligible. 1. Benefits under the Scheme can be availed by a particular student not more than twiceRs. irrespective of the number of chances he/she may be entitled to take in a particular competitive examination and irrespective of the number of stages in the exam. 1. The applicant should not already be availing of the benefits of any other coaching scheme.
**NOTE:** A list of beneficiaries availing the scheme will also be uploaded on the website of the Ministry and shall be shared with Central Universities/Central Institutes to avoid the possibility of the candidate availing benefits of a similar coaching scheme simultaneously or more than twice.
> **For beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme:** - All beneficiaries of the PM CARES Children Scheme who have a certificate (with beneficiary ID) issued by the Central Government confirming their status as beneficiaries are eligible. - There will be no income or caste-related restrictions for such beneficiaries to avail of the benefits under this scheme.

name: Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Viranarayan Singh Shram Ann Yojana" for unorganized worker on 17 January 2018. The main objective of the scheme to provide the food assistance for unorganized worker at their work places.
benefits:
1. Hot food is being distributed to construction workers at 5/- in food centers.
1. Cooked riceRs. dalRs. vegetable or khichdiRs. fai dalRs. vegetable or cumin riceRs. fried dalRs. vegetable.
1. Pickles will also be payable along with the food.
eligibility: - Registered unorganized workers are eligible for benefits.

name: Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2010. Under this schemeRs. One cycle will be provided free of cost to each unorganized beneficiary. The main objective of the scheme to empower the unorganized Samaachaar-Patr Hokar worker through provide them free cycle.
benefits: > A free of cost cycle will be provided.
eligibility:
1. This scheme is for unorganized newspaper delivery workers (hawker) registered in any district of the state.

name: Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided for the medical treatment of serious illness like treatment of kidneyRs. cancerRs. sickle cell anemiaRs. heart diseaseRs. AIDS and paralysis.

> Unorganized workers can receive up to 50Rs. in medical assistance to help cover the cost of treating kidneyRs. cancerRs. sickle cell anemiaRs. heart diseaseRs. AIDSRs. and paralysis.

1. The applicant must be registered as a beneficiary of unorganized workers under Section 10 of the Act.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur suraksha upakaran sahaayata yojana
brief_description:
The "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana" has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh.
Under this schemeRs. Safety Equipment Assistance will be provided to the construction worker of the Chhattisgarh state.
benefits:
> The said material(helmetsRs. footwearRs. glovesRs. safety jacketsRs. and masks) will be purchased by the beneficiary at his own expenseRs. as per the rate fixed by CSIDC or Rs. 1Rs./- whichever is less.

> The beneficiary will be responsible for procuring the mentioned materials at their own cost. Once obtainedRs. the Board will provide the reimbursement upon receipt of an application and the corresponding invoice.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. Applicant should be a registered construction worker in Chhattisgarh state.

1. This subsidy is available to individual growersRs. joint ownersRs. or family members applying jointly (limited to motherRs. fatherRs. wifeRs. and children). 1. Eligible applicants can possess coffee holdings of up to 10 hectares.
> **Subsidy Applicability** The subsidy is applicable for two primary purposes: (a) Water harvesting structures like water storage tanksRs. open wellsRs. or ring wells. (b) Procurement of irrigation equipmentRs. including sprinkler or drip systems.
> **Subsidy Conditions** A grower who has availed subsidy for a specific activity/component cannot avail it again during the Multi-Year Thrust Plan (MTF) period unless new beneficiaries are included.
> **Subsidy Combination** The subsidy may be availed for any one of the water harvesting structures combined with any one of the irrigation equipment during the MTF period. The subsidy amount is limited to the corresponding category of holdings.
> **Previous Subsidy History** Growers who have benefited from a subsidy for a particular water augmentation activity within the past 10 years are not eligible for the same activity. HoweverRs. they become eligible from the 11th year onwards.

The land for this purpose should be in the name of the grower or their family members (motherRs. fatherRs. wifeRs. and children only).

name: FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program
brief_description: The scheme "FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program" is being administered by the MeitY (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology) to promote a novel skilling ecosystem in the countryRs. the programme/scheme would incentivize the cost of the eligible course(s) concernedRs. providing authentic and accredited certifications that are acceptable in the industry. FutureSkills Prime has introduced a first-of-its-kind incentive program for digital upskilling. The learners can upskill in 10 of the most in-demand technologies and earn incentives up to 14Rs.*. The program covers FoundationRs. Bridge and Deep Skilling courses across technologiesRs. including AIRs. IoTRs. Big Data AnalyticsRs. Cloud ComputingRs. Cybersecurity etc. The government will now directly fund the ambitions of eligible learners enabling them to navigate careers in these fascinating technology domains. While the platform offers numerous industry-handpicked courses and pathwaysRs. many of them free of costRs. this incentive program will help candidates upskill in paid technical courses while earning reimbursement on completion.
benefits:
> **Course Categories and Incentives**
##### **DeepSkilling Paid Pathway** **Incentive Threshold:** Post successful course completion and certificationRs. the maximum incentive per Deep Skilling course is limited to 50% of the course fee paid by the Subscriber/beneficiaryRs. up to 8Rs. (inclusive of all applicable taxes). **Assessment Reimbursement:** 600 for every successful certification up to the threshold of 8Rs..
##### **DeepSkilling Free Pathway** **Incentive Threshold:** Post successful course completion and certificationRs. the incentive is 1Rs. provided the Subscriber/beneficiary enrols for the next paid course with a cost greater or equal to 1Rs. (including applicable taxes). **Assessment Reimbursement:** 600Rs. provided the Subscriber/beneficiary enrols for the next paid course with a cost greater or equal to 1Rs. (including applicable taxes). ##### **Bridge Courses** **Incentive Threshold:** Post successful course completion and certificationRs. the maximum incentive per course is limited to 50% of the course fee paid by the Subscriber/beneficiaryRs. up to 3Rs. (inclusive of all applicable taxes). **Assessment Reimbursement:** 600 for every successful certification up to the threshold of 3Rs..
##### **Foundation Courses** **Incentive Threshold:** The maximum incentive per course is limited to 50% of the course fee paid by the Subscriber/beneficiaryRs. up to 3Rs. (inclusive of all applicable taxes). **Assessment Reimbursement:** 600 for every successful certification up to the threshold of 3Rs..
> **Maximum Incentive** A Subscriber can enrol in multiple courses across different categories. HoweverRs. the maximum incentive for a Subscriber/beneficiary is capped at 12Rs. subject to specific conditions in the respective course categories.
> **Payment Schedule** The incentive will be credited to the applicant's bank account within 30 days of submitting the application.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The incentive program is open to all Indian citizensRs. regardless of their ageRs. educational qualificationRs. or income level. 1. The incentive can be availed for all courses offered on the FutureSkills Prime platformRs. except for free courses. 1. The incentive can be availed only once for each course.
> **Eligibility Criteria based on the Course Categories**
**DeepSkilling Paid Pathway** 1. The Subscriber/beneficiary must successfully complete the course and assessment. 1. Application for course incentive and assessment reimbursement must be made together. 1. A Subscriber/beneficiary can only apply and avail of Government of India (GOI) incentives once for the same course and related assessment.
**DeepSkilling Free Pathway** 1. The Subscriber/beneficiary has 180 days from the date of certification for the DeepSkilling Free Course to enrol in a paid course. 1. The next course's fee should be greater than or equal to 1Rs. (including applicable taxes). 1. If the Subscriber/beneficiary fails to enrol within 180 daysRs. 1Rs. will be withdrawn from the Learner LedgerRs. and the incentive cannot be claimed for the current course and assessment. 1. A Learner can apply and avail of the GOI incentive once for this category.
> **Bridge Courses** 1. The Subscriber/beneficiary must successfully complete the course and assessment. 1. Application for course incentive and assessment reimbursement must be made together. 1. A Learner can apply and avail GOI incentives once for the same course and related assessment. > **Foundation Courses** 1. The Subscriber/beneficiary must successfully complete the course and assessment. 1. Application for course incentive and assessment reimbursement must be made together. 1. A Learner can apply and avail GOI incentives once for the same course and related assessment.

name: Padho Pardesh
brief_description:
The Padho Pardesh scheme is a central government program that provides interest subsidies to minority students who are pursuing master'sRs. M.PhilRs. or Ph.D. degrees abroad. The objective of the scheme is to award interest subsidy to meritorious students belonging to economically weaker sections of notified minority communities so as to provide them better opportunities for higher education abroad and enhance their employability.
The subjects/ disciplines in which courses (for MastersRs. M.Phil and Ph.D only) may be undertaken for the grant of interest subsidy are listed below:- 1. Arts/ Humanities/ Social Sciences 1. Commerce 1. Pure Sciences 1. Engineering 1. Bio- technology/ Genetic Engineering 1. Industrial Environmental Engineering 1. Nano- technology 1. Marine Engineering 1. Petro-chemical Engineering 1. Plastic Technology 1. Cryogenic Engineering 1. Mechatronics 1. Automation Robotics including artificial intelligence 1. Laser Technology 1. Low Temperature Thermal Dynamics 1. Optometry 1. Art Restoration Technology 1. Dock and Harbour Engineering 1. Imaging System Technology 1. Composite Materials Engineering including Decentralized power Distribution (for Solar Heat) systemRs. Energy Storage EngineeringRs. Energy conservationRs. Energy Efficient Habitat 1. Packaging Engineering/ Technology 1. Nuclear Engineering 1. Information Technology including Computer EngineeringRs. SoftwareRs. Software Quality assuranceRs. Networking/ Connectivity EngineeringRs. Communication system under Hazardous or Post-disaster conditionsRs. Multi- media Communication 1. Industrial Safety Engineering 1. Agriculture & Agro Technology 1. Agronomy 1. Medical 1. Floriculture & Landscaping 1. Food Sciences & Technology 1. Forestry & Natural Resources 1. Horticulture 1. Plant Pathology 1. Energy Studies 1. Farm Power & Machinery 1. Veterinary Sciences 1. Soils & Water Management 1. Plant Breeding & Genetics 1. Small- scale Rural Technology 1. Ocean & Atmospheric Sciences 1. M.B.A 1. M.C.A
benefits: 1. **Financial assistance:** The scheme provides an interest subsidy on education loansRs. which can help to reduce the cost of overseas education for minority students.1. **Increased access to education:** The scheme makes overseas education more accessible to minority students from all backgroundsRs. regardless of their financial situation.1. **Improved employability:** Studying abroad can give students a competitive edge in the job marketRs. and the Padho Pardesh scheme can help minority students to achieve their career goals.1. **Personal and professional development:** Studying abroad can be a transformative experienceRs. and the Padho Pardesh scheme can help minority students to develop their skills and knowledge in a global context.
eligibility:
1. Students must have been admitted to an approved master'sRs. M.PhilRs. or Ph.D. program abroad.
1. Students must have been admitted to a recognized university or institution abroad.
1. Student's family income must not exceed 6Rs. per annum.
1. Students must have obtained an education loan from a scheduled bank under the Indian Banks Association (IBA) Education Loan Scheme.
1. Students must apply for the scheme's benefits during their first year of study. Applications received in the second year or later will not be accepted.
1. Priority will be given to applications from states and union territories with lower bank interest rates.
1. Payment of financial benefits may be linked to the student's Aadhaar number.

name: Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen

name: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
brief_description:
The scheme Empowering Youth for Undertaking Value Added Innovative Translational Research (E-YUVA) is started by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) to promote a culture of applied research and need-oriented (societal or industry) entrepreneurial innovation among young students and researchers. The scheme provides funding support (through fellowship and research grant)Rs. technical and business mentoringRs. exposure to bio incubation modelRs. orientation to an entrepreneurial cultureRs. etc. to students at various levels including undergraduatesRs. post-graduatesRs. and post-doctoral.
The scheme provides support under the following two categories:
BIRACs Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
**BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students):**
BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows shall apply as a team and pursue their research work at their College/University labs and will also be allowed access to facilities at EYC and EYC Knowledge Partners as and when required. It will be mandatory for all the fellows to spend 3-4 weeks at EYC/EYC Knowledge Partner during their fellowship period.
> **Areas covered:**

BIRAC encourages interdisciplinary proposals from any stream that can help the conversion of innovative ideas into biotech products and technologies in any of the above fields.
> **Nature of Proposals supported:**

Proposal should:

- be original
- apply interdisciplinary knowledge
- aim at the development of innovative Biotech products/technologies with societal/commercial potential

> **Number and Duration of Fellowship:**


- Each EYC will support up to 5 teams with upto 5 students each every year.
- Fellowship is provided for a period of 12 months.

> **Expected Deliverable:**


- Create a culture of innovation at the Undergraduate student level in academic Institutions.
- Capacity building at the UG level
- Opportunity creation and access for Biotech Entrepreneurship facilitated by BIRAC
benefits:
**BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows will receive a quarterly stipend and annual research grant as mentioned below:**

1. Quarterly Stipend: INR 7Rs./- per quarter per student of the team
1. Annual research grant: INR 2Rs./- per team
1. EYCsRs. EYC knowledge partnersRs. and BIRAC provide continuous mentoring support to fellowsRs. including but not limited to Technical MentoringRs. IP SupportRs. Legal SupportRs. Networking and OutreachRs. TrainingRs. Regulatory AdviceRs. Business MentoringRs. and Fundraising.

**Note 01:** Stipend is released quarterly to the students accountRs. subject to the Mentors approval.
**Note 02:** The annual research grant is released in two installments (1st installment: 75%; 2nd installment: 25%) to the Institutes account and is managed by the mentor/guide.
eligibility:
1. Indian students from Indian Institutes/colleges who are pursuing under graduation in any domain should apply as a team.
1. A team should comprise a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 Indian students from Indian Institutes/colleges pursuing under graduation in any domain.
1. Teams with students from different disciplines are encouraged.
1. One team can have students from the same/different colleges/institutes.
1. The team should be supported by a mentor/guide.

**Note 01:** BIRACs E-YUVA Fellows shall pursue their research work at their College/University labs and will also be allowed access to facilities at EYC and EYC Knowledge Partners as and when required.
**Note 02:** It will be mandatory for all the fellows to spend 3-4 weeks at EYC/EYC Knowledge Partner during their fellowship period.
