1. The applicant/farmer should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in AgricultureRs. possessing own or leased land of at least 0.2 (hectares) or more.

**Note:** The applicant farmer can avail of the benefits of the scheme on a first come first serve basis.

name: Plantation Crop Development Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Plantation Crop Development Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to boost up the area and production of all plantation crops like ArecanutRs. CashewnutRs. CoconutRs. Pineapple etc.Rs. and to provide 50 % subsidy planting materials and construction of soakage tank.
benefits:
> **Type of assistance:**


- Financial assistance at a 50% subsidy for purchasing of planting materialsRs. and polypipes.
- Financial assistance at a 50% subsidy for the construction of soakage tank.

> **Pattern of assistance:**


- One-year assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in AgricultureRs. possessing own or leased land of at least 0.2 (hectares) or more.

**Note:** The applicant farmer can avail of the benefits of the scheme on a first come first serve basis.

name: Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
brief_description: The scheme Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's WelfareRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the farmers from the General Category are provided with a grant of 65% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessoriesRs. subject to a maximum of 50Rs./ per tubewell per individual.
benefits:
- 65% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessoriesRs. subject to a maximum of 50Rs./ per tubewell per individual.
- The subsidy amount shall be released through the Electronic Clearing System (ECS) if the applicant has undertaken the construction with his/her funds. In caseRs. he/she has availed himself/herself loan from the Nationalized Bank / Cooperative Bank towards the construction of the tubewellRs. the subsidy amount shall be remitted to the Bank against the loan account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from the General Category.
- The applicant should be a farmer in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- The tubewell in which the submersible/centrifugal motor pump sets is going to be erect and should have been registered in Pondicherry Ground Water AuthorityRs. Puducherry.
- The applicant should hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell to be constructed and the applicant should have ownership of the land at least for 2 years and should have a clear ownership title deed in his/her name.
- The eligible land holding of 1.5 acres should be in favour of the applicant farmer or in favour of the spouse or favour of the member of a joint/undivided family.
- The farmers who have already availed themselves of the subsidy for the said purpose within 5 years are not entitled to any benefit under this scheme.
- The applicant should not convert the lands for a maximum period of 10 years from the date of construction of the tubewell/filter point to any purpose other than agriculture and should execute a bond accordingly.

name: Floriculture Development Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Floriculture Development Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to motivate the farmers to take up floriculture (traditional and non-traditional flowers) as a commercial venture through the distribution of planting materials and other inputs.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- By providing good quality flower planting material at 50% subsidy and low cost polyhouse free of cost with a minimum of 100sqm/unit area.

> **Type of Assistance:**


- To motivate farmers by cultivating low volume high-value crops to increase economic income. Under this aspectRs. poly house and good quality flower planting materials including organic fertilizersRs. micronutrientsRs. and organic-based and P.P chemicals and drip irrigation are provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana
brief_description: The Madhya Pradesh government launched the Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana under the Women and Child Development Department. Under this schemeRs. a pension on monthly basis will be provided to all those children whose parents or guardians have died due to coronavirus infection. This pension will be provided till the child attains the age of 21 years. Apart from thisRs. education and ration facilities will also be provided. All those children whose parents or guardians have died between March 1Rs. 2020Rs. and July 31 will be able to avail the benefits of this scheme. Only the natives of the state can avail the benefit of this scheme.
benefits:
> ***Financial Assistance:***


- Each child beneficiary receives 5Rs./- per month deposited in a joint account until they turn 18.
- Guardian and child receive free monthly ration under National Food Security Act.

> ***Education Assistance:***


- School Education:



1. Free education in government schools.
1. Fees paid for RTE provision private schools.
1. RTE reimbursement limit for other private schools.



- Class 9 to 12:



1. Free education in government schools.
1. 10Rs./- per year for private school students.
1. Additional to scholarships and other benefits.



- Higher Education:



1. General Courses.
1. Full fee assistance in government/aided universities.
1. Up to 15Rs./- fee reimbursement in private universities.



- Technical Education:



1. Full fee assistance in government/aided colleges.
1. Up to 1Rs./- per year or actual fee in private colleges (JEE Mains/separate entrance exam).
1. Up to 75Rs./- per year or actual fee in private colleges (12th class exam).



- Medical Education and AYUSH:



1. Full fee assistance in government/private colleges based on NEET score.
1. Doctors serve in rural areas for 2-5 years (bond required).
eligibility:
1. The affected family should be a local resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The family should not be eligible to avail the benefits of Chief Minister Covid-19 Yodha Kalyan Yojana.
1. The deceased parents of the child beneficiary should not have been government servants or employees of a government undertaking who were eligible to receive pension under the old pension scheme.
1. Such boys/girls whose age is 21 years or lessRs. but till the prescribed duration of graduation courseRs. whichever is less and whose-

- Parent has died from COVID-19 or
- Parents have died earlier and their legal guardian has died due to Covid-19.
- One of the parents has died in the past and now the other has died of Covid-19.
- Only During from 01 March 2021 to 30 June 2021

name: Home for the Aged and Infirm
brief_description: The scheme Home for the Aged and Infirm" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to cater to the needs of persons who are aged/infirmRs. i.e. senior citizensRs. both male and female above the age of 60 years from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
benefits:
1. Free FoodRs. LodgingRs. Medical Facilities.
1. In-door Entertainments Such as TelevisionRs. RadioRs. Books Etc.
1. 4 Sets of Clothes Are Provided to Them Every Year.
1. 5/- is Given to Them Daily as Pocket Money.
1. Annual Tour to Places of Interest is Conducted for the Inmates Subject to Their Health Conditions.
1. Annual Day Function is Also Celebrated Without Affecting Their Health Conditions.
1. The Inmates Can Continue to Stay in the Home Till the End of Their Life.
1. The Last Rites of the Inmates Are Also Carried Out by the Government at Free of Cost.

**NOTE:** Contact the authorities below in case of delay in disbursal of benefits:
Puducherry: The DirectorRs. Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Saradhambal NagarRs. EllaipillaichavadhyRs. Puducherry.
Karaikal: The CollectorRs. Karaikal.
Mahe/Yanam: The Regional AdministratorRs. Mahe/Yanam.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have no one to look after them.
1. The applicant should be above 60 years of age.
1. The applicant should not be suffering from communicable disease or mental illness is not be admitted to the Home.

name: "Vocational Training" Component of the "Development of Industries" Scheme
brief_description: The "Vocational Training" Component of the "Development of Industries" Scheme by the District Industries CentreRs. Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of Puducherry aims to create more employment opportunities broadly for the unemployed youth particularly women to pursue wide career openings besides self-ventures by giving training in trades like Tailoring & EmbroideryRs. Beauty ParlourRs. Arts & Design. The training is institution oriented.
benefits:
- Institution-oriented training in trades like Tailoring & EmbroideryRs. Beauty ParlourRs. Arts & Design.
- Stipend to Trainee: 1Rs./- per month.
- Honorarium to the Master Trainer: 300/- per trainee per month.
- An amount of 150/- per trainee per month will be paid to the training institution towards compensation for wastage of raw materials.

**Commencement of Training:** In September.
**Period of Training:** 6 months.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.
- The applicant should be unemployed.
- The applicant should have passed Class 10th (SSLC) passed.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry (or) continuous resident of the area for the past three years.

name: Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients
brief_description: Launched on 1st August 2015Rs. the scheme "Pension Scheme for Grade II Deformed Leprosy Patients" is a Pension Scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura. The scheme provides financial assistance of 2Rs./- per month to Leprosy Patients who are residents of Tripura. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Pension of 2Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.
1. The applicant should be affected with Leprosy Grade II.

name: Bio Control Laboratory and Pesticides Testing Laboratory Scheme
brief_description: The Bio Control Laboratory and Pesticides Testing Laboratory Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is the production of Bio Control Agents such as TrichodermaRs. TrichogrammaRs. etc.Rs. and further distribution to farmers as awareness and demonstration for organic Plant Health Management in order to promote organic crop production.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Distributions of bio agents to farmers.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Free distribution to popularise the method.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Integrated Technology Enabled Agriculture Management System Or iTEAMS
brief_description:
The scheme Integrated Technology Enabled Agriculture Management System Or iTEAMS was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to address the critical issues of enabling and facilitating access to remunerative and sustainable markets for farmers' produce in the most transparent and effective manner through facilitation service iTEAM Dial 1917Rs. whereby farmers can be assisted on the following activities

- 12/6 Physical Connectivity to Markets.
- Access to input suppliers and bidders.
- Tailor-made advisory solutions on cropsRs. Package of practicesRs. Animal Health CareRs. etc.
- Assured logistics and Transport solutions at the rate of 0.20/kg/km.
- Livelihood options through leasing Agri Response Vehicle.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Free Telephonic advisoryRs. Access to Subject Matter Specialist (SMS)Rs. Transport services.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Telephone adviceRs. free mobile SMS to registered farmersRs. transport service to evacuate farmers' produce to markets at the rate of INR 2.00 per KM per Quintal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Integrated Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
brief_description: The Integrated Agriculture Training Centre (IATC) Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to provide training for enhancing the skills of farmers besides imparting updated agricultural technologies to departmental functionaries. Awareness Programmes/ trainings conducted periodically.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Conduct trainings and awareness programmes.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
- The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients
brief_description: The scheme Pension Scheme for Cancer Patients" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of 2Rs./- to persons suffering from cancer.
benefits: 2Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.
1. The income of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.
1. No member of the family (fatherRs. motherRs. son(s)Rs. or unmarried daughter(s)) of the applicant should be in government service.
1. The applicant should be suffering from cancer.

name: Nirman Shramik Siksha Kaushal Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK SIKSHA KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA (NSKKVY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance for education and skill development to the children of registered construction workers in the state. Under the schemeRs. scholarships for education will be provided to the workers' children. According to the scheme formatRs. children studying from the 6th class to higher class (ITIRs. DiplomaRs. GraduationRs. Post Graduation) can avail of the scheme's benefits by applying for the scholarship.
benefits:
> **The following scholarships will be provided to the male and female students after taking admission in the upcoming class: -**
ClassStudentStudent / Specially abledFrom class 6th to 8th 8Rs./- per year 9Rs./- per yearFrom class 9th to 12th 9Rs./- per year 10Rs./- per yearITI 9Rs./- per year 10Rs./- per yearDiploma 10Rs./- per year 11Rs./- per yearGraduation (General) 13Rs./- per year 15Rs./- per yearGraduate (Professional) 18Rs./- per year 20Rs./- per yearPost Graduate (General)15Rs./- per year 17Rs./- per yearPost Graduate (Professional) 23Rs./- per year 25Rs./- per year
> **Beneficiary meritorious students will be given the following cash awards under the scheme:-**
ClassPrize moneyClass 8th to 9th 4Rs./-class 11th 6Rs./-Diploma 10Rs./-Graduate 8Rs./-Postgraduate 12Rs./-Graduate (Professional) 25Rs./-Post Graduate (Professional) 35Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a registered construction worker in the board.
1. Only the son/daughter/wife of the beneficiary will be eligible for the education assistance (scholarship) scheme.
1. A maximum of two children of the beneficiary or one child and wife will be eligible to receive the scholarship. HoweverRs. if both husband and wife are registered beneficiariesRs. then a maximum of two children of the husband and wife will be eligible for the scholarship. HoweverRs. there will be no limit for meritorious students to receive cash awards.
1. The student must be studying regularly in a government or private school or college recognized by the Central/State Government from class 6 to postgraduate level.
1. The student must be studying regularly in a government or recognized private ITI and polytechnic course run in the state.
1. To receive the cash awardRs. meritorious students must have passed the class 8 to 12th examination with 75% marks or equivalent grade. Must have obtained/passed 60% or more marks or equivalent grade in diplomaRs. graduation and postgraduate level examination (including medicalRs. engineering or other professional examination).
1. The age of the beneficiary's wife should not be more than 35 years for the eligibility of scholarship and she should be studying regularly in an educational institution.
1. Scholarship will be payable only after passing the relevant examination for a year.
1. The student will be eligible for the scholarship only after getting admission in the next class after the opening of the educational/training institution after the summer vacation. HoweverRs. in case of passing the final examination of 12th classRs. diplomaRs. graduation or postgraduate courseRs. it will not be necessary to take admission in the next class.
1. A beneficiary who does not deposit the contribution for a continuous period of one year will cease to be a beneficiary. ThereforeRs. the son/daughter/wife of such a construction worker who fails to deposit the contribution will not be eligible for the scholarship under the scheme. HoweverRs. the scholarship will be paid on restoration of the beneficiary under the proviso of the above section and rule.

name: Indira Gandhi National Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
brief_description: Indira Gandhi National Vridhavastha Pension YojanaRs. Under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial support to the citizens whose families live below the poverty line.
benefits: > Pension amount: 600/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The age of the applicant (male or female) is 60 years or more.
1. The applicant should belong to a family living below the poverty line as per the criteria set by the Government of India.

name: Mukhyamantri Janakalyaan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Asangathit Karmakaar Manda)
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Asangathit Karmakar Mandal) is a scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government to provide social security to unorganized workers in the state. This scheme covers unorganized workers from specific age group who are not covered under any other social security scheme and benefits will be provided directly into the beneficiary's account through the DBT system.
benefits:
1. Funeral Grant Amount : 5Rs./- Ex-gratia
1. On accidental death : 4Rs./-
1. General Death Benefit : 2Rs./-
1. Permanent Disability Benefit : 2Rs./-
1. Partial Permanent Disability Benefit : 1Rs./-
eligibility: 1. Applicant must be a Unorganized worker. 1. Applicant have a "Samagra ID" and "Pariwar ID". 1. Applicant should not have other social security cover like Provident FundRs. Employees' State Insurance SchemeRs. Gratuity etc 1. Applicant or his wife/husband (as the case may be) should not follow below categories 1. Should not have more than 01 hectare of agricultural landRs. 1. Should not be in government service 1. Should not an income tax payer. 1. Should not have other social security cover like Provident FundRs. Employees' State Insurance SchemeRs. Gratuity etc

name: Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students
brief_description: The "Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students" initiated by the Directorate of School EducationRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. is designed to extend financial assistance to OEBC studentsRs. mitigating the risk of dropouts due to financial constraints. The scheme provides scholarships to students in standards 6 to 10Rs. based on specific eligibility criteria.
benefits: > **Rate of Scholarship** - For standards 6 to 8: 50 per month per student (500 per year per student). - For standards 9 & 10: 75 per month per student (750 per year per student). _* For ten months in an academic year._ > **Mode of Disbursement** The amount is disbursed directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
- The applicant should be studying from standard 6 to 10 and should have secured promotion to the next higher class.
- The applicant should belong to the Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC).
- The family income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs. per annum.

name: Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The "Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" initiated by the Directorate of School EducationRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. is designed to make sure that no brilliant student is prevented on the grounds of poverty alone from pursuing an academic career. Through this schemeRs. scholarship is awarded to students studying in 11th and 12th standards and have secured promotion to the next higher class with 60% & 50% of marks in 10th and 11th standards respectively.
benefits:
> **Number of Slots**

90 scholarships for 11th Standard and 90 scholarships for 12th Standard are awarded every year.
* This number may vary depending on the availability of funds in the budget of the year.
> **Rate of Scholarship**


- Day Scholar: 60/month per student (600/year/student).
- Hosteller: 100/month per student (1Rs./year/student).

* For ten months in an academic year.
> **Mode of Disbursement**

The amount is disbursed directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
- The applicant should be studying in 11th or 12th standard.
- The applicant should have secured promotion to the next higher class.
- The family income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs. per annum.
- If the applicant is studying in 11th standardRs. she/he should have secured 60% marks in 10th standard.
- If the applicant is studying in 12th standardRs. she/he should have secured 50% marks in 11th standard.

**NOTE:** _If proposals received more than the required numberRs. the Directorate selects the required number of beneficiaries strictly in the order of merit of marks in per cent starting from the top and also in the order of preference of students from the Government schoolsRs. Government Aided schools and then from the Private schools recognized by the Government._

name: Plant Protection including Integrated Pest Management Scheme
brief_description: The Plant Protection including Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to mobilize and support farmers to use bio-pesticides and bio- agents for plant health management through the distribution of bio-pesticides and other IPM tools and through the sale of Sprayers and Plant Protection Equipment to encourage organic crop production.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Distribution of bio-pesticide and other IPM tools to farmers.
- Sale of Sprayers and Plant Protection Equipment.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


1. Free distribution of Bio-pesticides and other IPM tools.
1. 50% subsidy sale on Plant Protection Equipment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme
brief_description: The scheme The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Allowance to Destitute Women Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to the poorest and destitute women in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
benefits:
1. The quantum of Allowance to Destitute Women shall be 2500/- per month subject to eligibility.
1. Payment of allowance shall be made through Bank Account on a monthly basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for more than 10 years at the time of making the application.
1. The applicant should be a poor and destitute woman.
1. The household income of the applicant does not exceed 4000/- per month.
1. The applicant should not be availing of any kind of assistance or pension from the government.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme
brief_description: The scheme The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Widow Pension Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to poor and destitute widows in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The beneficiary shall cease to receive the assistance if she gets remarried or becomes financially independent afterwardRs. which may be divulged by due enquiry or through records.
benefits:
1. The quantum of Widow Allowance shall be 2500/- per month subject to eligibility.
1. Payment of allowance shall be made through the Bank Account on a monthly basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for more than 10 years at the time of making the application.
1. The applicant should be a poor widow.
1. The household income of the applicant does not exceed 4000/- per month.
1. The applicant should not be availing of any other financial assistance or grant from the government or any other source.
1. The applicant shall cease to receive the assistance if she gets remarried or becomes financially independent afterwardRs. which may be divulged by due enquiry or through records.

name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme- Differently-abled and Posthumously
brief_description: The scheme Laxman Award/Rani Laxmi Bai Award was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttar Pradesh the sportspersons will be honoured by the state government with the Lakshman award for male sportsperson and Rani Lakshmi Bai award for a female sportsperson in 31 sports disciplines. The Laxman/Rani Laxmi Bai award will be given to differently-abled players (General Category and Veteran Category) and the Laxman AwardRs. the highest sports award of the state will be given posthumously to Shahid.
benefits: - This award recognizes sports personalities with a CitationRs. a Bronze statue of either Laxman or Rani Laxmi BaiRs. a ScrollRs. and a cash prize of 3Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The player must be a bonafide native of Uttar Pradesh. 1. The sportspersons for at least three consecutive times for the year 2020-21 (year 2018-19Rs. 2019-20 & 2020-21) must have been a member of the state senior team for the year 2021-22 (2019-20Rs. 2020-21 & 2021-22) participated in the National Games/National Senior Championship and also the medal earned by him in the year for which the award is recommended. 1. If a player has participated in the National Senior Championship and he/she will participate in the international competitions mentioned in the government order such as the Olympic GamesRs. World Championship/World Cup (held at an interval of 04 years) Asian GamesRs. Commonwealth GamesRs. Asian Championship and Commonwealth Championship (held 01 time in 04 years)Rs. SAF Games If he participatesRs. will also be considered eligible. 1. The player will have to give an affidavit along with his application that he has never been a participant in the consumption of drugs in any competition/championship or sports event nor has he been found guilty in this case. 1. The applicant shall also submit an oath that he has not been found guilty in any suit by the Hon'ble Court nor has he been found guilty in connection with sexual harassment. 1. The players who have the above eligibility will be given the Laxman Award to the male player and Rani Laxmi Bai Award to women players included in 31 sports (SwimmingRs. ArcheryRs. AthleticsRs. BadmintonRs. BasketballRs. BoxingRs. Canoeing & KayakingRs. CyclingRs. Horse RidingRs. FencingRs. FootballRs. GymnasticsRs. HandballRs. HockeyRs. JudoRs. KabaddiRs. Kho - KhoRs. RowingRs. ShootingRs. Table TennisRs. Lan TennisRs. VolleyballRs. Weightlifting/Best physicsRs. WrestlingRs. TaekwondoRs. YachtingRs. GolfRs. CricketRs. Soft TennisRs. Karate and Wushu) by conferring Lakshman/Rani Lakshmi Bai Award to male/female sportsperson who bring laurels to the state and the country by achieving significant achievements in the respective sports. 1. One person will be rewarded only once. 1. The award can also be given posthumously. 1. The Government may cancel the name of any person from the list of awardee sportspersons and in that direction such person shall be required to return the statue and inscription given to him. The cancellation will thus be final and no appeal can be made against it. 1. Any form of conveying ( pleading ) in relation to a recommendation will disqualify that entry. 1. The players only participating in National Senior Championships/National Games will not be considered eligible for the award. 1. The Laxman/Rani Lakshmi Bai Award for Veteran category sportsperson age should be 40 years and above. The eligibility will be valid if the player is 40 years of age or above on April 1 of the year for which the application is being made in the veteran category. 1. In the Veteran categoryRs. such veteran female / male player of any two of the above-designated sports can be awarded the Lakshman / Rani Laxmibai Award for bringing glory to the state and the country by achieving significant achievements in the National Championship / International Competitions (National Championship / International Competitions for points) in the respective sport.

name: "Advance/High Skill Training in Coir" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
brief_description: The "Advance/High Skill Training in Coir" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to enhance the skills of Coir artisans and interested individuals. The objective is to acquire the latest skills and modern technologies through advanced/high-skilled training available across various locations in IndiaRs. offering valuable benefits to eligible candidates.
benefits:
- Trainees receive a stipend of 2Rs. per month.
- Accommodation charges for trainees are 500 per month.
- Travelling allowance covers to-and-fro 2nd class sleeper train fare.
- Full course fees are paid to the training units/institutions as prescribed.
eligibility:
- The applicant must either be a native of Puducherry or have been a continuous resident for the past 3 years.
- The age limit for applicants is between 18 to 35 years.
- Educational qualifications should meet the standards specified by the Training Units/Institutions.
- Candidates who have already undergone this training are not eligible to apply.

name: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
brief_description: Vidhwa Vivah Uphar Yojana is a government Under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. scheme that assists in the process of marriage of widows. This scheme is for those widows who have decided to start a new life after the time spent with their former husbands. The government provides a certain amount to widowsRs. which can be used in the marriage of widows. The money is used to help widows meet the comfortable needs of their new home.
benefits: > Financial Assistance/Gift amount 51Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be a widow women from Rajasthan State.
1. Applicant must be resident of Rajasthan or living in Rajasthan for 3 years before re-marriage.
1. Applicant should be entitled to pension as per widow pension rules.
1. Applicant age should be between 18-50 years.
1. If the applicant has remarried before this scheme then he/she will not be eligible.

name: Disability Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Disability Assistance was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. the Secretary of the Board may sanction an amount not exceeding 25% of the total amount of compensation dueRs. as calculated under the Employees Compensation Act 1923 on the production of a certificate from competent medical authorities in respect of the percentage of disability along with application for grant of assistance along with last pay slip & age proof. The ex-facto approval from the Board shall be obtained for the same.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. the Board may sanction an amount not exceeding 25% of the total amount of compensation dueRs. as calculated under the Employees Compensation Act 1923 on the production of a certificate from competent medical authorities in respect of the percentage of disability.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in any building & other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
1. Construction workers who become disabled due to an accident during the course of their employment are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-I
brief_description: The 'Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to abolish caste and community discrimination by encouraging inter-caste marriage by giving financial assistance to newly married couples of whom one spouse should be from a Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe and the other from a different Community.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 25Rs./-. - 1 Sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.
> **Mode of disbursal:** 15Rs. through Electronic Clearing Service and 10Rs. in the form of National Savings Certificate.
eligibility: 1. The bride should have passed the 10th standard (5th standard in case the applicant is from a Scheduled Tribe). 1. The age of the bride should be above 18 years at the time of marriage. 1. One spouse should be from a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe and the other should be from a different Community.

name: Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram
brief_description: The Farm Pond Construction ProgramRs. initiated on April 1Rs. 2020Rs. by the Rajasthan Agriculture DepartmentRs. offers a solution to addressing a critical challenge of water scarcity for Rajasthan's farmers . This program allows farmers to establish farm pondsRs. essentially rainwater collection structuresRs. for irrigation purposes. Recognizing the program's significanceRs. the state government provides subsidies to facilitate farm pond construction. This enables farmers to effectively utilize rainwater and irrigate their fields.
benefits:
- Subsidy breakdown:



1. Raw farm pond: 50% of the construction cost (capped at 52Rs.)
1. Plastic lined farm pond: 50% of the construction cost with lining (capped at 75Rs.)



- Additional subsidy:



1. Raw farm pond: Up to 60% of the total cost (capped at 63Rs.)
1. Plastic lined farm pond: Up to 60% of the total cost (capped at 90Rs.)
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. All categories of farmers are eligible.
1. The applicant farmer should have a minimum cultivable land of 0.5 hectares at one place on his name.

name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Funeral Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the Board may sanction an amount of 7Rs./- to the nominees/dependents of the deceased Construction Worker towards funeral expenses. The applicant should be submitted within two months from the date of death of the Construction Worker.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 7Rs./- credited within 7 days through DBT.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be the nominee/dependent of the deceased Construction Worker.
- The Construction Worker should have been a citizen of India.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have contributed regularly to the fund.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.

name: "SUPER 30" Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Super 30" was launched by the Directorate of Secondary EducationRs. Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide free coaching for JEE/ NEET to the students who are appearing in the class 10th Board Final Examination and want to pursue Science Stream in Class 11th & 12th with the aspiration to crack the JEE / NEET exam.
benefits: The scheme covers the coaching fees (capped at 1Rs./-) & the accommodation fees of 1Rs./- per annum (with 5% extra in 2nd year)Rs. for attaining a two-year coaching programme for JEE/ NEET at a nationally reputed Coaching Institution outside Tripura.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST)/ Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Person with Disability (PH) community.
1. The student should have passed the class-10th Pre-Board/ Pre-Test Exam from the government-recognized school of Tripura with 50% marks.
1. The applicant should be appearing for the class 10th board final exam.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-II
brief_description: The "Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-I" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides financial assistance to the orphan girls for their marriage. The bride should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 25Rs./-.
- One sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.

> **Mode of Disbursal:** Through Electronic Clearing Service.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The applicant should be an orphan.
1. The bride should be 18 years or above at the time of marriage.
1. The applicant should have a degree passed from regular collegesRs. distance education/government-recognized open university.
1. The applicant should have a diploma passed from the Institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.

name: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana (RS-CSEP)
brief_description:
The Rajasthan government's Women and Child Development Department offers a program called Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana (RS-CSEP). This free program helps women and girls improve their spoken English and communication skillsRs. along with building their confidence. By learning new skills or sharpening existing onesRs. participants gain the tools they need to find better jobsRs. start their own businessesRs. and achieve financial independence. The program goes beyond just skills trainingRs. aiming to empower women by providing support and knowledge in areas like entrepreneurshipRs. leadershipRs. managing moneyRs. and personal growth.
> **Training period :** 130 hours (2 hours a dayRs. 5 days a week).
benefits: > **RKCL( Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited)Rs. free spoken English and personality development training is given to women and girls.**
eligibility:
- The applicant is a native citizen of Rajasthan.
- The applicant's age should be 16 to 45 years old.
- The applicant should have passed class 12th.
- Widow/divorced/abandoned women suffering from violence be given priority.

name: Mukhyamantri Work Form Home-Job Work Yojana
brief_description:
Rajasthan government has launched 26-08-2022 a new scheme for womenRs. the Mukhyamantri Work FromJob Work Scheme Under the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Rajasthan who can contribute to the family income while working from home. Now women of the state will be able to get employment sitting at home through this scheme. Many women cannot go out and workRs. the government wants to help them by giving them work at home so that they can work at home and earn money to support their families financially. During work from homeRs. women will be made to work from home through various departments like the Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. School and Higher and Technical EducationRs. Works DepartmentRs. and Information Technology and Communication DepartmentRs. and this will include typingRs. documentationRs. dictationRs. etc. Instructions will be issued keeping this in mind.
> **School and higher and technical education** Through school and higher and technical educationRs. women students will be allowed to study online and some women will be given the work of stitching dresses to be given to the students in the school. Along with thisRs. women can do the work of washing clothesRs. bedsheetsRs. etc. used in school while sitting at home.
> **Department of Information Technology and Communication** In this departmentRs. women will be given work related to programming like software designRs. data analysisRs. and web design. Due to this women will be friends with modern methods and through thisRs. they will also be able to earn a good income.
> **Finance department** Important instructions will be issued to women in the financial department to get the work related to accounting and auditing done in government agencies by the women of the state through work from home.
> **Women Empowerment Department** Under this workRs. counseling services will be provided to women in the form of work from home.
> **Medical Health and Family Welfare Department-** Online consultation service from women specialist doctorsRs. transcriptionRs. sewing work of clothes used in hospitals.
> **Department of SkillsRs. Employment and Entrepreneurship -** Organize employment fairs/ camps and ensure participation of such employers who provide employment opportunities in the form of work-from-home-job work. To provide work from home job work to the women registered under the scheme through these fairs/camps.
> **Rajasthan Skills and Livelihood Development Corporation (RSLDC) -** To connect at least 10 percent of the women trained under the training being conducted by Rajasthan Skills and Livelihood Development Corporation through training partners with work from home-job work.
> **Rajasthan Co-operative Dairy Federation (RCDF) ** To provide work from home- job work opportunities to women in work related to the processing and marketing of milk and milk products.
benefits:
> **Financial and non-financial incentives -**


1. Advertisement of such private unit which provides work from home-job work to a maximum number of women will be displayed free of cost on the Work from Home-Job Work portal.
1. If a private unit provides work from home - job work to women and the payment for the work given to the woman is more than 5Rs. then 3Rs. per trainee will be given as a training incentiveRs. as a training fee. HoweverRs. the payment of the training incentive amount will be given to the female trainee only after the offer letter is given by the private entity in the form of work from home- job work.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The minimum age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. Preference will be given to widow/abandoned/divorced/disabled/victim of violence.

name: Diggy
brief_description:
In Agriculture DepartmentRs. Rajasthan Government has started the Diggy Scheme to provide subsidies to the farmers of Rajasthan for making dig for irrigation. Under the schemeRs. farmers can prepare ways in their fields collect water in one placeRs. and do more irrigation with the help of sprinklers. By providing this grant amount to the farmersRs. the government will encourage the farmers to grow good crops by building dig and irrigating the crops without any financial pressure. This scheme is to help farmers improve their farming by using more water resources and encourage them to grow good crops.
> **Other Important Points** - Start the construction of the dig only after the administrative approval of the Agriculture Department. - Verification will be done by the department before and after construction. - Installation of drip/sprinkler set on dig is mandatory. - The grant amount will be deposited directly into the farmer's account.
benefits:
- The farmer must purchase a permanent container with a minimum filling capacity of 4 lakh liters and above.
- The state government will provide a 75% to 85% subsidy.
- Farmer will be provided a grant amount of up to 3Rs./- to 3Rs./- by the government for making a dig in fields.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. A farmer must have at least 0.5 (half) hectares of irrigated agricultural land.

name: Winter Cropping & Development of Cultivable Land Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Winter Cropping & Development of Cultivable Land was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objectives of the scheme are as follows:

- To bring more areas under cultivation during the normally lean winter season under different crops other than paddy.
- To increase production and productivity of various crops like cerealsRs. pulsesRs. oilseedsRs. and vegetables during Rabi Season.

**Note:** _This availability of the above state plan scheme in any particular year is subject to the availability of funds and necessary sanction by the State Government. The continuation of any scheme in a particular year is also subject to the discretion of the State Government. Farmers are therefore advised to check the availability of any scheme with the respective District Agriculture Officers._
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- TrainingRs. ExtensionRs. Technology SupportRs. and Subsidy on Inputs.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Free distribution of Agril inputs i.e. High Yielding VarietiesRs. SeedsRs. bio-pesticides/bio-fertilizers/fencing materials.
- Conduct of farmers' training/ awareness programme.
- Construction of water conservation structures i.e. check damsRs. and water harvesting ponds to facilitate Rabi cultivation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. hostel facilities for free accommodation and meals shall be provided to the children of migrant construction workers in primary school. The objective of the scheme is to provide primaryRs. secondary and higher education to the children of migrant construction workers.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. children of migrant construction workers should be provided free accommodation in primary school.
eligibility:
1. The children of registered construction workers who are studying in the government primary and secondary schools of the district can avail the benefits under the scheme.
1. The construction workers should be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Shramik Basera Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Shramik Basera Yojana is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. accommodation facilities will be provided to registered construction workers in temporary prefabricated housing with basic amenities that can be dismantled.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. accommodation facilities will be provided to the laborers/workers at the rate of 5/- per day.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and their families will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The registered worker has to present the identity card/smart card (e-Nirman card) as a construction worker to get assistance and the identity card/smart card should be renewed on time.

name: Housing Subsidy Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description:
The Housing Subsidy Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board to build their own houses.
In order to provide financial relief to the construction workers by giving subsidies for the houses purchased by them and to provide social stability to the construction workersRs. the "Housing Subsidy" schemewasn started in the year 2021-22. It is planned to provide financial relief and social stability to construction workers through providing subsidies.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the assistance of 1Rs./- will be provided to registered construction workers for a duration of 5 yearsRs. with 30Rs./- disbursed annually subject to the terms of assistance.
1. The construction workers who have taken a loan up to a maximum of 15 lakhs to buy their house will be provided 30Rs./- per year for the five years as per plan.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. At the time of applying for the benefits of this schemeRs. it will be mandatory to have at least the last 2 years of registration with the construction worker's board.
1. To avail the benefit of this scheme the construction worker should have documented the building after the date of resolution of the scheme (29/06/2020). The application has to be made within one year from the date of the document mentioned in the house purchase document.
1. The loan taken for a house purchased by a registered construction worker should not exceed 15 lakhs and the loan tenure should be 10 years or more.
1. The registered construction worker benefiting from this scheme should not own any house or property in the joint name of the worker or his wife or jointRs. which guarantee has to be given by the worker in an affidavit as per the prescribed format herein.
1. The registered construction worker has to submit the bank loan interest certificate/bank loan statement after the completion of the financial year to avail the assistance under the Housing Subsidy Scheme.
1. The registered construction worker receiving benefits under this scheme has to submit a written proposal every year at the district office of the concerned board to get the remaining four years of assistance after receiving the assistance for the first time along with a copy of the in-principle approval letter and the annual statement of interest.

name: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Valarmani Award
brief_description: The "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Valarmani Award" scheme by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance 6Rs./- and certificates of appreciation. The scheme is being implemented in all Districts of Tamil Nadu.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 6Rs./-.
- Certificate of Appreciation.
- A shawl worth 500/-.
- 5 eminent artists are awarded every year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 19 to 35 years.

name: Mini Sprinkler Sanyantr
brief_description:
The Mini Sprinkler Sanyantr scheme Under the Agriculture Department Rajasthan government will provide 70% to 75% subsidy to farmers for installing sprinkler plants. Through this farmers can irrigate more land by getting sprinkler subsidy. The subsidy given by the state government to the farmers will be sent directly to their bank accounts through DBT. The income of farmers will improve through this scheme. Apart from thisRs. efficient utilization and production will also increase.
> **The important points** 1. After the administrative approval of the Horticulture Department is issuedRs. the plants should be ordered and installed as per the departmental norms. 1. If found correct during physical verificationRs. the grant amount is transferred to the account of the farmer or the supplier manufacturer/dealer with the consent of the farmer.
benefits:
1. General farmers: Up to 70% of the grant
1. Small and marginal farmersRs. including small marginal/SC/ST/women farmers: Up to 75% of the grant
eligibility:
1. The agricultural land should be owned by the applicant.
1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan.
1. Farmers should have at least 0.2 hectares of irrigated cultivable land.

name: Green House
brief_description:
The Green House Scheme under the Agriculture Department of Rajasthan Provides the benefit of subsidy on greenhouses and earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetablesRs. flowersRs. fruitsRs. etc. by controlling the ago-climatic factorsRs. temperatureRs. humidityRs. and sunlight. A greenhouse is a hut-like structure made of glass or polythene. Plants are grown inside it by controlling the environment. Where certain types of crops cannot be grown in the open due to extreme coldRs. these crops can be easily grown by using greenhouses. In case production of crops is not possible due to excessive heatRs. crops can be grown in greenhouses. In this wayRs. it becomes easier for farmers to grow crops in any season through greenhouses. Greenhouses are mostly used for the cultivation of fruitsRs. flowersRs. and vegetables. Through thisRs. good production can be achieved especially in vegetable farming.
> **Other important points** 1. The construction of the greenhouse can be started only after the administrative approval/work order is issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. After constructionRs. verification will be done by the committee formed. 1. Payment of grant amount directly into the bank account of the farmer or to the producer firm based on written consent of the farmer.
benefits:
- For areas up to a maximum of 4Rs. square metersRs. farmers will receive subsidies grant based on approved rates or department-specified unit costsRs. whichever is lower.



1. General-category farmers : 50% grant.
1. SmallRs. marginalRs. scheduled casteRs. and scheduled tribe farmers : 70% grant.
1. The farmers of Scheduled Tribe areas and all the state's small and marginal category farmers : 25% additional grant.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a Farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

name: Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi
brief_description:
The "Chhaatron Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi" scheme Under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students who may face challenges in accessing education due to financial constraints. Studying agriculture aims to equip individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to enhance agricultural productivity sustainably.
This includes learning about innovative farming techniquesRs. crop management practicesRs. breeding strategiesRs. and technological advancements that can increase yields and efficiency in agricultural production. Students learn about food safety standardsRs. quality control measuresRs. food processing techniquesRs. and foodborne pathogens to ensure the safety and integrity of the food supply.
benefits:
1. Senior Secondary Level:

- Girls studying agriculture in 11th and 12th standard will receive a scholarship of 15Rs. per year.

1. Undergraduate Level:

- Girls enrolled in undergraduate agricultural programs (4/5 years) like HorticultureRs. DairyRs. Agricultural EngineeringRs. Food ProcessingRs. and Shri Karna Narendra Business SchoolRs. Jobner will receive a scholarship of 25Rs. per year.

1. Postgraduate Level:

- Girls pursuing M.Sc. Agriculture (2 years) will receive a scholarship of 25Rs. per year.

1. PhD Level:

- Girls pursuing PhD in Agriculture (maximum 3 years) will receive a scholarship of 40Rs. per year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Girl.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan
1. The applicant should be studying in schoolsRs. collegesRs. and universities recognized by the government and state government.

name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
brief_description: The Kisan Kaleva SchemeRs. initiated by the Rajasthan Government's Agriculture DepartmentRs. provides food at concessional rates through coupons to farmers and their assistants selling crops in vegetable market premises. Registered farmers and their assistants can avail a plate of food for 5/- under this provision. This initiative aims to alleviate the financial burden on farmers and their helpers while ensuring they have access to affordable and nutritious meals during their visits to the market. Through the Kisan Kaleva SchemeRs. the government demonstrates its commitment to supporting agricultural communities and promoting their well-being by offering practical assistance.
benefits:
1. The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious meals to farmers and their helpers at a subsidized rate of 5/- per plate.
1. The meals will be provided in the mandi premises itself.
1. The menu for the meal includes:

- 8 chapatis (made from 250 grams of flour).
- 1 bowl of dal (125 grams).
- 1 bowl of vegetables (125 grams).
- 50 grams of jaggery (in winterRs. from October to March).
- 200 ml of buttermilk (in summerRs. from April to September).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be Hamal/Palledar/Tulara of the farmers coming to sell agricultural commodities.
- The applicant should be a member of the market premises.
- The applicant should be a license holder of the market.

name: One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEdRs. BPEdRs. DTEdRs. PGDCA" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. up to 20Rs./- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen to pursue the mentioned programs/courses from Government-recognized Schools/InstitutionsRs. upon prior permission from the Department. name: "Outstanding Artisan of the Year" under Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief_description: "Outstanding Artisan of the Year" under Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. name: Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to Folk Artists, Troupes for the Purchase of Musical Instruments, Costumes
brief_description: "Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to Folk ArtistsRs. Troupes for the Purchase of Musical InstrumentsRs. Costumes" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides a sum of 2Rs./- to individual folk artists & 6Rs./- for cultural troupesRs. as a grant for the purchase of Musical Instruments and Costumes.
benefits:
For Folk ArtistsRs. financial Assistance of 2Rs./-.

eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Folk Artist/Troupe.

name: Kam Lagat Pyaaj Bhandaran Sanrachna
brief_description:
The Kam Lagat Pyaaj Bhandaran Sanrachna yojana under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government provides subsidies and supportRs. the scheme aims to assist farmers in constructing storage facilities for onions at affordable rates. This initiative seeks to address post-harvest lossesRs. prolong the shelf life of onionsRs. and stabilize market prices by ensuring adequate storage infrastructure. UltimatelyRs. the scheme aims to enhance the income of onion farmers and contribute to the overall development of the agricultural sector.

eligibility:

1. The applicant should be a Farmer.
1. The applicant must have a minimum of 0.5 land ownership.
1. A farmer who is cultivating onion and wants to build a low-cost onion storage structure.

name: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)

name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Law Graduates of Scheduled Caste
brief_description: The scheme Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Law Graduates of Scheduled Caste was launched by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)
brief_description: The "Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Labour Welfare BoardRs. name: Coaching Assistance Scheme for Preparation of Recruitment Exams for Scheduled Caste Students

- Companies ActRs. 1956

name: Poompuhar State Award

name: Book Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)

name: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana

name: Naye Fal Bagicho Ki Sthapana
brief_description:
The "Naye Fal Bagecho Ki Sthapana" under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government Increases farmers' income by facilitating the cultivation of high-value fruit crops that have a potentially higher market demand and profitability compared to traditional crops. Farmers of tribal areas will be exempted from the requirement of a drip irrigation system if they plant gardens in less than 0.4-hectare area. 1. NHB for the establishment of fruit orchards. The subsidy will be given on purchasing saplings from Accredited Nursery/Ramhans Nursery/Government Undertaking/Agricultural Universities/Agriculture Colleges/Semi-GovernmentRs. Government of India institutions/Research Centers/Farm or any other government institution and planting a garden. 1. name: Financial Assistance to Meet the Funeral Expenses of Differently Abled Person

name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)

name: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh
brief_description: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship specifically designed to support Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) students who are financially disadvantaged and pursuing secondary education in Class 9 or 10. benefits:
- Component-1



1. 3Rs./- per annum (Day Students).

- Component-2



1. 3Rs./- per annum (Day Students).
1. 8Rs./- per annum (residential students).
