name: OBC Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh
brief_description: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship specifically designed to support Other Backward Class (OBC) students who are financially disadvantaged and pursuing secondary education in Class 9 or 10. This scholarship program recognizes the importance of education in empowering students from marginalized communities and aims to bridge the financial gap that might otherwise hinder their academic progress. By providing financial assistanceRs. the scholarship helps alleviate the financial burden on SC families and encourages students to complete their matriculationRs. opening doors to further educational opportunities and brighter futures.
benefits:
- 150/- per months (for max 10 months).
- 750/- per annum (residential students).
eligibility:
1. Beneficiary must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Beneficiary must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) caste category.
1. Beneficiaries who are dependents of people in occupations traditionally considered untouchable.
1. Beneficiaries' parents' annual income should not be more than 2Rs./-.
1. All the children of the applicant's parents will be eligible.
1. Students cannot receive other scholarships alongside this one (with some exceptions).
1. Beneficiary's age limit is 12 to 20 years old (as of July 1st).

name: Alpasankhyak Post-Maitrik Chhaatravrtti Yojana
brief_description: The Alpasankhyak Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme under the Higher Education Department of the Madhya Pradesh goverment provides financial assistance to students from minority communities in Madhya Pradesh pursuing post-secondary education. This scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on economically disadvantaged minority studentsRs. enabling them to access quality education and pursue higher studies. By offering scholarships for tuition feesRs. maintenance allowancesRs. and other educational expensesRs. it seeks to promote inclusive growth and empower minority communities through education.
benefits:
1. Tuition fee of 3Rs./- per year for graduate and postgraduate students.
1. Maintenance allowance of 570/- per month for undergraduate and postgraduate hostel students.
1. Maintenance allowance of 300/- per month for non-hostel students
1. Maintenance allowance M.Phil. And Ph.D. 1Rs./- per month to hostel students.
1. Maintenance allowance of 550/- per month for non-hostel students
1. Maintenance allowance will be payable for 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of the minority category of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents and guardian should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. Not less than 50 percent marks in the last qualifying examination.

name: Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. the eligible workers of the board are provided with medical assistance upto 10Rs./- in case of being hospitalized for 05 or more days due to an accident or any disease.
benefits: - 2Rs./- for the first five days. - 200/- each for remaining daysRs. upto a maximum of 10Rs./-Rs. available from the date of registration.
eligibility:
> **For Registration**

- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application**

- The applicant should be registered with the "Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
- The applicant should have been hospitalized for 05 or more days.
- The cause of hospitalization should be an accident or any disease.

name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandi shramik kalyaan yojana
brief_description: The Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan Government is pleased to announce the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandi Shramik Kalyan Yojana. This program is designed to enhance the lives of mandi workers within the state. The Yojana offers a comprehensive suite of benefitsRs. including healthcare services with a focus on medical insurance coverage. FurthermoreRs. the program extends financial assistance to aid mandi workers with matrimonial endeavors. In the event of a medical conditionRs. the Yojana can facilitate access to appropriate treatment facilitiesRs. ensuring workers receive the necessary care.
benefits:
> **Obstetric Support:** - For a maximum of two deliveriesRs. the female license holder Hammal and Palledar are entitled to be paid assistance equivalent to 45 days' wages as per the prevailing wage rate determined by the state government as an unskilled labourer. - As paternity leaveRs. an amount equivalent to 15 days wages is payable to the Hammal/Tulara/Palledar father of the child as per the prevailing wage rate determined by the State Government as an unskilled laborer. > **Help for marriage:** - To the extent of the marriage of a licensed woman and two daughters of a licensed womanRs. 50Rs./-per marriage assistance is payable. - Application has to be submitted in the format prescribed by the concerned licensee 90 days before the marriage.
> **Scholarship / Meritorious Student Award Scheme** - Every student who gets first-division marks and whose guardian is a licensed Hammal or Palledar in Mandi is given a merit scholarship at the following rate:- ClassMale StudentFemale StudentHigher grades (70% to 80%) in the 10th 3Rs./- to 2Rs./-3Rs./-to 2Rs./-lump sum per studentHigher scores in the 12th Between 80% to 90% between 70% to 80%5Rs./-Rs./-Rs./-6Rs./-Rs./-Rs./-lump sum per studentMore than 60% marks in graduation4Rs./-5Rs./-lump sum per studentMore than 60% marks in post-graduation3Rs./-4Rs./-lump sum per student
- **This award is payable as soon as possible within three months of establishing eligibility.** > **Medical Aid:-** - Reimbursement of medical expenditures up to a maximum of 20Rs./-is permitted if a licensed Hammaal or Pulladar becomes gravely ill (due to cancerRs. heart attackRs. liverRs. kidneyRs. etc.) and is admitted to a government hospital or health center.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be Farmers/agricultural laborers of the Rajasthan.
1. The applicant workers hold licenses from the market committee.

name: Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons
brief_description: 'Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide readers allowance to visually impaired studentsRs. specific allowance rates based on the education level ranging from secondary school to postgraduate and professional courses.
benefits: > **Reader's allowance is being paid at the following rate:** - 9th**** To 10th Standard - 3Rs./- (per annum).- Degree Courses - 5Rs./- (per annum). - Post Graduate and Professional Courses - 6Rs./- (per annum).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a visually impaired student.
1. The applicant enrolled in 9th standard or above in a recognized/bonafide institution.

name: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to registered workers for indoor treatment of chronic diseases like CancerRs. TBRs. AIDSRs. etc. as per government rules.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance up to 1Rs./- is provided to registered workers for indoor treatment of chronic diseases like CancerRs. TBRs. AIDSRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a regular membership for one year.
1. The workers who are registered and require indoor treatment for chronic diseases such as cancerRs. tuberculosis (TB)Rs. AIDSRs. etc.Rs. are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The application frequency is limited to once.

name: Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
brief_description: The 'Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. battery-operated wheelchairs are given to muscular dystrophy and tetraplegia-affected persons. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of Battery-Operated Wheelchairs.**
eligibility: - The applicant should be affected by Muscular Dystrophy or Tetraplegia.

name: West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance
brief_description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 25th AprilRs. 2023. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the nominee in case of natural death/accidental death of the registered migrant worker.
benefits:
- 50Rs./- (Rupees Fifty thousands) onlyRs. in case of normal death.
- 2Rs./- (Rupees two Lakhs) onlyRs. for accidental death.
eligibility:
> **For registration as a Migrant Worker:**


- The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicants age should be between 18-60 years.
- The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed/ likely to be employed in any State/Union Territories other than the state of West Bengal/ Outside India.

> **For the application of Welfare Scheme:**


- The beneficiary should be a nominee i.e.Rs. a person nominated by the registered Migrant Worker from his/ her family.
- The migrant worker should have lost his/her life due to natural death/accidental death.

name: West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body
brief_description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 25th AprilRs. 2023. Under this schemeRs. if any registered Migrant Worker dies in the course of employment outside the State of West BengalRs. an assistance of 25Rs./- will be provided to the nominee of the worker for bringing the dead body to his/ her permanent address.
benefits: - 25Rs./- to the nominee of the Migrant Worker.
eligibility:
> **For registration as a Migrant Worker:** - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicants age should be between 18-60 years. - The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed/ likely to be employed in any State/Union Territories other than the state of West Bengal/ Outside India.
> **For the application of Welfare Scheme:** - The beneficiary should be a nominee i.e.Rs. a person nominated by the registered Migrant Worker from his/ her family. - The migrant worker should have lost his/her life due to death during the course of employment outside the State of West Bengal.

name: West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Cremation
brief_description: "West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Cremation" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 25th AprilRs. 2023. Under this schemeRs. if a registered Migrant Worker dies at his / her work place or the place he /she had to stay for the purpose of his / her jobRs. an assistance amounting to 3Rs./- will be provided to the nominee of the worker for cremation at the placeRs. the worker was employed.
benefits: 3Rs./- to the nominee of the registered Migrant Worker.
eligibility:
> **For registration as a Migrant Worker:** - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicants age should be between 18-60 years. - The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed/ likely to be employed in any State/Union Territories other than the state of West Bengal/ Outside India.
> **For the application of Welfare Scheme:** - The beneficiary should be a nominee i.e.Rs. a person nominated by the registered Migrant Worker from his/ her family. - The migrant worker should have lost his/ her life due to death during the course of employment at his/ her work place or the place he/ she had to stay for the purpose of the job.

name: Scholarship (Above VIII Standard) - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil NaduRs. offers the "Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Above Grade 8)" program. This initiative provides financial assistance to differently-abled students enrolled in government-recognized schoolsRs. collegesRs. or training centers to help with educational expenses.
benefits:
Scholarships are provided as:

- For students studying from 9th to 12th Standard: 4Rs./- per annum.
- For Degree Courses: 6Rs./- per annum.
- For PostgraduateRs. MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. VocationalRs. and Other Professional Courses: 7Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a student.
1. The beneficiary must be a differently abled person.
1. The beneficiary must be a student of the following courses:

- 9th to 12th Standard.
- Degree Courses.
- PostgraduateRs. MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. VocationalRs. and Other Professional Courses.

1. The beneficiary must be differently abledRs. who are studying in government-recognized schools/colleges/training centers.
1. The beneficiary must have obtained not less than 40% of the marks in the previous qualifying examination.

name: Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Fitter Training to Hearing Impaired Persons" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give fitter training to the hearing-impaired candidates at the ITIRs. Guindy for two years and a stipend of 300/- per month. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits:
- Fitter training is given to the hearing-impaired candidates at the ITIRs. Guindy for 2 years.
- A stipend of 300/- per month is given to the trainees.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a hearing-impaired person.
1. The applicant should pass the 10th standard.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 25 years of age.

name: Chief Ministers Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme - Tamil Nadu
brief_description:
Chief Minister Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme launched on 23.07.2009 as Kalaingar Kaappittu Thittam. Now the scheme from January 2022 to 2027 is implemented through United India Insurance Company. The scheme provides quality health care to the eligible person through empanelled government and private hospitals to reduce the financial hardship to the enrolled families and move towards universal health coverage by effectively linking with the public health system. This scheme provides free health insurance coverage to families residing in Tamil Nadu with an annual income of less than 1Rs..
> Totally 1090 proceduresRs. 8 follow up procedures and 52 diagnostic procedures are covered under CMCHIS in 800 Government 900 Private empanelled hospitals.
benefits:
1. The scheme seeks to provide cashless hospitalization-specific ailments and procedures.
1. The scheme provides coverage up to 5Rs. per family per year on a floater basis for the ailments and procedures covered under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should have their name included in the family card.
1. The applicants family income should not exceed 1Rs. per annum.
1. The applicant should submit a family cardRs. an Aadhaar cardRs. and an income certificate issued by VAO/Revenue AuthoritiesRs. along with a self-declaration.

name: Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. an amount not exceeding 20Rs./- may be sanctioned as loan to the members of the fundRs. for the purchase of work related tools.
benefits: - An amount not exceeding 20Rs./- may be sanctioned as loan to the members of the fundRs. for the purchase of work related tools. **Note:** The loan amount shall be recovered in not more than sixty installments.
eligibility:
> **For Registration:** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 65 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application:** - The applicant should be registered under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for not less than one year. - The applicant should remit their contribution regularly. - The applicant should not exceed 55 years of age.

name: Bicycle Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Bicycle Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the purchase of a new bicycle for commuting on duty from their residence to the institution.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- is provided to the workers for the purchase of a new bicycle once in every five years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 18Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for 2 years.
1. The worker will get the benefit after every five years in the whole service period.

name: Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is given to the widow or dependent of the worker working in the industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana state in case of his death due to any reason.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is given to the widow or dependent of the deceased worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the widow or dependent of a deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. There is no maximum limit set for the monthly salary of the worker.
1. There is no fixed service period requirement for the worker.
1. The application should be submitted within two years from the date of death of the worker.

name: Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Delivery of a Child or the Miscarriage of Pregnancy or the Termination of Pregnancy" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. The Tamil Nadu Folk Artiste's Welfare Board offers assistance for the delivery of a childRs. miscarriageRs. or termination of pregnancy to registered female folk artists.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** - Child Delivery 6Rs./- (1Rs./- per month for six months). - Miscarriage 3Rs./-. - Termination 3Rs./-. > **Note:** Assistance is available only twice.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered female folk artist.
1. The applicant can be eligible only if she is giving birth to a child or has a miscarriage or termination of pregnancy.
1. The applicant should not have any dues payable to the board.
1. The female folk artist is not eligible if already has two children.

name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society
brief_description: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society is a sub-scheme under West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024"Rs. launched by the MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 7th MarchRs. 2024Rs. and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of the scheme is to provide systematic financial support for toolsRs. equipmentRs. Workshed and other fixed assets to a group of at least 10 artisans coming under an industrial cooperative society.
benefits:
- 3Rs./- for tools/equipmentRs.
- 7Rs./- for Work Shed and other fixed assets.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to any group of artisans.
- The age of the applicant should be between 18-60 years.
- Applicant should be engaged in traditional Craft/trade with hand tools/equipment/ small machines.
- Applicant should be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers.
- Applicant should be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years.
- For Work shedRs. an industrial cooperative society of the eligible artisans should possess a piece of land whereupon sheds will be constructed/ machines will be installed.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals
brief_description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals" scheme was launched by the Arts and Culture DepartmentRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 10Rs. for publishing manuscripts/research journals. They are published on cultural subjects such as languageRs. literatureRs. philosophyRs. religionRs. historyRs. musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. and other fine arts etc.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance of 10Rs./-.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant's proposed book or journal for publication must pertain to one or more cultural subjects such as languageRs. literatureRs. philosophyRs. religionRs. historyRs. musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. and other fine arts.
1. The applicant should be using language Tamil/Malayalam/Telugu/English/French.
1. The applicant's work should be a thesisRs. dissertationRs. or original research based on personal study and critical analysisRs. provided it is not intended for obtaining any degree.
1. Fictional works are not eligible for financial assistance under this scheme.

name: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana with the objective of encouraging the farmers for conservation and development of the Indigenous breeds of cows and buffaloes.
> **Long-term objectives:**


- Conservation and up-gradation of valuable indigenous germplasm available in the State of Haryana.
- Increase in milk production and overall productivity.

> **Medium-term objectives (5 years Horizon):**


- Identification of top-quality germplasm of indigenous breeds of Cow and buffalo and their insemination with high-quality semen for sustainable genetic improvement.
- Encouraging the farmers to rear and breed high-yielding animals of genetic merit.

> **Description of Scheme:**


- Murrah buffaloes meeting the benchmark of 18 kg daily peak yield would be properly identified (with ear tags) along with their progeny. Cash incentives ranging from 15Rs./- to 30Rs./- would be provided to owners of these buffaloes.
- HaryanaRs. Sahiwal and Belahi cowsRs. meeting the benchmark of 8 kgRs. 10 kgRs. and 5 Kg peak yield respectively would be properly identified (with ear tags) along with their progeny. The cash incentives ranging from 5Rs./- to 20Rs./- would be provided to owners of these cows.
- The beneficiaries will be under obligation not to sell the buffalo/cow and its progeny for at least one year as the main objective of scheme is to conserve the indigenous breeds of Cow and buffalo.
- The identified animals would be insured and part of insurance premium will be borne under the prevailing insurance scheme if anyRs. and rest will be paid by the beneficiary as per insurance scheme.
- If no Livestock Insurance Scheme is in operation then the beneficiary would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals on its own and the insurance premium shall be paid by the beneficiary.
benefits:
**1. Cash incentives at the following rates in different slabs would be provided to the owners of the recorded Murrah Buffaloes as below:**
**Sl. No.****Slabs of Lactation yield in Kg (Peak Yield in Kg)****Incentive Money ()**118 to 22 Kg15Rs./-2>22 to 25 Kg20Rs./-3Above 25 Kg30Rs./-**2. Cash incentives at the following rates in different slabs would be provided to the owners of the recorded Cows of different Indigenous breeds as below: (Hariana Cows)**
**Sl. No.****Slabs of peak Yield in Kg****Incentive Money ()**18 to 10 Kg10Rs./-2>10 to 12 Kg15Rs./-3Above 12 Kg20Rs./-**3. Sahiwal Cows**
**Sl. No.****Slabs of peak Yield in Kg****Incentive Money ()**110 to 12 Kg10Rs./-2>12 to 15 Kg15Rs./-3Above 15 Kg20Rs./-**4. Belahi Cows**
**Sl. No.****Slabs of peak Yield in Kg****Incentive Money ()**15 to 8 Kg5Rs./-2>8 to 10 Kg10Rs./-3Above 10 Kg15Rs./-In lieu of the cash incentive providedRs. the owner would be under obligation not to sell the recorded Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and its male progeny at least for one year. The beneficiary would be further bound to look after the male calf properly and the Department will have the first right to purchase it. In caseRs. the beneficiary does not abide by the contract i.e. disposes of the identified Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and/or its male calfRs. he would not be eligible for the cash incentive. The owners of the recorded cows/buffaloes would be required to breed their animals through artificial insemination by the Government.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must be of the age of 18 - 55 years.
1. A Cow or Buffalo eligible to be recorded must be between 05 to 75 days of the date of its Calving as on date of application.
1. A maximum of two milch animals (two Cows or Two Buffaloes or One Cow and One Buffalo) per applicant/beneficiary would be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme.
1. The cows must be true to HarianaRs. SahiwalRs. or Belahi breed and buffalo must be of Murrah Breed only.
1. Incentive for a particular animal could be provided only twice in its life span i.e. if the incentive is provided to a beneficiary for a particular animal twiceRs. such beneficiary would stand debarred for receiving an incentive for that animal in its subsequent calving in the future.
1. The scheme is individual beneficiary-oriented.

**Note 01:** A maximum of two milch animals per applicant will be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme. HoweverRs. the recordings of more than two buffaloes/Cows of an applicant may be carried out for collecting data of the top quality Murrah buffaloes/Indigenous cattle (HarianaRs. SahiwalRs. and Belahi). But incentive money would be provided only for two animals (in the highest slabs) of that applicant in a particular year.
**Note 02:** In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be keptRs. than the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept (Within state of Haryana only).

name: Financial Assistance to Indigent Tamil Scholars
brief_description: The Arts and Culture DepartmentRs. Puducherry launched the scheme "Financial Assistance to Indigent Tamil Scholars". The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month to indigent artists aged 58 years and above and contribution to Tamil language and literature must be of significance. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an indigent artist.
1. The applicant's age should be 58 years and above.
1. The applicant should contribute to Tamil language and literature.
1. The income of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./- per month.

name: Nehru Child Literature Prize
brief_description: The Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry launched the "Nehru Child Literature Prize" scheme. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 10Rs./- with a certificate to writers/authors for the books published in Tamil on Childrens Literature. The applications will be accepted offline.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of 10Rs./-. with a certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a writer/author/ joint author.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years.
1. The applicant should submit texts that must be printed and published as first edition by 31st December from the first day of the specified year.
1. A one-time awardee is ineligible to apply for the subsequent four years.
1. The applicant should not submit an abridgmentRs. adaptationRs. translationRs. or paraphrase of another text for the competition.
1. Essay and thesis submitted for a university degree or examination are not eligible for this award.
1. The texts written for the syllabus will not be accepted for the prize competition.
1. The Children's literature should be published in Tamil not exceeding 120 pages.
1. Foundation lecturesRs. other lecturesRs. serials in journals PublishedRs. etc. will not be accepted.
1. The applicant should include categories such as novelsRs. short storiesRs. poemsRs. playsRs. traveloguesRs. collections of essaysRs. etc. written for children's literature.

name: Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. monthly financial assistance/pension of 3Rs./- will be provided to Stage III and IV cancer patients of Haryana from 01.01.2024. The scheme will be applicable for all age groupsRs. Stage IIIRs. and IV cancer patients throughout the State of Haryana. The financial assistance provided under this scheme will be in addition to the benefits received by the applicant under any other social security pension scheme. This scheme shall come into operation from the date of its publication in the official Gazette.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance/pension of 3Rs./- per month will be provided to Stage III and IV cancer patients starting from 01.01.2024.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana as per Government instructions issued from time to time.
1. The applicant should have Parivar Pehchan Patar (PPP) - Family ID.
1. All Stage III & IV cancer patients will be eligible under the scheme.
1. Cancer patients whose family income is less than 3Rs./- per annumRs. except the amount of other Social Security Pension Schemes will be eligible.

**Note:** The financial assistance provided under this scheme will be in addition to the benefits received by the applicant under any other social security pension scheme.

name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Facilitation Supports
brief_description: Facilitation Supports is a sub-scheme under West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024"Rs. launched by the MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 7th MarchRs. 2024Rs. and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of the scheme is to provide various types of facilitation support to the artisans and Industrial Cooperative Societies.
benefits:
- Facilitation for enlistment on the State Portal for Artisans.
- Facilitation for formation of Industrial Cooperative Society.
- Facilitation for obtaining statutory requirements.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to any group of artisans.
- The age of the applicant should be between 18-60 years.
- Applicant should be engaged in traditional Craft/ trade with hand tools/ equipment/ small machines.
- Applicant should be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers.
- Applicant should be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities. The unemployed persons will be assisted by way of providing financial assistance in the form of subsidies for establishing dairy units of 4Rs. 10Rs. 20Rs. and 50 milch animals like buffaloesRs. indigenous cows (HarianaRs. SahiwalRs. BelahiRs. Red SindhiRs. TharparkarRs. and Gir breeds only) and crossbred cows.
**Medium-term objectives:**

- To provide gainful self-employment to the unemployed persons.
- To supplement the income of the families of the beneficiaries.
- To raise the socio-economic status of the weaker sections/Antyodaya families of the society.
- To commercialize dairy units by encouraging small dairy unit owners to increase the size of their unit to 20 and 50 milch animals.

**Long-term objectives:**

- Creation of employment opportunities through Animal Husbandry activities.
- To increase milk production and Dairy products.
- To upgrade and develop valuable Breeds/Germplasm available in the State.
- To increase per Capita milk availability in the state.
benefits:

- Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division I District Level in the State to the desirous persons.

name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities to Schedule castesRs. the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Dairy unitsRs. Piggery unitsRs. and Sheep/Goat units.
**Long-term objectives:**

- To create self-employment opportunities for the Scheduled Castes families through animal husbandry activities.
- To increase milkRs. woolRs. and meat production and overall productivity of livestock.
- To up-gradate and develop valuable breeds/germplasm available in the State.
- To increase per Capita milk availability in the state.

**Medium-term objectives:**

- To provide gainful self-employment to the unemployed men/women of Scheduled Castes families.
- To raise socio-economic status and to provide socio-economic security to Scheduled Castes Antyodaya families of Haryana.
- To supplement the income of the families of the weaker sections.

**The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways:**

- Sponsoring of loan applications to banks/financial institutions.
- Purchase of animalsRs. taggingRs. and issuance of Health certificates.
- Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc.
- Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division/District Level in the State to the desirous persons.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance under the Scheme:**

**Establishment of Dairy units of 2/3 milch animals:**

- 50% subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2/3 milch animals;
- Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:
- 50% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for the establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
- A maximum amount of 50Rs./- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:**

- 90% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
- A maximum amount of 88Rs./- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Note 01:** The subsidy will be provided three months after the purchase of livestock or disbursement of the Loan by the bankRs. whichever is laterRs. and subject to verification of unit by the concerned veterinary surgeon.
**Note 02:** The unit should be financed through a loan from the bank/financial institution.
**Note 03:** The subsidy would be provided in the loan account of the beneficiary.
> **Financial Assistance for Insurance of Livestock Unit:**


- If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of unit is to be covered under that SchemeRs. wherever permissible.
- HoweverRs. if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own.
eligibility:

1. There will be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.

HoweverRs. the maximum permissible cost for a grant of assistance as a subsidy would not exceed the cost indicated against in the tables mentioned above.

name: Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities- Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under this schemeRs. education loans of up to 50 lakhs are provided to persons with disabilities (Orthopedically HandicappedRs. Visually HandicappedRs. Hearing HandicappedRs. Mentally Retarded) for pursuing professional and technical education both in India and abroad. Permanent residents of HaryanaRs. aged between 18 and 55 yearsRs. with a disability of more than 40%Rs. are eligible to benefit from this scheme.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. education loans of up to 50 lakhs are provided to persons with disabilities (OH/VH/HH/MR) for pursuing professional and technical education both in India and abroad.
eligibility:

name: Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: The "Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme" was launched by the Department of PersonnelRs. and ReformsRs. TrainingRs. Public GrievancesRs. Government of Sikkim. The scheme aims to provide loans free of interest for the duration of one particular course of study with one one-year moratorium period offered to all student beneficiaries and special consideration to the student belongs to the below-poverty-line family and pursuing professional courses in a recognized institution whether in India or abroad.
benefits:
- The maximum loan amount is 5Rs./- for full-time professional courses within Sikkim - The loan amount of 7Rs./- for studies in IndiaRs. and 15Rs./- for studies abroad.
**Note:** In case of discontinuity of studies or the loanee diesRs. the co-applicant shall be liable to refund the entire amount of the loan within a period not exceeding one year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./- for studies within India and 5Rs./- for studies abroad. 1. The institution where the applicant wants to studyRs. whether in India or abroadRs. must be recognized by the relevant authority in India. 1. Only one member per family shall be considered for the benefitRs. except in the case of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. 1. Only members of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families will be considered for the study in Sikkim.
Note: Children of Government/Public Sector Undertaking employees are also eligible.

name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
brief_description: The scheme "Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under the schemeRs. education loans are provided to sections of the minority population defined based on a "Creamy Layer" i.e.Rs. an annual family income of 8Rs./-. benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. name: State Award for Teachers
brief_description: The scheme "State Awards to Teachers" by the Directorate of EducationRs. Government of Goa aims to celebrate the unique contribution of the finest teachers in the state and honor those who have improved the quality of school education and enriched students' lives. Through this schemeRs. ten state awards consisting of 100Rs. and a citation each are provided to teachers across different categories including PrimaryRs. SecondaryRs. High School HeadmastersRs. and Higher Secondary levels. The applications for this scheme are accepted by hand or email. The scheme is implemented through a two-tier selection process involving District and State Selection Committees.
benefits:
**Monetary Award** - Amount: 100Rs. per awardee - Total awards: 10 **Additional Benefits** Citation
**Distribution of Awards** - Primary Teachers: 2 awards (one per district) - Secondary Teachers: 4 awards (two per district) - High School Headmasters: 2 awards (one per district) - Higher Secondary Teachers: 1 award (state-level) - Higher Secondary Principal: 1 award (state-level)
> **NOTE:** Out of the 10 awardsRs. 2 awards are reserved for differently abled teachers/Special Educators/Head of schools. Special Educators are allowed to apply for State Awards under the category of Sr. No. 1 & 2.
eligibility:
1. School teachersRs. special educatorsRs. and Heads of Schools working in recognized government or aided primary/middle/highRs. and secondary schools. In-service teachers shall have to fulfil the required academic and professional qualifications as per cadre for the State Award to Teachers.
1. The retired Teachers are not eligible for State awards. In-service teachers shall have to complete at least 5 years of regular teaching service as of 30th June 2019 after probation in the State of Goa only and are eligible for the State Award to Teachers.
1. Those teachers who are due for retirement for the year to which the State Awards relate are not eligible for State Awards to Teachers.
1. In caseRs. no sufficientRs. suitable and eligible teacher/ Head of the Institution/Special Educator is available in that particular categoryRs. then it shall not be binding on the government to grant an award.
1. The teacher/Head of School should not have indulged in tuition.
1. Only regular Teachers and Heads of Schools will be eligible.
1. Contractual TeachersRs. Para teachersRs. part-time instructors and NSQF instructors will not be eligible.
1. There shall be no vigilance /criminal case pending against the applicant.

benefits: 1. name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
brief_description:
The "Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Animal Husbandry & CooperativeRs. Government of Jharkhand. This scheme is mainly to provide financial assistance to the farmers in the event of crop damage due to any natural calamity and natural accidents. The scheme is not a crop insurance scheme but a compensation scheme provided to farmers in case of crop damage. This will fulfill the objective of providing security coverage to farmers in case of crop loss due to natural calamities and providing a certain financial assistance. This scheme will cover both the land owner and the landless farmer. Farmers will not need to pay any kind of crop insurance premium under this scheme and they will be provided financial assistance directly by the government in the event of crop loss.
**Objective:**

- To provide financial assistance to farmers affected by crop damage due to unforeseen natural calamities or events.
- To strengthen the income of the farmers to continue the agricultural work.
- Ensuring financial flow for agricultural work.
- To pave the way for food securityRs. crop diversificationRs. rapid growthRs. and competition in agriculture.

**The following types of natural calamitiesRs. which may affect the cropRs. will be included in this scheme:**

- Flood and Water Logging
- Earthquake
- Volcanic Eruption
- Landslide
- Drought or dry winds (if drought has not been declared by the State Government)
- Widespread Epidemic
- Naturally Caught Fire
- Thunderstorm
- Storm
- Torrential Rain
- Cyclone

**The following risks will not be considered under the scheme:**

- Losses caused by war/nuclear risksRs.
- Malicious losses and other preventable risksRs. such as unscientific farming practices by farmers etc.


- Loss due to attack by wild animals (Under thisRs. the loss caused to the crop will be covered under the schemes of ForestRs. Environment and Climate Change DepartmentRs. Government of Jharkhand).
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. assured financial assistance is provided to eligible farmers in the event of crop loss occurring due to natural calamity.
1. In the event of 30-50% loss: 3Rs./- per acre maximum upto 5 acres
1. In the event of >50% loss: 4Rs./- per acre maximum upto 5 acres

**Note 1:** Both Kharif (Paddy & Maize) and Rabi (WheatRs. MustardRs. GramRs. and Potato) season crops are covered under this scheme.
**Note 2:** No intermediary role of insurance companies and no premiums are required to be paid by applicant farmers.
**Note 3:** Loss estimation through data of Crop Cutting Experiment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer.
1. The applicant should be a Raiyat or Bataidaar farmer.
1. The age of the farmer should be at least 18 years.
1. The farmer should have a valid Aadhaar Number.
1. Farmers cultivating on government or non-majorua land with lease or settlement documents from the Revenue Department are also eligible.
1. The farmer should possess requisite land papers (LPC/Land Receipts).
1. Farmers can avail benefits for agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 10 decimals to a maximum of 5 acres under the scheme.
1. Crop assistance will be provided to farmers only in case of crop loss of at least 20%.
1. This scheme will be voluntary for all farmers.

**Note:** Under the schemeRs. special efforts will be made to ensure maximum coverage of SC/ST/Women/Paharia Tribe/Primitive Tribe farmers.

name: Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
brief_description: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance CorporationRs. Andhra Pradesh launched scheme "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" under its Action Plan 2017-18Rs. aims to provide Motorized Three Wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. The Motorized Three Wheelers are distributed by the Assistant DirectorsRs. Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior CitizensRs. and District ManagersRs. A.P. name: Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining)
brief_description:
The government of Odisha is committed to providing "Pucca Houses" to all the eligible kutcha households in all the mining-affected blocks of nine mineral-bearing Districts: AngulRs. DhenkanalRs. JajpurRs. JharsugudaRs. KeonjharRs. KoraputRs. MayurbhanjRs. Sundargarh & Rayagada. Assistance to construct Pucca houses will be sanctioned to eligible households in these areas under the "Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining)" Scheme.
**Objectives of the Scheme:** The objective of the Scheme is to convert all Kutcha houses into Pucca houses. The HHs residing in Blocks affected by mining activities will be covered in saturation mode. A Pucca house means that it should be able to withstand normal wear & tear due to usage and natural forcesRs. including climatic conditions.
**A "Pucca" house is one with the following characteristics:** - Material: It should have a foundationRs. wall and roof of permanent material. - Wall material: Fly ash bricksRs. burnt bricksRs. stones (packed with lime or cement)Rs. cement concreteRs. etc. - Roof Material: TilesRs. GCI (Galvanized Corrugated Iron) sheetsRs. asbestos cement sheetsRs. RBC (Reinforced Brick Concrete)Rs. RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) etc. - Lifetime: The expected life of the structure must be a minimum of 30 years. - It is clarified that the above definition is only for verification of households with Pucca houses. The roofs of the houses that shall be constructed under this Scheme shall be of RCC or any other material of equivalent strength approved by the PR & DW Department.
A **"Kutcha"** house is one in which walls and/or roof are made of materials such as un-burnt bricksRs. bambooRs. mudRs. grassRs. reedsRs. thatchRs. loosely packed stones etc. and materials not mentioned in the above pucca house characteristics which are not durable due to inappropriate application of techniques and are not able to withstand normal wear and tear.
benefits:
1. The unit cost under the Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining) for the construction of a new Pucca house is 1Rs./- for non-IAP Districts and 1Rs./- for IAP Districts. This can be revised by the State Government from time to time.
1. The beneficiary of Pucca Ghar Yojana will get a wage component for 90 person days and 95 person days in non-IAP and IAP Districts respectivelyRs. under MGNREGSRs. which can be revised by the government from time to time.
1. The beneficiary of Pucca Ghar Yojana Mining will avail assistance for Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) under the said scheme. The unit assistance for the construction of an Individual House Hold Latrine will cost 12Rs. which can be revised by the government from time to time.
1. In additionRs. the beneficiaries are entitled to convergence for potable drinking water supply systemRs. Electrification under Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDU GJY)/ BGJYRs. wages for Land Development under MGNREGSRs. Social Security under AABY / RSBY etc. as per extant guidelines.
1. The beneficiary will avail of an incentive for early completion of the house as follows:-

name: Disability Aids and Appliances - Telangana
brief_description: The "Disability Aids and Appliances" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. LET&F (Labour) Department. Telangana. The scheme aims to provide artificial limbsRs. wheelchairsRs. tricyclesRs. and other fabricated appliances to registered construction workers who have lost limbs or sustained disabilities due to accidents.
benefits: - **Free distribution of artificial limbsRs. wheelchairs/tricyclesRs. and fabricated appliances.**
eligibility:
1. The worker should be a registered building or construction worker with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The disablement must have occurred due to an accident at the worksite or anywhere.

name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme in Ladakh
brief_description: The scheme "Sindhu Darshan Scheme in Ladakh" was started by the Religious Trusts and Endowments DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on the Sindhu Darshan pilgrimage. Such persons of Madhya PradeshRs. who have completed the journey of Sindhu Darshan located in Ladakh by getting a place in the list of persons selected by the Government of Madhya PradeshRs. then after the journeyRs. they will have to present the certificate of the actual expenditure incurred on the journey and the expenditure incurred on such journey reimbursement of 50% up to a maximum of 10Rs./- per pilgrim will be done by the state government.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in LadakhRs. up to a maximum of 10Rs./- per pilgrim.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have completed a pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in Ladakh after being selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Religious Trust and Endowment Department.
1. Only individuals selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Religious Trust and Endowment Department for the pilgrimage are eligible for the scheme's benefits.
1. The applicant must not be an income taxpayer.
1. Financial assistance is available to each individual only once in their lifetime.

**Note:** To avail the benefit of this schemeRs. pilgrims should submit all the documents detailing their actual expenses during the journey.

name: Sri Lanka's Sita Temple Tour
brief_description: The scheme "Sri Lanka's Sita Temple Tour" was started by the Religious Trusts and Endowments DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to state pilgrims traveling to the Sita Temple and Ashoka Vatika in Sri LankaRs. as well as the Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. natives of Madhya Pradesh who complete visits to Sita Temple & Ashok Vatika in Sri LankaRs. as well as Angkor Wat Temple in CambodiaRs. are eligible for reimbursement.
1. Upon submission of the certificate detailing the actual expenses incurredRs. the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expensesRs. up to a maximum of 30Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have completed a pilgrimage to the Sita Temple and Ashoka Vatika in Sri Lanka and the Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia.
1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
1. Each individual is eligible to receive financial assistance only once in their lifetime.

name: Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers
brief_description: The "Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and is implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to improve the financial condition of minority communities involved in silk reeling and spinning by providing financial assistance through loans and subsidies. This support is intended to enhance working capitalRs. improve basic infrastructureRs. and promote better productivity and economic stability.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


- Silk reeling/spinning workers can receive a loan of up to 2Rs./-Rs. with 50% of the loan amount being provided as a subsidy.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the religious minority category of the state.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the state.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 55 years.
1. The family income from all sources should not exceed more than 6Rs./-
1. No member of the applicant's family should be a State/Central Government employee.
1. The applicant or his family members should not have availed of any loan/subsidy facility from the Corporation in the last 5 years except the Arivu education loan and Foreign Education Loan Scheme.
1. The applicant should not be a sustainer of the corporation.

name: Community Based Training Scheme
brief_description: The "Community Based Training Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to provide training in Heavy Vehicle DrivingRs. Short HandRs. Security ServicesRs. Office Soft SkillRs. Retail SalesRs. Beauty Parlor Course (Male and Female) to the unemployed young men and women belonging to minority community for self employment or employment in MNCRs. BPOs and other activities.
benefits: - **The scheme provides training in Heavy Vehicle DrivingRs. Short HandRs. Security ServicesRs. Office Soft SkillRs. Retail SalesRs. and Beauty Parlor Course (Male and Female).**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the religious minority community of the state.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 35 years.
1. The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources should be less than 1Rs./- in urban areas and less than 96Rs./- in rural areas.
1. The selected applicants should compulsorily complete the training.
1. The applicant must have a minimum qualification of SSLC.
1. The applicant should not have previously taken training in any schemes of the state or central government.

name: Overseas Educational Loan Scheme
brief_description: The "Overseas Educational Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme objective is to provide financial/loan assistance to students belonging to minority communities who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized universities abroad.
benefits: - The loan amount will be provided up to 20Rs./- at a zero interest rate.
eligibility: 1. The student should be a resident of Karnataka State. 1. The student should belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. JainRs. BuddhistRs. Sikh and Parsi). 1. The student should have secured at least 60% marks in the previous year. 1. The student should have received an offer letter from a foreign university. 1. Loans will be provided only on mortgage of property (building/land) to the corporation. The value of the property should not be less than the loan amount. 1. The students who have not received a scholarship from the Directorate of Minorities.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Bihar
brief_description:
The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme" was introduced in Bihar during the year 2009-10 as a part of the National Social Assistance Programme. The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to persons with disabilities in the age group of 18 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to persons with disabilities belonging to poor families of the society by providing them financial assistance.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a monthly pension of 400/-.

**Note:** The pension amount is being paid to the beneficiaries through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process. In this processRs. the pension amount is transferred directly into the beneficiaries' accounts via the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) at the state levelRs. based on the account numbers provided by the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a person with disabilities.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or more.
1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 79 years.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: Bihar Disability Pension Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Bihar Disability Pension Scheme" was initiated by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. to cover only those persons with disabilities who are not covered under the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension of 400/- is given to persons with a disability of 40% or moreRs. regardless of their income or age group.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the differently-abled section of the poor family of the society by providing them financial assistance.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible differently-abled persons will receive a monthly pension of 400/-.

**Note:** The pension amount is being paid to the beneficiaries through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process. In this processRs. the pension amount is transferred directly into the beneficiaries' accounts via the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) at the state levelRs. based on the account numbers provided by the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar or should have been residing in Bihar for at least the past 10 years as of the date of application submission.
1. The applicant should be physically disabled.
1. The applicant should possess a disability certificate with a minimum of 40% disability.
1. There is no minimum or maximum age limit for availing of the benefits of the scheme.
1. There is no upper limit on annual income for availing of the pension.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme
brief_description:
The "Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month is given to leprosy patients with Visible Deformities Grade-II in the state. The state government fully funds this scheme.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the state's leprosy patients.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month is given to leprosy patients with Visible Deformities Grade-II.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a leprosy patient with Visible Deformities Grade-II.

name: Continuation of Pension (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Continuation of Pension'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. This scheme is designed to support registered building and construction workers who have paid their subscription fee for a minimum of three (3) continuous years and remain active in their profession until the age of sixty (60) can receive a monthly pension. Beneficiaries must not be receiving a similar pension from any other government scheme.
benefits: - **Monthly Pension:** 2Rs./- to eligible registered workers.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The beneficiary should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
- The worker should have paid subscription fees for at least three (3) continuous years.
- The worker should remain an active construction worker.
- The workers age should be below 60 years.
- The worker shall not avail similar benefits under any of the Government Schemes.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Ewam Anusuchit Janjati Civil Sewa Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Civil Sewa Protsahan Yojana" has been initiated by the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students who qualify in the preliminary examination of the Civil Services Competitive Examination conducted by the Bihar Public Service CommissionRs. PatnaRs. and the Union Public Service CommissionRs. New DelhiRs. to support their preparation for the main examination and interview.

Under this schemeRs. candidates who pass the preliminary examination of Civil Services Competitive Examinations are eligible for the following incentives:

1. Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates who pass the Preliminary Examination of the Combined Competitive Examination conducted by the Bihar Public Service CommissionRs. PatnaRs. will receive a one-time financial assistance of 50Rs./- for further preparation.
1. Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates who pass the Preliminary Examination of the Civil Services Competitive Examination conducted by the Union Public Service CommissionRs. New DelhiRs. will receive a one-time financial assistance of 1Rs./- for further preparation.

1. The benefit of this scheme is available to each candidate only once.

name: Production of Foundation and Certified Seeds
brief_description: The scheme Production of Foundation and Certified Seeds by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is aimed at encouraging farmers to produce high-quality seeds. Under this initiativeRs. farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department of Agriculture are eligible to receive a subsidy.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per quintal.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should produce and supply Foundation or Certified seeds to the Department.

name: Grant for Purchase of Tools (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Grant for Purchase of Tools" scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers who have completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of upto 15Rs./- for purchasing trade-related tools.

name: Visit of Contract Farming Farmers to the Research Stations in Karnataka
brief_description: The scheme Visit of Contract Farming Farmers to the Research Stations in Karnataka by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to enhance the agricultural practices of contract farming farmers by enabling visits to research stations in Karnataka. A batch of 50 farmers will be sponsored for a 3-day visit. The scheme focuses on increasing exposure to advanced techniques and research findings to improve farming outcomes.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per batch of 50 farmers for 3 days.- **Learning Program:** Exposure to the latest agricultural research and innovations.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

name: Distribution of Minikits At Free of Cost
brief_description: The Distribution of Minikits at Free of Cost scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides subsidies for minikits to maize-growing farmers in specific districts including CoimbatoreRs. DindigulRs. ErodeRs. DharmapuriRs. KrishnagiriRs. NamakkalRs. PerambalurRs. VirudhunagarRs. TheniRs. VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. TirunelveliRs. and Thoothukudi.

- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of any of the following districts of Tamil Nadu: CoimbatoreRs. DindigulRs. ErodeRs. DharmapuriRs. KrishnagiriRs. NamakkalRs. PerambalurRs. VirudhunagarRs. TheniRs. VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi.
- The beneficiary should be involved in maize cultivation.

name: Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra Yojana: Dress for Pre-school Children
brief_description: The "Dress for Pre-school Children" scheme is a component of the "Samekit Baal Vikas Chhtra YojanaRs." initiated by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a cash amount of 400/- per child per year is provided for uniforms to all children aged 3 to 6 years who are receiving pre-school education at Anganwadi Centres. eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The beneficiary should be a child.
1. The beneficiary should be between 3 and 6 years of age.
1. The beneficiary should be enrolled at an Anganwadi Centre.
1. The beneficiary should be receiving pre-school education at the Anganwadi Centre.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
brief_description: Launched on 15th August 1995Rs. the "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme" is a pension scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. The scheme provides financial assistance to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households. Individuals aged 60 to 79 years are eligible to receive a monthly pension of 1Rs./- as part of the old-age pension support.
benefits:
**Amount of Pension:** 1000/- per month.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary through bank transfers or money orders.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Jammu and Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

name: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, and Law)
brief_description: The "Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. AgricultureRs. VeterinaryRs. and Law)" launched on 7th MayRs. 2012Rs. by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to assist students from Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC). The scheme covers tuition feesRs. special feesRs. and non-refundable compulsory fees as prescribed by the governmentRs. along with the full examination fee.

1. The beneficiary should be a student.

name: Burial Ground-Provision of Burial Grounds and Pathway to Burial Grounds
brief_description: The "Burial Ground-Provision of Burial Grounds and Pathway to Burial Grounds" scheme launched by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

name: Training of Farmers on Pulses Production Technologies

benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 15Rs./- per batch for 50 farmers.- **Training Program:** Training on advanced pulse production techniques.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a Farmer. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should raise seed farms with Pulses crop.

**Financial assistance ranging from 2Rs./- to 5Rs./- as a subsidy for opening a showroom or mobile van:**

MochigarRs. MochiRs. muchiRs. Telugu MochiRs. kamaati mochaRs. RohidasRs. DhorRs. kakkayyaRs. KankayyaRs. SamagaraRs. SamagarRs. Aadhi AnddraRs. Aadhi DravidaRs. Aadhi Karnataka among scheduled castes.

name: Maternity Benefit to the Female Beneficiary
brief_description: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board (MBOCWWB) launched welfare scheme "Maternity Benefit to the Female Beneficiary". The scheme provides financial assistance in cases of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancyRs. up to two times. This benefit is aimed at ensuring health and financial support for female workers during such critical situations.

eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a female construction worker.
1. The worker should be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Workers for Class 9th to 12th Through National Scholarship (JKBOCWWB)

The scheme provides annual financial assistance of 1Rs. per child (up to two children) for the education of registered BOC workers' children through the national scholarship portal.

> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**
