1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


1. One of the student's parents must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOC) Welfare Board.
1. The applicant must be studying in classes 9th to 12th.

name: Awards to Bright Students
brief_description: The Awards to Bright Students scheme by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers financial assistance to the top two boys and two girls from Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity in each district who have excelled in their 10th standard public examinations and continue their studies.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - **For the first year:** 800/-. - **For the next five years (per year):** 960/-.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a student.
- The beneficiary should have passed 10th std.Rs. Public Examinations.
- The beneficiary should be among the top two boys or two girls in their concerned district.
- The beneficiary should be continuing their studies after 10th standard.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities.

name: Prize Schemes to the Students (State Level Prizes)
brief_description: The "Prize Schemes to the Students (State Level Prizes)" launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aimed at supporting students from Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC). The prizes are distributed to students from both Government/Government Aided and Private Schools who have studied Tamil as their first language. Awards are given in various categoriesRs. with no income limit.
benefits: - **First Prize:** 50Rs./- (boys from BC)Rs. 25Rs./- (girls from BC) - **Second Prize:** 30Rs./- (boys from BC)Rs. 20Rs./- (girls from BC) - **Third Prize:** 20Rs./- (boys from BC)Rs. 15Rs./- (girls from BC)
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a student. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC)/ Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ Denotified Communities (DNC). - The beneficiary should be studying in a Government/ Government Aided/ Private School. - The beneficiary must have studied Tamil as the first language. > **Note:** If more than one student secures the same marksRs. awards are granted to all students.

name: Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana
brief_description: Launched on 08-07-2015Rs. the scheme "Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana" by the WomenRs. Child Development & Social Security DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to support primitive tribal families in the state. Financial assistance is provided to the adult married woman in each family. If there is no adult married womanRs. financial assistance is provided to the male head of the family. This is a family-based pension scheme. The scheme was earlier known as "Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana".
benefits: Financial Assistance of 1Rs. per month is directly transferred to the bank account of the beneficiary through the Aadhaar-Based Payment System (ABPS) and Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an adult woman.
1. The applicant should be married.
1. The applicant must belong to one of the recognized primitive tribal groups: AsurRs. BirhorRs. Hill-KhariaRs. KorwaRs. Mal-PahariaRs. etc.
1. No family member of the applicant should have a government or public sector job that provides a regular salary.
1. The family should not have a steady income from any government or public sector employment.
1. The applicant cannot receive benefits from other pension schemes like the Indira Gandhi National Old Age PensionRs. Indira Gandhi National Widow PensionRs. or similar schemes.

**NOTE:** If there is no married adult woman in the familyRs. the male head of the family can receive the pension.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)" is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. differently-abled individuals aged 18 to 65 years with a disability of 80% and above are eligible to receive a pension of 600/- per month.
benefits: A monthly pension of 600/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
1. The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more.
1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 65 years.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: Providing Tin stalls to Gatai Kamgar
brief_description: "Providing Tin Stalls to Gatai Kamgar" is a social welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance of the Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Caste individuals engaged in leather footwear production and leather goods preparation. The scheme offers 100% government-funded tin stalls and provides 500/- as financial assistance to help protect them from heatRs. rainRs. and wind.
benefits: 500/- is provided as financial assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.
1. If the applicant resides in a rural areaRs. his/her total household income should be less than 40Rs..
1. If the applicant resides in an urban areaRs. his/her total household income should be less than 50Rs..
1. The applicant should be 18 years or above in age.
1. The place where the applicant asking for the stall must be provided on rent/ lease/purchased/official free hand by Gram panchayatRs. MunicipalityRs. Cantonment Board or Municipal corporation or must be of own property of the applicant.

name: Stipend to Educated Unemployed
brief_description: The Stipend to Educated Unemployed scheme was launched by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram. Under this schemeRs. provides a stipend of 650 per month to assist 25 educated persons with disabilities who have registered in an Employment Exchange for over three years and have not been placed in gainful employment.
benefits: - Stipend of 650/- per month to the educated unemployed individuals with disabilities.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be a disabled person. 1. The applicant should be an educated unemployed registered with an Employment Exchange for at least three years. 1. The applicant should be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

name: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs
brief_description: The scheme "Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to enhance the quality of life of the Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribe (VJNT) families by developing sustainable income sources and promoting economic stability. Each family will receive a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5Rs. square feet). This plot of land will include the construction of a 269-square-foot home as part of the assistance provided under the scheme.
benefits:
- Each family is provided with a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5Rs. square feet).
- This plot of land will include the construction of a 269-square-foot homeRs. forming a cluster of 20 families.
- The project will also cover the essential amenitiesRs. including shelterRs. internal roadsRs. drainageRs. water supplyRs. electricityRs. and a community hall (Samaj Mandir) for social activities.
- The entire project aims to improve the living standards of VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) families by offering them stable housing and related amenities.
- The benefit of this scheme is given every year to 3 villages amongst 34 districts (except Mumbai & B. Mumbai) to 20 families.

_*The land for the house shall be given under this scheme on the names of the husband and wife jointly. HoweverRs. in the case of widow and divorceeRs. land and house shall be given by their name._
_*The land allotted under this scheme is non-transferableRs. it will not be sold to anyone. The house or land should not be given on rent._
eligibility:
1. The family of the applicant should be residing in Maharashtra.
1. The family of the applicant should belong to the original VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) category.
1. The family of the applicant should not be having their own house.
1. The family of the applicant should be residing in a tent house or hut.
1. The family of the applicant should be landless.
1. The family of the applicant should be residing in one place for at least six months andRs. for the remaining monthsRs. should be wandering from village to village for livelihood.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./-.
1. The family of the applicant should not have availed of the benefits of any other housing scheme such as Gharkul etc.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be given to one member only of the eligible family.

_*Priority shall be given to families living in tentsRs. with no earning hand widowsRs. divorceesRs. handicapped and flood-affected persons._

name: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
brief_description: The Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children of registered construction workersRs. providing 20Rs./- per year for diploma courses and 25Rs./- per year for postgraduate diploma courses.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance For:** - Government Recognized Diploma Courses- 20Rs./- - Postgraduate Diploma Courses- 25Rs./-
> **NOTE:** Benefit applies to a maximum of two children and to the wife of registered male workers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra. 1. The applicant should be a child or spouse of a registered construction worker. 1. The construction worker should be registered under the MBOCWW. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government-recognized diploma or postgraduate diploma course.

name: Funeral Assistance
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance is implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance for funeral expenses to the nominated heir of a registered worker in the event of their death.
benefits: - In case of the death of a registered workerRs. an amount of 10Rs./- is payable as funeral assistance to the nominated heir.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased worker. 1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society: Jewel Loan (Interest Free)
brief_description: The "Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society: Jewel Loan (Interest Free)" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide interest-free loans for up to 1Rs./- through cooperative societies on jewel loans. The purpose is to offer financial relief without charging any interest on jewel loansRs. thus aiding citizens in managing expenses or urgent requirements.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Loan up to 1Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** No interest.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a member of a Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society. - The beneficiary should be interested to avail Jewel Loan from the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.

name: Lalima Abhiyaan
brief_description: The "Lalima Abhiyaan" scheme of the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to improve the health of childrenRs. adolescent girlsRs. and women of reproductive age. The scheme focuses on preventing anaemia and raising nutrition awareness among adolescent girlsRs. pregnant womenRs. and lactating mothers. It has been launched to address the widespread issue of anaemia linked to poor nutrition and lack of proper food.
benefits: 1. **Anemia Prevention:** Free iron folic acid tablets are provided to combat anemia among childrenRs. adolescent girlsRs. and women.1. **Improved Nutrition:** Awareness campaigns promote healthy diets and better nutrition practicesRs. especially for adolescent girls and mothers.1. **Collaborative Approach:** The campaign is supported by multiple departmentsRs. including Public HealthRs. AYUSHRs. and School EducationRs. ensuring wide outreach.1. **Mission Mode Operation:** The campaign works in a focusedRs. large-scale effort to quickly address anemia and improve health outcomes.
eligibility:
The applicant should be one of the following -

- School-going girl.
- Adolescent Girl.
- Pregnant Woman.
- Lactating Woman.
- Child in the age group of 6 months to 10 years.
- Woman of reproductive age group (19 to 49 years).

name: Mukhyamantri Nijee Nalkup Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Nijee Nalkup Yojana launched by the Minor Water Resources DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to provide financial support to farmers for borewell construction and motor pump installation to ensure water availability for irrigation purposes. It focuses on helping farmers in underprivileged regions with limited irrigation infrastructure.
benefits:
> **Subsidy for Borewell Construction:**
**Category****Subsidy Amount (Per Meter)** **Depth Allowed**General 600/-15-70 metersBackward/Most Backward Classes 840/-15-70 metersScheduled Caste/Tribe Category 900/-15-70 meters
> **Subsidy for Motor Pump Installation:**
- The amount of subsidy will be payable to General CategoryRs. Backward/Extremely Backward Classes and Scheduled Caste/Tribe Classes at the rate of 50%Rs. 70% and 80% respectively on the cost of 2HPRs. 3HPRs. 5HP motor pump at the rate of maximum 20000/-Rs. 25000/- and 30Rs./- respectively.
eligibility: 1. Farmers identified under the Saat Nischay-2 "Irrigation Water to Every Field" after a joint technical survey are eligible. 1. Farmers must own at least 0.40 acre (40 decimal) of land. Priority will be given to small and marginal farmers. 1. There should not be an existing borewell at the site. 1. No previous grants or financial assistance have been taken for borewell construction at the same site by the Farmer. 1. The grant is valid for one borewell and one motor pump set per farmer. 1. Borewell must be dug to a depth of 15-70 meters and with 4-6 inch diameter to qualify for the grant.

name: Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 1966Rs. the scheme "Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free accommodation and mess facilities to students from studying in Class 9th to 12th in a government/recognized school.
benefits: Free Accommodation and Mess Facilities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category.
1. The applicant should be a student of class 9th to 12th.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government or recognized school.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous year's examination.

name: Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme
brief_description: The Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical EducationRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to students pursue higher education without financial constraints. Under this schemeRs. eligible students can avail education loans up to 15 lakhs at a subsidized 4% simple interest rateRs. with additional benefits for female students.
benefits: 1. Education loans up to 15Rs./- at a subsidized 4% interest rate. 1. Long Repayment Term: Maximum repayment tenure of up to 15 years. 1. No Processing Fees: No additional fees for loan processingRs. sanctioningRs. or disbursement.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be an Indian national. 1. The student should have completed class 10th to pursue a diploma and class 10th and 12th to pursue undergraduate or higher courses from a recognized school in Jharkhand. 1. The student should have secured admission in institutions like IITsRs. IIMsRs. IIESTsRs. ISIsRs. NLUsRs. AIIMSsRs. NITsRs. XLRIRs. IISCsRs. BITSRs. SPARs. NIDRs. IIFTsRs. ICFAI Business School etc within and outside of the state (within India) which are ranked up to 200 in the overall list or ranked up to 100 in their respective individual category of NIRF Rankings or have been accredited grade either A" or above by NAAC. 1. The student should not be aged more than 40 (forty) years at the time of application for loan. 1. The student should not be a prior beneficiary of the scheme. 1. The student should not have availed education loan from any State Co-operative BanksRs. Central Co-operative BanksRs. District Central Co-operative BanksRs. or any Public or Private sector Banks for the course in which he/she is applying for a loan under the Scheme.

name: Study Abroad Scholarships (Scheduled Tribe)
brief_description: Launched in 2003Rs. the scheme "Study Abroad Scholarships" by the Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh covers tuition fees of 40Rs. US Dollars per yearRs. along with a living allowance of 9Rs. US Dollars and a contingency allowance of 1Rs. US Dollars. To be eligibleRs. students must have passed the graduation final examination with at least 55% marks for postgraduate studiesRs. and the postgraduate examination with at least 50% marks for Ph.D. The scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students for pursuing higher education abroad.
benefits:
1. The scheme covers tuition fees of 40Rs. US Dollars per yearRs. along with a living allowance of 9Rs. US Dollars and a contingency allowance of 1Rs. US Dollars.
1. Additional expenses such as visa feesRs. insuranceRs. poll taxRs. airfareRs. and rail/bus fare are also provided.

**NOTE:** The fees are paid into the University account and subsistence/contingency allowance and other allowances are paid directly into the applicant's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be 35 years old as of 1st January.
2. The applicant should have an annual income limit of 10 lakhs.
3. The applicant should meet the course duration requirements:

- Postgraduate 2 years
- PhD 4 years
- Research 1 year 6 months

4. The applicant should have the following educational qualifications:

- For Postgraduate: Must have passed the graduation final examination with at least 55% marks.
- For PhD: Must have passed the postgraduate examination with at least 50% marks.
- The applicant should choose the foreign educational institution for admission independently.
- The applicant should be applying for a postgraduate or higher-level degree.

name: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2013Rs. the scheme "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme" aims to provide permanent houses to registered construction workers in the rural areas of Madhya Pradesh who are homeless or living in kutcha/semi-pucca houses. This scheme is applicable in all rural areas of the state (excluding urban and Nazul outer areas).
benefits:
1. The Board reimburses a minimum loan grant of 50Rs. to the beneficiary.
1. The Banks may approve an additional loan of up to 30Rs. based on repayment capacityRs. with no role for the State Government.
1. The grant is limited to 50Rs. per case.

**NOTE:****** The Board provides the grant to District Labour OfficesRs. which distribute it to banks based on approved loan cases.
eligibility:
**For Registration:**

1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.

**For Application:**

1. The applicant should not fulfil the eligibility criteria for housing grants under Indira Awas Yojana or Chief Minister Antyodaya Awas Yojana.
1. The applicant should have a family with a maximum of three hectares of agricultural land.
1. The applicant's family's maximum income from all sources should be up to 3 lakh per annum.
1. The applicant should have sufficient land available for house constructionRs. as mentioned in clause 6 above.
1. The applicant should be eligible to receive land for housing from the government.
1. The applicant should be willing to construct a house on agricultural land owned by them.
1. The applicant should be eligible to obtain a landholder certificate in the village population.
1. The applicant should agree to obtain a bank loan for constructing a house with a 225 sq. ft. plinth area in the prescribed layout and provide their own contribution in the form of labour/material/inclusion.

name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Permanent Partial Disability
brief_description: The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana launched by the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 37Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state.
1. The applicant must work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years.

> **Note:**



- Applicant&#39;s age will be calculated as of the 1st of July of any year.
- **Permanent Partial Disability:** Permanent partial disability means that one eye or one leg becomes useless due to an accident. Apart from thisRs. one eye/ one leg becomes useless due to paralysis.

name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries
brief_description: The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana launched by the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 5Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state.
1. The applicant must work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years.

> **Note****:**



- Applicant&#39;s age will be calculated as of the 1st of July of the year.

name: Post Matric College Scholarship (Scheduled Caste)
brief_description: Launched in 1976-77Rs. the "Post Matric College Scholarship" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance to encourage Scheduled Caste students to pursue higher education. One-third of the subsistence allowance is payable to students residing in departmental hostels who are provided free lodging and boarding facilities.
benefits: Post-matric students are provided with scholarships.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The student must come from a family with an income limit of up to 6.00 lakh to qualify.
**Note:** One-third of the subsistence allowance will be payable to students residing in departmental hostels who are provided with free lodging/boarding facilities.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Pension
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Pension by the Labour DepartmentRs. is designed to support unorganized transport workers upon retirement. Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of 1500/-Rs. which increases by 10/- for each year of enrolment beyond 5 yearsRs. provided they have been continuously enrolled in the scheme for at least 5 years. This initiative aims to ensure financial stability and dignity for transport workers during their retirement years.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 1Rs./- per month for beneficiaries aged 60 and above. - **Incremental Benefit:** Additional 10/- per month for every completed year of enrolment beyond five years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses. 1. The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. 1. The applicant must have been continuously enrolled in the scheme for at least 5 years to qualify for pension benefits.

name: Phool Vikash Yojana
brief_description: The Phool Vikash Yojana launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aims to support farmers in 15 districts of the state by offering financial assistance for marigold flower cultivation. The scheme provides a 50% subsidy for up to 4 hectares.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% subsidy on 80Rs./- per hectare for marigold cultivation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha). 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal Agriculture Department. > **Note 1:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form. > **Note 2:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Employability Excellence with College Education & Learning (EXCEL)
brief_description: The Employability Excellence with College Education & Learning (EXCEL) is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojna launched by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training and Skill DevelopmentRs. Jharkhand. It integrates skill training with traditional education programs in colleges to improve employability. The program focuses on life skillsRs. spoken EnglishRs. computer skillsRs. and domain-specific trainingRs. benefitting students with industry-aligned capabilities.
benefits:
1. Provides training alongside traditional education in college campuses.
1. Enhances employability through life skillsRs. communicationRs. and domain-specific training.
1. Free-of-cost training conducted within existing college infrastructure.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student must have completed their 12th education.
1. Open to university studentsRs. former pass-outsRs. and non-college-going youth from the community are eligibile.

name: Makhana Beej Vitaran
brief_description: Makhana Beej Vitaran launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aims to enhance Makhana cultivation and increase farmers' earnings. Under this schemeRs. improved seed varieties such as Swarn Vaidehi and Sabour Makhana-1Rs. developed by Bihar Agricultural UniversityRs. are distributed to farmers in 11 districts of Bihar. The scheme is to be implemented in 10 districts of the state under Schedule 1Rs. 2 and 3 of the approval orderRs. namelyRs. KatiharRs. PurniaRs. DarbhangaRs. MadhubaniRs. KishanganjRs. SupaulRs. ArariaRs. MadhepuraRs. Saharsa and Khagaria.
benefits: - **Subsidized Seeds:** Seeds of recommended varieties will be made available to farmers at the rate of 30 Kg/Ha. - **For Swarn Vaidehi variety:** 4Rs./- will be given as a subsidy (75%). - **For Sabour Makhana-1 variety:** 5Rs..50/- will be given as a subsidy (75%).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to any of the following districts of Bihar: KatiharRs. PurniaRs. MadhubaniRs. KishanganjRs. SupaulRs. ArariaRs. MadhepuraRs. SaharsaRs. DarbhangaRs. Sitamarhi and Khagaria. 1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha). 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
> **Note 1****: Beneficiary allocation:** Women Participation: 30%. > **Note 2:****** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form. > **Note 3:****** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Chai Vikas Yojana
brief_description: Chai Vikas Yojana launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aimed at fostering the tea industry in Bihar by expanding tea plantations in selected districtsRs. namely in KishanganjRs. ArariaRs. SupaulRs. Purnia and Katihar. Under this schemeRs. farmers will independently purchase planting materialsRs. and a subsidy will be provided in two installments based on a 75:25 cost-sharing model for purchasing various horticultural machinesRs. such as pruning machinesRs. mechanical harvestersRs. plucking shearsRs. leaf carriage vehiclesRs. and leaf collection sheds.
benefits:
> **Subsidy on Planting Materials:**





- 75% subsidy in the first yearRs. with 25% provided in the second year if plant survival reaches 90%.




> **Subsidy on Machines:**





- Pruning Machine: 50% of the cost or 60Rs./- (whichever is less) (Minimum Land Area: 2 acres).
- Mechanical Harvester: 50% of the cost or 50Rs./- (whichever is less) (Minimum Land Area: 2 acres).
- Plucking Shears: 50% of the cost or 1Rs./- (maximum of 20 shears) (Minimum Land Area: 2 acres).
- Leaf Carriage Vehicle: 50% of the cost or 7Rs./- (whichever is less) (Minimum Land Area: 10 acres).
- Leaf Collection Shed: 50% of the cost or 37Rs./- (whichever is less) (Minimum Land Area: 5 acres).




> **Note :**





- Women Beneficiary allocation: 30%.
- Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should belong to any of the following districts of Bihar : KishanganjRs. ArariaRs. SupaulRs. Purnia and Katihar.
1. The applicant must have a minimum land area of 2 acres.
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

name: Incentive For The Simple Marriage (Scheduled Tribe)
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive for the Simple Marriage" was launched by the Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Karnataka. The scheme provides an incentive of 50Rs./- to ST individuals residing in Karnataka who marry another ST individual on or after 11th August 2015. The scheme aims to reduce expensesRs. prevent dowryRs. and promote a more accepting society. The combined income of the couple should be less than 2Rs./-.
benefits: An incentive of 50Rs./- is provided to the married couple.
eligibility:
1. The couple should be residing in Karnataka.
1. Both partners should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The combined annual income of the couple should be less than 2Rs./-.
1. The application should be submitted within one year of marriage.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 11th August 2015.

name: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
brief_description: Launched in 2014Rs. the " Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site" is a welfare initiative by the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides funeral assistance of 3Rs. and ex-gratia payments in the event of death or permanent disability of unregistered laborers during construction work. It supports construction workers in the unorganized sector who are not registered under the Board and lack a valid identity card.
benefits:
1. **Funeral Assistance:** 3Rs. payable in case of death of a construction laborer.1. **Grace Amount:**


- Death due to an accident during construction work: 4Rs./-.
- Permanent disability due to an accident during construction work: 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The deceased construction worker should have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB).
1. The deceased construction worker should have held an active regular membership.
1. The only person who is a legal heir/dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The deceased worker should have valid identity card.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Kela Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
The Kela Vikas Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar.
This component promotes plantain cultivation across 15 districts in Bihar by providing financial assistance and quality tissue-cultured plants. It ensures inclusivity with reserved quotas for SCRs. STRs. and women beneficiaries. Payments are processed through DBTRs. and both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme.
benefits: > **Financial Support:** - **First year:** 46Rs./- per hectare. - **Second year:** 15Rs./- per hectare. > **Plant Distribution:** - Supply of high-quality tissue-cultured plants.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Papita Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The Papita Vikas Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar. This component promotes papaya cultivation across all districts in Bihar by providing financial assistance and high-quality plants. It ensures inclusivity with reserved quotas for SCRs. STRs. and women beneficiaries. Payments are processed through DBTRs. and both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme.
benefits:
> **Financial Support:**

name: Post Matric Students of Class 11th &12th ( Scheduled Caste)
brief_description: Launched in 1976-77Rs. the "Post Matric Students of Class 11th & 12th" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides reimbursement of scholarship fees to students in Class 11th and 12th. It aims to encourage students from the Scheduled Caste category in the field of education and provide them with financial assistance.
benefits: The facility of reimbursement of scholarship fee is provided to the students of class 11th and 12th.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The student should be enrolled in Class 11th or 12th in a recognized educational institution.
1. The student should provide a valid income certificate of the familyRs. confirming that the annual income is below the prescribed limit.
1. The guardian should provide a declaration stating that there has been no increase in the family income for the last financial year.

name: Sant Ravi Das Swarojgaar Yojana
brief_description: The Sant Ravi Das Swarojgaar Yojana under the Tribal Welfare and SC DepartmentRs. Madhya PradeshRs. provides funding for manufacturing units (1 lakh to 50 lakh) and service/retail trade projects (1 lakh to 25 lakh) for Scheduled Caste applicants. Scheduled Caste beneficiaries can receive a 5% annual interest subsidy on Term and Working Capital Loans for up to 7 yearsRs. including the moratorium period. Beneficiaries can also avail a 12-day entrepreneurship development training through an online training module.
benefits: 1. Scheduled Caste beneficiaries can receive a 5% annual interest subsidy on Term and Working Capital Loans for up to 7 yearsRs. including the moratorium period. 1. The subsidy is provided on the condition of regular loan repayment as per the prescribed schedule.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age. 1. The applicant should be belong to Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant should have a minimum educational qualification of 12th class passed. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 12.00 lakhs. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institutionRs. including MFIRs. NBFCRs. SFBRs. or PACS. 1. The applicant should not currently be a beneficiary of any other self-employment scheme of the state or central government. 1. Family Definition: - If unmarried: The applicant and dependent parents. - If married: The applicantRs. spouseRs. and dependent children (no age bar for dependentRs. unmarried children).

name: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority and Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to enhance the participation of Scheduled Caste students in education by providing financial support. It focuses on students from Class 1st to 10th who are studying in state government schools in Jharkhand. The scheme intends to reduce dropout rates and ensure equal education opportunities.
benefits:
> **Financial assistance to cover educational expenses:** **S.NO****Class****Rate for Hostel (For 10 months)****Rate for Daylight (For 10 months)**11st to 5th1Rs./-1Rs./-26th to 8th2Rs./-2Rs./-39th to 10th4Rs./-4Rs./-
**NOTE:** - Direct transfer of scholarships to beneficiaries bank accounts via PFMS. - Residential students receive higher scholarship amounts compared to non-residential students. - Class 9th and 10th scholarships are funded jointly by the state (40%) and central (60%) governments.

name: Aahar Anudan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Aahar Anudan Yojana" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides monthly assistance of 1Rs. to studentsRs. girlsRs. and women from backward tribes like BaigaRs. BhariaRs. and Saharia. The scheme aims to combat malnutrition among special tribal families in the state by ensuring access to nutritious food through financial assistance.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The applicant should be from the BaigaRs. Bharia or Saharia tribe.
1. The applicant or any member of the applicant's family should not be in government service.
1. The applicant or any member of the applicant's family should not be an income tax payee.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority & Backward Class WelfareRs. Govt. of JharkhandRs. aims to promote the socialRs. economicRs. educationalRs. and health development of Scheduled Tribe communities in tribal-dominated villages. Under this schemeRs. benefits such as financial grantsRs. equipmentRs. training programsRs. & healthcare services are provided to the tribal population to ensure their holistic development.
benefits:
1. Financial support of 1Rs./- to women self-help groups (SHGs) in selected villages as a grant.
1. Assistance of up to 2Rs./- for self-employment or equipment for unemployed educated youth.
1. Organization of regular health camps focusing on diseases like malariaRs. sickle cell anemiaRs. and other chronic illnesses.
1. Support for tribal-specific economic activitiesRs. including purchasing lac and minor forest produce at minimum support prices.
1. Training programs for women SHGs and unemployed youth through selected NGOs and professional institutions.
1. Provision of forward marketing linkage to enhance economic activities.

eligibility:
**Eligibility For SHGs:** 1. The group must be selected by the Gram Sabha. 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicants village should have at least 80% tribal population. 1. The village should be included in the list of selected villages under the scheme.
**Eligibility For youth self-employment:** 1. The applicant should be an unemployed educated youth. 1. The applicant must have passed at least 10th grade. 1. Priority will be given to those with vocational training. 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicants village should have at least 80% tribal population. 1. The village should be included in the list of selected villages under the scheme.

name: Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana
brief_description: The "Birsa Awas Nirman Yojana" was launched by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority & Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of JharkhandRs. and aims to provide durable housing for the economically weaker Scheduled Tribes (ST) with a focus on timely constructionRs. monitoringRs. and quality management. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is disbursed in three installments to beneficiariesRs. with an additional 500/- incentive per unit provided to Panchayat Volunteers or Self-Help Groups (SHGs) for overseeing construction milestones.
benefits:
> **Financial Support: Beneficiaries receive 1Rs./- for constructing houses under the scheme:** 1. First Installment: 40Rs./- upon approval of the house. 1. Second Installment: 75Rs./- after window sealing. 1. Third Installment: 16Rs./- upon completing the houseRs. including painting.
> **Incentives for Monitoring: Panchayat Volunteers or SHGs receive 500 per house in phases:** 1. 100/- after plinth completion. 1. 100/- after lintel level completion. 1. 100/- after roofing completion. 1. 200/- after full house completion.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe community in Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must fall under the economically weaker section.
1. Only individuals residing in rural areas are eligible.

name: Kisan Suryoday Yojana (KSY)
brief_description: The "Kisan Suryoday Yojana (KSY)" was launched by the Energy and Petro Chemicals DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. in 2020-2021 with the goal of providing daytime electricity to farmers for agricultural activities. This innovative scheme aims to address the power demands of farmers by supplying electricity from 5:00 am to 9:00 pm. By maximizing the use of solar and non-conventional energy sourcesRs. the scheme ensures a reliable and eco-friendly power supply. The KSY is being implemented in phasesRs. aligned with the operationalization of solar and alternative energy generation plants.
benefits: - **Daytime Electricity Supply:** Ensures uninterrupted electricity for agricultural activities during the day from 5:00 am to 9:00 pm. - **Sustainable Energy:** Promotes the use of solar and non-conventional energy sourcesRs. reducing dependency on conventional power.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a farmer or engaged in agricultural activities.

name: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2010Rs. the "M.P. Professional Talent Test Award Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to recognize and reward backward-class students who excel in professional entrance examinations. Through this schemeRs. monetary awards are provided to backward-class students who secure the top three positions in entrance examinations like PETRs. PPTRs. and MCA conducted by the Professional Examination Board. The scheme is implemented by the Assistant DirectorRs. Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare.
benefits:
**Prize Money**

- Second Position: 50Rs./-
- Third Position: 25Rs./-

- The applicant should be pursuing technical and vocational subjects.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Udyami YojanaRs. launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals from all categories in the state. The remaining 50% (up to 5Rs./-) is offered as an interest-free loanRs. with a nominal 1% interest under specific sub-schemes.) - **Skill Development:** Mandatory training sessions are provided to enhance entrepreneurial skills.

name: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2009Rs. the "Backward Classes Student Merit Award Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to recognize and reward academic excellence among backward class students. Through this schemeRs. monetary awards are provided to one boy and one girl student from backward classes who secure the highest marks at the district level in class 10th and 12th board examinations. name: Jharkhand Sportsperson Pension Scheme
brief_description: The Jharkhand Sportsperson Pension Scheme was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth AffairsRs. Government of Jharkhand. aims to provide financial support to retired athletes for their lifelong contribution to sports. AthletesRs. including ArjunaRs. DronacharyaRs. and Dhyan Chand awardeesRs. Olympic participantsRs. and Commonwealth or Asian Games medalistsRs. receive a monthly pension.

name: Construction of Godown for Grain Storage
brief_description: Launched on 24th December 2013Rs. the scheme "Construction of Warehouse for Grain Storage" by the Panchayat and Rural Development DepartmentRs. name: Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana

BiharRs. aims to support landless beneficiaries listed under the Pradhan Mantri Awas YojanaRural (PMAY-G). name: Advanced Animal Breeding Scheme (Supply of Breedable Pedigree Murrah Bull on Subsidy)

name: Scheduled Tribe Relief Scheme

name: Doodh Sanjivani Scheme

name: Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana

name: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana Jharkhand

Government of JharkhandRs. aims to promote solar energy-powered irrigation systems to reduce dependency on fossil fuels and lower agricultural costs. name: Admission in Post Matric Hostel

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Net SGST reimbursement to Micro, Small and Medium Manufacturing Enterprise (MSMEs):
brief_description:

The component "Net SGST reimbursement to MicroRs. Small and Medium Manufacturing Enterprise (MSMEs)" provides reimbursement of net SGST based on the taluka category of the project.
benefits:
**Category of Taluka** **Quantum of Incentive** Category 1100% of net SGST for 10 years upto 7.5% of eFCl p.a. Category 2 90% of net SGST for 10 years upto 6.5% of eFCl p.a. Category 3 & Municipal Corporation Areas80% of net SGST for 10 years upto 5% of eFCI p.a.

name: Nursing Kaushal College Jharkhand

name: Rearing Pond Construction Scheme
