- Second installment: 2Rs. after three feet of excavation.
- Remaining funds after full excavation and dressing verification.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a fisherman.
1. The applicant whose proposed land is near their residenceRs. consisting of oneRs. twoRs. or three plots of "don" land.
1. The applicant should be engaged in fish farming or have constructed a fish seed hatchery with a departmental subsidy.
1. The land proposed for pond construction must be undisputed. At least 130 decimals of land are required for a 100 decimal water area. For larger pondsRs. the ratio of water area to total land should be at least 1:1.3.
1. The proposed land must not be mortgaged against any bank loan.
1. The applicant must have valid possession of the proposed land and provide the necessary documentation.
1. The applicant should be financially capable of contributing their share of the pond construction costs.

name: INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Rural)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to disburse monthly pensions to the individuals 18 years or above in age and having a disability of 40% or above. To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of the districtRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible individuals on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible citizensRs. in the presence of SarpanchRs. Gram Panchayat Members and the Office Bearers of Village Organization.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be a local resident of the district.
- The applicant should be from a rural area.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
- The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.
- The applicant should be 18 years or above in age.

_* The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Panchayat Secretary with the Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO)._

name: Female Child Birth Gift Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Female Child Birth Gift SchemeRs." introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB)Rs. aims to provide financial support for the birth of daughters to registered beneficiaries. Under this schemeRs. the Board offers an amount of 51Rs./- (fifty-one thousand) for each of two daughtersRs. deposited in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR). This financial aid can only be withdrawn once the daughter turns 18Rs. promoting long-term financial security for the girl child.
benefits: Financial support of 51Rs./- per daughter (up to two)
eligibility:
***For Registration as a Building/Construction Worker:*** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building or Construction Worker. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration must be renewed annually.
***Eligibility Criteria for Female Child Birth Gift Scheme:*** 1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application. 1. The worker should have at least a two-month subscription to the Welfare Board. **Notes:** The benefit is applicable for the birth of up to two daughters of the registered worker.

name: Paddy Procurement Scheme Jharkhand
brief_description: The "Paddy Procurement Scheme 2012-13" by the FoodRs. Public DistributionRs. and Consumer Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to procure paddy from farmers at the Minimum Support Price (MSP) to ensure fair compensation and food security. Through this schemeRs. farmers receive direct procurement services at predetermined MSP ratesRs. minimizing exploitation by middlemen and ensuring timely payments.
benefits:
- MSP is set at 1250/- per quintal for the "Common" grade. - MSP is set at 1280/- per quintal for "Grade A" paddy.
**NOTE:** - Direct procurement of paddy from farmers at MSP. - Payment is made directly to farmers through designated agencies.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand state. 1. The applicant must be a registered farmer. 1. The applicant must cultivate paddy in the Kharif season of 2012-13. 1. The applicant must possess a valid landholding certificate or proof of cultivation. 1. Farmers associated with Primary Agriculture Credit Societies (PACS) and Large Area Multipurpose Cooperative Societies (LAMPS) are eligible.
**NOTE:** Preference is given to small and marginal farmers.

name: Compensation Amount Towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals
brief_description: Launched on 6th February 2024Rs. the scheme "Compensation Amount towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals" by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides compensation in case of death of cattle due to attacks by wild animals. The cattle owner will receive a relief amount. The nearest forest officer must be informed in writing or verbally within 48 hours of the incidentRs. and the dead cattle should not be removed from the place of death.
benefits:
- 1Rs./- as immediate assistance for wild animal injury.
- 30Rs./- for medical expenses (normal injury).
- 1Rs./- for permanent disability and full treatment cost.
eligibility:
1. The cattle of the owner should have been injured by a wild animalRs. as defined under the Wild Life (Protection) ActRs. 1972.
1. The cattle owner should have reported the incident to the nearest forest officer within 48 hours of its occurrence.
1. The cattle owner should be able to provide necessary proof or verification documents as required by the Forest Department.
1. The compensation applies only to cattle owners who are residents of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Kharmore Sonchidia Award Scheme
brief_description: In the scheme "Kharmore Sonchidia Award" by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. the farmers are rewarded with 5Rs./- if a Kharmor bird is sighted in the private land of the farmer and 10Rs./- if a Golden bird is sighted in the private land of the farmer. The farmers are rewarded provided they ensure the protection of the birdsRs. their eggsRs. and their habitat on their private land.
benefits:
**Reward of 5Rs./- on Sighting of Kharmor Bird**

- Installment 1: 1Rs./- if sighted in July-August
- Installment 2: 4Rs./- if sighted in the same area in September-October

**Reward of 10Rs./- on Sighting of Golden Bird**

- Installment 1: 2Rs./- for the first sighting
- Installment 2: 8Rs./- if sighted again in the same area
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer or landowner.
1. The applicant should own private land.
1. Either Kharmor Bird or Golden Bird should have been sighted on the applicants land.
1. The applicant should have ensured the protection of the birdsRs. their eggsRs. and their habitat without causing harm.

name: Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme
brief_description: The "Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme" implemented by the WomenRs. Child Development & Social Security DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to promote better hygiene practices and health awareness among women and adolescent girls. Under this schemeRs. free sanitary pads are provided quarterly to women aged 2040 yearsRs. enhancing their health and hygiene standards while reducing the risk of diseases.
benefits:
***Free Sanitary Pads Distribution:***

- Beneficiaries receive 3 packs (each containing 6 sanitary pads) every quarter.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a women.
1. The applicant age should be between 2040 years.
1. The applicant or her dependent must not be:


- Permanently employed in central/state government or public sector enterprises.
- Retired government employees or pension recipients.
- An income tax payer.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh Identity Card for Transgender
brief_description: The scheme "Transgender Utthan Kosh Identity Card for Transgender" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. with the aim of identifying transgender persons and issuing identity cards to them. This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposesRs. including obtaining a ration cardRs. Aadhaar cardRs. birth certificateRs. etc. For the issuance of identity cardsRs. NGOs can generate ID cards through the online portalRs. for which they will receive an honorarium per ID card. If a transgender person applies for the ID card independently through the online portalRs. they can receive the payment directly into their account upon presenting their own card.
benefits:
- Issuance of identification cards to recognized transgender individuals.
- Transgender person applies for an ID card themselvesRs. the payment will be made to their account upon presentation of the ID card.
- This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposes like ration cardRs. Aadhaar card and birth certificate etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must belong to the transgender community.

name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Widower
brief_description:
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme: For Widower" is implemented by the Social JusticeRs. EmpowermentRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes and Antyodaya (SEWA) DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme came into effect on 1st JulyRs. 2023Rs. with the aim of providing Social Security to Widowers who are unable to sustain themselves from their own sources and are in need of financial assistance from the State.
Under this schemeRs. a monthly financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to a widower who has attained the age of 40 years and has a verified annual income of up to 3.00 lakh. A person who is a divorcee or in a live-in relationship shall not be eligible for financial assistance under the scheme.
benefits:
1. The scheme provides monthly financial assistance of 2750 to eligible beneficiaries.
1. The financial assistance will continue until the beneficiary turns 60 years old.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The financial assistance is disbursed through the Public Finance Management System (PFMS) directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

**Note:** The Bank will not permit the beneficiary to withdraw the benefits from outside the district in which he is registered.
**Frequency of Disbursement:**

- The assistance is provided on a monthly basis.

**Expected Time of Disbursement:**

- The beneficiary list is updated monthlyRs. and payments are processed accordingly.

> **Validity:**

> The assistance continues until the beneficiary turns 60 years oldRs. after which they may transition to the Old Age Samman Allowance Scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana or have been residing in the state for at least the last 15 years.
1. The applicant should be a widower.
1. The applicant should have attained the age of 40 years.
1. The applicant's verified annual income should be up to 3Rs./-.
1. The applicant should possess a Family IDRs. as verification is based on data from the Haryana Parivar Pehchaan Authority (HPPA).

**Other terms and Conditions:**

1. Any benefits received under the SchemeRs. by suppressing true information or making wrong claim or the condition for which the pension was granted no longer exists or the beneficiary got married after the grant of benefitRs. would be recovered as arrears of land revenue with @12% interest per annum.
1. Financial Assistance shall cease to be payable on the death of a beneficiary. HoweverRs. the amount of assistance will be paid for full month in which death of the beneficiary occurs (any date of the month) to the nominee.
1. Financial Assistance under this scheme shall not be liable to attachment under any court of law.
1. If a person is detected of having more than one bank account under the PFMSRs. all his bank accounts will be terminated. He would become ineligible to receive benefits under any Social Security Scheme of the State in future.

name: Pashudhan Mitra Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 20th June 2013Rs. the scheme "Pashudhan Mitra Scheme" is a livelihood and service-based scheme by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to expand veterinary and animal breeding facilities while ensuring efficient service delivery and a strengthened information system through Gausevaks and private artificial insemination workers. It also provides an incentive honorarium to Pashudhan Mitras (working cow-helpers and private artificial insemination workers) to support their livelihood and sustain their interest in the work.
benefits:
- **Castration Work:** 20/- per calf (cow/buffalo) brought to the institution.- **Participation in Medical Camps & Exhibitions:** 400/- per event for assisting in medical campsRs. cattle fairsRs. and exhibitions under official supervision.- **Vaccination Work (Per Animal):**
- Bovine/Pig: 7/-
- Goat/Sheep/Dog: 5/-
- Poultry: 1/-
- **Integrated Sample Survey Work:**
- 1Rs./- per village per season (four-month work period).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should have experience in animal husbandry or artificial insemination.
1. The applicant should be physically fit for fieldwork.
1. The applicant should possess basic knowledge of vaccination and castration procedures.

name: Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme
brief_description: The "Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. with the objective of providing financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. In the first phaseRs. six students will benefit annually from the scheme. Under this schemeRs. selected students will receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjectsRs. including SociologyRs. Public AdministrationRs. LawRs. EconomicsRs. Political ScienceRs. and Anthropology.
benefits:
***Financial Assistance:***

- Selected Ph.D. candidates receive a monthly fellowship of 15Rs. for up to three years.

***Mode of Disbursement:***

- The fellowship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account by cheque or DD.

**Duration*****:***

- The fellowship continues for a maximum duration of 3 yearsRs. subject to satisfactory academic progress.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks.
1. The applicant should be below 35 years of age at the time of application.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 2Rs./- from all sources.
1. Priority is given to candidates enrolled in central or state government universities in Rajasthan.
1. A maximum of two children from a single family (parents/guardians) can apply under the scheme.
1. The applicant should have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Rajasthan in one of the following subjects:


- Sociology
- Public Administration
- Law
- Economics
- Political Science
- Anthropology

***Other terms & conditions:***

1. The selected candidate will have to submit a certificate regarding admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute in which he/she is pursuing Ph.D.
1. Candidates selected for Ph.D. will have to submit certificate regarding attendance as prescribed by University Grants Commission (UGC).
1. Every year a progress report of the research work done by the student will be submitted to the department and after completion of the research work a copy will be made available to the department also.
1. In case the amount received as fellowship is misused by the studentRs. the amount paid along with 10% interest will be recovered from the concerned student. The student will have to submit an undertaking to this effect on a non-judicial stamp of 100/-.

name: Devnarayan Chhatra Cycle Scheme
brief_description: The "Devnarayan Chhatra Cycle Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to promote education and mobility among girls belonging to the Special Backward Classes (SBC) or specific communities such as BanjaraRs. BaldiaRs. LabanaRs. Gadiya-LoharRs. GadoliaRs. GujarRs. GurjarRs. RaikoRs. Rebari (Debasi)Rs. and Gadaria (GadriRs. Gyari). Under this schemeRs. free bicycles are provided to girl students studying in 9th Class in government schools of Rajasthan.
benefits: - Free distribution of cycles to girl students**.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in class 9th in a government school of Rajasthan.1. The applicant must belong to one of the following Special Backward Class (SBC) communities:


- BanjaraRs. BaldiaRs. Labana
- Gadiya LoharRs. Gadolia
- GujarRs. Gurjar
- RaikaRs. Rebari (Debasi)
- Gadaria (GadriRs. Gyari)

name: Haryana State Merit Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Haryana State Merit Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Haryana Education DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to pursue higher education.
The objective of this scheme is to award Merit-cum-Poverty Scholarships to talented students from economically backward classes pursuing General University Education for DegreeRs. Post-GraduateRs. and Doctorate courses. Students who pass the specified Public Examination from Punjab UniversityRs. Kurukshetra UniversityRs. or any other examining body notified by the awarding authority are eligible to apply under this scheme. AdditionallyRs. the students whose parents/guardians are the citizens of India and are domiciled in the Haryana State are eligible to apply.
benefits:
**Name of the Examination based on which Scholarships are Awarded & Scholarship Rates:**
**Course Name****Rate of Scholarship****Duration**Metric150/-year in Prep/ Hr.Sec. II10+2300/-Minimum tenure is 3 academic years for B.A./B.Sc./B.Com./ B.Sc. Home Science Course (including Hon's) School Course.Degree Level450/-Maximum tenure two academic years for M.A./M.Sc.Hons./M.Sc. /M. Com./ M.Sc./ Home Science Course. Maximum tenue one academic year for B.T./B.Ed. Course.B.Ed. / M.Phil / Ph.D.900/-One Scholarship is Tenable at Jawahar Lal Nehru UniversityRs. New Delhi for full duration of M.Phil./Ph.D. Course Minimum three years.**Note:** For the students of integrated courses after 10+2 e.g. M.B.A./M.C.A./B.A.L.L.B./ B.Com. L.L.B./B.B.A.L.L.B./M.F.A. etc.Rs. the scholarship amount for initial three years will be amount fixed for UG course and for remaining period (i.e. 01Rs. 12 Rs. 2 years as the case may be) will be amount fixed for PG course.
> **Note:**

> **Conditions for Receiving Benefits:**

> The applicant must maintain satisfactory academic performance.

> The applicant must comply with the institutions discipline and attendance requirements.

> **Mode of Disbursement:**

> Scholarships are directly transferred to the beneficiarys bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

> **Frequency of Disbursement:**

> The scholarship is disbursed on a monthly basis for the entire academic year (12 months).

> **Validity:**

> The scholarship remains valid for the full duration of the academic programRs. provided the student meets the required academic and conduct standards.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a citizen of India and a domiciled resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must have passed the qualifying examination from PunjabRs. Kurukshetra UniversityRs. or any other recognized examining body.
1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized course in a higher education institution in Haryana or Chandigarh.
1. The applicant must have obtained at least a Second Division in the qualifying examination.
1. For Rural Area Merit ScholarshipsRs. the applicant must have secured at least 40% marks in Matric/Higher Secondary (Final)/Pre-University Examinations.
1. The applicant must not be receiving any other merit-based scholarshipRs. except for need-based scholarships from specific welfare boards.

> **Note:**

> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:**


1. One Ph.D./M.Phil. scholarship is exclusively tenable at Jawaharlal Nehru UniversityRs. New Delhi.
1. Rural Area Merit Scholarships are limited to students whose parents permanently reside and earn their livelihood in rural areas.

name: Scheme for Relief and Rehabilitation of Women Acid Victims
brief_description:
The scheme "Relief and Rehabilitation of Women Acid Victims" was launched by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. It aims to provide financial and medical assistance to acid attack victims who are residents of Haryana and have suffered attacks within the state.
Under the schemeRs. the victim is entitled to receive 100% free medical treatment from government or government-approved hospitals. AdditionallyRs. an ad-hoc relief of 1.00 lakh is provided to the acid attack victimRs. which is later reimbursed by the Women and Child Development Department.
benefits:
Under the schemeRs. the following benefits will be provided to women acid attack victims:

1. 25Rs./- as ad-hoc relief immediately by the concerned Deputy Commissioner.
1. 75Rs./- within 15 days by the Women and Child Development Department for immediate medical expenses.
1. Finance Support for 100% medical treatment including medicineRs. foodRs. bedding and plastic surgery/reconstructive surgeryRs. if any from amongst any of the Government Hospital/Government approved hospitals.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an acid attack victim girl/woman.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be a victim of an acid attack occurring on or after 02.05.2011.
1. The applicant should have suffered an acid attack within Haryana.
1. The applicant should not have been fully cured or completed all medical proceduresRs. as continuing treatment is covered under the scheme.

> **RTS Time Limit:**

> This scheme's RTS (Right to Service) time limit is 30 days.

name: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Swaraozgar Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Swaraozgar Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 5Rs./- will be made available as a loan to specially-abled individuals in the state whose annual incomeRs. including that of their familyRs. is up to 2Rs./-Rs. to help them start their own self-employment. A grant of 50% of the loan amount or a maximum of 50Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided.
***Self-Employment/Business Activities:***
STD/PCOsRs. Electric Motor (Sales and Service)Rs. Auto Parts ShopRs. Gold/Silver Jewelry MakingRs. Gold/Silver Plating WorkRs. Building Material ShopRs. Dhaba/RestaurantRs. Utensil ShopRs. Bicycle SalesRs. RepairRs. and RentalRs. Tailoring ShopRs. Artificial Jewelry ShopRs. Grocery/Betel/Fruit-Flower/Vegetable ShopRs. FertilizerRs. SeedRs. MedicineRs. Agricultural Equipment ShopRs. Tent HouseRs. Dry Clean/Washing ShopRs. BakeryRs. BookRs. Stationery ShopRs. Electrical Goods ShopRs. ShoeRs. Slipper Making and SalesRs. Cloth Dyeing and PrintingRs. Typing and Electronic TypingRs. Computer InstituteRs. Beauty ParlorRs. Readymade GarmentsRs. Mobile Computer RepairingRs. Steel FurnitureRs. Flour MillRs. ComputerRs. Xerox Machine CenterRs. Soft Toys MakingRs. Animal HusbandryRs. Spray PaintingRs. Offset PrintingRs. Mobile Repair and SalesRs. Hardware ComputerRs. Embroidery WorkRs. Steel FabricationRs. Fine ArtRs. Screen PrintingRs. Two-Wheeler Vehicle ServiceRs. Car Servicing and WashingRs. Cloth Matching Center (Ladies)Rs. Water Purifier Sales/ServiceRs. E-MitraRs. Readymade GarmentsRs. Book BindingRs. TV RepairRs. Electronics (Home Appliances)Rs. Interior DecorationRs. Crafts WorkRs. Dairy WorkRs. Poultry FarmingRs. Turner WorkRs. Fitter WorkRs. Machinist WorkRs. C and Fridge RepairingRs. Gem Cutting and PolishingRs. UPS/Inverter Sales and ServiceRs. Transformer WindingRs. DTP/Printing MachineRs. Other businesses as suggested from time to time by the Disabled Vocational Rehabilitation CenterRs. Jaipur.
benefits:
***Financial Assistance***

- Loan up to 5Rs./- for starting self-employment.
- Subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or a maximum of 50Rs. whichever is lower.

**NOTE:** The loan is provided as one-time financial support.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a specially-abled person as per the Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 1995.
- The applicant should have a minimum disability of 40% or more.
- The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age.
- The annual income of the applicants family should not exceed 2Rs./- from all sources.
- The applicant should not have availed of benefits under any other self-employment subsidy scheme like "Kiyosk Yojana" etc.
- The applicant should not have any overdue loans from banksRs. cooperative societiesRs. or government institutions.
- The applicant should possess a valid disability certificate and passbook.

name: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection
brief_description: The scheme "Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial aid to farmers to install wire fencingRs. helping prevent damage to crops from wild and stray animals. This initiative ensures minimal agricultural produce wastage and supports sustainable farming practices.
benefits: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Wire FencingPer Running Meter 200/- or 50% of the actual expenditure incurredRs. whichever is less Once in lifetime
eligibility: The applicant must be a landholding farmer or a farmer group The applicant must have a minimum of 2 hectares (ha) of land in a cluster. > **Note:** - Only one of the holders mentioned in 8-A land records per account is eligible for benefits with the consent of other holders. - A farmer is eligible for assistance for a maximum of one account.

name: Assistance to Farmers to Purchase Heavy Farm Equipment (Tractor)
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Farmers to Purchase Heavy Farm Equipment (Tractor)" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support farmers by offering subsidies for the purchase of tractors. It ensures that modern agricultural equipment reaches farmersRs. enhancing productivity and efficiency.
benefits:
- **Subsidy Assistance:** 25% of the cost for:

1. Models up to 40 PTO HP (Max 45Rs./-).
1. Models above 40 PTO HP and up to 60 PTO HP (Max 60Rs./-).

> **Note:**


- Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: 10 years.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a landholding farmer.
- The applicant should belong to the Gujarat state.


- The applicant must purchase the Tractor from an [authorized dealer](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_DealerDetails.aspx).
> **Note:**


- Beneficiary farmers can receive the benefit of one tractor component per land record (8 A).
- Among the holders of a land record mentioned in 8-ARs. if there is more than one farmerRs. only one of these farmers will get benefits.
- If a farmer holds multiple land records or has a name in multiple land recordsRs. the benefits will be availed by the farmer on a single land record only.
- The benefits are available once every 10 years per land record.

name: Grant of Financial Incentives for Hotels, Resorts, and Tourism Projects
brief_description: Launched in 2004Rs. the scheme "Grant of Financial Incentives for HotelsRs. ResortsRs. and Tourism Projects" by the Department of Industrial Development (Tourism)Rs. Government of PuducherryRs. aims to encourage private entrepreneurs in the field of tourism by providing financial incentives for the development of hotelsRs. resortsRs. heritage hotelsRs. and other tourism-related projects. The scheme offers capital grants and subsidies to eligible projectsRs. including star-classified hotelsRs. heritage hotelsRs. and tourism infrastructure like water theme parksRs. amusement parksRs. and convention centers. Eligible applicants include those who have financially invested in and developed tourism projectsRs. with incentives ranging from 2Rs./- per room for one-star hotels to 25% of the capital investment (up to 1Rs./-) for higher-category projects. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Industrial Development (Tourism)Rs. Government of Puducherry.
benefits:
> **Capital Grant for Star-Classified Hotels**


- 2Rs./- per roomRs. subject to a maximum of 30Rs./- for one-star hotels.
- 3Rs./- per roomRs. subject to a maximum of 75Rs./- for two-star hotels.
- 3Rs./- per roomRs. subject to a maximum of 1Rs./- for three-star hotels.

> **Capital Grant for Heritage Hotels**


- 3Rs./- per roomRs. subject to a maximum of 75Rs./-.
- The building must be listed in the current list of heritage buildings in Puducherry and conform to architectural and conservation guidelines.

> **Capital Subsidy for Higher-Category Projects**


- 25% of the capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum of 1Rs./- for hotels/resorts with more than three-star classification and other tourism projects like water theme parksRs. amusement parksRs. yacht marinasRs. family entertainment centersRs. convention centersRs. and cruise tourism.

> **Service Apartments**


- 1Rs./- per apartmentRs. subject to a maximum of 6Rs./- for 'Silver' category.
- 2Rs./- per apartmentRs. subject to a maximum of 12Rs./- for 'Gold' or higher category.

> **Mode of Disbursement**

The incentive is directly released to the authorized/approved financial institutions if a loan was taken for the project. If no loan was takenRs. the amount is released directly to the applicant.
> **Expected Time of Disbursement**

Priority for disbursement is based on the date of star classification/heritage classification or the date of commercial operation for other tourism projects.
eligibility:
- The scheme applies to star-classified hotels/resortsRs. heritage hotelsRs. and other tourism projects completed and commissioned from 2005 onwards.
- The project must be in continuous commercial operation.
- The applicant must have financially invested in the property and developed the project.
- The hotel/resort must have star classification or heritage classification approved by the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of India.
- The project must not have availed any other capital subsidy/incentive from the Government of Puducherry or the Government of India.
- The project must continue in the same name and style for eight years from the date of release of the incentive.

name: Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers
brief_description:
The Government of India had introduced the 'Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers' from 1st JulyRs. 2003 which is a combination of 'Janshree Bima Yojana (JBY)' and 'Add-on Group Insurance Scheme (AGIS)'. The Scheme was revised w.e.f. 1st JanuaryRs. 2008 and the revised Scheme was known as "Group Insurance Scheme for Powerloom Weavers". This scheme is implemented in collaboration with the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India.
**Objective:**
The basic objective of this scheme is to provide insurance cover to the powerloom weavers in the case of natural deathRs. accidental death as well as partial and permanent disability due to accident.
benefits:
1. In the event of the natural death of the memberRs. Sum assured of 60Rs./- will become payable to the nominee.
2. In the event of death by accident or Partial/Total Permanent Disability due to accidentRs. the following benefit shall be payable:

- On death due to accident: 1Rs./-
- Permanent total disability due to accident: 1Rs./-
- Permanent partial disability due to accident: 75Rs./-

**Educational Benefits:**

- An educational grant of 600/- per child per half year for two children studying from Class IX to Class XII for a maximum of 4 years under the Shiksha Sahayog Yojana (SSY).

**Premium:**
The total annual premium 470/- per memberRs. will be shared as follows:

- Government of India Contribution: 290/-
- Workers/Weavers Contribution: 80/-
- Contribution from Social Security Fund: 100/-
eligibility:
1. The Powerloom weavers who are between 18 to 59 years of age.
1. The scheme will be universally applicable for powerloom workers/weavers irrespective of their status with reference to BPL/APL categories.
1. The scheme is applicable to the families of powerloom workers engaged in the activity of weaving on powerlooms and in allied pre-weaving/preparatory activities like twistingRs. windingRs. warping and sizing.
1. Self-employed weaver families owning not more than 4 looms will also be eligible.
1. Family for the purpose of the scheme shall be the beneficiary and his/her spouse and only one of them shall be eligible for coverage.
1. The scheme is operational on yearly basis i.e. the premium paid will cover the applicant under this insurance scheme for one year. He can continue the insurance every year during 12th Plan period by paying premium up to the age of 59 years.

name: HSCST Fellowship Programme
brief_description:
The Haryana State Council for ScienceRs. Innovation and Technology (HSCSIT) will award HSCST Fellowship to bright young men and women for training in methods of research under the expert guidance of faculty members /scientists working in University Departments/ National Laboratories and Institutes in Haryana in various fields of Science & Technology and Medical Sciences namelyRs. Life SciencesRs. Physical SciencesRs. Chemical Sciences and Mathematical Sciences etc.
The HSCST Fellowships are tenable in Universities/Post-Graduate Colleges/Government Research EstablishmentsRs. R&D establishments of recognized public or private sectorRs. Industrial firms and other recognized institutions of Haryana. The programme is aimed at Human Resource Development for S&T.
The award of HSCST Fellowship is for a fixed tenure and does not imply any assurance or guarantee for subsequent employment by HSCSIT to the beneficiary. The awardee shall not lay claim to permanent absorption in HSCSITRs. after the expiry of Fellowship.
Candidates who have qualified JRF-NET (CSIR/UGC) & LS-NET in joint CSIR-UGC Test for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and eligibility for lectureship (NET) will be selected for carrying out their Ph. D. work in any of the University/Institute in Haryana.
benefits:
***Stipend:***

- Candidates who have qualified JRF-NET (CSIR/UGC) will be given fellowship at par with CSIR/UGC in case they are not availing fellowship from CSIR/UGC for some valid reason i.e. 31Rs./- per month for JRF and 35Rs./- for SRF.
- Candidates who have qualified LS- NETRs. the fellowship will be given at existing rates for both CSIR/UGC with preference for CSIR i.e. 18Rs./- per month for JRF and 21Rs./- per month for SRF.
- The fellowship will carry an annual contingency grant of 20Rs./- which will be provided to the University/Institution.

***Tenure:***

- Tenure of the fellowship will be 3 years extendable to 4th and 5th year as per terms & conditions of the programme.
- The total tenure as JRF plus SRF will not exceed five years.

***Temporary Teaching & Research Job:***

- A Research Fellow may be permitted by HSCSIT to take up temporary paid lectureship/research job in a recognized R&D Institution/UniversityRs. College/Institute of repute/Recognized R & D Institution/PDF studies in India & abroad for a period not exceeding 1 year during the entire tenure of the Fellowship (JRF & SRF together).

***Leave:***

- Leave with stipend not exceeding 45 days for each completed year of tenure may be allowed by the Guide after the request has been communicated to HSCSIT.
- The leave will be treated as part of the Fellows tenure.
- The leave due can be carried over to the next yearRs. however not more than 90 days can be accumulated at any time during the tenure.
eligibility:
1. The candidate should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The candidate should hold an M.Sc. or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 55% marks.
1. The candidate should have qualified JRF-NET (CSIR/UGC) & LS-NET in the Joint CSIR-UGC Test for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and eligibility for lectureship (NET).
1. The candidate should be interested in pursuing full-time research leading to a Ph.D. degree in relevant science disciplinesRs. including Life SciencesRs. Physical SciencesRs. Chemical SciencesRs. Mathematical SciencesRs. and EarthRs. AtmosphericRs. Ocean & Planetary Sciences.
1. Candidates receiving a fellowship or financial assistance from any other source are not eligible.
1. The upper age limit for JRF is 28 yearsRs. with a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. WomenRs. Physically Handicapped (PH)Rs. and Other Backward Classes (OBC) applicants.

name: Foreign Education Scheme
brief_description: The "Foreign Education Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. is designed to support meritorious students from economically weaker sections who wish to pursue higher education abroad. The financial assistance helps cover tuition feesRs. living expensesRs. and other educational costs. The repayment structure is flexibleRs. ensuring students can repay the loan after completing their studies. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** A loan of the total tuition fee of the entire course or 15Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided by the Corporation at a simple interest of 4%.
**Collateral:**


- For loans of total loan amount of 7Rs./- or less for the entire courseRs. a charge of one and a half times the loan amount will have to be registered on the beneficiary&#39;s own property or that of a relative.
- If the total loan amount for the entire course is more than 7Rs./-Rs. the immovable property of oneself or any other relative equal to that total amount will have to be mortgaged in favor of the Corporation.


**Loan repayment:**


- In case of total loan up to 5Rs./-Rs. it will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 5 (five) yearsRs. 1 year after completion of studies.
- In case of loan exceeding 5Rs./-Rs. it will have to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 6 (six) yearsRs. starting 1 year after completion of studies.
- The money from the loan being repaid will continue to be deposited as interest first.
- The borrower can repay the loan even before the specified time limit.
eligibility:

name: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana
brief_description:
The "Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY)" is a National Program of Fellowship in Basic Sciences which is initiated and funded by the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of IndiaRs. to attract exceptionally motivated students to pursue basic science courses and research careers in science. Under this schemeRs. students are encouraged in science research from school level to postgraduate level.
***Objective:***

- Identify students with talent and aptitude for research.
- Help them realize their academic potential.
- Encourage them to take up research careers in science.
- Ensure the growth of the best scientific minds for research and development in the country.

***Streams under KVPY:***
KVPY exam is conducted for various streams:

1. **Stream SA:** This is for those students who are studying in class 11 with Science and who have interest in Science. 1. **Stream SX:** It is for students who are pursuing class 12 science and have interest in pursuing science research at the graduate level. 1. **Stream SB:** It is for students who are studying in the first year of graduation (B.Sc./B.S./B.Math./B.Stat./Int. M.Sc.) and want to pursue a career in science.
***KVPY Exam Format:***
The entrance examination of KVPY consists of two stages:

1. **Aptitude Test:** This exam is conducted online and questions are asked based on the subjects of PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. MathematicsRs. and Biology. It consists of objective type questions. 1. **Interview (no longer applicable):** EarlierRs. students were called for interview after the qualifying exam but now the examination process includes only aptitude test.
benefits:
**Scholarships and Awards:**
Under this schemeRs. scholarships and grants are provided to studentsRs. offering financial assistance for studies ranging from undergraduate programs (such as B.Sc.Rs. B.S.Rs. B.Stat.Rs. B.Math.Rs. Int. M.Sc.Rs. M.S.) to postgraduate programs (such as M.Sc. and M.S.).

- **For school students (11th & 12th):** Scholarship of 5Rs./- per month and contingency grant of 20Rs./- per year.

- **For undergraduate and postgraduate students:** Scholarship of 7Rs./- per month and contingency grant of 28Rs./- per year. - **For Masters students:** Scholarship of 7Rs./- per month and contingency grant of 28Rs./- per year.
**Note 1:** Apart from this scholarshipRs. KVPY scholars are also given opportunities to study and do research in various research institutesRs. universities and laboratories.
**Note 2:** KVPY scholars get opportunities to participate in research work in the field of science and technology.
**Note 3:** Scholars get opportunities to attend various workshopsRs. seminars and conferencesRs. which help in their development.
**Note 4:** KVPY exam provides students a path to build a promising career in science and researchRs. and it gives them the opportunity to study in the premier science institutes of India.
eligibility:

name: National Awards to Teachers
brief_description: Launched in 1958Rs. the scheme "National Awards to Teachers" by the Ministry of Education aims to honour and celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the country whoRs. through their commitmentRs. have enriched the lives of their students and improved the quality of school education. Two significant benefits of this scheme are to give public recognition to meritorious teachers and to honour those teachers who have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students. Two significant eligibility criteria include being a school teacher or Head of School working in a recognised primaryRs. middleRs. or secondary school and being a regular teacher or Head of School with a minimum of ten years of service. The scheme is implemented under the overall supervision of the Ministry of Education (MOE).
benefits:
- Public recognition is given away by The President of India (or) The Vice President of India on 5th September (Teacher's Day) every year. This recognition is for meritorious primaryRs. middle and secondary school teachers.
- The purpose of National Awards to Teachers is to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the country and to honor those teachers whoRs. through their commitment and industryRs. have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students.
