name: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 1st February 2002Rs. the scheme "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" by the Department of Information and PublicityRs. Government of GoaRs. aims to improve the welfare of working journalistsRs. who are working in GoaRs. after retirementRs. and their families. The two significant benefits include a monthly welfare fund of 7Rs./- and family welfare providing 50% of the pension in the event of the journalist's death. The two significant eligibility criteria are working as a journalist in Goa under the definition of the Working Journalists and Newspaper Employees Service Conditions and Miscellaneous Conditions ActRs. 1955Rs. and having retired after fifteen years of serviceRs. being not below 50 years of age in GoaRs. with continuous or interval service.
benefits:
> **MONTHLY WELFARE FUND**


- **Amount & Intended Use:** 7Rs./- per monthRs. for the welfare of eligible working journalists retired after working in Goa.- **Disbursement Frequency & Mode:** By cheque by the Director of Information and PublicityRs. after the sixth of every month. GenerallyRs. from the succeeding month of retirement.- **Expected Time of Disbursement:** From the first day of the month following retirement.- **Conditions:** Consideration and order by the Governing Body or authorised Sub CommitteeRs. satisfaction of the convener (for temporary welfare subject to ratification)Rs. and verification of the passbook by the Director of Information and Publicity.
> **FAMILY WELFARE**


- **Amount & Intended Use:** 50% of the journalist's pensionRs. for the spouseRs. unmarried children below 21 yearsRs. and dependent parents of a deceased working journalist who was a member of the scheme.- **Disbursement Frequency & Mode:** MonthlyRs. likely after the sixth of every monthRs. by cheque by the Director of Information and Publicity.- **Conditions:** Submission of an application by family members and based on the nomination by the deceased member.
> **RETURN OF CONTRIBUTION**


- **Amount & Intended Use:** The member's contribution towards the fundRs. to be returned to members who lose membership due to not working as a journalist for one continuous year or defaulting on contributions for six continuous months.- **Expected Time of Disbursement:** Within one year of losing membership.
eligibility:
**All working journalists who fall under the categories mentioned below will be eligible for welfare under the scheme -**

- Those who retire after fifteen years of serviceRs. not below 50 years of age in GoaRs. continuous or with intervalsRs. and who have contributed for a period of 180 months under this scheme only after attaining the age of 58 or after he or she retire from service.
- Those who register under the Scheme within 6 months of the implementation and whose contribution falls less than 180 monthsRs. they will be governed by the [Registration clause](https://dip.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Jour-wel-fund.pdf). HoweverRs. a relaxation could be granted if the working journalist concerned is afflicted and is undergoing treatment for any serious ailment. Such a relaxation could be granted only after the governing body ratifies such a request from the working journalist concerned.- Any member who attains 58 years of ageRs. or completes 50 years after becoming a member of the schemeRs. whichever is earlierRs. will be entitled to welfare under the scheme.
- Any journalist who is covered under the Working Journalists Act will be eligible under the Scheme for welfare.
- Any journalist who has retired after continuous service for 15 years or with intervals and who is a member of the welfare scheme.

_*A relaxation could be granted to working journalists registering within six months of implementation with less than 180 months of contributionRs. if afflicted with a serious ailment and undergoing treatmentRs. subject to Governing Body ratification._

name: Cash Amount for Encouraging Scheduled Tribe Sportsperson Students
brief_description: The scheme " Cash Amount for Encouraging Scheduled Tribe Sportsperson Students" was launched in 1996 by the Department of Tribal Area DevelopmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to promote and encourage sports participation among Scheduled Tribe (ST) students residing in scheduled areas of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. cash awardsRs. certificatesRs. and mementos are provided as a form of encouragement to Scheduled Tribe sportspersons students who secure the top three positions in national and international sports events.
benefits:
**Students who have secured top positions at national and international levels are rewarded with the following incentives as a form of encouragement:**

- Cash Prize
- Certificate of Appreciation
- Memento
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Scheduled Tribe area of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant should participate in a national or international-level sports competition.
1. The applicant should have secured a top-three position at national or international level competition.

name: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana" was launched by the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. It aims to enhance the employability and income-generating capacity of youth from backward and extremely backward communities through skill development training. Under this schemeRs. free domain-specific skilling programs are provided to youth to help them become job-ready or self-employed.
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by the Bihar State Backward Classes Finance and Development CorporationRs. in coordination with the Bihar Skill Development Mission (BSDM).
> **Training**

Training is conducted through Skill Development Centres (SDCs) approved by BSDM under various sectors like ITRs. constructionRs. beauty & wellnessRs. and more.
benefits:
**Free Skill Training:**

- Domain Skilling Programs in various sectors like ApparelRs. Beauty & WellnessRs. ConstructionRs. ElectronicsRs. IT-ITESRs. RetailRs. etc.

**Certification:**

- Candidates receive certificates post successful completion of training and assessment.

**Placement Support:**

- Support for employment or self-employment opportunities after course completion.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class or Extremely Backward Class category.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years of age.
1. The applicant should possess the Aadhaar number (mandatory for Aadhaar-based registration).

name: Anya Pichhda Varg Kalyan Chhatravaas
brief_description: The Scheme "Anya Pichhda Varg Kalyan Chhatravaas" under the BC & EBC Welfare DepartmentRs. BiharRs. is being implemented to address the issue of educational backwardness among weaker sections of societyRs. especially students from rural areas. The scheme provides hostel facilities for Other Backward Class (OBC) students in all 38 districts of the stateRs. offering benefits such as 12Rs. per year and 15 kg of free food grains per month.
benefits:
- 1Rs./- per month hostel grant for each student.
- 15 kg of free food grains per month (9 kg rice + 6 kg wheat).
- Free facilities like cotRs. mattressRs. bedsheetRs. and cooking utensils.
- Food arrangements under superintendent's supervision; students bear actual meal costs.
- Hostel facilities may include CCTVRs. water purifierRs. TVRs. Wi-FiRs. computer labRs. and sports equipment (based on fund availability).
- Support for competitive exam preparation and access to library.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicants age should be between 11 to 40 years.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC).

name: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
brief_description: The "Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. for students belonging to the Denotified TribesRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. free bicycles will be distributed to students from these communities who are studying in government and recognized private educational institutions/schools from Class 6 to Class 11Rs. to facilitate their commute between home and school.
benefits: - Free bicycle distribution to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions. - Equal distribution of benefits among boys and girls (50% boys and 50% girls).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should belong to one of the Denotified TribesRs. Nomadic TribesRs. or Semi-Nomadic Tribes as notified by the Government of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be studying in the 6thRs. 7thRs. 8thRs. 9thRs. 10thRs. or 11th class.1. The applicant should be enrolled in a government or a private educational institution/school affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary EducationRs. Ajmer .
1. The applicant should have secured 60% or more marks in the previous academic year.
1. The students who has already availed the benefit of this scheme once will not be eligible.

> **NOTE:**

> Students belonging to a total of 32 communities (including 9 Denotified TribesRs. 10 Nomadic TribesRs. and 13 Semi-Nomadic Tribes) will be eligible as per Government [Order No. F-1(1)(2)S.W/63 dated 24.02.1964](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=68)Rs. Annexure 'A'.

name: Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana
brief_description:
The Atma Nirbhar Matsya Palan Yojana (ANMPY) was launched by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Arunachal Pradesh. It aims to promote self-reliant fish farming practices and enhance income generation among Scheduled Tribe (ST) beneficiaries through aquaculture activities. Under this flagship schemeRs. a credit-linked front-ended subsidy is provided for fisheries development to individual farmersRs. Self Help Groups (SHGs)Rs. and Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs) in Arunachal Pradesh.
> **Scheme Implementation**

The scheme is implemented by the District Fisheries Development Officers (DFDOs)Rs. under the supervision of District Level Screening Committees (DLSCs).
benefits:
> **Benefits:**


1. 45% Government Subsidy.
1. 45% Bank Loan (credit-linked).
1. 10% Beneficiary Contribution.
eligibility:
**Eligibility Criteria for Individual Farmers**

1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe (ST) of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant must be between 18 to 60 years of age.
1. The applicant must not be a bank defaulter.
1. The applicant must not be a government servant.
1. The applicant must have experience in fisheries or aquaculture.
1. The applicant must have sufficient and suitable land for aquaculture activity.

**Eligibility Criteria for Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**

1. SHGs must be affiliated with APRSLM (Arunachal Pradesh State Rural Livelihood Mission).
1. SHGs under NERCOMP (for Changlang) are also eligible.
1. SHGs must be actively engaged in fisheries or aquaculture.

**Eligibility Criteria for Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs)**

1. The FPO must be registered.
1. The FPO must have at least 100 shareholders.
1. The FPO must have at least one audited balance sheet.
1. Only FPOs engaged in fisheries/aquaculture are eligible.

name: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students
brief_description:
The 'Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students' schemeRs. administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. provides financial assistance to deserving girl students from Scheduled Castes (SC). Eligibility is extended to those who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSLC examination. The scheme's objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher educationRs. thereby fostering their academic parity with the broader population through a substantial incentive. Assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation. An incentive of 5Rs./- will be disbursed to students as approved by the Selection Committee.
**The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
benefits: A financial incentive of 5Rs./- is provided.
eligibility: - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must be female. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed 5Rs./-.

name: Rural Technology Complex
brief_description: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE)Rs. aims to support livelihood enhancement in the Himalayan region through the application of need-basedRs. eco-friendly technologies. The scheme involves the establishment of Rural Technology Complex(RTC) within institutional premisesRs. where local technological needs are addressed by training participants in sustainable practices. These sessionsRs. focused on skill developmentRs. aim to create awareness and equip trainees with techniques to improve their income generation capacities using low-cost and environmentally compatible tools. Training is provided at no costRs. and is open to government officersRs. NGO representativesRs. educatorsRs. studentsRs. womenRs. and rural self-help group members.
benefits: - **Free Training:** All training programmes under the scheme are provided at no cost. - **Livelihood Enhancement:** Training equips individuals with skills for sustainableRs. eco-friendly income generation. - **Practical Exposure:** Training includes hands-on learning and field demonstrations. - **No Participation Charges:** There is no fee for training or the exposure visit to the Rural Technology Campus.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to any of the following categories:


1. A central or state government officer or staff member.
1. A representative of a non-governmental organisation (NGO).
1. A student from a recognised university or educational institution.
1. A teacher or faculty member from any recognised educational institution.
1. A rural woman or man interested in acquiring environment-friendly livelihood-based technological skills.
1. A member of a registered self-help group (SHG).

name: ICSSR Post-Doctoral Fellowship
brief_description: This scheme is open to Indian citizens under the age of 45 who hold a Ph.D. and have demonstrated research ability through earlier publications. All candidates must be affiliated with a Ministry of Education or UGC-recognized public-funded Indian universityRs. and a senior faculty member (not less than an Associate Professor) from the same institution must supervise their study. The fellowship offers a 31Rs. monthly grant and 20Rs. annual contingency grant for a period of two years. The applications for the fellowship are invited through advertising on the ICSSR website and social media platforms. The scheme covers a wide range of disciplines under the discipline of social sciencesRs. with 26 major areas including priority research topics. In addition to conducting full-time researchRs. fellows are expected to provide progress updates on a regular basis and publish at least two research publications in reputable journals. The final submission includes published articlesRs. audited financial dataRs. summariesRs. and a book-length report. Given India's social science ecosystemRs. it seeks to promote research excellenceRs. evidence-based researchRs. and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.
benefits:
1) Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.31Rs. per month
2) Contingency Grant @ Rs.20Rs. per annum
3) API points as per the UGC Guidelines in force at the point of time
4) Institutional overhead (7.5%) supports the hosting institution.
eligibility:
1) The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2) Must be under 45 years of age (5-year relaxation for SC/ST/PwD).
3) Must possess a Ph.D. in a social science discipline.
4) Must have demonstrable research competence via publications.
5) Must affiliate with a public-funded Indian institution approved for Ph.D.
6) Must have a supervisor who is a serving faculty (Associate Professor or above).
7) Applicant must not be a defaulter of any ICSSR grant/project/fellowship.

name: ICSSR Senior Fellowship
brief_description: The Senior Fellowship Scheme is specifically designed for senior researchers who are between the ages of 45 and 70Rs. affiliated with a UGC-recognized universityRs. deemed universityRs. institute of national importanceRs. or ICSSR-recognized research instituteRs. have a PhD and has made significant academic contributions in their fields through booksRs. journal articlesRs. or research initiatives. The fellowship is for two years with progress reports to be submitted every six months. An annual contingency grant of 40Rs. and a monthly stipend of 45Rs. are included in the fellowship to help with research-related costs. The applications for the fellowship are invited through advertising on the ICSSR website and social media platforms. The scheme covers a wide range of disciplines under the discipline of social sciencesRs. with 26 major areas including priority research topics. All the scholars must submit a book-length final reportRs. and at least two published research papers at the end of two years. The fellowship program supports dedicated academics to generate noteworthy research with national priorities and international academic standards with precise guidance on grant disbursementRs. monitoringRs. reportingRs. and the responsibilities of both the fellow and the affiliated institution. Given India's social science ecosystemRs. it seeks to promote research excellenceRs. evidence-based researchRs. and scholarship that is also relevant to policymakers.
benefits:
1) Monthly Fellowship amount @ Rs.45Rs. per month
2) Contingency Grant @ Rs.40Rs. per annum
3) API points as per the UGC Guidelines in force at the point of time
eligibility:
1) The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2) Must have a Ph.D. in any Social Science discipline.
3) Age: Between 45 to 70 years as on the last application date.
4) Must have an established publication record in reputed journals or books.
5) Must be affiliated with a UGC-recognized or ICSSR research institute.
6) Should not be availing any other fellowship concurrently.
7) Must not be a defaulter of ICSSR funds.

name: Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal Swavalamban Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal Swavalamban Yojana was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD)Rs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among village-level male and female youth groups (Mangal Dals) by providing financial support for the purchase of essential materialsRs. enabling them to become self-reliant and undertake community-based activities.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 14Rs./- is provided to purchase essential materials for community useRs. aimed at making the Mangal Dals self-reliant.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a recognized Yuvak Mangal Dal or Mahila Mangal Dal in UttarakhandRs. formally affiliated with the Department of Youth Welfare and PRDRs. Government of Uttarakhand.

name: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
brief_description: The scheme "Indira Amma Bhojanalaya" was introduced by the Rural Development DepartmentRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. aims to arrange and operate cheap food canteens in the state. The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens. The canteens are operated by women's self-help groups under the supervision and control of the Chief Development Officer (CDO). The canteens will be established in the headquarters of each district.
benefits:
1. Nutritious and affordable food at subsidized rates.
2. **Subsidized Rates:**

- The consumer pays 25/- per plate in hilly areas.
- The consumer pays 20/- per plate in DehradunRs. HaridwarRs. Udham Singh NagarRs. and Nainital districts.
- A subsidy of 10/- per plate is borne by the State Government.

3. The Urban Development AuthorityRs. Municipal CorporationRs. or Municipality provides free spaceRs. furnitureRs. and other essential resources required for the operation of the canteen.
4. Uttarakhand Power Corporation and Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan provide electricity and waterRs. respectivelyRs. free of cost.
5. The arrangement of fuel/LPG gas for running the canteen is made through the District Supply Officer.
6.**** Provides continuous income-generating employmentRs. leading to economic strengthening for women's Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
> **Conditions:**


1. Maximum 1Rs. plates of food are to be provided per day in high-population districts like DehradunRs. HaridwarRs. and Udham Singh Nagar.
1. A maximum of 800 plates of food are to be provided per day in other districts.
1. Canteens opened solely for employees within office premises are not eligible for subsidy.
1. The State Government reserves the right to determine future subsidies based on the canteen's annual income or profit.
1. Canteens aiming to become self-sustainable will continue to receive facilitator support from the State Government.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a women Self-Help Group (SHG) formed according to the guiding principles of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).
1. Self-Help Groups (SHGs) formed as per NRLM guidelines that are actively functioning and have received the minimum Revolving Fund (RF) either under the restructured SGSY scheme or directly under NRLMRs. if not previously covered under SGSY shall be eligible to operate the canteen.
1. In urban areasRs. self-help groups (SHGs) under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) are also eligible to operate Indira Amma Canteens. The Rural Development Department provides grants to support these groups in running the canteens.

***Notes:***__

- It is essential for self-help groups to maintain complete records of beneficiariesRs. including their names and places of residenceRs. to ensure transparency and prevent any irregularities in receiving contributions provided by the state government.
- SHGs formed under NRLM guidelines and having received the Community Investment Fund (CIF) or a Micro Credit Plan specifically for operating an Indira Amma Canteen will be given preference.
- The tenure of operation of State Government funded/aided canteens operating in Municipal Corporation areas shall be maximum of 01 year and thereafter they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 02 years.
- Except Municipal Corporation areasRs. the tenure of operation of canteens funded/aided by the State Government in other institutions/offices/bodies etc. will be maximum 02 years. ThereafterRs. they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 04 years.

name: Financial Assistance to Scheduled Tribe (Plains) Students for Coaching for Getting Admission into Medical/Engineering/IIT/etc.
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Scheduled Tribe (Plains) Students for Coaching for Getting Admission into Medical/Engineering/IIT/etc." was launched by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial support to eligible ST (P) students for coaching to crack competitive entrance examinations for MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. and Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT). The scheme offers reimbursement for coaching expenses incurred by students and prioritizes merit-based selection. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must belong to the ST (P) community and must be undergoing or have completed coaching (within the last one year) for the specified entrance exams. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes and Backward ClassesRs. AssamRs. and applications are accepted offline via submission to the Directorates office.
benefits: Financial reimbursement for coaching expenses related to Medical/Engineering/IIT entrance exams.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (Plains) community.
- The applicant must be undergoing or have completed coaching (within the last one year) for Medical/Engineering/IIT entrance examinations.
- The applicant must have appeared/passed the 10+2 examination.

_*Selection is based on merit (percentage secured in the Matriculation Examination)._

name: Promotion of Tribal Culture
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Tribal Culture" by the Directorate of Welfare of Plains Tribes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to provide financial grants to NGOsRs. TrustsRs. and Voluntary Organizations working for the advancement of tribal culture among Scheduled Tribes (Plains) in Assam's plain districts (excluding BTC area). The scheme supports initiatives like heritage preservationRs. literature promotionRs. cultural activitiesRs. and local brews. Eligible organizations must be registered and have prior experience in tribal culture promotion. Applications are invited through advertisementsRs. and grants are disbursed subject to Selection Committee approval.
benefits:
**Financial Grant:** Maximum of 3Rs./- per organization for tribal culture promotion initiatives (e.g.Rs. heritageRs. literatureRs. local brews).
**Disbursement:** Subject to Selection Committee approval and fund availability.
_*Financial assistance is not a right; approval depends on eligibility and fund availability._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a Registered NGO/Trust/Voluntary Organization under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1980Rs. or equivalent.
- The applicant must have a demonstrated background in promoting tribal culture.

_*Priority is given to organizations with ST(P) members._

name: Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam
brief_description: Launched for the current yearRs. the scheme "Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam" by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes & Backward ClassesRs. AssamRs. aims to support ST and OBC/MOBC students appearing in the final examination of APSC/UPSC. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible candidates who have cleared the preliminary exam. To qualifyRs. applicants must belong to the ST or OBC/MOBC community of Assam and have passed the APSC/UPSC preliminary exam in the current year. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Plain Tribes & Backward ClassesRs. Assam. Applications are accepted offline via a prescribed format available on the official website.
benefits: Financial Assistance is providedRs. subject to eligibility verification and fund availability.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Other Backward Classes (OBC)/More Other Backward Classes (MOBC) community of Assam.
- The applicant must have passed the Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) or Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination in the current year.

_*Fulfilling eligibility does not guarantee benefitsRs. as the Selection Committee has the right to reject applications without assigning reasons._

name: Freeship Staff Ward
brief_description: The Freeship Staff Ward scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support the education of students who are wards of university staff and are pursuing undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. or PhD courses by providing tuition fee concessions.
benefits: The eligible students will receive a 50% concession on tuition fees.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a 4-year undergraduate courseRs. a 3-year postgraduate courseRs. or a 3-year Ph.D. program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar.

name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline Area" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for the construction of new ponds in saline or alkaline areas. Through this schemeRs. polythene lining costs are provided for new water bodies created under various state government initiatives. The intended beneficiaries are those creating new ponds for fish or shrimp culture in saline/alkaline areas. The scheme is implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana.
benefits: - The project cost is 8Rs./- per hectare. - The subsidy provided will be limited to 25% of the project cost for all categories.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The polythene lining cost shall be provided for new water bodies created under the various state government.
1. Beneficiaries shall be provided with central assistance for the polythene lining cost for the initial crop only in newly constructed.
1. Central assistance for the Polythene lining cost shall be released only after the ponds are ready for fish/shrimp culture.
1. The projects having land on long-term lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance. HoweverRs. the registered lease period/agreement shall not be a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.

name: Personal Accident Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Personal Accident Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmersRs. agricultural laborersRs. and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.
benefits: Under the Mandi Act of UttarakhandRs. farmersRs. agricultural labourersRs. and Mandi labourers working in Mandi areas regulated by the stateRs. who are engaged in agricultural activities or the operation of agricultural equipment such as power equipmentRs. digging or deepening wells and ponds for irrigationRs. using tractors for threshing or transporting produceRs. or performing other fieldwork are covered under the scheme operated by the Mandi Marketing Board through Mandi Committees. In case of physical injury or death resulting from an accidentRs. the scheme provides them with compensation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to claim compensation.

name: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets - Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to support the construction of fish retail marketsRs. including those for ornamental fish and aquariums. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance for project costs is provided to individual beneficiaries.
benefits: The scheme provides a subsidy for the construction of fish retail marketsRs. including ornamental fish or aquarium markets. The project cost is 1Rs./- per unit. **The subsidy provided is:** - 40% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - 60% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women categories.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) stating that all operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them.
1. The applicant must commit to keeping the fish market in operational condition for 10 years.
1. The applicant must agree to permanently display a board at the infrastructure facility indicating that the fish market was constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).
1. Central assistance will be restricted to one unit per individual beneficiary.
1. Projects with land on a long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance. The registered lease period or agreement must not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.

name: Art Exhibition Assistance in the State
brief_description: The scheme "Art Exhibition Assistance in the State" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to encourage visual artists of Gujarat to showcase their work by offering financial support for organizing exhibitions across the state. The scheme particularly targets those who have either undergone formal art education or have experience in holding art exhibitions. This initiative helps elevate the reach and recognition of regional art and artists. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Lalitkala Academy.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 25Rs./- or actual expenses incurred (whichever is less) for organizing an art exhibition.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have received formal art education or should have conducted a previous individual or group art exhibition. 1. The applicant should organize an exhibition within Gujarat. 1. The applicant should exhibit a minimum of 30 artworks in the sponsored exhibition.

name: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Cycle with Ice Boxes" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide central assistance for the cost of cycles with ice boxes to beneficiaries involved in fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. central assistance for Cycle with Ice Box costs is provided for the initial crop only in the purchase of newly purchased cycles with ice boxes.
benefits:
- The scheme provides a subsidy for the cycle with ice boxes for fisheries activities. - The project cost is 0.10/- lakh per unit. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries falling under the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries who are Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women.
> **Note:** The Government of India and the Government of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurementRs. operationRs. maintenanceRs. and management of the fish transport facilities.
eligibility: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. Beneficiaries should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. Beneficiaries shall be provided central assistance for Cycle with Ice box the initial crop only in the purchase of newly purchased Cycle with Ice Box 1. Central assistance for Cycle with Ice Box cost shall be released only for the fisheries activity. 1. Govt. of India and Govt. of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurementRs. operationRs. maintenance and management of the fish transport facilities.

name: PMMSY: Construction of New Rearing ponds - Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Rearing Ponds (nursery/seed rearing ponds)" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to expand fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds. Through this schemeRs. central assistance and subsidy are provided for the construction of new rearing units and initial crop costs in newly constructed ponds.
benefits: - Provides financial assistance for the construction of New Rearing Ponds (nursery/seed rearing ponds). - The project cost of 7Rs./- per Hectare is provided. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new rearing ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areasRs. only under the construction of new ponds under the PMMSY scheme.
1. The applicant shall be provided with central assistance for the Construction of New Rearing unit costs for the initial crop only in the newly constructed ponds.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. HoweverRs. the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.
1. The applicantRs. having their landRs. must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.

name: Small Business (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Small Business (GBCDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) for undertaking small businesses like grocery storeRs. dairy parlourRs. animal fodder sales centreRs. mobile-computer repairing shopRs. etc.Rs. for casual business. Through this schemeRs. a loan amount is provided at a low interest rate to promote self-employment among SEBC individuals across the state. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC). Beneficiaries can apply online without any application fee through the official GBCDC portal.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance in the form of a loan up to 2Rs./-. 1. The loan can be utilised for starting small businesses such as grocery storesRs. dairy parloursRs. animal fodder sales centresRs. mobile and computer repairing shopsRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward class. 1. The applicant's total annual individual/family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Samruddhi" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide a small-scale credit scheme for creating self-employment for women from backward classes. Through this schemeRs. low-interest rate loans are provided to female beneficiariesRs. enabling them to undertake a business of their choice. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Class Development Corporation. The primary objective is to empower women from socially and educationally backward classes by facilitating self-employment opportunities.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to 1Rs./-. 1. The interest rate on these schemes will be 4% per annum. 1. In these schemesRs. 95% of the unit cost will be provided as a loanRs. where 95% will be contributed by the National Corporation and 5% by the State Government. 1. This loan is to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installmentsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backward classRs. specifically Other Backward Classes (OBC). 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
brief_description:
> **Background** An Expert Group was constituted by the Prime Minister on 18th AugustRs. 2010 in the context of enhancing employment opportunities among youths of Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh to formulate job plan involving public and private sectors. Among the key recommendations of the Expert GroupRs. one was to offer 5000 fresh scholarships per annum to encourage the youth of J&K and Ladakh to pursue higher studies outside the UTs. The proposal arises out of the identified strategy of a human resource development initiative focused on improving skill set through improving access to education
> **Objective** To provide academic fee (tuition and other admissible fee) and maintenance allowance (to bear expenses on account of hostel & mess feeRs. cost of books and other incidental charges) to students belonging to J&K and Ladakh whoRs. after passing Class XII or equivalent examinationRs. secure admission in Government colleges/institutions and other select institutions outside the UTs of J&K and Ladakh through AICTEs counselling process under the supernumerary quota created by the Government except in medical courses. Scheme was launched in the year 2011 and modified from time to time to make the scheme student friendly. The scheme also envisages to build capacities of the youth of J&K and Ladakh to enable them to compete with their peers in the national mainstream and exposure to other states and union territories cultureRs. languageRs. and livelihood and promote the understanding of Ek Bharat Shrestha Bharat..
> **SCOPE** Under the scheme 5000 fresh scholarships are available per annum. Out of theseRs. 2070 scholarships are for General Degree CoursesRs. 2830 for Professional/Engineering courses and 100 for Medical Courses. The number of scholarships for Engineering and Medical Studies would be kept flexibleRs. subject to the ceiling of 5000 fresh scholarships per annum and subject to the savings accruing from any shortfall in the number of students opting for General Degree courses
benefits:
**Rate of ScholarshipsRs. Academic Fee & Maintenance Allowance:** > **Stream: General Degree** - Number of Scholarships: 2070 (fixed) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): 30Rs./- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): 1Rs./-*
> **Stream: Professional/Engineering/B.Sc.Nursing / B. Pharmacy/ B. Architecture (subject to NATA)/HMCT Degree** - Number of Scholarships: 2830 (flexible) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): 1Rs./- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): 1Rs./-*
> **Stream: Medical/BDS or equivalent Medical Stream (subject to NEETRs. wherever applicable)** - Number of Scholarships: 100 (flexible) - Academic Fee (Upper limit): 3Rs./- - Maintenance Charges (Fixed): 1Rs./-* > *Not exceeding 1Rs. per annum (in ten equal installments to meet hostelRs. messRs. booksRs. stationery & other incidentals). Fresh students admitted in the academic session 2024-25 onwards maintenance allowance will be paid through NSP portal. > The number of scholarships for engineering and medical studies would be kept flexibleRs. subject to the ceiling of 5000 fresh scholarships per annum and subject to the savings accruing from any shortfall in the number of students opting for general degree courses
> **Disbursement of Scholarship:** - The scholarship towards academic fees will be paid directly to the Institution as per claim or as per rate fixed by the respective State Fee Regulatory Authority or as fixed by any Regulatory Authority appointed by the GovernmentRs. whichever is less and within the overall ceiling fixed for the course. - All the Institutions may note that the upper ceiling of the Academic Fee inclusive of all admissible components taken together is 1Rs./- for the Professional / Engineering Stream; 30Rs./- for General Stream and 3Rs. for Medical Stream. - Even if the total fee of the institute is more than the ceilingRs. neither AICTE shall reimburse the extra amount nor the institute can charge the same from the students. - The fixed maintenance allowance of 1Rs. per annum for all streams will be paid to the bank account of the student through NSP portal using the PFMS gateway in 10 monthly installments of 10Rs./- each. > **Duration of Scholarships:** - The scholarships granted under the scheme are renewed in subsequent classes subject to good conduct and maintenance of attendance as prescribed by the respective institution. - Students failing to get promoted to the next class/level would get the scholarship in the following year subject to the condition that if the student fails again for the second timeRs. then he/she would forfeit the scholarshipRs. and the scholarship would not be renewed for the subsequent years. - If a scholar is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illness and/or on account of any unforeseen incidentRs. the scholarship may be renewed for the next academic year on submission of a medical certificate and other proof to satisfy the Head of the Institution who will also certify the same. The scholarship will not be paid twice for the same year of study.
eligibility: 1. Candidates should be domicile of Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh. 1. Candidates must have passed 12th examination from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools located in UTs of J&K and Ladakh. 1. The family income of the Candidate should be less than or equal to 8Rs. per annum. 1. The candidate who wants to take admitted under the Lateral Entry Scheme have to pass a Diploma in Engineering from the Polytechnic Institutes recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education(DTE)Rs. UTs of J&K and Ladakh. 1. Candidates are compulsorily required to apply online on the AICTE web-portal and verify their documents through nearest Facilitation Centers of UTs of J&K and Ladakh within time frame. 1. Admission under the Lateral Entry Scheme will be subject to allocation of seats / vacant seats of the preceding year in the Engineering Stream and in the relevant stream only. 1. Merit list will be prepared for HSC and Lateral Entry students and the same shall be displayed on the students portal only for conduction of online counselling for final allotment of seats in colleges to eligible candidates subject to choice filling/availability of scholarships.

name: Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
brief_description: The scheme "Transportation Scheme" by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas NigamRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide loans for the purchase of auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance for vehicle purchase is offered to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam.
benefits: Loans are provided on an individual basis to purchase auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. - Maximum Loan Limit: 2Rs./- - Interest Rate: 6% per annum - Loan Amount: 95% of the vehicle cost - Beneficiary Contribution: 5% of the vehicle cost
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Gujarat GovernmentRs. aims to provide financial assistance to female Safai Kamdars and their dependents to start small businesses. Through this schemeRs. loans for various self-employment ventures are provided to eligible female individuals. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN).
benefits: 1. An individual loan of 1Rs./- is provided. 1. The interest rate on the loan is 4%. 1. The loan is intended for various businesses/occupations such as Mandap DecorationRs. ComputerRs. Electrical ShopRs. Animal HusbandryRs. Grocery ShopRs. Bamboo WorkRs. Sewing WorkRs. EmbroideryRs. Beauty ParlourRs. Mobile RepairingRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native resident of Gujarat State. 1. The applicant must be a sanitation worker or a dependent woman. 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 50 years on the date of the advertisement.

name: Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to preserve and promote classical music in Gujarat by offering financial support to eligible Gurus for imparting training and to their disciples for receiving it. The scheme facilitates a 10-month classical music training period where selected Gurus can train up to 2 disciplesRs. and both Gurus and disciples receive monetary assistance. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Rajya Sangeet Natak AkademiRs. GandhinagarRs. which releases a public advertisement annually inviting applications.
benefits: > **For Gurus:** - Financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month for a duration of 10 months (i.e.Rs. 10Rs./- per disciple) for training up to 2 disciples. > **For Disciples:** - A scholarship of 10Rs./- per annumRs. calculated at 1Rs./- per month for 10 monthsRs. for receiving classical music training from the selected Guru.
eligibility: > **For Gurus:** - The applicant should be a classical music artist. - The applicant should have completed formal education in classical music or must possess at least 7 years of experience in teaching classical music. - The applicant should be capable of training a maximum of 2 disciples during the 10-month training period. > **For Disciples:** - The applicant should be a student of classical music residing in Gujarat. - The applicant should be undergoing training under an eligible Guru selected under this scheme. - The applicant should submit a certificate of training provided by the Guru.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
brief_description: The Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure by promoting hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for direct fish selling.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: 3Rs./- per unit (for purchasing a three-wheeler e-rickshaw equipped with an ice-box for selling fish.) - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the fish transport facility (e-rickshaw) is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant is eligible to purchase only one new three-wheeler e-rickshaw with an ice box for fisheries activities under this scheme. 1. The applicant should agree that neither the Central Government nor the State Government shall be held responsible for any financial or operational losses incurred in the procurementRs. operationRs. maintenanceRs. or management of the fish transport facilities.

name: Khel Pratibha Puraskar
brief_description: The scheme Khel Pratibha Puraskar by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to financially support and honour sportspersons from Gujarat who have earned medals at national and international levels by awarding them cash prizes between 10Rs./- and 5Rs./- depending on the level and nature of their sporting achievement. The scheme intends to inspire athletic excellence and acknowledge the hard work and dedication of Gujarats athletes on prestigious platforms.
benefits: - **Cash Prize:** An amount ranging from 10Rs./- to 5Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should have won a medal at a national or international level. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat or should be representing Gujarat officially in the sporting event.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Small RAS Culture System Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland) with the component of Establishment of Small RAS (with 1 tank of minimum 100m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) culture system" by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to increase inland fish production by promoting fish rearing in reservoirs and providing employment to individuals involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for setting up Small Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) unitsRs. enabling higher fish yield using minimal land and water resources. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
Beneficiaries can receive assistance for the Establishment of Small RAS (with 1 tank of a minimum 100m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) culture system. 1. For the general categoryRs. the standard of assistance will be 40% of the unit cost 7Rs./unit or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. 1. For womenRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categoriesRs. the standard of assistance will be 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Assistance is paid through 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments. > **Validity:** The benefit can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with the component of the Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish HatcheryRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims provide financial assistance for various inland fisheries activitiesRs. establishment of freshwater hatcheriesRs. and support for advanced fish farming methods are provided to individualsRs. societiesRs. self-help groupsRs. associationsRs. reservoir leaseholdersRs. and private entities involved in inland fisheries activities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained on less land and less water.
