benefits:
For the Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish HatcheryRs. the unit cost of the project is 30Rs./-. Assistance is provided as follows: 1. **General category:** 40% of the unit cost.1. **WomenRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories:** 60% of the unit cost.1. **Funding structure:** - 60% contribution from the Government of India. - 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** Once in a lifetime benefit per eligible beneficiary for this specific component.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)
brief_description: The "Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to enhance the Seed Replacement Rate among farmers by distributing certified seeds of various agricultural crops. This initiative is supported under the centrally sponsored National Food Security Mission (NFSM) and NFSM-Oilseeds schemes. The goal is to provide access to quality seeds and promote better agricultural practices for increased yield and income.
benefits: - **Seed Distribution:** Certified seeds are distributed to eligible farmers.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be residing in Gujarat.

name: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote sustainable agricultural practices by encouraging farmers to adopt organic farming methods. The scheme provides financial support for the registration and certification processes conducted by the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA) and Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)-approved agencies. It also offers input cost assistance per hectareRs. enabling farmers to reduce chemical usage and enhance soil health.
benefits: - **Organic Farming Registration and Certification Assistance (GOPCA):** The scheme provides 75% at-source assistance in cost to the farmer for registration and certification when undertaken through the Gujarat Organic Products Certification Agency (GOPCA).- **Organic Farming RegistrationRs. CertificationRs. and Transportation Assistance (APEDA-approved agencies):** When certification is done through APEDA-approved organic certification agenciesRs. the scheme offers 50% assistance in registrationRs. certificationRs. and transportation fees. The maximum benefit for certification support is limited to 2Rs./- per hectare.- **Input Assistance for Organic Farming:** Farmers are also eligible for input assistance amounting to 5Rs./- per hectare to promote organic farming practices.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in organic farming activities.

name: Scheme of Awarding Eklavya Award, Sardar Patel Award and Jaidipsinhji Awardj
brief_description: The "Scheme of awarding Eklavya AwardRs. Sardar Patel Award and Jaidipsinhji Award" by the SportsRs. YouthRs. and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and incentivize the outstanding achievements of sportspersons by providing financial rewards across senior and junior categories based on their performances at stateRs. nationalRs. and international levels. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: 1. **Eklavya Senior Award:** 1Rs./-. 1. **Eklavya Junior Award:** 50Rs./-. 1. **Sardar Patel Senior Award**: 50Rs./-. 1. **Sardar Patel Junior Award:** 25Rs./-. 1. **Jaidipsinhji Senior Award:** 20Rs./-. 1. **Jaidipsinhji Junior Award:** 10Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a male 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have made notable achievements in sports at the stateRs. nationalRs. or international level.

name: "Orthodox or Specialty Tea Production Subsidy" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
brief_description: Launched in 2020Rs. the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from CrushRs. TearRs. Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. through multiple implementing agenciesRs. including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
benefits: **Benefit Amount:** 10/- per kilogram for Orthodox teaRs. Green teaRs. White teaRs. Oolong teaRs. Singhpo teaRs. Purple TeaRs. Yellow teaRs. or other Specialty tea **Special Rate:** 12/- per kilogram for applications of Financial Year 2023-24 only (tea production year 2022-23). **Validity Period:** Extended from Financial Year 2023-24 to 2027-28. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Claim Deadline:** Latest by 30th June on completion of every financial year. **Additional Benefit:** Provided in addition to any other subsidy claimed from the Tea Board of India or any other agency.
eligibility:
**General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing CrushRs. TearRs. Curl TeaRs. Orthodox TeaRs. or Speciality tea including Green teaRs. Oolong TeaRs. White teaRs. Yellow tea and Purple tea - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam
**Production Subsidy Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox teaRs. Green teaRs. White teaRs. Oolong teaRs. Singhpo teaRs. Purple TeaRs. Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through CrushRs. TearRs. Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 1st of AprilRs. 2020.

name: Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th
brief_description: The scheme "Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th" by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 10th. Through this schemeRs. scholarships are annually provided to boysRs. girlsRs. and extremely backward students from Classes 1st to 10th.
benefits:
The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships. The amounts are as follows: > **For Boys** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of 750/-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of 1Rs./-. > **For Girls** - Class 1 to Class 5: Annual scholarship of 750/-. - Class 6 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of 1Rs./-. > **For Extremely Backwards Students** - Class 1 to Class 8: Annual scholarship of 1Rs./-. - Class 9 to Class 10: Annual scholarship of 1Rs./-.
> **Mode of Disbursement:****** The benefits to the beneficiaries will be disbursed through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method. > **Frequency of Disbursement:****** The scholarship is provided annually.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to 10th.

name: Scholarships and Stipends
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarships and Stipends" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote excellence in sports by offering financial support to individuals who have represented the state at national-level events and have won medals. This initiative is designed to reduce the financial burden on athletes and to recognize their achievements at the national levelRs. thereby motivating them to continue their athletic pursuits and strive for excellence. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Scholarships:** 2Rs./- per player is awarded to athletes who have won medals at the national level. - **Stipends:** 2Rs./- per player is awarded to athletes who have participated at the national levelRs. irrespective of winning.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should have participated in a national-level sports event. - The applicant should have won a medal at the national level to be eligible for the scholarship.

name: Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste
brief_description: The scheme "Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to facilitate holistic personality developmentphysicalRs. mentalRs. and spiritualamong Scheduled Caste youth aged between 14 and 35 years by organizing 7-day free training camps. These camps are conducted across all 250 talukas in 41 Scheduled Caste-majority districts of Gujarat and are designed to empower 50 youth participants per taluka through structured personality enhancement and Yogasana sessions.
benefits: - **Personality Development:** Participants undergo structured sessions for enhancing communicationRs. confidenceRs. disciplineRs. and overall character. - **Physical Development:** Daily Yogasana training and exercises aimed at physical fitness. - **Mental and Spiritual Development:** Yoga and related practices to foster mental peace and spiritual well-being.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. - The applicant should be between 14 and 35 years of age.

name: State Mountaineering Reward Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "State Mountaineering Reward Scheme" was launched by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide awards in the field of mountaineering is in place to enthusiastically engage and inspire the youth of the state towards risky and adventurous activities like summitingRs. mountaineering and rock climbing and to honor and commend the youth of the state who have achieved exceptional achievements in the field of mountaineering. Under the schemeRs. a cash awardRs. a mementoRs. and a certificate will be awarded to each of the adventurers of the state every year for their outstanding achievements in the field of mountaineering.
benefits: A cash award of 25Rs./-Rs. a mementoRs. and a certificate will be awarded to each of the adventurers of the state every year for their outstanding achievements in the field of mountaineering.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a native of Gujarat. - The applicant should have climbed a height of 7Rs. meters once or a height of more than 6Rs. meters twice. - The climbing achievement of the applicant must be confirmed by the Director of the Indian Mountaineering Foundation (IMF). - The applicant should not be involved in any criminal activity. ****This award can also be given posthumouslyRs. for which the legal heir of the awardee will have to apply.***

name: "Subsidy for Orthodox & Speciality Tea Unit for Plant & Machinery" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
brief_description: Launched in 2020Rs. the scheme "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from CrushRs. TearRs. Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. through multiple implementing agenciesRs. including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
benefits: **Benefit Amount:** 25% of the cost of Plant & Machinery. **Maximum Amount:** 30Rs./- or 25% of actual costRs. whichever is less. **Validity Period:** Units starting production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. **Claim Period:** Within 12 months of the start of commercial manufacturing activities. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Post-Selection Condition:** Manufacturing unit shall not sell the machinery before expiry of at least 5 years from start of manufacturing.
eligibility:
**General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes. - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing CrushRs. TearRs. Curl TeaRs. Orthodox TeaRs. or Speciality tea including Green teaRs. Oolong TeaRs. White teaRs. Yellow tea and Purple tea. - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam. - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam.
**Plant & Machinery Subsidy Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox teaRs. Green teaRs. White teaRs. Oolong teaRs. Singhpo teaRs. Purple TeaRs. Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through CrushRs. TearRs. Curl process). - The applicant must have started production on or after 01-04-2020 and before 31-03-2028. - The applicant must be either an entirely new unit or an existing unit which has expanded its capacity by creating additional infrastructure for production of Orthodox and Speciality Tea. - The applicant must use all new machinery (no subsidy available on second hand machinery or parts of a machine). - The applicant must not have claimed any similar subsidy under any other scheme of the Government of India or the State.

name: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program
brief_description: The scheme Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to improve agricultural productivity and reduce manual labor burden by providing financial assistance for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to farmers. The scheme offers a subsidy based on the horsepower of the machinery and the applicant's category to promote inclusive agricultural mechanization and improve efficiency in farming operations.
benefits: > **Mini Tractors up to 20 HP and Power Tillers above 8 BHP:** - **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of 45Rs./- or 40% of the equipment costRs. whichever is less.- **SC/ST Farmers:** Financial assistance of 60Rs./- or 50% of the equipment costRs. whichever is less. > **Power Tillers Below 8 BHP:** - **General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of 40Rs./- or 40% of the equipment costRs. whichever is less.- **SC/ST Farmers:** Financial assistance of 50Rs./- or 50% of the equipment costRs. whichever is less.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support. - The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HPRs. or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).

name: Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans
brief_description: The "Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans" by the Gujarat Matikam Kalakari & Rural Technology InstituteRs. Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial support to individual artisans for procuring essential tools like electric chalk and electric footmillRs. offering a substantial 75% subsidy on the tool cost. The scheme offers this significant subsidyRs. requiring a 25% beneficiary contributionRs. and ensures that assistance is provided solely in the form of instrumental supportRs. rather than cash. The applicant must fulfill specific criteriaRs. including being directly involved in pottery workRs. belonging to the Prajapati/Kumbhar caste or being another associated artisanRs. and falling within the prescribed age group of 18 to 50 years. The procurement of Tool under this scheme is managed by the Gujarat Rural Industries Marketing Federation (GRIMCO)Rs. and applications are accepted at the office of the institution as per the prescribed format.
benefits:
- Provision of tools such as an electric chalk and an electric footmill. - 75% subsidy on the cost of the tool. - The instrument assistance is to be used solely for the purpose for which it was given and for the potter's work. - The assistance will be given only in the form of instrumental assistance and not in cash.
_*The beneficiary must submit 25% of their contribution amount to the office of the institution through a demand draft in the name of 'GMK & RTI' of an authorized bank on the day disclosed by the organization._ _*The applicant must use the instrument assistance only for the purpose for which it has been given and for the matter involving the potter's work._ _*If the applicant misuses the assistanceRs. the amount of tool assistance given will be recovered by the revenue organization._ _*During verification by an officer of the institutionRs. if the instrument assistance is found not to have been used for the intended purposeRs. the amount of the instrument assistance given will be withdrawn._ _*The benefit of resource support will be available to only one person per family._ _*The delivery of the tool must be checked upon receiptRs. as no complaint of any kind of instrument will be taken into account after delivery._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be directly involved in the business of the Prajapati/Kumbhar caste. - The applicant should be directly involved in pottery work or pottery. - The applicant will have to give a certificate of competent authority for the purpose of doing pottery along with the application form. - The applicant can be another artisan associated with the pottery business who does potteryRs. provided they give a certificate of meaning along with the application form. - The applicant's age should be between 18 and 50 years. - The applicant must be the only person in their family applying for the benefit of resource support.
**Post-Selection Conditions** - The applicant shall have to use the instrument assistance for the purpose for which the instrument assistance has been givenRs. only for that purpose and for the matter involving the potter's work. - The applicant must ensure the instrument assistance is used as intended; otherwiseRs. the assistance amount will be withdrawn by the institution.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Training of Scheduled Caste Trainees" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of a stipend is provided to SC beneficiaries undergoing fisheries training to enhance their knowledge and skills. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of FisheriesRs. Government of Gujarat. **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits:
1. The trainee is paid a stipend of 1Rs./- after completing ten days of training. 1. The stipend is paid at the rate of 125/- per day.
> **Training Duration:** 10 days of fisheries training. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individualRs. a societyRs. a self-help groupRs. an associationRs. a reservoir monopolyRs. or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.

name: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand" is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand who are studying in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools located outside the state.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarships:** - 40Rs./- per annum for students from families with a monthly income up to 12Rs./-. - 30Rs./- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of 12Rs./- to 15Rs./-. - 20Rs./- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of 15Rs./- to 18Rs./-. - 10Rs./- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of 18Rs./- to 22Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be studying in Classes 6 to 12 in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand. - The scholarship will be awarded on the basis of the applicants family income. - The applicant is not eligible if the monthly family income exceeds 22Rs./-.

name: National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm: Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm
brief_description: The scheme component "Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat. aims to promote the cultivation of oil palmRs. enhance domestic productionRs. and reduce dependency on imports. The scheme provides assistance to farmers for maintenance and intercropping during the four-year gestation period of oil palm plantationsRs. ensuring the timely provision of essential inputs such as seedsRs. fertilizersRs. crop protection materialsRs. and other related resources.
benefits: - **First Year:** 10Rs./-. - **Second Year:** 10Rs./-. - **Third Year:** 10Rs./-. - **Fourth Year:** 10Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement
brief_description: The "Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to honor state agitators who became permanently disabled and bedridden during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement by providing them with monthly financial assistance.
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 20Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a participant of the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement. 1. The applicant must have become permanently disabled and completely bedridden due to incidents during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement.

name: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
brief_description: The scheme "Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 20Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow or widower of a recognized democracy fighter. 1. The applicants deceased spouse must have been imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.

name: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
brief_description: The "Residential - Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free educationRs. accommodationRs. mealsRs. study materialsRs. sports facilitiesRs. etc. across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.
benefits: - Students from Class 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodationRs. educationRs. mealsRs. sports facilitiesRs. and other essential services. - In these schoolsRs. 50% of the total seats are reserved for girls and 50% for boysRs. with 80% of the seats reserved for students from rural areas and 20% for students from urban areas. Reservations for SCRs. STRs. OBCRs. EWSRs. orphansRs. and other eligible categories are applicable within these seats. - Admissions to these schools are only for Class 6.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 5 in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed Classes 3 and 4 from the same school where the applicant is currently studying in Class 5.

name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel
brief_description: The scheme Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel is an initiative under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free hostel facilities to the children (both boys and girls) aged 6 to 18 years who are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. There are a total of 13 residential hostels in Dehradun (BaniyawalaRs. AragharRs. JhadipaniRs. Nabha House- Rishikesh)Rs. Haridwar (AlipurRs. LaladhangRs. Mohitpur)Rs. Pauri (SrinagarRs. Peethsain)Rs. Champawat and Udham Singh Nagar (GadarpurRs. KashipurRs. Sitarganj).
benefits: - All children residing in the hostels are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. - All hostel facilities are provided free of cost. - Children are also given a monthly stipend of 200/-.
eligibility: Free hostel facilities are provided to boys and girls aged 6 to 18 years who: - Belong to BPL families or whose family's annual income is less than 55Rs./-Rs. or - Belong to SC/ST/OBC or minority communitiesRs. or - Have one or both parents deceasedRs. or - Are children with disabilitiesRs. or - Are ragpickersRs. beggarsRs. or from urban deprived and weaker sections.

name: Yoga Wellness Center
brief_description: The Yoga Wellness Center is implemented by the Ayush DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote holistic health and wellness among people of all age groups through yogaRs. naturopathyRs. and personalized counseling.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. YogaRs. naturopathyRs. and counseling services are provided based on the individuals health condition. For thisRs. the OPD fee is 1.00 per person in rural areas and 2.00 per person in urban areas.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary can belong to any age group. 1. The beneficiary must be registered at an identified Government Ayurvedic Centre or Hospital.

name: Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr
brief_description: The scheme "Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve the rich experiences of veteran tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely to the development of TiatrRs. as their experiences form a part and parcel of the history of Tiatr for future generations. The scheme provides video recording of artistes' experiences on High Definition or higher format camera with preservation on Digital Versatile Disc at Tiatr Academy of Goa's Library and a onetime remuneration as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applicant must have made at least 20 years contribution to the Konkani stage and must be a script writerRs. directorRs. actorRs. singerRs. musicianRs. backstage artiste or organizer involved in tiatrs. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: > ***Financial Benefits*** - Onetime remuneration as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa to the artiste to be documented. - Additional amount as decided by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for artistes living outside Goa. - Remuneration to the interviewer as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. > ***Non-Financial Benefits*** - Video recording of artiste's experiences on High Definition or higher format camera. - Preservation of documentation on Digital Versatile Disc at Tiatr Academy of Goa's Library. - One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc provided to the artiste concerned. - Potential upload of recording on Tiatr Academy of Goa's websiteRs. other internet sitesRs. or other media channels.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a veteran artist who has contributed to the development of Tiatr. - The applicant must be a script writerRs. directorRs. actorRs. singerRs. musicianRs. backstage artiste involved in stage settingRs. light effectsRs. background musicRs. costumesRs. make-upRs. or those involved in organizing tiatrs. - The applicant must have made at least 20 years of contribution to the Konkani stage. - The applicant who is a writer or director must have scripted at least 15 tiatrs. - The applicant who is other than writer or director must have participated in at least 20 tiatrs. > ***PreferenceRs. Selection and Implementation*** - At least five artistes will be considered for documentation in a financial year. - Artistes will be selected by the Managing Committee of Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Preference will be given to old and sick artistes.

name: SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0
brief_description: The scheme "SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0"was launched by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM)Rs. Labour and Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide access to skill development programmes to a wide range of beneficiaries at taluka/village levelRs. enhancing employability and competitiveness in the job market while promoting entrepreneurship. The scheme provides Short-Term Training in National Skills Qualifications Framework Level 1Rs. 2Rs. and 3 courses along with Gujarat Council of Vocational Training coursesRs. and implements Special Projects for marginalized and vulnerable groups. The applicant must be a domicile of GujaratRs. looking for fresh skillsRs. reskillingRs. upskilling opportunities. The scheme is implemented by GSDM through empanelled Implementation Partners across all 33 districts of Gujarat. The applications are accepted online through the GSDM portal.
benefits: ##### ***Training Benefits*** - Short-Term Training of approximately 300 hours duration in National Skills Qualifications Framework/Gujarat Council of Vocational Training aligned courses. - On-the-Job Training as an integral part of Short-Term Training with duration determined by specific job roles. - Specialized training courses for Special Projects tailored to meet specific needs of marginalized and vulnerable groups. - Training conducted at Saksham Centers established at taluka/village level. - Access to certified Training of Trainers trainers endorsed by respective Sector Skill Councils. - Industry expert and entrepreneur guest lectures on rotational basis. ##### ***Assessment and Certification Benefits*** - Assessment and certification carried out by Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council of Vocational Training. - Assessment and certification fees paid directly by Gujarat Skill Development Mission. - Candidates eligible for assessment with minimum 70% attendance for classroom training and 70% for On-the-Job Training. ##### ***Employment Support Benefits*** - Placement assistance and employment opportunities from Implementation Partners. - Multiple placement options including wage employmentRs. probation with stipend/salaryRs. service aggregator portal registrationRs. job work acceptanceRs. self-employmentRs. and apprenticeship opportunities. - Post-placement tracking and support services. ##### ***Infrastructure and Facility Benefits*** - Training centers with basic amenities including drinking water and separate toilets for boys and girls. - Aadhaar-based biometric attendance system and Internet Protocol-based Closed-Circuit Television cameras with Digital Video Recorder systems. - Teaching aidsRs. furnitureRs. fittingsRs. and equipment as per job role requirements. ##### ***Conditions*** - Minimum 70% attendance required for classroom training to be eligible for completion. - Minimum 70% attendance required for On-the-Job Training to be eligible for completion. - Original Aadhaar card verification required during assessment to prevent duplication. - Adherence to batch timings from earliest 7:00 AM to latest 7:00 PM with minimum 4 hours and maximum 8 hours per day training.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a domicile of Gujarat. - The applicant must be minimum 14 years of age as per labour law for non-hazardous occupations. - The applicant must be maximum 59 years of age for Short Term Training. - The applicant must be maximum 65 years of age for Special Projects. - The applicant must be looking for fresh skillsRs. reskillingRs. or upskilling opportunities for Short Term Training. - The applicant must be out of educationRs. school/college dropoutRs. or unemployed youth for Short Term Training. - The applicant must belong to marginalizedRs. vulnerable groups requiring special attention or specific job roles for Special Projects. > ***Eligibility for Special Projects*** The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: _Jail InmatesRs. Former PrisonersRs. Juvenile homesRs. Scheduled CastesRs. WomenRs. Members of the Transgender CommunityRs. Members of the Beggar CommunityRs. Senior Citizens and Old age homesRs. Patients recovered from Mental illnessRs. Children in Shelter Homes and OrphanagesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Economically Backward CommunitiesRs. Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Rural ArtisansRs. or Migrant Workers._

name: Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2015-16Rs. the scheme "Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana" (also known as "Free Laboratory Testing Scheme") by the Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide quality diagnostic facilities without charge at all government health institutions and ensure timely and accurate diagnosis of diseases like malariaRs. tuberculosisRs. cancerRs. diabetesRs. hypertension to reduce morbidity and mortality in communities. The scheme provides free essential pathologyRs. biochemistryRs. hematologyRs. microbiology testing services at all government health institutions and strengthens existing laboratory facilities with quality equipment and trained staff along with regular supply of reagent kits. The applicant must be seeking healthcare services at government health facilities and require diagnostic testing for medical conditions. The scheme is implemented through a three-tier healthcare structure consisting of Sub Health CentersRs. Primary Health CentersRs. Community Health CentersRs. Sub-District HospitalsRs. District Hospitals and Medical Colleges with a total budget allocation of 200.94 croresRs. and applications are accepted offline at respective government healthcare facilities.
benefits: > **Primary Benefits** - Free Laboratory Testing Services: All essential pathologyRs. biochemistryRs. hematologyRs. and microbiology tests provided without any charge. - Diagnostic Facilities: X-rayRs. sonographyRs. and Electrocardiography services at Community Health Centers - Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Testing for communicable and non-communicable diseasesRs. maternal and child health conditions. > **Service Delivery** - Timely Diagnosis: Early detection of diseases like malariaRs. tuberculosisRs. cancerRs. diabetesRs. hypertension. - Quality Equipment: Modern diagnostic equipment and trained laboratory technicians. - Regular Supply: Continuous availability of reagent kits and testing materials. - Accessibility: Services available at doorstep through Sub Health CentersRs. Primary Health CentersRs. Community Health CentersRs. Sub-District HospitalsRs. District HospitalsRs. and Medical College hospitals. > **Implementation Structure** - Total Budget: 200.94 crores allocated for the scheme. - Two-Phase Implementation: First phase focuses on strengthening existing facilitiesRs. second phase adds new equipment and services. - Coordination System: Multi-tier coordination cells from state to facility level for effective implementation. > **Conditions for Availment** - Services available only at government healthcare institutions. - Testing must be prescribed by qualified medical officers. - Regular maintenance and quality checks of equipment ensured through designated coordination cells.
eligibility: - The applicant must be seeking healthcare services at any government health facility in Gujarat. - The applicant must require diagnostic testing as prescribed by a qualified medical officer. - The applicant must visit designated government healthcare institutions including Sub Health CentersRs. Primary Health CentersRs. Community Health CentersRs. Sub-District HospitalsRs. District HospitalsRs. or Medical College hospitals.

name: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2020Rs. the scheme "Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme" by the Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to victims of road traffic accidents to ensure timely treatment and reduce mortality rates. The scheme provides medical treatment packages ranging from 1Rs./- to 45Rs./- for various types of injuries and covers emergency medical proceduresRs. surgeriesRs. and hospitalization for accident victims. The applicant must be a victim of road traffic accident requiring immediate medical treatment and the treatment must be provided at empanelled hospitals under the scheme. The scheme is implemented by Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat and applications are accepted through participating hospitals where treatment is provided.
benefits:
**Medical Treatment Packages** Comprehensive treatment packages ranging from 1Rs./- to 45Rs./- covering various types of injuries:
**Package-wise Benefits** - Simple Injury-I (Package 1): 1Rs./- for treating simple woundsRs. injection Tetanus VaccinationRs. analgesicRs. antibioticsRs. general conditions checkRs. cleaningRs. suturing and dressing - Simple Injury-II (Package 2): 2Rs./- including face and scalp woundsRs. change of soiled cloth with disposable dressRs. intravenous lineRs. multiple lacerated wounds suturing - Deglove Injury of Extremities (Package 3): 12Rs./- for wound debridement in operation theatre under anaesthesiaRs. intravenous lineRs. intravenous antibioticsRs. remaining wounds suturing and inpatient treatment - Simple Fracture Without Anaesthesia (Package 4): 1Rs./- for closed reductionRs. cleaningRs. suturingRs. dressing of woundsRs. fracture stabilization with splint - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for First Fracture (Package 5): 4Rs./- including closed fracture reduction under short general anaesthesia with plastering and inpatient treatment - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for Additional Fracture (Package 6): 5Rs./- for additional fractures with similar treatment as Package 5 - Dislocation Reduction Under Anaesthesia (Package 7): 8Rs./- for joint dislocation reduction under general anaesthesia and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Small Bone (Package 8): 17Rs./- including internal/external fixation of fracture in compound fracturesRs. flap cover and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Large Bone (Package 9): 40Rs./- for large bone fractures with similar treatment as Package 8 - Inter Costal Drainage One Side (Package 10): 8Rs./- including intercostal drainage and inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral (Package 11): 11Rs./- for bilateral intercostal drainage with inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit (Package 12): 12Rs./- with Intensive Care Unit stay - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit and Ventilator (Package 13): 14Rs./- including ventilator support - Blunt Injury Abdomen (Package 14): 10Rs./- for suspected blunt injury abdomen with stabilization as inpatient - Blunt Injury Abdomen with Intensive Care Unit Stay (Package 15): 12Rs./- including Intensive Care Unit stay - Supra Pubic Cystostomy (Package 16): 5Rs./- including supra pubic cystectomy and inpatient treatment - Immobilization for Suspected Spine Injury (Package 17): 5Rs./- for non-operative management using spinal brace/collar - Cervical Spine Injury-Skeletal Tong Traction (Package 17): 25Rs./- with tong traction - Spine Injuries with Computed Tomography/Magnetic Resonance Imaging (Package 18): 7Rs./- including Computed Tomography scan/Magnetic Resonance Imaging - Tracheostomy (Package 19): 5Rs./- for tracheostomy procedure - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay Conservative (Package 20): 7Rs./- for non-operative management with Intensive Care Unit stay - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay with Ventilator (Package 21): 15Rs./- including ventilator support - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Surgical Intervention (Package 22): 25Rs./- for operative management including burr hole surgery - Blood Transfusion (Package 23): 1Rs./- per unit (maximum admissible 3 units) - Road Traffic Accident Injuries Associated with Burns Conservative Management (Package 24): 4Rs./- for conservative management of burns - Intensive Care Unit Stay Other than Head Injury (Package 25): 4Rs./- for non-head injury Intensive Care Unit care - Pelvic Injury-Conservative Management (Package 26): 20Rs./- for non-operative management with pelvic belt and traction - Pelvic Injury-External Fixation with Implant (Package 27): 45Rs./- for stabilization with external fixation and haemodynamic stabilization
**Mode of Disbursement** Cashless Treatment: Treatment provided at empanelled hospitals without upfront payment.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a victim of road traffic accident. - The applicant must require immediate medical treatment for injuries sustained in the accident. - The applicant must receive treatment at hospitals empanelled under the Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme. - The applicant must have Medico Legal Case registered for the accident. - The applicant must have police intimation with acknowledgment for the road traffic accident.

name: Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel
brief_description: The scheme "Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel" is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities for women with higher education or professional trainingRs. as well as working womenRs. to stay in urban areas.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. hostels have been arranged for women to stay in urban areas by paying a nominal fee. - Facilities include: AccommodationRs. MessRs. LibraryRs. GymRs. TV HallRs. CrecheRs. and more.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a woman pursuing higher education or professional trainingRs. or a working woman.

name: Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work
brief_description: The scheme "Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage research work in the field of Tiatr and facilitate writers to take up research work in different aspects of TiatrRs. its Song & Music. The scheme provides publication of research work in book form with a minimum of 500 copies printed and remuneration as fixed by TAG as per the researcher's experience. The applicant must be a researcher interested in writing books on tiatr after doing thorough research and must submit three typed copies of the manuscript for approval. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: > ***Publication Benefits*** - TAG will publish the research work in book form after thorough research on the subject. - The publication may be in English or Konkani (Roman Script). - TAG will print a minimum of 500 copies of the book. - 100 copies will be given to the writer. - The remaining copies will be used by TAG for various purposes. > ***Financial Benefits*** The author/researcher will be given remuneration as fixed by TAG as per his/her experience for the research work undertaken. > ***Editorial Support*** - The manuscript approved by the Recommendation Board shall be edited by a member of Editorial Board. - Editing will include checking for spelling and orthography. ***Conditions*** _*The manuscript received from the author/researcher will be considered for publication only after getting approval from the Recommendation Board appointed by TAG._ _*The author/researcher will have to provide TAGRs. 3 (three) typed copies of the manuscript._ _*If approvedRs. the author/researcher will have to submit a soft copy of the manuscript on a Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/pen drive._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a researcher interested in writing books on tiatr after doing thorough research on the subject. - Preference will be given to any researcher who has already done research on any aspect of TiatrRs. its Song & Music.

name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
brief_description: The scheme "Preservation of Tiatr Literature" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve the literature related to Tiatr/Khell Tiatr/KhellRs. their scriptsRs. lyrics of songs (kantaram)Rs. musicRs. scripts of one-act playsRs. and encourage script writers and lyricists to publish their works in book form. The scheme addresses the issue thatRs. although thousands of tiatrs have been produced and staged and songs (kantaram) composed and sung over the decadesRs. not many books of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays scripts and lyrics of songs (Kantaram) have been published. The scheme provides printing of scripts of tiatrs/khell tiatrs/khellsRs. one-act playsRs. lyrics of kantaram with or without music in book form in Konkani in Roman ScriptRs. and payment of honorarium along with free copies to eligible writers.
benefits:
##### ***Printing Services*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa will print scripts of tiatrs/khell tiatrs/khellsRs. one-act playsRs. lyrics of kantaram with or without music in book form in Konkani in Roman Script. - Minimum of 500 copies of each book will be printed.

name: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers
brief_description: The scheme "PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Govt. of India. The scheme aims to bridge the gap in supply and increasing demand in the field of geriatric caregiversRs. provide more professional services to senior citizensRs. and create a cadre of professional caregivers in geriatrics. The scheme provides training in four specific job roles: Geriatric Caregiver (Institutional & Home Care)Rs. Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical)Rs. Elderly Care CompanionRs. and Wellness Therapist for ElderlyRs. with an emphasis on physicalRs. mentalRs. and overall well-being of the elderly through a multi-disciplinary approachRs. including on-job training for specific courses. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment with the help of the National Institute of Social Defence. The applications for this scheme are accepted through registration on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH).
benefits: > ***Skill Training*** The scheme provides training to candidates in four specific job roles: Geriatric Caregiver (Institutional & Home Care) (480 hours)Rs. Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical) (360 hours)Rs. Elderly Care Companion (450 hours)Rs. and Wellness Therapist for Elderly (570 hours). > ***On-Job Training (OJT)*** For job roles as mandated by the National Council for Vocational Education and TrainingRs. On-Job Training is providedRs. with its duration guided by the approved qualification pack. > ***Assessment and Certification*** The skill assessment is conducted by empaneled Assessment AgenciesRs. and a certificate is made available to candidates in physical and digital formRs. along with corresponding 'credits' as per the National Credit Framework of MSDE. The assessment fee is provided under the scheme. > ***Re-assessment Opportunity*** Every candidate is offered one chance of re-assessment free of costRs. to be borne from the scheme. > ***Placement Support*** Apprenticeship is promotedRs. and training linked to captive placements (training and placement within the same industry) will be encouraged. Trainees are also encouraged to participate in Rozgar Melas for placementRs. with Training Institutes having tie-ups for proper placement.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must meet the minimum age as specified in the respective job role. - The applicant must be less than 40 years of age. - The applicant must have the minimum education qualification as per the required job roles. - The applicant must not indulge in any substance abuse.

- The applicant must be an Educational InstitutionRs. Cultural AssociationRs. Dramatic TroupeRs. or Individual. - The applicant must be interested in promoting Tiatr culture in the village. - The applicant must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (in case of MumbaiRs. Sindhudurg and other parts of the country). - The participating artistes must be from the particular village/urban area/parish (Educational Institutions only). - A maximum of 3 artistes from outside the village/urban areas/parish must be allowed to act as well as sing in the tiatr. - The tiatr must be produced in its original format including 6 or 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 'cantos' and comedy linked to the story of the play. - The tiatr must include at least 14 'Kantaram' which includes at least 2 DuetsRs. 1 DuoRs. 2 TriosRs. 1 Quartet/QuintetRs. 2 Choral Songs and Solos. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against casteRs. creed and religion in the scripts/lyrics of songs/performances/speeches which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. - The applicant must communicate the schedule of practices to Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance. - The applicant must discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide who will be the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour at the performance well in advance. - The applicant must ensure this is the first performance of the tiatr for which financial assistance is sought from Tiatr Academy of Goa.
***Script and Performance Requirements*** - The script and songs may be written/composed by anyone from within the village or elsewhere but acting and singing must be done by the artistes from the particular village/urban area/parish. - Musicians may be from anywhere and not necessarily from the village. - Advertising Requirements: In all advertisementsRs. oralRs. or print or electronic mediaRs. bannersRs. etc. the following must be inserted/published/announced 'This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa'.

name: Visit to Old/Sick Artistes
brief_description: The scheme "Visit to Old/Sick Artistes" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to make our younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of Tiatr artistes of yesteryears. TAG has observed that many veteran tiatr artistes who have contributed to the development of tiatr immensely in the pastRs. today have become oldRs. and often pass their time in sickness/loneliness. ThereforeRs. TAG has formulated this scheme so that occasional visits to these veteran artistes will make them feel that TAG cares for them during their old age.
benefits: - Members of tiatr fraternity will visit these sick/old artistes at their residences or if admittedRs. visit the hospital and inquire about their health. - TAG will provide the vehicle or travelling allowance to travel and refreshments/working meal to the members who volunteer to visit the old/sick artistes. - During the first visit of this natureRs. one-time financial assistance of Rs. 10Rs./- (or as fixed by TAG) by cheque will be gifted to the artiste which he/she can use for his/her medical expenses.
eligibility: 1. TAG will identify the sick/old tiatr artistes based on reports from the fraternity. 2. The artistes who have contributed at least 10 years towards tiatr (Commercial or Non-commercial) /khell tiatr/ khell or the writer/director who has staged at least 10 tiatrs (Commercial or Non-commercial) /khell tiatr/ khell will be eligible. 3. Members of tiatr fraternity must visit these sick/old artistes at their residences or if admittedRs. visit the hospital and inquire about their health.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)
brief_description: The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatrRs. its song and music in the pastRs. addressing the need to acknowledge their lifetime dedication to this traditional art form. The scheme provides a comprehensive recognition package including a shawlRs. mementoRs. citationRs. and cash award as fixed by Tiatr Academy of GoaRs. along with the prestige of being honored at a special function held annually on 14th December on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho FernandesRs. 'The Father of Tiatr'. The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age (with health-based relaxation provision) and must have at least 20 years of contribution in the field of tiatr with specific performance requirements based on their role. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers.
benefits: **Award Components:** ShawlRs. mementoRs. citationRs. and cash award as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa **Special Recognition Ceremony:** Honored at a special function organized on 14th December every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho FernandesRs. 'The Father of Tiatr' **Annual Limit:** Not more than 5 artistes from the field will be conferred with awards every year **Exclusivity:** Award conferred only once in a lifetime across all categories (Commercial/Non-Commercial TiatrRs. KhellRs. Khell-TiatrRs. or Konkani Cinema) _*The selected artiste must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
eligibility: - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have at least 20 years of contribution in the field of tiatr. - The applicantRs. if an actor/singer/Stage Manager/Lights provider/Make-up artist/Costume designer/Live Music/Background music provider/organizer/contractorRs. must have performed in at least 30 tiatrs. - The applicantRs. if a writer/directorRs. must have written/directed at least 20 tiatrs. - *The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artist is not well. ##### ***Assessment Criteria*** The applicant's excellence as an actorRs. script writerRs. directorRs. singerRs. lyricistRs. set designer will be considered. The applicant's receipt of any awards in their field will be evaluated. The applicant's innovations on the tiatr stage will be assessed. The applicant's songs (kantaram) recorded on recordsRs. cassettesRs. CDs/DVDs or online will be considered (if singer/musician). The applicant's work in dramas in other languages or films besides tiatr will be evaluated. The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be considered (if script writer or lyricist). ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award.

name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Right to Education Act 2009 is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free educationRs. textbooksRs. uniformsRs. and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana to children up to Class 8 in private schoolsRs. targeting rural and urban children from weaker and deprived sections of Uttarakhand.
benefits: - Under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education ActRs. children from weaker and disadvantaged sections in rural and urban areas of Uttarakhand are provided free educationRs. textbooksRs. uniformsRs. and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana up to Class 8 in private schools. - In private schoolsRs. 25% of the total seats in the entry-level class are reserved for children from weaker and disadvantaged sections under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act.
eligibility: **Children from the following categories will be eligible for admission up to Class 8 in private schools:** 1. **Children from weaker sections:** Those whose parents/guardians have an annual income of 55Rs./- or lessRs. or are BPL card holders. 1. **Children from disadvantaged classes:** SCRs. STRs. and children belonging to the non-creamy layer of OBCRs. with a family annual income of up to 4.5 lakh. 1. Orphan children. 1. Children with physical disabilities. 1. Children living with HIV/AIDS or those dependent on parents who are HIV/AIDS positive. 1. Children dependent on disabled parents or parents affected by leprosyRs. with a family annual income of less than 4.5 lakh. 1. Children dependent on a divorced or widowed motherRs. with an annual family income of less than 80Rs./-.

name: State Level Sports Awards - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme State Level Sports Awards was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize and honor players and coaches from Uttarakhand who have achieved remarkable success at the national and international levels in sports.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. in recognition of the remarkable success achieved by players and coaches of the state at the national and international levelsRs. the following awards are conferred: Khel Ratna (1 player 5.00 lakh)Rs. Himalaya Ratna (6 players 1.00 lakh per player)Rs. and Dronacharya Award (2 coaches 3.00 lakh per coach).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a player or coach who has achieved remarkable success at the national or international level in the field of sports.

name: Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE): Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons
brief_description: Launched on 12th February 2022Rs. Composite Medical Health for Transgender Persons is a component of the Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons sub-scheme of the Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE) scheme. The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide health Insurance coverage to all Transgender persons living in India to improve their health condition through proper treatment including sex re-assignment surgeries as well as medical support. The scheme provides health insurance in the form of Ayushman Bharat PlusRs. inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery and comprehensive transition-related healthcareRs. covering hormone therapy and post-operation formalitiesRs. redeemable at all private and government healthcare facilities.
benefits: - Health insurance cover of 5Rs./- (Five Lakh Rupees) per year. - Coverage is provided in the form of Ayushman Bharat Plus health insurance. - Coverage is inclusive of gender reaffirmation surgery within the health benefit package under Ayushman Bharat Yojana. - The comprehensive package covers all aspects of transition related healthcare for Transgender persons. - Coverage specifically includes hormone therapy and Sex Re-assignment surgery inclusive of post operation formalities. - Treatment for the beneficiary shall be cashless. The Government of India provides for 100% of the approved expenditure.
eligibility: - The applicant should be Transgender. - The applicant should not be availing similar benefits from any other schemes of the Central Government or State Government.

name: Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)
brief_description: The scheme "InformationRs. MonitoringRs. Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Govt. of India. The component Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) aims to intensely examine the implementation of schemes at the ground level and monitor scheme outputs and outcomes to ensure the quality of services being provided under these schemes. The scheme component provides for physical inspection of every scheme of the MinistryRs. such as Grant-in-Aid institutionsRs. scholarship holdersRs. free coaching schemesRs. implementation of projects under Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Caste Sub PlanRs. hostel schemesRs. and Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana villages.
benefits: - ***Financial Outlay:*** The total financial outlay for the Project Monitoring Unit component for 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) is 52Rs./- (52.5 Crore). - ***Annual Financial Outlay Breakdown (in Indian Rupee):*** 2021-22: 9Rs./- 2022-23: 10Rs./- 2023-24: 10Rs./- 2024-25: 10Rs./- 2025-26: 11Rs./- - ***Field Inspections Target:*** A total of 32Rs. field inspections are targeted to be conducted by the Project Monitoring Unit over the 5-year period from 2021-22 to 2025-26.- ***Human Resource Requirement:*** The number of Project Monitoring Unit members needed will increase from 40 (initially) to 49 by the year 2025-26.- ***Flow of Funds:*** Funds will be provided by the Ministry to the National Institute of Social Defence (NISD)Rs. which is the implementing agency for the Project Monitoring Unit.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a fresh graduate. - The applicant must be selected from top Colleges/Universities/Research Institutes as per the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Information Technology (IT) skills. - The applicant must be selected based on modalities determined by the Ministry to ensure they are among the brightest and best students along with social consciousness.

name: AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens
brief_description: The scheme "AVYAY - National Action Plan for Senior Citizens: Health and Shelter for Senior Citizens" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Govt. of India. The scheme is a component of the umbrella scheme " Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)". The scheme aims to improve the quality of life of Senior CitizensRs. particularly those who are indigentRs. by providing basic amenities like shelterRs. foodRs. medical care and entertainment opportunities. The scheme provides financial assistance for projects such as the maintenance of Senior Citizen Homes (popularly known as Old Age Homes)Rs. Continuous Care HomesRs. Regional Resource and Training Centres (RRTCs)Rs. Mobile Medicare UnitsRs. and Physiotherapy Clinics under its two sub-schemes: the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPSrC) and the State Action Plan for Senior Citizens (SAPSrC).
benefits:
**Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Senior Citizen Homes (25 beneficiaries)** Annual recurring expenditure grants are provided based on the classification of the city (XRs. YRs. or Z)Rs. ranging from 25Rs./- (X Category) to 24Rs./- (Z Category). **Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Senior Citizen Homes (50 beneficiaries/50 elderly women only)** Annual recurring expenditure grants range from 42Rs./- (X Category) to 41Rs./- (Z Category). **Grant-in-Aid (GIA) for Continuous Care Homes (minimum 20 beneficiaries)** Annual recurring expenditure grants range from 30Rs./- (X Category) to 30Rs./- (Z Category). **Non-Recurring Grant for Senior Citizen Homes (25 indigent)** A grant of 3Rs./- is admissible every five yearsRs. which includes the cost of Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras and website development charges. **Non-Recurring Grant for Senior Citizen Homes (50 indigent)** A grant of 4Rs./- is admissible every five years. **Non-Recurring Grant for Continuous Care Homes (20 indigent)** A grant of 3Rs./- is admissible every five years. **Funeral Expenses** Reimbursement of funeral expenses is provided at 10Rs./- per person or the actual expenses incurredRs. whichever is lessRs. in case of the demise of any inmate. **State Action Plan for Senior Citizens (SAPSrC) Funding** Financial support equivalent to 90% of the project cost is provided for admissible programmes proposed under State Action Plans.
##### ***Disbursal ModeRs. FrequencyRs. and Conditions*** - Grant-in-aid is provided through the E-anudaan portal and the Public Financial Management System (PFMS)/ExpenditureRs. Audit and Tender (EAT) module. - The total annual grant is released in two equal half-yearly instalments. ***Conditions for Disbursement*** - Recurring Grant-in-aid for Senior Citizen Homes is based on the number of days of attendance of beneficiaries as recorded through a contactless Information Technology (IT) system. - The second half-yearly instalment is released only after the inspection report of the State GovernmentRs. the officers of the Central MinistryRs. or the Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) is received. ***Conditions for Continuation*** - Implementing Agencies must maintain the standards laid down in the scheme guidelines. - Implementing Agencies must use the ExpenditureRs. Audit and Tender (EAT) module of the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). - Implementing Agencies must provide live streaming of the institution's functioning via Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras on their websites/E-anudaan website. - The assistance provided is subject to the Implementing Agency maintaining the institution in the manner prescribed in the guidelines and standards.
eligibility: ##### ***For Senior Citizens*** 1. The applicant must be a Senior Citizen. 2. The applicant must be one of the following: - IndigentRs. having no sufficient means to maintain himself/herselfRs. as determined by the State Government. - Afflicted with Alzheimer's disease/Dementia or seriously ill requiring continuous nursing careRs. for admittance into Continuous Care Homes. ##### ***For Implementing Agencies (General)*** 1. The applicant must be one of the following: - State/Union Territory Government. - Panchayati Raj Institution (PRI). - Urban Local Body (ULB). - An Institution or Organization set up by the Government as autonomous/subordinate bodies. - A Government Recognized Educational Institution. - A recognized youth organization such as Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS). ##### ***For Implementing Agencies (Non-Governmental Organizations/Voluntary Organizations)*** 1. The applicant must be registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860 (XXI of 1860) or any relevant Act of the State/Union Territory. 2. The applicant must be one of the following: - A Public Trust registered under the law for the time being in force. - A charitable company licensed under Section 25 of the Companies ActRs. 1958. - Indian Red Cross Society or its branches. - Any other public body or institution having a legal status of its own. - Any other organization of reputeRs. which may be approved by the SecretaryRs. Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. 3. The applicant (Voluntary Organization) should have been registered for at least two years. 4. The applicant should have had at least two years' experience in the social sector at the time of applying for the grant. 5. The applicant must have a Bank Account maintained and operated in the joint name of the Non-Governmental Organization/Voluntary Organization. 6. The applicant (for Continuous Care Homes) must have shown a credible track record in running Charitable Hospitals/Nursing Homes/Medical Institutions/Colleges. ##### ***Preference/Priority*** The applicant agency will be selected in the order of preference as follows: Self Help Groups of the senior citizensRs. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Foundations/Charities already in the field of elderly careRs. Start-ups in the segment of elderly careRs. and Non-Governmental Organizations/Trusts operating in the elderly care segment.

name: Samriddhi Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups
brief_description: The scheme "Samriddhi Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups" was launched by the All India Council for Technical Education. The scheme aims to provide opportunities for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students to designRs. launchRs. and run their own business or startup after formal education is completed or during their final year of education. The scheme provides a limited one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- (of which 1Rs./- per year is a recurring grant) to the instituteRs. which then selects nine registered startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students and provides 2Rs./- seed money to each startup.
benefits: - Total funding provided is 20Rs./-. - Limited one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided to the Institute. - Seed money of 2Rs./- per startup will be givenRs. and this amount is non-refundable. - Funding is allocated for nine startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students. - 2Rs./- will be given to the institute specifically for meeting the expenditure associated with the selection procedure. - 1Rs./- per year shall constitute a recurring grant portion of the total funding. > ***Other Details*** - The total duration of the Scheme shall be for a period of 2 years. - 100% of non-recurring funds are released at the time of the award of the scheme. - 1Rs./- each is released as recurring funding for two consecutive years. - The seed money is provided to passed out or present students for starting their own enterprise after completion of the formal education from the same institute. > ***Conditions*** - The Institute must set up a committee to select nine already registered startups of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students. - It is essential that the center has dedicated faculty serving as the Principal Coordinator and dedicated support staff to ensure smooth functioning and effective meeting of its objectives. - The Institute must devise a feedback mechanism to assess the importance of the program. - Feedback shall be obtained after each program from each of the beneficiaries. - If deemed necessary based on feedbackRs. the Institute can update its curriculum for these programs. - Exclusions from Benefit - Startup beneficiaries who are already receiving benefits from other schemes of the All India Council for Technical Education or the Government of India will not be entitled to this scheme.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) approved institute or an All India Council for Technical Education approved University Department. - The applicant (Institute/University Department) must have been in existence for a period of at least 10 years. - The applicant (Institution) must possess a good incubation center. - The incubation center's activities must have been happening for at least 5 years. - The applicant (Institute) must have a minimum of 50 Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students enrolled on average during the last 3 years. - The applicant (Institute) must comply with the guidelines of the Tribal Sub Plan and the Scheduled Caste Sub Plan of the Government of India. - Student Eligibility (For selection by the Institute) - The applicant (Student) must be in the final year of their degree or diploma course. - The applicant (Student) must have a registered company or startup in their name.

name: Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Completely Damaged/Destroyed Houses is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals whose residential houses have been completely or partially damaged due to natural disasters in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided: - Pucca houseRs. Kutcha houseRs. severely damaged/destroyed houseRs. or partially damaged/destroyed house: 1Rs./- per house in plain areas. - For hilly areas (including districts covered under the Integrated Action Plan): 1Rs./- per house. - Pucca house (other than hut) with at least 15% damage: 6Rs./- per house. - Kutcha house (other than hut) with at least 15% damage: 4Rs./- per house. - Damaged/destroyed hut: 8Rs./- per hut. (A hut means a temporaryRs. transferableRs. and below-grade unit constructed with materials such as thatchRs. mudRs. or plasticRs. and is traditionally recognised as a hut by the State/District Administration.) Note: The damaged house must be verified as an authorised construction by the competent authority of the State Government. - Cattle shed attached to the house: 3Rs./- per cattle shed.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be the owner of a disaster-affected house.

name: Akhil Bhartiya Veda Sammelan and Akhil Bhartiya Jyotish Vastu Sammelan
brief_description: The scheme Akhil Bhartiya Veda Sammelan and Akhil Bhartiya Jyotish Vastu Sammelan is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a platform for scholars engaged in the studyRs. teachingRs. propagationRs. and research of VedasRs. AstrologyRs. and Vastu Shastra to participate in the conference.
benefits: In the conferenceRs. scholars gain the opportunity to understand the subtle knowledge of Vedic literatureRs. AstrologyRs. and Vastu Shastra; interpret the scriptures from a contemporary perspective; exchange knowledge and receive certificates of participation.
eligibility: 1. Scholars engaged in the studyRs. teachingRs. propagationRs. and research of the VedasRs. AstrologyRs. and Vastu Shastra will be eligible to participate in the respective conference.

name: CM-Vashistha Guru Puraskar
brief_description: The scheme CM-Vashistha Guru Puraskar was launched by the Directorate of EducationRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the state and to honour those teachers who through their commitment and industry have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students. The scheme provides State Awards to TeachersRs. with each award consisting of a cash amount of 1Rs./- (Rupees One Lakh) and a citation.
benefits: **Cash Award:** 1Rs./- (Rupees One Lakh). **Citation:** Provided with each award. **Total 10 Awards:** - Primary Teacher: Two Awards (One in each District). - Secondary Teacher: Four Awards (Two in each District). - High School Headmaster: Two Awards (One in each District). - Higher Secondary Teacher: One Award (One in entire State). - Higher Secondary Principal: One Award (One in entire State). _*The recipients will be felicitated at the hands of the Chief Minister of Goa during the Teachers Day function._ _*The selected teachers will have to make a presentation before the State Level Committee._
eligibility: ***Target Group Definition*** The applicant must be a school teacherRs. special educatorRs. or Head of School. The applicant must be working in a recognized government or aided primaryRs. middleRs. highRs. or higher secondary school. The applicant must be an in-service teacher. The applicant must fulfill the required academic and professional qualifications as per their cadre for the State Award to Teachers. ***Service Requirements*** The applicantRs. if an in-service Regular Teacher or Special EducatorRs. must have completed at least 15 years of regular teaching service in the State of Goa as on June 30th of the academic year for which they are applying. The applicantRs. if a HeadmasterRs. must have 5 years of administrative experience out of the required 15 years of regular teaching service in the State of Goa. ***Preference/Reservation*** One award out of the 10 is reserved for a differently abled teacher or Head of the School/Special Educator from Regular or Special Schools. The applicant applying for the Differently Abled Category must attach a disability certificate indicating more than 40% disability.

name: Vidhyadeep Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Vidhyadeep Yojana was launched by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to students studying in primaryRs. secondaryRs. and higher secondary schools in the State.
