The scheme provides maximum financial assistance up to 50Rs./- per student in case of accidental death or permanent total disability. The scheme is implemented by the State Insurance Fund (Directorate of Insurance) or private/public sector general insurance companies. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Office of the District Primary Education Officer / District Education Officer / Administrative Officer (through the Principal of the school concerned).
benefits: > ***Accidental Death*** 50Rs./- per student. > ***Accidental Permanent Disability*** - In case of loss of two eyes or both limbs or arm/leg due to accident: 50Rs./-. - In case of loss of one eye and one limb due to accident: 50Rs./-. - In case of loss of one eye or one limb due to accident: 25Rs./-. > ***Conditions*** - The incident must be unexpectedRs. suddenRs. and unintentionalRs. and show visible signs of external violence. - The claim application must be submitted to the Nodal Officer within ninety (90) days from the date of the accident or death. - The benefit amount must not be paid for more than one category if the beneficiary is covered under multiple categories of the overall scheme.
eligibility: > ***For the Student Beneficiary*** - The beneficiary must be a student studying in all PrimaryRs. SecondaryRs. and Higher Secondary schools of Gujarat. > ***For the Applicant/Claimant*** - The applicant must be the successor or the disabled beneficiary themselves in case of permanent disability. - The applicant must appear in person with the original identity card. - The applicant must submit the written application in the prescribed format to the local Nodal/Competent Officer. - The application must be submitted within ninety (90) days from the date of death or accident.

name: S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students
brief_description: The scheme "S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government PrimaryRs. Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students" was launched by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide concession in bus fare fees to the students studying in PrimaryRs. SecondaryRs. Higher SecondaryRs. and Higher Secondary Technical Education in Government and Non-Government schools. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC). The application for this scheme is accepted online.
benefits: Concession in Fees of the Buses of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a Student. - The applicant must be a Girl. - The applicant must be studying in Primary / Secondary / Higher Secondary / Higher Secondary Technical Education. - The applicant must be studying in a Government or Non-Government School.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Medical Treatment" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members in indigent circumstances to meet expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitalsRs. including travelling and accommodation expenses outside the state for treatment. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance shall be sanctioned to meet the expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals. - Financial assistance shall be provided to meet the expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members. - The maximum financial assistance under this category shall not exceed 50Rs./-. - The Government may relax the ceiling in case of major chronic ailments. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode. - The disbursement shall be one-time financial assistance. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary shall not avail the benefit of medical reimbursement from any other Government department or under any schemes or policies for the medical treatment for which the financial assistance is granted under this scheme. - The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers shall be furnished to the department after availing the treatment. - The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount if any shall be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
eligibility: - The applicant must be any Goan aged needy artistRs. born and brought up in the state of Goa. - The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The applicant must have an annual family income from all sources not exceeding 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age. **Relaxation** The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.

name: Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi
brief_description: The scheme Kisan-Vaigyanik Sangoshthi is implemented by the Uttarakhand Council for Biotechnology under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to guide farmers and youth in biotechnology-based farming and animal husbandry by providing technical training and solutions to enhance self-employment and income generation.
benefits: Through Kisan-Vaigyanik SangoshthiRs. the Council provides technical guidance from subject matter experts to the states farmersRs. helping to address challenges in biotechnology-based agriculture and animal husbandry. The Council also continuously works to improve farmers livelihoods and promote self-employment by sharing technical knowledge on hydroponicsRs. soilless farmingRs. kiwifruit cultivationRs. fish farmingRs. beekeepingRs. vegetable productionRs. and floriculture.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youthRs. a farmerRs. a member of a self-help groupRs. or a livestock farmer.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Incentive for Self-Employment" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding 50Rs./- or the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment venturesRs. helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: > ***Financial Assistance*** - 50Rs./- or the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. shall be provided for setting up self employment venture. - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode. - The assistance is provided as a one-time grant. > ***Conditions*** - The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers must be furnished to the department after utilizing the grant. - The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amountRs. if anyRs. shall be refunded to the Government within the stipulated timeframe.
eligibility: - The applicant must be GoanRs. i.e.Rs. born and brought up in Goa. - The artist must be an artist recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must not be employed or self-employed at the time of application.

name: Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students
brief_description: The scheme Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage WomenRs. Women ScientistsRs. Teachers and Young Students is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of womenRs. women scientistsRs. teachersRs. and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development among studentsRs. teachersRs. and women of the stateRs. the following conclaves are organized and felicitations are given: - Yuva-Bal Samagam: Medhavi Chhatra Samman - Teacher/Science Conclave: Vigyan Prasar Samman - Woman Scientists Conclave: Utkrisht Yuva Mahila Vaigyanik Samman - Mahila Prayogdharmi Samman
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand state. 1. The applicant must be a studentRs. teacherRs. womanRs. and the general public.

name: USERC Establishment and Operation of Entrepreneurship Development Centers
brief_description: The scheme Establishment and Operation of Entrepreneurship Development Centers is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to establish and operate Entrepreneurship Development Centers to provide structured training in entrepreneurship to studentsRs. womenRs. and the general public of the state.
benefits: In the U-SERC Entrepreneurship Development CentresRs. training in entrepreneurship development is provided to students of the areaRs. womenRs. and the general public.
eligibility: 1. All studentsRs. womenRs. and general public in Uttarakhand will be eligible to receive the training.

name: Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals
brief_description: The Compensation for Livestock Loss Caused by Wild Animals scheme is launched by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals whose livestock is injured or killed by wild animals. The scheme applies to both urban and rural areas and covers a variety of livestock including cowsRs. buffaloesRs. camelsRs. goatsRs. sheepRs. donkeysRs. mulesRs. and pigs.
benefits: **Compensation Amounts:** - Dairy animals (cowRs. buffaloRs. camel): 30Rs. - Sheep/Goat: 3Rs. - Non-dairy animals (bullRs. buffaloRs. camelRs. horse): 25Rs. - Young animals (calf of cow/buffalo/horse/camel)Rs. Donkey/Mule: 16Rs. - Pig: 3Rs. **Injury Compensation:** - 50% of the amount payable for injury under revenue circular provisions. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Compensation is paid directly to the beneficiary via e-payment. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - Compensation is provided within 30 working days of claim verification.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be the owner of the livestock injured or killed by wild animals.

name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)" scheme is implemented by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to enhance milk productionRs. promote improved livestock breedingRs. and support small and marginal livestock farmers by providing two high genetic qualityRs. pregnant Murrah buffaloes (five months or more)Rs. each yielding an average of 8 to 10 liters of milk per dayRs. on a subsidy basis to ensure early productivity.
benefits: > **Subsidy Process:** - General Category: 50% subsidy and 50% beneficiary contribution. - Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. and Scheduled Caste farmers: 75% subsidy and 25% beneficiary contribution. - Provision of 2 Murrah Buffaloes with high genetic qualityRs. each yielding 810 liters of milk daily. - Pregnant buffaloes (5 months or more) are provided to ensure immediate milk production.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a resident of SehoreRs. VidishaRs. or Raisen districtRs. where the scheme is currently implemented. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer. 1. The applicant must belong to the GeneralRs. Schedule CasteRs. or Schedule Tribe category. 1. The applicant must have basic infrastructure for maintaining two dairy animalsRs. such as a shed and water availability.

name: Bal Shakti Yojana
brief_description: The Bal Shakti Yojana was launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical EducationRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. It aims to reduce child mortality caused by severe malnutrition among children below 5 years of age. The scheme provides free medical careRs. nutrition rehabilitationRs. dietRs. and transport through 315 Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs) across the state.
benefits: - Free institutional management and treatment for severely malnourished and sick children at Nutrition Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs). - Free balanced diet - Free medical check-upRs. medicinesRs. and diagnostic services for enrolled children. - Free transport facility. - Counselling and training sessions. - Nutritional awareness.
eligibility: 1. The child should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a child below 5 years of age. 1. The child must be severely malnourished or sick and meet at least one of the following criteria: - Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) less than 11.5 cm. - Weight-for-height Z-score less than -3 SD (standard deviation). - Bilateral pitting oedema (swelling on both feet).

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital component of the scheme offers a capital subsidy rate of 10% or 15% (for special categories) of fixed capital invested in Fixed AssetsRs. capped between 25Rs./- to 50Rs./- per unit per yearRs. depending on the project category and location. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa Online Portal.
benefits:
##### **Standard Projects** - Eligible entities (Logistics Parks (Multi-modal/Integrated)Rs. Inland Container DepotsRs. Container Freight StationsRs. Air Freight StationsRs. WarehousesRs. Cold Chain UnitsRs. Testing FacilitiesRs. Truck Terminals) are entitled to 10% of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets. - **Maximum Amount:** Capped at 25Rs./- per unit per year. ##### **Special Category Projects** - Eligible entities (Projects constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities) are entitled to 15% of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets. - **Maximum Amount:** Capped at 50Rs./- per unit per year. ##### ***Benefit Disbursal Criteria/Conditions*** - **Mode and Frequency:** The processing of the application and the disbursement of the incentive amount must be completed within a maximum period of 90 days from the date of application received. Disbursement is performed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC).- **Time/Chronology:** All sanctioned claims will be organized chronologically and disbursed to the respective entities following due procedure.- **Sanction Basis:** The subsidy shall be sanctioned to aided entities within the project cost approved by the Financial Institution and an empanelled Chartered Accountant.- **Employment Criteria:** The quantum of benefit sanctioned is determined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls:- If Goan employment is 60% or aboveRs. the entity receives 100% of the calculated benefit. - If Goan employment is more than 40% but less than 60%Rs. the entity receives 80% of the calculated benefit.
##### ***Conditions*** - The entity must grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted. - The entity must submit all necessary reportsRs. informationRs. and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC) time to time or as and when required. - The entity must ensure that the information and documents submitted are correctRs. otherwiseRs. if found incorrect or falseRs. the financial incentive shall be revoked. - The entity undertakes to refund 10 times the concessions claimed if the benefits were obtained by misrepresentation of facts or in case of misuse.
eligibility: - The applicant must not be classified as a Mega Project. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services providerRs. as the categories of business activities listed in Annexure-XI are exhaustive. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment. - The applicant must submit claims in the prescribed application form (ANNEXURE-II) through the Goa Online Portal. - The applicant must ensure that the unit was not set up with second-hand machinery. - The applicant must ensure that the value of plantRs. machineryRs. and equipment procured has not previously enjoyed any incentives under any earlier incentive schemes. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (Must be met at time of application/claim)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics ParkRs. Inland Container DepotRs. or Container Freight Stations. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1Rs. square meters for Air Freight StationsRs. WarehousesRs. or Truck Terminals. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 200 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (For Special Categories)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics ParkRs. Inland Container DepotRs. or Container Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1Rs. square meters for Air Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 500 square meters for Warehouses or Truck Terminals if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 100 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities.

name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Kamdhenu Yojana
brief_description: The "Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Kamdhenu Yojana" scheme was launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide business opportunities in the dairy sectorRs. especially to unemployed youthsRs. increase milk productionRs. strengthen economic conditionsRs. and enable farmers will get economic benefits even in adverse circumstances.
benefits:
> **Loan will be disbursed in four stages (Amount in Lakhs)** Stages of PaymentTime PeriodComponent DescriptionIndigenous Breed ( in Lakh)Crossbred/Hybrid/ Buffalo ( in Lakh)First installment1st MonthShed Construction11Rs.Second installment4th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport9Rs.Third installment10th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport8Rs.First installment18th MonthAnimal Purchase + Insurance + Transport8Rs.Total 36Rs.
- Financial assistance for the construction of cattle shedsRs. the purchase of high-yielding milch cattleRs. cattle insuranceRs. and transportation costs. - Each unit consists of 25 cattle (either all crossbred cowsRs. indigenous cowsRs. or buffaloes of similar breeds). - A beneficiary can avail up to 8 units (200 cattle) depending on landholding and repayment record. - Loan amount ranges from 36Rs. (for indigenous breed units) to 42Rs. (for crossbred cows/buffalo units). - The scheme ensures insurance coverage for cattleRs. shedsRs. and transit risks. - Tagging of purchased animals is mandatory and registered on the Bharat Pashudhan App. - Preference is given to farmers already supplying milk to milk unions or located along milk collection routes. - The disbursement occurs over an 18-month period in stages. - The beneficiary becomes eligible for another unit after 2 yearsRs. provided the earlier loan is regularly repaid.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be at least 21 years of age. - The applicant must be a livestock farmer. - The applicant belongs to all categories: SCRs. STRs. and others are eligible to apply. - The applicant must possess a minimum of 3.5 acres of agricultural land per unit (25 cattle). - The applicant can apply for up to 8 unitsRs. with land requirement increasing proportionately. - The applicants familys collective landholding can be considered; in such casesRs. there will be co-borrowers. - For scattered landholdingsRs. at least half an acre must be in one location. - The applicant must hold a training certificate from a reputed institute/organization in dairy management.

name: Solar Based Hydroponic System
brief_description: The scheme Solar Based Hydroponic System is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to develop and promote an innovative solar-based hydroponic system that integrates solar energy with modern greenhouse technology and mobile application support.
benefits: A solar-based hydroponic system has been installed at UCOST Dehradun. The solar-based hydroponic system is the latest research in the stateRs. in which an innovative and integrated solar greenhouse-based hydroponic solution and an Android mobile application have been developed for farmers and consumers. Benefit: The automated solar-based hydroponic system will reduce energy consumptionRs. minimize water usageRs. and enhance crop yields. The system also has the potential to serve as an entrepreneurial or business model and can be replicated in other Himalayan statesRs. thereby creating improved livelihood opportunities for hill farmers and youth. Smaller off-grid models of solar-based hydroponic systemsRs. proposed to be developed in addition to on-grid systemsRs. can be installed in remote areas where electricity supply is a major issue. This would help increase the individual income of hill farmers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmerRs. researcherRs. studentRs. or entrepreneur. 1. AnnuallyRs. over 500 farmersRs. consumersRs. researchersRs. studentsRs. and entrepreneurs benefit from this system.

name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of 'Electric Vehicles' to Consumers in State of Goa
brief_description: The scheme "Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of 'Electric Vehicles' to Consumers in State of Goa" was launched by the Department of New and Renewable EnergyRs. Government of Goa. The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy for the purchase or conversion of Electric two-wheelersRs. three-wheelersRs. and four-wheelersRs. along with scrapping incentives for old vehiclesRs. incentives for local manufacturing in GoaRs. and low-cost loans provided by Convergence Energy Services Limited (CESL). The scheme is implemented by the Goa Energy Development Agency (GEDA). The applications for this scheme are accepted on a First Come First Serve (FCFS) basis.
benefits:
##### ***State Subsidy (Quantum of Subsidy per kilowatt-hour)*** - Financial Year 2021-2022: 10Rs./- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two WheelersRs. Three WheelersRs. and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2022-2023: 8Rs./- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two WheelersRs. Three WheelersRs. and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2023-2024: 6Rs./- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two WheelersRs. Three WheelersRs. and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2024-2025: 4Rs./- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two WheelersRs. Three WheelersRs. and Four Wheelers. - Financial Year 2025-2026: 2Rs./- per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for Two WheelersRs. Three WheelersRs. and Four Wheelers. ##### ***Capping of State Subsidy (Maximum amounts)*** - Two Wheeler: Not exceeding 30Rs./- (for a maximum of 3Rs. vehicles). - Three Wheeler: Not exceeding 60Rs./- (for a maximum of 50 vehicles). - Four Wheeler: Not exceeding 3Rs./- (for a maximum of 300 vehicles). ##### ***Scrapping Incentives (Goa Government Incentive for scrapping of vehicle)*** - Two Wheeler: 5Rs./-. - Three Wheeler: 10Rs./-. - Four Wheeler: 10Rs./-. ##### ***Other Contribution for Scrapping of Vehicle by Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or Convergence Energy Services Limited (CESL)*** - Two Wheeler: 5Rs./-. - Three Wheeler: Not applicable (NIL). - Four Wheeler: Not applicable (NIL). - Incentive for Vehicle Manufactured in Goa: - Two Wheeler: 5Rs./-. - Three Wheeler: 10Rs./-. - Four Wheeler: 15Rs./-. ***Central Government Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles (FAME)-II Scheme Subsidy:*** Provided as applicable. ***Low Cost Loans:*** Convergence Energy Services Limited will provide low cost loans to the consumer for the purchase of an Electric Vehicle if the vehicle is purchased from Convergence Energy Services Limited. ***Training and Capacity Building:*** Convergence Energy Services Limited will provide training/capacity building to local youths in the field of servicing of electric vehicles.
##### ***Benefit Disbursal Conditions*** - The total amount of financial subsidy will be decided by the Department of New and Renewable Energy. - Disbursement will be done on a First Come First Serve (FCFS) basis. - The subsidy shall be disbursed in a single installment to the beneficiary concernedRs. which is 100% on purchase or conversion of the vehicle. - The Purchase Incentive for conversion of an Old Internal Combustion Engine vehicle into an Electric Vehicle by a retrofitting kit will be provided as per the capacity of the battery or maximum up to the capping of the State subsidyRs. whichever is lower. - If a consumer opts to purchase an Electric Vehicle directly from a dealer and avail benefits from the Government of GoaRs. the financial assistance from Convergence Energy Services Limited will not be available. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - The beneficiary must ensure that the purchase incentive for conversion is subject to the approval of the retrofitting kit by the Regional Transport Office. - The registered owner of an Electric Vehicle claiming a Scrapping Incentive must obtain confirmation of scrapping and de-registration of the old Internal Combustion Engine vehicle by the Regional Transport OfficeRs. as reimbursement is subject to this confirmation.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Goa. - The applicant must be the registered owner of the Electric Vehicle for which the Purchase Incentive is claimed. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle is an Electric Two WheelerRs. Three WheelerRs. or Four Wheeler purchased or converted in the State of Goa. - The applicant must purchase the Electric Vehicle from Convergence Energy Services Limited to avail of their low-cost loans and financial incentives.

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Logistics Management Software
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy towards Upgradation in Logistics Management Software component of the scheme provides financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement covering 50% of the expenditure incurred on the purchase and installation of logistics management softwareRs. which is capped at 2Rs./- per installation for each entityRs. provided the installed software directly contributes to the efficiency of logisticsRs. transportationRs. shippingRs. freight forwardingRs. or warehousing operations. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC). The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.
benefits: - A one-time reimbursement equating to 50% of the expenditure incurred on the purchase and installation of logistics management software. - The reimbursement is capped at 2Rs./- per installation for each entity. - The scope of Logistics Management Software eligible for subsidy encompassesRs. but is not limited toRs. the following systems: Transportation Management System (TMS)Rs. Warehouse Management System (WMS)Rs. Fleet Management SystemRs. Hub Management SystemRs. Route optimization softwareRs. Reverse logistics softwareRs. and Rating and Billing system for logistics and warehousing units. - The installed software must directly contribute to the efficiency of logisticsRs. transportationRs. shippingRs. freight forwardingRs. or warehousing operations to qualify for the incentive. ##### ***Conditions*** - This is a one-time reimbursement. - Each entity is entitled to benefit from this scheme once per year. - The claims pertain to expenses incurred after the official announcement of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The benefits under this scheme are subject to first come first serve basis subject to availability of funds in a particular fiscal year. ##### ***Continuation*** - The entity must submit all necessary reportsRs. informationRs. and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)Rs. time to time or as and when required. - The entity must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government. - The entity undertakes to refund 10 times the concessions claimed if found obtained by misrepresentation of facts or in case of misuse.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a non-mega industry (projects with investment of less than 100Rs./- and/or employment generation of less than 1Rs. Goans). - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must possess a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity (proprietor in the case of sole proprietorshipRs. firm in case of partnershipRs. and in the name of the company in case of Private Limited companiesRs. etc.). - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses for the software upgrade post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must ensure the installed software directly contributes to the efficiency of logisticsRs. transportationRs. shippingRs. freight forwardingRs. or warehousing operations. - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). ##### ***Quantum of Benefit Criteria*** The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls: - The applicant must have 60% or above Goan employment to receive 100% of the benefit. - The applicant must have more than 40% but less than 60% Goan employment to receive 80% of the benefit. - The applicant must have less than 40% Goan employment to be ineligible.

name: Flower Development (Demonstration)
brief_description: The scheme Flower Development (Demonstration) launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to promote flower cultivation by conducting demonstrations of major flowers such as roseRs. tuberoseRs. asterRs. marigoldRs. chrysanthemumRs. and gladiolus in farmers' fields. Under this schemeRs. demonstrations are carried out in an area of 0.04 hectares (400 square meters) to encourage farmers to adopt flower farming practices.
benefits: - Exhibition: Demonstrations of major flowers such as roseRs. tuberoseRs. asterRs. marigoldRs. chrysanthemumRs. and gladiolus are conducted in farmers fields over an area of 0.04 hectares (400 square meters). - Financial Assistance: A subsidy is provided at the rate of 75% or a maximum of 3Rs./- per demonstrationRs. whichever is lessRs. based on 4Rs./- per demonstration for seedsRs. plantsRs. bulbsRs. or suckers.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme" launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to protect farmers from weather-related losses through insurance coverage for selected crops cultivated during Kharif and Rabi seasons.
benefits: - **Insurance Coverage for Crops:** Provides protection to crops against losses caused by adverse weather conditions such as high or low temperaturesRs. excess or deficient rainfallRs. and wind speed.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Information-Monitoring, Evaluation, and Social Audit (I-MESA): Social Audit
brief_description: The scheme "InformationRs. MonitoringRs. Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)Rs. Govt. of India. The "Social Audit" component of the scheme aims to ensure that the implementation of the schemes at the ground level shall be examined intenselyRs. ensuring transparency and accountability in the implementation of these programmes. The social audit process involves examining and assessing a programme/scheme with the active involvement of peopleRs. comparing official records with actual ground realitiesRs. and consolidating issues backed by evidence into a report. The scheme is implemented by Social Audit Units set up in every state under MGNREGARs. facilitated by the National Resource Cell for Social Audits-DoSJE established at the National Institute of Social DefenceRs. New Delhi.
benefits: - Bringing to light gaps and lapses in programme implementation for improvement. - Creating awareness generation regarding the programmes being implemented. - Providing a platfm for mutual dialogue among various stakeholders for scheme improvement. - Providing a platform for right holders for timely grievance redressal. - Ensuring transparency and accountability in scheme implementation. - Seeking responses from primary stakeholders based on ground realities for course correction and policy framework impact. - Promoting peoples participation in all stages of programme implementation. ##### ***Conditions*** - The cost of conduct of social audits will be met from the respective schemes administrative cost. - Funds shall be given to Social Audit Units through the National Institute of Social DefenceRs. New DelhiRs. based on budgets calculated and reviewed by the National Resource Cell for Social Audits. - The first installment (50% of the total budget) is provided after the submission of the social audit calendar. - The second tranche will be provided after completion of all auditsRs. uploading of findingsRs. and preparation of the annual analytical report.
eligibility: - The applicant must have experience of working with the Social Audit Unit for at least 2 to 3 years. - The applicant must have experience facilitating social audits of schemes apart from the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act. - The team Coordinator leading the team must preferably have completed a 30 days certificate course on social accountability and social audit. - The applicant must ensure the representation of the Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Classes community and the especially abled in the team. - The team must preferably comprise 50% women members. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** - The applicant should have experience working with the elderlyRs. childrenRs. victims of substance abuseRs. and experience working in rehabilitative institutions. - Anganwadi workersRs. Accredited Social Health ActivistsRs. Civil Society Organization representativesRs. or para-legal volunteers working in that area can be included in the team for community support and mobilization. - Students/Interns from academic institutions can be engaged as members of the Social Justice Cell after being trained.

name: Awas Sahayta Yojana for 100% Hearing and Visually Impaired Disabled Students in Special Trades of Industrial Training Institutes
brief_description: The scheme "Awas Sahayta Yojana for 100% Hearing and Visually Impaired Disabled Students in Special Trades of Industrial Training Institutes" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Welfare for Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure qualitative admission of 100% hearing and visually impaired students equivalent to other categoriesRs. thereby enabling them to obtain high-quality technical education free from economic constraints. The scheme provides housing assistance and related allowances for food and accommodation to eligible disabled students pursuing specialized training programs in Industrial Training Institutes.
benefits: - Housing assistance up to 4Rs./- per student per month for food and accommodation is availableRs. provided the student is studying outside their home residence at an Industrial Training Institute. - Housing assistance of 2Rs./- per month per student for food and other expenses only is availableRs. if the student receives hostel facility provided by the Principal of the Industrial Training Institute. - The assistance is provided for the academic duration of the training programRs. whether it is a one-year or two-year trade. ##### ***Disbursement*** - **Mode:** Funds are transferred using Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS).- **Frequency:** The sanctioned amount is transferred monthly into the students Aadhaar-based bank account. The Departmental District Officer provides the advance funds to the Principal of the Industrial Training Institute in two installments every six months.- **Limit:** The assistance is payable only once in a lifetime for the duration of the training program.- **Geographic Scope:** The scheme operates in 07 divisional Industrial Training Institutes located in IndoreRs. BhopalRs. UjjainRs. RewaRs. JabalpurRs. SagarRs. and Gwalior. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary disabled student must pay the rent amount to the landlord using an Account Payee Cheque. - The student must maintain regular attendance at the Industrial Training Institute for the Principal to disburse the monthly assistance amount. - Any rental amount exceeding the determined maximum housing assistance must be borne by the disabled students themselves from their own sourcesRs. and the department will provide no other facility.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must be 100% visually or hearing-impaired. - The applicant must be admitted to an Industrial Training Institute. - The applicant must not have received admission into any Government Hostel. - The applicant must not have received assistance from any Government Department. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must present a certificate or declaration from the guardian stating that the guardian does not have an residential address at the same location or division where the Industrial Training Institute of regular study is situated.

name: Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army
brief_description: The Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the maintenance and livelihood of parents of martyred soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the line of duty.
benefits: - A pension of 10Rs. per month is provided to the parents of martyred soldiers.
eligibility: 1. The martyred soldier must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be the mother or father of a martyred soldier. 1. The martyred soldier whose death has been recognized as a battle casualty by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The annual income of the applicant's parents must be less than 10Rs..

name: Kishor Swasthya Paramarsh Clinic - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Kishor Swasthya Paramarsh Clinic is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The initiative aims to promote the physicalRs. mentalRs. and emotional well-being of adolescents aged 10 to 19 years by providing free health counselling and guidance.
benefits: Free counselling services are provided at the Adolescent Health Clinics.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be an adolescent between 10 and 19 years of age from Uttarakhand.

name: Hemoglobinopathy - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Hemoglobinopathy is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive careRs. supportRs. and treatment to patients suffering from Thalassemia and Hemophilia in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. free blood filtersRs. chelatorsRs. and blood are provided to patients suffering from Thalassemia. Free haemophilia factors (life-saving medicines) are provided to patients suffering from Haemophilia.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be suffering from Thalassemia or Haemophilia.

name: Mukhyamantri Majadoor Suraksha Yojana
brief_description: The scheme is implemented by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to benefit labourers residing in rural and agricultural sectors. Under this scheme: registered workers receive maternity assistanceRs. scholarships for their childrenRs. and insurance cover. It aims to bring social and economic security to families of unorganised agricultural workers by facilitating access to welfare assistance and ensuring eligibility criteria are met.
benefits: 1. Maternity Leave Assistance - 45 days wage equivalent for registered female workers or wives of registered workers (first two deliveries). - 15 days wage equivalent for fathers (paternity leave). 1. Maternity Expense Assistance - Institutional deliveries covered under Janani Suraksha Yojana. - 500/- aid for home deliveries of below-poverty-line women. - Managed by the Public Health & Family Welfare Department. 1. Medical Assistance - Coverage under Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana and State Illness Assistance Scheme. - Child heart-disease treatment under Mukhyamantri Bal Hriday Upchar Yojana. 1. Scholarship / Student Award - Children of registered beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. or General Category will receive scholarships under respective departmental schemes. - Beneficiaries covered under Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana whose two children are studying in Classes 912 will receive educational scholarships through Life Insurance Corporation (LIC). - Disabled children of registered workers with a disability of 40% or more will be eligible for disability scholarships. 1. Marriage Assistance - Financial support for first marriage of registered workers daughters aged 18 + under Mukhyamantri Kanyadan/Nikah Yojana. 1. Insurance Assistance Insurance via Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana: - Normal death 30Rs./- - Accidental death 75Rs./- - Permanent disability 75Rs./- - Partial disability 37Rs./- 1. Funeral Assistance - 2Rs./- immediate help for funeral expenses upon death of worker or family memberRs. provided through Gram Panchayat.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should have been residing regularly in the Gram Panchayat for at least five years. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 59 years. 1. The applicant should be capable of performing wage labor. 1. The applicant should earn his livelihood by working as a laborer in agricultureRs. horticultureRs. afforestationRs. collection of forest produceRs. fishingRs. etc. 1. Neither the applicant nor any member of his family should own agricultural land.

name: Financial Assistance to Shaurya Medal Recipients by the Government of Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The Financial Assistance to Shaurya Medal Recipients by the Government of Madhya Pradesh scheme is launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide monetary support and recognition to the recipients of the Shaurya Medal for their exemplary acts of bravery and service to the nation.
benefits: Financial assistance is provided to Shaurya Medal awardees.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a Shaurya Medal awardee.

name: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Multiplication Programme
brief_description: The Annapurna Scheme was launched by the Department of Farmers Welfare and Agricultural DevelopmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The Seed Exchange Programme component of the scheme aims to improve the economic status of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe small and marginal farmers by providing them with economic assistance to access improved seeds of high-yielding foodgrain cropsRs. thereby increasing productivity and production. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Agriculture through the District PanchayatsRs. Sub-Directorate of AgricultureRs. and the Senior Agriculture Development Officer. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Rural Agriculture Extension Officer based on targets set according to the population of the target groups and the district's demand.
benefits:
- Provision of Breeder or Certified I Grade Seeds for seed production. - A 75% subsidy is provided on the Breeder or Certified Seed. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum area of 1 hectare. - The payment of registration fees required by the Seed Certification AgencyRs. including the application feeRs. registration feeRs. inspection feeRs. and sample feeRs. is covered from the scheme funds.
##### ***Conditions*** - _The produced seeds must be made available to other Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers under the scheme at a fair price in the subsequent year._ - _An agreement (Anubandh) must be executed between the department and the beneficiary through the Seed Production Committee or Farm Superintendent to ensure seed productionRs. marketing (muktjan)Rs. and payment according to policy._ - _The entire agricultural methodology (Sampuurna Krishi Kaaryamaala) must be adopted for higher production._ - _Undesirable plants (Avaanchhaniy Paudhon) must be separated to maintain seed purity._ - _The raw seed produced under the program will undergo gradingRs. processingRs. stackingRs. and packing at the Government Agricultural Farm or at the processing center of the Seed Corporation or other institutions if facilities are unavailable at the farm._ - _The expenditure incurred on gradingRs. processingRs. stackingRs. and packing of raw seeds produced at Government Agricultural Farms may be met by the Deputy Director of Agriculture from the scheme fundsRs. provided the prepared seed is used only under the scheme._ - _The remaining amountRs. after deducting the processing expenditure from the prescribed price of the supplied seedRs. must be deposited in the Government Treasury by challan towards payment to the Government Agricultural Farm._
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. ##### ***Criteria Specific to "Seed Production Programme"*** - The applicant must be willing to participate in the Seed Production Programme. - The applicant's land must fall within the 10 km perimeter of the selected Government Agricultural Farms. - The applicant must conduct the program in a minimum area of 1/2 acre (0.2 hectare). - The maximum area for which subsidy is eligible is 1 hectare. - The applicant must mandatorily register with the Seed Certification Agency. ##### ***Crops Included*** - Kharif crops - PaddyRs. JowarRs. BajraRs. MaizeRs. KodoRs. KutkiRs. Ragi. - Rabi crops - WheatRs. Barley. ##### ***Operational Area*** The program is implemented within the 10 kilometer perimeter of 46 specified Government Agricultural Farms. These farms are located across various districtsRs. including BhindRs. GwaliorRs. DatiaRs. ShivpuriRs. RaipurRs. RajnandgaonRs. RaigarhRs. JanjgirRs. KorbaRs. SatnaRs. SidhiRs. DamohRs. ChhatarpurRs. PannaRs. SeoniRs. BalaghatRs. ChhindwaraRs. NarsinghpurRs. KatniRs. UmariaRs. KhargoneRs. DewasRs. ShajapurRs. RatlamRs. MandsaurRs. BhopalRs. SehoreRs. RaisenRs. BetulRs. RajgarhRs. JagdalpurRs. KankerRs. SitapurRs. KoriyaRs. MandlaRs. ShahdolRs. DharRs. and Jhabua.

name: Own Transformer Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Own Transformer Scheme" launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide quick permanent irrigation pump connections to farmers by allowing them to install transformers at their own cost as per set standardsRs. individually or in groups.
benefits: - **Provision for Installing Own Transformer:** Farmers can install transformers at their own expense according to prescribed standards. - **Group Installation Option:** Farmers have the option to install transformers collectively as a group.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be willing to install the transformer at their own expense.

name: Police Internship Scheme
brief_description: The "Police Internship Scheme" was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to familiarize meritorious students with the functioning of the Madhya Pradesh Police Department and to encourage research in policing and law enforcement. > **Internship Period** Selected students are offered a six-week internship opportunity at district police stationsRs. where they gain practical experience in administrativeRs. legalRs. and investigative procedures.
benefits: **Professional Exposure:** Interns gain firsthand experience of police administrationRs. law enforcementRs. investigation proceduresRs. and public dealing. **Research Opportunity:** Each intern submits an analytical research paper of 3Rs. words on an approved topic related to policing. **Certification:** A Police Internship Certificate is awarded upon successful completion by the respective unit head (Superintendent of Police). **Supervised Training:** Each intern is placed under the supervision of at least a Sub-Inspector or higher-ranking officerRs. who mentors and evaluates daily work. **Practical Learning:** Interns maintain a daily duty recordRs. authenticated by their supervising officer the following day. **Placement Structure:** Large police stations (in IndoreRs. BhopalRs. JabalpurRs. and Gwalior): 23 interns **Medium police stations:** 1 intern **Mode and Duration:** Internship duration: 6 weeks (June 1July 12) Mode: Full-timeRs. in-person at designated police stations. **Honorarium:** The scheme is unpaid. No salary or stipend is provided. Lodging and food arrangements must be made by the interns themselves. **Disciplinary Provisions:** No leave is permitted during the internship period. Lack of interest or misconduct may result in termination by the Superintendent of Police.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a student enrolled in a recognized educational institution. 1. The applicant must be between 21 and 26 years of age as of May 1 of the application year. 1. The applicant should be pursuing one of the following courses: - Five-Year Integrated Law Course - B.E. / B.Tech. - Masters or Postgraduate Program from any UGC-recognized institution - MCA / BCA / PGDCA - CA / CS - Diploma in Police-Related Subjects (e.g.Rs. Human RightsRs. Criminology) - Ph.D. or Research in Police-Related Subjects

name: Integrated Vegetable Development Program
brief_description: The scheme Integrated Vegetable Development Program launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to increase vegetable production through integrated vegetable development by providing financial assistance for hybrid and improved seeds and seed treatment to farmers within the targeted area.
benefits: - **For General Category Farmers:** Financial assistance of 1Rs./- per hectareRs. including 1Rs./- for hybrid/improved seeds and 100/- for seed treatment medicine. - **For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Farmers:** Financial assistance of 2Rs./- per hectareRs. including 2Rs./- for hybrid/improved seeds and 150/- for seed treatment medicine.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the General/ Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe category.

name: Gomantak Govsamvardhan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Gomantak Govsamvardhan Yojana" was launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to conserve the Local Breeds of Cattle in the State of Goa by ensuring that Dairy Farmers or individuals rear these cattleRs. feeding them with feedRs. fodderRs. and providing water on a daily basis in their own property and cattle shed. The scheme provides financial assistance of 80/- per animal per dayRs. disbursed quarterlyRs. to cover maintenance costs including feedRs. fodderRs. and other miscellaneous costsRs. with a maximum limit of 05 Local Breed Cattle per family. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting a duly completed form along with a Notarized Agreement Bond to the relevant local area Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 80/- per animal per day. - This assistance covers the cost of maintenance of Local Breed CattleRs. which includes feedRs. fodderRs. and other miscellaneous costsRs. bundled together in one component. - Microchipping or ear tagging of the cattle will be done by the area Assistant DirectorRs. Veterinary OfficerRs. or Veterinary Assistant of the Veterinary Hospital/Dispensary sub-centres under the instruction of the Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer. - The subsidy will be credited in the account of the beneficiary. - Financial assistance will be provided on a quarterly basis. - The area Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer shall visit the cattle shed every month and submit the quarterly report (as per Annexure A) for the release of the subsidy. ##### ***Benefit Limitations*** - The Scheme will be limited for a maximum of total 05 Local Breed Cattle per family. - The Government has the power to restrict the number of cows to be reared per applicant. - The number of cattle to be reared shall be restricted to 250 cows per District for the Scheme in the financial year 2024-2025Rs. with subsequent increases based on response. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must ensure the cattle are stall-fed in the cattle shed or kept within the paddock area. - The cattle must be housed as per the approved housing regulations for cattle by the Bureau of Indian Standards. - The cattle must be housed in a fashion that can be easily inspected and counted by the local area Assistant Director or Veterinary Officer of the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services. - The Local Breed Cattle must be regularly vaccinated. Refusal to vaccinate the cattle will lead to the forfeiture of the benefits of the scheme immediatelyRs. including any benefits supposed to be received. - If the Local Breeds Cattle are found let loose outside the paddock areaRs. further benefit of the Scheme will be stopped immediately and the farmer will not be considered in the Scheme in the future. - One-Time Exemption: In case the animal has let itself loose due to circumstances beyond the control of the ownerRs. only one chance will be given. This requires a written request providing photographic proof of the animalsRs. duly recommended by the Area OfficerRs. and addressed to the DirectorRs. Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Dairy Farmer or an Individual of the State of Goa. - The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Goa for at least the preceding 15 years. - The applicant must own non-descript cattle or Shwet Kapila cattle. - The applicant must have an adequate cattle shed as per the Bureau of Indian Standard. - The scheme shall be applicable to rural areas and Class C and B Municipalities. - The applicant must be responsible for fulfilling the Pollution Control Board norms if the number of cattle reared exceeds 25 in number. _*If the number of applications received for rearing are more than 250 cattle per districtRs. priority can be decided based on the grazing area of the beneficiary._ ##### ***Reservation*** - Out of the 250 cattle per districtRs. 12% shall be reserved for the Scheduled Tribes (ST). - Out of the 250 cattle per districtRs. 2% shall be reserved for the Scheduled Castes (SC) respectively. - In case there is no demand in the reserved categoriesRs. the demand shall be booked under the general component.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Street Vendor Rin Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Gramin Street Vendor Rin Yojana" was launched by the Department of Panchayat and Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to make low-cost equipment or working capital available as a loan through banks to poor-class migrant workers/small traders in the rural sector of the state. The scheme provides loan access only for existing businesses in the rural area and for the establishment of new enterprises by migrant workersRs. who must also undergo Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training through Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI) for new business establishment. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the Street Vendor Portal.
benefits: - Provision of low-cost equipment. - Provision of working capital (Karyasheela Punji). - Provision of loan (Rin) through banks. - Provision of Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training through Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI). ##### ***Conditions*** - The loan is made available from banks following the training. - The benefit is only for existing businesses (old enterprises) in the rural area. - The benefit is for establishing new businesses for migrant workers. - Rural migrant workers establishing a new business must undergo Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training through Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI).
eligibility: - The applicant must reside in Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must reside in a rural area. - The applicant must be between 18 and 55 years of age. - The applicant must belong to the poor class. - The applicant must be a migrant worker or a small trader (Street Vendor). - The applicant must be applying for a loan for an existing enterprise located in a rural area. - The applicant must be a migrant worker establishing a new enterprise.

name: State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes
brief_description: The "State Award To Two Anganwadi Workers Under Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes" was launched by the Directorate of Women and Child Development (DW&CD)Rs. Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the exemplary performance of Anganwadi Workers. The objective is to highlight their success in improving the coverage and quality of services delivered to children and pregnant and lactating mothers under the Integrated Child Development Services Scheme. FurthermoreRs. the scheme recognizes their contribution towards the implementation of various programmes and schemes of the central GovernmentRs. state GovernmentRs. or local bodies. The award provides each selected Anganwadi Worker with a cash prize of 5Rs./- and a citation. The selection process is based on recommendations made by various authoritiesRs. which are then forwarded to a Scrutiny Committee.
benefits: - Each selected awardee receives a Cash Award of 5Rs./-. - Each selected awardee receives a citation.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an Anganwadi Worker under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Schemes. - The applicant must demonstrate exemplary performance in improving the coverage and quality of services provided to children and pregnant and lactating mothers under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme. - The applicant must show contribution towards the implementation of programmes or schemes of the central GovernmentRs. state GovernmentRs. or local bodies.

name: Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI)Rs. mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivatorsRs. enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers.
benefits: This policy has been formulated with the objective of simplifying the sale of medicinal and aromatic products produced through cultivation. Farmers can sell the medicinal and aromatic products grown on their own agricultural land to markets operated by the Forest Department or to any other buyer. This arrangement has simplified the marketing process of medicinal and aromatic plant products produced through cultivation.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a cultivator producing medicinal and aromatic plants on measured land. - The applicant must be legally cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants on the measured land.

name: Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops
brief_description: The scheme "Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops" was launched by the Directorate of EducationRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to get full exposure to changing technology for teachersRs. who need to handle computers daily and enhance the quality of teaching through visual effectsRs. Multimedia presentationRs. and Graphics in schools in the State of Goa. The scheme provides an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of 1Rs./- for the purchase of a LaptopRs. which is issued via Cheque through Messers Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC)Rs. Government of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the respective educational institution and subsequently forwarded to the Directorate of Education.
benefits: - An Interest Free Loan up to a maximum amount of 1Rs./- is granted for the purchase of a Laptop. - The loan is disbursed in the form of a Crossed Cheque. - The Cheque is drawn in favor of the dealer. - The Cheque is issued through Messers Goa Education Development Corporation (GEDC)Rs. Government of Goa. ***Conditions*** - _The purchase of the Laptop must be made from any registered or authorized dealer of the branded manufacturer._ - _The Cheque amount sanctioned shall not exceed the maximum amount of 1Rs./-._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a regular/permanent full-time teacher. - The applicant must be teaching in Secondary schools or Higher Secondary schools. - The applicant must be working in a Government school or in a Government Aided school. - The applicant must be covered under the Administrative control of the Directorate of Education in the State of Goa.

name: National Bio Energy Programme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
brief_description: The scheme National Bio Energy Programme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under Department of EnergyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the use of biogas as a clean and renewable energy sourceRs. help livestock farmers set up biogas plantsRs. reduce the use of conventional fuelsRs. and support eco-friendly rural development in the state.
benefits: The gas produced from biogas plants can be used for cookingRs. and high-quality compost manure can also be obtained as a byproduct. The grant for establishing biogas plants is payable as follows: - 1 cubic meter 17Rs./- - 24 cubic meters 22Rs./- - 6 cubic meters 29Rs./- - 810 cubic meters 34Rs./- - 15 cubic meters 63Rs./- - 2025 cubic meters 70Rs./- The estimated cost of a small biogas plant is approximately 40Rs./-Rs. and the department provides a grant of 22Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a livestock farmer residing in Uttarakhand. 1. To install a biogas plantRs. 12 sq. meters of land (4 3 m) and at least 3 animals are required.

name: Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa" was launched by the Department of LabourRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to the trainees belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres operating in different parts of Goa. The objective of the program is to train members of industrial workers in crafts like embroideryRs. needle workRs. cuttingRs. and tailoring so that they become self-employed and earn income to help their families.
benefits: - A stipend of 1Rs./- per month shall be provided to the eligible applicant/trainee. - The scheme's main objective is to train the members of Industrial workers so that they become self-employed. Trainees can earn to some extent to help their family. - The stipend shall be paid monthly. - The stipend will be paid till the completion of the course of that particular academic year. - The period of stipend will commence from July to April of a particular academic year. ****If the attendance of the applicant/trainee is less than 75% for a particular monthRs. no stipend will be paid to that trainee.***
eligibility: - The applicant must be enrolled under the respective Labour Welfare Centre for a particular academic year. - The applicant must have resided in Goa for atleast 15 years. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community. - The applicant must not have any source of income of her own. - The applicant must not be owing business. - The applicant must not be drawing any stipend from any other source.

name: Chief Ministers Award for Excellence in Public Administration
brief_description: The scheme "Chief Ministers Award for Excellence in Public Administration" was launched by the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (DPAR)Rs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to recognize outstanding and exemplary performance by a team of officials under the Union Territory of Puducherry for achievements of initiatives and projects whose qualitative and quantitative outcomes/results are of very high order and which have benefitted a large number of citizens. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Secretary to the Government (Administrative Reforms Wing)Rs. Chief SecretariatRs. Puducherry-605001.
benefits: ##### ***Chief Minister's Award for Excellence in Public Administration*** - The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash Award of 10Rs./- each. - Two such awards are given: one each for Departments and Organizations/Institutions categories. ##### ***Chief Minister's Appreciation for Initiative in Public Administration*** - The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash Award of 5Rs./- each. - Two such awards are given: one each for Departments and Organizations/Institutions categories. ##### ***Conditions*** - The amount of the cash award can be varied by the Government from time to time subject to the availability of funds. - The Government reserves the right not to present an Award in any year.
eligibility: - The applicant must represent one of the following: a) A Local Body under the UT of Puducherry. b) An Autonomous Body under the UT of Puducherry. c) A Corporation under the UT of Puducherry. d) An Agency under the UT of Puducherry. e) A Public Sector Undertaking under the UT of Puducherry. f) A Government Department under the UT of Puducherry. - The applicant must be nominated only through the Administrative Secretary. - The applicant must submit an application that contains the recommendation of the Departmental Committee. - The applicant must propose achievements of initiatives and projects whose qualitative and quantitative outcomes/results are of very high order and which have benefitted a large number of citizens. - The application should be made for rewardable work done during the previous one calendar year as on the date of nomination.

name: Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Cultivation of Aromatic Plants under MGNREGA scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage farmers in rural areas to grow aromatic plants by providing them free planting materialRs. technical helpRs. and wage support through MGNREGA.
benefits: - Under MGNREGARs. when aromatic cultivation is undertakenRs. the wages for the work done by the labourers in land preparation and related activities are paid by the Rural Development DepartmentRs. and the farmer does not have to pay the wages. - The Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP) provides free planting material along with technical supportRs. consultancyRs. and monitoring services to the farmers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in a rural area of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be interested in aromatic plant cultivation. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years.

name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide stipend to Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to the students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for the benefit of poor students. The scheme is also intended to provide financial assistance to students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing their studies at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the SIRISH-Online Application Portal.
benefits: - The benefits are to provide stipend to Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to the students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for the benefit of poor students. - The scheme is to provide financial assistance to the students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing their studies at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. ##### ***Conditions for Availment/Continuation*** - _The scholarship holder under this scheme shall not hold any other scholarship or stipend disbursed by any Government Department._ - _Students who are also undergoing coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers with financial assistance from the Government will not be eligible._ - _In case of detained studentsRs. he or she shall not be eligible to apply for scholarship for the same class twice._ - _The applicant eligible for the "Post-Matric Scholarship" will not be eligible for other schemesRs. except for the scheme "Simon Sing Horo (Special Post-Matric) ScholarshipRs." if eligibleRs. in the same year._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community. - The applicant must produce a valid Caste certificate which is duly certified or issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his or her designated officer. - The applicant must submit an undertaking on the annual family income stating that it is not exceeding 5Rs./- per annum. - The Pre-Matric Scholarship is awarded to students from Class 9th to Class 10th. - The Post-Matric Scholarship is awarded to students pursuing studies from Class 11th to normal Three Years Degree Courses (Bachelor of ArtsRs. Bachelor of Business AdministrationRs. Bachelor of CommerceRs. Bachelor of ScienceRs. Integrated Graduate plus Post Graduate courses like integrated Master of Business Administration / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Law / Bachelor of Arts-Bachelor of Education / Master of Social WorkRs. etc.). - The scholarships are available for all recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in recognized institutions. ##### ***Special Provisions*** - All children of the same parents or guardians are eligible. - Students studying through correspondence course are also eligible to apply.

name: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017
brief_description: The scheme "Interest Subsidy SchemeRs. 2017 was launched by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)Rs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. The scheme provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan availed from specified financial institutions. The subsidy is subject to minimum engagement of 60% Goan manpowerRs. with maximum benefits up to 25Rs./- per annum (or 27Rs./- for all women and Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants).
benefits: - For claims of interest paid on term loanRs. subsidy will be calculated to the extent of 30% of the interest paidRs. subject to the scheme ceiling. - For claims of interest paid on working capital loanRs. subsidy will be calculated to the extent of 112% of the total turnover or 30% of the interest paid by the units/enterpriseRs. whichever is less. - The subsidy payable shall not exceed the ceiling of 25Rs./- per annumRs. calculated on pro-rata basis for part of the year as claimed. - The subsidy payable shall not exceed the ceiling of 27Rs./- per annum for all women and Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicantsRs. calculated on pro-rata basis for part of the year as claimed. ##### ***Disbursal Conditions/Criteria*** - _The period of grant of subsidy shall not exceed seven yearsRs. that is 27 continuous quarters subsequent to the quarter in which the subsidy is first claimed._ - _The benefits under this scheme shall be disbursed to eligible applicants beyond the validity of this schemeRs. providedRs. application for at least one claim is submitted to the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC) during the validity of this scheme._ - _In case the unit fails to file the yearly claim after the first claim within the stipulated time frameRs. the unit shall be eligible to file the delayed claim in the subsequent year within the time frame as specified in the Umbrella Scheme._ - _The facility of filing delayed claims shall not be available for the last claim._ - _The lapsed claim shall not be revived by any authority._ - _In case the unit fails to include any portion of interest that cannot be claimed due to non-payment before filing of applicationRs. the unit shall be eligible to claim such interest subject to payment of the same in the subsequent year._ - _In case of default in payment of term loan (i.e. not paid as per schedule of repayment) reimbursement of interest shall be reduced to the extent of default._ - _Only the limit of original loan granted and not rescheduled loan shall be considered for interest reimbursement._
eligibility: - The applicant must represent one of the following - (a) A MicroRs. Small and Medium manufacturing industry. (b) A project of Hinterland Eco tourism in lesser developed talukas registered with/recognized by the Department of Tourism/Goa Investment Promotion Board/Town & Country Planning/Planning & Development Authority/Eco Sensitive Zone Authority. - The industry must be listed under White categoryRs. Green category and Orange category. - The industry must have commenced production after 01-10-2017. - The industry must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. - The industry must have availed loan as term loan and/or working capital loan for conducting business of the unit claiming the benefit. - The loan must be availed from any nationalized bankRs. scheduled private bankRs. Co-operative BankRs. Economic Development Corporation LimitedRs. or any Non-Banking Financial Institutions recognized by the Reserve Bank of India.

name: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme
brief_description: The Incentives to Green Investment Scheme was launched by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC)Rs. Government of Goa.
