The scheme aims to give financial support to industrial units for adopting environmentally friendly equipment and processesRs. and to support the adoption of new technology and renewable energy aimed at conserving the use of natural resources. The scheme provides reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Water and Energy Audit Reimbursement*** - Reimbursement of 25% of the cost of water and energy audits. - Subject to a maximum of 1Rs./- per unit during the validity of this scheme. ##### ***Energy Conservation Equipment Capital Reimbursement*** - Reimbursement of 40% of the capital cost incurred on the purchase of the equipment. - Subject to 10Rs./- per unit. - A unit can avail this benefit multiple timesRs. subject to the maximum ceiling mentioned above. - This benefit shall be in addition to benefits availed under State and Central Subsidy Schemes. ##### ***Maximum Benefit Cap Conditions*** - The total subsidy received by the applicant towards the purchase of the said equipment must not exceed 100% of the purchase value of the respective equipment. - For the purpose of calculationRs. total subsidy includes: Subsidy under this scheme + Any other Subsidy received from Government of Goa/Government of India + Interest subsidy received/receivable under any soft loan or low interest loan availed for purchasing the said equipment under any State/Central Government scheme. - Benchmark interest for calculating interest subsidy as received due to a subsidized rate of interest will be 10%. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation._ - _No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued because allocation is exceeded._ - _The applicant must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or registers or holding discussions with employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a manufacturing unit. - The applicant must fall under the microRs. smallRs. mediumRs. or large category. - The applicant must ensure the water and energy auditsRs. if claimedRs. are carried out by a recognised institution/consultant certified by the Bureau of Energy EfficiencyRs. Ministry of Power and Government of India. - The applicant must ensure the energy conservation equipmentRs. if claimedRs. is certified as an energy conserving fixed asset of capital nature by a recognised institution/consultant certified by the Bureau of Energy EfficiencyRs. Ministry of PowerRs. Government of India. - The applicant must ensure the total subsidy received (Subsidy under this scheme + Any other Subsidy received from Government of Goa/Government of India + Interest subsidy from soft loan/low interest loan schemes) does not exceed 100% of the purchase value of the respective equipment.

name: Shooting Permission Certificate
brief_description: The scheme Shooting Permission Certificate is implemented by the Department of Information and Public RelationsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify the process of granting official permission for film shooting in Uttarakhand through a single-window online systemRs. ensuring timely approvals and promoting the state as a film-friendly destination.
benefits: Permission is provided for shooting films in the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a film producer.

name: Bee Keeping
brief_description: The scheme Bee Keeping is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxesRs. bee coloniesRs. and training support to farmersRs. thereby increasing honey productionRs. enhancing farm incomeRs. and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Bee families (beesRs. including the queen bee) and bee colonies (bee boxes) are provided with a 40% subsidy (maximum cost per bee box is 2Rs./- and per bee colony is 2Rs./-). 50 bee boxes are provided in plain areas and 25 in hilly areas. - For exampleRs. if a bee box and bee colony cost 200/-Rs. the farmer has to deposit 120/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The government bears a subsidy of 80/-Rs. and the farmer receives the box for 120/-. - If a farmer wishes to keep bee colonies in their own orchardsRs. financial assistance of 350/- per bee colony is provided. - If a farmer wants to receive trainingRs. the department provides a free seven-day beekeeping training program. Along with the trainingRs. the farmer is given 100/- per day (totaling 700/-) and 50/- per day (totaling 350/-). A total of 1Rs./- is provided to each beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in beekeeping.

name: Financial Assistance for Higher Studies
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Higher Studies" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community pursuing higher studies. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - This assistance supports students pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of MedicineRs. Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)Rs. Master of Business Administration (MBA)Rs. EngineeringRs. and such other technical/higher education. - The assistance covers higher studies in AdministrationRs. MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. LawRs. ResearchRs. and Education within and outside the State/Country for the students.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must be pursuing higher studies such as Bachelor of MedicineRs. Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)Rs. Master of Business Administration (MBA)Rs. EngineeringRs. and such other technical/higher education. - The applicant's family income must not exceed 5Rs./- per annum. - The applicant should not be a Government Service holder. - Students studying through correspondence course are also eligible to apply.

name: Coaching For Higher Studies
brief_description: The scheme "Coaching for Higher Studies" was launched by the Directorate of Tea Tribes and Adivasi WelfareRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide coaching to students of Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil ServicesRs. MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level)Rs. Banking (Probationary Officers)Rs. etc. so that they are able to compete with other candidates and succeed. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: Provision of coaching to students for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil ServicesRs. MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level)Rs. and Banking (Probationary Officers)Rs. to enable them to compete with other candidates and succeed.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must secure the requisite percentage of marks in the qualifying examination prescribed for the desired coachingRs. based on subject matter and on the available seats. - **For Undergraduate students who are preparing for medical entrance examinationsRs.** the applicant should be from the science stream with PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. and Biology.- **For Undergraduate students who are preparing for engineering entrance examinationsRs.** the applicant should be from the science stream with PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. and Maths.

name: Scheme for Purchase of Mobile Sales Van
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Marketing Organisations was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the Khadi & Village Industries (KVI) Institutions for the purchase of new mobile sales vans for stocking display sales of KVI products and also toRs. transport of raw materials for producing KVI Products. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial assistance is provided for purchase of new mobile sales vans for stocking display sales of KVI products and also toRs. transport of raw materials for producing KVI Products. - The loan limit must not exceed 3Rs./- per vehicle. - The number of vehicles should not exceed six.
eligibility: Individuals / Partnership Concerns / Private Limited / Public Limited Companies experienced in marketing of Village & Small Industries (VSI) products are eligible.

name: Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a Term Loan covering 65% of the project cost and Seed Capital covering 25% of the project costRs. structured around a maximum project cost of up to 10Rs./-. The applicant must be a woman entrepreneur setting up a new Small Scale Industrial unit or service activity. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - The scheme provides financial assistance for projects with a cost up to 10Rs./-. - The assistance includes a Term Loan component covering 65% of the project cost. - The assistance includes a Seed Capital component covering 25% of the project cost. - The applicant receives a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal interest rate charged for loans. - The applicant receives a 50% concession on the investigation fee. - The calculated Debt-Equity Ratio (D.E.R) for the project is 1.857:1. ##### ***Repayment and Term Details*** - The repayment period for the Term Loan is 6 to 8 yearsRs. which includes a moratorium period of 1 to 2 years. - The repayment period for the Seed Capital is 10 years. - The Promoter's contribution required is 10% of the project cost. ##### ***Conditions*** - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offeredRs. in addition to the mortgage or hypothecation of proposed fixed assets._ - _For units promoted by women entrepreneursRs. the value of the immovable property to be offered as security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._ - _The valuation of the properties offered as security must be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers/valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a woman entrepreneur. - The applicant must be setting up a new Small Scale Industrial unit. - The applicant must be setting up a service activity. - The applicant must propose a project with a maximum cost of up to 10Rs./-. _*The applicant is eligible for a concessional rate of interest that is 0.5% less than the normal rate._ _*The applicant is eligible for a 50% concession on the investigation fee._ _*The collateral security requirement is relaxedRs. mandating the value of the property offered to be fixed at 50% of the loan amount._

name: Single Window Scheme (PIPDIC)
brief_description: The scheme Single Window Scheme was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide term loan for fixed assets and loan for working capital through the same agency the total working capital requirement of such units inclusive of all fund based facilities may be taken into account for determining the working capital facility eligible for finance. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Term Loan for fixed assets and loan for working capital through the same agency. - The total working capital requirement of such units inclusive of all fund based facilities may be taken into account for determining the working capital facility eligible for finance. _*The total project outlayRs. including total working capital requirementRs. must not exceed 2Rs./-._
eligibility: - Entrepreneurs setting up new project in SSI/tiny sectorRs. new promoters acquiring unencumbered fixed assets of existing SSI concerns and also existing well run units undertaking modernization / Technology upgradation and potentially viable sick units undertaking rehabilitation scheme. - The total project outlayRs. including total working capital requirementRs. must not exceed 2Rs./-.

name: Financial Assistance to Launderers and Barbers
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Launderers and Barbers" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to the Launderers and barbers for the purchase of worktables & furnitureRs. etc. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: Loan of upto 1Rs./- for purchase of worktables & furnitureRs. etc.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a Launderer or Barber. - The applicant must have a minimum of three years' experience.

name: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme" was launched by the Department of ArchaeologyRs. Government of GoaRs. to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast. The scheme provides financial assistance through four research fellowships (two Junior level and two Senior level)Rs. each awarded for a period of 24 monthsRs. with an objective to encourage research based on primary archaeological sourcesRs. promote research cultureRs. and promote interdisciplinary research in educational organizations.
benefits:
- Eligible scholars under the Junior category shall be awarded a fellowship of 25Rs./- per month for a period of 24 months. - Eligible scholars under the Senior category shall be awarded a fellowship of 40Rs./- per month for a period of 24 months. - Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Junior category. - Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Senior category. ##### ***Other Non-Monetary Outcomes*** - Unexplored archaeological treasure will be brought to light which will help to carry out further research in the field of Archaeology of Goa. - A database of archaeological heritage of Goa will be created. - More and more researchers will come to visit the Protected Monuments of the Department of Archaeology for research activities. - Researchers will help in creating awareness about the Protected Monument and Sites of Goa and archaeological treasure of Goa in general. - The Department will generate research on the archaeological past of Goa for publication. ##### ***Conditions*** - A half yearly progress report shall be submitted by the research fellow. - The project reportRs. in the form of two hard copies and a soft copyRs. must be submitted within a period of 30 days after the completion of her/his 24 months of fellowship. - The project submitted shall be exclusively the property of the Department of ArchaeologyRs. Government of Goa.
_*The fellowship shall be awarded to any scholar only once in her/his lifetime under each of the two categories._ _*A fellow will not be eligible for any other fellowship offered by the Department in any other category for a period of five years from the date of the submission of her/his project._ _*Any grace period or extension will not be considered under the quantum of the fellowship financial assistance._
eligibility: ##### ***For Junior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his post-graduation (M.A. in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 35 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicantRs. if applying as a Goan ScholarRs. must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicantRs. if applying as an Indian ScholarRs. must have Indian citizenship. ##### ***For Senior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his Doctorate (in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 45 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicantRs. if applying as a Goan ScholarRs. must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicantRs. if applying as an Indian ScholarRs. must have Indian citizenship.

name: Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration
brief_description: The Atithi Uttarakhand Home-Stay Registration scheme has been introduced by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote rural tourism and generate local employment by enabling residents to register their homes as certified home-stays that offer safeRs. affordable accommodation and meal facilities to tourists in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. any house owner in the state who wishes to make the residential rooms of their house available to tourists can register their home with the Tourism Department as a home-stay. After registrationRs. the owner can provide night stay and meals to guests and charge a fee for these services. The main objective of this scheme is to offer accommodation and food facilities to tourists and to provide employment opportunities to rural residents at their homes. After registrationRs. the respective accommodation is listed on the departments website under the Home Stay directoryRs. allowing any tourist to obtain information from the website and avail night stay facilities.
eligibility: 1. For registration under this schemeRs. a No Objection Certificate (NOC) must be issued by the Development Authority/Local Body in urban areasRs. and by the Gram Pradhan in rural areas. 1. The accommodation unit must be entirely residentialRs. and the house owner must reside there with their family. 1. There must be at least one and a maximum of six rooms available for guests/tourists. 1. The residential unit must have a toiletRs. should be clean and well-maintainedRs. equipped with fire safety equipmentRs. and built in a structurally robust manner.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households in UttarakhandRs. ensuring dignified living conditions for economically and socially disadvantaged families.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. selected eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of 130Rs./- for house construction. Beneficiaries are also provided 12Rs./- for toilet construction under convergence with MGNREGA/SwajalRs. along with 95 man-days of labour employment from MGNREGA. After the house is completedRs. the State Government provides an additional 6Rs./- for purchasing kitchen utensils as per the Honble Chief Ministers announcement.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The selection of eligible beneficiaries for housing is done based on the SocialRs. Economic and Caste Census 2011 (SECC-2011) and the Awaas Plus Permanent Waiting List.

name: License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments
brief_description: The scheme "License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments" was launched by the Department of legal metrologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities by enabling skilled individuals to legally engage in the repair and maintenance of weights and measuring instruments used in trade.
benefits: - For self-employmentRs. traders can obtain licenses for weightsRs. measuresRs. and weighing instruments by paying the repair taxRs. repair feeRs. and prescribed government charges to ensure their livelihood.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must possess one of the following qualifications: - ITI (Electronics) or its equivalent along with 2 years of relevant experience; or - Diploma in ElectronicsRs. InstrumentationRs. or Electrical Engineering with 1 year of relevant experience; or - B.Sc. degree with Physics and 1 year of relevant experience; or - B.E./B.Tech degree in ElectricalRs. ElectronicsRs. or Instrumentation Engineering.

name: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
brief_description: The scheme "Free Pre-Recruitment Training" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for the MilitaryRs. ParamilitaryRs. and Police forces to the sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the MilitaryRs. ParamilitaryRs. and Police Forces is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a son of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant's age should be more than 16 years and less than 21 years. 1. The applicant should have passed high school with 45% marks. ***All expenses incurred on training (honorarium of trainers + food + accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.*** **Note: 5** courses are conducted each year.

name: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
brief_description: The Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Sub Plan scheme was introduced by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clustersRs. comprising a minimum of 10 ponds at one locationRs. are created for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The scheme provides 60% of the total cost as a grant for pond construction and the first-year investmentRs. including expenses on fish hatcheries and feed. A minimum of 10 ponds will be constructed in each village. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible to receive a grant for a maximum of 500 cubic metersRs. up to 3Rs./-. For societiesRs. groupsRs. mahasanghsRs. federationsRs. or mangal dals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled TribesRs. a grant of 5Rs./- is providedRs. which constitutes 60% of the total project cost of 8Rs./- for the construction of a 1-hectare pond in the plains. - Ponds of sizes ranging from 0.05 to 0.50 hectares will be constructed in the plains under this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individual belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category and residing in the mountainous or plain areas of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be interested inRs. or currently engaged inRs. fish farming or fish production. 1. The applicant (individual or group) must own or lease land and have a nearby water source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Free Shoe and Bag Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Free Shoes and Bags Scheme" is implemented by the Basic Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government and government-aided schools for purchasing shoes and bags.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for purchasing shoes and bags for boys and girls as follows: - 318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 - 462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 The amount is transferred directly to the students' account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of Classes 1 to 8 studying in any government or non-government aided school in Uttarakhand.

name: RIMC Scholarship (Military Scholarship)
brief_description: The RIMC Scholarship (Military Scholarship) scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand who are pursuing their education at the Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC).
benefits: The scholarship is payable to students at the rate of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be studying at the Rashtriya Indian Military College.

name: Financial Assistance to Youth Groups
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Youth Groups was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD)Rs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among rural youth by providing financial support. Financial assistance is provided to Mangal Dals affiliated with the department to help them start employment-oriented projects in 18 identified business sectorsRs. including dairyRs. electronicsRs. tent servicesRs. beauty parlorsRs. and more.
benefits: **Financial support for starting one of the 18 Identified Business Activities for Starting Employment-Oriented Projects/Businesses in Uttarakhand State:** - Dairy Production 1Rs./- - Tent Utensil Rental 50Rs./- - Sound System Rental 50Rs./- - Flour Mill Setup 50Rs./- - Photocopy/Fax/Lamination Machine 1Rs./- - Mushroom/Vegetable/Flower Cultivation 50Rs./- - Handloom/Woolen Items Production Equipment 50Rs./- - Adventure Sports Equipment 4Rs./- - Tailoring/Beauty Parlor Equipment 50Rs./- - Organic Fertilizer/Animal Feed Production 50Rs./- - Fruit Preservation Unit 50Rs./- - Animal Husbandry 50Rs./- - Cultural Instrument Purchase 50Rs./- - Electronics Repairs/Works 50Rs./- - Vehicle Repair Work 50Rs./- - Plumbing Work 10Rs./- - Mobile Phone Repair 12Rs./- - Innovative Projects 1Rs./- **Funding Process:** Financial assistance will be 75% of the total project cost or the specified amount for the chosen activity (whichever is lower). The remaining cost must be arranged by the beneficiary youth groups on their own.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Mangal Dal affiliated with the Youth Welfare and PRD Department of Uttarakhand. 1. The members of Mangal Dal must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant (Mangal Dal) must not have benefited previously under the scheme.

name: Farmer Pension Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Farmer Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to elderly farmers residing in the state of Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to farmers who are above 60 years of ageRs. own up to 2 hectares of landRs. and cultivate their own land.
benefits: A pension of 1Rs./- per month is provided to eligible farmers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer actively engaged in cultivating their own land. 1. The applicant must be above 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must own and cultivate up to 2 hectares of agricultural land.

name: Dr. Y.V. Singh Award for Best Thesis in Vegetable Science
brief_description: The Dr. Y.V. Singh Award for Best Thesis in Vegetable Science scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize and encourage students for their outstanding research work in the field of Vegetable Science.
benefits: **Award Amount:** 20Rs./- per year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The applicant must have submitted a thesis in the field of Vegetable Science at the university. 1. The award is granted for a period of one year only.

name: Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)
brief_description: The Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture across all disciplines by awarding a monthly fellowship for one year.
benefits: **Amount of Fellowship:** 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. Agriculture program (all disciplines) at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The fellowship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme is implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar IndustryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity and improve sugar recovery by promoting the cultivation of high-qualityRs. high-yieldingRs. and newly developed sugarcane varietiesRs. while providing farmers with financial supportRs. modern cultivation techniquesRs. and access to advanced agricultural technology.
benefits: 1. **Sugarcane Seed Modification and Varietal Balance:** A plan has been prepared to replace sugarcane varieties that have been cultivated for a long time and are currently grown (such as Ko.Sha.-767Rs. Ko.-1148Rs. Ko.Sha.-97264Rs. Ko.Sha.-94257Rs. and Ko.Sha.-8436Rs. etc.) with better qualityRs. high-yieldingRs. and certified varieties. Newly developed quality sugarcane varieties include Ko.Pant. 12221Rs. Ko.Sha. 8272Rs. Ko. 0118Rs. Ko.P.K. 5191Rs. Ko. 15023Rs. Ko.P.B. 91Rs. Ko.P.B. 92Rs. Ko.P.B. 96Rs. Ko.P.B. 98Rs. Ko. 13035Rs. Ko.LKH. 9709Rs. Ko.LKH. 12207Rs. Ko.LKH. 14201Rs. Ko.Sha. 13235Rs. Ko.LKH. 15201Rs. and Ko.LKH. 16202Rs. etc. For low-lying areasRs. these high-yielding varieties should be cultivated in sufficient quantities to increase the success rate of sugarcane cultivation and enhance sugar recovery in mills. Sugarcane seed from research centers attracts a 20% premium over the government-declared sugarcane price. Farmers will be given an incentive for sugarcane seed purchased above the mill gate price. It is also proposed to provide farmers with a 100% subsidy on harvestingRs. loadingRs. and transportation costs when sourcing sugarcane seed from research centers at the mill gate rate per quintal. 1. **Subsidy on Base/Primary Nursery:** To encourage farmersRs. it is proposed to provide a subsidy of 50/- per quintal to base nursery holders and 25/- per quintal to primary nursery holders for the distribution of sugarcane seeds. 1. **Latest Methods of Sugarcane Sowing**: For sugarcane sowingRs. the latest trench method or row-spacing method should be adoptedRs. under which the furrow-to-furrow distance should be 4 feetRs. the depth 1 footRs. and the distance between two-eyed pieces should be 46 inches or 69 inches. To encourage farmersRs. it is proposed to provide a subsidy of 10Rs./- for demonstration of 1 hectare of early varietyRs. single-eye/two-eye plantingRs. and mixed farming on farmers fields. 1. **Weed Management System:** A 50% subsidy is proposed on herbicides for effective weed control in sugarcane crops. 1. **Protection of Crops from Insects and Diseases:** A 50% subsidy is proposed on agricultural chemicalsRs. including high-quality insecticides and pesticidesRs. to protect sugarcane crops from insects and diseases. 1. **Providing Information About Latest Technology to Farmers:** From time to timeRs. technical information related to higher yield and improved sugarcane varieties will be provided to farmers. The Sugarcane Development Department and the Sugarcane Farmers Institute & Training CenterRs. KashipurRs. provide training to farmersRs. employeesRs. and officialsRs. and organize district-level farmers seminars. 1. **Providing Access to Modern Agricultural Equipment to Farmers:** Farmers will be provided with modern agricultural equipment suitable for sugarcane cultivationRs. including battery-operated or petrol-powered sprayersRs. harrowsRs. and cultivators. It is proposed to distribute drone sprayers and trench openers in the coming years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicants name must be registered in the land records of the state.

name: Scheme for Providing Soft Skill Training Courses to Students Studying in State Colleges
brief_description: The Scheme for Providing Soft Skill Training Courses to Students Studying in State Colleges scheme is implemented by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the soft skills of students studying in state colleges of Uttarakhand by providing training through Mahindra Pride Classroom and the Nandi Foundation.
benefits: Soft Skill training courses are being organized in various colleges of the state through Mahindra Pride Classroom and Nandi Foundation.
eligibility: 1. All students studying in the colleges of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Sthaniya Fasal Protsahan Karyakram
brief_description: The scheme Sthaniya Fasal Protsahan Karyakram was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. to promote the cultivation of local cropsRs. enhance productivityRs. ensure the use of quality seedsRs. and provide fair prices to farmers in the mountain districts of Uttarakhand.
benefits: **Under the schemeRs. the following objectives will be achieved by distributing verified seeds of local crops at 100% subsidy:** a. Distribution of certified seeds on subsidy to increase the cultivation area according to the specific region. b. Ensuring the recommended seed replacement rate is met. c. Enhancing production and productivity through the use of quality seeds. d. Promoting and encouraging the cultivation of local pulse crops. e. Ensuring farmers receive a fair price for their produce. Seed production will be carried out by the Agriculture Department in clusters formed under the Traditional Agriculture Development SchemeRs. through the CLF/LC established under UGVS-REAPRs. and directly by the Agriculture Department. For crops where traditional clusters are not operationalRs. clusters will be identified through CLF/LC for certified seed production. The Agriculture Department will conduct seed production programs in these areasRs. and the produced seeds will be distributed region-wise after appropriate allocation. **Traditional crops selected under the program:** 1. Kidney Beans 2. Gahat 3. Ramdana 4. Red Rice 5. Maize Nainital and Chakrata region 6. Bhatta 7. Ugal/Phafar 8. Kauni 9. Toor (Pigeon Pea)
eligibility: - All farmers from the mountain districts of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and motivate girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state by providing financial scholarships to support their education.
benefits: **Scholarship Amount:** - Girl students from classes 6 to 12 are provided 251/0 per monthRs. at the rate of 3Rs./- annually.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a girl student of any category. 1. The girl student must be studying from class 6 to class 12 in a Sanskrit school of Uttarakhand. 1. A total of 175 enrolled girl students will be eligible.

name: Medical Check-Up facility (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Medical Check-Up Facility is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide medical check-up facilities to registered construction workers through door-to-door visitsRs. health campsRs. and collection centers.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. medical check-up facilities are provided to construction workers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Ex-Gratia Payment for Life-Threatening Injury Requiring Hospital Stay for Treatment
brief_description: The scheme Ex-Gratia Payment for Life-Threatening Injury Requiring Hospital Stay for Treatment is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals who sustain life-threatening injuries due to disasters and require hospitalization for treatment.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. an ex-gratia grant of 16Rs./- per person is provided in case of a hospital stay for more than one weekRs. and 5Rs./- per person in case of a hospital stay for less than one week.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a person admitted to a government or non-government hospital due to an injury caused by a disasterRs. including those engaged in relief or disaster preparedness activities who sustained injuries during such work.

name: Financial Assistance/Pension to Former Renowned Sportspersons
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance/Pension to Former Renowned Sportspersons was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of a pension to former renowned sportspersons of Uttarakhand who are above 50 years of age and are financially weak.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financially weak former renowned sportspersons of the state are provided a lifelong monthly pensionRs. with a minimum of 4Rs./- and a maximum of 10Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be an ex-sportsperson. 1. The applicant must be above 50 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be currently employed. 1. The applicants monthly income from all private sources should not exceed 20Rs./-. 1. The applicant should be a former medalist or participant in: - Olympic GamesRs. World Cup/Championship - Asian GamesRs. Commonwealth Games - Afro-Asian GamesRs. SAF Games - Para-Olympic/Special Olympic (Mental/Physical Disabilities) - World Marathon (Disabled)Rs. International Veteran (Masters) Championships

name: State Government Health Scheme (Golden Card)
brief_description: The scheme State Government Health Scheme (Golden Card) has been implemented since January 1Rs. 2021Rs. by the Uttarakhand State Health Authority under the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide quality healthcare facilities to all government employeesRs. pensionersRs. and their dependents in the state.
benefits: The State Government Health Scheme has been implemented with the aim of providing quality healthcare facilities to all government employeesRs. pensionersRs. and their dependents in Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. prescribed medical treatment is provided free of cost.
eligibility: 1. All government employees and pensioners of Uttarakhand who have obtained Golden Cards and make monthly contributions are eligible under the scheme.

name: Discount Scheme on Sale of Khadi Garments
brief_description: The scheme Discount Scheme on Sale of Khadi Garments is implemented by the Uttarakhand Khadi and Village Industries Board under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the use and sale of Khadi garments by providing a 10% discount to consumers on purchases made at Khadi production and sales centres registered with the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).
benefits: Under this schemeRs. a 10% discount on Khadi garments is provided to customers from Gandhi Jayanti (2nd October) to Republic Day (26th January).
eligibility: 1. The discount is provided to production/sales centres in Uttarakhand that are registered with the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (Government of India)Rs. which then pass it on to the customers.

name: Bhed Palan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Bhed Palan Yojana" was introduced by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sheep rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiariesRs. particularly from SECC categoriesRs. by providing financial support for rearing a sheep unit.
benefits: - Self-employment in sheep rearing is facilitated by providing beneficiaries with a sheep rearing unit comprising 10 female sheep and 1 male sheep for a period of 10 to 14 months. - The total cost of the unit is 70Rs./-Rs. of which 90% (63Rs./-) is funded by the State GovernmentRs. and the remaining 10% (7Rs./-) is contributed by the beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must be included in the SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) category. 1. The applicant should have an interest in sheep rearing.

name: State Level Awards for Divyang Persons
brief_description: The scheme State Level Awards for Divyang Persons has been implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. to honor the exceptional achievements and contributions of persons with disabilities in various fields. Under this schemeRs. a cash prize of 8Rs./-Rs. along with a medal and a certificate of appreciationRs. is awarded to outstanding individuals in categories such as disabled employeesRs. outstanding sportspersonsRs. and best self-employed service providers. The awards are distributed annually on the occasion of World Disability Day (December 3) to recognize and encourage excellence among persons with disabilities.
benefits:
**Award Details:**

- An amount of 8000/- is given as a cash prize.
- Medal and Certificate of Appreciation.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The amount disbursed through the cheque or bank draft at the award ceremony.

**Expected Time of Disbursement:**

- Awarded annually on December 3 (World Disability Day).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
1. The applicant should have verifiable records of achievements or work.
1. The applicant should be in any one of the following categories:


- Differently-abled (Divyang) employee
- Outstanding Sportsperson
- Best Self-Employed Service Provider

name: Sanitary Napkin Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Sanitary Napkin Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free sanitary napkins to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workersRs. in order to promote health and hygiene.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. free sanitary napkins will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The benefits of the scheme will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers registered with the Board.

name: Healthy Lifestyle for School Children through Ayurvidya-AYUSH
brief_description: The Healthy Lifestyle for School Children through Ayurvidya-AYUSH is implemented by the Ayush DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote and develop a healthy lifestyle among school children through the principles and practices of AYUSH.
benefits: - Promoting a healthy lifestyle among school children through AYUSH and providing free distribution of medicines based on their specific health conditions. This facility is provided free of cost to the students.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a student enrolled in a government school in Uttarakhand.

name: Pragati Scholarship (81 for Uttarakhand girl students (Diploma) and 50 for Graduation)
brief_description: The scheme Pragati Scholarship is implemented by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girl students of the state by providing financial assistance in the form of a scholarship. Under this schemeRs. scholarships are awarded to 81 girl students enrolled in Diploma courses and 50 girl students enrolled in Graduation courses in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Financial assistance of 50Rs./- per annum is provided for girl students at the Diploma and Graduation levels.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a girl student. - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicants annual family income must not exceed 8Rs./-. - A maximum of two girl children are allowed per family to avail of this scholarship.

name: Dr. K.C. Sharma Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture, Agronomy (Second Year) Students)
brief_description: The Dr. K.C. Sharma Fellowship (M.Sc. AgricultureRs. Agronomy (second year) students) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture (Agronomy) who are in their second year of studyRs. by awarding them a monthly fellowship for one year.
benefits: **Fellowship Amount:** 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the second year of the M.Sc. (Agriculture) in Agronomy program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The fellowship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Animal Husbandry: Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers
brief_description: The scheme Animal Husbandry: Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to small and marginal farmers for the replacement of productive livestock lost due to notified natural disasters such as floodsRs. landslidesRs. or other calamities.
benefits: **Replacement of MilkRs. AgriculturalRs. and Transport Animals:** - **Milch animals:** 37Rs./- per animal (Buffalo/Cow/Camel/Yak/Mithun) will be payable.- 4Rs./- per animal (Sheep/Goat/Pig) will be payable. **Agricultural and Haulage Animals:** - 32Rs./- per animal (Camel/Horse/Bullock) will be payable. - 20Rs./- per animal (Calf/Donkey/Pony/Mule) will be payable. **Poultry Farming:** - 100/- per birdRs. up to a limit of 10Rs./- per beneficiary family. The death of birds must be due to a notified natural disaster to be eligible for assistance.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Small or Marginal Farmer from Uttarakhand who has lost their milkRs. agriculturalRs. or haulage animals due to a notified natural disaster.

name: Toolkit Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Toolkit Assistance is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide registered construction workers with a toolkitRs. including hand gloves and other construction-related toolsRs. worth up to 10Rs./-.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers are provided with a toolkit worth up to 10Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Stamp Duty Exemption for Property Registration
brief_description: The Stamp Duty Exemption for Property Registration scheme is implemented by the Department of Stamps and Registration under the Finance DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial relief during property registration by offering exemptions or rebates in stamp duty to specific sections of society.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. stamp duty exemptions are provided at the time of property registration to: - Include deprived sections of society in the mainstream of development. - Promote economic upliftment. - Support improved performance in agriculture-related activities. - Recognize and give importance to the states military personnel. - A 25% rebate in stamp duty is allowed on the transfer of immovable property up to the value of 25 lakh in favor of a woman buyerRs. a maximum of two times in her lifetime. - A 25% rebate in stamp duty is allowed on the transfer of immovable property up to the value of 25 lakh in favor of a disabled personRs. a maximum of two times in his lifetime. - An exemption of up to 25% in stamp duty is allowed on the transfer of immovable property up to the value of 25 lakh for serving or retired military officers/personnel of the State. - Exemption from stamp duty is provided on mortgage deeds executed for loans taken for agricultural activities.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must belong to one of the following categories: - A woman - A person with a disability - A serving or retired state military officer/personnel - An individual taking a loan for the purpose of agricultural activities

name: Mushroom Production
brief_description: The scheme Mushroom Production is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote and support mushroom cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing mushroomRs. compostRs. and spawn production unitsRs. thereby enhancing both farmer income and overall mushroom production in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under the scheme: - To promote mushroom productionRs. a 40% subsidy is provided to the individual sector (farmers or persons interested in mushroom cultivation). - For setting up a mushroom production unitRs. a 40% subsidy is providedRs. up to a maximum of 20Rs./- per unit. - For setting up a compost production unitRs. a 40% subsidy is providedRs. up to a maximum of 20Rs./- per unit. - For setting up a spawn production unitRs. a 40% subsidy is providedRs. up to a maximum of 15Rs./- per unit. - For the public sector (government departmentsRs. institutionsRs. agricultural/industrial universitiesRs. etc.)Rs. 100% subsidy is provided on the total cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom production. 1. The farmer must either own land or have land on lease. 1. Each farmer is eligible for assistance for only one unit. 1. There is no provision to provide assistance or subsidy if the farmer does not take a loan.

name: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Fencing in Gardens is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to protect fruit plantsRs. horticultural cropsRs. and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing.
benefits: The scheme provides financial support for fencing gardens to protect fruit plantsRs. horticultural cropsRs. and orchards from wild animalsRs. offering a subsidy of 50% of the total costRs. up to a maximum of 1.00 lakh per hectare.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.

name: Scheme for Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads
brief_description: The "Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. It is a sub-scheme under the umbrella scheme "Scheme for Infrastructure Development". The scheme aims to assist SSI units for the Development & Maintenance and Construction of Roads. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: Need-based loan for acquisition of capital goods equipments required for the activity.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to existing SSI units engaged in the activityRs. which have been in operation for at least 3 yearsRs. with profits in the last 2 years.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Cage Culture - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Fish Cage Culture is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and generate employment opportunities for individuals engaged in inland fisheries. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for activities such as fish cage culture and fish seed stockingRs. benefiting primarily the Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities involved in inland fisheries. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost of 3Rs./- to 1Rs./-Rs. or 60% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. > **Minimum Time Limit for Reclaiming Benefits:** 3 year from the date of availing benefit.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private unitsRs. etc.Rs. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.

name: Merit Loan Scheme for Good Borrowers
brief_description: The "Merit Loan Scheme for Good Borrowers" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist the units of PIPDIC whose loan accounts are classified as Standard Assets continuously for 3 years. The assistance is provided for construction of additional buildingRs. purchase of additional machineries & equipments essential for expansion/modernisation/diversification and meet the working capital needs. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** Maximum amount of loan shall be the equal amount paid by the unit. **Interest Concession:** 1% less than the normal rate of interest.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the following - - Already assisted units of PIPDIC whose loan accounts are classified as Standard Assets continuously for 3 years. - Good Borrowers who have already settled the loan account with PIPDIC.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing by Women - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Fish Seed Rearing by Women is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production through inland fisheries and provide employment opportunitiesRs. particularly to Scheduled Tribe women engaged in fish seed rearing. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for fish seed rearing activities to women involved in inland fisheries. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: - The 90/- will be paid per 1Rs. numbersRs. with a minimum 30% recovery for spawn to fry. - The rearing time for fish seed is 30 days. - Minimum 1 year required before reclaiming benefits under this component again.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an Individual woman involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary fisherwoman must have her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation:****** The scheme is specifically targeted at Scheduled Tribe women.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy to Establish a New Deluxe/Three Star or Higher Category New Hotel and Resort
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy to Establish a New Deluxe/Three Star or Higher Category New Hotel and Resort" was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% on fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./-. The applicant must invest a minimum of 10Rs./- in capital expenditure and ensure the establishment of at least 50 lettable air-conditioned rooms. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board and applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state's investment portal.
benefits: - The beneficiary is entitled to a Capital Investment Subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy provided is 5Rs./-. ##### ***Disbursal Conditions*** - _The unit must be operational for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The unit must submit a self-declaration regarding continuous operation on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within 1 year of receiving the subsidyRs. 80% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 2 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 60% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 3 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 50% of the amount must be refunded._ - _Investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation will be accepted for calculating the capital subsidy._
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a new Hotel or Resort that falls under the "Deluxe/Three Star or Higher" category. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 10Rs./-Rs. as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the facility has a minimum of 50 lettable air-conditioned rooms available. - The applicant must be a private investorRs. as the policy aims to promote private investment. - The applicant must submit the application for the capital subsidy within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must not have claimed Investment Promotion Assistance for the same unitRs. as units claiming that assistance are not entitled to capital subsidy.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of New Resort and Wellness Centre
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of New Hotel or Mini Resort of Standard Category" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% against fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 50Rs./-. The applicant must invest a minimum capital expenditure of 2Rs./- and ensure the availability of a minimum of air-conditioned lettable rooms (25 for hotels or 10 for resorts). The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted within one year from the date of commencement of operation.
benefits: - The scheme provides a Capital Investment Subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 2Rs./-. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - The unit must be established and operationalised during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy 2025. - If the unit executes and operates the entire project in one goRs. the capital expenditure incurred up to a maximum of 05 years prior to the commencement of the unit (as approved by the department) will be considered valid for the calculation of the capital grant. - If the unit is entitled to a grant/subsidy in more than one categoryRs. the applicant must choose only one category in which they are willing to get the benefit. - The unit must be run for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidyRs. and a self-declaration regarding continuous operation must be submitted on or before the 15th of April every year. - On non-compliance regarding the three-year operation periodRs. the subsidy is liable to be recovered with interest/penalty: a) Closure within 1 year: 80% to be refunded. b) Closure within 2 years: 60% to be refunded. c) Closure within 3 years: 50% to be refunded.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private investor establishing a Tourism Project in Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must establish a new Resort and Wellness Centre equipped with AyurvedicRs. YogaRs. and Naturopathic treatment facilities. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 5Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the unit is established as per the definitionRs. criterionRs. and standards defined by the Government of India or the State Government. - The applicant must obtain the necessary certification for the wellness/resort project as required by the Tourism Department. - The applicant must submit the application for the subsidy within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must not have claimed Investment Promotion Assistance or capital subsidy under any other category for the same project.

name: Capital Subsidy for Heritage Hotel under Proprietorship
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Subsidy for Heritage Hotel under Proprietorship" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of heritage hotels through private investment by providing financial assistance to proprietors. The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 15% on fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 2Rs./-. The applicant must be a proprietorship firm establishing a Heritage Hotel with a minimum capital expenditure of 3Rs./-. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state investment portal or the designated department within one year from the date of commencement of operation.
benefits: - The beneficiary receives a subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum subsidy amount is capped at 2Rs./-. ***Benefit Disbursal Conditions*** - _The unit must be established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the policy._ - _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within 1 year of receipt of subsidyRs. 80% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 2 years of receipt of subsidyRs. 60% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 3 years of receipt of subsidyRs. 50% of the amount must be refunded._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Proprietorship. - The applicant must be establishing a "Heritage Hotel" as a Tourism Project. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 3Rs./- (as approved by the department). - The applicant must have established and operationalized the project during the operative tenure of the policy. - The applicant must submit the application within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must ensure the investment claimed for subsidy was made not prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation (or 5 years if the project was executed in one go). - The applicant must not claim Investment Promotion Assistance if claiming this capital subsidy.

name: Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene/Petrol
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to OBM Boat Owner Fishermen on Purchase of Kerosene/Petrol" has been launched by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishermen owning small boats with Outboard Motors (OBM) by subsidizing the cost of kerosene or petrol. This initiative supports the fishing community and promotes fisheries in Gujarat.
benefits: **Assistance under the scheme:** **Name of Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Assistance on the purchase of Kerosene/Petrol Maximum assistance of 50/- per literBenefits are available as per the prescribed quota throughout the year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must be a Kerosene Card holder. 1. The applicant must own a small boat operated by an Outboard Motor (OBM).

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (3 years - 6 years)
brief_description: The Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (3 years 6 years) scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomesRs. with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 3 years and 6 years.
benefits: - **The monthly entitlements for SUW children in the 3 years to 6 years & MAM children in the 6 months to 5 years category for a period of 75 days will be as follows:** **Sl. No.****Type of Take Home Ration (THR)****Quantity**1Hot Cooked Meals under regular SNP25 days2Besan-Atta Premix750 gram3Banana16 pieces4Eggs5 pieces - **Date of delivery:** Hot cooked meals under regular SNP at Anganwadi Centres (AWCs)Rs. Besan Atta Premix to be delivered to the beneficiaries at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) on the 1st of every monthRs. Eggs and Banana to be given weekly by the Anganwadi Workers (AWW). - After 75 daysRs. if the child graduates to normal categoryRs. the child would will be continue getting Hot Cooked Meals as children under normal category under SNP programme. - Regular growth monitoring and medical examination of all SUW & MAM children will be undertaken monthly during the VHSND by Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) and on the event of any medical complications child needs to be referred to the Community Health Centre (CHC). - If the child has not graduated to normal category or cured even after 75 days of enrolmentRs. the child may be referred to the nearest Community Health Centre and based on the suggestion from the doctorRs. the child can be again enrolled under MSPY for one more cycle only.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 3 years and 6 years. 1. The child must be identified as Severely Underweight (SUW) or Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) by the Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

name: Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana is a scholarship scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to female students belonging to the Balmiki community. The Balmiki communityRs. also known as ValmikiRs. is a socially and economically disadvantaged community in India. The main objective of this scheme is to promote education and empower students from economically weaker backgrounds. It recognizes the importance of education in uplifting individuals and communities and seeks to bridge the gap by providing financial support. The beneficiary receives 18Rs. per annum for college-level studies and professional courses.
benefits: Scholarship of 18Rs. per annum.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant should be a girl student.
3. The applicant should belong to the Valmiki Family engaged in Unclean Occupation.
4. The applicant should have been admitted to a matriculation course.

name: Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna
brief_description: The scheme Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh during the year 2013-14. Under the schemeRs. an Incentive/Award will be given to all those students of the State who are selected and take admission for a degree course in any Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT) or All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) or a post Graduate Diploma Course in any Indian Institute of Management (IIMs). Indian School of Mines (ISM) Dhanbad at Jharkhand & Indian Institute of Science (IISc) at BangaloreRs. have also been added to the list of institutions eligible for award under this scheme w.e.f. 2014-15.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. a one-time incentive/award of 75000/- will be given to all the eligible students.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a native of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The studentRs. who is selected and take admission for a degree course in any Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) or All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) or for a Post Graduate Diploma Course in any Indian Institute of Management (IIM) or Indian School of Mines (ISM) Dhanbad or Indian Institute of Science (IISc)Rs. is eligible to apply for award under this scheme.

name: Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The **Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme** was started by the Department of EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. Under the schemeRs. a scholarship is given to the students of Himachal Pradesh studying at Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra. The Scholarship will be awarded on merit-cum-means basis to such students who are eligible for admission and who join the Sainik Schools based on a competitive entrance examination that may be held every year for this purpose.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the scholarship will be given to the eligible students at the rate of 18Rs./- per annum.
1. The students will also be given Dietary Money @ 10/- per day for 295 days.
1. Clothing Allowance @ 1Rs./- per annum for the first year and 750/- per annum for the subsequent years.
eligibility:
1. The students studying at Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra and Bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh from Class VI to XII will be eligible to apply for the scholarship.

> **Conditions for the award of Renewal of Scholarships:**

A scholarship once awarded to a student will continue to be awarded to him throughout this stay in the schoolRs. provided:-

1. The student makes satisfactory progress in his standard.
1. The student is not reported adversely regarding discipline.
1. No scholarship holder under this scheme draws a scholarship for financial assistance from any other source.
1. If the student fails in any Class the scholarship will be suspended for that particular class.

> **Revision of Scholarships:**

A scholarship once awarded will be tenable for the entire course of education and will not be subject to any revision for subsequent changes in income.

name: Capital Subsidy for Establishment of Sea Plane, Amphibian Tourist Vehicle and Aero Sports and Aero Sports Training Centre/Academy
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Subsidy for Establishment of Sea PlaneRs. Amphibian Tourist Vehicle and Aero Sports and Aero Sports Training Centre/Academy" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government Of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote adventure tourism and enhance connectivity by incentivizing the establishment of aero sports facilities and the operation of specialized tourist vehicles. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 25% on the fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 10Rs./-. The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- to be eligible for this specific subsidy category. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the designated investment portal.
benefits: - The beneficiary will receive a capital investment subsidy equivalent to 25% of the approved fixed capital investment. - The maximum subsidy amount provided under this scheme is capped at 10Rs./-. - For Aero Sports and Aero Sports Training Centres/AcademiesRs. the subsidy shall be given after one year from the date of operation. - For Sea Plane and Amphibian Tourist VehiclesRs. the subsidy will be released in phases: 40% at the start of operationRs. and 20% per year in the subsequent 2ndRs. 3rdRs. and 4th years. - Investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation of the unit shall be accepted for calculating the capital subsidy.
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a tourism project falling under the category of Sea PlaneRs. Amphibian Tourist VehicleRs. Aero SportsRs. or Aero Sports Training Centre/Academy. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy 2025. - The applicant must register the unit with the Tourism Department to avail of the benefits. - The applicant must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of April every year for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - The applicant must ensure that if the unit is closed within specified timeframes (1 to 3 years) after receiving the subsidyRs. the applicable amount (80% to 50%) is refunded.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy For Expansion Of Established Star/Deluxe/Standard Hotel/Resort/Heritage Hotel
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy For Expansion Of Established Star/Deluxe/Standard Hotel/Resort/Heritage Hotel" was launched by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the expansion of existing tourism accommodation units by incentivizing private investment in the state. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% against the fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./-. The applicant must ensure an expansion of at least 50% in the staying capacity of the established unit to be eligible for the subsidy. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Madhya Pradesh Government's Invest Portal.
benefits: - The beneficiary is entitled to a Capital Investment Subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum ceiling for the subsidy is 5Rs./-. - The subsidy is granted for the expansion of established StarRs. DeluxeRs. Standard HotelsRs. ResortsRs. or Heritage Hotels. ##### ***Conditions*** - The unit must maintain continuous operation and submit a self-declaration on or before the 15th of April every year regarding the continuous operation of the unit for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - If the unit closes within 1 year from the date of receipt of the subsidyRs. 80% of the subsidy amount has to be refunded. - If the unit closes within 2 years from the date of receipt of the subsidyRs. 60% of the subsidy amount has to be refunded. - If the unit closes within 3 years from the date of receipt of the subsidyRs. 50% of the subsidy amount has to be refunded.
eligibility: - The applicant must have an established StarRs. DeluxeRs. or Standard HotelRs. ResortRs. or Heritage Hotel. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure an expansion in terms of a minimum of 50% increased staying capacity to be eligible for the subsidy. - The applicant must obtain the necessary certification of heritage hotels/tourism projects from the Tourism Department to avail the exemptions/facilities. - The applicant must submit the application for capital subsidy within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must ensure that the investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation is not calculated for the capital subsidy.

name: Installation of Ropeway Infrastructure for Transport in Inaccessible Tourist Places or Forest Areas
brief_description: The scheme "Installation of Ropeway Infrastructure for Transport in Inaccessible Tourist Places or Forest Areas" was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote private investment in establishing transport infrastructure in difficult terrains to enhance tourist accessibility. The scheme provides a Capital Investment Subsidy of 40% on Fixed Capital InvestmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./-. The applicant must invest a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- to install ropeway infrastructure in inaccessible tourist places or forest areas. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism BoardRs. and applications are accepted online through the state investment portal.
