benefits: **Capital Investment Subsidy:** The scheme offers a subsidy of 40% against the Fixed Capital Investment. **Maximum Ceiling:** The maximum subsidy amount is capped at 5Rs./- (Five Crore Rupees). ***Conditions*** - The unit must be established and operated as per the definitionRs. criterionRs. and standards defined by the Government. - The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding continuous operation on or before the 15th of April every year. - If the unit closes within one year of receiving the subsidyRs. 80% of the amount must be refunded.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private investor or entity establishing a tourism project defined under the policy. - The applicant must propose a project for the installation of ropeway infrastructure for transport. - The applicant must locate the project in inaccessible tourist places or forest areas. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- (One Crore Rupees) as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy. - The applicant must submit the application for capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation.

name: Special Incentives for Wildlife Resorts
brief_description: The scheme "Special Incentives for Wildlife Resorts" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the establishment of wildlife resorts within the boundaries of notified National ParksRs. Tiger ReservesRs. and Sanctuaries in the state to promote balanced and sustainable tourism. The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 20% on the fixed capital investmentRs. with a maximum ceiling ranging from 1Rs./- to 3Rs./- depending on the specific forest area category. The applicant must establish a resort meeting the minimum capital expenditure and room capacity requirements specific to the classified forest zones. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state investment portal.
benefits:
##### ***Category A Forest Areas (KanhaRs. BandhavgarhRs. Pench Tiger ReserveRs. Ratapani Tiger Reserve & adjacent National Parks & Sanctuaries)*** - The beneficiary receives a Capital Subsidy of 20% on the approved fixed capital investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 1Rs./-. ##### ***Category B Forest Areas (Panna & Satpuda Tiger Reserve and adjacent National Parks & Sanctuaries)*** - The beneficiary receives a Capital Subsidy of 20% on the approved fixed capital investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 2Rs./-. ##### ***Category C Forest Areas (Sanjay Dubri Tiger ReserveRs. Kuno National ParkRs. Veerangana Durgavati Tiger ReserveRs. Madhav National ParkRs. Gandhi SagarRs. other protected areasRs. and new entry routes of Category A and B)*** - The beneficiary receives a Capital Subsidy of 20% on the approved fixed capital investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 3Rs./-.
#### ***Conditions*** - The unit must remain in continuous operation for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - The unit must submit a self-declaration regarding continuous operation on or before the 15th of April every year. - If the unit closes within 1 year of receipt of subsidyRs. 80% of the subsidy amount must be refunded. - If the unit closes within 2 years of receipt of subsidyRs. 60% of the subsidy amount must be refunded. - If the unit closes within 3 years of receipt of subsidyRs. 50% of the subsidy amount must be refunded.
eligibility: - The applicant must establish the wildlife resort within the boundaries of notified National ParksRs. Tiger ReservesRs. and Sanctuaries in the state of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy. - The applicant must submit the application for capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation. ##### ***For Category A Forest Areas*** - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 5Rs./-. - The applicant must construct a minimum of 10 rooms. ##### ***For Category B Forest Areas*** - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 3Rs./-. - The applicant must construct a minimum of 07 rooms. ##### ***For Category C Forest Areas*** - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./-. - The applicant must construct a minimum of 05 rooms.

name: Odisha Sahaya Scheme - Pre & Post Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha recognizes that beggars are valuable human resources for society and seeks to create an environment that provides them equal opportunitiesRs. protection of their rightsRs. and full participation in society. The SSEPD DepartmentRs. Government of OdishaRs. as part of an integrated initiative for beggarsRs. promotes the scheme SAHAYA-PRE & POST MATRIC SCHOLARSHIP to provide financial assistance to child beggars and children of beggars studying at pre and post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships are available to child beggars and children of beggars for studies in India only and are awarded where the applicant is studying.
benefits: 1. The students desirous to avail of the scholarship shall submit applications in the prescribed format to the DSSO with certification/ recommendation by the head of the educational institutions. 2. Under this scheme students so eligible will get a scholarship for a maximum period of 10 months in an academic year. The students availing scholarships from either the Central or State Govt. under any other scheme shall not be considered. 3. Rate of scholarship - Pre-Matric (From Std. V to X) 800/- Per month. - Post-Matric (From Std. XIXII) 1Rs./- Per month. - General Graduate/ Post Graduate Courses 1Rs./- Per month. - Professional Degrees/ Diplomas/ Certificates 2Rs./- Per month. 4. The DSSOs will scrutinize the applications and shall submit requirement of funds to the Department by the end of September. After receipt of the fundsRs. DSSOs will remit the scholarship to the accounts of the students with the approval of the Collector. 5. The scholarship required will be remitted in advance for one year in question and roll over to the next academic session. 6. The utilization certificate on the expenditure shall be submitted by the DSSO along with proof of remittance with due counter signature of the Collector to the Department by 28th February of each year. 7. Efforts should be made to utilize funds in the same year. In exigenciesRs. the undisbursed balance amount should be rolled over for next year's payment and shall be utilized first.
eligibility: 1. The applicant is a bona fide resident of Odisha. 1. The applicant is either a beggar or the child of a beggar. 1. The applicant is a regular student of recognised educational institutions. 1. The applicant shall have a family income of not more than 2Rs./- per annum. 1. The applicant is not in receipt of any financial assistance from the State Govt./ Central Govt. under any other scheme.

name: Modular Employable Skills
brief_description:
The Department of Technical EducationRs. Vocational and Industrial TrainingRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme to meet the demand for specific skills a PPP model was initiated between Government and Industry to promote skills development programme under the name Skill Development Initiative. Under the Skill Development Initiative Scheme (SDIS) based on Modular Employable Skills Training was introduced. It is aimed at improving the employability of the Indian workforce by providing vocational training.
**The objective of the scheme are:-**

1. to provide vocational training to school leaversRs. existing workersRs. ITI graduatesRs. etc. to improve their employability by optimally utilizing the infrastructure available in Govt.Rs. private institutions and the Industry. Existing skills of the persons can also be tested and certified under this scheme.
1. to build capacity in the area of development of competency standardsRs. course curriculaRs. learning material and assessment standards in the country.

**Key Features of the Scheme are:-**

1. Demand driven short term training courses based on Modular Employable Skills (MES) decided in consultation with Industry. MES is the minimum skills set which is sufficient for gainful employment.
1. Central government will facilitate and promote training while industryRs. private sector and State Governments will train the persons.
1. Optimum utilisation of existing infrastructure to make training cost effective.
1. Flexible delivery mechanism (part timeRs. weekendsRs. full timeRs. onsite/ offsite) to suit needs of various target groups.
1. Different levels of programmes (Foundation level as well as skill upgradation) to meet demands of various target groups.
1. The services of existing or retired faculty or guest faculty to be utilized.
1. Courses would also be available for persons having completed 5th standard.
1. Testing & certification of skills acquired informally.
1. Testing of skills of trainees by independent assessing bodiesRs. which would not be involved in training deliveryRs. to ensure that it is done impartially.
1. The essence of the scheme is in the certification that will be nationally and internationally recognized.

**Note:**
Under Skill Development initiative scheme (SDIS) based on Modular Employable Skills Training is provided in different ITIs / VTPs the field of Eighteen sectors namely:

1. Automotive RepairRs.
1. Banking and AccountingRs.
1. Beauty Culture & Hair DressingRs.
1. ElectricalRs.
1. ElectronicsRs.
1. Garment makingRs.
1. Plastic processingRs.
1. Fashion designRs.
1. Information and Communication TechnologyRs.
1. FabricationsRs.
1. PrintingRs.
1. Production and ManufacturingRs.
1. Refrigeration and Air conditioningRs.
1. Toy makingRs.
1. PaintRs.
1. ConstructionRs.
1. Wood work and
1. Industrial Electrical.

There are 77 nos of Vocational Training Providers as on date.
benefits:
1. **Improved employability:** The MES scheme is designed to provide vocational training to individuals in various sectorsRs. making them more employable in the job market. 1. **Flexible training:** The training provided under the MES scheme is modularRs. meaning that it can be taken up in partsRs. making it flexible for individuals to learn at their own pace. 1. **Certification:** The MES scheme provides certification for the skills learnedRs. which is recognized by the industryRs. making it easier for individuals to get jobs. 1. **Skill development:** The MES scheme provides training in various skillsRs. including soft skillsRs. technical skillsRs. and practical skillsRs. which help in the overall development of an individual. 1. **Cost-effective:** The MES scheme is a cost-effective way of providing vocational training to individualsRs. as the training is provided in modulesRs. reducing the cost of training. 1. **Encourages entrepreneurship:** The MES scheme also encourages entrepreneurship by providing training in various sectorsRs. making it easier for individuals to start their own businesses.
**Note:** OverallRs. the MES scheme has been beneficial in providing vocational training to individuals and improving their employabilityRs. which is important for the growth of the Indian economy.
**MES would benefit different target groups like :**

1. Workers seeking certification of their skills acquired informally workers and ITI graduates seeking skill upgradation early school drop-outs and unemployed Previously child labour and their families.
1. The essence of the scheme is in the certification that will be nationally and internationally recognized. Successful persons will be awarded certificates issued by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a school leaverRs. existing workerRs. or ITI graduate seeking vocational training to improve employability. 1. The applicant should be willing to undergo skill assessmentRs. trainingRs. or certification under the scheme. 1. The applicant should meet the course-specific eligibility norms prescribed by the concerned training institution or industry.

name: Indira Gandhi Utkrisht Chattervriti Yojana
brief_description: The Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme named "**Indira Gandhi Utkrisht Chattervriti Yojana**" for post plus two students. Through this schemeRs. a scholarship of 18Rs./- per annum will be awarded to 10 meritorious students each from Class 12 (ArtsRs. ScienceRs. and Commerce) and from the merit list of B.A.Rs. B.Sc. and B.Com. degree. The scholarship will be renewed yearly until they complete the degree/course. This scheme aims to recognize and financially support exceptionally meritorious students pursuing higher educationRs. promoting academic excellence and equal opportunities across the state.
benefits: - A total of 150 meritorious students will receive 18Rs. per annum based on merit.
eligibility:
**To be eligibleRs.**

- an applicant must**** be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh and fulfil the below academic criteria:

1. **Class 12:** Students must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education (HPBOSE) Class 12 examination in any stream (ArtsRs. ScienceRs. Commerce). 1. **Graduate Level:** Students must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the undergraduate degree examination from a recognized university. 1. be enrolled in an academic or professional stream at a recognized university or institution within or outside Himachal Pradesh.

name: State Technical Scholarship for ST Student
brief_description: The State Technical Scholarship for ST Student is a scholarship schemeRs. implemented by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Nagaland. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to students of Scheduled Tribe Communities who are pursuing Diploma/Degree/Post Graduated/course in Engineering Institutes recognized by All India Council for Technical Education. Assistance is also provided to students who are pursuing UG or PG in Forestry courses.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance/scholarships will be given to students according to the course/programme in which they are enrolled.
1. Scholarship shall be provided for a maximum period of 3 years for DiplomaRs. 4 years for Degree (B.E/B.Tech.)Rs. and 2 years for (M.E/M.Tech).
eligibility:
A student should fulfil the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

1. The applicant/student should be an inhabitant of Nagaland.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe Community.
1. The annual income of the applicants parents from all sources must not exceed 6 lakhs.
1. The applicant pursuing Diploma/Degree/Post Graduated/ course in Engineering Institutes recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education can apply.
1. The applicants pursuing UG or PG in Forestry courses are eligible for this scheme.
1. Applicant must not be an employee of any government/semi-government establishment.

**Note 01:** Applicant pursuing courses other than mentioned in Sl. No. 2 & 3 are not eligible for this scheme.
**Note 02:** If any documents are found to be false/fraud or a candidate availing more than 1 (one) scholarship schemes in the same academic year the candidate shall be disqualified/debarred under state Technical Scholarship.

name: Scholarship For Differently Abled Students
brief_description: The scheme Scholarship for Differently Abled Students was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. the differently abled students studying in SchoolsRs. CollegesRs. and those who attend ProfessionalRs. PG courses and technical training are being given scholarships by Social Justice Department. The disability category of students (Blind/Deaf/Orthopedically handicapped/Mental Retardation) with a disability of 40% or more and who obtain 40% marks in the examination in the previous year are eligible to apply for the scholarships.
benefits:
The scholarship is being provided to students whose disability percentage is 40% or above on the following basis:
**Sl. No.****Standard****Day Scholars****Hostel Students****Readers allowance**1Students from Class 1 to Class 4300/- per month-200/- per month2Students from Class 5 to Class 10500/- per month-200/- per month3+1Rs. +2Rs. IT Equivalent courses750/- per month1000/- per month300/- per month4DegreeRs. PolytechnicRs. Equivalent training coursesRs. (Implant training) 1000/- per month1500/- per month400/- per month5ProfessionalRs. PG courses1000/- per month1500/- per month400/- per month
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.
- The applicant should be a differently abled student.
- The differently abled student should have a disability of 40 % or more.
- Disability category of students (Blind / Deaf / Orthopedically handicapped/ Mental Retardation).
- The differently abled students studying in SchoolsRs. Colleges and attending ProfessionalRs. PG courses and technical training are eligible to apply under the scheme.
- Students with disabilities who have secured at least 40% marks in the previous year can apply under the scheme.
- The annual family income of the applicant should be below 36Rs./-.

name: Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent (Class - 11 To 12)
brief_description: The Government of Odisha in School & Mass Education DepartmentRs. is awarding the Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship (PSMTS) out of the State budget to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School Students of Odisha having proficiency in Mathematics studying in Odia medium Government/Aided/Recognised Institutions. The scholarship is awarded to students pursuing their studies in Class XI and XII in Higher Secondary Schools affiliated with the Council of Higher Secondary EducationRs. Odisha. Under this schemeRs. the top 1000 students fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive 5Rs./- per month for 10 months in a year. > **Merit Criteria for Selection:** The following factors will be taken into consideration: 1. Fulfilment of eligibility conditions as per the modalities. 2. Online authentication/invalidation of student records by the Principal/Head of the concerned Higher Secondary Schools/Institutions. 3. Final Merit/Selection list of 1000 students will be drawn in terms of aggregate marks plus the marks secured in Mathematics in the HSC Exam provided by BSE (O). 4. In case of a tieRs. the candidate's position shall be determined by the mark secured in S.C.P. > **Procedure for Disbursement:** The scholarship would be sanctioned subject to the fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility criteria by the students and validation/authentication by the Principals of the concerned Higher Secondary Schools/ Institutions in online mode only. The scholarship will be paid to the selected students by the Directorate of Higher Secondary Education through DM (Direct Benefit Transfer) mode only and will be transferred to the Bank account of the beneficiaries. > **Duration of Scholarship and its Renewal:** A student eligible for the scholarship will be paid for 10 months a year. Scholarship awarded to any student under the Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship is renewable if the awardee qualifies for promotion to a higher class (Class XII)Rs. which will be authenticated online by the concerned Higher Secondary School/Institution. For scholarship renewalRs. the names of selected students in the previous selection year will be listed in the Principal's login ID. Only students continuing in the concerned academic year have to be authenticated online by the Principal. If any student is found to have dropped out/not been promotedRs. then the Higher Secondary School shall not validate their record.
benefits: 1. The students of Class XI and XII fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive 5Rs./- per month for 10 months in a year. 1. A student may enjoy more than one scholarship at a timeRs. including PSMTS.
eligibility:
1. The student pursuing his/her studies in Class XI and XII in Higher Secondary Schools affiliated to Council of Higher Secondary EducationRs. Odisha.
1. The students have proficiency in Mathematics.
1. The candidate must belong to the GeneralRs. SCRs. STRs. OBC/SEBC & EBC categories.
1. The scheme is applicable to students reading in Odia Medium Higher Secondary Schools affiliated to CHSE(O).
1. There shall be no income criteria for the award of this scholarship.

name: Vidyakiranam Scheme-Educational Assistance To Children Of Disabled Parents
brief_description: The scheme Vidyakiranam Scheme-Educational Assistance to Children of Disabled Parents was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The government of Kerala has initiated this scheme which provides educational assistance to children of differently abled parents (disability for both parents/ disability for anyone parent) who are economically deprived. Under the schemeRs. educational assistance will be provided to 25 children from each district for a duration of 10 months.
benefits:
**The following benefits will be provided to the children of differently-abled parents studying in various classes under this scheme:**
**Sl. No.****Class****Scholarship Rate**1Standard 1 to 5300/- per month for 10 months2Standard 6 to 10500/- per month for 10 months3+1Rs. +2Rs. ITI equivalent courses750/- per month for 10 months4DegreeRs. Post-GraduationRs. PolytechnicRs. Equivalent CoursesRs. Training CoursesRs. Professional Courses1000/- per month for 10 months**Note 01:** The scholarship will be provided to all classes for a duration of 10 months.
**Note 02:** Financial assistance will be awarded only once per class.
**Note 03:** The scholarship amount will be transferred to the bank account of the eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.
1. The children of differently abled parents belonging to the BPL category (Both / Anyone) will get a scholarship under this scheme.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The disability of the applicants father/ mother must be 40% or above.
1. The students pursuing courses from Govt. approved institutions are eligible to apply under this scheme.

name: Junior Merit (Class - 11 To 12)
brief_description:
The Government of Odisha in School & Mass Education Department is awarding "Junior Merit Scholarship" under the Scheme 'e-medhabruti out of the State budget to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School students of Odisha from families whose parental income does not exceed 6.00 lakhs to meet a part of their educational expenses while pursuing their higher studies.
The scholarship is awarded to students pursuing Class XI & XII in the Higher Secondary Schools of the State.
**Merit Criteria For Selection:** The following factors will be taken into consideration:

- Fulfillment of eligibility conditions as given in the scheme.
- Online authentication/validation of student records by the Principal of the concerned Higher Secondary School/Institute.
- Final Merit/Selection lists of the students will be drawn in terms of the percentage of marks obtained in the HSC examination from among the validated students in the meritRs. proportionately based on the data. The mode of selection for scholarship shall be made through descending order of merit till it reaches the eligible quota of scholarship. For exampleRs. a student who has secured 92% of mark in the last examination shall come first then the one who has secured 91% markRs. and so on.
- In case of a tie in the percentage of marks under a particular type of scholarship and some are to be left out due to exceeding the maximum quota of scholarshipRs. then the parental income ceiling will be considered i.e. the student with a lower parental income ceiling will get preference.
- The CBSE/ICSE grading system in the form of CGPA i.e. Grade points shall be converted to the percentage by multiplying with 9.5 formula percentage (%) = CGPA x 9.5.

**Procedure for Disbursement:**
The scholarship would be sanctioned subject to fulfillment of the prescribed eligibility criteria by the students and validation/authentication by the Principals of the concerned Higher Secondary Schools/ Institutes in online mode only. The scholarship will be paid to the selected students by the Directorate of Higher Secondary Education through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) mode only. It will be transferred to the Bank account of the beneficiaries.
**Duration of Scholarship and its Renewal:**
A student will be eligible for the scholarship for the total duration of the course (Class XI to XII). Scholarship awarded to any student under State Scholarship Portal is automatically renewableRs. subject to the student continuing in Class XII (2nd Year) and online validation authentication done by the institute.
**Cancellation of Scholarship:** The scholarship sanctioned is liable to be cancelled on the following occasions.
1. If the student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statements/ fabricated documents.
2. If the student discontinues his/her studiesRs. the scholarship shall be stopped from the subsequent year.
benefits:
1. The students pursuing Class XI & XII in the Higher Secondary Schools of the State will receive a scholarship amount of 3000/- per year.
1. The number of scholarships will be awarded to 10Rs. students (Boys & Girls in 50:50 ratio).
eligibility:
1. The student must be a permanent resident of Odisha State.
1. The Student must have passed HSC with 60% or more marks from an institution recognized by BSE OdishaRs. CBSERs. ICSERs. or Equivalent BoardsRs. and pursuing regular Class XI courses of 10+2.
1. The income of the parents of the students from all sources should not exceed 6.00 lakh per annum.
1. Students shall apply for Junior Merit Scholarship in the 1st year of the course (Class XI).
1. The students belong to GeneralRs. SCRs. STRs. OBC/SEBC & EBC categories may eligible to apply.

name: Varnam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses
brief_description:
The scheme Varnam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The Government has started this scheme for supporting Transgender students which provides financial assistance to Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma/ PG courses through distance education. Several Transgender students are not able to study regular courses in colleges but instead pursue Degree/Post Graduate courses via distance education. Due to their deprived financial conditionsRs. they are unable to meet the expenses incurred for payment of Registration feesRs. Tuition feesRs. Exam feesRs. study materialsRs. etc.
**Aims & Objectives:**

1. Majority of the transgender persons are either dropouts or discontinue education in the early stages and due to the stigma the family members also disown them. Since they are unable to find a sustainable livelihoodRs. they suffer financially. This scheme will support transgender students to complete their education successfully and earn a decent living and make them financially independent.
1. With the help of this distance education schemeRs. transgender students will be able to pursue their desired courses.
1. Transgender persons who are eligible for higher studies can complete their education and secure a decent job to lead a dignified life. This will encourage them to be self-sufficient and will open up a world of opportunities for such a target population.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a maximum amount of 24Rs./- will be provided annually to each eligible Transgender student.
1. For students pursuing PG courses the assistance will be provided for 2 years and for Under Graduate students the assistance will be given for 3 years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State. 1. The applicant should be Transgender. 1. Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma/ PG courses from Open universitiesRs. Distance educationRs. or Private registration are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Shikshashree Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Shikshashree Scheme was implemented by the Government of West Bengal during 2014-15 by merging the existing schemes of Book Grants & Maintenance Grants to provide financial assistance to Schedule Caste students studying in classes V to VIII. FormerlyRs. day-scholar students of classes V-VIII belonging to the Scheduled Caste category enjoyed two grants namely a) assistance in the form of a book grant and b) assistance in the form of a maintenance grant. The number of such grants was meager and did not serve the intended purpose. FurtherRs. the method of selection of candidates and that of disbursements is cumbersome and time-consuming. In order to do away with these predicaments inherent in the scheme and to provide quality assistance to Schedule Caste (SC) students of Classes V to VIII in a smoothRs. transparentRs. and efficient wayRs. a new scheme of providing assistance to the target group is being formulated in the name of "Shikshashree Scheme". The "Shikshashree Scheme" scheme of providing assistance to SC day scholars of Class V-VIII is evolved by merging the existing schemes of Book Grants and Maintenance Grants. It is applicable to the day scholars of West Bengal reading in class V-VIII in any GovernmentRs. Government-aided and all Government recognized schools of West Bengal. **Objective:** - To provide financial assistance to the SC students reading in classes V to VIII to improve their participation in Pre-matric stages and minimize the incidence of drop-out especially in the case of girl students.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. eligible students shall be provided financial assistance through Bank Account only:
**Class****Rate (Per Annum)**V750/-VI750/-VII750/-VIII800/-2. To improve participation of students in Pre-matric stages and minimize the incidence of drop-out especially in the case of girl students.
eligibility: 1. The students should belong to Scheduled Caste. 1. Students of classes V-VIII are eligible for the scheme. 1. The annual family income of the student should not exceed 2.5 lakhs. 1. Only day scholars belonging to West Bengal can apply for this scholarship. 1. The applicant should be a regular full-time student reading in a Government School/Government-aided School and Govt. recognized schools in West Bengal. 1. The award once made will continue subject to subsequent application of the student up to class VIII and good conduct and attendance and otherwise being eligible. 1. The applicant should not get any other scholarship or stipend in any form for the same period. In case it is detected that the incumbent has drawn any amount of similar character from any other source this scholarship has to be refunded. 1. The applicant should be a holder of a bank account in a nationalized bank with a core banking facility. 1. The Scholarships for studying in any class will be available for only one year. If a student has to repeat a classRs. he/she would not get a scholarship for that class for a second year. HoweverRs. if he or she is promoted to the next class subsequently he/she will enjoy the benefit provided the incumbent applicant is otherwise eligible.

name: Aamar Dukan On Wheels
brief_description: **Details** The Government proposes to introduce a new module of Aamar Dukan namely AAMAR DUKAN ON WHEELS in the same line as the existing Aamar Dukan. Under the new moduleRs. 22 Non-PDS items (which may increase to 36) will be delivered to the doorstep of the consumer at below MRP with a minimum profit margin. Eco-friendly E-rickshaws will be used as the transportation mode under the Scheme. Through this schemeRs. Government plans to promote cashless transactions as the E-Rickshaws will have a GPS-enabled smart phoneRs. and Bluetooth billing printer which will be connected to the smart phone. **Objective** The basic objective of the Scheme Aamar Dukan on Wheels is to control the price of essential commodities by avoiding the middleman. Through this schemeRs. the consumers will get their daily requirements of essential commodities at their doorstep at a reasonable price and shall also contribute to the removal of the unemployment problem.
benefits: **Benefits** 1. The beneficiary will keep the commodities allotted by the Department in case of AAMAR DUKAN on wheels in addition to other commodities. 1. The selected beneficiaries of AAMAR DUKAN on wheels is allowed to take a profit margin of Rs. 2.00 to Rs. 3.00 per Kg./Per litre from consumers. 1. The selected beneficiaries must abide by the direction of the DirectorRs. FCS&CARs. Deputy Commissioners/Sub-Divisional Officers/Principal Secretaries of all Autonomous Councils. Any lapse on their part will be viewed seriously and legal action may be initiated also they will have to return the financial aid in addition to interest to the authority. 1. The beneficiary should operate his shop as per the schedule specified by the authority. Any lapses in this regard will amount to the cancellation of his licence. 1. The area of operation will be specified by the local authority for each beneficiary. 1. The AAMAR DUKAN holders on wheels must display the displaying board of prices while distributing commodities. 1. The AAMAR DUKAN holders on wheels will lift commodities from the selected wholesalers/stockists as per the direction of the respective Deputy Commissioners/Sub-Divisional Officers/Principal Secretaries of all Autonomous Councils. 1. The beneficiary should operate his shop as per the schedule specified by the authority. Any lapses in this regard will amount to the cancellation of his licence. 1. The AAMAR DUKAN on wheels should maintain the stock book and distribution register for inspecting authority.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The applicant should be educated unemployed youth.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Assam.
1. He should attain the age of 18 years and above.
1. His name should be registered in the Employment Exchange.
1. The minimum educational qualification will be HSLC or equivalent.

name: Post Matric Merit Scholarship
brief_description: The Post Matric Merit Scholarship is a scheme implemented by the Mizoram Scholarship BoardRs. Higher and Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram. The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to permanent residents of Mizoram State securing 60% marks in Board/University Examination. The scheme is 100% funded by the State Plan Fund.
benefits:
- Tuition fees
- Maintenance allowance (for boarding and lodging expenses)
- Other related expenses like booksRs. stationeryRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a bonafide permanent resident of MizoramRs. or the child/ward of a bonafide permanent resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be pursuing regular studies in a recognized post-matric institution in India. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks or a first division/class in the last Board or University examination. 1. The applicant pursuing postgraduate courses in Medicine will be eligible only if they are not allowed to practice during the course duration.

name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post 10+2 Courses)
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post 10+2 Courses) was started by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The objective of the scheme is to provide additional financial assistance (scholarship) to the ST students pursuing higher education after Senior Secondary i.e. 12th Standard in the Colleges/Universities anywhere in IndiaRs. as an incentive to supplement the cost of their education.
> **Scope:**

This additional scholarship shall be provided by the Directorate of Tribal WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands Administration to the students belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for undertaking studies anywhere in India and shall be in addition to the Scholarship/maintenance cost being awarded to the ST students by the Department of EducationRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration and Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of India.
> **Funding pattern of the scheme:**

The scheme shall be implemented by the Directorate of Tribal WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands Administration through the funds made available under the Union Territory Plan.
> **Duration of Scholarship:**

The award of additional scholarship once made shall be tenable from the stage at which it is given to the student till the completion of the courseRs. subject to good conduct and regularity in attendanceRs. as certified by the Head of the Institution.
benefits:
> **Value of Additional Scholarship:**


1. Under this scheme of additional scholarships for Scheduled Tribe StudentsRs. an amount of 1000/- per month shall be given to the eligible students.

> **Payment and mode of disbursal of additional scholarship:**


1. The additional scholarship shall be payable for ten months in an academic session.
1. The additional scholarship shall be normally admissible to the pass-out students of the previous academic session.
1. The additional scholarship money shall be directly released to the bank account of the beneficiaries by the Directorate of Tribal Welfare.
eligibility:
1. The additional scholarship shall be open to all students of Scheduled Tribes (STs) of Andaman and Nicobar Islands as notified by the President of India under Article 342 (1) of the Constitution of India vide the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheduled Tribes Order No. 58 dated 31.03.1959.
1. Only those students who belong to STs so specified and notified in relation to Andaman and Nicobar Islands and are domicile of A&N islands and who have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized Board of Senior Secondary Education or any other higher examination from a recognized University shall be eligible for additional scholarship.
1. StudentsRs. who fail to clear Bachelor courses in Arts/Science/Commerce for which they had been awarded this additional scholarshipRs. and join any other recognized Professional or Technical certificate/Diploma/ Degree coursesRs. shall be awarded additional scholarship if they are otherwise eligible.
1. Students studying in class XI of the Higher Secondary School courses or the XII class of the Multipurpose High School shall not be eligible for this additional scholarshipRs. because of its not being a higher/ professional course. HoweverRs. in casesRs. where the tenth class examination of such courses is treated as equivalent to Matriculation and students who after passing the Tenth class join other recognized professional/ technical coursesRs. such students shall be treated as Post-Matric students and thereforeRs. shall be eligible for the award of this additional scholarship.
1. Students pursuing Post-Graduate courses in Medicine shall be eligible for this scholarship provided they are not allowed to practice during the period of their course.
1. The additional scholarship shall be given for pursuing higher studies for all recognized regular and full-time Post-Senior Secondary courses (post 10+2 courses)Rs. Graduate/Post Graduate courses (leading to Diploma/ Degree)Rs. Doctoral and Post-Doctoral coursesRs. in any of the Government recognized Institutions and/or AICTE/UGC approvedRs. or equivalent institutionsRs. anywhere in the countryRs. such as:


- All courses leading to a Graduate DegreeRs. e.g. B.A/B.Sc./B.Com. etc.
- All Post-Graduate CoursesRs. e.g. M.A/M.Sc./M.Com/M.Ed/M. Pharma. etc.
- Degree and Post-Graduate level courses including M.PhilRs. Ph.D and Post-Doctoral Research in Medicine (AllopathyRs. Indian and other recognized systems of medicines)Rs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary and allied SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance/ AdministrationRs. Computer Science/ApplicationsRs. etc.
- Post-Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of Management and medicineRs. Commercial Pilot License (including helicopter pilot and multiengine rating) courseRs. etc.
- C.A/I.C.W.A./C.S./I.C.F.A. etc.
- M.PhilRs. Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Progammes (D.Litt.Rs. D.Sc. etc.)
- Graduate/Post-Graduate Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B. Pharm)Rs. Nursing (B. Nursing)Rs. LLBRs. BFSRs. other paramedical branches like Rehabilitation DiagnosticsRs. etc.Rs. Mass CommunicationRs. Hotel Management & CateringRs. Travel/ Tourism/ Hospitality ManagementRs. Interior DecorationRs. Nutrition & DieteticsRs. Commercial ArtRs. Financial Services(e.g. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. Taxation etc.) for which educational qualification is minimum Sr. Secondary (10+2).
- All post-matriculation level non-degree courses for which educational qualification is the vocational streamRs. ITI courseRs. 3 years Diploma Course in PolytechnicRs. etc.

**Note 01:** The additional scholarship is dependent on the satisfactory progress of the beneficiary.
**Note 02:** If a student is found to have obtained an additional scholarship by false statementRs. his/her additional scholarship can be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the additional scholarship paid shall be recoveredRs. at the discretion of the sanctioning authority. The student concerned shall be blacklisted and debarred from applying for an additional scholarship under any scheme of the Directorate of Tribal WelfareRs. thereafter.
**Note 03:** An additional scholarship awarded may be cancelled if the beneficiary changes the subject of the course of study for which the additional scholarship was originally awarded or changes the institution of studyRs. without prior approval of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration.
**Note 04:** A beneficiary is liable to refund the additional scholarship amount at the discretion of the Andaman & Nicobar AdministrationRs. if during the course of the yearRs. the studies for which the additional scholarship has been awardedRs. are discontinued by him/her.
**Note 05:** The provisions of the scheme can be changed at any time at the discretion of the Andaman & Nicobar Administration.
> **Renewal of Scholarship:**


1. The scholarship will be renewed from year to year provided that within a courseRs. which is continuous for a number of yearsRs. the beneficiary secures promotion to the next higher class irrespective of the fact whether such examinations are conducted by a University or Institution.
1. If a ST beneficiary pursuing a course fails in the yearly examination for the first timeRs. the scholarship may be renewed. For second and subsequent failures in any classRs. the student shall bear his/her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class.
1. If a beneficiary is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illness and /or on account of any other unforeseen eventRs. the award may be renewed for the next academic year on submission of a medical certificate and /or other required sufficient proof to the satisfaction of Head of the Institution and his /her certifying that the beneficiary would have passed the examination had he appeared in it.
1. If according to the Regulations of a University/InstitutionRs. a student is promoted to the next higher examination of the junior class again after some timeRs. he/she will be entitled to an additional scholarship for the class to which he /she is promoted if the student is otherwise eligible for additional scholarship.

name: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship For Minority
brief_description:
Launched in June 2006 under the Prime Minister's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of MinoritiesRs. the "Post-Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to the Minority Communities" by the Ministry of Minority AffairsRs. Government of India aims to provide better opportunities for higher education to meritorious students from minority communities.
Through this schemeRs. scholarships including admission feesRs. tuition feesRs. and maintenance allowance ranging from 230 to 1Rs. per month are provided to students from MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. and Zoroastrian (Parsis) communities whose family income is less than 2Rs. per annum. The State Government of Haryana implements the scheme in collaboration with the Union Ministry of Minority Affairs.
benefits: **1.** **Admission and Tuition Fee:** - Classes 11 and 12: Up to 7Rs./- per annum - Technical/Vocational Courses (11 and 12): Up to 10Rs./- per annum - Undergraduate/Postgraduate: Up to 3Rs./- per annum **2.** **Monthly Maintenance Allowance (for 10 months):** **1. Classes 11 and 12 (including technical courses):** - Hostellers: 380/- per month - Day Scholars: 230/- per month **2. Undergraduate/Postgraduate (non-technical):** - Hostellers: 570/- per month - Day Scholars: 300/- per month **3. M.Phil and Ph.D.:** - Hostellers: 1Rs./- per month - Day Scholars: 550/- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. or Zoroastrian (Parsi) community. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 50% marks in the previous final examination. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./- from all sources. 1. The applicant should be a regular student in a government or private higher secondary school/college/university. 1. The applicant should not be availing of any other scholarship for the same purpose.
> **Preferences:** - Priority to students from BPL families. - 30% of scholarships are earmarked for girl students.

name: Education Loan Scheme - Delhi
brief_description: "Education Loan Scheme" by the Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities and Handicapped Financial Development Corporation Ltd.Rs. Government of DelhiRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Other Backward Classes (OBC)Rs. MinoritiesRs. and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) for pursuing professional and technical courses in recognized institutions in India and abroad. The scheme offers need-based loans with a maximum limit of 7Rs./- for studies in India and 15Rs./- for studies abroad. To be eligible the applicant must be a permanent resident of DelhiRs. with an annual family income below 5Rs./-.
benefits:
- Need-based finance with a ceiling of 7Rs./- for studies in India.
- Need-based finance with a ceiling of 15Rs./- for studies abroad.

_*No promoters contribution required for loans up to 4Rs./-._
_*For loans above 4Rs./-Rs. 5% contribution is required for studies in India and 15% for studies abroad._
_*Loan repayment period is up to 10 years after the commencement of repayment or until the date of employmentRs. whichever is earlier._
_*The applicant has the option to repay the loan earlier if desired._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. MinorityRs. Persons with Disability.
- The annual income of parents/guardian should be below 5Rs./-.
- The applicant must have secured admission in a recognized/Government/Technical Institution in India or abroad.
- The College/Institute should have been offering the course for the last three years.
- The College/Institute should be recognized by the Central/State Government or by appropriate authorities such as UGC (University Grants Commission)Rs. AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)Rs. etc.
- The duration of the course should not exceed 5 years.

**Post Sanction Eligibility for the Borrower**

- The borrower must not participate in any unlawful activity that would debar them from pursuing studies and must follow all rules and regulations laid down by the educational institution.
- The borrower must not enter into any pecuniary obligation or financial liability during the currency of the loan.
- The borrower must strive to secure suitable employment after completing the course and furnish full particulars of such employmentRs. including income detailsRs. to DSFDC.

name: Higher Education And Skill Development Guarantee Scheme
brief_description:
The Higher Education and Skill Development Guarantee Scheme aims to provide financial support through the banking system to meritorious students for pursuing higher education in DelhiRs. as well as recognized degreeRs. diplomaRs. or skill development courses offered by Central or State Government universities and institutions located outside Delhi (within India). The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that deserving students are able to pursue higher education with access to affordable and reasonable financial assistance from banks.
Under this schemeRs. education loans of up to 10 lakh availed by students will be covered under a Higher Education and Skill Development Credit Guarantee Fund created by the GovernmentRs. which provides a guarantee to banks in case of loan default. Students will not be required to provide any collateral or margin money. The scheme is universal in nature and is applicable to all eligible studentsRs. irrespective of their social or economic background.
benefits: **Benefits** - The maximum amount of education loan guaranteed under this scheme is up to 10 Lakhs Only.
eligibility:
**Eligibility** 1. Students who wish to pursue a diploma or degree or specified skill development courses in Delhi and have done their Class-X and ClassXII from Delhi are eligible under this Scheme. For courses for which the qualifying examination is Class-XRs. students who have done Class-X in Delhi would be eligible under this Scheme. Students who are children of employees of Govt. of NCT of Delhi or Officials/government servants who are posted with the Govt..of NCT of Delhi are also eligible under this scheme. 1. The student should have secured admission to a higher education course or specified Skill development courses (diploma or degree including bachelorRs. Master and Doctoral Degrees) in recognized institutions in Delhi through the Entrance Test/ Merit Based Selection process after completion of the Secondary Examination/Senior Secondary Examination/required qualifying examination. 1. The guarantee would be available for loans for all recognized diploma/degree courses from Government Institutions /Universities and constituent colleges of the University of Delhi. It would also be available for Private/ Self-financed Institutions located in Delhi having NAAC/NBA/SFRC grading. The department will persuade all the Private Institutions to get accreditation from NAAC/NBA. Till such timeRs. grading as given by the Third State Fee Regulatory Committee (SFRC) set up by the Directorate of Higher Education and Directorate of Training & Technical Education may be used for Private InstitutionsRs. since this grading is based on the infrastructureRs. faculty and academic standards of the institutions as also the costs being incurred by it. 1. It would also be available for Institutions of Technical/Training Skill Development such as courses by World Class Skill Centre or any other technical training/skill development institutions specified by the Government of NCT of Delhi.
**Courses Eligible for Studies in Delhi** 1. Approved courses leading to graduate/ post-graduate degrees and PG diplomas conducted by recognized colleges/ universities recognized by UGC/ Government/ AICTE/ AIBMS/ ICMR etc 1. Courses like ICWARs. CARs. CFA etc 1. Courses conducted by IITRs. NIFTRs. NLURs. IIFT etc 1. Regular Degree/Diploma courses like aeronauticalRs. pilot trainingRs. shippingRs. including those run by Polytechnics etc.Rs. degree/diploma in nursingRs. physiotherapy or any other discipline approved by the Director General of Civil Aviation/Shipping/Indian Nursing Council or any other regulatory body as the case may be if the course is pursued in Delhi. 1. Skill Development Courses as may be specified by Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

name: Scholarship/Merit scholarship to OBC/MIN/SC/ST students from Class I to XII
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship/Merit Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/Minority Students" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of Delhi aims to provide financial assistance to students from SC/ST/OBC/Minority communities studying in classes 1st to 12th in government or recognized schools in Delhi. The scheme offers varying scholarship amounts based on class and academic performanceRs. ensuring support for education. Key benefits include annual scholarships ranging from 1Rs./- to 4Rs./-Rs. depending on the student's category and marks. Eligibility criteria include belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Minority communitiesRs. studying in recognised schoolsRs. and having a family income not exceeding 2Rs./- per annum. The scheme is implemented through the e-district portal of NIC Delhi.
benefits:
**Class 1st to 8th SC/ST/Minority Students**
1Rs./- per Annum (No % of Marks Required).
**OBC Students (6th to 8th)**

- 600/- per Annum (55% to 60% Marks in Previous Class).
- 720/- per Annum (Above 60% Marks in Previous Class).

**Class 9th to 10th SC/ST/OBC/Minority Students**

- 1Rs./- per Annum (55% to 60% Marks in Previous Class).
- 2Rs./- per Annum (Above 60% Marks in Previous Class).

**Class 11th to 12th SC/ST/OBC/Minority Students**

- 3Rs./- per Annum (55% to 70% Marks in Previous Class).
- 4Rs./- per Annum (Above 70% Marks in Previous Class).

_*The bank account should be in the name of the student (a joint account with a parent/guardian is permissible)._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Other Backward Classes (OBC)/Minority (including Jain) community


- Students from the Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Minority category should be studying in Class 1st to 12th.
- Students from the Other Backward Classes (OBC) category should be studying in Class 6th to 12th.
- The applicant should be studying in a Government/Aided/Recognised school affiliated to the Directorate of Education/Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan/National Open School/Schools affiliated to NDMC/Delhi Cantonment BoardRs. East Delhi Municipal CorporationRs. North Delhi Municipal CorporationRs. and South Delhi Municipal Corporation.
- For students from the OBC/Minority categoryRs. the income of the family should be less than or equal to 2Rs./-.
- The applicant can avail of only one scholarshipRs. either under the State Plan Scheme or Centrally Sponsored Scholarship SchemeRs. whichever is more beneficial.

name: UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Scheme
brief_description: The UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Scheme has been implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC)Rs. Ministry of EducationRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to strengthen basic science research in universities by engaging talented faculty nearing superannuation. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance and research grants are provided to enable senior professors to continue their research and guide young Ph.D. scholars. The scheme is implemented by the UGC under its Basic Scientific Research (BSR) Programme. It helps retain experienced faculty in research and mentorship rolesRs. ensuring continuity in high-quality research output and guidance for emerging scholars. > **Objectives** - To facilitate talented teachers in Science and Technology at the verge of superannuation to continue their productive research for an additional period of THREE YEARS after superannuation. - To play a research mentorship role for young researchers and Ph.D students.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance under the scheme shall be: 50Rs./- per month (exclusive of the pension and / or other retirement benefits)Rs. and a research grant of 5Rs./- per annum. 1. The Research can be utilized for purchase equipmentRs. computer / laptopRs. printerRs. chemicals glassware and consumablesRs. contingencyRs. hiring project/technical assistantRs. field workRs. travel (within India)Rs. etc. 1. The grant cannot be utilized for International travel and purchase of furniture. 1. The recipient can decide the quantum of funds under these heads depending on his / her needs. 1. Tenure of fellowship for Three years / 68 year whichever is earlier. The awardee shall execute the undertaking to UGC along with the university for joining the fellowship and to abide by the norms and guidelines of UGC pertaining to this fellowship from time to time and to send the bi-annual progress report and UC/annual audited statement of accounts. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - Fellowships and grants are disbursed directly to the awardees bank account through UGC-designated banks. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** - A Continuation Certificate is required every 3 months for the release of the next instalment. > **Validity:** - Valid for 3 years or until the awardee reaches 68 yearsRs. whichever is earlier
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Reader/Associate Professor/Professor in the Science and Technology departments of a university. 1. The applicant should have successfully supervised: - 15 Ph.D. dissertations in Basic SciencesRs. or - 10 Ph.D. dissertations in Engineering and Technology. - At least 5 candidates must have received their degrees in the preceding 10 years. 1. The cumulative impact factor of the published papers by the applicant should be > 50 (according to the Journal citation Reports of Thomson Reuters). 1. The applicant must have handledRs. as Principal InvestigatorRs. at least 3 sponsored research projects funded by national / international agenciesRs. in the last 10 years. 1. The applicant must apply within one year of the date of superannuation in the University. 1. The applicant shall not hold any administrative responsibility during tenure of the fellowship which would be from the date of superannuation. 1. The Department / School / University shall have to provide an undertaking in the application that the applicant would be provided: - with the required laboratory infrastructure and administrative assistance for undertaking the fellowship work and - with permission to take a minimum of Two stipendiary candidates for Ph.D. under the applicantRs. if selected for the UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Award.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme is a Central Sector Scheme launched in 2008 by the Department of School Education & LiteracyRs. Ministry of EducationRs. Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue their education at secondary stage. Under this schemeRs. it is proposed to award 1Rs. scholarships to the gifted or meritorious students whose parental income is not more than 3Rs./- per annum from all sources at the time of selection of awardees for scholarship. Each State/UT has [fixed quota](https://dsel.education.gov.in/sites/default/files/NMMSS_Guidelines_22.pdf) of scholarship for concerned age group of class VII and VIII. The scheme will provide reservation to different categories of students as per the State/UT norms; as different States/UTs have their own norms of reservation. This scholarship will be provided on yearly basis to the students studying as regular students and entering in class IX in a GovernmentRs. Government-aidedRs. local body schools. ThusRs. the scholarship will be for a maximum period of four years. The scheme has been approved for continuation for another 5 years during the period of 15th Finance Commission cycle from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. 1Rs. fresh scholarships @ 12Rs./- per annum (1Rs. per month) are awarded to the meritorious students every year at Class IX levelRs. which can be continued upto Class Xll. 1. The awardees will be required to open bank accounts preferably in SBIRs. or any public sector bank or any scheduled bank which has core banking facility. 1. The amount of scholarships will be disbursed to students directly into their bank accounts by electronic transfer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: > **For Fresh Applications:** 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. Students whose parental income from all sources is not more than 3Rs./- per annum are eligible to avail the scholarship. 1. The students must have minimum of 55 % marks or equivalent grade in Class VII examination for appearing in selection test for award of scholarship (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students). 1. The students should be studying as regular student in a GovernmentRs. Government-aided and local body school. **Note:** There is reservation as per State/UT Government norms. > **Procedure for Selection of Awardee Students:** Each State/UT will conduct its own test at the 8th-grade level for the selection of students. The State Level Examination may consist of the following two tests: - Mental Ability Test (MAT)Rs. 90 minutes duration: 90 multiple-choice questions testing verbal and non-verbal meta-cognitive abilities like reasoning and critical thinking. The questions in the test may be on analogy. classification. numerical seriesRs. pattern perceptionRs. hidden figureRs. etc. - Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT)Rs. 90 minutes duration: 90 multiple-choice questions covering subjectsRs. namelyRs. scienceRs. social studiesRs. and mathematicsRs. as taught in classes 7th and 8th. > **For selecting the studentsRs. the following conditions shall apply:** - The students must pass both the MAT and the SAT with at least 40 % marks in aggregate taken together for these two tests. For the SC/ST studentsRs. this cut-off will be 32% marks. - At the time of selection for the award of scholarshipRs. the student must have scored at least 55% mark or equivalent grade in the Class 8th examination. There will be 5 % relaxation for SC/ST students. - The awardees should satisfy the other eligibility conditions mentioned in the scheme. > **Note:** An awardee is eligible for the scholarship provided he/she: - Takes up studies in approved courses. - Maintains good conduct as certified by the Head of the College/Institution and continues his/her studies as a regular student in a government/Government aided/ Local Body school. - Does not absent himself/herself without proper leave. - Takes up studies on a full-time basis. - The scheme will provide reservations to different categories of students as per the State/UT norms; as different States/UTs have their own norms of reservation. - A student can avail of only one Scholarship under any Central Government Scholarship scheme. - The awardees will be required to open bank accounts preferably in SBIRs. any public sector bankRs. or any scheduled bank which has a core banking facility. - No claim for scholarship arrears will be entertained after the expiry of 12 months of the academic session for which one has applied for the claim. - In case any awardee leaves his/her course of study within one month of registration/admissionRs. no scholarship shall be paid to him/her. - In case the student is not able to appear at the annual examination due to serious illnessRs. he/she should send the medical certificate to the Head of the Institution within three months of his/her falling ill. The duration of illness should be clearly certified by a specialist who is a Registered Medical Practitioner. The facility will be available to the student to continue the same course in which they are studyingRs. provided the principal or the head of the institution certifies that the overall performance of the student during the year has been very good. - The student must join the next class/desired course within 3 months of the declaration of the result of the previous class/course. - The scholarship shall be deemed to be discontinued if any gap of one academic session arises in studies at any time due to any reason. - Scholarship once discontinued on the basis of the rules of disbursement of scholarship cannot be revived under any circumstances. - All rules are subject to change from time to timeRs. as and when requiredRs. which will be binding on all awardees. > **For Renewal Applications:** - The awardees should get a minimum of 60% marks in Class 10th for the continuation of the scholarship (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST candidates) in the next higher classes. - For continuing the scholarship in class 10th and 12thRs. the awardees should get clear promotion from class 9th to class 10th and from class 11th to class 12th in the first attempt. > **Note:** - The awardees should get clear promotion from class 8th to Class 9th for being eligible for starting the scholarshipRs. as indicated above. - The scholarship at the Secondary and Higher Secondary stage or equivalent classes 9th to 12th is payable for a maximum period of four years for studies in India only. - For continuing the scholarship in class 10th and 12thRs. the awardees should get clear promotion from class 9th to class 10th and from class 11th to class 12th in the first attempt. - The awardees must obtain a minimum of 60% marks in the Class 10th examination (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students) or equivalent examination for continuation of the scholarship at the higher secondary stage. - In case an institution/school does not conduct an examination at the end of Class 9th and/or Class 11thRs. the scholarship for the second year will be continued on the submission of a certificate to this effect from the Head of the Institution/School.

name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP): Scholarship Component
brief_description: The National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP) Scholarship Component has been launched by the Office of Development Commissioner for HandloomsRs. Ministry of TextilesRs. running from 2021-22 to 2025-26. It aims to bolster India's handloom sector and improve the lives of handloom weavers. It particularly targets the children of these weaversRs. offering financial assistance of up to 2Rs./- annually. This support covers tuitionRs. admissionRs. and examination fees at recognised textile institutions. AdditionallyRs. beneficiaries receive a monthly stipend of 5Rs./-. The scheme's primary objective is to empower weavers' families through educationRs. ensuring the sustainable growth of the handloom industryRs. thus enhancing their socio-economic conditions and contributing to India's cultural heritage.
benefits:
1. **Financial Coverage:** The scholarship covers tuition feesRs. admission feesRs. examination feesRs. and other annual fees/charges as required by the academic institution.1. **Stipend:** In addition to the academic feesRs. eligible candidates will receive a stipend of 5Rs./- per monthRs. subject to a maximum of 2Rs./- per child per annum or actualsRs. whichever is less.1. **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Funds will be directly transferred to the bank account of the concerned handloom weaver/worker or their children through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.
> **Payment Schedule** - The scholarship for the first year will be disbursed after the admission of the ward of handloom weavers/workers. - Subsequent years' scholarships will be paid upon submission of the proposalRs. along with a copy of the mark sheet for the annual examRs. and admission proof for the next academic session from the relevant institution.
eligibility:
1. The scholarship is for the children of handloom weavers/workers (up to 2 children).
1. This support is available for pursuing 3/4 years Diploma/Graduate/Post Graduate courses at Central/State Government recognized and funded Textiles Institutions.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance
brief_description: The Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance scheme has been launched by the Department of CultureRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. one-time monetary support is provided to eligible disabled artists and litterateurs for disability-related medical treatment. The assistance helps beneficiaries manage treatment expenses arising from permanent or severe physical disability.
benefits: - One-time financial assistance of up to 1Rs./-. - Assistance is provided exclusively for the treatment of physical disability. > **NOTE:** Direct transfer to the beneficiarys bank account.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a physically disabled artist or litterateur. 1. The applicant should be 21 years of age or above. 1. The applicants monthly income from all sourcesRs. including spouse incomeRs. should not exceed 10Rs.. 1. The total monthly family incomeRs. including dependentsRs. should not exceed 20Rs.. > **NOTE:** Income limits are revised annually with a 6 percent increase for eligibility calculation.

name: Gallantry Medal PMG/GM
brief_description: The scheme Gallantry Medal PMG/GM has been implemented by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. It aims to recognise acts of gallantry and exceptional courage. Through this schemeRs. gallantry medalsRs. a Presidential scrollRs. and monetary allowances are provided to eligible personnel of PoliceRs. FireRs. CorrectionalRs. Home GuardRs. and Civil Defence Services. The scheme honours personnel who display conspicuous or rare gallant acts in saving life and propertyRs. preventing crimeRs. arresting criminalsRs. or preventing the escape of prisoners. The level of risk involved is assessed with due regard to the duties and obligations of the officer. The scheme covers two categories of awardsRs. namely the Presidents Medal for Gallantry and the Medal for Gallantry. There is no fixed quota for the number of awardees. > **Ceremony Details** The medals are announced on the occasions of Republic Day and Independence Day.
benefits: 1. **Monetary Allowance :** - Presidents Medal for Gallantry (PMG): 6Rs./- per month. - Medal for Gallantry (GM): 2Rs./- per month 1. **Decoration:** A scroll signed by the PresidentRs. along with the medalRs. is provided. > **No. of Awardees:** No fixed Quota
eligibility: > **Presidents Medal for Gallantry:** 1. The applicant should have performed a rare and conspicuous gallant act involving exceptional courage and skill. 1. The act should involve saving life or propertyRs. preventing crimeRs. arresting criminalsRs. apprehending a prisonerRs. or preventing a prisoners escape. 1. The risk incurred by the applicant is assessed with due regard to the obligations and duties of the officer. 1. The applicant should be a member of the Police ServiceRs. Fire ServiceRs. Correctional ServiceRs. Home Guard ServiceRs. or Civil Defence Service. > **Medal for Gallantry:** 1. The applicant should have performed a conspicuous gallant act of merit. 1. The act should involve saving life or propertyRs. preventing crimeRs. arresting criminalsRs. apprehending a prisonerRs. or preventing a prisoners escape. 1. The risk incurred is assessed with due regard to the official duties of the applicant. 1. The applicant should be a member of the Police ServiceRs. Fire ServiceRs. Correctional ServiceRs. Home Guard ServiceRs. or Civil Defence Service.

name: Rules Related to Madhya Pradesh State Disease Assistance Fund
brief_description: The Rules Related to Madhya Pradesh State Disease Assistance Fund scheme was launched by the Department of Public Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for major surgical and medical treatments to Below Poverty Line (BPL) patients suffering from life-threatening diseases. > **Scheme Implementation:** The scheme is implemented by the State Illness Assistance Fund (SIAF) Management CommitteeRs. supported by District CollectorsRs. Civil SurgeonsRs. and designated medical institutions.
benefits: - Financial assistance ranging from 25Rs. to 2Rs. for major surgeries or medical interventions. > **NOTE:** 1. The SIF assistance amount cheque is provided directly to the Hospital/Institution where the approved case (patient) is referred. 1. The grant will be permissible for the recognized hospitals within the state & outside the state. 1. For cancer casesRs. the grant will be given to the JLN Cancer HospitalRs. Bhopal.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant must be suffering from a [disease listed](https://www.health.mp.gov.in/sites/default/files/siaf-approved-rate-list-2018.pdf) among the approved illnesses under the scheme.1. The hospital must be a recognized institution within or outside Madhya Pradesh. 1. Only one eligible family member can receive assistance once.

name: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
brief_description: The "Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles" scheme under the National Technical Textile Mission by the Ministry of TextilesRs. Government of India. This scheme shall be referred to as the General Guidelines for Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles. **Objectives** The main objectives of the scheme are: Establish a reservoir of skilled individuals for recruitment in the technical textiles industry. Develop transferable skills that can be adapted across different companies. Create a robust knowledge and skill ecosystem within the sector. Ensure seamless integration of qualified professionals into diverse rolesRs. promoting a dynamic and agile workforce. Foster a culture of continuous learningRs. innovationRs. and adaptability within organizations. **Scheme Phases** The implementation will be carried out in two phasesRs. targeting strategically important segments of technical textiles: **Phase I:** AgrotechRs. BuildtechRs. GeotechRs. IndutechRs. MeditechRs. MobiltechRs. and Protech **Phase II:** ClothtechRs. HometechRs. OekotechRs. SportechRs. and Packtech
benefits: 1. **Joint Funding:** Training cost is shared between the Ministry of Textiles and the trainee.1. **Financial Support:** Reduces the training cost burden for trainees.1. **Standardised Programs:** Ensures quality training following the Common Norms for Skill Development Schemes.1. Ministry Contribution: Covers expenses like: - Mobilisation of candidates - Curriculum development - Trainers training - Equipment and teaching aids - Raw materials - Assessment costs - Salary of trainers - Other components as per standard skill development norms
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an Indian citizen and at least 17 years of age. 1. The applicant can be an unskilled worker or a professional seeking upskilling or reskilling. 1. The applicant can be an undergraduate student or a personnel working in technical textile fields. 1. (Exact age and qualification requirements for the applicant may vary depending on the specific training program.) **Eligibility for Implementing Agencies:** 1. The agency can be a Training and Research Agency (TRA)Rs. Center of ExcellenceRs. Ministry of Textiles bodyRs. or public academic institution. 1. The agency can also be an industry associationRs. textile companyRs. export councilRs. or other related eligible organization.

name: The CM IT Fellowship Program
brief_description: The scheme "The CM IT Fellowship Program" was launched by the Electronics & Information Technology DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to empower and train young professionals in the field of Software-Driven Analysis to bring measurable improvements to governance by deploying skilled professionals. The scheme provides a unique blended learning experience where fellows earn an M.Tech in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) from IIIT Naya Raipur while working on real-world government projects with a monthly stipend of 50Rs./-. The applicant must be a GATE-qualified graduate or postgraduate from ChhattisgarhRs. aged up to 30 yearsRs. and willing to work with government departments. The scheme is implemented by CHiPS (Chhattisgarh Infotech Promotion Society) in collaboration with IIIT Naya Raipur. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the IIIT-NR website.
benefits: **Monthly Stipend:** The scheme provides a stipend of 50Rs./- per month during the 2-year program duration. **Academic Qualification:** Fellows are enrolled in a full-time M.Tech in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) program at IIIT Naya Raipur. **Professional Experience:** Fellows gain hands-on experience by working directly with government departments on data-driven policy making and digital transformation initiatives. **Mentorship:** The program offers mentorship from top academiciansRs. IT leadersRs. and policymakers to help fellows grow as future-ready professionals. _*Fellows are deployed at CHiPS or assigned departments for 4 months in Semester 2Rs. 6 months in Semester 3Rs. and 5 months in Semester 4 as part of the engagement._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be an Indian National. - The applicant must hold a Domicile of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be upto 30 years of age as of the application deadline. - The applicant must be a graduate or postgraduate student. - The applicant must have qualified for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) in Computer Science (CS) or Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI). - The applicant must have secured a minimum CPI of 6.5 or 60% or First Class in their qualifying degree.
##### ***Relaxations*** - The applicant belonging to SC/ST/PwD categories is eligible for a relaxation of 5% marks or 0.5 CPI. - The applicant is eligible for age relaxations as per the Chhattisgarh Government reservation rules.

name: Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse Scheme
brief_description: The **Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse SchemeRs.** under the Chief Ministers CM-ELEVATE Program by the PlanningRs. Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. focuses on enhancing agricultural infrastructure through the establishment of warehouses across the state. It aims to reduce post-harvest lossesRs. stabilize market pricesRs. and improve farmer incomes. The scheme offers easy credit access via partner banks and substantial government subsidies to ease entrepreneurs financial burden. Implemented by the Meghalaya Basin Management Agency (MBMA)Rs. it supports individuals and registered entities in creating weatherproof storage for agricultural produceRs. enabling value additionRs. market linkagesRs. and long-term storage for the farming community.
benefits: 1. 5% of project cost to be contributed by the entrepreneur 75% of project cost provided upfront by Government of Meghalaya as margin money support to the bank remaining 20% via bank loan. 1.
