Direct credit linkage with partner banks. 1. Guidance and handholding in the application process through implementing agencies. 1. Support in project realization for the warehouse venture. 1. Training and capacity building for entrepreneurs to manage post-harvest storage effectively. 1. Technical support for maintenance and operations of warehouses.
eligibility: **For Individuals:** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should have ownership of the land where the warehouse is proposed or leased land for at least the next 10 years. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter of any bank. **For Registered Entities:** 1. The applicant should be based in the village where the program is being availed. 1. The applicant should have an active bank account and submit the bank statement of the last six months. 1. The applicant should have been in operation for at least two years. 1. The applicant should possess landRs. either self-owned or leasedRs. duly verified by the competent authority. 1. The applicant should not be a credit defaulter of any bank.

name: Chief Minister's Meghalaya Homestay Mission Scheme
brief_description: The Chief Minister's Meghalaya Homestay Mission SchemeRs. launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. is aimed at strengthening tourism infrastructure and promoting community-led hospitality. The scheme focuses on developing new homestays and upgrading existing ones to enhance Meghalayas position as a leading eco-tourism destination while creating sustainable livelihood opportunities.
benefits: 1. Up to 70% of the project cost supported 1. Enhanced subsidy of up to 80% (8 lakhs) for Persons with Disability (PwD) applicants 1. 50Rs. grant per room (up to 2 lakhs) for upgradation of existing homestays 1. Credit linkage through partner banks (Meghalaya Rural Bank and others notified) 1. Collateral-free loans with 1-year moratorium: subsidy disbursed as EMI support over 24 months 1. Design and architectural support provided by empanelled firms (cost borne by Department of Tourism) 1. Capacity building and training programs on hospitalityRs. housekeepingRs. culinary skillsRs. and marketingRs. conducted by the Tourism Department and partners (MSSDSRs. IHM ShillongRs. FCI Tura) 1. Exposure visits for high-performing beneficiaries to learn best practices 1. Mandatory furnishing and solar panel support (1 lakh allocation per homestay included in project cost) 1. Integration with digital platforms (M-TIME portalRs. Meghalaya Tourist App) for bookingRs. branding and performance tracking.
eligibility: **Development of New Homestays** 1. The applicant must provide proof of land ownership or a registered lease agreement for a minimum period of 7 years. 1. The applicant must select one homestay design from the 33 standard designs prepared by the Department of Tourism. **Upgradation of Existing Homestays** 1. The applicant must provide proof of homestay operations for at least 6 months. 1. The applicant must ensure that the guest register shows a minimum of 50 bed nights.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission Grameen PHASE I
brief_description: Launched in 2014Rs. the scheme "Swachh Bharat Mission Grameen (Phase I)" by the Department of Drinking Water and SanitationRs. Ministry of Jal ShaktiRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to eliminate open defecation in rural India through behavioral change and construction of household and community toilets. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance and awareness interventions for toilet construction were provided to poorRs. underprivilegedRs. and marginalized households in rural areas. **Objectives:** 1. To bring about mass-scale behavior change regarding sanitation and hygiene 1. To ensure the construction and usage of household-owned and community-owned toilets 1. To establish an accountable mechanism for achieving ODF (Open Defecation Free) India 1. To promote Solid and Liquid Waste Management (SLWM)
benefits: 1. 12Rs. financial assistance per toilet to rural households for construction. 1. Enhanced rural sanitation coverage through individual and community toilets. 1. Significant reduction in open defecation practices across India. **Activities under the Scheme:** - Construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) - Construction of Community Sanitary Complexes (CSCs) - Solid Liquid Waste Management (SLWM) activities - InformationRs. Education and Communication (IEC) - Human Resource Development (HRD) activities
eligibility: - The applicant should be from a rural household that lacked a toilet before the scheme. - The applicant should belong to poorRs. underprivilegedRs. or marginalized sections. > **Note:** Preference given to households led by womenRs. elderlyRs. disabledRs. or socio-economically weaker sections.

name: Social Security Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Social Security Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to Below Poverty Line (BPL) Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and dwarf individuals to support them in living a respectful life.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a pension of 500/- per month.

**Note:** The pension amount will be directly transferred to the applicant's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be either a person with a disability or a dwarf person.
1. Children with disabilities (CwDs) aged 6-17 years are eligibleRs. the CwDs in the age group of 6-14 should be school-going.
1. Persons with disabilities who are 18 years or older and have a disability of 40% or above are eligible for the scheme.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits from any other central or state government pension scheme.
1. The applicant's name should be included in the list of families living the Below Poverty Line.

**Note:** Disabled children aged 6-14 years who are not attending school are not eligible.

name: Providing Latest Technology to Group of Pottery Artisans (Energy Efficient Kiln)
brief_description: The scheme "Providing Latest Technology to Group of Pottery Artisans (Energy Efficient Kiln)" by the Gujarat Matikam Kalakari & Rural Technology InstituteRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide latest technology and equipment to pottery artisans for better productivityRs. improved quality and reduce health risks. The scheme provides 100% financial assistance on development of the kiln with unit cost of 83Rs./- and energy-efficient furnaces to groups of registered clay artisans and potters. The applicant must be directly involved in the pottery business and be in the age group of 18 to 58 yearsRs. with at least 800 to 1000 square feet of open space available for pottery business. The scheme is implemented by the relevant Gujarat State Government Department and applications are accepted through prescribed application forms with required details and certificates.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** 100% financial assistance is provided on development of the kiln with unit cost of 83Rs./-. **Technology Provision:** Energy-efficient furnaces are provided to improve productivity and quality. **Health Benefits:** Reduced health risks for pottery artisans through improved technology.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - The assistance will be given only in the form of an energy saving furnace. - No assistance related to the kiln will be paid in cash.
> **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - The energy-saving furnace must be used only for pottery business. - Beneficiaries must send a report about the utility of the furnace to the organization every 3 months after the furnace is ready. - Cost of maintenance and repair of the furnace must be borne by the beneficiaries at their own expense after construction and installation. - Misuse of the furnace will result in legal action by the institute.
eligibility: - The applicant must be registered clay artisans and potters eligible for the scheme on 100% subsidy basis. - The applicant must be directly involved in the pottery business and carry out pottery activity. - The applicant must be in the age group of 18 to 58 years. - The applicant must be part of a group doing at least 2 (two) pottery. - The applicant must have at least 800 to 1000 square feet of open space in their own rent lease or for at least five years on the date on which they apply for pottery business. - The applicant must be associated with pottery in the state of Gujarat only. **Post-Selection Conditions** - The applicant must adhere to the policy rules of the institute as well as the norms regarding the construction of the kiln. - The applicant must use the energy-saving furnace only for pottery business. - The applicant must compulsorily use the energy-saving furnace as per the guarantee letter given unanimously.

name: Handloom Rebate Scheme
brief_description: The "Handloom Rebate Scheme" by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Government of GujaratRs. provides financial rebates to boost sales of handloom products during festivals. It offers 10% special rebate for 120 festival days; Additional 5-15% permanent rebates for regular sales; Enhanced 20% rebates for women-led cooperatives. The scheme aims to enhance market competitiveness for Gujarat's handloom cooperatives and apex societies while directly benefiting artisans.
benefits: **Festival Rebate:** 10% on sales for 120 days; 20% for women-led cooperatives. **Permanent Rebates:** 5% standard; 15% for women-led groups. **Additional Support:** e-Voucher toolkit distribution; Priority for SC/ST/BPL artisans.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a registered cooperative societyRs. apex institutionRs. or women-led group. - The applicant must produce handloom products. - The applicant must obtain prior rebate certification from the Commissionerate.

name: FOCUS Scheme (Farmers Collectivization For Upscaling Production and Marketing System)
brief_description: The **FOCUS Scheme** (Farmers Collectivization for Upscaling Production and Marketing Systems) is one of the flagship schemes of the Planning DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. an annual cash benefit ranging from 50Rs. to 1Rs. is provided to Agriculture and Agri-allied Producer Groups (PGs). Each PG may consist of 10 to 20 members. The benefit amount is credited directly to the PGs bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: 1. The subsidy is disbursed through approved financing partners. 1. Loans are provided by selected partner banks with a repayment period of up to 15 years. 1. There are no pre-closure penalties on the loan. 1. The Government of Meghalaya pays 80% of the total project cost upfront. 1. The remaining 20% is provided as a bank loan (5% paid by the entrepreneur and 75% by the government). 1. Agriculture and Agri-allied Producer Groups (PGs) receive an annual cash benefit ranging from 50Rs. to 1Rs..
eligibility: 1. The Producer Group must consist of 10 to 20 producers from the same village. 1. The members must be engaged in the same or similar agricultural or allied activities with high income-generation potential. 1. The group must formally form a Producer Group (PG) under the scheme. 1. Each member must hold a valid Family ID/Citizen ID of Meghalaya. 1. All members must belong to different households. 1. Each member must have a separate and unique Family ID of Meghalaya.

name: Chief Minister's Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The **Chief Minister's Scholarship Scheme** under the Education DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. provides financial support to students from Class XI to Ph.D. level. The scheme offers a fixed annual scholarship of 6Rs. for post-matric studiesRs. which is paid directly into the students bank accounts. This scholarship may be provided in addition to other scholarships. **Objectives of the Scheme:** (a) To empower eligible students of Meghalaya to pursue quality education from post-matriculation to doctorate level by providing financial assistance. (b) To ensure timelyRs. directRs. and error-free delivery of scholarships to the targeted beneficiaries.
benefits: An eligible student shall be awarded a fixed scholarship of 6Rs./- (Rupees six thousand only) per annum.
eligibility: 1. The student must be a domicile of Meghalaya. 1. The student must have a valid bank accountRs. mobile numberRs. and email ID. 1. Students pursuing part-time or correspondence courses are not eligible. 1. The student must have secured at least 35% marks in the preceding academic year. 1. The scholarship is available only to students pursuing full-time regular courses in recognized institutionsRs. including: i) Government institutes/colleges/universities ii) Institutions of National Importance iii) Central/State Universities; autonomous colleges recognized by UGC; and institutions recognized under Section 2(f) and/or 12(b) of the UGC Act iv) Deemed Universities v) Private universities/institutions affiliated with Central/State Universities vi) Government/Government-aided/Private schools (for Classes XI and XII) vii) State/UT-recognized diploma-granting institutions viii) NCVT-affiliated vocational training institutes ix) Institutions recognized by regulatory bodies such as MCIRs. AICTERs. etc. **Cancellation of Scholarship:** The Directorate reserves the right to cancel the scholarship under the following circumstances: (a) If the student is involved in misconduct or disciplinary proceedingsRs. as reported by the concerned institution. (c) If the student is found to be ineligible at any stageRs. either during verification or thereafter. In such casesRs. the student shall be liable to refund the entire scholarship amount received.

name: Meghalaya Any Business Venture Scheme
brief_description: The **Chief Ministers CM-ELEVATE Program** by the Government of Meghalaya promotes entrepreneurship across the state. Under this programRs. the **Meghalaya Any Business Ventures Scheme** provides financial support to 50 entrepreneurs to help them establish their own business ventures. **Objectives of the scheme** - **Identifying demands present within the state**: The focus is on identifying existing market needs and gaps in the local economyRs. paving the way for strategic business development.- **Supporting underserved business ventures:** The objective is to extend support to enterprises that have been historically underrepresented or lacked resourcesRs. fostering inclusivity in entrepreneurship.- **Exploring the potential for developing products of national importance:** The aim is to investigate opportunities for the creation of products or innovations with significance on a national scaleRs. contributing to the country's growth.- **Providing a platform to showcase their skills:** The initiative involves creating a platform where individuals and businesses can exhibit their talentsRs. skillsRs. and offerings to a wider audience.- **50 facilities to be supported across the state:** The plan includes providing assistance and resources to a total of 50 facilitiesRs. strategically distributed across the entire state.- **Offering businesses an opportunity to showcase their uniqueness:** Businesses are encouraged to highlight their distinctive qualitiesRs. enabling them to stand out in the market and attract customers.- **Overall economic development by providing people with job opportunities and an increase in other economic activities:** By generating employment opportunities and stimulating various economic sectorsRs. the overarching goal is to contribute to the comprehensive development of the region.
benefits: - 25% upfront subsidy (max 12.5 lakhs) by Government of Meghalaya - Up to 5 lakhs EMI support (10% of project cost) - Loan up to 70% of project cost via MCABRs. SBIRs. HDFCRs. etc - 15-year loan term with 18-month moratorium - Mentorship and coaching via PRIME - Support for business registration if required
eligibility: **Eligibility Criteria Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant and all partners involved in the proposal should be residents of the state of MeghalayaRs. and valid identification documents demonstrating residency should be submitted. 1. The applicant should provide proof of relevant experience in the field related to the proposed project; fresh applicants without demonstrated experience should not be considered. 1. The applicant should provide proof of land ownership or a valid lease agreement for the proposed establishment. 1. The applicant should demonstrate commitment to the project by providing proof of the required contributing shareRs. including financial contributionsRs. resourcesRs. or any other form of investment outlined. 1. The applicant should commit to employing local residents in accordance with the funds received and the type of unit being established. **Eligibility Criteria Registered Entities** 1. The applicant (authorized representative/partners) should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. All partners involved in the proposal should be residents of the state of MeghalayaRs. and valid identification documents demonstrating residency should be submitted. 1. The applicant should provide proof of relevant experience in the field related to the proposed project; fresh applicants without demonstrated experience should not be considered. 1. The applicant should provide proof of land ownership or a valid lease agreement for the proposed establishment. 1. The applicant should demonstrate commitment to the project by providing proof of the required contributing shareRs. including financial contributionsRs. resourcesRs. or any other form of investment outlined. 1. The applicant should commit to employing local residents in accordance with the funds received and the type of unit being established.

name: Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC- Haryana
brief_description:
The scheme "Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The HSFDC is a Company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly Government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India.
Under this schemeRs. the loan is provided to Safai Karamchari and their dependents for projects with a maximum cost of up to 1Rs./- per beneficiary for small and petty trade/business and various income-generating activities. The beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years of age and should be either Safai Karamchari or his/her dependentRs. and permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged inRs. or employed for any sanitation work and includes his dependents.
benefits:
**Project Cost Ceiling:** The Corporation (HSFDC)Rs. in collaboration with NSKFDCRs. provides loans of up to 1Rs./- per beneficiary for small and petty trade/business and various self-employment income-generating activities. **Margin Money:** The Corporation provides margin money @ 10% of the project cost. **Subsidy:** The corporation provides a subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum subsidy amount is 10Rs./-). **Note:** The subsidy is only provided to the beneficiary below the poverty line. > **Interest criteria for the loan amount recoverable by HSFDC:** Upto Amount ()Interest % P.A.Penal Interest % P.A.1Rs./-54
**Interest Starts on****Penalty Start After****Principal Recovery Starts After****Installment Starts After****Installment Period**Same Day30 Days120 Days120 Days 30 Days
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The applicant should be either Safai Karamchari or his/her dependent.

**Note 1:** Permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged inRs. or employed for any sanitation work and includes his/her dependents.
**Note 2:** The applicant shall have to produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari from the Head of the Government Departments (i.e. SchoolRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry having rank not less than Gazetted Officer)Rs. elected members of Municipal Body/ Corporation and Pradhan of Gram PanchayatsRs. Local Revenue Officer or an Officer of Local Municipal OfficeRs. or Cantonment Executive Officer of the Cantonment or an officer of the Railways not below the rank of gazette officer.

name: Construction of Water Storage Tanks for Drip Irrigation
brief_description: The scheme "Construction of Water Storage Tanks for Drip Irrigation" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to offer financial assistance to farmers for setting up cemented water tanks essential for efficient drip irrigation. It supports sustainable agriculture through water conservationRs. especially for horticultural practices.
benefits: - **Unit cost of construction:** 1Rs./- per tank. - **For General category farmers:** 50% subsidyRs. up to 50Rs./-. - **For SC/ST farmers:** 75% subsidyRs. up to 75Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant must plan to construct a cemented water storage tank of at least 25.50 cubic meters capacity.

> **Note:** Cemented mature water tanksRs. drip set mandatory.

name: Assistance to Farmers in Purchasing Nano Fertilizers Under the Agricultural Assistance Program for Farmers Other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Farmers in Purchasing Nano Fertilizers Under the Agricultural Assistance Program for Farmers Other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial aid to non-SC/ST farmers in Gujarat to help them purchase Nano Fertilizers. By encouraging the use of efficient and innovative agricultural inputsRs. the scheme strives to boost farm productivityRs. improve crop yieldsRs. and raise the overall economic well-being of farmers.
benefits: - Up to 50% of the purchased price per hectare or 750/- (within a maximum limit of 4 hectares per account.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must belong to the General category (i.e.Rs. not SC or ST).
- The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
brief_description:
Through the Gargi Puraskar YojanaRs. girls are given incentives from the government to move forward in the field of education. Girls of all classes can take advantage of the scheme. The amount of this scheme will be given every year on Basant Panchami.
The girl students who will get the benefit of the scheme in class 10th will be required to enrol in the school in classes 11th and 12th. And the government will give the amount to the beneficiary girl child through a checkRs. so it is mandatory for the girl child to have a bank account. You can apply for the scheme online.
benefits: - Payable for 11 & 12 class girl students: Rs. 3Rs./- each year on the day of Basant Panchami.
eligibility:
1. The student must have secured minimum 75% marks in class 10th.
1. The girl student should be studying regularly in class 11 or 12.
1. There is no restriction on incomeRs. occupation and caste etc. of the parents of the student.

name: Scholarship for Ph.D. Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
brief_description: The Scholarship for Ph.D. Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) students pursuing M.Phil. or Ph.D. to encourage higher education and research.
benefits: **Scholarship Assistance:** - 25Rs./- for students pursuing M.Phil. - 1Rs./- for students preparing Ph.D thesis.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be pursuing M.Phil or Ph.D at a recognized institution. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "Swayam Saksham Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote economic self-reliance among professionally educated unemployed youth (both men and women) from the Thakor and Koli communitiesRs. aged between 18 and 35 yearsRs. who hold degrees in fields such as PharmacyRs. ArchitectureRs. Software/HardwareRs. Automobile EngineeringRs. LawRs. Chartered AccountancyRs. and others. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans is provided to eligible beneficiaries who have completed higher professional education and wish to become self-reliant by starting their own business in their respective fields. It specifically supports individuals trained in professional fields like medicineRs. lawRs. engineeringRs. accountingRs. hotel managementRs. and even wrestling or sculptureRs. to use their skills for gainful self-employment.
benefits: **Loan Amount:** - Up to 5Rs./-. **Interest Rate:** - 5% per annum. **Contribution Split:** - 95% of the business/project cost is covered under the scheme as a loan. - 5% contribution must be made by the beneficiary. **Loan Repayment Terms:** - Repayable in 60 equal monthly installments (maximum 5 years). - The repayment period depends on the nature of the business plan.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste/community. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicant should have technical/professional education or experience in the field of business/trade. 1. The applicant should be unemployed and looking to start a self-employment unit. 1. The applicant familys annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should have completed professional education in areas such as MedicalRs. LawRs. ArchitectureRs. EngineeringRs. Chartered AccountancyRs. Hotel ManagementRs. Software/HardwareRs. Financial ConsultancyRs. Sculpture or Wrestling (with training) etc. > **Note:** Out of total loans disbursedRs. at least 50% will be allocated to families with income up to 1Rs./-.

name: Uniform Assistance for Economically Backward Class Students Studying in Class 1st to 8th
brief_description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Economically Backward Class Students Studying in Class 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support students from economically weaker backgrounds by reducing the burden of education-related expenses and promoting school attendance. The scheme ensures that eligible students from Classes 1st to 8th studying in government and aided schools receive 900/- for three pairs of school uniforms annuallyRs. enhancing their dignity and inclusion in the school environment.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 900/- is provided to each eligible student for the purchase of three pairs of school uniforms.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should belong to the state of Gujarat.
- The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided primary school.
- The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Sections.

name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Socially and Educationally Backward Girls studying in Class 9th
brief_description: The "Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Socially and Educationally Backward Girls studying in Class 9" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme offers free bicycles to girls enrolled in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aided schoolsRs. facilitating easier access to education and encouraging regular school attendance. This physical aid helps in improving educational participation and empowering female students from Socially and Educationally Backward classes.
benefits: - Free bicycle provided to each eligible girl student.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must be a female student.
- The applicant must be studying in Class 9th.
- The applicant must be enrolled in a government or grant-in-aided school in Gujarat.
- The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC).
- The applicant's family income must not exceed 6Rs. per annum.

name: Microcredit Finance Scheme- Self Help Groups (DAADC)
brief_description: The "Microcredit Finance Scheme- Self Help Groups" is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals and Antyodaya Self-Help Groups by providing microloans for starting small-scale businesses. Under this schemeRs. unemployed individuals from SC communities receive financial assistance to become self-reliant through entrepreneurship.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** Up to 50Rs./- (maximum 5Rs./-)- **Interest Rate:** 6% annually- **Loan Tenure:** 36 months (3 years)- **State Government Share:** 95% (47Rs./-)- **Beneficiary Share:** 5% (2Rs./-)- **Guarantor:** Not required- **Possible Installment amount :** 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant must be part of an Antyodaya (AAY) family. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a self-help group of unemployed persons. 1. The applicant must be a member of a registered self-help group (SHG) or apply individually with valid business intent.

name: Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers
brief_description: The scheme "Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers" was launched by the Energy and Petrochemicals DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. with financial allocation starting from the year 2016-17Rs. to provide agricultural electricity connection to Scheduled Caste farmers on a priority basis. The scheme provides electrification of agriculture wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers. Free domestic electricity connections are also provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste farmer. The applications for this scheme are accepted at the Subdivisional Office or via the All Discom Website.
benefits: Electrification of agriculture wells of the farmer.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be from a Scheduled Caste.

name: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.)
brief_description: The scheme "Loan for Foreign Study (E.B.C.)" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide students belonging to the Educationally Backward Class (E.B.C.) with financial assistance for higher education abroad. The scheme provides a maximum loan of 15Rs./- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) for higher studies in foreign countries. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the official website [https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/).
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - A maximum Foreign Study Loan of 15Rs./- is provided for higher education abroad. - The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%. - The loan covers costs such as air ticketsRs. registration feesRs. tuition feesRs. education feesRs. hostel feesRs. booksRs. and other expenses associated with the first year of the course abroad. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - The full loan amount of 15Rs./- will be disbursed to the student in a single installment. - The money will be deposited into the student's bank account after the submission of the original registered mortgage deed. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - After the sanction order is receivedRs. the student's parent or guardian must obtain the prescribed mortgage deed form from the District Office. - The property presented by the student's parent/guardian or the guarantor must be registered as a mortgage in favor of the government. - The loan repayment must begin one year after the completion of the student's study. - The loan must be repaid in monthly or quarterly installments. - The principal loan amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 10 years. - The interest amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 2 years. - The student must ensure all required documentation is completed within the prescribed time limit.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.). - The applicant's family annual income must be less than 10Rs./-. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in 12th standard. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks if they belong to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT)Rs. More BackwardRs. or Extremely Backward categories. - The applicant must be pursuing higher education abroad. - The applicant must be pursuing a DiplomaRs. GraduateRs. Post GraduateRs. Post Graduate DiplomaRs. Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)Rs. or higher-level courses in any field. - The course must be for a minimum duration of 1 (one) academic year or moreRs. or at least two semesters. - The applicant must apply before traveling abroad or within six months of arriving abroad. - The applicant must submit one solvent guarantor.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges
brief_description: The Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges was implemented by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to encourage higher education by providing financial support to meritorious students in government colleges. Under this schemeRs. students of ScienceRs. CommerceRs. and Arts streams receive annual scholarships to pursue higher education.
benefits: > Scholarships are provided to students: - Science stream: 3Rs. per annum. - Commerce stream: 2Rs. per annum. - Arts stream: 1Rs. per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government college in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be pursuing higher education in ArtsRs. CommerceRs. or Science stream. 1. The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination. 1. The applicant should have secured a rank in the firstRs. secondRs. or third position at the university level in ArtsRs. CommerceRs. or Science.

name: Best Book Award
brief_description: The Best Book Award scheme by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. promotes high-quality literary creation and recognition of literary talent. It awards the best books published each calendar year in various languages through the Gujarat Sahitya Akademi. Under this schemeRs. the first prize includes 11Rs. along with a certificate and shield; the second prize includes 7Rs. with a certificate and shield; and the third prize includes 5Rs. also with a certificate and shield. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Sahitya Akademi.
benefits:
> **Monetary Benefits:**


- **First Prize:** 11Rs./-.- **Second Prize:** 7Rs./-.- **Third Prize:** 5Rs./-.
> **Other Benefits:**


- Certificate of Achievement
- Commemorative Shield
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an author.
- The applicants book should have been published within the relevant calendar year.
- The applicants book should be written in a language recognised by the Gujarat Sahitya Academy.

> **Note:**


- Prizes are awarded to the best books in the respective language published by Cha Sahitya Academy every calendar year.
- The scheme is applicable to Gujarat as well as across the country.

name: Bankable Scheme
brief_description: The "Bankable Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Scheduled Caste Development Corporation (GSCDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled caste persons for self-employment opportunities. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided for businessRs. industryRs. or service activitiesRs. along with a subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or a maximum of 50Rs./-. For setting up or expanding self-employment ventures in areas like animal husbandryRs. tailoringRs. groceriesRs. beauty parlorsRs. carpentryRs. RCC centeringRs. footwearRs. bamboo workRs. embroideryRs. and other small-scale trades.
benefits: - Loan assistance up to 2Rs./- for businessesRs. industriesRs. and service activities. - Maximum loan of 1Rs./- for business and 1Rs./- for the industry/service sector individually. - Subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or up to 50Rs./-Rs. whichever is lower.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be from a scheduled caste. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 to 60 years. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicant must be capable of undertaking business activity**.**1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any financial institution. 1. The applicant's annual income must not exceed 1Rs./- (if residing in urban area) and 1Rs./- (if residing in rural area).

name: Scheme for Providing Incentives to Coaches of Athletes who have Won Competitions at the National and International Levels
brief_description: The Scheme for Providing Incentives to Coaches of Athletes who have Won Competitions at the National and International Levels scheme was launched by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to honour coaches who have significantly contributed to the success of athletes in the field of sports. Under this schemeRs. financial incentives are provided to coaches of athletes who have won competitions at national and international levels.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial incentives of up to 10% of the prize money awarded are provided to coaches of winning players in national and international level competitionsRs. subject to a maximum limit of 10 lakh.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be domiciled in the State of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a coach of an athlete/player who has won a national or international level competition. 1. The scheme is applicable to coaches of players who have received cash sports talent awards in the year 2015-16 and onwards. 1. The coach should be employed in the Sports Department of the State Government on a permanent or contract basis. 1. The coach must have trained at least five players. 1. The coach must provide supporting evidence from the players who have undergone training. 1. OnlineRs. postalRs. or telephonic coaching will not be considered.

The applicant must be an Engineering PostGraduate or equivalentRs. with at least 75% marks in the qualifying degree. 1. name: Vikaas-Day Care Scheme For Person with Disability Children
brief_description: Vikaas is a Day care schemeRs. launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Rs. Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment. Govt. of IndiaRs. primarily to expand the range of opportunities available to a person with disability attaining the age of 10 years for enhancing interpersonal and vocational skills as they are on a transition to higher age groups.Registered Organisation(RO) centre will also offer caregiving support to Person with Disability(PwD) during the time the PwD is in the Vikaas centre. In addition it also helps in supporting family members of the PwDs with disabilities covered under the National Trust Act to get some time during the day to fulfil other responsibilities.
benefits: 1. **Day Care:** RO should provide day-care facilities to PwDs for at least 6 hours in a day(between 8 am to 6 pm) along with age specific activities.1. **Staffing:** Interpersonal and vocational skills would be provided for the betterment of the children.1. **Counselling:** Counselling and guidance especially for Activities for Daily Living (ADL)must be provided to parents or guardians of PwDs. RO should provide assistance to PwDs for further trainingRs. education and employment.1. **Transport Facilities (OPTIONAL):** RO can also provide transportation facilities to PwDs in case it so desires. The National Trust will provide additional transport allowance to RO only for PwDs who are availing transport facilities provided by RO.
eligibility: 1. Beneficiary should be of the age of 10 years or more 1. Beneficiary should have one of the disabilities under the [National Trust ActRs. 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf)Rs. which are AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilitities.1. Beneficiary should not be simultaneously enrolled under Samarth or Gharaunda scheme.

name: Pandit Omkarnath Music Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Pandit Omkarnath Music Competition" was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to honour the memory of Pandit Omkarnath and promote classical music among young artists by organizing competitive platforms for singingRs. vocalRs. and percussion performancesRs. addressing the need to nurture and recognize classical music talent in the state. The scheme is implemented by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Gujarat. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: - Classical music artists are provided with the opportunity to participate in organized competitions for singingRs. vocalRs. and percussion performances. - Competitions are organized separately for two age categories: 12 to 19 years and 20 to 35 yearsRs. ensuring age-appropriate competition levels. - The scheme provides a platform for recognition and promotion of classical music talent in the state of Gujarat.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be between 12 to 19 years of age or between 20 to 35 years of age. - The applicant must be a classical music artist. - The applicant must specialize in singingRs. vocal performanceRs. or percussion instruments.

name: SITARE-Appreciation Grant
brief_description:
Students Innovations for Translation & Advancement of Research Explorations (SITARE) Scheme is started by the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) for supporting innovative student projects in the area of biotechnology. The schemes mandate is to promote and encourage young students for embracing translational research to develop innovative products and technologies addressing unmet needs. The scheme has two components: SITARE-Gandhian Young Technological Innovation Award Grant (SITARE-GYTI) and SITARE-Appreciation Grant.
**SITARE-Appreciation Grant:**
Residential workshops called as Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) for undergraduate students are organized to provide hands-on technical training and mentorship for problem identification in 3-4 weeks duration. Out of 30-40 students per workshopRs. 10 students are selected and provided grant support of up to INR 1 lakh each to encourage their inquisitiveness and sustained efforts. The recipients are recognized as BIRACs SITARE-Appreciation beneficiaries. In a yearRs. 3 such workshops are conducted.
> **About BIIS:**

The mandate of Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) is to provide exposure and orientation for the entrepreneurial journey through hands-on-technical trainingRs. interactive sessions with expertsRs. access to a bio incubation centerRs. etc. This is to promote grassroots innovations and nurture ideas with societal impactRs. pioneered by undergraduate studentsRs. especially from Tier II/III cities. The selected few would receive financial support of INR 1 lakh as an encouragement to pursue their inquisitive entrepreneurial idea. The fund recipients would be recognized as SITARE-Appreciation recipients and may also receive follow-up training and mentoring.
The BIIS is a national-level programme to provide up to 4 weeks of residential training benefitting up to 40 students in each session.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the residential workshops called as Biotech Innovation Ignition School (BIIS) for undergraduate students are organized to provide hands-on technical training and mentorship for problem identification in 3-4 weeks duration.
1. Out of 30-40 students per workshopRs. 10 students are selected and provided grant support of up to INR 1 lakh each to encourage their inquisitiveness and sustained efforts.
1. The recipients are recognized as BIRACs SITARE-Appreciation beneficiaries.
1. In a yearRs. 3 such workshops are conducted.

**Note:** The grantees are expected to conduct further research on the topic either at home institution or at the SITARE Partners lab. SITARE Partner can extend mentoring and other support required for the same.
> **Travel/Accommodation:**

The following expenses will be covered for student participants:
Class II Rail fare and local travel expenses
Hostel accommodation
BreakfastRs. lunchRs. dinner
Shuttle facility from hostel to project site
> Other activities:

SITARE Partner is encouraged to provide mentoring to BIIS participants by organizing invited talks by experts from institutions such as but not limited to TiERs. BRECRs. Management schoolsRs. etc.Rs. and may undertake tour(s) to nearby reputed colleges/institutions/incubation centres.
eligibility:
1. Students pursuing Bachelors programme in any discipline are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The student should have a valid ID issued by the Institution/University.
1. A student can avail of only one opportunity for BIIS workshop training across all SITARE PartnersRs. except for the SITARE-Appreciation Award Grantees who will be eligible to avail access to subsequent workshops by other Partners on recommendation by SITARE Partner/BIRAC.

**Note:** The preference will be given to the students who are from Tier II/Tier III cities and aspirational districts within India.

name: National Science Chair- Scientific Excellence
brief_description:
There are a few chairs/professorships available in the country instituted by various ministries/departments/ academies with public funds. Considering the limited number of such opportunitiesRs. the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) has been catering to one such scheme - National Science Chair: Scientific Excellence & Science Leadership. The main aim of the scheme is to recognize active eminent senior resident Indian superannuated scientists for their outstanding contributions both nationally and internationallyRs. in the areas of ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. EngineeringRs. Mathematics (STEM)Rs. and MedicineRs. to promote excellence and growth in R&D.
**Mode-1: Scientific Excellence:**
The performing senior scientists who have made outstanding contributions to researchRs. as evidenced by S&T output indicators (i.e. publicationsRs. patentsRs. technology transferRs. software development or an impact on policy) and wish to continue their work in R&D will be recognized through this mode. SERB recognizes the need for utilizing the expertise of exceptionally meritorious senior scientists. Non-utilization of their expertiseRs. in one senseRs. is a national loss and age should not be the criterion for performing scientists.
> **Objective:**

To extend continuance of support for excellence in R&D activities of eminent senior superannuated scientists who are passionate in research as evidenced by the S&T output.
> **Advisory Committee:**

A committee referred to as the National Science Chair Advisory Committee (NSCAC) has been constituted to oversee the development of the ChairsRs. make recommendations for the selection of the awardeesRs. review their progress /extensionRs. undertake assigned activities to ensure promotionRs. relevanceRs. and quality of R&DRs. as well as to meet the goal of the awards.
> **Number of Positions:**


- The maximum number of positions is restricted to thirty (30).

> **Tenure and Commencement:**


- The award will be given initially for a period of 3 years and is extendable for a maximum of another two yearsRs. subject to the recommendations of the NSCAC.
- Selected Chairs will have to join within a period of six months from the date of issue of the offer letter.
benefits:
1. An amount of 1.5 lakhs per month will be given to the awardee as a fellowship.
1. The Research Grant in this case will be 25 lakhs per annum.
1. For overhead expensesRs. 1.0 lakh per annum will be given to the host institution.

**Note:** The grant shall be used for manpowerRs. equipmentRs. travel (including international)Rs. contingencyRs. etc. It needs to be utilized as per the norms of the Host Institute. Items purchased out of the contingency grant will be the property of the Host Institute after the completion of tenure. HoweverRs. in certain listed itemsRs. their retention by the awardee will be decided in accordance with the existing government rules and regulations on the subject.
eligibility:
> **Eligibility for nomination:**


1. The nominee should be an active resident Indian scientist/academicianRs. with an outstanding research track record in any one or more areas of STEM and medicineRs. particularly during the last five years.
1. The nominee must have received recognition for his/her work from national/international scientific bodies such as fellowship in prestigious academies and S&T awards.
1. The nominee could be affiliated with an academic institutions/R&D lab or should have consent on the subject from the future host institution.

**Note:** The nominee should not hold any administrative roles and functions and is not in receipt of any honorarium/fellowship/salary from any other institute or organization at the time of initiation of the NSC award if offered by SERB.
> **Assessment Criteria:** The assessment criteria for the selection of the awardee will be decided by NSCAC and it will be generally based on the following considerations:


1. Outstanding research track record of the nominee and international standing in the field.
1. Quality/originality of proposed research plan.
1. Ability to mentor young researchers and implement proactive approaches towards the advancement of S&T talent in the country.

name: Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar
brief_description:
Science and Technology are essential tools for development of the society. Scientists play a very important role in selflessly driving the systematic quest for truth and the development of new knowledge. They are the backbones of the nation who contribute tirelessly to the society's development. The exemplary and outstanding contributions of scientists need to be recognized so that they can serve as an inspiration to others.
> **Objective** The objective of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (RVP) is to recognise the notable and inspiring contribution made by the scientistsRs. technologists and innovators individually or in teams in various fields of scienceRs. technology and technology- led innovation. The RVP shall be one of the highest recognition in the field of scienceRs. technology and innovation in India. Scientists/ technologists / innovators working in governmentRs. private sector organizations or individuals working outside any organisationRs. who have made distinguished contributions in terms of path-breaking research or innovation or discovery in any fields of scienceRs. technology or technology- led innovation shall be eligible for the awards. People of Indian origin staying abroad with exceptional contributions benefiting the Indian communities or society shall also be eligible for the awards

> **The awards shall be given in the following four categories** a) Vigyan Ratna (VR) award to be awarded to recognize lifetime achievements & contributions made in any field of science and technology. b) Vigyan Shri(VS)award to be awarded to recognize distinguished contributions in any field of science and technology. c) Vigyan Yuva- Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (VY-SSB) award to be awarded to recognize & encourage young scientists who made an exceptional contribution in any field of science and technology. d) VigyanTeam (VT) award to be awarded to a team comprising three or more scientists/researchers/innovators who have made an exceptional contribution working in a team in any field of science and technology.
> **No. of Awardees:** Name of AwardMax. No. of Awards Vigyan Ratna (VR)03Vigyan Shri (VS)25Vigyan Yuva - Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (VY-SSB)25Vigyan Team (VT)03
> **Ceremony Details** a) These awards shall be announced on the National Technology Day (11th May) every year. b) The Award Ceremony for all categories of awards shall be held every year on the National Space Day on 23rdAugust. c) The Hon'ble President of India / The Hon'ble Vice President of India may confer the Awards. d) The Award Ceremony may be organised every year in Vigyan Bhavan or at an alternative suitable venue. e) All these awards would commence from the year 2024.
benefits:
- The awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate) signed by the President of India & a medallion. A commemorative brochureRs. containing the citation and photograph of the awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony.
- In case of posthumous awardRs. the decoration of the award shall be received by the next of kin of such awardee.
- The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony due to personal reasons (including indispositionRs. preoccupationRs. etc.) the award shall be deemed to have been conferred on such a person. No other person (including the spouse/next of kind) should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awards except in posthumous cases.
eligibility: - All scientistsRs. technologists and innovators working in any field of science in government or private organizations who have contributed or done pathbreaking researchRs. technology led innovation or discovery in any fields of science or development of innovative technologies/ significant societal impact shall be eligible for the award. - ScientistsRs. technologists and innovators of Indian origin abroad with exceptional contributions benefitting the Indian communities or society at large shall also be eligible. - The Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar shall be given in the following 13 domains: 1. Physics. 1. Chemistry. 1. Biological Sciences. 1. Mathematics & Computer Science. 1. Earth Science. 1. Medicine. 1. Engineering Sciences. 1. Agricultural Science. 1. Environmental Science. 1. Technology & innovation. 1. Atomic Energy. 1. Space Science and Technology. 1. Others.

name: National Awards To Teachers (Higher Education)
brief_description:
The purpose of the National Award to Teachers under the Department of Higher Educational Institutions is to recognize the distinctive contributions of some of the finest faculty members in the country and honor them for their dedication and hard workRs. which have not only improved the quality of higher education but also enriched the lives of their students. The Award seeks to recognize and honor faculty members' unique and path-breaking achievements in teachingRs. researchRs. institutional serviceRs. community outreachRs. and novelty of work in higher education.
> **No. of Awardees** - Fifty Awards (25 in Category II and 25 in Category III) shall be conferred annually.
> **Selection Process :****** The selection procedure for NTA-2023 will follow a two-step process. - Preliminary Search cum Screening Committee for initial shortlisting of candidates. - Committee of Jury for the final section of awardees from the shortlisted candidates.
> **Ceremony Details** - The ceremony is held on 5th September every year.
> **Nominations for the award can be made by any of the following:** 1. Vice-Chancellor/Director/Principal of the institution. 1. A colleague or former faculty member of the same institution. 1. Self-nomination is not allowed. 1. Former Vice-Chancellor/Director/Principal may apply if currently teaching full-time. 1. Search committee members can nominate outstanding faculty. 1. Award Jury members cannot nominate.
benefits:
1. A medal.
1. A certificate.
1. Cash Prize of 50Rs./-
eligibility:
**The award is open to all the faculty members of colleges/universities/higher educational institutions in IndiaRs. satisfying the following conditions:**

1. Should be a regular faculty member.
1. Should have at least five years of full-time teaching experience at the Undergraduate and/or Post-graduate level.
1. Should not be above 55 years of age as of the last date of receiving an application for the awards.
1. Vice-Chancellor/ Director/Principal (regular or officiating) are NOT eligible to apply.

name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
brief_description:
The Scheme "Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar" was instituted in the year 2009 by the Department of Sports. There are four categories of awards under the Scheme: (a) Identification and nurturing of budding/young talent (b) Encouragement to sports through Corporate Social Responsibility (c) Employment of sports persons and sports welfare measures (d) Sports for Development
**OBJECTIVE** The objective of the award is to encourage and promote the involvement of corporatesRs. voluntary organizationsRs. sports control boardsRs. etc.Rs. in the promotion and development of sports in the country.
Any corporate entityRs. public or privateRs. sports control boards and non-governmental organization NG0s) including sports bodies at the state and national levelRs. which have played a visible role in the area of ports promotion and development will be eligible to be considered for Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar.
benefits:
1. The awards will consist of a citation and a trophy in each of the above-mentioned categories. There will be no cash award. There will be only one award every year for each category of the award. 1. The Awards will be presented to the winners at the function for the presentation of the Award to be held at a place and on a date to be determined by the Government. 1. The Awards will be in addition to any other awardRs. that the corporate entities may have got from other organizations for the same achievements.
**Note 1:** In order to ensure due diligence in the selection of awardeesRs. the Ministry and Sports Authority of India will make necessary verification prior to finalizing the names of the awardees.
**Note 2:** An entity nominated for the Award shall be deemed to have accepted the provisions of the scheme.
**Note 3:** At the time of the ceremony in Rashtrapati BhavanRs. the awards will be conferred only on those awardeesRs. who are present. The awards can be received by the Head/CEO of the entity or any other person authorized by the head/CEO.
**Note 4:** No Award will be made for a second time to the same entity for the same category.
eligibility:
**Eligibility of the Candidate -**
1. Any corporate entityRs. public or privateRs. sports control boards and non-governmental organization NGOs including sports bodies at the state and national levelRs. which have played a visible role in the area of sports promotion and development. 2. For the category of **'Identification and nurturing of budding/young talent'**Rs. the entity should have identified and nurtured at least 50 young and budding sportspersons each year during the last three years.
3. For the category of **'Encouragement to sports through corporate social responsibility'**Rs. the entities should have contributed a minimum of 5% of their gross profit or an amount not less than Rs. 2 crores in the preceding three financial years towards sports promotion and development. Outlays meant purely for commercial purposes will not be counted towards this contribution. Only contributions of non-commercial nature as part of corporate social responsibility will be considered for assessing the contribution made by the corporate concernedRs. towards the promotion and development of sports in the country. Copies of audited statements of accounts for the last here years should be submitted along with the application.
4. For the category of **'Employment of sportspersons and sports welfare measures'**Rs. the entity should have recruited at least 50 sportspersons during the last three years.
5. For the category of **'Sports for Development'**Rs. only non-governmental organizationsRs. which have been working for the promotion and development of sports at least for the last three years would be eligible to apply. Memorandum of AssociationRs. Rules & RegulationsRs. Bye-lawsRs. etc under which the applicant NGO has been established and documents indicating the source of funds for its functioning and activities should also be submitted along with the application.
**Eligibility of the Nominating Agency -**
1. All recognized National Sports Federations; Indian Olympic Association; Industry Chambers such as the Federation of Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)Rs. Associated Chamber of Commerce (ASSOCHAM)Rs. and confederation of Indian Industries (CII)Rs. State Governments; Sports Authority of India and Sports control/Promotion Boards of various Government Organizations such as the All India Police Sports Control BoardRs. Army Sports Control BoardRs. Railway Sports Promotion BoardRs. Services Sports Control BoardRs. Indian Navy Sports Control Board and Air Force Sports Control BoardRs. Petroleum Sports Promotion BoardRs. Ministries/Departments of the Government of India etc.
2. Any corporate entityRs. public or privateRs. a non-governmental organization including sports bodies at the state or national levelRs. which has made a contribution towards sports promotion and development as per the schemeRs. can also apply directly to the Government.
3. Notwithstanding the aboveRs. Government reserves the right to nominate any corporate entityRs. public or privateRs. a non-governmental organization including sports bodies at the state and national levels in deserving cases where their nominations have not been received from the agencies mentioned under the Scheme.
**Note:** Canvassing in any form for/by an entry will render it liable to disqualification.
**Selection criteria -** The Committee will evaluate nominations/applications on the basis of multi-faceted criteria for the various categories of the awards as detailed below: -
**a) Identification and nurturing of budding talent:** (i) Number of children identified and nurtured year-wise in the last three years (ii) Details of sports infrastructure created (iii) Number of schoolsRs. collegesRs. universitiesRs. clubsRs. or other such units adopted (iv) Number of sportspersons trained (v) Equipment support and other support extended (vi) Number of competitions/tournaments held (vii) Sports achievements of identified children (viii) Any other incentive is given to trainees
**(b) Encouragement to sports through corporate social responsibility:** (i) Funds earmarked under corporate social responsibility for sports-related activities yearwise (during the last three preceding financial years) (ii) Details of sports activities (including creation and development/upgradation of sports infrastructureRs. procurement of sports equipmentRs. engagement of coachesRs. the conduct of sports competitions/tournamentsRs. training and coaching of sportspersons and teams) funded under Corporate Social Responsibility during last preceding three years.
**(d) Employment of sportspersons and other welfare measures:** (i) Number of sportspersons employed year-wise during the last three years (ii) Level of employment along with salary structure (iii) Promotional avenues offered to sportspersons employed (iv) Sports achievements of employed sportspersons (v) other welfare measures for sportspersons
**(e) Sports for development:** (i) Details of activities undertaken for harnessing the potential of sport to contribute to the achievement of development objectives and peaceRs. (ii) Details of activities to ensure that communities have physical play environments that are safe and accessibleRs. (iii) Details of activities undertaken towards enhancement of the capacity of schools and teachers to effectively deliver sports and physical education programs. (iv) Year of coming into existence of the NGO.

name: Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards
brief_description: The Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards scheme launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to recognize acts of bravery and humanity in saving lives during emergencies such as accidentsRs. firesRs. drowningRs. disastersRs. and attacks. Under this schemeRs. medalsRs. certificatesRs. and financial allowances are provided to individuals who demonstrate exceptional courage in life-saving situations.
benefits: **Types of Awards** - Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak For most conspicuous bravery involving extreme risk to life - Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak For bravery and promptness in serious risk situations - Jeevan Raksha Padak For courage and promptness in life-saving acts involving injury risk **Tangible Benefits** - Medal (As Per Category) A distinguished medal is awarded based on the level of bravery demonstrated. - Certificate of Recognition An official certificate acknowledging the act of gallantry is provided. - Financial Allowance (As Per Government Norms) A monetary allowance is granted as per rules prescribed by the government of india. - National-Level Recognition The awardee receives nationwide recognition for their courageous act. - Posthumous Award Provision The award can also be conferred posthumously to honor deceased rescuers. **Mode of Disbursement** - The medal and certificate are presented physically during the official award ceremony. - The awards are conferred once every year. - The awards are presented after approval by the president of India. - The award is a one-time recognition granted for a specific act of bravery.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be any individual from any field of life 1. The applicant should have performed a life-saving act involving courage and risk 1. The applicant should have acted in emergencies such as fireRs. drowningsRs. accidentsRs. disastersRs. etc. 1. The applicant may belong to armed forcesRs. policeRs. CAPFsRs. fire servicesRs. or civilians 1. The applicant can be recommended posthumously

name: 100% Penalty Mafi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "100% Penalty Mafi Yojana" was launched by the Urban Development and Urban Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to beneficiaries of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell who have pending installment dues by offering a complete waiver of penalty amountsRs. thereby reducing the financial burden on property allottees and encouraging them to clear their outstanding dues. The scheme provides 100% waiver on penalty amounts if all arrears of installments are paid in one go by 31st March and facilitates the transfer of property ownership to eligible applicants. The applications for this scheme are accepted Online.
benefits: - The applicant receives 100% waiver on the penalty amount accumulated on pending installments. - The waiver is applicable on all arrears of installments pertaining to old schemes of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell. - The benefit is a one-time waiver granted upon fulfillment of payment conditions. - The waiver is applied at the time of final settlement of dues. ***Conditions*** _*All arrears of installments must be paid in one go (lump sum payment)._ _*The payment must be completed by 31st March._ _*The waiver applies only to the penalty component; the principal installment amount must be paid in full._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a beneficiary of the Gujarat Housing Board or Slum Clearance Cell. - The applicant must have pending installment arrears under the old schemes of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell. - The applicant must clear all arrears of installments in one lump sum payment. - The applicant must complete the payment by 31st March. - The applicant must be either the original tenantRs. a successive power of attorney holderRs. or the existing occupant of the property.

name: Top Class Education For Students With Disabilities
brief_description: A scholarship scheme by DoEPwDs for Students with Disabilities (SwDs) pursuing studies beyond class 12th admitted in a full-time course in one of the 'notified institutions'. The students with the specified disabilities defined in Schedule of the "Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016" will be eligible under this scheme. This includes persons with visualRs. hearingRs. speechRs. loco-motorRs. mental retardationRs. and other disabilities. At times SwDs are deprived of harnessing their latent skills and thereby miss the opportunity. This scheme aims to support SwDs to study further in order to prepare themselves to earn their livelihood and to find a dignified place for themselves in the society as they face several barriers physicalRs. financialRs. psychologicalRs. mental in pursuing studies and living with dignity.
benefits: 1. Payment of **Full tuition fee** and non-refundable charges (Ceiling of 2.00 LPA per student for private sector institutions)1. **Living expenses**: 3000/- per month per student.1. **Books and stationery**: 5000/- per annum per student.1. A **computer/laptop** with accessories (UPS and printer) is limited to 30Rs./- per student (one-time assistance).1. Reimbursement of expenses for the purchase of **Aids and Assistive Devices** including necessary software related to the particular disability of the selected candidate: 30Rs./- per student (one-time assistance).1. **Special Allowance** (related to types of disabilities like Reader AllowanceRs. Escort AllowanceRs. Helper Allowance etc.): 2000/- per month. > **The aids and assistive devices may include:** > **For the blind I low vision:** - Braille / Brailer Typewriter - Laptop with screen-reading software - Laptop with Screen Magnification software - Talk software for mobile phone accessibility - DAISY Recorder and player > **For the hearing impaired:** - Binaural digital programmable hearing aid with provision for button cells. - Cell phone with SMS SIM Card - Laptop with WiFi (Bluetooth) facility.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Student admitted in a full-time course in one of the "notified institutions".
1. The Percentage of Disability should be 40% or above.
1. The applicant should be Pursuing a Graduate or Post Graduate Degree or Diploma.
1. The Total Annual Income of the Parent / Guardian should be less than or equal to 6.00 Lakh per Annum.
1. The applicant MUST NOT be the third sibling in his/her family who is availing of this scholarship.

name: National Gopal Ratna Award
brief_description: The scheme National Gopal Ratna Award has been launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)Rs. Government of India. aims to motivate farmers to enhance the productivity of indigenous milch animal breeds scientificallyRs. encourage Artificial Insemination (AI) Technicians for 100% AI coverage under Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)Rs. and promote growth and competitiveness among dairy cooperatives and milk producer companies. Through this schemeRs. awards including certificates of meritRs. mementoesRs. and monetary prizes are provided to dairy farmersRs. dairy organisationsRs. and AI technicians. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD). A total of 12 awards are given annually across 3 categories. The applications are screenedRs. verifiedRs. and shortlisted through agencies like the Quality Council of India (QCI) and the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB). Final selection is carried out by designated committees constituted by DAHD. The awardees are announced on 25th November and awarded on National Milk Day (26th November). > **Objective:** - To motivate farmers to take up the productivity enhancement of indigenous breeds of milch animals in a scientific manner. - To motivate Artificial Insemination Technicians to take up 100% AI coverageRs. under Rashtriya Gokul Mission ( RGM). - To motivate Cooperative and Milk producer Companies to grow and to instill competitive spirit.
benefits: 1. The National Gopal Ratna Award 2025 will be conferred to 1stRs. 2ndRs. 3rdRs. and one special Award for the North Eastern Region(NER) states in each of the above 3 categories. It will consist of a Certificate of meritRs. a memento and a monetary prize in the first two categoriesRs. i.e.Rs. Best Dairy Farmer and Best DCS/FPO/MPCsRs. as under: - 5Rs./- (Rupee five lakh only) - 1st rank - 3Rs./- (Rupee three lakh only) - 2nd rank - 2Rs./- (Rupee two lakh only) - 3rd rank - 2Rs./- (Rupee two lakh only) -Special Award for North Eastern Region (NER) and Himalayan States (UttarakhandRs. J&KRs. Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh). 1. In the case of the Best Artificial Insemination Technician (AIT) categoryRs. the National Gopal Ratna Award-2025 will consist of a Certificate of Merit and a memento only. No cash prize will be provided in the Artificial Insemination Technician (AIT) Category. > **No. of Awardees:** A total of 12 awards are given each year (4 awards in each Category). > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** Awards are conferred on 26th November (National Milk Day).
eligibility: 1. For Dairy Farmers - The applicant should be maintaining recognised indigenous breeds. - The applicant should be maintaining breeds out of 53 cattle breeds or 20 buffalo breeds. 1. For Dairy Cooperative Societies / FPO / MPC - The applicant organisation should be engaged in dairy activities. - The applicant should be registered under the Cooperative Societies Act or the Companies Act. - The applicant should be operating at the village level. - The applicant should collect at least 100 litres of milk per day and have at least 50 farmer members (for Non-NER states). - The applicant should collect at least 20 litres of milk per day and have at least 20 farmer members (for NER states). 1. For Artificial Insemination Technicians (AIT) - The applicant should be associated with State/UT Livestock Development BoardsRs. Milk FederationsRs. NGOsRs. or private organisations. - The applicant should have completed a minimum of 90 days of AI training.

name: Presidents Medal for Distinguished Service
brief_description: The Presidents Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM) scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to recognize exceptional serviceRs. distinguished recordsRs. and meritorious contributions in policeRs. securityRs. fireRs. prisonRs. and civil defence services. Under this schemeRs. prestigious medalsRs. national recognitionRs. and service acknowledgment are provided to eligible personnel serving in various uniformed and public safety services.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits** - Award of Medal (PSM or MSM) for recognition of service. - National-level prestige and honour. - Official recognition recorded in service records. - Career enhancement and increased professional credibility. - Eligibility consideration for future honors and promotions. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical conferment of the medal and citation by the President of India. - Announced annually on national occasions (e.g.Rs. Republic Day/Independence Day). - Lifetime recognition unless withdrawn under disciplinary grounds.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a member of the Police ForcesRs. CAPFsRs. CPOsRs. Fire ServicesRs. Prison AdministrationRs. Home GuardsRs. or Civil Defence. 1. The applicant should have a clean service record; no major penalties in the review period. 1. The applicant should demonstrate exceptional abilityRs. meritRs. or devotion to duty. 1. The applicant should have completed a minimum 25 years of service. 1. The applicant should have at least 10 years of ACR/APAR records under review. 1. The applicant should have at least 8 Very Good/Outstanding ratings; at least 5 must be Outstanding. 1. The applicant should not have more than 1 missing ACR; last year ACR must be available. 1. The applicant should maintain SHAPE 1 physical fitness (relaxation possible in exceptional cases). 1. The applicant should have a gap of at least 6 years after receiving MSM (relaxable to 4 years in special cases).

name: National Metallurgist Award
brief_description: The National Metallurgist AwardRs. instituted by the Ministry of SteelRs. Government of IndiaRs. is open only to Indian nationals who have made significant contributions to the field of metallurgy in India through their work in industryRs. research and developmentRs. or academia. The award recognizes outstanding achievements in areas such as operationsRs. research and developmentRs. waste managementRs. and energy conservation. Individuals from industry as well as research and academic institutions are eligible to apply. The awards will be presented in the following four categories: 1) Lifetime Achievement Award 2) National Metallurgist Award 3) Young Metallurgist a) Environment b) Metal Science 4) Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector **No. of Awardees** 1. Lifetime Achievement Award 1 awardee 1. National Metallurgist Award 1 awardee 1. Young Metallurgist (Environment Science) 1 awardee 1. Young Metallurgist (Metal Science) 1 awardee 1. Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector 1 awardee
benefits: 1. Lifetime Achievement Award Certificate + Memento 1. National Metallurgist Award Certificate + Memento 1. Young Metallurgist (Environment Science) 1Rs./- + Certificate + Memento 1. Young Metallurgist (Metal Science) 1Rs./- + Certificate + Memento 1. Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector 1Rs./- + Certificate + Memento
eligibility: 1. **Lifetime Achievement Award:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 20 years of experienceRs. be minimum 50 years of ageRs. and hold a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **National Metallurgist Award:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 15 years of experienceRs. be minimum 40 years of ageRs. and hold a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Young Metallurgist (Environment Science):** The applicant/nominee should have at least 5 years of experienceRs. be maximum 35 years of ageRs. and hold a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Young Metallurgist (Metal Science):** The applicant/nominee should have at least 5 years of experienceRs. be maximum 35 years of ageRs. and hold a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 10 years of experienceRs. be minimum 35 years of ageRs. and hold a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.

name: National CSR Awards
