brief_description: The National CSR AwardsRs. instituted by the Ministry of Corporate AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. aim to recognize companies that have made a positive impact on society through innovative and sustainable Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. These awards represent the highest recognition for CSR excellence in India. **The objectives of the awards are:** 1. To increase competition in various categories of companies to infuse excellence in their CSR activities 2. To encourage companies to spend the entire amount i.eRs. eligible CSR spend; 3. To recognize the impactRs. innovationRs. usage of technologyRs. gender and environment issuesRs. sustainabilityRs. scalabilityRs. and replicability of CSR activities; and 4. To channelize CSR activities of corporates so that the benefits of their activities reach the marginalized sections of society and in remote areas of the country. **Under National CSR Awards there are three main categories as under:-** 1. Corporate Awards for Excellence in CSR 2. CSR Awards for CSR in Aspirational Districts/Difficult Terrains 3. CSR Awards for contribution in National Priority Areas
benefits: > The awardees are presented with a trophy and scroll and runner ups with a medal and scroll.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 or 2013 and must comply with Section 135 of the Companies ActRs. 2013. 1. The CSR project and related expenditure should pertain to the specified financial years. 1. The impact of the CSR project/programme should be demonstrated based on the required reporting period as per submitted details.

name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Gallantry
brief_description: The "Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Gallantry" scheme has been launched by the Ministry of PortsRs. Shipping and Waterways under the Directorate General of ShippingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to recognize extraordinary bravery in maritime situations. Under this schemeRs. recognition is provided to Indian seafarers who risk their lives to save others or protect the marine environment.
benefits: - Trophy - Citation - Individual Medals (if multiple persons)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an Indian seafarer serving on any vessel. 1. The applicant should have performed an act of exceptional bravery in adverse maritime conditions. 1. The applicants act should involve saving livesRs. propertyRs. or environment beyond normal duty.

name: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide free residential education to students from Special Backward Classes (SBC) i.e. BanjaraRs. BaldiaRs. LabanaRs. Gadia-LoharRs. GadoliaRs. GujarRs. GurjarRs. RaikaRs. Rebari (Debasi)Rs. and Gadaria (GadariRs. Gayari). Under this schemeRs. selected students admitted to Class 6 in government-approved schools receive free educationRs. accommodationRs. mealsRs. uniformsRs. textbooksRs. and writing materials.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. eligible students receive free educationRs. accommodationRs. mealsRs. uniformsRs. text books and study materials in government-approved schools.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant's family should not be a taxpayer.
1. The applicant must be a regular student in a government or non-government school.
1. The applicant must have passed class 5th with a minimum of 50% or above marks.1. The applicant should belong to one of the following Special Backward Class (SBC) communities:


- BanjaraRs. BaldiaRs. Labana
- Gadiya LoharRs. Gadolia
- GujarRs. Gurjar
- RaikaRs. Rebari (Debasi)
- Gadaria (GadriRs. Gyari)

**Note 1:** Only students who qualify on merit after clearing the pre-admission examination will be admitted to the 59 schools selected by the department.
**Note 2:** Students will be given admission in Class 6 as per their merit based on marks obtained in Class 5.

name: Coir Udyami Yojana
brief_description: Coir Udyami Yojana is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up coir units with a project cost up to 10Rs./- plus one cycle of working capitalRs. which shall not exceed 25% of the project cost. Working capital will not be considered for subsidy. Coir Udyami Yojana is a Central Sector Scheme to be administered by the Ministry of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises. The Scheme will be implemented by the Coir Board a statutory organization under the Ministry of MSMERs. as the Nodal Agency at the national level. > **Financial Institutions providing loan under CUY:** - All the Scheduled Commercial Banks listed in the 2nd schedule of the RBI Act - All Regional Rural Banks - Co-operative Banks that are Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) of the Credit Guarantee Trust Fund for MSMERs. as well as through SC/ST/OBC Finance and Development Corporations.
benefits: - **Beneficiarys Contribution (of Project Cost):** 5%- **Bank Credit:** 55%- **Rate of Subsidy (of project cost):** 40% > **Note****:** - The maximum admissible cost of the project is 10Rs./- plus working capital. Working capital shall not exceed 25% of the project cost. Subsidy will be computed excluding the working capital component. - The Bank will sanction 95% of the project cost after adjusting 5% beneficiary contribution deposited and disburse the full amount of the project costRs. including the beneficiary contributionRs. in installments for setting up the project.
eligibility: > **Eligibility conditions of the Beneficiaries:** - The applicant must be an individual above 18 years of age with Indian Citizenship. - The applicant will not be subject to any income ceiling for receiving assistance under the scheme. - The applicant must set up a project related to the production of coir fibreRs. yarnRs. or products under the coir sector. - The applicant may be an individualRs. a CompanyRs. Self self-help group (SHG)Rs. a Non-Governmental Organization (NGO)Rs. Institution registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860Rs. a Production Co-operative SocietyRs. a Joint Liability GroupRs. or a Charitable Trust. - The applicant must not have already availed a government subsidy under any other scheme of the Government of India or the State Government for the same purpose. > **Other eligibility conditions:** - The applicant belonging to special categories must produce a certified copy of the caste/community certificate issued by the competent authority. - The applicantRs. if applying as an institutionRs. must submit a certified copy of the bylaws wherever applicable. - The applicant must ensure that the project cost includes capital expenditure such as building and machinery. - The applicant may include one cycle of working capital in the project proposalRs. but it will not be considered for subsidy. The loan for working capital will only be sanctioned and released after the unit is set upRs. and the working capital must not exceed 25% of the total project cost. - The applicantRs. if already owning a work shedRs. will have the cost of only the required machinery considered as the project cost under the scheme. > **Note :** - Special focus on SC/ST and beneficiaries from the North Eastern Region (NER). - The scheme encourages women and youth participation in rural areas. - Only one person from one family is eligible for obtaining financial assistance for setting up of projects under Coir Udyami Yojana. The family includes self and spouse.

name: A Scheme to Provide Free Tablets to Std.12th Pass Students
brief_description: The A Scheme to Provide Free Tablets to Std.12th Pass Students scheme was implemented by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. provide free tablets to ST students who have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination and are admitted to the first year of a graduate-level course in a recognized university are reimbursed for the token amount of 1Rs. deposited for receiving tablets from the Education Department.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of 1Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC/Std. 12) examination. 1. The applicant should be admitted to the first year of a graduate-level course in a recognized university.

name: IELTS & TOEFL Training Assistance
brief_description: The "IELTS & TOEFL Training Assistance" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) students aspiring to pursue higher studies abroad after class 12th. Under this schemeRs. the tribal students receive structured guidanceRs. IELTS and TOEFL trainingRs. and financial assistance to prepare for admissions to reputed foreign universitiesRs. with additional support for visa and passport processes.
benefits: - Financial aid of 3Rs./- per student to cover IELTS and TOEFL training expenses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be a student and must have passed class 12th (HSC).1. The applicant should be residing in a notified tribal area of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must intend to pursue higher education abroad. 1. The applicant must require IELTS or TOEFL training as part of their admission preparation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan" was launched on 9th June 2016 by the Ministry of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide fixed-day assuredRs. comprehensive and quality antenatal care universally to all pregnant women (in 2nd and 3rd trimester) on the 9th of every monthRs. addressing the critical need for standardized maternal healthcare services and reducing maternal and infant mortality rates across the country. The scheme provides assuredRs. comprehensive and quality antenatal careRs. free of costRs. universally to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month and includes a minimum package of antenatal care services provided by Obstetrics and Gynaecology specialistsRs. RadiologistsRs. and Physicians at government health facilities. The applicant must be a pregnant woman in her 2nd or 3rd trimester of pregnancy and must be willing to visit designated government health facilities on the 9th of every month for antenatal care services. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of India through National Health Mission at state and district levels and applications for this scheme are accepted both online through the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan portal and offline at designated government health facilities.
benefits: ##### ***Medical Services Provided*** - **Comprehensive Antenatal Care:** Special Antenatal Care services provided by Obstetrics and Gynaecology specialistsRs. RadiologistsRs. and Physicians at government health facilities.- **Minimum Package of Services:** A minimum package of investigations and medicines such as Iron Folic Acid and calcium supplements provided to all pregnant women attending Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan clinics.- **High Risk Pregnancy Identification:** Identification and follow-up of high risk pregnancies with red stickers added to Mother and Child Protection cards.- **Fixed Day Service:** Services provided on the 9th of every month at designated facilities. ##### ***Service Delivery Mechanism*** - **Single Window System:** Using principles of single window system for providing investigations and medicines.- **Mobile Application Support:** Mobile and web-based application to help pregnant women find their nearest Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan facility.- **Cost:** Completely free of cost to all beneficiaries. ##### ***Coverage Areas*** **Facility Types:** Services provided at Government health facilities including Primary Health CentresRs. Community Health CentresRs. District HospitalsRs. and urban health facilities in both urban and rural areas. ##### ***Conditions*** - Regular attendance on the 9th of every month for antenatal check-ups. - Compliance with medical advice and treatment prescribed by healthcare providers. - Follow-up visits as recommended for high-risk pregnancies. - Carrying Mother and Child Protection card during visits.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a pregnant woman in her 2nd or 3rd trimester of pregnancy. - The applicant must be an Indian citizen residing in India. - The applicant must be willing to visit designated government health facilities on the 9th of every month. ##### ***Trimester Specific Criteria*** - The applicant must have completed the first trimester of pregnancy (beyond 12 weeks of gestation). - The applicant must be in 2nd trimester (13-28 weeks) or 3rd trimester (29-40 weeks) of pregnancy. ##### **Special Categories** - The applicant identified as high-risk pregnancy cases receive priority attention and follow-up care. - The applicant who are dropouts from regular antenatal care services are encouraged to participate.

name: Nagaland State Merit Scholarship
brief_description: **Details** All those students who have secured 80% marks in the class 10th exam while holding the domicile of Nagaland state can apply online under the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship for getting the scholarship amount. This scholarship will not be provided to students who have failed the previous years exam. The DHE has launched the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship for providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state. The student must be studying or getting admission to the post-matric class (class 11thRs. 12Rs. UGRs. PG Degree). The students will also need to secure minimum marks in the previous years exam. **Objective** - The primary objective of launching the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship is to provide financial stability to the students studying or undertaking post-matric classes from the Nagaland government schools and colleges. The students will need to secure at least 70% to 80% marks in the previous years exam. In case of the scholarship renewalRs. the students can submit their last years Marksheet. - The Nagaland State Merit Scholarship is to provide scholarship amounts to students belonging to the citizenship of Nagaland state so that they will be able to avail the best educational opportunities or facilities after getting this scholarship amount. The Department of Higher Education will be delegated with the task of carrying out scholarship operations.
benefits: 1. Nagaland State Merit Scholarship will provide social security provisions to the students of Nagaland state. 1. This will proven to be an amazing opportunity. 1. Students of post-matric classes will be able to secure their scholarship rights. 1. Students will be given the scholarship amount either on a monthly basis or a yearly basis. 1. The only selection criteria will be that the student will need to secure at least 70% to 80% marks in the previous years exam. 1. One can also get a scholarship renewal after submitting his or her Marksheet. 1. This will provide an equal amount of educational opportunities to the students. 1. Students belonging to the ST categories will also be given the same scholarship references. 1. Students can apply online under the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship before the last date of online form submission for getting registration on a time. 1. Students will be given the scholarship amount in the DBT mode
eligibility: 1. The student must be a permanent resident or citizen of Nagaland state. 1. The applicant must be a student in a Post-matric class. 1. The student must secure 70% or 80% marks in the last years exam for getting a scholarship renewal. 1. Students in the ST category will also be given scholarship enrollment. **Note:** To apply as a Fresh candidateRs. the student must be enrolled in the first year of the course. Renewal is applicable only to beneficiaries of this Scheme from the previous year.

name: Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science
brief_description:
The Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science (PROWIS-II) is dedicated to the young women scientists of both India and France. This programme will encourage women candidates to work with the Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.
> **Duration of Programme:**

The duration of the Programme will be for two weeks.
benefits: 1. Return airfare (economy class)Rs. accommodation & per diem allowancesRs. local travel in India/FranceRs. airport transferRs. insuranceRs. and visa charges shall be given to the selected candidates.
eligibility:
1. Women applicants must be Indian or French citizens (citizens residing in France) from a recognized university or research institution in India/France.
1. Indian applicants should hold a PhD degree & sanctioned/tenured post in a scientific/academic institution and be willing to undertake collaborative research projects in French institutions/universities.
1. French women applicants holding a PhD degree and currently completing a postdoctoral project & willing to undertake collaborative research projects in Indian institutions/universities.
1. The mobility should take place during the employment period of the applicant in the concerned institution.
1. The applicant should not have availed of any visiting fellowship in France/India during the last 5 years.
1. This fellowship cannot be availed simultaneously with any other fellowship.

**Note 01:** Preference will be given to those candidates who don't have any international exposure.
**Note 02:** CEFIPRA may relax the eligibility conditions in case of potential candidates.

name: Nari Shakti Puraskar - National Award for Women
brief_description: The Nari Shakti Puraskar has been instituted by the Ministry of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of IndiaRs. to recognize outstanding contributions of women towards empowermentRs. especially of vulnerable and marginalized groups. The awards are announced annually by 20th February and conferred on 8th March on the occasion of International Womens Day. The scheme aims to promote womens participation in all spheres and highlight their role in nation-building. It also seeks to inspire citizensRs. particularly youthRs. by showcasing exemplary achievements of women.
eligibility: - The awards are open to individuals only. - The applicants must be at least 25 years of age on 1st July of the award year. - The applicant should not be a recipient of the same award earlier (including Stree Shakti Puraskars as were awarded by the Ministry earlier). - The Nari Shakti Puruskar may be awarded for outstanding workRs. preferably in exceptional circumstancesRs. to individuals in the areas of: economic and social empowerment of women or pertaining to this theme or incidental thereto. - The Nari Shakti Puruskar may be awarded to individuals who encouraged women to participate in decision making roles; encouraged women's skill development in traditional and non-traditional sectors; facilitated basic amenities for rural women; promoted women in non-traditional sectors like science and technologyRs. sportsRs. artRs. cultureRs. concretely and significantly towards safety and securityRs. health and wellnessRs. educationRs. skill developmentRs. life skillsRs. respect and dignity of women etc. - An award may also be given to a State or Union TerritoryRs. which has appreciably improved Child Sex Ratio (CSR). - Normally the awards shall not be presented posthumously; excepting in cases where death occurred subsequent to a proposal having been submitted to the Ministry in the manner as stipulated in these guidelines. ***Nominations:*** 1. Nominations for the award shall be invited from: - State GovernmentsRs. Union Territory AdministrationsRs. concerned Central Ministries/ Departments. - Non-Governmental OrganizationsRs. Universities/ InstitutionsRs. Private and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). - The Selection Committee may alsoRs. suo-motoRs. recommend an individual for the award with sufficient justification. - Self-nominations & recommendations for the awardsRs. bothRs. shall be considered. 2. The Nominations would be submitted to the Ministry of Women and Child Development with details as per online application form along with supporting documents as mentioned in the application form. 3. The entities as recommending the nominations should clearly certify the work carried out by the nominees for which the award is being recommended.

name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
brief_description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation" is a Sub-Component of the Scheme "Integrated Coffee Development Project During the Medium Term Framework (MTF) Period: Development Support to Stakeholders" by the Coffee BoardRs. Department of CommerceRs. Ministry of Commerce and Industry. This scheme aims to improve the productivity and quality of coffee by facilitating the creation of infrastructure for water augmentation for irrigation and wet processing of coffee.
benefits:
**Subsidy Details** - The eligible subsidy for water harvesting structures and sprinkler units is 75% of the unit costRs. capped at a maximum ceiling of 1Rs. for all related activities combined. - For below-ground water storage tanksRs. the subsidy is based on the lower value between dimension and unit cost applicable to the size of the holding. - For above-ground water storage tanksRs. the subsidy is based on the lower value between the actual cost or the unit cost applicable to the below-ground water tank. **Subsidy Availability** Growers can claim subsidies for water harvesting structures and irrigation equipment either simultaneously or at different times.
**Unit Cost and Subsidy for Water Harvesting Structures** **Size of Holding****Dimension of Water Harvesting Structure****Total Unit Cost ()****Subsidy Amount**Up to 2 Ha.30' x 30' x 10' (9000 Cft.)43Rs..0075% of Unit Cost2 Ha to 4 Ha & above43' x 43' x 10' (18490 Cft.)89Rs..0075% of Unit Cost**Unit Cost and Subsidy for Sprinkler/Drip Unit** **Size of Holding****Total Unit Cost ()****Subsidy Amount**Up to 1.00 Ha. 60Rs. 75% of the Unit Cost1.00 to 2.00 Ha. & above 1Rs. 75% of the Unit Cost
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a tribal grower. 1. The applicant should not have received a subsidy for Water Augmentation during the XII plan period. 1. The land records must be in the beneficiary's name. 1. These records should be certified by the Village Authority/State Government/Competent Authority. **Eligible Activities** Installation of the water storage tankRs. open wellRs. and irrigation equipment (sprinkler/drip) to enhance productionRs. productivityRs. and quality. **Location Specifications** - Water storage tank construction can be above or below ground level. - Water augmentation structures must be on the estate or within its vicinity.

name: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
brief_description: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribes Candidates" is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs. Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE)Rs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes candidates for study at Bachelor Degree programme in various branches of AgricultureRs. viz. B.Sc. (Agri.)Rs. B.V.Sc.Rs. B.Sc. (Agril. Engg.)Rs. B.Sc. (Home Science)Rs. B.F.Sc.Rs. B.Sc. (Forestry) etc. It is expected that through this scheme the students from the weaker sections of the society will be able to come up to receive post-graduate education in agriculture and allied sciences.
benefits: ***Value Of Scholarship*** - The value of the scholarship will be 1Rs./- per month along with a contingent grant of 750/- per annum for the payment of tuition feesRs. purchase of booksRs. cost of uniformsRs. etc. ***Duration Of Scholarship*** - The duration of the scholarship will cover the whole of the normal period of the particular degree programme to which the candidate is admitted.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes communities as defined by the Government of India. - Only those students who have been admitted in Agricultural Universities in any of the undergraduate degree programmes of Agriculture & Allied Sciences will be eligible for this scholarship. ***General Condition:*** (a) The student who accepts this scholarship will not be permitted to avail any other scholarship / concession provided by any other agencies nor permitted to accept any part-time employment. (b) Termination of Scholarship: The scholarship will be terminated without notice (i) from the date the scholar debases to be on the roll of the institution or on the date of expiry of the sanction of the scholarship which ever is earlier. The scholarship can also be terminated without notice at any time if in the opinion of the institution and the Council the scholar is found to be negligent in his/her studies or is guilty of misconduct; (ii) if the scholar is dropped by the institution due to peer performance.

name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of ESM
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Vocational Training of Widows of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) scheme has been launched by the Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows of ex-servicemen to help them become self-reliant through vocational training. The scheme is implemented by the Kendriya Sainik Board.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance** - For vocational trainingRs. AFFDF is provided as a one-time aid of 50Rs./- (max) on successful completion of said vocational training.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a widow of an ex-serviceman (ESM). 1. The applicants spouse should be of rank up to Havildar or equivalent. 1. The applicant should have completed vocational training from a recognized institution. 1. The applicant should have relevant spouse details recorded in the service book of the ESM. 1. The applicant should be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB) and Rajya Sainik Board (RSB).

name: The Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme
brief_description: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI)Rs. under the Ministry of PortsRs. Shipping and WaterwaysRs. has introduced the Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme to provide exposure to students on the development of Inland Waterways Transport in India. The scheme enables young academic talent to understand IWAIs functioningRs. contribute through researchRs. analysisRs. and report preparationRs. and gain practical experience. Interns are provided working spaceRs. required to use their own laptopsRs. and must submit a report and declaration of secrecy during the internship. A certificate is awarded upon satisfactory completionRs. with an intake of 10 Undergraduate and 15 Postgraduate/Research interns for each year.
benefits: - **Remuneration:** Stipend @ 10Rs./- for Undergraduates and 20Rs./- for Post Graduate/ Research Scholars per month will be payable on satisfactory completion of their internships. **Note:** 1. Last month's remuneration shall be provided on submission of their Report/paper. 1. Interns will be eligible for remuneration equivalent to the number of days of attendance in the office against the total number of working days in that month. - **Experience Certificate:** A certificate regarding the successful completion of the Internship shall be issued by IWAI in the enclosed format in [Annexure-B](https://iwai.nic.in/sites/default/files/Internship%20Policy%202024-25-1.pdf) of the Scheme Guidelines. **Note:** 1. The certificate will be issued upon the submission of their Report/paper and its evaluation by the Director/ Director-In Charge level officers in their concerned Division. 1. Internship is neither a job nor any assurance for job in IWAI. 1. No accommodation will be provided to interns. 1. The internship may be terminated by IWAI by giving one month notice in case the performance of the candidate is not up to the mark. 1. Interns not completing the requisite period as stipulated in their offer will not be issued with any certificate.
eligibility: - The applicant should meet any of the following conditions: 1. The applicant should be pursuing or have completed a Graduate or Postgraduate degree from a recognized university (national or international). 1. The applicantRs. if applying as a Graduate studentRs. should have secured at least 75% marks in Class 12. 1. The applicantRs. if applying as a Postgraduate studentRs. should have secured at least 60% marks in Graduation. 1. The applicantRs. if applying as a Research ScholarRs. should have secured at least 60% marks in the Postgraduate degree.

name: Travel Grant Scheme for College Teachers/Vice Chancellors/Commission Members
brief_description: This scheme is implemented by the University Grants Commission for providing financial assistance to permanent teachers of colleges and vice chancellors of state universitiesRs. deemed to be universities and central universitiesRs. recognised under section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC ActRs. to present research papers at international conferences abroad. In addition to thisRs. this facility is available to the permanent teachers of institutions of national importance with 10% slots of the total approved cases in a year. Commission members are also eligible to apply under this scheme. ***Objectives:*** To enable the permanent Teachers in Colleges / Vice-Chancellors and Commission Members to present their research paper(s) in international conferences.
benefits: - The financial assistance for permanent teachers of colleges enlisted in [2(f) and 12 B of the UGC Act](https://www.ugc.gov.in/colleges) will be limited to 50% of the total admissible expenditure such as travelRs. registration feeRs. per diem allowance and visa feeRs. once in three years. - For Commission members and Vice-Chancellors of Universities enlisted in [2(f) and 12 B of the UGC Act](https://www.ugc.gov.in/colleges)Rs. the assistance will be 100% on admissible expenditure once in three years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent teacher of a college or a Commission MemberRs. or a Vice-Chancellor of a State UniversityRs. Deemed-to-be UniversityRs. or Central University recognized under [Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act](https://www.ugc.gov.in/colleges). 1. The applicant must be presenting a research paper at an international conference abroad.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (PLI 1.2) for Specialty Steel
brief_description: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Specialty Steel Scheme under the Ministry of SteelRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to enhance domestic manufacturing by providing incentives on the incremental production of notified specialty steel products. The scheme defines eligibility based on incremental investment and incremental sales over a baseline. It includes provisions for applicationRs. project managementRs. approvalRs. incentive calculationRs. and disbursement through a structured mechanism involving the Project Management Agency (PMA) and the Empowered Committee.
benefits: 1. Incentive on incremental sales of manufactured specialty steel 1. Encouragement for investment in plantRs. machineryRs. and technology 1. Promotion of domestic value addition 1. Support for employment generation 1. Development of advanced steel manufacturing capabilities
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a company registered in India under the Companies ActRs. 2013Rs. engaged in the manufacture of identified specialty steel gradesRs. ensuring end-to-end domestic manufacturing wherein input material is melted and poured within the country. 1. A maximum of 20% of the total value addition may be undertaken through third parties; howeverRs. the incentive shall be claimed only by the company manufacturing the eligible end product sub-category. 1. The net worth of the applicant companyRs. including that of its group companiesRs. shall not be less than 30% of the total committed investmentRs. based on audited financial statements of the immediately preceding financial year. 1. In the case of new companies or group companies incorporated after 31/03/2025Rs. the net worth shall be at least 30% of the total committed investment prior to the date of application submission.Where an applicant applies for multiple product sub-categoriesRs. the net worth requirement shall be evaluated with reference to the total committed investment across all applied sub-categories. 1. The applicant must meet the prescribed minimum threshold values for incremental productionRs. capacityRs. and investment as specified under the scheme guidelines. 1. Only those investments classified as eligible under the prescribed provisions shall be considered for the purpose of calculating investment. 1. An eligible company may avail benefits under other schemesRs. subject to applicable provisions; howeverRs. the same investment and sales shall not be considered for incentives under other PLI schemes. 1. Companies availing benefits under this scheme are not restricted from applying to PLI schemes of other Ministries or Departments for products not covered under this scheme. 1. Projects that have received or are expected to receive incentives under previous rounds of the PLI Scheme for Specialty Steel shall not be eligible to participate in the current round.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Poultry Development
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Poultry Development" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial support to farmers for poultry and cattle developmentRs. with loans available up to 14Rs./- for 200 poultry birds or 17Rs./- for 2 cows. The interest rate ranges from 14.5% to 16.5%Rs. subject to periodic changes.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 1. Up to 14Rs./- for 200 birds (poultry). 1. Up to 17Rs./- for 2 cows. - **Interest Rate:** 14.5% to 16.5% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in poultry farming or cattle development. - The beneficiary should be interested to avail loan for poultry farming or cattle development. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for poultry farming or cattle development.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Plantation (Tea)
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Plantation (Tea)" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial support to farmers for tea plantations. Under this schemeRs. eligible farmers can obtain a loan of up to 33Rs./- per acreRs. with interest rates ranging from 11% to 12.5%. This initiative aims to empower farmers and promote sustainable tea farming practices.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 33Rs./- per acre. - **Interest Rate:** 11% to 11.5% (subject to change).
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a farmer.
- The beneficiary should be interested in tea plantation.
- The beneficiary should be interested in availing loan for tea plantation.
- The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for tea plantation.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production:Large Cardamom Replanting/New planting (Ha)
brief_description: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice BoardRs. Department of Commerce and IndustryRs. Ministry of Commerce.
benefits: 1. 33.33% of cost of cultivation of large cardamom subject to a maximum of 33Rs./- per Ha for General Category and 75% of cost of cultivation 75Rs./- per Ha for SC/ST payable in two annual installments of 16Rs./- and 37Rs./-Rs. respectively. 1. Small and marginal growers owing up to 8.00 Ha. The minimum area to be replanted / new planted contiguously under the scheme is 0.10 Ha Maximum area eligibility per grower is 8.00 Ha but at a time i.e.Rs. in a financial year a grower can avail subsidy only up to 4.00 Ha as replanting has to be carried out in a phased manner.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal grower owning up to 8 hectares of land. 1. The applicant should belong to the SC/ST category. 1. The applicant should undertake replanting/new planting in a minimum contiguous area of 0.10 Ha. 1. The applicant should not exceed 8.00 Ha total eligibilityRs. and should avail subsidy for a maximum of 4.00 Ha per financial year in a phased manner. 1. The applicant should be cultivating in eligible regions such as SikkimRs. DarjeelingRs. KalimpongRs. and other North Eastern states. 1. The applicant should ensure a minimum plant population of 4000 plants per hectare with spacing of 5 5 feet. 1. The applicant should allow inspection by designated officialsRs. and assistance will be granted only after approval. 1. The applicant should avail second-time assistance for the same area only after 8 yearsRs. except in cases like natural calamities.

name: National Savings Recurring Deposit Account(RD)
brief_description: The National Savings Recurring Deposit Account (RD) is operated by the Department of PostsRs. Ministry of CommunicationsRs. Government of India. It offers an interest rate of 6.7% per annum. The minimum deposit is 100 per month or any amount in multiples of 10Rs. and there is no maximum limit on deposits. **Deposit** 1. Minimum - 100 or any sum in multiple of 10. 1. Maximum- No limit 1. The first monthly deposit shall be made at the time of opening of the account and the amount of such deposit shall be the denomination of the account. 1. Subsequent deposits equal to the first deposit shall be made up to the fifteenth day of each monthRs. if account is opened before the sixteenth day of a calendar month; and up to the last working day of each monthRs. if the account is opened between the sixteenth day and the last working day of a calendar month. **Advance deposit** [Please See Para 7](https://www.indiapost.gov.in/documents/offerings/schemesandservices/posb/NationalSavingsRecurringDepositScheme2019English.pdf) 1. Individual can make advance deposit for any period up to 5 years. 1. Rebate on advance deposit for an account of one hundred rupees denomination is as follows: 1. If six or more deposits but not exceeding eleven deposits made in any calendar month: - 10/- 1. o If twelve or more deposits made in any calendar month: - 40/- for every twelve deposits and 10/- for the balanceRs. if anyRs. of not less than six deposits
benefits: 1. Encourages regular savings by allowing small monthly deposits starting from 100. 1. Provides safe and guaranteed returns at 6.7% per annum with no maximum deposit limit. **Loan** [Please See Para 14](https://www.indiapost.gov.in/documents/offerings/schemesandservices/posb/NationalSavingsRecurringDepositScheme2019English.pdf) 1. Depositor may avail loan facility up to 50% of the deposits made in the accounts after the account has been in operation for at least one year and twelve-monthly deposits have been made in the account 1. Loan can be repaid in one lump-sum or in equal monthly instalments. 1. Simple interest at the rate of 2% points over and above the interest rate applicable to the account of the loan shall be payable as per provisions given under the scheme rules. 1. In case loan is not repaid till the closure of the accountRs. outstanding amount due shall be recovered from the amount payable on closure of the account.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident citizen of India. 1. The applicant can be a single adult. 1. The applicant can be a guardian on behalf of a person of unsound mind (Authorised Account). 1. The applicant can be a minor who has attained the age of 10 years. 1. The applicant can open any number of accounts individually or jointly. 1. Joint Account (up to three adults) (Joint A or Joint B) a. Joint A typeRs. to be operated by all the depositors or the surviving depositors jointly. b. Joint B typeRs. to be operated by any of the depositors or the surviving depositors separately **Note:** Upon reaching the age of 18 yearsRs. account holders must submit a new Account Opening Form (AOF) and fresh KYC documents at their Post Office to convert their minor account into to an adult account. **Note:** Accounts can also be opened through e-Banking or Mobile Banking facility. It is to be noted that Post Office Savings Account is a prerequisite for availing internet banking facility

name: Post Office Savings Account(SB)
brief_description: The Post Office Savings Account (SB) schemeRs. operated by the Department of Posts under the Ministry of CommunicationsRs. Government of IndiaRs. offers an interest rate of 4% per annum with interest paid periodically. It can be opened with a minimum amount of 500Rs. and the account holder must be a resident citizen of India. **Deposit and Withdrawal** 1. All deposits/ withdrawals shall be made in whole rupees only. 1. Minimum deposit amount: - 500 (subsequent deposit not less than- 10) 1. Minimum withdrawal amount: - 50 1. Maximum deposit:- No maximum limit 1. No withdrawal will be permitted which has effect of reducing minimum balance under 500 1. Note: In case account balance not raised to 500 at the end of financial yearRs. 50 will be deducted as Account Maintenance Fee and if account balance becomes NilRs. the account shall stand automatically closed. **Nomination** [Please refer Rule-14 of GSPGR 2018](https://www.indiapost.gov.in/documents/offerings/schemesandservices/posb/GSPREnglish2018.pdf) 1. A Depositor in a Single AccountRs. or the depositors in a joint accountRs. as the case may beRs. shall nominate one or more individuals as nominee but not exceeding four individualsRs. who in the event of the death of the depositor in a Single Account or all the depositors in a joint accountRs. shall be entitled to receive the eligible balance. 1. Such nomination shall be made at the time of opening of the account by furnishing the following information in Form 10: (a) Name(s) of the nominee(s); (b) Percentage of share each nominee shall be entitled to; (c) Whether the nominee shall receive the amount as a beneficiary with absolute and exclusive right of ownershipRs. or as a trustee for the benefit of the legal heirs of depositor.
benefits: 1. Safe place to keep money with 4% interest. 1. Easy to open with just 500 minimum balance. **Interest on deposits** 1. Interest will be calculated based on minimum balance between 10th of the month and end of the month and allowed in whole rupees only. 1. No interest will be allowed in a month if balance at any time between 10th and last day of the month falls below 500/-. 1. Interest shall be credited in account at the end of each Financial Year at the interest rate prescribed by Ministry of Finance from time to time. 1. At the time of closure of accountRs. interest will be paid up to the preceding month in which account is closed. 1. u/s 80TTA of the Income Tax ActRs. from all Savings Bank AccountsRs. interest up to 10Rs. earned in a Financial Year is exempted from taxable Income. **Silent Account** [(Please refer Rule-8 of Post Office Savings Account Rules 2019)](https://www.indiapost.gov.in/documents/offerings/schemesandservices/posb/PostOfficeSavingsAccountScheme2019English.pdf) 1. If no deposit/withdrawal takes place in an account during continuous three financial yearsRs. the account shall be treated as silent. 1. To revive a silent accountRs. simply apply at your Post OfficeRs. along with updated [KYC ](https://www.indiapost.gov.in/documents/posb/KYC_SB_order_08_2023.pdf)documents and passbookRs. this revival process is free of charge.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident citizen of India. 1. The applicant can be a single adult opening an individual account. 1. The applicant can open a joint account with up to three adults. 1. The applicant can choose Joint A type (operated jointly) or Joint B type (operated by any holder). 1. The applicant can be a guardian opening an account on behalf of a minor. 1. The applicant can be a guardian opening an account for a person of unsound mind (Authorised Account). 1. The applicant can be a minor above 10 years who can open and operate the account. 1. The applicant can have only one single account in their name. 1. The applicant cannot convert a single account into a joint account or vice versa. 1. The applicant (in joint account) becomes the sole owner if other holders pass awayRs. subject to rules. **Note:** Upon reaching the age of 18 yearsRs. account holders must submit a new Account Opening Form (AOF) and fresh KYC documents at their Post Office to convert their minor account into an adult account.

name: Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. . It aims to employRs. engageRs. and empower the youth and rural communities by promoting entrepreneurship in agriculture logisticsRs. addressing critical gaps in farm-to-market connectivity. The scheme provides easy access to credit through onboarding of multiple partner banksRs. coupled with substantialgovernment support in the form of upfront capital subsidy and EMI co-payment. By enabling entrepreneurs to procure small commercial vehiclesRs. pickupsRs. trucksRs. and refrigerated carriersRs. it seeks to improve transportation efficiencyRs. reduce post-harvest lossesRs. and enhance market access for farmersRs. especially in remote areas. Implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. the scheme integrates with 1917iTeams for generating transport demandRs. GPS-enabled trackingRs. and providing training and capacity buildingensuring beneficiaries can operate profitably while strengthening the agricultural value chain in Meghalaya. > **Objectives of the scheme** **Economic growth of the state:** With 77% of the population involved with agriculture and allied sectors in rural areasRs. the PRIME ARVS is envisaged to accelerate and sustain economic development of the state through entrepreneurship developmentRs. job creation in the rural community. **Encourage entrepreneurship among rural youth:** The scheme is intended to encourage entrepreneurship among the rural youth by providing them easy credit access and financial grant to buy commercial vehicles. These vehicles can be used by the entrepreneurs to earn their income by providing transportation solution to local farmersRs. tradersRs. and buyers. **Logistics solution to farm produce:** To provide a transportation solution to evacuate farms produce to intended destinations such as marketsRs. processing facilities or aggregation centres. SimilarlyRs. the vehicles can also transport various farming inputs from the market for timely and successful agricultural operations. **Lower transportation cost:** Introducing more numbers of commercial goods carriers will potentially help reduce logistics cost for the marginal farmers by fostering competition among the logistics providers. Various farmers groups who will be benefitted with the vehicles under the scheme will significantly reduce the transportation cost of their own grown/ aggregated farm products. **Market accessibility to farmers from remote area:** The majority of the vehicles are intended for entrepreneurs residing in remote areas so that farmers living in their proximity from nearby villages and clusters can be benefitted. The farmers residing in these areas can quickly avail their transportation services to sell their farm produce and buy back their essentials from the markets. **Increase farmers profitability:** Timely evacuation of farm produce will have a significant impact on farmers profitability by minimizing spoilage of perishable products; reducing additional storage costs such as refrigerationRs. storage facilities; increasing market accessibility; maintaining cash flow through quicker sales and lastly by enhancing customer satisfaction by building trust and long-term relationship with the buyers. **Financial grant and easy credit to the entrepreneurs to buy goods carriers** 300 Prime Agriculture Response Vehicles (Prime-ARVs) to be distributed across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid on the total cost of the vehicle including the interest charged by the bank to finance the vehicle. **Demand creation through 1917iTeams** Vehicles will be registered with 1917iTeams who will provide transportation demand calls from customers to the vehicle owners. Vehicles will be pre-fitted with GPS device ensuring trackability of the vehicle by 1917iTeams. The live location of the vehicle will help in immediately connecting the farmers/ aggregators/ buyers to their nearest available vehicle.
benefits: 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicantRs. 45% by Government of Meghalaya) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks (MRBRs. MCABRs. SBIRs. SCUB) 1. Additional 3% annual interest subvention on reefer trucks with Aadhaar linkage 1. Pre-fitted GPS device with 5-year warranty 1. Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government 1. Capacity building and training programs by DepartmentRs.iTeams 1. Market linkage through 1917iTeams with live vehicle tracking 1. Eligibility for various vehicle typesRs. including reefer trucks for perishable goods transportation
eligibility: **Individuals** 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid commercial driving license. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must be involved in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) is required as proof of agricultural involvement. 1. The applicant should not be a loan defaulter with any bank. **Registered Entities** 1. The applicant must be a registered entity such as a CooperativeRs. Farmer Producer Company (FPC)Rs. or Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) under the Government of Meghalaya. 1. The entity must be engaged in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) must be provided as proof of agricultural involvement. 1. The entity should not have availed benefits under the first phase of the PRIME Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme. 1. The applicant must submit an Incorporation Certificate or Registration CertificateRs. as applicable. 1. At least two members of the entity must have a training certificate in the relevant sector from a recognized institution (preferably a government institute). 1. The entity should not be a loan defaulter with any bank. **Unregistered Entities** 1. Any unregistered entity such as village organizationsRs. self-help groupsRs. producer groupsRs. or other traditional institutions based in Meghalaya can apply. 1. The entity must be involved in the agriculture sector for at least two years. 1. A certification letter from the Block Development Officer (BDO) must be provided as proof. 1. The entity should not be a defaulter with any financial institution. 1. The entity should not have availed benefits under the first phase of the PRIME Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme.

name: Widow Re-marriage Scheme
brief_description: The Widow Remarriage Scheme under the Government of Himachal Pradesh aims to support the rehabilitation of widows by encouraging men to marry widows through a monetary incentive. Under this schemeRs. a grant is provided to bona fide Himachali men (above 21 years) and women (above 18 years) at the time of marriage.
benefits: If any widow re-marriesRs. a cheque of 20Rs./- is given to the women and a Fix Deposit worth 30Rs./- for the 5 years term is given to the couple.
eligibility:
1. The widow should have remarried.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. Groom should not be less than 21 years of age
1. Women should not be less than 18 years of age.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
brief_description: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th" is implemented by the "Department of Tribal Affairs (Plain)"Rs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe children studying in classes 9th and 10th so that the incidence of drop-out is minimizedRs. and they have a better chance of progressing to the post-matric stage of education. The scheme provides a monthly scholarship of up to 525/-Rs. an annual book grant of up to 1Rs./-Rs. and an additional disability allowance of up to 9Rs./- annually via Direct Benefit Transfer. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled TribeRs. study in class 9th or 10th in a recognized schoolRs. and have a total family income not exceeding 2Rs./- per annum.
benefits: **Scholarship for 10 Months** - Day Scholars receive a scholarship of 225/- monthly (2Rs./- annually). - Hostelers receive 525/- monthly (5Rs./- annually). **Books and Ad Hoc Grant** Day Scholars receive a lump sum grant of 750/-Rs. and Hostelers receive a grant of 1Rs./-. **Additional Disability Allowance** - Divyangjan studentsRs. leprosy-cured studentsRs. and students having sickle cell anemia or Thalassemia receive an additional grant paid for all twelve months. - Hosteler students receive 800/- monthly (9Rs./- annually)Rs. and Day Scholars receive 600/- monthly (7Rs./- annually). **Disbursement Mode** Benefits are distributed directly to the student's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)Rs. preferably using the Aadhaar Enabled Payment System. **Conditions** - The award once made will continueRs. subject to good conduct and regularity in attendance. - The scholarship will be renewed for Class X after the student successfully passes Class IX. - If a student has to repeat a classRs. they will not receive the scholarship for the same class twice.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled TribeRs. as specified in relation to the State or Union Territory to which they actually belong (Domicile State). - The applicant must be studying in Class IX or Class X. - The applicant must be studying in a Government School or in a School recognized by the Government or a Central or State Board of Secondary Education. - The applicant must have a total family income from all sources that does not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must have a valid account in a Scheduled Bank. - The applicant must have a bank account linked with their Aadhaar number. - The applicant must have a bank account linked with an active mobile number. - The applicant must not be getting any other scholarship.

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
brief_description: The "Nikshay Poshan Yojana"Rs. launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Health and Family WelfareRs. provides financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month to each notified tuberculosis (TB) patient for nutritional support. All TB patients notified on or after 1st April 2018 and registered on the NIKSHAY portal are eligible. The scheme aims to improve treatment outcomes by addressing malnutrition and supporting patients throughout their treatment.
benefits: - **Financial Incentive:** An amount of 1Rs./- per month for each notified TB patient.
eligibility: - All patients with tuberculosis (TB) who are notified to the government on or after April 1Rs. 2018Rs. including those who are already being treated for TBRs. are eligible for financial incentives. - To be eligible for the incentivesRs. patients must be registered or notified on the NIKSHAY portal.

name: Mizoram Sports Incentive Cash Award Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Mizoram Sports Incentive Cash Award SchemeRs. 2022" by the Sports & Youth Services DepartmentRs. Government of MizoramRs. aims to recognize and reward outstanding sports persons through providing cash incentives and allowances to medal winners and participants in national and international competitions. It also encourages disciplineRs. motivationRs. and participation in sports by offering incentives and support to athletes.
benefits: > **Incentive Cash Award:** - Lump sum cash award to GoldRs. SilverRs. and Bronze medal winners in recognised sports disciplines. - Applicable for National and International ChampionshipsRs. and Invitation Competitions/Tournaments Organized by the Recognised Federation. - The amount of the incentive cash award will be as per the Annexure in the [Official Guidelines](https://sys.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2022/09/4e39860f74233bd0ccfccab9d698a156/incentive-cash-award-scheme-2022.pdf) (Refer page no 3Rs. 4Rs. and 5).- Only one award per sports discipline in a championship or tournament. > **Support to Sports Officials:** - OfficialsRs. ManagersRs. CoachesRs. MasseursRs. PhysiotherapistsRs. and Doctors are entitled to 25% of the award amount applicable to the sportsperson. > **Sports Kit Allowance:** - 20Rs./- provided to sports persons of Mizoram representing the country in international competitions. > **Additional Service Benefits:** - Award of incrementRs. recruitmentRs. or promotion for sports persons under or not under State GovernmentRs. as per applicable rules.
eligibility: - A person must be a resident of MizoramRs. representing any state of the unionRs. the Sports Control BoardsRs. or the Country. - Winner of firstRs. secondRs. or third position in the specified championship as enumerated in column 3 of Annexure. - Any sports-person participating in the International Championship. - OfficialsRs. ManagerRs. CoachRs. MasseurRs. PhysiotherapistRs. and Doctor will also be entitled to receive 25% of the award applicable to the sports- person. - Any sports person of Mizoram representing the Country in any recognised sports discipline in any international sports or championship will be entitled to receive Rs. 20Rs./- as sports kit allowance. - For the purpose of awarding the incentive cash awardRs. there can be only one award in one sports discipline in a championship or tournament.

name: Award Of Scholarships To Young Artists In Different Cultural Fields
brief_description:
The scheme Award of Scholarships to Young Artists in Different Cultural Fields was launched by the Ministry of CultureRs. Government of India. This scheme seeks to give assistance to young artists of outstanding promise for advanced training within India in the field of Indian Classical MusicRs. Indian Classical DanceRs. TheatreRs. MimeRs. Visual artRs. FolkRs. Traditional and Indigenous ArtsRs. and Light Classical Music.
**Subjects/Fields in which Scholarships can be awarded:**

1. Indian Classical Music - Classical Hindustani Music (Vocal and Instrumental)Rs. Classical Carnatic Music (Vocal & InstrumentalRs. etc.)
1. Indian Classical Dance/ Dance Music - BharatnatyamRs. KathakRs. KuchipudiRs. KathakaliRs. MohiniattamRs. Odissi Dance/ MusicRs. Manipuri Dance/ MusicRs. ThangtaRs. Gaudiya NrityaRs. Chhau Dance/ MusicRs. Sattriya dance.
1. Theatre - Any specialized aspect of theatre artRs. including actingRs. directionRs. etc.Rs. but excluding playwriting and research. Mime.
1. Visual Arts - GraphicsRs. SculptureRs. PaintingRs. Creative PhotographyRs. Pottery & CeramicsRs. etc.
1. FolkRs. TraditionalRs. and Indigenous Arts - PuppetryRs. Folk TheatreRs. Folk dancesRs. Folk SongsRs. Folk MusicRs. etc.
1. Light Classical Music -

a) ThumriRs. DadraRs. TappaRs. QawaliRs. GhazalRs.
b) Light Classical music based on Carnatic StyleRs. etc.
c) Rabindra SangeetRs. Nazrul GeetiRs. Atulprasad.
**Terms of Scholarship:**

1. The nature of training will be determined in each case after taking into consideration the previous training and background of the scholar. NormallyRs. it will be in the nature of advanced training under a Guru/Master or in a recognized institution.
1. The Scholar will be required to undergo a rigorous training. Such training will include minimum of three hours a day for practice alone apart from the time spent for acquiring knowledge of the theory of the subject/field concerned and also an appreciation of the related disciplines.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. total number of scholarships is 400.
1. Each scholar will be paid 5000/- per month for a period of two years to cover his/ her living expenses on travelRs. booksRs. art materialRs. or other equipment and tuition or training chargesRs. if any.
1. The scholarships are provided in the field of Indian Classical MusicRs. Classical DancesRs. Light Classical MusicRs. TheatreRs. Visual ArtsRs. and Folk/ Traditional and Indigenous Arts.
eligibility:
1. Candidates should be Indian Nationals.
1. Candidates should have adequate general education to pursue their training effectively.
1. Candidates must give evidence of their desire to make the pursuit of their training effectively.
1. As the scholarships are meant for advanced training and not for beginnersRs. candidates must have already acquired a degree of proficiency in the chosen field.
1. The candidate should have undergone a minimum of 5 years of training with their Guru/Institutes. The Certificate duly signed by the present Guru / Institute and former Guru/ Institute (if any) should be submitted along with the application.
1. Candidates should have adequate knowledge of the connected arts/ disciplines.
1. The candidate's age should not be less than 18 years and not more than 25 years as of 1st April of the year in which the application is being made. Age relaxation is not permissible.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
brief_description: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of EducationRs. implemented by AICTERs. aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young studentRs. who is otherwise specially abledRs. the opportunity to study further and prepare for a successful future through technical education/ knowledge. 50Rs./- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 4 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 3 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college feeRs. purchase of computerRs. stationeriesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. softwareRs. etc. The candidate should be admitted to the First year of the Degree level course OR the Second year of the Degree level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year. Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.
benefits:
1. 50Rs./- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 4 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 3 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college feeRs. purchase of computerRs. stationeriesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. softwareRs. etc.
1. After selectionRs. the awardee will be paid a scholarship through DBT mode on annual basis.
1. The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of renewal through National Scholarship Portal by submitting a passing certificate/ mark sheet along with letter from the Head of the Institution on the online portal
eligibility: 1. The candidate should be admitted to the first year of the degree-level course or the second year of the degree-level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year. 1. Specially-abled students have a disability of not less than 40%. 1. Family income from all sources should not be more than 8Rs./- per annum during the current financial year. A valid income certificate issued by the state/UT government needs to be enclosed.

name: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
brief_description:
The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) established under the Indian Potash Limited (IPL)Rs. Department of FertilizersRs. Ministry of Chemicals and FertilizersRs. has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially which can be renewed up to 4 times. The internship program shall be available throughout the year. The placement of interns will be made at the Head office and regional offices of NPC / IPL depending upon the preference of interns and the requirements of the offices concerned.
> **Objectives**


1. To promote productivity-related employment by enhancing vocational skills among youth and rural people.
1. To create awareness about the enhancement of agriculture productivity.
1. To create a network of youth entrepreneurs with skills to work in rural settings.
1. To work towards the improvement of knowledge resources on youth interface.
1. To ensure environmental sustainability and conservation of natural resources.
benefits:
> **STIPEND**


- The selected intern shall be entitled to ** 6Rs./- per month** as a stipend during the period of internship.
> **CERTIFICATE**


- The interns will be issued an **Internship Completion Certificate** upon successful completion of the internship.
**NOTE:** No payment towards transportation and other allowance etc. shall be paid to the interns.
eligibility: 1. The applicant for the internship should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be 12th Pass / Diploma Holder / Graduate or in the Final Year of their graduation degree. 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-45 years. > **Reservation/Preference/Priority** Preference will be given to candidates having agriculture or related sector qualification.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / water storage structures(nos)
brief_description: The scheme Large Cardamom Irrigation Land Development: Irrigation / Water Storage Structures (Nos) is a sub-scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion and Quality Improvement in SpicesRs. and Research & Development of Cardamom implemented by the Spice Board under the Department of Commerce and IndustryRs. Ministry of Commerce. The scheme aims to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation by supporting the construction of water storage structuresRs. rainwater harvesting systemsRs. and the installation of irrigation equipmentRs. thereby increasing the productivity and improving the quality of large cardamom.
benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of 30Rs. per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of 45Rs./- per unit for SC/ST. 1. The minimum capacity of irrigation structure should be 25 cubic meter for availing maximum subsidy under the program. Any farmer who has availed this benefit earlier is not eligible to avail the benefit. 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha are eligible to avail this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a grower of large cardamom located in SikkimRs. DarjeelingRs. and Kalimpong districts of West BengalRs. or other North Eastern States. 1. The applicant should undertake irrigation or water storage construction activities only in permissible areasRs. ensuring that such constructions do not block the natural flow of waterRs. including streamsRs. and are not objectionable to the local community or concerned authorities. 1. The applicant should ensure that the proposed work complies with all local regulations and environmental norms. 1. The applicant should submit the application for inspection by the designated officialsRs. who will conduct a final inspection and recommend only eligible cases for assistance. 1. The applicant should allow verification by the Inspecting OfficerRs. who must confirm that all conditions are fulfilled and no violations exist before recommending the case for sanction.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Program
brief_description: The Scheme of Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Meritorious Girl Students belonging to the Minority Communities was earlier known as Maulana Azad National Scholarship for Meritorious Girls belonging MinoritiesRs. and the same was launched by the then Prime Minister of India (late) Atal Bihari Vajpayee at National Conference of Educational & Economic Development of Minorities held on 03.05.2003 at Vigyan BhawanRs. New Delhi.
benefits: - **For Class IX & X:** 5Rs./- each. - **For Class XI & XII:** 6Rs./- each.
eligibility: - Only girl students belonging to six notified Minority Communities i.e. MuslimsRs. ChristiansRs. SikhsRs. BuddhistsRs. Jains and Parsis are eligible. - The scholarship will be awarded to minority girl students who are studying in Class 9th to 12th and have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grades in aggregate in the previous class/qualifying exam. - The annual income of the students parent/guardian from all sources does not exceed Rs.2.00 lakh. - An Income certificateRs. issued by a Competent Authority in the State/UTs Governments is required in respect of parent/guardian of the student. - A self-Certified Community Certificate is required from a student who has attained 18 years of age. For othersRs. the Community Certificate certified by the parent/guardian of the student is required. - If a student violates school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scholarshipRs. the scholarship may be suspended or cancelled. The State Government/Union Territory Administration can also directly cancel the award if duly satisfied with the reasons of violation of these regulations governing the scheme. - If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statementRs. her scholarship will be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the scholarship paid will be recovered by the concerned State/UT Govt. - The student obtaining benefits under this scheme shall not be allowed to avail of benefits under any other scheme for this purpose. - A student shall be eligible for only one scholarship out of all the available Scholarships of the Central Government meant for SC/ST/OBC/minority. - The scholarship will not be given to more than two students from a family of the same class - No scholarship shall be given for studies abroad for any course.

name: Financial Incentive For Inter-Caste Marriages Under Protection Of Civil Rights Act 1955 And Scheduled Castes And Scheduled Tribes (Prevention Of Atrocities) Act 1989 In Assam
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Incentive For Inter-Caste Marriages Under Protection Of Civil Rights Act 1955 And Scheduled Castes And Scheduled Tribes (Prevention Of Atrocities) Act 1989 In Assam" was launched by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Assam. It aims to financially support eligible inter-caste married couples. The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of 2Rs./- in a fixed depositRs. jointly in the name of the coupleRs. with the first name being of the womanRs. for a strict lock-in period of three years without the facility for its premature encashment. The applicant must submit the completely filled application form along with the mandatory self-attested documents. The scheme is officially implemented by the DirectorRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Assam.
benefits: - A one-time financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to the eligible inter-caste marriage couple. - The financial assistance is granted directly in the form of a fixed deposit. - The fixed deposit is opened jointly in the name of the couple in a Government or Nationalized bank. ***Conditions*** _*The opening of joint accounts for the eligible inter-caste marriage couple will be initiated by the_ ***Office of the Director Welfare Of Scheduled Castes And Backward ClassesRs. Assam***_._ _*The first name on the joint fixed deposit account must exclusively be that of the woman._ _*The financial incentives provided are strictly subject to the availability of budget provision and the sanction of funds from the Government._ _*The joint fixed deposit has a mandatory lock-in period of three years._ _*There is absolutely no facility permitted for the premature encashment of the fixed deposit amount during the lock-in period._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a spouse in an inter-caste marriage. - The applicant must ensure that one spouse of the inter-caste marriage belongs to the Scheduled Caste. - The applicant must ensure that the other spouse of the inter-caste marriage belongs to the General Caste Hindu. - The applicant must have had their marriage officially performed between 1st January 2025 and 31st January 2025. - The applicant must be applying for their first marriageRs. as there will be no incentive provided for a second or subsequent marriage. - The applicant must have a combined annual income of the couple from all sources of income of 5Rs./- and below.

name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
brief_description: A scholarship scheme by Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for regularRs. full-time students from Scheduled CastesRs. Denotified Nomadic and Semi Nomadic TribesRs. Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans; to obtain higher education viz.Rs. Master degree or Ph.D courses by studying abroad in Institutions/Universities accredited by the Government/authorized body of that country in any field of study.
benefits: 1. **Annual Maintenance Allowance:** For the United States of America (USA) & other countries except for the UK: 15400 US Dollars. For United Kingdom (UK): 9900 Great Britain Pounds1. **Contingency Allowance:** For the United States of America (USA) & other countries except for the UK: 1500 US Dollars. For United Kingdom (UK): 1100 Great Britain Pounds1. **Tuition Fees:** Actual as charged1. **Visa Fees:** Actual Visa Fees in INR1. **Medical Insurance Premium:** Actual as charged1. **Incidental Journey Allowance & Equipment Allowance:** 20 US Dollars for each or its equivalent in INR.1. **Air Passage:** Purchase air tickets (from the nearest Airport to Hometown in India to the nearest place to the educational institution and back to India) from the three authorized travel agents viz. Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited (BLCL)Rs. Ashok Travels & Tours (ATT)Rs. Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC). The ticket purchased must be of economy class/shortest route on the date of booking. The choice of the travel agent for booking the ticket is left open to the awardees. No Booking charges/excess baggage/cancellation charges & other add-ons will be reimbursed to awardees. **Note:** - The awardees will claim reimbursement of airfare from their respective Indian Mission abroad after joining the University and providing a joining report from the University. - The conditions will be effective from 1st Jan 2022. - Return tickets will be booked by Indian Mission abroad as per Clause 11(iii) of the scheme guidelines.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student belonging to a Scheduled CasteRs. Denotified NomadicRs. Semi Nomadic TribeRs. Landless Agricultural LabourerRs. or a Traditional Artisan.
1. The applicant must have been admitted to or received an unconditional offer of admission for pursuing a master's / Ph.D. from an institute/university located abroad.
1. The institute/university of the applicant must be accredited by the Government/authorized body of that country.
1. The applicant must have secured at least 60% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying examination (In the case of Ph.D. coursesRs. the qualifying exam is a Masters Degree; In the case of a Masters DegreeRs. the qualifying exam is a Bachelor's Degree)
1. The total income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) is less than or equal to 8 lakh per annum.
1. Two or more of the applicant's siblings must not be already availing of this scholarship.
1. In case a student has completed a Bachelor of Engineering after completing a Diploma (Lateral Entry to 2nd year)Rs. the percentage of marks obtained in Bachelor's degree will be taken into account.
1. 30% of the awards for each year shall be earmarked for women candidates. HoweverRs. in caseRs. adequate women candidates are not available as per the stipulations of the schemeRs. then the unutilized slots will be utilized by selecting suitable male candidates.
1. There are 115 slots for Scheduled CastesRs. 6 slots for DenotifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic TribesRs. and 4 slots for Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans.

name: Domestic Funding Of Foreign Training
brief_description: The scheme "Domestic Funding of Foreign Training (DFFT)" is a scheme introduced by the Department of Personnel and TrainingRs. Government of India in the year 2001-02 with an objective to upgrade the knowledge & skills of the Government officers as well as to provide exposure to international best practices by deputing them to different long/shortterm training programmes. The Training Division of the Department of Personnel and Training has been implementing the scheme. The DFFT Scheme envisages leveraging the officers with exposure to international best practices and developments in the field of policy and governance by nominating the officers to Universities/Institutes abroad and enhancing the knowledgeRs. skillsRs. and competence of the officers in their current areas of employment and also in their future assignments.
benefits:
Under the schemeRs. different international training programmes will be offered to eligible government officers as mentioned below:

- Long-Term Foreign Training Programmes (6-12 months)
- Short Term Foreign Training Programmes (up to 6 months)
- Partial Funding of Foreign Study (of more than 6 months)
eligibility:
1. All Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Officers / Group A officers belonging to Central Secretariat Service (CSS)Rs. Central Secretariat Stenographer Service (CSSS)Rs. and State Civil Service (SCS).
1. Indian Police Service (IPS)Rs. Indian Forest Service (IFoS)Rs. and Group A Central Civil Service Officers during the tenure of deputation under the Central Staffing Scheme of DoPT.

name: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research
brief_description: The scheme Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER) aims to strengthen the participation of women researchers in India and Germany through collaborative research in ScienceRs.
