name: Prabhuddha Overseas Scholarship
brief_description:
The PRABHUDDHA OVERSEAS SCHOLARSHIP scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the SC/ST communities who wish to pursue their undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. and doctoral (PhD) programs in various fields of study. The scholarship is available for students studying in the fields of Engineering and ManagementRs. Pure Sciences and applied sciencesRs. Agriculture sciences and medicineRs. International CommerceRs. EconomicsRs. Accounting FinanceRs. HumanitiesRs. Social scienceRs. fine artsRs. and law.
The scholarship will be granted to around 250 undergraduate and 150 postgraduate and PhD students from the SC/ST communities based on their family's annual income. Students whose family income is below Rs 8 lakh will receive 100% scholarshipRs. while those whose family income is between Rs 8 to 15 lakh will receive a 50% scholarship. Students whose family income is above Rs 15 lakh will receive a 33% scholarship. The scholarship quota also includes a reservation of 33% for women and 5% for Physically Handicapped Candidates.
To be eligible for the PRABHUDDHA OVERSEAS SCHOLARSHIP schemeRs. the applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka State and have a valid passport. The age limit for applying to this scheme is 35 years for PhD and postgraduate courses and 21 years for undergraduate courses. Candidates must have passed GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS exams with minimum scores before applying for the scholarship. They should have secured admission to a full-time degree program at an overseas university/college. Candidates are also required to meet the eligibility criteria set by the schemeRs. including marks or equivalent grades in relevant qualifying exams.
eligibility:
1. Residency: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka state in India.
1. Age Limit: The age limit to apply for this scheme is 21 years for undergraduate coursesRs. and 35 years for postgraduate and doctoral programs.
1. Qualifying Marks: Candidates applying for the scholarship must have scored at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in their qualifying degree exams for postgraduate and doctoral coursesRs. and 80% marks or equivalent grade in qualifying exams (PUC/12th class) for undergraduate courses.
1. Standardized Test Scores: The candidates should have cleared standardized tests like GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS exams with minimum score marks before applying for the scholarship.
1. Admission: Applicants should have secured admission into a full-time degree program at an overseas university/college.
1. Documents: The candidates must have the necessary documents like Aadhaar CardRs. Caste CertificateRs. Latest Income CertificateRs. Last 2 years IT ReturnsRs. Degree/Master Degree Convocation CertificateRs. Degree/Master Degree All Semester Marks CardRs. Offer letter from the university obtainedRs. Copy of the PassportRs. and Tuition fee and maintenance fee as sent by the university.
1. Field of Study: The scholarship covers various fields of studyRs. including Engineering and ManagementRs. Pure Sciences and applied sciencesRs. Agriculture sciences and medicineRs. International CommerceRs. EconomicsRs. Accounting FinanceRs. HumanitiesRs. Social scienceRs. fine artsRs. and law.

name: Krushak Assistance For Livelihood And Income Augmentation
brief_description:
Financing agriculture and insuring the cultivators is essential to eradicate poverty and to boost shared prosperity of the state. Through the implementation of Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation - KALIA Scheme Rs. the State Government aims to lend farmers with an all inclusive and flexible support systemRs. ensuring accelerated agricultural prosperity. At the heart of a progressive scheme like KALIA lies the motivation to empower the farmers of the state with finance options that will enable the growth and development of agriculture in Odisha. Enhancement of the accessibility to suitable financial services will further ensure agricultural productivity and increase income among farmers Rs. particularly the small and marginal land holders.
Amounting to over 10Rs. crore the scheme has been tailored to relieve the debt ridden farmers from the debt trapRs. keeping a pragmatic vision to directly attack poverty by providing financial assistance to the vulnerable agriculture householdsRs. landless labourers as well as marginal cultivators of the state. Proposed by the Government of Odisha Rs. KALIA scheme brings under its umbrella 92% of cultivators of the state and almost all needy landless cultivators Rs. who can avail the benefits of this scheme through Direct Benefit Transfer Mode.
eligibility:
1. Residency: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha.
1. Agricultural activities: The applicant must be engaged in agricultural activitiesRs. such as farmingRs. cultivationRs. horticultureRs. or animal husbandryRs. either as a landownerRs. tenant farmer or sharecropper.
1. Household status: The applicant's household should be categorized as "deprived" or "vulnerable" under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 or any other state government survey.
1. Landownership: The applicant must either own cultivable land or be a sharecropper/tenant farmer cultivating someone else's land.
1. Age: There is no age limit for applying for the KALIA Scheme.
1. Income: The applicant's annual income should be less than Rs. 2.00 lakhs per annum.
1. Bank account: The applicant must have a bank account in his/her name and a valid Aadhaar number linked to the account.
1. Criminal record: The applicant must not have any criminal record or involvement in any illegal activities.

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana
brief_description: "**Madhu Babu Pension Yojana**" under the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities DepartmentRs. Government Of Odisha is a social welfare scheme designed to provide financial assistance to elderly citizensRs. widows who are economically weaker. All the beneficiaries being covered under the "State Old Age Pension SchemeRs. 1989" and the "Orissa Disability Pension SchemeRs. 1985" in the State are covered under this scheme. The scheme is applicable to person with benchmark disability (irrespective of age) and unable to do normal work due to his/her deformity or any other disability notified under the Rights of Persons with Disability Act.
benefits:
1. For the beneficiary who is between 60-79 years of ageRs. the pension would be 500/- per month.
1. For the beneficiary who is 80 Years and Above in ageRs. the pension would be 700/- per month.
1. The pension will be disbursed on the 15th of every monthRs. on "JANA SEWA DlWAS" in the denomination of 100/-.
eligibility:
- The applicant is a permanent resident/domicile of Odisha since 20 years.
- The applicant should not been convicted of any criminal offence involving moral turpitude.


- The applicant should qualify for one of the following -


1. The age of the applicant is 60 years and above.
1. The applicant is a widow.
1. The applicant is a leprosy patient with visible signs of deformity.
1. The applicant is a person of 5 years of age orRs. above and unable to do normal work due to his/her deformity or disability being blind orRs. orthopedically handicappedRs. mentally retardedRs. with cerebral palsy.
1. The applicant is the widow of an AIDS patient.
1. The applicant is an AIDS patient identified by the State / District AIDS Control Society (irrespective of income as under Rule 6 (b).


- The applicant is an unmarried woman belonging to BPL category.
- The applicant has family income from all sources not exceeding 24Rs./- per annum.
- The applicant is not in receipt of any other pension from the union Government or the state government or any organization aided by either Government.

name: Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata
brief_description: Launched on 7th August 2016 (National Handloom Day)Rs. by the Honble Minister of TextilesRs. the scheme Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata aims to meet the needs of handloom weavers for assistance on a larger scale for looms and accessories. It aims to provide financial assistance for technological up-gradation to improve the quality of the fabric and productivity. Under HSSRs. financial assistance to the extent of 90% of the cost of technological up-gradation items shall be borne by the Govt. of India while the remaining 10% shall be borne by the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of the state of Orissa.
1. The applicant should be a Handloom Weaver.
1. The applicant should have undergone training in weaving in the last 2 years under various government programmesRs. including Block Level Clusters.
1. The applicant should be willing to contribute 10% of the total cost.

name: Rupashree Prakalpa
brief_description: The "Rupashree Prakalpa" scheme was launched by the Department of Women and Child Development and Social WelfareRs. Government of West BengalRs. on 1st April 2018. The scheme aims to mitigate the financial difficulties faced by poor families in bearing the expenses of their daughters marriagesRs. for which they often have to borrow money at very high interest rates. Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial grant of 25Rs./- is provided to economically stressed families at the time of their adult daughters marriages. The scheme is being implemented across all districts of West Bengal.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial grant of 25Rs./- is provided to economically stressed families at the time of their adult daughters marriages. **Note:** - The schemes financial benefit will be paid by direct bank transfer to a bank account held singly in the name of the applicant. - The sanctioned grant is transferred through IFMS (Integrated Financial Management System) to the bank account of the applicant. The fund transfer must be executed at least five days before the date of the proposed marriage.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a woman who proposes to be married. 1. The applicant should have attained the age of 18 years. 1. The applicant should be unmarried on the date of submitting her application. 1. The proposed marriage should be her first marriage. 1. The applicant should have been born in West BengalRs. OR she should have been a resident of West Bengal for the last 5 yearsRs. OR her parents should be permanent residents of West Bengal. 1. The applicant's family income should not be more than 1Rs./- per annum. 1. Her prospective groom should have attained the age of 21 years. 1. The applicant should have an active bank account for which she is the sole account-holder. The bank account should be in a bank that has an IFSC (Indian Financial System Code) and a MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) code and transacts e-payments through NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer).

name: Post Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste
brief_description:
**Details** The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Scheduled Caste students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2Rs./- (Rupees two lakhRs. fifty thousand only) per annum.
**Scope** 1. These scholarships are available for studies in India only and the awardees are selected by the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant belongs (i.e. the State/UT in which permanently settled or domiciledRs. as per the terms of domicile decided by the State) 1. This applies to all the students who are currently beneficiaries of the scheme as well as fresh admissions. - **Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses**: All Professional courses in MedicineRs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary & Allied SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance /AdministrationRs. Computer Science/ Applications (ii) Post Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of Management & Medicine(iii) C.A/N.CWA./CS/I.CF.A. etc. (iv) M.PhilRs. PhD and Post-Doctoral Programmes (D.Lit.Rs. D.Sc. etc.) of GroupRs. Group Il and Group Ill courses.(v) L.L.BRs. Integrated LLBRs. LLM. - **Group 2: Other Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate** shall mean all Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. M Ed. / M. Pharma.Rs. DiplomaRs. Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B Pharma.)Rs. Nursing(B Nursing)Rs. BFSRs. other para-medical branches like rehabilitationRs. diagnostics etc.Rs. Mass CommunicationRs. Hotel Management & CateringRs. Travel/Tourism/Hospitality ManagementRs. Interior DecorationRs. Nutrition& DieteticsRs. Commercial ArtRs. Financial Services (e.g. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. Taxation etc.) for which entrance qualification is minimum Sr. Secondary (10+2) and Vocational streamRs. ITI courses and Polytechnic where entrance qualification is Class XII or above. - **Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate** courses shall mean: courses not covered under Group 1& Group 2 e.g. BA/B.Sc./ B.Com etc. M.A/ M. Sc./ M.Com etc. - **Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses** shall mean: All post-matriculation level non-degree courses for which entrance qualification is High School (Class X)Rs. e.g. Senior secondary certificate (class XI and XII); both general and vocational streamRs. ITI coursesRs. 3-year diploma courses in PolytechnicsRs. efc. - **Note**: The list of courses in various groups Is indicative and States/UTs may add courses as per the laid down standards in the State/UT.
eligibility:
**Eligibility of Students**

- The scholarships are open to the Nationals of India only.
- Only those candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes so specified about the State/Union Territory to which the applicant belongs /domiciled as determined by the State/UT and who have passed the Matriculation or Higher Secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary Education will be eligible.
- Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parent's/guardian's income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2Rs./- (Rupees Two lakh Fifty thousand only) during the last Financial Year. An income certificate is required to be taken once only i.e. at the time of admission only to courses which are continuing for more than one year. The income certificate shall be issued by the Authority as decided by the State Government.
- The ceiling on age limit for admission as regular students in different classes should be decided by the concerned Institutions.
- Candidates whoRs. after passing one stage of education are studying in the same stage of education in a different subject e.g. Intermediate Science after Intermediate Arts or B.Com after B.A. or M.A. in one subject after M.A. in other subjects will not be eligible.
- StudentsRs. who pursue their studies through correspondence/online coursesRs. are also eligible. The term correspondence includes distant and continuous education for courses in Central/ State Universities only. Non-refundable fees shall be paid and no academic allowance will be paid.
- All the children of any parent/guardian will be entitled to receive the benefits of the scheme.
- A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend. If awarded any other scholarship/stipendRs. the student can exercise his/her option for either of the two scholarships/stipendsRs. whichever is more beneficial to him/herRs. and should inform the awarding authority through the Head of the Institution about the option made. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this scheme from the date he/she accepts another scholarship/stipend. The student canRs. howeverRs. accept free lodging or a grant or ad-hoc monetary help from the State Government or any other source for the purchase of booksRs. and equipment or for meeting the expenses on board and lodging in addition to the scholarship amount paid under this scheme.
- All seats filled through arbitrary and non-transparent processes (including management quotaRs. NRI quotaRs. spot admissions etc.) without following the merit criteria as decided by the State Government are not eligible for these scholarships. The fees claimed against management quota seatsRs. and spot admission seats in any Institution /University will not be reimbursed. In case of any contradiction on the classification of seats or non-clarity on the classification of seats in the State/UTRs. the following criteria may be followed:


1. If there is no arbitrariness/ discretion in the admission process and the fee for the course is fixed by the Fee Fixation/Fee Rationalization committee set up by the competent authorityRs. the said seats may not be considered as the Management Quota Seats. HoweverRs. the State Governments may satisfy themselves with the following before releasing scholarships: i
1. That the applicants claiming the scholarship have been admitted through a transparent process which involved calling of applications through advertisementsRs. preparation of ranksRs. selection of candidates on the merit listRs. and publication of selection list and others as deemed fit by the State Government;
1. That the fees for courses are duly approved by the Fee Fixation/Fee Rationalization Committee set up by the competent authority.


- Students shall be encouraged to have Aadhaar-linked Bank accounts to facilitate payments through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge.

name: NEET/JEE Coaching For Tribal Students
brief_description:
The NEET/JEE Coaching for Tribal Students Scheme is a government initiative launched by the Rajasthan Tribal Area Development Department to provide free coaching to tribal students in the state who are preparing for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and Joint Entrance Examination (JEE). The aim of the scheme is to help talented tribal students in Rajasthan to get admission to prestigious medical and engineering colleges in India by providing them with high-quality coaching.
Under the schemeRs. the Rajasthan government has partnered with reputed coaching institutes to provide free coaching to eligible tribal students. The coaching includes intensive classroom sessionsRs. doubt clearing sessionsRs. study materialsRs. and mock tests. The coaching institutes also provide guidance and mentorship to students to help them develop a better understanding of the subjects and excel in the exams.
To be eligible for the schemeRs. the student must belong to a tribal communityRs. have passed the 12th class examinationRs. and have a valid NEET/JEE score.
The NEET/JEE Coaching for Tribal Students Scheme is an important initiative to help talented students from tribal communities in Rajasthan to realize their dreams of pursuing a career in medicine and engineering.
eligibility: 1. Belong to a tribal community. 1. Have successfully completed 12th grade in the science stream with a first-class standing.

name: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana" is an Insurance Scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme is also known as the "Jharkhand Construction Worker Death/Accident Assistance Scheme" in English. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department (http://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in). The scheme provides social security to all registered workers in the age group of 18-60 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a registered Construction Worker (Nirman Shramik / Nirman Karmakar).
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.

name: Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" is a Medical Assistance scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides medical assistance to all registered workers who are admitted to the hospital for five or more working days.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The applicant should be admitted to the hospital for five or more working days.

name: Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana
brief_description: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department (http://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in). The scheme provides scholarships of up to 50Rs./- to the children of the registered workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous examination with atleast Second Division or 45% marks in any examination (except Class 1st to 5th) OR have got admitted/enrolled in the course on the basis of a competitive examination.
1. The applicant should be the child of a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The scholarship can be availed by upto two children of the Registered Worker.

name: 40% Subsidy On Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme
brief_description: The "40% subsidy on Hank YarnRs. Dyes & Chemicals Scheme" is a Subsidy Scheme by the Department of Handlooms & TextilesRs. Government of Andhra Pradesh. The entire assistance under the scheme will be in the form of Grant from the State Government. The scheme is operative from 29th April 2011. The subsidy will be available only on purchases / procurements from NHDC & APCO. The amount sanctioned will be credited directly to the members bank account of the concerned primary weavers cooperative societies.
eligibility:
1. The subsidy will be available only on purchase / procurement of yarn from NHDCRs. Yarn Deports sanctioned by NHDC and APCO for self-consumption of Handloom Weaver Cooperative Societies for providing work to weaver members. 1. The subsidy will be allowed only on the Hank yarn purchased from the APCO & NHDC and its depots and utilized for the production on SocietiesRs. account during the quarter. 1. The claims for subsidy shall be submitted by the Weavers Cooperative Societies in the prescribed proforma on quarterly basis during the financial year with in 15 days from the end of the respective quarter. 1. The claims for subsidy in complete shape should reach Head Office with in 30 days from the end of the Quarter.

**NOTE 1:** The Weavers Coop Societies shall NOT claim any subsidy on the YarnRs. Dyes and Chemicals purchased from private yarn dealersRs. Mills etc. **NOTE 2:** The Weavers Coop. Societies should NOT claim any subsidy on YarnRs. Dyes & Chemicals even if purchased from APCO or NHDCRs. but not utilized for production of cloth by way of issue of yarn and sold to non-members.

name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) Scheme Of Festival Assistance For Participating In International & National Festival
brief_description: The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) Scheme of Festival Assistance for Participating in International & National Festival" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art and CultureRs. Govt. of Manipur. Through this schemeRs. the artists will be extended a sum of financial assistance to meet their travel costs and journey costs when they are invited to participate in International Festivals abroad with conditions that they have to bear international travel costsRs. visa feesRs. performance remunerationRs. etc.
eligibility:
> **For International Festival Assistance:** 1. The applicant should be a resident/domicile of the State of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be an Artist. 1. The individual artists or groups should have already given a performance/show in at least 2/3 of the National Festival recognized by the National Academies / Zonal Cultural Centres / Ministry of CultureRs. Government of India / Culture Department of State Government. 1. The individual artists or groups should have participated in 3/4 of the State Level Programme. 1. The applicant individual or group should not have been sponsored wholly by any individual or institution for the same purpose.
> **For National Festival Assistance:** 1. The applicant should be a resident/domicile of the State of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be an Artist. 1. The individual artists or groups should have already given a performance/show in at least 3/4 of recognized National Festivals. 1. The individual artists or groups should have participated in 3/4 State Level Programmes. 1. The applicant individual or group should not have been sponsored wholly by any individual or institution for the same purpose.
**Method of Selection:** The selection of artists/groups will be done by a Screening / Selection Committee constituted by the Government. This Committee will also decide whether a festival/event is to be considered an International or National Festival.

name: Vocational Training Of Destitute Women And Adolescent Girls
brief_description: "Vocational Training of Destitute Women and Adolescent Girls" is a scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Manipur. In this schemeRs. a 6-months training is provided in the Trades such as Tailoring & CuttingRs. EmbroideryRs. and Computer. The application form can be collected from the Welfare Training InstituteRs. TakyelRs. or can be downloaded from the Department website www.socialwelfare.mn.gov.in. The completely filled and signed application forms should be submitted to the Office of Welfare Training InstituteRs. Takyel. This is a State Sponsored Scheme and only the citizens who are domiciled in the State of Manipur can apply for this scheme. The application should be submitted through the respective District Social Welfare Officer.

1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Manipur.
1. The applicant should be a Destitute Woman or an Adolescent Girl.
1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 38 years age group.
1. The Minimum Educational qualification for Computer Course is 12th Pass.

name: Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides pension of 1Rs./- per month to those who have contributed to the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board) for at least 30 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should have been a Worker registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board).
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be at least 60 years of age in order to receive the pension.
1. The applicant should have engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The registered worker should have made continuous contributions for 30 years.

name: LIDCOM Training Scheme

1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 50 years age group.

name: Aswasakiranam
brief_description:
**Detailed** Kerala is a state well known for its efficient and effective health care system. Despite these advancementsRs. much headway could not be made in-home care. Most of the lowest income group always opt for homely treatment as they cannot afford the charges levied by the well-known hospitals. They are bedridden causing a heavy social burden on their family members who are forced to stay back at home to look after these bedridden patients. While the upper-income group can possibly afford to engage paid caregivers or home nurses for looking after such bedridden family membersRs. the lower-income group usually take it upon themselves to care for their bedridden brethren. These family members in fact function as informal caregiversRs. without due recognition or economic gain.
**Coverage Of Diseases** All bed-ridden patients who need a full-time caregiver. Mentally challenged (AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental retardationRs. Mental illness). 100 % blindRs. bed-ridden cancer patientsRs. old-aged bed-ridden. Brittle bone disease.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. One who is totally bedridden and at home with a debilitating disability (physicalRs. functional or mental).
1. One can not take care of himself/herself for any day-to-day activity without the support of another person.
1. One who belongs to a familyRs. Below Poverty Line as per the BPL list and as per the ration card.

name: Karma Veer Dadasaheb Gaikwad Sabalikaran & Swabhiman Yojana
brief_description: Being implemented particularly for the Scheduled Caste CommunitiesRs. the "Karma Veer Dadasaheb Gaikwad Sabalikaran & Swabhiman Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. The main objective of this scheme is to improve the financial condition of the scheduled castes and Nav-Buddhists who are landless workers and are from "Below Poverty Line". Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 60 years age group.
1. The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste or should be a Nav-Buddhists.
1. The applicant should be landless.
1. The applicant should be from the "Below Poverty Line" category.

name: Journalist's Medical Welfare Scheme - Assam
brief_description:
In consideration of the long pending demands of the journalists in the State for their welfare etc. the State Govt. has considered to introduce a new scheme viz. Journalist Medical Welfare Scheme for financial assistance to the Accredited Journalist as identified by the Director of Information & Public Relations (DIPR) Assam under the Rule of the Assam Press Correspondents (Accredited/ Recognitions) RulesRs. 1989 for Medical treatment of such journalists who suffer from:-
1. Complicated ailments needing long-termRs. highly expensive treatment/involving the transplant of organs/complicated surgeries/long-term medical treatmentsRs. e.g. cardiological/ nephrological/ oncological/ neurological/ gastroenterogical/ endoerinological etc. in nature. 2. Complicated surgical treatments arising out of injury caused by accidents etc. including the cost artificial replacements of etc.Rs. as and where required. 3. Incurable chronic ailments requiring life-saving devices/treatment etc. 4. Any other serious health-related problems that may be Medically Diagnosed to be of life-threatening nature. For this purpose the State Govt. have introduced a new Head of Accounts in the Annual Budget Estimates from the financial year 2009-10 and the fund provided under this Head of Account shall be administered by a committee to be constituted by the Information & Public Relations Department with the following members and the D.D.O. powers shall be delegated to the DIPRRs. Assam.
Under this schemeRs. one-time financial assistance is provided to the accredited and recognized journalists of Assam for their medical treatment. This scheme covers the medical requirements of the journalist as well as their dependent family members. This financial assistance is extended out of the interest accrued from the corpus fund of the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be an ordinary resident of Assam. 1. The applicant must be a journalist who is formally accredited / recognised by the DIPR and fulfil all the norms required for the said accreditation/ recognition.
**General Note:** Grant of financial assistance to any working journalist is not a matter of right. Assistance would be extended depending on the Committees satisfaction as to the eligibility/ merits of the cases and the availability of the financial resources for the purpose. The Committee reserves the right to reject or accept any application without assigning any reasons thereof.

name: Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: The scheme Chief Minister's State Disability Pension Scheme (CMDPS) was started by the Women & Child Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Sikkim to provide financial assistance to the differently abled person who has a disability of 40% and above. name: Scholarships For Higher Education Abroad To Meritorious Boys And Girls From Open Category
brief_description: The scheme Scholarships for Higher Education Abroad to Meritorious Boys and Girls from Open Category was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical EducationRs. Government of Maharashtra on 4th October 2018. name: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home
brief_description: The "Grant in Aid to Old Age Home" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. grants are provided to the NGOs for accommodating old men and womenRs. destituteRs. and disabled victimsRs. into Old age HomesRs. and providing them with facilities such as foodRs. accommodationRs. resortRs. Free lodging & Boarding & Medical AssistanceRs. etc. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered Non-Governmental Organization (NGO).
1. The applicant should only accommodate old/destitute/disabled victims.
1. In the case of old menRs. the age should be 60 years and above. In the case of old womenRs. the age should be 55 years and above.
1. The old age person should be a citizen of India.
1. The old age person should be a permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra.

name: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
brief_description:
The **Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana (CMKRY)** is a scheme initiated by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to support farmers by providing them with zero-interest crop loans. Under this schemeRs. the government offers an interest subvention of 4% on crop loans or Kisan Credit Card limits up to Rs. 3.00 lakhsRs. sanctioned by all banks during the current financial year. This interest subvention is provided over and above the subvention given by the Government of India to banks and farmers per the policy circular issued by RBI/NABARD. AdditionallyRs. farmers who promptly repay their short-term production credit (crop loan) within one year of disbursement or withdrawal can avail themselves of an interest relief of 3% per annum. In other wordsRs. farmers who take loans up to Rs. 3.00 lakhs and make timely repayments are eligible for the zero-interest credit facility. NABARD acts as the channel partner for reimbursement to banks regarding the interest subvention amount of this scheme. The state government also issues a notification wherein a certificate of the cultivated area and crops being grown is issued by the Circle OfficerRs. which is considered a valid document by banks for issuing Kisan Credit Cards to farmers.
**Salient Features:**

1. The farmer will get interest subvention of 4% on crop loan / KCC limit upto Rs. 3 lakh.
1. The farmers can take loans from any bank within the state during the current financial year.
1. If the farmer make their loan payment on time they will also get interest relief of 3% per annum on their crop loan.
1. The government will not provide any relief for the production of perennial food crop and plantation crop.
1. The farmers will be selected separately through district and concerned bank wise.

**Objective of this scheme:**

1. To provide a facility of crop loans at zero interest rates for farmers in the state.
benefits:
**Benefits**

1. Kisan Credit Card and card limit up to 3.00 lakh as loanRs. sanctioned by all banks to all farmers of the state during the current financial year.
1. Interest subvention of 4% on crop loanRs. over and above the subvention given by the Government of India.
1. In effectRs. farmers making timely repayments can avail 3.00 lakh of the loan with access to an interest credit facility.
1. Zero-interest crop loans provide financial relief to farmers and reduce their burden of interest payments.
1. Easy access to formal credit through banking channels promotes financial inclusion for farmers.
1. The scheme sets a target to cover 7500 farmers under crop loansRs. contributing to the state's agricultural development.
eligibility:
- Eligible Beneficiary/Group Farmers cultivating short-term crops in Arunachal Pradesh.
- Farmers who hold Kisan Credit Cards or avail themselves of crop production loans from commercial banksRs. APRBRs. and APSCAB Ltd are eligible for the scheme.
- The farmers should have a good repayment track record and promptly repay their short-term production credit (crop loan) within one year.
- The scheme is available for crop loans or Kisan Credit Card limits up to Rs. 3.00 lakhs.
- The farmers must fulfill the eligibility criteria and documentation requirements set by the banks.
- The scheme is open to both small and marginal farmers as well as large farmers in the state.

name: Tripura Industrial Investment Promotion Incentive
brief_description:
The Tripura Industrial Investment Promotion Incentive (TIPII) scheme is a comprehensive initiative launched by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Government of Tripura. The primary objective of the scheme is to attract domestic and foreign investments in various industrial sectors within the state. TIPII offers a range of incentivesRs. financial supportRs. and facilitation services to eligible businessesRs. creating a favorable environment for industrial development.
Under the TIPII schemeRs. eligible industries can avail themselves of benefits such as capital investment subsidiesRs. interest subsidiesRs. power tariff subsidiesRs. reimbursement of expenses for skill developmentRs. and assistance for land acquisition. The scheme also provides customized support for specific sectorsRs. including IT and IT-enabled servicesRs. agro-based industriesRs. tourismRs. and renewable energy. AdditionallyRs. the scheme includes provisions for single-window clearanceRs. simplification of proceduresRs. and assistance in obtaining necessary approvals and licenses.
eligibility:
- The proposed project should be located within the state of Tripura.
- The industry should comply with all relevant legal and environmental regulations.
- The investment should be in sectors specified under the scheme.
- The business should have a clear plan for employment generation and contribute to the socio-economic development of the state.
- The applicant should have a sound financial track record and demonstrate the ability to implement the project successfully.

name: House Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: The housing subsidy scheme was launched by the Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide financial assistance to individuals from marginalized sections for the construction of their own houses. Under this schemeRs. a subsidy of Rs. 1Rs./- is provided to persons from Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. Minority CommunitiesRs. Single WomenRs. or handicapped for the construction of their houses. This scheme aims to improve the living conditions and overall quality of life of individuals from these sections.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant should belong to Scheduled CastRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. Minority CommunityRs. Single WomenRs. or Handicapped. 3. The applicant's annual income should be less than Rs. 3.00 lakhs. 4. The applicant should not have availed of any such subsidy earlier. 5. The applicant should have a bonafide Himachali certificate of the couple. 6. The applicant should possess a Scheduled Cast/Other Backward Classes/Minority Community/Single Women or Handicapped Certificate. 7. The applicant should have income and revenue papers (Record of Right Parcha & Tatima). 8. The applicant should have a recommendation from the concerned Gram Panchayat. 9. Latest photographs of the present house are required.

name: CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme
brief_description: The "CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme" was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The objective of the scheme is to encourage talented candidates from Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. Extremely Backward ClassRs. Economically Weaker Section or Minority categories of Rajasthan by providing financial assistance after their selection in various competitive examinationsRs. such as IASRs. RASRs. IITRs. IIMRs. CPMTRs. NITRs. and other government engineering and medical entrance exams.

1. The candidate must possess the minimum qualifications required for the competitive examination.

name: Shravanbal Seva State Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Shravanbal Seva State Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. a monthly pension of 600/- is provided to destitute persons in the state of Maharashtra. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
1. The applicant should be destitute.
1. The applicant should be 65 years or above in age.
1. The name of the applicant should be in the list of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families OR the annual income of the family should be less than or equal to 21Rs./-.

name: Bank Tie-Up Scheme
brief_description: Through the "Bank Tie-Up Scheme"Rs. the Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC) arranges loans through banksRs. and subsidy is provided by PSCLDFC. The permanent residents of Punjab belonging to Scheduled Castes and living Below Poverty Line are eligible under this scheme. This is a 100% State Sponsored SchemeRs. and only the permanent residents of the state of Punjab can apply for this scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Punjab.
1. The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL).
1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) should be 67Rs./- per annum (for rural areas); 88Rs./- per annum (for urban areas).
1. The applicant should not already be availing the benefits of the scheme.

name: Chief Ministers Shasakt Kisan Yojana
brief_description:
To increase production and productivity and also to maintain a marketable surplus of major fruit crops in the State as well as to double farmers incomeRs. the government has adopted region-wise feasible and need-based Horticulture activities in the various districts of Arunachal Pradesh under budget announcement during the financial year 2019-20Rs. targeted up to 2021-22.
**Objective:**
The main aim of the government scheme is to uplift the status of womenRs. marginal and small farmers of the state for self-employment generation & commercialization of horticulture activities to double their income as per immediate felt needs of the farmersRs. according to thrust areas enumerated district-wise on suitable crops grown in the specific areas.
**Important Features:**
Inputs are provided to farmers for teaRs. rubberRs. and double croppingRs. per hectare
Crops under double cropping are selected based on soil testing
eligibility:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant should be a progressive farmer of any area/field.
3. All categories of farmers are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme was announced by the Department of School EducationRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh in 2013. This scheme is basically providing incentives towards the beneficiaries of girl child students studying in classes VI to XII only which institutes/schools are fully run by the State Govt. and Govt. Aided Schools in Arunachal Pradesh. The main aim and objective of this scheme are to be retained and continue in the schools during the occurrence of their menstrual period. FurtherRs. this scheme increases awareness among adolescent girls on Menstrual Hygiene.
**Important Features:**

- Sanitary napkins are supplied in a decentralized mode in terms of cash transfer in the account of beneficiaries/ school management/ or by central procurement at the district level.
- Further distribution of napkins to the beneficiaries takes place at the school level.
benefits: 1. 50/- per student per month in all Govt. schools through DBT (all year amount is credited to the account of the beneficiary).
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a girl student.
1. The beneficiary must be studying in classes VI to XII.
1. The beneficiary must be enrolled in a government or government-aided school.
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Arunachal Pradesh.

name: Motorisation Of Traditional Crafts
brief_description: The scheme Motorisation of Traditional Crafts was launched by the Department of Fisheries & Animal Resources DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha to increase the catch per voyage and incomes of traditional fishermen. **Objective:** - To increase the marine fish production from the State. - To increase the income and livelihoods of traditional fishermen by motorizing their traditional non-motorized crafts. **Implementation Target & Area Of Operation:** The scheme shall be implemented by the Additional Fisheries Officer (Marine)/DFO (B&T)Rs. Balugaon in seven maritime districts of the State. The district-wise annual target shall be communicated by the Director of Fisheries at the beginning of the financial year. The target is interchangeable depending on the progress made by the District Level Officers.
benefits: 1. Unit Cost and Subsidy Assistance are to be provided to the eligible beneficiary as under: **Sl. No.****Type of Engine****HP of Engine****Approximate Unit Cost in INR****Maximum Admissible Subsidy (40% for General Category)****Maximum Admissible Subsidy (60% for SC/ST Category)**1IBM/OBMUp-to 100 HP1Rs.. Financial Assistance shall be limited to 1 (one) unit per individual beneficiary. 3. Back-ended subsidy will be limited to 60% for SC/ST and 40% for General Category on the actual cost of the boat engine as per the GST bills. 4. Subsidy should be released directly to the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
**The following are the eligibility criteria of the beneficiary:**

- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha and must possess identity and residential proof including Aadhaar Card.
- The applicant must have Bank Account in his/her name in the State of Odisha.
- The applicant must be a traditional marine active fisherman.
- The applicant must not have availed subsidy for the purchase of an engine under any Government scheme in the last five years.
- The applicant must possess a traditional non-motorized fishing boat/traditional motorized fishing boat duly registered in Odisha.
- The applicant must possess a valid ownership certificateRs. Registration certificateRs. and Fishing license under the ReAL craft for a non-motorized traditional boat or traditional Motorized boat/craft.
- The applicant must not have acquired a boat through the transfer of ownership which is motorized under any Government scheme in the last five years availing subsidy by previous owners.

name: Livelihood Support To Marine Fishermen During Fishing Ban Period
brief_description:
**Livelihood Support to Marine Fishermen during the Fishing Ban Period Scheme** under the Department of Fisheries & Animal Resources DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha aims to support the livelihood of marine fisher families. This scheme is under the state sector Umbrella Scheme **Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana (MMKY)**. The scheme supports the livelihood of marine fisher families in and around the turtle nesting and breeding areas of the state including round the year fishing ban in Bhitarkanika areas as no alternative is available. As the livelihood earning of fishermen is solely based on sea fishing and the ban on fishing directly prohibits the profession over a long period of seven months in a year (1st November to 31st May) (both days inclusive) along with a Uniform ban from 15th April to 14th June (61 days).
**Area of Operation:**
The Scheme shall be implemented in the Marine Districts of KendraparaRs. JagatsinghpurRs. PuriRs. and Ganjam along the Coastline of Odisha where the marine Fishers who are affected due to the ban on fishing round the year at Gahirmatha Marine SanctuaryRs. Bhitarkanika National park and adjoining areas of Devi River and Rushikulya River Mouth for Sea Turtle Conservation.
benefits:
1. Only one member of the affected families shall be assisted with 15Rs./- annually under the scheme.
1. The amount shall be paid to the beneficiaries between November and March of a financial year in one Installment.
1. The assistance amount shall be released to the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility:
**The following are the eligibility criteria for the beneficiary:**

1. The beneficiary must be an active Marine fisherman.
1. The assistance will be provided to only one member of a family on behalf of the family.
1. The beneficiary must be in the age group of 18-70 years.
1. The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Odisha and must possess identity and residential proof including an Aadhaar card.
1. The beneficiary must have a bank account in his/her name in the state of Odisha.
1. The beneficiary must be a boat owner (Motorized Boat)/ a crew member of a Motorized Boat / Fish trader/ engaged in sortingRs. and grading FishRs. and other ancillary activities.
1. The Fishers should preferably belong to the BPL Category i.e. covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) and not belong to the automatically excluded household under the socio-economic and caste census (SECC)-2011.
1. If the fisherman is a Boat OwnerRs. he must have valid registration (Real Craft) and a valid fishing license.
1. If the fisherman is a crew memberRs. he must work in a registered fishing boat with a valid date fishing license and will produce a certificate from the boat owner in this respect.
1. If the fisherman is a Fish trader / engaged in sortingRs. grading of FishRs. and other ancillary activities he must produce a certificate from a registered boat owner in this respect.

**Note:**
Preference of selection of beneficiaries shall be undertaken in the order of:

1. Boat Owner.
1. Crew member of a fishing boat.
1. workers engaged in sortingRs. gradingRs. and other ancillary activities.

name: Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
brief_description:
Special provisions have been enshrined in the Constitution for the welfare of SC / ST people in every sphere of their life. There are a number of SC / ST people suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases who are unable to carry forward the treatment of their diseases due to the economic hardships faced by them. The government has decided to bring some help to such patients by making available some financial assistance in the form of grants in Aid to SC/ST patients suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases.
SC / ST patients who are suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases are unable to afford advanced treatment due to their Socioeconomic condition prevalent in the community. So financial assistance in the form of grants in Aid is proposed to be provided to such patients through a scheme namely "Grants in Aid to SC / ST patients suffering from cancer and other malignant diseases". Under the schemeRs. such SC / ST patients will be given a one-timeRs. fixed financial assistance of Rs. 50Rs./- (Rupees Fifty thousand) only.
eligibility: 1) The applicant must belong to an SC / ST community of Assam. 2) Person suffering from cancer or other malignant diseases may apply. 3) No person shall be eligible to claim this financial aid more than once.

name: Chief Ministers Free Diagnostic Services
brief_description:
Quality diagnosis is vital for medical practitioners to make effective decisions about treatment. Access and availability of quality Radiology and Laboratory Services have been key challenges for the health system. The out-of-pocket expenditure of patients on diagnostic tests is increasing and forms the second major segment of such expenditure after medicine. HenceRs. the provisioning of quality diagnostic services (laboratory and radiological services) in public health facilities is critical for ensuring evidence-based care and reducing expenditure.
To address the above issuesRs. Chief Minister's Free Diagnostics Services Programme is envisaged to ensure the availability of a minimum set of diagnostic services at government health institutions. Under Chief Minister's Free Diagnostic Services Programme CT ScanRs. X-Ray and Laboratory services are provided in the State of Assam free of cost to all patients in Govt. Health Institutions are irrespective of APL/BPL status.
benefits: 1. To provide essential diagnostic services free of cost to all patients visiting government hospitals. No user charges will be levied on the patient. 2. Ensure the availability of a minimum set of diagnostics appropriate to the level of care. 3. Reduce high out-of-pocket expenditure incurred by patients for diagnostics. 4. Use of appropriate diagnostics to screen patients for a set of chronic conditions so as to enable secondary prevention measures. 5. Improve overall quality of healthcare and patient experience as a result of the availability of comprehensive healthcare in public health facilities. 6. Free CT scan servicesRs. X-Ray servicesRs. and Laboratory services are being implemented in District HospitalRs. PHCsRs. CHCsRs. etc in PPP mode
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Assam. 2. The scheme is applicable to individuals of all age groups. 3. There is no specific income criteriaRs. and the scheme is open to all socio-economic backgrounds.

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
brief_description: INSPIRE INTERNSHIP aims to provide exposure to the top 1% of students at the Class X Board level by organizing Science Camps either during summer or winter which provides an opportunity for them to interact with Science icons from India and abroadRs. including Nobel LaureatesRs. to experience the joys of scientific pursuit. These science camps nourish the curiosity of students in scienceRs. help them to think out-of-the-boxRs. and attract students at an early age of 16-17 years to choose science subjects for further studies. Annually 50Rs. students who are among the top one percent in their X Board Examination and pursuing science in standard XI would be benefited through summer/ winter camps. These camps would nourish the curiosity of children in science; help them to think out of the box and attract the students at an early age of 16-17 years (i.e. in XI standard) to pursue a research career.
benefits:
**Duration of the Summer/Winter Camp:** 5 days (excluding the days of Journey) **Nature of the Camp:** Residential except in Metropolitan Cities
> **For the Interns:** 1. Each day the schedule of the Program should comprise at least two lectures cum discussion of one and a half hours in the morning hours followed by hands-on experience in the second half (i.e.Rs. 1400Hrs to 1730hrs). 1. The coordinator should engage students in the thinking process on issues of national importance by way of organizing sessions for interns for writing on new and innovative ideas. The following are some of the key areas of priority: Second Green Revolution; Renewable and non Renewable energy; Clean energy; Natural resources utilization for sustainability; Make in India; Swachh Bharat & Ganga Rejuvenation; Energy conservation efficiency and sustainability; Harnessing Modern Technology for the second green revolution; Dairy and Livestock Sector; Solid & Liquid Waste Management; Recycling & processing of waste to conserve resources. 1. The program Coordinator can organize a pre-dinner interactive session with the students on the first day and initiate discussions about the role of science and technology in the development of the nation. 1. A session with the participating interns on writing new and innovative ideas on the above areas. The organizer shall evaluate these ideas by the external mentors present during the 4th or 5th day and select the best three write-ups in the raking of 1st 2nd 3rd ..... 10th. The interns whose write-ups will be selected for 1st-10th rank will be awarded during the valedictory function. 1. Each visiting Nobel Laureate has to interact with the Interns. 1. Pre-dinner Discussions of INSPIRE interns with Mentors may be arranged each day. 1. Lab infrastructure in the area of PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Life ScienceRs. Earth Sciences Mathematical SciencesRs. etc.Rs. Auditorium with sound systemRs. Guest HouseRs. Hostel accommodation for boys and girls.
> **For the Organizers/Mentors:** 1. For the INSPIRE Internship camp of 5 days (excluding the Journey days)Rs. 6500/- student (as an uppermost ceiling/student) will be provided to the coordinating Institute/Department/agency to meet the INSPIRE Internship camp cost. 1. This cost includes travel costs (as per entitlement & actual)Rs. Boarding & LodgingRs. Stationary including Books & small experimental gadgetsRs. etc.Rs. ConsumablesRs. Honorarium (to the MentorsRs. etc.)Rs. and organizational expenses for the Students and Indian Mentors invited for the respective INSPIRE Internship camps. 1. Honorarium to the mentors should be paid a maximum of 3000 per contributing dayRs. with an upper limit of 6000 per mentor if the mentor contributes for more than one day in the entire camp duration. 1. For inviting a Noble Laureate to interact with the students in these Camps as an International MentorRs. INSPIRE has also a provision of providing support with a maximum of 10Rs. (all-inclusive) per Noble Laureate. Every year a maximum 50 no. of Noble Laureates can be invited to the INSPIRE Internship Camps.
eligibility:
> **For the Interns** 1. The applicant should be a School Student. 1. The applicant should be in the top one percent ranking in their 10th Board Examination. 1. The applicant should be pursuing Science in Class 11th. 1. The applicant should not have attended a similar camp earlier. 1. The applicant should be within the same State or Union Territory.
**Note:** In case the number of top 1% students of a respective examination board is more than the allocated number of INSPIRE internsRs. for participation in such campsRs. of the respective state/UTRs. top rankers will be selected for INSPIRE Internship science camp provided they had applied for the same.
> **For the Science Camp Organizers** 1. University/College or Academic/Research institute should have the required infrastructure of related Science Laboratories for holding INSPIRE InternshipCamps. 1. Availability of auditorium with well-equipped sound system and LCD projectors. 1. Availability of Guest HouseRs. Hostel for Girls and BoysRs. with holding capacities. 1. UniversityRs. CollegeRs. or academic/Research institute shall owe the administrative and financial responsibility for the organization of INSPIRE Internship Camp.
**For the Mentors** 1. Mentors for INSPIRE Internship would be various Academy FellowsRs. Bhatnagar AwardeesRs. ScientistsRs. and academicians of National and International repute.

name: Gaon Ki Beti
brief_description: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to talented girls from rural areas to encourage them to pursue higher education. It seeks to motivate young girls to continue their studies and build a bright future.
benefits:
1. Each yearRs. girls who pass the 12th standard with first-class marks from a village will be eligible.
1. Selected students will receive a scholarship of 500/- per month.
1. The scholarship will be provided for a maximum of 10 months per year.
eligibility: 1. The student must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard. 1. The girl must reside in a rural area and possess a "Gaon Ki Beti" (Daughter of the Village) certificate. 1. She must be enrolled in a recognized institution for higher education.

name: AASRA Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme AASRA Scheme is an insurance scheme and it was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Jammu & Kashmir in 2015 to provide Social Security cover to widowsRs. DestituteRs. Below Poverty Line (BPL) familiesRs. and Breadwinners of such families whose annual income is less than 75000/-. The Government of Union Territory will bear the premium of all these policies and will cover the entire segment of the destitute and BPL families in the Union Territory.
The scheme has already been notified by the Cabinet vide decision No. 102/08/2015 dated 19.8.2015 to launch a comprehensive Social Security Scheme namely AASRA Scheme and vide Government Order No. 150-F of 2015 dated 20.08.2015 under which the UT government would pay or reimburse premium for the following two insurances scheme.
1. Pardhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
2. Pardhanmantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
1. **Pardhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY):**
**Eligibility:**
a) People in the age group of 18 to 70 years with bank accounts will be covered and a premium of 12/- per annum per beneficiary.
b) Any person in the age group of 18 to 70 years having a bank account and Aadhaar No. linked to the Bank account are to be covered and who can give a simple form every year before the 1st of June in order to join the scheme. Name of the nominee to be given in the form.
c) Payment Mode: The premium will be auto-debited by the Bank from the subscriber's account.
d) Risk Coverage: For accidental death and full disability 2.00 lakh and for partial disability 1.00 lakh.
e) Terms of Risk Coverage: A person has to opt for the scheme every year he can also prefer a long-term option of continuing in which case his account will be auto-debited every year by the bank.
2. **Pardhanmantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY):**
**Eligibility:**
a) A person in the age group of 18 to 50 years and having a bank account can however continue to have the risk of life up to the age of 55 years subject to payment of a premium of 333/- per annum.
b) Payment Mode: The payment of the premium will be directly auto-debited by the bank from the subscriber's account.
c) Risk coverage: 2.00 lakh in case of death for any reason.
**Objective:**
The main objective of the scheme AASRA Scheme is to provide social and financial security to eligible beneficiaries and entails providing a zero balance saving Bank account to every eligible beneficiary to avail of the insurance coverage benefits under which the UT Government would pay or reimburse premium for a period of five years for the above two schemes.
**Funding pattern:**
The "Aasra Scheme" is a scheme sponsored by the Government of Union Territory for which assistance will be made available to provide benefit to all Breadwinners of families whose total annual income does not exceed 75000/- and all widows or destitute residing in the UT according to the normsRs. guideline & laid down conditionsRs. outlined in the insurance schemes. The funds will be provided by the Finance Department under Non-Plan expenditureRs. in a lump sum or on an annual basis to implement the schemeRs. and further upward revision in the amount would be considered if so required.
benefits:

name: Him Kukkut Palan Yojna
brief_description:
The scheme Him Kukkut Palan Yojna was launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide the subsidy to the entrepreneurs/farmers who are interested and engaged in poultry farming in the state. Since more and more poultry farmers have shown an inclination towards adopting poultry as per occupation consequent to their success in backyard schemesRs. they want the department to focus on commercial broiler farming in the state as well. For the benefit of such entrepreneurs/farmers and seeing the benefits of poultry rearing as an enterpriseRs. such farmers need to be incentivized by way of assistance through Government by Broiler scheme on a subsidy basis in the state.
**The following aims and objectives will also be achieved:-**

- To provide a good diet to the people of the state. It will be possible to make poultry available at reasonable rates if it is produced locally. Large rural populations face the problem of protein-calorie malnutritionRs. thus needing animal proteins with high biological values which can be met through poultry meat.
- To augment the income of the rural people where poultry farming along with livestock rearing is being carried on as a mixed farming complementary to crop production.
- Doubling of income of farmers.
- To increase the employment opportunities for the rural population since most of them are unemployed or grossly underemployed.
- To produce manure of high grade at a minimal cost.
benefits: - The government shall be providing funds against Capital Investment in this scheme under a subsidy component as per approved norms on a first come first serve basis as per the availability of budget. - For the subsidy on total capital investmentRs. 60% will be the subsidy assistance while a maximum of 40% will be the component to be provided by the beneficiary/banks to the beneficiaries belonging to SCRs. ST & General Category. - Since the beneficiary may not be able to raise 3000 chicks at one go due to constraintsRs. so provision is being kept to provide chicks in installments of 1000 chicks as per requirement. - To produce manure of high grade at a minimal cost.
eligibility:

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Govt. of India on 1st July 2015. The scheme mainly focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at the farm level through Micro Irrigation (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation System). BesidesRs. it also supports micro-level water storageRs. and water conservation/management activities (Other Interventions) to supplement source creation for Micro Irrigation.
**Objectives:**

- Increase the area under micro irrigation technologies to enhance water use efficiency in the country.
- Increase the productivity of crops and income of farmers through precision water management.
- Promote micro-irrigation technologies in water-intensive/consuming crops like sugarcaneRs. bananaRs. cottonRs. etc.Rs. and give adequate focus to extend the coverage of field crops under micro-irrigation technologies.
- Make potential use of micro irrigation systems for promoting fertigation.
- Promote micro-irrigation technologies in water-scarceRs. water-stressedRs. and critical groundwater blocks/districts.
- Link tube-well / river-lift irrigation projects with micro irrigation technologies for the best use of energy both for lifting and pressurized irrigation as far as possible.
- Establish convergence and synergy with activities of ongoing programmes and schemesRs. particularly with created water sources for their potential useRs. integration of solar energy for pressurized irrigationRs. etc.
- PromoteRs. developRs. and disseminate micro irrigation technology for agriculture and horticulture development with modern scientific knowledge.
- Create employment opportunities for skilled and unskilled personsRs. especially unemployed youth for installation and maintenance of micro irrigation systems.

**Important Features:**

- Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) not only focuses on creating water sources for assured irrigationRs. but it also creating protective irrigation by harnessing rainwater at the micro level through Jal Sanchay and Jal Sinchan. Micro irrigation is an integral component of the scheme to maximize water use efficiency at the farm level.
- There are four components to the scheme: Accelerated Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP)Rs. Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)Rs. Har Khet Ko PaniRs. and Watershed Development
- Per Drop More Crop: to focus on micro-level storage structuresRs. efficient water conveyance & applicationRs. precision irrigation systemsRs. topping up of input cost beyond MGNREGA permissible limitsRs. secondary storageRs. water lifting devicesRs. extension activitiesRs. coordination & management - being implemented by DAC&FW.

**Nodal Department:**

- Since the final outcome of PMKSY is to ensure access to efficient delivery and application of water at every farm thereby enhancing agricultural production & productivityRs. State Agriculture Department may be the Nodal Department for implementation of PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop). HoweverRs. State Govt. is free to identify the nodal department based on the established institutional setup and mandate of the department. All communication between the Ministry of Agriculture (MoA) and the State Government would be preferable with and through the nodal department.
- States are free to identify dedicated implementing agencies/departments for the implementation of Per Drop More Crop.
benefits:
- Financial assistance to farmers for the installation of irrigation components under Micro Irrigation (all assets/ water sources for this must be mandatorily linked with a Micro Irrigation system to achieve water use efficiency).
- Installation of drip or sprinkler irrigation in the farmers field for selected crops.
- Installation of the irrigation system can be done either by the farmers themselves or by the selection of any approved Micro Irrigation companies.
- The pattern of assistance payable to the beneficiary under the micro irrigation scheme will be 55% for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers which will be met by both the Central Government and State Government in the ratio of 60:40 for all states except the North Eastern and Himalayan states. In the case of these statesRs. the ratio of sharing is 90:10. For the Union TerritoriesRs. the funding pattern is 100% granted by the Central Government.
- Direct Benefit Transfer into the accounts of farmers.
- Farmers can also avail benefits like water harvesting structures both at individual and community levelsRs. water lifting devices for conveyance efficiencyRs. and digging of a farm pondRs. under Other Interventions of Per Drop More Crop.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. All the farmers of the State & Union Territory are eligible to take the benefits of this scheme.
1. The subsidy payable to the beneficiary will be limited to an overall ceiling of 5 hectares per beneficiary.

**Note 01:** The beneficiary has to purchase only BIS-marked systems/components under the scheme.
**Note 02:** The scheme is to be implemented through the mechanism of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Aadhaar details of the beneficiary are required to access the benefit of the programme.

brief_description:
The government of Odisha introduced Bio-floc-based farming and aims to promote sustainable intensification of freshwater fish and brackish water shrimp farming for boosting productivity and generating high income in a limited area and during the current 5000 nos. of Bio-floc tanks will be developed under this program with subsidy support under the state plan.
The objective of the program are:-

- To promote high-yielding intensive fish farming in small areas using Bio-floc technology.
- To encourage farmersRs. entrepreneursRs. and unemployed youth into income generation through a small-scale Bio-floc farming system.

> **SCHEME SUBSIDY :**

benefits: 1. **Increased Productivity:** The adoption of bio-floc technology in aquaculture can lead to increased productivity by maintaining optimal water quality conditions. The technology helps in controlling water parameters such as dissolved oxygenRs. ammoniaRs. and nitrate levelsRs. thereby creating a conducive environment for fish and shrimp growth.1. **Water Conservation:** Bio-floc technology promotes water conservation by minimizing the need for water exchange in aquaculture systems. The microbial communities formed in bio-floc tanks help in recycling nutrients and reducing water wastageRs. making it a sustainable approach to aquaculture.1. **Cost Reduction:** By reducing the dependence on water exchange and minimizing the usage of artificial feedsRs. the adoption of bio-floc technology can potentially lead to cost savings for fish and shrimp farmers. This can contribute to the economic viability of aquaculture operations.1. **Environmental Sustainability:** The implementation of bio-floc technology aligns with the goal of environmental sustainability in aquaculture. The technology reduces the release of effluents into natural water bodiesRs. mitigating the potential negative impacts on the environment.1. **Skill Development and Capacity Building:** The initiative may include training and capacity-building programs for farmersRs. providing them with knowledge and skills related to bio-floc technology and its application in aquaculture. This can empower farmers with the necessary expertise to adopt and adapt to modern aquaculture practices.

name: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana was launched by the Department of Religious Trusts and EndowmentsRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh in June 2012. Under the schemeRs. the state government provides one-time assistance to senior citizens above 60 years of age (2 years relaxation in case of women) of the state to visit a prescribed pilgrimage outside the state. In this schemeRs. free travel is made to senior citizens of the state to the identified pilgrimage site in the country. The pilgrims travel by special trainRs. breakfastRs. foodRs. and pure drinking waterRs. arrangements for stay at pilgrimage placesRs. travel by bus where necessaryRs. and other facilities are made available by Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC) contracted with Religious Trusts and Endowments DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme got underway on September 3Rs. 2012Rs. with a journey to Rameshwaram.
**Pilgrimages:**
At presentRs. the State Government has selected Shri BadrinathRs. Shri KedarnathRs. Shri Jagannath PuriRs. Shri Dwarka JiRs. HaridwarRs. AmarnathRs. Vaishno DeviRs. ShirdiRs. TirupatiRs. Ajmer SharifRs. KashiRs. AmritsarRs. RameshwaramRs. Sammed ShikharRs. Shravan Belgola and Belangi ChurchRs. Nagapattinam as pilgrimages under the scheme.
**General Instructions which should be followed by the pilgrims during the journey:**

1. It is mandatory to provide the mobile number and residential address of a concerned person in case of an emergency.
1. The pilgrims should have good conduct during the journey.
1. It is forbidden to carry inflammable substances and intoxicants during the journey.
1. It is prohibited to take any valuable gemsRs. jewellery etc. with you during the journey.
1. It is necessary to follow the instructions of the Liaison Officer / Supervisor / Escort during the journey.
1. Passengers are requested not to indulge in any such behaviour during the Yatra which tarnishes the image of the state.
1. Passengers are expected to carry weather-appropriate clothingRs. woolen clothingRs. and personal items such as blanketsRs. sheetsRs. towelsRs. soapRs. combRs. shaving kitRs. medicinesRs. etc.
1. It is mandatory for the passengers to carry identity proof like Aadhaar Card/Voter Card along with them.
1. The Covid protocol should be compulsorily followed during the journey.
1. The state government or any of its officers/employees will not be responsible for any accident or difficulty that may occur during the Yatra.
benefits:
1. The State Government provides one-time assistance in a lifetime to senior citizens above 60 years of age (2 years relaxation in case of women) to visit a prescribed pilgrimage outside the state.
1. In this schemeRs. senior citizens of the state are made to travel to the identified pilgrimage sites of the country free of cost.
1. The pilgrims travel by special trainRs. breakfastRs. foodRs. and pure drinking waterRs. arrangements for stay at pilgrimage placesRs. travel by bus where necessaryRs. and other facilities are made available by Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC) contracted with Religious Trusts and Endowments DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh.

**Note 02:** The applicant providing false information and hiding facts can be deprived of benefits under the scheme anytime.
**Note 03:** In order to travelRs. it is mandatory for the applicant to provide a medical certificate that he is physically and mentally fit and not suffering from any infectious disease.
