1. This scheme will pave the way for the development and promotion of the economy by helping 5 lakh beneficiaries working in the informal business sector of Rajasthan state.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 40 years.
1. To get the benefit of this schemeRs. the monthly income of the applicant should be Rs 15Rs./- or less.
1. The monthly income of the applicant's family should be Rs. 50Rs. or less.
1. All those small traders who have been provided with a certificate or identity card by the urban body are also eligible for this scheme.
1. Traders left out in the survey or beneficiary Wonder with a recommendation letter from Town Vending Committee will also be eligible for this scheme.
1. The vendors selected during the survey will also be eligible for this scheme. (To whom a certificate or identity card has not been issued)

name: Artificial Limbs/Assistive Equipments Scheme
brief_description:
The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial grants to persons with disabilities to buy artificial limbs and auxiliary equipment whose (employed or self-employed) or whose familys income (in case of dependant) is not more than the decided BPL limit i.e.Rs. Rs.46Rs./- for rural areas and Rs.56Rs./- for urban areas from all sources and this annual income is scaled for per family or as per the amendments made by the Uttar Pradesh Government.
As per the disabilityRs. artificial limbs/auxiliary equipment will be provided to the Persons with Disability: 1. Mobility Assistance Equipment like:- TricyclesRs. WheelchairsRs. C.P. ChairRs. CrutchesRs. Walking Sticks and Walking stick. 1. Students who are visually impaired will be provided with educational equipment like mathematicalRs. abacusRs. geometry kits and Braille educational kits. 1. Blind stick for visually impaired persons. 1. For hearing-impaired personsRs. different types of hearing-aided equipment and education kits. 1. M.S.I.D. kit (Multi-Sensory Education Development Kit) for children and students with mental disabilities. 1. Daily activity kits for people free from leprosy. 1. In case of multi-disability or persons with disabilities who need more than one assistance/aid equipmentRs. they will be provided with a maximum of Rs.10Rs./- financial grant in one go.
benefits:
- The maximum amount of financial grant will be Rs.8Rs./- for the purchase of artificial limbs and auxiliary equipment for person with disabilities.


- In case of multi-disability or persons with disabilities who need more than one assistance/aid equipmentRs. they will be provided with a maximum of Rs.10Rs./- financial grant in one go.
eligibility:
1. Any person with a disability of any age who is the resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Such person with disabilityRs. whose minimum disability is 40% and should be certified by Competent Authority of State Government.
1. In the state of mental retardationRs. the state of the blocked or incomplete development of the mind which is specially characterized by abnormalities of growthRs. which has been certified by the competent authority.
1. Medical Officer has recommended for the artificial limbs / accessories required for Person with Disabilities.
1. Such person with disabilities who are not benefited by the Indian Government/State Government/Local Bodies in last three years for equipment. HoweverRs. for the regular students of any educational institution this limit will be for one year.
1. The annual income of the applicant or his family is within the definition of the poverty line (currently fixed at Rs. 46Rs./- in rural areas and Rs. 56Rs./- per family per year in urban areas) will be eligible for the grant.

name: Matribhasha Satyagrahi Pension Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Matribhasha Satyagrahi Pension Scheme was launched by the Department of InformationRs. Public Relations and LanguagesRs. Haryana on 12th December 2017. Under the schemeRs. the Government of Haryana is providing a monthly pension of 10Rs./- to the Matribhasha Satyagrahis of Hindi Aandolan-1957 due to whose struggle and sacrifices Haryana came up as a separate State on the map of India. In caseRs. a Satyagrahi has already passed awayRs. the monthly pension will be given to his/her surviving spouse.
In the year 1957Rs. a number of people from Hindi-speaking parts of erstwhile Punjab launched a crusade for the honourRs. promotionRs. and implementation of their mother tongue. This movement helped a lot in the creation of Haryana as a separate State. During this SatyagrahRs. Sh. Sumer SinghRs. a resident of village Naya BansRs. District Rohtak even lost his life.
These Matribhasha Satyagrahis were identified by constituting committees in all the districts of the State under the Chairmanship of the respective Deputy Commissioners concerned. The Deputy CommissionersRs. being the chairpersons of the committeeRs. had got the record of Matribhasha Satyagrahis verified by the concerned Superintendents of Police by checking/verifying their record from the jails.

- The Administrative Secretary of InformationRs. Public Relations & Languages DepartmentRs. Haryana will be competent to accord sanctions under this scheme.
- The expenditure under this scheme will be borne by the InformationRs. Public Relations & Languages DepartmentRs. Haryana. After sanction by the Administrative Secretary of this departmentRs. the amount of pension will be deposited in the bank account of beneficiary Satyagrahi.
benefits: 1. A monthly pension of 10Rs./- will be given to the eligible beneficiary by the state government of Haryana.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Matribhasha Satyagrahi of Hindi Aandolan-1957 and had been imprisoned for participating in Matribhasha Hindi Satyagraha (Hindi Andolan).
1. The beneficiary Satyagrahis will have to open an Aadhaar-linked savings bank account in any nationalized bank for transferring the pension amount to their bank accounts.
1. The beneficiary Satyagrahis have to give a live certificate in the month of January every year.
1. A SatyagrahiRs. getting a pension or honorarium of any kind from any other State Government will also be eligible. HoweverRs. if an otherwise eligible Satyagrahi is getting a pension from any other State Government for the same purpose of an amount less than 10Rs./- per monthRs. the entitlement of pension under this scheme would be reduced by that amount.

**Note 01:** The Matribhasha Satyagrahis were identified by constituting committees in all the districts of the State under the Chairmanship of the respective Deputy Commissioners concerned.
**Note 02:** The Deputy CommissionersRs. being the chairpersons of the committeeRs. had got the record of Matribhasha Satyagrahis verified by the concerned Superintendents of Police by checking/verifying their record from the jails.
**Note 03:** The CommitteesRs. already constituted under the Chairmanship of respective Deputy Commissioners of all the districtsRs. will examine fresh applicationsRs. as and when receiveRs. and send their recommendations to the State Government whose decision shall be final.
**Note 04:** In case of the demise of any of the SatyagrahiRs. the monthly pension will continue to be given to his/her surviving spouse.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
brief_description:
Honble Chief Minister of Rajasthan Sh. Ashok Gehlot announced this scheme on 20th August 2021 in commemoration of late Shri Rajiv GandhiRs. former Prime Minister of India. In order to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan to study in top foreign universities of the world.
**Objective**:

1. To assist students of Rajasthan financially to pursue higher studies in the top 150 QS World Universities
1. International exposure to students for their career development.
1. To give priority to students having gross family income less than 8 lakh rupees/annum.
1. To provide better opportunities to female students by earmarking 30 % seats (Income category-wise).
benefits: 1. **E1: Family gross annual income less than 8 Lakh** (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). Living Expenses: 12 Lakh Rupees. (iii). One-time advance of Rs 3 Lakh to candidates who will start their course after application on the portal (adjusted against living expenses). 1. **E2: Family gross annual income 8 25 Lakh** (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). Living Expenses: 6 Lakh Rupees 1. **E3: Family gross annual income above 25 Lakh** (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). No Living Expenses
eligibility:
1. Bonafide Resident of Rajasthan.
1. Less than 35 years of age on 1st July 2023
1. Admitted / Obtained offer letter in top 150 World QS ranked Universities as of 1st AprilRs. 2023
1. All disciplines for UGRs. PGRs. PhD and Post Doc courses.
1. Maximum 7.5 % seats ( 37 ) for EngineeringRs. ArchitectureRs. MedicalRs. Dentistry courses at UG level

name: Stipend Scheme For Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend
brief_description: The scheme Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Schedule Tribes through scientific poultry farming training. Under this schemeRs. the beneficiary will be given a maximum 2000 (direct in bank account) stipend for six days of training and a poultry training certificate after completion of training.
benefits:
- The beneficiary will be given maximum 2000 (direct in bank account) stipend for six days training. (Considering 300/- per dayRs. 1800/- for 6 days as daily allowance and 200/- as to & fro transport fare with the maximum total stipend 2000/-)
- Beneficiary will be given poultry training certificate after completion of training.
eligibility:
1. The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of Schedule Tribes people of the society of Gujarat State.
1. The beneficiary will have to provide income proof and a caste certificate.
1. Females and beneficiaries Below Poverty Line will be given priority.

name: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
brief_description:
Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme has been launched by the Government of Rajasthan. This scheme is an important scheme by the Government of Rajasthan for the Divyangjan of the state. It was started mainly to provide financial assistance to disabled persons.
In StateRs. a specially-abled person of any age who is suffering from any one or more disabilities (40% and above disability) will be eligible for a pension. From October 2Rs. 2021Rs. the process of issuing automatic approval of applications received online without human intervention was started using the metadata available on the Jan Aadhaar portal for the pension scheme.
benefits:
1. For women below 55 years of age and men below 58 years of age: Rs. 750/- per month.
1. To women aged 55 years and aboveRs. men aged 58 years and above but less than 75 years of age: Rs. 1Rs./- per month.
1. To the beneficiaries of 75 years and above age ( male and female): Rs. 1Rs./- per month.
1. To leprosy-free beneficiaries of all ages ( male and female): Rs. 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. Specially abled persons of any age with 40% and above disability.
1. Applicants are suffering from any one or more following disabilities :

1. BlindnessRs.
1. Short-sightednessRs.
1. Locomotor disabilityRs.
1. Leprosy freeRs.
1. Hearing lossRs.
1. Mental retardationRs.
1. Mental illnessRs.
1. Dwarfism (less than 3 feet 6 inches in height in case of an adult and holding a certificate issued by an authorized medical officer)Rs.
1. Naturally suffering from eunuchism.

1. Native of Rajasthan and living in Rajasthan.
1. Own combined annual income (from all sources) is up to Rs. 60Rs./-.

name: Internship Scheme By The Unique Identification Authority Of India (UIDAI)
brief_description:
The Internship Scheme by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) enables the students to gain adequate exposure to various Technology tracks and other units within UIDAI HeadquartersRs. Technology Centre and Regional offices. It would be expected to work in the field of application developmentRs. legal domains (like cyber laws/IT act) & general management. For the Interns the exposure to the functioning of the UIDAI & the technologies applied shall be an add-on furthering their future career prospects in niche technologyRs. legal domainsRs. management and many other areas as the case may be.
> **Objective** 1. To allow young academic talent to be associated with UIDAIs work for mutual benefit. 1. The Interns shall have an opportunity to know about the UIDAI functioning. It will enable UIDAI to interact with young scholars and to get fresh ideas and study/research support from the field of academics. At the same timeRs. it will provide an opportunity to young scholars to contribute in the UIDAI work and have an insight into the related technical domainsRs. management fields or related legal aspects.
> **Period** The period of the Internship shall be at least six weeks but not exceeding 12 months. **NOTE:** Interns not completing the requisite period will not be issued any certificate.
> **Place of Internship** All the interns should work either at the Technology CentreRs. Bengaluru or Regional offices of UIDAI or UIDAI Headquarters or assigned from a remote location under the guidance of the Project Supervisor (not below the Director rank).

(Premises): 40Rs.; (Remote): 20Rs. - MBA (Premises): NA; MBA (Remote): NA - Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Premises): NA - Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Remote): NA - PhD (Premises): 50Rs.; PhD (Remote): 25Rs.
> **2. Professional** - B.Tech. (Premises): NA; (Remote): NA - M.Tech. (Premises): NA; (Remote): NA - MBA (Premises): 40Rs.; MBA (Remote): 20Rs. - Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Premises): NA - Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Remote): NA - PhD (Premises): NA; PhD (Remote): NA
> **3. Non-Technical** - B.Tech. (Premises): NA; (Remote): NA - M.Tech. (Premises): NA; (Remote): NA - MBA (Premises): NA; MBA (Remote): NA - UG in Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Premises): 20Rs. - PG in Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Premises): 30Rs. - UG in Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Remote): 10Rs. - PG in Other relevant fields like Economics and Law (Remote): 15Rs. - PhD (Premises): NA; PhD (Remote): NA
##### **Logistic Support** - The basic lodging facilities can be made available on a payment basis in UIDAI Technology CentreRs. only. - The intern may be given access to the office internetRs. which shall be at the sole discretion of the supervising officer and subject to compliance with the Information Security Policy of UIDAI. **NOTE 1:** The Intern has to make his/her own accommodation arrangement during the internship in case of working from UIDAI premises. **NOTE 2:** They shall arrange their own transport to and from the office. **NOTE 3:** The Intern will not be given any Computer System/Laptop etc for carrying out his/her assignments during the internship. **NOTE 4:** The intern shall be required to bring his/her own Laptop for carrying out the work assigned to him/her.

> **For Internship** 1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 2. The applicant should be a bonafide student of any recognized University/ Institution within India or abroad. 3. The applicant should fulfil ANY ONE of the following conditions: A) The applicant should be studying in the 3rd / 4th year (Final or pre-final) in B.Tech / BE course of any discipline and secured a minimum of 60% marks (GPA avg of 6.0) in all prior semester examinations. These fellowships are for six to nine months (extendable to 12 months) on Computer Science (IncludingRs. but Not Limited to It Act and Cyber Laws Related to Data PrivacyRs. Cyber SecurityRs. Digital EconomyRs. Block ChainRs. Quantum ComputingRs. Computer VisionRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. Machine Learning and Big Data Analytics) and on Public Policy and Management.

name: Scholarship To Son And Daughter Of Differently Abled Persons

The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships to eligible students. The exact amount and duration of the scholarship may vary based on the level of education and the government's guidelines. The Son/Daughter of persons with disabilities will get financial assistance from Rs.1Rs. to Rs.6Rs. as Scholarships.
benefits:
The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of scholarships to eligible students. The exact amount and duration of the scholarship may vary based on the level of education and the government's guidelines.
Scholarships given to the Son/Daughter of persons with disabilities are as follows:

1. The Son who has passed in 10th Standard will get Rs.1Rs..
1. The daughter studying 11th Standard will get Rs.1Rs..

name: SEBI ITD Internship Program
brief_description:
The SEBI ITD Internship Program provides hands-on training to the students of the institutes based in and around Mumbai. The program accepts up to 15 interns. The Interns accepted under this program would be given an opportunity to work on different Information Technology (IT) projects including Data Analytics (DA)Rs. regulatory business processes and reportingRs. and FinTech at SEBI. Such projects will provide an exceptional opportunity to the interns to apply their IT and DA skills while gaining valuable exposure to the functioning of the Indian capital markets.
> **Duration** The internship program is proposed to be for a contiguous period of minimum 1 year which may comprise of either 2 semesters and 1 summer / winter internship or 3 trimesters and 1 summer / winter internship.
> **Schedule** At least 3 days a week of internship at SEBI (excluding SaturdaysRs. Sundays and Public Holidays).
benefits:
> **Stipend ()** 1. For interns working 3 days in a week: 25Rs. 1. For interns working 4 days in a week: 30Rs.
> **Leaves** 1. For interns working 3 days in a week: 9 1. For interns working 4 days in a week: 12
> **Accommodation** Unfurnished shared accommodation only for outstation candidatesRs. subject to availability
> **Certificate** A certificate of completion of internship program by SEBI.
> **Other Perks** 1. Public holidays as observed by SEBI. 1. Lunch at SEBI office.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student pursuing a full-time MBA/MCA or equivalent degree or diploma of a duration of two years from an eligible institute.
1. The applicant should hold a full-time graduate degree in engineering or a BCA degree.
1. The applicant should have a strong aptitude for computer programming and data analytics.
1. The applicant should have a minimum 60% aggregate marks at graduate level or equivalent CGPA
1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 30 years as on 1st January of the respective year.
1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen.

**NOTE:** A basic understanding of financial markets is desirable but not mandatory.

name: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
brief_description:
The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme that provides to encourage V.J.N.T. & S.B.C. students and promotes their interest in Technical education.
The Scheme Objective is to encourage V.J.N.T. & S.B.C. students and to promote the interest in Technical education vide G.R. No. EBC-1079/ 56243/ D-1 dated 7/5/1983 Govt. has introduced a scheme named as Award to I.T.I. students is given Rs.40/- p.m. stipend through Technical Education Department and Rs. 60/- p.m. stipend through this Department. For the student who has not been given a stipend from Technical Education DepartmentRs. Rs.100/- p.m. as a stipend is being given to these VJNT and SBC students by this Dept.

eligibility: 1. Students should belong to V.J.N.T. or S.B.C category. 1. Students should be trainees of approved I.T.I. 1. The parent/Guardian's income should be up to 65290/- per year. 1. The selection process is completed by the Principal of the concerned ITI.

name: Disability Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Disability Assistance for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under the schemeRs. a lump sum financial assistance of 1.50 lakh to 3.00 lakh is given to registered workers on the basis of the percentage of disability which occurred due to an accident at the workplace during the course of employment.
benefits:
On the basis of the percentage of disabilityRs. a lump sum financial assistance will be given to registered workers as under:
**Sl. No.** **Percentage of Disability****Amount to be Paid** 1 Upto 50% Disability 1Rs./-2 51% to 75% Disability 2Rs./-
3 76% or above 3Rs./-
eligibility:

**Note 02:** The disability Certificates in regard to the percentage of disability issued by the Government Medical Board.

name: Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- will be given to registered construction workers for the purchase of a bicycle once in 3 years. The benefits of the scheme will be given only to register workers who have 1 year of continuous membership of the welfare board.
benefits: 1. The registered worker will be provided 3000/- for the purchase of the bicycle.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
2. The registered worker should have a minimum of one-year regular membership.
3. The worker may avail of the benefits only once in 3 years.
**Note:** The beneficiary needs to submit an undertaking for the purchase of the bicycle giving the priceRs. trademarkRs. sourceRs. and date.

name: Financial Assistance To Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Disabled Children (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2000/- per month is given to the children of registered workers who are declared by the medical authority 50% or more physically or mentally disabled. FurtherRs. it is necessary for the registered worker to have regular membership of one year for availing of the benefits of the scheme.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 2000/- per month is provided to the children of registered workers who are declared by the medical authority 50% or more physically or mentally disabled.
eligibility:
1. The construction worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one-year regular membership.
1. The registered worker who has dependent children with 50% or more physical/mental disability is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The worker should have a disability certificate of 50% or more physical or mental disability of his/her dependent children issued by the District Medical Board.
1. The dependent child's name has to be included in the ration card.
1. The dependent child of the registered worker has not availed of the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year from any other Haryana Government Department/Board/Corporation.
1. The dependent child of the worker should not have any source of income.
1. The dependent child of the worker should not be married.

**Note:** The worker has to submit/upload the live certificate of the dependent child every year to continue the financial assistance under the scheme.

name: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
brief_description: To promote girl education by motivating Saharia tribe girl students of Baran district to study in higher education and provide financial assistance to Sahariya tribe girl students for encouragement for higher secondary education. Those who are studying regularly in government schools in higher secondary classes (11th and 12th) and who have not got accommodation in government hostels.
benefits: The student will be paid 3Rs./- for a total of 10 months at the rate of Rs. 350/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The girl student should belong to the Saharia tribe of the Baran district of Rajasthan.
1. The girl child should be studying regularly in a government school.
1. The mother/father/guardian/guardian of the student should not be an income taxpayer.
1. The girl studentsRs. who are studying in residential schools/ashram hostels run by the governmentRs. they will not be entitled.
1. Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar should be there.
1. Students should be a native of Rajasthan.

name: Vayomadhuram Scheme For Providing Glucometer To Senior Citizens
brief_description:
The scheme Vayomadhuram Scheme for Providing Glucometer to Senior Citizens was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Kerala has the largest number of diabetes patients in India and 19.4% of people have diabetes in Kerala on the basis of studies conducted by ICMR (Indian Council of Medical Research). 80% of the old-age population in Kerala suffers from diabetes.
The Government of Kerala has started this scheme which provides glucometers freely to elderly diabetic persons coming under Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. Under this schemeRs. the Government will provide glucometers to 1000 diabetic old age persons in each district of Kerala State.
benefits:
- Glucometers are provided freely to elderly diabetic persons coming under Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
- Glucometers are provided to 1000 diabetic old age persons in each district of Kerala.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicants age has to be 60 years or above.
1. The applicants should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. An authorized Doctor has to certify that the applicant is suffering from diabetes.

**Note:** If there are a large number of applicantsRs. priority will be given to older persons.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah / Nikaah Yojana
brief_description: Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah Yojana" with the objective to provide financial assistance to needy girls/widows (Kalyani)/abandoned sisters at the time of their marriage.
benefits:
- To the Bride

1. Account Payee Check : Rs: 11Rs./-
1. Marriage Gift : Rs. 38Rs./-



- Amount: Rs.6Rs./- per girlRs. to the mass marriage organizing body.
eligibility:
1. The guardian of the bride/groom should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The bride has completed the prescribed age for marriage (At presentRs. the minimum legal age for marriage for a girl is 18 years and the minimum legal age for a man is 21 years).
1. Abandoned women who have been legally divorced.
1. There will be no restriction on income for the beneficiary to get assistance under the schemeRs. but it will be necessary that the beneficiary should get his marriage done only by participating in the group marriage program to be organized on the scheduled dates. In case of a single marriageRs. the benefit of the scheme will not be available.

name: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
brief_description: The "Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training to Sex Workers and Sexually Abused Women) SchemeRs. 2013 (PRABHAT)" by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of GoaRs. provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodiesRs. who are involved in the rehabilitation of sex workers.
benefits:
_(For availing of the benefit under this scheme the victim has to reside in Goa)_
> **Financial Assistance** The beneficiary (excluding victims housed in Protective Home) will be provided with a stipend of 2Rs./- per month for a period of three months or till she joins a livelihood programmeRs. whichever is earlier.
> **Technical/Vocational Training** Based on their literacyRs. skillsRs. interestRs. etcRs. the Mentor/Probation Officer will help the beneficiary to join a technical/vocational training programme of the Government or Non-Government institutesRs. emphasizing on the training programmes which has opportunities for jobs or setting up their own enterpriseRs. such asRs. repair of the home appliancesRs. mobile repairRs. beauty treatmentRs. tailoringRs. bakeryRs. cateringRs. etc. The feesRs. travel and other miscellaneous expenses will be covered.
> **Education** The beneficiaryRs. if she is interested in pursuing her educationRs. will be supported for her education till 12th Standard. All the expenses related to her educationRs. boardingRs. travelRs. feesRs. booksRs. toiletriesRs. etc.Rs. may be paid.
> **Shelter** If in need of shelterRs. she shall be admitted to a shelter home/protective home being managed by a non-Government organization or Government organization or organization receiving grants from the State/Central Government.
> **Psycho-Social Services** A victim of commercial sexual exploitation will be provided counselling by Probation Officer or by a person appointed as Mentor or by a professional counsellor or psychiatrist working in a Government or non-Government organization. Expenses incurred for feesRs. travelRs. medicineRs. etc.Rs. will be covered.
> **Health** The victim shall be provided health services for all kinds of ailments at the Government hospital. Victims suffering from HIV or Tuberculosis will be connected to ART and DOTS schemes. In cases where the victim is suffering from AIDS and requires institutional careRs. she shall be admitted to one of the care centres meant for people with HIV/AIDSRs. for a period of six months.
> **Children** The children of the trafficked victim shall be provided counselling and assistance for admission in the school by the Probation Officer or by a person appointed as a Mentor. All the expenses related to the education of the childrenRs. such as boardingRs. travelRs. feesRs. booksRs. toiletriesRs. etc.Rs. up to 12th Standard shall be covered.
> **Reintegration** The Probation Officer or Mentor shall help the victim in reintegrating with her family and community by providing counselling to the family members and if necessary to the members of the community.
> **Protection** The Probation Officer or Mentor shall take the assistance of the family membersRs. community membersRs. religious leaderRs. local police and Integrated Anti-human Trafficking Unit of Goa police in ensuring that the victim is not harassed by the traffickers. The Probation Officer or Mentor may also make a written complaint to the Chairperson of the Goa State Commission for WomenRs. for victims' protection and the Commission shall take necessary action to protect the victim.
> **Livelihood (a)** The Probation Officer or Mentor shall assist her in finding a jobRs. based on her interests and skills. In case the victim is unable to get a job or is not interested in a jobRs. then the Probation Officer or Mentor based on the interestRs. skill and viability of a business shall help her in setting up a business enterprise.
> **Livelihood (b)** Those victims who have successfully completed the vocational training may be provided all the support by the Probation Officer/Mentor for preparation of project reportsRs. availing loan from financial institutions etc. The Department may provide such financial assistance to the victim for setting up business enterprises as may be decided by the Government from time to time.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the Women and Children who are victims of Commercial Sexual Exploitation.
1. The applicant should be either residing in Goa or be a native of Goa.

**NOTE 1:** The place of commercial sexual exploitation is not a criterion for eligibility (women and girls from Goa being commercially sexually exploited outside Goa also qualify).

name: Widow Daughter Marriage Scheme
brief_description:
Department of WCDRs. Delhi Government is implementing various Financial Assistance Schemes for the benefit of different sections of the society through Financial Assistance Cell. Department of Women and Child Development is running **Widows Daughter Marriage(WDM) Scheme** for the benefit of widows/women in distress.
**AIMS AND OBJECTIVE**

1. To provide financial assistance to the poor widows for performing the marriage of their daughters(up to two daughters).
1. To provide financial assistance to the guardians including Homes/Institutions or foster parents of an orphan girl for her marriage.
1. This is a one-time grant.
benefits: 1. The Quantum of assistance for this scheme is 30Rs./- only.
eligibility:
1. The financial assistance can be granted for performing marriage up to two daughters only.
1. Residence of a minimum of 5 years in Delhi before the date of application.
1. The income of the applicant should be less than Rs 1Rs./-Per year from all sources (including rentRs. interest/dividends on savings & investmentsRs. earnings from the farmRs. property sale proceedsRs. etc.) of the applicant.
1. Applicant should have an Aadhar number.
1. The Applicant should have a single-operated Aadhaar-linked account with any bank in the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi only.
1. The applicant should not be in receipt of any assistance from the discretionary fund of the Lt. Governor or the Chief Minister of Delhi for the same purpose.
1. The girl for whose marriage the Financial Assistance is soughtRs. should be major on the date of marriage i.e.Rs. above 18 years of age.
1. The application must be submitted within a period of sixty daysRs. before or after the date of marriage being solemnized.
1. The applicant should not be receiving any pension from Central Govt./State Govt./MCD and/or NDMC or any other source for this purpose.

name: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category) was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. the Government of Kerala provides financial assistance to inter-caste married couples (except SC/ST category) who suffer from financial problems.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance of 30Rs./- will be given to inter-caste married couples.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The inter-caste married couples who are legally married are eligible for financial assistance.
1. The combined family income of the couple should not exceed 1Rs./-.
1. The couples are entitled to financial assistance one-time only.
1. The couples must apply for financial assistance after one year of marriage but not exceeding 2 years from the date of marriage.

**Note 01:** The financial assistance should be utilized for purposes like starting a businessRs. for the purchase of landRs. or for the construction of a house. The Local Self Government Institutions (LSGIs) should ensure that funds are being utilized for the said purposes.
**Note 02:** While receiving financial assistanceRs. couples will be required to sign an agreement and submit it to the LSGIs.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme was launched by the Department of Social Welfare & Women EmpowermentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme is also called the Pudhumai Penn Scheme and has been launched to enhance the enrolment ratio of girls from Government schools to Higher Education Institutions. The enrolment ratio of girl students from Government schools in higher education is very low and to promote higher education among girls belonging to economically weaker familiesRs. the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Marriage Assistance scheme shall be transformed as the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme.
**Salient Features of this scheme:**
By providing financial benefits to the girl studentsRs. this programme negotiates a behavioral change in the area of reduction in higher incidences of early marriage and a low ratio of enrolment in higher educationRs. and retention of girl students in higher education. ThereforeRs. this scheme envisages the empowerment of girls specifically those who have passed out from Government schools.

- Promotes girl students' educational status and instills motivation to pursue higher education giving them a better foundation in both economic and social spheres including improving gender parity at higher levels.
- Enables the creation and participation of skilled women workforce.
- Financial benefits enable girl children to pursue education without incurring additional expenses and hindrances.
- Enable Girl Students to get involved in public spaces and enhance career opportunities.
- Ensures Socio-Economic Empowerment of Women.
- Prevents dropouts beyond higher secondary and increases the retention ratio in higher education.
- The cash incentive is extended to any number of girl students in a family pursuing higher education at recognized Institutions / Colleges / Universities.
- A Separate Programme Management Unit (SPMU) for the scheme is to be established for monitoring the effective implementation of the scheme.

**Steering/Monitoring/Committee:**

- A State level Steering Committee will be constituted to review and monitor and coordinate all matters relating to the implementation of the scheme. The State level Steering Committee headed by Chief Secretary will meet twice in a year (at ACS / Principal Secretary Level).
- State Level Monitoring Committees (Department HODs) will be constituted under the Chairmanship of the Director of Social Welfare which will meet once in 3 months and coordinate with all line departments and report periodically to State Level Steering Committee
- District Level Monitoring Committee will be constituted under the Chairmanship of District Collectors which will meet every month and review the progress on a monthly basis.
benefits:
1. All girl students who studied from Classes 6th to 12th in Government schools will be paid 1Rs./- per month till the completion of their undergraduate degreeRs. diplomaRs. ITIRs. and any other recognized course.
1. The assistance amount under this scheme will be disbursed directly into the students Bank Account.
1. The students shall be eligible for this in addition to other scholarships.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be residing in the state of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be a female to avail of benefits from this scheme.
1. All girl students who studied from Classes 6th to 12th in Government schools of Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The assistance can be extended to any number of girl students in a family pursuing higher education at recognized Institutions/Colleges/Universities.
1. The girl students should pursue their education in recognized courses and colleges/universities.
1. Only the first course of higher education will be considered as an eligible factor.

**Note 01:** The girl students availing of other scholarships are also eligible to enroll in this scheme.
**Note 02:** The higher education department facilitates opening a "zero balance" bank account and certifying every six months in a year viz.Rs. 30th June and 31st December on the bonafide status of the girl students who had applied.
**Note 03:** Four core banks viz.Rs. Indian BankRs. Canara BankRs. Indian Overseas BankRs. and SBI have been identified to open bank accounts to the students wherever necessary to furnish the debit card.

name: Internship Scheme For Students Of Counselling/ Psychology/ Social Work/ Home Science Etc
brief_description:
This is an Internship Scheme by the Directorate of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Goa. The objective of this scheme is to offer aspiring postgraduate students an opportunity for internship facilities to be trained as qualified interns in state-run private children's and shelter homes who can be offered hands-on job training experience. The scheme is open to any student who has passed out from any of the recognised universities with a Master's Degree in Social Service/ Social Work/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Home Science/ Post Graduate Diploma in Counselling etc.
> **Number** The total number of slots for interns per year shall be fixed at 15Rs. extendable upto 20.
> **Duration** The period of internship shall be for a maximum of twelve months.
> **Location** The selected interns will have to undergo training and work at the following places: 1. State-Run Children's Home. 1. Protective Home for Women. 1. Juvenile Justice Boards. 1. Child Welfare Committees. 1. At any other Children's HomeRs. Shelter Homes etc recognized by the Government.
> **Reporting** The Interns shall work as per directions and under total supervision of the officers in charge at the respective place of deployment during the period of internship or when deployed for field work at any place for preparation of Probation Officers' reports or for Home study report inquiries etc.
benefits:
> **Allowance** The interns shall be paid 15Rs./- lumpsum as internship allowance per month and for part of the month shall be paid on a pro-rata basis.
**Leaves** 1 (One) Paid Leave per Month during the training period.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have passed out from any of the recognised universities with a Master's Degree.
1. The Master's Degree should have been in Social Service/ Social Work/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Home Science/ Post Graduate Diploma in Counselling etc.
1. The applicant should have passed out as a post-graduate within three years prior to applying for the internship.
1. The applicant should have obtained at least 50% marks in aggregate in the final year of the postgraduation.

name: Chief Ministers College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)
brief_description:
The Chief Ministers College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)' implemented by the Directorate of University & Higher EducationRs. Govt. of Manipur aims at providing the required educational facilities to the displaced and affected undergraduate students because of the prevailing social unrest in the state. This scheme is initiated to enable such students to continue with their education without interruption.
> **Objectives** 1. To facilitate the transfer of students from the present college to a new college as per the request made by the students. 1. To provide free admission/waiver for affected students in the Government and Government Aided Colleges of Manipur for the academic session. 1. To provide monetary grants to the affected undergraduate students for the purchase of booksRs. stationeryRs. uniforms and other requirements for continuing with their education. 1. To control the dropout rate of the students at the undergraduate level as envisaged under NEP 2020. 1. To maintain a healthy Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) of the students in the colleges of Manipur as provided under NEP 2020. 1. To encourage a hybrid/blended mode of learning in higher education by making provisions for the availability of IT gadgets and software etc. to the affected students.
> **Notification** The notification for application shall be published in major newspapers of the state and announced on All India Radio/Local TV Channels. The tentative timeline for notification will be around **3rd week of July 2023**.
> **Helpdesk** The general public that any query on the scheme may be obtained by dialling the dedicated Mobile Number **7085303429** from 10 AM to 4 PM on all working days.
benefits:
**Component 1:** _Directly Affected Students_ 1. Transfer to a new college (as per request). 1. Free admission for 2023-24 (Admission amount ranging from 5Rs. to 9Rs. as per the stream/subjects offered). 1. One-time rehabilitation grant of 10Rs./- (5Rs./- as book/stationery grant and 2Rs./- for uniform and 3Rs. for miscellaneous expenditure) 1. Free Smart Phones under CMCMESS. 1. Provision for free sanitary pads and sports equipment under UHEHFS (for girl students)
**Component 2:** _Inter-College Transfer Facility_ 1. Transfer to a new college (as per request). 1. Free admission for 2023-24 (Admission amount ranging from 5Rs. to 9Rs. as per the stream/subjects offered)Rs. wherever applicable.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in an Undergraduate Programme.
1. The applicant should be studying in a Government or Government Aided College.
1. The college should be located in the state of Manipur.

name: Financial Incentives To Mothers Who Deliver A Girl Child (Mamta)
brief_description:
The scheme "Financial Incentives to Mothers who Deliver a Girl Child (Mamta)" is a scheme of Financial Assistance by the Directorate of Women And Child DevelopmentRs. Govt. of Goa. The objective of the Mamta Scheme is aimed at improving the Female Child Sex Ratio in the State. The scheme is open to all mothers who deliver a live Girl Child (max. 02 deliveries) in a registered medical institution.
> **Implementing Agency** The scheme shall be implemented through the ICDS i.e. Child Development Project OfficerRs. Mukhya SevikasRs. and Anganwadi Worker at Taluka/Block Level and Viliage Level respectively.
benefits:
1. 10Rs./- as a one-time financial incentive (at the birth of the child). 1. Those beneficiaries who had applied for the 1st Installment of 5Rs./- (as on the date of this Amended Scheme published in the Official Gazette) shall be eligible for 10Rs./- as per the amended scheme.
**NOTE 1:** Those beneficiaries who were paid the 1st Installment of 5Rs./- under the existing scheme shall be eligible for only the balance amount (2nd instalment) of 5Rs./- (to apply within 45 days from the date of the Amended Scheme published in the official Gazette).
> **Mode of Disbursal** The benefits are directly credited to the declared Bank Account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a mother who has delivered a live Girl Child in a registered medical institution.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for at least three years. OR
1. The applicant should be married to a resident of Goa.
1. The application for the scheme should have been made within 45 days of the delivery.

**NOTE:** The scheme is available to all mothersRs. irrespective of their social/economic status.

name: Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
brief_description:
The Honorable Chief MinisterRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh on January 28Rs. 2023 in entire Madhya Pradesh Announced the implementation of "Mukhya Mantri Ladli Behna Yojana". This will be an important step in the direction of women's health and nutrition and economic self-reliance.
The implementation of the scheme will not only reflect the improvement in the health and nutritional status of women and children dependent on themRs. but women will be financially more independent than before to spend according to their priority. Women will not only develop self-employment/livelihood resources using locally available resources with the financial assistance receivedRs. but will also be able to play an effective role in their decision-making at the family level.
benefits:
- An amount of 1Rs./- per month will be paid to each eligible woman in her eligibility period in the own Aadhaar linked DBT enabled bank account.
- If a woman is below the age of 60 years and already receiving less than 1Rs./- per month under any other Social Security Pension SchemeRs. then that woman will be reimbursed up to 1Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. Applicants must be local residents of Madhya Pradesh.
1. Applicants must be marriedRs. including widowsRs. divorced and abandoned women.
1. Should have completed 23 years and less than 60 years of age as on January 01Rs. in the calendar year of application.

name: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme For Higher Education For Orphans
brief_description: "Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme for Higher Education for Orphans" is a Fee Waiver Scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The objective of this scheme is to support the educational needs of the children who are orphaned of both parents i.e. father and mother and are deprived of higher education for want of financial resources. The Scheme envisages taking care of such children from their Undergraduate Course to the Post Graduate Course in the areas of General Education and Technical Education. The Scheme will be operated by the Directorate of Higher Education for students pursuing courses in General Education and by the Directorate of Technical Education for students pursuing Technical Education.
benefits:
1. A full waiver of the fees that were supposed to have been paid by the beneficiary in the Institutions where they have sought the admissions.
1. The amount of fee waiver shall consist of Tuition feesRs. Library feesRs. Laboratory fees and Development feesRs. if any plus other charges payable to Institution like Lodging/BoardingRs. Food (Hostel charges) or TransportRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have been born in Goa or have resided in Goa for at least the last fifteen (15) years.
1. The applicant should have passed his/her qualifying examination from any of the Institutions located in Goa.
1. The applicant should be an Orphan.
1. The applicant should be enrolled for the First Year of their Degree/PG Courses.

name: Short Term Professional Training Courses
brief_description:
The "Short Term Professional Training Courses" is provided by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa to train the youth of the Scheduled Tribe Community in order to start their own business. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the beneficiaries of the Scheduled Tribe community to acquire skills by joining the various training courses for the purpose of self-employment or for their livelihood.
> **Definition** Any training that would directly improve any individuals ability to perform his or her current/new job/self-employment.
> **Duration** Not more than 3 months and not less than 15 days.
> **Recognition/Affiliation** Registered with any of the Government Departments/Government Institutions/Government Autonomous Bodies in the State of Goa.
benefits:
> **List of Courses** 1. Motor Driving Training Course. 1. Tailoring Course. 1. Cookery and Bakery Courses. 1. Beautician Course. 1. Mobile Repairing Courses. 1. Computer Courses.
> **Quantum of Financial Assistance** 1. Financial assistance will be given to complete any one course with a maximum limit of 5Rs./-. 1. 50% of the actual fees with a limit of 2Rs./- shall be released as an advance to take admission in the particular course. 1. 50% balance amount will be released after the completion of the course on the production of the completion certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe Community of Goa.
1. The applicant shall be above 18 years of age and below the age of 50 years.

name: Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana
brief_description:
The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh introduced the "Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana" on March 4Rs. 2010Rs. through the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." This initiative is designed to provide benefits to registered female construction workers during pregnancy. The scheme applies to both male and female beneficiaries who are registered and possess a beneficiary identity card at least 90 days before the scheme application date.
**Note:** The name of this scheme was changed from "Bhagini Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" to "Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana" on May 12Rs. 2022.
benefits: > A lump sum amount of 20Rs./- will be provided to the registered female construction worker after the birth of the child.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh. 1. The applicant should be a woman worker. 1. The applicant should be registered Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The benefit will only be provided for only first two children. 1. The applicant should be registered as a construction worker 90 days in advance.
**Note:** In case of the death of the beneficiary female worker during deliveryRs. the payment of the Assistance Scheme will be payable to her husband (full amount).

name: Gopal Ratna Award Scheme
brief_description:
"Gopal Ratna Award Scheme" by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Govt. of Goa. This scheme was introduced in order to honour the eminent personalities in the field of Dairy Farming. This scheme intends to appreciate the achievement of Dairy Farmers for the highest individual milk production by undertaking scientific Dairy Farming in the State of Goa and encouraging youth to take up the Dairy Business.
> **Objectives** 1. To honour the eminent personalities in the field of Dairy Farming. 1. To felicitate and appreciate the dairy farmers for achieving the highest milk production by undertaking scientific Dairy Farming in the State. 1. To encourage the dairy farmers to undertake Dairy activities as a Business. 1. To make the State self-sufficient in milk production.
benefits: 1. The selected dairy farmer shall be honoured with the Gopal Ratna Award constituting a Certificate of AppreciationRs. Memento and **cash prize of 1Rs./-**.1. The award will be conferred upon the selected beneficiary on Independence Day i.e. 15th August at the hands of the Honourable Chief Minister of the State.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a dairy farmer.
1. The applicant should have given extraordinary contributions in the field of dairy farming by achieving the highest milk production in the State.
1. The applicant should be a member of the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help GroupRs. registered with the concerned Department.
1. The applicant has to register his dairy farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services through the respective Area Officers of Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Goa for at least the preceding five yearsRs. owning a cattle shed with milch animals in the State of Goa.
1. The applicant shall produce and pour a minimum of 1Rs. litres of milk in the preceding year (April to March) with a minimum average of 250 litres of milk per dayRs. to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group.

name: Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology
brief_description:
The programme Chief Ministers Career Advancement in Biotechnology (CM-CAB) aims at providing opportunities to Young Faculty and Scientists in Biotechnology to have national and/or international collaborative research training and exposure to advanced techniques and technologies in emerging fields of biotechnology. The fellowship is envisaged to help the candidate further his/her research capability and expertise to contribute to higher education with a global perspective as well as to forge long-term relationships with distinguished experts in these fields.
> **Fellowship Duration:**

The duration of the fellowship will be 3-6 monthsRs. where the host institution is from abroad. In the cases where the host institution is within IndiaRs. the fellowship will be for 3-12 months.
> **Host Institution:**

The applicant should produce along with the application a consent letter from a Host faculty/ scientist that details his/her willingness to host the fellow in their institute or laboratory. The consent letter should clearly mention that the host faculty/scientist will extend the facilities to the fellow to carry out the proposed work.
> **Terms and conditions of the Fellowship:**


- A progress report has to be submitted to the Kerala State Council for ScienceRs. Technology and Environment/Kerala Bio-Technology Commission (KSCSTE/KBC) every six months with the remarks of the Host faculty/scientist where they are undertaking research.
- On completion of the tenure of the CM-CAB fellowshipRs. the fellow must submit a detailed consolidated report of research work done during the entire period of fellowship and audited statements of expenditure to the KSCSTE/KBC.
- No fellow shall discontinue his/her CM-CAB fellowship without prior approval of KSCSTE/KBC. In case he/she wishes to discontinue the fellowship prior to completion of the tenureRs. he/she must submit the resignation to the KSCSTE/KBC through the Mentor Scientist and the Head of the Institution indicating specific reasons for not continuing the fellowship. In such casesRs. the Fellow shall be required to refund the whole of the expenditure incurred on him/her during the fellowship period to KSCSTE-KBC
- The CM-CAB fellow shall inform KSCSTE/KBC about any achievementsRs. patentsRs. and submission/publication of any research paper arising out of the research work done during the tenure of the PD fellowship.
- Due acknowledgment of KSCSTE/KBC shall be given in all the publications/patents emanating from the research work.
benefits:
1. Fellowship of USD 1500 per month (in equivalent Indian Currency) in cases where the host institution is outside India.
1. The fellowship will be 50Rs./- per month if the host institution is within India.
1. A contingency grant to meet the expenses for local travelRs. VISA feesRs. insuranceRs. etc. will also be paid as per actuals subjected to a ceiling of 50Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The fellowship is offered to a scientist/faculty who is a permanent employee of an academic/research institute in Kerala State.
1. The candidates must be officially sponsored by their employer/head of the institution with the commitment to depute them for research/training under CM-CAB.
1. The applicant should possess a Ph.D. degree in biotechnology-related subjects.
1. The applicant should have a proven record of independent research work evidenced by publications in peer-reviewedRs. indexed journals and patents.
1. Age Limit 37 yearsRs. with 5 years relaxation in the case of SC/ST and/or Women Candidates.

**Note:** The pay and allowances during the fellowship period will have to be paid by the institution to the candidate.

name: Financial Assistance to ST Students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
brief_description:
"Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa. Under this schemeRs. additional financial assistance of upto 15Rs./- is provided to the Scheduled Tribe Students as the maintenance allowance given under the Post Matric Scholarship is inadequate to meet the expenses on food & travel.
> **Duration** Scholarships for studying in any class will be available for only one year.
benefits:
1. An Additional Maintenance Allowance of 7Rs./- to Day Scholars for 10 Months.
1. An Additional Maintenance Allowance of 15Rs./- to Hostellers for 10 Months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) in the State of Goa.
1. The student should be a regularRs. full-time student studying in a recognized Institution / University.
1. The applicant should have availed or should be eligible for Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship during the current Academic Year.
1. The income of parents/guardians of the applicant should not exceed 5Rs. per annum.

**NOTE:** If a student has to repeat a classRs. he/she shall not be eligible to get a scholarship for a second time in the same class.

name: Snehasparsham
brief_description:
The Government of Kerala has launched the Snehasparsham scheme to protect and help unwed mothers. The problems of unwed mothers are linked with various socio-economic and cultural variables. In KeralaRs. this problem is coupled with the ignorance and exploitation of the backward classes. It has been pointed out that there are many women in Wayanad and other districts of Kerala who are victims of social exploitation and atrocities and are often forced to become unmarried mothers. Unwed mothers have a special need for educationRs. employmentRs. and health care especially reproductive and child health. Quite often they are neglected from the mainstream of life. The percentage of abortion-related hazards and death is high among teenage unwed mothers.
As a part of this schemeRs. the Government is giving 1000/- per month to them. One curious fact that can be noted is that the women who are exploited never blame the person who caused their miseryRs. largely due to their style of living. At a young ageRs. they long for love and care. Their husbands do not stay with them for long. They go in search of jobs and sometimes do not come back. Their place is taken up by someone else whom these women believe in. ThereforeRs. their condition becomes pathetic and it becomes necessary to address their problems too.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 1000/- per month will be given to unwed mothers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be an unwed mother.
1. The applicant should be under 65 years.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other pension schemes of the government.

**Note:** The applicant must be an account holder in a post office.

name: Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
brief_description: In 2019Rs. Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker. With this schemeRs. family will able to get the financials benefits after the death or disability of the unorganized worker.
benefits: **Situation****Financial Help**On Death 1Rs./-Permanent Disability 50Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Unorganized workers must be between the ages of 18 and 60 are eligible.
1. Unorganized workers must be registered as beneficiaries under Section 10 (3) of the Act.
1. Assistance will not be provided in the case of death due to suicideRs. drug or substance abuseRs. or death due to fighting with each other with the intent to commit a crime.
1. Benefits will be given only on the death of the registered worker and not on the death or accident of a family member.
1. Beneficiaries who have benefited from the Financial Assistance and Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme for unorganized workers suffering from silicosis run by the Board will not be eligible.

name: Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers
brief_description:
Certain communities among the Other Backward Classes are engaged in traditional occupations including pottery. Traditional pottery workers are following conventional methods for manufacturing products and face tough competition in the market. In this circumstanceRs. this traditional industry has to be revived by imparting training to pottery workers on modern methods/techniques of production and also by providing financial assistance to mechanize and modernize the sector.
In view of the aboveRs. the scheme Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers is launched by the Backword Classes Development DepartmentRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided to Traditional Pottery makers belonging to the state OBC category for the purchase of modern machinery for job modernization.
benefits: 1. The financial assistance of 25Rs./- will be provided to the Traditional Pottery Makers for upgrading the occupation and purchasing machinery.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Kerala State.
2. The applicant should belong to the State Backward Community of Kerala State.
3. The applicant should be currently engaged in a traditional pottery-making occupation.
4. The annual family income of the applicant should be 1Rs./-.

name: Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts
brief_description:
> **Introduction:**

A sizeable population of OBCs is engaged in traditional occupations like handicraftsRs. jewellery makingRs. metalworkRs. weavingRs. etc. Due to these low-paid occupations and due to modern technological intervention they face tough competition in the market which creates a feeling of inferiority and incapacity threatening their very existence. In order to have the traditional occupation as a sustainable self-employment and income-generating source for the families of traditional craftsmen their traditional skills need to be upgraded and they need to be equipped with modern technology to meet the market demands. The scheme is intended for the above purpose of improving the productivity and competitiveness of the traditional OBC craftsmen ensuring quality goods for enhanced income and thereby qualitative improvement in their living conditions.
There are several craftsman communities among OBCs such as ViswakarmaRs. Padmasaliya chekkala etc. The Scheme envisages providing modern skill training and Tool Kits for these groups.
> **Aims/Objectives:**

1. To create awareness among the skilled and semiskilled OBC workers on the need to adopt new technology in the highly technological eraRs. for meeting the market needs.
2. To ensure sustainable self-employment for fair livelihood.
3. To ensure social justice through the overall economic development of the traditional craftsmen communities.
> **Implementation:**

The DirectorRs. the Backward Communities Development Department will implement the scheme through Regional Deputy Directors of the Department. Tie-up shall be made with KSBCDC for training and loan for the scheme.
> **Monitoring and Evaluation:**

The DirectorRs. BCDD will monitor and evaluate the scheme periodically.
> **Traditional craftsmen community:**

1. Viswakaramas (Asari ChaptegraRs. KallassaryRs. KalthachanRs. KammalaRs. KamsalaRs. KannanRs. KaruvanRs. KitaranRs. KollanRs. Malayala KammalaRs. MoosariRs. PandikammalaRs. PandithattanRs. PerumkolllanRs. ThachanRs. ThattanRs. VilkurupRs. VillasanRs. Viswabrahmanan or Viswabrahmanar and Viswakarmala)
2. SaliyaRs. Chaliya (Chaliya)
3. Tholkollans
4. Moopar or Kallan Mooppan or Kallan Mooppar.
benefits:
1. The training costsRs. stipend (if found necessary)Rs. and tool kit grant together shall be limited to 25000/-.
2. The training and stipend portion is limited to 5000/-.
3. The maximum period of training will be three months.
**Note 01:** The focus will be on machinery and equipment.
**Note 02:** The tools developed by reputed institutions will be encouraged amongst the craftsmen.
**Note 03:** The choice of tools and machinery will be based on the occupation.
**Note 04**: The beneficiaries can freely select whichever agency to procure equipment.
**Note 05:** The grant is for modernization of traditional occupation i.e. for procurement of modern tools and machinery.
**Note 06:** The grant should not be used as working capital.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Kerala State.
2. The applicant should belong to the State Backward Communities of Kerala State.
3. The applicant should be engaged in traditional craftwork/skilled work.
4. The upper age limit of the applicant should be 60 years.
5. The annual family income of the applicant should be 1Rs./-.
**Note 01:** Those having more than two girl children shall get preference.
**Note 02:** The differently abled person shall get preference.
**Note 03:** Those having more than 10 years of experience shall get preference.

name: Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture
brief_description:
The scheme Financial Assistance to ReviveRs. Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture by the Directorate of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa has been designed with the objective of encouraging Goan Folk artists to reviveRs. preserve and protect the Goan Maand culture consisting of folk forms viz. ZagorRs. RanmalleRs. KalloRs. Perni ZagorRs. TalgadiRs. TonyamellRs. ShigmoRs. ChalleRs. NamanRs. JatigayanRs. GoffRs. Dhallo-Fugadi and folklore and folk music viz. SuvarivadanRs. GhumatvadanRs. ShamelvadanRs. Dholvadan and any other folk formsRs. folklore and folk music as selected by the committee of experts which basically originated from Goan Maand.
> **Objectives** 1. To reviveRs. preserve and protect the Goan Maand culture that has produced various folk art forms and folk music and folklores in the State of Goa. 1. To maintain bonding of unity integrity and brotherhood amongst the villagers to uplift the cultural bondage and carry the tradition for future generations. 1. To provide necessary infrastructure and financial support for the purpose. 1. To preserve and protect the old age traditions of Maand culture to its unique original formRs. keeping the Maand culture authenticRs. and intact by providing all kinds of infrastructure to the Maand group within the ambit of cultural structure. 1. To support existing Maand groups that are on the verge of extinction. 1. To create cultural interaction between village to village in the form of a village exchange programme. 1. To create a legacy of Maand artists through folk programmes at StateRs. National and International levels.
benefits:
> **Nature and Quantum of Assistance**
1. The honorarium to Maand Guru/Trainer shall be 9Rs./- per month. 1. The honorarium to the Assistant shall be 6Rs./- per month. 1. The stipend to trainees shall be 1Rs./- per month. (Each Maand group may consist of at least thirty artists/trainees). 1. Financial assistance of 50Rs./- will be provided to purchase folk instruments (a list of the required musical instruments should be attached). 1. Financial assistance of 40Rs./- will be provided towards the upkeep of Maand culture (repairs of old musical instruments and Maand place). 1. Financial assistance upto 60Rs./- to purchase costumes and drapery for the performance. 1. (The exact quantum will be decided by the committee of experts as per the requirement). 1. Financial assistance of 25Rs./- will be provided to upkeep and maintain the place of Maand. (daily cleaning and floor maintenance).
[**NOTE:** The Financial Assistance provided in point 4Rs. and 7 above shall be for the duration of the training course.]
eligibility:
1. The Maand group should have a legacy of practising folk art forms for at least the past thirty years at such a traditional Maand place. 1. The applicants who desire to join training under this scheme shall not be less than 10 years of age. Whereas any old age folk artist in the course of training could share their experience and guide the new generation with kind co-operation from Maand Guru.
> **Relaxation / Preference / Priority** Preference will be given to those Goan Maand culture which are on the verge of extinction.

name: Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)
brief_description: The scheme "Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)" also known as "SRE (R&R) Scheme" was also introduced in 1989-90 by the Jammu and Kashmir DivisionRs. Ministry of Home Affairs to support the relief and rehabilitation of the Kashmiri migrants who have been uprooted from the Valley during the militancy period besides other relief & rehabilitation measures. It provides for 100% reimbursement. 60% of the amount is reimbursed upfront on receipt of claims and the remaining 40% is released after receipt of the audit report. It broadly covers relief to Kashmiri and Jammu migrantsRs. expenditure incurred on PM's package for return and rehabilitation of Kashmiri migrantsRs. relief to NoKs of civilians/security personnel killed in militant-related attacksRs. rehabilitation of surrendered militants etc. "SRE (R&R) Scheme" is a component of the Umbrella schemeRs. 'Modernization of Police Forces (MPF)". SRE (R&R) is funded entirely by the Central Government. In response to the serious militancy situation in Jammu and KashmirRs. the Government of J&K incurred significant expenditure to maintain peace and tranquillityRs. this scheme aims to reimburse the expenses incurred by the State Government for various Relief and Rehabilitation activities.
benefits:
1. Cash relief to Kashmiri and Jammu migrants settled in J&K: 3Rs. per person per monthRs. with a maximum of 13Rs. per family per month. 2. Cash relief to Kashmiri migrants settled in Delhi/NCR: 3Rs. per person per monthRs. with a maximum of 13Rs. per family per month. 3. Cash relief to migrants in the hilly areas of the Jammu divisionRs. equivalent to Kashmiri migrants: 2Rs. per person per monthRs. with a maximum of 10Rs. per family per month. 4. Relief for ration/fodder to migrants in hilly areas of Jammu divisionRs. including 9 kg of AttaRs. 2 kg of Rice per person per monthRs. and 10 litres of kerosene oil per family per monthRs. along with 300 per cattle per month for fodder. 5. Basic dry ration for needy migrantsRs. including 9 kgs of riceRs. 2 kgs of Atta per personRs. and 1 kg of sugar per family per monthRs. with additional ex-gratia relief for property lossRs. up to 10Rs. divided between immovable and movable property.
The Government of India also supports employment opportunities for Kashmiri migrantsRs. providing 3000 youths with salaries until they secure regular positions in the State Government. AdditionallyRs. an extra 3000 State Government jobs were approved for Kashmiri migrants under PMDP-2015.
**Financial support is directed towards the rehabilitation of migrantsRs. including the construction of transit accommodations and housing facilitiesRs. along with scholarshipsRs. employment opportunitiesRs. and waivers on interest for loans. This includes:** 1. One-time compensation of 5Rs. for the Next of Kin (NoK) of civilians killed in militancy-related incidents. 2. Pension of 750 per month for widows of civilians killed in militancy-related violence. 3. Scholarships for orphans affected by militancyRs. with an additional 150 per month for vocational/technical training. 4. Construction of 6000 transit accommodations for Kashmiri migrants with State Government jobs. 5. An advance of 19Rs. crore for the Corpus Fund of the Jammu and Kashmir State Rehabilitation Council.
- Ex-gratia payments of 5 lakh have been extended to the Next of Kin of JKP/SPOs/CAPFs/Army personnel deceased due to violence. Relief measuresRs. including the construction of bunkersRs. have been initiated to support those living in areas affected by Cross Border Firing. - A surrender policy has been put in place with a stipend of 2Rs. per month for three years and an immediate grant of 1Rs.. Incentives for the surrender of weapons have also been specified. - Relief is offered to victims of cross-border firingRs. terrorismRs. and militancyRs. including compensation for housingRs. cropRs. and livestock losses. The compensation for the loss of milch animals has been increased from 30Rs. per animal to 50Rs. per animal. - FurthermoreRs. the Government of India provides ex-gratia cash relief of 5Rs. to the Next of Kin or victims with over 50% disability due to Cross Border FiringRs. effective from 24.08.2016. Financial assistance of 5Rs. per family is provided to 5764 families of West Pakistani Refugees (WPRs).
eligibility: The beneficiary should be Kashmir or Jammu Migrant.
