**Note 08:** Relaxations of 60% minimum marks in degree/PG is considered onlyRs. subject to the candidate getting an adequate score in eligibility test such as GRE/GMAT//IELTS/TOEFL/PTE and getting unconditional admission in the abroad Universities/Institutions in case if the registrations are not up to the expected levels within the Budget allocated and being done only on a case to case basis by the Government.

name: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
brief_description: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up units in estuarine watersRs. and in open sea. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **Setting Up of Unit in Estuarine Waters**

50% subsidy limited to 25Rs. per unitRs. maximum for 2 units. Each unit in the estuarine water will be of size 4 meters x 4 meters.
> **Setting Up of Unit in Open Sea**

50% limited to 40Rs. per unitRs. maximum for 2 units. Each unit in the Open sea will be of size 6 meters x 6 meters.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Groups/ Societies/ AssociationsRs. interested in setting up the Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming Unit in Goa.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
- The applicant should have undergone a training programme on Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming organized by the Fisheries Department/ MPEDA/ ICAR/ any other institute.

name: Yuvasree Prakalpa
brief_description: 'Yuvasree' (earlier named as "Yuva Utsaha Prakalpa") was launched by the Labour DepartmentRs. Govt. of West BengalRs. with effect from 1st October 2013. The objective of the scheme is to provide unemployment assistance to the enrolled jobseekers of the Employment Bank to enable them to upgrade their level of skill in order to make them employable or suitable for setting up of self-employment ventures.
benefits: - **Cash Benefits:** Subject to fulfillment of the aforesaid eligibility criteria an individual may receive unemployment assistance under the scheme 1500/- per month.- **Job Seeking:** By registering in Employment BankRs. beneficiaries can search and apply for jobs per their skills.- **Training Program:** The recipient can upgrade his/her skill subsequently under any of the Skill Development programs of the state government / private training institutes and increase his/her employability. The training program shall include soft skills trainingRs. basic IT trainingRs. basic communication trainingRs. and other skill as per the need or the interest of the beneficiary.- **Placement Support**: Assistance in placing the candidate in a Government or Private organization.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
1. The applicant must be unemployed.
1. The applicant should be enrolled with the Employment Bank as a job seeker.
1. The applicant should be class 8th pass and above.
1. The applicant should be between 18-45 years of age on the 1st day of April of the year in which he/she is considered under the scheme.
1. The applicant had not to availed financial assistance /loan under any state/central government sponsored Self-Employment scheme.
1. Only one member of a family is eligible to receive assistance under the scheme.

name: Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 1st April 2020Rs. Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal. The scheme is aimed at the Scheduled Tribe (ST) residents of West Bengal of the age of 60 years and above who do not receive any other pension from any other authority. Over 3Rs. beneficiaries have been brought under the fold of the scheme. The amount of monthly pension of 1Rs./- is transferred directly to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.
benefits: A monthly pension of 1Rs./- is transferred directly to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
1. The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years or more.
1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of Government pension or pension from any other organization.

name: Toposili Bandhu (Old Age Pension) Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 1st April 2020Rs. Toposili Bandhu (Old Age Pension) is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal. The main objective of the scheme to provide the financial assistance to old age person who are belongs to the scheduled caste category of West Bengal State.
benefits: Pension : 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of West Bengal.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years or more.
1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of Government pension or pension from any other organization.

name: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
brief_description: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme was launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment. Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to provide affordable Health Insurance to persons with AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities. The scheme provides insurance coverage of up to 1Rs./-Rs. which must be renewed annually after the financial year.
benefits: 1. **Health insurance coverage:** Up to 1Rs./- for various expenses.1. **Outpatient department (OPD) treatment:** Covers medicinesRs. pathologyRs. diagnostic testsRs. etc.1. **Regular medical checkups:** For non-ailing individuals with disabilities.1. **Dental care:** Preventive dentistry services.1. **Surgery:** To prevent further disability worsening or for existing disabilities (including congenital).1. **Non-surgical/hospitalization:** Coverage for non-surgical treatments and related stays.1. **Ongoing therapies:** For managing disability and related complications.1. **Alternative medicine:** Coverage for alternative treatment options. > **Health insurance coverage: Up to 1Rs./- bifurcation for various expenses.** - **Section I: Hospitalization** **:** The overall limit for hospitalization expenses is 55Rs./-. This includes: - Corrective Surgeries for existing Disability including congenital disability (Under SECI(A)a maximum capping of 15Rs./- For other than the corrective surgeries for Existing DisabilitiesRs. which is include in the overall limit of 40Rs./- of Sec I(A)) - Non-surgical or hospitalization costs are covered up to 15Rs./-. - **Section II: Outpatient Department (OPD)** **:** The overall OPD treatment limit is 19Rs./-Rs. broken down as: - OPD treatmentRs. including medicinesRs. pathologyRs. diagnostic testsRs. etc.Rs. is covered up to 15Rs./-. - Dental preventive dentistry is covered up to 4Rs./-. - **Section III: Ongoing Therapies** - A total of 20Rs./- is allocated for ongoing therapies aimed at reducing the impact of disability. - ***Section IV: Alternative Medicine (AYUSH)*** - Treatment under AYUSH systems of medicine is reimbursable up to 4Rs./-. - **Section V: Transportation** - Transportation costs related to medical treatment are covered up to 2Rs./-.
eligibility: - All the disable person who have at least one of the disabilities under the [National Trust ActRs. 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf) with valid disability certificate.

name: "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" is a Sub-Component under the Umbrella Scheme "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending financial grants for the reactivation of wooden/steel mechanized boats.
benefits:
A financial grant for the reactivation of a registered wooden/steel mechanized boat will be extended at 10Rs. per boat and 5Rs. for a registered fiber-reinforced plastic mechanized boat.
****The grant is subject to revision as and when approved by the Government from time to time.***
eligibility:
- The applicant should either belong to the fishermen community or be one of those professionally engaged in fishing/fish trade occupation on a full-time basis/prospective entrepreneurs.
- The applicant must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of not less than five years at the time of applying for extending subsidies/ grants.
- The applicant must have been enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society and be above the age of 23 years and below 60 years.
- The applicant must not have been a recipient of Old Age PensionRs. issued by the department.
- The applicant should not be employed in Government/ Government Undertakings/Fishermen Co-operative Society.
- The applicant must not have any dues to be paid to the Department/Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of making the application.
- The applicant should possess a registered mechanized boat.
- The applicant should have carried out overhauling/ repairs to the engine/hull during the notified fishing ban period and should not have ventured fishing during the notified ban on fishing periods.

name: "Subsidy for the Purchase of Fiber-reinforced Plastic Cattamaran/ Vallam/ Wooden Nava/ Marine Plywood Canoe With Nets" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidy for the Purchase of Fiber-reinforced Plastic Cattamaran/ Vallam/ Wooden Nava/ Marine Plywood Canoe With Nets" is a Sub-Component under the Umbrella Scheme "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending subsidies to the fishermen for the procurement of fiber-reinforced plastic vallam with nets.
benefits:
- 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of 50Rs. per unit in case of fibre-reinforced plastic catamaran and marine plywood canoe with netsRs. linked to own finance/loan component from National Co-operative Development Corporation/bank.
- 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of 1Rs. per unit in case of fibre-reinforced plastic vallam with netsRs. linked to own finance/loan component from National Co-operative Development Corporation/bank.
- 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of 40Rs. per unit in respect of wooden nava with netRs. linked to own finance/loan component from National Co-operative Development Corporation/bank.
- 50% subsidy to a maximum of 5Rs. per unit for the procurement of inland catamaran with nets (unit cost 10Rs.).

****The rate of subsidy may be fixed by the Government from time to time.***
eligibility:
- The applicant should either belong to the fishermen community or be one of those professionally engaged in fishing/fish trade occupation on a full-time basis/prospective entrepreneurs.
- The applicant must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of not less than five years at the time of applying for extending subsidies/ grants.
- The applicant must have been enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society and be above the age of 23 years and below 60 years.
- The applicant must not have been a recipient of Old Age PensionRs. issued by the department.
- The applicant should not be employed in Government/ Government Undertakings/Fishermen Co-operative Society.
- The applicant must not have any dues to be paid to the Department/Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of making the application.
- In the case of male applicantsRs. they should possess sea fishing experience in any mechanized or motorized/non-motorized traditional crafts for a minimum period of 5 yearsRs. issued by the owners.
- In the case of women applicantsRs. they should possess five years of fish trade experience issued by the Village Panchayat concerned.
- The applicant should be ready to deposit 50% of the cost of craft and net with the Federation/Marketing Union/the Fishermen Co-operative Societies as per the norms/pattern of assistance modified from time to time.

name: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh
brief_description:
The Uttar Pradesh governmentRs. recognizing the unique challenges faced by widows living within the stateRs. has implemented the Widow Pension Scheme. This compassionate initiativeRs. administered by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. offers a vital form of financial assistance to these vulnerable women.
The scheme provides a monthly pensionRs. acknowledging the significant impact of losing a spouse on household income and stability. This crucial support empowers widows to navigate the hardships of their situationsRs. rebuild their lives with dignityRs. and secure a measure of financial security. The Widow Pension Scheme stands as a testament to the government's commitment to the well-being of its widowed citizensRs. fostering hope and fostering a path towards a brighter future
benefits: Financial Assistance : 1Rs./- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh state.
1. The applicant's husband has died.
1. The age of the applicant should not be less than 18 years.
1. The annual income of the applicant and her family from all sources should not exceed 2Rs./-

name: Punjab Farm Tourism Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Punjab Farm Tourism Scheme was launched by the Department of Tourism & Cultural AffairsRs. Government of Punjab. The scheme envisages to provide to tourists with a cleanRs. hygienicRs. and comfortable stay in the farmhouses spread across the State of Punjab. The scheme also aims to provide a cultural experience to domestic and foreign tourists through their exposure to village life. The concept will also help to provide additional sources of income to the farming community. ThusRs. it will be a complete package of farm tourismRs. adventure tourismRs. rural and village tourism and cultural tourism to visiting tourists in the predominantly agricultural State of Punjab. It has therefore been decided to register the farm stay units by the Department of Tourism (DoT)/Punjab Heritage Tourism Promotion Board (PHTPB) and lay down suitable guidelines for the same.
**Farm Stay unit:**
A farm stay unit will be a property having an area of at least 2.5 acres or above with suitable accommodation built inside for providing a comfortable stay to the guests/tourists as per the standards prescribed in this scheme. The construction must be compliant with policies and limits prescribed by the Department of Housing and Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Punjab.
benefits:
The Farm Stay Scheme will provide the following benefits to the registered owners of the property:

1. A useful source of additional income to the farm owners of the registered Farm Stay units.
1. Registered Farm stay units shall be allowed to use Punjab Tourism Logo on their sign boards.
1. The benefit in terms of support from the Department of Tourism (DoT)/Punjab Heritage and Tourism Promotion Board (PHTPB) in marketing the Farm Stay unitRs. through:


- Promotion on the official website of Punjab Tourism.
- Media coverage by travel writers.
- Promotion of the Farm stay units through brochures/leaflets and other printed material published by the Department of Tourism and Punjab Heritage and Tourism Promotion Board.
- Promotion through domestic and international trade fairs. During the registered farm stay owners shall be provided space for promotion free of any charges.

**Issuance of FTS Certificate:**

- Certificates will be issued by the Chief Executive Officer (CEO)Rs. PHTPB
- The duration of the Certificate is Lifetime.
eligibility:
**The registration of the Farm Stay units shall be done in two categories:** ***Gold Category & Silver Category***
> **Eligibility for Gold category:**

The Farm stay units having:

1. An area of more than 5 acres with comfortable accommodation of not more than 9 lettable rooms (18 beds) built in it as per standards prescribed in A[nnexure-II](https://pbindustries.gov.in/webportal/uploads/pdffiles/481f31afd3f5844b86e8eee060712cfa.pdf) of the scheme guidelines. 1. Facility for providing cooked meals for the tourists.
1. Facility for hygienic storage of the food.
1. Facility can be managed by a Manager also.

> **Eligibility for Silver Category:**

The Farm Stay units having:

1. An area up to 5 acres having comfortable accommodation of not more than 9 lettable rooms (18 beds) built in it as per the standards prescribed in [Annexure - II](https://pbindustries.gov.in/webportal/uploads/pdffiles/481f31afd3f5844b86e8eee060712cfa.pdf) of the scheme guidelines. 1. Facility for provision of cooked meals for the tourists.
1. Facility for hygienic storage of the food.
1. Facility to be operated by owner only.
1. The unit can be run in any existing house in a village also.

> **Other General Conditions:**


1. Tariffs charged under the scheme shall be at the discretion of the Registered Farm stay unit owner. The registered owner shall specify the rates for stayRs. foodRs. and other activitiesRs. that he may be providing.
1. Every registered unit must be furnished and decorated to a high standard of comfort suitable for international and domestic tourists.
1. Every bedroom must have a neat & clean attached bathroomRs. 24-hour hot and cold running water facilityRs. Western-style toiletRs. and adequate arrangements for power supply and backupRs. ventilationRs. and lighting facility.
1. The building should be structurally safe and in good condition and should also meet high standards of hygieneRs. cleanlinessRs. and safety.
1. The tourists should also be allowed to venture out in the fields during their stay in the unit.

> **Compliance by the registered Farm Stay units:**


1. The registered Farm Stay unit will be required to maintain. The standards as prescribed in [Annexure -II](https://pbindustries.gov.in/webportal/uploads/pdffiles/481f31afd3f5844b86e8eee060712cfa.pdf) of the scheme at all times. The Chief Executive OfficerRs. PHTPBRs. or any other officer authorized by the Government can conduct a surprise inspection of the unit at any time between 9.00 am to 5.00 pm without any prior notice. 1. Any change in the facilities of the Farm stay unit will have to be informed to the Chief Executive Officer within 30 days of such change.
1. The owner of the Registered Farm stay shall be responsible for providing due assistance to the visitor for transport and medical help in case of any medical emergency. In case of any lossRs. sustained by the guests or tourists due to the negligence of the farm stay owner or his staffRs. he/they will be compensated by the farm owners.
1. The registered Farm stay owner shall be responsible for strictly adhering to the rules and regulations of the other departments/ agencies of the GovernmentRs. as may be applicable.

name: Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana (BNTYY) was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Odisha on 01st February 2016 in collaboration with IRCTC (Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation) wherein the pilgrims will be taken on a visit to different pilgrimage centers in the country from particular boarding points in the state as per the schedule approved for the journeys. The scheme is envisaged to help senior citizens over 60-75 years of age to undertake pilgrimage with Government assistance.
benefits:
1. The scheme offers a great opportunity to the poor and deprived senior citizens (60-75 years) of the State to the realization of their lifelong dream of having one Tirtha Darshan (Pilgrimage) and fulfill their spiritual aspirationsRs. with the support of the state.
1. This scheme will be offered to people of all regions/faiths.
1. The scheme is envisaged to help senior citizens over 60-75 years of age to undertake pilgrimage with Government assistance.

> **Facilities for pilgrims:**


1. The district administration will make arrangements for transportation of the selected pilgrims including their attendants to district HQ and further to the Starting Point i.e. originating railway station or directly from home to the starting point and also on the return journey from the Starting Point back to their homes.
1. Arrangements for stay and food for the pilgrims coming from various districts on the day previous to the actual departure will be done by the district administration of the Starting Point i.e. originating station.
1. Vegetarian MealsRs. BreakfastRs. Tea & Snacks with Drinking Water throughout the journeyRs. Road transportRs. Accommodation in nearby destinationsRs. Tour escortsRs. tour guidesRs. travel insuranceRs. and medical facilities with professional physicians shall be provided by IRCTC.
1. The tentative food menu to be provided at the starting point by the Tourism Department as well as during the journey by IRCTC are as follows: Break Fast-8-9 AM- Upama & Dalma/ Puri & Veg. Mix. Curry/IdleeRs. SambarRs. and Tea & WaterRs. (b) Lunch- 12 Noon-2 PM- Veg.-Rice/RotiRs. DalRs. one CurryRs. one Veg. FryRs. KhataRs. WaterRs. (c) Tea & Biscuits- 4-5 PMRs. (d) Dinner- 7-9 PM- Veg.-Rice/ RotiRs. DalRs. Veg. Curry & Water.
1. The travel kit shall be provided by IRCTC to the pilgrims within a cost as per the MOU signed between the state Govt. & IRCTC for each year. The kit shall contain a toothbrushRs. toothpasteRs. coconut oilRs. shampooRs. bathing & washing soapRs. bedsheetRs. blanketRs. capRs. towelRs. hand napkinRs. combRs. mirrorRs. identity card & a bag. The bag shall be properly branded with the Odisha Tourism logo.
1. If pilgrims desire to avail of any facility other than that prescribed by the Government during the journeyRs. then they will have to make payment for the same. Tourism Dept. / IRCTC cannot take responsibility for the extra services desired by the pilgrims.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be over 60 years of age & within 75 years of age (except in cases of joint application of a married couple where one of the spouses can be less than 60 years of age). For the computation of ageRs. the last date of submission of the application will be taken into account.
1. The applicant has to be a domicile of Odisha.
1. The applicant should have the requisite fitness to undertake the journey and should not be suffering from any communicable disease.
1. Under the schemeRs. an attendant can also accompany applicants above 70 years of age. The application of the attendant should be a joint application with the prospective 'Pilgrim'.
1. The attendant has to pay 50% of the travel cost in the shape of a Bank Draft drawn on scheduled banks in favour of the DirectorRs. Tourism payable at Bhubaneswar along with the application.
1. The attendant should be over 18 years of age.
1. A married couple can apply 'jointly' for the pilgrimage trip. Their joint application will be treated as one applicationRs. butRs. the facilities provided will be individual. The joint application will be held eligible even if one of the spouses is less than 60 years of age.
1. Under the schemeRs. the pilgrim can avail the benefit of a journey only once in a lifetime.
1. Since the scheme is meant for poor and deprived sections of societyRs. the applicant should mandatorily possess any of the following:


- Antyodaya/ Annapurna cardRs.
- Ration Card under NFSA
- Widow Pension/ Old Age Pension
- MGNREGS Job Card
- The auto inclusion and the deprivation criteria used by the Panchayati Raj Department which has replaced the criteria for identification of BPL category people and weaker sections for different development schemes can be used to filter the eligible applicants for this scheme.
- Any other similar documents issued by the State Govt. reflecting their weak economic status or deprivation.

**Note:** Applicant providing false information will be debarred of benefit under the scheme.
**Responsibility of Pilgrims Selected for Yatra:**

1. As far as possible the pilgrims should avoid wearing jewellery.
1. Pilgrims should give an undertaking that they have the requisite fitness to undertake the journey and they are not suffering from any communicable disease.
1. The pilgrim has to give an undertaking that he/she is taking the journey on his own will and at his/her own risk and that the state government will not be responsible for any unforeseen untoward incidentRs. if anyRs. during the entire duration of the pilgrimage up till the time they reach their homes.
1. The selected pilgrims should not deviate from the scheduled program journey and site visits under any circumstances.
1. The pilgrims should listen to the instructions of the IRCTC officials during the entire duration of the journey.
1. The pilgrims should maintain good behaviour among themselves and with IRCTC officials

name: Incentive to Widow's Remarriage
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive to Widow's Remarriage (IWR)" is a social welfare scheme by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to encourage and support widows to remarry and lead a normal life in society. Through this schemeRs. eligible individuals receive financial assistance of 50Rs./- in the form of a National Saving Certificate. The bridegroom should be a bachelor or a widower.
benefits: Financial assistance of 50Rs./- in the form of a National Saving Certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a Widow.
1. The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence of not less than 5 years.
1. The applicant should not be carrying a child.
1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 75Rs./- per annum.
1. The bridegroom should be a bachelor or a widower.
1. The Bride and the Bridegroom should be of legal marriage ageRs. i.e. 18 years for the Bride and 21 years for the Bridegroom.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students
brief_description: The scheme "Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The award is granted to top ranking boy and girl student in each region (PondicherryRs. Karaikal and Yanam) who have secured not less than 55% of marks in the aggregate in the Higher Secondary Examination.
benefits: Cash Award of 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should have secured 55% or above marks in the Higher Secondary Examination.
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for not less than 5 years.

name: MMKY-Financial Assistance for New Boat, Engine, and Net
brief_description:
The State plan scheme MMKY-Financial Assistance for New BoatRs. EngineRs. and Net was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha under Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana (MMKY) in order to increase the marine fish production and to enhance incomes and livelihoods of the marine fishers.
> **Objectives:**


- To support the Coastal communities by provision of new wooden/FRP BoatRs. Engine and purchase of new fishing net.
- To increase the marine fish production in the state.
- To increase the income and to improve the welfare of coastal communities in the State.

> **Area of Operation:**

The scheme shall be implemented by the Additional Fisheries Officers (Marine)/District Fisheries Officer (B&T)Rs. Balugaon for marine fishing in the coastal districts of Odisha. The district-wise annual target shall be communicated by the Director of Fisheries. The target is interchangeable depending on the progress made by the District Level Officers.
benefits:
**Unit Cost and Subsidy Assistance:**
Sl. No.ItemMaximum Unit Cost ( in Lakh)Maximum Government Assistance ( in Lakh)/BeneficiaryMaximum Government Assistance ( in Lakh)/BeneficiaryGeneral (40%)Women/SC/ST/PWD/Transgender (60%)1Fishing Boat7.503.004.502Engine1.400.560.843Life Saving Equipment0.100.040.064Fishing Net1.000.400.60Total10.004.006.00***NB: Items at Sl. No. 1 & 3 are mandatory and others are optional as per the requirement of the fisherman.**
**Note 01:** Financial Assistance shall be limited to 1(one) unit (boat with engine and net) per individual beneficiary.

**Note 05:** In caseRs. Government in the F & ARD Department enhances the percentage of subsidy that shall be applicable for those beneficiaries who have received go -ahead letter during the FY 2023-24.
eligibility:
**The following are the eligibility criteria of the beneficiary:**

1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Odisha and must possess identity and residential proof including an Aadhaar Card.
1. The beneficiary should have a Bank Account in his/her name in the State of Odisha.
1. The beneficiary should have QR Coded Aadhaar Card.
1. The beneficiary should not have received any financial assistance from Government /any Agency towards the purchase of any new boat/engine in the last 5 Years (the beneficiary should not have availed subsidy after 1st April 2018) and net in the last 3 Years (the beneficiary should not have availed subsidy after 1st April 2020).
1. While availing subsidyRs. the beneficiary family will be considered instead of individual members of the family. One beneficiary family should not be provided with multiple benefits under one particular scheme. A family will not be eligible for subsidy under the same scheme if any of its members have received a subsidy during the last three years.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles, Denture, Hearing Aid (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Purchase of SpectaclesRs. DentureRs. Hearing Aid was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB for the purchase of SpectaclesRs. Denture and Hearing Aid.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance for Purchase of SpectaclesRs. Denture & Hearing Aid:**
**Sr. No****Name of article****Amount**1Spectacle1500/-2Denture5000/-3Hearing Aid4000/-
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be working in the EstablishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contribution towards the labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
1. The applicant shall be eligible to avail the benefit of the scheme only after 06 months of becoming a member of the Board.
1. The financial assistance will be given on the prescription of the Government Medical Officer/Chief Medical Officer/Principal Medical Officer of any Government Institute in tri-city and once in a lifetime.
1. The beneficiary should apply for the benefit of this scheme within one yearRs. with all required documents.
1. The financial assistance for the purchase of spectaclesRs. DentureRs. and hearing aid shall not be given to those beneficiaries who are covered under ESIC.

name: Interest Free Loan (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Interest Free Loan was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. interest free loan shall be granted to the registered construction workers of the Board for the purchase of items like FridgeRs. Television/ LCDRs. Motor Cycle/ScooterRs. CoolerRs. Fan & Bicycle.
benefits:
**Interest Free Loan for the purchase of the following items:**
**Sr. No.****Name of items****Amount of loan****Re-payment period**1Purchase of motorcycle /scooter25000/-20 equal installments2Purchase of Fridge15000/-15 equal installments3Purchase of television/ LCD15000/-15 equal installments4Purchase of cooler7500/-10 equal installments5Purchase of Fan2500/-10 equal installments6Purchase of bicycle4000/-10 equal installments
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be working in the EstablishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contribution towards labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
1. The beneficiary can apply for the grant of loan for the purchase of one item at a time.
1. The installment of the loan will be recovered from the salary of the workers by the employer and said amount should be deposited through the payee A/c Cheque in favour of Chandigarh Labour Welfare Board by the Principal Employer.
1. Interest free loan amount will be recovered in equal monthly installments as per the rule.
1. The loan will not be granted to those beneficiaries who will be found defaulters in the earlier loan.
1. The Loan will be sanctioned subject to the standing guarantee of the employer.
1. Any beneficiary will be eligible to avail of benefits of the scheme only after 06 months of becoming the beneficiary member of the Board at least for the last six months.

name: Assistance under SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act

- The applicant should have been affected by an atrocity.

name: Educational Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Educational Assistance scheme was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. **Educational Assistance under the scheme is as follows:-**

name: MMKY-New Tank Excavation Under Brackish Water Aquaculture
brief_description:
The State plan scheme MMKY-New Tank Excavation Under Brackish Water Aquaculture was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development DepartmentRs. **Area of Operation:**
The scheme shall be implemented in the coastal districts of Odisha as per the provisions of the Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act (CAA) - 2005 and Amendment Act- 2023Rs. CAA Rules- 2005 and Amendment Rules-2022.

eligibility:
**The following are the eligibility criteria for the beneficiaries:**

1. The beneficiary should have a bank account in his/her name in the State of Odisha.

1. While availing subsidyRs. the beneficiary family will be considered instead of individual members of the family. One beneficiary family should not be provided with multiple benefits under one particular scheme. A family will not be eligible for subsidy under the same scheme if any of its members have gotten a subsidy during the last three years.

**Note 01:** Preference will be given for the selection of beneficiaries in cluster mode.
**Note 02:** The documentary evidence in support of the suitable land needs to be provided by the beneficiary. (Copy of the RoR/Copy of the lease agreement in case of lease land for a minimum period of seven years of lease needs to be submitted).

name: Disability Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The scheme Disability Pension was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. Under this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance as disability pension to a beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis leprosyRs. TB.Rs. accident etc. in addition to this pension he/she will be eligible for an one time Ex-gratia payment depending upon the percentage of disability and subject to such conditions as fixed by the Board.
benefits:
1. A monthly disability pension of 2Rs./- plus 100/- per month for every completed year of service from the year of registration will be given to the eligible beneficiary.
1. In addition to this pensionRs. the beneficiary will also be eligible for a one-time Ex-gratia payment of not more than 3.00 Lakhs depending upon the percentage of disability and subject to such conditions as fixed by the Board.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Assam.
1. The applicant should be engaged in any building & other construction work.
1. The construction worker should be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The applicant should have an active membership with the Board.
1. The construction worker who is permanently disabled due to paralysis leprosyRs. TBRs. accidentRs. etc. is eligible to apply for the scheme.

name: Perunthalaivar Karma Veerar Kamarajar Scheme of Financial Assistance Towards Funeral Expenses of the Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme Perunthalaivar Karma Veerar Kamarajar Scheme of Financial Assistance Towards Funeral Expenses of the Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. In this schemeRs. financial assistance of 15Rs./- is provided to meet the expenses in connection with funeralRs. in the event of the death of the differently abled person concerned.
benefits: On the death of the differently abled personRs. financial assistance of 15Rs./- shall be paid to the claimant.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.
- The claimant should be son/daughter/spouse or any other close relative under whose care and maintenance the differently abled person was living.
- The application shall be made within 30 days from the date of death of the differently abled person.

name: Home for Mentally Challenged Children
brief_description: The scheme "Home for Mentally Challenged Children" by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of PuducherryRs. aims to provide care for children facing mental challengesRs. i.e. low Intelligence Quotient (IQ). The scheme offers free boarding and lodgingRs. uniform setsRs. daily living needsRs. and medical check-ups for the inmates. AdditionallyRs. it includes educational and recreational activities to enhance their overall well-being.
benefits:
- Free boarding and lodging for all the inmates. - Free supply of 4 uniform sets to the inmates per year. - Free supply of all daily living needs for the inmates. - Free medical check-upsRs. including paediatric and psychiatric servicesRs. for all the inmates. - Annual tours and local picnic trips to places of interest for the inmates. - Annual Day for prize distribution to winners in sports events and cultural programmes. - Non-formal education to assist and develop inmates in their day-to-day activities. - Training in habits of disciplineRs. cleanlinessRs. good healthRs. drawingRs. paintingRs. yogaRs. and other extracurricular activities.
**NOTE:** Contact the authorities below in case of delay in disbursal of benefits: - **Puducherry:** The DirectorRs. Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Saradhambal NagarRs. EllaipillaichavadhyRs. Puducherry. - **Karaikal:** The CollectorRs. Karaikal.- **Mahe/Yanam:** The Regional AdministratorRs. Mahe/Yanam.
eligibility:
The applicant should qualify as ANY ONE of the following:

- Boys in the age group of 7 to 17 years.
- Mild Mental Retardedness with an IQ level between 50-70.
- Moderate Mental Retardedness with an IQ level between 35-49.
- Severe Mental Retardedness with an IQ level between 20-34.
- Profound Mental Retardedness with an IQ level under 20.
- Unspecified Mental Retardedness with mental efficiency and sub-normality.

name: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
brief_description: The scheme Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide scholarship to the differently abled persons who are students for enabling them to secure education. The assistance is extended to Student with Disabilities studying from Class 1st upto Postgraduate/ Professional courses.
benefits:
- 1st to 5th Standard: 1Rs./- per year.
- 6th to 8th Standard: 2Rs./- per year.
- 9th to 12th Standard: 3Rs./- per year.
- Undergraduate Course: 5Rs./- per year.
- Postgraduate/Professional Course: 6Rs./- per year.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The applicant should have an annual income (from all sources) not exceeding 75Rs./- per annum.
- The disability of the applicant should be 40% and above.
- The assistance is extended to Student with Disabilities studying from 1st Standard upto Postgraduate/Professional courses.

name: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired
brief_description: The scheme Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of PuducherryRs. was introduced to facilitate the education and self-confidence development of visually impaired and hearing-impaired children.
benefits:
- Free boarding and lodging facilities for the children admitted.
- Free academic education within the campusRs. along with training in vocal/instrumental music by specially appointed teachers.
- Free supply of two sets of uniform dress per year for all school inmates.
- Free distribution of text booksRs. note booksRs. and other educational necessities.
- Free supply of daily living needs.
- Free supply of Brailee books for visually impaired children.
- Free annual tour arranged for all admitted children.
- Free supply of hearing aids.
- Separate accommodation facilities available for boys and girls in these schools.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a child who has completed 5 years of age.
- The child must be visually impaired and hearing impaired.

name: Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person
brief_description: The scheme Issue of Free Bus Pass to Differently Abled Person was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme provides free bus passes to all the differently abled persons to facilitate their mobility/transport in buses run by the Government and non-governmental organizations within the Union Territory of Puducherry.
benefits: Free Bus Passes in Buses Run by the Government and Non Governmental OrganizationsRs. Within the Union Territory of Puducherry.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
- The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs./-.
- The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.

name: Medical Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The scheme Medical Assistance was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. name: Health Check-up (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Health Check-up benefit scheme was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. name: The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme
brief_description: The scheme The Punjab Financial Assistance to Acid Victims Scheme was launched by the Department of Social Security And Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Punjab in the year 2017. The objective of the Scheme is to provide monthly Financial Assistance to females who have been rendered 40% disabled due to acid attack. 1. The acid attack victim should be a resident of Punjab State.

name: Aushadhi Avam Sugandhit Fasal Shetra Vistar

name: Pension Scheme for Transgender

name: Integrated Horticultural Development Program Through Diversification of Agriculture
brief_description: The scheme Integrated Horticultural Development Program Through Diversification of Agriculture (IHDPDA)" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's WelfareRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the farmers are provided subsidy through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) mode for Organic Manures for Coconut PalmsRs. name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Vulnerable Women

Unmarried WomenRs. and also to the women who are in need of special careRs. support or protection because of their ageRs. disability or risk of abuse or neglect.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 2000/- per month.- **Mode of Disbursal:** The sanctioned grant will be transferred directly to the individual bank account of the applicant.- The list of beneficiaries will be made available on the [official website](https://socialwelfare.tripura.gov.in/) of the Social Welfare & Social Education DepartmentRs. Govt. of Tripura.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
brief_description: Under this scheme an amount of Rs. 6000/- will be transferred annually in three equal instalments Government Resolution No Kisani-2023/CR 42/11 A dated 15/06/2023 has been issued regarding the scheme. Farmers which are eligible for PM Kisan Yojana will be eligible for the benefit of "Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana"
benefits: 1) Eligible Farmers families as per PM KISAN will be Benefited Rs. 2000/- per Instalment. 2) The beneficiaries benefited in PM KISAN will get the benefit of NSMNY. 3) The NSMNY beneficiaries will be benefited from the list provided by GoI. 4) First instalment of NSMNY is given as per the list of 14th instalment of PMKISAN. 5) Eligible farmers family will get Rs. 2000/- from PMKISAN & NSMNY at each instalment. 6) Eligible farmers will get Rs. 12Rs./- in a year from both PM KISAN & NSMNY schems. 7) Farmers will be benefited through DBT. 8) The benefit of the NSMNY will be credited only in Aadhar linked bank accounts. 9) The benefit credited to the ineligibles in NSMNY will be recovered as per the SoP of PMKISAN
eligibility: Cultivable land holding farmers families (comprising of husbandRs. wife and minor children) having land holding on dated 01.02.2019 are eligible for both PM KISAN & NSMNY scheme.

name: Allowance for 100% Blind

Pension of 2Rs./- per month.

1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.

1. The applicant's age should be 10 years and above.
1. The annual income of the applicant's family should be up to 1Rs./-.

name: Honorarium for Pradhan Samajpatis of Indigenous Tribal Community

Government of Tripura on 1st July 2021 to provide financial assistance to the Pradhan Samajpatis (Chief Community Headman) of indigenous tribal communities in Tripura.

name: 60% and above Disability Allowances

benefits: Pension of 2Rs./- per month.

name: Sabji Shetra Vistar Yojana

name: Seed Testing Laboratory Scheme

name: "Training in Silk" Component of the "Development of Silk" Scheme

> **For Trainees**

name: "Input Assistance to Farmers for Taking up Fish Farming in Farm Ponds" Component of the "Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana" Scheme
brief_description: The "Input Assistance to Farmers for Taking up Fish Farming in Farm Ponds" Component of the "Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana" Scheme was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development DepartmentRs. Input assistance is provided to the farmers who have excavated farm ponds under MGNREGA for facilitating the production of fingerling and fish. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Fisheries through its field functionaries in Odisha.
benefits:
- One-day training and awareness programme will be conducted by the District Fisheries Officers for skill up-gradation of the beneficiaries.
> **Type of Farm Pond with Unit Cost and Pattern of Assistance** The input assistance towards pisciculture on the unit cost of 4Rs./- hectare shall be given to the farmer as a one-time support at 40% for General CategoryRs. and 60% for Scheduled Castes (SC)/ Scheduled Tribes (ST)/Women/Transgender/Person with Disability (PwD) Category of farmers.
**Model 1** - Specification of Farm Pond: 20m x 20m - Seed: 2400 - Feed: 10800 - Other Input: 2800 - Unit Cost (): 16000 - Subsidy Assistance () - General (40%): 6400 - SC/ST/Women/Transgender/PwD (60%): 9600 **Model 2** - Specification of Farm Pond: 15m x 15m - Seed: 1350 - Feed: 6075 - Other Input: 1575 - Unit Cost (): 9000 - Subsidy Assistance () - General (40%): 3600 - SC/ST/Women/Transgender/PwD (60%): 5400 **Model 3** - Specification of Farm Pond: 10m x 10m - Seed: 600 - Feed: 2700 - Other Input: 700 - Unit Cost (): 4000 - Subsidy Assistance () - General (40%): 1600 - SC/ST/Women/Transgender/PwD (60%): 2400 ****Other Inputs include fertiliserRs. limeRs. pro/pre/grow bioticsRs. Vit-min mixRs. disinfectantRs. medicinesRs. castnetRs. etc.*** **NOTE 1:** Farmers are free to stock more seed as per their choice for seed raising purpose. **NOTE 2:** The assistance shall be limited to 0.5 acres of water spread area per beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
1. The applicant must have a bank account in his/her name in Odisha.
1. The farm pond should have been excavated by the applicant.
1. The farm pond should have been excavated under the various Government schemes including Watershed Development Projects & MGNREGA through the Directorate of Soil Conservation & Watershed Development.
1. The farm pond should have a minimum 5 feet water depth.
1. The farm pond should have sufficient water retaining capacity for a minimum 5 months of culture period.
1. While availing subsidyRs. the beneficiary family will be considered instead of individual member of the family.

name: Pension to the Persons who lost 100% eye sight
brief_description: The scheme Pension to the Persons Who Lost 100% Eye Sight" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of 2Rs./- to the differently-abled persons who are 10 years and above in age and have 100% blindness.
benefits: Pension of 2Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura.
1. The age of the applicant should be 10 years & above.
1. The applicant should be 100% Visually Handicapped.
1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./-.
1. No member of the family of the applicant should be a government employee.

name: Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana
brief_description: This schemeRs. launched by the Rajasthan Government's Labor DepartmentRs. is designed to alleviate the financial burden of visa expenses for construction workers seeking employment abroad. By reimbursing these costsRs. the scheme aims to encourage construction workers to pursue overseas employment opportunities and contribute to the state's economy through foreign remittances.
benefits: > The beneficiary will be reimbursed for the expenses incurred for a visa for employment abroad up to a maximum of 5Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. Construction workers must be registered with the board as beneficiaries and must be continuously depositing their contributions.
1. To obtain overseas contract employmentRs. construction worker need permission from the Protector of Emigrants (POE) office under the Emigration ActRs. 1983.
1. The recruiting agency must be registered under the Emigration Act or possess a valid permit from the POE office
1. The reimbursement of the visa amount will be payable only if the beneficiary has a valid passport with a minimum validity of 6 months along with a valid visa.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be payable only if the future employment of the beneficiary abroad is in the construction and other construction works.
1. The beneficiary will be entitled to the assistance amount only once.
1. If any information given in the assistance application submitted by the beneficiary under the scheme is found to be falseRs. the concerned beneficiary will be responsible for depositing the entire assistance amount approved under the scheme along with interest in one go.

name: Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana" has been started for the laborers working in stone mines in Rajasthan. An assistance scheme has been started for the beneficiaries suffering from silicosis. In which financial assistance will be provided to laborers and workers in case of silicosis or death. Applicants can apply for the assistance scheme to silicosis victims through both online and offline modes.
benefits:
1. In case of suffering from silicosis : 1Rs./-
1. In case of death of a victim of silicosis : 3Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Those construction workers who are registered with the Board as beneficiaries and are depositing contributions 1. The beneficiary is suffering from silicosis as certified by the Pneumoconiosis Medical Board constituted under the Rajasthan Workmen's Compensation (Occupational Diseases) RulesRs. 1965. 1. The beneficiary cannot receive silicosis assistance amount from the Rajasthan Environment and Health Care Fund (Rehab).
**Note - A person suffering from silicosis will be eligible to get assistance only under any one of the schemes of Rajasthan Environment and Health Cess Fund or the Board.**

name: Seed Farms Scheme
brief_description: The Seed Farms Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is the production of high-quality seeds of cerealsRs. pulsesRs. oilseeds etc.Rs. and for raising Horticultural seedlings such as orangeRs. coconutRs. arecanutRs. etc. for distribution to cultivators.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Supply of quality seeds to farmers.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Subsidy sale
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Dulari Scheme
brief_description: The Dulari Scheme was launched by the Health DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands on 26th JanuaryRs. 2013 to give incentives to newborn baby girls and girl children on passing VIIIRs. X & XII standards. As per the present schemeRs. the girl child born on or after 26.01.2013 will be eligible to get the benefit under the scheme for birth incentives and the girl children who are below 13 years of age not registered under the Planned family scheme (old scheme) will also get the benefit of this scheme.
benefits:
As per the schemeRs. the following benefits are given to the girl child whose parents are domicile of Andaman & Nicobar Islands:
**Sl. No.****Descriptions****Amount of Assistance**1Benefits at Birth- Institution deliver8Rs./-2Benefits at Birth- Home delivery5Rs./-3Benefits on passing VIII Standard5Rs./-4Benefits on passing X Standard10Rs./-5Benefits on passing XII Standard10Rs./-6Benefits on getting married at the age of 21 years5Rs./-7Benefits on getting married after age of 25 years10Rs./-
> **Note**- The incentive amount will be fixed in a bank account and must not be withdrawn before the girl attains 18 years of ageRs. unless permitted by the A&N Administration.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a domicile of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The applicant must be a woman or a girl child to avail benefits under the scheme.
1. The applicant must be born on or after 01.10.2013 to receive full benefits.
1. Girl children between 013 yearsRs. born before 01.10.2013 and not covered under the Planned Family SchemeRs. should be eligible only for educational incentives after passing Class VIII.

name: Scheme for Grant of Pension Benefits to Journalists
brief_description: The "Scheme for Grant of Pension Benefits to Journalists" by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to provide financial support and recognition to eligible media professionals. The scheme offers a monthly pension of 6Rs./- to qualified journalists who are 58 years or above in ageRs. and have served for a minimum of 20 years in roles such as Full-time EditorRs. ReporterRs. Sub-EditorRs. Press Photographer / Videographer / Correspondent.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 6Rs./- per monthRs. or as may be fixed by the Government from time to time.- **Date of Payment:** Payment will be made on the 10th of every month.- **Mode of Payment:** Payment will be made through the Electronic Clearing System.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than ten years.
- The applicant should be 58 years or above in age at the time of application.
- The applicant should have served for a minimum of 20 years in roles such as Full-time EditorRs. ReporterRs. Sub-EditorRs. Press Photographer / Videographer / Correspondent of a Newspaper/Periodical/News Agency/Electronic MediaRs. including Newspapers and Periodicals published in Puducherry and News Agencies/Electronic Media having headquarters outside Puducherry.
- In the case of Media Persons who are unable to pursue their profession on account of chronic ill-health or are permanently incapacitated from performing their jobRs. the pension shall be sanctioned if they have put in service for at least 10 years in any capacity (as mentioned in Point 4)Rs. irrespective of their present ageRs. if they meet all the other eligibility criteria.
- The applicant should not be receiving pension/honoraria from the Central/State Government.
- In the case of the death of the journalistRs. his/her spouse is eligible for 50%)of the pension.

name: Antim Sanskar Yojana
brief_description:
This scheme "Antim Sanskar Yojana" started by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh to provide the financial assistance in the case of death. On the death of such an eligible workerRs. his family members are to be provided financial assistance in the form of funeral expenses.
**Objective:**

- This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the dependents of registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh in the case of their death.
- It offers support to alleviate the immediate financial burden on families caused by funeral expenses.
benefits: > **Lump sum financial assistance amount : 6Rs./-**
eligibility:
1. Construction worker must be registered with labor department.
1. Beneficiary must not be received assistance for last rites from any other department.

name: Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations
brief_description: The scheme "Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations" was launched by the Directorate of School EducationRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. cash awards of 50Rs./-Rs. 30Rs./- and 20Rs./- are granted to the 1stRs. 2nd and 3rd Rank Holders respectively from Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) ExamRs. Secondary School Certificate (SSC) ExamRs. Matriculation ExamRs. and for Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) ExamRs. and Intermediate (2nd Year) Public Examinations.
benefits:
> **Quantum of Award**


- 1st Rank: 50Rs./-.
- 2nd Rank: 30Rs./-.
- 3rd Rank: 20Rs./-.

* Every yearRs. the awards are granted separately for each of the top three Rank Holders from Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) ExamRs. Secondary School Certificate (SSC) ExamRs. Matriculation ExamRs. and for Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) ExamRs. and Intermediate (2nd Year) Public Examinations.
* The awards are granted separately for each of the four regions of the UT of PuducherryRs. i.e. PuducherryRs. KaraikalRs. MaheRs. and Yanam.
* The awards are granted separately for Government Schools and for Private Schools.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be studying in a Government/Private High/Higher Secondary School or in Intermediate Level (2nd Year) in a Government Junior College in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- The applicant should be among the top three Rank Holders from Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) Exam/ Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Exam/ Matriculation Exam/ Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Exam/ Intermediate (2nd Year) Public Examination.

name: Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education
brief_description: The "Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education" was launched by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to raise the enrolment of girls in the schools between the age group of 11-14 years in the middle stage of education and also to avoid dropouts among girl students.
benefits: - **Scholarship Amount:** 200/- per annum per student.- **Mode of Disbursement:** Disbursed directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the applicant through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
- The applicant should be a Girl.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be in the age group of 11 to 14 years.
- The applicant should be studying in a GovernmentRs. Government Aided or a Government-recognized Private School in Puducherry.
- The applicant should not belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribes Category.
- The applicant should have an annual family income of 75Rs./- or below.
- The applicant must have secured 97% (or above) attendance in the preceding year.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme' is a state initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Its goal is to offer a 1Rs. pension to individuals aged 18 and aboveRs. who belong to households below the poverty line. Eligibility criteria include a disability percentage of 80% or aboveRs. or severe/multiple disabilities.
benefits:
**Pension:**

- 1Rs./- per month.

**Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali:**

- One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
- One free saree to a female pensioner.

**Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres:**

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meal.
- 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the "Below Poverty Line" category.
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years and above.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or aboveRs. or should have multiple disabilities.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme -Tamil Nadu
brief_description: 'The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension of 1Rs./- to destitute people of 60 years and above belonging to households below the poverty line. The scheme also provides one free saree to femalesRs. one free dhoti to males during Pongal and DeepavaliRs. and free rice in the Anganwadi Centres.
benefits:
**Pension:**

- 1Rs./- per month.

**Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali:**

- One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
- One free saree to a female pensioner.

**Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres:**

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meal.
- 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be destitute.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years and above.
1. The applicant should belong to the "Below Poverty Line" category.

name: Scheme for Providing Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Laptop or Desktop Computer to the Media Persons of the Union Territory of Puducherry
brief_description: "Scheme for Providing Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Laptop or Desktop Computer to the Media Persons of the Union Territory of Puducherry" by the Department of Information & PublicityRs. PuducherryRs. aims to grant financial assistance for the purchase of laptops or desktop computers to eligible media personsRs. keeping in view the special nature of the service rendered by the Media Persons to society in creating a sense of socio-political awareness among the people.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** Upto 15Rs./- per monthRs. or as may be fixed by the Government from time to time.
**Purpose:** For the purchase of ANY ONE of the following -

- A brand new personal computer that runs on AC power.
- A brand newRs. smallRs. portable personal computer that runs on either batteries or AC power; designed for use during travel.

**Mode of Payment:** The Member Secretary-cum-Director will hand over the amount to the applicant after obtaining the necessary receipt from the applicant in the prescribed format ([Form-VI](https://info.py.gov.in/sites/default/files/25-laptop.pdf)).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
2. The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than ten years.
3. The applicant should have served for five years in ANY ONE of the following positions:

- A full-time Editor/Reporter/Sub-Editor/Press Photographer/Correspondent of a Newspaper/Periodical duly registered with the Registrar of Newspapers of IndiaRs. New Delhi.
- Reporter/Photographer of News Agencies in Puducherry with headquarters outside the Union territory of Puducherry.
- Reporter/Videographer in the employ of electronic mediaRs. namely Satellite Channels.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief Ministers Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam
brief_description: The 'Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief Ministers Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam' is a state scheme that was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give a pension of 1Rs./- to old-age farmers and destitute agricultural labourers who have membership card under Chief Ministers Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam (CMPUT).
benefits:
**Pension:**

- 1Rs./- per month.

**Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali:**

- One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
- One free saree to a female pensioner.

**Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres:**

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meal.
- 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be destitute.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years and above.
1. The applicant should be farmer or a landless agricultural labour.
1. The applicant's fixed assets should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows: Scheme-II
brief_description: The "E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows: Scheme-II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The aim is to help poor widow mothers who face financial hardship in conducting their daughter's marriage. The scheme provides financial assistance 50Rs./- along with one sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam for the marriage of their daughters.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 50Rs./- for marriage expenses. - 1 Sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam. **Mode of Disbursal:** Through Electronic Clearing Service.
**NOTE:** The benefit can be given to the bride in case of the death of the widowed mother.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Widow.
1. The applicant should be the mother of a girl child.
1. The annual income of the family should not exceed 72Rs./-.
1. The age of the bride should be above 18 years.
1. The allowance is granted for the marriage of one daughter only.
1. The bride should be one of the following:


- A degree holder from regular collegesRs. distance education/government-recognized open university.
- A diploma holder from the Institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.

name: Riyaayati Dar Par Copies Ka Vitaran
brief_description:
The "Riyaayati dar par Copies Ka Vitaran" scheme iniatited by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh with the aim to provide financial assistance to the children of the construction worker. It will reduce the financial burden and help to educate their children.
> **Objective:** - Promoting literacy and access to educational materials. - Reducing the financial burden of buying educational supplies for workers' children. - Encouraging school attendance and participation
benefits:
- 10 Small Copies: 10/- per copy
- 10 Registers : 14/- per register
eligibility:
1. Applicant construction workers should be employed in industrial units/establishments falling within the circle's jurisdiction.
1. The benefit extends to a maximum of two children per worker.
1. It is mandatory for the concerned worker to deposit the amount of copies in the board through the institute.

name: Farmers Training Institute Scheme
brief_description: The Farmers Training Institute Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to provide training to farmers at the village level on updated and innovative agriculture technology. The Training Institute facilitates exposure visits for farmers to agriculturally advanced states. The Scheme also facilitates exposure visits for farmers within and outside the State.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Farmers are imparted specialised training at the center including in the farmers' field.
- Exposure programmes and field tours are also conducted for farmers' groups.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Assist in Training and capacity building and sponsoring Progressive/Award winning farmers for Exposure trips within/outside the State.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana
brief_description:
Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana has been started on June 01Rs. 2016 by the Rajasthan Government to develop positive thinking towards girls to improve their health and educational level and to make them self-reliant. The benefit of this scheme will be given to all those girls of the state who were born after June 1Rs. 2016.
This scheme have the following objective

1. Promote the education of girls.
1. Improve the health and social status of girls.
1. Encourage a positive mindset towards girls in society.
1. Address gender bias.
benefits: - **Financial Benefits are** **Time to provide benefits****Amount of profit**At the time of birth2Rs./-1 year after vaccination2Rs./-On admission to first class4Rs./-On taking admission in sixth class5Rs./-On taking admission in the tenth class11Rs./-On taking admission in class 12th25Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The girl child must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. She must be born on or after June 1Rs. 2016.
1. The girl child must be born in a government or private medical institution registered with Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY).
1. Only two girl child will be eligible.
1. Girl's parents must have an Aadhar Card and a Bhamashah Card.

name: Maternity Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Maternity Benefit is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of maternity benefits shall be provided to women construction workers registered under the Board during their maternity period.
benefits: 1. The registered women construction workers shall receive financial assistance of 1Rs./- as maternity benefits during their maternity period.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a woman engaged in building or other construction works.
1. The applicant should be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The applicant should have an active membership of the Board.
1. Women workers are eligible to avail of maternity benefits during their maternity period.
1. This benefit shall not be allowed for more than twice.

name: Cash Award (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Cash Award is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. the Board annually awards cash prizes to three male and three female children of registered construction workers in each district who scores the highest marks in the SSLC examination.
benefits:
1. Every yearRs. the Board awards a cash prize to three male and three female children of registered construction workers in each district who achieve the highest marks in the SSLC examination.
1. The award amounts are 1000/-Rs. 750/-Rs. and 500/- respectively.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
1. Registered construction workers whose child or children achieve the highest marks in the SSLC examination within their district can apply to avail the benefits of the scheme.

name: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme-II
brief_description: The 'Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to encourage widow remarriage and to rehabilitate widows by giving financial assistance along with 1 sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin. Interested applicants should apply offline or via CSC.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 25Rs./-.
- One sovereign (8gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.

> **Mode of Disbursal:**

15Rs./- through Electronic Clearing Service and 10Rs./- as a National Savings Certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a widow.
1. The bride (widow) should be 20 years or above in age.
1. The bridegroom should be less than 40 years or above in age.
1. The applicant should have a degree passed from regular collegesRs. distance education/government-recognized open university.
1. The applicant should have a diploma passed from the Institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.

name: Higher Educational Finance Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Higher Educational Finance Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is extended to the wards of the Construction Workers who get admission into higher education programs through CENTACRs. Puducherry. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the ward of the worker. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Qualification: M.B.B.S / B.D.S (CENTAC); Benefit: 1Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech. (CENTAC); Benefit: 50Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: Diploma in Engineering; Benefit: 20Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: UG; Benefit: 2Rs./- per annum.
- Qualification: PG; Benefit: 4Rs./- per annum.
- Qualification: Diploma; Benefit: 2Rs./- per annum.
- Qualification: PG Diploma; Benefit: 3Rs./- per annum.
- Qualification: MD General Medicine & Related; Benefit: 1Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: MS Orthopaedics & Related; Benefit: 1Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: MD Clinical Pharmacology & Related; Benefit: 1Rs./- (One Time Payment).
- Qualification: M.Tech / M.E Engineering Courses; Benefit: 75Rs./- (One Time Payment).

_*The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the ward of the worker._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be a ward of a Construction Worker.
- The Construction Worker should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have secured admission into a higher education program through CENTACRs. Puducherry.

name: Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Assistance Scheme for Occupational Diseases is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is given to registered construction workers for 15 types of occupational diseases and 23 types of serious injuries.
benefits:
1. Free medical treatment and monthly assistance of 1500/- shall be provided to the registered construction worker under normal circumstances in case of less than 90% disability.
1. Free medical treatment and monthly assistance of 3000/- shall be provided to the registered construction worker in case of 90 to 100% disability.
1. The above assistance shall be provided up to a maximum limit of 3Rs./-.
1. Financial assistance is provided to the registered construction workers for 15 types of occupational diseases and 23 types of serious injuries.

> **Terms and Conditions:**

Labourers falling under the category of construction workers as determined by the State Government from time to timeRs. who should be registered with the Board as construction workersRs. shall be treated free of cost in a hospital approved by the State Government.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The registered worker who has any type of disability due to an occupational disease or any serious injuries can avail of the benefits under this scheme.

name: Specialized Treatment & Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Specialized Treatment & Medical Assistance Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The Board provides for upto 2Rs./- for taking specialized medical treatment in Hospitals having tie-up with Government General Hospitals. The amount for the medical treatment is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Financial Assistance of upto 2Rs./- for taking specialized medical treatment in Hospitals having tie-ups with Government General Hospitals.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
