- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should have either met an accident or should be suffering from a disease such as TuberculosisRs. Lung IssuesRs. Neurological DisordersRs. etc.

name: Cash Benefit Scheme Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Cash Benefit Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to provide educational financial assistance to the wards of construction workers who have secured the top three ranks at the State Level and Regional Level in the Higher Secondary course or its equivalent examinations. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee/ dependent. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
> **State-Level Cash Benefit (Onetime Payment)** a) First Prize: 1Rs.. b) Second Prize: 80Rs.. c) Third Prize: 60Rs..
> **Region Wise Cash Benefit (Onetime Payment)** a) First Prize: 60Rs.. b) Second Prize: 40Rs.. c) Third Prize: 20Rs..
> **Annual Educational Assistance** a) Degree Courses: 2Rs.. b) Post Graduate Courses: 4Rs.. c) Diploma courses: 2Rs.. d) Postgraduate Diploma: 3Rs..
> **Mode of Disbursal** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be a ward of a Construction Worker.
- The Construction Worker should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have secured 1st/2nd/3rd Rank at the State/Regional Level in the Higher Secondary course or its equivalent examination.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Maternity Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the women employees who are beneficiary of the fund shall be given 5Rs./- each as maternity benefit during the period of maternity. The spouse of male employee who is the beneficiary of the fund shall also be given this benefit. The benefits can only be availed twice.
benefits:
Financial Assistance of 5Rs./- credited within 15 days through DBT.
*The spouse of male employee who is the beneficiary of the fund shall also be given this benefit.
*The benefits can only be availed twice.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should be a Woman.
- The applicant should be Pregnant.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the fund until he/she attains the age of 60 years.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should not already have received the benefits of this scheme two times.
- The spouse of male employee who is the beneficiary of the fund is also eligible.

name: Accident Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Accident Medical Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the Board may sanction an amount of 1Rs./- per month to the Construction Worker who has met an accident and sustained fracture. The financial assistance is provided until he/she becomes physically fit to resume normal work. The claim from the worker should be supported by medical certificates issued by a prescribed doctor.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month credited within 15 days through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
- The financial assistance is provided until he/she becomes physically fit to resume normal work.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should have met an accidentRs. and sustained fracture(s).
- The applicant should not be physically fit to resume normal work.

name: Accidental Death Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Accidental Death Benefit Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. This scheme extends financial assistance of 2Rs./- to the nominees/dependents of the deceased Construction WorkerRs. apart from the 2Rs./- extended through the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC). The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee/dependent. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 2Rs./-.- **Time of Disbursal:** Within 15 days of the application.- **Mode of Disbursal:** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be the nominee/dependent of the deceased Construction Worker.
- The Construction Worker should have been a citizen of India.
- The Construction Worker should have died in an accident caused due to the harness.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have contributed regularly to the fund.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.

name: Mukhyamantri Bhagyalaxmi Bond Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Bhagyalaxmi Bond Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme has been implemented with the objective of "Beti Bachao Beti Padhao" to prevent female foeticide and to meet the education and marriage expenses of the daughter of a construction worker. Under the schemeRs. a bond is provided in the name of the first girl childRs. of age up to 1 year of ageRs. of the registered Building and Other Construction Workers.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a bond of 25Rs./- or of the amount as resolved from time to timeRs. with maturity at 18 year of the age of the girl childRs. upto one girl is given to the registered Building and other Construction workers.
1. The amount can be withdrawn by the daughter after completing 18 years of age.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The construction workers are eligible to avail the benefits of the scheme in the event of the birth of a girl child.
1. The benefit of the scheme is given upto one girl child.
1. The application form should be made within 12 months from birth.

name: Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to encourage the children of laborers who are enrolled in professional or design courses by providing assistance for purchasing laptopsRs. thereby reducing the financial burden of education.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. 50% of the amount or 25Rs./- whichever is less will be given to the student admitted in a professional or designing courseRs. with consideration to the laptop price limit of 50Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. Workers who are employed in a factory/institute within the state of Gujarat and have been contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund for at least one year at the local office are eligible to apply for benefits under this scheme for their children.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given to children of workers who have passed the class 12th board exam and secured all over 70% or more.
1. The student should be admitted in any professional or design course.
1. The laptop should be purchased in the name of the student.
1. Students who have taken admission abroad are not eligible to benefit from this scheme.
1. In the year in which the board exam has been givenRs. the application will have to be made within 6 (six) months after purchasing the laptop in the same year.

name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Maize Development through Cluster Approach was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to increase food grain production in order to attain self-sufficiency by growing high-yielding varieties of maize and also by adopting crop and location-specific production technology.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. quality seeds shall be supplied to farmers at subsidized rates for higher yield.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
1. The applicant should have sufficient available cultivable land of (0.025 hectares).

name: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The scheme "Government Service Home" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme aims to provide institutional care to widowsRs. destitute womenRs. deserted womenRs. adolescent girls and differently-abled women and their children who are economically and socially backward by giving them protectionRs. education and vocational training.
benefits: The beneficiary is provided accommodationRs. FoodRs. EducationRs. Vocational trainingRs. Free supply of textbooksRs. notebooksRs. uniformsRs. chappalsRs. and sanitary napkins.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 72Rs./- (not applicable for differently abled). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 14 to 45 years. 1. The applicant should qualify as one of the following: - Widow. - Destitute Woman. - Deserted Woman. - Adolescent Girl. - Differently Abled Woman. - Woman from Socially and Economically Backward Sections.
**NOTE: The women can stay with their male child up to 5th standard and girl child up to 12th standard in the Service Home.**

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Senior Artists in Contemporary Art Field
brief_description: The "Scheme for Giving Awards to Senior Artists in Contemporary Art Field" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage senior artists and develop the Painting and Sculpture arts by giving an award of 15Rs./- at the state-level contemporary art exhibition. The Traditional Art / Contemporary Art exhibitions are conducted by Oviya Nunkalai Kuzhu at the state level and awarded works will be on display for public view in the exhibition.
benefits: Prize Money of 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant's age should be 30 years or above.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artists
brief_description: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month to artists who are in indigent circumstances and their dependents. The Indigent artists who have rendered services in the field of Art and Culture during their lifetime ar eligible for this scheme.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 3Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should be in indigent circumstances.
1. The age of the applicant should be 58 years or above.
1. The applicant should have professionally served for the enrichment of one or more art disciplines such as musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. film folk artsRs. etc.
1. The annual income of the applicant or their legal spouse should not exceed 12Rs./-.

name: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream)
brief_description: The Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream) is implemented by the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (General Stream) and have obtained 75% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching feesRs. as per merit prepared at state level up to 100 students.
benefits:
> **Assistance Details:**

Standard 11th: 8Rs./- per annum as a private tuition fees
Standard 12th: 4Rs./- per annum as a private tuition fees
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
1. The student should be studying in Standard 11th & 12th General Stream.
1. The student should have 75% or more marks in Standard 10th.
1. The annual family income of the student should be up to 4.50 lakhs.

**Note:** Assistance is given to the first 100 eligible students based on merit.

name: Scheme of Conferring Kalaichemmal Awards
brief_description: The "Scheme of Conferring Kalaichemmal Awards" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage eminent artists in the field of paintings and sculptures in recognition of their meritorious service in the fields of Traditional Art and Contemporary Art. The Kalaichemmal awardees are given a citation and a cash award of 1Rs./-. The exhibitions are conducted by Oviya Nunkalai Kuzhu at the state level and creations works will be on display for public view in the exhibition.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of 1Rs./-. - Copper Citation Plaque.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an eminent artist.
- The applicant should be a domicile of Tamil Nadu or should be a resident of the state for at least five years.
- The eminent artist should have outstanding records of achievement in the field of Contemporary or Traditional art.
- The eminent artist should have continuous involvement in their fields.
- The eminent artist should have participated in art Exhibitions conducted on behalf of the Government or in the major exhibitions of Art conducted by others.
- The eminent artist should receive awards at the National-level or State-level art Exhibitions.

name: Subsistence Allowance (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: The scheme "Subsistence Allowance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Veterans of the Second World War (WWII)Rs. Non-pensioners ESM above 60 years under "Below the Poverty Line (BPL)"Rs. and their widows. This scheme applies only to the Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- 10Rs. per month for Second World War (WWII) VeteransRs. irrespective of financial status.
- 9Rs. per month for Non-pensioners ESM above 60 years under "Below Poverty Line (BPL)".
- 9Rs. per month for widows of the above two categories.

*The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an [Ex-Serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen) or the Widow of an Ex-Serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure) with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.

name: Immediate Assistance for Severe Injury in Road/Fire Accident (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Immediate Assistance for Severe Injury in Road/Fire Accident" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. 25Rs./- is provided to the registered Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen who have suffered a severe injury in a Road/Fire Accident. The members of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) are not eligible. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 25Rs./-Rs. credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)/Widow of an Ex-serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.

- The applicant should have suffered a severe injury in a Road/Fire Accident.
- The applicant should not be a member of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).

name: Denture Grant (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Denture Grant" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. 20Rs./- is provided for the purchase of Denture to the registered Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen. The members of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) are not eligible. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 20Rs./- is provided for the purchase of Denture.


- The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)/Widow of an Ex-serviceman.- The applicant should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The applicant should not be a member of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).

name: Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)
brief_description: "Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the academically meritorious wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM pursuing higher education are provided cash incentive of 1Rs. per month. The application should be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the result of the respective exam.
benefits: Cash Incentive of 1Rs. per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Ward of an ESM / Ward of the Widow of an ESM.
- The applicant should be registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.
- The applicant should have scored 95% in Class 11th/12th.
- The applicant should have scored 90% in the semester/annual exam of a non-professional course (80% in the case of professional course).
- The applicant should not be in receipt of any other academic scholarship.

name: Uniform Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Uniform Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM studying in Government-recognized Institutions are provided allowances towards purchase of their uniform. The application should be submitted offline within three months from the date of completion of the education.
benefits:
> **Allowance (in per annum) according to the Level of Qualification**


- School Level: 2Rs.
- Other Courses: 2Rs.

_*The rate listed above or the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. is reimbursed._
_*The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Ward of an Unemployed ESM / Ward of the Widow of an ESM.
- The applicant should be registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.
- The Ward should be studying in a Government-recognized Institution.
- The scheme is applicable for upto two wards of the Unemployed ESM / Widow of an ESM.

name: Vermicompost Ikai
brief_description:
The Vermicompost Ikai under the Agriculture Department Rajasthan government provides subsidies to farmers. Through the organic manure methodRs. good quality manure can be prepared in a very short time under normal temperatures in which entire species of earthworms are used. In thisRs. the cellulose and microorganisms present in the intestines of earthworms together decompose the ingested organic matter very rapidly. Due to the effect of their digestive process and the combined mixture of organic matterRs. these earthworms leave out a waste material which is called vermicomposting and these Manure pits are not found without earthworms.
> **Important points** 1. Verification can be done by the committee formed after construction. 1. After physical verificationRs. the grant amount will be paid directly into the farmer's bank account.
benefits:
1. Vermicomposting Unit with RCC Construction

1. Size: 30 feet X 8 feet X 2.5 feet
1. Cost: 50% of the installation costRs. up to a maximum of 50Rs./- per unit
1. Subsidy is proportional to the size of the unit

1. HDPE Vermibed Unit

1. Size: 12 feet X 4 feet X 2 feet
1. Cost: 50% of the installation costRs. up to a maximum of 8Rs./- per unit
1. Subsidy is proportional to the size of the unit
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The Applicants must Cultivate horticultural crops on a minimum of 0.4 hectares of own land.
1. The farmer must have livestockRs. waterRs. and fossils available.

name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the meritorious wards of the ESM are provided grants for their achievements in sports at national and international levels. The application should be submitted offline within three months from the date of the achievement.
benefits:
- Grant of 50Rs./- for achievements in sports at the international level.
- Grant of 30Rs./- for achievements in sports at the national level.
- The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Ward of an ESM / Ward of the Widow of an [Ex-Serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen) (ESM).- The ESM / Ward of the Widow of an ESM should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The event should be organised by a body approved/recognized by the Government.
- The applicant should have achieved merit in a sport at the national/international level.

name: Funeral Grant (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "Funeral Grant" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. funeral Assistance of 12Rs./- or 10Rs./- is provided in the event of death of the ex-Serviceman (ESM) or of the Widow of the ESM respectively. This scheme applies only to the Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- In case of death of the ESMRs. 12Rs./- is provided to the ESM's Widow.
- In the case of the death of the Widow of the ESMRs. 10Rs./- is provided to a member of the ESM's family.
- The assistance is provided immediately on occurrence with permission for burial/cremation from the appropriate authority (Death Certificate not required).
- The amount is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT.
eligibility:
- In case of death of the [ESM](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)Rs. the applicant should be the ESM's Widow.- In case of death of the Widow of the ESMRs. the applicant should be any other member of the ESM's family.
- The deceased ESM/ deceased Widow of the ESMRs. in their lifetimeRs. should have been [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The scope of this scheme will also apply to those ESM / living spouse/widows who are re-employed as regular / deemed to be regular in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Private Organizations and self-employed IT assesses.

name: Shednet House
brief_description:
The Shednet House scheme under the Agriculture Department Rajasthan Government provided subsidies to farmers so they could earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetablesRs. flowersRs. fruitsRs. etc. by controlling the agro-climatic factorsRs. temperatureRs. humidityRs. and sunlight. A shednet house or other woven material is a structure that has openings for the necessary sunlightRs. moistureRs. and air to enter from the open spaces. It creates a suitable microenvironment conducive to the growth of the plant. It is also called shednet house or net house.
> **Other important points** 1. Construction of shednet house should be done only after administrative approval/work order has been issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. After constructionRs. verification will be done by the committee formed. 1. Payment of grant amount directly into the bank account of the farmer or to the producer firm based on written consent of the farmer.
benefits:
> **For a maximum area of 4000 square meters** 1. 50 percent subsidy is given to general-category farmers. 1. 70 percent subsidy is given to smallRs. marginalRs. scheduled casteRs. and scheduled tribe farmers.
> **In compliance with the Chief Minister's budget announcementRs. 25 percent additional grant is being given to all the small and marginal category farmers of the state along with the farmers of the Scheduled Tribe areas.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

name: Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the worker registered with the Board is provided with a loan of 5Rs./- for the purchase of tools. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Loan of 5Rs./- for the purchase of tools.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Worker.
- The worker should be between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The worker should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year.
- The applicant should be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed three years of membership in the fund.
- The applicant should be remitting regular contributions to the fund.

name: Disability Pension (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Disability Pension (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the worker who is permanently disabled due to Paralysis / Leprosy / Tuberculosis(TB) / Accident is provided with financial assistance of 300/- per monthRs. and an ex-gratia payment of not more than 10Rs./-Rs. depending on the percentage of the disability.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 300/- per month.
- An ex-gratia payment of not more than 10Rs./-Rs. depending on the percentage of the disability.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Worker.
- The worker should be between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The worker should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year.
- The applicant should be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be permanently disabled.
- The disability should have been caused by Paralysis / Leprosy / Tuberculosis(TB) / Accident.
- The unregistered workers/ their dependents shall be eligible upon production of a certificate from the builder or Inspector of the area stating that he/she is a building worker.

name: Advance for Purchase or Construction of House (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Advance for Purchase or Construction of House (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Goa. Through this schemeRs. the worker registered with the Board is sanctioned financial assistance of upto 50Rs./- in advance for the outright purchase/construction of a house. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: 50Rs./- is sanctioned as advance and shall be recovered in equal instalments as may be fixed by the Board.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Worker registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The worker should be between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The worker should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year.
- The applicant should have had membership in the Fund continuously for five years.
- The applicant should have fifteen years of service for superannuation.

name: Unemployment Allowance to Disabled Persons
brief_description: The Unemployment Allowance To Disabled Person scheme under the Social WelfareRs. Women & Child Development Chandigarh Government is to provide unemployment allowance to handicapped individuals who have been unemployed for an unduly long period and belong to the poor section of society. These individuals need assistance until they secure gainful employment. The scheme seeks to alleviate the financial burden faced by unemployed handicapped personsRs. ensuring they can meet their basic needs while actively seeking employment opportunities. By offering financial supportRs. the scheme aims to empower disabled individuals to become self-sufficient members of society.
benefits: > To all categories of Handicapped Persons: 500/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an unemployed person.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18-30 years.
1. The applicant's total family income of parents should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.
1. The applicants should have a minimum of two years of registration in the Special Employment Exchange in the U.T. Chandigarh.
1. The applicants should have been residing in U.T. Chandigarh for at least three years immediately before the submission.

name: Living Craft Treasure Award
brief_description: The "Living Craft Treasure Award" scheme was launched by the HandloomsRs. HandicraftsRs. TextilesRs. and Khadi DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This is the highest award for handicrafts at the state level was introduced in the year 2013-2014 to craftspersons of eminence who are above the age of 65 years. This award consists of a cash prize of Rs.1.00 lakhRs. a thamirapattiramRs. an 8-gram gold medalRs. and a certificate. The award is granted yearly.
benefits:
- Cash Prize of 1Rs./-.
- Thamirapattiram.
- 8-gram Gold Medal.
- Certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artisan.
1. The applicant should be a native of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be working in the handicraft industry in Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be 65 years of age or above.
1. The experience of the craftsman and the service he has rendered in his profession's special features will be taken into consideration during selection.

name: Personal Accident Relief for Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Personal Accident Relief for Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Dept. for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. In this schemeRs. accident relief is provided to differently-abled persons up to 1Rs./-. The scheme covers cases such as deathRs. loss of both legs/both hands/one hand/one legRs. and loss of sight in one eye/both eyes.
benefits:
1. Relief to the Legal Heir in the event of death of the differently-abled person: 1Rs./-.
1. Relief in the case of Loss of both legs & both hands/ one leg & one hand/ loss of sight in both eyes: Upto 1Rs./-.
1. Relief in the case of Loss of one hand/ one leg/ loss of sight in one eye: 50Rs./-.
1. Relief in the case of Total disablement not covered in Sl. no.2 and 3 above: 25Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The person should have died or should have become differently-abled in an accident.
2. The disability should be one of the following:

- Loss of Both Legs and Both Hands.
- Loss of One Hand and One Leg.
- Loss of Sight in Both Eyes.
- Loss of One Hand.
- Loss of One Leg.
- Loss of Sight in One Eye.

3. The person should be/ should have been a registered member of the "Welfare Board for the Differently-Abled".

name: Pension Benefit (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Pension Benefit (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Goa. Through this schemeRs. a member of the Fund who has been working as a building worker for not less than one yearRs. be eligible for a pension of 300/- per monthRs. on completion of sixty years of age. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
Pension of 300/- per monthRs. with an increase of 10/- for every completed year of service beyond 5 years.
_*The pension will be payable from the first day of the succeeding month to the month in which he/she becomes 60 years old._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be registered as a 'Building Worker' for not less than one year with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be a member of the Fund of the Board.

name: Fodder Minikits under Schedule Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
brief_description: The scheme Fodder Minikits under Schedule Castes Sub Plan is implemented by the Directorate of Animal HusbandryRs. AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. improved varieties of fodder seeds are provided to beneficiaries for widespread publicityRs. demonstrationRs. and adaptation by farmers.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. the fodder seed minikit of 3 KgRs. 7 KgRs. or 10 Kg is given to the eligible beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
1. The beneficiary of the Scheduled Caste category can avail the benefit under this scheme.
1. The beneficiary should possess 10 Guntha of land to his or her name.

name: Poompuhar District Craft Award
brief_description: The "Poompuhar District Craft Award" scheme was launched in the year 2011-2012 by the Department of HandloomsRs. HandicraftsRs. Textiles & KhadiRs. Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The award was introduced to recognize and honor the artisans district-wise. The awards are conferred every year and consist of a cash prize of 10Rs./-Rs. a silver medalRs. and a certificate. The award is granted annually.
benefits:
- Cash Prize of 10Rs./-.
- Silver Medal.
- Certificate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artisan.
1. The applicant should be a native of Tamil Nadu.
1. Handicraft competitions will be conducted in the following 16 types of handicrafts: Panchaloka IdolsRs. Brass Lamps and Brass ArtifactsRs. Thanjavur PaintingsRs. Thanjavur PlatesRs. Wood SculpturesRs. Stone SculpturesRs. Fire ClayRs. Kalamkari Pathik and Applique WorkRs. Pulp ToysRs. Mat WeavingRs. Bamboo and Palm Leaf ProductsRs. Neti WorkRs. TextilesRs. Temple JewelleryRs. Pictorial Embroidery Work and Other Handicrafts.
1. The experience of the artisans and the service rendered by them in their profession and other special features will also be taken into consideration during the passing.

name: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Grant for the Purchase of Work-Related Tools for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. aims to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for purchasing work-related tools. Through this schemeRs. a grant of 5Rs. is provided to the members of the Fund. The scheme is implemented by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: - An amount of 5Rs./- as a grant to the members of the FundRs. for the purchase of work-related tools once in 5 years. > **Validity****:** The benefit can be applied for after three years from the date of registration.
eligibility:
> **For Registration:** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application:** - The applicant should be registered under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for not less than 3 years. - The applicant should remit their contribution regularly. - The applicant should not exceed 55 years of age. - The applicant must be a registered construction worker.

name: Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment
brief_description: The "Early Intervention Centre for Infants and Young Children with Hearing Impairment" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme has established early intervention centres for infants and young children with hearing impairment in all districts except Thiruppur and Ramanathapuram. These centres provide training to develop speech and language skillsRs. aiming to integrate children into regular schools by the time they reach 5 years old.
benefits: - Infants and young children with hearing impairment are given the training to develop speech and language skills.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary child should be between 0-6 years.
1. The beneficiary child should have hearing impairment.
1. The beneficiary child should not have any other disabilities.

name: Prosthetic Aid and Appliances for Person with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme "Prosthetic Aids and Appliances for Person with Disabilities" was launched by the Director Social DefenceRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. a Person with Disabilities with 40% or more disability is given relief in his/her disability as well as equipment for self-employment within the limit of 20Rs./-. The scheme is fully funded by the state government.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following equipment is given within a limit of 20Rs./-.

1. Artificial limbRs. crutch or calipersRs. tricycleRs. folding wheelchair to Person with Disabilities.
1. Hearing aids and other tool assistance for mute and deaf persons.
1. Musical instrumentsRs. brail kit for visually impaired persons.
1. M. R. child kit for mentally challenged persons.
1. For self-employmentRs. hand cartsRs. sewing machinesRs. instruments of electric repairingRs. tools of cycle repairingRs. hair cutting kitRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have 40 % or more disability.
1. Employment-oriented tools will not be provided to individuals under the age of 16.
1. Under this schemeRs. employment-oriented and disability-relieving equipment will be available only once in a period of 5 years.
1. Both employment-oriented and disability-relieving equipment are available for persons with disability under the scheme.

name: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. maternity benefits of 30Rs./- is provided to the registered women members and wives of male members for upto 2 children from the date of joining membership of the fund.
benefits: - 30Rs./- is provided to the registered women members and wives of male members for upto 2 children from the date of joining membership of the fund.
eligibility:
> **For Registration**


- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For Application**


- Registered women member Under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board .

OrRs.
Wives of registered male members Under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

- The applicant shall be eligible to avail the benefits only for their first 2 children.

name: Free Travel in S.T Bus to the Disabled Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Free Travel in S.T Bus to the Disabled Persons" was launched by the Director Social DefenceRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. the benefit of free travel in all types of busses of the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation is provided to Persons with Disabilities in all state routes and also provides the benefit of travel to the last route out of state. The scheme is fully funded by the state government.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. a free traveling facility is provided to Persons with Disabilities in all types of buses of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation.
1. The benefit of free travel is also provided up to the final/last station of the bus route in the case of travel outside the state of Gujarat.
1. A card is also issued by the District Social Defense Officer after the approval of the application.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or more in order to avail of the benefits under the scheme.

name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP- ST Category)
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Tribal Area Sub Plan is implemented by the Directorate of Animal HusbandryRs. AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is given to dairy farmers belonging to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category on purchase of electric powered chaff cutters. By using power driven chaff cutterRs. dairy farmers can reduce wastage of green and dry fodder which is economically important for their profitable dairy farming.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance up to 75% of the purchase cost of powered chaff cutter or 18Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. is given to beneficiaries of Scheduled Tribes category.

**Note:** The amount of assistance will be deposited in bank account of the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The beneficiary should have a minimum of five (5) animals of his/her own.

name: General Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh
brief_description: The Social Welfare Department recognizes the importance of education in shaping the futureRs. and is committed to providing opportunities for all. That's why they offer scholarships to financially disadvantaged students from General castesRs. enrolled in Class 9 or 10. This program bridges the financial gap that can hinder a student's academic journeyRs. empowering them to complete secondary school and pursue their educational goals. By alleviating the financial burden on familiesRs. the scholarship encourages students to stay in schoolRs. focus on their studiesRs. and reach for a brighter future through higher education.
benefits: For complete course duration : 3Rs./- annually.
eligibility:
1. Beneficiary must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Beneficiary must belong to the General category.
1. Beneficiaries who are dependents of people in occupations traditionally considered untouchable.
1. Beneficiaries' parents' annual income should not be more than 2Rs./-.
1. All the children of the applicant's parents will be eligible.
1. Students cannot receive other scholarships alongside this one (with some exceptions).
1. Beneficiary's age limit is 12 to 20 years old (as of July 1st).

name: Maintenance Allowance for Leprosy Affected Persons
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil NaduRs. recognizes the enduring challenges faced by individuals affected by leprosy. In responseRs. the government has established the Maintenance Allowance Scheme for Leprosy Affected Persons. This program aims to provide vital financial support to improve the well-being and standard of living for those living with the after-effects of leprosy.
benefits:
Financial Assistance of 2Rs./- per month.
> **NOTE:** The allowance is sent through ECS to their bank account directly from the Treasury.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be leprosy affected with deformity of 40% and above.
1. The beneficiaries should not receive any other pension benefit of Tamil Nadu.

name: Purchase/Construction of House for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Purchase/Construction of House for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Through this schemeRs. an advance amount of 3Rs./- to 5Rs./- is provided to the registered workers for purchasing or construction of houses. The amount sanctioned as advance shall be recovered in equal instalments as may be fixed by the Board. The house constructed will be under hypothecation to the Board till the last instalment of advance is paid by the
benefits:
- 3Rs./- to the workers who have 10 years left to complete 60 years of age.
- 5Rs./- to the workers who have 15 years left to complete 60 years of age.
eligibility:
> **For Registration**


- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For Application**


- The applicant should have a minimum of 10 years to 15 years of service for superannuation.
- The applicant should have been registered with the Board for not less than three years.

name: Pension Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Pension Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a member of the fund who has been working as a building worker for not less than three years shall on completion of sixty years of age be eligible for a pension. The pension will become payable from the first day of the succeeding to the month in which he completes sixty years of age.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. a registered construction worker is given a pension of 3Rs./- per month after the age of 60 years.
eligibility:
1. Applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of three years of regular membership before completing the age of 60 years.
1. The registered worker should not be availing the pension benefits from any other Department/Board/Corporation of the Haryana Government.

**Note 01:** It is necessary to mention the payment of the registration fee and contribution on the identity card of the registered worker.
**Note 02:** At the time of registrationRs. it is necessary to attach a copy of the document submitted regarding proof of age.
**Note 03:** It is necessary to attach the No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
**Note 04:** It is mandatory to submit/upload a life certificate every year in the month of NovemberRs. otherwiseRs. the board will be unable to give a pension.

name: Early Intervention Center for the Children with Intellectually Disabled
brief_description: The "Early Intervention Center for the Children with Intellectually Disabled" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Early intervention Center for children with intellectual disabilities have been established in all the districts to benefit 50 children in each districtRs. except Dharmapuri. These centers have been established through NGOs. > **Objective** The main objective of these Center is to identify children with intellectual disability and children with allied disabilities at birth and to provide early intervention.
benefits: - Early intervention provides to children with intellectual disabilities.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary child's age should be 6 years or below.
1. The child with intellectual disability and allied disabilities is eligible.

name: Modular Reflective Folding Sticks (Smartcane)
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil NaduRs. has introduced the "Modular Reflective Folding Sticks (Smartcane)" scheme to support visually impaired individuals in achieving self-orientation and independent mobility. The canes' modular design allows for adjustments to suit individual needsRs. enhancing comfort and functionality. By distributing these canesRs. the program empowers visually impaired individuals to navigate their surroundings with confidenceRs. fostering self-reliance and improving their quality of life. The scheme reflects the government's commitment to inclusivity and ensuring that visually impaired individuals have the necessary tools to lead independent and fulfilling lives.
benefits: - **Free distribution of modular reflective folding sticks.**
eligibility: - The applicant should be a visually impaired person.

name: Retrofitted Petrol Scooters - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Retrofitted Petrol Scooters by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a retrofitted petrol scooter to orthopedically differently-abled persons whose legs are affected. The studentsRs. employed and self-employed differently abled persons are eligible to get the scheme benefits.
benefits: - **Free distribution of retrofitted petrol scooters.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an orthopedically differently abled person.
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.
1. The applicant should be a resident of the district/area of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be any one of the following:



- Student.
- Employed (working in private organizations).
- Self-employed.

name: Walking Device - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Walking Device by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a rollator/walker to enable walking training to orthopedically differently abled children having difficulties in walking. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of walking devices.**
eligibility:
1. The child should be orthopedically person.
1. The child is having difficulty walking.

name: Pension Scheme for the Journalists
brief_description: The "Pension Scheme for the Journalists" was launched by the Tamil DevelopmentRs. Religious EndowmentsRs. and Information DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give a monthly pension to retired journalists who fit with the eligibility criteria.
benefits: - **Pension Amount of 4Rs./-** **per month**.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a retired journalist.
1. The age of the applicant should be 58 years or above.
1. The applicant should have worked full-time for 20 years in one of the posts of teacherRs. assistant teacherRs. reporterRs. photographerRs. proofreaderRs. or news correspondent.
1. 10 years of journalism experience is sufficient if the applicant is terminally ill or physically disabled.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 20Rs./-.
1. The applicant received gratuity and pension from previous companies should not exceed 30Rs./-.
1. In any year when the applicant was employedRs. their income should not exceed 50Rs./-.

name: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana is implemented by the Directorate of InformationRs. Public Relations & LanguagesRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. members of families with an annual income of less than 1.80 lakhs who are over 60 years of age will be taken for pilgrimages to AyodhyaRs. VaranasiRs. and other sacred places. The state government will bear all the expenses for their travel.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. the facility is provided to senior citizens who wish to visit religious destinations such as AyodhyaRs. VaranasiRs. Nanded SahibRs. Patna SahibRs. Ajmer SharifRs. and other such destinations in India.
1. The Scheme also ensures that constraints of travel and local arrangements do not hinder senior citizens from undertaking the journey.
1. The Government shall bear the cost of Rail travel (to and fro) in 3rd tier AC to destinations such as AyodhyaRs. VaranasiRs. Nanded SahibRs. Patna SahibRs. Ajmer SharifRs. and other such destinations in India.
1. The Government shall also bear the cost of transport from the place of residence to the Start of Train journey station at normative rates fixed by the Government. This cost shall be reimbursed to the applicant after the confirmation of completion of journey in the bank account of applicant linked with PPP ID.
1. Facility of an attendant to accompany the applicant may be availed by the applicant of age more than 80 years on payment of 50% of railway ticket fare charges either through online payment or by deposit of cash at nearby Antyodaya Saral Kendra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
1. The applicant should have completed 60 years of age (as on 1st January of the year in which the application is made for availing the scheme). Relaxation in age may be given to the spouse accompanying the applicant.
1. The applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme once every three years.
1. Family Income of the applicant from all known sources should be upto 1Rs./- per annum as verified by PPP.
1. The attendant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).

name: One Family One Job Scheme
brief_description: The scheme One Family One Job Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of EmploymentRs. Government of Haryana on 1st DecemberRs. 1992 in Haryana State. Eligible applicants can register their names under this schemeRs. making them eligible for all benefits provided by the Employment Department. A resident of Haryana State aged 18 to 35 years (with a relaxation of up to 5 years for SC or BC applicants) is eligible to apply under the schemeRs. provided no member of their family is employed in the public or private sector and no family member is an income tax or sales taxpayer.
benefits: 1. Candidates registered under this scheme are eligible for all benefits provided by the Employment Department.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be between 18 and 35 years old (with a relaxation of up to 5 years for SC or BC applicants).
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana State.
1. No member of the applicant's family should be employed in the public or private sector.
1. No member of the applicant's family should be an income tax or sales taxpayer.
1. No member of the applicant's family should be a current or former MP/MLA or a chairman of any boardRs. corporationRs. or undertaking.

name: Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows
brief_description: The scheme "Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to supply notebooks to children of poor widows studying up to higher secondary courses. The scheme has been extended to children in govt. children's homes and service homes.
benefits:
**Note Books are supplied free of cost as mentioned below:**

- 1st to 2nd Standard Books worth 50/- (per child per annum).
- 3rd to 5th Standard - Books worth 125/- (per child per annum).
- 6th to 8th Standard - Books worth 175/- (per child per annum).
- 9th to 10th Standard - Books worth 300/- (per child per annum).
- 11th to 12th Standard - Books worth 600/- (per child per annum).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a child of a poor widow.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in higher secondary.
1. The applicant's family income should not exceed 24Rs./- per annum.

name: Medical Assistance/Wage Compensation during Illness (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Medical Assistance/Wage Compensation during Illness is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. wage compensation/financial assistance is provided to registered construction workers as per the prevailing minimum wages in the state in case of an accident or illness. This assistance applies if the registered worker is admitted to a government or government-approved private hospital for treatment for a period ranging from 4 to 30 days.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. wage compensation or financial assistance is provided to registered workers if they are admitted to any government or empanelled private hospital for treatment for a minimum of 4 days and a maximum of 30 days.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in any building or construction work.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one year of regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. A worker who is admitted to a government or government-approved private hospital for treatment for 4 to 30 days due to an accident or illness is eligible for assistance.
1. The assistance shall be for a period not exceeding one month in a year.

name: Mahila Samiriddhi Yojana for Minority Community
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Samiriddhi Yojana for Minority Community" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under this schemeRs. loans up to 1Rs./- per beneficiary are provided only to women entrepreneurs of the target groupRs. either directly or through Self-Help Groups. Only women beneficiaries who are permanent residents of Haryana and belong to minority communities such as MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. ParsisRs. and Jains are eligible for the loans.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. Nigam provides loans up to 1Rs./- per beneficiary only to women entrepreneurs of the target groupRs. either directly or through Self-Help Groups.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 16 to 45 years.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The applicant should belong to Minority Community i.e. MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. ParsisRs. and Jains.
1. The annual family income of applicant should not exceed 98Rs./- (Rural Area) and 1Rs./- (Urban Area).
1. The applicant should have relevant educational/technical/vocational qualifications/experience and background to avail the loan benefits under this scheme.
1. The applicant should have Pariwar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).

name: Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged
brief_description: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance CorporationRs. Andhra PradeshRs. under its Action Plan 2017-18Rs. aims to provide tricycles to orthopedically challenged individuals to enhance their mobility and independence. The tricycles are distributed by the Assistant DirectorsRs. Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior CitizensRs. and District ManagersRs. A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.
benefits: - Eligible beneficiaries receive a free tricycle to improve their mobility and independence.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the [RPwD ActRs. 2016](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e58aea67b01fa747687f038dfde066f6/uploads/2023/10/202310161053958942.pdf).1. The applicant should be eligible for sanction only once in three years. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: Out of School Children scheme under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan
brief_description: The "Out of School Children" scheme under the Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) is designed to ensure that every child in the 6 to 14 age group receives a complete elementary education. The primary objective is to identify children who are out of schoolRs. whether they have never enrolled or have dropped outRs. and to reintegrate them into the educational system through specialized training programs.
benefits: Sanctions are granted to the NGOs for providing special training in the centre as per the norms of Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA).
eligibility:
- The child should not be enrolled in a school.
- The child should be in the age group of 6 to 14 years.

name: Establishment of Entrepreneur for Breed Development in Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)
brief_description:
Launched in the Financial Year 2014-15Rs. the scheme **"National Livestock Mission"** by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Ministry of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry and DairyingRs. aims towards employment generationRs. entrepreneurship developmentRs. increase in per animal productivity and thus targeting increased production of meatRs. goat milkRs. egg and wool. The excess production will help in the export earnings after meeting the domestic demands. The concept of the NLM Scheme is to develop the entrepreneur in order to create the forward and backward linkage for the produce available in the unorganized sector and to link with the organized sector.
**"Establishment of Entrepreneur for Breed Development in Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)"** is a component of the "Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry" scheme of the National Livestock Mission. The objectives of this component are: - To develop entrepreneurs in the small ruminant sector. - To develop a sustainable business model on sheep-goat. - To incentivize individual entrepreneursRs. FPOsRs. FCOsRs. SHGsRs. JLGsRs. and Section 8 companies for the development of an integrated rural sheep-goat production system. - Conversion of the small ruminant sector from unorganised sector to organised sector through promotion of entrepreneurship & investment and creation of forward & backward linkages. - Spreading awareness about scientific rearing practicesRs. nutritionRs. disease prevention etc. - Promotion of stall feeding model of sheep and goat rearing.
The Entrepreneurs / Eligible Entities can establish sheep and goat breeding unit with a minimum of 500 females and 25 males. The sheep and goat unit to be established with the High Genetic Variety used for producing Goat milkRs. meat and fine wool quality. The breed of sheep and goat can be selected from the list provided with this guideline or in consultation with the State Government.
benefits:
**CAPITAL SUBSIDY STRUCTURE**

- Maximum capital subsidy of Rs. 50 lakh offeredRs. split into two equal instalments.
- Subsidy is specifically for capital expenditureRs. not operational costs.
- Instalments are released through SIDBI based on project milestones.

**DISBURSEMENT PROCESS FOR BANK-FINANCED PROJECTS**

- First instalment released after bank provides initial loan and SIA confirmation.
- Second instalment provided after project completion and SIA certification.
- SIDBI manages fund transfer through scheduled banks/financial institutions.

**SELF-FINANCING PROJECT REQUIREMENTS**

- Project requires bank appraisal where entrepreneur holds account.
- First 50% subsidy released after verified 25% infrastructure expenditure.
- Remaining subsidy provided post-project completion and SIA verification.

**BANK GUARANTEE SPECIFICATIONS**

- Three-year bank guarantee required for self-financing projects.
- Guarantee must cover project cost beyond subsidy amount.
- Original document held by State Implementing Agency with copies for online portal.

**EXCLUSIONS FROM SUBSIDY**

- Subsidy not applicable for working capital needs.
- Personal vehicles and land purchase not covered.
- Rental and lease costs ineligible for subsidy support.
eligibility:
1. Individuals
1. Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
1. Farmer Cooperatives (FCOs)
1. Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
1. Joint Liability Groups (JLGs)
1. Section 8 Companies

name: Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti
brief_description: The scheme "Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti" was launched by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to motivate students from marginalized sections of societyRs. whose parents are involved in unclean and hazardous occupationsRs. to pursue their education. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per annum is provided as a scholarship to students from Class 1 to Class 10.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. regular students studying in Class 1st to Class 10th are given a scholarship of 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or other deprived categories of society.
1. One or both parents of the applicant should be engaged in unclean/unhygienic occupations (Scavenger/Flayers/Tanner). Students whose parents left these occupations after 1997 are also eligible for the scheme.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 10th.
1. Only two children from one family are eligible.
1. The applicant should be a native/resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant is not eligible for any other state scholarship.

name: Term Loan under NSKFDC- Haryana
brief_description:
The scheme "Term Loan under NSKFDC" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The HSFDC is a Company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly Government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India.
Under this schemeRs. loans are provided to Safai Karamcharis and their dependents for any viable income-generating activities with a maximum cost of up to 15Rs./- per beneficiary. These income-generating activities include auto repair and spare parts shopsRs. electrical goods workshopsRs. leather footwear manufacturing unitsRs. beauty parlorsRs. welding worksRs. carpentryRs. photographyRs. grocery shopsRs. sanitary supply storesRs. ready-made garmentsRs. cyber cafesRs. band partiesRs. tent housesRs. etc. The beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years of age and should be either Safai Karamchari or his/her dependent.
benefits:
**Project Cost Ceiling:** - The Corporation (HSFDC)Rs. in collaboration with NSKFDCRs. provides loans of up to 15Rs./- per beneficiary for various self-employment income-generating activities. - The beneficiaries can avail loans ranging from 10Rs. to 15Rs./-. **Note:** The income-generating activities include auto repair and spare parts shopsRs. electrical goods workshopsRs. leather footwear manufacturing unitsRs. beauty parlorsRs. welding worksRs. carpentryRs. photographyRs. grocery shopsRs. sanitary supply storesRs. ready-made garmentsRs. cyber cafesRs. band partiesRs. tent housesRs. etc. **Margin Money:** - The Corporation provides margin money @ 10% of the project cost. **Subsidy:** - The corporation provides a subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum subsidy amount is 10Rs./-). **Note:** The subsidy is only provided to the beneficiary below the poverty line. > **Interest criteria for the loan amount recoverable by HSFDC:** **Upto Amount ()****Interest % P.A.****Penal Interest % P.A.**15Rs./-64
**Interest Starts on****Penalty Start After****Principal Recovery Starts After****Installment Starts After****Installment Period**Same Day30 Days120 Days120 Days30 Days
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The applicant should be either Safai Karamchari or his/her dependent.

**Note 1:** Permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged inRs. or employed for any sanitation work and includes his/her dependents.
**Note 2:** The applicant shall have to produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari from the Head of the Government Departments (i.e. SchoolRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry having rank not less than Gazetted Officer)Rs. elected members of Municipal Body/ Corporation and Pradhan of Gram PanchayatsRs. Local Revenue Officer or an Officer of Local Municipal OfficeRs. or Cantonment Executive Officer of the Cantonment or an officer of the Railways not below the rank of gazette officer.

name: Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter
brief_description: The Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (ABC) LimitedRs. a government undertakingRs. has launched the "Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter" (KS-FS) to address the critical needs of underprivileged Brahmins in Andhra Pradesh. This initiative aims to alleviate the financial burden of food and shelter expensesRs. including orphan childrenRs. differently-abled individualsRs. widowsRs. destitute women separated from their husbandsRs. and elderly Brahmins. The program offers financial assistance and encompasses all 13 districts of the state.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


- 2Rs./- per month to orphan children.
- 2Rs./- per month to different abled persons.
- 2Rs./- per month to widow or destitute women (separated from husband).
- 2Rs./- per month for elderly staying in his/her own home.
- 4Rs./- per month for elderly staying in any Old-Age Home in Andhra Pradesh.
- 2Rs./- per month for elderly staying in any Old-Age Home in Andhra Pradesh and getting a pension through the NTR Bharosa Scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Brahmin community and reside in Andhra Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a holder of a white ration card.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 75Rs./-.
1. The orphan children below 14 years of age as of 31st Jan 2019.
1. The Elderly above 60 years of age as of 31st Jan 2019.
1. All differently abled of any age and widows & destitute women (separated from husbandRs. but do not have legal documents) of any age.
1. The applicant should not have availed himself/ herself of any amount under any other Government scheme for the same purpose.

name: Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons" by the Dept of Social WelfareRs. WCDRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to encourage social integration and acceptance by promoting marriages between differently abled persons and normal personsRs. as well as between two differently abled individuals. Through this schemeRs. a one-time cash incentive of 1Rs./- is provided to eligible differently abled persons entering into such marriages.
benefits: - A one-time cash incentive of 1Rs./- is provided to eligible differently abled persons who marry either a normal person or another differently abled person under this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should ensure that the marriage is between a person with a disability and a person without a disability. 1. The applicant should ensure that neither the bride nor the bridegroom has availed of the incentive award under this scheme earlier. 1. The applicant should ensure that the bridegroom is 21 years of age and the bride is 18 years of age at the time of marriage.

name: Death Benefit
brief_description: The "Death Benefit'' scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance to the nominee(s) of the beneficiary as death benefit for both natural and accidental death.
benefits: - **For Natural Death:** 50Rs./-.- **For Accidental death:** 1Rs./-
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a nominee of a deceased registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
- The member should have lost his/ her life due to death.

name: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)
brief_description: The "General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)" schemeRs. launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to motivate and economically support students from lower economic backgrounds. Under this schemeRs. scholarships are provided to students studying in Classes 6 to 8 in government schools. Students whose annual family income is less than 1Rs./- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category are eligible for the benefits.
benefits:
- Girl students will receive a scholarship of 300/- per year.
- Boy students will receive a scholarship of 200/- per year.

**Note:** The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6 to 8.
1. The student should be studying at a government school.
1. The student should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The student's parents' total income from all sources should be less than 1Rs./- per year.
1. The student should have passed the previous class.

name: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
brief_description: The "Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child" scheme was launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to ensure the continuity of education for girl students who are the only daughters of their parents. Under this schemeRs. eligible girl students who are the only child of their parents and have passed the 10th class examination with at least 60% marks receive a scholarship of 5Rs./- per year.
benefits:
- Under the schemeRs. a scholarship of 5Rs./- per year is given to single girl child students.

**Note:** The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be the only girl child of her parents.
1. The girl student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The girl student should have scored 60% or more marks in the 10th class examination under the curriculum of the Madhya Pradesh Secondary Education Board.
1. The girl should be studying in Class 11 or 12 at a recognized private school.
1. The school tuition fees should be less than 1Rs./- per month.
1. The girl student should have passed the previous class.

**Note 1:** If the parents are government employeesRs. a certificate from the head of the office confirming the applicant is the only child or an attested copy of the family list in the ration cardRs. is required.
**Note 2:** If the parents are not government employeesRs. an affidavit from a notary confirming the applicant is the only childRs. or an attested copy of the ration cardRs. is required.

name: Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management
brief_description: The "Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management" schemeRs. implemented by the Higher Education Department of the Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide incentives to disabled students. This scheme benefits students pursuing computer or management courses at government collegesRs. provided their annual parental or guardian income does not exceed 1Rs./-. Under this schemeRs. eligible students receive reimbursement for the fees charged for computer and management courses. AdditionallyRs. they are provided a subsistence allowance of 1Rs./- per month and a transport allowance of 500/- per month if they are in Municipal Corporation areas and 300/- per month if they are in Municipal Council areas. Every year 2000 students can avail of this benefit.
benefits:
Eligible students under this scheme will receive the following assistance:

- Reimbursement of fees for computer and management courses.
- A monthly subsistence allowance of 1Rs./-.
- A transport allowance of 500/- per month for those in Municipal Corporation areas and 300/- per month for those in Municipal Council areas.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a disabled student.
1. The student should be studying a Computer or Management subject/course at a government college.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Pension Benefit (TBOCWW)
brief_description: The "Pension Benefit" scheme was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Department Tripura.
