The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the registered beneficiary who has retired due to old age attaining 60 years. The registered beneficiary will apply in the prescribed form through electronically.
benefits: - **A pension of 1Rs./- per month is to be paid till the death of the pensioner.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered applicant should be working as a building worker for not less than 5 years.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years or above.

name: Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana
brief_description: The "Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana" was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Department Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered female construction workers and maximum of two daughters of registered construction workers for marriage purposes. The registered beneficiary will apply in the prescribed form through electronically.
benefits: - **A one-time grant of 50Rs./- is provided to meet the marriage expenses of the female registered construction worker and a maximum of two daughters of a registered construction worker.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a female registered construction worker.
1. The female construction worker should have been registered for at least one year continuously.
1. The family of a registered construction worker can avail of this assistance only twice: howeverRs. there shall be only one claim in respect of a given marriage irrespective of the number of registered construction workers in the family.
1. The registered construction workers should not have any dues payable to the Board.
1. The registered construction worker's daughter should have attained the age prescribed by law for marriage for whose marriage the assistance is sought.
1. The registered construction worker's daughter should not be an employee in government or quasi-government.

name: International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED)
brief_description:
The "International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED)" was launched by the Indian Audit and Accounts DepartmentRs. and the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. The iCED Internship Scheme offers a unique opportunity for students specializing in Ocean ScienceRs. Environmental ScienceRs. Environmental ManagementRs. Environment AuditRs. Environmental EconomicsRs. Environmental LawRs. Public AdministrationRs. Public PolicyRs. Sustainable DevelopmentRs. Information TechnologyRs. Data AnalyticsRs. ArchitectureRs. Human Resource ManagementRs. Disaster ManagementRs. and related fields. This internship will focus on developing awareness about iCEDs workRs. with a particular emphasis on Blue EconomyRs. Climate ChangeRs. and gender-related themes.
> ***Duration:*** The internship duration would be 2 monthsRs. which may be extended up to 6 months.
> ***Number of interns:*** Two interns from one Institution/University would be selected for internship.
benefits:
> ***Token Remuneration:*** Interns will receive a token remuneration of 10Rs./- per month to cover conveyance and daily needs. NOTE: If boarding and lodging are provided by iCED the remuneration will be reduced to 5000/- per month.
> ***Certificate of Internship:*** Certificate will be issued upon satisfactory completion of the internshipRs. assignment submissionRs. and evaluation by the competent authority at iCED.
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be an Indian national.
1. Applicant must be a Graduate or pursuing Post Graduate/Doctoral courses in one of the following fields

- Ocean Science
- Environmental Science
- Environment Management
- Environment Audit
- Environmental Economics
- Environmental Law
- Public Administration
- Public Policy
- Sustainable Development
- Information Technology
- Data Analytics
- Architecture
- Human Resource Management
- Disaster Management
- Other similar streams

1. Applicant must be studying at a University/Institution of National or International repute.
1. Those awarded Junior Research Fellowship by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for research in these subjects will be given preference.
1. If there are more applications than requiredRs. the screening of applicants will be done using an appropriate methodology.

name: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
brief_description: The "State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)" schemeRs. implemented by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to ensure the continuity of education for students from the Backward Classes section of society. This scheme provides scholarships to Backward Classes students studying in Classes 6 to 10. To be eligibleRs. students should be domicile of Madhya PradeshRs. and their parents or guardians should not be income taxpayers or own not more than 10 acres of land.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students at the following rates:

- **Class 6 to 8:** 200/- per year (for boys) and 300/- per year (for girls) - **Class 9 to 10:** 300/- per year (for boys) and 400/- per year (for girls)
**Note:** The scholarship will be transferred directly into the student's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should belong to the Backward Classes or Minorities community.
1. Students from Class 6 to 10 are eligible for the benefits under this scheme.
1. The parents or guardians should not be income taxpayers or own more than 10 acres of land.

**Note:** There should not have been any increase in the income of the parents or guardians in the past year.

name: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The "Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. This scheme aims to enhance educational levels and provide assistance to children from low-income families. The scholarship is provided to the first one lakh students whose annual family income is up to 2Rs./- and who are not receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance.
**This scheme aims to provide scholarships to the following:-**

- New one lakh students who fulfill the eligibility.
- All such students who have approved scholarships under this scheme last year and who are continuously studying in institutions of higher education.

**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to talented students of low-income groups for pursuing higher education.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. eligible students will receive the following financial assistance::

- The students will receive 500/- per month for a maximum of 10 monthsRs. totaling up to 5Rs./- annually.
- The students with a disability of 40% or more will receive 1Rs./- per month for up to 10 monthsRs. totaling a maximum of 10Rs./- annually.

**Note:** The benefits under this scheme are available for a maximum of 5 years for regular students studying in higher educational institutions. If students discontinue their studies before completing 5 yearsRs. the benefits will be valid only for the previous year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a regular student.
1. The student should be studying at a government or recognized non-government higher or technical institute in Rajasthan.
1. Students should have passed the 12th examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary EducationRs. AjmerRs. in the current year with a minimum of 60% marks and secured a position within the top one lakh of the board's merit list.
1. Disabled students should have a disability of 40% or more.
1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The student should not be receiving benefits from any other scholarship or equivalent scheme provided by the Government of India or the State Government.
1. The student should have a savings account in a nationalized bank.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Aadhaar card.
1. The student should have a Jan Aadhaar Card (Bhamashah Card).

name: Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The Funeral Expenses for the Construction Workers scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to the nominee of each deceased registered member to meet their funeral expenses.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 3Rs./- for each deceased beneficiary payable to the nominee.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a nominee of a deceased registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.

name: Kalyani Sahayata Yojana (Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board)
brief_description: The "Kalyani Sahayata Yojana" is implemented by the Labour Welfare Board under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to the widows of organized sector workers. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 6Rs./- every six months (totaling 12Rs./- per year) will be provided to the wife of a deceased worker employed in an industrial unit or establishment in Madhya Pradesh. The application must be submitted within one year of the worker's death. Assistance continues annually upon submission of an affidavit confirming the widow is alive and has not remarried.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible widows of deceased workers receive financial assistance of 6Rs./- every six monthsRs. in June and December. This amounts to a total of 12Rs./- per year.

**Time limit:** The assistance amount will be paid to the concerned within 30 days of receipt of the application in the designated office for one year from the date of death of worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be the widow of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been employed in an industrial institution or establishment covered by the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund ActRs. 1982Rs. for at least one year prior to his death.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Board.
1. The widow should not have remarried.
1. The widow should not be receiving financial assistance from any other government department.

**Note:** The Board must have received regular contributions from the industrial institution or establishment for the deceased workerRs. in accordance with the rules.

name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows of Ex-servicemen (other than War Widows)
brief_description: The "Marriage Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows of Ex-servicemen (other than War Widows)" scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 11Rs./- is provided to the widows of ex-servicemen (other than war widows) for the marriage of their daughtersRs. for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 11Rs./- is given to the widows of ex-servicemen (other than war widows) for the marriage of their daughters.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be the widow of an ex-serviceman who did not die in the war (other than a war widow).
1. The daughter should be at least 18 years old.
1. The widow can receive the benefit for up to two of her daughters.
1. The widow should not have remarried. If remarriedRs. she should only have married the real brother of her late husband.

**Note:** The entire verification of claimants will be carried out at the level of the Secretaries of Zila Sainik Boards as hither-to-fore.

name: Swaran Jayanti Ashray Yojana - Himachal Pradesh
brief_description: The "Swaran Jayanti Ashray Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh aims to provide financial assistance for the construction of houses who are permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh belonging to Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward Classes.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 1Rs./- for construction of new house.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. or Other Backward Classes (OBC).
1. The applicant's annual income does not exceed 50Rs./-.
1. The applicant should not have his own house.
1. The land in the applicant's name should be in the revenue record for the construction of the house.

name: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Old Age Pension
brief_description: The scheme "Old Age Pension (OAP)" is a sub-component of the Integrated Social Security Scheme (IGSSS) implemented by the Social and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Under this schemeRs. pension is provided to old aged persons males (60 years & above) and females (55 and above) and who are destitute in the sense of having no means of subsistence from their own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources.
benefits: **Amount of pension:** 1Rs./- per month per beneficiary
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Ladakh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) Category.
1. The applicants age should be 60 years and above for males and 55 years and above for females.
1. The applicant should have no means of subsistence from their own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources.

name: Disabled Marriage Incentive Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 1st April 2005 by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. the scheme "Disabled Wedding Incentive Scheme" provides financial assistance for marriage to the persons with disabilities who do not fall under the category of income tax payers. The objective of the scheme is to socially rehabilitate the persons with disabilities. In case both husband and wife and differently-abledRs. the couple is provided with 50Rs./- (lump sum). In case either husband or wife is differently-abledRs. the couple is provided with 1Rs./- (lump sum). The application needs to be submitted in the prescribed form to the Joint Director / Deputy DirectorRs. Panchayat and Social Welfare of the district.
benefits:
- In case both husband and wife and differently-abledRs. the couple is provided with 50Rs./- (lump sum).
- In case either husband or wife is differently-abledRs. the couple is provided with 1Rs./- (lump sum).
- The amount will be disbursed to the concerned beneficiary directly through **NEFT/RTGS**Rs. whenever possible.
_*The incentive amount will be jointly payable to the eligible couple._
_*If the marriage is dissolved without a valid reason within five years of the wedding dateRs. the entire incentive amount will be recovered as land revenue._
_*Incentive amount will be given only once in a lifetime._
eligibility:
1. At least one partner in the couple should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above (as per [Section 2 of the Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 1995](https://thenationaltrust.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/Persons%20with%20Disability%20Act%201995.pdf)). 1. The applicants marriage should be conducted as per social customs or legally solemnized by a competent court.
1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
1. The age of the bride at the time of marriage should be 18 to 45 years.
1. The age of the bridegroom at the time of marriage should be 21 to 45 years.

name: Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide compensation to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability who do not have Health Cards under Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.
benefits: - **Compensation for Complete Disability:** Ex-gratia amount of 4Rs./-. - **Compensation for Partial Disability:** Proportionate amount of 4Rs./- shall be given on the basis of percentage of disability i.e.Rs. 4Rs./- for each 1% disability and maximum of 4Rs./-.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The member should have complete or partial disability.
- The member should not possess Health Cards issued under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.

name: One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students
brief_description: The Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Tripura was launched by the "One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students" scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to economically weaker meritorious Scheduled Tribe (ST) students. This support enables them to pursue professional and other courses in government-recognized institutes and colleges with the necessary financial support to continue their education without financial constraints.
benefits:
> **Financial Support:**

A one-time financial support of 1Rs./- will be provided to selected students in two installments:

- 1st Installment: 50Rs./- released immediately after selection.- 2nd Installment: 50Rs./- upon production of pass certificates for the 1st year course.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a domicile of Tripura.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community.
1. The student should have passed Class 10th (Madhyamik) for pre-12th courses or Class 12th (H.S level) for post-12th courses in 2022 with at least 45% marks.1. The student must have taken admission in any professional course listed in [Annexure-A and Annexure-B](https://twd.tripura.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notification_for_Public_Domain-OTFS.pdf) during the academic year 2022-23Rs. with a course duration of at least 2 years.

name: Arivu Education Loan Scheme
brief_description: The "Arivu Education Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and is implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to provide loans to students who wish to pursue professional courses such as M.B.B.S.Rs. M.D.Rs. M.S.Rs. B.E.Rs. B.Tech.Rs. M.E.Rs. M.Tech.Rs. B.D.S.Rs. M.D.S.Rs. B.AyushRs. M.AyushRs. M.B.A.Rs. M.C.A.Rs. L.L.B.Rs. B.ArchRs. M.ArchRs. B.Sc. in HorticultureRs. AgricultureRs. Dairy TechnologyRs. ForestryRs. VeterinaryRs. Animal SciencesRs. Food TechnologyRs. BiotechnologyRs. FisheriesRs. SericultureRs. Home/Community SciencesRs. Food Nutrition and DieteticsRs. B.PharmaRs. M.PharmaRs. Pharma.DRs. and D.Pharma.
benefits:
> ***Loan Amount:*** - The loan amount is granted from 50Rs./- to 5Rs./- every year until the course duration.
> ***Loan Renewal Process:*** - Renewal and pay 12% of the loan amount issued by the corporation during the previous year at their respective District Office.
> **Loan Repayment:** - Repay the loan with service charges of 2% after 6 months of completion of the course.
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the State Religious Minority Community.
1. The student should be a permanent resident of the State.
1. The annual income of the family should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Mata Shabri Mahila Sashktikaran Yojana
brief_description: The "Mata Shabri Mahila Sashktikaran Yojana" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The main objective of this scheme is to provide grants to women of Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe families living below the poverty line and provide them relief from tasks like collecting firewood for domestic purposes and improving the environment.
benefits:
**Subsidy:** The maximum subsidy amount is 1Rs./-.
**Note:** The subsidy covers 50% of the total cost of purchasing an LPG connection and stove.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant should belong to a scheduled caste or scheduled tribe family. 1. The applicant's family income should not exceed 35Rs./-.

name: Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana" was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The objective of this scheme is to provide quality education to meritorious students from minority communities in the state and to make them mentallyRs. physicallyRs. sociallyRs. and emotionally capableRs. fostering their all-round development in residential schools.
Under this schemeRs. students from minority communities will receive free education from Class 9 to Class 12 at residential schools. The school is based on a co-education system. In these schoolsRs. 50% of the seats will be reserved for girlsRs. and 75% of the seats in both boys' and girls' categories will be reserved to rural students.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. students from minority communities enrolled in residential schools will receive the following benefits:

- Free education from Class 9 to Class 12.
- Provision of free accommodationRs. including foodRs. clothingRs. medicineRs. and booksRs. along with free enrollment/admission.
- Access to well-equipped modern laboratories.
- Facility for studying subjects like PCM (PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Mathematics)Rs. PCB (PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Biology)Rs. ArtsRs. etc.Rs. at the higher secondary (Intermediate) level.
- Provision for special coaching and vocational training within the school.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should belong to a minority community.
1. The maximum age limit for admission is 16 years for Class 9 and 18 years for Class 11.
1. The student's annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

**Note:** Admission will be based on the merit list of marks obtained in the examination.

name: Griha Lakshmi Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Griha Lakshmi" by the by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Karnataka aims to empower women by providing financial assistance to female heads of households. The scheme offers a monthly financial aid of 2Rs./- to eligible womenRs. helping them manage household expenses and improve their quality of life. Eligible beneficiaries include women who are listed as the head of the family in the ration cardRs. and the scheme is open to families holding Below Poverty Line (BPL) or Above Poverty Line (APL) ration cards.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 2Rs./- per month.
- The amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account linked with Aadhaar (DBT) or through RTGS for non-Aadhaar linked accounts.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a woman.


- The applicant should be listed as the head of the family on the ration card.
- The applicant should be the head of the family as per the ration card (BPL or APL).
- The family of the applicant should be a resident of Karnataka.

**Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation**

- Women from BPL families are given priority.
- In case of the death of the family headRs. the next eligible female member can be registered.

name: Bihar State Madarsa Strengthening Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Bihar State Madarsa Strengthening Scheme" was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. to improve the quality of education in recognized Madarsas. Under this schemeRs. the state government provides essential facilities and infrastructure to Madarsas recognized by the Bihar State Madarsa BoardRs. as well as other government Madarsas.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. basic facilities and infrastructure will be provided to madrasas recognized by the Bihar State Madarsa Board and other government madarsas to enhance educational quality. The support includes:

- Construction of buildingsRs. office roomsRs. multipurpose hallsRs. hostelsRs. and vocational training halls.
- Establishment of computer and science labsRs. additional classroomsRs. and libraries.
- Provision of essential amenities such as kitchensRs. mess hallsRs. and toilets.
- Renovation of existing structures and installation of borewellsRs. pumpsRs. and tanks for clean drinking water.
- Upgrades to electricity systems and installation of solar power plants etc.
eligibility:
1. The Madarsa should be located in Bihar.
1. The Madarsa should be recognized by the Bihar State Madarsa Board or other Government-Recognized Madarsas.
1. The Madarsa Management Committee should not have been subject to any disciplinary actions in the past three years.
1. The Madarsa should possess sufficient landRs. which should be legally owned and free from disputes.
1. The Madarsa should have an enrollment of more than 70 students.
1. The Madarsa should have been recognized for at least two years.
1. The Madarsa should adhere to all relevant state regulations and guidelines for educational institutions.

name: Disability Pension and Ex-Gratia (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Disability Pension and Ex-Gratia'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this SchemeRs. financial support shall be provided to registered construction workers in the form of pension who are partially disabled due to accidents or diseases incurred at their worksite. Beneficiaries may receive an ex-gratia payment depending on the extent of their disability. The pension is discontinued upon the beneficiary reaching sixty (60) years of age.
benefits: - **Monthly Disability Pension:** 2Rs./-. - **Additional Ex-gratia Payment:** 2Rs./- based on the percentage of disability.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
- The applicant should be partially disabled due to worksite accidents or diseases.
- The applicant should not have availed Accident Benefits for the same disability.
- The applicant must be below sixty (60) years of age.

**Note:** The Disability Pension granted shall be discontinued once the beneficiary attains the age of sixty (60) years.

name: Incentive for the Inter Caste Marriage Couple
brief_description: The Karnataka Social Welfare Department offers an incentive to encourage inter-caste marriagesRs. aiming to reduce caste-based discrimination and promote a more inclusive society. This scheme is targeted at Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals who marry outside their casteRs. particularly Hindu non-SC individuals.
benefits:
**Incentive Amount:**

- 2Rs./- for SC men marrying a woman from another caste.
- 3Rs./- for SC women marrying a man from another caste.

**Subsidy Disbursement:****** The incentive is provided in two installments.

- 50% in cash.
- 50% as a fixed deposit with a minimum term of 3 years.
eligibility:
1. The bride and groom should belong to the Hindu Category.
1. The bride and groom should be residing in Karnataka.
1. The marriage should be performed between Scheduled Caste and other communities.
1. The income of the couple should not exceed 5Rs./-.
1. The age of the bride should be between 18 to 42 years at the time of marriage.
1. The age of the groom should be between 21 to 45 years at the time of marriage.

name: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field
brief_description: The scheme Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil Nadu aims to support farmers by subsidizing the cost of water-carrying pipes up to 800m. The subsidy is either 50% of the total cost or 15Rs./- whichever is lower. The pipes can be of any material or size as required by the farmerRs. including PVC and HDPE. The initiative targets ensuring water access to farms.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** Subsidy on 50% cost or 15Rs./- for water carrying pipes upto 800m and all types of pipes(PVC HDPE etc.Rs.) and all sizes as per the requirement of the farmer.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

name: Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme
brief_description: The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities and provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities to start or expand their economic activitiesRs. thereby fostering economic empowerment and self-sufficiency.
benefits:
Financial Assistance provided totals 1Rs./- in two parts:

- 50% Loan Amount
- 50% Subsidy Amount
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to a religious minority community as defined in the Government Order.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
1. The age limit should be between 18 to 55 years.
1. The annual income of the applicant's family from all sources should be less than 1Rs./- in urban areas and less than 81Rs./- in rural areas.
1. No member of the applicant's family shall be an employee of the State/Central/ Government PSU.
1. The applicant and family members should not have availed of benefits under any other scheme (Excluding the Arivu Scheme) of the KMDCL in the last 5 years.

name: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana" is a sub-scheme of the "Mukhyamantri Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana"Rs. initiated by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the disabled women/men of the state by encouraging their marriage and providing them financial assistance. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a grant of 1Rs./-.

**Note 1:** The financial grant is provided to disabled individuals in a coupleRs. and if both spouses are disabledRs. both are eligible for the grant.
**Note 2:** If a disabled person marries inter-casteRs. they are entitled to both the disabled marriage grant and the inter-caste marriage grant. For exampleRs. if both the husband and wife are disabled and belong to different castesRs. three units of the grant will be admissible. The wife will be eligible for both the inter-caste marriage grant and the disabled marriage grantRs. while the husband will be eligible for the disabled marriage grant.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. At least one individual in the couple (either the bride or groom) should have a disability.
1. The minimum age requirement at the time of marriage is 18 years for the bride and 21 years for the groom.
1. The bride and groom should belong to poor families.

name: Farmers Training
brief_description: The Farmers Training schemeRs. by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers training to farmers and agricultural laborers to enhance their skills and knowledge. Each training session supports up to 50 participantsRs. with a grant of 5Rs./- provided per session to cover the costs.
benefits: - **Financial assistance:** 5Rs./- per training session of 50 Farmers/Agricultural labourers.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should have interest in joining the training to enhance agricultural skills.

name: Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka
brief_description: The "Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka" scheme aims to upgrade the skills of artisans in leather technologyRs. footwear/leather goods makingRs. and designing by sending them for advanced training at renowned institutions like CFTI ChennaiRs. CLRIRs. and Karnataka Institute of Leather Technology. The program enhances artisans skillsRs. allowing them to contribute to the development of the leather industry through advanced training.
benefits: - **Course Sponsorship:** The corporation covers the entire cost of the course for selected artisans.- **Stipend:** A stipend is provided during the course duration to support the participants
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be leather artisans.
1. The applicant should belongs to sub-castes ArundathiyarRs. ChammadiyaRs. ChamarRs. ChambarRs. ChamagarRs. MadarRs. MadigRs. MadigaRs. Mini MadigRs. JambavaluRs. HaralayyaRs. MachigarRs. MochigarRs. MochiRs. muchiRs. Telugu MochiRs. kamaati mochaRs. RohidasRs. DhorRs. kakkayyaRs. KankayyaRs. SamagaraRs. SamagarRs. Aadhi AnddraRs. Aadhi DravidaRs. Aadhi Karnataka among schedule castes.
1. The applicant should have passed a Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC)/Pre-University Courses (PUC)/Degree to apply for the program.
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 30Rs./- in rural areas and 25Rs./- in urban areas.
1. The applicant or their family members must not have received benefits from other schemesRs. except training programs.
1. The applicant's family members should not be employed in government or semi-government organizations.

name: Providing Artificial Limbs and Other Appliances to Disabled BOC Workers
brief_description: The "Providing Artificial Limbs and Other Appliances to Disabled BOC Workers" scheme was launched by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. The scheme aims to provide artificial limbs & other appliances to registered disabled construction workers to improve their quality of life by offering essential prosthetic support in collaboration with the Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India. The scheme also covers the replacement of limbs every three years based on the workers' needs.
benefits:
- **Free distribution of artificial limbs and other fabricated appliances.**
- **Replacement of limbs every three years based on the workers' needs.**
eligibility:
1. The worker should be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker should be a disabled person.

name: 15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training
brief_description: The A. P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training". The scheme aims to provide skill trainingRs. safetyRs. and hygiene education for building and other construction workers registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Upon successful completion of the trainingRs. workers will receive stipends and tool kits. This scheme will help workers acquire new skills or upgrade existing onesRs. improving their productivity and employability.
benefits:
- Stipend of 7Rs./-.


- Skill development training for construction workers.
- Tool kits provided post-training.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a registered construction worker under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Free Education upto 12th Std. to All
brief_description: The scheme Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Free Education upto 12th Std. to All by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support students from Adi DravidarRs. TribalRs. and Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities by offering free education up to the 12th standard. The tuition fees for eligible students are waivedRs. and the government reimburses the amountRs. ensuring financial barriers do not hinder access to education.
benefits: - Reimbursement: Full reimbursement of tuition fees for students up to the 12th standard.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity community.
- The beneficiary must be enrolled in a school up to the 12th standard.

name: Admission of Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students in Plus One at Reputed Schools
brief_description: The scheme Admission of Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students in Plus One at Reputed Schools introduced on 7th MayRs. 2012 by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to enhance the quality of education for Adi Dravidar and Tribal students. It selects the top 10 students from each district who secure the highest marks in Class X from governmentRs. municipalRs. or welfare schools and admits them to Plus One in reputed private schools. The scheme includes coverage of tuition and boarding fees up to Rs. 28Rs. per year for the selected students.
benefits: - **Admission Assistance:** Free admission into reputed private schools for Plus One. - **Financial Coverage:** 28Rs./- per yearRs. including boarding charges.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be currently enrolled in school.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal community.
- The beneficiary must have secured the highest marks in Class X from Government/Corporation/Municipal/Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare schools.
- Beneficiarys annual family income should be less than 1Rs./-.

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Stationary-Text Books
brief_description: The scheme Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Stationary-Text Books by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support students from 1st to 12th standard who are enrolled in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools by offering them free textbooks. This initiative aims to ensure that no student is deprived of education due to a lack of study materials.
benefits: - **Textbooks:** Free textbooks for students from 1st to 12th standard.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be enrolled in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools.
- The beneficiary must be studying in any class between 1st to 12th standard.

name: Pre Examination Training Centre For All India Service Examinations Like I.A.S., I.P.S., I.R.S., Etc.
brief_description: The scheme Pre Examination Training Centre For All India Service Examinations Like I.A.S.Rs. I.P.S.Rs. I.R.S.Rs. Etc. introduced on 7th MayRs. 2012 by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide coaching and other facilities such as free boarding and lodging to the candidates of the Adi Dravidar and Tribal communityRs. aspiring to qualify for All India Service Examinations (IASRs. IPSRs. IRSRs. etc.).
benefits: - **Coaching:** Free coaching for All India Service Examinations (IASRs. IPSRs. IRSRs. etc.). - **Boarding:** Free boarding and lodging for candidates. > **Note:** Mess Charges 1Rs./- per month should be paid by the students whose parental income is above 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal community.

name: Seed Multiplication Scheme of Paddy, Millets, Pulses, Oilseeds and Cotton
brief_description: The Seed Multiplication Scheme of PaddyRs. MilletsRs. PulsesRs. OilseedsRs. and Cotton by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers subsidies to farmers to produce seeds under contract with the Department of Agriculture. Farmers receive trainingRs. source seedsRs. and guidelines for maintaining seed quality. After quality checks and processingRs. farmers are paid based on the quality of seeds produced. A 90% Minimum Support Price payment is made during processingRs. with the remainder settled after quality certification.
benefits: - **Premium:** On seeds ranges from 1/- to 3/- per kg. - **Foundation Class Seeds:** The premium is between 7.5% to 30% over the Local Market Rate per kgRs. depending on the type of oil seed. - **For Certified Class Seeds:** The premium is between 5% to 20% over the Local Market Rate per kgRs. based on the specific oil seed. - **Training:** The farmer so desirous of enrolling himself/herself will be given a training by the authorities concerned at the beginning of each year
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should produce and supply seeds for the Department of Agriculture on a contract basis.
- The seed Farms should be registered by the Seed Producer viz.Rs. the Assistant Director of Agriculture of the respective Blocks.
- Field Run Produce has to satisfy the standards of physical/genetic purityRs. moisture levels and germination percentage as prescribed in the Certification standards.

name: Production of Foundation Seeds
brief_description: The scheme Production of Foundation Seeds by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support farmers in the production of foundation seedsRs. particularly for pulses. Eligible farmers receive a subsidy. Special benefits are provided for SC/ST farmers (24%) and farm women (20%).
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per quintal.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should raise seed farms with Pulses crop.

name: Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers
brief_description: The "Scheme to Provide Relief in Case of Death or Disability of Registered Building Workers" is a Welfare Scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Department. In cases of accidental deathRs. permanent disabilityRs. or natural deathRs. the scheme provides financial assistance to help mitigate the financial burden on the worker's family. This scheme aims to protect construction workers and their families during times of crisis.
benefits:
- Accidental Death: 5Rs./-
- Permanent Disability: 5Rs./-
- Natural Death Relief: 60Rs./-
eligibility:
***Eligibility for Accidental Death/Natural Death Relief*** 1. The applicant should be the nominee/dependent of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker should be registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
***Eligibility for Permanent Disability*** 1. The construction worker should be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The construction worker should be disabled.

name: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field-Pulses ISPOM
brief_description: The scheme Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field-Pulses ISPOM by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to support farmers by subsidizing the cost of water-carrying pipes up to 800m. The subsidy is either 50% of the total cost or 15Rs./- whichever is lower. The pipes can be of any material or size as required by the farmerRs. including PVC and HDPE. The initiative targets ensuring water access to farms.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** Subsidy on 50% cost or 15Rs./- for water carrying pipes upto 800m; all types of pipes(PVC HDPE etc.Rs.) and all size as per the requirement of the farmer.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Bihar
brief_description:
The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to widows in the age group of 40 to 79 years who belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the widows of poor families of the society by providing them financial assistance.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible widows will receive a monthly pension of 400/-.

**Note:** The pension amount is being paid to the beneficiaries under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process. In this processRs. the pension amount is paid directly into the accounts of the beneficiaries through PFMS from the state level on the basis of the account number provided by the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a widow.
1. The widow's age should be between 40 and 79 years.
1. The widow should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The widow should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.

name: Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness" scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. medical assistance of 1Rs./- for the treatment of serious ailments for registered worker and his/her family members. (the benefit can be availed only after 26th July 2014 as the benefit is covered under the Mediclaim & Personal Accident Insurance scheme).
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided for medical treatment.**
eligibility:
1. The worker must be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The worker should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW).
1. The worker or family member must be undergoing treatment for a serious illness or critical medical condition.

name: Free Education Scheme
brief_description: The "Free Education Scheme" launched on 7th MayRs. 2012Rs. by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and De-notified Communities (DNC) students in pursuing higher education without the burden of fees. It covers all special feesRs. non-refundable compulsory feesRs. and examination fees for students enrolled in 3-year undergraduate programs (B.A.Rs. B.Sc.Rs. B.Com.) in Government and Government Aided Arts and Science Colleges.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Special fees and other non-refundable compulsory fees are paid as prescribed by Government and examination fee in full.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a student.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC).
1. The beneficiary should be studying 3-year undergraduate degree (B.A.Rs. B.Sc.Rs. B.Com.).
1. The beneficiary should be enrolled in a Government or Government Aided Arts and Science College.

name: Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries
brief_description: The "Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries" scheme launched by the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance of 6Rs./- per pregnancy to women registered as beneficiaries and wives of registered beneficiaries. The assistance can be availed up to two times.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 6Rs./- per pregnancy (up to two times).**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered women construction worker under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board or the wife of a registered male worker.
1. The applicant should be Pregnant.
1. Benefit is available for the first two live births.

name: Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard
brief_description: The Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme provides financial assistance 10Rs. per year to children of registered construction workers who are studying in the 11th or 12th standard. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children per worker and extends to the wife of a registered male worker.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 10Rs. per year for children studying in 11th and 12th grades.
> **Note:** Benefit applies to up to two children and the wife of a registered worker.
eligibility:
1. The children's parents or guardians should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The child/wife must be studying in 11th or 12th standard.
1. Only children and spouse of registered construction workers are eligible to get educational assistance.

name: Educational Assistance for Degree Course
brief_description: The Educational Assistance for Degree Course scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme provides financial assistance of 20Rs./- per year to children of registered construction workers pursuing their undergraduate degrees. This benefit is also extended to the wife of a registered male worker.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 20Rs./- per year for undergraduate students.
eligibility: 1. The children's parents or guardians should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The student must be enrolled in a degree course (1stRs. 2ndRs. 3rdRs. or 4th year). 1. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children and the wife of a registered male worker.

name: Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students
brief_description: The Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. educational assistance of 10Rs./- to the children of the registered worker scoring 50% or more marks in the 10th and 12th standard examinations.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 10Rs./- for children scoring 50% or more in 10th or 12th standard exams.
eligibility:
1. The children's parents or guardians should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The child must have passed the 10th or 12th standard with at least 50% marks.
1. Only children and spouse of registered construction workers are eligible to get educational assistance.

name: Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses
brief_description: The Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department launched the Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses scheme. Under this schemeRs. financial aid of 1Rs./- is granted for medical degreesRs. and 60Rs./- for engineering degrees to the children and spouses of registered construction workers.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance For:**


- Medical Degree: 1Rs./-
- Engineering Degree: 60Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The children's parents or guardians should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The student must be enrolled in a government-recognized medical or engineering institution. 1. A maximum of two children or the wife of the registered worker can apply.

name: State Senior Citizens Home
brief_description: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram launched the State Senior Citizens Home for the homeless aged persons. It provides shelter and recreational facilities to homeless elderly individuals aged 60 and aboveRs. who lack family support. This Home is the only one of its kind in the state and has a capacity of 25 residents.
benefits:
- Safe and secure living space for homeless elderly residents.
- Recreational and wellness programs to enhance quality of life.
- Access to essential amenities and supportive care.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant's age should be 60 years or older. 1. The applicant should have no supporter/relative.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Revamped Micro Credit Loan for Women Vendors of Flower, Vegetable, Fruit etc.
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Revamped Micro Credit Loan for Women Vendors of FlowerRs. VegetableRs. FruitRs. etc." scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers revamped micro-credit loans to women engaged in vending activities like selling flowersRs. vegetablesRs. fruitsRs. etc. The scheme allows women vendors to obtain a loan between 100/- to 5Rs./- at an interest rate of 11% (subject to change)Rs. supporting their businesses and enhancing their income generation opportunities.
benefits: - **Access to Micro-Loan:** 100/- to 5Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 11% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a woman. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be engaged in vending activities of flowersRs. vegetablesRs. fruitsRs. etc.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Handloom and Other Non Farm Sector Activities
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Handloom and Other Non Farm Sector Activities" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to offer financial support for handloom and other non-farm sector activitiesRs. enabling farmers to diversify income sources beyond agriculture. Loans under this scheme can be obtained based on the project costRs. with a limit of 2Rs./-. Interest rates range from 11% to 12.5%Rs. subject to change.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 2Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** From 11% to 12.5%Rs. (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in handloom or non-farm sector activities. - The beneficiary should be interested to avail the loan for handloom or non-farm sector activities. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for handloom or non-farm sector activities.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Animal Husbandry
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Animal Husbandry" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial support to farmers specifically for animal husbandry activities. This initiative aims to empower farmers by boosting livestock development and enhancing agricultural productivity.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 1. **For purchasing 2 Buffaloes:** 20Rs./-. 1. **For purchasing 21 Goats:** 24Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 14.5% to 16.5% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in animal husbandry. - The beneficiary should be interested to avail Animal Husbandry Loan from the Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for animal husbandry (e.g.Rs. purchasing buffaloes or goats).

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Working Women
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Working Women" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial support through a loan of up to 20Rs./- at a nominal interest rate of 12%. The loans are facilitated by District Central Cooperative Banks and their branchesRs. which ensure accessibility to women seeking financial assistance for professional and personal growth.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 20Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 12% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a working woman.

name: Term Loan Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Term Loan Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Government of Maharashtra and funded by the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)Rs. aims to uplift economically disadvantaged members of the Charmakar community (DhorRs. ChambharRs. HolarRs. MochiRs. etc.). The scheme focuses on their educationalRs. economicRs. and social advancementRs. helping them secure a respectable place in society. It also supports the production of various types of footwear and leather goods for supply to government departments and sale in the open market.
benefits:
> **Loan Amount:** - NSFDC provides Term Loans ranging from 1Rs. to 2Rs. for various schemesRs. with separate limits for vehicle loans.
> **Project Financing:** - NSFDC finances 75% of the project cost. The corporation provides 20% as a Seed Loan. 10Rs. is provided as a subsidy. - The remaining 5% of the project cost is contributed by the beneficiary.
> **Interest Rates:** > **For Loans up to 5Rs.:** NSFDC charges 7% per annum. The corporation charges 4% per annum. > **For Loans above 5Rs.:** NSFDC charges 8% per annum. The corporation charges 4% per annum.
- **Repayment Terms**: Loan instalments are payable monthly over a period of up to 60 months.- **This structure ensures clear and concise information about the Term Loan Scheme for potential beneficiaries.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant should belong to the Charmakar Community.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 50 years.
1. For the 50% Subsidy Scheme and Margin MoneyRs. the applicant's annual income should be below the poverty line.
1. The applicant should be able to provide an Income and Caste Certificate from an authorized government officer.
1. The applicant should have knowledge of the business for which they are applying for the loan.
1. For the NSFDC Scheme:


- Income should be below 98Rs. for rural areas.
- Income should be below 1Rs. for urban areas.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Professional Loan to Doctors, Engineers and Self Employed Professional
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Professional Loan to DoctorsRs. Engineers and Self Employed Professional" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers financial assistance to professionals such as doctorsRs. engineersRs. and self-employed individuals to help them expand or enhance their professional activities. Applicants can receive up to 10Rs./- as a loan at a competitive interest rate of 13%.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 10Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 13% (subject to change).
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a Doctor/ Engineer/ Self-Employed Professional.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. Loans should be applicable only for professional purposes.

name: Financial Assistance for Natural Death
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Natural Death was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. Under the schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance of 2Rs./- to the legal heir of a registered worker who dies due to natural death.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided by the Board to the legal heir of a registered worker who dies due to natural death.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be the legal heir of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. 1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to natural death.

name: Skill Development Training Manipur
brief_description: The "Skill Development Training" scheme was implemented by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. The scheme offers skill development training to registered building workersRs. their spouseRs. dependent siblingsRs. and children. The training includes vocational and skill development courses from recognized government and private providersRs. aiming to enhance the employability of beneficiaries.
benefits:
- Financial assistance covering course training fees.
- The financial assistance for boarding and lodging upto 150/- per day.
- Stipends or compensation for loss of daily wages during the training period.
- Training courses leading to certifications or degrees recognized by the government.
- Upgradation of training infrastructure through grants for eligible training providers.
eligibility:
> ***For Construction Worker:*** - The applicant should be registered construction worker under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board******
> ***For Dependent:*** - The applicant should be a spouseRs. dependent siblingsRs. and children of the registered construction worker.

name: Rural Girls Incentive Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Rural Girls Incentive Scheme" launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers financial aid to girls students of Most Backward Classes (MBC) and Denotified Communities (DNC)Rs. attending government or government-aided schools in rural areasRs. excluding Chennai District. Priority is given to girls from families headed by widows or destitute parents. The scheme aims to enhance educational opportunities and reduce dropout rates among these communities.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - For 3rd to 5th grade: 500/- per annum. - For 6th grade: 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a student.
1. The beneficiary should be a female.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu (should not be from Chennai District).
1. The beneficiary should be from a rural area.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ Denotified Communities (DNC).
1. The beneficiary should be Studying in classes 3rd to 6th in government or government-aided schools
1. The beneficiary's parental annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

**Note:**

- This scheme is implemented in all the Districts except Chennai District.
- Preference will be given to Girl Children of Widows/ Destitutes.

name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: Launched on 13th August 2013Rs. the "Funeral Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides 3Rs./- for the last rites of destitute individuals and unclaimed bodies. The scheme also supports families registered under labour schemesRs. especially those in the unorganized sectorRs. who struggle to afford last rites due to financial constraints. The scheme helps ease this burden by providing essential funds for performing the final rites.
benefits: A financial assistance of 3Rs./- is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The deceased should have been a member of a family registered under the labour cadre schemes operated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Inland Fishing
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Inland Fishing" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to support farmers interested in inland fishing by providing financial assistance up to 3Rs./- per hectare. The loan has an interest rate of 11% - 12%Rs. which is subject to change. This financial aid aims to empower farmers to establish or expand inland fishing operations and increase their income.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 3Rs./- per hectare. - **Interest Rate:** 11% to 12% (subject to change).
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a farmer.
- The beneficiary should be engaged in inland fishing.
- The beneficiary should be interested in availing the loan for Inland Fishing.
- The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for Inland Fishing activities.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Family Pension
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Family Pension by the Labour DepartmentRs. is aimed at ensuring financial support for the families of unorganized transport workers in the state. BeneficiariesRs. upon retirement or unfortunate demiseRs. will have 50% of their last drawn amount transferred monthly to their families through a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.
benefits: - **Monthly Family Pension:** 50% of the amount last drawn by the beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses. 1. The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use. > **Note:** A nominee/ dependent of a beneficiary shall be entitled for the benefits.

name: Goat Unit Scheme On Grants And Bank Loans
brief_description: The "Goat Unit Scheme"Rs. launched by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to improve beneficiaries economic status by supporting goat rearing. Through this schemeRs. individuals with goat farming experience can apply for grants and loans to purchase (10+1) goat units for milk and meat production. The scheme covers a 40% subsidy for general applicants and 60% for SC/ST beneficiariesRs. based on a total unit cost of 77Rs./-.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 40% subsidy for General beneficiaries and 60% for SC/ST beneficiaries. - **Economic Gains:** Earn income from the sale of goat milk and meat products.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
- The applicant must be a landless laborer/ marginal farmer/ small farmer.
- The applicant should have prior experience in goat farming.

name: Mushroom Kit Vitaran
brief_description: The Mushroom Kit Vitaran scheme launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aims to encourage farmers and individuals to engage in mushroom cultivation by providing high-quality mushroom kits at a 90% subsidy and through training programs.
benefits: - **Subsidized Mushroom Kits:** Kits provided at 60/- each with a 90% subsidy. - **High-Quality Materials:** Kits weigh 5 kg and include 100 grams of superior mushroom spawn. - **Training Support:** 2-days group training is providedRs. with a daily allowance of 1000/- per farmer.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal. 1. Farmers who have taken advantage of the scheme in the last three years (202-22Rs. 2022-23 and 2023-24) will not be given the benefit of the scheme this year.
> **Note:** 1. The benefit of this scheme will be given only once to one member of the family. 1. Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Paternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Paternity Benefit" schemeRs. introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB)Rs. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered workers and their families. Under this schemeRs. the wife of a registered worker is entitled to receive 6Rs. per deliveryRs. for up to two deliveriesRs. as a form of maternal support. In additionRs. the scheme also offers 1Rs. to the male beneficiary as paternity assistance on the birth of a child.
benefits:
1. The scheme gives 6Rs. to the wife of a registered worker for up to two deliveries.
1. The male worker receives 1Rs. as paternity assistance.
eligibility:
**For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.. 1. The applicant should be aged between 18 and 60 years. 1. The worker should have completed at least 90 days of building and other construction work in the last 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should have been renewed annually.
**For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:** 1. The beneficiary must be a Building and Other Construction Worker. 1. The worker should be registered with the "Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board". 1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active. 1. The wife of the worker should have delivered a baby.

name: Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana" launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. aimed at improving transportation facilities in all panchayats of the state. It offers financial assistance to beneficiaries for purchasing vehicles.
benefits: - **Standard vehicles:** 50% of the purchase price or up to 1Rs./-. - **E-rickshaws:** 50% of the purchase price or up to 70Rs./-. - **Ambulances:** 50% of the purchase price or up to 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of the state.
- The applicant must belong to a rural area.
- The applicant should not have benefited from a similar scheme previously.
- For ambulance purchasesRs. applicants must be willing to use it for public health services.

name: Incentive For The Devadasi Childrens Marriage to Schedule Tribe
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive for the Devadasi Childrens Marriage to Schedule Tribe" was launched by the Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Karnataka. The scheme provides financial support to ST couples from the Devadasi community to reduce casteism and promote social acceptance. Couples married on or after 01-04-2019 are provided an incentive of 8Rs./-Rs. i.e. 3Rs./- for the groom and 5Rs./- for the bride. The application should be submitted within 18 months of marriage. The scheme is open to ST residents of Karnataka who marry either a Hindu non-ST or a Hindu ST individualRs. with a combined annual income of less than 5Rs./-.
benefits: An incentive of 8Rs./- is provided to the married coupleRs. i.e. 5Rs./- for the bride and 3Rs./- for the groom.
eligibility:
1. The couple should be residents of Karnataka.
1. The couple should belong to the Hindu religion.
1. The total annual income of the couple should be less than 5Rs./-.
1. The application should be submitted within 18 months of the marriage.
1. One spouse should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community and should be a resident of Karnataka.
1. The marriage should have been between: (a) An ST individual and a non-ST individual; (b) Two ST individuals.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 1st April 2019.

name: Death Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief_description: Launched in 2004Rs. the "Death Assistance Scheme" is a welfare initiative by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB)Rs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides funeral assistance and ex-gratia payment to the heir of a worker in the event of their death. It also offers ex-gratia in case of permanent or partial temporary disability of a registered worker due to an accident. The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of the accident or death.
benefits:
**Funeral Assistance:** 6Rs./-
**Ex-gratia Payment:**

1. In case of normal death: 2Rs./-
1. In case of death due to accident: 4Rs./-
1. In case of permanent disability due to accident: 2Rs./-
1. In case of partial permanent disability due to accident: 1Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she was registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB) when he/she died.
1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she held an active regular membership with the MPBOCWWB.
1. Only the legal heir or dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply for benefits under the scheme.
1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she had a valid identity card.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Class 11th 12th And College
brief_description: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship" started in 1945 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Madhya PradeshRs. provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 11thRs. 12thRs. CollegesRs. PhDRs. and Professional Courses.
benefits: This scholarship is provided to Scheduled Tribe students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 11thRs. 12thRs. collegeRs. PhDRs. or professional courses.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government or government self-financed educational institution (income limit restriction has been abolished for these institutions).
1. The parents/guardians of the applicant should have an annual income of up to 6.00 lakh if the student is studying in a non-government institution (non-professional courses).
1. The applicant should be eligible for the payment of half the non-refundable compulsory feesRs. including tuition feesRs. at prescribed rates for government-related courses.

name: Integrated Hostel Scheme
brief_description: "Integrated Hostel Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides free residential facilitiesRs. mealsRs. and basic amenities to SC/ST/OBC students studying in classes 1st to 12th and also to the students pursuing college education.
benefits: The hostel provides free residential facilitiesRs. including accommodationRs. electricityRs. waterRs. mealsRs. furnitureRs. beddingRs. libraryRs. coachingRs. and basic amenities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Other Backward CastesRs. Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled Tribes category.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 1 to 12 or college-level classes.
1. The applicant should reside in a remote rural area (priority given).
1. The applicant's school should be within a maximum distance of 3 km for girls or 8 km for boys.
1. The applicant should not have any income restrictions.

name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
brief_description: The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana launched by the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to provide social security through various types of financial assistance to workers and artisans in the unorganized sector.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 7Rs./- to 30Rs./- (for detailed view refer to Page no. 7 of the scheme [Guidelines](https://state.bihar.gov.in/labour/cache/40/14-May-21/SHOW_DOCS/Schemes-1.pdf))
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state.
1. The applicant must work as a worker or craftsman in the unorganized sector within Bihar.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 65 years.

> **Note****:**



- Applicant&#39;s age will be calculated as of the 1st of July of any year.

name: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The "Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority and Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education among OBC students in Jharkhand and provides financial assistance to students pursuing professional and academic courses at the post-matriculation level. The scheme covers a wide range of coursesRs. including professionalRs. technicalRs. and academic programs.
benefits:
**Covers tuition feesRs. academic allowanceRs. and maintenance fees:** Course GroupHosteller ()Day-scholar ()Group- 1 "A"1Rs.Group- 1 "B"90Rs.Group- 1 "C"85Rs.Group- 2 "A"75Rs.Group- 2 "B"70Rs. 65Rs. Group- 2 "C"65Rs.Group- 345Rs.Group- 435Rs.
**NOTE:** - The amount is directly credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer). - 60% funding by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of IndiaRs. and 40% by the Jharkhand State Government. - The student must adhere to the attendance system prescribed by their educational institution or university to qualify for the scholarship. - If a student switches courses mid-wayRs. they are eligible for the scholarship in the new course only if they did not receive a scholarship for the previous course in the same academic year.
eligibility:
**Eligibility Criteria for the Student:** 1. The student should be a native of Jharkhand. 1. The student belongs to the Other Backward Class category. 1. The student's family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. The student must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution that complies with the rules of the scheme and is registered on the departmental scholarship portal. The student should be pursuing a post-matric course (DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. CertificateRs. or equivalent). 1.
