The student should not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government.
**Classification of Courses:****** [**Page No. 18**](https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/downloads/Post_Matric_Scholarship_sankalp_2022.pdf) Group 1: Professional degree/postgraduate courses in institutions with A++ to B++ NAAC accreditation. Group 2: Vocational and diploma courses requiring Class 12 or higher qualifications. Group 3: Polytechnic and other courses not covered in Groups 1 or 2. Group 4: Graduate and Post Graduate course.Group 5: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level non-degree courses).

name: Primary Education Scholarship (Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: The "Primary Education Scholarship" scheme by the Department of De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic WelfareRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides a state scholarship of 150/- for 10 months at the rate of 15/- per month to students from De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic communities studying in classes 1 to 5. The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public Education.
benefits: Scholarship of 150/- for 10 months at the rate of 15/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be from a [De-Notified](https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Public/Pages/TribesDetail?ID=2)Rs.[ NomadicRs. or Semi-Nomadic](https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Public/Pages/TribesDetail?ID=1) Community.
_*The applicant should not need to apply again for renewal while continuing in classes of the same rate (e.g.Rs. classes 1 to 5)._
_*The applicant should be eligible for the scholarship even if they fail one academic year._

name: Operation of SC Senior Hostel
brief_description: The scheme "Operation of SC Senior Hostel" by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide accommodations and a conducive learning environment for Scheduled Caste students. Through this schemeRs. separate juniorRs. seniorRs. and college hostels with free boarding and lodging facilities are provided to both boys and girls. The applications for this scheme must be submitted within one month after the fixed date for school admissions. The scheme is implemented at the state level through Divisional District Officers.
benefits:
**Accommodation** - Free boarding facilities - Free lodging facilities - Separate hostels for boys and girls - JuniorRs. seniorRs. and college-level accommodations
**Additional Facilities** - Sports equipment - Toilet kits - Library facilities - Scholarship (90% paid to joint account of Hostel Superintendent and Mess SecretaryRs. 10% to student's account)
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant must be a regular student of a recognized institution.
1. There is no income limit for senior hostels.

name: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana (MMY)" launched in 2022 by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. focuses on improving the health and nutrition of pregnant women and mothers with children under 2 years. The scheme offers a nutritional kit containing groundnut oilRs. tuver dalRs. and chana to support calorie and protein needs. The initiative addresses the critical first 1000 days of lifeRs. aiming to enhance maternal and child healthRs. reduce infant mortalityRs. and prevent low birth weight.
benefits: - **Commodities:** The nutrition kit includes 1 Litre of Groundnut oilRs. 1 Kg Tuver DalRs. & 2 Kg Chana.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant must be a woman who is conceiving for the first time.
1. The applicant must be a mother with her first child who is under the age of 2 years.

name: Reimbursement of Fees of ST Students Studying in Sainik School Private Institutions
brief_description: The scheme "Reimbursement of Fees for ST Students Studying in Sainik Schools and Private InstitutionsRs." implemented by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides free arrangements for accommodationRs. school feesRs. and education for eligible students.
benefits: Free arrangement for accommodationRs. school fees and studies for the students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized Sainik School or private institution covered under the scheme.

name: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad"Rs. offered by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial assistance to eligible students. Every yearRs. 20 students can avail of this benefitRs. provided their family income from all sources does not exceed 8 lakh. To qualifyRs. applicants must have at least 75% marks in a postgraduate examination in the relevant subject and either two years of teaching experience or an M.Phil degree in the relevant subject from a recognized university or government college in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits:
**Financial Support:**
Covers actual expenses or up to $38Rs. annuallyRs. plus an additional $2Rs. for booksRs. equipmentRs. typingRs. thesis bindingRs. and other academic work.
**Total Amount:**
A maximum of $40Rs. annually or its equivalent in the local currency is provided.
**Bond Requirement:**
The applicant must sign a bond for the entire amount received under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be seeking a postgraduate degree with at least 75% marks in their graduation from a recognized university/institute in Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have an annual family income not exceeding 8 lakh from all sources.
1. The applicant should be under 25 years of age for postgraduate studies and under 35 years of age for PhD research.
1. The applicant should have secured admission to a study program abroad.
1. The applicant should have qualified for international tests such as GRERs. GMATRs. TOEFLRs. or IELTS.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a PhD and have:


- 75% marks in postgraduate studies in the relevant subject.
- Two years of teaching experience or an M.Phil degree in the relevant subject from a recognized university or government college in Madhya Pradesh.

name: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
brief_description:
"Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme" by the Panchayat and Rural Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh provides working capital assistance of up to 10Rs. promotes regular loan repaymentRs. and trains entrepreneurs in business practices. Street vendors (rehri walaRs. cycle walaRs. thela walaRs. etc) are an integral part of the rural informal economy. They provide various kinds of goods and services to the rural people at their homes at reasonable prices. They sell items like ice creamRs. fruitsRs. samosa/kachoriRs. bread-biscuitsRs. chicken & eggsRs. clothesRs. small utensilsRs. shoes & slippersRs. broomsRs. etc. They provide services like barberingRs. tool repairRs. etc. in rural areas.
Low-cost equipment or working capital is made available to poor migrant workers/ small traders of rural areas of the state in the form of loans through banks. Entrepreneurship Development (EDP) training is to be provided to rural migrant workers through the "Self Employment Training Institute (RSET)" for setting up new businesses. After trainingRs. the loan is provided by banks for setting up the business.
benefits:
- Low-cost equipment or working capital is made available to poor migrant workers/ small traders of rural areas of the state in the form of loans through banks.
- Entrepreneurship Development Training is to be provided to rural migrant workers through the "Self Employment Training Institute (RSET)" for setting up new businesses.
- After trainingRs. an **Interest-free loan of 10Rs./-** is provided by banks for setting up the business.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a resident of a rural area.
1. The applicant should be a small trader or vendor from the rural poor class.
1. The applicant should not have defaulted on any prior government loans.

name: Free Distribution of Text Books to Students
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2008Rs. the scheme "Free Distribution of Textbooks to Students" by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools.
benefits: Free textbooks.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th to 12th.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Udyami YojanaRs. launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals from all categories in the state. Under this componentRs. financial assistance of up to 10Rs./- is provided to female applicants for establishing and operating business venturesRs. thereby fostering economic growth and empowerment in the state. This scheme also provides benefits to Transgender community.
benefits: - **Substantial Financial Support:** Receive up to 10Rs./- for setting up a business (50% of the total financial assistance (up to 5Rs./-) is provided as a non-repayable grant. The remaining 50% (up to 5Rs./-) is offered as an interest-free loanRs. with a nominal 1% interest under specific sub-schemes.) - **Skill Development:** Mandatory training sessions are provided to enhance entrepreneurial skills.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be female.
- The applicant should have passed at least 10+2Rs. IntermediateRs. ITIRs. Polytechnic DiplomaRs. or equivalent.
- The applicant must be aged between 18 and 50 years.
- The business unit must be a proprietorship or partnership firm.
- This scheme also provides benefits to Transgender community.

name: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
brief_description: The "Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra" is an initiative launched by the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aimed at supporting underprivileged candidates aspiring to appear for competitive exams. It offers free coaching for exams like Civil ServicesRs. SSCRs. and others. The program includes expert guidanceRs. study materialsRs. and mentoringRs. enabling candidates to prepare effectively and achieve their career goals.
benefits:
- **Free Coaching:** Free coaching in [Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendras](https://state.bihar.gov.in/bcebcwelfare/cache/41/30-Dec-24/SHOW_DOCS/Letter%20No-I-179552.pdf). - **Incentive:** Students will be provided an incentive amount of 3Rs./- (three thousand rupees) based on 75% attendance.
**Note:****** There is no hostel provision in the centers.
eligibility:
1. The student must be a permanent resident of Bihar state.
1. The student must belong to the Backward Class or Extremely Backward Class.
1. The maximum annual income of the student or their guardianRs. from all sourcesRs. should not exceed 3Rs./-.
1. The students age and minimum educational qualifications must meet the eligibility criteria for the competitive exam related to the respective course.

name: Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme
brief_description: The "Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme (JSFSS)" by the Department of FoodRs. Public Distribution and Consumer AffairsRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide subsidized/free food grains to eligible beneficiaries. Through this schemeRs. food grainRs. primarily riceRs. is provided at a subsidized rate or free of cost to individuals holding a Green Card. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Food and Consumer AffairsRs. Ranchi.
benefits:
1. Subsidized/free rice is provided to Green Card holders beneficiaries under JSFSS. 1. Benefits are delivered directly through the Directorate of Food and Consumer Affairs.
**NOTE****:** Priority is given to individuals from economically weaker sections.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must possess a Green Card issued under JSFSS.

name: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
brief_description: The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic WelfareRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides a scholarship of 1Rs. per month for boys and 1Rs. per month for girls for 10 months. The scheme benefits students from De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic tribes studying in local educational institutions.
benefits:
- A scholarship of 1Rs. per month for boys.
- A scholarship of 1Rs. per month for girls.
- The scholarship is given for 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student belonging to the De-NotifiedRs. NomadicRs. or Semi-Nomadic tribes.
1. The applicant should be studying in a local educational institution.
1. The applicant should apply for admission before the new academic session.
1. The applicant should secure a vacant seatRs. as new admissions depend on availability.
1. The applicant should have a higher percentage in the last passed examination for priority admission.

name: Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme
brief_description: The "Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme" by the Department of FoodRs. Public Distribution and Consumer AffairsRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to support eligible families under the National Food Security Act (NFSA)Rs. 2013Rs. Jharkhand State Food Security SchemeRs. and White Card holders. Through this schemeRs. beneficiaries receive 1 liter of kerosene oil at subsidized rates with a dealer commission of 0.50 per liter supported by the government.
benefits:
1. Beneficiaries receive 1 liter of kerosene oil at subsidized rates.
1. Dealer commission of 0.50 per liter is covered by the government.
1. Distribution occurs monthly through designated PDS dealers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must be covered under the c (NFSA)Rs. 2013Rs. Jharkhand State Food Security SchemeRs. or possess a White Card.
1. The applicant must not have access to other subsidized fuel schemes.

name: Strengthening Skills, Arts and Employment through ITIs
brief_description: The "Strengthening SkillsRs. ArtsRs. and Employment through ITIs" initiative by the Department of De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic WelfareRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to bridge traditional knowledge and art with modern technology. Communities under this department have historically relied on traditional knowledge and art for their livelihood. To connect these skills with modern technologyRs. short-termRs. employment-oriented training has been provided through ITIs. The target for the financial year 2022-23 is to train 180 studentsRs. with a goal of benefiting 250 students in the coming year. After completing the trainingRs. there is a provision for employment or self-employment under the self-employment scheme.
benefits: The scheme provides employment-oriented training through ITIsRs. aiming to enhance traditional skills and offer employment or self-employment opportunities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from the De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic communities listed in Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer.
1. The applicant's educational qualification should meet the course requirements.

name: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
brief_description: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Department of De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic WelfareRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to encourage girls from De-notifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic communities to pursue education. Under this schemeRs. an incentive amount of 3Rs. is provided to girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time. The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public DistributionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: An incentive of 3Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from DenotifiedRs. NomadicRs. or Semi-Nomadic Community.
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in the 11th Standard.
1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized institution.
1. The applicant should have studied continuously without any academic breaks.

name: Distribution of Pulses
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Pulses" by the Department of FoodRs. Public DistributionRs. and Consumer AffairsRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide pulses at affordable rates to eligible householdsRs. ensuring nutritional support and food security. Under this schemeRs. pulses at subsidized rates are made available to beneficiaries holding AAY and PHH cards under NFSA and Green Cards under JSFSS.
benefits:
1. Subsidized pulses are provided to the households.
1. The scheme supports food security by reducing the cost of essential pulses for low-income families.
1. Benefits are delivered monthly through designated ration shops.
1. Households holding AAY and PHH cards under NFSA and Green Cards under JSFSS are given Pulses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand. 1. The applicant should hold an Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) card under NFSA or a Green Card under JSFSS.

name: Incentive Scheme in Civil Service (Chhattisgarh)
brief_description: Launched in 2018Rs. the scheme "Incentive Scheme in Civil Service" by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh aims to encourage bright and meritorious persons with disabilities to pass competitive exams in the field of civil services. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to help with upcoming preparations. The scheme benefits include lump sum amounts on passing the different stages of the Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Examinations. The scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department.
benefits:
- 20Rs./- lump sum on passing the Preliminary Examination.
- 30Rs./- lump sum on passing the Mains Examination.
- 50Rs./- lump sum on selection in Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.
1. The applicant should have passed the Union or Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Examination.

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students for studying in India
brief_description: The "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBCRs. EBC and DNT Students for studying in India" aims at providing financial assistance to students from the Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)Rs. and DenotifiedRs. NomadicRs. and DenotifiedRs. Nomadic Tribes (DNTs) to pursue higher education. This scholarship aims to alleviate the financial burden on students belonging to these marginalized communitiesRs. enabling them to continue their studies and enhance their skills. The scholarship covers tuition feesRs. maintenance allowancesRs. and other academic expenses. The financial support is extended to students studying in both government and private institutions.
benefits:
**Components of the Scholarship**

- Maintenance allowance for the complete duration of the course.
- Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees.
- Study tour charges (if applicable).
- Thesis typing/printing charges (for research scholars).
- Book allowance for students pursuing correspondence courses.
- Additional allowances for students with disabilities.

**Financial Support Breakdown**
**Category of Courses****Academic Allowance (Yearly in )****Tuition Fee (Yearly in )****Total (Yearly in )**Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses10Rs.Group 2: Other Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate8Rs.Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under Group 1 & Group 26Rs.Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses5Rs._*Students pursuing C.A./I.C.W.A./C.S./I.C.F.A. shall be treated as day scholars for academic allowance purposes._
_*Students studying through correspondence/online courses shall not be eligible for academic allowance._
_*Tuition fees shall be paid to online/correspondence students._
_*The State Governments mayRs. if they decideRs. top up the academic allowance from their own resources._
_*The scholarship amount will be disbursed annually to the bank account of the beneficiary._
_*The scholarship continues for the duration of the courseRs. subject to satisfactory academic progress._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from Other Backward Classes (OBC) / Economically Backward Classes (EBC) or from DenotifiedRs. NomadicRs. and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
- The applicant should be studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage of education.
- The applicant should be permanently settled in the State/UT where they are applying.
- The applicant should be studying in an institution recognized by the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) or Unified District Information System for Education (UDISE).
- The applicant's institution should have National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) or National Board of Accreditation (NBA) accreditation.
- The applicant should maintain Aadhaar-based attendance in the institution.
- The applicant must have a valid "Freeship Card" issued by the State/District Authority.

**Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:**
A maximum of 20 slots per annum are reserved for Commercial Pilot License coursesRs. including helicopter and multi-engine training.

name: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to disburse monthly pensions to old age citizensRs. both male and femaleRs. who are 65 years of age or above and are destitute (with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon). To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of the districtRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible citizens on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible citizensRs. in the presence of SarpanchRs. Gram Panchayat Members and the Office Bearers of Village Organization.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be a local resident of the district.
- The applicant should be from a rural area.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
- The applicant should be 65 years of age or above in age.
- The applicant should be destitute.
- The applicant should have no means of subsistence.
- The applicant should have no family or relatives to depend upon.

_* The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Panchayat Secretary with the Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO)._

name: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to support unemployed individuals who have completed short-term skill training programs aligned with the National Qualification Framework (NSQF). Under this schemeRs. candidates receive a financial incentive to enhance their employability.
benefits:
- A financial incentive of 5Rs./- per annum for eligible candidates.
- Special categories like widowsRs. abandoned womenRs. primitive tribesRs. and persons with disabilities receive an additional 50% incentive.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be unemployed (not employed in the public/private sector or self-employed).
1. The applicant must be registered in a Jharkhand employment exchange.
1. The applicant should have completed a skill training course conducted by a government ITIRs. polytechnicRs. or other government vocational institutes aligned with NSQF.
1. The applicant must not have availed of any similar incentive under another scheme.
1. The applicant must be a domicile of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should have a valid bank account and Aadhaar card.
1. The applicant should not have been convicted of a crime with a sentence of 48 hours or more.
1. The applicant must be between 18 to 35 years old on the date of employment exchange registration (relaxation as per government norms for SC/ST candidates).

name: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme" by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Haryana aims to support meritorious students studying in government colleges by providing them with financial incentives. Monetary rewards are granted to students who secure top positions in annual university examinations across ArtsRs. CommerceRs. Science (Medical and Non-Medical)Rs. and Education streams.
benefits:
**Monetary Incentive**

- 5Rs./- per annum for students securing the first position in their stream.
- 3Rs./- per annum for students securing the second position in their stream.
- 2Rs./- per annum for students securing the third position in their stream.

**Mode of Disbursement**
Payment is made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
**Validity**
The incentive is applicable only for the academic year in which the student secures a top position.
eligibility:
1. This scheme will be college-specific and three meritorious students in each stream who stood firstRs. second and third in the annual university examination will be given this incentive.
1. The award will be given only to students pursuing general courses in the Government Colleges.
1. Candidates from Non-Government Colleges and those who pursue their studies through correspondence courses/open universities will not be eligible for the award.

**NOTE**

- The merit list will be prepared separately for the Boys (General Category)Rs. Girls (General Category) and Scheduled Caste students (Combined list of girls and boys).
- If Scheduled Caste students qualify for the general listRs. his/her name will be considered in the general list and an extra award will be given (on a merit basis only) to the students of the Scheduled Caste category.
- The award holder under this scheme will hold any other scholarship/stipend from the State Government or any other source.

name: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to widows irrespective of their age. To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of a district of Andhra PradeshRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals in the presence of Ward members and office bearers of DWCUA.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a local resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh.
- The applicant should be from an urban area.
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be a widow.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

_*The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Bill Collector with the Municipal Commissioner._

name: IT Saksham Yuva Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "IT Saksham Yuva Scheme" was launched by the Citizen Resources Information DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of minimum 3 months offered by Haryana State Electronics Development Corporation Limited (HARTRON)Rs. Haryana Knowledge Corporation Limited (HKCL)Rs. Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU)Rs. or any other agency notified by Government from time to time.
Under this schemeRs. skilled and eligible youths shall be given employment opportunities in various Departments/ Boards/ Corporations/Registered Societies/ AgenciesRs. etc. under the Haryana Government or private entities. The first phase of the scheme shall provide employment opportunities to 5Rs. youths in the State by training them through specially designed IT courses such as:

1. Secure coding in JavaRs. DotNetRs. PHPRs. etc.
1. DBA in SQLRs. Postgre SQLRs. etc.
1. UI/ UX designRs. web design
1. Networking Network supportRs. LAN/ WAN
1. Server Administration Microsoft/ Linux
1. Web and mobile application development
1. Digital Marketing & social media handling
1. Any other courseRs. in the field of Emerging TechnologiesRs. can be added as per need.

This scheme is envisioned to provide the youth of Haryana a much-needed career-readiness for the digital world of workRs. and imbibement of desired skills necessary to enter effectively into the 21st Century workplaces in various digital domains. The Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID) will facilitate providing employment opportunities to these trained IT Saksham Yuva and the eligible applicant will be employed for up to 2 years. Based on the order of merit & role preferenceRs. the applicant would be employed in the Indenting Government / private entities on a first-come-first-serve basis.
**Objectives:**

- The objective of the scheme is to position Haryana as a leading IT powerhouse by leveraging its human capital potentialRs. fostering innovationRs. creating a conducive ecosystem for technology-driven growthRs. and strengthening e-governance in the State.
- The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to the eligible youths of Haryana by training them under the IT program intended to upgrade their skills. This is further expected to enable the youth to develop their skill which in turn will give them the needed experience thereby enabling them to take up better employment or self-employments in the IT sector.
benefits:
1. Employment opportunities for unemployed youths.
1. Provides digital literacy and IT-related skills to improve employability.
1. Eligible candidates may receive an unemployment allowance.
1. Entrepreneurial/Startup support after successful completion of employment tenure of one year.
1. The eligible candidates who cleared/passed the exam will be given remuneration/allowance of 20Rs./- pm (for first 6 months) / 25Rs./- (7th month onwards).

> Note:- HoweverRs. if the candidate has cleared/ passed the assessment test and is awaiting deploymentRs. the unemployment allowances of 10Rs./- pm will be paid by the CRID.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a domicile of Haryana having a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra ID.
1. Applicants age should be between 18 to 35 years.
1. Applicants should not be in any kind of employment e.g.Rs. public/government/private sector/ quasi-government or self-employment at the time of applying for the scheme.
1. Applicants should be graduate or post-graduate (B. Tech./ BCA/ BSc. IT) / (M.E./M. Tech./MCA/MSc IT/MBA IT) from recognized institutes/ colleges/ universities.
1. The candidates will be eligible for unemployment allowance only if the annual family income of the candidate does not exceed rupees three lakhs ( 3 lakhs) from all sources.
1. The unemployment allowance will only be commenced post 1 month from the Date of issuance of the passing certificate for the assessment test of the course completed.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship Scheme was introduced during the year 2005-2006 by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Haryana under the Education Encouragement for Excellence (EEE) Scholarships for High/Senior Secondary School Students. This scheme aims to encourage and reward brilliant students by providing incentives/scholarshipsRs. provided they have secured a first division in their previous class. Under this schemeRs. scholarships/incentives are awarded to students from Class VI to Class XII who secured the first position in their respective classes in the preceding academic year. One student from the boys' category and one from the girls' category in each schoolRs. from Class VI to Class XIIRs. will be awarded the scholarship.
**Objectives:**
To encourage brilliant students.
To inculcate a spirit of competition among students to excel in studies.
benefits:
**Scholarship Amount:**

1. 750/- per annum for middle-class students (Class VI to VIII).
1. 1Rs./- per annum for High and Senior Secondary students (Class IX to XII).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student of a government school in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class VI to Class XII.
1. The applicant should have secured the first position in the preceding class.
1. The applicant should have obtained a first division in the preceding examination.

name: Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana
brief_description: The "Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. a financial incentive of 5Rs./- is provided to inter-caste married couples to support their married life and household setup. > ***Objectives:*** - To eliminate caste-based discrimination and untouchability. - To promote social harmony by encouraging inter-caste marriages between Scheduled Caste individuals and upper-caste Hindus. - To provide financial assistance to inter-caste couples for economic stability and social acceptance.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - Financial assistance of 5Rs./- is provided per couple. > **Disbursement Process:** - 2Rs./- is deposited as a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank for eight years (not withdrawable before maturity). - 2Rs./- is directly transferred to the couples joint bank account for household and essential needs.
eligibility: 1. One of the applicants should belong to the general categoryRs. and the other should be from the scheduled caste. 1. Both applicants should be natives of Rajasthan. 1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 35 years (females above 18 years and males above 21 years) at the time of applying. 1. The annual family income of the couple must not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. The applicant should not have any criminal record. 1. The couple must not have received financial benefits from similar state/central government schemes. 1. There should be no case of remarriage; the benefit of this scheme is given only on the first marriage. 1. A man who marries a widow shall be free from the contract of first marriage.

name: Grishm Kaleen Dhan Ke Badle Dalhan, Tilhan, Makka Fasal ko Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: Launched on 30th April 2014Rs. the scheme "Grishm Kaleen Dhan Ke Badle DalhanRs. TilhanRs. Makka Fasal ko Protsahan Yojana" was introduced under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology DepartmentRs. Govt. of Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to promote the cultivation of pulsesRs. oilseedsRs. and maize as an alternative to summer riceRs. helping to conserve groundwater and increase crop production in the state. Under this schemeRs. farmers receive subsidies per acre in the form of seedsRs. fertilizersRs. and other inputs. Beneficiaries can purchase these inputs from cooperative societiesRs. the Chhattisgarh State Seed and Agriculture Development CorporationRs. or authorized private vendorsRs. with the state government reimbursing the cost up to the subsidy limit.
benefits:
- The subsidy amount is 2Rs./- per acre (0.4 hectare).
- A maximum subsidy of 10Rs./- is available for up to 2 hectares.
- The subsidy will be 10Rs./- or the actual costRs. whichever is lower.
- Each farmer must cultivate a minimum area of 0.4 hectares to be eligible.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer cultivating pulsesRs. oilseedsRs. or maize in place of Rabi/Summer rice.
1. The applicant should be growing these crops in the same or an additional area as in previous years.
1. The applicant should be cultivating pulsesRs. oilseedsRs. or maize in lieu of summer paddy to be eligible for the subsidy.
1. The applicant should be a sharecropper or landowning farmerRs. as both are entitled to the scheme benefits.
1. The applicant should be a first-time cultivator of summer pulsesRs. oilseedsRs. or maize to receive priority.
1. The applicant should submit their application earlyRs. as selection will be on a first-comeRs. first-served basis if applications exceed the target.
1. The applicant should note that a particular farmer will be eligible for the benefit only once under the scheme.

name: Food Bill Assistance
brief_description: The "Food Bill Assistance" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support students who are required to live away from their families due to the unavailability of educational facilities in their home taluka. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per month for 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a non-reserved category.
1. The applicant must be pursuing a graduate-level course in MedicalRs. DentalRs. TechnicalRs. or Para-Technical fields.
1. The applicant must be staying in a government/non-aided hostel outside their home taluka.
1. If the applicant is a girl studying in Std. 9 to 12Rs. she must be staying in a hostel run by a societyRs. trustRs. or institution.
1. The applicants annual family income must be 4Rs./- or less.

name: Interest Help Scheme For Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate
brief_description: The scheme "Interest Help Scheme for Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. provides financial assistance in the form of interest subsidy on loans for self-employment. Beneficiaries from the unreserved category who are doctorsRs. lawyersRs. technical graduatesRs. and want to open their own clinicRs. laboratoryRs. radiology clinic or office will be eligible for interest subsidy on loans taken from the bank. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits: - **Quantum of Subsidy:** 5% interest subsidy on loans up to 10Rs./- taken from a bank.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 50 years.
1. The business must have the necessary registration as per the rules.
1. The applicant must be a doctor/ lawyer/ technical graduate and have an interest in opening their own clinic/ laboratory/ radiology/ clinic or office.

name: Nawabihan Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2005Rs. the scheme "Nawabihan Scheme" by the State Government aims to implement the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005. Two significant benefits of this scheme include providing necessary legal advice and offering shelter facilities to women affected by domestic violence. Two significant eligibility criteria include being a woman who has experienced domestic violence and requiring assistance as per the provisions of the aforementioned Act. The scheme is implemented by the State Government through the designated Women Protection Officer in each district. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline through the concerned authorities.
benefits:
- Provision of legal advice to the aggrieved woman as per her requirement.
- Provision of counselling services to the aggrieved woman as per her requirement.
- Arrangement of medical facilities for the aggrieved woman as per her requirement.
- Provision of transportation facilities to the aggrieved woman as per her requirement.
- Arrangement of shelter facilities for the aggrieved woman as per her requirement.

brief_description: The "Intensive Castration Scheme" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. name: Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State" by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Chhattisgarh GovernmentRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students domiciled in Chhattisgarh who are pursuing B.E./B.Tech courses in recognised engineering colleges outside the state. Key benefits include financial aid to cover educational expenses and encouragement for students to pursue quality education beyond state borders. name: Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste Families
brief_description:
The scheme Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste FamiliesRs. implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to promote diversification into horticultural crops to improve the income and livelihood of scheduled castes farmers who have small landholdings. Under this schemeRs. Scheduled Caste farmers will be provided with quality planting material and other inputs for mushroom cultivationRs. bamboo stacking in vegetablesRs. and protected cultivation with a subsidy of up to 90%. AdditionallyRs. training will be offered on various aspects of these practices.
**Objectives:**

- To encourage the SC farmers to take horticultural crops as diversification option.
- To acquaint the SC farmers about the latest technologies in the field of horticulture.
- To increase the income of the land of SC families by way of increasing output by adopting various horticultural crops.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. Scheduled Caste farmers receive 90% subsidy on components like Mushroom TraysRs. Bamboo Stacking in vegetable cropsRs. Protected Structures (Poly House/Net House/Walk-in-Tunnels)Rs. Cultivation of High Value vegetables/ flowers under Protected Structures and other cultivation technologies in Haryana.
- Training will be provided on various aspects of horticultural crops cultivation technologies.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The farmer should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
1. The applicant should own or lease agricultural land.

**Note:** The scheme targets Scheduled Caste families with small landholdings in the state.

name: Indira Priyadarshini Award
brief_description:
The "Indira Priyadarshini Award" scheme was launched by the Secondary and Elementary Education DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. in the year 2019-20. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among girl students belonging to eight specified social categories: Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. MinorityRs. DisabledRs. General CategoryRs. Special Backward ClassRs. and Below Poverty Line (BPL).
Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial reward is provided to girl students who secure the first position in each district in Class 8thRs. Class 10thRs. and Class 12th (separately for ArtsRs. ScienceRs. & Commerce streams) examinations conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education. AdditionallyRs. a girl student who secures the first position at the state level in the Class 8thRs. Praveshika and Varishtha Upadhyay examinations conducted by the Sanskrit Education Department is also rewarded under this scheme in each of the above-mentioned social categories.
From the academic year 202122Rs. the award has been extended to eight girl students of Class 10th and eight girl students of Class 12th who secure the first position at the state level in the vocational education examination within the specified social categories. FurthermoreRs. from the same yearRs. girl students of Swami Vivekanand Government Model Schools who secure the first position at the state level in the respective categories and obtain a CGPA of 9 or above are also eligible for the award.
***Implementation:***
The scheme is implemented by the Balika Shiksha FoundationRs. Jaipur.
***Award Ceremony:***
The awards are presented ceremoniously every year on November 19Rs. the birth anniversary of Smt. Indira GandhiRs. at the district headquarters.
benefits:
**The scheme provides the following one-time financial rewards to the girl students:**
***Class 8 Girl Students:***

- 40Rs./- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level).

***Class 10 Girl Students:***

- 75Rs./- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level).

***Class 12 Girl Students (ArtsRs. ScienceRs. and Commerce streams considered separately):***

- 1Rs./- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level).
- A Scooty is also provided to all awardees of Class 12.

***Vocational Education (From 202122):***

- Girls from the above categories who secure first position at the state level in vocational exams are also awarded.

***Swami Vivekanand Government Model Schools (From 202122):***

- Top 8 girls each from Class 10 and Class 12 who score 9 CGPA or more are awarded at the state level.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student and enrolled as a regular student.
1. The applicant should belong to one of the following categories: Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Other Backward Classes (OBC)Rs. Minority CommunitiesRs. Differently-abled (Disabled)Rs. General CategoryRs. Special Backward Classes (SBC)Rs. or Below Poverty Line (BPL).
1. The applicant should have secured the first position at the district level in Class 8Rs. 10Rs. or 12 examinations (ArtsRs. ScienceRs. or Commerce stream) conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education.
1. The student should have obtained at least 60% marks in the respective examination.
1. Girl students who secure the first position at the state level in Class 8Rs. (10) PraveshikaRs. or (12) Varishtha Upadhyay examinations conducted by the Sanskrit Education Department are also eligible.
1. Girl students securing the first position at the state level in vocational education examinations for Class 10 or 12 are eligible under the scheme.
1. Girl students from Swami Vivekananda Government Model Schools who score a CGPA of 9.0 or above in Class 10 or 12 are also eligible.

**Note:** The caste/category certificate submitted by the student at the time of applying for the board examination will be treated as final.

brief_description:
The "Chief Ministers Education Assistance Scheme (CMEAS)" was launched by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Sikkim. The objective of scheme is to provide financial assistance to students from economically weaker sectionsRs. marginalized communities and specially-abled students. Under this schemeRs. students receive financial aid for pursuing education within the stateRs. outside the stateRs. abroadRs. and in registered coaching institutions.
> ***Scheme Implementation:***

name: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. for students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS). Under the schemeRs. a cash award of 50Rs. will be given to students studying in government schools affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary EducationRs. AjmerRs. who secure the highest marks in the EWS category in the Class 10th and Class 12th examinations (ArtsRs. CommerceRs. and Science streams). The cash award will be disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the student's bank account linked to their Jan Aadhaar.
benefits:
***Each selected student will receive:***

- A one-time cash award of 50Rs./- per student.
- A Certificate of Appreciation.

***No. of Students selected:***

- A total of 32 students will be benefitted under the scheme.

***For Class 10 students:***

- 10 boys and 10 girls (total 20 students) will be selected.

***For Class 12 students:***

- In Arts stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected.
- In Science stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected.
- In Commerce stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected.

**Note:**
The amount receive through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked to the student's JanAadhaar.
eligibility:

1. The student should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS).
1. The student is studying in government schools in Rajasthan.

**Note:** Students benefiting from any other incentive schemes run by the state and central government will also be eligible for benefits under the scheme.

name: Jan Nayak Pustakalaya evam Digital Adhyan Kendra
brief_description:
The "Jan Nayak Pustakalaya evam Digital Adhyan Kendra" schemeRs. under the BC & EBC Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. aims to develop all Jannayak Karpoori Thakur HostelsRs. other backward class welfare hostelsRs. and OBC girls hostels across the state into Jan Nayak Pustakalaya evam Digital Adhyan Kendra.
**Objectives**
(a) To ensure the availability of competitive and high-quality books and study material.
(b) To ensure quality education and guidance through digital learning.
(c) To organize inspirational guidance sessions through experts and previously successful candidates in competitive examinations.
Through this initiativeRs. studentsespecially those in remote areaswill have access to high-quality study material and expert guidance in a modern educational environment.
benefits: The scheme provides students with access to quality study materialsRs. digital learningRs. and expert guidance to enhance their academic and competitive exam preparation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC) category.
1. The applicant should be residing in a Jannayak Karpoori Thakur Hostel or other OBC/EBC welfare hostel in Bihar.

name: Hostel Rent Assistance Scheme for Tribal Students
brief_description: The scheme "Hostel Rent Assistance Scheme for Tribal Students" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to encourage tribal students (both boys and girls) of Rajasthan to pursue higher education in undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Under this schemeRs. hostel rent assistance is provided for a maximum period of five years to Scheduled Tribe students studying in government colleges who reside in rented accommodation for the purpose of regular studies. The scheme is applicable only to students from Scheduled Areas of Rajasthan enrolled in government colleges.
benefits:
> **Students receive the following rental assistance as a cash benefit:**

- The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account linked with the Bhamashah card.

name: Atma Nirbhar Plantation Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Atma Nirbhar Plantation Yojana (ANPY)" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Arunachal PradeshRs. aims to promote self-reliance in the agriculture sector through sustainable plantation activities across the state's diverse agro-climatic zones. Under this schemeRs. support in the form of plantation assistance and allied resources is provided to individual farmersRs. Self-Help Groups (SHGs)Rs. and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
benefits: - Access to plantation support including technical guidanceRs. planting materialRs. and financial assistance.
eligibility:
- The Scheme can be applied by individual farmers as well as Self-Help Groups (SHGs)/ Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs).

**Eligibility Criteria for Individual Farmers**

1. The applicant should be a native of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be an individual farmer.
1. The applicant should have landholding between 0.50 hectares and 25 hectares.
1. The applicant should not be a bank defaulter.
1. The applicant should not be a government servant.

**Eligibility Criteria for Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**

1. The applicant should be a Self-Help Group (SHG) based in Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The SHG should have a minimum of 1.0 hectare and up to 50 hectares of land.
1. The SHG should not be a bank defaulter.
1. An already existing SHGs prior to involvement of SrLM shall be considered.
1. SHGs formed for small-scale industries such as weavingRs. knittingRs. tailoringRs. and other similar businesses shall not be entertained or considered eligible.

**Note:** The SHGs formed especially for Agri- sector shall be given priority.
**Eligibility Criteria for Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs)**

1. The Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) should be registered in Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The FPO should have a minimum of 5 hectares and a maximum of 50 hectares of land.
1. The FPO should have at least 100 shareholders.
1. The FPO should submit at least one audited Balance Sheet.
1. All board members and shareholders of FPO should be non-defaulters to any bank/financial institution.
1. All types of FPOs engaged in agriculture business will get benefit from this programme.

name: Pension for Agitators Who were Jailed for 7 Days or Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement
brief_description: The "Pension for Agitators Who were Jailed for 7 Days or Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to agitators who were jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement and are unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 6Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an agitator who was jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The applicant must be unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.

name: Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan
brief_description:
The scheme "Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme" was introduced by the Devasthan DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. on 1st April 2016. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this schemeRs. selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expensesRs. up to a maximum of 10Rs./- per pilgrim.
> **Total Number of Beneficiaries**

The scheme is limited to 200 pilgrims per year. If there are more applicants than available slotsRs. selection will be by lottery.
benefits:
- Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expensesRs. up to a maximum of 10Rs. per pilgrim.

> **Note:**

Payment is made via online bank transfer or through account payee cheque or demand draftRs. depending on departmental conditions.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant's age should be 21 years or above.
1. The applicant should not be a person who subsists on alms.
1. The applicant should not be an income tax payer.
1. The applicant should not be a retired employee/officer of the Central Government/State Government/Central & State Government Undertakings/Local Body.
1. Only one-time assistance per lifetime is permitted.

**Note:** Only the person selected by the Devasthan DepartmentRs. Rajasthan is eligible to get the benefit of the scheme.

name: Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme" was introduced by the Tribal Area Development DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. during the year 20072008. It aims to provide basic primary educationRs. nutritional supportRs. and awareness on health and sanitation to out-of-school children from Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. KathodiRs. and Sahariya communities in remote tribal areas. Under this schemeRs. free education (classes 1st to 4th)Rs. nutritious mealsRs. uniformsRs. and learning materials are provided to tribal children aged 6 to 12 years residing in areas where the nearest school is 1.52 km away. The scheme is implemented by the Tribal Area Development Project Office with community participation and employs local educated tribal youth and women.
> **Objectives:**


- Enroll 30 tribal children aged 6 to 12 years at each Maa-Badi CentreRs. giving preference to girls.
- Provide free breakfast and mid-day meals to enrolled children.
- Distribute uniformsRs. shoesRs. socksRs. tiesRs. beltsRs. and sweaters to each child.
- Prevent migration of children of agricultural laborers by ensuring consistent education.
- Involve mothers of enrolled children in food preparation on a rotational basis with honorarium.
- Link tribal women to adult literacy programs through Maa-Badi centres.
- Create awareness about government schemes on healthRs. nutritionRs. and sanitation.
- Operate centres through local Village Development Committees with oversight from technical staff.
benefits:
**At these centersRs. children are provided following benefits:**

- Free primary education (classes 1st to 4th).- Breakfast and nutritious mid-day meals.
- Free uniformsRs. school bagsRs. shoesRs. socksRs. sweatersRs. tiesRs. and belts.
- Free sports equipment etc.

**Day-Care Centre Specific Benefits:**

- Full-day (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM) operation.
- 2 education facilitators and 3 assistants at each centre.
- Meals are provided twice a day.

**Maa-Badi Centre Specific Benefits:**

- Operates as per the school calendar.
- 1 education facilitator and 2 assistants per centre.
- Breakfast and one mid-day meal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a child aged 6 to 12 years.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled TribeRs. KathodiRs. or Sahariya community.
1. The applicant should reside in UdaipurRs. DungarpurRs. BanswaraRs. PratapgarhRs. SirohiRs. or Rajsamand districts.
1. The applicant should not currently be enrolled in any formal school.
1. The applicant should reside in areas where the nearest school is at least 1.52 km away.

name: ICSSR International Collaboration
brief_description: Through this programmeRs. it promotes academic links amongst the social scientists in India and abroadRs. provides opportunity to develop new insights and to enlarge their research perspective and contribute to the advancement and dissemination of knowledge in social science subjects. Under this schemeRs. the financial assistance is provided to Indian scholarsRs. who have been invited to contribute and present papers at International Conference abroad. Invitation received from global subject associations/reputed international organisations/universities are given preference. Applications are invited in all broad disciplines within the domain of social sciences. Faculties with regular service in public funded Universities / Deemed-to-be-Universities/CollegesRs. Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE / UGCRs. and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes having a PhD degree are eligible to apply. PhD/PDF scholars in the advanced stage of their research are also eligible. The applications shall be accepted at least three months before the due date of the Seminar/Conference. Faculties will be eligible for financial assistance up to 50% of the total cost of visit under this scheme. HoweverRs. the faculties belonging to SC/STRs. Persons with Benchmark Disability and Doctoral/Post-Doctoral scholars (without pay protection) will be considered for full financial assistance. The expenditure are reimbursed on submission of the original boarding passRs. attendance certificateRs. statement of expenditure and a brief report on the Seminar/Conference/ Workshop/Proceedings.

1) Airfare As per actuals
2) Visa fee - As per actuals
3) Travel Insurance - As per actuals
4) Registration Fee up to US$200
5) Maintenance As per the Ministry of External Affairs notifications
eligibility:
1) The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
2) Faculties with regular service having a PhD degree are eligible to apply.
3) PhD/PDF scholars in the advanced stage of their research are eligible.

5) Must be affiliated public funded Universities / Deemed-to-be-Universities/CollegesRs. Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE / UGCRs. and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes

name: Rani Laxmi Bai Self-Defense Training
brief_description: The Rani Laxmi Bai Self-Defense Training is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free self-defense skills training (including judoRs. karateRs. martial artsRs. and boxing) to girl students in upper primary and secondary schools across the state.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and support candidates from the minority community of Uttarakhand by providing financial incentives for the preparation of competitive examinations. These incentives are given at various stages of success in examinations conducted by bodies such as the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)Rs. Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) (including combined competitive and higher judicial services exams)Rs. as well as entrance examinations for national-level institutions like IITs and IIMs.
benefits: **The following incentives are provided to candidates from the minority community for their preparation:** **For the All India Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC):** - 75Rs./- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - 25Rs./- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. **For the Uttarakhand State and Subordinate Services (Direct Recruitment)Rs. Combined Competitive ExaminationRs. Higher Judicial ServiceRs. and Provincial Civil Services (Judicial) conducted by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC):** - 60Rs./- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - 20Rs./- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. **For admission to national-level institutes through entrance examinations:** - Group A: Admission to IITs and IIMs 60Rs./- after clearing the entrance examination and securing admission. - Group B: Admission to AIIMSRs. IISc BangaloreRs. IISER (Kolkata & Bangalore)Rs. national-level medical colleges recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI)Rs. National Institutes of Technology (NITs) recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)Rs. National Law Universities recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI)Rs. and through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) 50Rs./- after passing the entrance examination and securing admission.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. ParsiRs. BuddhistRs. or Jain). 1. The applicant must have successfully cleared either the Preliminary or Main Examination stage of UPSCRs. UKPSC (Combined Competitive or Higher Judicial Services)Rs. or the entrance examination of a national-level institution (such as IITsRs. IIMsRs. etc.). 1. The annual income of the applicants parents/guardians (including the applicants own incomeRs. if any) must not exceed 4.50 lakh. 1. The grant amount will be released only after the candidate submits the admit card of the relevant examination and the original application form/certificate of success to the competent authority.

name: Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)
brief_description: The scheme "Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)" under the Scheme for Implementation of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016 (SIPDA)Rs. aims to financially support the creation and modernization of assistive educational tools for visually impaired students pursuing school and higher education. Through this schemeRs. implementing agencies receive grants to procureRs. produceRs. and enhance the capacity of institutions producing educational aids such as Braille presses and digital books. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD).
benefits: - **Support for Braille Presses:** Assistance is given for the installation of new Braille presses and enhancement of the capacity and modernization of existing Braille presses. - **Upgradation of Talking Book Studios:** Financial support is offered for increasing the capacity and modernization of existing Talking Book Studios. - **Creation and Enhancement of Digital Book Production Centers:** Grants are available for setting up new Digital Book Production Centers and modernizing existing centers to improve production capabilities. - **Support for Large Print Book Production:** Funding is provided for establishing new Large Print Book Production Centers and increasing the capacity and modernization of existing large print facilities.
eligibility:
> **Individual Eligibility:**


- The applicant must be a visually impaired student enrolled in school or pursuing higher education.
- The applicant must have a valid Unique Disability ID (UDID) card issued by the competent authority.

> **Institutional Eligibility:**


- The agency must be approved for SIPDA projects.
- The agency must be actively involved in the developmentRs. productionRs. or distribution of educational materials for persons with visual disabilities.

name: Skill Development and Economic Empowerment
brief_description: The scheme "Skill Development and Economic Empowerment" by the is a central sector scheme that aims to provide inclusive vocational training and empower visually challenged individuals for economic self-reliance. Through this schemeRs. training is provided in various trades such as computer operationsRs. stenographyRs. programming assistanceRs. secretarial assistanceRs. and other technical fields. AdditionallyRs. students are provided with free mealsRs. hostel accommodationRs. library facilitiesRs. teaching aidsRs. and medical care. benefits: > **Free Vocational Training:** - Provides training in various professional coursesRs. including Computer OperatorRs. StenographerRs. Mushroom ProducerRs. Radio JockeyRs. Data Entry OperatorRs. ReflexologyRs. and Gardener. > **Essential Skill Training:** - Offers training in Braille orientation and mobilityRs. computer typingRs. Hindi and EnglishRs. and home management skills. > **Modern Learning Tools:** - Senior students receive smartphones and laptops to facilitate modern and convenient studies. > **Comprehensive Support for Trainees:** - Free food and accommodation are provided. - Commuting allowance is given for participation in the program. - Uniforms are provided. - Library facilities are accessible. - Medical facilities are available. - Accessible teaching materials are supplied. - Assistive devices are provided.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to the Persons with Disabilities category.

name: Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme

Group C exams and other competitive examinations. The scheme is implemented by the governmentRs. non-governmentRs. and private institutions approved by the state.

**Free Coaching:**

- Provided for competitive exams such as IASRs. PCSRs. EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. NursingRs. NDARs. Group CRs. and others.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Accident Insurance Scheme"Rs. a sub-component of the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada YojanaRs. is implemented by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The applicants age must be between 18 and 70 years at the time of enrollment.

name: Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th
brief_description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Other Backward Classes (Minority) Students Studying in Standard 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. name: Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer)

name: scholarship scheme - Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scholarship scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmersRs. agricultural laborersRs. and market workers of Uttarakhand to pursue higher education in AgricultureRs. ForestryRs. FisheriesRs. Horticulture & other related fields.
benefits: Students pursuing courses in AgricultureRs. ForestryRs. FisheriesRs. Horticulture and other related fields at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar; R.M.P. (P.G.) CollegeRs. Gurukul NarsanRs. Haridwar; V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and ForestryRs. BharsarRs. Pauri Garhwal; and the College of HorticultureRs. V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and ForestryRs. RanichauriRs. are eligible for scholarshipsRs. which are awarded to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmersRs. agricultural laborersRs. market laborersRs. and their dependents to support their higher education in these fields.

name: University Scholarship (Ph.D.) - Uttarakhand

Government of Uttarakhand.
