name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana has been started by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote rural and eco-tourism by encouraging local residents to develop homestay facilitiesRs. thereby generating employment and income opportunities within the state.
benefits: - There is a provision for financial assistance to permanent residents/native of the state who take a loan for the construction of homestays. - In hilly areasRs. a subsidy of up to 50% of the project costRs. subject to a maximum of 15.00 lakhRs. is provided along with an interest grant of up to 1.50 lakh for the first five years. - In plain areasRs. a subsidy of up to 25% of the project costRs. subject to a maximum of 7.50 lakhRs. is provided along with an interest grant of 1.00 lakh for the first five years. The beneficiarys contribution at the time of availing the loan must be 12.5%. - The subsidy is applicable only when the loan is taken. - In addition to the construction of new housesRs. funds/subsidy are also provided for the upgradation of old buildingsRs. including their extensionRs. renovationRs. improvementRs. and construction of toiletsRs. as mentioned above.
eligibility: 1. This benefit is provided as a subsidy for the construction of homestays across the state of UttarakhandRs. excluding areas under Municipal Corporations and Municipalities. 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The building ownerRs. who resides in the building with their familyRs. may construct a minimum of one and a maximum of six guest rooms. 1. Upon construction of a new homestay or renovation of an existing oneRs. the property must be registered with the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.

name: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to cropsRs. livestockRs. or agricultural land caused by fireRs. floodRs. or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.
benefits: Damage caused by fire accidents to standing cropsRs. harvested crops in the fieldRs. crops stored in barns for threshingRs. or residual produce in the notified market areas of Uttarakhand StateRs. as well as damage to property and livestock due to fire in the farmers houseRs. and damage to agricultural land due to floods or rain-induced soil erosionRs. all such losses make farmers eligible to receive compensation under this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a minimum of 18 years of age to submit and receive a claim.

name: Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief_description: The scheme Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from economically weaker sections pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of 400 per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding 6Rs./-.
benefits: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of 400/- is given to NT/DNT Caste students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Nomadic Tribe and Denotified Tribe (NTDNT) communities. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicants individual and family income should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 30-ton capacityRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to strengthen fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR/SCP to keep the unit operationalRs. bear all post-construction costsRs. and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
benefits:
- The project cost is 120Rs./-

> **Subsidy Distribution :**


1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR/SCP to bear all operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction management costsRs. and to ensure the continuous operation of the ice plant/cold storage.
1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on the actual costRs. within the overall ceiling specified under the relevant PMMSY sub-components.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price.
1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible.

name: Green Business Scheme - Haryana
brief_description: The "Green Business Scheme" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSCFDC) in collaboration with the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) within the state of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. loans of up to 2.00 lakhs are provided to Scheduled Caste residents of Haryana for undertaking income-generating activities such as e-rickshawsRs. compressed air vehiclesRs. solar energy gadgetsRs. polyhousesRs. and similar ventures. Activities that contribute to mitigating the greenhouse effect are eligible for assistance under this scheme.
benefits: 1. The CorporationRs. in collaboration with NSFDCRs. provides a loan for various economic development schemes having a unit cost up to 2Rs./-. 1. The Corporation provides margin money @10% of the project cost. 1. The Corporation (HSFDC) provides a subsidy of 50% of the total project costRs. with a maximum amount of subsidy being 10Rs./- of the total project cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 45 years. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's annual family income should be up to 3Rs./-. **Note:** The income ceiling is at least 50% of the beneficiaries having an annual family income up to 1Rs./-Rs. and the balance 50% of the beneficiaries having an annual family income up to 3Rs./-.

name: Award of Fellowship to Most Eminent Artist
brief_description: The scheme "Award of Fellowship to Most Eminent Artist" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to recognize and financially assist artists aged 60 years or above who have retired from professional artistic practice and have made distinguished contributions in the field of plastic arts at the national level. The fellowship is intended to support such artists by enabling them to acquire necessary equipment and continue contributing meaningfully to the arts. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy. In this schemeRs. 10 artists are given a monthly fellowship of 5Rs./- for one yearRs. and it is extendable for a maximum of two yearsRs. depending on the quality and impact of the artists continued work.
benefits: - **Monthly Fellowship:** 5Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an artist.
- The applicant must be 60 years or older.
- The applicant should be retired from the professional field of plastic arts.
- The applicant should have attained national-level fame and established a distinct identity through excellence in paintingRs. sculptureRs. or graphic arts.

name: Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts
brief_description: The scheme "Publication Support Scheme for Fine Arts" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase awareness about fine arts and promote the publication of fine arts literature by supporting artists and art institutions financially. Under this initiativeRs. applications are invited annually through paid newspaper advertisementsRs. and 2 (two) artists/art institutions are provided assistance for the publication of fine arts books.. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% of the total printing cost or a maximum of 20Rs./- (whichever is lower).
eligibility: - An individual artist or an art institution working in the field of fine arts is eligible for this scheme.

name: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of Fish Kiosks including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental fish" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosksRs. including those for aquarium/ornamental fish.
benefits: The project cost is 10Rs./- per unit. Subsidy of 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries. Subsidy of 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self Contained Proposal (SCP) to the effect that all operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by them.
1. The applicant should ensure the fish kiosk will be kept in operational condition for 10 years.
1. The applicant should display a board permanently at the infrastructure facilities to the effect that the fish kiosk is constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).
1. The applicant can only avail of central assistance for one unit.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. HoweverRs. the lease period/ agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.

name: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Inputs for fresh water AquacultureRs. including Composite fish cultureRs. ScampiRs. PangasiusRs. TilapiaRs. etcRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to expand fisheries production in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It provides input cost subsidies for the first crop in newly constructed ponds under PMMSYRs. aiming to promote aquaculture in urban and semi-urban areas.
benefits:
- The project cost is: 4Rs./- per hectare

> **Subsidy Distribution:**


1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries
1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana with a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant will be eligible for input cost subsidy provided by the State Government only for the expansion of fisheries in urban or semi-urban areas under the construction of new ponds.
1. The applicant will receive central financial assistance only for the initial fish crop (fertilizer) in newly constructed ponds.
1. The applicant will be eligible for central financial assistance on input costs only if the pond is properly prepared for fisheries.
1. The applicant may use land on a long-term registered leaseRs. provided the lease period is at least 7 yearsRs. for eligibility under this scheme.

name: Ambubhai Purani Award
brief_description: The scheme "Ambubhai Purani Award" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote the development of gymnasiums and traditional Indian physical culture by honoring individuals who have shown exceptional contribution in this field. The scheme provides financial assistance of 51Rs./- and state-level recognition to outstanding individualsRs. fostering motivation and continuity in preserving indigenous physical training traditions. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 51Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a male individual. 1. The applicant should have performed excellent work in the field of Gymnasiums (Akhadas).

name: Manav Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: Launched on 11th September 1995Rs. the scheme "Manav Kalyan Yojana" implemented by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to uplift economically disadvantaged sections by providing toolkit assistance (via e-vouchers) for self-employment in 10 designated trades. The scheme replaces previous self-employment initiatives and targets individuals/families with an annual income of up to 6Rs./- in rural/urban areas. It focuses on empowering artisans and marginalized communitiesRs. including SC/ST and nomadic tribesRs. with no income limit for the most backward sub-castes. Applications are submitted online via the e-Kutir portalRs. and beneficiaries receive toolkits through a transparent e-voucher system.
benefits:
**Toolkit Assistance:** E-vouchers for toolkits in 10 specified trades.
**Trades Covered:** Dairy Product SalesRs. PlumberRs. Bharat Kaam (Embroidery)Rs. Centering WorkRs. Beauty ParlorRs. Electric Appliances RepairingRs. Papad MakingRs. Pickle MakingRs. Vehicle ServicingRs. Puncture Kit
_*The maximum cost limits per toolkit are predefined (exact amounts not specified in the document)._
**Training Option:** Applicants can opt for skill training during the application process.
**Transparent Disbursement:** E-vouchers (QR codes) are generated post-approval and redeemed at approved dealers.
eligibility:
- The applicants must be between 18 and 60 years of age to qualify for the scheme. - The applicants from Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. or Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) nomadic tribes are eligible without any income proof requirement. - The applicants from general categories must have a family annual income of 6Rs./- or lessRs. and must submit an income certificate as proof.
**Additional Requirement for Rural Applicants** The rural applicants must - a) either be listed in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list with a poverty score of 0 to 16. b) or submit an income certificate issued by the relevant authority.
**Income Criteria Exemptions** The income limit does not apply to the following: a) Individuals from the 12 most backward sub-castes within the Scheduled Castes. b) Members of the most backwardRs. nomadicRs. or de-notified tribes under the SEBC category. _*For all other applicantsRs. the annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./-Rs. whether residing in rural or urban areas._

name: Subsidy on Rehri alongwith (Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensil etc.) for the Fish/Fish Product Sale
brief_description: The scheme Subsidy on Rehri along with StoveRs. Gas ChulhaRs. UtensilsRs. etc. for Sale of Fish/Fish Products is implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers for the purchase of a Rehri (handcart) equipped with stoveRs. gas chulhaRs. utensilsRs. and other essentials for selling fish and fish products. A 60% subsidy is provided on the total project cost of 60Rs./- per beneficiary.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided for the purchase of a Rehri (Handcart) along with essential items such as stoveRs. gas chulhaRs. utensilsRs. etc.Rs. for selling fish or fish products.
- A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of 60Rs./- will be grantedRs. amounting to 36Rs./- per beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years.

name: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Ponds for Saline/Alkaline Areas" by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this schemeRs. subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries. The scheme considers ponds with a long duration and a registered lease period of at least 7 years for grants.
benefits: - The project cost is 8Rs./- per hectare. - The subsidy is limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new ponds subsidy will be provided by the state government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme.
1. Only central financial assistance will be provided to the beneficiaries for the initial fish crop only on the fertiliser of newly constructed ponds.
1. Central financial assistance on the construction of new ponds will be provided only on ponds prepared for fisheries.
1. Under this schemeRs. ponds whose pond duration will be for a long timeRs. and the registered lease period will be at least 7 yearsRs. will be considered for a grant on those ponds.

name: PMMSY: Construction of New Grow Out Ponds - Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Grow out Ponds" by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas through the construction of new grow-out ponds. Through this schemeRs. subsidies are provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to beneficiaries who are engaged in fisheries.
benefits: - The scheme provides financial assistance for the Construction of the New Grow-out Ponds. The project cost is 7Rs./- per Hectare. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries falling under the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries who are Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new grow-out ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new grow-out ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme.
1. Central financial assistance for the construction of new grow-out ponds will be provided only for the ponds prepared for fisheries.
1. The applicant should have own land with clear title or having land on a long-term registered leaseRs. not less than a minimum of 7 years.

name: C H Muhammedkoya Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "C H Muhammedkoya Scholarship" by the Minority Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of KeralaRs. aims to provide financial assistance to girl students from MuslimRs. LatinRs. and Converted Christian communities who are natives of Kerala. Through this schemeRs. scholarships are provided for undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. and professional coursesRs. along with a separate hostel stipend for eligible beneficiaries. The scheme is implemented by the Minority Affairs Department.
benefits: The scholarship provides monetary benefits to eligible students for their studies and hostel expenses. - **Undergraduate:** 4Rs./- per annum (for 3Rs. students).- **Post Graduates:** 5Rs./- per annum (for 1Rs. students).- **Professional Courses:** 6Rs./- per annum (for 1Rs. students).- **Hostel Stipend:** 12Rs./- per annum (for 2Rs. students).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the MuslimRs. LatinRs. or Converted Christian community. 1. The applicant should be a native of Kerala. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should be studying for the first year of Graduation or Higher courses in a Government/Aided Institution. 1. The applicant should have gained admission to self-financing colleges from the merit seat. 1. The applicant should have scored 50% or above in the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 4Rs./-. 1. The applicant applying for Hostel stipend should be staying in recognized hostels.

name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid for Professional Associations/ Organisations of Social Scientists including Universities, Colleges and Research Institutes for Publication/ Running of their Research Journal(s)
brief_description: Journals supported under this scheme must be at least three years old with consistent publication records. The publisher may be a universityRs. collegeRs. research instituteRs. or professional association registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860. The organisation and the journal may be discipline-specific or interdisciplinary. The maximum annual grant is Rs. 5Rs. for one journal and Rs. 8Rs. for multiple journals. Where journals are published commerciallyRs. financial support is limited to editorial/processing costs (up to Rs. 1Rs. per journal). Additional funding may be considered for special issues or back volumes. The final 10% of the grant is released after submission of the Audited Statement of Accounts and Utilization Certificate.
benefits: 1) Grant up to Rs. 5Rs. per annum per journal. 2) Up to Rs. 8Rs. for multiple journals by a single organisation. 3) Rs. 1Rs. support for journals with commercial publishers (editorial cost only)with a ceiling of Rs. 2Rs. if the organisation publishes more than one journal. 4) Additional support for publishing back issues or special issues. 5) Amount is disbursed in two instalmentsRs. first installment is 90% and second will be 10%Rs. which will be released after submitting Audited Statement of Accounts and Utilisation Certificate
eligibility: 1. Must be a universityRs. collegeRs. research instituteRs. or registered association. 2. Journals must follow professional publishing standards (peer reviewRs. citationsRs. etc.). 3. In case it's a privately funded institution or association of social scientistsRs. it should be registered under Societies of Registration ActRs. 1860. 4. Must submit audited accounts and annual reports for the last three years. 5. SC/ST category journals must focus on SC/ST-related research themes. 6. Grant-in-Aid may be provided to journals being published in regional languages and translation thereof.

name: Scheme of Publication Grant/Subsidy for Publication of Doctoral Thesis/Research Report/ Papers Presented in Seminars/Conferences, etc.
brief_description: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR)Rs. under the Ministry of EducationRs. Government of IndiaRs. provides financial assistance for the publication of high-quality doctoral thesesRs. research project/fellowship reportsRs. and seminar/conference papers in the field of social sciences. The maximum grant offered is Rs. 2Rs. and manuscripts are evaluated by subject experts. The final publication must follow ICSSR publishing standards and is to be completed within one year from the date of grant. ICSSR pays the publisher directly and mandates submission of copiesRs. royalty termsRs. and quality assurance. The publication must acknowledge ICSSR support.
benefits: 1. Grant up to Rs. 2Rs. for publishing the approved manuscript. 2. Direct payment to the publisher upon submission of required documents. 3. Includes cost of printingRs. editorial workRs. and production. 4. Royalty to be paid to the author (minimum 10% on actual sales). 5. ICSSR may purchase additional copies with a 25% discount.
eligibility: 1. Manuscripts must be based on social science research. 2. Doctoral theses must be approved within the last 3 years. 3. The author must have at least one research paper published in a reputed journal. 4. Reports must be from ICSSR/non-ICSSR-funded projects/fellowships or seminar papers of quality.

name: Small Scale Lending Scheme (Microfinance)
brief_description: The scheme "Small Scale Lending Scheme (Microfinance)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide microcredit to the small entrepreneurs of the target group. The scheme provides loans up to 1Rs./- at subsidized interest rates of 5% per annum to eligible beneficiaries. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes among the socially and educationally backward classes and must be aged between 21 to 45 years. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Department of Agriculture and Animal Husbandry (DAAD) Online portal.
benefits: **Loan Amount:** Maximum loan limit of 1Rs./-. **Interest Rate:** Subsidized interest rate of 5% per annum. **Loan Coverage:** 95% of the project cost is covered through a loan. **Beneficiary Contribution:** Only 5% contribution is required from the beneficiary. **Target Group Support:** Specifically designed for small entrepreneurs from the Rabari and Bharwad communities.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes among the socially and educationally backward classes. - The applicant must be aged between 21 to 45 years. - The applicant must have an annual income of less than or equal to 3Rs./-.

name: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 2nd Year to 5th Year Lease Money
brief_description: The Subsidy on 2nd Year to 5th Year Lease Money is a scheme component under the Scheme for the Welfare of Scheduled Caste Families in the Fisheries SectorRs. launched by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their economic status by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas. Under this schemeRs. a subsidy is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries to partially cover the lease amount for Panchayati ponds or watershed areas from the second year to the fifth yearRs. thereby reducing long-term operational costs and facilitating the continuation of pond lease arrangements.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** - 40% of the actual lease amount OR 40Rs./- per hectareRs. whichever is less. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary. **Note:** Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.

name: Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards
brief_description: The scheme "Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to preserveRs. promoteRs. and celebrate the Indian classical music heritage by recognizing and awarding distinguished male artists who have significantly contributed to this field. The award is conferred annually during the Pt. Omkarnath Shastri Sangeet MohotsavRs. where artists are selected by an expert committee based on their lifelong serviceRs. adherence to the guru-shishya traditionRs. and national or international recognition in classical music.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance and Recognition:** Eligible male artists receive a prestigious award that acknowledges their lifelong dedication to Indian classical music.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should be an artist. - The applicant should have significantly contributed to the field of Indian classical music. - The applicant should have rendered at least 40 years of service in classical music at the state or national level. - The applicant should have received formal training under the traditional guru-shishya parampara (teacher-disciple tradition). - The applicant should have worked for the promotionRs. protectionRs. and nurturing of classical music. - The applicant should have received recognized awards at the national or international level. - The applicant should have conducted noteworthy research in the development and conservation of classical music.

name: Girnar Arohan-Avrohan Competition
brief_description: The scheme Girnar Arohan-Avrohan Competition by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage physical enduranceRs. sports participationRs. and cultural spirit among individuals by organizing an annual state-level stair-climbing competition on Mount Girnar. Out of the 9Rs. steps of the mountainRs. the competition mandates male participants to complete 5Rs. steps and female participants to complete 2Rs. steps. Participants who secure positions among the top 10 are rewarded with substantial cash prizesRs. thereby motivating individuals of all backgrounds to embrace physical challenges and celebrate Gujarats heritage.
benefits: - **Cash Prize:** A total of 8Rs./- is distributed among the first 10 winners.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be physically fit and willing to participate in the stair-climbing competition. - The applicant should complete the required number of steps: 5Rs. steps for men and 2Rs. steps for women.

name: International Financial Assistance
brief_description: The scheme "International Financial Assistance" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to encourage and support sportspersons from Gujarat participating in international-level competitions by providing a one-time financial assistance of 75Rs./- to cover costs related to boardingRs. lodgingRs. air travelRs. kitRs. or miscellaneous expenses. This initiative ensures that deserving athletes are not hindered by financial constraints in their pursuit of excellence on global platforms.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 75Rs./- is provided to eligible sportspersons to cover expenses for boardingRs. lodgingRs. travel (including air tickets)Rs. sports kitsRs. and other related miscellaneous expenses.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a sportsperson representing Gujarat in any recognized international-level sports competition. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be male.

name: Individual loaning scheme: Haryana Women Development Corporation
brief_description: The scheme "Individual Loaning Scheme" by the Haryana Women Development CorporationRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to provide financial assistance to women for economically viable projects. Through this schemeRs. subsidies and loans are provided to eligible women for projects costing. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation.
benefits: **1. Financial Assistance:** For economically viable projectsRs. the total cost of which should not exceed 1Rs./-. **2. Subsidy:** - 25% (subject to a maximum of 10Rs./-) for other categories. - 25% (subject to a maximum of 25Rs./-) for Scheduled Caste (SC) Categories. - EarlierRs. the subsidy was only 10% (subject to a maximum of 5Rs./-) for all categories. **3. Beneficiary Share:** 10% of the project cost. **4. Balance Loan Amount:** Provided by commercial/nationalised banks.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be female. 1. The applicant must require a loan for a project not exceeding 1Rs./-. 1. The applicant's annual income must be less than 1Rs./- per annum. 1. The applicant's spouse or parents are not income tax payees. 1. The age of the prospective beneficiary should be between 18 and 60 years at the time of applying for the loan.

name: Subsidized Scheme for Widows: Haryana Women Development Corporation
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidized Scheme for Widows" by the Women & Child Development DepartmentRs. Haryana GovernmentRs. aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana-domiciled widowsRs. divorcedRs. and Legally Separated Women. Through this schemeRs. a subsidy on the total loan is provided. The scheme is covered without collateral security by the bank. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation.
benefits:
1. A 25% flat subsidyRs. subject to a maximum of 50Rs./-Rs. will be provided on the total loan (not as a capital subsidy). 1. The beneficiary's share is 10% of the total loan. 1. The maximum loan limit is 3Rs./-. 1. The scheme will be covered under without collateral security by the bank. 1. The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks. > **Moratorium Period:** The moratorium period will be three months after disbursement of the loan.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Haryana-domiciled widowRs. divorcedRs. or a legally separated Woman. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./- per annum. 1. The age of the prospective beneficiary should be between 18 and 55 years at the time of applying for the loan.

name: Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Imbichi Bawa Housing Renovation Scheme" by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KeralaRs. aims to improve the basic facilities of houses belonging to widowedRs. divorcedRs. or abandoned women from minority religious communities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for house repairs to eligible women belonging to MuslimRs. ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. SikhRs. ParsiRs. and Jain communities. The scheme is implemented by the District Collectorates under the Minority Welfare Department.
benefits: - A non-refundable grant of 50Rs./- is provided for the repair of a house. - This financial assistance is intended for improving basic amenities in houses that lack proper windowsRs. doorsRs. roofingRs. flooringRs. finishingRs. plumbingRs. sanitationRs. or electrification.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to one of the following minority religious communities: MuslimRs. ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. SikhRs. ParsiRs. or Jain. - The applicant must be a widowRs. divorced womanRs. or abandoned woman. - The houseRs. owned by the applicant or her spouseRs. should not exceed 1200 square feet in area. - The applicant must be the sole breadwinner of the family. - The house should lack basic facilities such as proper windowsRs. doorsRs. roofingRs. flooringRs. finishingRs. plumbingRs. sanitationRs. or electrification. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation** _*Preference is given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families._ _*Preference is given to applicants whose children face physical or mental challenges._ _*Preference is given to applicants who have only daughters._ _*Preference is given to applicants who do not have children._

name: Trekking in Coastal Area for Scheduled Caste
brief_description: The scheme "Trekking in Coastal Area for Scheduled Caste" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to offer Scheduled Caste youth a direct introduction to the culture of SagarkanthaRs. increase awareness about coastal industries and marine wealthRs. and motivate them to engage in ocean-related developmental activities.
benefits: - **Cultural and Industrial Exposure:** The program provides 100 Scheduled Caste youth annually with a 10-day trekking tour to explore the culture of SagarkanthaRs. learn about coastal wealthRs. and understand local industries.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. - The applicant should be between 15 and 35 years of age.

name: Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme
brief_description: The Viksit Delhi CM Internship Programme is a scheme of the Delhi Government to engage young interns pursuing graduation/post-graduation from various fields. The programme aims to harness the energy and innovative ideas of the youth pursuing graduation and post-graduation in IndiaRs. which will be implemented in policy and decision-makingRs. to make Delhi a smartRs. cleanRs. caring and prosperous metropolis. The summary of the scheme is as following:- - This internship scheme is for 89 days (3 months approx.) referred to as Term. - The time period of this scheme starts on 30 JunRs. 2025 and ends on 28 SeptemberRs. 2025. - Initially screened candidates are required to bring original certificates and their candidature/selection is subject to verification of certificate. - Reservation for SCRs. STRs. OBCRs. EWS & PHYSICALLY DISABLED applicable as per Delhi and Central Government rules. ***Boot Camp:*** 300 candidates shall be selected through prelim/online screening test. These 300 candidates shall be allowed to attend boot camp wherein 150 candidates shall be shortlisted based on performance in essay writing during boot camp. - Boot camp shall be held on 23rd July 2025. - Candidates screened through online exam mode will be given a topic for essay writing. - 150 interns shall be finalized on the basis of performance in essay writing. - Candidates are required to bring their original documents for verification. **Note:** The venue and timing of boot camp will be announced shortly on the [website](https://viksitdelhiyuva.org/). It is advised to check the website frequently for details.
benefits: 1. Interns will be eligible for 5 days' leave during the entire duration of the internship. 1. Each intern shall be paid an amount of 20Rs./- per monthRs. i.e. 60Rs./- for a complete termRs. subject to attendance. 1. At the end of the internshipRs. interns will submit their report to the HODs of the concerned department. 1. Interns who successfully complete the programme will receive a certificate signed by the concerned Head of the Department/Authorised signatory.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be pursuing a graduation or post-graduation course. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the electoral roll of Delhi or have any residential proof in Delhi. 1. The applicant must have scored 70% or above marks in the Class 12th examination. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on the date of application. **Reservation/Relaxation:** - Reservation for Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. Other Backward Class (OBC)Rs. Economically Weaker Section (EWS)Rs. and Physically Disabled candidates is applicable as per Delhi and Central Government rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Small Biofloc Establishment Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with a component of Small Biofloc Establishment (7 tanks 4mm diameter and 1.5m height) introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. inland fish farming is promoted using advanced technologies such as Biofloc and Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) to maximise fish production in less land and water. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
Small Biofloc Establishment (7 tanks 4mm diameter and 1.5m height): > **Financial Assistance:** - The unit cost is 7Rs./- per unit. - General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. - Women/Scheduled Caste (S.C.) and Scheduled Tribe (S.T.) Categories: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Assistance is paid through 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments. > **Validity:** The benefit for small biofloc establishment can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development
brief_description: The scheme "National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Reinforced Area Development" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote location-specific sustainable agriculture production by encouraging improved agronomic practicesRs. soil health managementRs. better rainwater utilizationRs. judicious use of agrochemicalsRs. crop diversificationRs. and the progressive adoption of integrated farming systems involving cropsRs. livestockRs. and trees.
benefits: - **Financial Help:** Provides financial assistance to eligible farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices. - **Improved Agronomic Practices:** Encourages the implementation of location-specificRs. modernRs. and efficient farming techniques. - **Soil Health Management:** Supports initiatives for maintaining and enhancing soil fertility and health. - **Enhanced Rainwater Use Efficiency:** Promotes techniques and infrastructure for optimal utilization of rainwater in agriculture. - **Judicious Use of Chemicals:** Advocates for reduced and responsible application of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. - **Crop Diversification:** Encourages farmers to cultivate a variety of cropsRs. promoting resilience and better income opportunities. - **Integrated Farming Systems:** Supports the adoption of integrated crop-livestock-tree farming for holistic farm management.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.

name: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
brief_description: The "Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to empower women and urban citizens by offering hands-on training in value additionRs. preservationRs. canningRs. and kitchen-gardening of fruits and vegetablesRs. along with promoting self-sustenance and nutritional well-being. The scheme includes financial support of 500/- per trainee per day- 250/- as a direct stipend and the remaining 250/- towards training materialRs. expert honorariumRs. and other resources.
benefits: - **Stipend:** 500/- per trainee per day sanctioned as training expenditure. Out of thisRs. 250/- is provided as a direct stipend to the traineeRs. and 250/- is utilized for material costRs. training literature kitRs. and honorarium to resource persons. - **Skill Development Training:** Training duration ranges from 2 to 5 days. Modules include fruit and vegetable preservationRs. canningRs. kitchen gardeningRs. and value addition.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be willing to participate in horticulture-related skill development training.

name: Dattopant Thengadi Artisan Interest Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Dattopant Thengadi Artisan Interest Subsidy Scheme" by the Government of GujaratRs. Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. aims to provide financial assistance for machinery or working capital at low interest rates with ease to workmen registered as artisans in urban as well as rural areas of the State. The scheme provides financial assistance up to a maximum credit limit of 1Rs./- for machinery or working capitalRs. or bothRs. for purchasing raw materialsRs. equipmentRs. or tools for business development. It offers a Margin Money Subsidy and an Interest Subsidy at a rate of 7%. The applicant must be registered as an artisan with the Indext-C of the Cottage and Rural Industries Department and possess an Identity card issued by the Development Commissioner Handloom/Handicraft/Indext-C or a Provisional Certificate from the General ManagerRs. District Industries Centre. The scheme is implemented by the District Industries CentreRs. which acts as the nodal agency. Applications for this scheme are accepted through the District Industries CentreRs. and financial assistance is provided through Nationalized BanksRs. Regional Rural BanksRs. Co-operative BanksRs. Public Sector BanksRs. and Private Banks.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance** - A maximum credit limit of 1Rs./- is available for machinery or working capital (raw materials) or both. - Intended Use: This financial assistance is provided to purchase raw materialsRs. equipmentRs. toolsRs. and machinery for the development of existing or new businesses. **Margin Money Subsidy** - 20% of the loan amount for General Category (Male) beneficiaries. - 25% of the loan amount for Reserved Category (Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes)Rs. WomenRs. and blind or handicapped beneficiaries with 40% or more disability. - Disbursement: The subsidy is available after the disbursement of the loan and is credited to the beneficiary's Bank Account. - Validity: The Margin Money Subsidy is available on a maximum loan of up to 1Rs./- during a period of three years. **Interest Subsidy** - An interest subsidy is available at the rate of 7%. - Disbursement: The subsidy is credited to the beneficiary's account on a half-yearly basis. - Conditions for Disbursement: The subsidy is credited after the receipt of the subsidy claim from the bank. Penal interest or other charges must not be included in the claim. - Validity: The subsidy is available for a maximum period of three years.
**Conditions for Continuation:** Further benefit under this scheme can be extended for a maximum of three times with the same conditionsRs. upon the recommendation of the BankRs. to beneficiaries who regularly pay the instalments as fixed by the Bank. **Mode of Disbursement for all Subsidies** - All subsidy disbursements will be made through RTGS/e-Payment only. - Beneficiaries must provide details such as their Account NumberRs. IFSC CodeRs. TAN No.Rs. and Aadhaar Number for this purpose. **Conditions for Availment/Continuation of Loan and Benefits** - The beneficiary is bound to repay the loanRs. along with its interestRs. regularly within a period of a minimum of one year (12 monthly instalments) and a maximum of three years (36 monthly instalments)Rs. as fixed by the Bank. - The artisan must regularly pay the instalments and interest to the bank and must not be a defaulter of the bank. - The loan sanctioned must be used only for the purpose for which it was approved. If used for any other purposeRs. the beneficiary is bound to immediately repay the loanRs. interestRs. and government assistanceRs. and agrees that it can be recovered as land revenue arrears. - The implementing agency will ensure through on-site visits that the machineryRs. equipmentRs. or raw materials are purchased for the intended purpose after the disbursement of the loan.
eligibility: **General Eligibility** - The applicant must be more than 18 years of age. - The applicant must have an Identity card issued by the Development Commissioner Handloom/Handicraft/Indext-C. - The applicant must have skills in Handloom or Handicraft art. - The applicant must be registered as an artisan in urban as well as rural areas of the State with the Indext-C of the Cottage and Rural Industries Department. **Relaxation/Inclusions** - The applicant may be a Physically Handicapped or Blind ArtisanRs. who can also avail the benefits of this scheme. - The applicant may hold a Provisional Certificate as an artisan issued by the General ManagerRs. District Industries CentreRs. if they do not possess an Identity Card from the Development Commissioner.

name: Assistance for Protected Cultivation
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Protected Cultivation by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote modernRs. climate-resilient horticulture practices by providing financial support for protected cultivation infrastructure like mulchingRs. nursery developmentRs. and plug nurseries. The scheme encourages self-employment and sustainable income generation for farmers through the use of polyhousesRs. shed net housesRs. and starter kits to improve crop productivity and resource efficiency.
benefits: > **Plastic Cover (Mulching):** - **General Area:** 32Rs./- per hectare. - **Hilly Area:** 36Rs./- per hectare. - 50% of the expenditure incurredRs. limited to 1 hectare per beneficiary. - **Self-Employment Oriented Horticulture Nursery Development Programme:** - **Nursery Structure:** 3Rs./- per unit - 3Rs./- per unit for 500 sq.m. area - **Starter Kit:** 50Rs./- per unit - Assistance up to 65% of the cost or 2Rs./-Rs. whichever is less. > **Shed Net House & Polyhouse:** - **Coverage:** 500 sq.m to 4Rs. sq.m - Assistance as per square meter cost based on empanelled company prices - Structures supported: CylindricalRs. bambooRs. and wooden. > **Plug Nursery:** - **Public sector:** 30Rs./- per hectare for 1 hectare - **Private sector:** Assistance of 50% or 15Rs./- per hectare (whichever is less) for 1 hectare.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Agricultural Fair/Exhibition/Farmer Camp Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Agricultural Fair/Exhibition/Farmer Camp" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide subsidized agricultural inputs to enhance productivity and livelihood of tribal farmers. Farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas can achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood by using plant protection equipmentRs. tarpaulinsRs. field demonstrationsRs. micronutrientsRs. agriculture fairsRs. water carrying pipelinesRs. castor cake/neem cake/LFOM/green manureRs. pump setsRs. 100% water-soluble fertilizerRs. plant protection pesticidesRs. etc. These tools and practicesRs. when used according to scientific recommendationsRs. can significantly increase crop production andRs. consequentlyRs. improve their livelihood.
benefits:
The assistance is provided with a limit of 1Rs./- can be spent for holding Agricultural Fair/Exhibition at the Taluka level. Farmer Shibir for 100 farmersRs. 15000/- can be spent within the limit.
> **Remarks:** LiteratureRs. teaRs. refreshmentsRs. mealsRs. traveling expensesRs. exhibition stall feeRs. mandapRs. bannerRs. photographsRs. sound systemRs. electricityRs. furniture rentRs. Vs. Can be spent on things.

name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden
brief_description: The scheme component "Replanting of Old Oil Palm Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to enhance oil palm production and lower dependency on imports by supporting farmers in uprooting and replanting old oil palm gardens that have reached the age of 2530 years. name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Pump Set (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Pump set (TASP & OTASP)" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide subsidized agricultural inputs to enhance productivity and livelihood of tribal farmers. Farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas can achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood by using plant protection equipmentRs. tarpaulinsRs. field demonstrationsRs. micronutrientsRs. agriculture fairsRs. water carrying pipelinesRs. castor cake/neem cake/LFOM/green manureRs. pump setsRs. 100% water-soluble fertilizerRs. plant protection pesticidesRs. etc. These tools and practicesRs. when used according to scientific recommendationsRs. can significantly increase crop production andRs. consequentlyRs. improve their livelihood.
benefits:
> **Subsidy on oil engines:** - **3.0 to 3.5 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 8Rs./- (whichever is less).- **5.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 12Rs./- (whichever is less).- **7.5 to 8.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 13Rs./- (whichever is less).- **10.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 13Rs./- (whichever is less). > **Subsidy on electric motors:** - **1.0 to 3.0 H.P.:** 75% of purchase price or 8Rs./- (whichever is less).- **5.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 9Rs./- (whichever is less).- **7.5 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 12Rs./- (whichever is less). > **Subsidy on submersible pump sets:** - **3.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 15Rs./- (whichever is less).- **5.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 22Rs./- (whichever is less).- **7.5 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 27Rs./- (whichever is less).- **10.0 H.Pa.:** 75% of purchase price or 33Rs./- (whichever is less).
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be availed once every 5 years. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35)

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level- Class 11 & 12)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level Classes 11 & 12) is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students entering Classes 11 and 12 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have secured 80% or more marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10 .
benefits: ***Rate of Scholarship:*** - **For Class 11th Students:** 1Rs./- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 12th Students:** 1Rs./- per month for 1 year.
eligibility: 1. The student must have secured at least 80% marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10 while studying in a state government school or a government-aided non-government school (excluding central and residential schools). 1. The student must maintain 75% attendance and 75% marks in Class 11. SC/ST students will be given a 5% relaxation in marks and attendance in the board examination. 1. There is no income criterion for the parent/guardian of the student under this scholarship. 1. The student cannot avail benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes simultaneously

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Power Operated Plant Protection Equipment Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc.Rs. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Power Operated Plant Protection Equipment" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to help farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood. benefits:
1. The assistance provided is 75% of the purchase price of power/machine-driven equipment or 4500/- whichever is less. (Maximum one unit per account is allowed.)
> Remark: As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35) > Frequency: Once in 3 Years.

name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
brief_description: The "RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM" scheme was launched by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB)Rs. Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India. Under this schemeRs. a monthly assistance paid annually is provided to support the orphans education and settlement. The scheme is implemented by the Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat in coordination with Zila Sainik Boards (ZSB) and Rajya Sainik Boards (RSB). > **Scheme Aim:** The aim of this aid gratis is to provide a small measure of relief from total penury to an orphaned child of an ESM.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month disbursed annually to each orphan child. > **NOTE:** Direct credit to the beneficiarys bank account via Electronic Clearing Service (ECS)**.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a legitimate offspring of an Ex-ServicemanRs. with details recorded in the Service Book. 1. The applicant must be a son below 21 years of age or an unmarried daughter. 1. The applicant must have lost both parents (ESM and spouse). 1. The application must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB).

name: Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship
brief_description: The "Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions who secure top ranks in the examination conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand.
benefits: Out of the top 100 students in the qualifying examination conducted by SCERT UttarakhandRs. 50 students from the Garhwal Division and 50 students from the Kumaon Division will receive 1Rs./- per month for a period of 10 months.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to either the Garhwal or Kumaon Division of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an institutional student of Class 8 in any governmentRs. local bodyRs. or government-aided school (excluding central and residential schools) in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have passed the annual Class 7 examination with a minimum of 50% marks (40% for reserved categories). 1. There is no restriction on the annual income of parents or guardians. 1. The scholarship will be awarded for a period of 4 yearsRs. from Class 9 to Class 12.

name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Harvesting Tools
brief_description: The scheme component "Harvesting Tools" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote oil palm cultivation by increasing production in the state and reducing dependency on imported oil palm. The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for purchasing harvesting tools and equipment required for efficient oil palm cultivation.
benefits: - **Cutter:** 2Rs./- per unit.- **Wire Mesh:** 20Rs./- per unit.- **Motorized Chisel:** 15Rs./- per unit.- **Portable Ladder/Polls:** 5Rs./- per unit.- **Chaff Cutter:** 50Rs./- per unit.- **Tractor Trolley:** 2Rs./- per unit.

name: Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Shodh Sammelan
brief_description: The scheme Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Shodh Sammelan is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a platform (Sanskrit Conference) for scholarsRs. professorsRs. lecturersRs. teachersRs. and students engaged in teachingRs. learningRs. and research to present their findings.
benefits: At the Sanskrit Shodh SammelanRs. participants gain knowledge through new research in Sanskrit literatureRs. exchange ideasRs. learn the methodology of writing research papersRs. and receive certificates.
eligibility: 1. AcharyasRs. co-acharyasRs. assistant acharyasRs. lecturersRs. assistant professorsRs. teachersRs. and research scholars from all states of the country who are engaged in studyRs. teachingRs. or research are eligible to participate.

name: Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training
brief_description: The scheme "Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training" was launched by the Directorate of Employment and TrainingRs. Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive residential training to aspiring candidates for recruitment in ArmyRs. Air ForceRs. NavyRs. Paramilitary Forces and Police ForcesRs. addressing the need for specialized coaching and preparation to enhance success rates in defence and police recruitment examinations. The scheme provides exam-oriented residential training programs and coaching facilities specifically designed for defence services examinations and conducts comprehensive preparation sessions covering written examinationsRs. physical fitness trainingRs. personality developmentRs. and interview preparation. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state and must be aspiring for recruitment in ArmyRs. Air ForceRs. NavyRs. Paramilitary Forces or Police Forces with appropriate age and educational qualifications as per the respective service requirements. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Employment and Training under the Labour and Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat and applications for this scheme are accepted through designated employment exchanges and training centers across the state.
benefits:
> **Training and Coaching Support** - **Residential Training:** Comprehensive exam-oriented coaching in residential format.- **Defence Examination Preparation:** Specialized training for ArmyRs. Air ForceRs. Navy recruitment examinations.- **Police Force Training:** Preparation for Police Force recruitment examinations.- **Paramilitary Force Coaching:** Training for Central Armed Police Forces and other paramilitary recruitment.
> **Training Components** - **Written Examination Preparation:** Subject-wise coaching and mock tests.- **Physical Fitness Training:** Physical preparation as per service requirements.- **Personality Development:** Communication skills and confidence building.- **Interview Preparation:** Mock interviews and counseling sessions.
> **Conditions** - Regular attendance in all training sessions and activities. - Compliance with residential training center rules and regulations. - Participation in mock tests and assessment programs. - Maintenance of discipline and conduct as per training center guidelines.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be aspiring for recruitment in ArmyRs. Air ForceRs. NavyRs. Paramilitary Forces or Police Forces. - The applicant must meet the age criteria as prescribed for respective defence and police services. - The applicant must possess minimum educational qualifications as required for the specific service examination they are preparing for. - The applicant must have completed relevant educational requirements as per Central Government norms for defence services. - The applicant must meet basic physical fitness standards for defence and police services. - The applicant must be medically fit as per general health requirements. - The applicant must be willing to undergo rigorous physical training programs. - The applicant must belong to economically weaker sections or demonstrate financial need for training assistance. - The applicant must not be receiving similar training assistance from other government schemes simultaneously.

name: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Refrigerated vehicles"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish healthRs. uplift fishermenRs. and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnesRs. ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
1. The unit cost of a refrigerated vehicle is 25Rs./-. 1. 40% assistance (up to 10Rs./-) is provided for general category beneficiaries. 1. 60% assistance (up to 15Rs./-) is provided for women and SC/ST category beneficiaries.
> **Conditions:** - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India. - The benefit is available once in a lifetime.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** Contribution is shared: 60% by the Government of India and 40% by State Governments. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time assistance. > **Validity:** Once in a lifetime for eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs. SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Trekking Traction Centre Home-stay Grant Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Trekking Traction Centre Home-stay Grant Scheme was launched in 2020 by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provides financial assistance to villagers for constructing or renovating home-stays in traditional hill-style architectureRs. ensuring quality accommodation for tourists.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. villages located within a 2-kilometer radius of the identified tracking traction center are eligible for benefits. For the construction of buildings with toilets along the identified routesRs. a grant of 60Rs./- per room is provided. In cases where building repairs are requiredRs. a grant of 25Rs./- per room is providedRs. for up to a maximum of six rooms.
eligibility: 1. This benefit is applicable only to villages located within a 2-kilometer radius of the trekking traction center identified by the Tourism DepartmentRs. and these villages must be separate from urban areas. 1. There is no obligation to take out a loan. 1. The applicant must be a native of a village in Uttarakhand near the traction center and must resideRs. or intend to resideRs. with their family in the proposed homestay. 1. Guest rooms should be provided for a minimum of one and a maximum of six. 1. The homestay must be registered with the departmentRs. or if newly constructedRs. it must be registered upon completion. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.

name: Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Through Academic Activities" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create interest in Tiatr among students of educational institutions and tiatr lovers in villages and cities. The scheme provides for the creation of awareness about tiatrRs. its songRs. and music through academic activities such as talksRs. symposiaRs. seminarsRs. and workshops. These activitiesRs. which must have at least 20 participantsRs. can be organized by the Tiatr Academy of Goa alone or in collaboration with other institutions or individualsRs. with the Academy covering various expenditures and providing necessary materials. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa on a 'First Come First Serve' basisRs. and applications for this scheme are accepted as per the availability of funds.
benefits:
**Awareness Creation:** Awareness about TiatrRs. its songRs. and music will be created through academic activities such as talksRs. symposiaRs. seminarsRs. and workshops. **Resource Person Honorarium:** Resource persons will be paid an honorariumRs. as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of GoaRs. for every sessionRs. with the amount dependent upon the distance from their residence to the venue. **Expenditure Coverage:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will cover the expenditure incurred on Resource PersonsRs. refreshmentsRs. and food (lunch or dinner) served to participants. AdditionallyRs. any other miscellaneous expenditure made in organizing the activity by an institution or individual by way of collaboration will be taken care of by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Provision of Materials:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide essential materialsRs. including a backdropRs. certificates for the participantsRs. and stationery. **Documentation Coverage:** The Tiatr Academy of Goa will document the SymposiaRs. SeminarRs. or WorkshopRs. and the expenditure incurred on this documentation will be borne by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
> **Conditions** _*Prior approval will be required from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing the resource personsRs. if the activity is organized in collaboration with others._ _*The cost of refreshments or food to be served must be verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalization._ _*The scheme will be implemented strictly on a First Come First Serve basis._ _*Applications will be consideredRs. and benefits disbursed as per the availability of funds._
eligibility: The applicant must be an educational institution or an individual interested in collaborating with the Tiatr Academy of Goa to organize academic activities for promoting Tiatr. The applicant must ensure the number of participants for conducting the SymposiaRs. SeminarRs. or Workshop shall be at least 20. The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing resource personsRs. if the activity is organized by others in collaboration. The applicant must get the cost of refreshments or food to be served verified and approved by the Tiatr Academy of Goa before finalizing them.

name: Employment Linked Skill Training Programme (ELSTP)
brief_description: The Employment Linked Skill Training Programme scheme was launched by the Department of Skill Development and EmploymentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide freeRs. self-employment-oriented training courses to unemployed/school dropouts/other disadvantaged youth of the state. It is a state-sponsored scheme that offers training in fields such as ITRs. healthcareRs. agricultureRs. beauty and wellnessRs. electronicsRs. and more.
benefits: - This training is free of cost and has a duration of 3 to 6 months. - Training offers employment/self-employment-oriented courses in areas such as ITRs. healthRs. agricultureRs. beautyRs. wellnessRs. electronicsRs. and more. - The training provider also strives to facilitate employment opportunities for participants.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an unemployedRs. school dropoutRs. or other underprivileged youth of the state.

name: Life Saving Technique Water Sports Operator
brief_description: The scheme Life Saving Technique Water Sports Operator is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train youth of the state as certified trainers and operators in water life-saving techniques.
benefits: The beneficiary will receive training as a Water Saving Life Trainer.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be able to swim 100 meters within 3 minutes. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy. > The total number of 15 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Mobile Learning Centre (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Mobile Learning Centre scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide education to the children of registered construction workers at construction sites through Mobile Learning Centre busesRs. ensuring their better and brighter future.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. mobile learning schools are operated to provide education to the children of construction workers.
eligibility: Children of workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board are eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme.

name: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks up to a Limit of Rs.5 Lakh for Self-Employment
brief_description: The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks up to a Limit of Rs.5 Lakh for Self-Employment" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to promote self-employment among scheduled tribe (ST) individuals by making business loans affordable. Under this schemeRs. ST beneficiaries availing loans for self-employment are provided a interest subsidy to reduce financial burden and encourage entrepreneurship.
benefits: - 6% interest subsidy on loans taken through banks. - Maximum loan amount eligible: 5Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of tribal areas in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have availed a bank loan for self-employment purposes.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)
brief_description: The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor non-commercial artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatrRs. its song and music through yearly Tiatr Festivals/Competitions organized by Kala Academy and by organizing tiatrs in villagesRs. as well as artistes who have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Konkani Song through All India RadioRs. Doordarshan and other media platforms. The scheme provides lifetime recognition awards consisting of a shawlRs. a mementoRs. a citationRs. and a cash burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of GoaRs. with special consideration given to excellence in actingRs. script writingRs. directingRs. singingRs. lyric writingRs. set designingRs. and innovative contributions to the tiatr stage.
