benefits: - The Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Award (Non-Commercial) consists of a shawlRs. a mementoRs. a citationRs. and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa - Recognition and honor at a special function on 2nd January on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Lucasinho Ribeiro the 'Pioneer of Tiatr' - Lifetime achievement recognition for contribution to tiatr field - Awards are conferred annually with not more than 5 artistes receiving the award each year. - Awards are presented at a special function on 2nd January.
eligibility: - The applicant should be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant should have at least 10 years contribution in the field of tiatr. - The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actorRs. script writerRs. directorRs. singerRs. lyricistRs. set designerRs. or other relevant role. - The applicant should have performed in at least 10 tiatrs if working as actor/singer/stage manager/lights provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music. - The applicant should have written/directed at least 10 tiatrs if working as a writer/director. ***Relaxation*** The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** *The selected artistes will have to be compulsorily present in person to receive the award. *Tiatr Academy of Goa will confer Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards only once in a lifetime be it in Tiatr (Commercial/Non-Commercial) or Khell or Khell-Tiatr or Konkani Cinema.

name: Kala Utsav Pratiyogita - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Kala Utsav Pratiyogita scheme is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote and encourage artistic talent among school students of Classes 9 to 12. In 2023-24Rs. the state-level competition was organized by the Haridwar district. Effective cooperation and coordination were ensured in organizing this competition from the district level to the state level.
benefits: A total of 20 studentsRs. who secured first place in 10 categories across boys and girls groupsRs. participated in the National Level Kala Utsav Pratiyogita held at Bal BhavanRs. New DelhiRs. representing the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of Classes 9 to 12. 1. The applicant must be studying in a school in Uttarakhand.

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
brief_description: The scheme "Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights ActRs. 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) ActRs. 1989" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)Rs. Government of India. The scheme aims to ensure effective implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights ActRs. 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) ActRs. 1989Rs. addressing the constitutional mandate to abolish untouchability and prevent atrocities against Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes members. The scheme provides central assistance for relief and rehabilitation of atrocity victims and incentives for inter-caste marriages. It facilitates functioning and strengthening of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Protection CellsRs. Special Police StationsRs. exclusive Special CourtsRs. awareness generation programsRs. and comprehensive support systems for affected communities.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Relief and rehabilitation support for atrocity victims (specific amounts vary by state implementation). - Incentive amounts for inter-caste marriages ranging from 10Rs./- to 5Rs./- depending on the state. - Central assistance provided to states on 50:50 basis and 100% assistance to Union Territories. ##### ***Institutional Support*** - Functioning and strengthening of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Protection Cells. - Special Police Stations establishment and operation. - Setting up and functioning of exclusive Special Courts for speedy trial. - 192 Exclusive Special Courts established across 13 states for faster case resolution. ##### ***Other Benefits*** - Awareness generation programs. - Legal support through specialized court system. - Administrative support through dedicated protection cells.
eligibility: ##### ***For Atrocity Relief*** - The applicant must be a from a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be a victim of atrocities as defined under the Protection of Civil Rights ActRs. 1955 or the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) ActRs. 1989. ##### ***For Inter-Caste Marriage Incentives*** - The applicant must be part of an inter-caste marriage where one partner belongs to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes.

name: Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land
brief_description: The scheme Investment Grant for Farmers with More than 2 Hectares of Agricultural Land is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers owning more than 2 hectares of agricultural land who suffer crop losses due to natural disasters.
benefits: Under this scheme: 1. 8Rs./- per hectare for unirrigated areas. 1. 17Rs./- per hectare for areas with assured irrigation. 1. 22Rs./- per hectare for all types of evergreen crops. In cases where crop damage exceeds 33%Rs. assistance will be provided only up to a maximum limit of 2 hectares per farmer.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.

name: Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations
brief_description: The "Scheme of Assistance to State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)Rs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide economic development assistance to Scheduled Castes living below the poverty line through State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations functioning in 23 States and 4 Union TerritoriesRs. addressing the financial mobilization challenges faced by this community. The scheme provides share capital contribution in the ratio of 49:51 between Central Government and State GovernmentsRs. along with financial assistance in the form of margin money loans at low interest rates and subsidies to reduce repayment liability. The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes and must be living below the poverty line. The scheme is implemented by State Scheduled Castes Development Corporations. The applications for this scheme are accepted through State Channelizing Agencies.
benefits: - Financial assistance in the form of margin money loans at low rate of interest. - Subsidy provision to reduce repayment liability of beneficiaries. - The quantum and ceiling of subsidy is the same as for schemes under Integrated Rural Development Programme. - Credit support facilitation through tie-ups with financial institutionsRs. banksRs. National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development CorporationRs. and National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Castes. - The applicant must be living below the poverty line.

name: Maths Wizard & Spelling Genius - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Maths Wizard & Spelling Genius is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and English by organizing competitions at the schoolRs. blockRs. districtRs. and state levelsRs. and by encouraging students through rewards.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. to enhance the interest of Class 5 students in Mathematics and EnglishRs. the Government of India organized the Maths Wizard and Spelling Genius competitions at the schoolRs. blockRs. districtRs. and state levels under AWP-B for the year 2023-24Rs. wherein participating students were encouraged through rewards.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Class 5 student of a government school in Uttarakhand.

name: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension (Police Line Yojana) for the democracy fighters of the state imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
brief_description: The scheme "Loktantra Senani Samman Pension (Police Line Yojana)" is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period (25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977).
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 20Rs./- per month
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must have been imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the emergency period (25 June 1975 to 21 March 1977).

name: Competition of Zomnivoilo Khell
brief_description: The scheme "Competition of Zomnivoilo Khell" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to preserve and promote the traditional folk theatre of Goa called 'The Khell'Rs. also known as 'Fell' or 'Zomnivoilo Khell'Rs. by organizing annual competitions in different parts of Goa to maintain this cultural heritage for future generations. The scheme provides financial assistance towards production costs for participating troupes and creates a platform for showcasing traditional Khell performances through structured competition format. The applicant must be an institution or individual with a Khell that has been staged during the current carnival season and must comply with the traditional format requirements including 8 to 10 cantos with specific duration limits. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms.
benefits: - Financial assistance towards production costs as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa from time to time. - Mementos awarded to first three winning positions (no cash prizes). - Video recording of all performances for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa library. - Complimentary Digital Versatile Disc copy of the performance provided to the director. - Platform for showcasing traditional Khell performances to wider audiences.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an institution or individual organizing a Khell performance. - The applicant must have staged the Khell during the current carnival season. - The applicant must comply with the exact format of Zomnivoilo Khell comprising 8 to 10 songs called Cantos. - The applicant must ensure each canto consists of 2 verses and one chorus with limited dialogues. - The applicant must maintain the duration of each Khell between 40 to 60 minutes. - The applicant must ensure comedy in the Khell is related to the story. - The applicant must use traditional musical instruments including drums and two blowing instruments. - The applicant must ensure no adverse remarks are made against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creedRs. and religion. - Artists can participate in only one group and one Khell (except musicians who can participate in multiple Khells). - Mandatory attendance at discussion session on positive and negative aspects of performances. - No adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creedRs. and religion. - The three Khell troupes which won 1stRs. 2ndRs. and 3rd places in the previous competition receive direct entry provided they apply within stipulated time.

name: All Goa One-Act Play Competition in Konkani
brief_description: The scheme "All Goa One-Act Play Competition in Konkani" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to attract youth towards dramatic activities and provide ample opportunities to showcase their talents in dramatics while promoting Goan culture through Konkani theatre. The scheme provides cash awards for the top 3 performances along with mementos and certificatesRs. individual awards for various categories like directionRs. actingRs. musicRs. and stage settingRs. and reimbursement of transport costs as per Regional Transport Office norms. The applicant must be an individualRs. clubRs. or association capable of presenting a One-Act Play in Konkani with duration between 35 to 45 minutesRs. and must submit a typed copy of the play in Roman script along with written permission from the playwright. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: - Cash awards for 1stRs. 2ndRs. and 3rd best performances (amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa). - Mementos and certificates for top 3 performances. - Individual awards with mementos (no cash) for DirectionRs. Male ActorRs. Female ActorRs. Background MusicRs. Stage SettingRs. Light EffectsRs. Make-upRs. and Script. - Reimbursement of transport expenses as per Regional Transport Office norms. - Video recording of all plays for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa Library. _*Performance must not contain adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creedRs. and religion._ _*Participants must abide by all competition rules and regulations._ _*Any violation may result in disqualification and forfeiture of benefits._
eligibility: - The applicant must be an individualRs. clubRs. or association. - The applicant must present a One-Act Play in Konkani language. - The applicant must ensure the play duration is not less than 35 minutes and not more than 45 minutes. - The applicant must ensure participation only when at least 5 groups are participating in the competition.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards
brief_description: The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the immense contribution of Khell and Khell-Tiatr artistes who have significantly contributed to the development of this traditional art formRs. addressing the need to honor veteran performers who have dedicated their lives to preserving and promoting this cultural heritage. The scheme provides a prestigious lifetime achievement award consisting of a shawlRs. mementoRs. citationRs. and cash burse of 50Rs./- to deserving artistesRs. with a comprehensive selection process that evaluates excellence in actingRs. script writingRs. directingRs. singingRs. lyrics writingRs. set designingRs. and other theatrical contributions. The applications are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers.
benefits: - Cash burse of 50Rs./- awarded to selected artistes. - Prestigious recognition through shawlRs. mementoRs. and citation. - Special honor ceremony held annually on 24th October on the Birth Anniversary of Rosario RodriguesRs. 'Promoter of Khell-Tiatr'. - Maximum 3 artistes are honored each year. _*The selected artistes must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award._
eligibility: - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have at least 10 years of contribution in the field of Khell-Tiatr. - The applicant must demonstrate excellence as an actorRs. script writerRs. directorRs. singerRs. lyricistRs. set designerRs. or other theatrical role in Khell/Khell-Tiatr. - The applicant who is an actor/singer/stage manager/lights effects provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music provider must have performed in at least 10 khell-tiatrs. - The applicant who is a writer/director must have written/directed at least 10 khell-tiatrs. _*Award can only be received once in a lifetime across all related categories._ ##### ***Evaluation Considerations*** - The applicant's innovative contributions to the presentation of Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be evaluated. - The applicant's work in other languages or films beyond Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be considered. - The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be taken into account. - The applicant's previous awards in the field will be considered. ##### ***Relaxation*** Age limit may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.

name: Tiatr Script Writing Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Tiatr Script Writing Competition" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to encourage new generation of Tiatr playwrights to script better quality of Tiatrs and enrich the Konkani language through annual script writing competitions. The scheme provides cash prizes up to 15Rs./- for winning scripts and opportunities for publication with honorarium paymentsRs. along with certificates for recognition of literary excellence in traditional Konkani theatre. The applicant must write original scripts in traditional tiatr format with minimum 6-7 podd'de and at least 4 CantosRs. and must submit scripts that have not been published or performed earlier. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications are accepted through offline submission of typed copies with duly filled application forms.
benefits: ##### ***Cash Prizes*** - 1st Prize: 15Rs./- - 2nd Prize: 10Rs./- - 3rd Prize: 5Rs./- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - **Certificates:** Provided to first three prize winners.- **Publication Opportunity:** Prize winning scripts can be printed in book form at Tiatr Academy of Goa's cost (subject to No Objection Certificate from script writer).- **Honorarium:** 5Rs./- one-time payment for published scripts (in addition to prize money).- **Complimentary Copies:** 100 copies of the published book provided to script writer. ##### ***Conditions*** - Scripts must comply with content guidelines - no adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against casteRs. creed and religion - For publication benefitsRs. script writers must provide No Objection Certificate to Tiatr Academy of Goa.
eligibility: ##### ***Basic Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts on themes as specified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the script has not been published or performed earlier. - The applicant must write original scripts only. ##### ***Script Format Requirements*** - The applicant must write scripts in traditional tiatr format. - The applicant must include minimum 6 to 7 podd'de in the script. - The applicant must include at least 4 Cantos in the script. - The applicant must write scripts in Konkani language using Roman script. - The applicant must ensure comedy is inter-related to the main plot (howeverRs. comedy may be absent in religious tiatr). ##### ***Content Guidelines*** - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions. - The applicant must ensure scripts do not contain content against casteRs. creed and religion that may hurt sentiments.

name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
brief_description: The scheme PM- Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN) was launched by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to improve the socio-economic status of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) by bridging gaps in healthRs. educationRs. and livelihoodsRs. and by saturating PVTG communities and families with basic facilities and services. The scheme provides 11 critical interventions through nine line Ministries/DepartmentsRs. focusing on ensuring access to pucca housesRs. safe drinking waterRs. road and mobile connectivityRs. electricityRs. and vocational education for individual households and habitations. A unique aspect is the inter-ministerial convergenceRs. with the Ministry of Tribal Affairs serving as the nodal ministry while each participating ministry implements its respective Central Sector and Centrally Sponsored schemes.
benefits: ##### ***Housing*** - Provision of pucca houses to all eligible Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households having kaccha houses (Target: 4Rs. households). - The basic unit cost of the house is enhanced to 2Rs./-Rs. with additional facilities raising it to 2Rs./-. ##### ***Road Connectivity*** - Construction of connecting roads (Target: 8Rs. KM) linking approximately 6Rs. Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group villages. - The construction cost per Kilometer would be 1Rs./-. ##### ***Drinking Water*** - Provision of piped water supply/Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) to all Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households. - Community water supply will be provided to villages/habitations with a population of less than 20 households. ##### ***Health*** - Deployment of Mobile Medical Units (MMUs) (Target: 1Rs. MMUs) in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group habitations/villages. - The cost is 33Rs./- per MMU per annumRs. with Operational Expenditure (Op Ex) as per norms. ##### ***Education Hostels*** - Construction of residential hostels (Target: 500 hostels) in existing schools in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group areas. - The cost is 2Rs./- per hostel constructionRs. subject to the actual estimate as per existing cost sharing ratio. ##### ***Anganwadi Centers (AWCs)*** - Construction of Anganwadi Centers (Target: 2Rs. AWCs) in Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group habitations/villages. - The unit cost is 12Rs./- per Anganwadi Center. ##### ***Livelihood (VDVKs)*** - Setting up of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) (Target: 500 VDVKs). - An amount of 15Rs./- meant for 300 members will be released on a pro rata basis. ##### ***Multipurpose Centers (MPCs)*** - Construction of Multipurpose Centers (Target: 1Rs. MPCs). - The unit cost is 60Rs./- per unit. ##### ***Solar Power/Electricity*** - Provision of solar power solutions to 1Rs. Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households. - Funding is 50Rs./- per household or actual cost for 300 Watt supply. ##### ***Telecom Connectivity*** Installation of mobile towers (Target: 3Rs. mobile towers) in all uncovered villages/habitations.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) community. - The applicant must reside in one of the 18 States and Union Territories having a notified Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group population. - The applicant household must be identified as eligible through the physical survey conducted by state governments using the mobile application on the PM Gati-shakti Portal. ***Eligibility Specific to Interventions*** - The applicant household seeking a pucca house must currently reside in a kaccha house. - The applicant household seeking solar power solutions must be an unelectrified household not covered under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS). - The applicant household seeking an on-grid electricity connection shall be an identified beneficiary household under PM-JANMANRs. irrespective of standard eligibility criteria under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) for the State and Electricity distribution company (DISCOM).

name: Prime Ministers Rural Development Fellows Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Prime Ministers Rural Development Fellows Scheme" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Ministry of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide a short-term work opportunity for young women and men who possess academic or professional expertise that will serve the district administration in improving programme delivery and interface with the marginalized section of the populationRs. thereby aiming to reduce developmental and governance deficits. The scheme provides structured learning and hands-on professional experience in rural development and poverty reductionRs. offering Fellows opportunities to act as Development Facilitators and assist District AdministrationRs. particularly in backward districtsRs. while participating in a post-graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessionsRs. leading to a post-graduate degree in Development Practice.
benefits: ##### ***Stipend Package*** - The Fellow shall be entitled to a consolidated stipend package of 50Rs./- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) per month during the orientation period. - The Fellow shall be entitled to 75Rs./- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) per month during the first year of the Fellowship (post-orientation). - The Fellow shall receive a 10% increment during the second yearRs. subject to satisfactory performance. - This package is deemed to cover the Fellows honorariumRs. boarding and lodging expenses during orientationRs. accommodation/house rent during the rest of the Fellowship periodRs. health insuranceRs. life and disability insurance coverRs. and any other contingency expenses. - Travel reimbursement will be based on actual costs and restricted to AC-II tier train fare by the shortest route or equivalentRs. plus local transport cost. Women Fellows with children below five years are allowed the travel cost of a care-giver if the care-giver accompanies the Fellow with her child. ##### ***Other Benefits*** - Participation in a post graduate degree programme through distance learning and contact sessions leading to a post graduate degree in Development Practice. - Award of a Fellowship Certificate and an appropriate post graduate degree in Development Practice upon satisfactory completion of engagement and course requirements. - Office facilities made available by the District CollectorRs. including suitable spaceRs. a computer/laptopRs. and internet connectivity free of charge. - Provision of suitable modes of transport by District administration while travelling within the district for regular work. ##### ***Disbursement of Stipend*** - During the orientation programmeRs. the stipend shall be paid by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society through the Programme Mentor. - Post-placementRs. the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society shall pay the monthly stipend to the Fellows by providing budgetary support to the State Rural Livelihood Mission society. - The State Rural Livelihood Mission society shall make direct deposits into the bank account of each Fellow immediately upon confirming the attendance of the Fellow from the District Collector at the end of the month. - The second-year increment is subject to the Fellows satisfactory performance as determined by the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society in consultation with the Programme Mentor. > ***Conditions*** _*It is mandatory for the Fellows to purchase suitable health insurance and life and disability insurance coverage for the entire duration of the FellowshipRs. including the orientation period._ _*The Fellow shall not take up any type of employment with any other personRs. firmRs. or agency during the tenure of the Fellowship._ _*On successful completion of FellowshipRs. the Fellow is required to spend at least one year in public service as a paid full-time employee of the State Rural Livelihood Mission in the State she/he is assigned to._ _*Failure to join or complete the required one year of public service mandates the Fellow to return to the National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society the entire amount spent on academic programmes during the Fellowship (including orientation)Rs. plus an amount equivalent to the stipend of the last three months of the Fellowship period as compensation._
eligibility: - The applicant should be a citizen of India. - The applicant's age must be between 22 years and 27 years at the time of application. - The applicant must hold at least a graduate degree from a recognized University with a four-year degree course. - The applicant must hold a post-graduate degree from a recognized University in case the graduate degree course duration was less than four years. - The applicant's one-year post graduate course will also be considered valid for eligibility if it is regularRs. full timeRs. and if the degree/equivalent diploma is recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education/Medical Council of India/University Grants Commission. - The applicant must have achieved at least 50% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade at the graduate or Post-graduate levelRs. whichever is qualifying. - The applicant must possess physical fitnessRs. certified by Government Medical HospitalRs. for the arduous nature of the work. - The maximum age limit will be 32 years for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe category. > ***Other Conditions*** _*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes._ _*Fifteen percent (15%) of seats are reserved for Scheduled Tribes._

name: Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award
brief_description: The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor artistes including tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of Konkani Cinema in the pastRs. addressing the need to acknowledge their significant contributions to this cultural art form. The scheme provides a prestigious annual award consisting of a shawlRs. mementoRs. citationRs. and cash purse of 50Rs./-Rs. with recognition given at a special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the release of the first Konkani film 'Mogacho Anvddo' by late Al-Jerry BraganzaRs. 'The Father of Konkani Cinema'.
benefits: **Cash Award:** 50Rs./- as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. **Honorary Items:** ShawlRs. mementoRs. and citation presented to the awardee. **Recognition Ceremony:** Special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the first Konkani film. _*The awardee must be present in person to receive the award at the ceremony._ _*The award ceremony attendance is mandatory - no proxy or representative acceptance is allowed._ _*Once receivedRs. the award cannot be conferred again in the recipient's lifetime across any category._
eligibility: - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have contributed to Konkani Cinema development. **Relaxation** - The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well. **Selection Considerations** - The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actorRs. script writerRs. directorRs. playback singerRs. lyricistRs. producerRs. or composer. - The applicant may have received awards in their respective field. - The applicant should have done innovation on the Konkani Cinema front. - The applicantRs. if a singer/musicianRs. should have songs recorded on vinyl recordsRs. Compact DiscsRs. Digital Versatile DiscsRs. online platformsRs. or brought out in video format. - The applicant may have worked in films of other languages in various capacities including actingRs. directingRs. singingRs. composing musicRs. composing lyricsRs. designing setsRs. providing background musicRs. or designing light effects. - The applicantRs. if a script writer or lyricistRs. may have published books of their scripts or lyrics.

name: Tiatr Competition for Educational Institutions at Higher Secondary/College/University Level
brief_description: The scheme "Tiatr Competition for Educational Institutions at Higher Secondary/College/University Level" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and develop Tiatr activities among students of educational institutions at higher secondaryRs. collegeRs. and university levelsRs. recognizing the enthusiasm shown by students in involving themselves in traditional Tiatr performances. The scheme provides financial support for production expenses and awards mementos and certificates to winners in various categories including best performanceRs. individual artistesRs. directionRs. and technical aspects.
benefits:
***Financial Support:*** Educational institutions receive financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa to meet expenses for music (live band with at least two blowing instruments)Rs. light effectsRs. stage settingRs. background musicRs. makeupRs. costumesRs. refreshments for rehearsalsRs. and transport ***Performance Platform:*** 15 educational institutions get opportunity to participate in production and staging of Tiatr ***Awards and Recognition:*** Mementos and certificates (no cash prizes) awarded in multiple categories including: - Best Performance (1stRs. 2ndRs. 3rd prizes) - Individual Artistes Acting (1st and 2nd prizes for male and female) - Best Comedian (male and female) - Best Direction (1stRs. 2ndRs. 3rd prizes) - Technical categories: Best SettingRs. Light EffectsRs. MusicRs. Background MusicRs. MakeupRs. Costumes - Best Singer Solo (1st and 2nd prizes for male and female) - Best songs categories: DuetRs. DuoRs. TrioRs. Quartet/QuintetRs. Choral Song - Best Lyrics (1st and 2nd prizes) - Best Script (1st and 2nd prizes) ***Video Documentation:*** One copy of Digital Versatile Disc provided free of cost to participating institutions ***Direct Entry Privilege:*** First three award winners of previous year's competition get direct entry provided their entries are received before due date _*All payments made by cheques in the name of educational institutions._ _*Awards distributed at special function announced by Tiatr Academy of Goa._
> ***Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain adherence to traditional Tiatr format as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr duration between 2 to 3 hours including interval of minimum 10 minutes and maximum 15 minutes. - The applicant must ensure no adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creedRs. and religion in scriptsRs. lyricsRs. performancesRs. or speeches. - The applicant must submit final typed copy of script and songs 3 days before competition commencement. - The applicant must limit prior performances of the script to maximum 2 shows before competition.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an educational institution at higher secondaryRs. collegeRs. or university level. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr script is either new or from any script published by reputed Tiatr writers. - The applicant must ensure Tiatr follows traditional format with 6 to 7 acts with at least 4 cantos. - The applicant must include comedy linked to the story of the play. - The applicant must include at least 8 kantaram including 1 duet (interactive)Rs. 1 duo (interactive)Rs. 1 trio (interactive)Rs. 1 quartet/quintet (interactive)Rs. 1 choral songRs. and solos. - The applicant must ensure not more than 2 shows of the given script have been performed prior to competition.

name: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Loss of Cattle Due to Wild Animal Attacks is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest AreasRs. which is implemented by the Department of ForestRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to owners of domestic animals who suffer losses due to attacks by wild animals in forest areas and their surroundings.
benefits: **At presentRs. the following compensation amounts are provided in case of animal loss due to attacks by wild animals:** **Type of Animal Loss****Total Payable Amount****Share of State Disaster Response Fund****Share of Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund**Milch Animals- Buffalo / Cow / Camel / Yak / Mithun etc. (Per Animal)30Rs./-30Rs./----Agricultural and Transport Animals CamelRs. Horse (per Animal)40Rs./-25Rs./-15Rs./-Mule (per Animal)40Rs./-16Rs./-24Rs./-Bull (per Animal)25Rs./-25Rs./----Heifer/Donkey/Pony (per Animal)16Rs./-16Rs./----Sheep/Goat/Pig (per Animal)3Rs./-3Rs./----
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The compensation is applicable only for the loss of domestic animals caused by any of the following wild animals: - Tiger - Leopard - Snow Leopard - All three species of Bear - Hyena - Wild Boar - Crocodile/Gharial - Snake

name: Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School ChhingchhipRs. Mizoram" was launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram. The scheme aims to award scholarships to all eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who qualify and are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip. The objective of establishing the school is to facilitate the all-round development of a childs personality and remove regional imbalance in entry into the officers cadre of the Armed Forces via the National Defence Academy. The scheme provides financial assistance covering School FeeRs. Dietary ChargeRs. and Clothing MoneyRs. with the quantum of benefits depending entirely upon the income level of the parent or guardian.
benefits:
***Benefit Component:*** School FeeRs. Dietary ChargeRs. Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) ***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Up to 50Rs./- OR General Category: Up to 25Rs./- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate I (Full) ***State Government's Share:*** 100% of Fee/Charge + 2Rs./- (For Fee only) ***Central Share:*** NIL
***Benefit Component:*** School FeeRs. Dietary ChargeRs. Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) ***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: 50Rs./- to 1Rs./- OR General Category: 25Rs./- to 50Rs./- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate II (50%) ***State Government's Share:*** 50% of Fee/Charge + 1Rs./- (For Fee only) ***Central Share:*** 50%
***Benefit Component:*** School FeeRs. Dietary ChargeRs. Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) Parent Income Category (per month): Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Above 1Rs./- OR ***General Category:*** Above 50Rs./- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate III (None) ***State Government's Share:*** NIL ***Central Share:*** 100%
- The scholarships cover approved compulsory fees payable to the InstitutionRs. with the States share disbursed to the Institution by the awarding authorityRs. the Mizoram Scholarship Board. - The States share of the scholarship is disbursed to the Institution (Sainik School Chhingchhip). - The scholarship is available for only one year for studying in any class but is renewable as per Rules/Condition. For renewalRs. the scholarship is paid following the month up to which the same was paid in the previous year. - Cadets are expected to use the sanctioned scholarship amounts to purchase necessary textbooksRs. stationeryRs. and related items.
***Conditions*** - The award is tenable from the stage it is given until the completion of the course. - Continuation is subject to the student demonstrating satisfactory progressRs. maintaining good conductRs. and ensuring regularity in attendance. - The award will be discontinued if the student fails to secure annual promotionRs. unless unavoidable reasons are certified by the competent authority of the scheme. - If a student repeats a classRs. they will not receive a scholarship for that specific class for the second or subsequent year. - If a cadet is declared medically unfit by the appropriate medical authority for entry into the National Defence AcademyRs. the scholarship awarded shall be discontinued from the date the cadet is declared unfit. - The value of the scholarship may be reduced at the sanctioning authority's discretion if the Principal reports that any scholar is without textbooks or stationery. - The scholarship may be cancelledRs. stoppedRs. or further payments withheld if the student makes unsatisfactory progress or is guilty of misconductRs. such as resorting to or participating in strikes or irregular attendance.
eligibility: - The applicant should belong to Mizoram State only. - The applicant must qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society. - The applicant must be admitted to Sainik School ChhingchhipRs. Mizoram. - The applicant must not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must submit Income certificates/salary certificates at the time of admission for the grant of scholarship. - For Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST): The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed 1Rs./- (One lakh) per month. - For General Category: The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed 50Rs./- (Fifty Thousand) per month. - The applicant must not be more than one child of the same parents/guardians eligible for the said scheme. _*The scholarship will be discontinued if the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the National Defence Academy._ _*The scholarship will be cancelled and the amount recovered if the student is found to have obtained the scholarship by false statementsRs. and the student will be blacklisted forever._ _*The student is liable to refund the scholarship amount if they discontinue the studies for which the scholarship was awarded during the course of the year._

name: Financial Assistance to Commercial Tiatr Troupes/Directors/Producers for Stage Setting
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Commercial Tiatr Troupes/Directors/Producers for Stage Setting" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage all round development of the Tiatr in all aspects by providing encouragement to commercial tiatr directors and producers to bring in development in stage settingRs. addressing the need for improved theatrical infrastructure and production quality. The scheme provides financial assistance to six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers annually for stage setting developmentRs. with specific conditions including mandatory completion of fifteen performances and display of Tiatr Academy logo on stage sets.
benefits: - Financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers annually for stage setting development. - Disbursal is made only upon completion of fifteen performances of the tiatr mentioned in the application. - Payment is processed as a one-time benefit per beneficiary. _*Tiatr Academy of Goa logo must be displayed on the front visible frames of the stage set._ _*The stage set designed under this scheme cannot be given on hire to others._ _*No adverse remarks against any individualRs. governmentRs. or political parties are permitted during the use of the set._ _*Work on the stage set must commence only after receiving written approval from Tiatr Academy of Goa._
eligibility: - The applicant must have been on the commercial tiatr stage for at least five years. - The applicant must have five years experience on the commercial tiatr stage along with the application. - The applicant must be a commercial tiatr troupeRs. directorRs. or producer. ***Selection Process*** - A maximum of six commercial tiatr troupes/directors/producers will be selected annually. - If more than six applicants applyRs. selection will be decided by way of lots. - Remaining applicants will be wait listed and provided with financial assistance in the following financial year. - In case of withdrawal by any selected applicantRs. the next applicant on the waiting list will be given preference for allotment.

name: Freeship Less than 1,00,000/- (UG Students Only)
brief_description: The "Freeship Less than 1Rs./- (UG Students Only)" scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide tuition fee concessions to students enrolled in 3-year undergraduate programs and 4-year veterinary programs.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. tuition fee concessions (Freeship Tuition Fees) are provided to eligible students.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a 3-year undergraduate program or a 4-year veterinary program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar.

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Aarogya Yojana
brief_description: Rajasthans Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (launched 1 May 2021) provides cashless health insurance to reduce out-of-pocket expenses and ensure quality treatment through government and empanelled private hospitals. Eligible families include NFSARs. SECC 2011Rs. contract workersRs. small/marginal farmersRs. and COVID-19 relief beneficiariesRs. while others may join by paying a premium.
benefits:
Under the Chief Minister Ayushman Arogya YojanaRs. along with the eligible families of NFSA and SECC currently benefiting from itRs. contractual workersRs. small and marginal farmer families and destitute and helpless families who received Covid-19 ex-gratia amount last year will get free insurance cover and apart from these categoriesRs. other remaining families of the state can join the scheme on payment of premium amount of Rs 850/- and the remaining 50 percent premium amount will be borne by the state government.
Free range family: - Farmers (Small and Marginal) of the StateRs. eligible beneficiary families under the State Food Security Act (NFSA)Rs. eligible families as per Socio Economic Census (SECC) 2011 - Contract workers - Contract workers working in all departments/boards/corporations/government companies of the state. - Destitute and helpless families receiving COVID-19 ex-gratia payment from the state government - Fee: Nil.
Fixed premium family - Those other families of the state who are not government employees/pensionersRs. i.e. are not taking benefits under the Medical Attendance RulesRs. can join the scheme by paying the prescribed premium. - Fee: 850/-
eligibility: 1. Free Category : - Families eligible under the National Food Security Act (NFSA). - Families identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011. - Contractual employees working in state departmentsRs. boardsRs. corporationsRs. and government companies. - Small and marginal farmers. - Destitute and helpless families who received COVID-19 ex-gratia relief in the previous year. 1. Premium Category : - Families not included in the free category. - Families who are not government employees or pensioners. - Families who are not availing benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules. - These families can enroll by paying 850 per year per family (50% of the premium)Rs. while the remaining 50% is borne by the State Government.

name: Doodh Sanjeevani Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Doodh Sanjeevani Yojana" was launched by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide fortifiedRs. flavoredRs. double toned pasteurized milk to studentsRs. pregnant women and lactating women. The scheme is implemented by the Anganwadi Centers and also by the Child Development Project Officers.
benefits: > ***For the Students (Education Department)*** The scheme aims to provide nutritious food to the students. The students get 200 milliliters of flavoured milk per day. The milk provided is fortified with added 3% fatRs. 24 grams carbohydrateRs. 7 grams proteinRs. Vitamin A 500 International UnitsRs. and Vitamin D 40 International Units. This provision is served five days in a week. > ***For Women & their Child (Women & Child Development Department)*** Children in the age group of 6 months to 6 years registered at Anganwadi centers receive 100 milliliters of fortifiedRs. flavoredRs. double toned pasteurized milkRs. five days a week. Pregnant and lactating mothers registered at Anganwadi centers receive 200 milliliters of fortifiedRs. flavoredRs. double toned pasteurized milkRs. twice in a week.
eligibility:
For the Students The student must be studying in an elementary school. The student must be studying in a Balvatika or in Standard 1st to 8th. The student must be a studying in a GovernmentRs. Grant-in-AidRs. or Primary School located in one of the 28 talukas of the developing tribal areas of Gujarat.
For Women & their Child The applicant must be a child registered at an Anganwadi center between 6 months and 6 years of age. The applicant must be a pregnant mother/lactating mother registered at an Anganwadi center.

name: Award of Merit Scholarship for Agricultural Engineering Students (B.Tech 3rd/4th Year)
brief_description: The Award of Merit Scholarship for Agricultural Engineering Students (B.Tech 3rd/4th Year) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support meritorious students pursuing B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering in their 3rd and 4th years by providing a one-year scholarship.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** 2Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 3rd or 4th year of the B.Tech (Agricultural Engineering) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)
brief_description: The "Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan)" scheme is launched by the Animal Husbandry and Dairy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The schheme provides short-term working capital loans to livestock farmers at subsidized interest rates. Eligible livestock farmersRs. dairy producersRs. and members of primary agricultural credit cooperative societies can avail financial support for operational purposes through banks.
benefits: - Short-term working capital loan for livestock activities through the Kisan Credit Card system. - Interest subsidy is provided on loans sanctioned under the scheme. - Expected Time of Disbursement: Typically within 15 days of application approval.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a member of a primary agricultural credit cooperative society. 1. The applicant should require short-term working capital for livestock activitiesRs. including dairy production.

name: Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals
brief_description: The Compensation for Human Death or Injury Caused by Wild Animals scheme is launched by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased persons or individuals injured due to attacks by wild animals. The scheme covers both urban and rural areas and ensures quick assistance through a time-bound process.
benefits: **Compensation Amount:** - **In case of death:** 4Rs. is paid to the deceaseds legal heir or family member after deducting any temporary assistance already given and the actual cost of medical treatment before death.- **In case of injury:** Actual medical expenses are reimbursedRs. along with 500 per day (maximum 50Rs.) if hospitalizedRs. after deducting any temporary assistance already provided. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - Within 3 working days in case of death. - Within 7 working days in case of injury. **Mode of Disbursement:** - The payment is made directly to the beneficiarys bank account via e-payment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a victim of a wild animal attackRs. resulting in injury or death. 1. The applicant should submit proof that the injury or death was caused by a wild animal (excluding snakesRs. monitor lizardsRs. and other poisonous creatures). 1. In the case of deathRs. the applicant must be a legal heirRs. family memberRs. or relative of the deceased person.

name: Research and Development Grant
brief_description: The scheme Research and Development is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage scientific research to address the states problems by providing grants and technical support to scientistsRs. researchersRs. and academic institutions across the state.
benefits: - Grants are provided to promote research aimed at addressing various problems in the interest of the state through scientific research. - Academic scientists from government or private colleges/universities/research institutes/technical institutionsRs. and research scholars across the state are eligible to participate.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a scientist/researcher.

name: Grant In Aid Hostels
brief_description: The scheme "Grant In Aid Hostels" was launched in 1969 by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities by government registered organizations to the tribal students who wish to pursue primaryRs. secondary and higher secondary education. the scheme provides free lodging and boarding facilitiesRs. addressing the challenge that the Scheduled Tribe population has a lower literacy level due to the absence of secondary and higher secondary schools in tribal areasRs. causing students to leave studies after getting primary education. The scheme is implemented by Non-Governmental Organizations. the applications for this scheme are accepted at the district level at the office of the concerned Project Administrator/Assistant Commissioner (Vigilance).
benefits: Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to the students. ***Conditions for NGOs*** - The voluntary institution must agree to adhere to the current rules for Backward Class Hostels and any future changes. - The voluntary institution must agree to comply with administrative or other instructions received from the Tribal Development Department and the DirectorRs. Tribal Development.
eligibility: > ***For the Student*** - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must be from a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in standard 5th to 12th. - The applicants family annual income must be up to 1Rs./- for rural area. - The applicants family annual income must be up to 1Rs./- for urban area. > ***For the Institution*** - The applicant must be a voluntary institution. - The applicant must be registered under one of the following acts: Public Trusts Act 1950Rs. Societies Registration Act 1860 - The applicant organization must have a bank balance (liquidity/working capital) certificate showing an amount exceeding 15Rs./-. - The building must be suitable and equipped with complete facilitiesRs. including water and electricityRs. and available at the demanded site for the hostel. > ***Preference/Priority*** - Preference must be given to selecting hostels only in places where there is currently no hostel facility. - Priority should be given to backward and remote areas during hostel selection.

name: Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products
brief_description: The scheme Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to increase cold storage capacity through providing 50% grant assistance to all eligible farmers.
benefits: - Grant Assistance: A grant of 50% of the project cost up to a maximum of 2Rs./- for cold storage facilities up to 5Rs. metric tons capacity.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization for Custom Hiring Centres / Big Farmers is implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote agricultural mechanization and enhance farm productivity by facilitating access to modern farm machinery. Under this schemeRs. individual large farmersRs. farmer groupsRs. cooperativesRs. self-help groupsRs. and custom hiring centres in the state can purchase agricultural equipment at a subsidized rateRs. with the Government of India providing a maximum subsidy of 40%.
benefits: Under the Custom Hiring Centre component (for groups of farmers involved in buyingRs. rentingRs. or selling agricultural equipment)Rs. farmer groupsRs. cooperativesRs. FPOsRs. self-help groupsRs. and individual farmers can purchase equipment valued between 10.00 lakh and 100.00 lakh. The Government of India provides a maximum subsidy of 40% on such purchases.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a large farmer (owning 5 hectares or more of land)Rs. a cooperative groupRs. self-help groupRs. or a custom hiring centre in Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer or group must have cultivable land located in Uttarakhand. 1. For an individual large farmerRs. their name must be recorded in the revenue records. For a groupRs. the names of all group members must be listed in the agricultural land documents.

name: Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to promote kitchen gardening through the free distribution of vegetable seed packets worth 75 to poorRs. small/marginal farmers and agricultural laborers living below the poverty line.
benefits: Free Vegetable Seed Packets: Each eligible beneficiary receives a packet of vegetable seeds worth 75 free of cost.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer/agricultural laborer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Exhibition Fair and Publicity
brief_description: The scheme Exhibition Fair and Publicity launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to spread awareness about horticultural technologies and departmental schemes through exhibitions and seminars conducted at district and block levels for the benefit of farmers.
benefits: - **Awareness Creation:** Farmers receive knowledge about horticulture schemes and technologies related to fruitRs. flowerRs. vegetableRs. and spice crops. - **Scheme Promotion:** Departmental schemes are publicized to ensure more participation and benefit utilization among farmers.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

name: STEM Lab
brief_description: The scheme STEM Lab is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote hands-on learning in scienceRs. technologyRs. engineeringRs. and mathematics by establishing labs across all blocksRs. giving students and teachers practical exposure to STEM experiments.
benefits: STEM labs are being established in all the blocks of the stateRs. through which students and teachers will be provided with information about experiments in scienceRs. technologyRs. engineeringRs. and mathematics.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student enrolled in a school located in Uttarakhand.

name: Sparsh Abhiyan: Surgery to Prevent Disability of Poor and Destitute Disabled People of Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The scheme Sparsh Abhiyan: Surgery to Prevent Disability of Poor and Destitute Disabled People of Madhya Pradesh is launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the surgery of destitute and poor peopleRs. specifically to prevent disability in such individuals in Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides reimbursement of expenses incurred on the surgery of eligible disabled persons. The scheme is implemented by the District AdministrationRs. with application submission handled by the Joint Director/Deputy DirectorRs. Panchayat and Social Justice at the district level. The applications for this scheme are accepted at the District Office of Panchayat and Social Justice.
benefits: - Provision of financial assistance for surgery of destitute and poor people. - Reimbursement of expenses incurred on surgery of disabled persons identified by the District Administration from the destitute funds collected at the district level under Madhya Pradesh Nirashrit Evam Nirdhan Vyakti Sahayata Niyam 1999 (as per rules amended from time to time). - Reimbursement of expenses incurred on surgery of visually impaired/low vision disabled persons from the funds received by the Public Health and Family Welfare Department under the National Blindness Prevention Program. - Reimbursement of expenses may be sourced from the funds of District Rogi Kalyan SamitiRs. Treasury of District Red Cross SocietyRs. or the amount collected from social workers and donors. ##### _Intended Use (Specific Surgeries Covered)_ - **Surgery for Visually Impaired/Low Vision Persons:****** Intraocular lens implantRs. CorneoplastyRs. Corneal repair- **Surgery for Hearing Impaired Persons:****** Cochlear ImplantRs. Tympanic Membrane RepairRs. Mastwired Surgery- **Surgery of Leprosy-affected Persons:****** Reconstructive surgery HeadRs. Reconstructive surgery Foot- **Surgery of Bone-Impaired Persons:****** SP Nail OperationRs. OrthosisRs. External FixationRs. Replacement ImplantRs. Surgery for Knee Hip and Ankle CorrectionRs. Shoulder Elbow and Wrist CorrectionRs. Post-Polio Correction SurgeryRs. Construction RepairRs. Ligament RepairRs. Soft Tissue Release SurgeryRs. Construction Correction SurgeryRs. Elizarobe Lengthening and Corrective Surgery
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a disabled person. - The applicant must have a disability as defined in the "Persons with Disabilities (Equal OpportunitiesRs. Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act 1995". - The applicants guardians/guardians' annual income must not exceed 96Rs./-. - The applicant must have surgery recommended by a subject specialist doctor. - The applicants surgery must be recommended by a subject specialist surgeon.

name: Financial Assistance to Non-Pensioner World War-II Veterans and Their Widows
brief_description: The Financial Assistance to Non-Pensioner World War-II Veterans and Their Widows scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial aid to ensure a dignified livelihood for world War-II veterans who are non-pensioners and their lawful wives.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance of 8Rs. per month is provided to non-pensioner world War-II veterans and their lawful widows. **Mode of Disbursement:** The financial assistance amount is directly credited to the beneficiarys bank account through the District Sainik Welfare Office. **Frequency of Disbursement:** The financial assistance is disbursed monthly. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** Disbursement is made within one week of application verification and approval.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a non-pensioner World War-II veteran who served between 1 September 1939 and 14 August 1945Rs. or his lawful widow. 1. The veteran must have been discharged from military service due to demobilization after the end of World War-II. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any pension from defense services or any other source. 1. In case of the veterans deathRs. only the lawful widow is eligible for the benefit. 1. Upon the death of the widowRs. no other heir (children or relatives) becomes eligible.

name: Free Electricity Supply Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Free Electricity Supply Scheme launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to support Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers by providing free electricity supply for agricultural pumps up to 5 horsepower and landholding up to 1 hectare.
benefits: - **Free Electricity Supply:** Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers having agricultural pumps up to 5 horsepower and landholding up to 1 hectare receive free electricity.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be a farmer owning agricultural land up to 1 hectare. - The applicant must have an agricultural pump of capacity up to 5 Horsepower (HP).

name: Financial Assistance to the Recipients of the Service Medal by the Government of Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The Financial Assistance to the Recipients of the Service Medal by the Government of Madhya Pradesh" scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial support and recognition to defense personnel who have received service or gallantry medals and are permanent residents of the state.
benefits: Financial assistance is provided to soldier medal awardees.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must belong a soldier category. 1. The applicant must be a service medal awardee.

name: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Exchange Programme
brief_description: The Annapurna Scheme was launched by the Department of Farmers Welfare and Agricultural DevelopmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The Seed Exchange Programme component of the scheme aims to improve the economic status of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe small and marginal farmers by providing them with economic assistance to access improved seeds of high-yielding foodgrain cropsRs. thereby increasing productivity and production. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Agriculture through the District PanchayatsRs. Sub-Directorate of AgricultureRs. and the Senior Agriculture Development Officer. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Rural Agriculture Extension Officer based on targets set according to the population of the target groups and the district's demand.
benefits:
- Provision of improved seeds of high-yielding varieties of foodgrain crops. - 75% subsidy on the actual price of the seed provided in exchange. - The maximum limit of the subsidy is 1Rs./-. - Seeds of suitable varieties for the land and area will be provided in equal quantity compared to the seed provided by the farmer. - The provision is limited to a maximum area of one hectare. - Certified seed will be provided.
##### ***Conditions*** - _The seeds supplied must be of the improved varietyRs. prioritizing those that are suitable for or prevalent in the area._ - _If certified seed is scarceRs. or depending on the specific crop conditionRs. true form seed may be distributed only with the permission of the Director of Agriculture._ - _If the farmer provides seed of a different crop for exchangeRs. the seed given by the farmer must be worth 25% of the actual price of the certified seed of the requested crop._ - _The improved seed provided to the farmer will not exceed the requirement for one hectare._ - _The seed received from the beneficiary farmer must be sold through auction (Ghosh Vikray) at the local Agricultural Produce Market Committee by a designated committee._ - _Cash received as the farmer's share or resulting from the auction of the grain provided by the farmer must be deposited into the Government Treasury by challan under Head 0401 Agriculture WorkRs. Other Deposit - 800 Other Deposit._ - _If a farmer who previously received seed is given seed againRs. it must not be for the same crop or variety provided in prior years._
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. - The applicant must be unable to afford the purchase of improved varieties of high-yielding foodgrain crops. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The farmer must exchange their existing crop or seed for the improved seeds.

name: Assistance Towards Sugarcane Supplied By The Sugarcane Growers
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance Towards Sugarcane Supplied By The Sugarcane Growers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to assist the Sugarcane Growers to take up sugarcane cultivation in Goa. The scheme provides financial assistance based on the actual tonnage of canes weighed at the Sugar factory weighbridgeRs. determined by the Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) fixed by the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories LimitedRs. New Delhi. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane in the State of GoaRs. possess a valid Krishi CardRs. and bear the cost of harvesting and transporting the harvested cane to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar KarkhanaRs. Dayanandnagar Dharbandora. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Agriculture. The applications for this scheme are accepted via registration through Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL).
benefits: - Financial assistance is provided based on the Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) fixed by the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories LimitedRs. New DelhiRs. from time to time. - Farmers will be paid based on the actual tonnage of canes weighed at the Sugar factory weighbridge. > ***Conditions*** - The farmers must harvest and supply the sugarcane on their own to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL). - The harvested cane must be loaded and brought to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar KarkhanaRs. Dayanandnagar Dharbandora by the farmer on his own cost. - The farmer must duly sign the GAR 32 formRs. which is used in the submission process by Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana to the Zonal Agricultural Office. - The Government or Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana will not take any responsibility to harvest and transport the sugarcane.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be cultivating sugarcane in Goa. - The applicant must possess a valid Krishi Card issued by the Directorate of Agriculture. - The applicant must ensure the sugarcane area is verified by the representatives of the Zonal Agriculture Office of the respective TalukaRs. along with the Fieldman of Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL). - The applicant must be issued an area certificate following verification of the sugarcane area. - The applicant must be present for the inspection of the harvested cane by the Fieldman of Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL) or any representative of the Agriculture Department.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Mitra Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Krushak Mitra Yojana launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to create infrastructure for permanent agricultural pump connections through the distribution company. The scheme provides grants and cost-sharing support to farmers and distribution companies for infrastructure development.
benefits: - **Cost Sharing Support:** Only 50% of the infrastructure development cost will be borne by the concerned farmer or group of farmers. - **Government Grant:** 40% of the cost will be provided directly by the State Government to the power distribution company as a grant.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a landholding farmer/group-farmer.

name: SC Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
brief_description: Under this schemeRs. Scheduled Caste girl students studying in Class 11 receive financial support from the Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure that girls from SC communities continue their education without financial barriers. Applications are accepted online through the Shiksha PortalRs. and the eligible amount is directly transferred to the students account after verification.
benefits: Eligible SC girl students of Class 11 receive an annual financial incentive of 3Rs./-Rs. credited directly to their bank account
eligibility: 1. Applicant must be a scheduled Caste girl students. 1. Applicant should have a attested photocopy of the permanent caste certificate from the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue). 1. Applicant's father or guardian must not be an income tax payer and self-declaration. 1. The student must be in continuous study.

name: Mukhyamantri Bijli Bill Bakaya Maaf Samadhan Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Bijli Bill Bakaya Maaf Samadhan Scheme launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide waiver of electricity bill dues through sharing of outstanding amounts between the state government and distribution companies for the benefit of registered workersRs. construction workersRs. and BPL consumers.
benefits: - **Waiver of Outstanding Dues:** Complete waiver of surcharge amount and 50% waiver of the principal outstanding amount as of the date of implementation of the scheme. - **Benefit to Consumers:** The entire surcharge and 50% of the principal amount are borne by the concerned distribution companies. - **State Government Support:** The remaining 50% of the principal amount is borne by the State Government as a subsidy to the distribution companies.
eligibility: The applicant must be a registered worker under the "Mukhyamantri Mazdoor Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana". The applicant must be a construction worker or a Below Poverty Line (BPL) consumer.

name: Annapurna Scheme: Seed Production Programme
brief_description: The Annapurna Scheme was launched by the Department of Farmers Welfare and Agricultural DevelopmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The Seed Production Programme component of the scheme aims to improve the economic condition of small and marginal farmers belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes by providing economic assistance for improved seedsRs. thereby increasing productivity and production. The scheme provides Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds of improvedRs. high-yielding food grain crops to selected farmers for seed production up to a limit of 1 hectareRs. along with a 75% subsidy on the actual cost of the seed.
benefits:
- Provision of Foundation or Certified Grade I seeds of improved varieties of high-yielding food grain crops for seed production. - Eligibility for a 75% subsidy on the actual cost of the Foundation or Certified seed up to a maximum area of 1 hectare. - Payment for registration (application feeRs. registration feeRs. inspection feeRs. and sample fee) with the Seed Certification Agency will be covered from the scheme budget. - Technical training and necessary information will be provided by the Rural Agricultural Extension OfficerRs. Senior Agricultural Development OfficerRs. and Subject Matter Specialist (Sub-Divisional level). - Guaranteed procurement of the produced seed by the Seed Production Committee or Farm Superintendent at government-fixed rates. - Expenditure related to the gradingRs. processingRs. stockingRs. and packing of raw seeds produced on Government agricultural farms can be carried out by the Deputy Director of Agriculture from the scheme budget.
***Conditions*** - _The farmer must utilize the seed provided for a maximum area of 1 hectare and a minimum area of 0.2 hectares (1/2 acre)._ - _The farmer must adopt the complete package of agricultural practices for higher production._ - _The farmer must ensure the removal of undesirable plants to maintain seed purity._ - _The farmer must sign an agreement with the department through the Seed Production Committee or Farm Superintendent regarding seed productionRs. procurementRs. and payment according to the policy._ - _The farmer must pay the remaining 25% of the seed cost in cash or by providing their own seed._ - _If the farmer provides their own seedRs. the price of that seed will be determined based on the support price._ - _The produced Certified Seed must be made available to other Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe farmers under the scheme in the subsequent year._ - _The expenditure incurred on processingRs. gradingRs. stockingRs. and packing will be deducted from the fixed price of the supplied seedRs. and the remaining amount must be deposited into the government treasury._
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be a small or marginal farmer. - The applicant must be willing to participate in the Seed Production Programme. - The applicant must operate within the 10-kilometer periphery of the selected Government agricultural farms. - The applicant must conduct the program on a minimum area of 0.2 hectares (1/2 acre). - The applicant must be eligible for a maximum grant up to 1 hectare. - The applicant must mandatorily register with the Seed Certification Agency. - The plan includes the food grain crops Paddy (Dhan)Rs. JowarRs. BajraRs. MaizeRs. KodoRs. KutkiRs. Ragi (for Kharif)Rs. and Wheat (Gehu)Rs. Barley (Jau) (for Rabi). ****Preference should be given to the names listed first in the approved list.*** ****The waiting list will remain valid only until the crop season.***
***Implementation Area*** The Seed Production Programme will be implemented within the 10-kilometer periphery of the following Government agricultural farms: _Gohad (Bhind)Rs. Mahuakheda (Gwalior)Rs. Indergarh (Datia)Rs. Gazaura (Shivpuri)Rs. Rannod (Shivpuri)Rs. Gariyaband (Raipur)Rs. Khairibilari (Raipur)Rs. Mohgaon (Durg)Rs. Surgi (Rajnandgaon)Rs. Bhavarmara (Rajnandgaon)Rs. Amethi (Raigarh)Rs. Ragja (Janjgir)Rs. Lakhanpur (Korba)Rs. Gehwara (Satna)Rs. Samda (Sidhi)Rs. Jabera (Damoh)Rs. Naogaon (Chhatarpur)Rs. Ajaygarh (Panna)Rs. Bhomakhatiya (Seoni)Rs. Kinhi (Balaghat)Rs. Delakhedi (Chhindwara)Rs. Narsinghpur (Narsinghpur)Rs. Pirprod (Katni)Rs. Manpur (Umariya)Rs. Bhikangaon (Khargone)Rs. Chandrakeshar (Dewas)Rs. Girwar (Shajapur)Rs. Panched (Ratlam)Rs. Patan (Mandsaur)Rs. Phanda (Bhopal)Rs. Rehthi (Sehore)Rs. Silwani (Raisen)Rs. Gundgaon (Betul)Rs. Sarangpur (Rajgarh)Rs. Keralapal (Jagdalpur)Rs. Kanker (Kanker)Rs. Pankhajor (Kanker)Rs. Chalta (Sitapur Surguja)Rs. Lohari (Koriya)Rs. Ori (Mandla)Rs. Biridodogari (Mandla)Rs. Birhuliya (Shahdol)Rs. Nogaon (Dhar)Rs. Jobat (Jhabua)Rs. Alirajpur (Jhabua)Rs. Garhi (Balaghat)._

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Annadoot Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Yuva Annadoot Yojana was launched by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies and Consumer ProtectionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide unemployed youth/women with employment opportunities under the MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises scheme by making vehicles available for lifting and transporting food grains from the Madhya Pradesh State Civil Supplies Corporation center to fair price shopsRs. thereby enabling them to be self-reliant for 7 years. The scheme provides benefits including an interest subsidy/grant for 7 years and a maximum refund of the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises fee of up to 1Rs./-.
