The applications for this scheme are accepted online at the Samagra Portal or through the MP Online Kiosk Center.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy/Grant:** A 3% interest subsidy/grant is provided for 7 years.- **CGTMSE Fee Refund:** A maximum refund of the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises fee of up to 1Rs./- is provided.- **Maximum Vehicle Cost Covered:** The scheme supports the purchase of vehicles with an approximate cost of up to 25Rs./-.- **Payment for Transportation:** Payment for the transportation of food grains and handling expenses is provided as per the fixed rate for the sector. ##### ***Disbursement*** - **Mode of Payment:** The payment for transportation of food grains and handling expenses for the sector will be paid directly into the bank account of the beneficiary monthly by the Madhya Pradesh State Civil Supplies Corporation.- **Penalty Provision:** If the food grain is not transported on time to the designated fair price shopRs. 33% of the total monthly transport rent/fare on the concerned fair price shop may be deducted from the beneficiary's transport rent/fare. This penalty deduction will only occur after a hearing has been granted by the designated Supply Officer/Collector. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must ensure the purchase of a vehicle within the capacity range of 7.5 Metric Tons (+/- 10%). - The beneficiary must utilize the vehicle for lifting and transporting allocated food grains from the Madhya Pradesh State Civil Supplies Corporation center to the fair price shops for 7 years. - The beneficiary must obtain a bank loanRs. as the Central Bank of India is designated to provide the loan for vehicle purchase.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a native resident of the rural or urban local body of the concerned district of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be aged between 18 and 45 years. - The applicant must have passed the 8th standard in educational qualification. - The applicant must possess a Heavy Motor Vehicle driving license to operate the vehicle. - The applicant must have clearance from the bank for obtaining the loan (defaulter status must be 'No'). - The applicant must not be a Government servant or pensioner. - The applicant must not have annual family income exceeding 12Rs./-. - The applicant must not be involved in any criminal activity or have a criminal background. - The applicant must not be currently benefiting from any other self-employment scheme.

name: Cancer Day Care Centre - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Cancer Day Care Centre is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure early detection and timely treatment of cancer by providing accessible and affordable healthcare services within the state.
benefits: Free screening for common cancers (oralRs. breastRs. and CA cervix) is being conducted across all districts of Uttarakhand to detect cancer at an early stage and start treatment.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a cancer patient.

name: Allotment of Commercial Godown
brief_description: The scheme Allotment of Commercial Godown is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to facilitate ease of doing business for traders by providing licensed traders with access to commercial godowns for storage and management of their goods.
benefits: The scheme facilitates ease of doing business for traders by allotting them with commercial Godowns.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must hold a valid traders license issued by the Mandi Committee.

name: Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan
brief_description: The Livestock Mission Scheme Interest Payment on Loan scheme has been introduced by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government.
benefits: **For promoting self-employment at the local levelRs. 90% of the interest subsidy on the bank loan taken by the applicant for setting up the following units is borne by the State Government:** ***Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - 5 cow units - 10 cow units - 2 buffalo units - 5 buffalo units ***Load Carrier Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - 1 mule unit - 2 mule unit ***Sheep and Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Sheep/Goat (5 female + 1 male) - Sheep/Goat (10 female + 1 male) ***Pig Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Pig (5 female + 1 male) - Pig (10 female + 1 male) ***Poultry Entrepreneurship Development Scheme:*** - Commercial broiler farm for 1Rs. birds - Small commercial layer farm for 250 birds
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an interested livestock farmer. 1. The livestock farmer must be eligible to avail a bank loan.

name: The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "The Grant of Honorarium to Legal Researcher Scheme" was launched by the Law DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to address the high volume of cases before various fora where Departments find it very hard to submit their defense documents (Affidavits/Reply Statements/Counter Affidavits) at the appropriate time through the Law OfficersRs. leading to officers of the Administration facing unnecessary embarrassment before the Courts. The scheme provides for engaging 15 Legal Research Assistants on a fixed honorarium for an initial period of two yearsRs. potentially extendable for one more yearRs. in order to obtain the services of the best incumbents and to follow up all legal issues including Court matter pending. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Under Secretary to GovernmentRs. Law DepartmentRs. Chief SecretariatRs. Puducherry.
benefits: - Research Assistant shall be paid 25Rs./- per month (Rupees twenty-five thousand only) as honorariumRs. for their assignment. - The assignment will be initially for a period of two years from the date of engagement. - The assignment can be extended for a further period of not exceeding one more yearRs. subject to the approval of the Secretary to Government (Law). - Research Assistants are permitted access to the Computers and internet facilities as available in the Law Department. - Research Assistant shall be entitled to one day Casual Leave for each Calendar Month. - The un-availed Casual Leave in a particular month may be carried forwardRs. subject to a maximum of 2 days. - The maximum eligibility of Casual Leave in a Calendar Year is 8 days. ****Research Assistant shall not be entitled to any other allowances or perks.*** ****Research Assistant shall not be treated or deemed to be an employee either in the Law Department or of the service of the Department of the Union Territory of Puducherry.*** ##### ***Assignment Location*** _The Legal Researchers shall be attached to the major Departments of this AdministrationRs. including LawRs. PoliceRs. EducationRs. RevenueRs. HealthRs. Local Administration DepartmentRs. Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms (D.P.&A.R.)Rs. Public Works DepartmentRs. Social WelfareRs. Civil SuppliesRs. Commercial TaxesRs. Industries and CommerceRs. Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. and Transport._ ##### ***Dress Code*** ***For Male Research Assistant:*** _White/Black PantRs. White shirtRs. Black shoe._ ***For Female Research Assistant:*** _White/Off White SareeRs. White/Off-White blouse._ ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - The Research Assistant must join their assignment within the period specified in their order of engagement. - The Research Assistant shall not be entitled to practice as an Advocate in any Court of Law or Tribunal or Authority during the currency of their assignment. - It will be obligatory for the Research AssistantRs. after accepting the assignmentRs. to inform the Bar Council concernedRs. in writingRs. that he/she shall not practice as an Advocate as long as he/she continues with the assignment as Research Assistant. - The Research Assistant shall not be entitled to take up any employment or engagement of whatsoever nature either on full-time or part-time basis during the currency of their assignment. - The Research Assistant should mark their attendance in the Attendance Register which shall be duly authenticated by the respective Head of the Institution in which they are posted from time-to-time and the same shall be communicated to the Law DepartmentRs. Puducherry. - The Research Assistant may be required to attend the Office on Saturday/Sunday and other holidays alsoRs. in addition to the normal working dayRs. for which he/she shall not be paid any honorarium/remuneration. - The Research Assistant will be permitted to proceed on Casual Leave only with prior permission of the respective Head of Institution. - If any Research Assistant is found to be exceeding the permissible limit of 8 days of Casual Leave in a Calendar YearRs. necessary deductions will be made from their honorariumRs. on pro-rata basis. - If the Research Assistant intends to leave the assignment within a period of two yearsRs. they shall be required to give prior notice of one month. - The assignment of any Research Assistant may be discontinued even before the completion of one yearRs. without noticeRs. if his/her services are found to be unsatisfactory. - During the assignmentRs. every Research Assistant shall maintain a high standard of reputation and integrity commensurate with the responsibilities entrusted to him/her.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a Postgraduate in Law (2 years programme) from the recognized Universities in the Indian Union. - The applicant must not be pursuing Postgraduate Degree in Law or any other Degrees or Programmes requiring their compulsory attendance elsewhere. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st January or 1st JulyRs. preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications. - The applicant must not have attained the age of 32 years as on 1st JanuaryRs. 2023Rs. if applying under the one-time age relaxation granted by the Honorable Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry. ****The educational qualifications and other eligibility criteria may be relaxed in case of exceptionally outstanding and deserving candidates by the Government.***

name: District Plan - Sugarcane Development Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Sugarcane Development Scheme a sub-component of the District PlanRs. implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar IndustryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance sugarcane productivity and quality in Uttarakhand by providing financial and technical support to farmers for improved seed productionRs. seed and soil treatmentRs. and pest and disease managementRs. thereby promoting sustainable farming and strengthening the livelihoods of sugarcane growers.
benefits: 1. **Scheme for Improved Sugarcane Seed Production:** A subsidy of 1Rs./- per hectare (2Rs./- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for established/base nurseriesRs. and 500/- per hectare (1Rs./- per hectare for SC/ST farmers) is provided for primary nurseries. 1. **Seed/Soil Treatment:** A 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for chemicals used in seed and soil treatment. Of thisRs. 25% is contributed by the governmentRs. while the remaining 25% is shared equally by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill. 1. **Sugarcane Stalk Base (Pedi) Management Program:** To protect ratoon sugarcane crops from pests and diseasesRs. a 50% subsidy is provided in all sugar mill areas for pesticides used in pest and disease control. The subsidy comprises 25% contribution from the governmentRs. with the remaining 25% shared by the Sugarcane Development Council and the sugar mill.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicants name must be registered in the land records of the state.

name: Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar
brief_description: The Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to honour exceptionally skilled artisans of the state for their outstanding contributions to the traditional craft sector.
benefits: - Every yearRs. 25 artisans from the state of Uttarakhand are honored with the "Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar." - Each selected outstanding artisan receives a cash prize of 1 lakhRs. along with a memento (symbolic representation)Rs. an angavastra (ceremonial stole) and a certificate of appreciation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a skilled artisan. 1. The applicant must be at least 45 years of age. 1. The applicant must be proficient in traditional or extraordinary art forms and has made unprecedented contribution in the field of traditional crafts. 1. The artisans must have contributed to the training of young artisans. 1. The applicant must have at least 15 years of experience in a recognized traditional craft. 1. The applicant must not be employed in government/semi-government/cooperative institution/union. **Note:** Preference will be given to artisans who have received national/state-level awards.

name: Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik (UDAN) Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme UDAN Yojana is implemented by Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development AuthorityRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to make air travel affordable and accessible for all citizensRs. enhance regional connectivity within Uttarakhand and promote tourism.
benefits: ***Under this schemeRs. the minimum one-way fare per person for helicopter services on the following routes is:*** 1. Dehradun to Tehri: 3Rs..00 1. Tehri to Srinagar: 3Rs..00 1. Srinagar to Gauchar: 3Rs..00 1. Gauchar to Srinagar: 3Rs..00 1. Srinagar to Tehri: 3Rs..00 1. Tehri to Dehradun: 3Rs..00 1. Dehradun to Srinagar: 3Rs..00 1. Srinagar to Dehradun: 3Rs..00 1. Dehradun to Gauchar: 3Rs..00 1. Gauchar to Dehradun: 3Rs..00 1. Sahastradhara to Gauchar: 4Rs..00 1. Gauchar to Sahastradhara: 4150.00 1. Sahastradhara to Chinyalisound: 3150.00 1. Chinyalisound to Sahastradhara: 3150.00 1. Dehradun to Haldwani / Pantnagar: 6281.00 1. Haldwani / Pantnagar to Dehradun: 6281.00 1. Pantnagar to Pithoragarh: 5111.00 1. eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be an Indian citizen.

name: Pension Scheme for Craftsmen
brief_description: The Pension Scheme for Craftsmen is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support and social security to traditional artisans of Uttarakhand who are aged 60 years or above and belong to families living below the poverty line.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. craftsmen aged 60 years or above who are already receiving an old age pension are provided with an additional incentive of 400/- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an artisan/craftsman aged 60 years or above. 1. The applicant must be already receiving an old age pension from the government. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. If the son or grandson of the artisan is 20 years of age or above and the family still lives below the poverty lineRs. the applicant remains eligible. 1. The applicant must be engaged in traditional handicrafts such as stoneRs. woodRs. ironRs. lampRs. ringalRs. bambooRs. and product development from natural fibresRs. or in any other crafts approved by the government from time to time.

name: Drip Irrigation Sprinkler
brief_description: The scheme Drip Irrigation Sprinkler is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote efficient and sustainable irrigation for horticultural crops by providing farmers with modern irrigation systems and financial subsidies to enhance productivity and water conservation.
benefits: Irrigation systems are established to provide irrigation facilities through drip irrigationRs. portable sprinklersRs. micro sprinklersRs. mini sprinklersRs. or rain gunsRs. as per the requirements of new plants. Under this schemeRs. a 45 to 55% subsidy is payable for areas ranging from 4 hectares up to a maximum of 5 hectares. An additional 25% subsidy is provided to state farmers as a top-up.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.

name: Tubewell Installation /Pond Construction
brief_description: The scheme Tubewell Installation/ Pond Construction is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance irrigation facilities for farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance for the construction of tubewells and pondsRs. thereby improving water availabilityRs. supporting horticultural developmentRs. and increasing agricultural productivity.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. to promote the development of irrigation facilitiesRs. farmers are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost for the construction of new tubewells or pondsRs. up to a maximum of 90Rs./- per unit (limited to one unit per farmer).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The farmer must confirm the availability of water in the concerned area. 1. A farmer is eligible for a subsidy for the construction of one tube well/pond.

name: Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
brief_description: The "Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship" was launched by the Directorate of Skill Development & EntrepreneurshipRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to spot the trainees of Industrial Training Institutes undergoing mentalRs. physical related stress and provide solace and a safeRs. confidential vent to release their stressRs. anguishRs. grievancesRs. guiltRs. or feeling of unrest/complain of neglect. The scheme provides youth-friendly counseling services delivered by appointed CounselorsRs. along with dedicated supervision and data entry support staff.
benefits: ##### ***Provision of Counseling Services*** - Youth-friendly counseling services are provided to assist distressed students to think more clearly and positively and develop the skills required to find their way forward. - Counselors discuss and assist trainees with various concernsRs. including Stress ManagementRs. adjusting to the Industrial Training Institute environmentRs. life transitions and changesRs. difficulties in family relationshipsRs. depressionRs. anxietyRs. angerRs. physicalRs. sexualRs. and emotional abuseRs. thoughts of suicideRs. traumaRs. and other feelings that cause discomfort. ##### ***Monetary Remuneration (For Contract Staff)*** - Remuneration for Counselors is 28Rs./-. - Remuneration for the Supervisor is 35Rs./-. - Remuneration for the Data Entry Operator is 20Rs./-. ##### ***Conditions*** - The appointment of the CounselorRs. SupervisorRs. and Data Entry Operator is on a contract basis for a period of 12 months. - The renewal of the contract shall be strictly based on the performance of the staff memberRs. which will be assessed by the constituted Committee. - The Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship will pay the remuneration from the funds provided by the State Government or by the Government of India through any Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
eligibility: ##### ***Eligibility for the Trainee (The Applicant)*** - The applicant must be a trainee studying in Government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (DSDE) in the State of Goa. ##### ***Eligibility for the Counselor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - OR The applicant must possess a Regular Graduation in Psychology (6 units)Rs. Social WorkRs. or Home Science (Human Resources) from a University Grants Commission (UGC) recognized College and a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 1 year experience in Counseling. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. ##### ***Eligibility for the Supervisor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters Degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - The applicant must possess a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years experience in Counselling. - The applicant must have experience of conducting training and workshops. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. - The applicant should possess a Master of Philosophy (M. Phil) or Doctor of Philosophy (Ph. D.) in Psychology. ##### ***Eligibility for the Data Entry Operator Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination (HSSCE) from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must possess a certificate confirming completion of a course in Computer for a minimum period of 3 months from a recognized Institute. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi.

name: Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme was launched by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade & CommerceRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to create manpower suitable to the needs of the Industry and to provide specific skill training to Goan youth to improve their employability by optimally utilizing the infrastructure available in Government and private institutions. The scheme provides reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees subject to a maximum of 60Rs./- per employee and 7Rs./- per unit per year. The applications for this scheme must be submitted offline.
benefits: - Reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees. - Maximum reimbursement of 60Rs./- per employee. - Maximum reimbursement of 7Rs./- per unit per year. - The benefit is for demand-driven Short Term Training Courses. _*The benefits under this scheme are subject to recommendation by the Task Force Committee (TFC)._ _*The benefits are subject to budgetary allocation._ ##### ***Conditions*** - _The payment made to the trainees by the employerRs. such as stipendRs. wagesRs. or allowancesRs. shall not be considered as cost of training under this scheme._ - _No Promissory Estoppel shall be applicable if benefits are discontinued in case the budgetary allocation is exceeded._ - _The applicant shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade & Commerce for conducting inspection or supervision of the unit or the registersRs. or for holding discussions with employed employeesRs. to ensure proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government._
eligibility: ##### ***For the Enterprise*** - The applicant must be a MicroRs. SmallRs. MediumRs. or Large manufacturing enterprise. - The applicant must have registered under the Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme (Umbrella Scheme). - The training must be conducted only through approved Skill Training Providers (STPs). - The course must be a demand driven Short Term Training Course. - The scheme shall not be applicable to cases which have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of Government of Goa. - The prospective employees/trainees must be between the age of 18 to 42 years. - The prospective employees/trainees must fulfill the criteria of being a Goan as defined in the scheme. ##### ***For the Trainee*** - The trainee must satisfy one of the following criteria to be considered a Goan: - The person must be born in the State of Goa. - The person must have a 10 years Residence Certificate issued by the Mamlatdar. - The person must have any other document indicating residence in Goa issued by the Government of India or Government of Goa or its organisationsRs. issued prior to 10 yearsRs. to the satisfaction of the Task Force Committee (examples include Driving licenseRs. Ration cardRs. Electoral Photo Identity Card (EPIC)Rs. or Passport).

name: Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to ensures that farmers are eligible to access the benefits of all schemes offered by CAPRs. including state and central government subsidiesRs. technical guidanceRs. training programsRs. and product clearance support.
benefits: - Registration of farmers with the Aromatic Plant Centre (CAP) is mandatory to avail of the benefits of all the schemes run by the Aromatic Plant Centre. - After registrationRs. CAP provides farmers with facilities such as subsidies provided by the State and Central GovernmentsRs. technical informationRs. trainingRs. product clearanceRs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The farmer must be engaged in aromatic plant cultivation.

name: Financial Assistance to Students who Cleared Civil Services Prelims Conducted by UPSC/APSC
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Students who Cleared Civil Services Prelims Conducted by UPSC/APSC was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission or Assam Public Service Commission during the current yearRs. so that they are supported in their preparation for the Mains Examination and succeed. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The assistance is intended to support them in their preparation for the Mains Examination and succeed.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam and must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must produce a valid Caste certificate which is duly certified/issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his/her designated officer. - The applicant should have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The applicant must produce his/her copy of the admit card and result of the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission. - The applicant should not be a Government service holder.

name: Minimum Support Price for Aromatic Oils/Products - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Minimum Support Price for Aromatic Oils/Products scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide registered farmers engaged in aromatic cultivation with a fair price and a guaranteed market for their produce.
benefits: - Farmers can sell 25 varieties of aromatic oils/products at the prescribed price to the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP). - Farmers are ensured a fair price and a guaranteed market for the aromatic oils they produce.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The farmer must be engaged in the cultivation of aromatic plants. 1. The farmer must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. Dehradun.

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Support for Urban Homeless Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Support for Urban Homeless is an initiative under the Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)Rs. implemented by the Nagar Nigam Dehradun under the Department of Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide safe and accessible night shelter facilities to homeless people living under the open sky in urban areasRs. ensuring they have protection and support at any time.
benefits: People living under the open sky are provided with benefits in night shelters.
eligibility: 1. Any person living under the open sky within the municipal areas of Uttarakhand is eligible to stay in a night shelter.

name: Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehiclesRs. specifically goods and passenger vehicles. The scheme provides financial assistance covering up to 70% of the cost of the vehicleRs. excluding road tax and insurance. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits:
- Financial assistance is provided up to 70% of the cost of the vehicle. - The calculation for the financial assistance excludes the cost of road tax and insurance. - The assistance is intended to meet the expenditure towards the cost of the chassis and body building for new transport vehicles (Goods and Passenger vehicle). - The maximum repayment period is 58 monthly instalments. - The repayment period includes a moratorium period of a maximum of 3 months. - A concessional rate of interest of 0.5% less than the normal rate is charged for units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. or Differently abled persons. **Financial Norms:** [https://pipdic.in/financial_norms](https://pipdic.in/financial_norms)
##### ***Conditions*** - _The proposed vehicle must be hypothecated._ - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered as per the lending policy of the Corporation._ - _If the immovable property used for collateral security is situated in the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. its value must be not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property is situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. the value of the property offered shall be not less than 150% of the loan amount if it includes land with a building._ - _If the property offered outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only landRs. its value shall not be less than 200% of the loan amount._ - _For units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. or Differently abled personsRs. the required value of the immovable property offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._ - _The valuation of the properties to be offered as security must be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers or valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must be seeking financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehiclesRs. which include Goods vehicles and Passenger vehicles. - The applicant must not be seeking financial assistance for second-hand vehicles.

name: Scheme for Hotel and Restaurant Projects
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Hotel and Restaurant Projects was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up entrepreneurs setting up of hotel/restaurant projects in urban areas. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial Assistance to entrepreneurs for setting up of hotel / restaurant projects in urban areas. - The Loan Limit is need based. - The Project Cost must not exceed 12Rs./-. - The Repayment Period is upto 10 years including moratorium period.
eligibility: Entrepreneurs setting up hotel / restaurant projects in urban areas are eligible.

name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Destitute Widow Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to help destitute widows meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to widows whose family monthly income is up to 4Rs./- or who belong to the BPL categoryRs. and who are not availing of any other pension benefits.
benefits: A pension of 1Rs./- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow. 1. The widow must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The widows family monthly income should not exceed 4Rs./-Rs. or she must possess a valid BPL (Below Poverty Line) certificate. 1. The widow must not be receiving any other pension benefits.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.
benefits: In the stateRs. after the institutional delivery of a pregnant womanRs. the following benefits will be provided: - The woman will receive one Mahalakshmi kit for the birth of each of her first two girl children. - In the case of twinsRs. the woman will be given one Mahalakshmi kitRs. and each child will receive a separate Mahalakshmi kit.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman registered with an Anganwadi Centre and eligible to receive a Mahalakshmi Kit after delivery. 1. The beneficiary must not be an income tax payer.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. pregnant and lactating women are provided eggs two days a week and dates two days a week. Dates are given to those registered women who do not consume eggs.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant or lactating woman.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level) is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 6Rs. 7Rs. and 8 by providing financial assistance to meritorious studentsRs. based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT)Rs. Uttarakhand.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** - **For Class 6th Students:** 600/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 7th Students:** 700/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 8th Students:** 800/- per month for 1 year.
eligibility: 1. The student must have passed Class 5 (institutional) from a Government School or Government-aided private school of the state (excluding Central and Residential schools) and must be studying in Class 6. 1. The applicant must qualify in the competitive examination conducted by SCERTRs. Uttarakhand. 1. Based on the examination resultsRs. a student securing a position in the top 10% of the total participants will be eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. The selected student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance and secure at least 60% marks in Classes 6 and 7. For SC/ST studentsRs. a relaxation of 5% is provided in both marks and attendance requirements. 1. There is no income criterion for the parents/guardians of the student under this scholarship. 1. A student cannot avail double benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes.

name: Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level
brief_description: The scheme Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level was introduced by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support athletes representing the state in various sports disciplines at the national level by providing them with sports kits.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. sports kits are provided through sports associations to players and team members participating in various sports disciplines at the national level across different age groups. - Approximately 1Rs. players benefit from the scheme annually.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a player or a member of a team representing Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant or their team must be participating in national-level sports competitions.

name: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
brief_description: The scheme One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance/annuity is provided to serving or ex-servicemen who have been conferred with the Gallantry Medal Award. In the event of martyrdom or death of the soldierRs. the grant is extended to the eligible family members or dependents.
benefits: - A one time grant of maximum of 50Rs./- and minimum 4Rs./- is given. - Annual financial assistance of a maximum of 3Rs./- and a minimum of 40Rs./- is given.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a serving soldierRs. an ex-servicemanRs. or in the event of martyrdom/death of the soldierRs. an eligible dependent. 1. The soldier must have been conferred with a Gallantry Medal Award. 1. In case of martyrdom or death of the soldierRs. the following dependents are eligible to apply: - Veer Nari (lifelong or until remarriage) - Son (up to 25 years of age) / Daughter (till marriage) - Parents - Unmarried sisters - Brother (up to 25 years of age)

name: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award
brief_description: The scheme One-Time Grant to Soldiers Conferred with the Vishisht Seva Medal Award is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance/grant is provided to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state who have been conferred with the 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'.
benefits: - A one-time grant ranging from a minimum of 75Rs./- to a maximum of 2Rs./- is given to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a serving soldier or an ex-serviceman of the state who has been conferred with the 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'.

name: Housing Assistance Grant
brief_description: The "Housing Assistance Grant" scheme is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial support to widows/dependents of soldiers martyred in wars and border clashesRs. as well as to war-disabled retired soldiers. Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time grant for the construction or repair of a house during their lifetime.
benefits: - A one-time grant of 2Rs./- for the construction/ repair of the house.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must be either: - A widow or dependent of a soldier martyred in a war or border clashRs. or - A war-disabled retired soldier. 3. The grant is provided only once in a lifetime for the purpose of building construction or repair.

name: Samudayik Sahbhagita
brief_description: The Samudayik Sahbhagita schemeRs. under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. is implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote public participation in education by forming SMC/SMDC in all government schools to actively engage the community in educational activities.
benefits: - SMC/SMDC are formed in all government schools to actively involve the community in education. - The scheme provides awards and certificates of appreciation to community members who demonstrate excellence in the field of education. - The Sapno Ki Udaan program promotes innovative and outstanding work in education to the public.
eligibility: 1. The members of the local community shall be eligible under this scheme. 1. SMC/SMDC are formed in all government schools to actively involve the community in education. 1. The regular training programs for SMC/SMDC members are conducted by the DIET. 1. Under Samudayik SahbhagitaRs. outstanding and innovative work in the field of education is promoted through documentary filmsRs. bannersRs. flexesRs. and radio broadcasts.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste)
brief_description: The Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. launched the "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste)" scheme. It aims to promote self-employment and income generation among Scheduled Caste individuals by supporting small businesses and livelihood projects. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of bank loansRs. margin moneyRs. and grants is provided to the beneficiaries for projects ranging from 50Rs./- to 2Rs./-.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - Project Cost Limit: 50Rs./- to 2Rs./- - Bank Loan: 60% of the project cost - Margin Money: 30% of the project cost (payable with applicable interest over 60 monthly installments) - Grant: Maximum of 10Rs./- > **Beneficiary Contribution:** - No contribution for project cost up to 1Rs./- - 10% contribution for project cost between 1Rs./- and 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicants age must be between 18 and 50 years.
1. The applicants annual income must not exceed 1Rs./- for rural areas and 1Rs./- for urban areas.

name: Smt. Bimla Rani Memorial Award (B.Sc. Ag., B.V.Sc. & A.H., B.H.Sc. & B.F.Sc.)
brief_description: The Smt. Bimla Rani Memorial Award (B.Sc. Ag.Rs. B.V.Sc. & A.H.Rs. B.H.Sc. & B.F.Sc.) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and encourage meritorious students pursuing Bachelor of Science in Agriculture (B.Sc. Ag.)Rs. Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.)Rs. Bachelor of Home Science (B.H.Sc.)Rs. and Bachelor of Fisheries Science (B.F.Sc.) courses.
benefits: **Award Amount:** 12Rs./- per year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the Bachelor of Science in Agriculture (B.Sc. Ag.)Rs. Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.)Rs. Bachelor of Home Science (B.H.Sc.)Rs. or Bachelor of Fisheries Science (B.F.Sc.) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The award amount is granted for a duration of one year only.

name: Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Gold Medal Award (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student)
brief_description: The Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Gold Medal Award (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. Agriculture course in their final year of studyRs. thereby recognizing their academic excellence and providing financial support to reduce their burden.
benefits: **Award Amount:** 25Rs./- per year per student.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the final year of the B.Sc. Agriculture course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The award is granted for a duration of one year only.

name: Free Legal Aid under the Legal Services Authority Act 1987
brief_description: The scheme Free Legal Aid under the Legal Services Authority ActRs. 1987 has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. NainitalRs. under the Department of LawRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free legal aid to all eligible persons in Uttarakhand who intend to file a caseRs. have already filed a caseRs. or need to defend a case under the provisions of the Legal Services Authority ActRs. 1987.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. eligible persons who intend to file a caseRs. have already filed a caseRs. or need to defend a case shall be entitled to receive free legal services from the State AuthorityRs. the High Court Legal Services CommitteeRs. the District Legal Services AuthorityRs. or the Taluk Legal Services CommitteeRs. as the case may be under the Act.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand state. 1. The following persons shall be eligible for free legal aid: - All citizens belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST). - Persons subjected to human traffickingRs. abuseRs. or forced labourRs. as defined under Article 23 of the Constitution of India. - All women and children. - All persons with disabilities and persons with mental illness. - Persons affected by natural calamities or disastersRs. including mass destructionRs. caste violenceRs. caste atrocitiesRs. floodsRs. earthquakesRs. industrial disastersRs. etc. - All workers employed in the industrial sector. - All persons detained in jailRs. prisonRs. protection homesRs. juvenile homesRs. psychiatric hospitalsRs. or nursing homes. - Ex-servicemen. - Persons belonging to the transgender community. - Senior citizens. - Persons infected with HIV/AIDS. - All other persons whose annual income from all sources is less than 3Rs./-. > _Note: There is no income limit for persons mentioned in serial numbers 1 to 11._

name: State Millet Mission
brief_description: The State Millet Mission launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. aims to promote millet cultivationRs. ensure fair prices for farmersRs. and strengthen food security in the state. The mission seeks to support farmersRs. particularly in mountain districtsRs. by procuring millet crops like Mandua and Jhangora at the minimum support price through cooperative groups.
benefits: - Under the missionRs. in the first phaseRs. 16Rs. metric tonnes of Mandua and Jhangora are being purchased from farmers fields at the minimum support price through cooperative groups by the Cooperative Department. - Under the National Food Security ActRs. the Government of India will distribute 1 kilogram per month through the Public Distribution System (ration card) via the Food and Supplies Department in four districts: Udham Singh NagarRs. HaridwarRs. NainitalRs. and Dehradun. Farmers groupsRs. LCs/LCFsRs. or PACS at established procurement centers are free to offer Mandua for sale. To encourage participationRs. an incentive of 150/- per quintal is provided. - Once the PACS accepts the millet crops from the groupsRs. payment will be made through RTGS/NEFT within a maximum of 72 hours.
eligibility: 1. All farmers from the mountain districts of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Deserted Women Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Deserted Women Pension Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to deserted married womenRs. mentally ill deserted husbands or wivesRs. and destitute unmarried women above 40 years of age residing in the state.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 1Rs./- per month.- **For Mentally Disabled ill Husband/Wife:** 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicants family monthly income must not exceed 4Rs./- or the applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant should fall into one of the following categories: - An abandoned/deserted married womanRs. or - A mentally ill deserted husband or wifeRs. or - A destitute unmarried woman aged above 40 years. ***For abandoned/deserted married women:*** - Marriage duration must be more than 1 year. - Husband must have been missing/absent for more than 1 year or must have deserted her. - A self-declaration regarding desertion must be certified by the Gram Pradhan/Ward Member. ***For mentally ill deserted husbands/wives:*** - Must submit a disability certificate from a government hospital certifying the inability to earn a livelihood due to mental disability. ***For destitute unmarried women:*** - Must be above 40 years of age. - Pension will be discontinued if the woman gets married.

name: Allotment of Shops in Kisan Bazaar
brief_description: The scheme Allotment of Shops in Kisan Bazaar is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to facilitate trade in products other than agricultural produce by providing commercial shops in Kisan Bazaars.
benefits: The scheme facilitates trade in products other than agricultural produce by allotting shops in the Kisan Bazaars to eligible residents of Uttarakhand.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund
brief_description: The scheme "Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund" was launched by the Department of Women Empowerment and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Anganwadi workers/mini workers/assistants of the state upon attaining the superannuation age of 60 years.
benefits: - A minimum amount of 30Rs./- will be provided. - Upon completing 20 years of serviceRs. 1Rs./- will be provided. **Note**: There is a provision for a 5% annual increase on the deposited amount.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an Anganwadi woman worker/mini worker/assistant working on an honorarium basis. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.

name: Free Blood to Patients - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Free Blood to Patients is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure the availability of blood free of cost to all patients admitted in government hospitals across the state.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. free blood is provided to all patients admitted to government hospitals.
eligibility: 1. All patients admitted to government hospitals in Uttarakhand who require blood are eligible.

name: Umbrella Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Umbrella Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free umbrellas to registered construction workers to protect them from rain and sunlight.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. an umbrella will be provided to registered construction workers to protect them from rain and sunlight.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Disability Pension (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Disability Pension scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to registered construction workers who have become permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosisRs. accidentsRs. etc.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 1Rs./- per month - **One-time Ex-gratia Amount:** 40Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who has become permanently disabled due to paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosisRs. accidentRs. etc.

name: Grant for the Marriage of Daughter of Destitute Widow
brief_description: The scheme "Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Destitute Widow" has been implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of up to two daughters of destitute widows who are receiving widow pension from the State Government.
benefits: **Grant Amount:** 50Rs./- per daughterRs. for the marriage of up to two daughters.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a destitute widow. 1. The widow must be receiving widow pension. 1. The familys total monthly income from all sources must not exceed 4Rs./-Rs. or the family must belong to the BPL category. 1. At the time of marriageRs. the brides age must be between 18 and 45 years. 1. At the time of marriageRs. the grooms age must be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The grant is applicable for the marriage of up to two daughters. **Note:** The Social Welfare Department verifies whether the widow is receiving widow pension or not.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization is implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage farm mechanization by providing financial assistance/subsidy to farmers for purchasing modern farm equipment. This initiative particularly focuses on supporting smallRs. marginalRs. SC/STRs. and women farmers by making advanced agricultural machinery accessible and affordable to them.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. all farmers of the state are eligible to receive financial assistance for the purchase of modern agricultural equipment for farming. A 50% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to SC/STRs. small and marginalRs. and women farmers (of all categories)Rs. while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers. The details are as follows: **Sl.
