SC/ST farmersRs. small and marginal farmersRs. and women farmers (of all castes) are eligible for 50% financial assistance under the schemeRs. while 40% subsidy/financial assistance is provided to other (large) farmers. 1. The name of the applicant farmer must be recorded in the revenue records of the cultivable land owned or cultivated by them.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE)
brief_description: The scheme Sub-Mission on Agricultural Extension is implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the adoption of modern and scientific farming practices among farmers across the state through continuous trainingRs. practical demonstrationsRs. and exposure visits.
benefits: Farmers are periodically trained in modern agricultural practices. Agricultural exhibitionsRs. fairsRs. and farmer seminars are organizedRs. and farmers are also taken on exposure visits to enhance their knowledge and skills. AdditionallyRs. farmerscientist interactions are conducted to facilitate the exchange of ideas and innovations. **Farm School:** Free seedsRs. fertilizersRs. and chemicals are provided to farmers for demonstration purposesRs. and training is imparted to a group of 30 farmers at each Farm School. **Progressive farmers who demonstrate excellence and innovation in agriculture are recognized and rewarded. Along with a certificateRs. the following cash awards are given:** - Block Level: 10Rs. Kisan Shri - District Level: 25Rs. Kisan Bhushan - State Level: 50Rs. Kisan Ratna
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must have cultivable land. 1. The farmers name must be duly registered in the relevant land records.

name: Merit Scholarship (Top 3 UG Students)
brief_description: The Merit Scholarship (Top 3 UG Students) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize and support academically outstanding undergraduate students by providing monthly financial assistance in the form of scholarships to students in their 3rd year of Medical and 4th year of Veterinary undergraduate (UG) programs.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** 800/- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 3rd year of the Medical or 4th year of the Veterinary undergraduate (UG) program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana is implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote organic farming among Uttarakhand farmers by providing financial support for purchasing organic inputs.
benefits: This scheme promotes organic farming by providing farmers with an incentive of 9Rs./- per hectare for purchasing organic inputs such as seedsRs. compostRs. green manureRs. biofertilizersRs. biopesticidesRs. neem oilRs. PROMRs. Burmese compostRs. waste decomposersRs. and other materials required for organic farming.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must own agricultural land within the state. 1. The farmers name must be recorded in the land revenue records.

name: Flower Area Expansion
brief_description: The Flower Area Expansion scheme is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote and expand flower cultivation by providing cultivators in Uttarakhand access to quality flower planting material at a subsidized costRs. thereby increasing flower production and enhancing farmers income.
benefits: To encourage flower productionRs. flower planting material (bulbsRs. plantsRs. and seeds) is provided to cultivators at a 50% subsidy on the total costRs. applicable for a maximum area of 4 hectaresRs. as follows: - For open flowersRs. planting material worth up to 20Rs./- per hectare is provided. - For stalked flowersRs. planting material worth up to 50Rs./- per hectare is provided. - For bulbous flowersRs. planting material worth up to 75Rs./- per hectare is provided. (For exampleRs. if 1 kg of marigold seeds costs 200/-Rs. the cultivator pays 100/- at the Horticulture Mobile team CenterRs. while the government provides a subsidy of 100/-Rs. allowing the cultivator to obtain the seeds for 100/-.)
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.

name: Fruit Area Expansion
brief_description: The scheme Fruit Area Expansion is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to increase fruit production by encouraging farmers to establish new orchardsRs. providing fruit plants at a 50% subsidy to support the expansion of fruit cultivation across Uttarakhand.
benefits: - Increasing production by establishing new orchards. - Fruit plants are provided at a subsidy of 50% of the total cost. - For developing orchardsRs. fruit plants such as mangoRs. guavaRs. pomegranateRs. appleRs. litchiRs. plumRs. peachRs. apricotRs. walnutRs. citrusRs. maltaRs. kiwiRs. dragon fruitRs. etc.Rs. are provided to farmers. (For exampleRs. if a walnut plant costs 400/-Rs. the farmer has to deposit 200/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team CentreRs. and the government bears the remaining 200/- as subsidyRs. so the farmer receives the plant for 200/-.)
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. If the farmer owns landRs. the maximum land allowed per beneficiary is 4 hectares and the minimum land allowed is 0.02 hectares. 1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 4 hectares.

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Adolescent Girls Nutrition
brief_description: The Adolescent Girls Nutrition scheme is a component of the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to enhance nutritional support for all adolescent girls aged 15 -19 years across the state. HoweverRs. in the 10 Aspirational DistrictsRs. the coverage is limited to girls aged 18 - 19 years. The scheme has been implemented for a five-year periodRs. commencing from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28.
benefits: - **Supplementary Nutrition:** Since adolescence is a period of growth spurtRs. nutritional requirement during the period is at its peak. Nutritional interventions at this stage would help in ensuring proper growthRs. addressing anaemia and ensure better outcomes during pregnancy and childbirth at a later stage. - **Daily Ration Cost:** 9.50/- per beneficiary per day for 300 days a year. - **Weekly Nutrition Supplements for Adolescent Girls (15-19 years):** The following items as Take Home Ration (THR) will be given to the Adolescent Girls (15-19 years) under this scheme for 300 days per year. **Sl. No****Type of Take Home Ration****Monthly Quantity**1Eggs16 Pieces2Roasted Chana1.5 kg3Paushtik Bhel (Bengal Gram or Chana is to be roasted and mixed in the Bhel or Mudhi)1.0 kg**Date of delivery:** All items will be provided to the beneficiaries at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) on the 1st of every month.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be an adolescent girl. 1. In the 10 Aspirational districts (BolangirRs. DhenkanalRs. GajapatiRs. KalahandiRs. KandhamalRs. KoraputRs. MalkangiriRs. NabarangpurRs. NuapadaRs. Rayagada)Rs. girls aged 18-19 years shall be included under the MSPY scheme as the adolescent girls in the 14 -18 years category are enrolled in the Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG) of Government of India. 1. In the Non-Aspirational districtsRs. all Adolescent Girls (15 -19 years) in the service area of the Anganwadi Centres (AWCs) shall be provided with Take Home Ration under MSPY. 1. Anganwadi Workers (AWWs) will prepare a line listing of the Adolescent girls (15 -19 years) in the service area and enroll the girls under the Programme.

name: Pada Pushti Karyakram
brief_description: The Pada Pushti Karyakram (PPK) has been launched by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of OdishaRs. to ensure access to supplementary nutrition by all childrenRs. residing in hard-to-reach villages where there is no Anganwadi centers. As part of this programme preschool children aged 3-6 years residing in hard-to-reach villages and currently not accessing the spot feeding programme that runs at the Anganwadi center shall be provided with both morning snacks and hot cook meals at their village location. The Pada Pushti Karyakram is functioning as an extension of respective Anganwadi Centers (AWCs) in the hard-to-reach villages. ***Objectives:*** The primary objective of Pada Pushti Karyakram are as follows: - **Improve access to entitlement:** To ensure that that all preschool children aged 3-6 years in the hard-to-reach villages have access to mandated Supplementary Nutrition entitlements. - **Increased uptake and utilization:** To improve coverage and utilization of ICDS services among children of nutritionally vulnerable communities. - **Community Participation:** To enhance awareness among mothers and community members on nutrition services and promote proper maternal and child nutrition practices in hard-toreach villages. ***Identification of hard-to-reach villages:*** The following criteria shall be followed for identification of villages for hard-to-reach villages for this programm - The pada/village that does not have its own Anganwadi Center and located more than two kilometers from the tagged center and there is geographic barrier for communication. - Forest villages not having an Anganwadi Center. - There should be at least 5 or more children between the age group of 3 years to 6 years to run Pada Pusti Karyakram. In case the number of children comes down below 5Rs. the program would be discontinued in that village and may be moved to another village.
benefits: ***Entitlements for children under Pada Pusti Karyakram:***__ The menu will be part of regular Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP) under ICDS for Anganwadi centers in Odisha and children of aged 3-6 years will be fed as per the government norm prescribed for spot feeding at Anganwadi Centre (AWC) for all six days in a week and minimum 300 days in a year. ***Growth monitoring of children of Pada Pusti Karyakram village at Anganwadi Centre:*** - Growth Monitoring of all children shall be done at the Anganwadi Centre every month as per the usual practice. - The ageRs. weight and height/length will be measured and recorded through Poshan Tracker and in other registers maintained by the Anganwadi worker. - The Anganwadi Workers in consultation with ICDS supervisor shall fix a day in a month to visit the respective pada/village with all growth monitoring devises and take the measurements of all children. ***Incentive for Pushti Sakhi:*** - Pushti Sakhi will be given a monthly lumpsum incentive of 1Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 3 and 6 years. 1. The beneficiary must be residing in an identified hard-to-reach village where no Anganwadi Centre is available.

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Kishori Mela
brief_description: The Kishori Mela is an initiative under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The initiative aims to make Kishori Diwas more engaging and eventful. Any Saturday in the month of January may be celebrated as Kishori MelaRs. with increased participation and a range of activities for all adolescent girls aged 15 - 19 years. The key objective of observing Kishori Mela is: - To reach out to the adolescent girls with varied health & nutrition services. - Create community level nutrition champions who with proper stimulus and motivationRs. may be effectively used as protagonists. - Act as a platform for showcasing the talent of the girls. Their potential needs to be tapped and leveraged for propagating and taking ahead the messages to their own peer groups as well as to key stakeholders.
benefits: **The following activities may be undertaken during the event:** - Administration of weekly IFA tablet and egg. - Screening of nutritionally at-risk adolescent girls (BMI checkup). - Screening for anaemia status (haemoglobin testing). - Counselling and referrals. The One Stop Centre Counsellors & State Social Welfare Board Counsellors maybe roped in for the purpose alongwith Health Counsellors. - IEC/SBCC activities through Tiki mausi and Kishori resources. - Identification of girls & boys for linkage with skill development programmes. - Cultural Programmes/ Speaking events/ Exhibitions by both adolescent girls & boys. - Boys & men to be encouraged to come forwardRs. support & participate in the event. This is highly desirable under the Departments initiative of roping in men & boys to come forward to fight against malnutrition (# menstreaming). - The event shall also be utilized for generation of Aadhaar numbers/ opening of bank accounts/ generation of birth certificates.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be an adolescent girl aged between 15 and 19 years.

name: Grant for Marriage of Daughters of Scheduled Caste Individuals
brief_description: The scheme "Grant for Marriage of the Daughter of a Scheduled Caste Individual" has been implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste families to help cover the marriage expenses of up to two daughters.
benefits: **Grant Amount:** 50Rs./- per daughterRs. for the marriage of up to two daughters.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 3. The familys total monthly income from all sources must not exceed 4Rs./-Rs. or the family must belong to the BPL category. 4. At the time of marriageRs. the brides age must be between 18 and 45 years. 5. At the time of marriageRs. the grooms age must be between 21 and 45 years. 6. The grant is applicable for the marriage of up to two daughters.

name: Manav Garima Yojana DCW (Minority)
brief_description: The "Manav Garima Yojana DCW (Minority)" scheme is launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to help minority community members start their own small businesses and live a dignified life through self-employment. Through this schemeRs. business tool kits are provided to minority beneficiaries so that they can undertake various small-scale business activities.
benefits: 1. The primary benefit is the provision of various business tool-kits to eligible beneficiaries so that they can engage in small business activities and become self-employed and financially self-sufficient. 1. The tool kits are given under the scheme targeted at the minority community.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the minority community. - The applicants family annual income should be 6Rs./- or less in general.

name: H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme **H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme**" for Govt. Schools was launched by the Department of Elementary EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh for students studying in Class V is meant to identify the talent and nurture it at an early stage. The meritorious students for the award of benefits under the scheme will be selected through a state-level examination. The examination will be conducted every year at the state level by the SCERTRs. Solan (H.P.). A total of 100 scholarships can be distributed among twelve districts of the StateRs. determining the district quota based on an average of the last three years' enrollment in class five (as per UDISE data of the latest three years) of the Government Schools in the State. The main objective of this scheme is to select Top 100 Students for scholarship after passing class Vth.

- **Important Dates:**
Tentative dates for submission of the application form and conduct of examination etc. are given below:
**Sl. No.****Important Dates****Date**1Date of advertisement for the examinationWill be fixed by SCERT2Date of applying for creation of login ID of Primary Schools for the examinationWill be fixed by SCERT3Last Date of SubmissionWill be fixed by SCERT4Date of Issuing of Roll NumberWill be fixed by SCERT5Date of ExaminationFirst Sunday of the month of November 6Declaration of ResultIn the month of December
- **The pattern of Examination:**
The state-level examination will comprise one test of 100 marks consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions of one mark each. The question paper will cover mental ability testsRs. scholastic aptitude testsRs. and language tests with the following distribution of marks:
**Sl. No.****Question Paper****Number of Questions**1Mental Ability test40 questions2Environment Science Scholastic Aptitude Test20 questions3Mathematics20 questions4Language TestHindi10 questionsEnglish10 questions
- **Mental Ability Test:**
It will be for testing verbal and non-verbal Metacognitive abilities like reasoning and critical thinking. The question in the test may be on analogyRs. classificationRs. numerical seriesRs. pattern perceptionRs. hidden figuresRs. etc.

- **Scholastic Aptitude Test:**
It will cover subjects mainly Mathematics & Environment Science as taught up to 5th Class in the Govt. Schools of the State.

- **Language Test:**
It will test the general understanding of Hindi and English language according to the curriculum of Class 1 to Class 5 of the Govt. Primary Schools in Himachal Pradesh.

- **Duration of Examination:**

The test will be of two & half hours (150 minutes) in duration. Children with a disability may be given half an hour of extra time.

- **Process of examination:**
The centers of examinationRs. important datesRs. and other details regarding the examination for the scholarship scheme will be notified through advertisements in daily newspapers. The information will also be available on the official website of SCERTRs. Solan (H.P.). SCERT will prepare and print the question paper and OMR sheets for the examination.
**Note:** There will be no negative marking in the examination.
benefits:
The selected students may be eligible for the scholarship as given below:
Scholarship Amount 4000/- per month (for 12 monthsRs. in 6th class)Scholarship Amount 5000/- per month (for 12 monthsRs. in 7th class)Scholarship Amount 6000/- per month (for 12 monthsRs. in 8th class)**Note:** The period of the scholarship shall be for three years (Class 6th to Class 8th).
eligibility:
1. All the students studying in Class 5th as regular students in the Government Schools are eligible to apply for the State Level examination to be conducted by the SCERTRs. Solan (H.P.).

**Note 01:** The student must continue to study in the Government School of H.P. Govt. without repeating any class for continuity of scholarship.
**Note 02:** It would be mandatory for the student to have at least 75% attendance during the session for which he/she is to be awarded the Scholarship.
**Note 03**: In genuine cases of acute illness or any medical exigencyRs. subject to verification by the Medical BoardRs. a condition of 75% attendance will not be applicable.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Training of Tribal Trainees - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Training of Tribal Trainees is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide training to Scheduled Tribe individuals involved in inland fisheries to enhance their capacity and skill set. The training is conducted at tribal area training centres run by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. located in KhedbrahmaRs. KadanaRs. Chhota UdepurRs. RajpiplaRs. MadhubanRs. and Ukai. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: A trainee is paid a scholarship of 2Rs./- per month for three monthsRs. amounting to a total of 6Rs./-. > **Training Details** **Duration:** 3 months **Location:** Tribal area training centers run by the Fisheries Department at KhedbrahmaRs. KadanaRs. Chhota UdepurRs. RajpiplaRs. MadhubanRs. and Ukai. **Conditions for Receiving Benefits:** A trainee is eligible for the scholarship only if they maintain a minimum of 60% attendance during the training period. **Validity:** The benefit is available once in a lifetime for each eligible trainee.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private unitsRs. etc.Rs. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.

name: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Marriage Incentives & Support
brief_description: The scheme "Marriage Incentives & Support" is a component of the Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons schemeRs. implemented by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the Cured Leprosy Persons who face social and economic challenges in arranging marriages for their daughters.
benefits: **Financial Support:** A one-time grant of up to 50Rs./- for the marriage of daughters of Cured Leprosy Persons.
eligibility:
- The applicant is a bonafide resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Cured Leprosy Person.
- The applicants daughter should be unmarried.

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for ITI Level
brief_description: The scheme Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for ITI Level was started by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. The objective of awarding this scholarship is two-foldRs. firstly to improve the quality of training by attracting promising trainees belonging to Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. and Other Backward ClassesRs. who otherwise would not be in a position to pursue training due to financial constraints and secondly to popularize technical training among these categoriesRs. so as to make them able to earn their livelihood respectably and honourably.
benefits: 1. The scholarships shall be paid at the rate of 250/- per month per trainee subject to the condition that the corresponding decrease shall be affected in the rate of scholarship if the trainees receive a stipend from any other department of the Government or any organization.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. or Other Backward Class (OBC) as notified by the Himachal Pradesh State Government. 1. The applicant should be a bonafide Himachali. 1. The applicant should be studying in a Government or Government-recognized Industrial Training Institute (I.T.I.) or I.T.I. for Women in Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be pursuing technical training and require financial assistance to continue the course.

name: Car Loan Scheme
brief_description: The "Car Loan Scheme" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist the employees of the Government of Puducherry & Employees of the Government of Puducherry undertaking for the purchase of a new car for personal use. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** 70% of the cost of the vehicle. **Security:** Immovable property situated in the UT of Puducherry to the extent of 100% of the loan amount.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the employees of the Government of Puducherry & Employees of the Government of Puducherry undertaking.

name: Additional Subsidy to Establish Tourism Projects in Distant and New Ulterior Areas
brief_description: The scheme "Additional Subsidy to Establish Tourism Projects in Distant and New Ulterior Areas" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote the development of tourism infrastructure in remoteRs. accessibleRs. and less developed regions of the state by offering enhanced financial incentives. The scheme provides an additional 5% Capital Investment Subsidy on top of standard policy ratesRs. removes the maximum ceiling on subsidy amountsRs. and significantly relaxes the minimum investment and room count requirements for eligible projects. The applicant must establish a tourism project in a location specifically classified as a "distant" or "ulterior" area by the Tourism Department. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism BoardRs. and applications for this scheme are accepted through the state's investment portal.
benefits: - **Additional Subsidy:** An additional 5% Capital Investment Subsidy is provided on top of the standard subsidy percentage applicable to the project.- **No Cap on Subsidy:** There is no upper limit (ceiling) on the maximum amount of capital subsidy that can be claimed under this scheme.- **Reduced Investment Requirement:** The minimum capital investment limit required to be eligible is reduced to 50% of the prescribed limit mentioned in the Tourism Policy for the specific project type.- **Reduced Capacity Requirement:** The ceiling for the number of rooms required is reduced to 50% of the standard requirement mentioned in the Tourism Policy.
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a Tourism Project (e.g.Rs. HotelRs. ResortRs. etc.) as defined in the Tourism Policy. - The applicant must locate the project in an area classified as "distant" or "new ulterior" by the Government of Madhya PradeshRs. Tourism Department. - The applicant must meet a minimum investment limit of at least 50% of the prescribed limit mentioned in the standard Tourism Policy for that project category. - The applicant must ensure the project meets at least 50% of the room capacity ceiling prescribed in the standard Tourism Policy. - The applicant must ensure the project is established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy.

name: Berojgari Bhatta Yojna
brief_description:
**Objectives**
The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance in the form of unemployment allowance to the educated youth of the state who are searching for employment. This scheme helps those who are educated and talented but cannot generate enough income to apply for government jobs or other jobs due to the financial crisis.
benefits: **Benefits** 1. The government will provide financial assistance of Rupees 1Rs. to Rupees 1Rs. till the time youths get desired job. 1. Private and government jobs are available on one portal. 1. Online application facility. 1. Facility to search jobs by categoryRs. locationRs. departmentRs. and salary.
eligibility: **Eligibility** 1. The candidate must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh. 1. Candidates must have passed at-least 10th standard (High School) examinations. 1. The candidate must be currently unemployed i.e he must not be not working in any private or government job. 1. MoreoverRs. all the applicants must lie in the age group between 21-35 years. 1. The total family income of the candidates from all sources must not exceed Rupees 3 lahks per annum.

name: State Disability Scholarship (Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities)
brief_description: The scheme State Disability Scholarship was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Nagaland to provide financial assistance to students from Class I to Class VIII who have a disability of 40% and above.
benefits:
- The physically disabled students from Class I to Class VIII are provided with scholarships ranging from 200/-.

**Note:** The amount of scholarships may vary as per guidelines of the Government of Nagaland.
eligibility:
A student should fulfill the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

1. Scholarship for Persons with Disability will be applicable for all the inhabitants of Nagaland.
1. The applicant should be from an Institution which has a valid AISHE/UDISE Code.
1. The annual income of the applicants parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed 2.50 lakhs.
1. Disabled Students should have the benchmark disability (40% and above) to be admissible under this scheme.
1. Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities will be applicable from Class I to Class VIII.
1. Students who have failed in their last examination (repeaters) are not eligible to apply.
1. Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme.
1. Scholarship will be provided to all types of disabilities as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017.

name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners
brief_description: The scheme Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. There are many persons imprisonedRs. some for known reasons and others for unknown reasons. Once they are lodged in jail their families that are suffering the most. They get ostracized from society. Due to the lack of moneyRs. their children might be denied education at a very early age itself. This might have huge repercussions later it may lead to the birth of new criminals in society. ThereforeRs. the government has initiated such a scheme that aims at bringing these people to the mainstream of society.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. scholarship/financial assistance will be provided to the children of prisoners for their expenses like foodRs. clothingRs. school feesRs. etc. as under:

**Sl. No.****Classes/Courses****Amount of Scholarship/Financial Assistance**11st Std. to 5th Std.500/- per month26th Std. to 10th Std.750/- per month3+1 (Plus one) & +2 (Plus two)1000/- per month4Degree/Professional Course1500/- per monthNote: Degree/ Professional course must be in Government/ Aided colleges inside Kerala.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
2. The applicants should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
3. The applicants should be studying in Class- I to Degree/Professional Course.
4. The applicants (Children of Prisoners) whose parents are in jail are eligible to apply under the scheme.
**Note:** Financial aid can be provided to the children even though the relativesRs. who are liable to protect them and falls under the Above Poverty Line (APL) categoryRs. provided both the parents are in jailRs. for that an inquiry report of the District Probation Officer is essential.

name: State Medical Scholarship (Scholarship Scheme for MBBS & Allied Courses, Nursing and Paramedical Students)
brief_description: The State Medical Scholarship is a scholarship schemeRs. launched by the Department of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of Nagaland. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to students who are pursuing MBBS & Allied CoursesRs. Nursing and Paramedical courses.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. financial assistance/scholarships will be provided to students according to the course/programme in which they are enrolled.
eligibility:
A student should fulfill the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

1. The applicant/student should be an inhabitant of Nagaland.
1. Students selected through NEET/NSEE/State Departmental Examination only and undergoing medicalRs. nursing and paramedical courses shall be eligible to apply.
1. Students failing to complete their curriculum within the specified duration of the course (repeaters) shall not be entitled to an additional stipend.

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Degree Level
brief_description:
The scheme Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for Degree Level has been started by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. scholarships have been awarded to students pursuing P.G. courses and degree-level courses in Engineering/TechnologyRs. including Architecture or any other equivalent course approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
Number of Scholarships: The total number of scholarships for P.G. and degree-level courses has been fixed at 175.
benefits:
1. The value of the scholarship for General Category students shall be 300/- per month.
1. The value of the scholarship for SC/ST students shall be 500/- per month.

**Note 01:** 100% Scholarships shall be awarded to the SC and ST Students in P.G./Degree Courses.
**Note 02:** All students belonging to Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe and those belonging to BPL families studying in Post Graduate degree and other coursesRs. shall get the scholarship and it will be over and above the sanctioned scholarships for these categories.
eligibility:
1. Only those students shall be eligible for the award of scholarships who are Bonafide Himachali and ward of Himachal Pradesh Government employees.
1. The Scholarships will be awarded to those students who are pursuing the P.G. Courses /Degree level Courses in Engineering /Technology including Architecture or any other equivalent course approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
1. The Scholarship shall be awarded only if the total income of parents or guardians from all the sources is not more than 36000/- per annum.

**Note 01:** The Scholarship shall be awarded on the basis of (i) Poverty-cum-Brilliance and (ii) Brilliance.
**Note 02:** The Scholarship shall be awarded strictly according to merit to be determined with reference to (i) Income of parents or guardian and (ii) Marks obtained in the Examination/Class by virtue of which a candidate is eligible for admission provided the students has Secured at least 60% of marks in the said exam. This condition will however not be applicable to the SC and ST Students.
**Note 03:** The students who become eligible for scholarships on the basis of poverty-cum-brilliance shall first be awarded scholarships. After their list is exhaustedRs. the remaining scholarships shall be awarded on the basis of brilliance.
**Note 04:** The Scholarship shall be tenable for the full course from the date of joining for the duration of the course and shall be awarded/renewed on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory progress of the student and continued good conduct.
**Note 05:** The recommendation of the Principal or other authorized officer of the institute where the student is studying will be necessary for the award/renewal of the scholarship.
**Note 06:** If the student fails in a university examination or in the Polytechnic examination or any examinations or tests while undergoing the course which prevents him/her from being promoted to the next higher classRs. the scholarship shall be discontinued. HoweverRs. two failures will not result in an extension in the total period of the course.
**Note 07:** The students who are not awarded a scholarship from the date of joining of courses i.e. in the first year can also be considered for award of scholarships in subsequent years in case a number of scholarships is available due to dropoutsRs. failure or otherwiseRs. in particularRs. the year shall not be exceeded.
**Note 08:** These scholarships shall be awarded on the basis of the performance of the previous annual examination they have passed in the Engineering course. Other conditions of award of fresh/renewal of scholarship will remain operative as at present in vogue.
**Note 09:** All students who are awarded scholarships under these rules shall be required to execute a bond to the effect that they will serve Himachal Pradesh for a period of at least five years after the completion of their course if their services are required by the State Government.

name: Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award
brief_description: The Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award (BYE) is a programme to promote commercialisation of bioscience ideas among graduate/postgraduate students in Biotechnology and to encourage them to develop biotechnology entrepreneurship. This is an annual competition organized along with a workshop. The participants will then develop a Business Plan which will be judged by a panel of experts.
benefits:
1. The winning teams will be given cash awards by the Kerala Biotechnology Commission.
1. Cash award for winners - first prize 1Rs./-Rs. second prize 50Rs./- and third prize 25Rs./-.
1. The awardees will be encouraged to establish start-ups through facilitation and support after evaluation and recommendation by an Expert Committee.
eligibility: 1. Students who are pursuing post-graduate programmes (including integrated PG degree programmes)Rs. doctoral degreesRs. B.E. or B.Tech. in Biotechnology or in the area of life sciences related to biotechnology (bioinformatics/Molecular biology/microbiology/biochemistry/Genetics and/or related subjects) from universities/Institutes in the State of Kerala are eligible to apply.

name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games for the Year
brief_description:
The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games for the Year is a category of award under the Biju Patnaik Sports Award" Scheme. The scheme was launched by the Sports & Youth Services DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha to commemorate the yeoman service of late Biju PatnaikRs. the ex-Chief Minister of OdishaRs. towards the development of Sports & Games in the State by conferring the highest honour of the Government of Odisha in the field of Sports in his name. The award is given to the sportspersons of Odisha who have achieved outstanding performance in any of the recognized sports during the year making the State of Odisha and India proud.
> **Objective:**

1. To encourage the development of Sports and Games in the State.
2. To honour meritorious sportspersons who have made the State Proud.
3. To inspire and motivate young talents to excel in sports and games by emulating the seniors.
**Sports Discipline:** The sports disciplines recognized by the International Olympic Committee (I.O.C.)Rs. Indian Olympic Association (I.O.A.)Rs. Government of India (G.O.I.)Rs. Sports Authority of India (S.A.I.) and Government of Odisha (G.O.O.) including Sports Event for Persons with Disability.
benefits:
1. The award shall be presented every year subject to the availability of a suitable candidateRs. which will carry a cash award of 2Rs./-.
1. A statueRs. a scroll of honourRs. and a blazer with a tie shall be given along with all the Cash Awards.
1. The Awardees shall be invited to receive the awards in person. They shall be given T.A. and D.A. at the rate admissible to a Grade 'A' Officer.

**Note 01:** Canvassing for the award in any form is prohibited.
**Note 02:** The award can also be given posthumously to the next of kin of the awardee.
**Note 03:** In case of selection of more than one person for an awardRs. the award money will be shared amongst the awardees.
**Note 04:** It will not be binding on the Department of Sports & Youth Services to confer the award every year. In case of non-availability of suitable persons for the awardRs. the award shall not be given for the respective year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the State of Odisha or shall be staying at least for a period not less than 07 years.
1. To be eligible for this awardRs. a sportsperson of Odisha must have achieved outstanding performance in any of the recognized sports during the year making the State of Odisha and India proud.
1. The applicant should not have been convicted of any criminal offence.
1. The award will be conferred on a person only once in his/her lifetimeRs. pertaining to the concerned category.
1. Persons found positive for use of drugs/banned substances for performance enhancementRs. will not be eligible for this Award.

**Note:** The award can be given posthumously to the next of kin of the selected sportsperson.
> **Annulment Cancellation of Award:**


- The Award may be cancelled in case it is found that it has been obtained by fraudulent means.
- In such eventRs. the concerned person shall be asked to refund the award failing which steps will be taken to recover the involved cost from him/her with simple interest @ 5% per annum.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students
brief_description: The scheme Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students was started by the Department of EducationRs. Himachal Pradesh. Under the schemeRs. the scholarship is given to the top 1250 meritorious students of the Scheduled Caste category after modification from the session 2018-19 declared as such in the result of the Matric Examination conducted by the H.P. Board of School EducationRs. DharamshalaRs. strictly on a merit basis to students studying in a recognized (including Professional/Technical) institution within or outside the State. The renewal in the 10+2 Class/2nd Year of course will be subject to satisfactory performance in internal examinations of the 10+1 Class/1st Year Course.
benefits: 1. Under this scholarship schemeRs. an amount of 18Rs./- will be given to each eligible student per year for two successive years after matric.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The student should belong to Scheduled Caste Category.
1. The scholarship will be given in case the eligible students take admission to any professional/technical course after Matric in a recognized Institution within or outside the state.

**Note 01:** The scholarship is limited for a maximum of two successive years after matric.
**Note 02:** The renewal in 2nd year of the course will be subject to satisfactory performance in 1st year of the course.

name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII)
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar IslandsRs. for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII) was started by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The objective of the scheme is to provide additional financial assistance (Scholarship) to the OBC students belonging to the non-creamy layer of Andaman & Nicobar Islands for pursuing higher education after Secondary (X)/Senior Secondary (XII)Rs. in Government-recognized Polytechnic/ITI/College/University anywhere in IndiaRs. as an incentive to supplement to the cost of their education.
> **Duration of Scholarship:**

The award of scholarship once sanctioned shall be tenable from the stage at which it is granted to the student till the completion of the courseRs. subject to good conduct and regularity in attendanceRs. as certified by the Head of the Institution.
> **Funding Pattern of the Scheme:**

The scheme shall be implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Andaman and Nicobar Administration through the funds made available under the Union Territory Plan.
benefits:
> **Value of Scholarship:**


1. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 1000/- per month shall be sanctioned to the eligible students belonging to the OBC category.

> **Payment and Mode of Disbursal of Scholarship:**


1. The scholarship shall be payable for a duration of ten months in an academic session.
1. The scholarship shall be admissible only to the passed-out students of the previous academic session. (e.g. A student after passing Class XI/Class XII will be eligible for a scholarship only after he/she completes 1st year of the higher education/professional course )
1. The scholarship amount shall be directly credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary by the Department of Social Welfare.
1. The award of a scholarship will depend upon the fund availability in a particular financial year.
eligibility:
1. The scholarship shall be open to students belonging to a non-creamy layer of OBC of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands listed in the Notification issued by the Andaman and Nicobar Administration dated 16th December 2005 and amendments therein.
1. Only those students who belong to OBCs so specified and notified in relation to Andaman and Nicobar Islands and are domicile of Andaman & Nicobar Islands and who have passed Secondary (Class X)/Senior Secondary (Class XII) from a recognized Board of School Education and pursuing higher education in a recognized Institution/University shall be eligible for award of this scholarship.
1. Only two children of the same parent/guardian shall be entitled to receive this scholarship. In case 2nd live birth is more than one child they all shall be eligible for the scholarship.
1. The scholarship shall be awarded for pursuing the below-mentioned higher educational and professional courses on a regular/full-time basis and Post-Secondary/Senior Secondary level (after Class X or XII) courses in any of the Government-recognized institutionsRs. anywhere in the countryRs. such as:


- All courses leading to a Degree of Graduation and Post-Graduation.
- M.PhilRs. Ph.D.Rs. and Post-Doctoral Programmes (D.Litt.Rs. D.Sc. etc.)
- Post-Doctoral Research in Medicine (AllopathyRs. Indian and other recognized systems of medicines)Rs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion Design and TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary and allied SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance/AdministrationRs. Computer Science/Applications etc.
- Post-Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of Management and medicineRs. Commercial Pilot License (including helicopter pilot and multiengine rating) courseRs. etc.
- C.A/I.C.W.A./C.S./I.C.F.A./ etc.
- Graduate/Post-Graduate Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. or Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B.Pharm)Rs. Nursing (B.Nursing)Rs. LLBRs. BFSRs. other Para-medical branches like Rehabilitation Diagnostics etc.Rs. Mass CommunicationRs. Hotel Management & CateringRs. Travel/Tourism/Hospitality ManagementRs. Interior DecorationRs. Nutrition & DieteticsRs. Commercial ArtRs. Financial ServicesRs. etc. (e.g. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. TaxationRs. etc.) for which educational qualification is minimum Sr. Secondary (10+2).
- Post Matriculation level non-degree courses for which educational qualification is Secondary Level (Class-X)Rs. for vocational streamRs. ITI courseRs. 3 years Diploma courses in PolytechnicRs. etc.
- Students pursuing Post-graduate courses in Medicine shall be eligible for this scholarship provided they are not allowed to practice during the period of their course.

**Note 01:** The scholarship shall be awarded on a year-to-year basis subject to passing the stage/year/semesters.
**Note 02:** A StudentRs. who fails to complete a particular full course for which he/she had been awarded this scholarship on a year-to-year basisRs. and joins any other recognized Professional or Technical/Certificate/Diploma/ Degree coursesRs. may be granted the scholarshipRs. but only for the period subsequent to the period to which they have already received the scholarship amount.
**Note 03:** If a student fails in a class for more than one year the scholarship for subsequent years will be stopped.
**Note 04:** If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statementRs. his/her scholarship shall be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the scholarship paid shall be recoveredRs. at the discretion of the sanctioning authority. The student concerned shall be blacklisted and debarred from applying for a scholarship under any scheme of the Department of Social WelfareRs. thereafter.
**Note 05:** A scholar is liable to refund the scholarship amount at the direction of the Andaman & Nicobar AdministrationRs. if during the course of the year the study for which the scholarship has been awardedRs. is discontinued by him/her.
> **Renewal of Scholarship:**


1. It will be renewed on a year-to-year basis provided that within a courseRs. which is continuous for a number of yearsRs. the scholar secures promotion to the next higher class.
1. If a scholar is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illness and /or on account of any other unforeseeable eventRs. the award may be renewed for the next academic year on submission of a medical certificate and /or other required sufficient proof with the recommendation of the Head of the Institution.
1. If according to the Regulations of a University/InstitutionRs. a student is promoted to the next level thenRs. he/she will be entitled to a scholarship for the class to which he /she is promoted provided the student is otherwise eligible for scholarship.

name: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-I
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-I (SPYTiS-I) is constituted for the purpose of providing financial and technical assistance to talented young students who have innovative ideas in scientific/technological pursuits. Under the schemeRs. students from schools will be selected every year to do a science projectRs. and selected students will be provided financial support for successfully completing the project.
The grant will be released to the Head of the institution in which the students are enrolled after successful completion of the workRs. subject to submission of signed terms and conditionsRs. final project reportRs. Statement of Expenditure (SERs.) and Utilization Certificate (UC). The grant shall be utilized only for the purpose for which it has been sanctioned. The awardees shall be requested to participate in a Science Talent FairRs. Children Science CongressRs. or Kerala Science Congress organized by the Kerala State Council for ScienceRs. Technology & Environment (KSCSTE) to present their projects/findings.
benefits:
1. Groups of a maximum of 5 students of Class VIII-XII from a school will be selected for financial assistance of up to 5Rs./- for doing a science project.
1. Financial assistance will be provided to the host school and the students have to work under the guidance/supervision of a teacher.
1. Awardees are encouraged to participate in the Science Talent FairRs. National Childrens Science CongressRs. or Kerala Science Congress organized by KSCSTE to present their projects/findings.
1. The duration of the project is one year.
eligibility:
1. The school students (maximum of 5 students per group) studying in Class VIII-XII of Kerala State can apply under the scheme.
**Note:** The maximum number of proposals to be forwarded from a school shall be limited as follows:
10 from a school
2 from a Principal Investigator/Teacher Supervisor from school

name: Mizoram Research Fellowship
brief_description: The "Mizoram Research Fellowship" is a fellowship scheme by the Higher & Technical Education Department of the Govt. of Mizoram. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to research workers and teachersRs. preferably below the age of 45 yearsRs. who have established their reputation for research OR have obtained a doctorate degree OR have published research work to their credit and have shown evidence of independent research work. The applicant should have secured at least 50% on average in the last university examination. The scheme is open to the bonafide permanent residents of Mizoram.
benefits: Financial Assistance to Research Workers and Teachers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a bonafide permanent residents of Mizoram.
1. The applicant must be prosecuting higher studies or research at a university/institution recognized/established by the law.
1. The applicant must not be guilty of misconduct or breach of discipline or participating in strikesRs. demonstrationsRs. picketingRs. and the like for unfair demands from any high-level authority.
1. (Unless otherwise relaxed by the awarding authority) The applicant must secure at least 50% on average in the last university examination.
1. The applicant must not be in receipt of any scholar or stipend except merit scholarshipRs. from any sources.

name: West Bengal Freeship Scheme
brief_description: The West Bengal Freeship Scheme (WBFS) has been introduced from the year 2011 by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of West Bengal. WBFS is for the under Graduate students level in Engineering & Technology/ Pharmacy/ Architecture programmes conducted by the self financing private Engineering and Technical Institutions of the State. The waiver is limited to the tuition fee for all the institutions concerned. All other fees except tuition fees will have to be borne by the beneficiary.
benefits: Benefits: Waiver for tuition fee.
eligibility:
1. Candidate must be domicile of the West Bengal.
1. Merit rank in State Level/NationaI Level Entrance Examination.
1. Annual family income of the candidate must not be more than 2Rs. /-.

name: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme
brief_description:
Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme aims to ensure that girl students continue their education beyond the primary level by promoting enrolment and reducing dropout rates at the senior secondary and higher secondary levels. The scheme is named after Mai BhagoRs. one of the bravest Sikh women warriorsRs. who led Sikh soldiers against the Mughals in 1705 and emerged as a hero of the battle for her courage and leadership.
In PunjabRs. many girls discontinue their education after the 8th standard because schools are located far from their homes. Due to the lack of affordable transportationRs. it becomes difficult for them to commute to schoolRs. as most families in rural areas cannot afford vehicles or bicycles for their daughters. The Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme supports such school-going girls by providing assistance to help them continue their education.
benefits: Free bicycles are provided to all girl students of 9th to 12th classes.
eligibility:
1. Girl students should be residents of Punjab state.
1. Girl students should be studying in standards 9thRs.thRs. 11thRs. and 12th in the government school.
1. Girl students should belong to those below the poverty line (BPL).

name: Mid Day Meals Scheme
brief_description:
The Mid Day Meals Scheme (MDM) is a welfare program introduced by the government to address the issues of hungerRs. malnutritionRs. and low school attendance among children. The scheme aims to provide free and nutritious meals to school children across the country. Under this initiativeRs. a hot cooked meal is served to children in primary and upper primary schools.
The primary objectives of the Mid Day Meals Scheme are twofold. FirstlyRs. it seeks to improve the nutritional status of childrenRs. ensuring they receive a balanced diet and essential nutrients necessary for their growth and development. SecondlyRs. it aims to increase school attendance and retention rates by removing the barrier of hunger and incentivizing parents to send their children to school.
benefits:
- Improved nutritional status of childrenRs. leading to better physical and cognitive development.
- Increased school attendance and retention rates among children.
- Reduction in malnutrition-related health issues among school children.
- Enhances the concentration and learning abilities of children.
- Promotes social equality by ensuring equal access to nutritious meals for children from all socio-economic backgrounds.
- Alleviates the financial burden on families by providing free meals to their children.
- Creates employment opportunities for local communities through the implementation of the scheme.
eligibility:
- Students in Government and Government-aided schools: The scheme primarily targets students studying in government and government-aided schools across India. Children enrolled in classes from the primary level up to the secondary level are eligible to benefit from the scheme.
- Age criteria: The scheme typically covers children between the ages of 6 and 14 years. HoweverRs. specific age requirements may vary slightly from state to state or depending on the educational policies of different regions.
- Socio-economic criteria: The Mid Day Meals Scheme aims to benefit children from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. TypicallyRs. children belonging to families with below-poverty-line (BPL) status or those from marginalized communities are given priority for enrollment in the scheme.
- School attendance: One of the key eligibility criteria for availing the benefits of the scheme is regular school attendance. Students are expected to attend school regularly to receive the mid-day meals.
- Enrolled in recognized schools: Children must be enrolled in schools recognized by the appropriate education authorities to be eligible for the scheme. The scheme is primarily implemented in schools that adhere to the government's educational standards and guidelines.

name: Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme
brief_description: Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme was launched by the Government of Punjab in 2011 with the objective of improving the gender ratio in the state. The scheme is a significant initiative aimed at preventing female foeticide and promoting the education and welfare of girl children. It provides financial assistance to eligible families at different stages to reduce the financial burden associated with the birth and upbringing of a girl child. Girls born on or after 1 January 2011 in the state of Punjab are eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme. Families with an annual income of less than 30Rs. qualify for the scheme. To dateRs. more than 26Rs. beneficiaries have been covered under the Bebe Nanki Laadli Beti Kalyan Scheme.
benefits: **Benefits** Financial assistance of Rs.61Rs. to the Guardian of Girl Child in different stages up to the age of 18 years. S NoPeriod of benefitAgeThe amount released by LIC to the guardian of the beneficiary1On the birth of newly born girl child0 years 2Rs./-2On attaining the age of 3 years (after full immunization)3 years 2Rs./-3On admission to Class -16 years 2100/-4On admission to Class IX14 years 2Rs./-5On attaining age of 18 years & passed Class- XII18 years 3Rs./-6Scholarship payable-(a)From class-1 to VI standard 100/- per month- 7Rs./-(b)From class-VI1 to XII standard 200/- per month- 14Rs./-Total benefitAt the age of 18 years 61Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The girl child must have been born on or after 1 January 2011. 1. The parents of the girl child must be permanent residents of Punjab. 1. Abandoned girl children found on or after 1 January 2011 and residing in orphanages or Childrens Homes in Punjab are also eligible. 1. The number of girl children born before this date will not be considered while determining eligibility. 1. The benefit of the scheme is not applicable to newly born male children. 1. The annual family income should be less than 30Rs.. 1. Proof of income must be provided in the form of a Blue Card issued by the Food and Supply DepartmentRs. Punjab. 1. If the girl child drops out of school for any reasonRs. the benefits under the scheme will be discontinued from that date onward.

name: Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme was started by the Department of Social Security and Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Punjab in the year 1996. The objective of the scheme is to assist students with disabilities to secure educationRs. academicRs. technicalRs. or professional training to enable them to earn a living and become useful members of society. This scheme is fully state-sponsored.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. scholarship @ 200/- per month per Student with Disability for education for class 1st to 8th.
2. Scholarship @300/- per month per the student with Disability for education/training from 9th Class onwards.
**Note:** The Directorate shall credit the scholarship online in the bank account of the student.
eligibility:
1. All students of Punjab having 40 % and above disability (In any disability contained in the schedule of RPwD Act 2016) certificate.
1. The monthly income of family/guardians should not exceed 5Rs./- per month.
1. The candidate should have secured at least 40% marks in the previous annual examination.
1. The scholarship will be provided to each student with disability from 1st class onwards.

name: Education Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Education Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. The objective of the scheme is to provide scholarships to the students studying in various classes for enabling them to bear the expenses required for their studiesRs.
benefits:
Sl. NoClass/LevelQuantum of Assistance (Per Month)1.Class 1 to 8 500/-2.Class 9 to 10 700/-3.Class 11 to 12 1Rs./- 4.Graduation level 3Rs./-5.ITI Course 4Rs./-6.L.LB. Course (5 Years) 4Rs./-7.L.LB Course (3 years) 3Rs./- 8.Polytechnic Diploma 5Rs./-9.Technical Course such as EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. MBA 10Rs./-10. Course/ Polytechnic Diploma/ Technical Course such as EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. MBA/ Open learning/ Distant learning.

name: Post Graduate Scholarship for Ph.D./LLM Students
brief_description: The scheme "Post Graduate Scholarship for Ph.D./LLM Students" by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students of Assam pursuing Doctor of Philosophy and Master of Laws degree courses in any recognized colleges or universities in the state and other states of the countryRs. focusing on those with uniformly good academic records. The scheme provides access to poor students of the state and helps them achieve the benefits of higher education through scholarship support for advanced academic pursuits. The applicant must have registered their names as Doctor of Philosophy/Post Doctorate Research Scholar in any recognized universities and must be domiciled in Assam. The scheme is implemented by Higher Education Department. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** Scholarship is provided to the poor students to help them achieve the benefits of Higher Education. **Mode of Disbursement:** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) _*The applicant must maintain registration as Doctor of Philosophy/Post Doctorate Research Scholar in recognized universities._ _*Academic performance standards must be maintained as per university requirements._
eligibility: - The applicant must have registered their names as Doctor of Philosophy/Post Doctorate Research Scholar in any recognized universities. - The applicant must be domiciled in Assam. - The applicant must have obtained at least 55% or above marks in the last qualifying examination. - The applicant must have uniformly good academic records.

name: Scholarship/Merit Scholarship Schools SC/ST/OBC/Min (Studying in College/Technical/ Professional Institutions)
brief_description: Launched by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. the scheme "Merit Scholarship to SC/ST/OBC/Minority students studying in recognised Colleges/Professional/Technical Institutions" aims to provide financial assistance to students from marginalized communities pursuing higher education in recognized institutions. The scheme offers monthly scholarships to hostellers and day scholars based on their course of studyRs. with amounts ranging from 420/- to 1Rs./- per month. Eligible students must have secured at least 60% marks in the previous academic year. Family income limits apply only to OBC and Minority students. The scheme is implemented by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of Delhi.
benefits:
> **Course of Study Group-A**


- Degree courses in medical/engineering/B.Sc. (Agri)/Veterinary Science/Forensic Science/Higher Technical and professional studiesRs. and degree-level courses in Indian medicine (B.A.M.S. and comparable courses in AyurvedicRs. Unani/TibbiaRs. and Homeopathy systems of Medicine): Hostellers: 1Rs./- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 900/- per month for 12 months.
- For Postgraduate courses in the above fields and other technical/professional courses: Hostellers: 1Rs./- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 960/- per month for 12 months.

> **Course of Study Group-B**


- Diploma-level courses in Indian medicineRs. engineeringRs. technologyRs. architectureRs. and other vocational coursesRs. as well as postgraduate courses in science subjects: Hostellers: 1Rs./- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 720/- per month for 12 months.

> **Course of Study Group-C**


- Certificate courses in engineeringRs. technologyRs. architectureRs. medicineRs. and other vocational courses (minimum duration of one year): Hostellers: 930/- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 630/- per month for 12 months.

> **Course of Study Group-D**


- General courses up to graduate level: Hostellers: 804/- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 420/- per month for 12 months.

Postgraduate studies in ArtsRs. CommerceRs. and other subjects: Hostellers: 930/- per month for 12 months; Day Scholars: 630/- per month for 12 months.
