- The scholarship amount will be reduced to 50% if a student fails the annual examination but continues studiesRs. except in cases of medical grounds or natural calamities.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should belong to the SC/ST/OBC/Minority category.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized schoolRs. collegeRs. or institution in India.
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should have secured a 60% or above marks in the previous examination.
- If the applicant is from OBC/Minority CommunityRs. his/her annual family income should not exceed 2Rs./-.

name: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Pratibha Yojna
brief_description: The objective of the scheme is to provide scholarships to the students studying in class 9th to 12th for enabling them to bear the expenses required for their studiesRs.SC/ST/OBC students of class IX to XII of all Government/Aided/Recognized public schools affiliated to Directorate of Education/Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan/National Open School/Schools affiliated to NDMC/Delhi Cantonment BoardRs. East Delhi Municipal CorporationRs. North Delhi Municipal Corporation and South Delhi Municipal Corporation
benefits: Amount of Assistance: 1. IX to X Class : 5Rs./- Per annum 1. XI to XII Class : 10Rs./- Per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of GNCT of Delhi. 1. There is a Minimum of 50% marks required for IX to X and 60% marks required for XI to XII Classes. 1. Annual Income Limit Criteria for annual family income 8 Lacs at par annum with the EWS income limitRs. subject to exclusions notified by the Government of India. If the student scores 75% and above marks in the previous classRs. no income limit is applicable for SC/ST/OBC category. 1. The applicant should upload a Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC) issued in the name of the student or his fathers name issued by the SDM/Deputy Commissioner (Revenue)Rs. GNCTD. HoweverRs. the Domicile Certificate of Delhi from the Revenue Deptt. Will be entertained for the SC beneficiary onlyRs. if the caste certificate is issued by the outside state authority instead of the competent authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi. 1. Repeaters in a particular class will not be eligible for this scheme. 1. Bank Account should be in the name of the student (a Joint Bank Account with parent/Guardian is also permissible)Rs. active and seeded with the Aadhaar no of the student.

name: Pre Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
brief_description: The scheme "Pre Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to the Scheduled Caste Community" was launched by the Mizoram Scholarship BoardRs. Government of Mizoram. The scheme aims to support parents from the Scheduled Caste community in the education of their children studying in classes 9th and 10th so that the incidence of drop-outRs. especially in the transition from the elementary to the secondary stageRs. is minimized. The scheme also aims to improve participation these children in the pre-matric stage of education so that they perform better and have a better chance of progressing to the post-matric stage of education.
benefits: Financial assistance is provided to the students. _*The scheme is funded by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Government of Mizoram in 90:10 ratio._
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be permanently settled in Mizoram. 1. The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste. 1. The income of the parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. 1. The applicant must be studying either in 9th or 10th standard.

name: AICTE Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
brief_description: The scheme AICTEMITACS Globalink Research Internship (GRI) has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)Rs. Government of India. It aims to foster cross-border partnerships and create a platform for collaborative research between India and Canada. Through this schemeRs. fully funded global research internship opportunities are provided to eligible Indian undergraduate students. The scheme enables students to undertake research projects aligned with their area of interest and expertise at Canadian universities. It focuses on expanding international research exposure among Indian students in the ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. EngineeringRs. and Mathematics disciplines. The program supports academic collaborationRs. professional skill developmentRs. and industrial engagement.
benefits: 1. The AICTE-MITACS GRI Program will be jointly funded for 300 students by AICTE & MITACS as per the details below: - The total cost of the program is $12Rs. CAD per student. - MITACS will contribute $9Rs. CAD per student. - AICTE will contribute $3Rs. CAD per student. 1. The full cost per student includes airfareRs. visaRs. medicalRs. stipendRs. accommodationRs. Globalink Student MentorsRs. programmingRs. and research costs. It will also include access to Globalink-branded activities in CanadaRs. which may include professional skills workshopsRs. receptionsRs. and industrial engagement activities.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a 3rd-year full-time student of an undergraduate program (B.E / B.Tech) in an AICTE-approved institution in the year of application. 1. The applicant must have a minimum CGPA / GPA of 85% in the 2nd year. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must be able to spend twelve (12) weeks between May and September at a university in Canada on a research project related to their area of interest and expertise. 1. The applicant must be able to demonstrate oral and written fluency in English or FrenchRs. depending on the primary language of the project as indicated by the Canadian host professor.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for the Wards/Widows of Central Police Force Personnel
brief_description: The scheme Prime Ministers Scholarship Scheme for the Wards/Widows of Central Police Force Personnel has been introduced by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. in the Academic year 2006-07 to encourage higher technical and professional education for the wards of widows and ex-CPF personnel. Service conditions of Central Police Forces (CPFs) Personnel are extremely exactingRs. toughRs. rigorousRs. and peculiar to the Services. The service condition often keeps these personnel away from family for long spells. This leads to neglect of family mattersRs. including the education of children. The Prime Minister has announced 5000 scholarships for the wards of ex-servicemen/widows of army personnel as well as para-military forcesRs. including the Railway Protection ForceRs. for pursuing advanced education in the field of Medical Engineering/IT and other technical subjectsRs. which would be funded out of the interest income generated from the National Defence Fund. Out of the total 5000 scholarshipsRs. 1000 scholarships have been allocated to the Ministry of Home Affairs and Railways. On the basis of the strength of the forcesRs. it has been decided that 910 scholarships for CPFs controlled by MHA and 90 for the Railways Protection Force controlled by the Ministry of Railways.
benefits:
> **Amount of Scholarship:**

1. 1250/- per month for boys
2. 1500/- per month for girls
> **Duration of the Scholarship:**

1. Two to five years as approved by the concerned regulatory body for the programme.
eligibility:
**1. Persons eligible for the scholarship:**
(a) Wards and widows of CPFs personnel died in harness.
(b) Wards of ex-CPFs personnel disabled while on duty.
(c) Wards of ex-CPFs personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards.
(d) Wards & widows of Ex-CPFs/in-service personnel (Below Officer Rank i.e. up to the rank of Subedar Major /Inspector only).
**2. Order of preference:** If the number of applications for scholarship exceeds the approved number of scholarshipsRs. the order of preference for allotment of scholarships will be as under:-
i)Category-AWards/Widows of CPFs personnel killed in action.ii)Category-BWards of ex-CPFs personnel disabled in action.iii)Category-CWards of ex-CPFs personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards iv)Category-DWards/Widows of CPFs personnel who died in harnessv)Category-EWards of ex-CPFs personnel disabled while in service with disability attributable to Govt. Service.vi)Category-FWards of ex-CPFs personnel (PBOR)vii)Category-GWards of in-service personnel (PBOR) subject to availability of scholarship on a merit basis.**3. Courses eligible for the Scholarship:**
First professional degree programme in engineeringRs. medicineRs. dentalRs. veterinaryRs. MBARs. MCARs. etc. duly recognized by the respective government regulatory bodiesRs. such as All India Council for Technical EducationRs. Medical Council of IndiaRs. etc.
**4. Academic requirement:**
At least 60% marks at the 10+2 level for the initial sanction. For renewal in subsequent yearsRs. 50% marks each year is mandatory.
**Note 01:** The scheme is open for widows and unmarried wards of CPFs personnel. HoweverRs. marriage/re-marriage subsequently would not disqualify a person.
**Note 02:** The scholarship is admissible for two children only per family. Since the scholarship from PMs Scheme is restricted to 2 children onlyRs. therefore particulars of all children should be indicated in the appropriate column.

name: Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of TripuraRs. to provide financial assistance of 500/- to pregnant women through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for antenatal checkups at any health facility.
benefits: 500/- is transferred into the bank account through DBTRs. after each antenatal check-upRs. up to four times.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant should have undertaken antenatal check-ups at any health facility.

name: Madhya Pradesh Janani Suraksha Yojana
brief_description: The "Janani Suraksha Yojana" was launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical EducationRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote institutional deliveries among pregnant women to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by providing cash incentives to women delivering in government and accredited private hospitalsRs. as well as to motivators (ASHA workers or family escorts) who assist them.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - 1Rs. to rural pregnant women delivering in government or accredited private hospitals. - 1Rs. to urban pregnant women for institutional delivery. - 350 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting a rural woman for delivery. - 200 incentive to the motivator (ASHA or escort) assisting an urban woman for delivery. - 250 as transport allowanceRs. if the motivator or family arranges transportation to the hospital. - Free hospital stay and maternal health services in government or accredited private hospitals.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant should deliver in a government or accredited private hospital. 1. The applicant should belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) or Antyodaya family.

name: Inter-Caste Marriage Award
brief_description: The scheme "Inter-Caste Marriage Award " has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to eliminate the practice of untouchability by encouraging marriages between the Scheduled Castes and other castes.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. a person from another caste who marries a person from a Scheduled Caste receives 50Rs./- or an amount decided by the Government from time to time.
eligibility: **Eligibility Criteria for Inter-Caste Marriage Award:** 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The age of the couple should not exceed 50 years. 1. The marriage must be registered under the applicable Act/Rules. 1. The applicant should not have received any Inter-Caste Marriage Award earlier.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance
brief_description: The Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance scheme has beenn launched by the Department of CultureRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to artists and litterateurs suffering from serious or long-term illnessesRs. accidentsRs. or calamities. Under this schemeRs. one-time financial support is provided to meet medical treatment expenses that the beneficiary cannot afford.
benefits: **Financial Assistance** - One-time financial assistance of up to 50Rs.. - Provided for serious or long-term illnessRs. accidentRs. or calamity-related treatment. **Mode of Disbursement** - Direct bank transfer to the beneficiary account.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an artist or a litterateur. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be suffering from a serious or long-term illnessRs. accidentRs. or calamity. 1. The applicants (husband/wife) monthly income should not exceed 10Rs.. 1. The total family income should not exceed 20Rs. per month. 1. The writer/artist's fully dependent spouseRs. fully dependent parentsRs. dependent minor brothers and sistersRs. dependent minor childrenRs. dependent widowed daughterRs. and dependent differently-abled brothers and sisters are eligible to get assistance.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
brief_description: The scheme "Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals" was launched by the Ministry of Chemicals and FertilizersRs. Department of Pharmaceuticals. The scheme aims to enhance Indias manufacturing capabilities by increasing investment and production in the sector and contributing to product diversification to high-value goods in the pharmaceutical sector. The scheme provides financial incentives on the incremental sales (over Base Year) of pharmaceutical goods and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices to selected applicants based on pre-defined selection criteria. The scheme is implemented by the Small Industries Development Bank of India. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the dedicated Project Management Agency portal.
benefits: - The scheme has a total financial outlay of 1Rs./-. - The incentive is provided on the net incremental sales of eligible products over a period of 6 years (Financial Year 2022-23 to Financial Year 2027-28). - The rate of incentive for Category 1 and Category 2 products is 10% for the first four years (Financial Year 2022-23 to 2025-26)Rs. 8% for the fifth year (Financial Year 2026-27)Rs. and 6% for the sixth year (Financial Year 2027-28). - The rate of incentive for Category 3 products is 5% for the first four years (Financial Year 2022-23 to 2025-26)Rs. 4% for the fifth year (Financial Year 2026-27)Rs. and 3% for the sixth year (Financial Year 2027-28). - The incentive allocation ceiling is 1Rs./- for Group ARs. 22Rs./- for Group BRs. and 17Rs./- for Group C. - The maximum incentive per applicant is capped at 10Rs./- for Group ARs. 2Rs./- for Group BRs. and 50Rs./- for Group C. ****Applicants must submit a claim for disbursement of incentive online on an annual basis within one month of the closure of the financial year.*** ****75% of the claim amount is released immediately upon orderRs. and the remaining 25% is released after the submission of final audited accounts.*** ****Selected applicants must furnish a self-certified quarterly review report within 30 days from the end of each quarter.***
eligibility: ##### ***Common Eligibility*** - The applicant must be a manufacturer of pharmaceutical goods registered in India. - The applicant must be engaged in the manufacturing of eligible pharmaceutical products covered under the three defined categories. - The applicant must not claim incentives for the same product under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Bulk Drugs or any other Production Linked Incentive Scheme. ##### ***Group A Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices greater than or equal to 50Rs./- (5Rs. crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of 10Rs./- (1Rs. crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of 50Rs./- (50 crores) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group B Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices between 5Rs./- (500 crores) and 50Rs./- (5Rs. crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of 2Rs./- (250 crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of 10Rs./- (10 crores) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group C Applicants*** - The applicant must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices less than 5Rs./- (500 crores) in the Financial Year 2019-20. - The applicant must achieve a minimum cumulative investment of 50Rs./- (50 crores) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of 1Rs./- (1 crore) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Group C (MSME) Applicants*** - The applicant must fall under the MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) category within Group C. - The applicant must achieve the Committed Investment (total eligible investment committed by the applicant) over a period of 5 years. - The applicant must achieve a minimum turnover of eligible products of 50Rs./- (50 lakhs) in the first year (Financial Year 2022-23). ##### ***Continuation Criteria*** - The applicant must achieve a 7% growth in sales over the previous Financial Year for subsequent years (Financial Year 2023-24 onwards) to claim incentives.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure social security and financial protection for registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors. Under this schemeRs. accidental insurance coverage is provided to the registered drivers and conductors.
benefits: **Accident Insurance Coverage** - 2Rs. is payable in case of accidental death. - 2Rs. is payable in case of total and irreversible loss of both eyesRs. both handsRs. both feetRs. or loss of one eye and one limb. - 1Rs. is payable in case of total and irreversible loss of one eye or one limb.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 70 years. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal.

name: Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme
brief_description: The Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme" has been launched by the Department of CultureRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote interest and skill development among youth in various art forms such as musicRs. danceRs. theatreRs. paintingRs. and crafts. Under this schemeRs. monthly training fellowships are provided to selected young artists to support their artistic training.
benefits: - Monthly training fellowship of 10Rs. per selected participant. - Professional art training at [government-recognized art and music institutions (Page No. 3)](https://www.culturemp.in/pdfs/fellowship-2023.pdf).- Certification after successful completion of training. - Opportunity to receive structured guidance in classicalRs. tribalRs. and folk art forms. - The fellowship is valid only for the approved training period of 3 months.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be interested in training in one art discipline such as singingRs. instrumental musicRs. danceRs. theatreRs. paintingRs. or crafts. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years of age.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)
brief_description: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice BoardRs. Department of Commerce and IndustryRs. Ministry of Commerce. The objective of this scheme is to promote farmers to produce quality and disease-free planting materials in their own fields for replanting.
benefits:
- 33.33% of the cost of production of planting material subject to a maximum of 3 per seedling for the General Category. - 75% of the cost of production of planting material @ 6.75 per seedling for SC/ST.
> **Time of Payment** Payment of subsidy will be in the succeeding year of planting the mother suckers/ seeds for multiplication in the nursery and satisfactory production of suckers/seedlings.
> **Mode of Payment** Eligible assistance will be paid to beneficiaries through **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)**Rs. except for specific cases like QGBGRs. weather-based insurance for cardamom (small)Rs. and distribution of polythene sheets.
eligibility:
Individual growers/farmers groups having suitable land and facility for irrigating the nursery.
> **Area of Operation** SikkimRs. Darjeeling & Kalimpong districts of West Bengal & other NE States.
> **Modalities** - Allotment of units will be multiples of 500 with a minimum of 1000 nos. to a maximum of 5000 nos. per beneficiary. - Farmers will start nursery follow-up visits will be conducted by the Field Staff and necessary technical guidance will be rendered for successful production of planting materials. - Planting materials produced in the nurseries will be used for replanting / gap filling by the applicants and the balance will be supplied to the neighbouring/needy farmers at an optimum price not exceeding the market price. Designated Officials will conduct final inspections and recommend the eligible cases.

name: Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme
brief_description: The **Chief Ministers CM-ELEVATE Program** includes **the Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme** under the Planning DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to employRs. engageRs. and empower the youth and rural communities by promoting Dairy related entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.
benefits: 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Mentorship and business advisory 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicantRs. 45% by Government) 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Technical training and capacity building
eligibility: **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess landRs. either self-owned or on leaseRs. verified by the competent authority. 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized InstitutionRs. preferably from a Government Institute. 1. name: Ramanujan Fellowship
brief_description:
"Ramanujan Fellowship" is meant for brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from outside India to take up scientific research positions in IndiaRs. those Indian scientists/engineers who want to return to India from abroad. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective. The Ramanujan Fellows could work in any of the scientific institutions and universities in the country and they would be eligible for receiving regular research grants through the extramural funding schemes of various S&T agencies of the Government of India.
> **Duration of Fellowship:**


- The duration of the fellowship will be for five yearsRs. and not extendable.
benefits:
1. The amount of the Fellowship will be 1Rs./- per month (consolidated including HRA).
1. Each Fellow willRs. in additionRs. receive a research grant of 7.00 lakh per annum (for consumablesRs. travelRs. research personnel & contingenciesRs. etc.) and 60Rs./- per annum as overhead charges.
1. The Ramanujan Fellows will be eligible to receive regular research grants through the extramural funding schemes of various S&T agencies of the Government of India.
eligibility:
1. The fellowship is open to brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world who are below the age of 40 yearsRs. who want to return to India from abroad.
1. The applicant should possess a higher degree or equivalentRs. such as a Ph.D. in Science/EngineeringRs. Master in Engineering or Technology/MD in MedicineRs. etc.Rs. and have adequate professional experience.
1. These Fellowships are very selective and only those who have a proven/outstanding track record as evident from their research publications and recognitions would be eligible.
1. In case a fellow is offered a permanent positionRs. he/she will be ineligible for the fellowship.
1. This fellowship is meant for working in new areas and laboratories in order to expand their research capabilitiesRs. other than the oneRs. where the candidate has obtained his/her doctorate degree.
1. Nominations from the Ph.D. guides of the candidate and nominations from the same institute where they opted for their Ph.DRs. will not be considered.
1. The age of the candidate should not be more than 40 years.
1. The candidate should be working abroad at the time of his nomination for the fellowship.
1. The Fellowship is only for those scientists who are not holding any permanent/tenure track/contractual position in any Indian Institute/University.

**Note:** In case the selected fellow gets any position such as permanentRs. tenure trackRs. or contractual positionRs. he/sheRs. will become ineligible for receiving fellowship including a research grant and overhead under the fellowshipRs. and has to relinquish the Ramanujan fellowship in total.

name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
brief_description:
University Grants Commission is implementing the scheme of Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm courses (including integrated dual degree courses).
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to help and attract young and talented graduate students to pursue education at the Post Graduate Level in Higher Education Institutions.
benefits:
1. The Scholarship under the scheme is 12Rs./- per month per student.
2. An annual contingency of 5Rs./- will be given to the eligible student.
**Note 01:** If a student scores below 60% in any semester he/she shall be paid a scholarship @ 1Rs./- in that particular semesterRs. if the student re-appear for the same semester and scores above 60 %Rs. he will be entitled to get regular scholarship i.e. @ 12Rs./- p.m. for that semester in which student reappeared. But thereafter after he is eligible for the full scholarship amountRs. in the next semesters.
**Note 02:** The contingency grant sanctioned will be reimbursed to the scholar on the actual expenditure incurred by him/her on the admissible items within the limit. The books and non-consumable items purchased or acquiredRs. out of the contingency grantRs. will be the property of the concerned university or the institution and the scholars have to return the same at the end of the programme i.e. post graduate and research work to the concerned institution.
**Note 03:** No house rent is admissible to M.E./M.Tech./M.Pharm. students.
**Note 04:** The scholar shall not undertake any paid assignment (emoluments/salary/stipend) during the tenure of the scholarship.
**Note 05:** It will be obligatory on the part of every post graduate student to undertake 8 to 10 hours (per week) of work related to teaching and research activities as assigned to him/her by the institute. This includes tutorialsRs. laboratory classesRs. development and maintenance of laboratoriesRs. assistance in research and activities undertaken by faculty membersRs. maintenance and operation of computer and other central facilitiesRs. assistance in libraryRs. etc.
**Note 06:** Scholarship shall be terminated immediately if the scholar has failed in any semester. It will be the responsibility of the University to take action in this matter.
eligibility:
1. The GATE/GPAT qualified students who have taken admission in M.E/M.Tech/M.Pharm courses and integrated dual degree programme in CentralRs. StateRs. DeemedRs. and Private Universities will be provided scholarships by UGC.
1. The students must be admitted as full-time scholars.

**Note 01:** The Government of India policy for SC/ST/OBC/PH is to be followed strictly. IfRs. in any caseRs. no student is available under the reserved seats then those seats may be treated as lapsed in that batch.

name: High Risk - High Reward Research
brief_description:
The Scheme High Risk - High Reward Research is implemented by the Science and Engineering Research BoardRs. Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of India with the aim to support proposals that are conceptually new and riskyRs. and if successfulRs. expected to have a paradigm-shifting influence on the S&T. This may be in terms of formulating a new hypothesisRs. or scientific breakthroughs which aid in emergence of new technologies.
> **Nature of Proposals to be Supported:**

The scheme is aimed at supporting proposals that are newRs. challenge existing hypothesisRs. and provide 'out of box' thinking on important problems. It should contain significant risk elements but promise of high reward if the difficulties could be circumvented. It is expected that the success of such proposals will have far-reaching implications in S&T. Outcome could be new and significant theoretical or experimental advancesRs. formulation of new hypothesisRs. or breakthrough science which will lead to new technologies. Proposals that address scientific issues which will result in 'incremental' knowledge will not be supported. IdeallyRs. the proposal must contain bold research ideas which will have wide-ranging impact and potential for new scientific and technological innovations.
> **Duration of Support:**

The funding is provided normally for a period of three years. In exceptional casesRs. the duration can be up to 5 years as assessed by the expert committee.
benefits:
1. No budget limit is prescribed for this type of project.
2. The research grant covers equipmentRs. consumablesRs. contingency and travel apart from overhead grants.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be an Indian citizen residing in India.
1. The applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution.
1. The proposals can be submitted by an individual or by a team of investigators. Proposals submitted by a team of investigators must identify a Principal InvestigatorRs. who will spearhead the research objectives and administer the grant.

name: Disha - Early Intervention and School Readiness Scheme
brief_description: Disha-Early Intervention and School Readiness Scheme was launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Govt. of India.This scheme aims at setting up Disha Centres for early intervention for Person with Disability (PwD) in 0-10 years of age covered under the National Trust ActRs. through therapiesRs. trainings and providing support to family members.
benefits: 1. **Day Care:** Day-care facilities to PwD for at least 4 hours in a day.1. **Staffing:** Provision of TherapiesRs. trainings and providing support to family members.1. **Counselling:** Counselling and guidance especially for Activities for Daily Living (ADL) must be provided to parents or guardians of PwD with regular follow-ups by RO to ensure that parents or guardians attend a minimum number of counselling sessions.1. **Transport Facilities:** Registered Organisations can also provide transportation facilities to PwD in case it is mutually suitable for both. 1. **Assessment and Evaluation:** PwD should be assessed and evaluated by experts in the related field on a regular basis to understand their individual needs and also to monitor the progress of the PwD.
eligibility: Following are the eligibility criteria that a PwD should have to be enrolled under Disha Centre: 1. PwD should be in the age group of 0-10 years. 1. PwD should have one of the disabilities covered under the [National Trust ActRs. 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf)Rs. which are AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities.

name: Free Coaching Scheme
brief_description:
Launched in 2021-22Rs. the scheme "Free Coaching" by the Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of India aims to provide good coaching quality for De-NotifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic (DNT) candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations and succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in Public/Private Sector. Through this schemeRs. free coaching for various competitive examinations with specified maximum fee limits and minimum durationsRs. monthly stipendsRs. and special allowances (for students with disabilities) are provided to the DNT candidates. A minimum physical coaching of 16 hours per week is mandatory for all courses. The scheme is implemented by the Development and Welfare Board for De-NotifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities (DWBDNC). The DWBDNC selects a total of 1Rs. students each yearRs. allowing them the liberty to pursue coaching in any institute of their choice.
**Objectives:** 1. To provide good coaching quality for DNT candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations. 1. To enable DNT candidates to succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in the Public/Private Sector.
benefits:
> **1. Coaching Fees:** The actual course fee of the institute in which the student is applyingRs. which the institute charges from general studentsRs. or the prescribed course fee by the Ministry as per the Annexure of the SchemeRs. whichever is less. This is subject to the limits for fees and duration of the course. The maximum total course fee for various courses is as follows:
**S. No.****Courses****Max. Total Course Fee in Rupees****Min. Duration in months**1Civil Services Exam by UPSC/SPSCs 1Rs./-9 months (4 months prelim + 5 months mains)2SSC/RRB 40Rs./-6 months3Banking /Insurance/ PSU/ CLAT50Rs./-6 months4JEE/NEET1Rs./-9 months (not exceeding 12 months)5IES80Rs./--do-6CAT /CMAT60Rs./--do-7GRE/GMAT/SAT/TOFEL35Rs./-3 months8CA-CPT/ GATE75Rs./-9 months9CPL Courses30Rs./-6 months10NDA/CDS20Rs./-3 months*A minimum physical coaching of 16 hours per week is mandatory for all the above courses.* If the course fee is more than the admissible amountRs. the candidate has to arrange for the remaining funds from his/her own sources.
> **2. Stipend:** A monthly stipend is provided for attending coaching classes. - For local students: 1Rs./- per month. - For outstation students: 3Rs./- per month. - The stipend will be paid for the duration of the course or for one yearRs. whichever is less.
> **3. Special Allowance:** Students with disabilities (having a valid disability certificate of 40% or more disability) are eligible for a Special Allowance of 2Rs. per month. This allowance is towards reader allowanceRs. escort allowanceRs. helper allowanceRs. etc.Rs. and is in addition to the regular stipend.
> **4. Courses for Coaching:** The coaching will be imparted for the following coursesRs. with specified minimum durations: - Group A and B examinations are conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)Rs. the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) and the various Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs). - Group A and B examinations are conducted by the State Public Service Commissions (SPSCs). - Officers Grade examinations conducted by BanksRs. Insurance Companies and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). - Premier Entrance Examinations for admission in (a) Engineering (e.g.Rs. IIT-JEE)Rs. (b) Medical (e.g.Rs. NEET)Rs. (c) Professional courses like Management (e.g.Rs. CATRs. CMAT) and Law (e.g.Rs. CLAT)Rs. and (d) Any other such disciplines as the Ministry may decide from time to time. - Eligibility tests/examinations like SATRs. GRERs. GMAT and TOEFL. - Entrance examination tests for Commercial Pilot License (CPL) courses/ National Defence Academy (NDA)Rs. and Combined Defence Services (CDS). - Indian Engineering Services (IES). - Chartered Accountant - Common Proficiency Test (CA-CPT)/Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE).
> **5. Number of Benefits:** The benefits under the Scheme can be availed by a particular student not more than twiceRs. irrespective of the number of chances he/she may be entitled to take in a particular competitive examination.
> **6. Coaching for Multi-Stage Examinations:** Where the competitive examination is conducted in two stagesRs. namely Preliminary and MainsRs. the candidates will be entitled to free coaching for both examinations. They will be entitled to free coaching up to two times each for Preliminary and Main examinations as per their convenience. HoweverRs. there will be no restriction on the number of chances for coaching for the Interview if the candidate is selected for the interview.
> **7. Distribution of Slots:** Of the total selected studentsRs. 40% shall be earmarked for competitive exams having eligibility condition as Class 12 (e.g.Rs. NEETRs. JEERs. CLAT etc.). The remaining 60% students shall be for competitive exams having eligibility condition as Graduation (e.g.Rs. CATRs. Civil Services ExaminationRs. etc.).
**Mode of Disbursement:** 1. **Coaching Fees:** The course fee shall be released directly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary candidate in two installments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. - The first instalment of 50% of the eligible amount will be released immediately after the candidate uploads the admission confirmation/assurance from the coaching institute on the online portal. - The remaining fee will be reimbursed after receiving proof of joining the institute by the candidate and deposition of the amount released as the first instalment by the candidate to the institute. 1. **Stipend:** The stipend to each student shall be paid directly by the Ministry through DBT.1. **Special Allowance:** The special allowance will be paid directly by the Ministry through DBT along with the stipend.
> **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - **First Installment of Fees:** Immediately after the candidate uploads the admission confirmation/assurance from the institute on the online portal. - **Second Installment of Fees:** After receiving proof of joining the institute and the deposition of the first installment by the candidate to the institute. - **Stipend and Special Allowance:** MonthlyRs. till the duration of the course or for one yearRs. whichever is less. > **Validity:** - The candidate will be required to join the selected course within 6 months of the release of the first installment of the fee. If the first installment of the fee amount is not paid to the selected institute within a period of 6 monthsRs. this amount will have to be returned to the Government and the second installment will not be eligible.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to De-NotifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic (DNT) communities. 1. The applicant's total family income from all sources should be 2Rs./- or less per annum. 1. The applicant should not be availing of any such benefits from a similar scheme of the Central Government or the State Government. 1. The applicant must have secured the minimum marks in the qualifying examination of the competitive exam for which coaching is soughtRs. as prescribed in the guidelines of the said competitive exam. 1. If the applicant has not yet appeared for the qualifying examinationRs. or if the result has not been declaredRs. the marks obtained in the Board/Degree exam just prior to the qualifying exam shall be taken into account. 1. For competitive exams where the qualifying exam is Class 12thRs. the applicant must have passed Class 12th or be studying in Class 12th as on the date of receiving the benefit under the scheme. 1. For competitive exams where the qualifying exam is at the bachelor's levelRs. the applicant must have completed the bachelor's level course or be studying in the final year of the bachelor's degree course at the time of receiving the benefits under the scheme. 1. The applicant will be required to submit an affidavit that he/she has not taken benefit more than twice under the Scheme. 1. The applicant is required to join an institute as empanelled by the Ministry under the Free Coaching Scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Other Backward Class (OBC) students. 1. A minimum physical coaching of 16 hours per week will be mandatory for all the courses.
> **Preference/Priority:** - For such examinationsRs. which are conducted in two partsRs. Preliminary and MainsRs. priority in the selection will be given to those students who have at least once qualified for the preliminary examination. - If the number of eligible applications received is more than the given slotsRs. the selection will be done in decreasing order of the marks obtained in the qualifying exams.

name: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme
brief_description:
The National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) was introduced by the Government of India to provide comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamitiesRs. pestsRs. and diseases. The scheme promotes the stability of farm incomes and encourages farmers to adopt modern agricultural practices.
> **Key Features** 1. Coverage for food cropsRs. oilseedsRs. and selected commercial/horticultural crops. 1. Protection against crop loss due to natural calamities such as droughtRs. floodRs. hailstormRs. cycloneRs. pestsRs. and diseases. 1. Coverage for different stages of the crop life cycle: - Sowing/planting risk. - Standing crop losses. - Post-harvest losses (due to specified perils). - Losses due to localized risks like hailstorms and landslides. 1. Subsidized premiums for small and marginal farmers. 1. Availability of the scheme across notified areas and seasons. > **Claim Process** - **Reporting** Losses: Inform the local agriculture office or insurer within 48 hours of the incident.- **Assessment**: Loss assessment will be conducted by a joint team comprising local authorities and insurance company representatives.- **Claim Settlement:** Upon verificationRs. claims are directly transferred to the farmers bank account
benefits:
> **Comprehensive Crop Coverage:** - Protection against crop loss due to natural calamities (floodsRs. droughtsRs. hailstorms)Rs. pestsRs. diseasesRs. and localized risks. - Includes coverage for sowingRs. standing cropsRs. and post-harvest losses. > **Subsidized Premiums for Small Farmers:** - Small and marginal farmers receive premium subsidiesRs. making the scheme affordable for them. > **Affordable Premiums for All Farmers:** - Low premium rates for both loanee and non-loanee farmersRs. with premiums deducted from agricultural loans. > **Quick Claim Settlement:** - Fast processing and direct claim settlement to the farmers bank account. > **Encourages Better Farming Practices:** - Promotes risk mitigation and adoption of modern agricultural practicesRs. increasing productivity. > **Wide Crop Coverage:** - Covers food cropsRs. oilseedsRs. and horticultural cropsRs. ensuring protection for most farmers. > **Nationwide Accessibility:** - Available to farmers across the countryRs. making it a national safety net.
**Premium Rates** - Food crops and oilseeds: - Kharif crops: 3.5% of the sum insured. - Rabi crops: 1.5% of the sum insured. - Commercial and horticultural crops: Actuarial premium rates apply. - The premium for Small & Marginal farmers is subsidised to the extent of 10% which is shared by the State Govt. and Govt. of India
eligibility:
> **Loanee Farmers:** 1. Farmers who avail seasonal agricultural operations (SAO) loans from financial institutions (banksRs. co-operative societiesRs. etc.) are automatically covered under the scheme. 1. The coverage for loanee farmers is compulsoryRs. and premiums are deducted from the loan amount.
> **Non-Loanee Farmers:** 1. Non-loanee farmers can apply voluntarily for the insurance coverage. 1. The application must be submitted before the deadline for each crop season.
> **Notified Crops and Areas:** 1. The crops to be insured and the areas where the scheme is applicable are announced by the government each year.

name: Youth Hostel Scheme
brief_description: The Youth Hostel Scheme is managed by the Department of Youth Affairs & Sports under the Ministry of Youth Affairs & SportsRs. Government of India. The Central Government provides financial assistance to the State Governments for the construction and maintenance of youth hostels. The State Governments are responsible for the day-to-day management of youth hostels.
benefits: 1. **Affordable accommodation:** Youth hostels offer a much cheaper alternative to hotels and guesthouses.1. **Social atmosphere:** Youth hostels are a great place to meet new people from all over the world.1. **Cultural experience:** Youth hostels are often located in places of cultural interestRs. giving you the opportunity to learn about the local culture and traditions.1. **Flexible options:** Youth hostels offer a variety of accommodation optionsRs. including dormitoriesRs. private roomsRs. and family rooms. You can also choose to book meals at the hostel or cook your own food.
eligibility: 1. There is no age restriction but if applicant is below 18 then he/she must be accompanied by a parent or guardian when staying in a youth hostel.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
brief_description: "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana" by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of India is a government scheme meant for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF). All Small and Marginal Farmers having cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares falling in the age group of 18 to 40 yearsRs. whose names appear in the land records of States/UTs as on 01.08.2019Rs. are eligible to get benefits under the scheme. Under this schemeRs. the farmers would receive a minimum assured pension of Rs./- per month after attaining the age of 60 years and if the farmer diesRs. the spouse of the farmer shall be entitled to receive 50% of the pension as family pension. Family pension is applicable only to the spouse.
benefits: - **Monthly Pension Benefit:** - The subscriber will receive a minimum assured pension of 3Rs./- per month after attaining the age of 60 years. - **Family Pension Benefit:** - In case of death of the subscriberRs. the spouse will receive 50% of the pension amount as family pension. - Family pension is applicable only to the spouse. - **Government Matching Contribution:** - The Government of India will contribute an amount equal to the subscribers monthly contribution to the pension fund. - **Disablement Benefit:** - If the subscriber becomes permanently disabled before the age of 60 yearsRs. the spouse can continue the scheme by paying contributions or exit by receiving the subscribers contribution with interest. - Exit Benefits: - If the subscriber exits within 10 yearsRs. only the subscribers contribution will be refunded with savings bank interest. - If the subscriber exits after 10 years but before 60 yearsRs. the subscribers contribution will be refunded with accumulated interest or savings bank interestRs. whichever is higher. - If the subscriber dies before 60 yearsRs. the spouse can continue the scheme or exit with a refund of the subscribers contribution with interest. - After the death of both subscriber and spouseRs. the corpus will be credited back to the pension fund.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Small or Marginal Farmer. 1. The applicant should have cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares as per State or Union Territory land records. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of entry. 1. The applicants name should appear in land records as on 01.08.2019. 1. The applicant should possess an Aadhaar card. 1. The applicant should have a savings bank account or PM-KISAN account.

name: ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
brief_description:
ICAR awards a certain number of Senior Research Fellowships for Ph.D. in an Agricultural University (AU)Rs. in different disciplines of agriculture and allied sciences. This is done to encourage talented students to undertake higher agricultural education.
In order to address the emerging challenges of agricultural research and educationRs. the ICAR supports specific time-bound schemes/projects. The schemes/projects generally have provisions for time-bound/non-regular/ contractual engagement of manpowerRs. contingenciesRs. and limited need-based traveling allowance (TA)Rs. besides other specifically needed provisions for a particular scheme/project. In supersession of all previous guidelinesRs. the following guidelines are formulated to regulate all aspects relating to engagementRs. emolumentsRs. and terms and conditions of Senior Research Fellows and Research Associates working in ICAR schemes.
benefits:
**Veterinary Sciences:** 12Rs./- per month With a contingency grant of 6Rs./- per annum. **All disciplines other than Veterinary Sciences:** 8Rs./- per month With a contingency grant of 6Rs./- per annum.
_The rates of fellowship and contingency grants for higher studies will be as prescribed by the Council from time to time._
eligibility:
**Method of Award** ICAR-SRF (PGS) will be awarded on the basis of merit in the All India Competitive Entrance Examination for - (i) ICAR-SRF (PGS)Rs. and (ii) concurrent admission to Masters degree program at - a) State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)Rs. and b) Deemed Universities viz. IARI (New Delhi) / IVRI (Izatnagar) / NDRI (Karnal) / CIFE (Mumbai) / AAU (Allahabad)Rs. Central Agricultural University (ImphalRs. Manipur)Rs. and c) Central Universities having faculty of agriculture viz. Banaras Hindu University (BHU)Rs. Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)Rs. Visva BhartiRs. and Nagaland UniversityRs. collectively hereinafter referred to as the Agricultural Universities (AUs).
**Eligibility** 1. Candidates having completed their Masters degree program with a minimum of 55% marks or an OGPA of 5.5/10.00 or 2.75/5.00 or 2.20/4.00 or an equivalent OGPA from any recognized University in India and abroad would be eligible. For SC/ST and Physically Handicapped (PH) candidatesRs. the minimum percentage of marks will be relaxed by 5 percent or an equivalent OGPA. The equivalence of OGPA to percent marksRs. where neededRs. will be certified by the Registrar of the concerned University. Candidates appearing in the final semester would also be eligible provided they complete their postgraduate degree in all respects by the date of examination and produce the complete degree certificate from the Registrar to this effect. 1. The fellowship would be granted only when the candidate gets eventually admitted and pursues a Ph.D. degree in an Agricultural University(AU) other than the Agricultural University(AU) from where the candidate has completed M.Sc./M.V.Sc./ M.E./M.Tech. degree. 1. The upper age limit would be 30 years as of the date of the examination. For SC/ST & PH categoriesRs. the upper age limit will be relaxed by 5 years. For OBC the upper age limit will be relaxed by 3 years. For in-service candidates of Agricultural Universities (AU)Rs. the upper age limit would be 45 years as of the date of examination whereasRs. the academic performance requirement would remain as stated above.
**NOTE 1:** Reservation of various categories such as SC/ST/OBC and PH etc. will be given as per Government of India rules/instructions issued from time to time. The responsibility of verification of the genuineness of SC/ST/OBC and PH certificates will solely rest with the concerned Agricultural University (AU) where the candidate has been recommended for admission or granted provisional admission.
**NOTE 2:** The ICAR-SRF (PGS) will NOT be available for admission in any university other than the AUs as mentioned above.

name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
brief_description: The "Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi" (PM-DAKSH) schemeRs. launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of India in 2020-21Rs. is designed to uplift the marginalized sections of society by offering skill development programs. It targets SCsRs. OBCsRs. EWSRs. DNTsRs. and Safai MitrasRs. providing upskillingRs. reskillingRs. short-term trainingRs. and entrepreneurial development courses. The scheme aims to empower these groups by boosting their skills to improve their employability and income prospects. Training is aligned with the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF)Rs. and post-training support is provided for employment or self-employment opportunities.
benefits:
##### **Key benefits:**

- Training free of cost for the traineesRs. 100% grants by Government.
- Stipend will be given to trainees during the period of training.
- Trained candidates will be provided certification after successful completion of training and assessment.
- Trained candidates will be provided placement after assessment and certification.

##### **Category of Skilling Programmes:**
##### ***1. Up-skilling/Re-skilling under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL):***

- **Target Group:** Up-skilling / Re-skilling under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) will only be applicable to SafaiMitras including waster pickers who constitute the bottom of the pyramid. - **Curriculum:** In respect of Safai Mitras including waste pickersRs. the curriculum will include the programmes on safe & healthy sanitation practicesRs. occupational practices as per relevant and approved Qualification Packs (QPs). Certification would be aligned with the standard process. - **Period of Training:** The duration of the training programmes will be of approximately 35 hours keeping in mind the occupational hours of the trainees. - **Training Cost:** The training cost will be limited to extent of Common Cost Norms (CCN) issued by Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) as applicable from time to time. - **Other Expenses:** As the trainees are already employedRs. they will be paid @500/- per person to Safai Mitras including Waste Pickers in the form of stipendRs. for duration of training of Up-skilling and Re-skilling under RPLRs. towards compensation of their wage lossRs. during the period of training.
##### ***2. Short-Term Courses (focus on wage/self-employment):***

- **Target Group:** Most disempowered groups belonging to SC/OBC/EWS/DNT and Sanitation Workers including Waste Pickers and their dependents having aspirations to be employed in sectors having good demand in job market with suitable wage. - **Curriculum:** The Curriculum of the training programmes will be as per National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF)/National Occupational Standard (NOS)Rs. issued by Ministry of Skill Development and EntrepreneurshipRs. Government of India in various job roles with focus on wage and self-employment opportunities such as self-employed tailors trainingRs. furniture makingRs. food processingRs. carpet weavingRs. beautician workersRs. leather workRs. latex harvestingRs. tyre fitting along with financial and digital literacyRs. etc. Training to be delivered through accredited and affiliated training centres. - **Period of Training:** The duration of the training programmes will be less than 1200 hoursRs. as stipulated in National Occupational Standards (NOS) and Qualification Packs (QPs). - **Training Cost:** The training cost will be as per Common Cost Norms for NSQF job roles or as stipulated by concerned board as applicable and as amended from time to time. - **Other Expenses:**


1. **For non-residential training programmes**Rs. the trainees will be paid stipend @ 1Rs./- per month for SC candidatesRs. 1Rs./- per month to OBCs/EWSs/DNTs and 1Rs./- per month to Sanitation Workers including waste pickers and their dependents. 1. **For residential training programmes**Rs. wherever necessaryRs. the trainees will be provided boarding and lodging and expenses compensated within CCNRs. for complete duration of the training programmes. No stipend will be separately payable except in case of Safai MitrasRs. Waste Pickers & their dependents who will be paid 500/- per month.
##### **3.** ***Entrepreneurial Development Programmes (EDP):***

- **Implementing Agency:** Ministry will approach National Institute for Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development (NIESBUD) or any other organisation viz Indian Institute of Entrepreneurship (IIE) under Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship for conducting EDP training.
eligibility:
- Applicant must be an Indian national with valid proof of nationality.
- Applicant must be aged between 18 and 45 years.
- Applicant must belong to one of the following groups:

1. Scheduled Castes (SC);
1. Other Backward Classes (OBC);
1. Economically Weaker Sections (EWS);
1. Denotified & Nomadic Tribes (DNT0Rs. or
1. Safai Mitras (including Waste Pickers).

- Applicant from OBC or EWS must have an annual family income below 3Rs./- .
- Applicant from SCRs. DNTRs. or Safai Mitras (including Waste Pickers) has no income limit.
- Applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar card (exemption for the candidates of such States which have not implemented Aadhaar completely).
- Applicant must have an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
- Applicant must register on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH).
> **Target Groups:**


- ***Up-skilling/Re-skilling under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL):*** Up-skilling / Re-skilling under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) will only be applicable to Safai Mitras including waster pickers who constitute the bottom of the pyramid. - **Short-Term Courses (focus on wage/self-employment):** Most disempowered groups belonging to SC/OBC/EWS/DNT and Sanitation Workers including Waste Pickers and their dependents having aspirations to be employed in sectors having good demand in job market with suitable wage. - **Entrepreneurial Development Programmes(EDP):** SCsRs. EWSsRs. OBCs and DNTs youth who are having an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
> **Note:**


- **Attendance:**


1. Compulsory AEBAS-based attendance of assessors and candidates during assessment.
1. More than 70% of biometric attendance is required for each candidate to appear in the assessment in all types of training.


- **On the Job Training (OJT):**


1. The establishments offering OJT will give a certificate at the end of OJT indicating the duration and attendance of the candidate.
1. It will be the responsibility of the Training Provider to ensure the attendance of the candidates.
1. The final assessment of the candidates will be carried out after completion of OJTRs. and it shall be the responsibility of the training provider to ensure the presence of all eligible candidates for the assessment after completion of OJT.
1. In districts where facilities for OJT are not availableRs. special exemptions will be given by PAC. In these districtsRs. candidates may carry out project work.

name: Nari Adalat
brief_description: "Nari Adalat"Rs. a component of the "Sambal" sub-scheme under Mission ShaktiRs. by the Ministry of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of India aims to provide an alternate grievance redressal mechanism through counsellingRs. mediationRs. and awareness to women and girls in need at the Gram Panchayat level. It also focuses on empowering women collectives to resolve disputes and promote access to justice in a community-based setting.
benefits: > **Grievance Redressal Support:** - Provides an alternative dispute resolution platform at the local level. - Addresses cases related to harassmentRs. domestic violenceRs. property disputesRs. and social issues. > **Counselling and Mediation:** - Offers counsellingRs. negotiationRs. and mediation services. - Ensures resolution through mutual consent and evidence-based approach. > **Awareness Generation:** - Spreads awareness about legal rightsRs. government schemesRs. and entitlements. - Conducts campaigns on gender equality and womens rights. > **Community Support and Facilitation:** - Acts as a support system for women through handholding and guidance. - Connects beneficiaries to institutions like policeRs. hospitalsRs. and legal services. > **Financial Support (Operational):** - 3Rs./- per meeting (for the entire group) to cover logistics such as stationeryRs. travelRs. and refreshments. - 500/- honorarium to Mukhya Nyaya Sakhi per meeting. - 200/- incentive to each Nyaya Sakhi per meeting. - 800/- per member for uniformRs. provided twice a year.
eligibility: > **For Beneficiaries:** - The applicant should be a woman or girl seeking assistance. - The applicant should be facing issues such as harassmentRs. violenceRs. or denial of rights. - The applicant should belong to the local community within the Gram Panchayat jurisdiction. > **For Members (Nyaya Sakhis):** - The applicant should be a woman resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat. - The applicant should be socially respected and active in community work. - The applicant should preferably be an Elected Women RepresentativeRs. Self-Help Group memberRs. or professional (teacherRs. doctorRs. lawyerRs. social worker).

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
brief_description: Started in 2011Rs. the scheme "Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)" by the Ministry of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide free and cashless deliveryRs. treatmentRs. diagnosticsRs. drugsRs. dietRs. and transport services to pregnant women and sick newborns/infants at public health institutions. It also aims to eliminate out-of-pocket expenses related to deliveryRs. treatmentRs. and essential maternal and child healthcare services.
benefits: > **For Pregnant Women:** - Free and zero expense Delivery and Caesarean Section - Free Drugs and Consumables - Free Essential Diagnostics (BloodRs. Urine tests and Ultra-sonography etc) - Free Diet during stay in the health institutions (up to 3 days for normal - delivery & 7 days for caesarean section) - Free Provision of Blood - Free Transport from Home to Health Institutions - Free Transport between facilities in case of referral - Drop Back from Institutions to home after 48hrs stay - Exemption from all kinds of User Charges > **For Sick Newborns And Infants (Up to 30 days after birth):** - Free and zero-expense treatment - Free Drugs and Consumables - Free Diagnostics - Free Provision of Blood - Free Transport from Home to Health Institutions - Free Transport between facilities in case of referral - Drop Back from Institutions to home - Exemption from all kinds of User Charges
eligibility: - The applicant must be a pregnant woman. - The applicant must be admitted to a government health facility.

name: Logistics Excellence, Advancement, and Performance Shield
brief_description: The **Logistics ExcellenceRs. AdvancementRs. and Performance Shield** (LEAPS) scheme under the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)Rs. Ministry of Commerce and IndustryRs. Government of IndiaRs.** is a flagship initiative designed to acknowledge and celebrate best practices and innovations within the logistics industry. In line with the National Logistics Policy 2022Rs. LEAPS aims to create a new benchmark in India as well as globally by recognizing outstanding leadership and innovative endeavours across various sectors of the logistics industryRs. including airRs. roadRs. seaRs. rail freightRs. warehousingRs. and multimodal transportation. It also recognizes MSMEsRs. startupsRs. and academia that provide innovative solutions across the logistics ecosystem. LEAPS also raises awareness about sustainabilityRs. ESG (EnvironmentalRs. SocialRs. and Governance) practicesRs. and green logisticsRs. while promoting collaboration between governmentRs. industryRs. and academia to drive progress and efficiency. Building upon the foundation laid by the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan and the National Logistics PolicyRs. LEAPS endeavours to further enhance Indias logistics infrastructure and efficiency. It aims to create a technologically enabledRs. integratedRs. and sustainable logistics ecosystem. This is the 4th edition of LEAPS. > **The key guiding principles for LEAPS are:** 1. Comprehensive coverage of all logistics sectors and ecosystem enablers 1. Special focus on MSMEs and Startups 1. Showcase of diversityRs. inclusion and ESG best practices in the logistics industry 1. Alignment with the objectives of PM Gati Shakti 1. Alignment with the mission of Aatmanirbhar Bharat 1. Process innovationRs. efficiency aided by technology adoption.
benefits: Trophy/Certificate
eligibility: **A. Core logistics and Special categories** 1. name: Prime Minister's Award for Yoga
brief_description: The Prime Ministers Award for Yoga under the Ministry of AyushRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to recognize and felicitate individuals and organizations that have made a significant and sustained contribution to the promotion and development of YogaRs. creating a positive impact on society. **Number of Awardees:** - 2 Awards for Individuals (National/International) - 2 Awards for Organizations/Institutions (National/International)
