name: Tagore National Fellowship for Cultural Research
brief_description:
The Scheme Tagore National Fellowship for Cultural Research has been introduced to invigorate and revitalize the various institutions under the Ministry of Culture (MoC) and other identified cultural institutions in the countryRs. by encouraging Fellows/academicians to affiliate themselves with these institutions to work on projects of mutual interest.
With a view to infuse fresh knowledge capital into the institutionsRs. the scheme expects these Fellows/academicians to select specific resources of the institutions to use in their projects and take up research works that are related to the main objectives of these institutions. It is also expected that the research work would enrich the institution with a new creative edge and academic excellence.
> **Nodal Institutions (Participating Institutions):**

The Scheme shall cover the institutions under the Ministry of Culture (MoC)Rs. as listed in the GuidelinesRs. and may cover other such institutions in the future. The scheme will also cover Non-MoC institutions with cultural resources like manuscriptsRs. artifactsRs. antiquitiesRs. booksRs. publicationsRs. recordsRs. etc.Rs. and seek to take advantage of the scheme by engaging distinguished Fellows to work on its resources and also known for its rich publications. The nodal institutions (both MoC and non-MoC) are classified into four groups broadly based on their different areas of specializationRs. focusRs. and resources. The classification is as follows:
1. Group-A: ArchaeologyRs. AntiquitiesRs. Museums & Galleries
2. Group-B: ArchivesRs. Libraries and General Fellowship
3. Group-C: Anthropology & Sociology
4. Group D: CraftsRs. Performing/Visual/Literary Arts
> **Scope of the Scheme:**

The scope of the Scheme is to enable the identified cultural institutions to engage Fellows of outstanding meritRs. to work on research projects in order to unravel their unexplored resources. For purposes of convenienceRs. monitoringRs. accountingRs. and responsibilityRs. one of the institutions listed above would be the Nodal Institution for each projectRs. and the Fellows will be attached/anchored to that institution.
> **Duration of the Fellowship:**


- The duration of the Fellowship will be for a maximum period of two years.
- In exceptional casesRs. the institution may recommend to the NSC an extension for a period of up to one more yearRs. or a reduction to somewhat less than two yearsRs. if it is supported by its assessment of the quality of the work undertaken. HoweverRs. in the case of extensionRs. the fellow wont be eligible for any remuneration including contingency.
- The award of the Fellowship will commence from the date of joining and the months and years will be reckoned accordingly.

> **Number of Fellowships:**


- The scheme envisages the granting of up to 15 Fellowships in a year.
- Each nodal institution can be awarded 1 Fellowship in a year. HoweverRs. the MoC has the discretionary power to relax these numbers.

> **Administration of the Scheme:**

The total number of Fellowships administered by the institutions may be decided by the Ministry of Culture from time to timeRs. in consultation with the participating institutions. This will be based on certain criteria such as the size of its untapped holdingsRs. physical facilities already existing in the institutionRs. the capacity of the institution to guide and inspire the Fellows to get the best out of themRs. its past record in publication and researchRs. need for research/study in a particular areaRs. etc. An amount of up to 2% of the total allocation may be set aside for meeting expenses related to the administration of the scheme including monitoringRs. implementationRs. inspectionRs. reviewRs. etc. of the research work carried out by the FellowsRs. through outsourcing or Consultants.
benefits:
> **Honorarium:**


1. A Tagore National Fellow who is from a UniversityRs. CollegeRs. Research InstituteRs. or Government setup in India would be entitled to the same payRs. including grade payRs. etc.Rs. which he/she would have drawn had he/she continued in his/her parent organization. Essential or mandatory contributions of the employer to Provident Fund etc. would be paid by the parent organizations as would have been paid by them had he/she continued in his/her parent organization.
1. A Fellow from abroad or from a set-up other than UniversityRs. CollegeRs. Research Institute or Government serviceRs. or who has retired from active service and/or is on pensionRs. would be entitled to a fixed honorarium of 80Rs./- per month.
1. No payment of honorarium would normally be made to a Fellow receiving full funding from other sources up to the level of the honorariumRs. but such Fellow willRs. howeverRs. receive a Contingency GrantRs. other allowancesRs. and facilitiesRs. as decided by the NSC.

> **Contingency Grant:**


- In case of foreign and Indian research fellows residing or serving abroad and having been selected as Tagore Fellows under Non-MoC institutionsRs. to and fro economy class airfare from their country of residence will be provided/reimbursed by the Ministry once during the course of the Fellowship.
- SimilarlyRs. all fellows under Non-MoC institutions who take up the Fellowship under the Scheme will be reimbursedRs. on an actual basisRs. contingent expenses for making academic tripsRs. engaging research assistantsRs. etc. up to a maximum ceiling of 2.50 lakhs per annumRs. during the tenure of Fellowship subject to verification of requisite bills by the Nodal Institutions.

**Note:** For Fellows selected under MoC InstitutionsRs. the expenditure in this regard will be borne by the concerned MoC Institution from the grant-in-aid received by them from their administrative Division of the Ministry.
> **Accommodation:**


- A Fellow who is not a bona-fide resident of the place of the Participating Institution to which he has proposed to be affiliated and who intends to take up rented accommodation in the city of the desired Institution will be required to indicate this fact at the time of applying for Fellowship.
- The selected Fellow will be entitled to receive a House Rent Allowance of up to 30% of the honorarium. HoweverRs. with respect to Fellows from UniversitiesRs. collegesRs. Research institutesRs. or Government setups HRA will be paid by the Parent Organization as per entitlement.
- The MoC Institutions will bear the expenditure in this regard from the grant-in-aid received by them from their administrative Division of the Ministry.
- In respect of Non-MoC InstitutionsRs. the Ministry of Culture will reimburse the House Rent Allowance directly to Fellows on submission of rent receipts (in original) to the Participating Institutions who will verify and forward the same to the Ministry for reimbursement.

> **Settling Allowance:**


- A Fellow from outstation will be givenRs. if requiredRs. a lump sum grant of 1.00 lakh as settling allowance for packing/transportationRs. etc.Rs. of his personal belongings from the old station to the new station of his stay during the tenure of FellowshipRs. if he moves station or otherwise transports books and academic effects.
- Allowance of an equal amount will also be given at the conclusion of the Fellowship for moving out of station. On a case-to-case basisRs. economy airfare from his/her place/country of residence will be provided/reimbursed upon joining and at the conclusion of the Fellowship. In this regardRs. Non-MoC Institutions will bear the expenditure and thereafter seek reimbursement from the Ministry after submission of certified copies of Bills along with justification.

> **Support to Fellows:**


- Infrastructural support will be provided by the Nodal Institution to the Fellows to enable them to conduct their research. This may include the provision of a computer with peripherals and connectivityRs. working space in the institutions premisesRs. providing a congenial atmosphere to carry out researchRs. etc. Other facilitiesRs. like appropriate seating arrangementsRs. library facilitiesRs. etc.Rs. will also be made available.
- One important advantage of this scheme will be the access of the Fellows to national institutions for study and avail original and rare research material. In respect of foreign fellows engaged under this schemeRs. necessary political/security clearances from the concerned Ministries/Departments shall be obtained by the Ministry of Culture.
- Encouragement and financial support may also be given to enable the Fellows to present papers at conferences hosted by the concerned institution or other related organizations and institutionsRs. which will be met out/reimbursedRs. on an actuals basisRs. with a ceiling of 1.00 lakh per annumRs. provided adequate academic interaction is arranged
eligibility:
1. Fellows who have sound academic or professional credentials and have made significant contributions to knowledge in their respective fields will be eligible to apply for Tagore National Fellowship.
1. Preferably the Fellows who have 5 years of experience in conducting/guiding research or the same experience in performing/any other arts can apply for Tagore National Fellowship.
1. The applicants must have an impressive list of publications into their creditRs. at least two monographs (single-authored).
1. Fellows to be engaged must have both the credentials as laid down in the preceding paragraphRs. as well as a strong reputation in the field covered by the Nodal Institution.
1. Those who have in the past directly engaged with major projects at the Nodal Institution and fulfilled the above-mentioned eligibility criteria for a Tagore Fellow are encouraged to apply for the Tagore National Fellowship.
1. Once awarded a Tagore National FellowshipRs. a candidate cannot apply again for a Fellowship under this schemeRs. either at the same or any other institution covered under the Scheme.
1. The Scheme will be open to both Indian and foreign nationals. HoweverRs. the proportion of foreigners will not normally exceed onethird of the total fellowships awarded in a year.

**Note 01:** Interested Fellows are required to enclose a research proposal prepared on the guidelines provided in Appendix A.
**Note 02:** Fellows are also required to prepare a short write-up on how the proposed research would be beneficial for the respective nodal institution.
**Note 03:** The honour and the honorarium are both of a very high order; the Institution Level Search-cum-Screening Committee (ILSSC) of the sponsoring institution and the National Selection Committee may keep these in mind while recommending/ selecting the Tagore National Fellows.
**Note 04:** In shortRs. a person selected for the Tagore National Fellowship should be one who has already become a legend in his area of work or is regarded very highly. It is appropriate that those who do not come near this description may not apply or be considered for the highest honour and honorarium accorded to a Fellow in India under this Fellowship.
> **Areas of Research and Eligible Projects:**


1. The selected Fellows will normally work on a project that benefits the Nodal Institution in terms of unraveling its resources. The subject of research should be one that can be usefully pursued with the resources and facilities of the Nodal Institution awarding the FellowshipRs. though he/she will be free to draw on the resources and facilities of other institutionsRs. as well.
1. If the subject of research extends to more than one institution or the Fellow otherwise needs to draw upon the resources and facilities of other institution(s)Rs. the Nodal Institution awarding the Fellowship would recommend the Fellow to such other institution(s). In rare casesRs. where two institutions appear to be of almost equal importance to the FellowsRs. the second institution may be deemed to be the Co-institution and the two may sign a Tripartite MoU regarding Intellectual PropertyRs. PublicationRs. Credit sharingRs. facilitiesRs. etc. but accounting shall be with the Nodal Institution.
1. Since the Scheme is focused on unraveling the cultural resources of the Nodal InstitutionRs. the project must be driven in that directionRs. that isRs. to use substantially the resources of the Nodal Institution. The inputs required for the project should have a very strong linkage with the resources available with the Nodal Institution and (in rare cases) the Co-institution.
1. At the end of itRs. the project outcome must be beneficial for the Nodal Institution or co-institutionRs. if anyRs. and must add to the existing knowledge of the institution/subject.

name: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to strengthen agricultural mechanization and improve the productivity of Scheduled Tribe farmers in tribal areas. Under this schemeRs. tribal farmers are provided with financial assistance to purchase essential farm machinery such as a 6-feet rotavator or a thresher machineRs. which they cannot afford due to poor economic conditions.
benefits: - Financial assistance to farmers to purchase a rotavator (6 feet) or a thresher machine.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a resident of tribal or forest areas of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer dependent on agriculture as the main source of livelihood. 1. The applicant should intend to use the machinery for self-employment and agricultural purposes.

name: NPC Students Internship Program
brief_description:
The National Productivity Council (NPC) of the Department of Industrial Policy & Promotion Ministry of Commerce & Industry provides internship training to students pursuing graduation and post-graduation. The interns shall be given exposure to related interventions being activities undertaken by NPCs which will provide opportunities to learn and implement new concepts as well as develop new skills and gain a deeper understanding of IT-enabled interventions through the hands-on application of the knowledge students learned during their course curriculum.
> **Areas** Industrial Engineering (IE)Rs. Environment Management(EN)Rs. Energy Management(EM)Rs. Agribusiness Services(AB)Rs. Economic Services(ES)Rs. Information Technology (IT) and Advanced Manufacturing & Industry 4.0.
> **Duration** 1. The internship duration shall be for a period of two months. 1. The internship program shall be effective from the first week of June. 1. The internship period may be extendableRs. if requiredRs. on an individual case-to-case basis for a further mutually agreed duration.
benefits:
> **Certificate** The interns will be issued an internship completion certificate upon successful completion and submission of the full project report.
> **Logistics & Support** NPC shall provide them with working space with an internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned reporting authorities. **NOTE:** The Interns will be required to bring their own laptops.

> **Remuneration** The selected interns shall not be entitled to any financial remuneration/stipend during their internship period. No payment towards a stipendRs. transportation etc. shall be paid to the interns by NPC.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should not already have applied for the internship before in the current financial year. 1. The applicant should be a student pursuing graduation and post-graduation studies.
##### Only for Interns in Information Technology (IT) > **Job Requirements** 1. Strong editingRs. written and oral communication skills. 1. Strong interpersonal skills. 1. Proactive technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 1. Knowledge and understanding of learning patterns and strong Research and networking for generating quality learning material. 1. Knowledge of current and emerging eLearning tools and applications. 1. Expertise in graphics creation for classroom-based trainingRs. online trainingRs. and websites. > **Desired Skills** 1. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (i.e. WordRs. ExcelRs. PowerpointRs. Outlook)Rs. Adobe Photoshop and/or Adobe In Design 1. Proficient in graphic designing tools such as Adobe PhotoshopRs. Corel DrawRs. IllustratorRs. Ink Shape & related software knowledge 1. Proficient in programmingRs. data/ content managementRs. and website development with JavaRs. .NETRs. JavaScript or HTML/DHTML. 1. The overall work may also include leveraging leading technologies like SASRs. Big DataRs. HadoopRs. HiveRs. PigRs. PythonRs. SQLRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. Machine LearningRs. and Data Annotation Services.

name: ICMR- Post Doctoral Fellowship
brief_description: The "ICMR Post Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF)" scheme implemented by the Indian Council of Medical ResearchRs. Ministry of Health & Family WelfareRs. aims to promote advanced research in health sciences. It provides opportunities to fresh PhDRs. MDRs. or MS holders to work in ICMR institutes and centres. The scheme focuses on research in areas like basic scienceRs. communicable and non-communicable diseasesRs. reproductive healthRs. and nutrition. Every yearRs. around 50 fellowships are awarded to deserving candidates. Fellows get access to modern research facilities and expert guidance at ICMR institutions. The aim is to strengthen high-quality research and build skilled professionals in the health sector.
benefits: - **Monthly Fellowship:** 65Rs./- per month along with HRA and NPA as per Government rules. - **Contingency Grant:** 3Rs./- per year for research-related expenses. - **Travel Support:** Up to 25% of the contingency grant for national travel related to research work. - **Tenure Duration:** 2 yearsRs. extendable by 1 more year based on performance. - **Refund Clause:** Fellowship amount must be refunded if leaving before 1 year. - **Fund Disbursement:** Fellowship and contingency grants are released every six months. - **Accommodation Facility:** Accommodation may be provided (HRA not applicable if provided). - **Medical & Leave Benefits:** As per ICMR rules for fellows.
eligibility:
1. ICMR-PDF is open to Indian nationals only.
1. Fresh PhDs/MD/MS within three years of completing their Ph.D./MD/MS degree (awarded) as on the last date of the application and also those who have received their provisional Ph.D./MD/MS degree can apply.
1. The Post-Doctoral proposed research work should be the continuation of the Ph.D. or MD/MS research work. If notRs. then the application will not be considered.
1. The maximum age limit is 32 yearsRs. relaxable up to 5 years in case of SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidatesRs. as on the last date of application.
1. For deserving candidates age can be relaxed maximum up to a maximum of 3 years based on earlier work doneRs. publicationsRs. awardsRs. etc. along with the request by the sponsoring Director/Director-in-Charge. Director GeneralRs. ICMR may consider and relax on the recommendation of the screening committee.
1. The PDF Guide should have the minimum designation of Scientist-C grade.
1. Postgraduate medical students are also permitted to carry out ICMRs PDF in MCI-recognized postgraduate medical colleges wherein a minimum of three batches have obtained their postgraduate degrees.

**Note 01:** Result notification/certificate or Viva-voce/Thesis submitted notification will not be considered.
**Note 02:** It is mandatory to submit the Plagiarism check report along with the declaration to be submitted to ICMR along with the PDF proposal and application.
**Note 03:** A list of ICMR Institutes/Centers and their niche Areas/R&D activities are available on the ICMR website.

name: National Renewable Energy Fellowship Scheme

The scheme provides financial fellowships to meritorious students and researchers for higher studies like M.TechRs. M.Sc.Rs. PhDRs. and post-doctoral research. It focuses on advanced and industry-relevant research in renewable energy technologies. The scheme is implemented with a total budget of 200 crore for the period 202122 to 202526. Around 375 fellowships will be awarded over five years based on merit and industry demand. It also aims to create skilled manpower and support innovation and commercialisation in the renewable energy sector.
benefits:
**Category****Fellowship (****/month)****HRA****Contingency (/annum)****Duration**JRF31Rs./-As per the central govt. norms20Rs./-Per Month2 yearsSRF35Rs./--do--do-2 yearsPDF/RA47Rs./- (Level I)Rs. 49Rs./- (Level II)Rs. 54Rs./- (Level III).-do--do-2 yearsM.Tech/M.S 12Rs./---20-24 months (as per the institute norm)M.Sc (Renewable Energy)4Rs./---24 months (as per the institute norms)

PhD in Renewable Energy technologies **OR** The applicant must be a Research Associate or post-doctoral Fellow pursuing advanced research in MNRE institutions and other key institutions. 1. name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards
brief_description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Quality Upgradation / Certification: Drying Yards" is a Sub-Component of the Scheme "Integrated Coffee Development Project During the Medium Term Framework (MTF) Period: Development Support to Stakeholders" by the Coffee BoardRs. name: Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh / Direct Benefits Transfer For LPG
brief_description: "Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh / Direct Benefits Transfer For LPG (PAHAL)" launched by the Ministry Of Petroleum and Natural GasRs. ensures transparency by transferring LPG subsidies directly to consumers' bank accountsRs. eliminating diversion and reducing subsidy leakages. It empowers usersRs. improves deliveryRs. and enables self-selection for subsidyRs. with provisions for Aadhaar-linked and non-Aadhaar-linked accounts. This initiative protects consumer entitlementRs. prevents fraudRs. and promotes efficient subsidy management.
benefits: - **Direct Subsidy Transfer:** LPG consumers receive subsidies directly in their bank accounts automatically. - **Improved Availability:** Enhanced market availability of new LPG connections for genuine consumers. - **Health Benefits:** Replaces unclean cooking fuelsRs. reducing indoor pollution and preventing respiratory diseases among women and children in rural areas.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be an LPG user.
- The combined taxable income of the applicant and their spouse should not exceed 10Rs. in the previous financial yearRs. as per the Income Tax ActRs. 1961.

name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Education Loan
brief_description:
An Education Loan (EL) scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide education loans to the students from the community of safai karamcharis\manual scavengers & their dependents for pursuing higher education.
> Education loan to the students from the community of Safai Karamcharis\Manual Scavengers & their dependents for pursuing - Professional or Technical Education of Graduation or higher levels in MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. ManagementRs. LawRs. IT/Computers. - Graduation courses in all disciplines (i.e. B.A.Rs. B.Sc; & B.Com etc). - Sanitary Inspector & other similar job oriented courses having minimum period of one yearRs. Diploma in PhysiotherapyRs. PathologyRs. NursingRs. Hotel Management & TourismRs. Journalism & Mass CommunicationRs. Geriatric Care. - Academic/Professional courses at Graduate & Post Graduate level like Bachelor of EducationRs. Ph.DRs. Language coursesRs. BCARs. MCA etc; (from authorized/recognized Institutes/Universities).
benefits: > **Educational Loan:** Study in India10Rs./-2% 6% (0.5% p.a. rebate for women candidates for study in India) Study in Abroad20Rs./-3% p.a. 7% p.a.(0.5% p.a. rebate for women candidates for study in India) **Note:** The interest on an education loan (for study in India) is reimbursable under the scheme of Ministry of Education Rs. Government of India to the beneficiaries whose family annual income is upto 4.50 lac per annum. > **Repayment period:** - 5 years after the co-termination of the course. eligibility: > **The following person(s)/entities shall be considered eligible for availing of financial assistance under the various schemes of NSKFDC:-** 1. Safai Karamcharis (including Waste pickers)Rs. identified Manual Scavengers and their dependents. 1. Registered co-operative societies of the target group. 1. Legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target groupRs. and 1. PersonsRs. who produce a certificate from local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/ Railway OfficerRs. Head of the Govt. Departments (i.e. SchoolsRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted OfficerRs. Elected Members of the Municipal BodyRs. name: WISE Fellowship for Ph.D.
brief_description:
The "WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PhD)" was started by the Department of Science and Technology under Women in Science and Engineering-KIRAN (WISE-KIRAN) Scheme to provide an opportunity to carry out Doctoral research in basic and applied sciences to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-45 years who want to pursue research in STEM fields as a bench-level scientist.
> **Vision:**

WISE-PhD provides an opportunity for women to pursue higher educationRs. i.e.Rs. a Ph.D. through an independent project grant.
> **Objectives:**

The main objective of WISE-PhD is to encourage women scientists to conduct Doctoral research in science and engineering and to engage them in knowledge dissemination through SSR.
> **Target Group:**

Women who have Post Graduation in Basic or Applied Sciences or an equivalent degree and wish to pursue Ph.D. in basic & applied sciences can apply to the WISE-PhD programme for financial support. Women in regular employment are not eligible for this programme.
> **Scientific Disciplines:**

Under WISE-PhDRs. support is available in 5 scientific disciplines viz. (1) Physical and Mathematical Sciences (2) Chemical Sciences (3) Life Sciences (4) Earth and Atmospheric SciencesRs. and (5) Engineering & Technology
> **Project Duration:**

The project is tenable for a maximum period of five (5) years or till submission of a Ph.D. thesisRs. whichever is earlier.
benefits:
1. The fellowship amount under this programme is 37Rs./- per month along with House Rent Allowances (HRA) as per norms.
1. This Programme also provides a Research Grant of 1.00 lakh per year and Institutional overhead charges @ 0.50 lakh per year (as per DST norms).
eligibility:
Unemployed women who want to pursue a Ph.D. can apply for a fellowship under WISE-PhD. The programme is open for both candidates; those who have not yet registered as well as those who have already registered for a Ph.D.Rs. but not availing of a fellowship from any sources. HoweverRs. candidates who have completed two (2) years duration in Ph.D. as of the date of application are NOT eligible. The following are the primary eligibility criteria:
> **Qualification:**

The applicant should have an M. Sc./ M. Tech. or equivalent degree like B. Tech.Rs. M.Phil.Rs. M. Pharm. etc. in basic and applied sciences from a recognized University/Institute.
> **Age:**

The minimum age to apply for the programme is 27 years and the maximum is 45 years (A relaxation of 3 years in the upper age limit is allowed for SC/ ST/ PH candidates). The cut-off date for age calculation would be the date of submission of the WISE-PhD application.
> **Employment:**

Women in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-PhD.

name: Internship Programme At Serious Fraud Investigation Office
brief_description: The scheme "Internship Programme At Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO)" conducted by the Serious Fraud Investigation Office under the Ministry of Corporate AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide exposure to government functioning and practical experience through interaction with SFIO officers to students pursuing higher studies and professional courses. The programme also provides an opportunity to interns to not only familiarize themselves with the working of the Government but also offers a chance to gain hands-on experience in specialized skills in their area of study as well as working in team.
benefits: - **Stipend:** The interns will be paid a stipend of 7Rs./- per month for the period of the internship. - **Certificate of Internship:** Certificates will be awarded to interns upon satisfactory completion of their internship and on submission of their end-of-assignment ReportRs. and its evaluation by the concerned official of SFIO. - **Duration:** The internship will be for a minimum period of one month and a maximum period of two months. > **Note:** The internship will neither be a job nor an assurance of a job in the Serious Fraud Investigation Office.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Indian National.
2. The applicant should be any one of the following -:

- Students in Post Graduate Courses MBA (Finance)Rs. Law Students in 4th/5th Year of a five-year stream with consistent and excellent academic records/fresh graduates with excellent academic records possessing a first-class graduation degree;
- Students pursuing post-graduation with a high second-class graduation degree (with at least 55% marks/students pursuing Masters/Research Courses in Economics/Finance/Management/Law at the National School of Economics/Law / Computer Forensics from recognized universities in India and Abroad.
- Students pursuing final year or the equivalent of ICAIRs. ICAI(CMA)Rs. ICSI/Central Universities/AICTE recognized financial/Economic Institutions/recognized National Management Institutes/Foreign Universities and Institutions of Excellence.

3. In the case of Graduate ApplicantsRs. the applicant should have secured First Class Degree in Graduation.

name: Women Helpline
brief_description: "Women Helpline" provides 24X7 emergency and non-emergency response through telephonic short-code 181 to womenRs. by linking them with appropriate authorities such as PoliceRs. One Stop CentresRs. HospitalsRs. Legal Services Authorities etc. AdditionallyRs. it provides information about women welfare schemes and services.The Women Helpline has been integrated with the Emergency Response Support System 112 (ERSS-112) helpline of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and Child Helpline (1098). FurthermoreRs. the Women Helpline (WHL) is being integrated with the One Stop Centre Scheme (OSC) and Hub for Empowerment of Women (HEW) to refer women affected by violence in need of redressal services.
benefits: - Emergency assistance. - Non-emergency assistance. - Information about government schemes and services. - Referral services.
eligibility: - Any woman in distress seeking emergency/non- emergency services or information or any other individual on her behalf can connect with the Women Helpline by calling the toll free 181.

name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
brief_description: The CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child (SGC) scheme has been launched by the Ministry of EducationRs. Government of IndiaRs. and implemented by the Central Board of Secondary Education. The scheme aims to promote education among single girl children and encourage meritorious students to continue their studies. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to single girl students studying in classes 11th and 12th. It supports students who have demonstrated academic excellence in class 10th examinations and are enrolled in CBSE-affiliated schools.
benefits: **Financial Assistance** - 1Rs. per month per student provided for a maximum period of 2 years (classes 11th and 12th) **Mode of Disbursement** - Direct transfer through ECS (Electronic Clearing Service) / NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) **Validity** - Up to completion of class 12 (maximum 2 years)Rs. subject to renewal conditions
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a single girl child of her parents. 1. The applicant should have secured 70% or more marks in CBSE class 10th examination.1. The applicant should be studying in Class 11 or 12 in a CBSE-affiliated school. 1. The applicant should have a tuition fee not exceeding 2Rs. per month in class 10th.1. The applicant should have a tuition fee not exceeding 3Rs. per month in classes 11th and 12th.1. The applicant should have gross parental/family income not exceeding 8Rs. per annum. 1. The applicant should be an Indian National. 1. The applicant should continue her studies in classes 11th and 12th.1. All children born together (such as twins) are considered a single girl child. 1. NRI students are eligible and their tuition fee should not exceed 6Rs. per month.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Tractor Purchase
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Tractor Purchase" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial assistance for acquiring tractorsRs. covering up to 90% of the tractor's cost. The interest rate ranges from 11% to 12.25%Rs. subject to market conditions.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Covers up to 90% of the tractor cost. - **Interest Rate:** 11% to 12.25% (subject to change).
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiary should be a farmer.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in agriculture activities.
1. The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for purchasing Tractor.

name: Distribution of Sewing Machines at Free of Cost
brief_description: The "Distribution of Sewing Machines at Free of Cost" scheme launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide free sewing machines to eligible individuals from Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNCs).
benefits: - Free provision of Sewing Machines to eligible individuals.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should belong to Backward Classes (BC)/ Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ and Denotified Communities (DNCs). - The beneficiary should possess tailoring knowledge. - Annual income should not exceed 40Rs./- in rural areas and 60Rs./- in urban areas. - The beneficiary should be between 20-45 years of age.

name: Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)-DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA) has been implemented by the Department of FisheriesRs. UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The scheme aims to help the families of the fishermen affected due to captured by Pakistani Marine Security Agency. Ameliorate the hardship due to apprehension/detention of the fishing vesselRs. by providing one time back ended financial assistance to the registered and licensed fishing vessel owners operating from the Union Territory to re-construct/replace their fishing boat/engine etc.
benefits: > **Pattern of Assistance:** - Unskilled daily wages rate as notified time to time by the U. T. Administration to the families of the Fishermen those are held 1s time captive/detained by Pakistani Marine Security Agency (PMSA)Rs. having valid ID Cards and resident of U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. - **T.A./D.A. to the fishermen during the repatriations from Pakistani Jail:-** 1. Travelling Allowance (T.A.) is admissible at 2nd class Sleeper of Railways Fair. 1. Daily Allowance (D.A.) of 250/- per day per person is admissible during repatriation. - One time financial Assistance in the form of back ended subsidy to the registered boat owner of the U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to re-construct/ replace their fishing vessels by new fishing vessels @ 25% maximum up to 10.00 lakhRs. with waiting period of five years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant must be a boat owner or fisherman captured by the Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)Rs. or a family member thereof.

name: The Operation of Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
brief_description: The scheme "The Operation of Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing" has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)Rs. Government of India. The scheme provides financial incentives to eligible companies based on their incremental sales of goods manufactured in India over a defined base year. It is a performance-linked scheme where incentives are disbursed only after actual production and sales are achievedRs. rather than as upfront support. The scheme is applicable to identified sectors and products notified by the Government of India and requires companies to meet specified investmentRs. productionRs. and sales thresholds. A Project Management Agency (PMA) is responsible for handling applicationsRs. verification of claimsRs. and monitoring implementation. The scheme also includes a structured approval mechanism involving designated authorities to ensure transparency and ensures that incentives are granted strictly based on verified incremental performance in manufacturing output.
benefits: 1. The scheme provides financial incentives linked to incremental production and sales of manufactured goods in IndiaRs. encouraging actual performance-based growth. 1. It promotes large-scale manufacturing investment in IndiaRs. helping companies expand capacity and strengthen production facilities in targeted sectors. 1. The scheme helps in increasing domestic manufacturing output and value additionRs. thereby strengthening Indias industrial base. 1. It reduces dependence on imports by encouraging domestic production of goods within the target segments. 1. The scheme supports the development of a globally competitive manufacturing ecosystem in IndiaRs. improving global integration. 1. It attracts domestic and foreign investment into identified manufacturing sectorsRs. boosting economic growth. 1. It ensures a performance-based incentive structureRs. where benefits are provided only after actual achievement of production and sales targets.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a company engaged in manufacturing under the specified target segments and must meet the defined qualification criteria for eligibility under the scheme. 1. The applicant should have a consolidated global manufacturing revenue in the relevant target segment exceeding the prescribed threshold in the base yearRs. including revenue of group companies as applicable. 1. The applicant should satisfy the minimum eligibility thresholds of incremental investment and incremental sales of manufactured goods over the base year as specified in the scheme guidelines. 1. The applicant should ensure that eligibility for incentive in any year is subject to meeting the required threshold criteria for that particular year under the scheme. 1. The applicant should acknowledge that failure to meet the threshold criteria in any given year will result in non-eligibility for incentive for that yearRs. without affecting eligibility in subsequent years. 1. The applicant should ensure that incremental sales of manufactured goods over the base year are considered for determining eligibilityRs. irrespective of invoice value thresholds. 1. The applicant should comply with the condition that only sales of manufactured goods under the target segments are considered for evaluation of eligibility. 1. The applicant should understand that eligibility under this scheme shall not impact eligibility under any other schemeRs. and vice versa.

name: Public Provident Fund Account(PPF)
brief_description: The Public Provident Fund (PPF) SchemeRs. operated under the Department of PostsRs. Ministry of CommunicationsRs. offers a secure and long-term investment option to individuals. The scheme currently provides an interest rate of 7.1% per annumRs. which is periodically revised by the government. To open a PPF accountRs. a minimum deposit of 500 is required in a financial yearRs. while the maximum limit is 1Rs.. Investors have the flexibility to make deposits either in a lump sum or in multiple installments within the financial yearRs. making it a convenient and disciplined savings option.
benefits: Interest payableRs. RatesRs. Periodicity etc.Minimum Amount for opening of account and maximum balance that can be retained7.1% per annumMinimum INR. 500/-. Maximum INR. 1Rs./- in a financial year. Deposits can be made in lumpsum or in installments**Deposit** 1. Minimum deposit 500/- in a Financial Year and Maximum deposit is 1.50 lakh in a Financial Year. 1. Maximum limit of 1.50/- lakh shall be inclusive of the deposits made in his/her own account and in the account opened on behalf of minor. 1. Amount can be deposited in any number of instalments in a FY in multiple of 50 and maximum up to 1.50 lakh 1. Subsequent deposits can be made through internet banking option (NEFT/RTGS) from another bank 1. Deposits qualify for deduction under section 80C of Income Tax Act **Interest** 1. Interest notified by Ministry of Finance from time to timeRs. shall be eligible for a calendar month on the lowest balance at the credit of an account between the close of the fifth day and the end of the month. 1. Interest shall be credited to the account at the end of each year 1. Interest earned is tax free under Income Tax Act **Loan and Repayment** 1. At any time after the expiry of one year from the end of the year in which the initial subscription was made but before expiry of 5 years from the end of the year in which the initial subscription was madeRs. the account holder may apply for obtaining a loan consisting of a sum of whole rupees not exceeding 25%.of the amount that stood to his credit at the end of the second year immediately preceding the year in which the loan is applied for (i.e. if loan taken during 2025-26Rs. 25% of balance credit on 31.03.2024) 1. The principal amount of a loan shall be repaid by the account holder before the expiry of 36 months from the first day of the month following the month in which the loan is sanctioned 1. After the principal amount of the loan is fully repaidRs. the account holder shall pay interest thereon in not more than two monthly instalments at the rate of 1% per annum of the principal for the period commencing from the first day of the month following the month in which the loan is drawn upto the last day of the month in which the last instalment of the loan is repaid: 1. Provided that where the loan is not repaidRs. or is repaid only in partRs. within a period of thirty-six monthsRs. interest on the amount of loan outstanding shall be charged at 6% per annum instead of at 1% per annum with effect from the first day of the month following the month in which the loan was obtainedRs. to the last day of the month in which the loan is finally repaid. 1. An account holder shall be entitled for only one loan in a year. 1. An account holder shall not be entitled to get a fresh loan so long as earlier loan has not been repaid in full together with interest thereon.
eligibility: 1. An individual may open an account 1. An individual may also open one account on behalf of each minor or a person with mental illness or intellectual disability of whom he is the guardian: Provided that only one account shall be opened in the name of a minor or a person with mental illness or intellectual disability by any of the guardian. **Note:** Joint account shall not be opened under this Scheme **Note:** Accounts can also be opened through e-Banking facility. It is to be noted that Post Office Savings Account is a prerequisite for availing internet banking facility (Please visit www.ebanking.indiapost.gov.in)

name: Mukhyamantri Sukh Ashray Yojana
brief_description: Mukhyamantri Sukh Ashray Yojana is a flagship social welfare initiative launched by the Himachal Pradesh government on February 16Rs. 2023. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive careRs. educationRs. and support to orphansRs. abandoned childrenRs. specially-abled individualsRs. destitute womenRs. and senior citizensRs. recognizing them as children of the state and ensuring their holistic development. **Objectives** 1. Declare orphans and abandoned children as state children and ensure their careRs. educationRs. and social security. 1. Empower destitute women and elderly individuals through financial assistanceRs. housingRs. and skill development. 1. Provide inclusive support covering healthRs. educationRs. housingRs. livelihoodRs. and marriage.
benefits: 1. Children Aged 0-14 Years: 1Rs. per month for general maintenance. 1. Children Aged 14-18 Years and Destitute Women: 2Rs. per month. 1. Young Adults Aged 18-27 Years: 4Rs. per month pocket allowance; up to 1Rs. annually for coaching and hostel fees; 3Rs. per month for PG rent where hostels are unavailable. 1. Housing Support: 3 bighas of land and 3Rs. for house construction. 1. Marriage Support: 2Rs. as marriage assistance for eligible beneficiaries. 1. Self-Employment Support: 2Rs. one-time grant to start a business or profession. 1. Educational Exposure Tour: 15-day annual educational tour including air travel and 3-star hotel accommodation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. OrphansRs. abandonedRs. or specially-abled children under 27 years of age. 1. Destitute women who are either unmarried or whose husbands have been missing for over 7 years. 1. Senior citizens who do not have any support are also eligible under this scheme.

name: Museum Grant Scheme
brief_description: The Museum Grant Scheme under the Ministry of CultureRs. Government of IndiaRs. provides financial assistance for setting up new museums and strengthening and modernizing existing ones at regionalRs. stateRs. and district levels. The scheme also promotes digitization of museum collections to make images and catalogues accessible online and focuses on capacity building of museum professionals. It supports institutions such as Central and State GovernmentsRs. Public Sector UndertakingsRs. SocietiesRs. Autonomous BodiesRs. Local BodiesRs. Academic InstitutionsRs. and Trusts registered under the Societies Act. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for establishing and developing museumsRs. digitizing art objectsRs. and training museum professionals. It covers a wide range of museumsRs. including those with collections of antiquitiesRs. numismaticsRs. paintingsRs. ethnological objectsRs. folk artRs. textilesRs. stampsRs. and other art and craft itemsRs. as well as online virtual museumsRs. theme-based museumsRs. Virtual Experiential Museums (VEM)Rs. and projects of national importance. For effective implementationRs. a Project Monitoring Committee reviews progressRs. and beneficiary museums must submit annual visitor (footfall) data for five years after project completion. **Monitoring** The museums granted financial assistance under the scheme would be required to send yearly footfall in the museums for 5 years after the completion of the project. A Project Monitoring Committee/cell constituted in the Ministry will periodically monitor and review the progress of the scheme for its effective implementation. **Scheme Components** 1. The Scheme will have 3 components as given below : 1. Development and Establishment of Museums at the regionalRs. state and District level 1. Digitization of Museum Collections 1. Capacity building and training of Museum Professionals
benefits: **The financial assistance will be provided to the museums in the following way :** **Category I****Maximum Amount of financial assistance ( In Crores)**Category I15**Category II****Maximum Amount of financial assistance ( In Crores)**Setting up of New Museums10Development of Existing Museums8**Category III****Maximum Amount of financial assistance ( In Crores)**Setting up of New Museums5Development of Existing Museums4**Digitization Component** **Category****Max Grant Amount**Category I50 LakhCategory II25 Lakh**Training & Capacity Building Component** **Category****Max Grant Amount**Category I30 LakhCategory II25 Lakh
eligibility: The applicant should belong to Category IRs. IIRs. or III as defined: - Category I: Central or State Government-owned museums in state capitalsRs. including Public Sector Undertakings (PSU) museums. - Category II: Central or State Government-owned museumsRs. including PSU museumsRs. not necessarily in state capitals. - Category III: All other museumsRs. including PSU museums. 1. The applicant should be located in the capital of the state or union territory (for certain categories). 1. The applicant should have a significant collection of historical or cultural objects/artifacts. 1. The applicant should be a museum of high repute in its region. 1. The applicant should have an annual footfall of at least 1 lakh visitors per year in the preceding two years. 1. The applicant should have been in existence for at least three years prior to application. 1. Note: This requirement may be relaxed in exceptional casesRs. with written justification by the Expert Committee. 1. The applicant should have a well-defined constitution and laid-down rules/bye-laws for functioning. 1. The applicant should not be run for personal profit. 1. The applicant should own and possess a substantial collection of objects for display. 1. The applicant should be able to maintain the museum and bear all recurring costsRs. including utilitiesRs. maintenanceRs. and staff. 1. The applicant should have adequate infrastructureRs. resourcesRs. and trained personnel to execute the work for which the grant is requested. 1. The applicant should provide a certificate from the State Government (Department of Culture or equivalent) attesting to satisfactory performance. 1. The applicant should own the land where the museum is situated or proposed to be constructed. 1. The applicant should ensure that the land and museum are easily accessible to visitors. 1. The applicant should be eligible for funding for construction of new museum buildings or galleries.

name: MANAGE Internship Programme
brief_description: "MANAGE Internship Programme" implemented by the National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers WelfareRs. is open to students from the disciplines of Extension EducationRs. EconomicsRs. SociologyRs. PsychologyRs. MSWRs. JournalismRs. CommunicationRs. and Environmental Science. The internships are open year-roundRs. and the duration ranges from 3 months to 6 months. The interns are provided a stipend of upto 35Rs./- per month. The applicants should be fluent in English and should have good writing skills. The internships are open year-round.
benefits: > **Stipend:** - **For 3 months Internship Programme:** 10Rs./- per month with free boarding and lodging.- **For 6 months Internship Programme:** 35Rs./- per month. > **Duration:** - The internships are available for a duration of 3 months to 6 months.
eligibility: - The applicant should have completed/ongoing PhD or M.Sc in Extension Education/ Economics/ Sociology/ Psychology/ MSW/ Journalism/ Communication/ Environmental Science. - The applicant should have secured an OGPA of a minimum of 8 out of 10 (minimum 80%). - The applicant should have fluency in English. - The applicant should have good writing skills.

name: TEC Internship Scheme
brief_description: The TEC Internship Scheme by the Telecommunication Engineering Centre (TEC)Rs. Department of TelecommunicationsRs. New Delhi intends to engage 25 Interns in order to study/formulate/operationalize/assess various works/projects/policies etc. The internship Programme will allow young talent to be associated with the TEC work for mutual benefit. It will enable TEC to interact with young scholars and get fresh ideas and study/ research support from academics. At the same timeRs. it will provide an opportunity for young scholars to contribute to the TEC work and have insight into the related technical work. > **Number of Interns** The number of Interns will be 25. **NOTE:** The number is provisional and may vary as per the actual requirements at the time of finalisation of the selection. > **Duration** The period of engagement initially will be for 6 (six) monthsRs. extendable to 12 monthsRs. if required. **NOTE:** An extension beyond six months shall be permittedRs. on the application of the intern duly recommended by the concerned Head of Division and with the approval of the Head of TEC.
benefits:
> **Token Amount** The interns will be paid a token amount of 15Rs./- per month.
> **Certificate** The Interns will be issued a [Certificate ](https://www.tec.gov.in/pdf/Vacancy/TEC%20internship%20scheme%20and%20corrigendum.pdf)at the end of the internship.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 2. The applicant should be studying at a recognized university in India or abroad. 3. The applicant should be studying in the 3rd/ 4th year (Final or pre-final year) in Bachelor's Degree course in Electronics/ Communications/ Telecommunication/ Radio/ Information Technology/ Computers / Electrical Engineering or related discipline and secured a minimum of 60% marks. OR The applicant should have completed the Bachelor's Degree course in Electronics/ Communications/ Telecommunication/ Radio/ Information Technology/ Computers/ Electrical Engineering or a related discipline course in the last year with a minimum of 60% marks. OR The applicant should have completed Post Graduate/Master's Degree courses in Electronics/ Communications/ Telecommunication/ Radio/ Information Technology/ Computers/ Electrical Engineering or related discipline courses in the last year with minimum 60% marks.
> **Reservation/Preference/Priority/Relaxation** 1. The qualifications may be relaxed in deserving cases based on the needs of the TECRs. on the recommendations of the Selection Committee and approval of the Head of TEC. 1. Candidates having exposure in the area of intended internship with good academic background and having higher qualificationsRs. based on need shall be given preference.
**NOTE:** Possessing the minimum qualifications above shall not guarantee an Internship in TEC.

name: Welfare Services for Other Socially Disabled Persons (Senior Citizens & Destitute)
brief_description: The "Welfare Services for Other Socially Disabled Persons (Senior Citizens & Destitute)" under the Mizoram Grant-in-Aid framework focuses on elderly persons (65+)Rs. destitute individualsRs. and socially disabled persons who lack means of livelihood. It supports NGOs in running old age homesRs. day care centresRs. mobile medical unitsRs. and specialized care services. The scheme ensures access to healthcareRs. shelterRs. companionshipRs. and mental health supportRs. promoting dignified living for senior citizens.
benefits: > **Care & Shelter** - Old age homes and respite care homes. > **Healthcare** - Mobile medical units. - Physiotherapy clinics. > **Day Care Services** - Multi-service centres for elderly. > **Special Care** - Dementia/Alzheimers care centres. > **Support Services** - Counseling and helplines.
eligibility: > **For Individuals (Beneficiaries):** - The applicant must be a senior citizen aged 65 years or above. - The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant must be a destitute person without any regular means of livelihood. - The applicant must not have family members or relatives to provide financial or social support. > **For Organizations:** - The applicant must be a registered voluntary organization/NGO/institution. - The applicant must be engaged in providing welfare services for senior citizens or destitute persons. - The applicant must have adequate infrastructure such as old age homesRs. day care centresRs. or care facilities. - The applicant must have experience in implementing elderly care or social welfare programmes. - The applicant must ensure that services are provided without discrimination on any grounds.

name: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
brief_description: ICAR awards a certain number of Junior Research Fellowships for Postgraduate Studies (course and research work) leading to a Masters degreeRs. in different disciplines of agriculture and allied sciences. This is done to ensure the recognition of talent and promotion of merit in generalRs. and for encouraging talented students to undertake higher agricultural education. The duration of the fellowship is two years. The minimum age limit shall be 19 years as of the date of the examination. Reservation of various categories such as SC/ST/OBC and PH etc will be given as per Government of India rules/instructions issued from time to time.
benefits:
- **Veterinary Sciences:** 12Rs./- per month With a contingency grant of 6Rs./- per annum. - **All disciplines other than Veterinary Sciences:** 8Rs./- per month With a contingency grant of 6Rs./- per annum.
_The rates of fellowship and contingency grants for higher studies will be as prescribed by the Council from time to time._
eligibility:
***Method of Award:***
ICAR-JRF (PGS) will be awarded on the basis of merit in the All India Competitive Entrance Examination for -
(i) ICAR-JRF (PGS)Rs. and
(ii) concurrent admission to Masters degree program at -
a) State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)Rs. and
b) Deemed Universities viz. IARI (New Delhi) / IVRI (Izatnagar) / NDRI (Karnal) / CIFE (Mumbai) / AAU (Allahabad)Rs. Central Agricultural University (ImphalRs. Manipur)Rs. and
c) Central Universities having faculty of agriculture viz. Banaras Hindu University (BHU)Rs. Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)Rs. Visva BhartiRs. and Nagaland UniversityRs. collectively hereinafter referred to as the Agricultural Universities (AUs).
***Eligibility***

1. Only those candidates having passed their Bachelors Degree or appearing at the Final Examination of the Bachelors Degree in the concerned fieldRs. under 10+2+5Rs. 10+2+4 or 10+2+3 (only for basic science subjects) are eligible to apply for admission. (For admissionRs. the eligibility requirement laid down by the respective AUs including remedial courses and tenure will be treated as final.)
1. Candidates must have obtained 60% marks or an Overall Grade Point Average (OGPA) of 6.60/10.00 or 3.25/5.00 or 2.6/4.00 for GeneralRs. OBCRs. and Under Privileged States(UPS) categories whereasRs. for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped (PH) categoriesRs. the candidates must have obtained 55% marks or an OGPA of 5.5/10.00 or 2.75/5.00 or 2.20/4.00. The equivalence of OGPA to percent marksRs. where neededRs. will be certified by the Registrar of the concerned University
1. For admission in M.V.Sc.Rs. candidates must have completed B.V.Sc.&A.H. with internship before the date of registration in the University.
1. The minimum age limit shall be 19 years as of the date of the examination. No relaxation is admissible regarding the minimum age limit.

**Note 1:** Reservation of various categories such as SC/ST/OBC and PH etc. will be given as per Government of India rules/instructions issued from time to time. The responsibility of verification of the genuineness of SC/ST/OBC and PH certificates will solely rest with the concerned Agricultural University (AU) where the candidate has been recommended for admission or granted provisional admission.
**Note 2:** The ICAR-JRF (PGS) will NOT be available for admission in any university other than the AUs as mentioned above.

name: Welfare Services for Women
brief_description: The "Welfare Services for Women" component under the Mizoram Grant-in-Aid framework implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. MizoramRs. is designed to address the needs of vulnerable women facing socialRs. economicRs. and psychological challenges. The scheme supports voluntary organizations in implementing programs that ensure safetyRs. rehabilitationRs. and empowerment of women in difficult circumstances. Target beneficiaries include widows without supportRs. women affected by domestic violenceRs. survivors of trafficking and sexual crimesRs. women affected by disastersRs. HIV/AIDS-affected womenRs. and women without any means of livelihood. The scheme provides financial assistance to organizations for establishing and running facilities such as working women hostelsRs. short stay homesRs. training centresRs. and support services like legal aidRs. counselingRs. and helplines. It also promotes awarenessRs. skill developmentRs. and income-generating activities to help women achieve self-reliance. Special focus is given to providing safe accommodationRs. healthcareRs. legal supportRs. and vocational trainingRs. enabling women to reintegrate into society with dignity and independence.
benefits: > **Shelter & Protection:** - Establishment of Working Women Hostels. - Short Stay Homes for women and girls. > **Financial Support:** - Assistance to widows without income. - Support for women in distress. > **Skill Development & Livelihood:** - Vocational training programmes. - Training-cum-production centres. - Support for self-employment. > **Support Services:** - Legal aid and counseling services. - Helplines and crisis intervention support. > **Health & Rehabilitation:** - HIV/AIDS careRs. treatmentRs. and counselling. - Clinical and psychological support. > **Awareness & Empowerment:** - WorkshopsRs. seminarsRs. and awareness programmes. - Education on rights and entitlements.
eligibility: The following individual types of applicants are eligible under this scheme: - Widows without family or financial support - Women facing domestic violence - Trafficked or rescued women/girls - Women affected by natural disasters - Women with HIV/AIDS - Economically backward women - Women labourersRs. including domestic workers

name: Overseas Visiting Doctoral Fellowship
brief_description:
> **Objectives:**


- To build national capacity in frontier areas of Science and EngineeringRs. which are of interest to India by providing research training to PhD students admitted in Indian institutions in overseas universities/institutions of repute.
- To provide an opportunity for performing Indian research students to gain exposure and access to top-class research facilities in academia and labs in specific Overseas Universities.
- To create opportunities to build long-term R&D linkages and collaborations with accomplished scientists and technologists from around the world.
- To tap the expertise gained by these young scientists to strengthen/initiate national programmes in their domain knowledge.

> **Duration of Fellowship:**


- The duration of the research training is up to a period of twelve months. In exceptional circumstancesRs. the fellowship may be extended for six more months' subject to performance evaluation.
benefits:
1. The selected fellows will be paid a monthly fellowship amount equivalent to US $ 2000Rs. one-time Contingency/Preparatory allowances of 60Rs./- to cover visa feesRs. airport transfer chargesRs. medical insuranceRs. etc.
1. The selected fellows will also be provided the shortest route economy class airfare from their place of work in India to the place of the host institute and back. Students should make their own arrangements for accommodation etc.
1. One visitRs. each by the Indian supervisor to the Overseas Institution where the student is working and overseas faculty to the host Indian Institution of the student is also admissible under the Scheme. The following provisions are made for them to undertake research visits:


- **Travel:** Both the Indian supervisor and overseas scientist will be provided the shortest route round-trip economy class airfare not exceeding 1.5 lakhs per round trip from their place of work to the city of the host institute and back. Any additional cost would have to be borne by the visitors.

- **Per-diem (Subsistence Allowance):**

**Indian Supervisors to Overseas Country****Overseas host to India****Overseas host to India**Up to 14 days>14 and up to 30 daysUS $ 75 per day up to 30 days3000/- per day2000/- per day
- **Accommodation:**

**Indian Supervisors to Overseas Country****Indian supervisors to Overseas Country****Overseas host to India****Overseas host to India**Up to 14 days>14 and up to 30 daysUp to 14 days>14 and up to 30 daysUS $ 150 per dayUS $ 100 per day4500/- per day3000/- per day
- **Contingencies and related travel costs:** Allowance of US $ 250 per visit is provided to both Indian Supervisor and Overseas host to cover the expenditure incurred towards visa feesRs. travel / medical insuranceRs. airport transfersRs. and other contingencies.
**Note:** For scientists/researchers in regular employmentRs. rules governing payment of salaryRs. leaveRs. medicalRs. gratuityRs. GPF pensionRs. etc. of the organization/ institution/ university to which the faculty belongs would continue to be applicable. No liability on any of these accounts will be borne by SERB.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is open to Indian nationals only.
1. The applicant should have registered for a full-time Ph.D. Degree in any of the recognized Institutions / Universities in India in ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. EngineeringRs. and Mathematics (including MedicineRs. PharmaRs. AgricultureRs. and related S&T areas) disciplines.
1. Part-time and sponsored students are not considered under the scheme.
1. The students who have submitted their thesis for the award of the Degree of Ph.D. are not eligible to apply.

**Note 01:** The selected fellows while taking up the SERB overseas fellowship should not draw their regular research fellowship in India.
**Note 02:** The exchange visit of the supervisors should be during the tenure of the Ph.D. work of the applicant. Both supervisors should ensure a residency period of at least two weeks and not exceeding 30 days in their respective foreign institutes.
**Note 03:** The Indian Institution should ensure the availability of necessary facilities including scientific equipmentRs. infrastructureRs. research personnelRs. etc. for facilitating the visit of overseas scientists for undertaking collaborative research. The institution should also extend all necessary administrative support to the proposed work.
**Note 04:** Purdue faculty may support only one OVDF application per call.

name: Food Safety & Standards Authority Of India (FSSAI) Internship Scheme
brief_description: The Internship Program by the FSSAI provides interns with unique learning opportunities in various areas of food regulation and food safety administration. FSSAI is a statutory body established under the Food Safety & Standards ActRs. 2006 under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of India. It is the apex body responsible for ensuring food safety and compliance with food standards across the country. > **Tenure:** The internship will be available throughout the year on a Quarterly basis. The internship will be offered for a duration of up to 03 monthsRs. which may be extended to a maximum period of 06 months. No internship of duration less than two months will be offered. > **Assignments:** Interns would be attached to one of the several Divisions at FSSAI (HQ)/ROs/LabsRs. depending on the academic and technical training and assigned project(s) related to different aspects of Food and Nutrition Management Processes. > **Place & Domain of Internship:** 1. Region: FSSAI (HQ)Rs. New Delhi; Topics/Subjects: Science & Standards; Regulation; Regulatory Compliance; KRCDC (Library); Human Resource; Finance & Accounts; Trade and International Cooperation/Imports; Quality Assurance; Legal; IT 1. Region: Regional Offices (Chennai & Kolkata); Topics/Subjects: Food Imports Clearance and Licensing 1. Region: National Food LaboratoryRs. GhaziabadRs. KolkataRs. and Chennai; Topics/Subjects: Food Sampling and Testing 1. Region: NFL Kolkata Extension CentreRs. Raxaul; Topics/Subjects: Food Sampling and Testing
benefits: > **Stipend:** - A stipend of 10Rs./- (Rupees ten thousand only) for the internship period will be given to the deserving Interns on the recommendation of the Office/Division that they are attached with by the respective FSSAI (HQ)/Regional Offices / Laboratories. **NOTE:** The criteria for deserving interns will be decided based on their (a) attendanceRs. (b) assessment by their respective reporting officers; and (c) evaluation of the report by the Committee. > **Working Space:** - FSSAI shall provide working spaceRs. internet facility and other necessities. **NOTE 1:** FSSAI shall not cover local lodging and travel facilities. **NOTE 2:** FSSAI will not bear the expenses of any Boarding. **NOTE 3:** Interns would be required to have their own laptops. > **Certificate:** - All the interns will be awarded a certificate by the Human Resource DivisionRs. FSSAI (HQ) on successful completion of the internship i.e. on submissionRs. review of final report/presentation and recommendation by the Project Evaluation Committee.
eligibility:
The students pursuing a full-time Graduate/Post Graduate Degree/higher degree from a Recognized Institute within India/ abroadRs. in any of the following: - Post Graduate Degree/B.Tech/BE from a recognized University or Institution in Chemistry or Biochemistry or Food Technology or Food Science & Technology or Food & Nutrition or Edible Oil Technology or Microbiology or Dairy Technology or Agricultural or horticultural Sciences or Industrial Microbiology or Toxicology or Public Health or Life Science or Biotechnology or Fruit & Vegetable Technology or Food Safety & Quality Assurance. - Business Administration & Management including policy regulation and related fields.- Only at FSSAI(HQ) - PG Diploma/Degree inRs. JournalismRs. Mass Communication and Public Relations. - B.E. / B. Tech (Only 3rd and 4th Year students not for 2nd or 1st Year) in Computer Science/Information Technology Software Engineering or related Stream. - Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Public Policy Public Administration. - Only forFSSAI (HQ). - Bachelor/Master of Law.- Only for FSSAI(HQ).
**NOTE:** All the students who have completed the abovementioned courses need not apply.

name: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (nos)
brief_description: The scheme Large Cardamom Irrigation Land Development: Irrigation Equipment (Nos) is a component of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion and Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom implemented during the 15th Finance Commission period (202122 to 202526) under the Export-Oriented Production component. The scheme aims to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation by supporting the construction of water storage structuresRs. rainwater harvesting systemsRs. and the installation of irrigation equipmentRs. thereby increasing productivity and improving the quality of large cardamom.
benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of equipment subject to a maximum of 15Rs. for General and 75% subject to maximum of 20Rs./- for SC/ST 1. Large cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
