name: Improved Cultivation and Advanced Retting Exercise (I-CARE)
brief_description: The scheme "Improved Cultivation And Advanced Retting Exercise (I-CARE)" was launched by the National Jute BoardRs. Ministry of Textiles. The scheme aims to support the small and marginal jute growers with adequate pre and post harvesting operations so that they can grow good quality jute and receive a higher price for their produce. The scheme provides 100% certified high yielding seeds at a 50% subsidized rateRs. demonstration and use of scientific jute cultivation practices with mechanical interventionRs. free distribution of a microbial consortium for advanced rettingRs. construction of retting pondsRs. and a 5Rs./- one-time maintenance assistance. The applicant must be a registered small or marginal jute grower willing to provide land consent for retting ponds and adopt scientific agronomic techniques. The scheme is implemented by the National Jute Board in association with the Jute Corporation of India and the Central Research Institute For Jute And Allied Fibres. The applications for this scheme are accepted through local agenciesRs. cooperative bodiesRs. and farmers' clubs at the block level.
benefits: - Provision of 100% certified high yielding jute seeds at a 50% subsidized rate supplied by the National Seed Corporation and the Central Research Institute For Jute And Allied Fibres to ensure better crop quality and yield. - Demonstration of scientific jute cultivation practices and free usage of mechanical interventionsRs. including multi-row seed drillsRs. nail weedersRs. and single wheel jute weedersRs. reducing manual weeding costs by approximately 35%. - Free distribution of a microbial consortium to improve the quality of jute fiber by at least one gradeRs. increase fiber productivity by 10%Rs. and reduce retting time from 18 to 12 days. - Construction of small retting ponds in the farmers fields through the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee ActRs. Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee YojanaRs. and Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana. - A one-time financial assistance of 5Rs./- per pond towards maintenance costs. ##### ***Disbursal Conditions for Financial Assistance*** - The 5Rs./- maintenance cost is transferred directly to the farmers bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer after the completion of the retting pond and the submission of a confirmation reportRs. photographic evidenceRs. and Global Positioning System coordinates by the field officials. - Extensive farmer training and awareness programs on the use of seed drillsRs. single wheel jute weedersRs. and microbial retting techniques. - Short Message Service advisories and voice messages detailing land preparationRs. sowingRs. de-weedingRs. plant protectionRs. and retting to educate the growers. ##### ***Conditions for Availment*** - The farmers must utilize the provided inputs such as certified seeds and the microbial consortium strictly for jute cultivation and rettingRs. and successfully maintain the constructed in-situ retting ponds on their fields.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a small and marginal jute grower. - The applicant must be registered in the scheme by the Jute Corporation Of India in association with different farmers societiesRs. co-operative bodiesRs. Primary Agricultural Credit SocietiesRs. Krishi Vigyan KendrasRs. or farmers clubs under the National Bank For Agriculture And Rural Development. - The applicant must provide formal consent for their land to be used by the State Government Department for the construction of the retting pond. - The applicant should be willing to transition from traditional stem retting to scientific methods of cultivation and microbial retting.

name: PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
brief_description:
The PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBCRs. EBC and DNT Students is a sub-scheme under the umbrella scheme namely PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM-YASASVI). This scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme which was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of India to provide educational assistance to the students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs)Rs. Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)Rs. and DenotifiedRs. Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the OBCRs. EBCRs. and DNT students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to enable them to complete their education.
> **Scope:**


- These scholarships shall be available for studies in India only and will be awarded by the Government of State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongsRs. i.e. permanently settled.

> **Definitions:**


- "**Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses**" shall mean all Professional courses in MedicineRs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary & Allied SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance /AdministrationRs. Computer Science/ Applications (ii) Post Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of Management & Medicine(iii) C.A./I.C.W.A./C.S./1.C.F.A.Rs. etc. (iv) M.Phil.Rs. Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Programmes (D.Lit.Rs. D.Sc. etc.) of Group IRs. Group II and Group Ill courses. (v) L.L.BRs. Integrated LL BRs. L.L.M (vi) Commercial Pilot License Courses from GoI institutes (including helicopter pilot and multiengine) (maximum 20 slots per annum) - "**Group 2: Other Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate**" shall mean all Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. M Ed. / M. Pharma.Rs. DiplomaRs. Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B Pharma.)Rs. Nursing(B Nursing)Rs. BFSRs. other para-medical branches like rehabilitationRs. diagnosticsRs. etc.Rs. Mass CommunicationRs. Hotel Management & CateringRs. Travel/Tourism/Hospitality ManagementRs. Interior DecorationRs. Nutrition& DieteticsRs. Commercial ArtRs. Financial Services (e.g. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. TaxationRs. etc.) for which entrance qualification is minimum Sr. Secondary (10+2) and Vocational streamRs. ITI courses and Polytechnic where entrance qualification is Class XII or above. - "**Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate course**" shall mean: courses not covered under Group 1& Group 2 e.g. BA / B.Sc. / B.Com etc. M.A/ M. Sc./ M.Com etc. - "**Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses**" shall mean All post-matriculation level non-degree courses for which entrance qualification is High School (Class X)Rs. e.g. Senior secondary certificate (Class XI and XII); both general and vocational streamRs. ITI coursesRs. 3-year diploma courses in PolytechnicsRs. etc. - The list of courses in various groups is indicative and States/UTs may add courses as per laid down standards in the State/UT.
- "**Freeship Card**" shall mean: A card issued by the State Govt./UT Administration that entitles a student eligible for a scholarship under this SchemeRs. to take admission in an institutionRs. without pre-payment of tuition fee and hostel fee.
benefits:
The scholarship includes the following components for the complete duration of the course:
**Sl. No.****Category of Courses****Yearly Academic Allowance (in )****Yearly Tuition Fee (in )****Total (in )**1Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses10Rs./-10Rs./-20Rs./-2Group 2: Other Professional Courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate8Rs./-5Rs./-13Rs./-3Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under Group I & Group II6Rs./-2Rs./-8Rs./-4Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses5Rs./-05Rs./-**Note 01:** Students pursuing CA./I.C.W.A./C.S./I.C.F.A. shall be treated as day scholars for the purpose of academic allowance. Students studying through correspondence/online courses shall not be eligible for academic allowance.
**Note 02:** Tuition fees shall be paid to online/correspondence students.
**Note 03:** The State Governments mayRs. if they so decideRs. top up the academic allowance from their own resources.
**Note 04:** The entire scholarship amountRs. both from the State and Central GovernmentRs. including the tuition feesRs. academic allowance and any other admissible allowance will be paid directly into the account of the students ONLY through DBT preferably through an Aadhaar Based Payment System (Aadhaar Payment Bridge).
**Note 05:** Scholarship will not be paid for the period of internship/housemanship in the M.B.B.S course or for practical training in other courses if the student is in receipt of some remuneration during the internship period or some allowance/stipend during the practical training in other courses.
eligibility:
1. The scholarships will be open to Indian nationals belonging to OBCsRs. EBCsRs. and DNTsRs. as notified by the Central Govt./State Govt./ UT Admin.
1. These scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses pursued in recognized institutions as specified in para 3 of the [Guidelines](https://socialjustice.gov.in/public/ckeditor/upload/65661651839791.pdf). 1. Only those candidates who belong to OBCs/EBCs/DNTs so specified in relation to the State/UT to which the applicant actually belongsRs. i.e. permanently settled and who have passed the Matriculation or higher secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary Education will be eligible.
1. Students studying in the XI Class of the Higher Secondary School courses or the XII class of the Multipurpose High School will not be eligible for it being a continuous school course. HoweverRs. in casesRs. where the 10th Class examination of such courses is treated as equivalent to Matriculation and students who after passing the 10th Class join other coursesRs. such students will be treated as post-matric students and will be eligible for the award of scholarships.
1. Students pursuing Post-graduate courses in medicine will be eligible only if they are not allowed to practice during the period of their course.
1. Students who after failing or passing the Under Graduate/Post-Graduate examinations in Arts/Science/Commerce join any recognized professional or Technical certificate/diploma/degree courses will be awarded scholarships if otherwise eligible. No subsequent failure will be condoned except for courses in Group '1' and no further change in the course will be allowed thereafter.
1. StudentsRs. who pursue their studies through correspondence/online coursesRs. are also eligible. The term correspondence includes distance and continuous education for courses in Central/State Universities only.
1. Only two boys of the same parents/guardians will be entitled to receive scholarships. This restriction willRs. howeverRs. not apply to girls. AccordinglyRs. scholarships availed by girls of the same parents/guardian will not adversely affect the admissibility of availing scholarships upto two boys of the same parents/guardian.
1. A scholarship holder under this Scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend. If awarded any other scholarship/stipendRs. the student can exercise his/her option for either of the two Scholarships/stipendsRs. whichever is more beneficial to him/herRs. and should inform the awarding authority through the Head of the Institution about the option made. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this Scheme from the date he/she accepts any other scholarships/ stipend. The student canRs. howeverRs. accept free lodging or a grant or ad-hoc monetary help from the State Government or any other source for the purchase of booksRs. and equipment or for meeting the expenses on board and lodgingRs. in addition to the scholarship amount paid under the Scheme.
1. Scholarship holders who are receiving coaching in any of the pre-examination training centers with financial assistance from the Central Government/ State Government will not be eligible for a stipend under the coaching schemes for the duration of the coaching programme.
1. The ceiling on the age limit for admission as regular students in different classes should be decided by concerned Institutions.
1. Employed students whose income combined with the income of their parents/guardians does not exceed 2.50 lakhs per annum shall be eligible for post-matric scholarship.
1. Unemployed students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed 2.50 lakhs per annum will be entitled to the scholarship under the scheme.

**Note:** Income Certificate is required to be taken once only; i.e. at the time of admission of coursesRs. which are continuing for more than one year.
> **Other Conditions for the Award:**


1. The scholarship is provided on the basis of satisfactory progress and conduct of the scholars. If it is reported by the Head of the Institution at any time that a scholar hasRs. by reasons of his/her own act or defaultRs. failed to make satisfactory progress or has been guilty of misconduct such as resorting to or participating in strikesRs. irregularity in attendance without the permission of the authorities concernedRs. etc.Rs. the authority sanctioning the scholarships may either cancel the scholarship or stop or withhold further payment of scholarship for such period as it may think fit.
1. If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statement his/her scholarship will be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the scholarship paid will be recoveredRs. at the discretion of the concerned State Government. The student concerned will be blacklisted and debarred for scholarship under any scheme forever.
1. A scholarship awarded may be cancelled if the scholar changes the subject of the course of study for which the scholarship was originally awarded or changes the institution of studyRs. without prior approval of the State Government. The Head of the Institution shall inform such cases to the scholar and stop payment of the scholarship money. The amount already paid may also be recovered at the discretion of the State Government.
1. A scholar is liable to refund the scholarship amount at the discretion of the State GovernmentRs. if during the course of the yearRs. the studies for which the scholarship has been awardedRs. are discontinued by him/her

> **Duration and Renewal of Awards:**


1. The award once made will be payable up to the completion of the course subject to satisfactory academic performance and attendance of 75% in every academic year. The attendance will be verified through an Aadhaar-based attendance System.
1. If a scholar is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illnessRs. the award may be renewed subject to the production of a medical certificate from a prescribed authority and acceptance of the same by the institution /college.
1. IfRs. according to the Regulations of a University/InstitutionRs. a student is promoted to the next higher class even though he/she may not have actually passed in the lower class and is required to take an examination of the junior class again after some timeRs. he/she will be entitled to scholarship for the class to which he/she is promoted if the student is otherwise eligible for scholarship. FurtherRs. in case a student fails in any class and then again joins the same class as a regular studentRs. he/she will be eligible for a scholarship for one additional year or the actual periodRs. whichever is lower.
1. If a scholar pursuing a Group I course fails in the examination for the first timeRs. the award may be renewed. For second and subsequent failures in any classRs. the student shall bear his/her own expenses until he/she secures promotion to the next higher class.
1. The authentication through Aadhaar would be compulsory at the time of renewalsRs. if not provided earlier at the time of admission.

> **Eligibility of Educational Institutions:**

Scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation or postsecondary courses (Intermediate/Senior SecondaryRs. DiplomaRs. long-term Vocational Training CertificateRs. GraduateRs. Post Graduate coursesRs. etc.) pursued in recognized Institutions/Universities/Colleges falling in any of the following 9 categories:

1. Institutions of National Importance;
1. Central University/State University/Autonomous colleges recognized by UGC and Universities/Colleges recognized under section 2(f) of the UGC Act;
1. Deemed Universities;
1. All Private Universities recognized by State/Centre;
1. Private Professional Institutions affiliated with a recognized Central/State University and covered by a Fee Fixation Committee as mandated by the Supreme Court;
1. Recognized schools/colleges for Classes XI and class XII;
1. Diploma granting Institutions as recognized by State/UT Governments;
1. Vocational Training Institutes affiliated to the National Council of Vocational Training (NCVT);
1. Institutions affiliated/ approved by the appropriate bodies like NMC/AICTE etc. or any regulatory body established by State/UT/Centre.

name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
brief_description: The "RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village Level Soil Testing Lab" scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare to provide easy access to soil testing facilities and affordable soil testing services to farmers at the grassroots level. Under the schemeRs. eligible rural youth and community-based institutions can establish Village Level Soil Testing Labs (VLSTLs) with a one-time financial assistance of 1Rs./-. The labs provide timely and accurate soil analysisRs. customized nutrient recommendationsRs. and promote awareness regarding soil health. The scheme also supports local data collectionRs. strengthens soil testing infrastructureRs. and generates employment opportunities in rural areas. Financial assistance is released through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode by the State Government.
benefits: - **One-Time Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided for establishing a Village Level Soil Testing Lab (VLSTL). - **Assistance for Soil Testing Equipment:** Up to 1Rs./- for soil testing equipmentRs. reagentsRs. sample shaker machineRs. and one-year Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC). - **Assistance for Laboratory Consumables:** Up to 50Rs./- for distilled waterRs. pH meterRs. conductivity meterRs. electronic balanceRs. glasswareRs. filter papersRs. and other required consumables. - **Soil Testing Services:** Provides affordable soil testing services to farmers at the village level. - **Soil Health Advisory:** Facilitates customized soil nutrient recommendations based on soil test results. - **Agricultural Productivity Support:** Helps farmers optimize fertilizer use and reduce input costs by avoiding under-application or over-application of fertilizers. - **Awareness Generation:** Promotes awareness regarding soil health and the importance of soil testing among farmers. - **Employment Generation:** Creates employment opportunities for rural youth through the operation of village-level laboratories. - **Soil Data Collection:** Supports the collection of local soil data for studiesRs. policy formulationRs. and region-specific agricultural interventions.
eligibility: - The Age of the applicant should be between 18 to 27 years - The Educational Qualification of the applicant should be 10th pass with science and knowledge of computer - The applicant / entrepreneur group should have their own premises / rented building with lease agreement for atleast four years.

name: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons" has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. It aims to provide shelter to destitute & abandoned Transgender persons with basic amenities like shelterRs. foodRs. medical care and recreational facilities. > **Objectives:** - To provide shelter with basic amenities such as foodRs. clothingRs. recreationRs. medical facilities and counselling. - To safeguard the rights of Transgender persons. - To confirm the prevalence of a congenial atmosphere in the Garima Greh by adopting uniform rules and regulations suitable for all Transgender persons. - To empower a TG person through skill-development and skill-upgradation programmes to lead a decent and dignified lifeRs. and protect them from atrocities and social stigma.
benefits: 1. Provision of shelter for transgender persons facing socialRs. psychologicalRs. and economic constraints. 1. Basic amenitiesRs. including foodRs. medical careRs. and recreational facilities. 1. Legal care and psychological counselling for reintegration into families and society. 1. Capacity-building and skill-development training for livelihood enhancement and economic independence. 1. Assistance in obtaining Identity CardsRs. Permanent Account Number (PAN) CardsRs. Ration CardsRs. PassportsRs. and other essential documents. 1. A safeRs. secureRs. and positive environment for the holistic development and rehabilitation of transgender persons.
eligibility: > **The following are the eligibility criteria of Transgender Person as a resident of Garima Greh:** - Transgenders certified issued through the National Portal for Transgender PersonsRs. and preferably living below the poverty line. Persons having such a certificate from elsewhere may be persuaded to register on the National Portal. - Transgenders who are abandonedRs. aged between 18 and 60 years - Transgenders should not be engaged in sex work and beggary - Transgenders must be unemployed and not engaged in productive commercial activities > The person needs to register by filling in the admission form ([Annexure 2](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/docs/GarimaGrehGuidleines.pdf)) and the personal affidavit as per the prescribed form [Annexure 3](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/docs/GarimaGrehGuidleines.pdf) provided in the guidelines document.

name: Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme" implemented by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation under the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. provides financial assistance to eligible youth of the target group of NSKFDC for pursuing vocational education and training courses. It aims to improve skillsRs. employabilityRs. and self-reliance among beneficiaries. Financial support is available for courses run or supported by Government MinistriesRs. DepartmentsRs. NSDCRs. or State Skill Missions. The course duration should be from 6 months up to 2 years and may lead to a recognized certificateRs. diplomaRs. or degree. Assistance is provided for up to 90% of the course expensesRs. subject to the prescribed loan limit.
benefits: **Quantum of loan** 1. Need-based finance to meet up to 90% of expenses shall be considered subject to the following Ceilings: - For courses of duration up to 2 years: up to Rs. 4Rs./- > Note: In case of cost over-runRs. it shall be borne by the beneficiary. **Interest** National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC) shall charge interest @ 1% per annum from the Channelizing AgencyRs. whichRs. in turnRs. shall charge 4% per annum from the beneficiaries. In the case of womenRs. an interest rebate of 0.5% shall be provided. **** **Repayment:** Up to 7 years.
eligibility: > **Eligibility Criteria:** 1. The person should be from the target group of NSKFDC. 1. The person should have secured admission in a course run or supported by a MinistryRs. DepartmentRs. or Organization of the Government or a companyRs. societyRs. or organization supported by the National Skill Development Corporation or State Skill Missions/State Skill CorporationsRs. preferably leading to a Certificate/Diploma/Degree etc. Issued by a Government Organization or an Organization recognized/authorized by the Government to do so. > **Course Eligibility:** Vocational Education and training courses of the duration of a minimum 6 months and up to 2 years run or supported by a Ministry/Department/Organization of the Government or a Company/Society/Organization supported by a National Skill Development Corporation or State Skills/Mission/State Skill Corporations. > **Age Eligibility:** The candidate should attain a minimum age of 18 years on completion of the course. The upper age limit is up to 50 years.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students
brief_description: The scheme Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students under the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. aims to increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher educationRs. especially those from the poorest householdsRs. by providing financial assistance at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to help them continue and complete their education. - **Scope** 1. These scholarships are available for studies in India only and the awardees are selected by the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs (i.e. the State/UT in which permanently settled or domiciledRs. as per the terms of domicile decided by the State). 1. This is applicable to all the students who are currently beneficiaries of the scheme as well as fresh admissions. **The Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students categorizes courses into four groups:** 1. **Group I:** Degree and Post Graduate level courses in MedicineRs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance/AdministrationRs. Computer Science/Applications Commercial Pilot License (including helicopter pilot and multiengine rating) course 1. **Group II**: Post Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of Management & medicine C.A/I.C.W.A. /C.S./I.C.F.A. etc. 1. **Group III:** Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under Group 1 & Group 2 B.A / B.Sc. / B.Com etc. M.A/ M.Sc. / M.Com etc. 1. **Group IV**: Management & CateringRs. name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Education of Children/Widows of ESM" is implemented by the Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to support the education of dependent children of eligible Ex-Servicemen and their widows through financial assistance. Assistance is available for studies from Class 1 to Class 12 and undergraduate degree courses. Widows pursuing a 2-year postgraduate degree course are also eligible. The benefit is available only to those who are not receiving similar educational assistance from the State Government or employer and is not applicable for professional or technical courses.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance for Children:** - 1Rs./- per month per child. - Available for a maximum of 2 eligible children. - Applicable from Class 1 to Class 12 and undergraduate degree courses. - The child must successfully complete the academic year/course. > **Financial Assistance for Widows:** - 1Rs./- per month. - Available for widows pursuing a 2-year postgraduate degree course. - The widow must successfully complete the course. > **Special Provision for Twin Children:** - If the 2nd and 3rd children are twinsRs. assistance may be granted to all 3 childrenRs. subject to fulfillment of eligibility conditions. - If the 1st and 2nd children are twinsRs. assistance is restricted to the twin children only.
eligibility: - Applicant must be an ESM/ widow/Orphan dependent. - Should be of rank Havildar/equivalent and below. - The scheme is applicable for classes 1 to 12 of school and undergraduate classes of a degree college. This grant is also admissible to widows who wish to pursue 2-year post graduate degree. The ward/widow shall complete the course successfully. - The applicant should not be drawing education allowance or similar benefit from the State or is employer. > The scheme is eligible for only first two children. HoweverRs. in case of twin childrenRs. below mentioned condition shall be applicable:- 1. In case the 1st and 2nd children are twins only twins will be eligible as maximum two children are permitted. 1. In case 2nd and 3rd children are twins both will be eligible for education financial assistance alongwith 1st. Thus the ESM can avail for three children subject to fulfilment of above mentioned criteria. - In case of unfortunate demise of 1st or 2nd child. In case of unfortunate demise of 1st childRs. 2nd and 3rd children as mentioned in discharge book will be eligible. Similarly in case of demise of 2nd childRs. the 3rd child will be eligible as mentioned in discharge book. The death certificate will be uploaded as supporting document with online application for scrutiny.

name: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme - For Fellows
brief_description: The Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC) Scheme is a flagship national initiative by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Ministry of EducationRs. Government of India that aims to attract and engage leading Indian-origin researchersRs. scientistsRs. and professionals from abroad and place them at premier government higher education institutions and national research laboratories in India to undertake cutting-edge research. The scheme embeds globally experienced researchers and professionals within leading Indian higher education and research institutions to undertake high-impact researchRs. teachingRs. and mentorship in strategic and emerging domains. Through long-term and structured engagements aligned with national prioritiesRs. the PMRC Scheme seeks to position India as a global hub for academic and research excellence. **Objectives:** - Establish industry and technology partnerships for research scale-up - Enhance Indias position in global research - Improve research quality and international collaboration - Build research and development capacity in Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) - Identify and integrate talent with Indias R&D ecosystem - Provide mentorship for niche areas ***The scheme is focused on supporting RDI activities by PMRC Fellows in the thematic areasRs. the details of which are provided below:*** - Advanced MaterialsRs. Rare-earth & Critical Minerals - EnergyRs. Sustainability and Climate Change - Agri & Food Technologies - Semiconductors - Advanced Computing (SupercomputingRs. AlRs. Quantum Computing) - Healthcare & MedTech - Space and Defence - Next-Gen CommunicationsRs. including Quantum Communication - Blue Economy - Cybersecurity - Manufacturing & Industry 4.0 - Biotechnology - Atomic Energy - Any other project aligned with the National Missions
benefits: The scheme leverages India's global scientific diaspora to strengthen domestic research capabilitiesRs. accelerate innovation in frontier domainsRs. and support national development missions. By embedding global expertise into premier government institutions in IndiaRs. the scheme enables sustained collaborationRs. institutional learningRs. and real-world impact. ***Under the schemeRs. the following benefits will be offered to Fellows:*** - Competitive fellowship fee with annual increments - One-time research grant for project initiation - Residential and medical allowance - Relocation benefits linked to tenure - Access to advanced research infrastructure and facilities - Academic visibilityRs. recognitionRs. and leadership opportunities
eligibility: 1. Eligible Fellow for the Scheme are: - Indian origin (Indian nationalsRs. Overseas Citizens of IndiaRs. or Persons of Indian Origin) researchers / scientists and professionals working at leading foreign HEIsRs. research laboratoriesRs. and research institutionsRs. reputed companies and other industries. - The Fellowship is in-person and they will be expected to work at Host Institutions. The Scheme will support Fellows for a pre-determined period of durationRs. with a maximum tenure of 5 years based on performance of the candidate. 2. Fellows must be able to demonstrate a distinguished track record in researchRs. as evidenced by publicationsRs. patentsRs. awardsRs. citationsRs. or other internationally recognised indicators of excellence. They must also be willing to commit to the prescribed engagement period and associated responsibilities including researchRs. teachingRs. and mentorship. It should be noted that candidates currently based in India are also eligibleRs. provided they meet the Indian-origin criterion and other requirements as determined by the Empowered Committee. 3. PMRC Fellows will be expected to: - Conduct originalRs. high-impact research in the identified priority sector(s) in collaboration with the Host - Teach and co-design coursesRs. contributing to curriculum enrichment - Mentor doctoralRs. postdoctoralRs. and postgraduate students and junior researchers - Facilitate international collaborationsRs. publicationsRs. and co-funded R&D projects - Engage with industry partners to promote applied research and real-world adoption of research outcomes - Ensure that research ideas translate into commercial products. The patents granted from work done under PMRC is of great importance so as to link research with industry-aligned innovation. They will be supported with patenting process chain. - Submit periodic progress reports and participate in evaluations as stipulated by the Empowered Committee **Categories of Engagement** Over the next five years (2026-27 to 2030-31)Rs. the Scheme envisions engaging at least 120 distinguished researchers/ scientists and professionals across the above-mentioned categories: - Young Research Fellows: Early-career researchers/ professionals with up to 5 years of post-PhD experience outside of India - Senior Fellows: Mid-career researchers/ professionals with 5 to less than 10 years of post-PhD experience outside of India - Research Chairs: Eminent researchers / professionals with 10 years or more of post-PhD experience outside of India **Note:** The eligibility criteria for selection of researchers/professionalsRs. projectsRs. and institutes will be finalised by the Empowered Committee.

name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana" was launched by the Ministry of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to promote the generation of sustained additional employmentRs. increase the formalization of the workforceRs. and enhance employability. The scheme provides comprehensive financial assistance to first-time employees to navigate their learning curve and incentivizes eligible establishmentsRs. particularly in the manufacturing sectorRs. for generating sustained additional employment over their established baseline. The applicant must regularly file the Electronic Challan-cum-Return along with provident fund contributions and fulfill the defined threshold criteria for new employment generation. The scheme is implemented by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation. The applications for this scheme are accepted continuously during the registration period from 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027 through the online updating of establishment details and employee Aadhaar authentication on the official portal.
benefits:
##### **Part A:****** ***First-Timer Benefits*** - The scheme provides a one-time incentive of up to 15Rs./- to assist first-time employees. - The first installment is up to a maximum of 7Rs./-Rs. calculated as half of the average Employees' Provident Fund wage for six continuous completed months. - The second installment is equal to the average of the twelve completed months' Employees' Provident Fund wage reduced by the first installmentRs. restricted to a total incentive of 15Rs./-. - The second installment will be kept in an appropriate saving instrument or deposit account for a specified period. - The incentives to the employees shall be paid through Direct Benefit Transfer using the Aadhaar Bridge Payment System to their Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts. - The incentive shall be disbursed within 45 days after fulfilling the eligibility condition and filing of the paid Electronic Challan-cum-Return.
##### **Part B:****** ***Support to Employers*** - The scheme provides incentives to the employer for two years in respect of employment generated over and above the baseline. - For the manufacturing sectorRs. the incentive to the employer will continue for the third and the fourth year. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage less than or equal to 10Rs./-Rs. the benefit to the employer is up to 1Rs./- per additional employment per month. - In respect of employees getting Employees' Provident Fund wages below 10Rs./-Rs. the incentive at the rate of 10 percent of the Employees' Provident Fund wage will be provided as an additional risk mitigation measure. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage greater than 10Rs./- and up to 20Rs./-Rs. the benefit is 2Rs./- per additional employment per month. - For additional employees with an Employees' Provident Fund wage greater than 20Rs./- and up to 1Rs./-Rs. the benefit is 3Rs./- per additional employment per month. - The benefits will be provided to all eligible establishments on a six-monthly lump-sum basis after the filing of six completed months' Electronic Challan-cum-Returns. - The incentive to the establishment shall be provided as a Direct Benefit Transfer to the Permanent Account Number-linked bank account of the establishment.
##### ***Conditions*** - _The employer must fulfill the threshold limit continuouslyRs. generating at least 2 additional employments with a baseline of less than 50Rs. and at least 5 additional employments with a baseline of 50 or above._ - _The first-time employee must successfully complete the mandatory Financial Literacy Course available through the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation Employee portal to receive the second installment._ - _The benefits to the employer will not accrue for any month in which the employer is not eligible as per the threshold criteria laid out in the Scheme._
eligibility: ##### ***Eligibility for Employees (First Timers)*** - The applicant must not have been a contributing member of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation or an Exempted Trust prior to the commencement of the scheme. - The applicant must join an establishment during the scheme registration period from 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027. - The applicant must have their Universal Account Number authenticated by Face Authentication Technology on the UMANG Application. - The applicant must have gross wages up to 1Rs./- per month at the time of joining the establishment. - The applicant must have Electronic Challan-cum-Returns along with contributions filed for six continuous months. - The applicant must continue with the same establishment for the entire period of six months if they are employed in a seasonal industry. ##### ***Eligibility for Employees (Re-joinees)*** - The applicant must have a previous contributory membership of the Employees' Provident Fund. - The applicant must join an establishment registered with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation or an exempted trust during the scheme registration period. - The applicant must have a Universal Account NumberRs. which is Aadhaar-authenticated using biometric or face authentication technology. ##### ***Eligibility for Establishments (Employers)*** - The applicant must be covered under the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions ActRs. 1952. - The applicant must have a unique Permanent Account Number. - The applicant must file the Electronic Challan-cum-Return along with contributions regularly. - The applicant must generate additional employment meeting the threshold of at least 2 additional employments if their baseline is less than 50. - The applicant must generate additional employment meeting the threshold of at least 5 additional employments if their baseline is 50 or above. - The applicant must provide details of their Permanent Account NumberRs. Goods and Services Tax NetworkRs. and a Permanent Account Number linked Bank Account Number.

name: Delhi Lakhpati Bitiya Scheme
brief_description: The "Delhi Lakhpati Bitiya Scheme" has been launched by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Delhi. The scheme aims to enhance the social status of the girl childRs. ensure her educationRs. promote empowermentRs. and provide long-term financial security. > **Objectives of the scheme:** - Enhance the social status of the girl child in society as well as within the family. - Ensure proper education and empowerment of the girl child. - Encourage continuation of education among girl children. - Ensure long-term financial security to girl children. - Protect the girl child from discrimination and deprivation.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance (Stage-wise Detailed Structure)** **At Birth** - 11Rs. deposited with milestone BRs. redeemable at 18 or 21 years **School Education Milestones** - 5Rs. at admission in Class I (Milestone O) - 5Rs. at admission in Class VI (Milestone S) - 5Rs. at admission in Class IX (Milestone N) - 5Rs. at admission in Class XI or Polytechnic/ITI after Class X (Milestone t) - 5Rs. at admission in Class XII (Milestone T) **Higher Education / Skill Development** - 10Rs. for 1-year Diploma (Milestone D) - 20Rs. for 2-year Diploma (10Rs. each year Milestones d1 and d2) - 20Rs. for 3-year Diploma (5Rs. + 5Rs. + 10Rs. H4) **Conditions** - The financial assistance is non-transferable and non-refundable - The amount cannot be withdrawn prematurely - No loan or credit facility is allowed against the deposited amount - The girl must remain unmarried until 18 years of age - Immunization compliance is mandatory at all stages - Failure to renew milestones may lead to the discontinuation of benefits **Mode of Disbursement** - Funds are deposited in the name of the girl child - Managed through an authorized banking partner - Final maturity amount is credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account - Valid until completion of milestones or attainment of 21 years
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a girl child born in Delhi. 1. The applicant should possess a birth certificate issued by the Registrar (Births and Deaths) of Delhi. 1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Delhi for at least 3 years preceding the application. 1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 1Rs.. 1. New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC)Rs. or government-recognized school in Delhi. 1. The applicant should apply within 1 year of birth or within 90 days of admission at the applicable stages. 1. The girl child can be registered under the scheme within one year of birth or at the time of admission in Class 1stRs. 6thRs. 9thRs. 11th or after passing class 10th upon admission to Polytechnic/ITI courses (anywhere in India); or upon admission to Graduation/Diploma courses after passing 12th.1. The applicant must be pursuing a professional diploma in any Government-recognised or affiliated universityRs. collegeRs. or institutionRs. or under any other Government body (State/Central)Rs. anywhere in India. 1. The applicant must be pursuing graduation in any universityRs. collegeRs. or institution affiliated with or recognised by the UGC or any other Government bodyRs. anywhere in India. 1. The applicant should remain unmarried until attaining 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should fulfill immunization requirements as per the government norms. > **For girl child residing in any Government run and Licensed Child Care Institutions (CCIs) located in DelhiRs. where guardian is the State:** 1. name: Agricultural Extension
brief_description:
Extension Division endeavours towards successful implementation of Agricultural Extension activities. Through its various programmesRs. schemes and activitiesRs. Extension Division helps farmers to get information regarding scientific research and new knowledge in agricultural practices. It assists and encourages the State Governments in organizingRs. maintaining and operating professional Extension Services. Extension Division implements SMAE (Sub Mission on Agricultural Extension)Rs. a Sub Mission of KrishonnatiYojana. The popular ATMA Scheme which supports the State Governments in their extension activities is also run by Extension Division The Division also provides Information Support to farmers in their agricultural activities. For thisRs. it coordinates with Prasar Bharati and All India Radio in the effective running of the DD Kisan channel and Krishi Vani programmes respectively. Kisan Call Centres have been established at 21 locations across the country covering all states and UTs where the farmers can call on a toll free number (1800-180-1551) and get information regarding their area of interest in agriculture. Extension Division also publishes four magazines two each in Hindi and English whereby information regarding various aspects of Extension activities and new developments is provided. Schemes of Extension Division The Sub Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE) focuses on awareness creation and enhanced use of appropriate technologies in agriculture & allied sectors. It has four main componentsRs. namely: 1. Support to State Extension Programmes for Extension Reforms 1. Mass Media Support to Agricultural Extension 1. Establishment of Agri-Clinic and Agri-Business Centres by Agriculture Graduates (ACABC). 1. Extension Support to Central Institutions The aforesaid components of Sub Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE) were run as separate schemes of the Extension Division. These were recently subsumed under the umbrella of SMAE. **Support to State Extension Programmes for Extension Reforms:** As the name suggestsRs. this scheme supports the state governments in their Extension Activities. It aims at making extension system farmers driven by way of new institutional arrangements for technology dissemination in the form of an Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA) at the district level to operationalise the extension reforms. Funds are released to State Governments in accordance with the scheme guideline which is also dependent on the State Governments releasing their share of contribution. **Mass Media Support to Agricultural Extension :** 1. Doordarshan and All India Radio 1. Print Media 1. Kisan Mela 1. Kisan Call Centre 1. Common Services Center.
**Establishment of Agri-Clinic and Agri-Business Centres by Agriculture Graduates (ACABC) :** This Programme aims to tap the expertise available in the large pool of Agriculture graduatesRs. And a 45 days specialized training is provided by selected institutes across the country. **Extension Support to Central Institutions** This scheme aims towards capacity building of Extension functionaries and alsoRs. towards skill development of rural youthRs. farmers and farm women. The prominent institutions involved in this effort are the Directorate of Extension (a subordinate office under the Extension Division)Rs. MANAGERs. Hyderabad (an autonomous institute associated with Extension Division)Rs. four Extension Education Institutes (EEIs) at the Regional level and the State Agricultural Management & Extension Training Institutes (SAMETIs) at the State level. **The main programmes under the scheme are as under:** **A. Programmes for Capacity Building:** - Extension Education Institutes (EEIs): - Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare has established four Extension Education Institutes at Nilokheri (Haryana); Hyderabad (Telangana); Anand (Gujarat) and Jorhat (Assam). These EEIs cater to the training needs of middle-level field extension functionaries working under agriculture and allied departments of States/UTs of respective regions. The programmatic activities of EEIs include the organization of on-campus/off-campus trainingRs. workshopsRs. conferences etc. in the areas of communication technologyRs. extension methodologyRs. training managementRs. Agriculture Knowledge Information System (AKIS) and Information Technology. - Model Training Courses(MTCs): - Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare has established four Extension Education Institutes at Nilokheri (Haryana); Hyderabad (Telangana); Anand (Gujarat) and Jorhat (Assam). These EEIs cater to the training needs of middle-level field extension functionaries working under agriculture and allied departments of States/UTs of respective regions. The programmatic activities of EEIs include the organization of on-campus/off-campus trainingRs. workshopsRs. conferences etc. in the areas of communication technologyRs. extension methodologyRs. training managementRs. Agriculture Knowledge Information System (AKIS) and Information Technology. **B. Kisan Call Center(KCC)** - The project aims to answer farmers queries on a telephone call in their own dialect. Presently these call centres are working in 21 different locations covering all the States and UTs. A countrywide common eleven-digit Toll-Free Number 1800-180-1551 has been allotted for Kisan Call Center. This number is accessible through mobile phones and landlines of all telecom networks including private service providers. Replies to the farmers queries are available from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm on all seven days of the week. - Kisan Call Center agents are known as Farm Tele Advisors (FTAs)Rs. who are graduates or above in agriculture or allied areas and possess excellent communication skills in their respective local languages. Queries which cannot be answered by FTAs are transferred to higher-level experts in call conferencing mode. These experts are subject matter specialists of State Agricultural DepartmentsRs. ICAR & State Agricultural Universities. - The restructured KCC has a number of unique features viz. 100% call recording; call barging; voice mail service; customized IVRs; call conferencing through the experts; playing state-specific advisories during call wait time; SMS to caller farmers giving a gist of answers given by FTAs and alsoRs. registration of farmers for receiving SMS from experts on the subject area provided by them for receiving regular updates on selected crops. **Programmes for Skill Development:** 1. Skill Training of Rural Youth(STRY): - The component aims at training rural youthsRs. rural artisans (blacksmithsRs. carpenters etc. designing/manufacturing farm implements) including farm women across the country. The training under this component focuses on specific vocational areas in agriculture & allied sectors. Both Public and Private/Non-Governmental Institutions including Vocational Training organisationsRs. Youth Organisations (like Nehru Yuva Kendra) are actively involved in the implementation of this programme. 1. Diploma in Agricultural Extension Services for Input Dealers (DAESI): -Agri-Input Dealers in the country are a prime source of farm information to the farming communityRs. besides the supply of inputs and credit. HoweverRs. the majority of these dealers do not have formal agricultural education. In order to build their technical competency in agriculture and to facilitate them to serve the farmers better and to act as ParaExtension professionalsRs. a self-financed One-year Diploma in Agricultural Extension Services for Input Dealers (DAESI) Program has been launched during the year 2003 with a course fee of Rs.20000/- to the input dealers. The National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE) is the nodal agency to run this program.
benefits: - To supplement efforts of public extension by necessarily providing extension and other services to the farmers on a payment basis or free of cost as per the business model of agri-preneurRs. local needs and affordability of the target group of farmers. - To support agricultural development - To create gainful self-employment opportunities for unemployed agricultural graduatesRs. agricultural diploma holdersRs. intermediate in agriculture and biological science graduatesRs. with PG in agri-related courses
eligibility: 1. The scheme is open to the following categories of candidates of the age group of 18 to 60 years. 1. Graduates in agriculture and allied subjects like HorticultureRs. SericultureRs. DairyRs. Animal HusbandryRs. FisheriesRs. Home/ Community SciencesRs. BiotechnologyRs. Agricultural EngineeringRs. ForestryRs. Food TechnologyRs. Food NutritionRs. and DieteticsRs. etcRs. from SAUs/ Central Agricultural Universities/ Universities and graduates in Environmental ScienceRs. BotanyRs. Zoology and Chemistry recognized by ICAR/ UGC. Degrees in Agriculture and allied subjects offered by other agencies are also considered subject to the approval of the Department of Agriculture & CooperationRs. Government of India on the recommendation of the State Government. 1. Diploma (with at least 50% marks)/ Post Graduate Diploma holders in Agriculture and allied subjects (as in para 3.1) from State Agricultural UniversitiesRs. State Agriculture and Allied Departments and the State Department of Technical Education. Diplomas in Agriculture and allied subjects offered by other agencies (autonomous bodiesRs. UGC affiliated universitiesRs. etc.) are also considered subject to the approval of the Department of Agriculture & CooperationRs. Government of India on the recommendation of the State Government. 1. Post Graduation in Agriculture & allied subjects. 1. Degree courses recognized by UGC have more than 60 percent of the course content in Agriculture and allied subjects 3.5. 1. Diploma/ Post-graduate Diploma courses with more than 60 percent of course content in Agriculture and allied subjects after B.Sc. in Biological Sciences from recognized colleges and universitiesRs. 1. Agriculture-related courses at the intermediate (i.e. plus two) levelRs. with at least 55% marksRs. 1. The scheme covers full financial support for training and handholdingRs. provision of loansRs. and credit-linked back-ended composite subsidy.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship
brief_description: The Pre-Matric Scholarship SchemeRs. implemented by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible students studying in governmentRs. aidedRs. and recognized educational institutionsRs. helping them continue their education and reducing the financial burden on their families. Through scholarship supportRs. the scheme seeks to promote educational advancementRs. reduce dropout ratesRs. and contribute to the social and economic upliftment of backward classes.
