name: National Pension Scheme For Traders And Self Employed Persons
brief_description: The scheme "National Pension Scheme For Traders And Self-Employed Persons" was launched by the Ministry of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide old age protection and social security to small-scale tradersRs. retailersRs. and self-employed individuals. The scheme provides a voluntary and contributory pension under which the beneficiary receives a minimum assured monthly pension of 3Rs./- after attaining the age of sixty yearsRs. along with matching contributions from the Government of India. The applicant must make monthly contributions ranging between 55/- and 200/- per month till they attain the age of 60 years.
benefits: ##### ***1. Pension Benefit*** - Each eligible subscriber under this scheme shall receive an assured minimum monthly pension of 3Rs./- after attaining the age of sixty years. - The Government of India will make a matching contribution into the subscriber's pension account every month as a subsidy. ##### ***2. Family Pension on Death of Beneficiary*** During the receipt of the pensionRs. if an eligible beneficiary diesRs. the spouse shall be entitled to receive fifty per cent of the pension received by such beneficiary as a family pensionRs. which is applicable only to the spouse. ##### ***3. Provisions for Permanent Disablement Before Age of Sixty*** - If an eligible beneficiary has given regular contributions and becomes permanently disabled before attaining the age of sixty yearsRs. the spouse shall be entitled to continue with the scheme by payment of regular contributions. - In case of permanent disablement where the spouse does not continueRs. they can exit the scheme by receiving the share of contribution deposited by the subscriberRs. with interest as actually earned thereon by the Pension Fund or the savings bank interest rateRs. whichever is higher. ##### ***4. Exit Before Completion of Ten Years*** In case an eligible beneficiary exits this scheme within a period of less than ten years from the date of joiningRs. the share of contribution by them only will be returned with the savings bank rate of interest payable thereon. ##### ***5. Exit After Ten Years but Before Age of Sixty*** If an eligible beneficiary exits after completion of a period of ten years or more from the date of joining but before the age of sixty yearsRs. their share of contribution only shall be returned along with accumulated interest thereon as actually earned by the Pension Fund or the savings bank interest rateRs. whichever is higher. ##### ***6. Death of Beneficiary During the Contribution Period*** - If an eligible beneficiary has given regular contributions and dies due to any causeRs. the spouse shall be entitled to continue with the scheme by payment of regular contributions. - If the spouse does not wish to continue after the beneficiary's deathRs. they can exit by receiving the share of contribution paid by the beneficiary along with accumulated interestRs. as actually earned by the Pension Fund or at the savings bank interest rateRs. whichever is higher. ##### ***7. Corpus Reversion After Death of Both Beneficiary and Spouse*** After the death of the beneficiary and his or her spouseRs. the corpus shall be credited back to the fund.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Laghu VyapariRs. self-employed personRs. shop ownerRs. retail traderRs. rice mill ownerRs. oil mill ownerRs. workshop ownerRs. commission agentRs. real estate brokerRs. small hotel ownerRs. or restaurant owner. - The applicant must be between 18 and 40 years of age. - The applicant must have an annual turnover that does not exceed 1Rs./-. - The applicant must possess a savings bank account in their name. - The applicant must possess an Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Number.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom : Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / Water Storage Structure (nos)
brief_description: The Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development: Irrigation / Water Storage Structure Scheme under the Spices Board IndiaRs. Ministry of Commerce and IndustryRs. Government of IndiaRs. is intended to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing water storage structuresRs. thereby increasing productivity and improving the quality of small cardamomRs. as per the modalities and scheme guidelines approved by the competent authority for the implementation of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (202122 to 202526).
benefits: 1. 50 % of cost of construction subject to a maximum of Rs 30Rs. per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of 45Rs./- per unit for SC/ST. 1. The minimum capacity of irrigation structure should be 25 cubic metre for availing maximum subsidy under the programme. Any farmer who has availed this benefit earlier is not eligible to avail the benefit. 1. Registered cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha are eligible to avail this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a small cardamom grower from KeralaRs. Tamil NaduRs. or Karnataka. 1. The applicant should undertake irrigation and land development activities by constructing irrigation or water storage structures. 1. The applicant should ensure that the proposed structure does not obstruct the natural flow of water or create objections from local communities or concerned authoritiesRs. subject to final inspection by designated officials.

name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Organic Certification Groups
brief_description: The scheme Organic Certification Groups under Spices Board IndiaRs. Ministry of Commerce and IndustryRs. is implemented as per the Modalities and Scheme Guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (202122 to 202526). The objective of this scheme is to support farmer groups and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) in obtaining organic certification for farmsRs. which is a prerequisite for the marketing and export of organic spices.
benefits: - 50% subject to maximum of 1Rs./- for ONER groups and 90% subject to a maximum of 2Rs./- for NER groups. - Preference on eligibility/selection First: - Group which produces organic spices Second: - Above 50% of the farmers in the approved list of farmers producing organic spices adopting any cropping system. - A group/FPO is eligible for assistance thrice in a block year of 5 years from 2021 to 2026 consecutively or in staggered manner as per availability of funds in the component.
eligibility: 1. The scheme is applicable to all spice-growing StatesRs. regionsRs. and Union Territories (UTs) in India. 1. Spices Board India reserves the right to conduct inspections or checks at any stage of the chain of custodyRs. either before or after providing assistance under the scheme.

name: North East Skill Centre
brief_description:
The North East Skill Centre (NESC) is a premier skill development institute in AssamRs. established as a joint international initiative between the Government of Assam and the Government of Singapore. Operating under the aegis of the Assam Skill Development Mission (ASDM) and in collaboration with ITE Education Services (ITEES)Rs. SingaporeRs. the center is designed to elevate the state's vocational training to international standards.
**Key Highlights & Capacity** - **International standards**: The curriculum and training frameworks are modeled after Singapore's renowned Technical & Vocational Education Training (TVET) standards to ensure high quality and global employability for the youth of the North East.- **Target Capacity**: Envisioned to produce 400 trained candidates annually.- **Placements**: Above 90% and students have already secured prestigious international placementsRs. including locations like Lulu Mall in Dubai.
**Offered Programs** NESC offers one-year certification programs focused on high-demandRs. service-oriented industries: 1. Hospitality Food & Beverage Service 1. Hospitality Housekeeping 1. Retail Service 1. Beauty & Wellness
benefits:
NESC will produce 400 trained candidates annually and offer a **one-year certification** program in - Hospitality - Food & Beverage Service - 100 Nos - Hospitality Housekeeping - 100 Nos - Retail Service - 100 Nos - Beauty & Wellness - 100 Nos
1. **International Certification**: Graduate with a globally recognized 1-year certificate developed in collaboration with ITE Education Services (ITEES)Rs. Singapore.1. **Global Career Opportunities**: Access direct placement pathways to top-tier international and domestic employers (such as Lulu MallRs. Dubai).1. **Industry-Aligned Training**: Learn from a cutting-edge curriculum specifically designed to meet the real-world demands of high-growth sectors (HospitalityRs. RetailRs. and Beauty & Wellness).1. **State-of-the-Art Infrastructure**: Train in premierRs. modern facilities equipped with industry-standard labs and equipment.1. **Personalized Attention**: Benefit from focused learning environments with restricted batch sizes capped at 100 students per course.1. **Government-Backed Credibility**: Gain a highly subsidizedRs. quality-assured education under the aegis of the Assam Skill Development Mission (ASDM).
eligibility: 1. **Educational Qualification & Age Limit:** 12th Pass and age between 17 and 25.1. **Domicile Reservation:** 80% seats are reserved for domiciles of Assam. If reserved seats remain vacantRs. they may be allotted to students from other states.1. **Physical Fitness Requirement:** All the Candidates shall be required to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner at the time of admission.

name: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Registering Housing Complexes
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0) implemented through verticals "***Registering Housing Complexes which provide minimum basic facilities specified in the Scheme as SPARSH 2.0 housing complexes***" by the Labour & Employment DepartmentRs. UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu aims to promote affordable rental housing infrastructure for workers and economically weaker section families. Through this schemeRs. recognition and registration under SPARSH 2.0 are provided to eligible housing complexes fulfilling the prescribed standards and infrastructure requirements. The scheme prescribes minimum standards for dwelling unitsRs. sanitation facilitiesRs. ventilationRs. water supplyRs. and renewable energy for housing complexes. It also mandates the reservation of dwelling units for beneficiaries of the Economically Weaker Section. Housing complexes registered under the scheme become eligible for further scheme incentives and benefits. The registration process also ensures annual monitoring and compliance verification. SPARSH 2.0 is applicable across DamanRs. Dadra and Nagar HaveliRs. and Diu for the period from 2022 to 2027. > **Objectives:** - To address the vision of Aatma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyan by creating a sustainable ecosystem of affordable rental housing solutions for workers in industriesRs. construction sitesRs. and other weaker sections. - To achieve the objective of Housing for All by promoting affordable rental housing for workers and labourers. - To create a conducive environment by incentivising public and private entities to invest in affordable rental housing stock. - To increase the productivity of industries by improving the health and well-being of workers. - To reduce the financial burden on workers due to treatment costs and wage loss. - To increase the happiness and quality of life of workers. - To harmonise the Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC) Scheme guidelines with the SPARSH Scheme.
benefits: Each Housing Complex under the Scheme shall either be a registered Housing Complex under the ARHC scheme orRs. in the alternativeRs. should provide the following minimum basic facilities or adhere to the following minimum basic specifications: 1. One dwelling unit of the complex should not be less than 322 sq ft. in area. Not more than 33% of the dwelling units of the complex should be more than 350 sq ft. 1. Each dwelling unit should have at least two rooms and a separate toiletRs. bathroom and either a separate kitchen for each room or a common kitchen for the entire housing complex. 1. Each Dwelling Unit should be properly ventilated. 1. If the dwelling unit is being used as a dormitoryRs. the dwelling unit shall not contain more than 1 bed per 55 sq feet. 1. Each DU should have a dedicated water supply. 1. The Housing Complex should have solar panelsRs. and common areas should have free of cost lighting for all residents. 1. The housing complex should have a valid construction permission and/or occupancy certificate. 1. The housing complex should have septic tanks or soak pits of size not less than 105 litres x 5 x the number of dwelling units x 2 or as per CPHEEO normsRs. whichever is higher. 1. At least 66% of the dwelling unitsRs. rounded to the lowest integerRs. should be reserved to be rented to the Economically Weaker Section. 1. The responsibility for maintenance of the housing complexRs. including the collection of waste in twin binsRs. etc.Rs. shall be of the owner of the housing complex. 1. The owner of the housing complex shall agree to rent at least 66% of the dwelling units of the housing complex to EWS for at least 20 years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Dadra And Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be the owner or authorised representative of the housing complex. 1. The housing complex should fulfil SPARSH 2.0 infrastructure norms. 1. The housing complex should possess a valid construction permission and/or occupancy certificate. 1. The applicant should agree to reserve at least 66% dwelling units for Economically Weaker Section beneficiaries. 1. The applicant should agree to maintain the housing complex and waste management systems.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
brief_description: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is an insurance scheme offering life insurance cover for death due to any reason. It is a one-year coverRs. renewable from year to year. The scheme is offered by banks/post offices and administered through life insurance companies. All individuals who are account holders of participating banks/ post office in the age group of 18 to 50 years are entitled to join.
benefits:
1. PMJJBY offers one- year term **life cover of 2.00 Lakh** to all the subscribers in the age group of 18-50 years.1. It covers death due to any reason.
1. **Premium payable is 436/- per annum** per subscriberRs. to be auto debited from the subscribers bank/post office account.
eligibility:
1. The age of the applicant must be between 18 to 50 Years.
1. The applicant must hold an individual bank / post office account.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
brief_description:
An employment scheme by the Ministry of Rural DevelopmentRs. providing provide at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work. Any Indian citizen above the age of 18 years and residing in a rural area can apply to this scheme. The applicant receives guaranteed employment within 15 days from the date of application.
The wage is deposited directly in the Bank Account / Post Office Account of the applicant. Wages are paid within a weekRs. or fifteen days at most. Men and Women are paid equally. MGNREGA covers the entire country with the exception of districts that have a hundred percent urban population.
benefits:
1. The applicant receives guaranteed employment within 15 days from the date of application. 1. Work is to be provided within a radius of 5 kilometers of the applicants residence if possibleRs. and in any case within the Block. If the applicant lives more than 5 km away from the worksiteRs. he/she will be entitled to a travel and subsistence allowance (10% of the minimum wage). 1. Wages are paid within a weekRs. or fifteen days at most. Men and Women are paid equally. 1. ShadeRs. drinking waterRs. and first-aid are provided at every worksite.
**Exclusive measures for the promotion of the participation of the disabled persons:** 1. Identification of suitable works 1. Mobilization of disabled persons by focussing on awareness and special provisions 1. Specifically identified works for disabled persons in the case of large GPs 1. Preference to appoint as mates and as workers for providing drinking waterRs. to manage crechesRs. etc.Rs. at the worksites 1. Adoption of tools and equipment/facilities at workplaces 1. Treating persons with disabilities with respect 1. Special drive to ensure 100 days of employment to such households 1. Provide a special job card of a distinct color
**Specific attention and provisions for Senior Citizens:** 1. Exclusive senior citizen groups may be formed and special works which require lesser physical effort are identified and allotted to these groups.
**Specific attention and provisions for Internally Displaced Persons:** 1. A special job card to be provided will be valid till these families are displaced and will lose its validity as soon as they return to their original place of residence.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
1. The applicant must be residing in a Rural Area.

name: State Marriage Assistance Scheme For Poor Girls
brief_description: A social welfare scheme by the Social Welfare Department of the Government of Jammu & KashmirRs. for Poor Girls of Marriageable Age who belong to either AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or PHH (Priority Households) ration card holder families. Through this schemeRs. they shall be paid one-time financial assistance @ 50Rs./- (rupees fifty thousand only) for getting married. The financial assistance shall have to be paid before her marriage. The financial assistance shall be directly transferred into the individual bank accounts of the beneficiaries (marriageable girls) through DBT mode. The receipt of applications as well as the transfer of assistance shall be in online mode only. The District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) shall verify the details of the beneficiary regarding her marital status & age and shall submit the case before the Deputy Commissioner along with all requisite documents and his/her recommendations. The Deputy Commissioner shall sanction the financial assistance in favor of the beneficiary girl after determining the eligibilityRs. and reasonably satisfying himself/herself about the genuineness of the case. The scheme is operational in all the districts across the Union Territory of Jammy and Kashmir.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a female.
1. The applicant must be of marriageable ageRs. i.e. 18 years or above (Legal Age for Marriage in India).
1. The applicant must be from either AAY (Antyodaya Anna Yojana) or PHH (Priority Households) ration card holder families.
1. The applicant must not have availed the financial benefit for the same purpose under any other UT/Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. especially Ladli Beti Scheme. She can avail of benefits only once under the scheme.
1. The applicant must have applied at least one month in advance (before the date of marriage) to the concerned District Social Welfare Officer along with proof of marriageRs. proof of ageRs. copy of AAY or PHH ration cardRs. and Aadhaar card.
1. The minimum qualification of the beneficiary girl has to be 8th Pass or equivalent. HoweverRs. in the case of school dropoutsRs. the following guidelines shall apply:

a) During the next three years i.e.Rs. from the financial yearRs. 2022-2023 to 2024-2025 restructured guidelines shall be implemented irrespective of the education status of the beneficiary girl.
b) From 01-04-2025 onwards beneficiary girl has to compulsorily produce a certificate for having passed 8th Class or equivalent.

name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students
brief_description:
A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for regularRs. full-time students from Scheduled TribesRs. to obtain higher education (post-graduate courses viz. MastersRs. Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Research) from foreign institutes/universities. The Scheme is implemented through the Indian Embassies/Missions abroadRs. Ministry of External Affairs. 30% of the scholarship awards are earmarked for female candidates. Bachelor-level courses in any discipline are not covered under the scheme. Financial assistance is provided till completion of the course/research or the prescribed duration of the courseRs. whichever is earlier.
Selection is based on Interview based merit list prepared by An Expert Committee. The Scholarship comprises of tuition feeRs. Annual Maintenance allowance of USD 15400Rs. Contingency Charges of USD 1532Rs. Poll TaxRs. Visa FeeRs. Medical InsuranceRs. Cost of Air journeyRs. Incidental Journey expenses. The fields of study covered in this scheme are -:

1. Pure/Applied Science/Engineering/Technology/Mathematics(STEM)Rs.
1. ManagementRs.
1. EconomicsRs.
1. FinanceRs.
1. LawRs.
1. Agriculture/MedicineRs.
1. Humanities/Social Science/Fine Arts.


- **Number of Award:**

20 awards every year would be sanctioned to ST students as under:
**Sl. No****Category****No. of Award** 1.Scheduled Tribes (ST) candidates 172.Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG)03**Total****20**
- **Subjects and Slots covered under the Scheme:**

The subjects/disciplines in which student can opt for studies abroad and the number of slots available under each field for grant of award are listed below: -
**Field of study****Number of slots for the field of study** Pure/Applied Science/ Engineering/Technology/ Mathematics (STEM) 10ManagementRs. EconomicsRs. FinanceRs. Law04Agriculture/Medicine04Humanities/Social Science/Fine Arts 02
- **Duration of award with Financial Assistance:**

Financial assistance will be provided till completion of the course/research or the prescribed duration of the courseRs. whichever is earlier: -
**Sl. No****Course****Maximum Duration** 1.Post-Doctoral Research 2 years 2.Ph. D4 years (four years) 3.Master's Degree 1 or 2 years (One/Two years) depending upon the type and duration of the Course.
benefits: **Sl. No.****Scholarship Component****Details**1.Annual Maintenance AllowanceThe Annual maintenance allowance in USD15Rs. ($ Fifteen thousand four hundred only) in US/ Pound sterling 9Rs. ( Nine thousand nine hundred only) in United Kingdom for all level courses. For other countriesRs. the USD or equivalent rates would be applicable.2.Annual Contingency and Equipment AllowanceThe Annual Contingency and Equipment Allowance for books/essential apparatus/study tour/typing and binding of thesis etc. will be $ 1532 (US Dollars One thousand five hundred thirty-two only) for the candidates in US and for candidates in United KingdomRs. it will be 1116 (Pounds sterling One thousand one hundred sixteen only). For other countriesRs. US Dollar or equivalent rates would be applicable.3.Poll TaxActuals shall be paidRs. wherever applicable.4.Visa FeesActual visa fees in Indian Rupees will be paid.5.Incidental Journey ExpensesIncidental journey expenses up to US Dollars 20 or its equivalent in Indian Rupees are permissible.6.FeesTuition fees and other non-refundable fees which is required to be compulsorily paid by the student for completion of the courseRs. as per actuals.7.Medical Insurance PremiumActuals as charged will be admissible. The Indian Embassy/Mission in the respective country will however examine the reasonableness of medical premium opted/claimed by the student.8.Cost of Air PassageAir passage grant on actual basis from India to the nearest place to the educational institution and back to IndiaRs. by economy class and shortest route at best available price shall be provided.9.Local TravelSecond class railway fare from the port of disembarkation to the place of study and back; in case of far flung places not connected by railRs. bus fare from the place of residence to the nearest railway stationRs. actual charge of crossing by ferryRs. air fare to the nearest rail-cum-air Station will be permissible.**Note:** Extension of stay beyond prescribed duration for levels of courses as mentioned aboveRs. will be without financial assistance of any kind except the air passage to return to IndiaRs. if the candidate decides to come back to India on completion of the course.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST).
- The applicant must be pursuing a post-graduate course (MasterRs. Ph.D.Rs. or Post-Doctoral Research) from a foreign institute/university.
- The annual income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) should not be greater than 6Rs./-.
- The applicant must have secured at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying examination (In the case of Post-Doctoral ResearchRs. the qualifying exam is Ph.D.; In the case of Ph.D.Rs. the qualifying exam is a Masters Degree; In the case of a Masters DegreeRs. the qualifying exam is a Bachelor's Degree)
- The applicant must be the only child in the family who is availing/has availed of this scholarship.

**Age Criteria:-**

- If pursuing Post-Doctoral ResearchRs. the age of the applicant as on 1st July of the selection yearRs. should not be greater than 38 years.
- If pursuing Ph.D.Rs. the age of the applicant as on 1st July of the selection yearRs. should not be greater than 35 years.
- If pursuing MastersRs. the age of the applicant as on 1st July of the selection yearRs. should not be greater than 32 years.

**Income Criteria:-**
Scholarships will be paid to the students whose family income from all sources does not exceed 6Rs./- (Rupees Six lakhs only) per annum. The family income shall be computed in the following manner: -

- In case where both father and mother are workingRs. the combined income of both of them from all sources shall be taken into account in computing total family income.
- In case any other member of the familyRs. other than father and motherRs. is an earning memberRs. his or her income shall not be included in computing total family income.
- In case only one parent is aliveRs. the income of that parent shall be taken into account for considering total family income. If other sibling or family member is an earning memberRs. their income shall not be included in computing total family income.
- In case of an orphanRs. supported by a guardianRs. income criteria shall not apply.

**Note:-**

1. 30% of the awards for each year shall be earmarked for women candidates.
1. HoweverRs. in caseRs. adequate women candidates are not available as per the stipulations of the schemeRs. then the unutilized slots will be utilized by selecting suitable male candidates.
1. There are 17 slots for ST candidates and 3 slots for PVTG candidates.
1. An individual is eligible for only one award and cannot be considered for any other award or same/higher level of award for the second time under the Scheme.

**Other Conditions:-**

1. Selected candidates shall furnish all such documents and enter into such agreements before their departure as shall be decided by the Government of India from time to time.
1. In case the candidate is already residing abroadRs. he/she shall furnish all relevant documents and enter into such agreements prior to the release of the scholarship by the Indian Mission.
1. The candidate shall not change the course of study or research and the Institute for which scholarship has been sanctioned.
1. It will be the responsibility of candidate to obtain the appropriate visa for a country wherein he/she intends to study.
1. In case the awardee has received overpayment through Indian Mission abroad or any other Government agencyRs. he/she shall refund the same to Indian Mission abroad.
1. After completion of the courseRs. the awardee shall upload the course completion details along with brief of study in the Alumni Module of National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) portal of the Ministry before his return tickets are booked.

**Criteria for preparation of Merit List:-**

- All applications received within the stipulated periodRs. will be scrutinized for the eligibility criteria.
- Separate merit list will be drawn for each field of study.
- The eligible applications will be considered for award of scholarship as per the procedure given below:


1. First priority will be given to the candidates who have already got admission and are pursuing their studies in the top 1Rs. ranked foreign Institutes/Universities (as per the latest QS world ranking). The merit list will be drawn based on the ranking of the Institute. In case of a tie between the QS rankings of two or more candidatesRs. merit will be decided on the basis of marks/grades secured by the candidate in the qualifying examination for higher studies for which the scholarship has been applied for.
1. In case sufficient number of students are not selected as mentioned in para (a) aboveRs. merit list will be drawn from the candidates who have already secured preliminary letter/offer of admission from top 1Rs. ranked foreign Institutes/Universities (as per the QS world ranking) and are yet to join. Merit list will be drawn in similar manner as mentioned in para a above; i.e. based on the ranking of the Institute and in case of tie in ranking of university/institutionRs. the marks/grades secured by the candidate in the qualifying examination.
1. In case sufficient students are not selected as per para 1 and 2 aboveRs. the vacant slots will be filled from among the remaining eligible candidates through personal interview by a committee of experts constituted by the Ministry. The candidates who have cleared GRE/GMAT/TOFEL etc. will be given preference.

name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
brief_description:
**INTRODUCTION** The Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) Scheme for Scheduled Caste is formulated and funded by the Ministry of Social Justice &Empowerment. The scheme is open to candidates who belong to Scheduled Caste and are pursuing higher studies such as regular and full-time M.Phil.and Ph.D.degrees in SciencesRs. HumanitiesRs. Social SciencesRs. and Engineering & Technology. There are 2000 slots for Scheduled Caste every year for all the subjects. 3% fellowships are reserved for Persons with Disabilities candidates belonging to SC categories as per the provision laid down by the Government of India.
**OBJECTIVE** The objective of the scheme is to provide five-year fellowships in the form of financial assistance to students from SC categoriesRs. as notified by the Central Government to pursue higher studies such as M.Phil. and Ph.D. at Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges as indicated below: i. Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under sections 2(f) and 12(B) of UGC Act. ii. Deemed to be Universities included under Section 3 of the UGC ActRs. 1956 and eligible to receive grants-in-aid from UGC. iii. Universities/Institutions/Colleges funded by Central/State Government iv. Institutes of National Importance.
eligibility:
**TARGET GROUP** The candidates belonging to one of the SC categories who have passed the post-graduation examination in the concerned subject and who are pursuing full-time research without JRF of UGC-NET or UGC-CSIR NET.
**ELIGIBILITY** A candidate has to fulfill the following conditions to be eligible for the award of this fellowship: i. The candidate should belong to SC/ST and should have passed the Post Graduate Examination. ii. The Candidate must be registered for M.Phil./Ph.D. iii. Transgender candidates are eligible to apply under the scheme. The reservation shall be followed as per the government of India norms

name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals
brief_description:
**INTRODUCTION** The scheme was initiated keeping in view the political and cultural bilateral relations of India with other developing countries of AsiaRs. AfricaRs. and Latin America. The scheme has opened new vistas for foreign students and teachersRs. enabling them to come to India and undertake advanced studies and research in sciencesRs. humanitiesRs. and social sciences in Indian Universities.
**OBJECTIVE** The objective of the scheme is to provide an opportunity for foreign students and teachers from developing countries to undertake advanced study and research leading to M.Phil/Ph.D. and postdoctoral research in sciencesRs. humanitiesRs. and social sciences at Indian Universities.
eligibility:
***Target Group:*** Students and teachers from developing countries of Asia/Africa and Latin America.
***For Junior Research Fellowship (JRF):*** 35 years for male candidates as of 1st July of the year of application and 40 years for female candidates. The candidates must have at least a high-class masters degree with a second-class bachelors degree or a second-class masters degree with a first-class bachelors degree.
***For Research Associateship (RA):*** In the case of male applicants the age should be 40 years as of 1st July of the year of applicationRs. and 45 years in the case of female candidates. The candidates must have a doctorate degreeRs. published research work to their creditRs. and evidence of independent research work.

name: Tripura Journalist Health Insurance Scheme
brief_description: A Health Insurance Scheme by the Directorate of Information & Culture AffairsRs. for Journalists who are permanent residents of the state of Tripura. The applicant must be an accredited journalist by the state government or PIB. The age must be in between 21-65 years. The applicant must not have been covered under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme or any other Health Insurance Scheme of the Central or State Government. The beneficiary will receive medical care facilities for all the diseases as listed by the State government after recommendation by the committee. The maximum coverage of benefits from all sources will be 3Rs.. The application shall be submitted to the DirectorRs. the Information and Cultural Affairs Department. The basic objective of the scheme is to financially protect the Journalists from monetary burdens and liabilities that are a result of unfortunate health-related situations and emergencies.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the state of Tripura.
1. The applicant must be an accredited working journalist by the state government or by the Press Information Bureau (PIB).
1. The age of the applicant must be in between 21 years and 65 years.
1. The applicant must not have been covered under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme or any other Health Insurance Scheme of the Central or State Government.

name: KCR Nutrition Kit
brief_description:
Telangana Government launched yet another pioneering initiative KCR Nutrition KitsRs. which is aimed at reducing Anemia and improving hemoglobin levels in pregnant women. Each kit contains a kg of Nutritional Mix PowderRs. a kg of Dates (Khajoor)Rs. three bottles of Iron SyrupRs. 500 grams of GheeRs. and a Cup. The kits were distributed to pregnant women in nine districts of Telangana where the prevalence of anemia was high. The programme was launched by Health Minister T Harish Rao at Kamareddy on 21st December 2022.
**Objective:** The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the nutritional status of pregnant and lactating women and young children in Telangana.
**Beneficiaries:** The scheme aims to cover all pregnant in Telangana. The beneficiaries will receive a kit containing essential food items every month.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women Development and Child WelfareRs. Government of Telangana.

OverallRs. the KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme is an important initiative aimed at improving the nutritional status of pregnant in Telangana. The scheme provides essential food items that can help in meeting the nutritional requirements of these vulnerable groups.
benefits:
The KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme in Telangana provides several benefits to the beneficiaries. Here are some of the key benefits of the scheme: ** To provide quality nutrition throughout pregnancy and post-delivery.** ** To reduce Anaemia and improve hemoglobin levels in pregnant women.** ** To reduce Maternal Mortality Rate and Infant Mortality Rate**
***Improved Nutritional Status:*** The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the nutritional status of pregnant women in Telangana. The nutrition kit provided to the beneficiaries contains essential food items that can help in meeting their daily nutritional requirements.
***Reduced Malnutrition:*** Malnutrition is a major problem among pregnant in Telangana. The KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme can help in reducing malnutrition by providing nutritious food to the beneficiaries every month.
***Improved Health:*** Good nutrition is essential for good health. The KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme can help in improving the health of pregnant women in Telangana by providing them with essential nutrients.
***Increased Awareness:*** The scheme can also help in increasing awareness about the importance of good nutrition among the beneficiaries. The Anganwadi workers can educate the beneficiaries about the importance of good nutrition and how to make the most of the food items provided in the kit.
***Empowerment of Women:*** The scheme can also help in empowering women by providing them with the necessary resources to take care of their health and the health of their children. The nutrition kit provided under the scheme can help in reducing the financial burden on women and enable them to make better decisions about their health and nutrition.
OverallRs. the KCR Nutrition Kits Scheme in Telangana has several benefits for the beneficiaries. It can help in improving their nutritional statusRs. reducing malnutritionRs. improving healthRs. increasing awarenessRs. and empowering women.
eligibility:
Pregnant Women: Pregnant women are eligible to receive the nutrition kit under the scheme. The scheme aims to provide support to pregnant women to ensure that they have access to essential nutrients required for a healthy pregnancy.
Age: Minimum 18 Gender: Female Residence Type: Both
**Resident of Telangana:** The scheme is applicable only to the residents of Telangana. Non-residents of the state are not eligible to receive the nutrition kit.
**Economically Weaker Sections:** The scheme is designed to provide support to the economically weaker sections of society. Families with a monthly income of less than Rs. 10Rs. are eligible to receive the nutrition kit.
**Identification by Anganwadi Worker:** The beneficiaries of the scheme are identified by the Anganwadi workers. The workers conduct surveys and identify the eligible beneficiaries based on the eligibility criteria mentioned above.

name: Rythu Bima Scheme
brief_description: Rythu Bima is a social security initiative of the Government of Telangana launched on 14th August 2018Rs. aimed at providing financial support to the families of farmers in the event of the farmer's untimely death. The main objective of the scheme to ensure financial security to the families of deceased farmers by offering life insurance coverage for both natural and accidental deaths.
benefits: - **Insurance Coverage:** 5Rs./- per eligible farmer- **Coverage Type:** Natural and accidental deaths- **Claim Settlement Mode:** Direct bank transfer to the nominees account- **Claim Process:** Entirely onlineRs. farmer families are not required to visit any office
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The applicant must be a resident of Telangana.
1. The applicant must be aged between 18 and 59 years.
1. The applicants details should be available in the Dharani database under RoR (Record of Rights) land records.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Pattadar Pass Book (PPB) or a RoFR (Recognition of Forest Rights) Patta.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
brief_description:
Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students was launched in 2009 by the Ministry of Minority Affairs for providing financial aid to students for their higher studies.
The objective of the Fellowship is to provide five year fellowships in the form of financial assistance to students from minority communitiesRs. notified by the Central GovernmentRs. to pursue M. Phil and Ph.D.
The scheme covers all Universities/Institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) as under : 1. Central/State Universities (including constituent and affiliated institutions) included under Section 2(f) of UGC ActRs. 1956 and having valid accreditation from NAAC. 1. Deemed Universities under Section 3 of UGC ActRs. i.e.Rs. Institution for higher education notified by Central Government to be deemed UniversityRs. in consultation with UGC and having and having valid accreditation from NAAC. 1. Institution fully funded by State / Central Government and empowered to award degrees. 1. Institutions of National Importance as notified by Ministry of Human Resource Development.
benefits: The rate of fellowship for JRF and SRF is at par with the UGC fellowshipRs. presently the rates are as follows: - **Fellowship in Science Humanities and Social Science:** 31Rs./- p.m. for initial two years (JRF)Rs. and 35Rs./- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF)- **Fellowship in Engineering & Technology:** 31Rs./- p.m. for initial two years (JRF)Rs. and 35Rs./- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF)- **Contingency for Humanities & Social Sciences:** 10Rs./- p.a. for initial two yearsRs. and 20Rs./- p.a. for remaining tenure- **Contingency for SciencesRs. Engineering & Technology:** 12Rs./- p.a. for initial two yearsRs. and 25Rs./- p.a. for remaining tenure- **Escorts/Reader assistance (All subjects):** 2Rs./- p.m. in cases of physically and visually handicapped candidate
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a part of one of the minority communities (BuddhistRs. ChristianRs. JainRs. MuslimRs. SikhRs. or Zoroastrian (Parsi)).
1. Applicant must qualify the UGC-NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination.
1. If applicant does not complete his/her research work during the period of fellowship shall not be eligible to apply again under this scheme.
1. If applicant completely or partially availed any fellowship earlier shall also not be eligible for fellowship under this scheme.
1. Employees of any universityRs. collegeRs. educational institutionRs. or centralRs. stateRs. or union territory government are not eligible for fellowshipsRs. even if they are on study leave or end of life (EOL) leave to pursue an M.Phil. or Ph.D. course

name: CIFE - Institutional Fellowship
brief_description:
ICAR-CIFE offers two years Masters (Masters in Fisheries Science) and three years Doctoral (Ph.D.) degrees in as many as eleven specialised disciplines of fisheries sciencesRs. perhaps one of its kinds in the world. Since its recognition as Deemed to be University in 1989Rs. under Section 3 of University Grants Commission ActRs. 1953Rs. CIFE offers its own degrees.
**Fellowship**
- ICAR offers Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) for post-graduate education leading to a Master's Degree Program at the rate of Rs. 5760/- per month for two years with a contingent grant of Rs. 6000/- per annum (for procurement of essential chemicalsRs. equipmentRs. books and travel allowances connected with the collection of research data). Continuance of Fellowship after the 1st year is dependent on maintaining the required OGPA as per guidelines. - As per 41st Academic council approvalRs. the students who secure and maintain the required O.G.P.A. even if he/she has not cleared the examination in a particular course will be entitled to fellowship. HoweverRs. the student will remain on Scholastic probation until he/she clears the examination for the course(s). - The JRF will be given only to those candidates who join the M.F.Sc. Program in the University/Institute other than that from where he/she has obtained the Bachelor's Degree. Under no circumstancesRs. a change of subject for JRF will be entertained. - ICAR Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) for Ph.D. Degree is offered at the rate of Rs. 7000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 5600/- in the third year with a contingent grant of Rs. 10Rs./- per annum (for procurement of essential chemicalsRs. equipmentRs. books and travel allowances connected with the collection of research data). - A maximum of Rs. 2500/- in the first year could be utilised for the purchase of books and Rs. 2500/- for the preparation of a thesis. The remaining contingent grant would exclusively be utilised for contingency connected with the conduct of research work. - Institutional Fellowship for M.F.Sc. Programs is at present at the rate of Rs. 5040/- per month for two years and for Ph.D. programs at the rate of Rs. 7000/- for three years. The contingent grant given is Rs. 6000/- per year at Masters's level and Rs.10Rs./- per year at Ph.D. level. - A maximum of Rs. 2500/- in the first year could be utilised for the purchase of books and Rs. 2500/- for the preparation of a thesis. The remaining contingent grant would exclusively be utilised for contingency connected with the conduct of research work.

**Eligibility** - **M.F.Sc.** The candidates having a Bachelor's Degree in the concerned field under 10 + 2 + 4 are eligible to apply for admission. Candidates must have obtained at least 60% marks or an overall grade point average (OGPA) of 6.50 out of 10.00Rs. 3.25 out of 5.00 or 2.60 out of 4.00 (for SC/ST candidates 55% marks or OGPA of 6.00 out of 10.00Rs. 3.00 out of 5.00 or 2.40 out of 4.00).- **Ph.D**. B.F.Sc. & M.F.Sc. (4 +2 yrs) or B.Sc & M.Sc. (3yrs) from CIFE (till 1995)Rs. with M.F.Sc./M.Sc. OGPA 7.5 out of 10 and 3.75 out of 5 For General / OBC candidates (OGPA for SC/ST candidates is 7.00 out of 10 and 3.50 out of 5). (OR) D.F.Sc. from CIFERs. provided the candidate holds a Bachelor's degree in biological science and has two years of experience in fisheries development work after obtaining D.F.Sc. In the case of sponsored candidatesRs. those holding M.Sc. in Fish and Fisheries and related disciplines with at least two years of experience in fisheries development work are also eligible to apply.- **Foreign students** Foreign students are exempted from appearing in the written test and interview. Thus admission is made on the scrutiny of the bio-data and on the recommendation of the Head of the concerned discipline
**Selection Procedure** - **For M.F.Sc.** A combined examination for the award of ICAR Junior Research Fellowship and admissions to 100% seats of the Master's Degree Programme at CIFE is conducted by the Indian Council of Agricultural ResearchRs. Krishi Anusandhan BhavanRs. PusaRs. New DelhiRs. in the first week of June. Candidates are selected for the award of ICAR Junior Research Fellowship and admission to State Agricultural Universities and Deemed Universities on the basis of merit in the Entrance Examination and Counselling.- **For Ph.D.** Admissions are made on the basis of written tests and interviews for Ph.D. The academic score has a weightage of 20%Rs. the subject matter written test score constitutes 70 %Rs. while the interview score contributes the remaining 10%. HoweverRs. from the year 2020Rs. the National Testing Agency (NTA) is organizing national-level Ph.D. entrance tests for admission to the CIFE.
- **For Foreign students** The last date for receipt of applications and results/marks-sheets from the applicants who are foreign nationals but are resident in India will be the same as prescribed for the applicants who are Indian citizensRs. and the self-financing foreign students out of them are called for the written test and interview only if they have prescribed qualifications as for the Indian applicantsRs. admission is through the open competition
