name: Employee Health Scheme
brief_description:
The Dr YSR Aarogyasri Health Care TrustRs. under the auspices of the Government of Andhra PradeshRs. has implemented the Employee Health Scheme (EHS) with the primary objective of providing quality healthcare to all State Government Employees. The scheme covers government employeesRs. pensioners and their dependent family membersRs. who are eligible for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals or Network Hospitals (NWH).
The EHS has replaced the erstwhile medical reimbursement process and offers new features such as post-hospitalisation medical care and treatment of chronic diseases. This scheme is applicable to both serving and retired employees of the state government of Andhra Pradesh. It is aimed at providing comprehensive healthcare services to the beneficiaries and ensuring their well-being by offering high-quality medical services.
eligibility:
1. Serving employees:

- All regular State Government employees. A State Government employee will have the meaning as defined under Fundamental Rules.
- Provincialised employees of local bodies.

2. Retired employees:

- All Service Pensioners
- Family pensioners
- Re-employed service pensioners

name: Allowance To Dwarf
brief_description:
**Details**
The acceptance of the basic needs of the citizens of the country financially is governed by the pension scheme for all the states. The benefit of the pension scheme is provided by dividing the citizens below the poverty line into old ageRs. minorRs. destituteRs. widow and orphan destitute etc. Keeping in mind the social security of the bonds by the state governmentRs. the purpose of providing housing allowance per month is to operate the Born Pension Scheme.
State of Haryana introduced the Dwarf Allowance Scheme in support for the dwarfs to avail equal opportunities in all sectors. A dwarf individuals who are living in various parts of the State are being given an allowance @ Rs. 2500 (w.e.f. 01-04-2021) per month per beneficiary. A male person of height 3 feet 8 inches or less height and a female of height 3 feet 3 inches or less (equivalent to 70% handicapped) is entitled to monthly pension.
eligibility: **Eligibility Criteria** 1. The applicant should be a Domicile of Haryana State and should have been residing in Haryana State for the last year at the time of submission of the application. 1. The age of the applicant shall not be less than 18 years. 1. The applicant must submit a certificate from the Civil Surgeon in support of his/her being a Dwarf.

name: Assistance Scheme For Construction Worker In Case Of General Or Accidental Death Or Injury
brief_description:
The Assistance to Construction workers in case of injury or death or accident is a scheme implemented in the state of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to construction workers and their families in case of an accident resulting in injury or death. Under this schemeRs. a compensation of up to Rs. 3 lakhs is provided in case of permanent disability or accidental death of a registered construction worker. AdditionallyRs. medical expenses are covered for the treatment of injuries sustained during an accident at the construction site.
To be eligible for this schemeRs. the construction worker must be registered with the Construction Workers Welfare Board in Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to construction workers and their families during times of distress and help them cope with the financial burden of medical expenses and loss of income due to the accident.
eligibility: 1. Applicant should be a Resident of Rajasthan State. 2. Construction workers in the age group of 18 to 60 years will be eligible for this scheme. 3. Applicant should be registered as Construction Worker under labor laws. No assistance shall be payable in the event of death or injury caused by suicide or by consumption of drugs or substances or in case of death or injury caused by assault on one another in contravention of law for the purpose of committing an offence.

name: Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme
brief_description:
**Features**

1. The government will allow only the senior citizens from the economically weaker sections to avail the benefits under this scheme.
1. Under this Uttar Pradesh old age pension schemeRs. the Government will transfer the pension amount to the beneficiaries through their bank account
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. Age should be between 60 to 150.
1. Applicant should be below poverty line or his/her annual income should be upto for Rural Areas Rs. 46Rs./- and Urban Areas Rs. 56Rs./-.

name: Nekar Samman Yojana
brief_description: **Details** Karnataka Nekar Samman Yojana: In 2020 amidst the Covid pandemicRs. CM B.S YediyurappaRs. the then Chief Minister of Karnataka launched a mega scheme Karnataka Nekar Samman Yojana. It was a relief scheme to provide financial support to the destitute weaver of the state engaged in the handloom and textile industry whose livelihood was adversely affected by the pandemic. To save their interests and provide assistance during tough timesRs. the state government launched the scheme and transferred monetary support to their bank accounts. The scheme was one of the important parts of the Rs.1610 crore Covid Relief Package released by the Karnataka Government in the year 2020. It was launched by the then CM of the state on 6th July 2020 in Bengaluru. In the first phaseRs. a total of 19Rs. weaver beneficiaries benefitted under the scheme. The scheme has been launched to assist and support the poor weavers (both handloom and power loom) engaged in the handloom and textile industry. The beneficiaries under the scheme are provided yearly assistance of Rs.2000. the amount is transferred to their registered bank accounts through DBT mode. With this schemeRs. the state government extends its assistance to the destitute weavers in improving their livelihood and promoting their businesses. The scheme also works for protecting the interests of workers engaged in these small textile and handloom businesses in the state. The implementation of the scheme was carried out by the Department of Handlooms and TextilesRs. Government. of Karnataka. The assistance under this scheme is provided only to the weavers who are successfully registered in the Seva Sindhu portal of the state. For the year 2023Rs. the registration and application details are yet to be released. As soon as any updates regarding the same will be released we will intimate our readers through this post. To get more insight into the Nekar Samman Yojana of the Karnataka GovernmentRs. one can have a look at this article. Here is everything you need to know about the Karnataka Nekar Samman Yojana.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Karnataka. They must have a valid resident certificate.
1. All the weavers and financially distressed workers engaged in the handloom/ power loom industry and ancillary activities such as cottonRs. woolRs. and silk in the state are eligible.
1. Prospective beneficiaries must have an active bank account.

name: Integrated Child Development Services: Chandigarh
brief_description:
Launched on 2nd OctoberRs. 1975Rs. the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme is one of the flagship programmes of the Government of India and represents one of the worlds largest and unique programmes for early childhood care and development. It is the foremost symbol of countrys commitment to its children and nursing mothersRs. as a response to the challenge of providing pre-school non-formal education on one hand and breaking the vicious cycle of malnutritionRs. morbidityRs. reduced learning capacity and mortality on the other. The beneficiaries under the Scheme are children in the age group of 0-6 yearsRs. pregnant womenRs. and lactating mothers.
To reduce mortality morbidity and malnutrition among the children in U.T of ChandigarhRs. the ICDS project was started on 1.8.1979 with 24 anganwadi centres. At present there are 3 ICDS Projects comprising of 450 anganwadi centres covering an approx. population of over 5.50 lac in peripheral areasRs. villagesRs. coloniesRs. and slum areas.
benefits:
- Supplementary Nutrition - Immunization - Health Check-up - Referral Services - Pre-School Education - Nutrition & Health Education
Three of the six services viz. immunizationRs. health check-up and referral services are related to health and are provided through National Health Mission and Public Health Infrastructure. The services are offered at Anganwadi Centers through Anganwadi Workers (AWWs) and Anganwadi Helpers (AWHS) at grassroots level.
eligibility:
- Children in the age group of 0-6 years.
- Pregnant women.
- Lactating mothers.
- Women from age group 14-18 years of UT Chandigarh.
- The Scheme is universal for all categories of beneficiaries and in coverage.

name: Mukhya Mantri Vivah Shagun Yojna
brief_description: The Haryana government has launched such a scheme for poor girlsRs. and for welfare of SC's and BC's in which there will be no problem in the marriage of girls from poor families. Under this SchemeRs. an amount of 71Rs./- will be given in the name of Kanyadan to the daughters of scheduled castes and widows living below the poverty line. In thisRs. an amount of 66Rs./- will be given as Shagun at the time of marriage and the remaining amount of 5Rs./- will be given at the time of registration of marriage.
benefits:
**Amount of Shagun:**
Sl. No.CategoryTotal Amount of Shagun1Widow /Divorced/Destitute/ Orphan and Destitute children. (whose family income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum)51Rs./-2SC/DT/Tapriwas Communities (whose family income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum)71Rs./-3Sports woman (Any caste whose family income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum).41Rs./-4All sections families (General and Backward Classes) having family annual income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum.41Rs./-5Divyangjan (whose family income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum): If new married couple both are disabled.51Rs./-6Divyangjan (whose family income is less than or equal to 1Rs./- per annum): If one spouse is disabled out of new married couple.41Rs./-7The couple belongs to all sections of society in Haryana who are not covered in the above provisions of the schemeRs. who register their marriages with in a period of 30 days from the date of marriage will be given a Shagun of 1100/- and a sweet box.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a girl aged 18 years or older.
2. The beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana.
3. The beneficiary should belong to one of the following categories:
Daughter of a widowRs. divorcedRs. or destitute woman
Orphan girl
Member of SCRs. DTRs. or Tapriwas communities
Daughter of a sportswoman (any caste)
From any section of society (General or Backward Classes)
Person with disabilities (Divyangjan)
3. The beneficiarys annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana
brief_description: "Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana" is a Medical Assistance scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides financial assistance of 15Rs./- for the first two deliveries of the registered female worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a female.
1. The applicant should be pregnant.
1. The applicant should be a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The scheme is applicable only for the first two deliveries.

name: Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana
brief_description:
**Details**
This scheme aims to supply self-employment to unemployed persons in urban and rural areas. Disabled and blind persons are also eligible to take benefits under this scheme
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. Age: 18 to 65 years.
1. Qualification: The applicant should have passed the minimum standard fourth ORRs. Training/ Experience: Should have undergone training for a minimum of three months from the private establishment or a minimum of one month from Government recognized InstitutesRs. in the area of the proposed business or should have experience of minimum 1 year in the same activity or should be a hereditary craftsperson.
1. No Income criteria

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: The scheme Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) was started by the Department of Women & Child WelfareRs. Govt. of Sikkim in 2014. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to differently-abled persons of the age group of 18 years & above belonging to a household Below Poverty Line category with severe or multiple disabilities of more than 80%. The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of 2000/- and this pension amount consists of the Central and State governments' share.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of the state of Sikkim. - The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant should have attained the age of 18 years and above. - The applicant with a disability of more than 80% is eligible under the scheme. - The applicant should not have any source of income. - The applicant should not be a recipient of salary/pension/family pension from the Central Government / other State Governments. - The applicant should have opened the Bank Account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.

name: Uniform Assistance To SC Students
brief_description:
**Objective**
- Main Objective is to provide economic support and motivation for education. Under this schemeRs. assistance is given to Students studying in classes 1 to 8.
- Through this schemeRs. the Gujarat government promotes primary education.
eligibility:
1. The student should be of Scheduled Caste.
1. Students should be studying in classes 1 to 8.
1. No Income Limit.

name: Scheme Of Assistance To Persons With Disabilities For Purchase/Fitting Of Aids And Appliances
brief_description: "Scheme of Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances" is a scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Manipur. In this schemeRs. the Person with a Disability is provided with Financial Assistance for the Purchase/Fitting of Hearing AidsRs. Artificial LimbsRs. and Other Appliances. This is a State Sponsored Scheme and only the citizens who are domiciled in the State of Manipur can apply for this scheme. The percentage of disability of the applicant should be 40% and above. The application should be submitted through the respective District Social Welfare Officer.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Manipur.
1. The percentage of disability should be 40% and above.
1. The applicant should not have received assistance during the last 3 years for the same purpose from any firm / approved organization. HoweverRs. for children below 12 years of ageRs. this limit would be one year.
1. The monthly income of the applicant from all sources should not exceed 15Rs./- per month.
1. In the case of dependentsRs. the income of parents/guardians should not exceed 15Rs./- per month.

name: Unemployment Allowance To The Educated Unemployed Persons With Disabilities
brief_description: "Unemployment Allowance to the Educated Unemployed Persons With Disabilities" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Manipur. The payment of unemployment allowance will be applicable to all categories of disabilities except Intellectual Disabilities as specified in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. The persons with disability should have minimum qualification of Matriculate and registered with Special Employment Exchange for more than two years and could not be placed in any gainful occupation. The person with disability shall be in the age group of 18-48 years. The applicant should be a Manipuri by birth or settled in the state for at least 10 (ten) years.
eligibility:
1. All categories of disabilities except Intellectual Disabilities as specified in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability.
1. The applicant should have a minimum qualification of Matriculate.
1. The applicant should be registered with Special Employment Exchange for more than two years and could not be placed in any gainful occupation.
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-48 years.
1. The applicant should be a Manipuri by birth or a person who has settled in the state for at least 10 years.
1. The annual family income of the applicant should not be more than 1Rs./-.

name: Antayoshti Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Antayoshti Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides 10Rs./- for the last rites in the case of the death of the registered beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The deceased should have been a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The deceased should have been a worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The deceased should have been between 18-60 years of age.
1. The deceased should have been engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.

name: State Pre-metric Scholarship For Disabled
brief_description: The "State Pre-metric Scholarship for Disabled" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students with disability (SwDs) to pursue education. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant should be a student admitted/enrolled in a school recognized by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (Visually HandicappedRs. Low VisionRs. Hearing ImpairedRs. Orthopedically HandicappedRs. etc).
1. The percentage of the disability should be 40% or above.
1. The applicant should not have failed in the last qualifying examination.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a pre-metric qualificationRs. i.e. Class 1st to Class 10th.

name: Rehabilitation Allowance To Lepers
brief_description: The rehabilitation Allowance to Lepers scheme is a welfare scheme launched by the government of Himachal Pradesh for the benefit of leprosy patients. The scheme provides a monthly allowance of Rs. 750 to people affected by leprosy who are residing in the state of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to leprosy patients who are living in various leprosy colonies across the state. The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the living conditions of leprosy patients and to ensure that they receive adequate medical care and attention.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a leprosy patient living in a leprosy colony. 2. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh. 3. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other government scheme or pension.

name: Skill Development Allowance Scheme
brief_description:
The Department of Labour & EmploymentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme named "**Skill Development Allowance Scheme**" also known by the name of The Himachal Pradesh Payment of Skill Development Allowance to Educated Unemployed Persons SchemeRs. 2013" with the aim of granting Skill Development Allowance to the unemployed youth aims at providing allowance to educated unemployed persons for their Skill upgradation.
**Objective:**

- This scheme intends to provide allowance to eligible educated unemployed Himachali youth for

their skill upgradation.

- This in turn will enable such youth to develop their skill which in turn will enable them to take up

employment or self-employment in the Sector of their choiceRs. since this scheme empowers the youth
to choose the Sector in which they would like to develop their skillRs. at the training institute of their
choice.
**Key features of this scheme:**

1. **Financial Assistance:** The scheme provides financial allowances to eligible candidatesRs. covering expenses such as tuition feesRs. study materialsRs. transportationRs. and living costs during the training period. This financial support reduces the financial burden on individuals and encourages them to pursue skill development programs. 1. **Enhanced Employability:** By promoting skill development aligned with industry requirementsRs. the scheme equips participants with relevant skills and knowledge. This increases their employability prospectsRs. making them well-prepared to meet the demands of the job market and secure gainful employment. 1. **Access to Quality Training:** The scheme facilitates access to reputable training institutions and programsRs. ensuring that participants receive high-quality training. This exposure to quality education and skill-building opportunities enhances the overall learning experience and improves the effectiveness of the training received. 1. **Sector-specific Skill Development:** The scheme focuses on various sectors such as healthcareRs. tourismRs. agricultureRs. ITRs. and manufacturingRs. recognizing the specific needs and demands of different industries. By targeting sector-specific skill developmentRs. the scheme aligns the training with the current and future workforce requirementsRs. increasing the chances of participants finding suitable employment. 1. **Economic Growth and Development:** By nurturing a skilled workforceRs. the scheme contributes to the economic growth and development of Himachal Pradesh. The availability of skilled individuals attracts investmentsRs. encourages entrepreneurshipRs. and leads to the creation of more job opportunities within the stateRs. ultimately bolstering the overall economic prosperity of the region.
benefits:
Allowance shall be payable to each educated unemployed applicant for a maximum period of two years; subject to fulfilling eligibility criteria & timely submission of attested copies of 8th/matriculation marks sheet/certificate to ascertain age and educational qualification and Affidavit as per form CRs. at the following rates:
1. **For Physically Challenged person** who have minimum 50% permanent disability recorded in her/his
Employment Exchange record (X-I)Rs. @ 1Rs./- per month.
2. **For all other categories of Persons** :- 1000/- (Rs. One Thousand) per month.
**Note:**

- The Allowance shall be credited to the recipient by RTGS/NEFT/ECS through Banks as mentioned in

Application FormRs. on monthly basis at the cost of the Government.

- This would be on bank accounts which are verified by Aadhaar number by the bank.
eligibility:
Subject to the provisions of this SchemeRs. all educated unemployed applicants shall be eligible for the
grant of Skill Development AllowanceRs. who fulfill the following criteria:

1. She/He should be unemployed (i.e. neither employed in Govt. sector nor in private sector nor self employed) and should be a Bonafide Himachali.
1. She/He should have passed minimum 8th from any Board/University/Institution recognized by H.P Govt. There will be no requirement of minimum qualification for admissibility of allowance under the Scheme when applicant wants to pursue training in Sectors such as masonryRs. carpentryRs. blacksmithy or plumbing etc.
1. She/He should be registered with any Employment Exchange in Himachal Pradesh as on the date of application.
1. Her/His annual family income for the Financial Year immediately preceding date of applicationRs. from all sources including that of spouse should be less than Rs. 2.00 Lakh (Rs. Two Lakhs).
1. She/He should be above 16years and below 36 years of age and in case of widow less than 45 years of age as on the date of application.
1. She/He should not be self-employed.
1. The employment under MGNREGA will not be counted as employment.
1. She/He should not be a dismissed Govt. employee.
1. She/He should not be convicted of any offence resulting in imprisonment for a period of 48 hours or more.
1. She/he should be enrolled in a skill development training.

name: Matrimonial Incentives
brief_description: The "Matrimonial Incentives" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. if a Person with Disability (PwD) gets married to a non-disabled personRs. then the couple is provided a marriage incentive of up to 50Rs.. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
benefits:
The eligible couple will get up to 50Rs./- as financial assistance. The nature of financial assistance is as below

1. Saving Certificate of 25Rs./-.
1. 20Rs./- in cash.
1. 4Rs./- in the form of household utility.
1. 500/- to attend the marriage incentive program.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability (Visually HandicappedRs. Low VisionRs. Hearing ImpairedRs. Orthopedically HandicappedRs. etc).
1. The percentage of the disability should be 40% or above.
1. The applicant should have been married to a non-disabled person.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanyadaan Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhya Mantri Kanyadan Yojana in Himachal Pradesh is a welfare scheme aimed at providing financial assistance for the marriage of daughters from economically weaker sections of society. Under this schemeRs. daughters of families below the poverty lineRs. widowsRs. destitute womenRs. and families with an annual income of less than Rs. 35Rs. are eligible for financial assistance from the government for their marriage. The scheme aims to reduce the financial burden on families during the marriage of their daughters and promote gender equality. The scheme has been successful in providing financial support to many familiesRs. particularly those from underprivileged backgroundsRs. and helping them to celebrate the marriage of their daughters with dignity and joy.
benefits:
> 1. The marriage grant at 40Rs./- in each cases shall be admissible to the parents/guardians of the destitute girl/women for their marriage.
> 2. In case of the inmates of Nari Sewa Sadan/ Nari NiketanRs. Marriage grant of 51Rs./-Rs. shall be admissible to the girl/women for their marriage.
eligibility:
1. Girl whose father is not alive and whose guardians total income does not exceed 35Rs./- per annum (excluding MNREGA income).
1. Girl whose father is incapacitated or bedridden due to physical or mental disabilityRs. including prolonged illnessRs. and whose family income does not exceed 35Rs. /- per annum (excluding MNREGA income).
1. Orphan girls/neglected girls and womenRs. including inmates of Nari Niketan and former inmates of Balika AshramsRs. with no regular source of income.
1. Deserted/divorced women whose income does not exceed 35Rs./- per annum (excluding MNREGA income).
1. Girls/women in moral danger or rescued from immoral trafficking.
1. Destitute women/girls released after imprisonment under any law.
1. Daughters of divorced/deserted women whose annual income does not exceed 35Rs./- per annum (excluding MNREGA income).

name: LIDCOM 50% Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: Being implemented particularly for the (Scheduled Caste) Charmakar CommunityRs. the "50% Subsidy Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM)Rs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. 50% amount is being given as a subsidy on a maximum loan amount of 50Rs./-. The subsidy is subject to the maximum limit of 10Rs./-. The bank charge of interest is as per the existing rate. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is completely funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The main objective of LIDCOM is to implement various schemes to uplift the lifestyle of Charmakars (DhorRs. ChambharRs. HolarRs. MochiRs. etc.) who are economically weak and below the poverty line and with an intention to develop them educationallyRs. economicallyRs. and socially so as to give them a respectable place in society.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 50 years age group.
1. The applicant should be from Charmakar Community only (DhorRs. ChambharRs. HolarRs. MochiRs. etc.).
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than or equal to 1Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have knowledge of the business for which he has applied for the loan.

name: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan
brief_description:
**"Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA)"** is a umbrella scheme under the Department of the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The aim of the scheme is to promote inclusivity and empowerment among marginalized communitiesRs. particularly focusing on those with disabilities and other forms of social disadvantage. To ensure equitable justice for PwDs the BBSA scheme will focus on the following broad objectives:

1. To create an enabling environment to ensure equal opportunitiesRs. equityRs. social justice & empowerment of persons with disabilities with focus on grass root PwD population.
1. To encourage voluntary action and participation of all stake holders for ensuring effective implementation of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016.
1. To expand outreach activities for rehabilitation of PwDs and create facilities for providing high-tech rehabilitation services.
1. To promote individual and group initiatives by PwDs for employmentRs. selfemployment and other socio-educational services.
1. To strengthen the existing implementation machinery and create facilities for coverage of all uncovered areas of the state for ensuring complete coverage of PwDs.

The scheme is designed to cater to the needs of the PwDs for providing rehabilitation support and social security.
benefits:
Persons with Disabilities covered under the new Act include the following categories:

1. Acid Attack VictimRs.
1. Autism Spectrum DisorderRs.
1. BlindnessRs.
1. Cerebral PalsyRs.
1. Chronic Neurological ConditionsRs.
1. DwarfismRs.
1. HemophiliaRs.
1. Hearing ImpairmentRs.
1. Intellectual DisabilityRs.
1. Leprosy Cured PersonRs.
1. Locomotor DisabilityRs.
1. Low-VisionRs.
1. Mental IllnessRs.
1. Muscular DystrophyRs.
1. Multiple SclerosisRs.
1. Parkinsons DiseaseRs.
1. Specific Learning DisabilitiesRs.
1. Speech and Language DisabilityRs.
1. ThalassemiaRs.
1. Sickle Cell DiseaseRs. and
1. Multiple Disabilities
eligibility: 1. The applicants must be bona fide resident of Odisha. 1. A Person with Disability (PWD) irrespective of age and category of disability may avail all or any of services as envisaged provided he/she has not availed the same previously.

name: Mother Teresa Asahay Matri Sambal Yojana
brief_description: Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh has introduced a scheme named "**Mother Teresa Asahay Matri Sambal Yojana**" aimed at empowering women who are unable to raise their children due to financial hardships. The scheme provides financial assistance per child per annum for up to two childrenRs. supporting expenses related to the child's upbringingRs. including educationRs. nutritionRs. and healthcare. The scheme is specifically designed for women from socially and economically weaker sections of societyRs. such as widows and destitute womenRs. who face significant challenges in bringing up their children. The goal of the scheme is to reduce the dropout rate of children from underprivileged backgrounds and promote the welfare of children from marginalized sections of society.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 5Rs./- per child per year for up to two children. 1. Support for expenses related to the child's upbringingRs. including educationRs. nutritionRs. and healthcare. 1. Empowering women who are unable to raise their children due to financial hardship. 1. Encouraging education and reducing the dropout rate of children from underprivileged backgrounds. 1. Promoting the welfare of children from marginalized sections of society. 1. The assistance shall be given once the children attain age of 18 years.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a woman who is unable to raise her child/children due to financial hardship. 1. The applicant must have a maximum of two children with maximum age of 18 years. 1. The applicant must belong to a socially and economically weaker section of society. 1. The applicant's children must be studying in a recognized school. 1. The annual family income should not be more than 35Rs./-.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sahara Yojana
brief_description: The Government of Himachal Pradesh has launched the 'Sahara Scheme' to provide financial assistance to patients from economically weaker sections of society suffering from specified diseases such as Parkinson's diseaseRs. Malignant CancerRs. ParalysisRs. Muscular DystrophyRs. HemophiliaRs. and Thalassemia. The scheme also covers patients suffering from chronic renal failure or any other disease that permanently incapacitates a person. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to patients suffering from fatal diseases as a social security measureRs. to mitigate the hardships faced during prolonged treatment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant must belong to the economically weaker section of society. 3. The applicant must be suffering from specified diseases such as Parkinson's diseaseRs. Malignant CancerRs. ParalysisRs. Muscular DystrophyRs. HemophiliaRs. and ThalassemiaRs. or chronic renal failure or any other disease that renders a person permanently incapacitated. 4. The applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other government-sponsored pension scheme.

name: Disability Relief Allowance Scheme
brief_description:
**The Disability Relief Allowance Scheme** under the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh provides financial assistance to individuals with disabilities to help them manage their living costs and improve their quality of life.
**Features:**

1. **Monthly Allowance:** Eligible individuals receive a monthly financial allowance. The amount may vary based on the severity of the disability and other factors. 1. **Purpose:** The allowance is intended to help with day-to-day expenses and medical costs related to the disability.
The scheme is for Persons with Disabilities who have been issued a permanent disability certificate of 40% or more from a Medical Board constituted as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016Rs. do not have any adult childrenRs. and whose income does not exceed 35Rs./- p.a from all sources. The Disability Percentage Certificate issued by the Medical Authority is valid for sanction of Disability Relief Allowance even if the multi-disability is certified at 40% or more as per the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India for assessment and certification of various types of disabilities. Mentally retarded persons and persons with 70% or more disability are provided pensions without any income limit.
benefits:
Following is the assistance provided:

1. Pensioners with 40-69% disability 1150/- per month
1. Pensioners with 70% disability or more 1700/- per month
1. Pensioners with disability aged 70 years or more 1500/- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant must have a minimum of 40% disability. 1. The applicant must not receive any other pension or allowance from the state or central government.

name: Border Areas Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Border Areas Scholarship" was launched by the Border Areas Development DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students from notified international border areas who face economic hardship. Under this schemeRs. year-wise scholarships or subsidies are provided to students studying in higher secondary schools and Colleges up to the Degree level. The Border Areas Development Department implements the scheme to help students continue their education without interruption due to financial constraints.
benefits: - Financial assistance in the form of annual scholarships/subsidies. - Awarded year-wise based on promotion examination results. - Intended to support education up to the Degree level for students from notified border area villages.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student residing in a village notified as a Border Area village by the Border Areas Department. 1. The applicant's father and mother should have income derived entirely from the Border Area. 1. The applicant should pass year-wise promotion examinations to continue receiving the scholarship. 1. The applicant should maintain good conductRs. regular attendanceRs. and satisfactory academic progress. 1. The applicant should not leave studies before completing the course.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Old Age Pension Scheme was started by the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB). The government of Arunachal Pradesh has introduced the pension scheme through the board and the aim of the scheme is to secure the economic dependency of a worker after retirement or at an old age period.
benefits: 1. Cash assistance of 500/- per monthRs. to the old age beneficiaries with an increase in 10/- on completion of every 5 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant must be employed in the Building and Other Construction works.
3. The applicant should be registered with Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
4. The applicant with a membership for at least 1 year after the age of 60 years is eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Chief Ministers Scheme For Wood Carving Artists
brief_description:
The scheme Chief Ministers Scheme for Wood Carving Artists was launched to sustain the rich tradition of work on wood and is encouraged to propagate with the enhancement of aesthetic sensibilities so that it may be at par with international standards. This is for the preservation and protection of the rich heritage of wood works (crafts)Rs. which is otherwise being neglected and dwindling.
**Objective:**

- To empower and develop typical wood carving artisans and introduce them to the well-organized market.
- To create entrepreneurs and traders in the field of wood business.

**Important Features:**

- To provide master craftsmanship trainers training to the traditionally expert wood carving craftsmen at 6 potential districts of Arunachal Pradesh at NIDRs. AhmedabadRs. NIFTRs. and Kolkata with latest technology on wood carving for product developmentRs. product finishing and linking these products to the right market.
- The trained Master Craftsman in turn will conduct skill development training on wood carving for the local upcoming artisans of the targeted districtsRs. which have rich tradition of wood carving activities.
benefits:
1. Distribution of new improved toolsRs. equipmentRs. and good quality raw material to the eligible wood artisans.
1. Skill-upgradation training with improved technology inputs.
1. Organise buyers-sellers meet/ participate in Exhibitions/Expos/Trades etc.
1. Support the artisans by linking their products to the market by identifying new marketsRs. providing a better support system to the manufacturersRs. and introducing new products to the international market as well.
1. Help on knowledge awareness on the economies of the marketRs. demand-supplyRs. product demandRs. strategic positioning etc. to the artisans.
1. Advertisement of products through social media/ electronic or print media.
1. 20 Master Craftsmen in one batch and around 100 to be trained by these master trainers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The preference to be given to a minimum of Class - VIII passes candidates of Arunachal Pradesh Schedule Tribe (APST).
3. The preference to be given to the candidate having experience certificate in trading.
4. For getting admissionRs. the age of the applicant should be 14 to 25 years.
**Note 01:** For getting admissionRs. there is no educational qualification bar. HoweverRs. preference is given to educated candidates.
**Note 02:** Duration of training courses varies from 1 to 2 years.

name: Semi-Commercial Duck Farming
brief_description:
The scheme Semi-Commercial Duck Farming started under the State Sector Scheme "Encouragement of Commercial Poultry Entrepreneur and Promotion of Backyard Poultry Production" to support small entrepreneurs in setting up Duck farms with a capacity of 1000 ducks. Under this new State plan schemeRs. individual farmers will be supported for taking up semi-commercial duck rearing with a subsidy of 40% subsidy.
**Aim:**
The scheme aims to support 100 individual farmers in setting up semi-commercial duckery units with a capacity of 1000 ducks per unit.
**Objective:**

- To strengthen the local production systems for enhancing livelihoods and for the generation of additional income among the farmers through duck rearing.
- To support nutritional requirements through the production of animal protein.
- To build the capacity of farmers for undertaking semi-commercial duck farming as a profitable enterprise.
benefits: - The individual beneficiary will be provided a maximum of 40% subsidy. - Training will be organized at the Block Head Quarter level or any other convenient place after the final approval of the list. - Each beneficiary will be trained on recommended management practices on feeding and wateringRs. brooding and rearing young ducksRs. record keepingRs. etc. - The concerned Livestock InspectorsRs. Gomitras and PraniMitras will guide the beneficiaries in field for managing the duck units. - Routine vaccination of birds on a priority basis. - The Block Veterinary Officer (BVO) will provide all technical guidance to the farmer for maintaining proper veterinary health care and immunization of the ducks. - The beneficiary shall directly procure quality ducklings from reputed sources which will be facilitated by the respective BVOs. **Note:** The subsidy will be released in two phases through DBT mode to the individual beneficiary. The 1st installment of 40% of the eligible subsidy will be released after the construction of the duck shed and 2nd installment of the eligible subsidy shall be released after the stocking of ducklings.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Odisha.
1. IndividualsRs. farmersRs. and entrepreneurs will be eligible to avail of support under the scheme.
1. All beneficiaries covered under the Scheme should mandatorily be Aadhaar linked to avoid duplication.
1. The beneficiaries who have availed of subsidy previously in a similar scheme should not be included.

name: Ladies Vocational Centres
brief_description:
The Ladies Vocational Centres was started by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Jammu & Kashmir. The Department of Social Welfare runs a number of Vocational Training Centres in Srinagar and Jammu. In these Vocational CentresRs. the trainees are provided training in the trades like cutting and tailoringRs. leather worksRs. machine embroideryRs. stenographyRs. and Croshia work. The duration of the Training is 11 months and the trainees are provided a monthly stipend @100/- per month to encourage them to come to the Centres. The Department also provides training to the trainees under the Cottage Industry Centre in the trade of CarpentryRs. leather workRs. and weaving. The intake capacity of the "Ladies Vocational Centre" located at Chand Nagar Jammu is 75 trainees and 25 trainees in each Social Welfare Centre. These Centres are operated under the UT Sponsored Scheme run by the department.
**Objective:**
The main objective of the "Ladies Vocational Centers" is to impart training in various trades i.e. cuttingRs. embroideryRs. knitting as well as stenography to the female folk to enable them to start their income-generating units.
benefits:
- The training is provided in the trades like Cutting and TailoringRs. Leather-workRs. Machine EmbroideryRs. StenographyRs. and Croshia work.
- The stipend @100/- per month is given to the candidates under training.
- The training is also provided under the Cottage Industry Centre in the trade of CarpentryRs. Leather-workRs. and Weaving.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union TerritoryRs. Jammu & Kashmir.
2. The applicant should be a woman/girl.
3. The women & girls are all eligible between the ages 14-40 years with a Middle pass for Craft.
4. The women & girls are all eligible between the ages 16-25 years with a 10+2 class pass for Stenography.
**Note 01:** The duration of the training will be 11 months.
**Note 02:** The intake capacity of the Ladies Vocational Centre located at Chand Nagar Jammu is 75 trainees and 25 trainees in each Social Welfare Centre.

name: State Programme For Rehabilitation Of Persons With Disabilities
brief_description:
The State Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities scheme is a state sector ongoing scheme implemented for the welfare and providing rehabilitation services to disabled persons of the state under the Person with Disabilities (Equal OpportunitiesRs. Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act. 1995. The State Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities (SPRPD) erstwhile National Programme for Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities (NPRPD) was launched in the state in the year 2001-2002 and was sponsored by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Govt. of India. During the year 2005-06Rs. this scheme had been transferred to the state government and implemented as a state sector ongoing scheme.
**Objective:**

- To provide Welfare & Rehabilitation services to the Disabled Persons of the state which is mandatory under the PWDs ActRs. 1995.

**Important Features:**

- Under this schemeRs. the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment and Tribal AffairsRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh under the State Programme for Persons with Disabilities(SPRPD) has been providing aids & appliances.
- Organizing Diagnostic Camp cum-Free Distribution of Aids & appliances at the district level from time to time.
- The Department also established a Physiotherapy Unit during the year 2013-14 at SDRC where needy patients are given treatment/therapy free of cost.
- For preventionRs. early detectionRs. and intervention of disabilitiesRs. the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment and Tribal AffairsRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh had trained 539 Nos. of Community Based Rehabilitation Workers (CBRWS) and engaged at the grass root level to conduct door-to-door survey reports of disabled persons to create awareness and prevention of disabilities.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. the state government will provide aids & appliances such as tricyclesRs. wheelchairsRs. crutchesRs. walking sticksRs. Blind sticksRs. RollatorRs. and Hearing Aids to persons with disabilities.
- The state government will organize a Diagnostic Camp-cum-Free Distribution of Aids & appliances at the district level from time to time.
- The state government also established a Physiotherapy Unit during the year 2013-14 at SDRC where needy patients are given treatment/therapy free of cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh. 2. An applicant with a 100% degree of disability is eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Saur Sujala Yojana
brief_description:
The Saur Sujala Yojana is to set up solar irrigation pumps for the irrigation needs of the farmers. The scheme has been started on November 01Rs. 2016 with the aim of empowering the farmers by providing irrigation pumps to the farmers at subsidized rates. The use of solar pump will help in increasing agricultural production in the state as well as conservation and augmentation of ground water and strengthening the rural economy. Under the planRs. there is a provision for setting up solar pumps of 03 H.P. and 05 H.P. capacity.
Saur Sujala Yojana is being implemented by Chhattisgarh State Renewable Energy Development Agency (CREDA- Chhattisgarh State Renewable Energy Development Agency). Beneficiaries under the scheme are selected by the Agriculture Department. Under the schemeRs. more than 01 lakh solar pumps have been installed.
eligibility:
1. Small/medium/large-scale farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme.
1. The farmer should be a resident of Chhattisgarh State.

name: Assam Arogya Nidhi Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Assam Arogya Nidhi (AAN) was launched by the Health & Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Govt. of Assam to provide financial assistance to BPL families and families having an annual income of less than 5.00 Lakhs. The financial assistance is provided for general and specialized treatment of (i) life-threatening diseasesRs. and (ii) of injuries caused by natural and manmade disastersRs. such as industrial/ farm/ road/ rail accidentsRs. bomb blastsRs. etc. Life-threatening diseases include Heart Diseases and Heart SurgeryRs. CancerRs. Kidney and Urinary diseasesRs. OrthopedicRs. ThallassemiaRs. Bone marrow TransplantRs. AIDSRs. and chronic Mental Illness with Surgical Treatment. Beneficiaries are selected by a Selection Committee that has been notified by the Government of Assam. Under the AANRs. the Government of India contributes 50% of the funds sanctioned by the State Government.
**Grant of Assistance:**
1. The Chief Minister of Assam may grant permission directly for the maximum benefits available under AAN.
2. The Chairperson of the Committee can clear the grant of financial assistance under AAN against eligible cases up to 2.00 Lakh.
3. For grant of assistance above 2.00 Lakh up to 3.00 LakhRs. the State Level committee will decide the eligible cases.
**Mode of disbursement:** Financial assistance will be disbursed to the beneficiary concerned or reimbursed to the hospital concerned through bank account transfer only. The advance payment shall only be to the hospital subject to a maximum of 3.00 lakh.
eligibility: 1. All Indian citizens who are ordinarily resident of the State of Assam will be eligible under the scheme. 1. The family income of the applicant should be less than 5.00 lakhs per annum. 1. There will be no age limit for coverage under the scheme. 1. No Govt. employee or Govt. pensioners and their family members will be eligible under the scheme. 1. Treatment should be undertaken in any govt. hospital including Govt. Medical Colleges and all reputed Pvt. Hospitals registered under Clinical Establishment Act. anywhere in the state or in the country.

name: Financial Assistance To Gad-Hanjis
brief_description: In the "Financial Assistance to Gad-Hanjis"Rs. financial assistance for the purchase of Nylon Twine is provided to the Licensed Fisherman (Gad-Hanjis) by the Social Welfare Department. The beneficiary shall approach the concerned District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) for submission of the application. This is a 100% State Sponsored SchemeRs. and only the permanent residents of the state of Jammu & Kashmir can apply for this scheme.
benefits:
The financial assistance for the purchase of Nylon Twine will be sanctioned at the following rates:
1. License holders having paid fee of 50/-: 500/-.
2. License holders having paid fee of 40/-: 400/-.
3. License holders having paid fee of 30/-: 300/-.
4. License holders having paid fee of 20/-: 200/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a Gad-Hanji (Fisherman) licensed by the Fisheries Department consecutively for the last 3 years.
1. The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 3Rs./-.
1. The applicant should not have received assistance under this scheme during the last 2 years.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Bunkar Yojana
brief_description:
The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Bunkar Yojana (DDUBY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to empower women weavers by facilitating their access to affordable credit from banks. The scheme aims to provide financial support to women engaged in weaving activitiesRs. encouraging entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods.
Under this schemeRs. women weavers can avail themselves of a 7% interest subvention on short-term creditRs. cash credit limitRs. working capital limitRs. weavers' credit cardRs. and Swarojgar credit card obtained from commercial banks and regional rural banks. The scheme covers loans disbursed during the current financial yearRs. subject to a maximum period of one year.
eligibility:
- Gender: The scheme is exclusively for women weavers.
- Weaving Activity: Applicants should be engaged in weaving activities as their primary occupation.
- Ownership of Working Loom(s): Applicants must possess or have ownership of a working loom(s).
- Individual or Group: Both individual women weavers and groups of women weavers are eligible to apply. Companies and partnership firms are not eligible.
- Unit Size and Number of Looms: There is no restriction based on unit size or the number of looms. Weavers of all categories and scales are eligible to apply.

name: Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural AffairsRs. Government of West Bengal in 2014 to revive the Folk and Tribal Culture in their respective genre across various zones and districts in the State. The scheme is primarily for the financially distressed rural Folk Artists as identified under the laid out procedure to enlist and ensure them with alternative economic support along with scope to further their domain folk culture hence preserving the cultural heritage of different parts of Bengal. The main objectives of the scheme are
1. To bestow dignity on folk artists by issuing them identity cards
2. To uphold the traditional folk forms of Bengal
3. To revive nearly extinct folk forms of art and culture
4. To uplift the socio-economic conditions of artists associated with folk culture
benefits:

name: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme (Revised 2009)
brief_description:

CancerRs. and Brain or any other life-threatening diseases including Knee surgery and Spinal surgery to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe persons whose annual family income is less than 1Rs./- per annum and will be implemented through the following Hospitals:

Jabalpur Hospital and Research CentreRs. JabalpurRs. Madhya Pradesh.
B. Barua Cancer InstituteRs. GuwahatiRs. Assam.
Birla Heart FoundationRs. KolkataRs. West Bengal.
Kalinga Hospital Ltd. ChandrashekharpurRs. BhubaneswarRs. Orissa.
Tata Cancer Research InstituteRs. MumbaiRs. Maharashtra.
Nizam Institute of Medical SciencesRs. HyderabadRs. Andhra Pradesh.
The Voluntary Health ServicesRs. Chennai.
All CGHS-approved Hospitals as revised from time to time by the Ministry of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of India.
All State Government Medical Colleges attached Hospitals even if not included under CGHS Scheme.

All Hospitals recognized by State Government.
All Hospitals are fully funded by either the Central Government or the State Governments.
All Government Hospitals in District Headquarters/ major towns where surgery or treatment facility for KidneyRs. HeartRs. Liver CancerRs. and Brain or any other life-threatening disease including knee surgery and spinal surgery is available.

Disbursement:

4. FurtherRs. medical aid from the foundation and other sources should not exceed the total estimated cost of the treatment. A certificate in this regard should be obtained from the Medical Superintendent of the concerned Hospital.
5. The Estimated Cost certificate to be submitted along with the application should contain the date fixed for the surgical operation.
benefits:
- Under this scheme medical treatment facilities provide to the patients suffering from serious ailments of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe persons whose annual family income is less than 1Rs./- p.a.

eligibility:

name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Tribe was started by the Dept. of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat. The eligible beneficiary can get an interest subsidy @ 12 % interest on a bank loan amount for 5 years if he/she has obtained a loan for setting up the unit in the current financial year 2023-24 through a nationalized bank or a financial institution approved by the Reserve Bank of India. **Note 02:** The amount of interest subvention will be deposited in the beneficiary's loan account in the form of a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in installments. There will be no cash assistance for any of the beneficiaries.

name: Land Ports Authority Of India (LPAI) Internship Scheme
brief_description:
The Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI) is pleased to announce its annual internship program for the academic year 2025-26. This program provides a unique opportunity for students and research scholars from BBIN countries (BhutanRs. IndiaRs. NepalRs. and Bangladesh) to gain practical experience in land port developmentRs. cross-border tradeRs. passenger movementRs. and border issues.
Enhanced Collaboration: For the first timeRs. the LPAI internship program extends invitations to talented students across the BBIN regionRs. including India. This expansion promotes regional collaboration and facilitates the exchange of knowledge and perspectives on land port development within South Asia. ***Program Highlights:*** Open to Students from BBIN Countries: The program welcomes qualified students from India and other BBIN countriesRs. fostering a diverse and enriching learning environment. Focus on Northeast India: We encourage applications from students interested in addressing land port development's unique challenges and opportunities in India's Northeast states. Diverse Research Methods: Interns can engage in various research methodsRs. including policy-oriented researchRs. social impact assessmentsRs. and economic impact assessments. Past intern reports serve as valuable resources for future exploration. Program Duration: The internship program lasts two monthsRs. with a possible extension of up to three monthsRs. subject to approval.
***Objective and Purpose*** a) The Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI)Rs. a statutory body under the Department of Border ManagementRs. Ministry of Home AffairsRs. was established by the Land Ports Authority of India Act 2010Rs. effective March 1Rs. 2012. Empowered by Section 11 of the ActRs. LPAI is tasked with developingRs. sanitizingRs. and managing facilities for cross-border passengers and goods at designated points along India's international borders. The Authority focuses on deploying systems that address security imperatives at the Land Ports while facilitating cross-border trade. b) Acknowledging the growing interest and potential contributions from academic institutions and young scholarsRs. the LPAI has expanded its Internship Program to include BBIN (BhutanRs. BangladeshRs. IndiaRs. Nepal) countries. This expansion aims to foster regional collaboration and knowledge exchange by providing opportunities for talented individuals from BBIN nations to participate in LPAI projects. c) LPAI engages with young scholars from India and neighboring BBIN countries through this extended internship program. This initiative is a two-way streetRs. facilitating the exchange of diverse perspectivesRs. fresh ideasRs. and research support from a broader regional context. It offers an avenue for young scholars to contribute to projects of national and regional significanceRs. thereby enhancing mutual understanding and cooperation among BBIN nations while providing insights into governmental operations and projects of national importance. > **Duration** 1. The minimum duration of the internship shall be eight weeksRs. extendable up to three monthsRs. subject to the Authority's requirements and the Intern's availability. 1. Extensions beyond three months will only be permitted in exceptional cases upon the recommendation of the relevant Authority and prior approval from the SecretaryRs. LPAI > **Placement** 1. Interns will be assigned to the LPAI research team and/or the respective head of the relevant Division within the Authority. 1. The internship does not constitute employment or guarantee future employment with the Authority > ***Submission of Paper*** a) The supervisor will create work plans and schedules that interns must consistently follow. b) After their internshipRs. interns must submit a report/paper detailing their internship activities to the Research team. The Member (Finance) /Director (Operations) at Headquarters will endorse this document to confirm successful internship completion. > ***Code of Conduct*** The Intern appointed by the Authority must adhere to the Code of Conduct of LPAIRs. encompassing the following guidelines: a) Upon joiningRs. submit the Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) form to maintain the utmost secrecyRs. confidentialityRs. and privacy. b) Interns are required to bring their laptops/tablets for work. c) Adherence to the general rules and regulations applicable to Authority employees. d) Compliance with the Authority's confidentiality protocolRs. refraining from disclosing confidential information about the AuthorityRs. its workRs. and its policies to any individual or organization. e) Presentation of their work to academic bodiesRs. seminarsRs. and conferences with prior permission from the Authority while ensuring the confidentiality of Authority information. f) Clearly stating in any papers or documents written/published that the views expressed are personal and do not represent or reflect the views of the Authority. g) Adherence to advice provided by the Authority regarding interactions with third parties. h) GenerallyRs. interns may not interact with or represent the Authority to third parties unless specifically authorised based on their roles and responsibilities. i) Interns are prohibited from interacting with or representing the Authority in the media (print and electronic). j) Maintaining professional conduct in interactions with the Authority and the public. > ***Termination*** a) The Authority may discontinue the intern's engagement if it deems the intern's services are no longer required. b) The Authority reserves the right to terminate the intern's services at any time and without providing reasonsRs. with immediate effect. c) If an intern chooses to end their engagement with the AuthorityRs. they should give a two-week prior notice. HoweverRs. in some instancesRs. particularly for interns intending to stay for more than two monthsRs. the Authority may specify a notice period of up to one month. The supervisor may occasionally waive the notice period depending on the intern's role. d) Upon terminationRs. the intern must return any documentsRs. equipmentRs. or assets provided by the Authority during their tenureRs. including any badges or ID cards issued to the intern. e) If the Authority discovers that a terminated individual is still acting as if the Authority employs themRs. appropriate legal action may be taken against them. **Resolution of Implementation Challenges** The Chairperson or their designated representative is empowered to address any obstacles hindering the implementation of these guidelines.
benefits:
> **Certificate of Internship**

Upon completion of the internship and submission of the reportRs. certificates will be issued to interns by HeadquartersRs. provided the report is countersigned and accepted by the competent authority.
eligibility:
Indian students from recognized universities in India or abroad who have attained a minimum of 60% marks in their most recent degree or certificate examination and fall under one of the following categories:
Completion of education under the 10+2+3 schooling patternRs. indicating completing 15 years of formal education. Or
Completion of a Polytechnic Diploma/Degree. Or
Pursuing the 4th year in the Engineering stream under the 10+2+4 pattern of education. Or
Pursuing MBA/PGDBM from premier institutes. Or
Pursuing the 4th or 5th year in the integrated degree course or dual degree under the 10+2+5 pattern of education. Or
Completion of the 2nd year of Engineering or Science course from any IIT or NIT. Or
Pursuing M. Tech/M.Eng./MCA from a prestigious institute. Or
Completion of the 2nd year in the law degree from a prestigious Law Institute/University.

> **NOTE 1:** Qualifications may be relaxed in deserving cases based on the Authority's requirementsRs. as recommended by the Member (Finance)Rs. LPAIRs. and subject to prior approval from the ChairmanRs. LPAI.

**** ***NOTE 2*****:** Meeting the minimum qualifications above does not guarantee an internship at LPAI. Preference will be given to candidates with exposure in the intended internship areaRs. a solid academic backgroundRs. and higher capability per the organization's needs. AdditionallyRs. students from the Northeast region and wards of stakeholders deployed with LPAI will be given preference.

name: Haryana Shubhra Jyotsna Pension Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Haryana Shubhra Jyotsna Pension Scheme was launched by the General Administration DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana on 16th April 2018. The Government of Haryana launched the scheme for providing a monthly pension of 10Rs./- to the residents of Haryana who participated actively during the period of emergency i.e. 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977 and faced imprisonment under MISA ActRs. 1971 and/or Defence of India ActRs. 1962 and Rules framed there under. The scheme shall be made applicable from 01.11.2017.
The expenditure under this scheme will be borne by the State Government. After sanction by the Administrative Secretary of this departmentRs. the amount of pension will be deposited in the bank account of beneficiary Emergency Sufferers. Chief Secretary will be the competent authority to sanction the pension under this scheme on the recommendation of the Deputy Commissioner concerned.
benefits: 1. The residents of Haryana who are eligible under the scheme will be given a monthly pension of 10Rs./- (Ten thousand only) with effect from 01.11.2017.
eligibility:
1. The scheme will be applicable to residents of Haryana who participated actively and struggled during the period of emergency and faced imprisonment even for one dayRs. under the MISA ActRs. 1971 and/or the Defence of India ActRs. 1962Rs. and Rules framed there under. The scheme shall also be applicable to widows of such persons.
1. He or She must be a resident of Haryana State and must have undergone imprisonment for any periodRs. during the Emergency Period i.e. 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977. He or She has to produce the jail certificate for the same issued by Jail Superintendent concerned and countersigned by District Magistrate.
1. In case the person cannot produce the jail certificate due to the record being missing or unavailableRs. he may produce a certificate from two co-prisoners. Such certificates of co-prisoners must be authenticated by an MLA or MP of the concerned district.
1. SufferersRs. getting a pension or honorarium of any kind from any other State Government will also be eligible. HoweverRs. if an otherwise eligible Emergency Sufferer is getting a pension from any other State Government for the same purpose of an amount less than 10Rs./- per monthRs. the entitlement of pension under this scheme would be reduced by that amount.
1. The benefit of the scheme be also provided to those persons who are/were domicile of another State but were arrested and jailed in Haryana State.

**Note 01:** The beneficiary Emergency Sufferers will have to open an Aadhaar linked Saving Bank Account in any Nationalized Bank for transferring the amount of pension to their bank accounts and have to give a live certificate in January every yearRs. as is being followed in the case of other pensioners.
**Note 02:** In case of the demise of any of the Emergency SufferersRs. the monthly pension will continue to be given to his/her surviving wife. If the beneficiary had died (Husband or Wife as the case may be)Rs. the pension will be given to the living spouse.
**Note 03:** If the applicant is receiving any other pension from the State GovernmentRs. this portion of the pension will be subtracted from Shubhra Jyotsna PensionRs. the only exception being the old age pension.
**Note 04:** Applicant can apply from only one district and he has to submit an affidavit to the effect that he has not applied from any other district.

name: Saphalam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses
brief_description:
The Saphalam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The Transgender community faces severe problems such as discrimination and infringement of rights. It is the responsibility of the government to provide special privileges to such target groupsRs. bringing them to the mainstream of society by ensuring social rehabilitation.
Due to a lack of proper education and social stigma in societyRs. the Transgender community is also subjected to severe unemployment. ThusRs. the Social Justice Department has rolled out this innovative scheme that provides financial assistance to Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma level professional courses. This scheme would provide an opening to Transgender students who possess high technical/professional competence.
Those students who have qualified for such professional courses and suffer from financial constraints can continue their education uninterrupted which in turn would increase their employment opportunities and help them to secure a good job and thereby lead a quality life.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. financial assistance up to 1Rs./- per year will be provided to transgender students for pursuing professional courses at the degree/diploma level.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be Transgender.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala.
1. Transgender students who have secured admission in merit seats in GovernmentRs. Aided/Self-financing colleges are eligible under this scheme.
1. Transgender students who secure admission for courses MBBSRs. Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSc)Rs. and BSc Agriculture in Government colleges are eligible.
1. Transgender students pursuing Diploma level government-accredited courses are also eligible.
1. Transgender students who have completed 18 years must submit a copy of their Transgender ID card.
1. Those Transgender students who are below 18 years must submit a self-declaration statement duly certified by the Head of Institution/Parent.

name: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Prisoners
brief_description:
The scheme Marriage Assistance to Daughters of Prisoners was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The Government of Kerala has implemented this scheme which provides financial assistance for the marriage of the daughters of those who have been undergoing imprisonment for more than 2 years. The maximum amount of financial assistance will be 30Rs./- per personRs. during the first phase of the scheme as many as 20 such families will be assisted.
When a person commits a crime and gets sentenced to imprisonmentRs. his family is vulnerable to financial instabilityRs. povertyRs. debtRs. and potential housing disruption. They often get stigmatized and marginalized in society following the incarceration of a family member. Due to the poor financial conditionsRs. the family members find it difficult to ensure proper education for their children and marry off their daughters. ThereforeRs. the Government of Kerala has implemented this scheme for the upliftment of such a target population.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. the maximum amount of financial assistance will be 30Rs./- per person.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicants must belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. Either the father or the mother should be undergoing imprisonment for more than two years.

**Note 01:** The application must be submitted after six months of marriage and within one year period.
**Note 02:** A maximum of two girls from a family can get financial assistance for marriage.
**Note 03:** Once the marriage grant has been sanctionedRs. if the existing marriage is dissolved and remarried for any reasonRs. the grant will not be eligible.
