- The applicant should be an Unorganized Worker: Taxi and Auto DriversRs. Workers Employed in Shops & Catering EstablishmentsRs. CarpentersRs. Nathaswara VidwansRs. Hair DressersRs. TailorsRs. Cycle Rickshaw DriversRs. CobblersRs. WashermansRs. GoldsmithRs. BlacksmithRs. Brass Vessel MakersRs. SculptorsRs. Loading and Unloading WorkersRs. Tree ClimbersRs. Pottery WorkersRs. Coir WorkersRs. Toddy Neera TappersRs. Bullock Cart DriversRs. ThatchersRs. CooksRs. HawkersRs. News Paper VendorsRs. Workers Engaged in Bricks and Tiles ManufacturingRs. One HundredRs. Workers Engaged in Distribution of Liquid Petroleum Gas CylinderRs. Domestic WorkersRs. Light Music Instrument PlayersRs. Automobile Workshop Workers.
- The applicant should be enrolled with the Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society.
- The applicant should be between 18 to 59 years of age.The applicant should be taking an Annual Subscription of 100/- every year.
- The applicant should be paying a Registration Fee of 25/-.

name: Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender
brief_description: The scheme "Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor transgender who are above the age of 40 years and are unable to earn their livelihood. Interested and eligible applicants should apply via Common Service Centres (CSC).
benefits: - Pension of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be Transgender.
1. The applicant should be destitute.
1. The applicant's age should be 40 years and above.
1. The applicant should be physically unable to work and earn.
1. The applicant should not have received assistance from any family member or other sources.

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists
brief_description: "Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Through this schemeRs. awards are conferred to the participant artists whose works are adjudged outstanding among the entries at the State-level Traditional Art Exhibition conducted by the Kuzhu. The awarded works are put on display for public view in the exhibition. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Oviya Nunkalai Kuzhu.
benefits: Prize Money of 5Rs./- per artist is given to 10 artists.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The artist should be a native of Tamil Nadu by continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
1. The artist should be in the field of creating artworks like tanjore paintingsRs. glass paintingsRs. traditional paintingsRs. wood carvingsRs. metal sculpturesRs. etc.

name: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Nanmani Award
brief_description: The "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Nanmani Award" scheme by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance 15Rs./- and certificates of appreciation. The scheme is being implemented in all Districts of Tamil Nadu.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 15Rs./-.
- Certificate of Appreciation.
- A shawl worth 500/-.
- 5 eminent artists are awarded every year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 51 to 65 years.

name: Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists
brief_description: The "Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage the postgraduate and graduate students of the Government College of Fine ArtsRs. Chennai & Kumbakonam by awarding scholarships every yearRs. as recommended by the Principals of the Colleges. These scholarships are given to outstanding students studying in their final year B.F.A (Bachelor of Fine Arts) and outstanding students studying in their final year M.F.A (Master of Fine Arts).
benefits:
**Government College of Fine ArtsRs. Chennai**

- Scholarship of 3Rs./- to 10 outstanding students studying in final year B.F.A. (Bachelor of Fine Arts).
- Scholarship of 5Rs./- to 4 outstanding students studying in final year M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts).

**Government College of Fine ArtsRs. Kumbakonam**

- Scholarship of 3Rs./- to 10 outstanding students studying in final year B.F.A. (Bachelor of Fine Arts).
- Scholarship of 5Rs./- to 2 outstanding students studying in final year M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in the final year of B.F.A. or M.F.A.
1. The applicant should be studying at the Government College of Fine ArtsRs. Chennai or the Government College of Fine ArtsRs. Kumbakonam.

name: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description:
The Shramyogi Home Town Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the payment of railway fares for migrant labourers employed in the organized sector in GujaratRs. enabling them to travel to or from their home country to the nearest railway station.
Considering the stagnant pace of industrial development in the state of GujaratRs. some labourers come from other regions for livelihood. Most of these Shramyogis live away from their families. Due to social or accidental reasonsRs. the economic burden of going to and from the labourers to their native place cannot be compensated by short salary. HenceRs. the plan for a labourer to visit his hometown once in two years.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. migrant laborers employed in the organized sector can avail of payment for railway fare to travel to or from their home countryRs. to the nearest railway station.

**Note:** The assistance amount will be credited to the beneficiary's bank account through DBT.
eligibility:
1. The worker/labour should have been working continuously with the company in Gujarat for one year and his/her labour welfare fund should have been deposited in the board to avail the benefits under the scheme.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be provided once within a block of two years. CurrentlyRs. the block years are set as 2022-23 and 2023-24.
1. If both the husband/wife are employedRs. only one of the beneficiaries will get the benefit of this scheme.
1. A Shram Yogi shall travel only after obtaining prior approval by applying prior to travel.
1. Within one month of the completion of the tourRs. necessary proofs along with in-principle approval have to be submitted by the worker/labour.

name: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Educational Award Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme has been implemented to encourage the students of the Labours to increase their enthusiasm and to get higher education through it.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. children of laborers who have passed 70% or above marks in the 10th Standard will receive 2Rs./- as an award.
1. The children of laborers who have passed 70% or above marks in the 12th Standard will receive 5Rs./- as an award.
eligibility:
1. Only the children (students) whose parents are working in a factory/institute in the state of Gujarat and whose parents have been paying the Labour Welfare Fund will be eligible for this scheme.
1. The children of labourers who have passed 70% and above marks in the 10th or 12th Standard can avail the benefits under the scheme.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Marriage Assistance Scheme was launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to female workers who are working in a factory/organization in the state of Gujarat after their marriage.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. female workers will be entitled to receive 11Rs./- after their marriage.
eligibility:
1. Only those women workers who are working in the factory/organization in the state of Gujarat and the Labour Welfare Fund of the concerned woman worker is paid by the organization at the officeRs. will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The Labour Welfare Fund of the last one year of the concerned woman worker should be mandatorily filled by the Factory/Company/Organization.
1. Application should be made within one year from the date of marriage.
1. There should be a gap of one year between the date of employment and the date of marriage of the woman worker.

name: Plastic Tunnel (Lo-Tunnel)
brief_description:
The Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government implemented the Plastic Tunnel (Lo-Tunnel) schemeRs. providing subsidies to farmers. A low plastic tunnel is a protected structure created by covering each crop bed with plastic sheeting at a low height after planting. It is made to protect crops from damage caused by low temperatures. This technique is very useful for off-season cultivation of vegetables in the plains of North India where the night temperature remains below 8 degrees Celsius for about 40 to 60 days during the winter season. This technique allows off-season vegetable cultivation. Vegetable seedlings are prepared using the plastic tray technique specifically in December and January.
> **Important points** 1. The low tunnel can be constructed only after administrative approval is issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. Verification can be done by the constituted committee. 1. The payment of the grant amount will be transferred directly to the farmer's bank account.
benefits:
1. 50 percent subsidy is available for a maximum of 1000 square meters.
1. Small/marginal category farmers are given a 75 percent subsidy for a maximum of 4000 square meters.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

name: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
brief_description: The Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream) is implemented by the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (Science Stream) and have obtained 70% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching.
benefits:
> **Assistance Details:**

11th Standard: 15Rs./- per annum as a private tuition fees
12th Standard: 15Rs./- per annum as a private tuition fees
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
1. The student should be studying in Standard 11th & 12th Science Stream.
1. The student should have 70% or more marks in Standard 10th.
1. The annual family income of the student should be up to 6 lakhs.

name: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
brief_description: The Food Bill Assistance to SC Students scheme is administered by the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are admitted in college affiliated hostels for food bill. The students will be eligible for food bill assistance up to 10 months in a year.
benefits: - The food bill assistance @ 1Rs./- per month (Up to 10 Months) will be granted to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students admitted in college affiliated hostels.
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
2. The students should reside in the hostelRs. affiliated to the college.
3. The annual family income of the student should be up to 6 lakhs.

name: Festival Gift Coupons (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: The scheme "Festival Gift Coupons" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide Festival Gift Coupons worth 4Rs./- per annum to the Non-Pensioner ESMs who are 60 years or older in age. To coupons are to be collected in person on intimation from DSWRs. normally between November and January. This scheme applies only to the Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen registered with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Festival Gift Coupons worth 4Rs./- per annum.

*The coupons are to be collected in person on intimation from DSWRs. normally between November and January.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an [Ex-Serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen) or the Widow of an Ex-Serviceman.- The Ex-Serviceman should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.- The Ex-Serviceman should be a Non-Pensioner.
- The Ex-Serviceman should be 60 years or older in ageRs. as on 31st March of the current year (No age bar for Widow of an Ex-Servicemen).
- The scope of this scheme will also apply to those ESM / living spouse/widows who are re-employed as regular / deemed to be regular in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Private Organizations and self-employed IT assesses.

name: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries
brief_description: The scheme Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries is administered by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was commenced in the year 1999 with the objective to provide an opportunity to Scheduled Caste students to study at abroad. Under this schemeRs. a loan of 15 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to offer financial assistance to bright career students of the Scheduled Castes who cannot go abroad for higher studies due to the their poor economic condition. In this schemeRs. loans are provided to students for pursuing graduate and postgraduate courses to cover expenses such as tuition feesRs. booksRs. hostel feesRs. living expensesRs. travel expensesRs. and pocket money.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. a loan of 15 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to the eligible students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be native of Gujarat state.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category of Gujarat State.
1. Loans for post graduateRs. Ph.D.Rs. higher level research and computer courses to those who have secured 50% or more marks in graduation.
1. Loans for technical and professional courses abroad after 12th Standard.
1. Loan can be given to maximum two persons of the same family.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The institution of the foreign country in which the student is studying must be recognized by that government and the degree obtained must be accepted in that country.
1. Approval will only be processed once the visa and air ticket have been issued.
1. Scheduled caste students of the state who are admitted to study abroad based on the syllabus of class-12 or above should have 50% or more marks. Also they offer DiplomaRs. GraduateRs. Post GraduateRs. Post Graduate DiplomaRs. Ph.D. Also eligible for loans for other courses of more than one year duration in all fields.

**Note 01:** Loan repayment starts after 6 months after the completion of the student's course. But the recovery of the loan has to be completed within 10 years. After the repayment of the principal amountRs. the interest also has to be recovered accordingly.
**Note 02:** The beneficiary will have to furnish a valid surety.
**Note 03:** The student can apply for a loan within six months of moving abroad.
**Note 04:** Students who have passed Class-10 and have completed a recognized ITI course of two years or more duration and have passed the NCVT or GCVT examination for the same according to their choiceRs. Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board. 12th or Gujarat Open School Examination in English subjectRs. those students will be treated as equivalent to 12th for the purpose of admission to higher secondary education courses.
**Note 05:** A student who has completed a three-year diploma course at a Polytechnic will be treated as equivalent to Class 12 for college admission.
**Note 06:** If the student settles abroadRs. change of place of work-residenceRs. contact numberRs. e-mail idRs. notification of movement to India "till the loan is repaid" will be mandatory.

name: Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes (Vandaniya Sant Shri Vasiyadada Scholarship)
brief_description: The scheme Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes is initiated by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. This scheme offers special scholarships to students from the Most Backward Castes among the Scheduled Castes category who are studying in Standards I to X. The Most Backward Castes eligible under the scheme in Gujarat state include ValmikiRs. HadiRs. NadiaRs. SenvaRs. TuriRs. GaroRs. Harijan-BavaRs. and Vanker-SadhuRs. who are granted special scholarships.
benefits:
**Assistance Details:**
**Sl. No.****Standard/Class****Students (Boys & Girls)****Scholarship Rate (Yearly)**1Standard I to VIIIBoth1000/-2Standard IX to XBoth1500/-
eligibility:
1. The student should belong to the most backward castes among the scheduled castes of Gujarat.
1. The student should be studying in Standard I to X.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The most backward castes eligible under the scheme in Gujarat state include ValmikiRs. HadiRs. NadiaRs. SenvaRs. TuriRs. GaroRs. Harijan-BavaRs. and Vanker-SadhuRs. who are granted special scholarships.

name: Dr. Savitaben Ambedkar Inter Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Dr. Savitaben Ambedkar Inter Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme has been implemented as part of social empowerment by addressing inequality through marriages between individuals from Scheduled Castes of Hinduism and those from castes other than Scheduled Castes of Hinduism. Under the schemeRs. the couple is to be provided financial assistance of 2Rs./- to encourage inter-caste marriages between Scheduled Castes and other Hindus. This scheme is a centrally sponsored initiative with a 50% contribution from both the state and central governments.
benefits:
The scale of assistance provided to the couple in the case of inter-caste marriage under the scheme is as follows:

1. An assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to the couple for domestic expensesRs. for purchasing household appliances.
1. An assistance of 1Rs./- is provided in the form of National Savings Certificates in the joint name of the married couple.
1. A total financial assistance of 2Rs./- will be provided to the couple under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. One person of the inter-caste marriage couple should be a native of Gujarat.
1. One person of the inter-caste marriage couple should belong to Scheduled Caste Category.
1. Such marriages have to be registered and applications for assistance under the scheme have to be made within two years of the marriage.
1. The parents of the inter-caste marriage couple should have been residing in the state of Gujarat for five years.
1. Any person other than a Scheduled Caste who is a migrant shall be required to furnish a certificate to the effect that he is not an untouchable in that Province or State and that he practices the Hindu religion.
1. If a widower or a widow who does not have children remarriesRs. assistance will be available under this scheme.
1. There is no income limit.

name: Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Goa. Through this schemeRs. the worker registered with the BoardRs. having a continuous membership for 3 yearsRs. is provided financial assistance of 4Rs./- for the marriage of their children. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 4Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Worker registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The worker should have a continuous membership with the Board for 3 years.
- The scheme also applies to the female beneficiary for her own marriage.

name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Post Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
brief_description: The scheme Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Post Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste was launched by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was launched in the year 1982. Under the schemeRs. loans/financial assistance is given to the Scheduled Caste Medical Post Graduate (M.D/M.S) Doctors to start their independent profession/clinic consultation roomRs. etc.
benefits:
**Loan/Assistance details under the scheme:**

1. Subsidy/assistance of 50Rs./-.
1. Loan up to 3Rs./- at an interest rate of 4%.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Medical Post Graduate (M.D/M.S) Doctor.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be given only to natives of Gujarat state.
1. There is no income limit.
1. The applicant availing the benefit of this scheme will not be eligible to avail the benefit of any similar scheme of the Government.
1. Scheduled Caste students with Graduate Medical (MBBSRs. B.S.A.M.Rs. B.A.M.S. and B.D.S. (Dental) degrees) benefited under the loan/assistance for starting an independent profession. If soRs. such scheduled caste post graduate doctors will not "entitle" any loan/assistance under this scheme.

**Note 01:** Loan assistance for margin money from the government will have to be used only for the purpose for which it is given. If found to be used for any other purposeRs. the amount given as loan assistance will be collected with penal interest from the date of repayment and will also be collected as revenue if required.
**Note 02:** The sanctioned loan will be recovered over a period of four years in equal monthly instalments after the completion of the instalment including interest on the loan taken by the applicant from the bank or other financial institution or after eight yearsRs. whichever is earlier.
**Note 03:** The applicant will be free to repay the outstanding amount earlier than the stipulated time.
**Note 04:** If the applicant fails to repay the sanctioned loan within the stipulated timeRs. a penal interest at the rate of 2.50% will be charged along with the instalments.

name: One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training (Sainik Welfare)
brief_description: "One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITIRs. TypewritingRs. AccountancyRs. BookkeepingRs. TailoringRs. Computer Training" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. up to 10Rs./- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen (ESM) / Widow of the ESM / Dependent of the Widow of the ESMRs. to pursue the mentioned programs/courses from a Government-recognized School/InstitutionRs. upon prior permission from the Department. The application should be submitted offline within three months from the date of successful completion of the course.
benefits:
- The actual cost of the program/course or 10Rs./- is provided to the beneficiary.
- The amountRs. as decided by the Management CommitteeRs. is credited to the beneficiarys Bank Account through RTGS/ NEFT
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an [Ex-serviceman](https://sainik.py.gov.in/definition-ex-servicemen)/Widow of the ESM/Dependent of the Widow of the ESM.

- The applicant should be [registered ](https://sainik.py.gov.in/registration-procedure)with the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.

- If the ESM is the applicantRs. he/she should have become unemployed within three years of discharge from service.
- The applicant should have obtained prior permission from the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry.
- The course/program should be one of the following: ITIRs. TypewritingRs. AccountancyRs. BookkeepingRs. TailoringRs. Computer Training.
- The course/program should be done from a Government-recognized School/Institution.

name: Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the worker who is hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or any disease is provided with 400/- for the first 5 days and 40/- for the remaining daysRs. subject to a maximum 2Rs./-.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 400/- for the first 5 days.
- Financial Assistance of 40/- for remaining daysRs. subject to a maximum of 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Worker.
- The worker should be between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The worker should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year.
- The applicant should be [registered](https://labour.goa.gov.in/eodb-bocwb/registration-eligibility/) with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.- The applicant should have been hospitalized for five or more days.
- The cause of the hospitalization should be an accident or disease.
- The unregistered workers/ their dependents shall be eligible upon the production of a certificate from the builder or Inspector of the area stating that he/she is a building worker.

name: Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme (ST Category)
brief_description: The scheme Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal HusbandryRs. AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. improved varieties of fodder seeds are provided to beneficiaries for widespread publicityRs. demonstration and adaptation by farmers.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. the fodder seed minikit of 3 KgRs. 7 Kg or 10 Kg is given to the eligible beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
1. The beneficiary of the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category can avail the benefit under this scheme.
1. The beneficiary should possess 10 Guntha of land to his or her name.

name: Aaws Bhatta Sahayata Yojana
brief_description:
The Awas Bhatta Sahayata Yojana is a scheme under the Higher Education Department of the Government of Madhya Pradesh to provide assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. It aims to support students who have to rent accommodation near their college due to the distance from their homes. Under this schemeRs. financial aid is provided to help cover rental expensesRs. thereby easing the burden on students pursuing higher education and ensuring equitable access to educational opportunities for marginalized communities in the state.
> **Important Point** 1. After approvalRs. reimbursement is made into the student's bank account. 1. Principals of government institutions will be the approving officers of their institution. For non-government institutionsRs. the principal of the government institution will be the approving officer of the concerned non-government institutions. 1. The amount of rent above the prescribed housing assistance will have to be borne by the student himself. 1. In case of failure or postponement of examination resultsRs. students will become ineligible for this scheme in the coming year.
benefits:
1. In BhopalRs. IndoreRs. JabalpurRs. GwaliorRs. and Ujjain cities 2Rs./- per student per month.
1. At district headquarters 1Rs./- per student per month.
1. At the tehsil and development block level 1Rs./- per student per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicant must be admitted as a regular student in a government or recognized non-government college.
1. The applicant must not be admitted to any government hostel.
1. The annual income of the student's family must be as per the income limit prescribed in the Post Matric Scholarship SchemeRs. which is currently 6Rs./- per annum.
1. The college or the student's permanent residence should not be located within the geographical limits of the same local body (urban body/gram panchayat).

name: Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme
brief_description: The Chetan Chauhan Shramik Krida Protsahan Yojana (CCSKPY) stands out as a remarkable initiative launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022. Recognizing the potential for sporting talent to blossom even from underprivileged backgroundsRs. the scheme bridges the financial gap for the children of registered construction workers. By offering a one-time grantRs. the CCSKPY empowers these young athletes who have excelled at districtRs. stateRs. nationalRs. and even international levels. This financial support proves to be a game-changerRs. allowing them to focus on rigorous trainingRs. acquire necessary equipmentRs. and participate in upcoming competitions. The CCSKPY not only fosters a love for sports among these children but also paves the way for them to achieve recognition and success in the sporting arenaRs. etching their names in the history of Indian athletics.
benefits:
Provide financial assistance who have been selected in districtRs. stateRs. national and international sports.

1. District level : 25Rs./- per son/daughter in lump sum once.
1. State level : 50Rs./- per son/daughter in lump sum.
1. National level : 75Rs./- lump sum per son/daughter.
1. International level : 1Rs./- lump sum per son/daughter.
eligibility:
1. The worker must be working in an establishment registered under the Factories ActRs. 1948.
1. The monthly salary (basic salary + dearness allowance) of the worker should not exceed 15Rs./-.
1. The worker must have worked continuously for at least six months in the establishment/factory and must be in service at the time of applying.
1. The benefit will be admissible to the worker or his two daughters only.
1. The benefit will be admissible to the worker or his two children only.
1. Only those players will be eligible who have been selected on or after March 23Rs. 2021.
1. In case of the female worker herself being a playerRs. she will be given the benefit.

name: Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 15Rs./- is provided to the legal heir in the event of the natural death of the differently-abled person. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 15Rs./- to the legal heir.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the legal heir of the differently abled person.
1. The differently-abled person should have died a natural death.
1. The differently abled person should have been a registered member of the "Welfare Board for the Differently-abled".

name: Tricycles - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The Department launched the 'Tricycles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute tricycles to deserving orthopedically differently-abled persons affected by both lower limbs and upper limbs that are normal for their easy mobility. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of tricycles.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be affected by both lower limbs and upper limbs should be normal.
1. The applicant should be a resident of the district/area of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant's age should be 12 years or above.

name: West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability
brief_description: Launched on 25th April 2023Rs. "West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal. Under this schemeRs. One-time assistance is provided to the registered Migrant Worker in case of disability arising out of accidents during work.
benefits:
- 50Rs./- in case of 40% to 80 % disability.
- 1Rs./- in case of more than 80% disability.
eligibility:
> **For registration as a Migrant Worker:**


- The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicants age should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed/ likely to be employed in any State/Union Territories other than the state of West Bengal/ Outside India.

> **For the application of Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a migrant worker.
- The applicant should be registered with the West Bengal Migrant Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DeptRs. Govt of West Bengal.
- The migrant worker should have a disability of 40%.
- The disability should have been caused due to an accident during work.
- The disability should be certified by a Government Hospital.

name: Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The 'Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to create self-employment avenues for differently abled personsRs. the government has issued orders for establishing Aavin parlour for differently abled persons to sell Aavin products.
benefits: - The government has issued orders for establishing Aavin parlour for differently-abled persons to sell Aavin brand products like milkRs. butterRs. curdRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a differently abled person.
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.

name: Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil NaduRs. launched a program offering Behind-the-Ear (BTE) hearing aids. This initiative aims to improve speech capabilities by encouraging studentsRs. self-employed individualsRs. and employed persons with hearing impairment to utilize hearing aids.
benefits: - **Free distribution of behind the ear hearing aids.**
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a hearing-impaired person.
1. The beneficiary should be studying 6th standard and above.
1. The beneficiary should be any one of the following:



- Student
- Self-Employed
- Employed Persons.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana" was launched by the Director of Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of GujaratRs. in the year 1999. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to Scheduled Caste individuals who do not own a residential homeRs. have an old rough residential homeRs. or own a plot for residenceRs. and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category for the construction of a house. The assistance will be paid in three installments to economically weaker Scheduled Caste individualsRs. especially those below the poverty lineRs. in both urban and rural areas for house construction on an individual basis.
**Implementing Agency:**
**In Urban Areas**: District Deputy DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste Welfare Office
**In Rural Areas:** District Social Welfare Officer Office
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. individuals belonging to the scheduled caste category are provided with 1Rs./- assistance for the construction of houses in both urban and rural areas.
1. The assistance will be paid in three instalmentsRs. first instalment is 40Rs./- (with order of administrative sanction)Rs. the second instalment is 60Rs./- (after reaching the lintel level)Rs. and the third instalment is 20Rs./- (On completion of constructionRs. including toilets).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. Economically weaker Scheduled Caste individualsRs. especially those below the poverty line are eligible to receive benefits under the scheme.
1. The beneficiary should not own a residential homeRs. possess an old rough residential homeRs. or have their own plot for residence.
1. The applicant or any other family members of the applicant should not have already received benefits under any other housing scheme implemented by the Government.
1. The annual income should not exceed 6Rs./- in rural area and 6Rs./- in urban area.
1. Those who are eligible for 12Rs. assistance for toilets will be eligible for it separately as per the rules of the scheme. HoweverRs. if the beneficiary is not eligible for assistance for a toiletRs. he/she will have to construct a toilet out which is mandatory for assistance of 1Rs./-.
1. On the house built under this schemeRs. the beneficiary will have to put a plaque as per State Government's Ambedkar Awas Yojana.
1. The upper limit on construction of houses will be 10Rs./- for urban areas and 7Rs./- for rural areas. The ceiling limit will not apply to the assistance provided under the Affordable Housing Scheme in urban areas.
1. The construction of the house has to be completed within 2 years from the payment of the first installment of the housing assistance.
1. The age of the beneficiary will be at least 21 years.
1. A scheduled caste beneficiary can also be given the benefit under this scheme if his adult sons or brother builds a house on the first floor of the person whose name currently has a house on the ground floor to build his own house with the consent of the house owner/landlord.
1. If the entire construction of the house cannot be completed with the assistance received under the "Dr. Ambedkar Awas YojanaRs." the beneficiary will need to contribute the remaining amount to ensure the completion of the construction of the house.

name: Disable Marriage Scheme (Divyang Lagna Sahay)
brief_description: The scheme "Disable Marriage Scheme" was launched by the Director Social DefenceRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities when a person with a disability marries another person with a disabilityRs. as well as when a non-disabled person marries someone with a disability.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. when two individuals with disabilities marry each otherRs. the couple is entitled to a total assistance of 1Rs./-Rs. equating to 50Rs./- per person.
1. If a person without disabilities marries someone with a disabilityRs. the individual with a disability is eligible to receive assistance of 50Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The age of the girl should be above 18 years and the age of the boy should be above 21 years.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be available only once (one time per couple).
1. Under this schemeRs. the application has to be made within two years of marriage.
1. Under this schemeRs. benefits are given as per the percentage of disability mentioned in the table below:

**Sl. No.****Type of Disability****Percentage of Disability**1BlindnessRs. low visionRs. hereditary muscular dystrophyRs. leprosy-curedRs. acid attack victimsRs. amblyopiaRs. cerebral palsyRs. dwarfismRs. multiple sclerosis-hardening disorder 40% or more
2Hearing impairment 71% to 100%3Chronic neurological conditionsRs. generalized traumaRs. malignant haemorrhageRs. tremorRs. muscular rigidityRs. intellectual disabilityRs. reduced hemoglobin contentRs. chronic anemiaRs. mental illnessRs. special learning disabilitiesRs. speech and language impairmentRs. neuro-developmental impairmentRs. multiple disabilities 50% or more
**Note:** In the case of a differently-abled applicant marrying a differently-abled woman from another stateRs. both the differently-abled spouses will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme on the production of the prescribed proof. FurtherRs. the District Social Defence Officer will have to obtain an undertaking from the applicant that the female beneficiary has not received disability marriage assistance from her state.

name: Post Metric Scholarship - Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The Post-Matric Scholarship Under the Higher Education Department of Madhya Pradesh aimed at providing financial assistance to students belonging to economically weaker sections of society to pursue higher education after matriculation. This scheme helps alleviate the financial burden on students and encourages them to continue their education beyond the secondary level. It covers various expenses such as tuition feesRs. maintenance allowanceRs. and other incidental costs associated with pursuing higher studies. By promoting access to education for allRs. regardless of financial constraintsRs. the Post-Matric Scholarship scheme contributes to fostering inclusivity and empowering disadvantaged students to achieve their academic aspirations.
benefits:
1. Reimbursement of full fee for professional courses when the fee is fixed by the Admission and Fee Regulatory Commission.
1. Reimbursement of full fee prescribed in the course of government institutions
1. In the courses of non-government collegesRs. half of the compulsory fee is reimbursed up to the income limit of 2Rs./-Rs. and for students with an income limit of 2Rs./- to 6Rs./-.
1. Monthly living allowance in undergraduate and postgraduate courses-



- Non-hosteler- 300/-
- Hostel - 570/-
eligibility: The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. If the applicant studying in non-government institutionsRs. the annual income limit of parents/guardians is up to 6Rs./-. There is no income limit for government institutions.

name: Sewing Machine Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Sewing Machine Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This scheme aims to encourage registered women construction workers and to enable them to mend their clothing at their homes. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to registered women construction workersRs. who have a minimum one-year regular membershipRs. for purchasing a sewing machine. This benefit is admissible once in a lifetime. The Board can also provide a sewing machine.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. the Board is providing financial assistance of 4Rs./- to registered women construction workers for purchasing a sewing machine.

**Note:** The Board can provide a sewing machine.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a woman and engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered woman worker must have a minimum of one years regular membership.
1. The applicant should have an active membership of the Board.
1. This benefit is admissible once in a lifetime.
1. The application frequency is limited to once.

name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Individual Artisans
brief_description: Grant to Individual Artisans is a sub-scheme under West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024"Rs. launched by the MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 7th MarchRs. 2024Rs. and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of the scheme is to provide the artisans of Bengal systematic financial support for procurement of modern tool kits to individual artisans.
benefits: One Time Grant up to 15Rs./- for purchase & repair of tool kits/ equipment.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a handicrafts artisan.
- The age of the applicant should be between 18-60 years.
- Applicant should be engaged in traditional Craft/trade with hand tools/equipment/ small machines.
- Applicant should be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers.
- Applicant should be an Indian citizen permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years.
- For Work shedRs. an industrial cooperative society of the eligible artisans should possess a piece of land whereupon sheds will be constructed/ machines will be installed.

name: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Assistance to Individual Handloom Weaver
brief_description: Assistance to Individual Handloom Weaver" is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024Rs. launched by the MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprise and Textiles DepartmentRs. Government of West Bengal on 7th MarchRs. 2024Rs. and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of this sub-scheme is to provide one-time financial assistance to the individual Handloom weavers who are not under the ambit of any Primary Weavers Cooperative Societies.
benefits:
- 5000/- per weaver towards repair/renovation of work shed and/or repair/modification of loom & accessories.
- 10Rs./- will also be provided towards raw material assistance for production of handloom products. To get this benefitRs. the raw materialRs. i.e. yarn has to be procured through Tantuja.
eligibility: - Applicant should be an Individual Weavers.

name: Incentive for Purchase of Electric Scooter for the Daughter of a Registered Construction Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Incentive for Purchase of Electric Scooter for the Daughter of a Registered Construction Worker is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. an incentive of 50Rs./- or the actual ex-showroom price of electric scooterRs. whichever is lowerRs. will be provided by the Board through e-RUPI to the daughter of a registered construction worker to facilitate her mobility while pursuing higher education. Only those girl students who are over 18 years oldRs. have passed class 12th with 60% or higher marksRs. and are studying in any higher education institute/college in the state of Haryana will be eligible for this incentive assistance.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. a maximum benefit of 50Rs./- or the actual ex-showroom price of an electric scooterRs. whichever is lowerRs. will be provided to the daughter of a registered construction worker in the form of e-RUPI.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in any building or construction work.
1. The applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one year's regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. Only those girl students who are daughters of construction workers and studying in any higher education institute/college of the state of Haryana will be eligible for this incentive assistance.
1. The age of the daughter of the worker should be 18 years or more and should not be married.
1. The daughter of the worker should have a valid license to drive a two-wheeler. (If applicable)
1. The percentage of marks in the 12th class passed by the girl student should be 60% or more.
1. The incentive assistance under this scheme is limited to the purchase of one electric scooter in a family.

**Note:** The applicant will upload the bill of purchase of the electric scooter online within a period of one month from receiving the incentive amount otherwise he/she will not be eligible for any benefit under any welfare scheme in the future.

name: Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give pensions of 1Rs./- to destitute agricultural labourers of 60 years. The scheme also provides one free saree to femalesRs. one free dhoti to males during Pongal and DeepavaliRs. and free rice in the Anganwadi Centres.
benefits:
**Pension:**

- 1Rs./- per month.

**Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali:**

- One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
- One free saree to a female pensioner.

**Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres:**

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meal.
- 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be destitute agricultural labour.
1. The age of the applicant should be 60 years and above.
1. The applicant should not have any source of income or means of subsistence to support.
1. The applicant should not be a habitual beggar.
1. The applicant should not possess property valued at more than 5000/-.
1. The applicant should not be supported by a son or son's son aged 20 years or above.

name: Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes
brief_description: The "Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide education to destituteRs. deserted and abandoned children by giving free foodRs. clothingRs. shelter and medical care.
benefits: - **FoodRs. accommodationRs. educationRs. uniformRs. free textbook and notebooksRs. medical facilitiesRs. chappalsRs. and bedding.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be destituteRs. desertedRs. and abandoned children. 1. The applicant's family income should not exceed 24Rs./- per annum. 1. The boys are eligible up to the 5th Standard. 1. The girl child's age should be 5 to18 yearsRs. in case girls without father and mother are admitted up to 21 years for their higher studies 1. The children without parents or with single parentRs. children of ailing parents and prisonersRs. children whose parents are alive but not able to be looked after by them since father/mother is severely differently abled and taken care of by mother/father are eligible.

name: Braille Watches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
brief_description: The 'Braille Watches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. braille watches are distributed to working visually impaired persons to enable them to reach the workplace on time. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of braille watches.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a visually impaired working person.
1. The applicant should be working in the unorganized sectors.
1. The applicant should be any one of the following:



- Employee.
- Self-Employed.

name: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- shall be provided to the dependents/nominees of the registered construction worker in the event of the worker's death due to an accident occurring during the course of employment at the workplace. AdditionallyRs. the Board provides financial assistance of 15Rs./- to the nominee/legal heir of the registered construction workers for funeral expenses.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance of 5Rs./- to the nominee/legal heir of a registered construction worker if the worker dies in an accident while working at the workplace.
1. The Board also provides financial assistance of 15Rs./- to the nominee/legal heir of a registered construction worker for funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The scheme allows for application only once.

name: Magnifiers - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The Department launched the "Magnifiers by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department" scheme for differently abled persons. Under this schemeRs. magnifiers are distributed to needy students with low vision to enable them to read books. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of magnifiers.**
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a student.
1. The beneficiary should be a person with low vision.

name: Leave Travel Concession Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 1Rs./- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial institutions of the state of Haryana in the form of Leave Travel Concession (LTC) for travel once in a block of 4 years. The first block will be considered for the year 2012-15.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 1Rs./- is given to the worker as LTC once in a block of 4 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 18Rs./-.
1. The service period of the workers is fixed for 5 years.
1. The worker should not have received any LTC amount earlier in the concerned block.

**Note:** The first block year will be considered as 2012-15.

name: Pension Scheme - Folk Artist
brief_description: The "Pension Scheme" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The Tamil Nadu Folk Artist Pension Scheme aims to provide financial support to aged and disabled folk artists who have dedicated significant periods of their lives to the promotion and preservation of folk arts. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Regional Office.
benefits: - Pension of 300/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered folk artist.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years or above.
1. The artist must have worked continuously in their profession for at least five years.
1. Disabled folk artists (sick and unable to work) who are under 60 but have been registered with the board for five continuous years are eligible for a pension.

name: Destitute Differently Abled Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Destitute Differently Abled Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a pension of 1Rs./- to differently-abled persons with disability 60% and above. One free saree to females and one free dhoti to males is given on Pongal and Diwali. A nutritious meal is provided to the beneficiaries.
benefits:
**Pension:**

- 1Rs./- per month.

**Free Clothes during Pongal and Deepavali:**

- One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
- One free saree to a female pensioner.

**Free Rice in Anganwadi Centres:**

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meal.
- 4kg/month to those who are not taking nutritious meal.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a hearing and speech-impaired person. 1. The applicant's age should be 45 years and above. 1. The applicant should have a disability of 60% or above. 1. The applicant should not have any source of income or means of subsistence to support. 1. The applicant should not be a habitual beggar. 1. The applicant should not be supported by a son or son's son aged 20 years or above. 1. The applicant should not possess property valued at more than 5000/-.

name: Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance of up to 1Rs./- to the children of construction workers for hostel facilities while they pursue technical/professional courses in recognized institutes. The financial assistance will be given directly to the recognized government or private instituteRs. collegeRs. universityRs. IITRs. IIMRs. AIIMSRs. etc. Reimbursement of admission expenses will be provided to the candidate upon submission of an attested copy of the original receipt.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance up to a maximum limit of 1Rs./- is provided to the children of construction workers for hostel facilities in professional/technical institutions.

**Note:** The financial assistance will be given directly to the Government/Government-recognized Private Institute/College/University/IIT/IIM /AIIMS etc. and the reimbursement of the admission expenses will be given to the candidate on the production of the attested copy of the original receipt.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one year of regular membership.
1. The worker should have an active membership with the Board.
1. The children of construction workers who stay in hostels while pursuing regular technical/professional courses are eligible for benefits under this scheme.
1. Financial assistance for hostel facilities will be available for up to three children per worker.

name: Tholkappiar Award
brief_description: The scheme "Tholkappiar Award" was launched by the Arts and Culture DepartmentRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 10Rs./- to writers and authors for outstanding research publications in Tamil literature who are natives of the Union Territory of Puducherry either by birth or domicile. The application was accepted offline.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of 10Rs./-. with an award and certificate.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a writer/author. 1. The applicant should be born in Puducherry or a resident of Puducherry for five years or have continuous residence before the date of application in the jurisdiction to exist. 1. The applicant should submit research books not less than 150 pages. 1. The applicant should submit texts that must have been printed and published as a first edition by December 31 of the specified year. 1. Essays and dissertations submitted for university degrees or examinations are not eligible. 1. A one-time awardee is ineligible to apply for the subsequent four years. 1. The texts submitted for competition should not be an abridgmentRs. adaptationRs. translationRs. or paraphrase of another text. 1. NovelsRs. short storiesRs. poetryRs. dramaRs. traveloguesRs. and collections of essays are not eligible for the Tholkappiar Award. 1. The thesis editor should be in Tamil language only. 1. The thesis submitted for the Tholkappiar Award should be published in the calendar year preceding the year of the award. It should not have been published in the previous year.

name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is implemented by the Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana to promote communal harmony by encouraging inter-caste marriages. The objective of the scheme is in diminishing caste consciousness among the people and to encourage inter-caste marriages. This scheme is effective from 01.04.1983.
Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is given to the couple when a Non-Scheduled Caste boy or girl marries a Scheduled Caste girl/boy. The amount is provided as an incentive to the married couple and deposited in the joint account of the couple for 3 years lock-in period. This is a 50:50 sharing basis scheme of the Government of India/State Government.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is given to the couple when a Non-Scheduled Caste boy or girl marries a Scheduled Caste girl/boy.

**Note:** Out of the total 2Rs./-Rs. 1Rs./- will be directly transferred to the joint account of the couple immediately after the marriage. The remaining 1Rs./- will be deposited in the couple's joint fixed deposit account for a lock-in period of 3 yearsRs. without the facility for its pre-mature encashment.
eligibility:
1. Both spouses should be citizens of IndiaRs. and one spouse must belong to the Scheduled Caste community i.e. a Non-Scheduled Caste boy or girl marries with a Scheduled Caste girl/boy.
1. The beneficiary (he or she) should be a permanent resident of Haryana State.
1. The beneficiary (he or she) should not have received benefits under a similar scheme.
1. The beneficiary can apply for the incentive within 3 years from the date of marriage.
1. The bride should be at least 18 years old.
1. The groom should be at least 21 years old.
1. The benefit of the scheme is only applicable for the first marriage.

name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General)
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing PiggeryRs. Sheep and Goat Units is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunitiesRs. the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Sheep or Goat Units (15 female+1 male) and Piggery Units (10 female+1 male).
**Medium-term objectives:**

- To provide self-employment to the unemployed.
- To provide socio-economic security to weaker sections/Antyodaya Families of the society.
- To increase wool/meat/pork production in the State.

**Long-term objectives:**

- Creation of employment opportunities through Animal Husbandry activities.
- Increase in wool/meat/pork production of the state.
- Upgradation and conservation of valuable breeds/germplasm available in the State.

**The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways:**

- Sponsoring of loan applications to banks/financial institutions.
- Purchase of animalsRs. taggingRs. and issuance of Health certificates.
- Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc.
- Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division/District Level in the State to the desirous persons.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance under the Scheme:**

**Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:**

- 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for the establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
- A maximum amount of 25Rs./- could be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:**

- 25 % subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
- A maximum amount of 24Rs./- could be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Note 1:** The financial assistance will be provided by the Government in the form of a subsidy after three months of establishment of the unit and tagging or loan disbursement by the bank whichever is laterRs. subject to verification of the unit by the concerned Veterinary Surgeon.
**Note 2:** The financial assistance may be delayed due to non-availability of the budget or any other unforeseen circumstances.
**Note 3:** The subsidy will be provided in the Loan account of the beneficiary.
> **Financial Assistance for Livestock Insurance under the Scheme:**


- If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of a unit is to be covered under that SchemeRs. wherever permissible.
- HoweverRs. if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must be unemployed (employment even in the private sector would bar an applicant from availing assistance under the Scheme).
1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit would not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.
1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

**Note:** In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept. ThenRs. the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept or intended to be kept (Within state of Haryana only).

name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana (MMAPUY) is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals. The subsidy can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units with two milch animals.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance under the Scheme:**

**Dairy units of 2 milch animals:**

- 25 % subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2 milch animals;

> **Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme:**


- Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year; otherwiseRs. the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must be unemployed.
1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
1. The applicant can apply for a dairy unit of 2 Milch animals only.
1. The applicant should have space/shed for keeping milch animals.
1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. 50 chicks of 10 days of age from the Government Hatchery Farm along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep. Any unemployed resident of Haryana aged between 18 and 60 years is eligible to avail of the benefits under this scheme.
benefits: - 50 chicksRs. 10 day old reared at Government Hatchery along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
2. The applicant should be unemployed.
3. The applicant should be between 18 to 60 years old.
4. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.

name: Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize
brief_description: The Arts and Culture DepartmentRs. Puducherry launched the "Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize" scheme. The objective of this scheme is to provide prizes of 10Rs./- and 10 awards to authors/writers in the field of novelsRs. short storiesRs. dramaRs. poems & prose in Tamil. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Director of Art and Culture Department.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 10Rs./-.
- No. of Awards: 10
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an author/writer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years.
1. The applicant should publish the best novelRs. short storyRs. dramaRs. poetry and prose.
1. First edition of the book should be published between 1st January and 31st December.
1. The publication must be of creative literature of their own.
1. The book should not be an abridged version of an imitation or translated version of another book or synopsis.
1. The literary critics/ thesis research presented to university degrees or examinations are not eligible for award
1. The author once awarded is not eligible to participate in the award for the next four consecutive years.
1. The books sent for the prize should be those not awarded by other Government / Non-Government Organizations and Voluntary Literary Organizations.

name: Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens launched the "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme to distribute free daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18. The Assistant Directors and District Managers are instructed to follow these guidelines to ensure proper distribution. The application is accepted online for this scheme.
benefits: Eligible beneficiaries of this scheme will be provided with a DAISY Player to facilitate accessible learning and information access.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the [RPwD ActRs. 2016](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e58aea67b01fa747687f038dfde066f6/uploads/2023/10/202310161053958942.pdf).1. The applicant should be eligible for sanction only once in three years. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
brief_description: The scheme "Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan NigamRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. loans of up to 30Rs./- are provided at a concessional interest rate to individuals from minority communities to enhance their employability. This applies to those with an annual family income between 98Rs./- and 8Rs./- in rural areas and 1Rs./- and 8Rs./- in urban areas. Applicants must be permanent residents of Haryana and belong to minority communitiesRs. including MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. ParsisRs. and Jains.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. Nigam provides loans of up to 30Rs./- at a concessional interest rate to individuals from minority communities to enhance their employability.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age.
1. The annual family income of the applicant should be between 98Rs./- and 8Rs./- in rural areas and between 1Rs./- and 8Rs./- in urban areas.
1. The applicant should belong to a minority communityRs. i.e.Rs. MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. ParsisRs. and Jains.
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).

name: Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
brief_description:
Launched in the Financial Year 2014-15Rs. the scheme "National Livestock Mission" by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Ministry of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry and DairyingRs. aims towards employment generationRs. entrepreneurship developmentRs. increase in per animal productivity and thus targeting increased production of meatRs. goat milkRs. egg and wool under the umbrella scheme "Development Programme". The excess production will help in the export earnings after meeting the domestic demands. The concept of the NLM Scheme is to develop the entrepreneur in order to create the forward and backward linkage for the produce available in the unorganized sector and to link with the organized sector.
**Key Objectives**

1. Employment generation through entrepreneurship development in small ruminantRs. poultry and piggery sector & Fodder sector.
1. Increase of per animal productivity through breed improvement.
1. Increase in production of meatRs. eggRs. goat milkRs. wool and fodder.
1. Increasing availability of fodder and feed to substantially reduce the demand through strengthening the fodder seed supply chain and availability of certified fodder seeds.
1. Encouraging establishment of fodder processing units to reduce the demand supply gap.

**The National Livestock Mission has the following three Sub-Missions:**

1. Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
1. Sub-mission on Feed and Fodder Development
1. Sub Mission on Innovation and Extension

**"Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry"** Proposes to bring sharp focus on entrepreneurship development and breed improvement in poultryRs. sheepRs. goat and piggery by providing the incentivization to the IndividualRs. FPOsRs. FCOs JLGsRs. SHGsRs. Section 8 companies for entrepreneurship development and also to the State Government for breed improvement infrastructure.
benefits:
**Capital Subsidy Provision**

- One-time 50% capital subsidy offered for total project cost.
- Maximum subsidy capped at 25Rs. per unit.

**Standard Subsidy Disbursement**

- First installment released upfront through SIDBI to bank/financial institutions.
- Second installment released after project completion and state agency certification.

**Self-Financing Project Protocol**

- Project requires bank appraisal and 25% expenditure verification.
- Subsidy released in two parts: 50% initially and 50% upon completion.

**Bank Guarantee Requirements**

1. Section 8 Companies

name: Additional Pension to 100% Disabled Ex-Serviceman having No Child

name: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
brief_description: The scheme "Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. ParsisRs. and Jains) as notified by the Government of India. benefits:

LaterRs. the Scheme has been extended to include ScienceRs. Engineering and Science equivalent GraduatesRs. B. Com and BA with MathsRs. BA (Arts) and 10+2 pass eligible applicants gradually.
benefits:
The following is the amount of Unemployment Allowance and Honorarium under the Saksham Yuva Scheme:
**Sl. No.****Qualification (for both Male & Female)****Rate of Unemployment Allowance** **Rate of honorarium**110+2900/- per month6Rs./- per month2Graduates1Rs./- per month6Rs./- per month3Post-Graduates3Rs./- per month6Rs./- per month
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a domicile of Haryana.
1. Applicant should be registered in the Live Register of the concerned Employment Exchange. If not already registeredRs. a 10+2/graduate/post-graduate qualified applicant may simultaneously register on [www.hrex.gov.in](https://hrex.gov.in/) website of the Department. 1. The eligible Post Graduate/Graduate degree should have been obtained only through regular courses from Punjabi UniversityRs. 1. That there is no encroachment on public/Panchayat land by any member of his/her family.
1. That the family of the applicant is not a defaulter of house tax payable to a Urban Local Body and if in defaultRs. then he/she undertakes to utilize part of the honorarium/allowance towards such dues.

name: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Worker
brief_description: The "Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. benefits:
- 10Rs./- is provided to the registered women members.

brief_description: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance CorporationRs. name: Fasal Pradarshan
brief_description:
The Fasal Pradarshan scheme under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan Government allocates grants to organize field and crop demonstrations on farmers' fields. These demonstrations aim to disseminate advanced crop production methods and the latest agricultural technologyRs. educating farmers about innovative techniques such as precision farming and crop management practices to enhance their understanding and adoption of modern agricultural practices.
> **Note:** - The demonstration will be organized in a dense area. - In the demonstrationRs. nutrients will have to be used necessarily on the basis of seed treatment and soil testing.
benefits:
Demonstration programGrant on performanceOilseed crops (Kharif season)50 percent or maximum of actual expenditure on inputs1. Peanuts10Rs./-2. Soybean60Rs./-3. Sesame seeds18Rs./-4. Castor seeds3Rs./-5. Rabi season: Mustard and flaxseed3Rs./-6. Taramira2Rs./-7. Mustard and beekeeping500/-
- **100 percent or maximum of actual expenditure on inputs** 1. Wheat7Rs./-2. Kharif pulses7Rs./-3. Gram9Rs./-4. Maize5Rs./-5. Barley6Rs./-6. Jowar3Rs./-7. Millet3Rs./-8. Non BT cotton7Rs./-9. BT cotton3Rs./-10. Guar 6Rs./-
eligibility:

1. Only one member from a farmer's family will be given the opportunity for demonstration.
1. The demonstration will be organized at the block level.
1. The selected seedsRs. fertilizersRs. and other inputs must be used as per the guidelines.
1. A farmer can set up a demonstration plot on a maximum of 1 hectareRs. but it can also be on less than 1 hectare on a pro-rata basis.

name: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)
