name: Financial Assistance to Para/Tetra/Hemi Plegic Ex-Servicemen
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Para/Tetra/Hemi Plegic Ex-Serviceman" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month shall be granted to ParaplegicRs. TetraplegicRs. and Hemiplegic Ex-Servicemen who are bonafide residents of Haryana State and are not in receipt of any kind of financial assistance from any department of the Haryana Government. Ministry of Defence.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month is given to Para/Tetra/Hemi Plegic Ex-ServicemanRs. with an annual increase of 400/- w.e.f. 01.11.2017 every year in November.

**Note:** Subject to the condition that application/claim case is found in order financial assistance to the ParaplegicRs. TetraplegicRs. or Hemiplegic Ex-Serviceman will be sanctioned with effect from the first day of the following month in which case is sanctioned by the competent sanctioning authority.
eligibility:

1. In the case of a Hemiplegic Ex-Serviceman of Haryana State financial assistance will be admissible to only those who after 6 months of the attack of the deceasedRs. do not recover and who are also declared 100% disabled on account of Hemiplegic disease by the Medical authorities even after 6 months of the attack of the disease.

**Note 1:** The financial assistance is admissible to eligible paraplegiaRs. tetraplegiaRs. or hemiplegia ex-servicemen in addition to any disability pension from Govt. of IndiaRs. Ministry of Defence.
**Note 2:** The old beneficiaries whose cases for grant of financial assistance have already been sanctioned prior to the issue of the guidelines shall continue to get the financial assistance at enhanced rates and they need not apply afresh. HoweverRs. payment shall be discontinued with immediate effect who fail to submit their survival verification proofs every year from the revenue authorities.
**Note 3:** Payment of financial assistance to those beneficiaries shall also be stopped immediately who fail to submit their survival verification proofs every year from the revenue authorities in the month of April.
**Note 4:** Every applicant shall have to produce a certificate issued by the concerned District Social Welfare Officer to the effect that the applicant is not getting any financial assistance/ Pension from the Social Justice & Empowerment Department of Haryana.
**Note 5:** If any beneficiaryRs. after the sanction of the financial assistance under this schemeRs. is found drawing any type of financial assistance from any other Department of Haryana Government. He/she shall be permanently debarred from getting financial assistance under all schemes.

name: Fatal Accident Relief - Telangana

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana" was started by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh in 2006. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the mass marriage of girlsRs. widowsRs. and abandoned women from destitute or poor families in the state.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided:

- Each eligible bride (including girlsRs. widowsRs. or abandoned women) participating in the mass marriage ceremony will receive a total of 49Rs./- through an Account Payee ChequeRs. on the day of the mass marriage ceremony.
- The organizing body that conducts the mass marriage ceremony will receive 6Rs./- per beneficiary.

**Note:** A total of 55Rs./- is provided per beneficiary under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The parents of the bride/groom should be natives of Madhya Pradesh.
1. Financial assistance will be provided to girlsRs. widowsRs. and abandoned women from destitute or poor families in the state at the time of their marriage.
1. The bride should be at least 18 years oldRs. and the groom should be at least 21 years old.
1. The applicant should belong to the GeneralRs. Other Backward ClassRs. Scheduled CasteRs. or Scheduled Tribe category.
1. There are no income restrictions for receiving assistance under the scheme.
1. The bride and groom should participate in the mass marriage ceremony organized on the prescribed dates.
1. The benefit of this scheme will not be available for single marriage ceremonies.

**Note 1:** Abandoned women who have been legally divorced are only eligible under the scheme.
**Note 2:** If the groom is from outside the stateRs. the bride will still be eligible for the benefits of the scheme. HoweverRs. if the parents of either the bride/groom are not natives of the stateRs. the benefits under the scheme will not be available.
**Note 3:** The bride should not have been previously married. This means that the marriage of the bride and groom must take place solely during a mass marriage ceremony organized under the schemeRs. and they should not have been married through a single or any other mass marriage ceremony before.
**Note 4:** A mass marriage ceremony will be organized only if applications are received from a minimum of 5 couples.

New DelhiRs. or the Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC)Rs. IndoreRs. is eligible for the scheme.

brief_description: The Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (NSPY) scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide pension to a Construction worker registered with the Board and is above 60 years old (OAP)/ widow (any age) (WP)/ widow of registered worker (any age)/ leprosy patient with deformity (CLP)/ physically challenged (any age) (DP)/ widow of HIV positive worker (WP-AIDS) or HIV positive worker (any age) (DP-AIDS).
benefits: - **Beneficiary (up to 80 years):** 500/- Per Month.- **Beneficiary (80 years and above):** 700/- Per Month.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**

- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be any of the following:


1. a construction worker and validly registered with the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and has completed 60 years of age (Old Age Pension-OAP).
1. a registered construction worker who is a widow (irrespective of age) (Widow Pension-WP)
1. a widow of a registered construction worker (irrespective of age).
1. a registered construction worker who is a leprosy patient with visible signs of deformity (CLP) as per rule.
1. a registered construction worker who is physically challenged (irrespective of age) (Disability Pension-DP).
1. a Widow of a registered construction worker who was a HIV-positive person (WP-AIDS).
1. a registered construction worker who is an HIV-positive person identified by the Orissa State AIDS Control Society or District AIDS Prevention Control Unit (D.A.P.C.U.) irrespective of age and income (DP-AIDS).


- The applicants family income from all sources not exceeding 24Rs./- per annum.
- The applicant has not been convicted of any criminal offense involving moral turpitude.
- The applicant is not in receipt of any other pension from the union Government or the state government or any organization aided by either Government.

> Note: Where both husband and wife are covered under the above definitionRs. each of them will be eligible for such pension.

name: Assistance for Purchase of Bi-cycle (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Assistance for Purchase of Bi-cycle scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. OdishaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall make one time reimbursement to each beneficiary who is registered with the Board for purchasing Bi-cycle on production of original bill/ voucher.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 4Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have deposited up-to-date annual contributions for three years to the Board.

name: Assistance for Purchase of Safety Equipment (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Assistance for Purchase of Safety Equipment scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. OdishaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall make one time reimbursement to each beneficiary who is registered with the Board for purchasing Safety Equipment like HelmetRs. Safety shoes and Hand-gloves on production of original bill/ voucher.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 1Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have deposited up-to-date annual contributions for one year to the Board.

name: Sweekruti: Assistance to Parents of Transgender Children
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Parents of Transgenders" is a component of the Sweekruti schemeRs. implemented by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the parents of transgender children to support them in successfully raising their children against societal intoleranceRs. stigmaRs. discriminationRs. and violence.
benefits: - **Financial assistance:** 1Rs./- per transgender child per month. > **Note:** - Assistance is provided until the child reaches the age of 18 years. - In case of death of the parentRs. supportive money will be made available to the guardian subject to production of the relevant Certificate of guardianship obtained from Competent Authority.
eligibility: - Applicant should be the parents/ guardian of the transgender child. - The child must be under 18 years of age. - The child should have gender non-conforming behavior.

name: Videsh Siksha Yojana (MPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Videsh Siksha Yojana has implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB) under the Labor Department of Madhya Pradesh for the children of registered construction workers from the year 2019. According to the schemeRs. there is a provision to provide assistance for study abroad to a maximum of 50 students every year to the children of registered construction workers to pursue quality higher education in recognized institutions abroad. Under the schemeRs. the selected students are entitled to scholarships and other benefits for courses at the postgraduate level and a research degree (Ph.D.) for two years abroad.
benefits:
The following financial assistance will be provided to the applicant for pursuing education under the scheme:-

- **Tuition Fee:** Payment of actual tuition fee or up to $40Rs. whichever is less. - **Subsistence Allowance:** A maximum of $10Rs. per yearRs. based on the monthly expenditure in India and abroad as shown by the educational institution where the student is studying. - In addition to the visa fee and insurance premiumRs. second-class rail/bus fare from the place of residence to the airport and back and actual economy-class airfare to the nearest place of the educational institution and back will be payable.

**Note:** The amount of grant will be credited into the student's account as per the prescribed fee payment schedule of the educational institution upon production of a certificate of continuity of studies in the institution.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a child of a construction worker.
1. Either parent of the applicant should be registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and hold a valid identity card for a continuous period of 5 years.
1. To pursue a postgraduate degreeRs. it is mandatory for the applicant to have passed the graduation degree with 60% marks in the first division or its equivalent grade.
1. For PhD degreeRs. it is essential to have passed a postgraduate degree with 60% marks in the first division and 02 years of teaching/research/M.Phil degree in the relevant field.
1. If the student is receiving benefits from any other sourceRs. he/she will not be eligible for this scheme.

name: Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. OdishaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance as medical expenses for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from disease of Nervous system (Brain & spine related)Rs. Cardiovascular SystemRs. Kidney and Cancer. The beneficiary should be registered at least for one year in lines of the Odisha State Treatment Fund.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 3Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or the applicant should be a dependent of the member.
- The beneficiary should be registered at least for one year in line of the Odisha State Treatment Fund.
- The applicant should suffer from any major diseases.

name: Marriage Assistance (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The Marriage Assistance scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. OdishaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide marriage benefit to the unmarried female member on her marriage or marriage of two unmarried girl children who are of above 18 years of age subject to a minimum of one year as registered beneficiary.
benefits:
- **Quantum of Assistance:** 50Rs./-.
> **Note:**


- Assistance shall be given for a maximum of two children.
- In case both spouses are registered beneficiariesRs. the benefit will be extended to one spouse only.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be female.
- The applicant should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or an unmarried girl child aged above 18 years of the member.
- The member should be registered for a period of one year or more under the board.

name: Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects
brief_description: The "Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects" schemeRs. launched by the Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to encourage student for taking admission in Science and Contemporary subjects. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed Class 10 and enrolled in Class 11 Science streamRs. and to those who have passed Class 12 and enrolled in a B.Sc. course in PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. MathematicsRs. or Biology.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. scholarships will be provided to Scheduled Tribe students at the following rates:

- **Students who passed Class 10th and are enrolled in Class 11th in the Science stream:** 2Rs./-- **Students who passed Class 12th and are enrolled in a B.Sc. course in PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. MathematicsRs. or Biology:** 3Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The scheme benefits are available to:


- Students who have completed Class 10 and are currently enrolled in Class 11 with a Science stream.
- Students who have completed Class 12 and are currently pursuing a B.Sc. degree in PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. MathematicsRs. or Biology.

name: Integrated Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The "Integrated Scholarship SchemeRs." implemented by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students who are deprived of other scholarships to pursue higher education and training in various fields. The scheme offers scholarships for PhDRs. M.Phil.Rs. Postgraduate (qualification-based and qualification cum instrument-based)Rs. and sportsRs. as well as merit-based scholarships for graduatesRs. ranging from 300/- to 600/- per month. Eligible students must be natives of Madhya PradeshRs. studying in a government collegeRs. with a family income not exceeding 54Rs./- per annum from all sources.
benefits:
The scholarships are provided at the following rates:
**Sl. No.****Type of scholarship****Amount per month** **Quota**1PhD600/- 182M.Phil.500/- 143Postgraduate (Merit based only)500/- 734Postgraduate (Merit cum means based)500/- 735Sports300/-226Graduation (Merit based only)300/-1467Graduation (Merit cum means based)300/-146**Note:** The scholarship is provided for 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
2. The applicant should be studying in a government/aided private college.
3. The annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant should not exceed 54Rs./-.
4. The other qualifications of the applicant:

- **Ph.D:** 55% marks in post-graduation. - **Postgraduate:** 55% marks in graduation. - **Graduation (qualification cum means):** 55% marks in the examination of the Board of Secondary Education. - 60% marks in Graduation (qualifying) examination of Board of Secondary Education.
- **Sports:** The applicant should be a member of the national sports team in the school team of Madhya PradeshRs. or should be a member of the adult team of the state or should have been in any of the first three places in the state level competition.

name: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker" scheme was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Department Tripura. This scheme gives financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers having a continuous registration for a period of six months under TBOCWWB.
benefits:
**Pre-Matric Courses:** - Class 1st to 5th: 1Rs./- per year- Class 6th to 8th: 2Rs./- per year- Class 9th to 10th: 4Rs./- per year
**Non-Degree Post-Matric Courses:** - Courses with entrance qualification as High School (Class 10th) (e.g.Rs. senior secondaryRs. ITI coursesRs. 3-year diplomas in Polytechnics): 4Rs./- per year
**Post-Matric Scholarships:** - **Group 1: 20Rs./- year** 1. Degree and Post Graduate level courses which include M.Phil.Rs. Ph.D.Rs. and Post-Doctoral research in Medicine (AllopathicRs. IndianRs. and other recognized systems of medicinesRs. EngineeringRs. TechnologyRs. PlanningRs. ArchitectureRs. DesignRs. Fashion TechnologyRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary & Allied SciencesRs. ManagementRs. Business Finance /AdministrationRs. Computer Science/Applications. 1. Commercial Pilot License (including helicopter pilot and multiengine rating) course. 1. Post Graduate Diploma courses in various branches of management & medicine. 1. C.A./I.C.W.A./C.S./I.C.F.A. etc. (v) M.Phil.Rs. Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Programmes (D. Litt.Rs. D.Sc.Rs. etc.): In existing Group 2 courses and In existing Group 3 courses - **Group 2: 12Rs./- year** 1. Graduate/ Post Graduate courses leading to DegreeRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B Pharma)Rs. Nursing (B Nursing)Rs. LLBRs. BFSRs. other para-medical branches like rehabilitationRs. diagnostics etc.Rs. Mass CommunicationRs. HotelManagement& CateringRs. Travel/Tourism/Hospitality ManagementRs. Interior DecorationRs. Nutrition & DieteticsRs. Commercial ArtRs. Financial Services (e.g. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. Taxation etc.) for which entrance qualification is minimum Sr. Secondary (10+2). 1. Post Graduate courses not covered under Group-I e.g. M.A./M.Sc./M.Com./M.Ed./M.Pharma etc. - **Group 3: 10Rs./- year** 1. All other courses leading to a graduate degree not covered under Group 1&2eg. BA/B Sc/B Com etc.
eligibility:
1. The children's parents or guardians must be registered construction workers under the Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
1. The scholarships are awarded for all recognized Pre-Matric and Post-Matric courses in recognized institutionsRs. except courses of 6 months or less.
1. The students studying in the same stage of education in different subjects (e.g.Rs. Class XI Arts after Class XI Science) are not eligible.
1. The student who completed one professional stream and is pursuing another (e.g.Rs. LLB after B.Ed.) is not eligible. The students will be allowed to take up only one professional stream.
1. The scholarship shall be tenable for the prescribed duration of a course. A candidate who receives the scholarship but fails to pass in a particular year shall not receive further scholarship till he/she passes the specific year of the course.
1. The student should maintain 50% of the annual attendance in the class.
1. Only two children of the same parents/guardians are eligible for scholarships.
1. The registered construction workers must have no dues payable to the Board.

name: Marketing Assistance Scheme
brief_description:
The "Marketing Assistance Scheme" was implemented by Karnataka Leather Industries Development Corporation LtdRs. Govt of Karnataka. The scheme aims to empower SC leather artisans by enabling them to market their products through Lidkar Leather Emporia under the Lidkar brand. It helps artisans avoid exploitation by private dealers and provides regular procurement of their products based on demand.
**Objective:** Regular procurement of products (once every 1-2 months) based on showroom demand. Branding and marketing through Lidkar Leather Emporia.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 50Rs./- to 1Rs./- worth of procurement from each artisan.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be leather artisans.
1. The applicant should belongs to sub-castes ArundathiyarRs. ChammadiyaRs. ChamarRs. ChambarRs. ChamagarRs. MadarRs. MadigRs. MadigaRs. Mini MadigRs. JambavaluRs. HaralayyaRs. MachigarRs. MochigarRs. MochiRs. muchiRs. Telugu MochiRs. kamaati mochaRs. RohidasRs. DhorRs. kakkayyaRs. KankayyaRs. SamagaraRs. SamagarRs. Aadhi AnddraRs. Aadhi DravidaRs. Aadhi Karnataka among schedule castes.
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 30Rs./- in rural areas and 25Rs./- in urban areas.
1. The applicant or their family members must not have received benefits from other schemesRs. except training programs.
1. The applicant's family members should not be employed in government or semi-government organizations.

name: Padhuke Kuteera Scheme Karnataka
brief_description: The "Paduke Kuteera Scheme" was implemented by Karnataka Leather Industries Development Corporation LtdRs. Department of Social WelfareRs. Govt of Karnataka. The scheme aims to provide a steel-made kiosk (Paduke Kuteera) and a tool kit free of cost to roadside cobblers engaged in repair work or footwear production. The scheme promotes self-employment by offering proper infrastructure and resources to cobblers.
benefits:
- **Free Paduke Kuteera made of steel material with signage board display arrangement.** - **Free Tool Kit.**
**NOTE:** Unit cost for each Kuteera is 1Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be leather artisans.
1. The applicant should belongs to sub-castes ArundathiyarRs. ChammadiyaRs. ChamarRs. ChambarRs. ChamagarRs. MadarRs. MadigRs. MadigaRs. Mini MadigRs. JambavaluRs. HaralayyaRs. MachigarRs. MochigarRs. MochiRs. muchiRs. Telugu MochiRs. kamaati mochaRs. RohidasRs. DhorRs. kakkayyaRs. KankayyaRs. SamagaraRs. SamagarRs. Aadhi AnddraRs. Aadhi DravidaRs. Aadhi Karnataka among scheduled castes.
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 30Rs./- in rural areas and 25Rs./- in urban areas.
1. The applicant or their family members must not have received benefits from other schemesRs. except training programs.
1. The applicant's family members should not be employed in government or semi-government organizations.

name: Pension Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The 'Pension Scheme' is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers who have completed a minimum of five years of membership and have attained the age of 60 are eligible for a pension of 1Rs./- per month. This benefit is provided only if the worker has not received a pension under any other social security scheme.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers receive a monthly pension of 1Rs./- after attaining the age of 60 years.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The worker should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker should have maintained continuous membership with the Board for a minimum of five years.
1. The worker should be 60 years of age or older.
1. The worker should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: SUBHADRA
brief_description: SUBHADRA is a flagship scheme by the Women And Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha aimed at empowering women through financial supportRs. enhanced digital literacyRs. and access to social safety nets. The scheme provides direct benefits and incentivizes digital transactionsRs. focusing on improving the socio-economic conditions of women and their families.
benefits: - **SUBHADRA Card:** All beneficiaries receive a SUBHADRA card (ATM-cum-debit card) to enhance identity and empowerment. - **Financial Support:** Eligible beneficiaries receive a total of 50Rs./- over 5 years (10Rs./- annually between 2024-25 to 2028-29). - **Digital Transactions Incentive:** Top 100 women in each Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body with the highest number of digital transactions in a year receive an additional 500/-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA)/ State Food Security Scheme (SFSS).
- Applicant without an NFSA or SFSS Card can apply under SUBHADRA if her family income is not more than 2Rs./-.
- The applicants age should be 21 years or more and less than 60 years as on the qualifying date.
- Applicants receiving financial assistance such as pensionRs. scholarship etc. of 1Rs./- per month or more or 18Rs./- per annum or more under any State or Central Government Scheme would be ineligible.
- The applicant should not be a current or former Member of Parliament (MP) or Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA).
- The applicant should not be an Income Tax Payee.
- The applicant should not be an elected public representative in any Urban Local Body or Panchayati Raj Institution (excluding Ward Member / Councillor)
- The applicant should not be Employed as a regular or contractual employee in State Government or Government of India or Public Sector Undertaking or Board or Local Body or Government Organization or is receiving pension after retirement. HoweverRs. all workers receiving honorarium such as ASHARs. Anganwadi WorkerRs. Community Resource PersonRs. Master BookkeeperRs. etc. and all those engaged through outsourcing agencies would be consideredRs. if otherwise eligible under this Scheme.
- The applicant should not be an elected / nominated/ appointed representative in any Government Department or Undertaking or Board or Organization of Government of India or State Government.
- An owner of a 4-wheeler Motor Vehicle except tractorsRs. mini-trucksRs. small commercial vehicles and other similar light goods vehicles.

> **Note:**

For 2024-25Rs. if a woman attains the age of 21 years after 01.07.2024Rs. she will get Rs.10Rs. per yearRs. only for the remaining years of the scheme period. In 2024-25Rs. women who complete 60 years of age after 01.07.2024Rs. will not receive the benefits for the remaining years of the scheme period.

name: Distribution of Soil Health Card
brief_description: Under the Distribution of Soil Health Card schemeRs. by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. Soil health cards will be distributed to all the farmers who have offered the soil sample for testing by paying a prescribed fee of 5/- each for Macro and Micronutrient testing.
benefits: - Soil Health Cards to farmers.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should have provided soil samples for testing.
- The beneficiary should have paid the prescribed fee 5/- each for Macro and Micronutrient testing.

name: Craftsman Training Scheme - Maharashtra
brief_description: The "Craftsman Training Scheme" was launched by the Skill DevelopmentRs. Employment and Entrepreneurship DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. This stipend aims to support the trainees financially and encourage them to pursue and complete their vocational trainingRs. thereby contributing to skilled manpower development in the state.
benefits: - **Stipend 500/- per month.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra state. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Freed Castes and Nomadic TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. Special Backward ClassesRs. Minority Communities and Open Category economically backward 1. The annual income of parents should not exceed 8Rs./-. 1. Only two siblings within a family are eligible for this benefit. 1. The trainee should maintain an average of 80% attendance. 1. The trainee should be passing the first year to enroll in a 2-year trade. 1. SC trainees with an annual income of less than 2Rs./- are also eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship. 1. Trainees suspended or found non-eligible for the All India Trade Test (AITT) will not qualify. 1. Trainees who have left the GITI are not eligible from their date of departure. 1. Trainees in PITI are ineligible for this scheme.

name: Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship
brief_description: The "Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship" scheme was launched by Social Justice and Special AssistanceRs. Government of MaharashtraRs. specifically designed to encourage Scheduled Caste (SC) students to pursue higher secondary education. The scholarship aims to enhance the educational standards and competitiveness of SC students by providing financial assistance to those who excel in their Class 10th examinations and are admitted to Class 11th in recognized junior colleges or colleges.
benefits:
> ***Scholarship Rate:*** - Class 11th: 300/- per month. - Class 12th: 300/- per month.
> ***Duration:*** - Ten months
**Note:** Totaling 3Rs. per academic year.
eligibility: 1. The boy/girl should belong Scheduled Caste. 1. The applicant should be studying in classes 11th and 12th in Junior Colleges and Colleges. 1. The applicant should have passed the Class 10th examination with 75% or more marks. 1. Backward-class students who have been admitted to class 11th in the junior college/college are eligible for this scholarship.

name: Nalkoop Khanan Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The "Nalkoop Khanan Yojana" was launched on 31st December 2001Rs. by the Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. to increase the irrigation area by harnessing underground water. Under this schemeRs. farmers from Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories are eligible for a subsidy covering 75% of the unit cost (up to 25Rs./-) for digging a tube well and 75% of the unit cost (up to 15Rs./-) for the successful installation of a tube well submersible pump. This scheme is effective in entire Madhya PradeshRs. except in Shajapur and Indore.
benefits:
> **Subsidy for Tube Well Digging:**


- A grant of 75% of the unit cost (up to a maximum of 25Rs./-)Rs. is provided for digging a tube well.
- Applicable for both successful and unsuccessful digging.

> **Subsidy for Submersible Pump Installation:**


- A grant of 75% of the unit cost (up to a maximum of 15Rs./-)Rs. is provided for the successful installation of a submersible pump on a tube well.
- Applicable only for successful installation of a Submersible Pump.

**Note:** The subsidy is transferred to the bank account of the farmers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. Farmers from Shajapur and Indore districts of Madhya Pradesh are excluded from this scheme.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant should own agricultural land within the state.

name: Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The Refund of Subscriptions for the Construction Workers scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the entire subscription deposited by the beneficiary will be refunded with 8% interest to the subscriber on maturity at the age of 60 years or unwillingness to continue as a beneficiary under the Board after 3 years or to the nominee (legal heir) upon the death of the subscriber.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** Subscription deposited by the beneficiary will be refunded with 8% interest to the subscriber.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
- The applicant should reach the age of maturity i.e. 60 years.

OrRs.

- The applicant do not want to continue as a subscriber under the Board after 3 years of registration.

OrRs.

- The subscriber has lost his/her life due to death. (Applicant should be nominee (legal heir) of the subscriber.

name: Micro Nutrient Spray
brief_description: The Micro Nutrient Spray scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is aimed at helping farmers improve crop nutrition by providing a subsidy for micro-nutrient sprays. The scheme offers a subsidy of 50% or 70/- per hectareRs. whichever is less. All farmers are eligible to applyRs. with a target of 24% of the benefits flowing to SC/ST farmers and 20% to women farmers or women groups.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% subsidy or 70/- per hectare for micro-nutrient spray.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a Farmer. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.

name: Disability Pension (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The 'Disability Pension' scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers with disabilities. Eligible workers receive 1Rs./- per month for permanent disabilities caused by conditions such as paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosisRs. or accidents. AdditionallyRs. a one-time assistance of 75Rs./- is granted for total permanent disabilityRs. and 50Rs./- for partial disability. To avail of benefits under this schemeRs. workers should maintain an active membership with the Board.
benefits:
Eligible registered construction workers under this scheme will receive the following financial assistance:

- A monthly financial assistance of 1Rs./- is given to workers with permanent disabilities caused by conditions such as paralysisRs. leprosyRs. tuberculosisRs. or accidents.
- A one-time assistance of 75Rs./- is given to workers in case of permanent total disability.
- A one-time assistance of 50Rs./- is given to workers in case of partial disability.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The worker should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker's membership with the Board should be active.
1. The worker should have a permanent total or partial disability caused by illness or an accident to be eligible for the scheme.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
brief_description: Launched on 15th August 1995Rs. the scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" is a pension scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. The scheme provides 1Rs./- per month to BPL individuals aged 18 to 79 who have severe or multiple disabilities. Launched under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)Rs. the scheme aims to ensure social justice by providing financial support to the most vulnerable sections of societyRs. fulfilling the Directive Principles of State Policy.
benefits:
**Amount of Pension:** The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of 1000/-.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed to the beneficiary either through bank transfer or money order.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and over 80 years. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
brief_description: Launched on 15th August 1995Rs. the "National Family Benefit Scheme" is a welfare scheme by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. The scheme provides one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- to ensure social security for bereaved families living below the poverty line in case of the death of their breadwinner.
benefits: A one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu and Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased person.
1. The deceased should have been the primary breadwinner (the main earning member of the family).
1. The family of the deceased must be living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).
1. At the time of deathRs. the deceased must have been between 18 and 59 years old.
1. The application should be submitted within one year of the death of the primary breadwinner (husbandRs. wifeRs. or son).

name: Professional Education (PEJKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Professional Education" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & KashmirRs. provides financial assistance to the children of registered workers who have engaged in at least 90 days of building or construction work in the preceding 12 months. Under this schemeRs. regular students receive 10Rs./- for Para Medical and ITI diploma coursesRs. 30Rs./- for 3-year engineering or other recognized diploma coursesRs. and 50Rs./- for professional or technical degree courses.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance based on the Educational Qualification -**


- Para Medical Diploma Courses (Regular Students): 10Rs./-.
- ITI Diploma Courses (Regular Students): 10Rs./-.
- 3-Year Engineering / Any Other Recognized Diploma Courses (Regular Students): 30Rs./-.
- Professional / Technical Degree Courses (Regular Students): 50Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration -**

The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.
> **For Application -**


1. The parents must be registered members of the "Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
1. The parents must have an active membership with the JKBOCWW Board.
1. The applicant must be a student.
1. The applicant must be a regular in attendance.

name: Academic Education (JKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Academic Education" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & KashmirRs. provides financial assistance to the children of the registered workers. Under this schemeRs. regular students in Class 9th to 10th receive 4Rs./-Rs. Class 11th to 12th receive 6Rs./-Rs. undergraduate students receive 10Rs./-Rs. and postgraduate students receive 15Rs./-.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance based on the Educational Qualification -**

1. Class 9th to 10th: 4Rs./-.
1. Class 11th to 12th: 6Rs./-.
1. Undergraduate: 10Rs./-.
1. Postgraduate: 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker -**


1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.

> **For Application to this Scheme -**


1. The parent/s must be registered member/s of the "Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
1. The parent/s must have an active membership with the JKBOCWW Board.
1. The child must be a student.
1. The child must be a regular in attendance.

name: Postmatric Scholarship
brief_description: The "Postmatric Scholarship" scheme launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aimed at supporting students from Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC). The scheme provides financial assistance to students in 11th and 12th standards in English MediumRs. helping cover tuition fees and full examination fees.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - Tuition fee assistance of 500/- (50/- per month for 10 months). - Full examination fee coverage for 12th-standard students.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a student. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC). - Parents' income should not exceed 1Rs./- (for Backward Classes (BC) students). - There should be no graduate in the family (for Backward Classes (BC) students). - The beneficiary should be studying in 11th or 12th standard in an English medium school.

name: Registered BOC Workers in case of an Accidental Death (JKBOCWWB)
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2018Rs. the scheme "Registered BOC Workers in Case of Accidental Death" is a Welfare Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & Kashmir. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 4Rs./- is provided to the nominee or dependents of registered BOC workers in the event of an accidental death. The applications are accepted online as well as offline.
benefits: 4Rs./- is provided to the nominee or dependents of the deceased worker.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


1. The applicant should be a nominee/dependent of a registered member/worker who has passed away due to accidental death.

name: Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice
brief_description: The Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice scheme by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers financial support to Adi Dravidar and Tribal lawyers who are in the early stages of their career. This scheme aims to provide them with the necessary incentives to establish a successful legal practice.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Incentives to unemployed Adi Dravidar/Tribal lawyers to start legal practice.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be an unemployed lawyer.
- The beneficiary should have registered their name as a lawyer within 5 years.
- The beneficiary should have an interest to start legal practice.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal community.
- Beneficiarys annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Award of 20,000/- to Best Writers
brief_description: The Award of 20Rs./- to Best Writers scheme by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aimed at recognizing and promoting literary talent within the Adi DravidarRs. TribalRs. and Adi Dravidar Christian-converted communities. A total of 10 writers from these communities will be selected to receive a cash prize. AdditionallyRs. one writer from any other community will also be chosen.
benefits: - **Cash Prize:** 20Rs./- to each of the selected writers (10 from Adi Dravidar/Tribal communities and one from other communities). - **Recognition:** Selected writers receive state recognition for their literary contributions.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be an unemployed writer.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar converted to Christian community.

name: Book Bank Scheme: I
brief_description: Under the Book Bank Scheme: IRs. launched by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. textbooks are purchased by the government and provided to libraries in educational institutions for the use of students in professional courses such as MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. LawRs. MBARs. VeterinaryRs. AgricultureRs. and Polytechnic. Adi Dravidar and Tribal studentsRs. who receive the Government of India ScholarshipRs. can access these books during their studies. After completing the courseRs. students must return the books to the library.
benefits: - **Free Textbooks Access:** Students receive textbooks for their entire course duration at no cost from the library. > **Note:** On completion of the course the students should return the books to the Library.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a student.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/ Tribal communities.
- The beneficiary must be receiving any Scholarship by the Government of India.
- The beneficiary must return the books after completing the course.
- The beneficiary must be enrolled in one of the following courses:


1. Medical
1. Engineering
1. Law (BL/LLB 3 years and 5 yearsRs. LLM/ML 2 years)
1. MBA (2 years)
1. Veterinary
1. Agriculture
1. Polytechnic
1. Chartered AccountantsRs. Cost Accountants (IntermediateRs. Final)
1. Postgraduate Technical Courses in MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. AgricultureRs. Veterinary
1. Other equivalent professional studiesRs. including Bio-Science.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Maternity Loan through Self Help Groups
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Maternity Loan through Self Help Groups" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers financial support through Self Help Groups to pregnant women for maternity-related expenses. The loan is capped at 2Rs./- with an interest rate of 11%Rs. subject to changes.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 2Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 11% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a woman. - The beneficiary should be pregnant. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - Loans should be applicable only for Maternity.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For SSI Unit Loan and Other NFS Activities
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For SSI Unit Loan and Other NFS Activities" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to support small-scale industries (SSI) and other NFS activities by providing loans up to 1Rs. at an interest rate of 13% (subject to change).
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 1Rs./-.- **Interest Rate:** 13% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - Loans should be applicable only for small-scale industries (SSI) Unit and Other Non-Farm Sector (NFS) Activities.

name: Financial Assistance for Normal Delivery and Surgical Delivery
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Normal Delivery and Surgical Delivery scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for natural delivery and delivery by cesarean operation to the wife of a registered male worker and/or to the registered female worker.
benefits: **Financial Assistance For:** - Normal Delivery- 15Rs./- - Surgical Delivery- 20Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered women construction worker under the MBOCWW or the wife of a registered male worker.
1. The applicant should be Pregnant.
1. Benefit is available for the first two deliveries only.

name: Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members
brief_description: The "Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide a medium-term loan facility to tribal members through the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society. The maximum loan amount is 60Rs./- with no interestRs. making it a cost-effective financing option for the community.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Loan up to 60Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** No interest.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should belong to the Tribal category. - The beneficiary should be a member of a Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society. - The beneficiary should be interested in availing Medium Term Loan from the Large Sized Multi Purpose Cooperative Society.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Fishing Boats (Catamarans)
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Fishing Boats (Catamarans)" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to offer financial assistance to farmers for acquiring fishing boats (Catamarans). The maximum loan amount is between 15Rs./- and 60Rs./-Rs. with interest rates subject to periodic updates.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Ranges from 15Rs./- to 60Rs./- for purchasing fishing boats. - **Interest Rate:** As per the bank policy (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in fishing activities. - The beneficiary should be interested in availing loan for Fishing Boats (Catamarans) from the Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for purchasing a fishing boat (Catamaran).

name: Incentive given to Encourage Inter caste Marriages
brief_description: The "Incentive for Encouraging Inter-Caste Marriages" scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Government of MaharashtraRs. and funded jointly by the State and Central Government (50:50). The scheme provides financial incentives to support inter-caste marriages between Savarna Hindus (including HinduRs. JainRs. LingayatRs. and Sikh communities) and individuals from Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Nomadic TribesRs. Nomadic CastesRs. and Special Backward Classes. The scheme promotes social harmony and aims to eradicate untouchability. The bride as well as the bridegroom should be permanent residents of Maharashtra.
benefits: A financial assistance of 50Rs./- issued as a joint draft in the names of both spouses.
eligibility:
1. The bride as well as the bridegroom should be permanent residents of Maharashtra.
1. One spouse must belong to the SavarnaRs. Hindu LingayatRs. JainRs. or Sikh community.
1. One spouse must belong to one of the following communities: Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Vimukta Jati (denoted tribe)Rs. Nomadic TribeRs. and Special Backward Class.
1. The male spouse should be 21 years or above in age.
1. The female spouse should be 18 years or above in age.

name: Employees Cooperative Societies Surety Loan
brief_description: The "Employees Cooperative Societies Surety Loan" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide a maximum loan amount of 1Rs./- at an interest rate of 14% (subject to change) through surety loans from the Employees Cooperative Societies. The purpose of this scheme is to extend loans to eligible citizens for financial support.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Surety loans up to 1Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 14% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a member of an Employees Cooperative Society. - The beneficiary should be interested in availing Employees Cooperative Societies Surety loan.

name: Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to reduce the economicRs. socialRs. and educational backwardness of Scheduled CastesRs. Freed CastesRs. Nomadic TribesRs. and Special Backward Classes in MaharashtraRs. helping integrate them into the mainstream of society. The grant is provided for the first marriage of both the bride and groom of these communities.
benefits:
1. A financial assistance of 10Rs./- is provided to couples who participate in mass marriage ceremonies.
1. An incentive grant of 2Rs./- per couple is offered to institutions and organizations that organize mass marriage ceremonies for these communities.
eligibility:
1. The bride and the groom must be residents of Maharashtra.
1. The groom should not be less than 21 years of age.
1. The bride should not be less than 18 years of age.
1. The grant is only admissible for the first marriage of the bride and groomRs. howeverRs. it is also admissible to a widow for her second marriage.
1. Either or both of the bride and groom must belong to Scheduled Castes (including Neo-Buddhists)Rs. Vimukta CastesRs. Nomadic Tribes (including Dhangars and Vanjaris)Rs. or Special Backward Classes.

name: Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18 scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a fixed deposit of 1Rs./- for one female child of a registered worker or spouse who has undergone a family planning operation after the birth of one female child.
benefits:
- Fixed deposit of 1Rs./- for one female child.
> **Note:** The fixed deposit will remain in the bank until the girl child turns 18 years old.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker in Maharashtra. 1. The worker or their spouse must have undergone contraceptive surgery after the birth of one female child.

name: Incentive For The Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Tribe Community
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive for Intra Caste Marriage within the Scheduled Tribe Community" was launched by the Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Karnataka. The scheme provides an incentive of 2Rs./- to couples who are both from the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community but belong to different sub-castes within the ST community. The marriage should have taken place on or after 1st April 2018. The couple must reside in Karnataka and apply for the scheme within one year of their marriage.
benefits: An incentive of 2Rs./- is provided to the married couple.
eligibility:
1. The couple should be residing in Karnataka.
1. Both the partners should be from the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community but from different sub-castes.
1. The combined annual income of the couple must be less than 2Rs./-.
1. The couple must apply to this scheme within one year of their marriage.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 1st April 2018.

name: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students
brief_description: The scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students" by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa aims to provide additional financial assistance to OBC (Dhangar) students to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance. Through this schemeRs. additional monthly allowances are provided to OBC (Dhangar) students to meet their foodRs. travelRs. and disability-related expensesRs. as the existing Post Matric Scholarship amounts are inadequate. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The scheme is being implemented by the Chief Minister Scholarship PortalRs. Government of Goa.
benefits:
**Additional Maintenance Allowance** - Day Scholars: 750 per month - Hostel Residents: 1Rs. per month **Duration:** 10 months during the academic year
**Additional Disability Allowance** Amount: 750 per month **Duration:** 10 months during the academic year
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should belong to the OBC (Dhangar) community.
- The applicant should have availed (or be eligible for) the Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship during the current academic year.

name: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana
brief_description: Beej Masaale Ki Yojana launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aims to encourage farmers to cultivate identified seed spices such as coriander and fenugreek keeping in mind their medicinal and nutritional properties. With the implementation of this schemeRs. the income of the farmers will increase as a result of increase in the production and productivity of seed spices.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% subsidy on the unit cost of 30Rs./- per hectareRs. amounting to 15Rs./- per hectare. (First year: 7Rs./- and Second year: 7Rs./-) - **Affordable High-Quality Seeds:** Farmers can access certified or verified quality seeds of spices through OTP verification from Bihar State Seed CorporationRs. Patna.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha). 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:** - General Category: 78.56%. - Scheduled Castes: 20%. - Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%. - Women Participation: 30%. > **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form. > **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
brief_description: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. aims to increase the production of Kufri Chipsona variety suitable for potato processing in Bihar by expanding its area and to increase the income of farmers by promoting processing. Under this schemeRs. certified quality seeds of Kufri Chipsona variety suitable for potato processing will be made available to farmers.
benefits: - **Affordable High-Quality Seeds:** Farmers will receive Kufri Chipsona-I potato seeds at an estimated price of 4Rs./- per quintal or the actual seed priceRs. whichever is lower. - **Financial Assistance:** Total 93Rs./- per hectare (First year: 70Rs./- and Second year: 23Rs./-).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 5 acres (2 ha).
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

<br>

> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:**



- General Category: 78.56%.
- Scheduled Castes: 20%.
- Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
- Women Participation: 30%.


> **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.

> **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Strawberry Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
The Strawberry Vikas Yojana a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar.
This component focuses on expanding strawberry farming through providing subsidies on seedlingsRs. wooden packaging boxesRs. and plastic containers.
benefits: 1. **Financial Assistance:** Farmers receive a subsidy of 3Rs./- per hectare to support strawberry farming. 1. **Subsidized Packaging Materials:** - 40% subsidy on wooden boxes for packaging (4.40/- per pieceRs. unit cost 11/-). - 40% subsidy on small plastic boxes (1/-per pieceRs. unit cost 2.50/-). 1. **Provision of Quality Seedlings:** High-quality strawberry seedlings are provided for cultivation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant must belong to any of the following district: GopalganjRs. JehanabadRs. LakhisaraiRs. SaranRs. SupaulRs. AurangabadRs. BegusaraiRs. BhagalpurRs. GayaRs. KatiharRs. KishanganjRs. MungerRs. MuzaffarpurRs. NalandaRs. West ChamparanRs. PatnaRs. East ChamparanRs. PurniyanRs. Samastipur and Vaishali.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 5 acres (2 ha).
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:**



- General Category: 78.56%.
- Scheduled Castes: 20%.
- Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
- Women Participation: 30%.


> **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.

> **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The Aam Vikas Yojana is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar. This component promotes mango cultivation across all districts in Bihar by providing financial assistance and high quality plants. It ensures inclusivity with reserved quotas for SCRs. STRs. and women beneficiaries. Payments are processed through DBTRs. and only ryot farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme.
benefits: > **Financial Support:** - **First year:** 18Rs./- per hectare. - **Second and third year:** 6Rs./- per hectare. > **Plant Distribution:** - Supply of high-quality plants.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a ryot farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha).
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:**



- General Category: 78.56%.
- Scheduled Castes: 20%.
- Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
- Women Participation: 30%.


> **Note 2:** The benefits of this scheme can be taken by ryot farmers on the basis of land documents and non-ryot farmers on the basis of contract form.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Hospitalization
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Hospitalization by the Labour DepartmentRs. offers assistance to transport workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident. Benefits are directly transferred to the beneficiaries' bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: - **Assistance for Hospitalization:** 400/- per day for the first 5 days of hospitalization due to an accident. - **Extended Financial Support:** 200/- per day for the remaining period of hospitalization after the first five days. - **Maximum Benefit:** Up to a total of 10Rs./- for the entire hospitalization period.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment.
1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses.
1. The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use.

name: Chhatrawas (Scheduled Caste)
brief_description:
Launched in 1966-67Rs. the "Chhatrawas" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide free residential facilities in Scheduled Caste hostels for boys and girls who are studying in recognized educational institutions. Students receive 1460/- to 1500/- per month for food and other related expenses.
**Note:** 90% of the scholarship amount is paid into the joint account of the hostel superintendent and mess secretary (student) for running the mess and the remaining 10% is paid into the student's account.
benefits:
**Financial Support:** Students receive 1460/- to 1500/- per month.
**Additional Facilities:** FoodRs. HostelRs. Material AssistanceRs. ScholarshipRs. Free Food and AccommodationRs. Sports EquipmentRs. Cosmetic Kit and Library Facility.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should be enrolled in a recognized educational institution.
1. The student should be a regular studentRs. attending classes in the institution.
1. The student should require residential facilities in the Scheduled Caste hostels.

name: Mukhyamatri Rojgaar Srijan Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Rojgaar Srijan Yojana" was launched by the Department of Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Minority and Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. MinoritiesRs. Backward ClassesRs. and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) by providing subsidized loans and financial assistance.
benefits:
***Subsidized Loan for Self-Employment:*** - 40% subsidy on loans or a maximum of 5Rs./-Rs. whichever is lower. - EMI will be calculated on the remaining loan amount after deducting the subsidy. ***Loan Guarantee Facility:*** - Loans up to 50Rs./- do not require a guarantor. - For loans above 50Rs./-Rs. a guarantor or collateral (movable/immovable property) is required. **Low Interest Rate:** - Loans are provided at an interest rate of 6%. ***Entrepreneurship Development Training:*** - Beneficiaries will receive training before starting their business ventures.
**NOTE:** For loans above 50Rs./-Rs. the applicant must deposit 10% of the loan amount as margin money.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 50 years.
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 5Rs./- for rural and urban areas.
1. The applicant should not be employed in any government or semi-government job.
1. The applicant must not be a loan defaulter in any bank.
1. Only environment-friendly business proposals are acceptable (businesses related to alcoholRs. drugsRs. or polythene are not allowed).
1. If the applicant is disabled the percentage of disability should not be less than 40%.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana" was introduced by the Rural Development DepartmentRs. BiharRs. to address the housing needs of beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Extremely Backward Classes whose cluster housingRs. built under previous schemes before January 1996Rs. has deteriorated. As these families are ineligible for the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana due to prior benefitsRs. this scheme provides financial assistance in three installments directly to the beneficiaries' accounts for reconstructing their homes.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- (Provided in three installments: 40Rs./- each through Direct Benefit Transfer or DBT).
eligibility:

name: Supply of Kadaknath Chicks on Subsidy
brief_description: The scheme "Supply of Kadaknath Chicken on Grant" by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Madhya Pradesh aims to improve the economic condition of beneficiaries through poultry farming and protect and promote the Kadaknath breed. Through this schemeRs. beneficiaries receive 40 chicks along with food grainsRs. medicineRs. and transportation support for 28 days without gender discrimination. The scheme is being implemented in all districts of the state.
benefits:
**Livestock Support**

- 40 Kadaknath chicks (65 per chick): 2Rs.
- Drug/Vaccination (5 per chick): 200
- Transportation (including chick box): 210

- Total unit cost: 4Rs.

- Government grant: 75% of total cost

1. The applicant can be from any category of poultry farmers.

name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana" by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to improve rural connectivity by incentivizing private bus operators and enhancing transportation facilities for rural residents. Under this schemeRs. rural routes connect remote villages to block headquartersRs. district headquartersRs. schoolsRs. collegesRs. medical institutionsRs. main roadsRs. and commercial centers.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** Operators receive financial support per kilometer based on bus seating capacity
- 33 to 42 seats: 18 per km.
- 25 to 32 seats: 14.50 per km.
- 13 to 24 seats: 10.50 per km.
- 7 to 12 seats: 7.50 per km.

- **Tax and Fee Waivers:** Exemption from road taxRs. permit fee (1)Rs. application fee (1)Rs. registration fee (1)Rs. and fitness inspection fee (1).- **Priority Access:** Rural buses are given priority at government bus stands and are exempted from all stand feesRs. tollsRs. and municipal entry fees.- **Route Permits:** Operators can obtain permits for routes up to 125 kmRs. connecting villages to block/district headquarters and essential services.- **Subsidies:** Operators can avail subsidies for operational costs such as fuel (diesel).- **Renewal Options:** Permits are renewable after five years based on satisfactory performance or till the scheme's validity.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a private bus operator registered in Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must operate new light/medium commercial four-wheeled vehicles with seating capacities ranging from 7 to 42 (excluding the driver).
1. The applicant must ensure the vehicles comply with the Motor Vehicles ActRs. 1988Rs. and have either a Hard Top or Soft Top body.
1. Preference will be given to vehicles connecting rural routes to block/district headquartersRs. schoolsRs. collegesRs. hospitalsRs. and main roads.
1. The applicant must agree to operate vehicles on approved routes and adhere to the fare structure prescribed by the government.
1. Operators who have previously violated permit conditions may be excluded from the scheme.

name: Shaktidoot Scheme
brief_description: The "Shaktidoot Scheme" SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. is designed to nurture promising athletes in Gujarat by providing resources to help them excel in sports. The scheme focuses on developing champions by offering need-based assistanceRs. including nutritious foodRs. advanced sports facilitiesRs. modern equipmentRs. competition expensesRs. expert trainersRs. psychological workshopsRs. and sports medicine. Financial aid varies based on the athletes potentialRs. achievementsRs. and the level of competition they participate in. Additional provisions include medical coverage and accidental death insurance.
benefits:
1. **Financial Support:** Up to 25Rs./- per year for Olympic-level (2020/2024) athletes. 1. **Sports Equipment:** Custom kits and advanced training tools. 1. **Medical Coverage:** 5Rs./- mediclaim and accidental death insurance. 1. **Nutrition and Diet Plans:** Customized diet plans and financial aid for supplementary nutrition. 1. **Psychological Workshops:** Mental training and focus improvement sessions. 1. **International Training and Competition:** Travel and training expenses for global events. 1. **Accommodation and Coaching:** Expert coaching and necessary arrangements for advanced training..
> **Duration of benefits:** The initial duration is 2 yearsRs. which can be extended for up to 7 years based on the athlete's performance and progress.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must have participated in games recognized by the School Games Federation of India or included in the Commonwealth GamesRs. Asian GamesRs. Afro-Asian GamesRs. or OlympicsRs. as determined by a committee appointed by the Government.
1. The applicant must below 20 years of age.
1. The applicant must have won state-level competitions based on their sporting achievements.
1. The applicant must have achieved success in junior or sub-junior competitions of the open category organized by a recognized All India FederationRs. prioritized based on their accomplishments.
1. The applicant must not use banned substances or have any impairment that disqualifies them from participationRs. as such individuals will be immediately dropped from the scheme.

> **Note:**


1. The applicants sports achievements over the previous two years will be considered for selection under the scheme.
1. The above criteria for eligibility will be generally taken into account but the committee may decide to grant such players an exceptional status under this scheme in view of the exceptional achievements of any athleteRs. in order to expand his talent at the international level and to fully develop his abilities.

name: Mukhyamantri Apprenticeship Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Apprenticeship Yojana (MAY)"Rs. launched in 2018-19 by the Labour and Employment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. seeks to create a robust ecosystem for skill development through "on-the-job" and "off-the-job" training. The scheme aligns with national initiatives like the "National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)" and the "National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)"Rs. targeting to engage 1 lakh youth in apprenticeships. The scheme provides additional incentives for employers beyond the benefits under NAPS and NATS.
benefits:
**Categories of apprentices****Stipend**Trade apprentice (MSDE)1500/-Optional trade apprentice (MSDE)3000/- (Graduate ); 2000/- (Any Diploma); 1500/- (Others)Technician (Vocational) apprentices (MSDE)1500/-Technician apprentices (MOE) (Diploma in engineering or non-engineering stream and undergoing apprenticeship training in designated trades)2000/-Graduate apprentices (MOE) (Graduates in engineering or non-engineering stream and undergoing apprenticeship training in designated trades)3000/-

Farmers are encouraged to plant trees on their lands with incentives covering 75% of plantation and maintenance costs over three years.
> ***Objectives of the scheme:*** - To increase the green cover in the state and maintain environmental balance. - To promote groundwater conservation through afforestation. - To encourage forest produce in private sectorsRs. reducing pressure on notified forests. - To enhance farmers' income by planting trees on their land. - To boost afforestation in the state with public participation.
