name: Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao YojanaRs. implemented by the Technical Education and Manpower Planning DepartmentRs. aims to provide On-the-Job Training (OJT) to youth with formal education in registered industrial and commercial establishments. This initiative encourages industries and businesses to actively participate in skill development while enabling young individuals to gain practical experience. 1Rs./- youth will benefit annuallyRs. with the flexibility to increase the target based on demand. AdditionallyRs. each participant will receive a stipend of up to 1Rs./-Rs. funded by the state governmentRs. during their training period.
benefits:
- Skill Enhancement: Offers practical training to improve job readiness.
- Stipend Support: Provides up to 1 lakh as financial aid during training.
- 12th Pass: 8Rs. per month.
- ITI Pass: 8Rs. per month.
- Diploma Pass: 9Rs. per month.
- Graduate or Higher Qualification: 10Rs. per month.

1. The applicant should be educated with a minimum qualification of 12th passRs. ITIRs. or higher.
1. The applicant should be designated as a Student-Trainee upon selection.

name: Ashram Schools (Scheduled Tribes)
brief_description: The scheme "Ashram Schools" was launched on 1st January 1966 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides free accommodationRs. messRs. and education facilities to Scheduled Tribe students.
benefits: Providing free accommodationRs. messRs. and education facilities.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The student should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.

name: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme" launched by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to empower widowed women by offering financial supportRs. ensuring they achieve self-reliance and dignity. benefits: **Monthly Pension:** Monthly financial assistance of 1Rs./-.

- The applicant must be a widowed woman.
- The applicant must be aged 18 years or above.
- The applicants annual income must not exceed 1Rs./- in rural areas and 1Rs./- in urban areas.

name: Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment
brief_description: The "Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment" scheme by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to increase milk production through employment generation and breed improvement. Under this initiativeRs. trained Gausevaks will receive an honorarium of 4Rs. along with equipment worth 18Rs.. Eligible candidates include pre-selected Gausevaks or unemployed youth (10th pass and above 18 years of age). This initiative promotes self-employment and strengthens the dairy sector.
benefits: - **Financial Support:** Trained Gausevaks receive an honorarium of 4Rs. and equipment worth 18Rs..- **Skill Development:** Provides three months of free training in artificial inseminationRs. including theory and practical sessions.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an unemployed youth.
1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old.
1. The applicant should have passed the 10th standard.
1. The applicant should have a keen interest in dairy farming and artificial insemination.

name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana
brief_description: The "Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher EducationRs. Department of Higher and Technical EducationRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide free coaching and financial assistance to students preparing for competitive exams conducted by national and state-level agencies. - 2Rs./- monthly stipends per student during the coaching period.
- Coaching will be provided by nationally reputed institutions within Jharkhand.

name: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
brief_description: The "Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students" scheme was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical EducationRs. Government of JharkhandRs. a wonderful opportunity for female students (Regular and Lateral Entry) pursuing B.Tech. at BIT Sindri. name: Special Health Scheme for Primitive Tribes

Government of JharkhandRs. aims to improve healthcare access and outcomes for primitive tribal communities. name: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher EducationRs. Department of Higher and Technical EducationRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide free coaching and financial assistance to students preparing for National Level Competitive Examinations like JEERs. NEETRs. CLATRs. NHMCETRs. NIFT-CET etcRs..
benefits:
- 2Rs./- monthly stipends per student during the coaching period.
- Free of cost coaching facility in reputed coaching institutes.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Jharkhand state.
1. The student should have passed class 10th from any recognized school in the state of Jharkhand **or** the student should possess a local residence certificate of Jharkhand. 1. 1. The student's annual family income should be less than 8Rs./- **or** the student should be covered under the National/State Food Security Scheme. 1. An applicant who has already received similar benefits from another department is not eligible for dual benefits.

name: Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar Yojana is implemented by the Department of HealthRs. Medical Education & Family WelfareRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide financial assistance for the treatment of critical illnesses such as cancerRs. kidney transplantRs. and severe liver diseasesRs. as well as support to acid attack victims. - Kidney transplant.
- Severe liver diseases.

name: Sports Scholarship Jharkhand
brief_description: The "Sports Scholarship" scheme implemented by the Department of WelfareRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to encourage sports participation and promote excellence among Scheduled Tribe students. The scheme provides scholarshipsRs. incentivesRs. and sports materials to student-athletes. The District Welfare Office coordinates with local administrations to implement the scheme.

> ***Scholarship for Student-Athletes:*** - 2Rs./- per year for middle and high school students. - 3Rs./- per year for college-level athletes.

name: Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST
brief_description: The scheme "Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST" by the Department of Information TechnologyRs. Electronics and CommunicationRs. Government of Goa aims to provide laptops to the meritorious students who were born in Goa. name: Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides financial support for residential facilities to Scheduled Caste students who are studying in colleges outside their native village/cityRs. enabling them to continue their college education.

- 2Rs./- per monthRs. if the student is residing in a Divisional headquarters (BhopalRs. IndoreRs. GwaliorRs. JabalpurRs. Ujjain).
- 1Rs./- per monthRs. if the student is residing in Other District Headquarters.

1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a College Student.
1. The applicant should meet the income limit prescribed under the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme.
1. The applicant should be residing outside their native city/village.

name: INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to disburse monthly pensions to destitute weavers who are 50 years or above in age. benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Panchayat Secretary disburses the pension to the eligible citizensRs. in the presence of SarpanchRs. Gram Panchayat Members and the Office Bearers of Village Organization.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should be a local resident of the district.
- The applicant should be from a rural area.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.
- The applicant should be a Weaver.
- The applicant should be 50 years of age or above in age.

_* The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Gram Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Panchayat Secretary with the Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO)._

name: Widow Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)

name: Refund of Fees

name: Gopal Incentive Scheme

Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to promote the rearing of Indian high-breed cattle and encourage increased milk production. benefits:
**Development Block Level Awards**

- Second Prize: 7Rs./-
- Third Prize: 5Rs./-

- Consolation Prize: 5Rs./- (Total 35Rs./-Rs. seven awards of 5Rs./- each)

name: Disability Pension (HPBOCWWB)

Government of Himachal PradeshRs. provides a monthly pension of 500/- to registered beneficiaries in case of disability caused by accidents or diseases. 1. The disability should have been caused due to an accident or an illness.

name: Cash Prizes Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Cash Prizes Scheme" was launched by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Students securing 60% or more in the 10th and 12th exams receive cash prizes of up to 25Rs./- per year. Upto two children of a registered construction worker are eligible.
benefits:
- On securing 80% or more in the 10th or 12th examination: 25Rs./- per year.
- On securing 70% to 79.99% in the 10th or 12th examination: 15Rs./- per year.
- On securing 60% to 69.99% in the 10th or 12th examination: 10Rs./- per year.
eligibility:
**For the Worker**

- The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
- The worker should be registered with the "Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
- The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
- The worker should have at least one year of membership with the Board.
- A maximum of two children of the registered construction worker will be eligible for the benefit.

**For the Child**

- The child should have passed the 10th or 12th examination conducted by a board in Bihar.
- The child should have scored 60% or above in the examination.

name: INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)
brief_description: Launched in 2006-07Rs. the scheme "INDIRAMMA Disabled Pension (Urban)" by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Andhra PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to persons with disabilities of 40% or above who are 18 years of age or above. To be eligibleRs. they should be from a BPL familyRs. be a resident of a district of Andhra PradeshRs. and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme. The eligible individuals will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals on the first date of every month.
benefits:
**Pension Amount:** The scale of benefit under the pension will be notified by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Bill Collector disburses the pension to the eligible individuals in the presence of Ward members and office bearers of DWCUA.
**Time of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on the first date of every month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a local resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh.
- The applicant should be from an urban area.
- The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
- The applicant should have a minimum of 40% disability.
- The applicant should be 18 years of age or above.
- The applicant should not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

_*The eligible citizens will be identified by their respective Ward Sabhas. The register containing the list of eligible citizens will be shared by the Bill Collector with the Municipal Commissioner._

name: State Merit Scholarship to Under Graduate Girls Students
brief_description: The scheme "Merit Scholarship to Undergraduate Girl Students" by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Haryana aims to promote higher education among meritorious girl students by providing a scholarship amount of 3Rs. per annum to 10 eligible girl students per government college who have excelled in their 10+2 examination. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Higher EducationRs. HaryanaRs. ensuring that financial barriers do not hinder academically bright students from continuing their undergraduate education. The scholarship is awarded based on meritRs. subject to renewal criteriaRs. and is disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.
benefits:
**Scholarship Amount**

- 3Rs./- per student per annum.
- Awarded to 10 girl students per government college.

**Conditions for Scholarship Renewal**

- The scholarship is tenable for three years during undergraduate studies.
- To continue receiving the scholarshipRs. the applicant must secure at least 55% marks in the qualifying examination each year.


- If an applicant cannot appear for the annual exam due to illnessRs. renewal may be granted upon submission of a valid medical certificate approved by the Head of the Institution.

**Mode Disbursement**

- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

**Validity**

- Only for students pursuing general academic courses in Government Colleges.
- Scholarship renewal depends on satisfactory progress and conduct.
- The scholarship may be revoked or changed at any time at the discretion of the government.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should have passed 10+2 with at least 60% marks.
1. The applicant should be pursuing an undergraduate general degree course in a Government College in Haryana.
1. The applicant should not hold any other scholarship or stipend.
1. The applicant may accept a grant for booksRs. equipmentRs. boardingRs. or lodging from the State Government or other sources.
1. There is no income limit for availing of this scholarship.

**Preference/Priority**
If multiple students secure the same marksRs. priority will be given based on:

- Marks are calculated up to three decimal places.
- If still tiedRs. the younger applicant will get priority.

name: Maternity Benefits Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Maternity Benefits Scheme" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare BoardRs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides an amount equivalent to 90 days of the minimum wages set by the State Government for unskilled workers at the time of childbirth. This benefit is applicable for the first two deliveries. The applicant should be a female construction worker who has completed one year of membership with the Board.
benefits: Financial assistance equivalent to 90 days of the minimum wages set by the State Government for unskilled workers.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be female.
- The applicant should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB).
- The applicant should have completed at least one year of membership with the Board.
- The membership must be active at the time of application.
- The benefits will be provided for the first two childbirths.

name: Dilli Swarojgar Yojna
brief_description: The scheme "Dilli Swarojgar Yojna" by the Delhi Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. and Minorities Financial and Development Corporation (DSFDC)Rs. Government of National Capital Territory (NCT) of DelhiRs. aims to provide need-based loans up to 5Rs./- at an interest rate of 6% per annum for various income-generating activities. The scheme targets individuals from Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Other Backward Classes (OBC)Rs. and Minority communitiesRs. enabling them to start or expand small businesses. Eligible applicants must be residents of Delhi for the last five yearsRs. aged between 18 to 50 yearsRs. and have an annual family income not exceeding 2Rs./-. The loans are disbursed for activities such as vegetable/fruit/flower shopsRs. dairy productsRs. tailoring shopsRs. and other permissible non-polluting manufacturing activities.
benefits: Need-based loans up to 5Rs./- at an interest rate of 6% per annum to support an [income-generating activity](https://dsfdc.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/dsy_scheme_details.pdf) mentioned in the scheme guidelines.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. Minority.
- The applicant must be a resident of Delhi for the last five years.
- The applicants age should be between 18 to 50 years.
- The annual family income of the applicantRs. from all sourcesRs. should not exceed 2Rs./-.
- The applicant should be willing to pursue one of the [income-generating activities](https://dsfdc.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/dsy_scheme_details.pdf) given in the scheme guidelines - - The applicant must have a proper workplace for starting the proposed activityRs. either owned by the applicant or their relative or rented.
- The applicant should not have been declared a defaulter under any of the schemes being implemented by the DSFDC.
- The applicant should have passed a minimum 8th standard.
- The applicant should have technical qualifications for the proposed activity. HoweverRs. this will not apply to traditional artisans or entrepreneurs already engaged in the activity for which the loan is appliedRs. for the past three years at least.

name: Big Loan Scheme
brief_description: "Big Loan Scheme" by the Delhi Scheduled Castes/Other Backward Classes/Minorities & Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation Limited (DSFDC)Rs. Government of National Capital Territory (GNCT) of DelhiRs. aims to provide term loans up to 5Rs./- for setting up income-generating activities under permissible non-polluting trades in Delhi. The scheme targets marginalized groupsRs. including Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. Safai KaramcharisRs. and Persons with Disabilities. The scheme is implemented by DSFDC in collaboration with National Apex Corporations.
benefits:
Term loan of up to 5Rs./- as a part of the total project cost / loan demanded by the aspirant applicants/beneficiaries on case to case basis.
_*Repay the loan in 60 monthly installments over five years with a six-month moratorium period._
_*For Persons with DisabilitiesRs. the maximum repayment period is ten years with a three-month moratorium period._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Delhi.
- The applicants age should be between 18 and 50 years.
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. Safai KaramcharisRs. and Persons with Disabilities.
- The annual family income of the applicant under Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. and Minority categories should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.
- For the creamy layer of the Minority categoryRs. the maximum income ceiling is 6Rs./- per annum.
- There is no income limit under Persons with Disabilities and Safai Karamchari categories.
- The applicant should not have been declared a defaulter under any scheme of DSFDCRs. Nationalized BankRs. Financial InstitutionRs. or Co-operative Bank.
- The applicant should possess knowledge and experience as per the requirement of the scheme.
- The applicant must have valid permissions like SSI CertificateRs. Pollution Control CertificateRs. or any other required permissions for setting up the Business/Industry (Manufacturing Unit) if required on a case-to-case basis.
- The loan is provided for setting up of Income Generating Activities under the permissible non-polluting trades approved in Delhi. However for manufacturing unitsRs. the work place should be in approved industrial area.

name: Artisan Promotion
brief_description: The scheme "Artisan Promotion" by the Delhi Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Safai Karamchari Finance and Development Corporation (DSFDC)Rs. Government of DelhiRs. aims to provide artisans with opportunities to showcase their talents by participating in various national fairs and exhibitions (ShilpotsavRs. IITFRs. East Himalaya ExpoRs. International Surajkund Mela) organized by the different National Apex Corporations. The scheme offers financial support for participation feesRs. lodgingRs. boardingRs. and stipendsRs. enabling artisans to gain exposureRs. recognitionRs. and financial benefits. The scheme is implemented by the DSFDC in collaboration with various National Apex Corporations.
benefits:
The Corporation provides opportunities for artisans to participate in fairs and melas organized by different National Apex Corporations.
> **Stipend for Beneficiaries from Scheduled Castes Category**


- Daily Allowance (DA) for Participant: 150/- per day
- DA for Attendant/Spouse: 100/- per day
- Travel Allowance (TA): Actual train fare by sleeper class or bus fare (on production of original tickets)
- Hotel Accommodation: 200/- per day (Male)Rs. 300/- per day (Female)
- Luggage/Transportation: 500/-

> **Stipend for Beneficiaries from Minority Category**


- DA for Participant: 1200/- per day (maximum for boarding & lodging for one person only)
- TA: Actual train fare by sleeper 2nd class or bus fare (on production of original tickets) one side.
- Other Backward Class Category:
- Reimbursement of to and fro 2nd Class journey by train/bus fare against the original tickets to participant and one helper.
- 150/- per day as daily allowance to the participant.
- Maximum 500/- towards freight charges for the luggage.

> **Stipend for Beneficiaries from Safai Karamcharis Category**


- To and Fro 2nd Class train ticket fare/bus for the shortest route & reasonable coolie charges.
- DA: 150/- per day per member.
- Lodging facility will be provided by the NSKFDC or 250/- per dayRs. per member.
- Local conveyance: 100/- per day per member or transport provided by NSKFDC.

> **Stipend for Beneficiaries from Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) Category**


- 500/- per day (including attendant).
- To & Fro 2nd Class fare of Train or Bus and maximum 6000/-.
- Boarding & Lodging: 500/- per day.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an Artisan.
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinorityRs. Safai KaramchariRs. and Persons with Disabilities.
- The applicant should be a beneficiary of the Delhi Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Safai Karamchari Finance and Development Corporation (DSFDC).
- The applicant should have availed a loan from DSFDC.
- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be registered online under MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSME) at the website www.udyogaadhar.gov.in.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
brief_description: The "Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender" scheme was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to support transgender students by providing scholarships to encourage their education and social upliftment. Under this schemeRs. transgender students receive a monthly scholarship to cover educational expenses from primary to pre-matric levels.
benefits:
***Pre-Matric Scholarship:***

- 225/- per month per student for 10 months.

**NOTE:** The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community.
1. The applicant should be studying at the primary to pre-matric level.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school within Rajasthan.
1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Post Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
brief_description: The "Transgender Utthan Kosh - Post Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender" scheme was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to support transgender students pursuing post-matric education. Under this schemeRs. transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of 1Rs./- to cover educational expenses for their post-matric studies.
benefits:
***Post-Matric Scholarship:***

- Scholarship @ 1Rs./- per month per student for 10 months.

**NOTE:** The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community.
1. The applicant should be studying at the post-matric level.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school/college in Rajasthan.
1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme
brief_description: The "Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. during the financial year 202122. It aims to provide financial assistance for accommodation to students from SCRs. STRs. OBCRs. MBCRs. and EWS categories who are regularly studying in undergraduate or postgraduate courses at government colleges located at the district level in Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. eligible students residing in rented accommodations receive 2Rs. per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- 2Rs./- per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year.

**Note:** Students will be paid on monthly/monthly basis.
**Duration of Benefit:**

- Maximum 5 years per student.

**Total Number of Beneficiaries:**

- 5Rs. students annually.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST)Rs. Other Backward Class (OBC)Rs. Most Backward Class (MBC) or Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government college at the district level for the academic course.
1. The student should be regularly enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at a government college.
1. The student should be pursuing an academic course in a government college located at the district level.
1. The student should not be a resident of the Municipal CorporationRs. Municipal CouncilRs. or Municipality of the district where they are studying.
1. The student whose parent/guardian owns a house in the city or town where they are studying is not eligible for benefits under this scheme.
1. The student who is residing in government-run hostel will not be eligible for benefits under the scheme.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be available to the student for a maximum of five years.
1. The annual income of the applicants family should not exceed:


- SC/ST/MBC: 2Rs./-
- OBC: 1Rs./-
- EWS: 1Rs./-

name: Motorized Tricycle Yojana
brief_description: The "Motorized Tricycle Yojana" is a scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. motorized tricycles are provided to eligible applicants for purposes such as self-employment and pursuing higher education from Senior Higher Secondary onwards. To be eligible for the schemeRs. the applicant must be a resident of RajasthanRs. a specially-abled person with 50% or more locomotor disabilityRs. and possess driving experience along with a valid driving license.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries will receive a motorized tricycle free of cost to support self-employment and higher education from the Senior Secondary level onwards.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be self-employed or a student pursuing senior higher secondary education.
1. The applicant must have a 50% or more locomotor disability.
1. The annual family (parents/guardians including applicant's incomeRs. if any) income should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The applicant's age must be 18 years or older.
1. The applicant must have prior experience in operating a vehicle and hold a valid driving license.

name: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances
brief_description:
The scheme "Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances" is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and the purchase of artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
Under this schemeRs. the beneficiaries receive financial assistance to procure prosthetic aids and equipment such as tricyclesRs. crutchesRs. wheelchairsRs. calipersRs. hearing aidsRs. blind sticksRs. smartphonesRs. Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm padsRs. etc.
benefits:
1. Financial assistance of up to 10Rs./- for purchasing artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
1. Covers aids like tricyclesRs. crutchesRs. wheelchairsRs. calipersRs. hearing aidsRs. blind sticksRs. smartphonesRs. Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm padsRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a disabled person.
1. The applicant should be suffering from 40% disability.
1. The applicants family should not be an income tax payer.

name: Self-Employment Scheme: Transport/ Logistics/ Travels/ Food Court Wyaaj Sahaay
brief_description: "Transport/ Logistics/ Travels/ Food Court Wyaaj Sahaay" is a component under the "Self-Employment Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries can avail of a 5% interest subsidy on a bank loan of 6.00 lakh for purchasing vehicles and setting up the required infrastructure for businesses like transportRs. logisticsRs. travelersRs. food courtsRs. etc.
benefits: - **Interest Subsidy:** A 5% subsidy on the interest for a bank loan of 6Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the unreserved category. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 years and 50 years. 1. The applicant must have a valid driving license. 1. The vehicle purchased under the scheme must be mortgaged (hypothecated) to the corporation. 1. The applicant must be willing to repay the loan in equal monthly installments over 5 years. 1. The annual income limit of the family should be 6Rs./- or less.
> **Note**: - The interest rate on the loan will be 5 percent simple interest per annum. - The simple interest will be calculated based on the amount of the loan given per year. - Only 1 person from a family can avail of the scheme benefits. - A maximum of 5 beneficiaries per village will be selected.

name: Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2007-08Rs. the scheme "Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana" by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Federation Limited aims to encourage and motivate the talented children of weaver families for higher education. The scheme provides monetary incentives to children of weavers who perform well in their 10th and 12th board examinations. It is designed for students whose parents are members of primary weaver cooperative societies affiliated with the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Federation LimitedRs. Raipur.
benefits:
The scheme provides monetary incentives to children of weavers based on their performance in 10th and 12th board examinations.
**For 10th Pass Students**

- 60% and above marks: 4Rs./-
- 70% and above marks: 8Rs./-
- 80% and above marks: 12Rs./-
- 90% and above marks: 16Rs./-

**For 12th Pass Students**

- 60% and above marks: 6Rs./-
- 70% and above marks: 10Rs./-
- 80% and above marks: 14Rs./-
- 90% and above marks: 20Rs./-
eligibility:
- The student's parent must be a regular member of a primary weaver cooperative society affiliated with the "Chhattisgarh Rajya Hathkargha Vikas Evam Vipanan Sahkari Sangh MaryaditRs. Raipur".
- The student must be a resident of Chhattisgarh state.
- The student's parent must be a regular member of the weaver cooperative society.
- The student must have passed 10th or 12th board examination with 60% or above marks.
- The parent's income from weaving should be more than 50% of their total income.

_*Weaver family refers to husbandRs. wifeRs. and their children._

name: Self-Employment Scheme: Vahan Loan Sahay Yojana
brief_description: "Vahan Loan Sahay Yojana" is a component under the "Self-Employment Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. self-employed individuals can avail of financial assistance as on-road unit cost for purchasing vehicles such as rickshawsRs. loading rickshawsRs. Maruti carsRs. jeep taxisRs. etc. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** On-road unit cost for vehicles like rickshawsRs. loading rickshawsRs. MarutiRs. jeep-taxiRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the unreserved category. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 years and 50 years. 1. The applicant must have a valid driving license. 1. The vehicle purchased under the scheme must be mortgaged (hypothecated) to the corporation. 1. The applicant must be willing to repay the loan in equal monthly installments over 5 years. 1. The annual income limit of the family should be 6Rs./- or less.
> **Note**: 1. The interest rate on the loan will be 5 percent simple interest per annum and 4 percent for women. 1. The simple interest will be calculated based on the amount of the loan given per year. 1. Only 1 person from a family can avail of the scheme benefits. 1. A maximum of 5 beneficiaries per village will be selected.

name: Coaching Help Scheme
brief_description: The "Coaching Help Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. offers an annual incentive to eligible students for tuition classes outside their school/college. The aim is to help academically bright students continue their studies without financial constraints.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 15Rs./- per year for coaching expenses outside the school/college.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a non-reserved category.
1. The applicant must have scored 70% or more in Standard 10th.
1. The applicant must be currently studying in the science stream in Standard 11th or Standard 12th.
1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 4Rs./-.


**Note:** The applicant can avail of the assistance only once per academic year.

name: Promotion of Science Education (POSE) Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Promotion of Science Education (POSE) Scholarship Scheme is implemented by the Haryana State Council for ScienceRs. Innovation & TechnologyRs. aims to encourage meritorious students towards science education and to support them for continuation of their science education up to higher level. Under this schemeRs. scholarships are awarded to the meritorious students to pursue their higher studies in Basic & Natural Science subjects i.e. B.Sc./B.S./B. Stat/B. Math/Integrated M.Sc./M.S. in (1) Physics (2) Chemistry (3) Mathematics (4) Biology (5) Statistics (6) Geology (7) Astrophysics (8) Astronomy (9) Electronics (10) Botany (11) Zoology (12) Bio-Chemistry (13) Anthropology (14) Microbiology (15) Geophysics (16) Geochemistry (17) Atmospheric Sciences (18) Oceanic Sciences (19) Ecology (20) Marine Biology (21) Genetics (22) Biophysics.
***Admissibility of Scholarship:***
The scholarships are limited only to the students who have taken admission in the first year in basic and natural science subjects in B.Sc./B.S./ B. Stat./B. Math/Integrated M.Sc./M.S. in Basic & Natural Science subjects in India.
benefits:
***Amount of Scholarships:***

- 1st to 3rd year of B.Sc./B.S./ B.Stat./B.Math/Integrated M.Sc./M.S. 4000/- pm.
- 4th to 5th years of Integrated B.S./B. Stat/B. Math/M.Sc./M.S./ M. Math./ M.Stat. 6000/- pm.

**Note:** The selected students will get mentorship grant (one time) of 12Rs./- in 3-year B.Sc. programRs. 17Rs./- in 4-year B.S. programRs. 22Rs./- in 5-year integrated M.Sc. program.
***Additional Features:***

- Reimbursement for research project expensesRs. including travelRs. accommodationRs. and equipment costs.

***Number of Scholarship:***

- 250 (upto post-graduate level)

***Notes:***

- The scholarships will be disbursed directly to the students in their bank accounts through online (NEFT / RTGS).
- The student may ensure that their bank account number should be linked with Aadhar Number.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a permanent residence of Haryana.
1. The students should have passed class X and XII Board examination from a school situated in Haryana with minimum 80% marks for Haryana Board School and 85% marks for other boards like CBSE/ICSE etc. in 12th class.
1. The students passing X or XII board examination from a school outside Haryana have to produce Haryana Residence Certificate.
1. The criteria mentioned in clause (2) above is not applicable to students admitted in reputed National Institutes i.e. Indian Institute of Technology (IIT)Rs. Indian Statistical Institute (ISI)Rs. Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER)Rs. National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER)Rs. Department of Atomic Energy Centre for Basic Sciences (DAE-CBS)Rs. Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in basic and natural science course.

***In case of tie preference will be given as under:***

1. Girl students will be preferred.
1. Preference to language score better of (English/Hindi) in 12th class board.
1. Student younger in age will be preferred.

***Other Terms & Conditions:***

1. The students selected under this scheme will not be entitled for any other scholarship.
1. This scholarship will be given to the students studying basic & natural science in the identified 22 subjects.
1. Only regular students will be eligible to apply for this scholarship.
1. The students studying privately or through correspondence / distance mode or in unrecognized institutions will not be eligible for this scholarship.

***Selection Criteria/Preparation of Merit List:***

1. First priority will be accorded to the students whose names appear in the Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY) aptitude testRs. 2021 (SARs. SX stream) extended list published by KVPYRs. IIScRs. Banglore and admitted in a basic and natural science course.
1. Second priority will be accorded to the students admitted in a reputed national institute i.e. IITRs. ISIRs. IISERRs. NISERRs. DAE-CBSRs. IISc in basic and natural science course.
1. Remaining scholarshipsRs. if anyRs. will be given to the others admitted in a basic and natural science course on merit. Merit list will be prepared based on average percentage score obtained in class 12th board examination in English/Hindi (better of the two) and best of three out of PhysicsRs. ChemistryRs. Mathematics and Biology (i.e. Total of four subjects divided by maximum marks in four subjects = %age).

**Note:** If number of students under (1) or (2) above is more than the number of offered scholarshipsRs. 12th board examination as mentioned under (3) will apply to shortlist the students within that category.

- Students who studied 11th & 12th class in a rural area school will be given additional 2% Rural area school will be regarded as those schools which are within the jurisdiction of the Gram Panchayat.
- The students who have passed their 11th & 12th class from rural area elite schools will not be given additional weightage of 2%. Elite schools are defined to be schoolsRs. where tuition fees and other charges payable exceed Rs. one lakh per year.
- Additional weightage would be added to the average percentage score obtained by the student for determining inter se merit (for example if a student got 90% marks in 12th class board exam and he/she has passed 11th and 12th class from a non-elite rural area school then his/her marks will be considered as 92%).
- The students claiming the benefit of rural area must submit the rural area school certificate of passing 11th and 12th class from the rural area school duly signed by the Principal of the schoolRs. Sarpanch/Gram Sachiv of the village panchayat from where 11th and 12th class passed and concerned BDPO.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi)" by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Ministry of EducationRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide financial support to meritorious students so that financial constraints do not prevent any youth of India from pursuing quality higher education. The scheme provides collateral-freeRs. guarantor-free education loans through a simpleRs. transparentRs. student-friendly and entirely digital application processRs. with 3% interest subvention for students from families with annual income up to 8Rs.. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must get admission on their own merit to one of the 860 designated Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) in India. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Higher Education in coordination with Canara Bank as the nodal bank. The applications for this scheme are accepted Online.
benefits: - A special loan product of collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans for students admitted to QHEIs. - The loan amount depends on the course fee and other associated expenses (messRs. hostel feeRs. refundable and non-refundable feesRs. laptopRs. living expenses) with no upper limit. - 75% credit guarantee by the Government of India for loan amounts up to 7Rs. irrespective of family income. - 3% interest subvention on loans up to 10Rs. for students with annual family income up to 8Rs. during the moratorium period (course period plus one year). - Full interest subvention is already offered to students with up to 4Rs. annual family income under PM-USP CSIS for technical/professional courses. - Interest rate capped at individual bank's Externally Benchmarked Lending Rate (EBLR) + 0.5%. - Up to 1% additional interest concession if interest is serviced during the study period and the moratorium period. - Repayment period up to 15 yearsRs. excluding moratorium period. - The interest subvention amount will be credited to PM-VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL RUPEE APP (CBDC WALLET) of the beneficiary and on redemption on the app by the beneficiaryRs. the amount will be transferred to the beneficiary loan account.
eligibility: **For Students** - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must get merit-based admission to one of the 860 designated Quality Higher Educational Institutions (QHEIs) in India. - The applicant must not be admitted through the management quota or a similar quota. - The applicant must have an annual family income of up to 8Rs. to qualify for 3% interest subvention. - The applicant must not be receiving any other Central/State Government Scholarship or interest subvention scheme or fee reimbursement. - The applicant must not discontinue the course midstream or be expelled from the institution on disciplinary or academic grounds. - The applicant must maintain satisfactory academic performance to receive interest subvention from the 2nd year onwards. - The applicant can avail interest subvention and credit guarantee benefits only onceRs. either for an undergraduate or postgraduate or integrated course. **For Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs)** The following institutions are eligible - - Top 100 ranked HEIs in the overall/category-specific and/or domainspecific rankings in latest list of NIRF published by the Ministry of Education. - Top 200 ranked HEIs under the governance of state/UT governments in the latest list of NIRF published by the Ministry of Education. - All remaining HEIs under the governance of the Government of India. _*Indian campuses of foreign education institutionsRs. foreign campuses of Indian education institutions and foreign education institutions will not be covered._

name: Special Jobs to PwDs - Helper
brief_description: The scheme "Special Job to PwDs - Helper" was introduced by the Department of Social Welfare & Tribal AffairsRs. Union Territory of LakshadweepRs. to provide temporary employment opportunities to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) with a minimum of 40% disability in the UT. Under this schemeRs. three (3) PwD candidates are employed as Helpers on an 89-day rotational basis in the District Panchayat offices of their respective islands to address issues related to disabled persons and other associated matters.
benefits:
1. Persons with Disabilities are employed as Helper in the District Panchayat offices of their respective islands.
1. A monthly salary of 9Rs./-.

**Note:** Employment is provided on 89 days rotation basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a local resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep.
1. The applicant should have a minimum of 40% disability and be physically capable of performing the work of a helper.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 45 years.
1. The applicant should have passed at least the 8th standard.

name: Subsidy for School Uniforms to the Students
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidy for School Uniforms to the Students" by the Department of Education (DoE)Rs. Government of National Capital Territory (GNCT) of DelhiRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students for purchasing school uniformsRs. ensuring equitable access to education. Under this schemeRs. a cash subsidy is provided annually to students from Nursery to Class XIIRs. irrespective of gender or incomeRs. to alleviate the financial burden on families. The scheme covers students enrolled in government and aided schoolsRs. with varying amounts allocated based on class levels. The subsidy amounts range from 1Rs./- to 1Rs./- per annumRs. depending on the class. Eligibility is universal for students in the specified classesRs. with no income or gender-based restrictions. The scheme is implemented by the Department of EducationRs. GNCT of Delhi.
benefits:
> **Cash Subsidy Amounts**


- Nursery to Class 5th: 1Rs./- per annum.
- Class 6th to 8th: 1Rs./- per annum.
- Class 9th to 12th: 1Rs./- per annum.

> **Disbursement**

**Mode:** Direct cash subsidyRs. disbursed annually to students or their guardians.
**Validity:** Applicable for the academic year in which the subsidy is disbursed.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student enrolled in a government or aided school in Delhi.
- The applicant should be studying in any class from Nursery to 12th Standard.

name: Millet Development Scheme
brief_description: The "Millet Development Scheme" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to encourage farmers to adopt millet cultivation. The scheme includes various promotional eventsRs. exposRs. processing unitsRs. and financial assistance for demonstration activities. Special preference is given to SC/STRs. OBCRs. and women farmers.
benefits: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**Millet Demonstration6Rs./- per HaRs. Maximum up to 1 HaOne time in a Year
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must have his own bank account.

> Note:


- All categories will benefit from the scheme.
- Priority will be given to SC/STRs. OBCRs. and women farmers.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The "Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana" scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to provide financial assistance to students with disabilities to support their education. Under this schemeRs. scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement facility are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding 2.00 lakhRs. who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.
benefits:
**Scholarship Grant:**

- Financial assistance is provided as a scholarship to the students.

**Tuition Fee Reimbursement:**

- The scheme covers the tuition fee expenses for students studying in government-recognized institutions.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should have at least 40% disability.
1. The applicant should be a regular student in a government or recognized educational institution.
1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous academic year.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other state government or NGO/trust-provided scholarship or allowance.

name: Marriage Assistance to Person with Disability / BPL
brief_description: The scheme "Marriage Assistance to Persons with Disability/BPL" was introduced by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Union Territory of LakshadweepRs. for the benefit of persons with disabilities (differently-abled) belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. The scheme aims to support differently-abled brides or bridegrooms from BPL families by providing financial assistance to meet marriage-related expenses and to encourage them to lead a dignified and normal life. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 30Rs./- is provided to Scheduled TribeRs. differently-abled brides or bridegroomsRs. and is applicable only for the first marriage.
benefits:
- The scheme provides a financial assistance of 30Rs./- to differently-abled individuals belonging to the BPL category for their first marriage.

> **Mode of Disbursement:** The amount will be directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.

> **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a differently-abled person belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should furnish a disability certificate indicating at least 40% disability and must possess a valid ration card.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The family income of the applicant should be below 18Rs./- per annumRs. certified by the Deputy Commissioner (DC) or Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) of the respective island.
1. Both spouses should be natives and permanent residents of Lakshadweep/citizens of India.
1. The applicant should not have availed benefits under any similar scheme from the State/Central Government or any other agency.
1. The eligible beneficiary may marry either a differently-abled person or a non-disabled (normal) person.
1. The minimum age requirement is 21 years for the male and 18 years for the female. It should be the first marriage for both individuals.
1. The assistance is applicable only for the applicants first marriage.

Note: The claim of incentive for marriage allowance will not be claimed as a matter of right.

name: Urdu Scholarship- Rajasthan
brief_description: The "Urdu Scholarship" scheme was introduced by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to promote the Urdu language by providing financial assistance to students who study Urdu as an optional subject. At the graduation levelRs. the scholarship is exclusively available to girl students who have secured at least 50% marks in their qualifying examination and are studying Urdu as an optional subject. At the postgraduate levelRs. both male and female students are eligibleRs. provided they have passed their graduation or post-graduation examination with at least a second division and have opted for Urdu as a subject. It is mandatory for all applicants to study Urdu as an optional subject to be eligible for this scholarship.
benefits:
- A monthly scholarship of 100/- for students studying Urdu at the undergraduate level.
- A monthly scholarship of 150/- for students studying Urdu at the postgraduate level.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. At graduation levelRs. only female students are eligible.
1. At post-graduation levelRs. both male and female students are eligible.
1. The applicant should be studying Urdu as an optional subject at the graduation or post-graduation level.
1. For graduation level applicantsRs. a minimum of 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination is required.
1. For post-graduation level applicantsRs. the student should have passed graduation/post-graduation with at least second division.
1. It is mandatory to study Urdu as a subject to receive the scholarship.
1. The scholarship is applicable only for those who are regularly enrolled in recognized colleges/universities.

name: Distance Education Scheme for Girls
brief_description:
The "Distance Education Scheme for Girls" scheme was launched by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan in 2022. It aims to provide distance education opportunities to girls and women who are unable to attend college or university regularly due to family or other reasons. Under this schemeRs. the fees for undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. diplomaRs. and certificate courses are reimbursed for girls from Rajasthan pursuing distance education.
***Objectives:***

- To support education of girl child in UGRs. PGRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate courses under ODL (open and distance learning) by reimbursing fee.
- To improve Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) as well as the ratio of female and male proportional representation in higher education that isRs. Gender Parity Index (GPI).

***Target Group:***

- Girl students of Rajasthan who are admitted in courses under distance education mode in the state funded Universities/ State Government Institutes including IGNOU.
- State funded Universities of Rajasthan included under section 2(f) & and 12(B) of UGC Act and IGNOU are only allowed in the scheme.
benefits:
***Reimbursement of full course fees for distance Education in:***

- Undergraduate (UG) courses
- Postgraduate (PG) courses
- Diploma courses
- Certificate and PG Diploma courses

**Note:** No other additional grant will be payable.
***Duration of Fee Disbursement:***

- After selectionRs. the candidate's fee will be reimbursed on Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode on annual basis on satisfactory academic performance of the student.
- The fee reimbursement would be awarded from the date of joining the course as certified by the University/Institution.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in UGRs. PGRs. DiplomaRs. Certificate or PG Diploma courses under distance education mode.
1. The applicant should be studying in a state-funded university or government institution in RajasthanRs. including IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University).
1. The applicant who is availing of other fee reimbursement in State Government Schemes during the same tenure is not eligible in this scheme. But these students will get reimbursement of difference amount of "Existing Scholarship" and "Distance Education Scheme for Girls".
1. Students holding prize/incentive scholarships are not excluded from applying for this scheme.

**Note:** The student who is eligible for distance education course in Post Matric/Other Scheme of Social Justice DepartmentRs. Govt. of Rajasthan will get fee reimbursement from the existing process of fee reimbursement under Social Justice Department/ Other Department. The student will not get fee reimbursement from SJE portal under the category "DE-HE".

name: Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm
brief_description: The "Establishment of 12 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to promote animal husbandry as an independent businessRs. encourage livestock owners to adopt dairy farming and enhance rural employment opportunities.
benefits:
- **Interest Subsidy:**


1. **General Category:** 7.5% for up to 5 years after availing of a bank loan. 1. **SC/ST/Female Beneficiaries:** 8.5% for up to 5 years. 1. Gir/Kankrej Breed Units: Up to 12% maximum subsidy.


- **Shed Construction Assistance:**


1. General Category: 50% of actual expenditureRs. up to 1Rs./-.
1. Gir/Kankrej Breed: 75% of actual expenditureRs. up to 2Rs./-.


- **Animal Insurance Premium (for 3 years):**


1. General Category: 75% subsidyRs. up to 43Rs./-.
1. Gir/Kankrej Breed: 90% subsidyRs. up to 51Rs./-.


- **Equipment Subsidy:**


1. Electric Chaff Cutter: 75% subsidyRs. up to 18Rs./- (General) ; 90% subsidyRs. up to 21Rs./- (Gir/Kankrej).
1. Fogger System: 75% subsidyRs. up to 9Rs./- (General) | 90% subsidyRs. up to 10Rs./- (Gir/Kankrej).
1. Milking Machine: 75% subsidyRs. up to 33Rs./- (General) | 90% subsidyRs. up to 40Rs./- (Gir/Kankrej).

> **Note:**


- Interest subsidy will be available on the amount determined above for the unit cost fixed by NABARD or through the bank for the establishment of units for dairy cattle of up to 12 animalsRs. whichever is less.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a livestock Farmer.
- The applicant must purchase 12 dairy animals (cows/buffaloes).
- The applicant must establish a new dairy farm.
- The applicant must have ownership rights or inheritance rights or leasehold rights of the land.
- The applicant must take a loan from a Reserve Bank-recognized institution/bank.

> **Note:** If the beneficiary does not own landRs. the dairy farm can be established on leased land for a minimum of 7 (seven) years.

name: Establishment of Goat Unit (10 +1)
brief_description: The "Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1)" scheme by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to promote the social and economic upliftment of goat breeders by encouraging goat breeding and genetic improvement through pure breeding. The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribe (ST) womenRs. and General category individualsRs. with priority given to widowed and abandoned women from Scheduled Tribes.
benefits: **Category****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit(In Year) for Reclaiming Benefits**Scheduled Tribe women beneficiaries50% Subsidy on Unit Cost or Maximum 45Rs./-once in a lifetimeScheduled Caste beneficiaries50% Subsidy on Unit Cost or Maximum 45Rs./- once in a lifetimeGeneral Category beneficiaries50% Subsidy on Unit Cost or Maximum 45Rs./-once in a lifetime
eligibility:
The applicant must belong to one of the following categories:

1. Scheduled Caste (SC).
1. Scheduled Tribe (ST) Women only.
1. General Category.

**Note:** Priority will be given to Scheduled tribe widows & abandoned women.

name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Specially Abled Persons
brief_description: The scheme "Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Specially Abled Persons" was introduced by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Union Territory of LakshadweepRs. aims to provide monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities who have no source of income. The scheme covers persons with disabilitiesRs. including those who are deafRs. muteRs. blindRs. mentally retardedRs. or orthopedically disabledRs. with a disability level of 40% or more. The District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats (VDPs) of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep implement the scheme to ensure smooth processing and disbursement. The pension amount is directly transferred to the beneficiarys bank account.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. eligible individuals receive a monthly pension of 1Rs./- (18Rs./- per annum).

- **Mode of Disbursement:** The pension is directly transferred to the beneficiarys bank account.- **Frequency of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed on a monthly basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Union Territory of Lakshadweep.
1. The applicant should be a specially-abled person who is deafRs. dumbRs. blindRs. mentally retardedRs. or orthopedically disabled.
1. The applicant should have at least 40% disabilityRs. certified by a competent authority.
1. The applicant should not have a monthly income exceeding 1Rs./- (18Rs. per annum).
1. The applicant should not have any source of income.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government.

name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Abandoned Ladies/Destitute
brief_description: The scheme "Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Abandoned Ladies/Destitute" was introduced by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Union Territory of LakshadweepRs. aims to provide monthly financial assistance to abandoned ladies and destitute women in the UT. The scheme covers women who have been divorced or abandoned by their husband or relativesRs. have not remarriedRs. and are without any source of income or have only a nominal income. The District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats (VDPs) of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep implement the scheme to ensure smooth processing and disbursement. The pension amount is directly transferred to the beneficiarys bank account.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of 1Rs. per month (18Rs. per annum).

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The pension is disbursed directly to the beneficiarys bank account.

**Frequency of Disbursement**

- The amount is provided monthly.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep.
1. The applicant should be a divorcedRs. abandonedRs. or destitute woman.
1. The applicant should not have remarried after separation or abandonment.
1. The applicant should either have no source of income or a nominal income not exceeding 1Rs./- per month (18Rs./- per annum).
1. The applicant should not be a beneficiary of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government.

name: Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the BC & EBC Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. BiharRs. Patna provides residential facilities to students studying in educational institutions near the Saharsa District Headquarters Hostel. To support hostel residentsRs. students receive 9 kg of rice and 6 kg of wheat per month under the Chief Minister's Hostel Foodgrain Scheme and 1000/- per month under the Chief Minister's Hostel Grant Scheme.
benefits:
- 9 kg rice and 6 kg wheat per student per month.
- 1000/- monthly grant under the Chief Ministers Hostel Grant Scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be studying in the current session in an educational institution nearest to the hostel.
1. The applicant should belong to the Extremely Backward Class (EBC).
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 10+2 or higher.

name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. is designed to support livestock owners during the critical post-parturition periodRs. one month after delivery. This time is crucial for the health of the mother cattle and the calf. Under the schemeRs. 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed is provided free of cost to livestock owners belonging to the General Category.

1. The applicant must be a livestock owner.
1. The applicant must belong to the General Category.
1. The animal must have recently calved (given birth).

name: Mahila Bakri Palan
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Bakri Palan" was introduced by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to empower womenRs. especially abandonedRs. widowedRs. destituteRs. singleRs. and disaster-affected womenRs. by providing them support for goat rearing to generate livelihood and improve household income.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. one unit of goats (3 females and 1 male) aged 12 to 18 months is provided to eligible women. The entire cost of the schemeRs. 35Rs. is borne by the State Government.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman. 1. The applicant must be from one of the following categories: - Abandoned - Widow - Destitute - Single woman - Disaster-affected woman

name: Free Computer Training
brief_description: The scheme "Free Computer Training" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemenRs. serving soldiersRs. their widowsRs. and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries are provided with a one-year free training course in ComputerRs. AccountingRs. Web DesigningRs. or Digital Marketing.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-servicemanRs. serving soldierRs. widow of a servicemanRs. or their dependentRs. and must have passed the 12th standard.

name: Free Scooty Distribution for Girls (GEN-CATEGAORY-EWS)
brief_description: The "Free Scooty Distribution for Girls" scheme was launched by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan in the year 2017-18Rs. aims to encourage meritorious girl students belonging to the economically weaker section of the general category in the state. Under this schemeRs. meritorious girl students from government and private schools who have scored 85% or above in the Class 10th and 12th (ArtsRs. CommerceRs. Science streams) examinations are provided with a free scootyRs. along with a helmet and petrol.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. Eligible girl students will receive a scootyRs. a helmetRs. and 2 liters of petrol.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) of General Category.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have studied in a government or private school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should have secured at least 85% marks in class 10th or 12th.

name: To Provide Financial Assistance to the Farmers Practicing Natural Farming Under the Completely Chemical Free Dang District
brief_description: The Scheme "To Provide Financial Assistance to the Farmers Practicing Natural Farming Under the Completely Chemical Free Dang District launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. is designed to support farmers who engage in natural farming practices without the use of chemical inputs in the Dang district. It aims to enhance soil fertilityRs. lower production costsRs. and promote eco-friendly farming.
benefits:
- **For the first year:** 10Rs. per hectare


1. 5Rs./hectare for Kharif
1. 5Rs./hectare for Rabi and Summer



- **For already benefiting farmers (second year onwards):** 6Rs. per hectare


1. 3Rs./hectare for Kharif
1. 3Rs./hectare for Rabi and Summer
eligibility:
1. The applicant farmer must own at least one indigenous cowRs. with or without an identification tagRs. at the time of application.
1. Only one beneficiary is allowed per farmer family (a farmer family includes husbandRs. wifeRs. and minor children listed on the barcoded ration card).
1. The applicant must be practicing natural farming on a minimum of 20 Guntha (0.5 acres) and a maximum of 2 hectares of agricultural land.
1. The applicant must be registered under natural farming by:



- An APEDA/NPOP recognized organizationRs. or
- Registered by September 2021 through the appropriate authority.

name: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University
brief_description: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides 1Rs./- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized engineering universities in Chhattisgarh. To be eligibleRs. the student must have passed the 10+2 (or equivalent 12th grade) examination from any recognised institution located in ChhattisgarhRs. with a minimum of 45% marks. The total annual income of the student's father/guardian should not exceed 2Rs./-.
benefits: Scholarship of 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be a Student. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognised engineering university in Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must have passed the 10+2 (or equivalent 12th grade) examination from any recognised institution located in ChhattisgarhRs. with a minimum of 45% marks. - The total annual income of the student's father/guardian should not exceed 2Rs./-.
**OTHER CONDITIONS** - In addition to students studying in a recognised government educational institution located in ChhattisgarhRs. scholarships can be given in a limited numberRs. based on meritRs. for regular study in BE/BTech courses in institutions outside the state approved by AICTE. Students regularly studying in institutions operated by a recognised university within the same campus will also be eligible for scholarshipsRs. even if they do not require AICTE approval. - As per the provision made in rule 1Rs. these scholarships will be given to eligible students for degree courses in engineering in national importance institutions of the country such as All India Institutes of Technology (IITs) and other higher technical institutions operated by the government (Central or State government) such as (NITs) and science education institutions such as (IISc)Rs. even if they do not require AICTE approval. - Without special approval from the governmentRs. no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. HoweverRs. if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concessionRs. then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its durationRs. then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regardRs. only one concession can be given that any such student who is regularly studying in a recognised institution and is receiving any scholarship can be allowed to do part-time work. - In special cases not covered under the provisions of these rulesRs. the government will provide special scholarships to eligible students at the rate prescribed for each course of studyRs. based on poverty and merit. The total annual expenditure incurred in this regard will not exceed the budget limit.

name: Scholarship for Chhattisgarh Students Studying Outside the State
brief_description: Launched in 2013Rs. the scheme "Chhattisgarh Ke Mool Niwasi Chhatra/Chhatraon Ke Liye Chhatravritti" by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students who are native residents of Chhattisgarh and are pursuing engineering degrees. A significant benefit of this scheme is the provision of a monthly scholarship of 2Rs./- to eligible students studying in recognized engineering colleges outside Chhattisgarh. Another key aspect is that there is no income limit specified for availing this scholarship. The primary eligibility criteria include being a native student of Chhattisgarh and currently enrolled in a recognized engineering degree program outside the stateRs. having secured a minimum of 60% marks in the qualifying examination. The scheme is implemented by the Director. The applications for this scheme are accepted as per the prevailing guidelines of the department.
benefits: Scholarship of 2000/- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be currently studying in a recognized engineering college outside Chhattisgarh. - The applicant must be pursuing an engineering degree course. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the qualifying examination. - There is no income limit specified for the applicant.
**Other Conditions -** - Without special approval from the governmentRs. no student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time. HoweverRs. if the institution where he is studying has given him any fee concessionRs. then he will be entitled to continue receiving it. - If any scholarship becomes vacant during its durationRs. then the approving authority can give such scholarships for its unexpired period to the next eligible and deserving candidate from the merit list. - Only those students will be eligible to receive scholarships who have passed the qualifying examination from any testing body of Chhattisgarh. But children of such permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh can be exempted from this condition who are on deputation to the Government of India or any other state government. - Such students will not be eligible to receive scholarships who are in full-time employment. In this regardRs. only one concession can be given that any such studentRs. who is regularly studying in a recognized institution and is receiving any scholarshipRs. can be allowed to do part-time work. - In special cases not covered under the provisions of these rulesRs. the government will provide special scholarships to eligible students at the rate prescribed for each course of studyRs. based on poverty and merit. The total annual expenditure incurred in this regard will not exceed the budget limit.

name: To Provide Interest Subvention to Fishermen of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card
brief_description: The scheme "To Provide Interest Subvention to Fishermen of the State at the Rate of 4% to the Beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide interest subvention to fishermen who avail short-term loans under the Kisan Credit Card scheme. If the loan is repaid on timeRs. the beneficiaries receive a 4% interest reliefRs. which helps reduce their financial burden and support sustainable fisheries-based livelihoods. The benefit can be claimed once per financial year.
benefits: **Name of Component** **Standard of Assistance** **Minimum Time Limit (in Year) for Reclaiming Benefits)**To provide interest subvention to fishermen of the state at the rate of 4% to the beneficiaries Kishan Credit Card.4% interest subvention on timely repayment of short-term loans taken by animal husbandry up to 2Rs./-.only once in a financial year
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a fisherman.
1. The applicant must have taken a short-term loan from any of the following during the financial year:

- Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Society
- District Central Cooperative Bank
- Nationalized Bank
- Gramin Bank
- Private Bank

1. The applicant must have repaid the loan on time.

name: State Art Exhibition (Student Category)
brief_description: The "State Art Exhibition (Student Category)" is an annual event organized by the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of GoaRs. to promote and encourage creativity in the visual arts field among local students. Kala Academy Goa annually organises the State Art Exhibition. The Exhibition is held under the promotion activity in the field of Visual Art with the view to encourage the local students and extend an opportunity to show their creative talentsRs. as well asRs. to provide a facility for the general public to seeRs. appreciate and enjoy the various modes of expressions. The Kala Academy endeavours to develop an atmosphere wherein student can express his/her feelings and ideas through the different media The State Art Exhibition will provide a glimpse into the latest works of the students. Goan Fine Art student are invited to contribute their works to different categories of the visual art namely > **Section -1 : Painting & Graphic Print** Consists of drawing and paintingsRs. executed oilRs. water coloursRs. inksRs. crayons or mix media collage and graphic prints. > **Section -2 : Applied Art & Graphic Design** Consists of Graphic design of visual communicationRs. original or printed work in Applied Art & Creative Photography. > **Section -3 : Sculpture** Consists of work in stoneRs. terra-cottaRs. metalRs. woodRs. marbleRs. plastic and fibre glass etc. (works of clayRs. glass & other easily breakable material are not accepted)
benefits:
**Three main prizes will be awarded in each section/category:** - 1st Prize: 10Rs./- - 2nd Prize: 7Rs./- - 3rd Prize: 5Rs./-
**Special Prizes:** - Ravji V. Gaunekar Memorial Prize by The Goa Hindu Association: 1Rs./- - Artist to Artist Award by Smt. Prafulla Dahanukar: 15Rs./- - Late Hanuman B. Neogi Memorial Prize: 1Rs./-
eligibility: 1. A participant must be a bona fide student of any recognised art college or institutionRs. studying one or more of the subjects in the exhibition sections. 1. If an art student submits their entry in the Student CategoryRs. they are not eligible to participate in the Artist Category. 1. Submission must include an official bonafide certificate from the student's institution; entries without it will not be accepted. 1. Declarations for Originality and Prior Exhibits - Each exhibit must be the students original workRs. neither a copy nor an imitation. A declaration to this effect must appear on the back of each entry. - If the work has previously won an award or been displayed in prior exhibitions by Kala Academy or any other institutionRs. it will not be acceptedRs. and a declaration to that effect must also be submitted. 1.
