Award Winners' Restriction for Next Year 1. A participant who receives an award in a given year is not eligible to receive an award in the same section in the following year

name: Prakashan Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Prakashan Sahayata Yojana" was launched by the Department of Tribal Area DevelopmentRs. Government of Rajasthan in year 2000. It aims to promote and support original literary and research work related to tribal communities by offering publication assistance. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to scheduled tribe authors for publishing their original literature / manuscripts / research work with reputed publishers. This scheme encourages documenting and disseminating tribal knowledgeRs. cultureRs. and issues by supporting tribal scholars and writers.
benefits:
> **Monetary Assistance:**


- Authors of original manuscripts or research work related to tribal subjects receive financial support ranging from 6Rs./- to 12Rs./- for publication through reputed publishers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be an author and belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The manuscript/research work/literature should be related to Scheduled Tribes and should be an original creation by the author.
1. The manuscript should be unpublished and original in nature.

name: Financial Assistance Scheme for Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan
brief_description:
The "Financial Assistance Scheme for Journalists and Litterateurs" scheme was launched by the Department of Information & Public Relations (DIPR)Rs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial support to journalists and litterateurs for the treatment of critical illnessesRs. medical emergencies and no source of income. The scheme is implemented by a committee constituted by the state government and managed under the Rajasthan Journalist and Litterateur Welfare Fund.
> **Under the schemeRs. illness covers:**

CancerRs. leprosyRs. valve replacementRs. angioplastyRs. bypass surgeryRs. kidney transplantRs. brain stroke (brain and neurological diseases)Rs. epileptic seizuresRs. severe injury in an accidentRs. severe infectious diseases - brain infectionRs. lung infection/pneumoniaRs. severe infection in other organs of the bodyRs. general surgery - (herniaRs. appendixRs. stones in kidney and gall bladder)Rs. pregnancy (cesarean) and serious gynecological diseasesRs. diseases related to excessive bleedingRs. paralysis/palsyRs. asthmaRs. Alzheimer'sRs. COVID-19Rs. thyroidRs. etc.
benefits:
> **Monetary Assistance for Medical Treatment:**


- Up to 1Rs./- for treatment of critical diseases (e.g.Rs. cancerRs. bypass surgeryRs. kidney transplantRs. brain strokeRs. etc.).
- In special casesRs. the committee may approve up to 2Rs./-.

> **Monthly Financial Assistance:**


- 1Rs. to 2Rs. per month for a maximum of one year to unemployed journalists or those without income due to illness or old age.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a journalist or litterateur.
1. The journalist or litterateur should meet one or more of the following criteria:


- Suffering from incurable diseases such as tuberculosisRs. cancerRs. leprosyRs. or requiring treatment for serious conditions like valve replacementRs. transplantationRs. angioplastyRs. bypass surgeryRs. or kidney-related ailments.
- Unemployed due to ill health and without any other source of income.
- Aged 60 years or above and having no other source of income.
- Eligible on any other humanitarian grounds as recommended by the designated Committee.

**Note:** Financial assistance will be given to only one person at a time.

name: Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties
brief_description: The "Scheme of Production of Domestic Indigenous Certified Seed of Cotton Varieties" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to promote the cultivation and production of local cotton seed varieties across Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. eligible farmers receive financial assistance of 750/- per quintal for certified seedsRs. as approved by the Gujarat State Seed Certification Agency.
benefits: - An amount of 750/- per quintal (for foundation and certified seeds certified by the Gujarat State Seed Certification Agency).
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant should be involved in producing certified or foundation cotton seeds.

name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Self-Employment/Business
brief_description:
The "Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana Self-Employment/Business" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan with the objective of providing financial assistance to beneficiary boys and girls under the State Governments Palanhar Scheme to help them establish their own self-employment ventures or businesses after completing their training. The scheme aims to create employment opportunities and ensure a dignified livelihood for these beneficiaries upon the completion of their training.
Under this schemeRs. the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls in two installments: 60% of the total sanctioned amount is disbursed in the first installmentRs. and the remaining 40% in the second installment. The assistance is specifically for setting up self-employment or business activities related to the training course completed by the beneficiary.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. RajasthanRs. at the state level and by the Deputy Director/Assistant DirectorRs. Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. at the district level.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


- Financial assistance up to 50Rs. or the actual/estimated costRs. whichever is lowerRs. to establish self-employment/business.

> **Payment Disbursed in Two Installments**


- First Installment: 60% for establishing the necessary shop/location or purchasing equipmentRs. raw materialsRs. etc.
- Second Installment: After establishingRs. the remaining 40% amount will be paid based on the inspection report by the officer appointed by the District Collector.

> **Mode of Disbursement:**


- The financial assistance is directly deposited into the beneficiary's bank savings account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should have completed skill training under the scheme.
1. The applicants age should be 21 years or above.
1. The applicant should be registered their business through Udyam Aadhaar Portal is required for self-employment assistance.

name: Scheme to Provide Assistance in Cow Maintenance Expenses to Farmers Practicing Completely Natural Farming Based on Indigenous Cows
brief_description: The Scheme to Provide Assistance in Cow Maintenance Expenses to Farmers Practicing Completely Natural Farming Based on Indigenous Cows launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage and support farmers who engage in natural farming practices that rely on indigenous cows. By covering part of the maintenance expenses for one native cowRs. the government promotes eco-friendly agricultureRs. reduces the cost of cultivationRs. and ensures better soil health.
benefits:
- 900/- per month (10Rs./- annually) assistance for maintaining one indigenous cow.

> **Note:** The benefit is available only once.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The applicant must be practicing natural farming on at least 1 acre (40 guntha) of land.
1. The applicant must own a native (indigenous) cow with an identification tag.

> **Note:**


- Priority will be given to farmers practicing natural agriculture and master trainers who have received training in natural agriculture from certified trainers.
- Assistance to one beneficiary per account (as per sample number 8-A).

name: All Goa Classical Dance Competition
brief_description: The scheme "All Goa Classical Dance Competition" by the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. GoaRs. is open for Bharatnatyam and Kathak disciplines. Only solo dance will be considered for the competition. Costumes and accompanists are to be arranged by the participants at their own cost. Local students in the age group of 12 and 20 years can participate.
benefits:
- 1st Prize: 5Rs./-Rs. 2nd Prize: 3Rs./-Rs. 3rd Prize: 2Rs./-Rs. Five Consolation Prizes: 500/- each.
- Each participant will receive 500/- (lump sum) towards travel expensesRs. along with one accompanist.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a local student.
- The applicant should be between 12 and 20 years of age.

name: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana" was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote high-qualityRs. interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across the state. The broad subject areas for research include ScienceRs. Arts and HumanitiesRs. Home ScienceRs. and Commerce & ManagementRs. while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.
benefits: The maximum research grant provided by the state government is 15 lakhRs. which may be increased up to 18 lakh in special circumstances.
eligibility: 1. The regular professors working in state government colleges and state university campuses of UttarakhandRs. as well as students and research scholars enrolled in regular programs at recognized institutions within the stateRs. are eligible to apply. 1. A research proposal may also include a co-investigator alongside the principal investigator. 1. The broad subject areas for research include ScienceRs. Arts and HumanitiesRs. Home ScienceRs. and Commerce & ManagementRs. while interdisciplinary subjects will also be accepted. 1. Research related to the state that proves to be productive and useful in socialRs. economicRs. contemporaryRs. or other areas of special importance will be encouraged. 1. Priority will be given to problem-orientedRs. solution-drivenRs. and action-based research topics (Problem and Action-Based Research Programme). 1. Research proposals may also be invited based on requests for specific issues raised by any department of the state government. 1. A maximum period of two years will be allowed for completing the research workRs. which may be extended by one additional year under special circumstances. 1. Only one research project will be permitted for any teacher or research scholar at a time.

name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana (Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation)
brief_description: "Mahila Adhikarita Yojana" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. is a centrally sponsored financial support scheme targeting women sweepers and their dependents. Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries are provided a loan of 20Rs. at a low interest rate of 5%Rs. with a repayment period of 5 years. This initiative aims to empower women engaged in sanitation work by providing them with the financial means to pursue economic activities and improve their quality of life. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation.
benefits: - **Loan Assistance:** An amount of 20Rs./- at 5% interest rateRs. with a repayment period of 5 years.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a woman sweeper or a dependent of a woman sweeper. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Operation of Ashram Hostels
brief_description: The scheme "Operation of Ashram Hostels" was launched by the Department of Tribal Area DevelopmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to ensure continued education for tribal students who lack access to nearby higher-level schools due to the poor economic condition of their families. Under this schemeRs. free accommodationRs. nutritious mealsRs. educational materialsRs. uniformsRs. personal hygiene itemsRs. and other facilities are provided to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students residing in ashram hostels operated by the Tribal Area Development Department.
benefits:
> **Students are provided with the following annually and monthly benefits:**

**Annually (per student):**

- School uniform with stitching
- ShoesRs. socksRs. towelRs. and warm sweater

**Monthly (per student):**

- Nutritious breakfast and meals
- Hair oil
- Bathing and washing soap
- Hair cutting service
- Laundry for bed linen (sheetRs. pillow coverRs. blanket)
- Electricity and water facilities
- Newspapers and magazines
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. Scheduled Tribe students are eligible if there is no primary school within 1.5 kmRs. no upper primary school within 3 kmRs. and no secondary/higher secondary school within 5 km of their residence.
1. The parents/guardians should not be an income tax payee.
1. The applicant's family should not own more than 400 square yards of urban land.
1. The applicant's family should not own more than 15 bighas of agricultural land.
1. The student should pass the current academic year to continue enrollment in the next year.
1. The student should be a resident of the same district in which the hostel application has been made.

**Notes:**

- All new admissions will be made on the basis of merit.
- Admission to hostels in specific tribal areas will be given only to tribal students belonging to the same area.
- Re-admission in the next academic year will be granted only if the student passes the annual examination.

name: Mukhyamantri Rajya Krishi Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Rajya Krishi Vikas Yojana is implemented by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar IndustryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to help sugarcane farmers grow better cropsRs. increase productionRs. improve sugar qualityRs. and provide support through high-quality seedsRs. modern techniquesRs. mechanizationRs. crop protectionRs. and advanced farming practices.
benefits: 1. **Breeder Seed Sugarcane Production Program:** The programme is proposed to be run by G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. on the farms of its subordinate research centres. Under this schemeRs. breeder seed production of the latest sugarcane varieties will be carried out. At sugarcane research centresRs. 25% of breeder seed nurseries will be established in autumn and 75% in spring. As per the allocation by the Sugarcane DepartmentRs. a subsidy of 100/- per quintal is provided to the institution for seed distribution from these nurseries. Based on the average yield of the districtRs. 50% of the subsidy will be provided for agricultural inputs such as fertilizers and pesticides at the time of sowing in the nurseryRs. with the remaining amount payable upon seed distribution. 1. **Establishment of Base Nurseries:** It is proposed to establish base nurseries. A subsidy of 50/- per quintal will be provided for sugarcane seed distributionRs. with a maximum limit of 15Rs./-. 1. **Establishment of Primary Nurseries:** It is proposed to establish primary nurseriesRs. under which a subsidy of 25/- per quintal of sugarcane seed will be providedRs. with a maximum limit of 10Rs./-. 1. **Field Demonstrations:** Demonstrations will be organized using the latest sugarcane sowing techniques. Sugarcane farmers will be provided a grant of 7Rs. per 0.5-hectare demonstration. 1. **Sugarcane Seed Transportation and Harvesting Loading:** A 100% subsidy on actual transportation costs will be provided to buyer-based nursery holders or the Sugarcane Development Council for transporting elite seeds produced at research farms. 1. **Subsidy on Agricultural Equipment:** Under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural MechanizationRs. human-operated equipment for sugarcane cultivation will be distributed to farmers. 1. **Sugarcane Seed Differential Price Payment:** The Department will provide a subsidy based on the actual cost of sugarcane seedsRs. which can be supplied from any sugarcane research center located within or outside the State. 1. **PestRs. DiseaseRs. and Weed Control:** A farmer is eligible for a subsidy of up to 3Rs./- per hectare for crop protection and weed control. The subsidy covers 50% of the actual costRs. with a maximum limit of 3Rs./- per farmer. 1. **Distribution of MicronutrientsRs. OrganicRs. and Bio-Fertilizers:** Farmers will receive a 50% subsidyRs. up to 1Rs./- per hectareRs. on the purchase of micronutrientsRs. organicRs. and bio-fertilizers to promote successful sugarcane cultivation and improve sugar recovery. 1. The scheme encourages farmers to adopt advanced sugarcane cultivation through publicity campaignsRs. soil testingRs. and training programs at the village and district levels.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane. 1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society. 1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming. 1. The applicants name must be registered in the land records of the state.

name: Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan
brief_description: The "Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra" scheme was introduced by the Devasthan DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. on 1st April 2011. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External AffairsRs. Government of India. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 1Rs./- is granted to each pilgrimRs. with a maximum of 100 beneficiaries selected per year.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance**


- 1Rs. per selected pilgrim after completing the Yatra.

> **Mode of Disbursement**

Direct transfer to the beneficiarys bank account via account payee cheque/demand draftRs. depending on departmental discretion.
> **Note:**


- The Yatra must be completed through the Ministry of External AffairsRs. Government of India.
- The benefit is available only once in a lifetime.
- A maximum of 100 beneficiaries per year.
- Selection via lottery if applications exceed the quota.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External AffairsRs. Government of India.
1. The applicant receives this grant only once in a lifetime.

**Note 1:** 100 pilgrims are selected each year. If there are more applicants than available slotsRs. selection is done through a lottery system.
**Note 2:** After completing the tripRs. a certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs confirming the successful completion of the journey is required.

name: Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students
brief_description: The scheme "Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students" by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD)Rs. DehradunRs. aims to empower students with benchmark disabilities by supporting their preparation for competitive exams such as SSCRs. RRBRs. BankingRs. InsuranceRs. and UPSC. Through this schemeRs. free coachingRs. book allowanceRs. transport/hostel allowanceRs. disability and other allowances are provided to eligible candidates. The scheme is implemented by NIEPVD.
benefits:
> **Financial Allowances:**


- Coaching fees.
- Transport or hostel allowance.
- Disability allowance.
- Book allowance.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a student with a benchmark disability (40% or more) as defined.
- The applicant must hold a valid disability certificate issued by a competent authority.
- The applicant must possess a Unique Disability ID (UDID).
- The applicant must have an Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrollment number.
- The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th
brief_description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support students from Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes by reducing the burden of education-related expenses and promoting school attendance. The scheme ensures that eligible students from Classes 1st to 8th studying in government and aided schools receive 900/- for three pairs of school uniforms annuallyRs. enhancing their dignity and inclusion in the school environment.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 900/- is provided to each eligible student for the purchase of three pairs of school uniforms.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should belong to the state of Gujarat.
- The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided primary school.
- The applicant should belong to the Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes.

name: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers
brief_description: The scheme Free Training for Vehicle Drivers was introduced by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing freeRs. high-quality driving trainingRs. thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. training will be provided to vehicle drivers to enhance their driving skillsRs. which will help reduce road accidents and enable them to pursue better self-employment opportunities.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.

name: Financial Assistance to SC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC
brief_description:
The 'Financial Assistance to SC students appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC' schemeRs. administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. is designed to provide financial grants to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who qualify for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Mains Examination. Each eligible beneficiary will receive an amount of up to 50Rs./-Rs. subject to budgetary provisions. The disbursement of assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation.
**The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
benefits: An amount of up to 50Rs./- is provided to each beneficiaryRs. subject to budget provision.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam.
- The applicant must have recently qualified for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination held in 2025.
- The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed 5Rs./-.

name: Freeship less than 1,00,000 (UG students only)
brief_description: "Freeship Less than 1Rs." Scheme by the Dean Student WelfareRs. Govind Ballabh Pant Krishi Evam Praudyogiki VishwavidyalayaRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious undergraduate students from economically weaker backgrounds. Through this schemeRs. a full tuition fee waiver is granted to selected students whose annual family income is less than 1Rs.. The benefit is especially extended to girls for an additional academic year. The scheme is implemented by the Office of the Dean Student Welfare in accordance with university regulations. Applications are scrutinized and the final list is approved by university authorities.
benefits: - Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver. - Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence. - The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing. - Granted once every academic yearRs. at the beginning of the session. - Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor. - Validity: Boys: Up to 3 academic years Girls: Up to 4 academic years
eligibility:
- The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University.
- The applicants annual family income should be less than 1Rs..
- The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the universitys merit guidelines.
- The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline

name: Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief_description: The scheme Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of 400/- per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding 6Rs./-.
benefits: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of 400/- is given to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant should belong to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes.
- The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course.
- The applicants individual and family income should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.

name: Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes
brief_description:
The "Mukhya Mantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes" scheme is introduced by the Animal Husbandry and Dairying DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. which aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries by providing them with sheep or goat units. Through this schemeRs. 10 female and 1 male sheep/goat units are provided free of cost. Through this schemeRs. free sheep or goat unitsRs. veterinary assistanceRs. and assistance for purchasing wool are provided to unemployed residents of Haryana. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB).
> **Long-term objectives of this scheme are as follows:** 1. To create self-employment opportunities through Sheep and Goat husbandry activities. 1. To upgrade and develop the Sheep and Goat breeds/germ plasm available in the State. 1. To increase income generation opportunities for the economically weaker segment of society.
benefits:
1. **Sheep Unit:** 20 Ewes and one Ram with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost. 1. **Goat Unit:** 20 Does and one Buck with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost.1. **Veterinary Assistance:** All animals in the established unit will receive dewormingRs. vaccinationRs. and treatment free of cost by the concerned Veterinary Institution.1. **Wool Purchase Assistance:** Assistance for purchasing wool from the established unit will be provided by the department.
> **Financial Assistance in form of subsidy for establishment of Sheep/Goat unit** > **under the Scheme:-** 1. 100% subsidy for the establishment of a Sheep and Goat unit of 10 females and 1 male would be provided to the Scheduled Caste (SC). 1. Initially beneficiary has to bear purchase cost of Sheep and Goat unit by there-own for 25% of the unit cost which will be of 17Rs./- per unit as margin money (proof for the same should be given by beneficiary)Rs. which would be provided to beneficiary account later on as per scheme guidelines. 1. In the case of SC CategoryRs. the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB)/Government will provide financial assistance of 75% of the unit cost (52Rs./- per unit) on the establishment of the livestock unit after the purchase of livestock to the seller within 15 daysRs. upon submission of all requisite documents. 1. The financial assistance of balance 25% of unit cost (17Rs./- per unit) in case of SC beneficiaries would be provided by the HLDB/Government in form of subsidy to beneficiary after two months of establishment of unit subject to verification of unit after purchase of all cases preferably by Deputy Director concerned himself or its representative not below the rank of Sub Divisional Officer/Semen Bank Officer other than purchase committee. 1. Beneficiaries shall have to purchase a complete/whole Sheep/Goat unit of 10+1 in one slotRs. and only one beneficiary per household could take the benefit of either Sheep or Goat unit under the scheme. 1. The financial assistance would be provided to the account of the seller through Concerned Semen Bank officer by the Managing DirectorRs. HLDBRs. out of the head of overall receipt of Milk Cess funds after verification and recommendation of the unit established by the Deputy Director concerned or its representative not below the rank of SDO/ SBO. The financial assistance may be delayed due to the unavailability of the budget or any other unforeseen circumstances. 1. The beneficiary would be provided veterinary assistance facilities (TreatmentRs. vaccination and consultancy) by the concerned area veterinary institutions free of cost. Assistance for the purchase of wool from an established unit would be provided by the Department.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste 1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana 1. The applicant should be a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should not be employed even in the Private Sector/ Govt. /Semi Govt. Organizations. 1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. Any group/firm/organisation would not be permitted to apply under the SchemeRs. as the Scheme being individual beneficiary-oriented. 1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration in the format annexed as [Annexure-I (Page-9)](https://pashudhanharyana.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/Scheme%202024-25/BhedBakri%20(SheepGoat)%20Palak%20Utthan%20Yojanafor%20the%20year%202024-25%20(N).pdf) on the portal for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

name: District Level Sports School
brief_description: Launched in 2013-14Rs. the scheme "District Level Sports School" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide intensive sports training and quality education to young athletes by establishing district-level sports schools under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model. The scheme seeks to identify sporting talent from events such as Khel Mahakumbh and train them using modern infrastructureRs. scientific methodsRs. expert coachingRs. and proper nutritionRs. while ensuring access to formal school education. The initiative began with 9 schools (6 residential and 3 non-residential)Rs. and expanded to 24 schools by 2017-18Rs. catering to over 2Rs. students in 21 sports disciplines. Selected athletes receive benefits such as accommodationRs. foodRs. school uniformsRs. booksRs. sports kitsRs. and equipment. An average of 2.25 lakh is spent per player annuallyRs. including 1 lakh Mediclaim security. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat (SAG).
benefits: > **Monetary Support & Facilities:** - Players are provided with free educationRs. stationeryRs. booksRs. accommodationRs. mealsRs. school uniformsRs. and modern sports equipment and kits. > **Medical Insurance:** - A Mediclaim security cover of up to 1Rs./- is provided to each selected athlete. > **Expert Coaching & Training:** - Intensive sports training is imparted in morning and evening sessions by expert coaches. In-school players receive additional training in 5 Physical Training (PT) periods.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be below 14 years of age. 1. The applicant must qualify under one of the following categories: - **Proven Talent (PT):** 1. The applicant should have already performed at School Games Federation of India (SGFI)Rs. State-levelRs. or National-level sports events. 1. The applicant must participate in a selection camp for final admission. - **Young Talent (YT):** 1. The applicant should have participated and secured first place at Taluka/District/Corporation level in Khel Mahakumbh (Under-9 or Under-11 category). 1. The applicant must register for Khel Mahakumbh and undergo the selection process. - **In-School Talent:** 1. The applicant should be identified within a school already running the DLSS program.

name: Cash Award to Women Players of the State
brief_description: The scheme "Cash Award to Women Players of the State" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote participation of women in sports and recognize their achievements by awarding them cash incentives for outstanding performance in state-level and national-level competitions. Female athletes securing the firstRs. secondRs. or third position in individual or team sports at the state levelRs. or representing Gujarat at national competitionsRs. receive annual scholarships based on their rank and category. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **First Position (Individual & Team Sports at State Level/ National Representation):** 4Rs./- per year - **Second Position (Individual & Team Sports at State Level):** 3Rs./- per year - **Third Position (Individual Sports at State Level):** 2Rs./- per year
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have secured firstRs. secondRs. or third position in individual or collective sports competitions held at the state level. 1. The applicant should have represented Gujarat state in national-level sports competitions. 1. The applicants accomplishment must have occurred within the respective financial year.

name: "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
brief_description: The "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" component of "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme (ATISIS)" by the Finance (Institutional Finance) DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from CrushRs. TearRs. Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The component provides interest subvention on working capital loans at 3% per annum. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. through multiple implementing agenciesRs. including banks and the District Industries & Commerce Centre. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through a dedicated portal with a Direct Benefit Transfer mechanism for reimbursement.
benefits: **Benefit Amount:** Interest subvention of 3% per annum on Working Capital Loan. **Maximum Claimable Amount:** 20Rs./- per annum per unit (garden). **Validity Period:** Extended for five years till the end of the Financial Year 2027-28. **Applicable Financial Years:** 2023-24Rs. 2024-25Rs. 2025-26Rs. 2026-27Rs. and 2027-28. **Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement. **Claim Period:** On completion of every financial year.
eligibility:
**General Eligibility** - The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes - The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing CrushRs. TearRs. Curl TeaRs. Orthodox TeaRs. or Speciality tea including Green teaRs. Oolong TeaRs. White teaRs. Yellow tea and Purple tea - The applicant must be located entirely in Assam - The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam
**Interest Subvention Specific Eligibility** - The applicant must have taken loan from a Scheduled Commercial Bank or a Public Financial Institution. - The applicant must have taken Working Capital Loan for activities directly related to plantation or manufacturing of Tea. - The applicant must have Working Capital sanctioned or renewed on or after 1st April of the financial year in which claim is to be made (2023-24Rs. 2024-25Rs. 2025-26Rs. 2026-27 and 2027-28). - The applicant must not have loan accounts declared as Non-Performing Asset as per Reserve Bank of India guidelines on the date of filing claim. - The applicant must not have availed any interest subsidy under any other scheme.

name: Small Business Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
brief_description: The scheme "Small Business Scheme" by the Social Justice & Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support small businesses. Through this schemeRs. individual loans at an annual interest rate are provided to individuals from the SEBC Rabari and Bharwad communities for establishing businesses such as grocery shopsRs. dairy parloursRs. animal food sales centresRs. and mobile-computer repair shops. Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam implements the scheme.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit is 2Rs./- per individual. 1. The interest rate is 6% per annum. 1. The loan amount disbursed is 95% of the total project cost. 1. The beneficiary Contribution is 5% of the total project cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan) (GNDTDC)
brief_description: The "New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan)" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. educational loans are provided to students belonging to Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities for pursuing higher professional and technical education at the graduate and postgraduate levels.
benefits: **1. Loan Amount:** The maximum loan limit for this scheme is up to 10Rs./-. **2. Included Expenses:** The loan amount will include the following: - Admission and tuition fees - Expenses for booksRs. uniformsRs. essential materialsRs. and exam fees - Accommodation and food expenses - Insurance Policy premium **3. Interest Rate:** - 4% per annum for male students - 3.5% per annum for female students **4. Contribution:** - 90% contribution from the Central CorporationRs. - 5% from the State GovernmentRs. - 5% from the beneficiary **5. Repayment Period:** - The loan will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest. - The loan will be recovered within 6 months of completion of the course or upon getting a jobRs. whichever is earlier.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should be pursuing one of the following courses: - MBA or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or its equivalent (AICTE-approved course) - Graduate-level engineering course approved by IIT/AICTE or any other approved professional graduate-level course - Graduate-level medical course from a college recognized by the Medical Council of India - Diploma course in Nursing **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families having an annual income of up to 1Rs./-.

name: Junior/Senior Fellowship in the Field of Fine Arts
brief_description: The scheme "Junior/Senior Fellowship in the Field of Fine Arts" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to nurture artistic talent and provide financial support for experimentalRs. research-basedRs. or revival-focused projects in the fields of paintingRs. sculptureRs. and graphic arts. The scheme benefits both junior and senior artists of Gujarat by awarding them monthly stipendsRs. thereby helping them undertake advanced trainingRs. revive endangered Indian or folk artsRs. and develop their careers in art. Under this schemeRs. 5 senior artists will be provided with a monthly stipend of 3Rs./-Rs. and 10 junior artists will be provided with a monthly stipend of 2Rs./- for one year. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy.
benefits: - **Fellowship for Senior Artists:** 3Rs./-per month. - **Fellowship for Junior Artists:** 2Rs./- per month.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident artist of Gujarat. - The applicant should be actively engaged in the field of paintingRs. sculptureRs. or graphic arts.

name: Term Loan Scheme (GNDTDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Term Loan Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities by providing financial assistance for agriculture and allied activitiesRs. small-scale businessesRs. craftsmanship & traditional occupations as well as service-based businesses/trades. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipmentRs. raw materialsRs. or working capital.
benefits: **Loan Amount Details:** - **Loan Amount:** Up to 20Rs./-.- **Interest Rate:** 6% per annum. - **Loan Contribution:** 85% will be from the National CorporationRs. 10% from the State GovernmentRs. 5% from the beneficiary.- **Repayment:** The total loan amountRs. including interestRs. must be repaid in 60 equal monthly instalments.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount under this scheme will be specifically allocated to families with an annual income of up to 1Rs./-.

name: Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award
brief_description: The scheme "Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award" was introduced by the Department of Minority WelfareRs. Government of Kerala. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to financially backward students from minority communities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance in the form of scholarship amounts is provided to eligible students from ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. SikhRs. MuslimRs. and Parsi communities to pursue higher education. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Minority WelfareRs. Government of Kerala.
benefits: - The students who score an A+ in Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC)/Plus Two (12) or Technical High School Leaving Certificate(THSL) will get 10Rs./-. - The undergraduate students with 80% marks will get 15Rs./-. - The postgraduate student with 75% marks will get 15Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent citizen of Kerala. - The applicant must belong to a minority community (ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. SikhRs. MuslimRs. or Parsi). - The applicant shall be from a below-poverty-line family. - The applicant shall be studying in any government school. - The annual income of the candidates family must be below 8Rs./- per year. - The applicant pursuing SSLCRs. Plus TwoRs. or Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) level must have a Full A+ grade to avail the scholarship. - The applicant pursuing undergraduate studies must have 80% marks to avail the scholarship. - The applicant pursuing postgraduate studies must have 75% marks to avail the scholarship.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Installation of Cage in Reservoir - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with the component of Installation of Cage in Reservoir (PMMSY)Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and providing employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for cage culture in inland reservoirs to encourage inland aquaculture and maximise fish production using advanced techniques. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. > **Objectives:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Accelerate inland fish farming activities in fresh water bodiesRs. increase inland fish production and boost inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or ponds In less land less water Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved in less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
1. The capital unit cost is 1Rs./- per cubic meter. 1. The operational cost is 1Rs./- per cubic meter. 1. **Minimum area per cage:** 100 cubic meters.1. **For individual beneficiaries:** Assistance up to 1Rs. cubic meters.1. **For Co-operative Societies / SHGs / Joint Liability Groups:** - 600 cubic meter per member - Maximum up to 7Rs. cubic meters water area. 1. **Subsidy Rate:** - General Category: 40% of unit cost. - Women / Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes: 60% of unit cost. - Government Share: 60% Central Government + 40% State Government.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** One-time benefit for the eligible component.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** > All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled Tribe) will get benefit under the Inland Schemes. > WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries receive 60% of the unit cost as assistance.

name: Safety Audit
brief_description:
The Safety Audit Scheme by the Government of Haryana aims to promote safety practices within MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) by supporting them in conducting safety audits and implementing safety equipment. The scheme seeks to minimize workplace hazards and enhance industrial safety standards.
**Objective** The objective of the scheme is to promote safety audit which is a tool that can be utilized to improve safety and attitudes in the workplace. A safety audit is an inventory or checklist of items specifically geared to operations of an enterprise. It allows them to take actionRs. correct hazardsRs. and determine the appropriate actions to take to achieve the desired safety goals. Measuring safety performance also provides a baseline to compare future safety initiatives. It documents the effectiveness of safety programRs. identify compliance deficienciesRs. suggest safety solutionsRs. improve the environment and personnel safetyRs. reduce incidents and injuries and increase workplace safety.
benefits: 1. 75% reimbursement of expenses incurred for conducting safety auditsRs. up to 1Rs./-. 1. 50% subsidy on cost of capital equipment required for safety measuresRs. up to 5Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a MicroRs. SmallRs. or Medium Enterprise (MSME)Rs. either newly established or existing. 1. The enterprise must be registered with the appropriate authority (e.g.Rs. Udyog Aadhaar / EM Part-II). 1. The safety audit must be conducted by auditors from a recognized ISO-certified agency. 1. The industrial units must also comply with the following conditions: - The item of manufacture should not fall in the restrictive list as notified by the State Government from time to time. - Investments in new plantRs. machinery and equipments focussed towards enhancing safety shall only be eligible for subsidy under this scheme. - The units should have obtained NOC/CLU from competent authorityRs. if applicable. - The units should be in commercial production. - The units should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit.

name: Stamp Duty Refund
brief_description: The Government of Haryana offers reimbursement of stamp duty charges to incentivize industrial investment and infrastructure development across the state. The Government of Haryanas Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme offers financial relief on stamp duty paid during land or property registration to promote industrial investment and infrastructure development. The scheme primarily benefits eligible enterprises in Category BRs. CRs. and D blocks across sectors like ITRs. ESDMRs. TextilesRs. and StartupsRs. offering 80% to 100% reimbursement based on location. Units must be registered under applicable industrial policies and apply within a defined period after the transaction.
benefits: 1. **General Industrial Units:** 100% refund in 'D' category blocks; 75% in 'C' category blocks and 60% in 'B' category blocks on the land meant for industrial useRs. after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Thrust Sectors/Bio Energy Enterprises [MSME]:** 100% refund in C and 'D' category blocks; 80% in B' category blocks on the land meant for industrial useRs. after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land. Note: Registered Farmer Producer Organization (FPO)/ Integrated Pack Houses (having gradingRs. sortingRs. packaging etc facilities) shall also be eligible.1. **Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) Thrust Sector [MSME]:** 100% reimbursement of stamp duty for setting up units in BRs. CRs. D category blocks on the meant for Industrial useRs. after commencement of commercial production within 05 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Data Centres and Co-Location Facility:** 100% refund of Stamp Duty throughout the State. Import Substitution Enterprises [MSME]: 100% refund in BRs. C and D category blocks on the land meant for industrial useRs. after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Essential Sector Enterprises:** 100% refund in BRs. C & D category blocks on the land meant for industrial useRs. after commencement of commercial production within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Industrial Park:** 80% Stamp duty refund to the developer of Industrial Park/Estate in C & D category blocks.1. **Service Enterprises:** 50% refund of stamp duty in C & D category blocks and 30% in B category blocks for new enterpriseRs. after commencement of service within 5 years from the date of purchase of land.1. **Expansion/Diversification:** - This benefit shall also be applicable to Enterprises [Sr. no. 2(ii) to 2 (xi) above] undergoing 50% additional investment in plant and machinery for expansion/diversification of existing unit. - The Mega projects undertaking expansion/diversification & the identified service enterprises at Clause 2(xi) of the scheme with same criteria of Investment shall be treated as Mega Projects.
eligibility:
**Industrial Units (MSMERs. LargeRs. Mega)** 1. Must commence commercial production after 01.01.2021 and within 5 years from the date of land purchase. 1. Land must be purchased before 31.12.2025. 1. Must file IEM/Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) and Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM). 1. Not listed in the restrictive/negative list of the State Government. 1. Must have NOC/CLURs. if applicable. 1. Unit must be in commercial production. 1. Must remain in production for at least 5 years.
**General Category Units** 1. Eligible under same criteria as MSME/Large unitsRs. even if not covered under thrust sectors.
**Industrial Parks / Estates (Developers) -** 1. Minimum area of 25 acres. 1. Must obtain Industrial License/NOC from competent authority. 1. Refund applicable after full infrastructure development. 1. Infrastructure must be developed within 5 years of land purchase (land purchased before 31.12.2025).

name: Khel Mahakumbh
brief_description: Launched in 2010Rs. the scheme "Khel Mahakumbh" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to foster sportsmanshipRs. encourage mass participation in sporting eventsRs. and recognize talent across all age groups through free sports servicesRs. structured competitionsRs. and significant monetary rewards. The scheme has witnessed continuous growth in participation since its inception and provides opportunities for outstanding performers to benefit from further sports training and development schemes under the Sports Authority of Gujarat. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Winners of competitions receive cash prizes worth 45Rs./- in total.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a native of Gujarat or should have been studyingRs. residingRs. workingRs. or doing business in Gujarat for the past 2 years. - Students must participate from the taluka/district where their school or college is located. - Employees transferred from other states are eligible if their transfer to the district occurred at least 6 months before the date of registration. **Note:** The applicant can register for a maximum of 2 sports only.

name: Trekking in Forest Area (Scheduled Castes)
brief_description: The scheme "Trekking in Forest Area" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to instill a deep love for natureRs. pristine landscapesRs. wild animals and birdsRs. treesRs. mountainsRs. springsRs. and ravines among the youth of the state by directly engaging them in a forest trekking experience. Under this initiativeRs. a forest area rotation program is conducted for 100 selected young men and womenRs. giving them immersive exposure to natural surroundings and biodiversity.
benefits: - **Nature Immersion Experience:** The selected beneficiaries will have the opportunity to participate in a guided forest trekking program designed to foster a love for nature and environmental awareness. - **Exposure to Biodiversity:** Participants will get firsthand experience of pristine natural sites including forestsRs. wildlifeRs. birdsRs. treesRs. springsRs. mountainsRs. and ravines.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. - The applicant should be between 14 and 35 years of age.

name: Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards (National Level)
brief_description: The scheme "Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards (National Level)" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to commemorate the legacy of legendary musical artistes Beldi Tana and Riri and promote the cultural heritage of Indian classical music by honoring two exceptional female artistes from across the country. These artists are felicitated at a prestigious national-level award ceremony held at VadnagarRs. GujaratRs. with a cash prize of 5Rs. a shawlRs. and a certificate each.
benefits: - **Cash Prize:** Each of the two selected female artists is awarded a cash prize of 5Rs./-.- **Other Benefit:** In addition to the monetary awardRs. recipients receive a shawl and a certificate recognizing their contribution.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of India. - The applicant must be a female artiste in the field of Indian classical music. - The applicant must have made notable contributions to classical music and demonstrated a distinguished record of achievement.

name: Personality Development and Yogasana Training Camp (TASP)
brief_description: The scheme "TASP Personality Development and Yogasana Training Camp (TASP)" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) youth across 17 districts of the state by providing a structured seven-day training program. This camp focuses on personality development and yogasana trainingRs. helping the participants to develop their physicalRs. mentalRs. and spiritual health. The scheme seeks to uplift tribal youth through skill-building and self-improvement techniques in a culturally inclusive and health-oriented environment.
benefits: - **Training and Development:** The scheme offers a seven-day residential training camp focused on personality development and yogasana. The training covers aspects of physical fitnessRs. mental well-beingRs. and spiritual awareness. > **Note:** A total of 50 tribal youths (both male and female) are selected from each of the 17 targeted districts.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.

name: Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC
brief_description: The "Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial relief for food expenses to SEBC category students pursuing higher education in the medical and engineering fields. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance per month for a maximum of 10 months is provided to eligible students.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** - 300/- per month (3Rs./- annually) towards mess charges for most eligible SEBC students. - 700/- per month (7Rs./- annually) towards mess charges for selected students (limited number of beneficiaries). - 1Rs./- per month (15Rs./- annually) for SEBC students studying in self-financed medical/engineering colleges and residing in hostels (with a fixed ceiling on the number of beneficiaries). - **Duration:** Maximum of 10 months in an academic year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Medical or Engineering degree in a recognized institution. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Class 12th).1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The applicant who is already availing similar mess assistance under any other government scheme is not eligible.

name: Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit crops
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion in Fruit Crops" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to enhance the production and productivity of fruit crops by providing financial assistance to farmers for adopting advanced cultivation methods such as high-density and ultra-high-density plantations like MangoRs. GuavaRs. LemonRs. and Pomegranate etc. This initiative supports the states agricultural growth and helps farmers increase their income through modern horticultural practices.
benefits: - **High-Density and Ultra High-Density Plantations:** Farmers can receive assistance ranging from 30Rs./- to 40Rs./- per hectare for crops like mangoRs. guavaRs. lemonRs. and pomegranateRs. with a maximum limit of 4 hectares per beneficiary. - **Tissue-Culture Banana Cultivation:** The assistance covers 40% of the expenditure incurred or 50Rs./-Rs. whichever is lessRs. per beneficiaryRs. with a limit of 4 hectares. - **Papaya Cultivation:** Farmers can receive assistance of 50% of the cost or a maximum of 30Rs./- per hectare.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.

name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Drip Irrigation
brief_description: The scheme component "Drip Irrigation" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote oil palm cultivation in Gujarat to meet domestic demand and reduce dependence on imports. The scheme facilitates the installation of drip irrigation systems for farmersRs. ensuring efficient water use and improved productivity. The subsidy is provided as per the norms of the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)Rs. with differential rates for small & marginal farmers and other farmers.
benefits: - **For Small & Marginal Farmers:** 55% subsidy.- **For Other Farmers:** 45% subsidy.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Establishment of Seed Garden
brief_description: The scheme component "Establishment of Seed Garden" launched under the "National Mission on Edible OilOil Palm" scheme by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase the production of oil palm in Gujarat and reduce dependence on imported oil palm. The scheme provides financial assistance for establishing new seed orchards and related infrastructure to enhance seedling production capacity. It supports farmers with maintenanceRs. input costsRs. and nursery development to promote self-reliance in oil palm cultivation.
benefits: - **For Establishment of New Seed Orchards:** 80Rs./- per seed garden. Minimum area requirement is 15 hectares. - **Nursery Development Assistance:** 40Rs./- per nursery for infrastructure and operational support.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Integrated Child Development Services- Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Integrated Child Development Services is implemented by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the nutritional and health status of all children aged 6 months to 6 yearsRs. along with pregnant women and lactating mothers in the stateRs. by providing supplementary nutritionRs. immunisationRs. and regular health check-ups.
benefits: **The following services are provided free of cost through Anganwadi Centres:** - Supplementary nutritionRs. immunisation/vaccinationRs. and related services for children between 6 months and 3 years. - Immunisation/vaccinationRs. pre-school educationRs. and related services for children aged 3 to 6 years. - Immunisation/vaccinationRs. health check-upsRs. nutritionRs. and health education services for pregnant and lactating mothers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All children between 6 months and 6 yearsRs. as well as pregnant women and lactating mothersRs. are eligible to avail benefits under this scheme. 1. There is no income limit for availing the benefits of this scheme.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions verities / Hybrids verities Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Distribution of Minor and Micro Elements - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Distribution of Minor and Micro Elements" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims the farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas can achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood by distribution of minor and micro elements.
benefits: 1. Distribution of minor and micro elements: The applicant receives a subsidy of 75% of the purchase price or 750/- per hectareRs. whichever is lessRs. for minor and micro elements of a Government-approved grade under FCO 1985. 1. The assistance is limited to a maximum of two hectares per account. > Remark: As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35) > Frequency: Every year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Field Demonstration (TASP & OTASP) Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidiesRs. etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Field demonstration (TASP & OTASP)" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide subsidized agricultural inputs to enhance productivity and livelihood of tribal farmers. Farmers belonging to scheduled tribes and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas can achieve higher production of agricultural crops and improve their livelihood by using plant protection equipmentRs. tarpaulinsRs. field demonstrationsRs. micronutrientsRs. agriculture fairsRs. water carrying pipelinesRs. castor cake/neem cake/LFOM/green manureRs. pump setsRs. 100% water-soluble fertilizerRs. plant protection pesticidesRs. etc. These tools and practicesRs. when used according to scientific recommendationsRs. can significantly increase crop production andRs. consequentlyRs. improve their livelihood.
benefits:
The assistance is provided within the limit of 4000/- for the demonstration of one acre (0.40 ha). A demonstration per account.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be availed every years. > **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35). And condition number-14 is to provide the input material prescribed by the committee.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.

name: Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal
brief_description: The scheme Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD)Rs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to form groups of interested women and men from Gram Panchayats across the stateRs. who are 18 years of age or aboveRs. enabling them to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake business or livelihood activities.
benefits: It is mandatory to form a group in order to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake any business activity.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an interested woman or man. 1. The applicant must be a resident of a Gram Panchayat in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age.

name: Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana (MBKVY)" by the LabourRs. Skill Development and Employment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide skill development training to youth in manufacturingRs. service and other sectors through new age technology-based courses to meet current industry requirements and create skilled manpower in the state. The scheme provides short-term coursesRs. digital trainingRs. future skill courses and new age courses with quality training according to current technologyRs. along with practical training as per the latest technology requirements. The applicant must be a domicile of Gujarat state and must have passed at least Standard 10/12/Industrial Training Institute/Degree-Diploma. The scheme is implemented by Gujarat Skill Development Mission under the guidance of Steering Committee and Implementation and Monitoring Committee. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through skills.gujarat.gov.in portal.
benefits:
**Training Cost Coverage:** Training cost will be directly paid to the Training Provider's bank account based on Common Skilling Norms for National Skill Qualification Framework courses. **Assessment Fee Coverage:** Assessment fee for National Skill Qualification Framework courses will be paid to the concerned Assessment Agency as per set standards. **Industry-Demand Based Course Fees:** For new courses based on industry demandRs. training cost will be paid to training centers as determined by the Steering Committee. **Special Course Fees:** For special types of courses conducted by Skill Institutes/Industrial Training Institutes/Kaushalya The Skill UniversityRs. training cost and method will be as approved by the Steering Committee. **Infrastructure Support:** Raw materialRs. guest facultyRs. Training of TrainersRs. tools equipmentRs. office expenses etc. will be covered under training cost for Industrial Training Institutes. **Certification:** Certification will be provided through concerned Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council for Vocational Training/Kaushalya The Skill University.
**Payment Milestones** _(as reviewed by Mission DirectorRs. Gujarat Skill Development Mission)_ - 30%: After commencement of training batch against valid candidates. - 40%: After certification of trainees (with respect to passed out trainees). - 30%: Based on placement results (final payment as per Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana guidelines).
eligibility: - The trainees must be a domicile of Gujarat. - The trainees must have passed at least 10th Standard / 12th Standard / Industrial Training Institute / Degree-Diploma. - Trainees must be registered on the portal with Aadhaar number submission by Training Provider. - Training must be conducted only through trainers as per course guidelines and syllabus. - On Job Training must be made mandatory as per course requirementsRs. with On Job Training/soft skills to be covered for others. - The Training Centers must carry branding of the MBKVY scheme. _*Monitoring will be portal-based and payments will be made based on portal data only._ _*For National Skill Qualification Framework coursesRs. assessment and certification will be done through concerned Sector Skill Councils/Gujarat Council for Vocational Training/Kaushalya The Skill University._ _*For new courses based on industry demandRs. assessment will be conducted as per standards set by Gujarat Council for Vocational Training or Kaushalya The Skill UniversityRs. with certification provided through Gujarat Council for Vocational Training and Kaushalya The Skill University._

name: Decentralized Peoples Nursery
brief_description: The scheme "Decentralized Peoples Nursery" by the Social Forestry wing of the Principal Chief Conservator of Forest & Head of the Forest Force (HoFF)Rs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to augment the income of farmers and increase tree cover by promoting afforestation activities. It allows individuals and institutions interested in raising seedlings to apply for assistance. The scheme typically involves a target of 20Rs. seedlings to be raised by an applicant. A key feature is that ownership of the seedlings remains with the beneficiaryRs. who is free to sell or use them without external permission. Financial compensation is provided in installments for the plants raised. The scheme is implemented by the Forest Department.
benefits: **Financial Assistance for Raising Seedlings:** 2.20 per seedling is provided in three installments. **Ownership of Seedlings:** The beneficiary retains full ownership of the seedlings raised and can sell or use them without requiring permission from anyone. **Income Generation:** The scheme is recognized as a "very good income generating activity". **Accessibility of Plants:** Decentralized people's nurseries ensure the availability of plants within a reasonable distance of villages for extensive tree plantations in both rural and urban areas. **Targeted Benefits for Scheduled Caste Community:** Under the "Special Component Program (SCP)-Decentralised Peoples Nursery"Rs. similar benefits are extended to beneficiaries and beneficiary groups belonging to the Scheduled Caste community.
eligibility: - The applicant must be interested in raising seedlings. - The scheme is open to all individuals. - The applicant must typically aim to raise a target of 20Rs. seedlings. **Preference** - An applicant who can keep a piece of land reserved for the purpose of nursery for a minimum of twelve months. - An applicant who plans to undertake the nursery activity as a commercial activity and not merely a seasonal one on that piece of land. **Specific to Decentralized School / Kisan Nursery** - The interested stakeholder must submit an application in response to an advertisement in the local media. - Small and marginal farmersRs. Below Poverty Line (BPL) cardholder familiesRs. landless laborersRs. and schools can raise plants under this variant. **Specific to SCP-Decentralised Peoples Nursery** - The beneficiary or beneficiary group must belong to the Scheduled Caste community.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level) is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 9 and 10 by providing financial assistance to meritorious studentsRs. based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT)Rs. Uttarakhand.
benefits: Rate of Scholarship: - **For Class 9th Students:** 900/- per month for 1 year.- **For Class 10th Students:** 900/- per month for 1 year.
eligibility: 1. The student must have passed Class 8 (institutional) from a Government School or Government-aided private school of the state (excluding Central and Residential schools) and must be studying in Class 9. 1. The applicant must qualify in the competitive examination conducted by SCERTRs. Uttarakhand. 1. The selected student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance and secure at least 60% marks in Class 9. For SC/ST studentsRs. a relaxation of 5% is provided in both marks and attendance requirements. 1. Based on the examination resultsRs. a student securing a position in the top 10% of the total participants will be eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. There is no income criterion for the parents/guardians of the student under this scholarship. 1. A student cannot avail double benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes.

name: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Upgradation of Existing Fishing Vessels for Export Competency"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish healthRs. uplift fishermenRs. and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnesRs. ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government. > **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags in exports due to non-norms. SoRs. cold storage/ice plant modernisation is necessary to keep the fish in a healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three-wheeler with ice boxRs. including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending centre to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
1. Unit cost : 15Rs./-. 1. General category : 40% assistanceRs. i.e.Rs. 6Rs./-. 1. WomenRs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribes (ST) : 60% assistanceRs. i.e.Rs. 9Rs./-. 1. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs.
