SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY" with a component "Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Insurance of Fishers is one of the sub-components of the PMMSYRs. and it provides insurance coverage to fishersRs. which includes fishermenRs. fish workersRs. fish farmersRs. and other individuals directly involved in fishing and related activities. The sub scheme offers coverage for deathRs. permanent total disability (PTD). The National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB) and M/s Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL) implement the scheme. The premium cost is shared between the Central and State GovernmentsRs. with no contribution from the beneficiary. The implementing agency of the scheme is the Commissioner of Fisheries.
> **Objective of scheme:** - To financially assist the fisherman/fisherman's family in case of death/injury.
benefits:
**Sr. No.****Name of Component****Standard of assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits**1. Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability5Rs./-Once to the legal heir after death
> **Mode of Disbursement:** - The claim amount is deposited directly into the claimant'sRs. nominee'sRs. or legal heir's savings account via Direct Bank Transfer (DBT). > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - The insurance company will settle the claim within 15 working days of receiving the complete claim documentation. If a claim is not settled within this periodRs. the insurance company will pay a simple interest of 10% on the admissible claim amount from the date of document submission until the payment date.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a fisherRs. which includes fishermenRs. fish workersRs. fish farmersRs. and any other person directly involved in fishing or fisheries-related activities. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 70 years old. 1. The insured person should not have been 71 years of age on the date of the accident. 1. The applicant must be approved by the State/Union Territory (UT) fisheries department. 1. At the time of a claimRs. the claimant or insured fisher must be verified and certified by an "Appropriate Authority". 1. The applicant should have registered himself in the concerned district office.

name: PMMSY: Construction of Ice Plant/Storage of Minimum 10 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Construction of Ice Plant/storage of minimum 10 tonne capacity"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernize cold storage and ice plant facilities to preserve fish in healthy condition and ensure hygienic delivery to consumers. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for the construction of ice plants/storage units of a minimum 10-tonne capacityRs. enabling fishermen and fish sellers to maintain the freshness of fish and improve income opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
Construction of Ice Plant/Storage (minimum 10 tonne capacity): - Unit cost is 40Rs./- lakhs. The amount of assistance will be available at the rate of 40% of the unit cost for the beneficiary of the general category and 60% of the unit cost for the beneficiary of the women and ST/SC category. - The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs. SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Skiing Course
brief_description: The scheme Skiing Course is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote skiing among the youth of the state by providing professional trainingRs. enabling participants to become proficient skiersRs. competitive athletesRs. or certified skiing instructors.
benefits: The beneficiary will become a skiing trainer or competitorRs. upon completing the course.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 25 years of age. 1. The applicant will be considered on a first-comeRs. first-served basis. > The total number of 40 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Basic Kayaking Course
brief_description: The scheme Basic Kayaking Course is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train and certify youth of Uttarakhand as skilled kayaking instructors with essential life-saving skills.
benefits: The beneficiary will receive the training in basic kayaking.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be able to swim 100 meters within 3 minutes. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically fit. 1. The applicant must have prior training in life-saving techniques and water sports operations from a recognized institute. > The total number of 15 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Rafting Course & Internship
brief_description: The scheme Rafting Course & Internship is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train and certify youth of UttarakhandRs. aged 18 to 30 yearsRs. as skilled and professional river rafting guides.
benefits: The beneficiary will receive training and internship opportunities to become a river rafting guide.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 30 years of age. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy. > The total number of 215 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration
brief_description: The scheme "Production of Audio Albums of songs on Patriotism & National Integration" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of Goa under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to strengthen the values of Patriotism & National Integration among members of Tiatr fraternityRs. addressing the problem that audio albums of Konkani songs of Patriotism & National Integration are rarely produced in Goa despite numerous audio albums of songs (Kantaram) in Konkani being produced. The scheme provides financial support as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for the production of audio albums containing at least 10 songs of Patriotism & National Integration and distribution of 300 copies to schools and groups participating in various competitions. The applicant must be a tiatr artiste (commercial or non-commercial). The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
##### ***Financial Support*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will give financial support as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for the production of the Album. ##### ***Distribution Channel*** Tiatr Academy of Goa will distribute 300 copies to schools & groups which participate in its various competitions and may also offer them to other schoolsRs. groupsRs. individualsRs. etc. who are interested in promoting Patriotism & National Integration. ##### ***Commercial Rights*** The applicant is free to sell the remaining Compact Discs. ##### ***Sponsorship Permission*** The applicant may take sponsorship to meet the cost of production of Album. ##### ***Quality Assurance*** Lyrics will be scrutinized by the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa with advisory support to improve quality.
**Conditions** _*The applicant must produce the Audio album strictly following the specified norms._ _*Melody and musical arrangement must be appropriate to the content of the song._ _*Lyrics must be approved by the Recommendation Committee._ _*Official letter of acceptance must be obtained from Tiatr Academy of Goa before production._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a tiatr artiste (commercial as well as non-commercial). - The applicant must submit a typed copy of lyrics of songs to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form. - The applicant must obtain approval of lyrics from the Recommendation Committee appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must receive official letter of acceptance from Tiatr Academy of Goa before production. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against casteRs. creed and religion in the lyrics of songs which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Album Content Requirements*** - The audio album must include at least 10 songs of Patriotism & National Integration. - The album should not have solo songs only. - 50% of the songs must be group songs and children's songs. - Melody and musical arrangement must be appropriate to the content of the song. - The applicant will have to give 300 copies of Audio albums to Tiatr Academy of Goa. ##### ***Quality Control Process*** - Lyrics will be scrutinized by the Recommendation Committee. - Committee will be free to advise the lyricists to improve the quality of lyrics. - Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disapprove the lyrics as per the opinion given by Recommendation Committee.

name: Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support cultural institutions and individuals in organizing various activities related to tiatr in their respective villages and towns to preserve and promote the traditional Konkani theatrical art form. The scheme provides financial support for organizing Konkani musical showsRs. singing competitionsRs. acting competitionsRs. one act playsRs. and programs celebrating the contribution of local tiatr artists both deceased and living but non-activeRs. while ensuring these activities are made accessible to the public free of charge. The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual willing to organize tiatr-related activities and must submit applications within specified advance notice periods ranging from 8 to 30 days depending on the activity type. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms available at the Tiatr Academy of Goa office.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Support Categories*** - ***Category A1*** ***- Konkani Musical Shows:*** Financial assistance for organizing shows with minimum 14 songs including duetsRs. triosRs. quartetsRs. choral songsRs. solos and at least 2 comedy skits.- ***Category A2*** ***- Singing Competitions:*** Financial assistance for organizing competitions with minimum 15 participants singing newly composed kantaram.- ***Category B1*** ***- Competitions:*** Financial assistance for acting competitions including monologueRs. dialogueRs. and one act play competitions.- ***Category B2*** ***- Celebrating Tiatr Artists:*** Financial assistance for organizing programs to remember and felicitate prominent tiatr artists. ##### ***Conditions*** - Programs must be staged free of charge to the public. - All promotional materials must acknowledge collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo is mandatory. - No adverse remarks against any governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or content against casteRs. creedRs. and religion permitted. - Chief Guest and Guest of Honour must be decided in consultation with Tiatr Academy of Goa. - President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual organizing tiatr-related activities in Goa. - The applicant must organize activities in their respective villages or towns. - The applicant must ensure the program is staged free of charge to the public. - The applicant must agree to acknowledge Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all promotional materials. - The applicant must ensure content does not contain adverse remarks against governmentsRs. individualsRs. institutionsRs. or content against casteRs. creedRs. and religion. ***For Konkani Musical Shows*** - The applicant must ensure lyrics are newly composed and not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drumsRs. keyboardRs. guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must organize minimum 14 songs including interactive duetsRs. duosRs. triosRs. quartets/quintetsRs. choral songsRs. solos and at least 2 comedy skits. - The applicant must submit typed lyrics and skit scripts at least 30 days in advance. ***For Singing Competitions*** - The applicant must ensure minimum 15 participants. - The applicant must ensure participants sing newly composed kantaram not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums. - The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drumsRs. keyboardRs. guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - The applicant must provide competition rules to Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must submit typed song lyrics at least 8 days in advance. ***For Other Competitions*** - The applicant must submit application form at least 30 days in advance. ***For Celebrating Tiatr Artists*** - The applicant must focus on prominent tiatr artists such as actorsRs. singersRs. writers. - The applicant must submit application form at least 15 days in advance.

name: Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made productsRs. thereby improving income and living standards. Under this schemeRs. tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project costs and the remaining 50% as a loan at a concessional interest rate.
benefits: > **Monetary Benefit** - 50% of the project cost or 5Rs. whichever is lessRs. provided as subsidy. - The remaining 50% of the project cost is provided as a loan. > ***Subsidy Disbursement*** - Given in two installments 60% in the first installment and 40% in the second installment. > ***Interest Rate*** - Loan at 4% per annum. > ***Repayment*** - Loan (excluding subsidy) must be repaid in 20 equal installments over 5 yearsRs. including interest. - Option to repay earlier is allowed. > ***Beneficiary Contribution*** - No upfront contribution required from the beneficiary.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be residing in a tribal area. - The applicant must be engaged in or willing to establish a self-employment venture through a Nahri Kendra.

name: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks
brief_description: The "6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals in purchasing vehicles for self-employment purposes. Under this schemeRs. tribal beneficiaries availing bank loans for vehicle purchase with interest subsidy. This financial support helps reduce the repayment burden on tribal entrepreneurs while encouraging mobility-based self-employment opportunities.
benefits: - 6% interest subsidy on bank loans for vehicle purchase. - Loan eligibility range: 5Rs. to 20Rs..
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of tribal areas in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have taken a bank loan specifically for vehicle purchase.

name: Self Employment Scheme Gujarat
brief_description: The "Self Employment Scheme" was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support to unemployed tribal individuals by offering affordable loans for self-employment opportunities. Under this schemeRs. loans ranging from 50Rs. to 5Rs. are provided at a concessional interest rate to enable beneficiaries to start any of the 85 identified businesses.
benefits: - **Monetary Benefit:** Loan assistance between 50Rs. and 5Rs. depending on the chosen business activity.- **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum.- **Coverage:** Applicable for 85 different types of businesses as identified by the department.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be unemployed at the time of applying.

name: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 1 - SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India from 2023-24 to 2025-26. The scheme aims to provide access to high quality education to students from Scheduled Caste communities in the best private residential schools in the countryRs. thereby securing their future opportunities and filling the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector. Under the "SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools)" modeRs. the scheme provides scholarships covering school fees including tuition fees and hostel fees including mess chargesRs. along with bridge courses to help students adapt to the new environment. The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste student with parental income not exceeding 2Rs./- per year and must qualify through the National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA conducted by National Testing Agency.
benefits: ##### ***Scholarship Coverage*** School fee including tuition fee and hostel fee including mess charges as per following limits: - Class 9th: 1Rs./- per student per annum. - Class 10th: 1Rs./- per student per annum. - Class 11th: 1Rs./- per student per annum. - Class 12th: 1Rs./- per student per annum. ##### ***Bridge Course Support*** - Up to 10% of annual fee provided separately for bridge course extending up to 3 months. ##### ***Mode of Disbursement*** - Direct transfer to school accounts through e-Anudaan portal. - Within 30 days from date of confirmation of admission on Information Technology portal. ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - _Automatic Progression__:_ Students admitted in Class 9 or 11 shall automatically be funded for next classes till they complete 12th class.- _Bridge Course_: Conducted outside school hours covering academic topics and personality development.- _Counsellor Support_: Schools designate one teacher as counsellor to resolve difficulties faced by students.- _Future Connectivity_: Students may be connected to Post Matric Scholarship Scheme or Top-Class Education Scheme for further studies. _*The applicant must pass the exams of the previous class to continue receiving funding for subsequent years._ _*The applicant must maintain enrollment in the assigned SHRESHTA school._ _*If student leaves after admission and payment of feeRs. it must be brought to notice of Central Government immediately and fees paid should be refunded to Consolidated Fund of India._
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste community. - The applicant must be studying in recognized schools - Private or Government or Local Body schools. - The income of the parents of the applicant must not exceed 2Rs./- per year. - The applicant seeking admission in Class 9th must have passed Class 8th in the academic year immediately preceding the year of admission. - The applicant seeking admission in Class 11th must have passed Class 10th in the academic year immediately preceding the year of admission. - The applicant must qualify in National Entrance Test for SHRESHTA conducted by National Testing Agency.

name: Children's Tiatr Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Children's Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage the development of Tiatr by providing a platform for children aged up to 16 years to participate in traditional Konkani theatre productionsRs. addressing the growing enthusiasm among students and individuals to involve children in Tiatr activities. The scheme provides financial support to participating groups and awards mementos and certificates across multiple categories including best performanceRs. individual artistesRs. directionRs. technical aspectsRs. and musical components. The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged 16 years or below on the application submission date and themes must be compulsorily based on the lives of children only. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms.
benefits: - Financial support as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - Financial assistance covers expenditure towards Music (Live Band with at least two blowing instruments)Rs. Light EffectsRs. Stage SettingRs. Background MusicRs. Make upRs. CostumesRs. Refreshments for rehearsalsRs. and Transport. - All payments made by cheques in the name of the Educational InstitutionsRs. Sports and Cultural AssociationsRs. or Individual Producer. - Free DVD copy of the recorded performance provided to the producer or director. - Mementos and certificates awarded to winners in different categories (No Cash Prizes). - Video recording of all tiatrs for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa Library. - First three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition get direct entry into the festival.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an Educational InstitutionRs. Sports and Cultural AssociationRs. or Individual Producer. - The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged up to 16 years on the date fixed for submission of application. - The applicant must ensure themes of Tiatr are compulsorily based on the lives of children only. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the tiatr is not less than one hour and a half and not more than two hours and a half (including interval of minimum 10 minutes and maximum 15 minutes). - The applicant must present the Tiatr in the traditional format as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the Tiatr has 6 to 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 cantos. - The applicant must ensure comedy is linked to the story of the play. - The applicant must include at least 8 Kantaram which should include 1 duet (Interactive)Rs. 1 Duo (Interactive)Rs. 1 Trio (Interactive)Rs. 1 Quartet/Quintet (Interactive)Rs. 1 Choral Song and Solos. > ***Priority*** - The first three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition will get a direct entry into this festivalRs. provided their entries are received before due date. > ***Other Conditions*** - Not more than 2 shows of the given script must have been performed prior to the performance at the competition. - No adverse remarks against any GovernmentsRs. IndividualsRs. Institutions or anything against casteRs. creed and religion in the scriptsRs. lyrics of songsRs. performancesRs. or speeches. - Artistes including technicians and backstage artistes whose names appear in the submitted list shall be permitted to participate only under that troupe (Only musicians can take part in more than one troupe).

name: Popular Tiatr Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Popular Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to bring about all round development of Popular Tiatr by organizing annual competitions in different parts of GoaRs. preserving and promoting the traditional format of tiatr performances. The scheme provides cash prizes ranging from 2Rs./- to 2Rs./- for various categories including performanceRs. directionRs. actingRs. singingRs. and technical aspectsRs. along with mementos and certificates for winners. The applicant must have completed at least 5 performances including Kantaram during the period from 1st April 2018 to 31st December 2018 and must perform in specified auditoriums across Goa. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through submission of application forms along with required documents.
benefits:
##### ***Cash Prizes for Performance Categories*** 1st Prize: 2Rs./- and Memento; 2nd Prize: 1Rs./- and Memento; 3rd Prize: 1Rs./- and Memento ##### ***Individual Artist Awards (Acting)*** - 1st Prize (Male): 10Rs./-; 2nd Prize (Male): 5Rs./- - 1st Prize (Female): 10Rs./-; 2nd Prize (Female): 5Rs./- - Best Comedian (Male): 10Rs./-; Best Comedian (Female): 10Rs./- - Best Supporting Artist (Male): 5Rs./-; Best Supporting Artist (Female): 5Rs./- - Best Actor in Negative Role (Male): 5Rs./-; Best Actor in Negative Role (Female): 5Rs./- ##### ***Best Direction Awards*** 1st Prize: 15Rs./-; 2nd Prize: 10Rs./-; 3rd Prize: 5Rs./- ##### ***Technical and Other Aspects*** - Best Setting: 10Rs./-; Best Light Effects: 10Rs./- - Best Live Music: 15Rs./- (To be shared by all Musicians) - Best Make-up: 5Rs./-; Best Costumes: 5Rs./- - Best Background Music: 10Rs./- ##### ***Best Singer Awards (Solo)*** - 1st Prize (Male): 10Rs./-; 2nd Prize (Male): 5Rs./- - 1st Prize (Female): 10Rs./-; 2nd Prize (Female): 5Rs./- - Child Artist (Male): 2Rs./-; Child Artist (Female): 2Rs./- ##### ***Best Actor (Child Artists)*** Child Artist (Male): 2Rs./-; Child Artist (Female): 2Rs./- ##### ***Other Songs Categories*** - Best Duet: 10Rs./-; Best Duo: 10Rs./-; Best Trio: 15Rs./- - Best Quartet/Quintet: 20Rs./- - Best Choral Song (Maximum four singers): 10Rs./- - Best Comedy Kantar (solo): 5Rs./- ##### ***Script and Lyrics Awards*** - Best Lyrics (1st Prize): 5Rs./- - Best Script (1st Prize): 10Rs./- - Best Script (2nd Prize): 5Rs./- ##### ***Additional Benefits*** - Performance Fee: 5Rs./- (only if the applicant gives consent to video record the performance). - Free DVD Copy: One copy of the performance recording will be provided to the applicant. - Video Recording: Expenditure on video recording will be borne by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
_*Awards will be announced and distributed in a specially organized Award Distribution Ceremony._ _*All prizes are one-time cash awards._
eligibility: - The applicant must have completed at least 5 performances including Kantaram during the period from 1st April to 31st December. - The applicant must perform in specified auditoriums including Ravindra Bhavan MargaoRs. Gomant Vidya Niketan MargaoRs. Hanuman Natyagraha MapusaRs. Kala Academy PanjimRs. Rajiv Gandhi Kala Mandir PondaRs. Ravindra Bhavan VascoRs. Ravindra Bhavan SanquelimRs. or Ravindra Bhavan Curchorem. - The applicant must present popular tiatrs having traditional format of the tiatr. - The applicant must maintain the traditional format strictly as specified. - The applicant must communicate the dateRs. time and place of staging of the tiatr in the competition to the organizers at least 15 days in advance from the date of performance. - The applicant must arrange for 6 passes for the Judges and the Organizers at the performance of the Competition show. - The applicant must ensure live music with a band consisting of at least 5 instruments which shall include drumsRs. keyboardRs. bassRs. guitar and 2 blowing instruments. - (Optional) The applicant may include child artists up to 12 years of age for special awards in singing and acting. ***Other Conditions*** - The tiatr must be strictly presented as per the given traditional format wherever it is staged. - If the format is not maintainedRs. the tiatr will not be eligible for 1stRs. 2nd and 3rd prizeRs. however individual prizes will be given for deserving artists. - The decision to award or not to award the prizes shall depend entirely on the recommendations of the panel of judges. - Political songs should be performed without exceeding the limits of freedom of expressionRs. and criticizing individuals by taking name or displaying images or character assassination will not be allowed.

name: Award Winning Tiatr Festival
brief_description: The scheme "Award Winning Tiatr Festival" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to popularize award winning tiatrs by organizing an annual festival comprising of tiatrs which have won 1stRs. 2nd and 3rd places in various competitionsRs. and will be organized in various Talukas of Goa with venues decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The scheme provides financial remuneration to directors/producers for staging their award-winning tiatrs and covers payment to service providers for arranging stageRs. lightsRs. sound etc. when no furnished auditorium is available. The applicant must be a director/producer of a tiatr that has won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd place in specified competitions and must submit self-attested copies of Aadhaar and Permanent Account Number Card along with the application. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Remuneration for Tiatr Performance*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr winners: 40Rs./- for each tiatr. - Kala Academy Group 'A' winners: 35Rs./- for each tiatr. - Kala Academy Group 'B' winners: 30Rs./- for each tiatr. - Tiatr Academy of Goa Children Tiatr winners: 25Rs./- for each tiatr. ##### ***Infrastructure Support*** - Payment to service providers for arranging stageRs. lightsRs. sound etc. at rates fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa (applicable when no furnished auditorium is available). ##### ***Performance Platform*** - Opportunity to showcase award-winning tiatrs in various Talukas of Goa. - Venues for the festival will be decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
eligibility: - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that has won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd place in any of the following competitions: - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Popular Tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'A' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd prize in Kala Academy Group 'B' tiatr Competition. - The applicant must be the director/producer of a tiatr that won 1stRs. 2nd or 3rd prize in Tiatr Academy of Goa Children's Tiatr Competition. ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - Presentation of tiatr including kantaram should be done exactly the way it was presented in the respective competitions. - The tiatr should be shown without charging tickets. - Non-adherence to performance norms may result in withholding the payments. - Tiatr Academy of Goa may depute an observer to verify whether the performance is as per the norms.

name: Gaura Shakti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Gaura Shakti Yojana is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The objective of the scheme is to prevent crimes against women and girls and to ensure prompt action in case of any incident. Under thisRs. a three-tier support system has been established in the stateRs. comprising Mahila Desks at the police station levelRs. Women Safety Helpline and Women Counselling Cells at the district levelRs. and the State Women Safety Helpline at the state level. Under this schemeRs. efforts are being made to structurally strengthen the three-tier systemRs. enhance transparency in functioningRs. create awareness among women and girls about their rightsRs. and provide them training in self-defence. AdditionallyRs. the responsibilities of police officers have been clearly defined at every level to ensure effective implementation.
benefits: Under this SchemeRs. the following steps have been taken by Uttarakhand Police to prevent crimes against women and ensure womens safety: 1. A Quick Reaction Team (QRT) has been formed under the Women Help Desk at every police station. On receiving a complaint related to women at the police stationRs. the QRT immediately reaches the spot and acts as the first responderRs. providing all possible assistance to the victim. 1. Identification of Hot Spots and sensitive areas with regard to crimes against women is being carried out. CCTV cameras/lights are being installed in such Hot SpotsRs. and their regular monitoring is ensured. 1. Regular patrolling by CheetahRs. Mahila CheetahRs. and CPU teams is conducted during the opening and closing hours of schoolsRs. collegesRs. and coaching institutes. 1. A team comprising Women Help Desk In-charges and four constablesRs. named Team GauraRs. has been constituted. The team regularly organizes awareness programmes to educate students on safetyRs. drugsRs. traffic rulesRs. cybercrimeRs. etc. To strengthen this initiativeRs. about 3Rs. awareness booklets have been distributed to districts from the headquarters. 1. From 20th to 22nd February 2023Rs. a total of 35 women personnel appointed to Team Gaura from all districts were provided Self-Defense Instructor Course (Level-I) training. In continuationRs. the process of providing Level-II training to these personnel is underway. These trained women police personnel are regularly conducting training programmes in schoolsRs. collegesRs. and other institutions across districts to teach self-defense techniques to girl students.
eligibility: 1. Women and girls of the state are eligible to receive assistance under this scheme.

name: Remembering Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears - Organisation of Special Dedicated Programmes
brief_description: The scheme "Remembering Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears - Organisation of Special Dedicated Programmes" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to make the younger generation aware of the contribution and sacrifices of great tiatr personalities of the past who are no more with usRs. addressing the problem that today's younger generation does not know much about these pioneers whose contribution to Goan tiatr is immense. The scheme provides collaboration with troupes/institutions/individuals for producing special dedicated programmes on the lives of particular artistes and financial assistance with auditorium/hall facilities for staging programmes. The applicant must be a troupe/institution/individual willing to produce special programmes dedicated to particular artistes and must obtain No Objection Certificate from the nearest family members of the late artiste. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for each show. **Infrastructure Support:** Provision of auditorium/hall to stage the programme. **Village Performances:** Financial assistance as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for erecting temporary pandalRs. providing stageRs. soundRs. etc. for village performances. **Additional Shows:** Option for additional 2 shows in villages at an amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa plus additional amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa for Pandal/Hall/Auditorium including StageRs. SoundRs. etc. **Documentation:** Tiatr Academy of Goa will document the programme and preserve it at Tiatr Academy of Goa's library. **Marketing Materials:** Provision of banner for tiatr performances and logo for musical shows. **Number of Shows:** Maximum of 4 shows at different places including 1 show at the area of residence. _* Tiatr Academy of Goa has no objection if sponsorship is taken by the producer from other sources._
> ***Conditions*** _*All shows must be shown to the public free without charging any tickets._ _*Programme duration should be at least 2 hours for musical show and 3 hours for tiatr._ _*Display Tiatr Academy of Goa banner compulsorily on front side wing of stage for tiatr or minimum size of 6ft. x 10ft. backdrop with Tiatr Academy of Goa logo for musical show._ _*Return banner to Tiatr Academy of Goa after all shows are staged._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a troupeRs. institutionRs. or individual. - The applicant must wish to produce and stage a special programme dedicated to a particular artiste of yesteryears. - The applicant must obtain No Objection Certificate from the nearest family members of the late artiste. - The applicant must invite family members compulsorily for the function. - The applicant must stage the inaugural show preferably in PanjimRs. Margao or in the village of the artiste where he resided. - The applicant must submit the proposal well in advance giving all details of the programme including script and lyrics to be presented including the names of the artistes. - The applicant must comply with all conditions specified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must not make any adverse remark in any form either written or verbal against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions in the scripts/song lyrics/performances/speeches. - In all advertisementsRs. oralRs. print or electronic mediaRs. bannersRs. etc.Rs. the following must be inserted/published/announced: 'This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa'. _* Tiatr Academy of Goa has no objection if sponsorship is taken by the producer from other sources._
***Programme Content Requirements*** - The programme must include staging of tiatr/one-act plays written by the artistes of yesteryears. - The programme can include musical activities such as songs and music composed and sung by the late artiste if he/she was a singer or music composer/musician. - The programme should include narration of history of the life of the late artiste to whom the programme is dedicated.

name: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 2 - NGO Operated Schools
brief_description: The umbrella scheme "Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA)" was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme has a sub-scheme/component called "SHRESHTA Mode 2: Non-Governmental Organization Operated Schools". The sub-scheme aims to provide quality education and opportunities to students from Scheduled Caste communities through grant-in-aid institutions run by Non-Governmental Organizations and residential high schoolsRs. addressing the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector. The scheme provides financial assistance to Non-Governmental Organization operated schools and hostels for school fees and residential charges for Scheduled Caste studentsRs. along with infrastructure support and monitoring mechanisms to ensure quality education delivery.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** _(Electronic transfer through e-Anudaan portal and Public Financial Management System)_ **Primary Level Students** - Residential: 44Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Non-residential: 27Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Hostel only: 30Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. **Secondary Level Students** - Residential: 55Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Non-residential: 35Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. - Hostel only: 30Rs./- per Scheduled Caste student per year. **Non-Recurring Grants (Every 5 Years)** - Secondary Residential School (100 students): 3Rs./- for fixed items plus 900/- per student. - Secondary Non-residential School (100 students): 3Rs./- fixed. - Secondary Hostel (100 students): 2Rs./- for fixed items plus 900/- per student. - Primary Residential School (100 students): 2Rs./- for fixed items plus 900/- per student. - Primary Non-residential School (100 students): 1Rs./- fixed. - Hostel for destitute Children (100 students): 2Rs./- for fixed items plus 900/- per student. ##### ***Attendance-Based Grant Disbursement*** - 75% or more attendance: Full grant. - 50% to less than 75% attendance: 75% of grant. - 25% to less than 50% attendance: 50% of grant. - Less than 25% attendance: No grant (without valid grounds).
eligibility: ##### ***Eligibility for the Organization*** - The applicant must be a reputed school chainRs. Corporate Social Responsibility foundationRs. or reputed organization running good quality schools. - The applicant must be registered and working in quality school education. - The applicant must have schools recognized by the State Government and affiliated to State or Central Boards. - The applicant must have a properly constituted Managing Committee with powersRs. duties and responsibilities clearly defined in written Constitution. - The applicant must have appropriate administrative structure and duly constituted Managing or Executive Committee. - The applicant must be initiated and governed by its own members on democratic principles. - The applicant must be a non-profit entity. - The applicant should have its own website for pro-active disclosure of information. - The applicant must be registered on the Non-Governmental Organization Darpan portal of National Institution for Transforming India Aayog. - The applicant must have been receiving Grant-in-aid and showing satisfactory performance. - The applicant must maintain higher classes up to at least Class 12th. - The applicant organization running primary schools (Classes 1st to 8th) must upgrade to Secondary or Senior Secondary Schools (up to at least Class 10th) before 2027. ##### ***Eligibility for the Student*** - The beneficiary must belong to Scheduled Caste community. - The beneficiary must be admitted in schools run by eligible Non-Governmental Organizations under this scheme. ##### ***Infrastructure-related Eligibility Requirements*** - The applicant must have one classroom for each class or section. - The applicant must have sufficient benches and desks or chairs and tables for all students. - The applicant must provide one decent cot and bed for every child in residential facilities. - The applicant must have light and fans for every classroom and residing room. - The applicant must have female service staffRs. wardens and chowkidars for girls' residential schools with adequate security provisions. - The applicant must have one toilet and bathroom for every 10 children maintained in clean and hygienic condition. - The applicant must have hygienic kitchen and dining room. - The applicant should provide nutritious and sufficient food to students thrice a day with maintained records. - The applicant must provide clean and safe drinking water facility to students. - The applicant should arrange regular doctor visits with maintained records and keep first-aid boxes and emergency medicines. - The applicant should provide 4 sets of uniforms including shoes per year to students with maintained distribution records. - The applicant should have games and sports facilityRs. physical educationRs. yogaRs. and playground available for students. - The applicant must install Closed Circuit Television cameras with linkage to website for live streaming. - The applicant must have Aadhaar based attendance system integrated into central portal. ##### ***School Performance Standards*** - The applicant school must have Class 10th and Class 12th pass percentage not less than average Board result of the State or Central Board. - The applicant must have qualified and well-trained teachers as per standards of State or Central Board. - The applicant must have teachers in High Schools who are at least graduates in their respective fields with Bachelor of Education qualification. - The applicant must maintain minimum 6 teachers in a school and minimum 2 teachers in a hostel. - The applicant should pay honorariums to teachers and staff in time as per minimum rates prevailing in the district.

name: Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and around Forest Areas: Assistance in case of Death/Injury/Disability due to Wild Animal Attack
brief_description: The scheme Assistance in Case of Death/Injury/Disability Due to Wild Animal Attack is a sub-component of the umbrella scheme Compensation for Loss of Life and Property Caused by Wild Animals in and Around Forest AreasRs. which is implemented by the Department of ForestRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals or their dependents in cases of deathRs. injuryRs. or disability caused by attacks from wild animals such as tigersRs. leopardsRs. elephantsRs. bearsRs. crocodilesRs. snakesRs. and other specified species in and around forest areas.
benefits: ***The following compensation amounts are currently given in case of injury/death of a person due to wildlife attack:*** **Type of Human Injury****Rates payable for ex-gratia amount as per Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution RulesRs. 2024****As per Norms of State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)****Source of Payment : Amount payable from State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)****Source of Payment : Amount payable under Human Wildlife Conflict Relief Distribution Fund Rules 2024**Minor Injury1. 15Rs./- 2. 16Rs./- A deep wound that requires hospitalization: 1. 5Rs./- per person 2. 16Rs./- per person9Rs./- per personSerious Injury1Rs./-A deep wound that requires hospitalization: 1. 5Rs./- per person 2. 16Rs./- per person1. 94Rs./- per person 2. 84Rs./- per personPartial Disability1Rs./-Loss of any body part (including penis) or eye/eyes: Disability between 40% and 60%: 74Rs./- per person. 74Rs./- per person26Rs./- per personTotal Disability3Rs./- 3.00 lakh per person for disability exceeding 60%Rs. subject to certification by a doctor from a Government hospital or dispensary confirming the extent and cause of the disability.2Rs./- per person50Rs./- per personIn Case of Death of an Adult or a Minor6Rs./- 4.00 lakh per person: This includes individuals involved in relief operations or preparedness activitiesRs. subject to certification of the cause of death by the competent authority.4Rs./- per person2Rs./- per person***HoweverRs. for compensation provided for human injury caused by wild animalsRs. it is illegal for family members or any other person to claim the ex-gratia amount if an elderlyRs. medically unfitRs. disabledRs. mentally unstableRs. or minor person is left alone in the forest and is harmed by wild animals.***
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant or their dependent must have suffered deathRs. injuryRs. or disability due to an attack by a wild animal such as: - Tiger - Leopard - Snow Leopard - Wild Elephant - All three species of bear - Hyena - Wild Boar - Crocodile / Gharial - Snake

name: Solo Drama Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Solo Drama Competition" was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote solo theatrical performances and encourage talent in the field of drama across Gujarat by organizing a state-level competition that recognizes excellence in actingRs. directionRs. writingRs. and scene composition. The scheme provides cash prizes to winning participantsRs. with the first prize winner receiving 2Rs./- and the second prize winner receiving 1Rs./-Rs. along with special category awards of 500/- each for Original DramaRs. Best DirectorRs. Best WriterRs. and Best Scene Composition. The applicant must be willing to participate in the state-level solo drama competition and perform a solo theatrical act.
benefits: - First prize winner receives 2Rs./-. - Second prize winner receives 1Rs./-. - Original Drama category winner receives 500/-. - Best Director receives 500/-. - Best Writer receives 500/-. - Best Scene Composition receives 500/-. _*The benefits are disbursed as one-time cash prizes awarded after the competition results are declared._

name: Scheme for Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms
brief_description: Launched in 26th September 2013Rs. the "Scheme for Action Research and Studies on Judicial Reforms" by the Department of JusticeRs. Ministry of Law and JusticeRs. Govt. of IndiaRs. aims to promote research and studies on issues related to the National Mission for Justice Delivery and Legal Reforms being implemented by the Department of Justice. The scheme provides financial assistance for undertaking action researchRs. evaluation studiesRs. monitoring studiesRs. capacity buildingRs. publishing reportsRs. and promoting innovative programmes in the areas of Justice DeliveryRs. Legal ResearchRs. and Judicial Reforms. Financial assistance is limited to a maximum ceiling of 25Rs./- (Rupees Twenty-Five Lakhs)Rs. although the Project Sanctioning Committee may relax this ceiling in exceptional cases involving large scopeRs. sample sizeRs. or project duration.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance shall be extended for undertaking action researchRs. evaluation studiesRs. and monitoring studies.- **Support for Events:** Financial assistance shall be extended for organizing seminarsRs. conferencesRs. and workshops.- **Capacity Building:** Financial assistance shall be extended for undertaking capacity building activity for research and monitoring activities.- **Publication Support:** Financial assistance shall be extended for undertaking publication of reports or material.- **Programme Promotion:** Financial assistance shall be extended for undertaking promotion of innovative programmes or activities in the areas of Justice DeliveryRs. Legal ResearchRs. and Judicial Reforms.- **Project Limit:** The financial assistance is subject to an overall ceiling of 25Rs./- (Rupees Twenty-Five Lakhs).
> ***Disbursal Conditions*** _*The financial assistance shall be given on agreed terms and conditions based on the Project Proposal submitted by the eligible implementing agency._ _*The assistance would be limited strictly to the actual expenditure incurred by the grantee institution._ _*The financial assistance may be given in instalments._ _*At least 10% of the project cost may be kept for payment as the final instalment._ _*The final instalment is paid upon acceptance of the final project report by the National Mission for Justice Delivery and Legal ReformsRs. Department of Justice._ _*Each instalment shall be released upon the approval of the Integrated Finance Division of the Ministry of Law and Justice._
eligibility: 1. The institution must be one of the following: - Indian Institute of Public Administration. - Administrative Staff College of India. - Indian Institute/s of Management. - Indian Law Institute. - National Law University. - National Council of Applied Economic Research. - National Judicial Academy. - State Judicial Academy. 2. The institution must be working in one of the following fields: - Justice Delivery. - Legal Education and Research. - Judicial Reforms. > ***Relaxation and Inclusion*** - The applicant may be a Government Institute or Organisation if allowed by the Project Sanctioning Committee. - The applicant may be a Government aided Institute or Organisation if allowed by the Project Sanctioning Committee. - The applicantRs. if a Government or Government aided Institute/OrganisationRs. must be found suitable for undertaking the project or activity permissible under the scheme by the Project Sanctioning Committee.

name: Sports Scholarship (UG) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Sports Scholarship (UG) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of scholarships to undergraduate students who excel in sports.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** 800/- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the first year of an undergraduate course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The applicant must be one of the six selected students eligible to receive this benefit.

name: Vats Palan Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The "Vats Palan Protsahan Yojana" scheme was launched by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to improve indigenous Indian high-yielding cattle breeds and encourage the conservation and proper care of calves born from these superior breeds. Under this schemeRs. financial incentives and monthly support for calf feed and medicines are provided to eligible livestock farmers to ensure the growth and maintenance of genetically superior calves.
benefits: - One-time incentive of 5Rs. for cows whose milk production is at least 30% higher than the breed average. - Monthly support of 500 per calf for feed and medicinesRs. from 04 months up to two years of age.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer owning Indian high-yielding indigenous cows. 1. The cows milk production must be at least 30% higher than the breed average. 1. The calf must be born through artificial insemination or natural insemination using genetically superior Indian bulls. 1. Both urban and rural farmers are eligible. 1. Both male and female calves receive support up to two years of age.

name: Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case
brief_description: The "Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case" scheme is launched by the Forest DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. It is implemented by the Divisional Forest Officer (DFO). Under this schemeRs. registered landowners and Lok Vaniki farmers can sell their teak and sal wood either at government-notified rates or through separate lot auctions and receive payment within a stipulated time.
benefits: - Farmers receive timely payment for the sale of their legally owned teak and sal wood. - Payment is made within 45 working days if sold at government rates and within 30 working days if sold through a separate lot after full recovery. - Ensures fair market value and legal compliance for forest produce sales. - Payments are made directly to the farmers bank account through e-payment. **Expected Time of Disbursement:** - 45 working days from the date of timber receipt in the depot (if sold at Government rate). - 30 working days from the date of full sale value realization (if sold through a separate lot).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered Malik Makbuza (private forest owner) or Lok Vaniki farmer. 1. The sale must involve only specified forest produce such as teak (sagwan) and sal.

name: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for Construction/Installation of Biogas Plants
brief_description: The scheme Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Assistance for Construction/Installation of Biogas Plants" component of the scheme aims to effectively manage on-farm livestock waste to produce renewable energy through biogas unitsRs. converting animal waste into a sustainable energy source. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
benefits: ##### ***Assistance for Construction/Installation of Biogas Plants*** - Biogas plants constructed by the farmer would be provided 90% subsidy against the estimated standard cost of construction/installation for Biogas. - To make the subsidy more inclusive and reflective of the actual costs involvedRs. excavation costsRs. transportation costsRs. and Goods and Services Tax (GST) included in the standard cost mentioned for both pre-fabricated and constructed biogas plants. ##### ***Standard Cost & Eligible Subsidy for Pre-Fabricated Biogas*** - For a 1 cu. m3 biogas plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 31Rs./- with 90% subsidy including central subsidy of Rs. 27Rs./-. - For a 2 cu. m3 plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 54Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 48Rs./-. - For a 3 cu. m3 plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 79Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 71Rs./-. - For a 4 cu. m3 plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 1Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 1Rs./-. - For 5 cu. m3 & above plantsRs. the standard cost is Rs. 1Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 1Rs./-. ##### ***Standard Cost & Eligible Subsidy for Constructed Biogas*** - For a 2 cu. m3 biogas plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 46Rs./- with 90% subsidy including central subsidy of Rs. 41Rs./-. - For a 3 cu. m3 plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 52Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 46Rs./-. - For a 4 cu. m3 plantRs. the standard cost is Rs. 57Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 52Rs./-. - For 6 cu. m3 & above plantsRs. the standard cost is Rs. 75Rs./- with subsidy of Rs. 68Rs./-. ##### ***Incentive Structure for Promoters*** - The incentive structure for promoters involved in the installation of biogas plants aims to encourage field staff including Agriculture AssistantRs. Field AssistantRs. Krishi Mitra's to actively participate in promoting biogas plants. The incentive amount for Constructed Biogas will be 1500 per unit. ##### ***Plant Size Determination*** The size of biogas units provided will be determined based on the number of cattle owned by the beneficiary. This approach ensures that the size of the biogas plant matches the amount of organic wasteRs. particularly manureRs. generatedRs. thereby promoting efficient gas production and utilization. The specific cattle-to-biogas unit ratios are as follows: - For a 2 cu. mtr. size biogas plantRs. the applicant should own 2 cattles with approximately 30-40 kgs. of cowdung available per day. - For a 3 cu. mtr. plantRs. 3 cattles are required with 45-60 kgs. of cowdung per day. - For a 4 cu. mtr. plantRs. 4 cattles are required with 60-80 kgs. of cowdung per day. - For a 6 cu. mtr. plantRs. 5 cattles are required with 90-120 kgs. of cowdung per day. ##### ***Repair Assistance*** - For long-term maintenance and sustainability of the biogas plantsRs. repair assistance of 20% of the standard cost will be provided after 6 years. - This assistance will help ensure that the biogas plants remain operational and continue to serve the beneficiaries' needs. ##### ***Lifetime Limit and Subsidy Adjustment*** - An individual beneficiary may receive a maximum of 3 units over their lifetime. - The subsidy provided by Government of India under Biogas programme shall be adjusted within this subsidy and balance shall be paid from State funds.
eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme.

name: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for use of Micronutrients
brief_description: The scheme Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Assistance for use of Micronutrients" component of the scheme aims to address micronutrient deficiencies in the soil that affect crop productivity and ensure healthy crop growth and production. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
benefits: ***Assistance for the use of Micronutrients*** - Micronutrients like ZincRs. BoronRs. Magnesium SulphateRs. and other notified micronutrients would be provided a 75% subsidy limited to Rs. 7Rs./-per ha for all categories of farmers and a maximum of 4 ha per farmer. - The subsidy would be released after the micronutrients are purchased and used by farmers.
eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - The farmer should be cultivating a minimum of 0.1 ha in general. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme. - Farmer should possess a Soil Health Card not older than a 2-year periodRs. or a certificate to that extent may be furnished by the Assistant Chemist of Soil Testing Laboratory (North/South).

name: Monsanto Scholarship (M.Sc. Agriculture Science and Agriculture Biotechnology)
brief_description: The Monsanto Scholarship (M.Sc. Agricultural Science & Agricultural Biotechnology) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agricultural Science & Agricultural Biotechnology by awarding them scholarships for three semesters.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** 1Rs./- per month (For 3 semesters only).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. in Agricultural Science or Agricultural Biotechnology program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of three semesters only.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Scholarships/Incentives" component of the scheme aims to provide financial support to the wards of recognized Goan artists who are pursuing higher educationRs. thereby addressing the economic challenges faced by artist families in supporting their children's educational aspirations and ensuring continuity of educational opportunities despite financial constraints. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: - A monthly scholarship of 750/- is sanctioned to eligible wards during the currency of the academic year. - The vacation period is excluded from the scholarship disbursement period. - The scholarship is disbursed on a half-yearly basis.
eligibility: ##### ***For the Artist*** - The artist must be a GoanRs. i.e.Rs. born and brought up in Goa. - The artist must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the artist (from all sources) must not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) ##### ***For the Ward of the Artist*** - The ward must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution. - The ward must be pursuing PostgraduateRs. DegreeRs. or Professional courses. - The ward may be enrolled in educational institutions within the state or outside the state.

name: House Building Loan Scheme for Employees of Government of Goa
brief_description: The scheme "House Building Loan Scheme for Employees of Government of Goa" was launched by the Debt Management DivisionRs. Department of FinanceRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to assist government employees in achieving their dream of owning a house by providing financial support to erstwhile House Building Advance scheme beneficiaries whose loans were operative as on 15th May 2020. The scheme provides loan takeover facility through empanelled banks with shared interest payment mechanism where the employee bears 2% of the interest plus the principal component while the Government bears the remainder of the interest subject to a maximum of 5%. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Accounts in coordination with empanelled banks notified separately by the Government. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - The Government bears the remainder of the interest charged by the empanelled bankRs. subject to a maximum of 5%Rs. while the employee bears 2% of the interest plus the principal component. - The loan takeover facility is provided for the amount outstanding as on the date of application after repayment of instalments from May 2020. - For employees who had availed additional loan over and above the House Building Advance amountRs. the Government's share of interest is restricted only to the extent of such House Building Advance loan outstanding as on the date of application. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The Government's share of interest is credited to the empanelled bank in a pool account on a monthly basis. - The Government's cumulative share of all instalments due for the succeeding month is credited to the bank within a specified dateRs. provided that the bank raises the demand at least 20 days in advance. - The Government's share commences from the succeeding month of sanction wherein the employee is due for repayment of the loanRs. provided the demand has been raised by the bank. ##### ***Duration and Validity*** - The Government's share is continued till the employee attains superannuation or for a maximum duration of 20 years of the total repayment periodRs. whichever is earlierRs. by considering the already paid instalments by the Government. - If the duration of the loan ends before superannuation of the employeeRs. the bank submits the closure letter to the concerned Government employeeRs. Head of Department and Directorate of Accounts. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The employee must ensure that his share of Equated Monthly Instalment reaches the bank within the stipulated time._ - _Any delay on part of the employee for contributing his shareRs. subject to a maximum default duration of two monthsRs. will make the concerned employee ineligible to avail any further benefits under this scheme._ - _The employee must carry out all the required documentation and valuation required for compliance from the bank sideRs. and the Government will not bear any costs for the same._ - _The deed of mortgage or any other collateral security executed in favour of Government earlier must be transferred in favour of the empanelled bank with an undertaking from the employee that he willingly desires to transfer the same in favour of the bank._ - _For employees who have availed benefits under the "One Time House Building Advance Settlement Scheme"Rs. the amount to the extent of benefits availed under that scheme would be adjusted in the initial instalments itselfRs. till which the Government will not start contributing its share of interest and the employee has to bear the full burden of instalments._ - _If the employee ceases to be in service for any reason other than normal retirement or superannuation or if he dies before repayment of the loan in fullRs. the entire outstanding amount will become payable forthwith by the Government employee or his successorRs. as the case may be._ - _Failure to repay the housing loan for any reason whatsoeverRs. either by the Government employee or the successorRs. as the case may beRs. will entitle the bank to enforce the mortgage and take action to recover the outstanding housing loan._
eligibility: - The applicant must be an erstwhile beneficiary of the House Building Advance who had their loans operative as on 15th MayRs. 2020. - The applicant must fulfill the eligibility criteria put forth by the empanelled bank for being eligible for housing loan under this scheme. - The applicant who had shifted his housing loan to other bank upon closure of earlier scheme must ensure that the loan account shall now be operated in any of the banks empanelled for the purpose of this scheme. - The applicant must approach any of the empanelled banks for takeover of the existing loan for a maximum loan amount restricted to the tune of amount outstanding as on date after repayment of instalments from May 2020. ##### ***Special Categories*** - The applicant who had availed top-up additional loan over and above the House Building Advance amount sanctioned by Government is eligible only to the extent of such amount of House Building Advance loan which is outstanding as on the date of application. - The applicant who is among the 45 employees whose cases were sanctioned but were awaiting drawal of advance as on 15th MayRs. 2020 is eligible to apply under this scheme.

name: Dr. S.K. Sharma (Ph.D. Mathematics)
brief_description: The Dr. S.K. Sharma (Ph.D. Mathematics) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to deserving scholars pursuing a Ph.D. in MathematicsRs. supporting advanced research and reducing their financial burden.
benefits: **Amount of Financial Assistance:** 25Rs./- per year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a Ph.D. program in Mathematics at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The financial assistance is provided for a duration of one year only.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Marriage Component" of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists to address their daughter's marriage-related expenses. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through prescribed proforma directly at the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Sanskruti BhavanRs. PattoRs. PanajiRs. Goa.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance of 20Rs./- shall be sanctioned for the first wholly dependent daughter's marriage. - Financial assistance of 15Rs./- shall be sanctioned for the second wholly dependent daughter's marriage. - Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible for this benefit. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The financial assistance shall be disbursed through Electronic Clearing System mode. - The assistance is a one-time grant per eligible daughter's marriage. ##### ***Conditions*** - The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers shall be furnished to the department. - The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount if any shall be refunded to the Government within 2 months from the date of marriage.
eligibility: ##### ***For the Artist*** - The applicant must be a Goan aged needy artistRs. born and brought up in the state of Goa. - The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age. - The applicant's annual family income from all the sources should not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. ##### ***For Dependent Daughter(s)*** - The daughters must be wholly dependent on the eligible Goan artist. - The daughters must be unmarried at the time of application. - Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible. ##### ***Relaxation*** - The Government may relax the age criteria for the artist for deserving cases under special circumstances.

name: Lab on Wheels
brief_description: The scheme Lab on Wheels is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote & popularize science education among school students and youth studying science subjects across all 13 districts of the state.
benefits: The Lab on Wheels program has been launched to popularize science in rural areas of Uttarakhand and promote science education in schools. It provides students from all districtsRs. including remote areasRs. with the opportunity to explore and learn the practical applications of science.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of one of the 13 districts of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student or youth studying science subject in a government or non-government school.

name: Janani Express Yojana
brief_description: The "Janani Express Yojana" was launched by the Public Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide free transport facilities for pregnant women to reach government health institutions for safe delivery.
benefits: - Free transport facility is provided to pregnant women for traveling to government hospitals for delivery.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman.

name: Top Working Program
brief_description: The scheme Top Working Program launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Madhya PradeshRs. aims to enhance horticultural productivity by training rural unemployed youth to convert local fruit plant species into improved varieties and providing financial assistance for grafting activities.
benefits: - **Training Benefit:** Provision of 20-day training on top working techniques to rural unemployed youth. - **Tool Kit Distribution:** Each trainee is provided with a tool kit worth up to 400/- during the training period. - **Financial Incentive for Successful Grafting:** A payment of 10/- per successfully grafted tree is provided once the branches reach approximately 2 feet in length.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to rural area. - The applicant must be an unemployed youth.

name: Mhaji Bus Scheme
brief_description: The Mhaji Bus Scheme was launched by the Department of TransportRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial and infrastructural support to private stage carriage bus operators in the State of Goa to ensure an affordableRs. safeRs. and reliable public transportation systemRs. increase the availability of buses across the StateRs. reduce traffic congestionRs. and promote the use of public transportRs. especially in rural and underserved areas. The scheme provides a subsidy of 3/- per kilometer operatedRs. 50% reimbursement of the annual insurance premium paid up to a maximum of 30Rs./-Rs. and assistance of 10Rs./- for replacing buses older than 15 years with new buses having a minimum seating capacity of 27.
benefits: - A subsidy of 3/- per kilometer operated shall be provided to eligible bus operators under the scheme. - Bus Insurance Subsidy is provided as 50% reimbursement of the annual insurance premium paid up to a maximum of 30Rs./-. - The scheme provides Assistance of 10Rs./- for replacing buses older than 15 yearsRs. with new buses having a minimum seating capacity of 27. - The operator shall retain full fare revenue collected from the passengers and shall not be required to deposit any fare amount with the Kadamba Transport Corporation Limited. - Bus operators participating in the scheme shall be entitled to receive 50% of the revenue generated from advertisements displayed on their buses. - Mobilization advanceRs. if requiredRs. may be sanctioned up to 60 days of operational subsidy based on the recommendation of Kadamba Transport Corporation Limited. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Kilometers for Financial assistance will be considered as per the Fare Chart issued along with the stage carriage permit by the Regional Transport Authority. - The amount collected through Kadamba Transport Corporation Smart transit Passes and Smart transit cards will be reimbursed to the respective operators as per the guidelines set by Kadamba Transport Corporation Limited.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private bus operator holding a valid stage carriage permit issued by the competent authority in Goa. - The applicant must be the registered owner of the bus/mini bus in the State of Goa. - The bus to be operated under this scheme must not be older than 15 years from the date of its initial registration. - The applicant must agree to comply with all operationalRs. brandingRs. safetyRs. and service norms specified under this scheme. - The bus must operate for the full month. - If the bus is off the roadRs. prior intimation must be given to the competent authority. ***Relaxation*** - For the initial period of 3 yearsRs. buses up to 20 years should be eligible to participate in this scheme. - The bus can be kept for repairs and maintenance for two days onlyRs. which should be SaturdaysRs. SundaysRs. or holidays.

name: Operation of Paragliding Activities
brief_description: The scheme Operation of Paragliding Activities is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote safeRs. regulatedRs. and professional paragliding activities in Uttarakhand by permitting certified paragliding companies and licensed tandem pilots to operate within the state.
benefits: Paragliding companies are permitted to operateRs. and tandem pilot licenses have been issuedRs. allowing license holders to earn a livelihood through paragliding activities in the state.
