eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand for at least ten years or a native of the state. 1. The applicant should possess advanced practical and technical knowledge of aero sports.

name: Janani Sahayogi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Janani Sahayogi Yojana" is launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical EducationRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. It aims to provide safe motherhood and child healthcare services to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families by offering free medical careRs. including normal deliveryRs. cesarean sectionRs. abortionRs. and newborn careRs. in government and accredited private hospitals to ensure maternal and infant health.
benefits: - Free delivery services (both normal and cesarean) for pregnant women belonging to BPL families. - Free maternal and newborn healthcareRs. including antenatalRs. deliveryRs. postnatalRs. and neonatal services. - Free abortion and emergency obstetric care when medically required. - Free medicinesRs. diagnosticsRs. and hospitalization at government or accredited private hospitals. - Linkage with Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) for eligible women to receive additional incentives.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant must present a valid BPL Health Card such as BlueRs. YellowRs. or Antyodaya Card.

name: Seed Program
brief_description: The scheme Seed Program launched by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to support small and marginal farmers and agricultural laborers living below the poverty line through the provision of free vegetable seeds to improve household nutrition and crop productivity. The scheme distributes seed packets worth 50 containing vegetables like bottle gourdRs. ladyfingerRs. beansRs. bitter gourdRs. ridge gourdRs. spinachRs. and cowpea.
benefits: - **Free Seed Distribution:** Seed packets containing seeds of bottle gourdRs. ladyfingerRs. beansRs. bitter gourdRs. ridge gourdRs. spinachRs. and cowpea worth 50/- are provided free of cost to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Manav Garima Yojna (NT DNT)
brief_description: The "Manav Garima Yojna (NT DNT)" scheme is launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to enable nomadic and de-notified caste persons to live with dignity and become self-employed in small businesses and financially self-sufficient. Through this schemeRs. various business tool-kits are provided to these target beneficiaries so that they may start small enterprises and become economically independent.
benefits: 1. The primary benefit is the provision of various business tool-kits to eligible beneficiaries so that they can engage in small business activities and become self-employed and financially self-sufficient. 1. The tool kits are given under the scheme targeted at nomadic and de-notified castes. 1. The annual income limit for eligibility is 6Rs. (for the family) for most of the target groups. - Among the SEBC castesRs. the income limit is removed for Nomadic and De-notified Castes and backward castes.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the nomadic or de-notified caste. - The applicants family annual income should be 6Rs./- or less in general. - In the case of Nomadic and Denotified Castes and backward castes among SEBC castesRs. the income limit has been removed.

name: Infrastructure Development Scheme for Dairy Co-operatives
brief_description: The scheme "Infrastructure Development Scheme for Dairy Co-operatives" was approved by the Government of GoaRs. Department of Co-operationRs. Office of the Registrar of Co-operative Societies. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Dairy Co-operative Societies for their developmentRs. smooth functioning of businessRs. and other allied activitiesRs. enabling them to become stable and create better infrastructure. The scheme provides financial support in the form of grant or subsidy to cover administrative and managerial expensesRs. including staff salariesRs. allowancesRs. wagesRs. office expensesRs. rentRs. ratesRs. taxesRs. and the purchase of equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submitting the proposal to the concerned Office of the Assistant Registrar.
benefits: ****The financial support is provided to meet administrative/managerial expenses on staff salaries and allowancesRs. wagesRs. office expensesRs. rent rates and taxesRs. and equipment.*** ****The Registering Authority shall verify the utilization of the grants released.*** ##### ***General Category Dairy Co-operative Societies*** - Above 500 liters per day: 1Rs./-. - 300500 liters per day: 1Rs./-. - 150300 liters per day: 75Rs./-. - 50150 liters per day: 30Rs./-. ##### ***Tribal Sub Plan/Schedule Caste Sub Plan Dairy Co-operative Societies*** - Above 1Rs. liters per day: 3Rs./-. - 1Rs.less than 1Rs. liters per day: 3Rs./-. - 750less than 1Rs. liters per day: 2Rs./-. - 500less than 750 liters per day: 1Rs./-. - 300less than 500 liters per day: 1Rs./-. - 75less than 300 liters per day: 1Rs./-. - 25less than 75 liters per day: 50Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Dairy Co-operative Society in the State. - The applicant must regularly supply the milk to the Milk Union. - The applicant must have completed one year of its registration. - The applicant must submit the Milk Supply Report from the Milk Union for the period for which the assistance is applied for along with the proposal. - The applicant must approve the proposal for Government assistance in the General Body/Special General Body before submitting the proposal to the concerned office of Assistant Registrar. ##### ***Tribal Sub Plan/Schedule Caste Sub Plan Category Criteria*** The applicant must have a minimum of 15% shareholders as Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled CasteRs. as the case may beRs. to be considered a Tribal Sub Plan/Schedule Caste Sub Plan Co-operative Society for the purpose of availing assistance.

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality component of the scheme provides financial assistance for quality improvement in the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The scheme aims to support environmentally sustainable industrial development while accelerating investment in Goa. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement equal to 50% of the expenses incurred for establishing a Quality Management SystemRs. capped at 5Rs./- per Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa Online Portal.
benefits:
- Entities are entitled to a one-time reimbursement equating to 50% of the expenses incurred for the establishment of a Quality Management System. - The provision is capped at 5Rs./- (Indian Rupees five Lakh) per Entity. - The expenditure incurred for availing Quality Certifications shall be deemed as costs associated with the implementation of a Quality Management System. - Quality Certifications acquired from recognized National and International bodiesRs. encompassing both Governmental and Private organizationsRs. are eligible for the incentive. - Costs associated with travelRs. foodRs. and lodgingRs. if anyRs. are excluded from this benefit. - The incentive amount shall be disbursed subsequent to the acquisition of the relevant certification.
##### ***Conditions*** - The benefits under this scheme are subject to a first come first serve basis. - The reimbursement is subject to the availability of funds in a particular fiscal year. - The quantum of benefit is defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls: 1. 100% benefit if 60% or above employees are Goan. 1. 80% benefit if more than 40% but less than 60% employees are Goan. - The Quality Certifications must reflect that the Entity's operational processes or services adhere to specified quality benchmarks. - The Quality Certifications should also signify the Entity's dedication to quality assurance and ongoing enhancement.
eligibility: - The applicant must be classified as a non-mega industry. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must have Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses for quality upgradation post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). - The applicant must apply for the subsidy only post acquiring the Quality Certifications. ##### ***Preference/Priority*** Entities owned by Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women Entrepreneurs must explicitly state their category when applying for incentives under various schemes on the Goa Online Portal.

name: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Skill Development
brief_description: The scheme "The Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives SchemeRs. 2025" was launched by the Government of GoaRs. to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The component "Subsidy Towards Skill Development" provides reimbursement of 50% of the cost incurred for skill upgradation and training manpowerRs. limited to a maximum of 5Rs./- per person employed in the Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC). The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.
benefits: - The benefit is a reimbursement of 50% of the cost involved in skill upgradation and training manpower. - The reimbursement is limited to 5Rs./- per person employed in the Entity. - Each entity is entitled to benefit from this scheme once per year. - The benefit is provided as a reimbursement. ##### ***Conditions*** - The scope of this incentive is limited to a maximum of 1Rs. individuals trained per year in the State of Goa. - Applications for this incentive are accepted on a first-comeRs. first-served basis. - Skill enhancement must involve assessment and certification by Government-approved (National or State level) institutes or institutes with international recognition and global accreditation. - The training must be conducted by certified individual trainers or institutes. - The training costs must be assessed and sanctioned by the Incentive Review Committee (IRC).
eligibility: - The applicant must be an entity that is a Logistics and Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must not be classified as a Mega ProjectRs. meaning projects with investment of 100Rs./- or more and/or employment generation of 1Rs. or more Goans. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses for skill development post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year). - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme or program of the State Government or Central Government. - The skill enhancement and training must aim specifically at improving the abilities of personnel engaged solely in logistics and warehousing tasks. - The reimbursement is confined to expenses incurred for operational training pertinent to the logistics and warehousing sector. - The skill enhancement must involve assessment and certification by Government-approved (National or State level) institutes or institutes with international recognition and global accreditation. - The applicant must submit the claim in the prescribed application form (ANNEXURE-VII). - The applicant must submit the claim through the Goa Online Portal. _*Entities owned by Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe/Women Entrepreneurs must explicitly state their category when applying for incentives under various schemes on the Goa Online Portal._ ##### ***Quantum of Benefit Condition*** - The quantum of benefit shall be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on the payrolls. - If the quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is 60% or aboveRs. the quantum of benefits is 100%. - If the quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is more than 40% but less than 60%Rs. the quantum of benefits is 80%. - If the quantum of Goan Employment on payrolls is less than 40%Rs. the entity is Ineligible. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The entity must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC) for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government. - The entity must submit to the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce all the necessary reportsRs. information and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and CommerceRs. time to time or as and when required. - The applicant must undertake to refund 10 times the concessions claimed if found obtained by misrepresentation of facts or in case of misuse.

name: Procurement of Food Grains From Farmers at Support Price
brief_description: The Procurement of Food Grains From Farmers at Support Price scheme was launched by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies and Consumer ProtectionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure fair and assured prices for farmers by enabling direct government procurement of wheatRs. paddyRs. maizeRs. and jowar from registered farmers at the centrally declared Minimum Support Price (MSP) along with any applicable state bonus during the designated procurement period.
benefits: - Farmers receive assured and fair prices for their crops at the Minimum Support Price (MSP) fixed by the government. - The scheme ensures direct procurement from farmers through government centers.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be a landholding farmer. - The applicant should register for procurement (Uparjan Registration) before selling crops. - The applicant should sell only Fair Average Quality (FAQ) grains that meet the specified standards.

name: Bal Swasthya Karyakram - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Bal Swasthya Karyakram is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. This initiative aims to ensure the survivalRs. healthy growthRs. and overall well-being of children aged 05 years by providing accessibleRs. comprehensiveRs. and quality healthcare services across the state.
benefits: Under this ProgrammeRs. medical services are provided to children aged 05 years through Special Newborn Care Units (SNCUs)Rs. Newborn Stabilization Units (NBSUs)Rs. and Nutritional Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs). AdditionallyRs. ASHA workersRs. Anganwadi workersRs. and ANMs distribute Vitamin A and IFA syrup free of cost to children aged 05 years.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a child between 0 and 5 years of age from Uttarakhand.

name: Balram Talab Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Balram Talab Yojana" was launched by the Farmer Welfare and Agricultural Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to support agriculture activities on a sustainable basis by conservation of rainwater in the fieldRs. enriching surface and groundwater availability. Only those farmers who have installed drip or sprinkler sets in financial year 2017-18 or thereafter and currently in operational condition will be granted approval for subsidized pond construction.
benefits: - General category farmers receive 40% of the construction cost or maximum 80Rs./- as subsidy. - Small and marginal farmers receive 50% of the construction cost or maximum 80Rs./- as subsidy. - Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category farmers receive 75% of the construction cost or maximum 1Rs./- as subsidy. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The subsidy will be disbursed to the beneficiary based on the progress of pond construction. - The subsidy will be provided within 30 days based on the evaluation by the Soil Conservation Staff. ##### ***Conditions*** - All conditions and eligibility must be verified by the Soil Conservation Survey Officer before subsidy benefits are provided. - Before providing the benefit under this schemeRs. verification of the land will be conducted by the Conservation Survey Officer. - From a security perspectiveRs. it is mandatory to install a board at the pond site to prevent drowning incidents. This must be installed at the farmer's own expense. In the absence of a boardRs. if any accident occursRs. the farmer will be solely responsible.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must possess agricultural land. - The applicant must have installed drip or sprinkler sets in financial year 2017-18 or thereafterRs. and these must be currently in operational conditionRs. to be eligible for subsidized pond construction. - The applicant must construct the pond on their own land. Subsidy will not be provided for pond construction on leased land.

name: Scheme for Goa Rajya Vidnyanik Puraskar
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Goa Rajya Vidnyanik Puraskar (GRVP)" was launched by the Department of Science & Technology & Waste Management (DS&T & WM)Rs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to introduce an award to be given to Goan Innovators/Scientists who have implemented their ideas to innovations and also achieved excellence in the field of Science and Technology and Innovation. The scheme also seeks to drive the innovation agenda in the State and harness the core competenciesRs. local resources and capabilities to create new InnovationsRs. while encouraging ScientistsRs. innovatorsRs. young talent in universitiesRs. educational institutesRs. Medium and Small Scale Industries (MSME)Rs. and Research and Development (R&D) institutes.
benefits: - Cash prize of 2Rs./- per award. - Three awards are given in each financial year. - The awards are categorized as one each for InnovationRs. EnvironmentRs. and Societal impact. - The cash prize shall be directly deposited in the beneficiarys Bank Account. - The scheme is subject to provision in the Annual Budget of the Department of Science and Technology and Waste Management (DS&T & WM). ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must submit a pre-receipt for the said amount to the DirectorRs. Department of Science & Technology & Waste Management (DS&T & WM). - The Goa State Innovation Council (GSInC) should forward the decisions/results declared by the Expert CommitteeRs. duly approved by the Chairman of the Goa State Innovation CouncilRs. along with the pre-receipt and Bank account details obtained from the beneficiariesRs. for further process to release the award money directly in their bank account.
eligibility: - The scheme is designed for StudentsRs. StartupsRs. InnovatorsRs. Research FacultyRs. and Scientists. The award is introduced to be given to Goan Innovators/Scientists. - The applicant must be a resident of Goa for the last 15 years. - The project must relate to hardware or software-based product innovation. - The applicant must be required to provide a Letter of Intent (LOI) in case the proposed idea/project is associated with the Industry or the Government. - The applicant must be registered under the Virtual Innovation Register (VIR) as a New Idea. - The applicant can avail of this scheme only once. - The proposals should preferably be in the following focus sectors: _Green technologyRs. Clean energyRs. Industrially utilizable smart materialsRs. Waste to WealthRs. Affordable HealthcareRs. Water & Sewage ManagementRs. Renewable Energy SourcesRs. Electric VehiclesRs. Smart CitiesRs. Agri-techRs. MeditechRs. Health Care Tech and Digital mediaRs. ITES._

name: Scheme To Support Orphan Child/Children Of Widows Belonging To Scheduled Tribe Community
brief_description: The scheme Scheme To Support Orphan Child/Children Of Widows Belonging To Scheduled Tribe Community was launched by the Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to give financial support to the orphan children and the children of widows for meeting the expenditure on foodRs. clothingRs. and shelter until the children attain the age of eighteen years. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Directorate of Social Welfare (for widows) or the Directorate of Tribal Welfare (for guardians of orphans).
benefits: - Fixed maintenance allowance of 1Rs./- per monthRs. per child of a widow. - Fixed maintenance allowance of 2Rs./- per monthRs. per child who is an orphan. ##### ***Disbursement Conditions/Criteria*** - The financial support is provided until the children attain the age of eighteen years. - For children of widowsRs. the benefit is limited to two children. ##### ***Mode of Disbursement*** - **For Children of Widows:** The amount is released to the beneficiary along with the benefits under the Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSS).- **For Orphans:** The benefit amount will be transferred through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS) to the Joint Account of the orphan and the guardian.
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) Community. > ***For Children of Widows (Applicant is the Widow)*** - The applicant must be a Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS) beneficiary. - The applicant must have minor children. > ***For Orphans (Applicant is the Guardian)*** - The applicant must be the guardian of an orphan. - The orphan must be under the care of a guardianRs. which includes grandparentsRs. near relativesRs. or a protective home/dharmasala. - The orphan must be up to the age of eighteen years.

name: National AIDS Control Programme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The National AIDS Control Programme is implemented by the Uttarakhand State AIDS Control Society under the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The programme aims to prevent and control the spread of HIV/AIDS through awarenessRs. testingRs. and treatmentRs. while providing care and support to affected individuals.
benefits: Raising public awareness about HIV/AIDS and providing free HIV testingRs. treatmentRs. and medication.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiaries should be the general public and HIV-infected individuals residing in Uttarakhand.

name: Atal Kisan Jyoti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Atal Kisan Jyoti Yojana launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to provide concessional electricity to farmers through a flat rate power supply of 750/- per horsepower per year to metered agricultural pump consumers up to 10 horsepower.
benefits: Electricity Supply at Concessional Rate: Farmers having metered permanent agricultural pumps up to 10 horsepower are provided electricity at a flat rate of 750/- per horsepower per year.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a permanent agricultural pump consumer. - The applicant must have a metered connection. - The applicants pump capacity should be up to 10 horsepower.

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkars Electric Auto (e-Auto) Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Dr. B. R. Ambedkars Electric Auto (e-Auto) Subsidy Scheme" was launched by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. The scheme aims to socially and economically empower Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe women by supporting them in income-generating activities through the use of electric autos. The scheme provides a subsidy of 75% of the total cost of the electric auto (e-Auto) or 3Rs./- whichever is lessRs. after utilizing Central Government incentives. It promotes eco-friendly public transportation and intends to make these women self-reliant. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: - A subsidy of 75% of the total cost of the electric auto (e-Auto) or 3Rs./- whichever is less will be paid. - This subsidy is paid after utilizing Central Government incentives under the Pradhan Mantri E-DRIVE Scheme (FAME-3)Rs. which provides a maximum subsidy of 50Rs./-. - The total cost of the electric auto will be calculated excluding extra accessories. ##### ***Disbursement*** - **In case the beneficiary has already purchased the vehicle:** The applicant must submit the original invoice along with the application to the DepartmentRs. and the subsidy amount will then be credited to the beneficiarys account.- **In case the beneficiary has not purchased the vehicle:** The applicant must pay 25% of the total cost of the vehicle as an initial payment to the dealer. The applicant has to submit the invoice for payment along with the applicationRs. and the subsidy amount will then be credited to the dealer's account. ##### ***Post-Selection Obligations*** - The beneficiary should not cause or permit a male driver to drive the vehicle. - The beneficiary must retain all relevant documents for 5 years from the date of subsidy disbursement. - The applicant has no power to sale/lease or any other transfer of ownership of the vehicle for a period of 5 years. - If the information furnished by the beneficiary is false or if the electric auto is found to have been sold within the 5-year periodRs. the total subsidy is liable to be returned to the Government or recovered with interest from the beneficiary.
eligibility: - The applicant should belong to the Union Territory of Puducherry either by virtue of birth or by virtue of continuous residence of not less than 5 years. - The applicant must be of the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe community recognized by the Union Territory of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a woman. - The total annual income of the applicant and her spouse must not exceed 2Rs./-. - The applicant must be at least 18 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be more than 45 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be availing assistance under a prolonged disease. - The applicant must have a valid driving licence for operating the electric auto issued by a Competent Authority. - The applicant must not have availed of a similar subsidy under any other State / Central Scheme for the same purpose. - Only one person per family can avail the benefit once in their lifetime. _*Applicants shall be selected by seniority in age on a first-come-first-served basis._

name: Government Food Science Training Centre
brief_description: The Government Food Science Training Centre is initiated by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide specialized education and skill development in food processingRs. canningRs. bakeryRs. confectioneryRs. and cookery to students from UttarakhandRs. empowering them with technical knowledge and practical expertise to pursue careers in the food industry and promote entrepreneurship.
benefits: The state has two Food Department Training Centres that offer one-and-a-half-year diploma courses in Canning and Food ProcessingRs. Bakery and ConfectioneryRs. and Cookery.
eligibility: 1. To seek admission in a diploma courseRs. the candidate/student must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. For admission to the Canning and Food Processing courseRs. the student must have passed Intermediate (Science/Agriculture) from an institute located in Uttarakhand. 1. For admission to other coursesRs. the student must have passed Intermediate from an institute located in Uttarakhand.

name: Aromatic Plants Cultivation - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Aromatic Plants Cultivation scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage farmers to grow aromatic plants by providing them with free seedsRs. planting materialsRs. and technical supportRs. helping them increase their income and promote aromatic farming in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the following support is provided: - Free seeds and planting materials are provided to farmers. - Seeds and planting materials for up to 5 Nali (0.1 hectare) per farmer are delivered to the farmers nearest motorable road or CAP office. - Free technical assistanceRs. consultationRs. and continuous support are offered to the farmers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The farmer must either legally own agricultural land or have leased land for a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The farmer must be interested in aromatic plant cultivation.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Tea/Coffee And Coconut Parlor
brief_description: The "Tea/Coffee And Coconut Parlor" is a sub-scheme of the Tribals Development Plan launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to attract tourists with better quality mechanized Tea and Coffee shops and tender coconut water parlorsRs. as Goa is a tourist destinationRs. ensuring better hygiene than other restaurants. The scheme provides entire project financing for establishing a parlorRs. with the cost estimated to be between 25Rs./- to 30Rs./-Rs. and targets benefiting about 275 households.
benefits: - Provision of the entire project financing for establishing a Tea/Coffee and Coconut ParlorRs. with a project cost of about 25Rs./- to 30Rs./-. - The beneficiary will be rewarded with the entire amount deposited if they successfully deposit the aforesaid amount. ***Conditions*** _*The beneficiary has to deposit 50% of the total project cost to the Department._ _*The deposit must be paid in 36 installments._ _*The required deposit must be completed within a period of three years._ _*If the beneficiary fails to deposit the amount or installments in time for three consecutive months or defaults for more than 3 timesRs. their right to ownership will be suspended until the entire amount is paid._ _*If the beneficiary fails to repay the amount for six monthsRs. the same will be forfeited in favor of the Government._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Goa. - The applicant must belong to one of the Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities notified in GoaRs. i.e. GawdaRs. VelipRs. or Kunbi. - The applicant must be part of a tribal household identified under the Tribals Development Plan. - The applicants family must fall under either: (a) the Below Poverty Line (BPL) categoryRs. or (b) the non-BPL category with annual income < 1Rs./-.

name: Scheme to Encourage Students for Innovative Projects
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme to Encourage Students for Innovative Projects" was framed by the Department of Science and Technology and Waste Management (DS&T&WM)Rs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to transform innovative student ideas into scalable projects that drive rapid economic growthRs. increased productivityRs. and social transformation. The scheme provides financial support of up to 50Rs./- to deserving students on a need-cum-merit basis for prototyping their technology-based innovative project ideas. The scheme is implemented through the Goa State Innovation Council (GSInC). The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial support of up to 50Rs./-. - A maximum of 10 projects will be supported through this scheme each financial year. - The financial assistance shall be permitted to be utilized only for student academic projects. - The funds should be used only for the purpose for which they are released. ##### ***Disbursement*** - The financial assistance shall be disbursed as a single installment. - The amount shall be deposited directly in the beneficiary institutes bank account. - Disbursement occurs upon submission of the pre-receipt for the said amount by the institutionRs. to the DirectorRs. Department of Science and Technology and Waste Management (DS&T&WM). ##### ***Conditions*** - The entire amount of the financial assistance approved and released should be utilized before March 31st in the subsequent financial year. - Copies of bills/invoices generated after purchasing materials and tools for building the project must be maintained and submitted to the Goa State Innovation Council (GSInC).
eligibility: - The applicant must be a student from an Educational Institute in Goa. - The applicant must be one of the following - (a) A final year student or a group of students working on a college project. (b) A High School or Higher Secondary School student working on a school project participating either in State or National level competitions. - The applicant must be working on a hardware or software-based Product/Process Innovation. - The applicant must be registered under the Virtual Innovation Register (VIR) as a New Idea. - The applicant must not already have received financial support under this scheme. - The proposed innovative idea/ project in the form of a product/solution must be associated either with AcademicsRs. Industry or the Government. - The proposals should preferably be in the following focus sectors: _Green technologyRs. Clean energyRs. Industrially utilizable smart materialsRs. Waste to WealthRs. Affordable HealthcareRs. Water & Sewage ManagementRs. Renewable Energy sourcesRs. Electric VehiclesRs. Smart CitiesRs. Agri-techRs. MeditechRs. Health care techRs. and Digital mediaRs. Information Technology Enabled Services (ITES)._

name: Solar Water Heater Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
brief_description: The scheme Solar Water Heater Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under the Department of EnergyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the use of solar energy for water heating in the state to reduce dependence on conventional electricity and fossil fuelsRs. and to encourage the adoption of green and sustainable energy sources in Uttarakhand.
benefits: 1. Under the Solar Water Heater SchemeRs. the power supply to electricity consumers in the state is often maintained by purchasing electricity at high rates by the DISCOM during peak hoursRs. which directly impacts both consumers and the state government. The installation of solar water heaters will reduce consumers' dependence on grid power and promote solar energy projects across the state. This scheme represents a significant contribution by the State Government toward fulfilling Government of Indias commitment to achieving the global SDG-7 goals. 1. The scheme will encourage the use of green and renewable energy across the state. 1. Increasing the installation of solar water heaters will lead to electricity savings during peak demand periods and a reduction in annual carbon dioxide emissions. Installing a solar water heater system with a capacity of 100 liters per day can reduce carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 1.5 tons per yearRs. resulting in positive environmental impacts. 1. In the mountainous regions of UttarakhandRs. where there is a frequent need for hot waterRs. it is often produced by burning woodRs. which harms the environment. The adoption of solar water heaters will significantly reduce environmental damage caused by traditional methods such as the use of wood or electricity for water heating.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have a valid electricity connection with Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL). 1. The applicant must be the owner of the residential property where the solar water heater is proposed to be installed.

name: Dairy Equipment Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Dairy Equipment Scheme was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to assist farmers in procuring dairy equipmentRs. reduce manual labourRs. and give a boost to the dairy industry. It addresses the practical difficulties faced by dairy farmers in purchasing essential equipment and aims to mechanise dairy operations. The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy of 75% of the permissible cost for purchasing new dairy equipmentRs. subject to a maximum limit. The applications are accepted offline through local Veterinary Officers or Assistant Directors.
benefits:
- Subsidy provided for the purchase of new dairy equipment or implements. - Subsidy at 75% of the permissible cost limited to 2Rs./- on total equipment purchased. - Equipment permissible cost ranges between 180/- and 70Rs./- per unit as per category and quantity of milch animals owned. - Maximum total subsidy limited to 2Rs./- per beneficiary. - Subsidy amount is directly credited to the beneficiarys bank account through Electronic Clearance System (ECS). _*Subsidy is available only for new equipment that is not previously subsidised under any other Government scheme._ _*Subsidy applicable for equipment purchased from authorised dealers registered with the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Goa._
> ***Conditions for Availment*** - Purchase approval from DirectorateRs. submission of billsRs. photographs of installed equipmentRs. and adherence to scheme guidelines. - Beneficiary must maintain the equipment and not sell or transfer it for at least 42 months (3.5 years) from the date of subsidy release. _*Breach of terms permits Government to recover subsidy through other incentives or revenue code._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer owning dairy milch animals. - The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Goa for at least the preceding 5 years. - The applicant must own cattle shed with milch animals within the State of Goa. - The applicant must not have claimed subsidy for the same items under any other scheme. - The applicant must obtain prior approval from the Directorate before purchasing the equipment. - The applicant must purchase only new equipment from authorised registered dealers located in Goa offering after-sales services. **Eligible Equipment:** Generator SetRs. Chaff CutterRs. Animal Shed WasherRs. Spray PumpRs. DehornerRs. Hoof TrimmerRs. Hoof Trimming Knife SetRs. Milking Machine (Single or Double Cluster)Rs. Cluster Can AssemblyRs. Calf Nipple BucketRs. Treatment CrateRs. Milk CansRs. Nylon RopesRs. Fans for Cow ShedRs. Pvc Pipeline for Dung DisposalRs. WheelbarrowRs. Water Storage TankRs. SicklesRs. PickaxeRs. GamelasRs. Rubber MatsRs. Wall-mounted or Pedestal Industrial Fans.

name: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme
brief_description: The Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme was launched by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. TradeRs. and CommerceRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to boost self-employment in the State and encourage beneficiaries under self-employed schemes to repay their loan regularly. The scheme provides 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment for all activities related to Industrial and other self-employment opportunities. The applications for this scheme are accepted at the office of the Economic Development CorporationRs. EDC HouseRs. Panaji-Goa.
benefits: - Payment of 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment for all activities related to Industrial and other self-employment opportunities. ##### ***Benefit Disbursement*** - In the case of the Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana SchemeRs. an amount equal to 20% of the Equated Monthly Installments (which corresponds to approximately 25% of the principal component of the Equated Monthly Installments)Rs. paid within the due dateRs. shall be credited to the principal accountRs. on the date of payment. - In the case of the Revised Chief Ministers Rojgar Yojana SchemeRs. an amount equal to 20% of the Equated Monthly Installments (which corresponds to approximately 25% of the principal component of the Equated Monthly Installments)Rs. paid within the due dateRs. shall be credited to the principal account on the date of payment. - For Revised Chief Ministers Rojgar Yojana beneficiariesRs. the subsidy is on the non-overdue outstanding Equated Monthly Installments of the disbursed assistanceRs. from the month following which the account is regularized. - Subsidy shall be applicable only on the fixed capital investmentRs. which includes premisesRs. plant and machineryRs. furniture and fixturesRs. office equipmentRs. electrificationRs. alternate power sourcesRs. etc. - For beneficiaries of the Revised Chief Ministers Rojgar YojanaRs. the subsidy shall be applicable on the entire non-overdue outstanding of the disbursed assistance. ##### ***Conditions for Availing the Benefits*** - The subsidy shall not be paid on the defaulted Equated Monthly Installments. - Subsidy can be resumed on payment of defaulted Equated Monthly Installments but shall be applicable only for the balance amount or for a fresh Equated Monthly Installment. - If the beneficiary pre-closes the loan account prior to the completion of one year of the first disbursement of the loanRs. then the subsidy amount paid to the beneficiary during the said period shall be reversed and debited to the loan account. - In the case of misrepresentation or miscalculationRs. the amount of such subsidy released shall be repayable forthwith by the borrower and shall be recovered as arrears of land revenue. - Working capital investmentRs. including raw materialsRs. stock of goods for saleRs. consumablesRs. etc.Rs. shall not be considered for the payment of subsidy.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an individual or a Group of individuals or a Partnership Firm. - The applicant must have availed financial assistance for the purpose of self-employment under the "Chief Ministers Rozgar Yojana (CMRY)" or "Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana (VKRY)" SchemesRs. or from Nationalized BanksRs. Scheduled Commercial BanksRs. Co-operative BanksRs. and registered Credit Societies. - The income of the applicant along with spouse must not exceed 3Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must be minimum 7th grade passed. - The applicant must be below 42 years of age. - In case of a group of individuals (except registered Self Help Groups)Rs. all the individuals must be below 42 years of age. - In the case of groups of individualsRs. all persons in the group must satisfy the residencyRs. ageRs. and education criteria. - The activity carried out must not be covered under the Red Category. - The activity carried out must not be related to tobacco and liquor. - The applicant must not be receiving assistance under the "Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana Scheme" for the acquisition of Yellow/BlackMotorcyclesRs. Yellow/BlackAuto RickshawsRs. Yellow/BlackTaxisRs. Tourist TaxisRs. or Buses. - The applicant must not be an existing beneficiary of the "Chief Ministers Rojgar Yojana Scheme" financed for the acquisition of Yellow/BlackMotorcyclesRs. Yellow/BlackAuto RickshawsRs. Yellow/BlackTaxisRs. or Tourist Taxis. - The applicant must not be a beneficiary under any other subsidy linked schemes of the GovernmentRs. wherein subsidy of approximately 25% or more is given by the concerned department. ##### ***PreferenceRs. RelaxationRs. and Automatic Coverage*** - The applicant should be born and resident for 15 years in Goa. - The applicant should be a resident of the State of Goa for at least 15 years prior to the application under this scheme. - The applicant should have passed graduation or 12th standard or 10th standard or schooling from the State of Goa. - The age limit shall be relaxable by 5 years for womenRs. disabled personsRs. Scheduled Caste/Scheduled TribesRs. and Other Backward Class persons. - Applicants eligible for age relaxation under the Chief Ministers Rozgar Yojana/Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana shall be considered under this scheme automatically. - The minimum VIIth grade requirement may be relaxed in deserving cases by a specific order of the Director of IndustriesRs. Trade & Commerce. - Applicants granted education relaxation under the Chief Ministers Rozgar Yojana/Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana Scheme shall be considered under this scheme automatically. - Self Help Groups (SHGs) of women and disabled persons shall be given priority. - Priority will be given to women entrepreneurs to the extent of 30% of the budgeted outlay on the scheme in case applications exceed total budgetary provision. - All beneficiaries under the Chief Ministers Rozgar Yojana/Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana Scheme are automatically covered under this schemeRs. and approval by the Task Force Committee is adequate. - Existing beneficiaries under the Revised and Modified Chief Ministers Rozgar Yojana having their account without any over dues as on 30-09-2015Rs. or from the month following which the account is regularizedRs. shall be eligible. - Existing beneficiaries of other subsidy linked schemes of the GovernmentRs. wherein the subsidy availed/eligible is less than 25%Rs. may be granted subsidy under this schemeRs. provided the subsidy availed is deducted from this scheme's subsidy on a pro-rata basis.

name: Laptop-e Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Laptop-e Scheme" was launched by the Directorate of EducationRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to equip students with individual portable computer systems (Laptops). The scheme aims to enhance learning and knowledge acquisition through Information Technology tools such as the InternetRs. CD-ROMsRs. and DVDsRs. and fully exploit the teaching infrastructure in schools. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Head of the Institution where the student is studying.
benefits: Provision of one (1) entry-level portable computer system (Notebook or Laptop). ##### ***Details of Equipment*** - The system must be equipped with at least mid-level Processors. - The system must include a DVD-ROM Drive. - The system must include Wi-Fi connectivity. - The system must include multimedia speakers. - The system must have a 15-inch or more screen size. - The system must have a requisite Preloaded Open Standards Supported Operating System. - The operating system must be backed by premium or comprehensive technical support for at least three (3) years from reputed software companies such as Windows Operating System. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Benefits are derived immediately after the approval of the GovernmentRs. depending on the availability of funds and after following all codal formalities. - The portable computer systems are supplied immediately to the students in various higher secondaries once tenders are decided and supply orders are issued to the various suppliers. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The applicant must deposit a refundable Registration Fee as decided by the Government._ - _The feeRs. once depositedRs. is not refunded in any case by the Government._ - _The studentRs. parentRs. or guardian shall give a valid receipt of the portable computer system received to the Education Department._ - _This receipt must be submitted after obtaining the portable computer system through the respective Head of the Institute._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a student of 11th standard. - The applicant must be studying in a recognized Higher Secondary School in Goa.

name: Swahid Dayal Das Panika Swaniyojan Achoni
brief_description: The scheme "Swahid Dayal Das Panika Swaniyojan Achoni" was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to self-employed youths belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community in Assam to encourage and initiate self-employment activities. The scheme is proposed as a means to enhance their capabilities. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance to the self-employed youths belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community in Assam. - The financial assistance is intended to encourage and initiate self-employment activities and enhance the capabilities of the beneficiaries. ***Conditions*** - _The applicant must not have availed such benefit during the last three years._ - _Only one applicant per family shall be selected for financial assistance._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant shall be between 20 to 35 years of ageRs. as on 1st January of the year of application. - The applicant must be a self-employed youth. - The applicant must have less than 10 bighas of land in the name of his family. ##### ***Preference*** - Candidates who have successfully completed at least 3 months skills training in the trade shall be given preference. - Physically Handicapped candidates may also apply and shall be given due weight-age as per Government norms.

name: Grant to Films
brief_description: The Uttarakhand film policy - 2024 Grant to Films is implemented by the Department of Information and Public RelationsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The policy aims to promote film production in Uttarakhand by providing financial grants to filmsRs. TV serialsRs. and web series shot in the stateRs. encouraging filmmakers to showcase Uttarakhands cultureRs. heritageRs. and locationsRs. and boosting local employment and the state's film economy.
benefits: Under the provisions of the Uttarakhand Film Policy2024Rs. grants are provided as follows: 1. For films made in regional languages and dialectsRs. a grant of 50% of the amount spent in the state or up to 2 croreRs. whichever is lowerRs. will be provided. 1. For films made in Hindi or in the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian ConstitutionRs. a grant of 30% of the amount spent in the state or up to 3 croreRs. whichever is lowerRs. will be provided. 1. For films made in foreign languages that have incurred an expenditure of at least 3 crore in the stateRs. and in which the shooting locations of the state have been appropriately showcasedRs. a grant will be provided of 50% of the amount spent in the state or up to 3 croreRs. whichever is lower. 1. For TV serials or web series produced in Hindi or in the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian ConstitutionRs. as well as in the regional dialects of UttarakhandRs. a grant will be provided of either 30% of the amount spent in Uttarakhand during the shooting period or up to 3 croreRs. whichever is lower.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a film producer.

name: Awareness Programme on Child/Human Trafficking, Family Planning, Legal Awareness, Health etc.
brief_description: The scheme "Awareness Programme on Child/Human TraffickingRs. Family PlanningRs. Legal AwarenessRs. Health etc." was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community on critical social issues. The scheme provides a platform to generate awareness regarding child/human traffickingRs. family planningRs. legal awarenessRs. and health issues such as the reduction of Maternal Mortality RateRs. Infant Mortality RateRs. and AlcoholismRs. along with maintaining hygiene. The applications for this scheme are accepted by inviting proposals through Expression of Interest (EOI).
benefits: - The benefit is to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community on issues like child/human traffickingRs. family planningRs. legal awarenessRs. and health (reduction of Maternal Mortality RateRs. Infant Mortality RateRs. AlcoholismRs. and maintenance of hygiene). - This awareness generation aims towards bringing effective social and behavioural change amongst the community.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Non-Governmental Organization. - The applicant must have valid registration under Societies ActRs. XXI of 1860.

name: Map Approval through UDAY App
brief_description: The Map Approval through UDAY App is implemented by the Haridwar - Roorkee Development Authority under Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to simplify and expedite the process of residential property map creation and approval for all landowners in Haridwar district through mobile app.
benefits: All landowners in Haridwar district can avail themselves of the benefit of map approval through the UDAY mobile app.
eligibility: 1. All landowners in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Scheme for Acquisition of Electro-Medical and Other Equipment (PIPDIC)
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Acquisition of Electro-Medical and Other Equipment was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the registered Medical practitioners for acquisition and installation of Electro Medical and other related equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial Assistance to registered Medical practitioners for acquisition and installation of Electro Medical and other related equipment. _*Cost of Equipment must not exceed 60Rs./-._
eligibility: - Registered Medical practitioners. - Cost of Equipment must not exceed 60Rs./-.

name: Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons
brief_description: The "Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons" scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide computer-based intensive trainingRs. screen-reading software supportRs. and a post-training laptop to visually impaired beneficiaries to enhance their education and livelihood opportunities. > **Objectives** The scheme provides intensive computer training with screen-reading software to visually impaired personsRs. improving their digital skills for education and employment. It helps them access information online and supports their goals in higher studiesRs. competitive examsRs. and self-employment. > **Training** The program is conducted in two shifts for two months and includes computer hardwareRs. softwareRs. trainersRs. internet connectivityRs. and study support.
benefits: **Computer Training with Screen-Reading Software** - Two-month intensive computer training is provided using screen-reading software. - Training is conducted in two batches dailyRs. each of four hours. - Training is delivered in seven divisions: BhopalRs. IndoreRs. JabalpurRs. GwaliorRs. SagarRs. RewaRs. and Ujjain. **Post-Training Laptop Support** - Each beneficiary receives a laptop after successful completion of the two-month training program. - The training and laptop distribution benefits are one-time and non-recurring. **Training Infrastructure Support** - Includes computer systems: Intel i3 or equivalent processorRs. 4 GB RAMRs. 250 GB or higher HDDRs. battery backupRs. and low-weight design. - Includes NBTR screen-reading software. - Includes instructor support and helper assistance. - Internet connectivity is provided during training. - Free access to an online library (provided at no cost by an external source).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must have 40% or more visual impairment. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household. 1. The applicant must have passed class 8th with at least 50% marks.1. The applicant is eligible to receive training only once under this scheme.

name: Scheme of Assistance to Good Borrowers: B Category
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme of Assistance to Good Borrowers: B Category" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specific categories of good borrowers for acquiring fixed assetsRs. setting up new unitsRs. and supporting expansionRs. modernizationRs. or diversification of existing units. The scheme provides loan limits ranging from a minimum of 5Rs./- to a maximum of 150Rs./-Rs. along with an interest concession of 0.5% less than the normal rate for 'B' Category borrowers. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** A loan limit of a minimum of 5Rs./- and a maximum of 150Rs./-.- **Interest Concession:** The borrower receives an interest concession of 1/2% less than the normal rate. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The collateral security offered in the form of immovable property must be valued by engaging a Chartered Engineer or valuer from the approved panel of the Corporation._ - _The applicant must acquire fixed assetsRs. such as purchasing balancing equipmentRs. replacement of machinery/equipmentRs. or acquiring assets for setting up new units or expanding/modernizing existing units._ - _The loan repayment period is 3 to 5 yearsRs. excluding the moratorium period._ - _The applicant must offer collateral security in the form of immovable property._ - _The value of the immovable property offered as collateral security must not be less than the term loan sanctionedRs. if the property is situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry._ - _If the immovable property is situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. the value offered must not be less than 150% of the loan amount if it is land with building._ - _If the immovable property situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only landRs. the value offered must not be less than 200% of the loan amount._
eligibility: - Existing assisted units satisfying the criteria under Good Borrowers which have not obtained reschedulement not for more than once and regular in repayment after reschedulement. - Units assisted by other institutions / banks satisfying the criteria and with the fixed assets in existing units is free from encumbrance.

name: Scheme for Tourism-related Activities
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Tourism-related Activities was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up or development of amusement parksRs. cultural centresRs. convention centresRs. restaurantsRs. tourist service agenciesRs. including expansion and modernization project. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial Assistance to entrepreneurs for setting up or development of amusement parksRs. cultural centresRs. convention centresRs. restaurantsRs. tourist service agenciesRs. including expansion and modernization project. - The Loan Limit is need based. - The Project Cost must not exceed 12Rs./-. - The Repayment Period is upto 10 years including moratorium period.
eligibility: Entrepreneurs setting up tourism-related activities are eligible.

name: Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes (PIPDIC)
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the entrepreneurs for setting up hospitals/nursing homes. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial Assistance to Entrepreneurs for setting up of small hospitals/nursing homesRs. polyclinics. etc.Rs. with 10 or more but less than 50 beds. _*Cost of Project must not exceed 5Rs./-._ _*Post-graduate doctors are to be associated._
eligibility: - Entrepreneurs setting up small hospitals/nursing homesRs. polyclinics. etc.Rs. with 10 or more but less than 50 beds. - Cost of Project must not exceed 5Rs./-. - Post-graduate doctors are to be associated.

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme
brief_description: The Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries is a component scheme under the "Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme" launched by the Fisheries Welfare and Fisheries Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. working capital is provided at a zero percent interest rate through cooperative banks to the fish farmers engaged in fisheries operations. The scheme offers interest subvention to ensure affordable credit for beneficiaries and reduce their financial burden.
benefits: - Short-term working capital loans for fisheries activities under the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility. - Fish farmers receive interest subventionRs. enabling access to zero-percent interest loans through cooperative banks. - The loan amount is determined as per bank norms and scheme provisionsRs. based on the financial requirement of the fish farmer.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a landholding farmerRs. marginal farmerRs. small farmerRs. fish farmerRs. livestock ownerRs. BPL beneficiaryRs. unorganized worker card holderRs. or registered worker. 1. The applicant must be engaged in fisheries activities.

name: Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The aim to provide social security and financial support to widowed women at the time of their remarriage. Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance is deposited into the beneficiarys savings bank account to help ensure economic stability and dignified reintegration into family life.
benefits: Financial assistance of 2Rs. is provided to widowed women at the time of their remarriage > **NOTE:** - Financial assistance is directly deposited into the beneficiarys bank savings account. - The assistance is provided only once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a widowed woman (Kalyani). 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya PradeshRs. and her spouse must also be a permanent resident. 1. The applicant must be 18 years or olderRs. and her husband must be 21 years or older at the time of marriage. 1. The applicant must not be an income taxpayer. 1. The applicant must not be a government employee of the stateRs. central governmentRs. or government-funded corporations and institutions. 1. The applicant must not be receiving a family pension from any government source. 1. There is no restriction of BPL under the scheme. 1. The husband must not have any living wife from a previous marriage. 1. There will be no compulsion to marry in a mass marriage ceremony for the Kalyani Vivah Yojana; individual marriages will also be considered valid. 1. The Kalyani has minor childrenRs. the responsibility for the children's upkeep will be jointly borne by the Kalyani and her husband.

name: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Teelu Rauteli Pension" has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to male/female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.
benefits: - A pension of 1Rs./- per month is provided to each eligible beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be male or female engaged in agricultural activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must be 20% to 40% disabled while performing agricultural work. 1. There is no income limit to avail the benefits of the scheme.

name: Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)
brief_description: The Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8) scheme has been implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to regularly enrolled disable students from Class 1 to 8.
benefits: ***Rate of Scholarships:*** - **Class 1 to 5:** 600/- - **Class 6 to 8:** 960/-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a disabled student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1 to 8. 1. The applicants annual family income must be less than 24Rs./-. 1. The student must not availing benefits from any other scholarship scheme.

name: Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home and Open Shelter Home
brief_description: The scheme Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care InstitutionRs. Government Communication HomeRs. and Open Shelter Home has been implemented by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support orphanedRs. destituteRs. abandonedRs. neglectedRs. and vulnerable children by providing them with clothingRs. foodRs. accommodationRs. medical careRs. counsellingRs. educationRs. trainingRs. and other essential facilities.
benefits: In the institutions and homesRs. children are provided with free facilities such as clothingRs. foodRs. accommodationRs. medical careRs. counsellingRs. entertainmentRs. trainingRs. and education. Along with these facilitiesRs. children are also provided day care facility based on their needs.
eligibility: 1. In Government Child Care InstitutionsRs. orphaned/destitute childrenRs. abandoned childrenRs. surrendered childrenRs. exploited and neglected childrenRs. and victimized children are admitted. 1. In Government Communication HomesRs. children who are in conflict with the law or have violated the law are admitted. 1. In Open Shelter HomesRs. destitute children living on the roadsideRs. beggarsRs. ragpickersRs. and children from slums who do not attend school are admitted.

name: Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs and Writers of Uttarakhand State
brief_description: The scheme Pension Scheme for ElderlyRs. Destitute ArtistsRs. LitterateursRs. and Writers of Uttarakhand was introduced by the Department of Culture and EndowmentsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly and impoverished artistsRs. litterateurs and writers who have dedicated their lives to the development of artRs. cultureRs. and literature and have made significant and distinguished contributions.
benefits: The department provides a monthly pension of 3Rs./- to the beneficiaries under this scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an elderlyRs. destitute artistRs. litterateurRs. or writer from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have dedicated their life to the development of artRs. cultureRs. and literature. 1. The applicant must have made significant and distinguished contributions in their field. 1. The applicant must be at least 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Nandaa Gaura Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Nandaa Gaura Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for up to two girls in a family. The assistance is given in two installments per girl child: the first installment is provided at the time of birth if the girl is born in a hospital or ANM centerRs. and the second installment is given when the girl passes Class 12th.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to two girls of an eligible family in two installments for each girl child: - 11Rs./- at the time of birth. - 51Rs./- when the girl passes Class 12. For the first installmentRs. the application must be submitted within six months of the girls birthRs. and the child must be born in a hospital/ANM center. For the second installmentRs. the application can be submitted when the girl passes Class 12. Applications are invited from July to November of the same year in which she passes. If applied in the next yearRs. the application will not be considered valid. The second installment will be granted only if the girl has passed Class 12 from the Uttarakhand BoardRs. Secondary Education Board of other statesRs. CBSERs. ICSERs. or the National Institute of Open SchoolingRs. New DelhiRs. and the girl must be unmarried.
eligibility: 1. The applicant family must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 2. The familys monthly income should not exceed 6Rs./-Rs. or the family should belong to the BPL category to be eligible. 3. The benefit is applicable for up to two girls per family. 4. It is mandatory for the mother/father/guardian to submit an affidavit regarding availing or not availing the benefit of the scheme for other girl children in the family in the past. The affidavit must include the following declarations: - All information regarding movable and immovable properties and other details sought by me have been provided correctly. - I certify that this benefit is being availed for my first/second daughter. - No facts have been concealed by me. - I have provided the details of all family bank accounts along with bank statements for the last one year. - In the case of applying after passing Class 12Rs. I confirm that my daughter is unmarried. 5. Girls living in Nari NiketanRs. Balika NiketanRs. orphanagesRs. or other state government-aided homes will be exempted from the requirement of birth certificateRs. permanent residence certificateRs. income certificateRs. or parents name to avail the benefit after passing Class 12.

name: Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication was introduced by the Department of Culture and EndowmentsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to the state's eminent litterateursRs. writersRs. poetsRs. and authors whose literary works remain unpublished due to financial constraints.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the department provides financial assistance to eminent litterateursRs. writersRs. and poets of the state whose works remain unpublished due to lack of funds.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an eminent litterateurRs. writerRs. authorRs. or poet. 1. The applicants literary work must remain unpublished solely due to financial constraints.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the health of pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) by providing nutritious foodRs. including eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a weekRs. at Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) are provided with eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children aged 3 to 6 years are eligible to receive nutritious food under this scheme.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)
brief_description: The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to empower persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for sustainable self-employment and livelihood generation. Under this schemeRs. the beneficiaries are supported with a mix of grantsRs. subsidized loansRs. and margin money for term loansRs. shop constructionRs. and bank-linked enterprises.
benefits:
**Term Loan Scheme:**


- Project Cost: 75Rs./-
- Grant: 20% or 10Rs./-Rs. whichever is less
- Term Loan: 65Rs./- at 6% annual interest rate


**Shop Construction Scheme:**


- Project Cost: 50Rs./-
- Grant: 20% or 10Rs./-Rs. whichever is less
- Margin Money Loan: 40Rs./- at 4% annual interest rateRs. repayable in 60 monthly installments


**Margin Money Loan Scheme for Bank Supported Loan:**


- Project Cost: Up to 2Rs./-
- Grant: 20%Rs. maximum of 10Rs./-
- Margin Money: 25% of the project cost at 4% annual interest rateRs. repayable in 36 monthly installments
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must possess a minimum of 40% disability.
1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 2Rs. in urban areas and 1Rs./- in rural areas.
1. The applicants age must be between 18 and 50 years.

name: Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF
brief_description: The scheme Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDARs. IMARs. OTARs. INARs. IAF was introduced by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. This scheme aims to recognize and reward candidates from Uttarakhand who have been selected for service at premier defence academies such as NDARs. IMARs. OTARs. INARs. and IAF.
benefits: **Award Amount:** 50Rs./- per candidate
eligibility: 1. The candidate must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The candidate should have been selected for service at one of the premier defence academiesRs. such as National Defence Academy (NDA)Rs. Indian Military Academy (IMA)Rs. Officers Training Academy (OTA)Rs. Indian Naval Academy (INA) or Indian Air Force (IAF). 1. The applicant must either be currently undergoing training at the respective academy or have been formally inducted into the defence service. 1. The candidate must have successfully completed the relevant training and course.

name: Organization of Multi-Purpose Camps/ Public Awareness Camps/ Medical Camps/Legal Service Camps
brief_description: The Scheme Organization of Multi-Purpose Camps/ Public Awareness Camps/ Medical Camps/L egal Service Camps has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. Nainital under the Department of LawRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to organize camps and awareness programs across urban and rural areas to inform and empower vulnerable groups such as womenRs. childrenRs. senior citizensRs. workers in the unorganized sectorRs. persons with disabilitiesRs. acid attack survivors and victims of trafficking about their legal rights.
benefits: For the effective implementation of public welfare schemes of the Honble National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)Rs. New DelhiRs. the District Legal Services AuthoritiesRs. Tehsil Legal Services CommitteesRs. and the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority also organize multi-purpose campsRs. awareness programsRs. debate competitionsRs. painting competitionsRs. and essay competitions across urban areas and remote rural regions.
eligibility: 1. IndividualsRs. womenRs. and children from all walks of life particularly workers in the unorganized sectorRs. persons with mental illness or disabilitiesRs. acid attack survivorsRs. senior citizensRs. and victims of trafficking and commercial sexual exploitation are provided information about their legal rights. 1. Multi-purpose camps are also organized to support the effective implementation of poverty alleviation schemes. 1. These camps are conducted in the presence of representatives from all departments.

name: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana was launched by the Department of Skill Development and EmploymentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the stateRs. enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. youth of Uttarakhand are provided with skill upgradation training in various domains such as languageRs. cultureRs. work ethicsRs. nursingRs. and hospitalityRs. along with country-specific training. - The training is provided as per the demand of foreign employers to enable the youth to secure suitable service and job opportunities abroad.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand.

name: Operation/implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath
brief_description: The scheme Operation/Implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. NainitalRs. under the Department of LawRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to spread legal awareness and provide information about welfare schemes to people in both urban and remote rural areasRs. ensuring that citizens are informed about their rights and available government benefits.
benefits: - Under the public awareness programmeRs. the mobile van of the State Legal Services AuthorityRs. "Vidhik Seva Rath"Rs. is sent to visit every urban area and remote rural areas of two to three districts every month and various welfare schemes run by the central and state government are shown through films. - The book "Saral Kanooni Gyan Mala" published on various subjects is distributed free of cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All residents of the areas visited by the van can benefit from these programs. The team members assigned to the tour inform the public about the schemes using a projector installed in the "Vidhik Seva Rath".

name: Scholarship to Poor Students
brief_description: The scheme Scholarship to Poor Students is implemented by Uttarakhand Sanskrit UniversityRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have the lowest annual family income among all students in the same courseRs. classRs. or subject.
