name: Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other Crimes, 2020
brief_description: The scheme Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other CrimesRs. 2020 has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. NainitalRs. under the Department of LawRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to women victims and survivors of sexual offencesRs. as well as other women victims of crime in the state.
benefits: - Women victims of crime are provided financial assistance/compensation ranging from a minimum of 3 lakh to a maximum of 10 lakh. - Upon receipt of an application for compensationRs. the State/District Legal Services Authority may pass an order to provide immediate first aid or medical benefits free of cost to the victim/dependentRs. or an immediate relief amount of 5Rs./- or 10Rs./-Rs. as required. This amount shall be disbursed immediately by the Member-SecretaryRs. State Legal Services Authority or District Legal Services Authority. - If a woman is a victim of sexual violence or an acid attack and is covered under more than one offenceRs. she will be entitled to receive a consolidated amount of compensation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All women of the state/their dependentsRs. who are victims of gang rapeRs. rapeRs. unnatural sexual assaultRs. pregnancy due to rapeRs. abortion or loss of fertility resulting from violenceRs. loss of lifeRs. disabilityRs. physical or mental injury requiring rehabilitationRs. burnsRs. or acid attacksRs. will be eligible to receive compensation under the scheme.

name: Dr. Dhyanpal Singh Memorial Award (for Final-Year Undergraduate Students of All Colleges)
brief_description: The Dr. Dhyanpal Singh Memorial Award (for Final-Year Undergraduate Students of All Colleges) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support and encourage meritorious students in their final year of undergraduate studies by reducing financial burdens.
benefits: The selected students will receive an amount of 30Rs./- per year in their final year of undergraduate.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the final year of an undergraduate course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The award amount is provided once per year.

name: Shri Varun Panwar Memorial Award for B.Sc. Agriculture (2nd Year, 3rd Year, and 4th Year) Students
brief_description: The Shri Varun Panwar Memorial Award for B.Sc. Agriculture (2nd YearRs. 3rd YearRs. and 4th Year) Students scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize and encourage B.Sc. Agriculture students in their 2ndRs. 3rdRs. or 4th year of study by awarding them a cash prize for their academic excellence.
benefits: 1. Award Amount: 10Rs./- per year 1. Number of Awards: One award for each class - 2nd Year: 1 student - 3rd Year: 1 student - 4th Year: 1 student
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the B.Sc. Agriculture program and be in their 2ndRs. 3rdRs. or 4th year of study at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The award is granted for a duration of one year only.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide loans to registered construction workers for the purchase or construction of a house at a minimal interest rate.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. registered construction workers are eligible to receive an advance loan amount of up to 50Rs./- for the purchase or construction of a houseRs. subject to the conditions specified by the Board.
1. Interest of at least 5% per annum is applicable on this loan.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. To avail an advance loan for the purchase or construction of a houseRs. the worker must have been a member of the fund for at least five years and should have a minimum of 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.

name: Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth
brief_description: The scheme Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth has been implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial assistance to parents or guardians for caring for their children below 18 years of age with more than 40% disability.
benefits: 700/- per month is provided to parents or guardians for caring for their children.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be the parent or guardian of a child with more than 40% disability. - The child must be below 18 years of age. - The familys monthly income must be less than 4Rs./- or the family must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Training Programme for Sugarcane Farmers
brief_description: The scheme Training Programme for Sugarcane Farmers was launched by the Department of Sugarcane Development and Sugar IndustryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the knowledge and skills of sugarcane farmers by providing free training and information on advanced and modern sugarcane cultivation techniques.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. information and training on advanced and modern sugarcane farming practices are provided to farmers free of cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer associated with a sugar mill area or a member of a cooperative society.

name: Appointment of Contract Sports Coaches
brief_description: The scheme Appointment of Contract Sports Coaches was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to appoint sports coaches on a contract basis to ensure the smooth functioning of local training camps for various sports across the state.
benefits: Every yearRs. around 250 coaches benefit from these training camps and gain employment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a sportsperson or a coach from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 21 and 70 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess the relevant educational and sports qualifications. 1. The sports coach is not required to be a domicile or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.

name: State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes
brief_description: The State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes scheme has been launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide shelter and essential care to destitute elderly residents of the state. Under this schemeRs. senior citizens are provided free accommodationRs. mealsRs. clothingRs. and healthcare in state-run residential facilities. CurrentlyRs. two homes are operational in the districts of Chamoli & Bageshwar.
benefits:
The following facilities are provided to elderly individuals in government-run Old Age and Infirm Homes:

- Free accommodation
- Free nutritious meals
- Free clothing
- Free medical careRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant should be a male or female.
1. The applicant's age must be 60 years or above.
1. There is no income ceiling for eligibility.
1. The applicant must not have a communicable disease (certified by a government doctor).

name: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities has been implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to enhance the mobility and functional independence of persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for the purchase and repair of essential assistive devices. Under this schemeRs. a grant of up to 3Rs./- (maximum 7Rs./- in special cases) is provided for the purchase of individual aids and 500 for the repair of prosthetic limbs and assistive equipment.
benefits: > **Grant Amount:** - 50/- to 3Rs./- for the purchase of assistive devices (maximum 7Rs./- in special cases). - 500/- for repair of artificial limbs and assistive equipment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant should be a person with a disability.
1. The applicant should have a minimum disability of 40%.
1. In the case of a minor beneficiaryRs. the monthly income of parents/guardians should not exceed 4Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have a medical recommendation from a Government Medical Officer or specialist recommending the device or its repair.

name: Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers
brief_description: The Assistance Scheme for Handloom Spinning-Weaving Women Workers is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to traditional women workers whose primary occupation is handloom weavingRs. spinningRs. or related weaving activities.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. for providing handloom / pantloom / frameloom and other related tools and equipment to selected women workersRs. 90% of the total cost (up to a maximum of 25Rs./-) will be borne by the departmentRs. while the remaining 10% will be contributed by the beneficiary herself.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman worker who belong to a family whose ancestral occupation is weavingRs. spinningRs. knittingRs. or allied handloom activities. 1. Preference will be given to women workers who have experience in the handloom sector but are unable to carry out weaving work due to the unavailability of a loom. 1. The woman worker must be registered with the Government of India or Government of Uttarakhand.

name: Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision
brief_description: The scheme Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of HandsRs. LegsRs. EyesRs. or Vision is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. an ex-gratia grant of 74Rs./- is provided to each affected person. In cases where the disability exceeds 60%Rs. a higher amount of 2Rs./- per person is provided.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either disaster-affected individual or involved in disaster relief or preparedness-related activities. 1. The extent and cause of the disability must be certified by a doctor from a government hospital or dispensary.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.
benefits: To strengthen small entrepreneurs and businessmen in rural and urban areasRs. financing of up to 50Rs./- is provided through banks for setting up micro enterprises or businesses. This financial assistance is also available for the expansion of existing businesses. The subsidy structure is as follows: - Subsidy for Category A districts: 35% for the general category (maximum 17Rs./-) and 40% for the special category (maximum 20Rs./-). - Subsidy for Category B and B+ districts: 30% for the general category (maximum 15Rs./-) and 35% for the special category (maximum 17Rs./-). - Subsidy for Category C and D districts: 25% for the general category (maximum 12Rs./-) and 30% for the special category (maximum 15Rs./-). The category-wise classification of districts is provided in [Annexure-2](https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf) (Page No. 157).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme. 1. The applicant must hold an account with the financing bank in the concerned area. 1. The applicant or entity must not be a defaulter of any bankRs. nationalized bankRs. financial institutionRs. or cooperative bank/institution.

name: Uttarakhand Oon Yojana
brief_description: The Uttarakhand Oon Yojana has been implemented by the Uttarakhand Khadi and Village Industries Board under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote traditional wool spinning and weaving activities in the state while providing sustainable employment opportunities to local artisans and weavers.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. four regional offices of the Regional Superintendent of Industries (Wool) have been established at ChambaRs. SrinagarRs. AlmoraRs. and Jaspur. These offices oversee spinning and weaving activities through departmental spinning/production centers. - Trainees who are willing to work in spinning and weaving are selected and provided with wool/NMC spinning wheels. They can carry out spinning and weaving either at the departmental centers or at their own homes. Weavers are compensated for their work according to rates fixed by the Khadi CommissionRs. Government of IndiaRs. ensuring year-round employment. - To support weavers and spinnersRs. the Khadi & Polyvastra Artisan Welfare and Pension Trust has been established in the state. Upon registrationRs. each artisan receives a 12% contribution from the artisan and a 12% contribution from the department. AdditionallyRs. artisans are entitled to receive 25% of their annual spinning and weaving wages as a bonus.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme.

name: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana was launched by the Department of Dairy DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the nutrition of dairy animals and enhance milk production by providing subsidized silage and feed to members of milk cooperative societies.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. members of milk cooperative societies in hilly and plain rural areas are provided with quality mineral mixtures and probiotics at current ratesRs. receive a 75% subsidy on silage including an upfront subsidy of 2.00 per kg. - Compact feed blocks are available at a 50% subsidyRs. costing the beneficiary 8.00 per kg.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society supplying milk to the society.

name: Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Dugdh Mulya Protsahan Yojana was launched by the Department of Dairy DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage milk production and ensure fair remuneration to cattle farmers by providing financial incentives based on the quality of milk supplied to cooperative societies.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. in addition to paying the price of milk to cattle farmers who supply milk to milk cooperative societiesRs. an incentive of 4.00 per litre or 3.00 per litre is also paidRs. as per the prescribed standards.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society supplying milk to the society.

name: Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH
brief_description: The Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH is implemented by the Ayush DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote the health and well-being of pregnant women and newborns by providing Ayurvedic-based healthcare services and treatment.
benefits: - Health benefits are provided to pregnant mothers and newborns through Ayurvedic treatment. - Medicines are dispensed as per the individuals medical condition. - An OPD fee of 10/- per person is charged for availing the services.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a newborn belonging to Uttarakhand.

name: Promotion of Institutional Delivery
brief_description: The scheme Promotion of Institutional Delivery is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote safe and institutional deliveries by providing free accommodation to pregnant womenRs. especially from disaster-prone areasRs. near district hospitals.
benefits: In all districtsRs. especially considering road blockages during disastersRs. arrangements are being made in coordination with the Health Department and the Women and Child Development Department to provide free accommodation for pregnant women from identified areas in the One Stop Centre (run by the Women Empowerment Department). These centresRs. operated as Birth Waiting Rooms near District HospitalsRs. allow women to stay up to 15 days before their expected delivery dateRs. ensuring that in case of emergencies or disastersRs. they can be promptly admitted to the nearest hospital for a safe institutional delivery. A One Stop Centre has been established in every district.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman.

name: Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme
brief_description: The Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme scheme was introduced by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities such as duckRs. poultryRs. and horticulture-based fisheries.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Fishermen who already own ponds are provided a 60% subsidy for repairing or improving their pondsRs. or for undertaking duck/poultry farming and other integrated activities. - To connect landless individuals with fish processing and marketing businessesRs. a 60% subsidy of 1Rs./- is provided against the cost of a mobile fish stall amounting to 2Rs./-. - A 60% subsidy of 42Rs./- is provided against the cost of 70Rs./- for the improvement of a 100-square-meter pond. - A 60% subsidy of 3Rs./- is provided against the cost of 5Rs./- for the improvement of a 10-hectare pond in plain areas. - A 60% subsidy of 83Rs./- is provided against the cost of 1Rs./- for establishing one integrated unit (chicken/duck/banana/papaya) in mountainous areas. - In plain areasRs. a grant of 60%Rs. i.e. 3Rs./-Rs. is provided against the cost of construction of one integrated unit valued at 6Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The applicant should be engaged in fish production and possess a pond or be landless and interested in engaging in fish processing or marketing businesses to be eligible.

name: National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card)" is implemented by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies & Consumer AffairsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. 5 kg of food grains per person per month are providedRs. including 2 kg of wheat at 2.00 per kg and 3 kg of rice at 3.00 per kg. At presentRs. from 1 January 2023Rs. food grains are being distributed free of cost.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. A household/person is eligible under the scheme if they meet any of the following criteria: - A household with a monthly income of less than 15Rs./- or not having an Antyodaya Ration Card. - A tribal household residing in a tribal or border area/widow/single woman/person suffering from an incurable disease/person with a disability/person aged 60 years or aboveRs. who is the head of the familyRs. with a monthly income of less than 15Rs./-. - A household whose total irrigated landRs. as per revenue recordsRs. is less than 2 hectares; or has less than 1 hectare irrigated and 2 hectares unirrigated; or has a total area of less than 4 hectares of unirrigated land. - A person engaged in occupations such as rickshaw pullingRs. porter workRs. laborRs. rag pickingRs. cobblingRs. blacksmithingRs. carpentryRs. rural artisanal workRs. domestic serviceRs. or sanitation work. - A household that cultivates land belonging to another farmer. - A household residing in a slum or hut in an urban areaRs. living in Uttarakhand since or before the date specified in the relevant Government Order. - A household whose annual income does not attract liability under the Income Tax Act. - A person who is homeless and separated from their social classRs. residing in organizations or ashrams such as widows ashramsRs. child reform homesRs. beggars homesRs. leprosy ashramsRs. orphanagesRs. ashrams for the mentally ill or handicappedRs. or old age homes. Eligible households or personsRs. once identified according to the above criteriaRs. will be selected in ascending order based on the lowest number in the BPL list prepared from surveys conducted by the Rural Development Department for rural areas.

name: Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs
brief_description: The scheme "Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs" was launched by the Department of Youth Welfare and prantiy rakshak dal (PRD)Rs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sports and identify grassroots-level talent among youth through structured competitions and training.
benefits: - Organizing Khel Mahakumbh Competitions Various sports competitions are organized for the age groups Under-14Rs. Under-17Rs. and Under-21. - Prizes are awarded for firstRs. secondRs. and third places as follows: **Sl. No.****Level****1****st** **Rank (Cash Prize )****2****nd** **Rank (Cash Prize )****3****rd** **Rank (Cash Prize )**1Gram Panchayat300/-200/-150/-2Block Development 500/-400/-300/-3District Level800/-600/-400/-4State Level1Rs./-1Rs./-700/- - During the competitionsRs. talented players who perform best at the Block Development levels and District levels are identified by the department and provided free training prior to state-level participation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth (boy or girl).

name: Silkworm Rearing Chamber
brief_description: The scheme Silkworm Rearing Chamber was launched by the Department of SericultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sericulture and enhance silk production among farmers by providing financial assistance for establishing dedicated silkworm rearing chambers.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided for the construction of a silkworm rearing chamber on an 80:10:10 cost-sharing basis. The farmer contributes 10Rs./- for completing the foundation of the chamberRs. while the state government provides 90Rs./- as a subsidy in two equal installments.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must have availed assistance under the Silk Tree Plantation Scheme. 1. The beneficiary must have at least 300 mulberry plants available for silkworm rearing.

name: Silk Tree Plantation
brief_description: The scheme Silk Tree Plantation was launched by the Department of SericultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote mulberry cultivation and silkworm rearing among farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistanceRs. technical supportRs. and organized cluster-based sericulture activities to enhance their income and livelihood.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. selected farmers in a cluster receive a grant of 17Rs./- for silk tree plantationsRs. and 2-silk trees are provided free of cost by the department.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must belong to a cluster or group. 1. In mountainous areasRs. a minimum of 25 farmers is required for a clusterRs. while in plain areasRs. at least 50 farmers are mandatory. 1. The beneficiaries in the group must have land available for the plantation of at least 300 plants. 1. Silkworm rearing is conducted under departmental supervision. ThereforeRs. clusters must be selected within a 1520 km radius of departmental silkworm farms. If the distance exceeds thisRs. the selected group must provide one acre of land for a collective rearing center and may conduct silkworm rearing after receiving training. 1. Priority is given to farmers who already practice sericulture or those who have mulberry saplings available. Mulberry silkworm rearing can be carried out up to an altitude of 4Rs. feetRs. although warmer valley areas are more suitable for this activity. 1. The department has not specified any particular regions for silkworm rearing; howeverRs. most state-run sericulture farms were established in locations where mulberry silk production is feasible.

name: Silkworm Rearing Equipment
brief_description: The scheme Silkworm Rearing Equipment was launched by the Department of SericultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support individuals in silkworm rearing by providing necessary equipmentRs. financial assistanceRs. and technical guidance.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. selected beneficiaries are provided 40Rs./- (in an 80:10:10 ratio) to purchase equipment necessary for silkworm rearing. Beneficiaries are required to contribute 10% of this amount themselves for the installation of the leaf chamberRs. while other rearing materials are provided by the department.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must belong to a cluster or group. 1. In hilly areasRs. a minimum of 25 farmers is required to form a clusterRs. while in plain areasRs. at least 50 farmers are mandatory. 1. The beneficiary must be willing to engage in sericulture. 1. Preference will be given to farmers who are already engaged in sericulture or who have mulberry seedlings available. 1. Under the Silk Samagra YojanaRs. saplings are planted on the boundaries of farmers fieldsRs. with a standard of 300 saplings per acre. 1. All farmers in the selected cluster are required to plant the saplings.

name: Vishesh Abhiyaan - Humdard
brief_description: The scheme Vishesh Abhiyaan - Humdard has been implemented by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. NainitalRs. under the Department of LawRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to organize special campaigns for senior citizensRs. mentally and physically challenged individualsRs. and other destitute people in the state to make them aware of welfare schemesRs. their legal rightsRs. access to benefitsRs. skill developmentRs. personal security & protectionRs. etc.
benefits: Under the scheme/campaignRs. all District Legal Services Authorities organize door-to-door programs for senior citizens to raise awareness about welfare schemesRs. their legal rights and access to these schemesRs. skill developmentRs. self-employmentRs. technical and financial literacyRs. as well as personal security and protection.
eligibility: 1. This special campaign has been organized by the Uttarakhand State Legal Services AuthorityRs. Nainital for senior citizensRs. mentally and physically challenged individualsRs. and other destitute people in the state.

name: Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote horticulture development in Uttarakhand by providing farmers with subsidized fruit plantsRs. seedsRs. pesticidesRs. and horticulture infrastructure such as Cool Houses and Refrigerator VansRs. thereby increasing productivityRs. reducing post-harvest lossesRs. and enhancing farmers income.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided: - 50% subsidy on the cost of fruit plantsRs. open-field vegetable seedsRs. spice seedsRs. and flower seeds. No direct monetary assistance is provided; the seeds and plants are supplied at a subsidized rate. - 60% subsidy on the cost of pesticides and other plant protection chemicals. No direct cash is given; the medicines are provided at a subsidized rate. - 50% subsidy on the total cost of 15.00 lakh for Cool Houses with a capacity of 30 MT. - 50% subsidy on the total cost of 26.00 lakh for Refrigerator Vans with a capacity of 9 MT.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a valid Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Existing Assets
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance for Purchase of Existing Assets" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist the units who are in existence for a minimum period of 2 years with good track record. The assistance is provided for purchase of existing landRs. building and machinery with prescribed residual life. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** Minimum of 5Rs./- and maximum as applicable to term loans. **Interest Rate:** 1% more than the prevailing rate. **Repayment:** 5 years including moratorium period of 1 year.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the units which are in existence for a minimum period of 2 years with good track record.

name: Dr. S.K. Mukherjee Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture Students (2nd & 3rd Year)
brief_description: The Dr. S.K. Mukherjee Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture Students (2nd & 3rd Year) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. Agriculture course in their 2nd and 3rd years of study by awarding a one-year scholarship.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship:** 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 2nd or 3rd year of a B.Sc. Agriculture course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Scheme for Setting Up of Industrial Estates
brief_description: The "Scheme for Setting Up of Industrial Estates" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. It is a sub-scheme under the umbrella scheme "Scheme for Infrastructure Development". The scheme aims to assist organizations (Public Limited CompaniesRs. Private Limited CompaniesRs. PartnershipsRs. Sole ProprietaryRs. and Municipalities) for setting up of industrial estates for exclusive allotment of sheds/plots to SSI units. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: Need-based loan for setting up of industrial estates for exclusive allotment of sheds/plots to SSI units.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to all Forms of organisationsRs. such as the following: - Public Limited Companies - Private Limited Companies - Partnerships - Sole Proprietary - Municipalities

name: Scheme for Purchase of Paddy Harvesting Machine
brief_description: The "Scheme for Purchase of Paddy Harvesting Machine" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist agriculturists belonging to Puducherry for the purchase of a tractor and harvesting machine to harvest the crops in their vicinity. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: Loan of upto 70% of the cost of the tractor and harvesting machine.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the agriculturists belonging to Puducherry.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of 500 or More Seater Convention Centre as Above cum Hotel under MICE
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of 500 or More Seater Convention Centre as Above cum Hotel under MICE" was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote MICE (MeetingsRs. IncentivesRs. ConferencesRs. and Exhibitions) tourism by encouraging the creation of large-scale convention infrastructure combined with hotels. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% on the fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 10Rs./-. The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 20Rs./- as approved by the department to be eligible. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - The beneficiary receives a capital subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum subsidy amount is capped at 10Rs./-. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within 1 year of receiptRs. 80% of the subsidy must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 2 years of receiptRs. 60% of the subsidy must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 3 years of receiptRs. 50% of the subsidy must be refunded._
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a tourism project that functions as a "Convention Centre cum Hotel under MICE". - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 20Rs./- (approved by the department). - The applicant must ensure the project conforms to the criteria and standards laid down by the Government of India for convention centers. - The applicant must ensure the seating capacity of the main convention hallRs. taken aloneRs. is 500 seats or more. - The applicant must submit the application within one year from the date of commencement of operation.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of Way Side Amenities Under Green Field or Franchise Model
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of Way Side Amenities Under Green Field or Franchise Model" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to improve travel infrastructure by encouraging private investment in the creation of standardized wayside amenities across the state. The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 15% on fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 50Rs./-Rs. for projects with a minimum investment of 25Rs./-. The applicant must ensure the unit is established and operated according to the Department's "Way Side Amenities Policy 2016" on sites identified or approved by the Managing Director of the M.P. Tourism Board. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism BoardRs. and applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state's investment portal.
benefits: - **Capital Subsidy:** The beneficiary is entitled to a subsidy of 15% of the fixed capital investment.- **Maximum Ceiling:** The maximum subsidy amount is capped at 50Rs./-.- **Availability:** This benefit is available for units established under the Green Field or Franchise Model. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The unit must be established and operationalized during the operative tenure of the Tourism Policy 2025._ - _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding continuous operation on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within one year of receiving the subsidyRs. 80% of the amount must be refunded; if within two yearsRs. 60% must be refunded; and if within three yearsRs. 50% must be refunded._
eligibility: - The applicant must be an investor or entrepreneur establishing a "Way Side Amenity" project. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 25Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must establish the unit under either a Green Field Model or a Franchise Model. - The applicant must locate the project at a site identified by the department or at a site explicitly approved by the Managing DirectorRs. M.P. Tourism Board. - The applicant must ensure the unit is established and operated in accordance with the definitions and standards laid out in the Department's "Way Side Amenities Policy 2016". - The applicant must submit the application for the capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Creation of Infrastructure
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation Of Infrastructure" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage private investment in developing essential infrastructure like power supplyRs. water supplyRs. approach roadsRs. sewageRs. and drainage systems on land and heritage assets leased from the Tourism Department. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 25% against fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 3Rs./-. The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 50Rs./- as approved by the department to qualify for this benefit. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the state's investment portal and single-window system.
benefits: - The beneficiary will receive a capital investment subsidy of 25% against the Fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 3Rs./-. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The unit must submit a self-declaration regarding continuous operation on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within one year of receipt of subsidyRs. 80% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within two years of receipt of subsidyRs. 60% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within three years of receipt of subsidyRs. 50% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a private investor or entity establishing a tourism projectRs.. - The applicant must have obtained the land or heritage assets from the Tourism Department on a lease basis. - The applicant must create infrastructure such as power supplyRs. water supplyRs. approach roadRs. sewageRs. and drainage systems on the obtained land or heritage assets. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 50Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must establish and operationalize the tourism project during the operative tenure of this policy. - The applicant must not claim Investment Promotion Assistance if claiming this capital subsidy.

name: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
brief_description: The '**Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education**' scheme introduced by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme is provisioned for providing laptops to the visually impaired students to pursue professional courses after XIIRs. under graduate and post graduate courses. The new provision of providing laptops to the visually impaired students forms part of the existing scheme Special Appliances.
benefits:
1. The DirectorRs. SSEPD shall distribute the laptops to the students on proper identification in camps organized in different regions of the State in presences of public representatives and Government Officers.
1. The JAWS Software for visually impaired students will be installed in the laptops.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha state.
1. The applicant must have a disability of 40% and above.
1. The applicant must be pursuing 1st year and above of the professional courses after +2Rs. Under Graduate or Post Graduate course including M.PhillRs. PhdRs. LawRs. ManagementRs. Medicine and other Technical courses.

name: Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. The objective of the scheme is the promotion of Odia Language by way of encouraging meritorious students to take up higher studies in Odia Language at U.G. and P.G. level. This is one time scholarship of 20Rs./- per student. There are 1500 scholarships awarded every year out of which 1200 are for the "Students studying UG with Odia Honours" CategoryRs. and 300 are for the "Students studying PG in Odia" Category.
benefits:
1. This is a one-time scholarship of 20Rs./- per student.
1. There are 1500 scholarships awarded every year out of which 1200 are for the "Students studying UG with Odia Honours" CategoryRs. and 300 are for the "Students studying PG in Odia" Category.
1. A student availing of other scholarships is also eligible for this Bhasabruti.
eligibility:
1. Students who have been admitted in +3 Arts with Odia as Honours subject (1St Year) in Degree Colleges / Autonomous Colleges/ State Universities of Odisha or other states after passing +2 Examination with 60% marks aggregate conducted by CHSERs. Odisha will be eligible for applying for this Scholarship at U.G. level. 1. The students who have taken admitted to M.A. (Odia) in any of the State Universities/ Degree Colleges and Autonomous Colleges in Odisha after securing 60% marks in Odia Honours subject will also be eligible for this Scholarship at the P.G. level. 1. A student availing of other scholarships is also eligible for this Bhasabruti. 1. The students will be selected on the basis of marks secured in the qualifying examinationRs. i.e.Rs. students pursuing +3 Arts having Odia as an Honours subject will be selected on the basis of their overall marks in the +2 examination conducted by CHSERs. Odisha. 1. The students pursuing M.A. (Odia) will be selected on the basis of the marks secured in Odia Honours in the +3 Arts final examinations. Basing on the common merit list for both categories the targeted beneficiaries will be selected (if the number of eligible applicants is more than the target).
**NOTE:** Students pursuing their higher studies through distance learning/ correspondence courses are not eligible for such scholarships.

name: State Horticulture Scholarship
brief_description: The State Horticulture Scholarship is a scholarship schemeRs. launched by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Nagaland to provide scholarship/stipends to students who are pursuing B.Sc. (Horticulture) M.Sc. (Horticulture) Ph.D. (Horticulture) courses. The department introduced the scheme to ensure that students pursuing Horticulture degrees should have the right to quality education and support their education in order to help achieve their maximum potential.
benefits:
- Under the schemeRs. scholarships/Stipends will be given to students according to the course/programme in which they are enrolled.

> **Time frame:** Applicant shall be awarded the stipend for a fixed number of years as follows:


1. **B.Sc. (Horticulture): 4 Years**
1. **M.Sc. (Horticulture): 2 Years**
1. **Ph.D. (Horticulture): 3 Years**
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be an indigenous inhabitant of Nagaland.
1. The students who are pursuing B.Sc. Hons. (Horticulture)Rs. M.Sc. Horticulture and Ph. D. Horticulture are eligible to apply.
1. The institution in which the applicant is currently studying must be recognized by UGC.
1. Applicant should not be receiving any form of financial assistance in the form of a Scholarship/Stipend from any other sources.

name: Sudakshya For Girls Child Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Sudakshya for Girls Child Scholarship" has been implemented by the Skill Development & Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. Many girl students left their academics after 10th due to various reasons. To encourage girls towards technical educationRs. a new initiative has been started by the Odisha government. Sudakshya for Girls Child Scholarship is specially designed for the General/ ST/ SC/ OBC/ SEBC/ EBC category girl child of Odisha state. Under this scholarship schemeRs. the government is going to provide financial help to the students. Girl students who win the award will get cash benefits. The scholarship is only for girls who are pursuing ITI courses in any trade.
benefits: 1. Reimbursement of Admission and Hostel Fee. 1. Maintenance Allowances will be given of 1Rs./- per month for Hostellers and 500/- for Day Scholars. 1. Reimbursable cost of uniform 3Rs./-. 1. Maintenance Allowances 1Rs./- per month for Apprenticeship Training after ITI inside the state and 1Rs./- per month for outside the state. 1. One Month Maintenance Allowances of 5Rs./- after completion of 6 months on Jobs outside the State. > **Note 01:** Benefits will be directly transferred to the bank account of the student. > **Note 02:** Maintenance Allowances shall be released on a half-yearly basis. > **Note 03:** STRs. SCRs. OBCRs. MinorityRs. Children of BOC WorkersRs. PwDRs. MCPRs. MeritRs. and other stipend/scholarship holders will get differential amounts only.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha state. 1. The applicant must be a girl child. 1. The applicant must belong to the General/ST/SC/OBC/SEBC/EBC category. 1. The applicant must be pursuing I.T.I. / I.T.C.Rs. Polytechnic/ Diploma courses.

name: Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award For Meritorious Children With Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award for Meritorious Children with Disabilities was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The government of Kerala has devised this scheme to provide a one-time cash award as motivation and helping hand to meritorious differently-abled students who have secured high marks in Degree/ Equivalent coursesRs. Post Graduate & Professional courses. Through this schemeRs. the government aims to mainstream Children with Disabilities and create awareness among them of their fundamental rights. The differently-abled persons face several obstacles in all spheres of life. Persons with disability are the marginalized groupsRs. who are sociallyRs. educationallyRs. and economically deprived. Especially in the case of Children with Disability (CWD)Rs. they struggle hard even to complete formal primary education. The Department of Social Justice is bound to guarantee access to a quality inclusive education for all children with disabilities.
benefits:
1. The amount of the award is as under:

**Sl. No.****Category****Eligibility****Amount of Award****No. of students per district**1Degree / Equivalent courses60% marks for Arts subjectsRs. 80% marks for Science subject8000/-10 students2Post-Graduation & Professional Courses60 % and above10Rs./-5 students2. As a token of appreciationRs. certificatesRs. and mementos will also be presented to the selected students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a differently abled student.
1. The applicant should have a 40% disability or more.
1. The applicant must complete their studies in the educational institutions within the State of Kerala.
1. The differently abled students who have secured high marks in Degree/ Equivalent coursesRs. Post Graduate & Professional courses are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The students who have secured 60% marks for Arts subjectsRs. 80% marks for Science subject and 60 % & above for Post-Graduation & Professional Courses.
1. The applicants must have passed the courses from Government / Aided Colleges/ Other Affiliated Institutions (Parallel CollegesRs. Distance Education Centers).
1. The applicants must have passed the examination in the first attempt.

**Note:** If two or more students have the same eligibility then priority must be given to a student with a higher disability percentage.

name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
brief_description:
The scheme Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course) was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. To help the children of prisonersRs. the Government of Kerala has devised this scheme which provides educational assistance to children of prisoners up to degree-level courses as per G.O (RT) No. 322/2014/SJD dated 08-05-2014. When an individual gets convicted and punished for any crime it's not only the person who suffersRs. the one who suffers the most are their children. They get deprived of all their rights; they face a lack of opportunities for education and a financial crisis.
When compared to the present educational standardsRs. the assistance provided to children pursuing degree-level professional courses in Government / Aided colleges is inadequate. Considering the different types of fee structures for professional coursesRs. State Government has fixed the assistance amount for children of prisoners to 100Rs./- (per student) including annual fees & hostel fees.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. State Government is providing assistance amount of 100Rs./- (per student) to the children of prisoners for pursuing degree-level professional courses in Government / Aided colleges.

**Note 01:** The assistance amount also includes annual fees & hostel fees.
**Note 02:** The assistance will be given to more than one child belonging to a single family.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
2. The applicants should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
3. The applicant must be the child of a prisoner sentenced to life imprisonment or death sentence.
4. Those applicants who have been admitted to courses through merit basis are eligible for assistance.
5. Applicant must have secured 70 % or above marks in Higher secondary level exams.
**Note 01:** Educational assistance is being provided for Degree level professional courses in Government/ Aided colleges inside Kerala.
**Note 02:** For courses like MBBSRs. B.VSc. assistance will be provided only if the children are studying in Government colleges.
**Note 03:** In case both mother and father are convicts and the child is being looked after by a relative who belongs to the Above Poverty Line (APL) category then the application can only be considered based on the inquiry report submitted by the Probation Officer.
**Note 04:** If more applicants are madeRs. preference will be given based on the percentage of marks.

name: Scheme of Scholarship for Sainik Schools
brief_description: "Scheme Of Scholarship For Sainik Schools" was launched by the Directorate Of Higher and Technical EducationRs. MeghalayaRs. to prepare young boys for a career in the Cadre of the Armed Forces. The scholarships are awarded to students whose parents are permanent residents of Meghalaya and whose family income is less than 8Rs./- per month.
benefits: - Scholarship of 20Rs./-Rs. awarded to the students whose family income is below 5Rs./- per month. - Scholarship of 10Rs./-Rs. awarded to the students whose family income is between 5Rs./- to 8Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student of the Sainik SchoolRs. Goalpara.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST)/ Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. or the applicant should be a child of Service Personnel (including the ex-servicemen community).
1. The student should be studying in class 12th.
1. The student should be fluent in the English language.
1. The parents of the student' should be permanent residents of Meghalaya.
1. The student's family income should be less than 8Rs./- per month.

name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching
brief_description:
The Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Coaching is a category of award under the Biju Patnaik Sports Award" Scheme. The scheme was launched by the Sports & Youth Services DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha to commemorate the yeoman service of late Biju PatnaikRs. the ex-Chief Minister of OdishaRs. towards the development of Sports & Games in the State by conferring the highest honour of the Government of Odisha in the field of Sports in his name. The award is given to the coaches who have devoted their career to imparting Coaching in any of the major sports disciplines and have coached Sportspersons achieving excellence at National and International levels.
> **Objective:**


1. To encourage the development of Sports and Games in the State.
1. To honour meritorious sportspersons who have made the State Proud.

**Coach:** A person who has been employed as a Coach in State GovernmentRs. Sports and Youth Services DepartmentRs. SAIRs. O.C.S.Rs. Sports AssociationsRs. or any other CorporateRs. Private SectorsRs. OrganizationsRs. Clubs with regular sports activities in pursuing active coaching in individual capacity or a person who produces outstanding result in different Olympic Sports Disciplines and non-Olympic Sports Disciplines recognized by G.O.I. and State Government and such Indigenous Sports which are recognized by the State Government under extant Rule.
**Sports Discipline:** The sports disciplines recognized by the International Olympic Committee (I.O.C.)Rs. Indian Olympic Association (I.O.A.)Rs. Government of India (G.O.I.)Rs. Sports Authority of India (S.A.I.) and Government of Odisha (G.O.O.) including Sports Event for Persons with Disability.
benefits: 1. The award shall be presented every yearRs. subject to the availability of suitable candidatesRs. which will carry a cash award of 1Rs./-. 1. A statueRs. a scroll of honourRs. and a blazer with a tie shall be given along with all the Cash Awards. 1. The Awardees shall be invited to receive the awards in person. They shall be given T.A. and D.A. at the rate admissible to a Grade 'A' Officer. > **Note 01:** Canvassing for the award in any form is prohibited. > **Note 02:** The award can also be given posthumously to the next of kin of the awardee. > **Note 03:** In case of selection of more than one person for an awardRs. the award money will be shared amongst the awardees. > **Note 04:** It will not be binding on the Department of Sports & Youth Services to confer the award every year. In case of non-availability of suitable persons for the awardRs. the award shall not be given for the respective year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the State of Odisha or shall be staying at least for a period of not less than 07 years. 1. To be eligible for this awardRs. a coach should have devoted his/her career to imparting Coaching in any of the major sports disciplines and should have coached Sportspersons achieving excellence at National and International levels. 1. The applicant should not have been convicted of any criminal offence. 1. The award will be conferred on a person only once in his/her lifetimeRs. pertaining to the concerned category. 1. The award can be given posthumously to the next of kin of the selected awardee. > **Annulment Cancellation of Award:** - The Award may be cancelled in case it is found that it has been obtained by fraudulent means. - In such eventRs. the concerned person shall be asked to refund the awardRs. failing which steps will be taken to recover the involved cost from him/her with simple interest @ 5% per annum.

name: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti
brief_description: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti under the Higher Education Department of Madhya Pradesh Goverment provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to these marginalized communities. The scheme helps alleviate financial burdens associated with tuition feesRs. maintenance allowancesRs. and other incidental expenses. Enabling access to education for these underprivileged groups promotes social equity and empowers them to pursue higher studies and better livelihood opportunities.
benefits:
- **Monthly subsistence allowance :** ClassHostel roomNon-hostelerGraduate400/-230/-Postgraduate450/-230/-M.PhilRs. P.H. D.850/-380/-
> **Important Point** - Reimbursement of non-refundable fees compulsorily paid by the student. - Reimbursement of full tuition fees and other mandatory fees to the students of self-financed courses run in government colleges/government universities. - Payment of fees for enrolment/registrationRs. tuitionRs. sportsRs. uniformRs. libraryRs. magazinesRs. medical check-upRs.s etc.
