name: Research (PhD) Scholarship for SC/ST Students
brief_description:
The "Research (PhD) Scholarship for SC/ST Students" schemeRs. implemented by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. offers financial support for PhD research work to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students. Eligible students receive 16Rs./- per monthRs. totaling 1Rs./- per yearRs. which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.
To qualifyRs. students should be registered for PhD research at any recognized university in IndiaRs. following an interview with the Research Degree Committee. They must also hold a postgraduate degree with minimum qualifying marks prescribed for SC/ST students as per University Grants Commission (UGC) guidelines. Every year a quota of 100 scholarships for Scheduled Castes and 56 scholarships for Scheduled Tribes is fixed.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. SC/ST students registered for research (PhD) work at any university in IndiaRs. following an interview with the Research Degree CommitteeRs. will receive a monthly scholarship of 16Rs./-Rs. totaling 1Rs./- per year.
- The scholarship is provided for a maximum period of 3 yearsRs. subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be registered for PhD research at a recognized university in IndiaRs. havingRs. following an interview with the Research Degree Committee.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant should have obtained the minimum qualifying marks in their postgraduate degree as prescribed for SC/ST students by the University Grants Commission.
1. The annual income of the applicants parents or guardians should not exceed 3Rs./-Rs. as set by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Tribal Welfare Department.
1. Each yearRs. a quota of 100 scholarships is allocated for Scheduled Castes and 56 scholarships for Scheduled Tribes.

name: Prathibha Scholarship Programme
brief_description:
Scholarships are awarded to students of Kerala origin who have qualified meritoriously in the Higher Secondary ExaminationRs. for pursuing Undergraduate and Postgraduate degree courses in Basic/ Natural Science in Institutions/ Universities in India. The objective of the programme is to motivate aspiring students to higher studies and a career in Science.
Prathibha Scholarship Programme is aimed at motivating bright Students to higher studies in Science by awarding Scholarships. Prathibha Scholars are also provided opportunities to attend Science Orientation Programmes and interact with pioneers in Science through the Student Programme for Excellence in Experimental Design (SPEED) scheme. Students are selected for Prathibha Scholarship at Under-graduate level based on the marks obtained by them for all Science subjects in the Higher Secondary Examination. The applicants should have secured admission for 3-year U.G/5-year Integrated P.G programme in Basic/Natural Sciences. Scholarship is applicable for maximum 5 years including U.G and P.G courses/Integrated P.G course subject to renewal norms as per guidelines.
benefits:
1. Scholarship is awarded for studies in Basic / Natural Sciences.
2. The selected students are eligible for scholarship as follows.
(a) U.G. Course/ First 3 years of Integrated P.G. Course:

- 1st Year - 12Rs./-
- 2nd Year - 18Rs./-
- 3rd Year - 24Rs./-

(b) P.G. Course (subject to scoring minimum 75% marks for Undergraduate course)

- 1st Year/ 4th Year of Integrated P.G. Course - 40Rs./-
- 2nd Year/ 5th Year of Integrated P.G. Course - 60Rs./-

3. Offers opportunities for attending Science Enrichment Programmes and summer internships in reputed National and State level R&D institutions in Kerala.
4. Eight Prathibha Scholars (two scholars in each of the disciplines- BiologyRs. ChemistryRs. Mathematics and Physics) are eligible to be considered for summer programmes at IISER-Trivandrum. The selection of Prathibha Scholars for summer programmes is subject to the norms of IISER-Trivandrum.
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be of Kerala origin.
1. Applicant should have qualified Higher Secondary Examination from Kerala.
1. Applicant should have qualified Higher Secondary Board Examination with minimum 90% marks or equivalent grade for all subjects put together and minimum 90% marks or equivalent grade for all Science subjects put together. (For SC/ST reservation categoryRs. the eligibility is stipulated to minimum marks of 80% or equivalent grade for all subjects in total and minimum 80% marks or equivalent grade for all Science subjects in total).
1. Applicant should have secured admission for 3 year B.Sc. / 5 year Integrated M.Sc. / 5 year Integrated BS-MS course in Basic or Natural Science (23 subjects enlisted in the guidelines) in any of the Institutions or Universities in India.

**Note 01:** Students are selected at Undergraduate level only.
**Note 02:** Selection is based on the aggregate marks obtained for all science subjects in the Higher Secondary Examination.
**Note 03:** Those who have availed Prathibha Scholarship for all 3 years of Undergraduate Course and have qualified Degree Course with minimum 75% marks are eligible to continue the scholarship for Postgraduate course.
**Note 04:** The scheme ensures at least 50% of the selection for girl students. 10% of the selection is reserved for SC/ST students.
**Note 05:** Scholarships are allotted with the weightage of 30% for mathematical scienceRs. 40% for Physical Science and 30 % for Life Sciences based on the subject main chosen for the Degree course. Students in Triple-main courses are ranked in all three subject areas and are selected based on their top ranking position.

name: Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
brief_description:
The objective of this scheme is to provide a loan subsidy of up to Rs 50Rs. on education loans to students pursuing higher education from good institutions. The Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme has been started with the Housing Scheme. Under this schemeRs. the Government of Assam will provide a one-time subsidy on loans to all students pursuing higher education on education loans. Under the Abhinandan Scheme all major banksRs. all commercial banks such as Federal Bank and HDFC are included.
In this schemeRs. the state government will provide subsidy to the family of those students who has taken an education loan of more than Rs 1 lakh. Students getting an education on an education loan can subscribe to this scheme online or offline
benefits: **Benefits** 1. A subsidy of Rs 50Rs. will be provided to students by the Government of Assam on education loans up to Rs 1 lakh. 1. In this schemeRs. all the applicant students can apply for the subsidy by paying 25% of their loans. 1. Under this schemeRs. the subsidy can be obtained only on loans taken from commercial banks like Federal Bank and HDFC and regional rural banks like Assam Rural Regional Bank. 1. In this schemeRs. all students have to get financial help by encouraging students on education loans.
eligibility: 1. It is mandatory for the student to be a permanent resident of the state of Assam. 1. The student must have taken a loan from a commercial or rural bankRs. otherwiseRs. he cannot avail of the benefit of the scheme. 1. The bank has been recognized by the Reserve Bank of India. 1. The benefit of this scheme can be availed only as a subsidy on education loans. 1. It is mandatory for the students parents to have an education loan of more than Rs 1 lakh.

name: Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: "Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme" was launched on 26 December 2019 by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Assam. The scheme is managed by the Finance DepartmentRs. Govt. of Assam. The govt. will provide a loan subsidy of up to 50Rs. on education loans to students pursuing higher education. This scheme would cover all commercial banks like the Federal Bank and HDFC and also the regional rural banks like Assam Gramin Vikash Bank within Assam. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students to pursue higher studies by providing subsidies on education loans. The applicant students can apply for the subsidy by paying 25% of their loans. Only the students who are permanent residents of the state of Assam can apply to this scheme.
benefits: The govt. will provide a loan subsidy of up to 50Rs./- per student.
eligibility:
1. The applicant student should be a permanent resident of Assam.
1. The Education Loan should have been availed from any Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank within the state recognized by the Reserve Bank of India.
1. The education loan should be a minimum of 1Rs..

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Chief Minister Self-Employment Scheme for Drivers/Conductors
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Chief Minister Self-Employment Scheme for Drivers/Conductors has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and economic stability among registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors. Under this schemeRs. financial assistanceRs. margin money subsidyRs. interest subsidyRs. and credit support are provided to the beneficiaries for purchasing their own transport vehicle.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance** **Project Cost:** 20Rs. to 10Rs. **Margin Money Subsidy:** - **General Category:** 15 percent of project costRs. up to 1Rs. (Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward Class (excluding creamy layer) - **Below Poverty LineRs. WomenRs. MinorityRs. and Persons with Disabilities:** 30 percent of project costRs. up to 2Rs.- **Interest Subsidy:** 5 percent per annumRs. for up to 7 yearsRs. subject to a maximum of 25Rs. per year- **Credit Guarantee Fee:** Provided as per prevailing rates for up to 7 years **Non-Financial Benefits** - No collateral security required by banks - Priority issuance of permits under the Rural Transport Scheme **Mode of Disbursement** - Subsidies are released through the concerned bank directly to the loan account of the beneficiary **Expected Time of Disbursement** - Loan applications are disposed of within 30 days - Loan amount is disbursed within 15 days after approval **Validity** - The benefit can be availed of only once by an eligible beneficiary
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years of age. 1. The applicant should have passed at least class 5th.1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any nationalized bankRs. cooperative bankRs. or financial institution.

name: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
brief_description: At the initial stageRs. groups of students from High School upto College level would be arranged to visit the Assam Legislative Assembly during the sessionsRs. in consultation with the Assam Legislative Assembly Sectt. The educational institutions may be identifiedRs. to the extent necessaryRs. with input by the respective DCs/Inspectors of SchoolsRs. and the students will be selected by the respective Headmasters/Principals. The students may preferably be from related subjects such as Political ScienceRs. EconomicsRs. etc. within the Arts/Humanities streams in colleges/higher secondary schools and social sciences in secondary schools. The groups of students would have both girls and boys (if the selected institution is co-educational). Each group will be accompanied and guided by one male and one female teacher to be deputed by the respective Headmasters/Principals.
benefits: 1. Practical Exposure: Students gain practical experience by visiting the Assam Legislative Assembly and witnessing the legislative sessionsRs. debatesRs. and bill discussions. 2. Interaction: Students have the opportunity to interact with dignitaries such as the Hon'ble SpeakerRs. Chief MinisterRs. MinistersRs. MLAsRs. and senior officials. 3. Understanding of Governance: The scheme helps students understand the functioning of the State Legislative Assembly and the legislative process.
eligibility: 1. Educational Institutions: High/Higher Secondary Schools and colleges within Assam are considered for participation. 2. Subjects/Streams: Students from related subjects such as Political ScienceRs. EconomicsRs. etc.Rs. within the Arts/Humanities streams in colleges/higher secondary schoolsRs. and social sciences in secondary schools are preferred. 3. Selection: Students showing good academic performance and enthusiastic participation in extracurricular activities like debating competitionsRs. student activitiesRs. mock parliamentRs. etc.Rs. may be selected. 4. Batch Size: The total number of students in one batch should not exceed 50. 5. Voluntary Participation: Student participation in the visit is voluntaryRs. and only willing students should be selected.

name: Payment Related to Wheat Procurement
brief_description: The Payment Related to Wheat Procurement scheme was launched by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies and Consumer ProtectionRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure timely and transparent payment to farmers who sell their wheat at government-operated procurement centers.
benefits: - Ensures timely online payment to farmers selling wheat at government procurement centers. - Payment is made directly into the farmers registered bank account through the JIT system. - Farmers receive the Minimum Support Price (MSP) fixed by the government every year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a landholding farmer. 1. The applicant should have sold wheat at a government-operated procurement center during the notified procurement period.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: The "Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram" scheme is launched by the Department of Public Health and Medical EducationRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to ensure free and cashless healthcare services to pregnant women and infants up to one year of age in government health institutions by providing free medicinesRs. diagnosticsRs. consumablesRs. blood transfusionsRs. dietRs. and transport services during pregnancyRs. deliveryRs. and postnatal care.
benefits: - Free and cashless delivery - Free treatment for sick newborns and infants up to one year of age. - Free medicinesRs. consumablesRs. and diagnostic services for both mothers and infants. - Free provision of blood and blood transfusion servicesRs. if required. - Free diet during hospitalization - Free transport facility
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicants child (newborn or infant) should be up to one year of age to receive benefits.

name: Haryana Merit Cum Means Scheme For Minority
brief_description: Launched in 2012Rs. the scheme "Merit Cum Means Based Scholarship" has been implemented by the Ministry of Minority AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. and aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from minority communities to pursue professional and technical courses. Through this schemeRs. monetary benefits are provided to support education-related expenses for eligible students belonging to minority groupsRs. ensuring their socio-economic empowerment. The scheme is implemented by the State Government of Haryana in collaboration with the Union Ministry of Minority Affairs. The primary objectives of the scheme are to encourage higher educationRs. support meritorious students from economically weaker backgroundsRs. and promote equitable education opportunities for minority communities.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** - For Hostellers: 30Rs./- per annumRs. including 10Rs./- as maintenance allowance and up to 20Rs./- as course fees. - For Day Scholars: 25Rs./- per annumRs. including 5Rs./- as maintenance allowance and up to 20Rs./- as course fees. - Full course fees are reimbursed for the listed institutions. **Conditions Associated with Benefits:** - The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed 2Rs./- from all sources. - Scholarships are awarded directly to the students bank account. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Funds are transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student's bank account. **Frequency of Disbursement:** - Disbursed annually upon approval of the application. **Validity:** - Applicable only for the duration of the courseRs. subject to yearly renewal based on academic performance.
eligibility: **General Eligibility:** - The applicant should belong to a notified minority community (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. or Parsi). - The applicant must be a resident of HaryanaRs. irrespective of the place of study. - The applicant should have secured admission to a professional or technical course in a recognized institution. - The applicant should have scored at least 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination. **Income Criteria:** - The annual family income should not exceed 2Rs./- from all sources. **Preference and Reservation:** - 30% of scholarships are reserved for girl studentsRs. transferable to male students if no eligible girl candidates are available.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students (Delhi)
brief_description: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. aims to provide financial assistance to SC students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education in recognized institutions within India. The scheme covers maintenance allowanceRs. tuition feesRs. and additional allowances for specific needs. Two significant benefits include the reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees and monthly maintenance allowances ranging from 230 to 1Rs. depending on the course group. Eligibility criteria include an annual family income limit of 2Rs./- and enrollment in a recognized institution. The scheme is implemented by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of Delhi.
benefits:
> **Maintenance Allowance (per month)**

**Group 1** (e.g.Rs. MedicineRs. Engineering): Hostellers 1Rs./-Rs. Day Scholars 550/-
**Group 2** (e.g.Rs. PharmacyRs. Nursing): Hostellers 820/-Rs. Day Scholars 530/-
**Group 3** (e.g.Rs. BA/BSc): Hostellers 570/Rs. Day Scholars 300/-
**Group 4** (e.g.Rs. ITIRs. Polytechnic): Hostellers 380/-Rs. Day Scholars 230/-
> **Other Benefits**


- Reimbursement of Compulsory Non-refundable Fees.
- Study Tour Charges.
- Thesis Typing/Printing Charges for Research Scholars.
- Book Allowance for Correspondence Courses.
- Book Bank Facility for Specified Courses.
- Additional Allowance for Students With Disabilities.

> **Conditions**


- Benefits are for the complete duration of the course.
- Hostel rent is provided as per scheme guidelines.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 2Rs./-.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized post-matriculation/post-secondary course in India.
- The applicant should not be availing of any other scholarship for the same course from any other source.

name: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat
brief_description: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat ( Rs. )Rs. also referred to as the Assam Tea Garden Workers' Financial Assistance Scheme 2025Rs. is launched by the Government of Assam to recognise the contribution of tea garden workers in the growth of the Tea Industry in the state. This initiative marks the 200th year celebration of Assam Tea and aims to provide one-time financial assistance to tea garden workers in recognition of their invaluable contributionRs. thereby supporting their socio-economic well-being. The primary objectives of this scheme is: a. To provide one-time financial assistance of Rs. 5Rs. to all tea garden workers (both temporary and permanent) and employeesRs. excluding tea garden management. b. To support the welfare and financial stability of tea garden workers. c. To promote financial inclusion by ensuring all beneficiaries have activeRs. Aadhaar-linked bank accounts
benefits: One-time financial assistance of 5000 to tea garden workers in recognition of their invaluable contributionRs. thereby supporting their socio-economic well-being.
eligibility: **To be eligible for the schemeRs. applicants must be:** a permanent resident of Assam and presently residing in Assam registered tea garden worker or employeeRs. excluding TE managementRs. engaged in an officially recognised Tea Garden of Assam hold an active AADHAAR-linked bank account in a scheduled commercial bank.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana" was launched by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to address the unique challenges faced by tribal communities by focusing on their holistic development and the preservation of their cultural heritage and identity. The scheme provides comprehensive support through six key componentsRs. including integrated village development under Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram YojanaRs. development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal GroupsRs. support to Tribal Research InstitutesRs. and Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarships. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe or reside in an identified village with a significant tribal population to avail of specific benefits.
benefits: ##### ***Village Development*** Provision of 20Rs./- per village under the Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana to bridge gaps in eight sectors including road connectivityRs. telecom connectivityRs. schoolsRs. Anganwadi CentresRs. health sub-centresRs. drinking water facilitiesRs. drainageRs. and solid waste management. ##### ***PVTG Development*** Financial assistance under the Pradhan Mantri PVTG Development Mission for essential amenities such as secure housingRs. clean drinking waterRs. sanitationRs. improved access to educationRs. healthRs. nutritionRs. and road and telecom connectivity. ##### ***Pre-Matric Scholarship*** Financial assistance for Scheduled Tribe students studying in Standard IX and X. ##### ***Post-Matric Scholarship*** Financial assistance for Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class XI and above. ##### ***Tribal Research*** Financial assistance to State Governments and Union Territories for Tribal Research Institutes to facilitate researchRs. documentationRs. and preservation of tribal cultural heritage. ##### ***Livelihood Support*** Procurement of Minor Forest Produces at Minimum Support Price and value addition training programs through Van Dhan Vikas Kendras under the Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission. ##### ***Residential Education*** Access to quality education for students from Class VI to XII through Eklavya Model Residential Schools in blocks with more than 50% ST population and at least 20Rs. tribal persons.
eligibility: ##### ***For Pre-Matric Scholarship*** - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in Standard IX or X. - The applicant's parental annual income must be up to 2Rs./-. ##### ***For Post-Matric Scholarship*** - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in Class XI or above. - The applicant's parental annual income must be up to 2Rs./-. ##### ***For Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (Village Eligibility)*** - The village must have at least 50% tribal population. - The village must have a total population of at least 500 Scheduled Tribes. ##### ***For PVTG Development*** - The beneficiary must belong to a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) family or habitation. ##### ***For Eklavya Model Residential Schools*** - The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student seeking admission in Class VI to XII.

name: Scholarships for Higher Education for Young Achievers Scheme (SHREYAS) (OBC & Others)
brief_description:
The scheme "Scholarships for Higher Education for Young Achievers Scheme (SHREYAS) (OBC & Others) has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment under the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The main objective of the schemes is the Educational Empowerment of OBC & EBC students by awarding fellowships (financial assistance) to obtain quality higher education and providing interest subsidies on educational loans for overseas studies. The scheme is implemented by the University Grants Commission for the fellowship component and by designated Nodal Banks for the interest subsidy component.
> SHREYAS integrates two ongoing Central Sector schemesRs. namely the National Fellowship for Other Backwards Classes and the Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies. The scheme is applicable during the period 202122 to 202526. **Scope of the Scheme:** The scheme is designed to provide a total number of 1000 Junior Research Fellowships per year to undertake advanced studies and research leading to M.Phil. /Ph.D. DegreesRs. who have qualified in the following tests: - National Eligibility Test ) Junior Research Fellowship (NET-JRF) of UGC (for Humanities/Social Sciences) orRs. - UGC-Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (UGC-CSIR) NET-JRF Joint Test (for Sciences) The scheme covers all universities/institutions recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and is implemented by the UGC itself on the pattern of the scheme of UGC Fellowships being awarded to research students pursuing M.Phil. and PhD. These 1000 slots will be over and above the number of OBC students selected under the normal reservation policy of the Government for UGC Fellowship.
benefits: 1. The scheme provides 1Rs. Junior Research Fellowships per year for eligible OBC students. Out of the total 1Rs. slotsRs. 750 fellowship slots are allocated for subjects covered under the University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test Junior Research Fellowship. 1. The remaining 250 fellowship slots are allocated for subjects covered under the Council of Scientific and Industrial ResearchUniversity Grants Commission National Eligibility Test Junior Research Fellowship for Science streams. 1. These 1Rs. fellowship slots are over and above the number of Other Backwards Classes students selected under the normal reservation policy of the Government for University Grants Commission fellowships. 1. **Rate of fellowship:** - The rates of fellowship for JRF and SRF will be at par with the UGC Fellowships. PresentlyRs. these rates are as follows: Fellowship in ScienceRs. Humanities and Social Science 31Rs./- PM for initial two years (JRF) 35Rs./- PM for remaining tenure (SRF)Fellowship in Engineering & Technology 31Rs./- PM for initial two years (JRF) 35Rs./- PM for remaining tenure (SRF)Contingency for Humanities & Social Science 10Rs./- PM for initial two years (JRF) 20Rs./- PM for remaining tenure (SRF)Contingency for ScienceRs. Engineering & Technology 12Rs./- PM for initial two years (JRF) 25Rs./- PM for remaining tenure (SRF)Escorts/Reader assistance (All Subjects) 2Rs./- PM in cases of physically and visually handicapped candidates - The House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be on the UGC pattern and will be payable to those students who are not provided with hostel accommodation. In case hostel accommodation offered by the University/institution is refusedRs. the student will forfeit his claim of HRA. Other facilitiesRs. such as medical facilitiesRs. leaveRs. including maternity leaveRs. will be governed as per the guidelines of the UGC in case of their fellowship programme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student belonging to the Other Backward Classes category. 1. The applicant should have qualified the University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test Junior Research Fellowship or the Council of Scientific and Industrial ResearchUniversity Grants Commission National Eligibility Test Junior Research FellowshipRs. as per the relevant examination notifications. 1. The applicant should be eligible for the award of the National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes and should secure placement in a UniversityRs. Indian Institute of TechnologyRs. or recognised institution. 1. The applicant should pursue a regular and full-time M.Phil. or Ph.D. programme in a recognised University or research institution. 1. The applicant should not be entitled to receive any other fellowship or similar financial benefit from the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. University Grants CommissionRs. or any other body offering similar benefits. 1. The applicant should commence the fellowship from the date of declaration of the National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes result or the date of joining the M.Phil. or Ph.D. programmeRs. whichever is laterRs. in applicable cases. 1. The applicant should note that the validity period of the Junior Research Fellowship offer is 3 years from the date of issue of the award letter. 1. The applicants fellowship tenure may be extended from Junior Research Fellow to Senior Research Fellow after 2 yearsRs. subject to satisfactory assessment of research progress as per University Grants Commission norms. 1. The total period of fellowship as Junior Research Fellow and Senior Research Fellow together should not exceed 5 years. > **Reservation and Relaxation:** 5% of the total fellowship seats are reserved for students with disabilities.

name: BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students - UGC
brief_description: The BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students has been implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC)Rs. Ministry of EducationRs. Government of India. The objective of the Basic Scientific Research (BSR) scheme is to provide opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences. The scheme is applicable to all Departments of SciencesRs. Bio-SciencesRs. Agricultural SciencesRs. Engineering Sciences of the eligible Universities. The Research Fellowship in Sciences for meritorious students BSR scheme of the UGC is open to candidates who are selected for registering to the Ph.D. programme of the university through a procedure outlined already in the UGC notification by a regular admission procedure . The registration for Ph.D. may follow after the admissions.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** ***Fellowship:*** **For GATE/NET Qualified candidates:** - JRF @ 24Rs./- per month for 2years - SRF@ 27Rs./- per month for remaining period **For others:** - JRF @ 21Rs./- per month for 2 years - SRF @ 24Rs./- per month for remaining period **Contingency** - JRF @ 12Rs./- per annum - SRF @ 25Rs./- per annum > ***Notes:*** - The tenure of fellowship is initially for two years under the BSR scheme. - Upon expiry of this periodRs. If the research work is found satisfactoryRs. his/her tenure will be extended further for a period of five year under the enhanced emoluments as SRF. - The recommendation of the Committee shall be submitted to the UGC designated agency for Upgradation to the level of RGNF-SRF in the prescribed proforma ([Annexure- VI](https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/9779504_BSR-fellowship.pdf)). - In case the work for the first two years is not found satisfactoryRs. an additional year will be given to him/her for improvement. In such cases work will be evaluated again after three yearsRs. and if improvement is foundRs. the Fellow will get two more years under the BSR. ThusRs. the total period of fellowship is five yearsRs. with no further provision of extension. - It may be noted that the fellowship amount shall be disbursed through UGC designated agency into the bank account of the Fellow directly. > ***HRA:*** 1. Suitable hostel accommodation may be provided to the candidates in the institutions. In such casesRs. the fellow is eligible to draw only hostel fees excluding messRs. electricityRs. water chargesRs. etc. A certificate to this effect is to be furnished through the Registrar/Director/Principal. HRA is not permissible for those candidates who are staying in Hostel accommodation. 1. In case of non-availability of hostel accommodationRs. the fellow may be provided with single accommodation by the host institution. In such casesRs. the rent paid by the fellow on actual basis may be reimbursed subject to the ceiling of HRA as per Govt. of India norms. 1. If the fellow makes her own arrangements of accommodationRs. he/she may be entitled to draw HRA as per categorization of cities by the Govt. of India. > ***Medical:*** - No separate/fixed medical assistance is provided. HoweverRs. the Fellow may avail the medical facilities available in the University/Institution/College. > ***Leave:*** 1. Leave for maximum period of 30 days in a year in addition to public holidays maybe taken by the BSR Fellow with the approval of the Head of Department. HoweverRs. they are not entitled to any other vacationsRs. such as summerRs. winter and pooja vacations. 1. Candidates are eligible for maternity/ paternity leave at full rates of the fellowship as per Government of India rules once during the tenure of the award. 1. The fellowRs. in special cases may be allowed by the CommissionRs. academic leave without fellowship and contingency for a period not exceeding one year during the tenure of award on the recommendation of the Head of the department of the institution concerned to undertake academic/ teaching assignment or foreign travel in connection with academic work. The expenditure on travel cannot be claimed from UGC. The period of leave without fellowship will be counted towards the tenure.
eligibility: 1. The candidates who are selected for registering to the Ph.D. programme of the university through a procedure outlined already in the UGC notification by a regular admission procedure in Universities with Potential for Excellence / Centres of Advance Studies and Department of Special Assistance identified by UGC are eligible to apply for fellowship under the scheme. 1. The registration for Ph.D. may follow after the admissions. ***Other Conditions:*** The University/Institutions/College shall admit the fellows under RGNF-SC scheme for research leading to M.Phil or Ph.D irrespective of the stipulated number of research students assigned to the Supervisor or the Department in the concerned subjects. ***Resignation:*** If the fellow wishes to leave the fellowship before the end of the tenureRs. the information regarding relinquishment may be informed to the identified Agency under intimation to UGC. Grant will be released upto the date of relinquishmentRs. provided it is whether the total tenure of fellowship. ***Cancellation of Award:*** The fellowship in liable to cancellationRs. in case of: - Misconduct. - Unsatisfactory progress of research work. - Candidate is later found ineligible. - Candidate is already availing scholarship/fellowship from any other sources. - Candidate if found employed during the M.Phil/Ph.D research. - Any false information furnished by the applicant or any fraudulent activity by the Scholar/Fellow/Research Awardees. ***Procedure for Monitoring the Progress of the Scheme:*** 1. The fellow will undertake full-time research work under the approved guide in a subject selected by him and approved by the university/selection committee. The fellow shall present to the universityRs. through his/her supervisorRs. yearly progress reports ending the month of June and DecemberRs. and the University/Institution/College will maintain a record of progress by obtaining the same. 1. The research fellow shall submitRs. through the senior faculty member with whom he/she is working and the head of the department/universityRs. a half-yearly report on the progress of his/her research work. ([Annexure-IV](https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/9779504_BSR-fellowship.pdf)). On completion of the award he/she will submit to the Commission a comprehensive report and a copy of his/her published workRs. if anyRs. and an abstract of the research work in about 500 words. 1. If a fellow wishes to relinquish the fellowship during the tenureRs. it should be done with the prior approval of the University/ institution/ College and the Commission. The fellow should also obtain prior permission of the University/institution/College and Commission for appearing in any examination conducted by any University/institution/College or public body. 1. In case the Progress of the work is found unsatisfactoryRs. the award may be decision of the Commission in this regard will be final. 1. The fellow shall not accept or hold any appointmentRs. paid or otherwiseRs. or receive any emolumentsRs. salaryRs. stipendRs. etc. from any other source during the tenure of the award. The fellow with the consent of the guide/head of departmentRs. may assist the University/ institution/ College in its academic workRs. including tutorialsRs. evaluation of test papersRs. laboratory demonstration workRs. seminar symposiaRs. etc.Rs. provided such work is not likely to hamper the research programme on hand. 1. If the Fellow is availing any other fellowship/ project from any other organization at the time of selectionRs. he/she shall be required to surrender one award. 1. Feedback After completion of the Research work the student will submit his/her research work in the INFLIBNET repository along with the research papers published M.Phil and Ph.D for RGNF (At least 4 research papers: 2 National and 2 International) 2 National/ International publication at the time of submitting Departmental review Committee Recommendation and 2 National/International publication by the end of the tenure must be submitted. 1. The fellow will be required to submit Ph.D./M.Phil. completion certificate after successfully submitting the comprehensive report of the research work and the publications in the UGCINFLIBNET repository. **Note:** The last 2 instalments will be released only after submission of the feedback and Research work in the Repository.

name: National Service Scheme
brief_description: The "National Service Scheme" (NSS) is a Central Sector Scheme of the Government of India launched in 1969. It provides opportunities to students of senior secondary schools (+2 level)Rs. collegesRs. universitiesRs. and technical institutions to participate in government-led community service activities. Under NSSRs. student volunteers engage in regular community serviceRs. special campsRs. national-level programmesRs. and awareness activities related to healthRs. educationRs. environmentRs. national integrationRs. disaster responseRs. and social welfare. The scheme follows the principle of Education through ServiceRs. enabling students to learn by serving society. Since its inceptionRs. NSS has benefitted more than 7.4 crore students across India.
benefits: **Financial Benefits (Awards & Cash Prizes)** **Outstanding NSS volunteers and institutions are rewarded under the National Service Scheme Awards:** Best University / +2 Council Cash Award: 5Rs./- Upcoming University Cash Award: 3Rs./- Best Programme Officer (10 awards) Cash Award: 1Rs. each Best NSS Unit (10 awards) Cash Award: 2Rs. each Best NSS Volunteer (30 awards) Cash Award: 1Rs. each - Develops leadership qualities and confidence - Promotes social service and national integration - Provides exposure through camps and festivals
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student studying in: - Class 11th or 12th (+2 level)Rs. or GraduateRs. Post GraduateRs. or Technical courses in a recognised institution. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a schoolRs. collegeRs. universityRs. or technical institution having an NSS Unit. 1. The applicant should be willing to participate in community service activities and camps. 1. The applicant should comply with NSS guidelines and complete the prescribed service hours.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
brief_description: The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to severely disabled (with a disability of 80% and above) and multi-disabled individuals aged 18 to 79 years who are living below the poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life. This scheme is centrally sponsored.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a monthly pension of 500/-Rs. (Central contribution- 300/-Rs. State Contribution- 200/-).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be a person with multiple disabilities.
1. The applicant should have severe disabilities (with a disability percentage of 80% or above).
1. The applicants age should be between 18 and 79 years.
1. The applicant's name should be included in the list of families living Below Poverty Line.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme.

**Note 1:** Severe disability means any one type of disability which is more than 80%.
**Note 2:** Multiple disabilities means more than one type of disability.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme- Chhattisgarh
brief_description: The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to widows aged 40 to 79 years who are living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life. This scheme is centrally sponsored.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a monthly pension of 500/-Rs. (Central contribution- 300/-Rs. State Contribution- 200/-).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
2. The applicant should be a widow.
3. The widows age should be between 40 and 79 years.
4. The widow's name should be included in the list of families living Below Poverty Line.
5. The widow should not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme.

name: New Charkha-Loom Scheme
brief_description: The "New Charkha-Loom Scheme" implemented by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernize Khadi production by providing financial assistance for Amber Charkhas and looms to registered Khadi spinners and weavers. The scheme offers 65% subsidy on equipment costs (13Rs./- for CharkhasRs. 30Rs./- for looms) to enhance productivity and sustain traditional artisans. Implemented through registered Khadi/Polyvastra organizationsRs. it targets spinners and weavers certified by Khadi institutions.
benefits:
**Subsidy for Equipment** - Amber Charkha: 65% of 13Rs./- (8Rs./- subsidy). - Looms: 65% of 30Rs./- (19Rs./- subsidy).
**Disbursement Mode** Credited to the beneficiarys account post-verification.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a registered Khadi/Polyvastra spinner or weaver.
- The applicants organization must hold a valid Khadi certification.
- Equipment must be purchased for active Khadi production.

name: Meghalaya Goat Farming Scheme
brief_description: The Chief Ministers CM-ELEVATE Program includes the Meghalaya Goat Farming Development Scheme under the Planning DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to employRs. engageRs. and empower youth and rural communities by promoting goat farming entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.
benefits: 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicantRs. 45% by Government) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. Technical training and capacity building 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Mentorship and business advisory
eligibility: **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess landRs. either self-owned or on leaseRs. verified by the competent authority. 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized InstitutionRs. preferably from a Government Institute. 1. The Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking Goatery. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the goats. 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination Scheme in place for the goats. 1. - BooksRs. StationeryRs. and other instruments required for the course.

- Boarding and lodging expenses.

The educational loan shall be provided through the state channelizing agencies to concerned Government Recognized Educational Institutions where the students have secured admission. In the case of Foreign countriesRs. only those institutions shall be considered which are duly recognized by the concerned authorities.
> **Professional/Technical Courses Covered:**

A regular full time recognized courses in India or abroad engineeringRs. (diploma/ B.Tech/B.E.Rs. M.Tech/ M.E.)Rs. Architecture (B.Arch/ M.Arch)Rs. Medical (MBBS/MD/MS)Rs. Actuarial Sciences (Graduation/Post Graduation/FIA)Rs. Associate Member of Institute of Engineers (AMIE) and Institute of Electronics & Telecommunication and Higher education like Doctoral Studies leading to M.Phil/PHD from recognized institutions.

1. The loan shall be provided to students for pursuing regular full time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad.
1. The Education loan for a particular student shall be made admissible only once either at Diploma/Graduation or Post Graduation Diploma/Post Graduation level. name: One Tea Scheme
brief_description: The One Tea SchemeRs. implemented by the PlanningRs. Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. is designed to support tea farmers in the state whose livelihoods have been affected by declining factory gate prices and shrinking cultivated areas. The initiative introduces a single-season price support mechanism that guarantees every registered grower a minimum price of 35 per kilogram of fresh tea leaves for conventional tea gardens and 40 per kilogram for organically certified tea gardens. By compensating the difference between the factorys actual purchase price and the guaranteed minimum priceRs. the scheme prevents farmers from being forced to sell their produce at a loss. This support helps ensure fair price realizationRs. provides economic stability for farmers to reinvest in their plantationsRs. and contributes to the preservation of ecological services and traditional knowledge associated with tea cultivation. In additionRs. the scheme offers a one-time financial benefit to bought-leaf factories to cover the gap between the price they pay for fresh green leaves from both small and large tea growers and the price at which they can profitably process and sell the manufactured tea.
benefits: 1. Ensures fair and stable prices for tea farmers. 1. Prevents distress sales due to low factory rates. 1. Provides direct financial support via DBT. 1. Farmers receive 35/kg and 40/kg support price. 1. Government pays the difference if factory rate is
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be 18 years of age or above. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be a tea farmer. 1. The applicant should possess a valid government-issued identity document.

name: Samarth-Respite Care Scheme
brief_description: Samarth (Respite Care) scheme was launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment. Govt. of India.The objective of the scheme is to provide respite home for orphans or abandoned PwDsRs. families in crisis and also for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) from BPL & LIG families including destitutes with at least one of the four disabilities covered under the National Trust Act. It also aims at creating opportunities for family members to get respite time in order to fulfil other responsibilities.
benefits: 1. **Group Home:** Registered Orgaisations(RO) should provide group home facilities for all age groups with adequate and quality care service with acceptable living standards including provision of basic medical care from professional doctors.1. **Vocational Activities:** Samarth Centre should provide age specific vocational activitiesRs. pre-vocational activities and assistance for training or schooling as applicable on case to case basis.1. **Staffing:** There should be a provision of at least two Special Educators (+Vocational Trainers)Rs. one Physiotherapist or Occupational TherapistRs. three CaregiversRs. two Ayas and a Cook in the Samarth centre.1. **Infrastructure facilities:** Samarth Centre should provide therapeutic aids and appliancesRs. hygienic lodging and other facilities for the PwDs.1. **Assessment and Evaluation:** PwD should be assessed and evaluated by experts in the related field on a regular basis to understand their individual needs and also to monitor the progress of the PwD. The Samarth centre should maintain a record in the growth and development charts of the PwD on a regular basis (with the help of experts).1. **Linkage with Gharaunda Scheme:** The Samarth Centre should facilitate shifting the PwD who is above 18 years of age and has spent more than 5 years in the Samarth Centre to Gharaunda centre.
eligibility: - Applicant should have one of the disabilities under the [National Trust ActRs. 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf)Rs. which are AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities.

name: Pre- Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
brief_description: This program provides financial aid to parents of children from Scheduled Castes and other disadvantaged groups to help them afford their children's education at the Pre-Matric level. The goal is to increase the participation of these children in educationRs. reduce the dropout rateRs. especially during the transition from primary to secondary schoolRs. improve their academic performanceRs. and increase their chances of continuing their education beyond the Pre-Matric stage.
benefits: The students shall be given a consolidated academic allowanceRs. as follows: 1. **Day Scholar:**- 3Rs./- per annum1. **Hosteller:** - - Component 1- 7Rs./- per annum - Component 2- 8Rs./- per annum (For Class III-X) - In additionRs. a 10% extra allowance shall be given to Divyang (Disabled) students.
eligibility:
- The scholarships are open to Nationals of India only.
- **Component 1: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC students**



1. Applicant students should be studying in class IX and X on a full time basis.
1. Applicant students should belong to a Scheduled Caste.
1. Parent/Guardian of applicant students income should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum



- **Component 2: Pre-Matric scholarship for children of parents/guardians engaged in Unclean and hazardous Occupation**



1. The students should be studying in classes I to X on a full time basis.
1. Scholarship will be admissible to the children/wards of parents/guardians whoRs. irrespective of their caste/religion belong to one of the following categories


- Persons who are Manual Scavengers.
- Tanners & Flayers.
- Waste pickers.
- Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning.


1. There is no family income ceiling under this component of the Scheme.



- Eligible for one scholarship at a time for classes I to X. Notify awarding body if another scholarship is received.

name: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana- SEBC & EBC
brief_description: The "Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana- SEBC & EBC" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to families from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes and Economically Backward Classes to help cover the wedding expenses of their daughters. Under this schemeRs. an amount of 12Rs. is provided for each daughters marriageRs. subject to a maximum of two adult daughters per family.
benefits: **Monetary Assistance:** - 12Rs. is provided for the marriage of a daughter. > **NOTE:** If the marriage occurred before April 1Rs. 2021Rs. assistance of 10Rs. is provided.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a woman belonging to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) or Economically Backward Class (EBC). 1. The annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The marriage must be legally registered. 1. The assistance is limited to two daughters per family.

name: Kutirjyoti Yojana Gujarat
brief_description: The Kutirjyoti Yojana was launched by the Energy and Petro Chemicals DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide free household electricity connections to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries living in tribal areas. Under this schemeRs. Below Poverty Line (BPL) and lower-income group beneficiaries can avail free electrification of their houses.
benefits: - Free electricity household connection is provided to BPL/lower income group beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be living in a tribal area of the state. 1. The applicants family should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) or lower-income group category. 1. The applicants family annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-. 1. The applicant should own land or a house under a poverty housing scheme or through land allotment.

name: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
brief_description: Visiting Advanced Joint Research (VAJRA) Faculty Scheme was launched by the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of India to bring a strong international connection to the R&D ecosystem of India. The scheme offers adjunct/visiting faculty assignments to overseas scientistsRs. faculty membersRs. and R&D professionals including Non-resident Indians (NRI) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) to undertake high-quality collaborative research in publicly funded academic and research Institutions of India. VAJRA Faculty will engage in collaborative research in cutting-edge areas of science and technology including interdisciplinary areas of priority such as energyRs. waterRs. healthRs. securityRs. nutritionRs. materials and manufacturingRs. etc. with one or more Indian Collaborators. VAJRA Faculty is expected to co-guide research students and may also be involved in technology developmentRs. innovationRs. start-upsRs. etc. The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB)Rs. a Statutory body of the Department will implement the Scheme.
benefits:
1. The residency period of VAJRA Faculty in India would be for a minimum of 1 month and a maximum of 3 months.
1. VAJRA Faculty will be provided US$ 15000 in the first month of engagement and US$ 10000 p.m. in the subsequent two months. While no separate support is provided for travelRs. accommodationRs. medical/personal insuranceRs. etc. the host institute may consider providing additional support.
1. **Return visit of Indian faculty to the Institute of VAJRA Faculty:** One research visit by the Indian host to the Institute of the VAJRA Faculty for a period not less than a week and not exceeding 30 days will be supported. The board will provide return economy airfareRs. not exceeding 1.5 lakhs per diemRs. and accommodation as per the norms of the Board. 1. **Student mobility (Doctoral & Postdoctoral Level: Across labs):** Collaborative research visit of not more than 2 studentsRs. doctoralRs. preferably co-advised / post-doctoral level after 2 years of engagement from the research group of Indian host to the Institute of the VAJRA Faculty for a duration of three to six months will be supported. The board will provide a return economy airfareRs. a one-time contingency grant of 60Rs./- and fellowship equivalent to the norms of the Board. 1. **Research Contingency Grant to the hosting Indian Collaborator:** 5.0 lakhs per year of research visit per VAJRA Faculty to the Indian host to meet expenses related to the collaborative research will also be provided. 1. **Support to engage VAJRA Faculty to give lectures in his/her area of expertise in the host Institute:** Support to VAJRA Faculty to the tune of 1.0 lakh per year for this activity will be provided.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is open to overseas scientistsRs. faculty membersRs. and R&D professionals including Non-resident Indians (NRI) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCI).
1. The overseas scientist/faculty should be an active researcher working in a leading academic/research/industrial organization with a proven track record of research and development.
1. Indian Collaborator(s) should be a regular faculty/researcher in academic/research institutions.
1. Indian Collaborator(s) from the Top 10 Private Institutions as per the NIRF ranking are also eligible to apply if the Institute contributes 50% of the cost.

name: SERB International Research Experience
brief_description:
The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB)Rs. a statutory body under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)". This Program aims to impart high-end research training in frontier areas of Science and TechnologyRs. which are of interest to India by providing an opportunity to visit leading institutions/universities across the globe for a period of 02-06 months. The SERB under this program selects candidates in frontier areas of S & T and supports their visit to top institutions around the globeRs. preferably to the institutions where internationally acclaimed scientists are working.
> **Objectives:**


- To build national capacity in frontier areas of Science and Technology by providing opportunities for International R&D experience by SIRE fellows.
- To tap the expertise gained by SIRE fellows to strengthen/initiate national programmes in their domain knowledge.
- To encourage research activities in priority areas that are still less explored in the Indian context.
benefits:
1. The selected fellows will be paid a monthly fellowship amount equivalent to US $ 3000.
1. One-time Contingency/Preparatory allowances of 75Rs./- to cover visa feesRs. airport transfer chargesRs. insuranceRs. etc.Rs.
1. Overseas Medical Insurance in India and abroad of 20Rs./-.
1. The selected fellows will also be provided the shortest route economy class airfare from their place of work in India to the place of the host institute and back.

**Note 01:** The maximum duration of the abroad visit is limited to 06 months.
**Note 02:** For scientists/researchers in regular employmentRs. rules governing payment of salaryRs. leaveRs. medicalRs. gratuityRs. GPF pensionRs. etc. of the organization/ institution/ university to which the fellow belongs would continue to be applicable as per their institutional norms. No liability on any of these will be borne by SERB.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is open to Indian nationals only.
1. Applicant should have a Ph.D. degree in the area of Science and Engineering from recognized institutions in India.
1. The applicant must hold a permanent position in any Indian research and academic institution.
1. Applicants having MBBS/MD degrees and Veterinary doctors are also eligible to apply.
1. Applicants having a Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE) award are also eligible to apply.
1. Applicant must submit a letter of support from the overseas host institution along with the application.
1. The age limit for applying under this scheme shall be 40 years (as of the date of submission of application). Age relaxation of 5 years will be given to applicants belonging to SC/ST/OBC/physically challenged and women categories.

name: SERB Research Scientist Scheme
brief_description:
The INSPIRE Faculty Scheme of the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Ramanujan Fellowship Scheme of the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) offer opportunities for young scientists to initiate and sustain research careers in various fields of science and engineering. These schemes do not offer an extension of the fellowship after the completion of five years. The support link is broken after the end of the tenure of the respective fellowships.
In order to provide a platform for the sustainment of their research for some more timeRs. the SERB Board has recently approved a new SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan FellowshipsRs. who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes. The fellows will be called SERB Research Scientists. The scheme provides an opportunity for them to continue their research activities and also to explore regular positions during the intervening period.
> **Objective:**

Identify and provide a platform for sustainment of the research career of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellows for an additional period of two years after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes.
benefits:
The SERB Research Scientists will be entitled to receive the grants as given below:
**Sl. No.****Budget Head****Amount**1Emolument***** Consolidated amount of 1Rs./- per month2Research Grant7Rs./- per annum3Overheads1Rs./- per annum*** All Inclusive**
**Note 01:** Research grants can be used for minor equipmentRs. consumablesRs. contingenciesRs. and travel. There is no provision for providing manpower support under this scheme. The Research Scientist is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the SRS Scheme.
**Note 02:** The SERB Research Scientists are not eligible to receive any other research project/fellowship from any Government or Non-Governmental source during the tenure of the Scheme.
**Note 03:** The SERB Research Scientists must seek the consent of SERB if he/she intends to be away from the implementing institute (except for field work related to the project) continuously for a period of more than eight weeks.
> **Leave:**


- SERB Research Scientists are entitled to leave as per the rules of the host institution.
- Participation in scientific workshops held in India or abroad will be treated as on duty.
- Maternity leave as per the Govt. of India instructions issued from time to time would be available to female candidates in all categories.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is open only to INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellows.
1. The applicant should have completed or nearing completion of the tenure of INSPIRE Faculty of DST or Ramanujan Fellowship of SERB.
1. The upper age limit for INSPIRE Faculty/Ramanujan Fellows is 40 years at the time of submission of application.
1. SRS can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career.

**Note 01:** The SRS Scheme will be made effective only after the completion of the tenure of the respective INSPIRE Faculty/Ramanujan Fellowship.
**Note 02:** The SRS scheme can be availed only once by a candidate in his/her career.
**Note 03:** The SRS is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized academic institutionsRs. national laboratories and other recognized R & D institutions. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support.
**Note 04:** The Faculty/Fellow can either implement the SRS Scheme from the present host institution or opt to choose a different host institution that is suitable to the objectives of the proposed research work.
**Note 05:** The SRSs will not be allowed to work at the same Department/institution where the candidates have earned their PhD/M.S./M.D degree.
**Note 06:** The SRS is purely a temporary and contractual assignmentRs. and is tenable for a period of 2 yearsRs. extendable to one more yearRs. subject to performance evaluation. Under any circumstancesRs. the support is not extendable beyond three years.

name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
brief_description:
The J.C. Bose fellowship is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective. The scientist should be in service at the time of nomination to this fellowship. The nominee should be an Indian national working in institutions in India.
> **Duration of Fellowship:**


- The duration of the fellowship will be initially for five years. In caseRs. the fellow superannuates during the term of the fellowshipRs. the fellowship can be continued if a host institution is willing to host the fellowship
- The tenure of the fellowship may be extended for the subsequent term of 5 years based on a rigorous assessment of research performance during the tenure of the fellowship. A minimum of 25% of the applicants seeking an extension will not be granted the extension.
benefits:
1. The fellowship amount is 25Rs./- per month in addition to regular income.
1. Research grant of 15 lakhs per annum.
1. Overhead of 1.00 lakh per annum to the host institute.
eligibility:
1. The candidate should be an active scientist with a record of outstanding performance apparent from the award of the SS Bhatnagar prize and/or fellowship of science academies (including engineeringRs. agricultureRs. and medicine).
1. The scientist should be in service at the time of nomination to this fellowship.
1. The nominee should be an Indian national working in institutions/Universities in India.
1. The fellowship can be availed up to 68 years of age.
1. The nominee is not availing of any other fellowship including personal fellowship amount and research grant (part of the fellowship) from any Government sources.

name: National Energy Conservation Award
brief_description: The National Energy Conservation Award under the Ministry of PowerRs. Government of IndiaRs. recognizes organizations for their outstanding efforts in energy conservation and energy efficiency.A total of 65 awards are given under different categoriesRs. including Tier-I and Tier-II. The award ceremony is held every year on 14th December on the occasion of National Energy Conservation Day. **Objective** a) Scope: The scope of the Awards is to cover sectors(IndustriesRs. BuildingRs. TransportRs. InstitutionsRs. Equipments) which have a share of around 56% of Indias total Electricity consumption(Energy Statistics 2022Rs. MOSPI). b) Purpose: The purpose of the awardis to recognize/reward organizations for the exemplary efforts on Energy Conservation and Energy Efficiency. It can be categorized into National Award(Tier-I/Tier-II) category.
benefits: > **Certificate & Trophy**
eligibility: All organizations are eligible to apply free of cost for the National Energy Conservation Award subject to the condition that their sector should be eligible for Award for a particular year.

name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
brief_description: The National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award under the Ministry of AyushRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to motivate vaidyas and Ayurveda experts to adopt and showcase best practices in AyurvedaRs. promoting high standards of excellence. The award also seeks to encourage innovation and outstanding performance in the field through healthy competition.
benefits: The awardee will be presented with a cash prize of 5Rs./-Rs. a TrophyRs. a sanadaRs. and shawl/Angvastram.

The applicant must hold a recognized degree in Ayurveda as per the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine ActRs. 2020Rs. or the Indian Medicine Central Council ActRs. 1970. 1. Past recipients of the award are not eligible to receive the same award again.

name: New Swarnima Scheme For Women
brief_description: The scheme "New Swarnima Scheme For Women" has been implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Govt of India. It aims to provide women entrepreneurs from backward classes to obtain a loan of up to 2Rs./- @ 5% per annumRs. thereby providing them social & financial security. The scheme is introduced by the National Backwards Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) and implemented by State Channelising Agencies (SCAs)Rs. which act as the nodal agency.
benefits: 1. A subsidy amount of 2Rs./- @ 5% per annumRs. for self-employment. (The remaining amount has to be self-owned by the beneficiary.) 1. The beneficiary woman is not required to invest any amount of her own on the projects upto cost of 2Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Female. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The applicant must be an Entrepreneur 1. The Total Annual Family Income of the Applicant must be Less than 3 Lakh per Annum.

name: Integrated Dairy Development Scheme Gujarat
brief_description: The Integrated Dairy Development Scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to uplift tribal families living below the poverty line by providing sustainable livelihood opportunities through dairy farming. Under this schemeRs. tribal women beneficiaries receive milch cattle along with essential dairy equipment.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance Structure:** - Total unit cost: 90Rs. - GTDC Loan (Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation): 29Rs. - Government of India Subsidy: 29Rs. - State Government Assistance: 29Rs. - Beneficiary Contribution: 3Rs. - Milch cattle and dairy equipment provided to tribal women beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Tribes (ST). 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a farmerRs. livestock keeper (Pashu Palak)Rs. or self-employed woman in tribal or forest areas. 1. The applicant should be interested in self-employment through dairy farming.

name: Rastriya Arogya Nidhi - Health Ministers Cancer Patient Fund

Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide financial assistance to Below Poverty Line cancer patients through support up to 2Rs./- (5Rs./- in emergencies) at Regional Cancer Centres.
