name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package: Insurance Scheme for Health Workers Fighting COVID-19" by the Ministry of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide 50Rs./- insurance cover to healthcare workers through financial protection against death or disability during COVID-19 duty.
benefits: - **Insurance Coverage:** 50Rs./- provided in case of death or permanent disability due to COVID-19.- **Risk Coverage:** Covers loss of life due to COVID-19; covers accidental death during COVID-19-related duty.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a healthcare worker; including doctorsRs. nursesRs. paramedicsRs. and support staff. - The applicant must be directly involved in COVID-19 related duties. - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be working in a COVID-19 designated hospital or care facility. - The applicant must be registered under a government health program.

name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee
brief_description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Consolidation of Coffee" is a Sub-Component of the Scheme "Integrated Coffee Development Project During the Medium Term Framework (MTF) Period: Development Support to Stakeholders" by the Coffee BoardRs. Department of CommerceRs. Ministry of Commerce and Industry. This scheme aims to increase the productivity of the existing coffee holdings by gap filling or rejuvenationRs. followed by improved cultivation methods such as application of compostRs. bush managementRs. shade managementRs. pest and disease controlRs. etc.
benefits:
**Unit Cost:** 60Rs. per hectare. **Scale of Subsidy:** 50% of the Unit CostRs. which is 30Rs. per hectare.
> **Release of Subsidy** The subsidy will be released in two installments: - 1st installment: 60% of the unit cost. - 2nd installment: 40% of the unit cost.
> **Mode of Payment** The Joint Director (Extn.) / Deputy Director (Extn.)Rs. after confirming the admissibility of the claimRs. will release the 1st and 2nd installments of the eligible subsidy amount to the grower's bank account through **EFT/RTGS/NEFT**.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a tribal grower.
2. The applicant's area is ineligible for subsidy if it received consolidation subsidy during the XII Plan period.
3. The applicant's land records must be in their name.
4. The applicant should provide land records or a certified possession certificate.
5. The applicant must procure seed material for gap filling or consolidation exclusively from the Coffee Board.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Workers of Jute Mills/MSME JDP Units
brief_description:
The National Jute Board ActRs. 2008Rs. provides to secure better working conditions and provisions and improvement of amenities and incentives for workers engaged in the jute industry under SectionRs. 5(2)(xxii) for the welfare of workers in jute-producing units. In line with the sameRs. NJB is going to extend support to the workers families to motivate them towards educating their girl childrenRs. a scholarship scheme as a Workers Welfare measure.
**Objectives of the Scheme:**
The objectives of the Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Jute Mills / MSMEs Workers are:

- To provide financial incentive to the girl children of the workers of the Jute Mills/MSMEsRs. upon passing the Secondary and Higher Secondary examinations to encourage them to acquire the minimum required education for making them employable .
- To encourage workers to work in the jute industry and to remain there for longer periodRs. hence help reduce workers attrition rateRs. which is big problem of the Industry .
- To help Jute Mills/MSME units to face lesser labour problems .
- The enhance Millers-Workers relationship.
- To make the workers feel socially protected through such welfare measures for their children .
- To support women empowerment through Girl Children education.
benefits:
- Secondary Education (for Girls only ): 5Rs./- (Five thousand)
- Higher Secondary Education (for Girls only): 10Rs./- (Ten thousand)
eligibility:
- Scholarship to the girl children on Passing out the Examination in 2021(2021-22)Rs. 2022 (2022-23)Rs. 2023 (2023-24)Rs. 2024 (2024-25)Rs. 2025 (2025-26) - Total 5 Years (2021-26) 15th Finance Commission period.
- The scheme will be applicable to the girl children of the workers of Jute Mills and MSME - JDP units engaged in the production of jute products.

name: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
brief_description: The Department of PostsRs. Ministry of Communications has launched a Scholarship Scheme called "Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana" to award children in the class category of Standard 6th to 9th. It is proposed to award annual scholarships to students who have good academic records and are also pursuing 'Philately' as a hobby. The objective of the scholarship is to Promote Philately among children at a young age in a sustainable manner that can reinforce and supplement the academic curriculum in addition to providing a hobby that can help them relax and de-stress. > **Number of Scholarships** 1. 920 scholarships will be awarded to students at the PAN India level. 1. Every Postal Circle will give a maximum of 40 scholarships to 10 students each from Standard 6thRs. 7thRs. 8thRs. and 9th.
benefits: > **Amount of Scholarship** 1. The amount of the Scholarship is to be 6Rs./- per annum @ 500/- per month. 1. IPPB/POSB will ensure that the scholarship is paid to awardees on a quarterly basis (Rs. 1500/- each quarter) after getting the list from each Circle. > **Renewability** 1. Selections to the scholarship would be for one year. 1. An already selected student can apply for the scholarship next year provided he/she fulfils other criteria. > **Mentor** 1. Every prospective school which participates in the competition would be assigned a Philately Mentor to be chosen from amongst the renowned Philatelist. 1. The Philately Mentor would help in the formation of the School level Philately ClubRs. providing guidance to young and aspiring Philatelists on how to pursue the hobby and also helping the aspiring Philatelists with their Philately Projects etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a regular student of Class 6th-9th. 1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized school in India. 1. The school should have a Philately Club and the candidate should be a member of that Club. In case the School Philately Club hasn't been establishedRs. a student having his own Philately Deposit Account may also be considered. 1. The applicant should have scored at least 60% marks or equivalent grade/ grade point in the recent final examination. Relaxation There will be a 5% relaxation for SC/ST.

name: Pension Scheme to Disabled Persons (Divyangjan)- DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme Pension Scheme to Disabled Persons (Divyangjan) is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to individuals with disabilities to cater to their basic needs and ensure social security in cases of disablement. The scheme covers Divyangjan aged between 18 and 59 years who have a disability of 80% or above and are domiciles of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. AdditionallyRs. the annual family income should not exceed 1.5 lakh per annumRs. and the applicant should not be availing financial assistance under any other Divyang pension schemes. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month is given to eligible beneficiaries.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month.

**Note:** The mode of fund transfer shall be Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the districts of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability (Divyangjan). 1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or above. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 59 years. 1. The applicant's family income should not exceed 1.5 lakhs per annum. 1. The applicant should not be availing financial assistance under any other Divyang Pension schemes.
**Special/General Conditions:** In case of non-availability of age proof the beneficiary shall be referred to Medical Board (Government Hospital) of the concerned district for verification of age. After attaining age of 60 years the beneficiary shall be transferred to scheme Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen).

name: Integrated Child Development Services Scheme
brief_description: In NagalandRs. the ICDS program was launched in the year 1975 in the Jalukie block of Peren district with 50 Anganwadi centers. The program has since grown and at presentRs. there are 60 (sixty) ICDS projects in 17 (Seventeen) districts of the State. Of this 2 (two) are Urban projectsRs. one is rural project and the rest are Tribal projects. All the 6(six) services under ICDS such as Supplementary nutritionRs. Health checkupRs. Non formal pre-school educationRs. ImmunizationRs. Nutrition & Health education and Referral services are being provided through a Network of 3980 Anganwadi centers in the State. Presently 60 (sixty) ICDS projects are operating in the state covering 2.11 Lakh beneficiaries under 3980 Anganwadi Centers where all the 6 (six) services are provided to children in the age group of 0-6Rs. pregnant women and lactating mothers and adolescent girls. Poshan Tracker management application provides a 360-degree view of the activities of the Anganwadi Centre (AWC)Rs. service deliveries of Anganwadi Workers (AWWs) and complete beneficiary management for pregnant womenRs. lactating mothersRs. children and adolescent girls. The POSHAN Tracker App is managed by National e Governance Division (NeGD) through a State Coordinator placed at the Social Welfare Directorate. **Objectives** 1. To improve the nutritional and health status of children in the age-group 0-6 years; 1. To lay the foundation for proper psychologicalRs. physical and social development of the child. 1. To reduce the incidence of mortalityRs. morbidityRs. malnutrition and school dropout; 1. To achieve effective co-ordination of policy and implementation amongst the various departments to promote child development; and 1. To enhance the capability of the mother to look after the normal health and nutritional needs of the child through proper nutrition and health education.
benefits: **The ICDS Scheme offers a package of six servicesRs.** 1. Supplementary nutrition. 1. Immunization. 1. Health check-up. 1. Referral services. 1. Pre-school non-formal education and 1. Nutrition & Health Education.
eligibility: **Eligible beneficiaries under this scheme include:** 1. Children up to 6 years of age 1. Pregnant women 1. Lactating mothers 1. Adolescent girls (1418 years)

name: State Research Scholarship
brief_description: Directorate of Higher Education Nagaland Kohima invites students who are eligible to submit applications for the Nagaland State Research Scholarship. This scholarship is specially designed for students who are pursuing research work. Under the schemeRs. beneficiaries will get cash awards to conduct their research work and financial aid to complete their studies.
benefits: 1. Under the Nagaland State Research Scholarship beneficiaries will get financial aid to complete their studies. 1. This scholarship is specially designed for students who are pursuing research work. Under the schemeRs. beneficiaries will get cash awards to conduct their research work.
eligibility: 1. Applicable for Scheduled Tribe and Indigenous students of Nagaland who are pursuing Ph.D/D.Litt. course from recognized Universities within India. 1. Scholars who have availed this Scholarship three times are no longer eligible. 1. Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other Fellowship/Scholarship scheme. 1. Applicant must not be an employee of any government/semi-government establishment. Note: To apply as a Fresh candidateRs. the student must be enrolled in the first year of the course. Renewal is applicable only to beneficiaries of this Scheme from the previous year.

name: LLB Internship Programme
brief_description: Ministry of Law and Justice under the Department of Justice (DoJ) has introduced an Internship Programme named "LLB Internship Programme" for young law students. The purpose of this Programme is to well acquaint young law students with the working of Department of Justice by giving training in the field of research & referencing workRs. in various specialized areas of justice deliveryRs. such as:- 1. Access to Justice (Tele-LawRs. Nyaya BandhuRs. Legal AidRs. Pro Bono Legal Services); 1. e-Courts services; 1. Fast Track Special Courts; 1. National Mission for Justice Delivery & Legal Reforms and; 1. CSS for Development of Infrastructure Facilities in the District and Subordinate Judiciary. > **Duration:** Duration of internship ordinarily remain for a period of one month (four weeks). > **Number of Interns:** The maximum number of interns to be allowed in a given monthly slots will be 10 candidates only subject to requirement of the Department. > **Placement:** Each selected intern shall be posted with an officer of the level of Deputy Secretary/Director/Joint Secretary/ or the O/o SecretaryRs. Department of JusticeRs. O/o the Minister of StateRs. Law & Justice (Independent Charge) with the approval of the Competent Authority. > **Attendance:** For satisfactory completion inter-aliaRs. 90% attendance is mandatory. This is a full-time internship to be attended physically.
benefits: - **Honorarium:** The interns may be given an honorarium of 5Rs./- on completion of their internship.- **Certificate:** On satisfactory completion of the internshipRs. a Certificate of Internship shall be awarded.

name: Good Samaritan Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 3rd Oct 2021 by the Ministry of Road Transport & HighwaysRs. the "Scheme for Good Samaritan" grants an award to the good samaritan who has saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident (involving a motor vehicle) by administering immediate assistance and rushing to Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident to provide medical treatment. The amount of award for each Good Samaritan would be 25Rs./- per incident. The scheme will remain operational till the completion of the 15th Financial CycleRs. i.e. till 31st March 2026. The objective of the scheme is to motivate the general public to help road accident victims in emergency situations and inspire and motivate others to save innocent lives.. A Good Samaritan who has informed the police of any accident involving a motor vehicleRs. or who has transported a victim of an accident involving a motor vehicle to the hospitalRs. shall not be subjected to any further requirements by the police or the hospital and shall be permitted to leave immediately.
benefits: - **Award Amount For Single Incident:** If one Good Samaritan saves one or more victims in a single fatal motor vehicle accidentRs. a total award of 5Rs./- is given. - **Award Distribution Among Multiple Samaritans (Single Victim):** If more than one Good Samaritan saves one victimRs. the award amount (25Rs./-) award is equally divided among them. - **Award For Multiple Victims And Samaritans:** If more than one Good Samaritan saves multiple victimsRs. 25Rs./- is given per victimRs. subject to a maximum of 5Rs./- per Good Samaritan. - **Certification Of Appreciation:** Each cash award is accompanied by a Certification of Appreciation. - **National Level Awards:** 10 most deserving Good Samaritans are selected annually and awarded 1Rs./- each. - **Maximum Award Limit Per Year:** An individual Good Samaritan can receive the award up to 5 times in a year.
eligibility: - The applicant should have saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident involving a motor vehicle by administering immediate assistance and rushing to the Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident to provide medical treatment. - Good SamaritansRs. who are not willing to disclose their detailsRs. would not be awarded under the scheme.

name: National Scheme Of Incentive To Girls For Secondary Education
brief_description: The National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education promotes the girl child's enrolment of 14-18 years age group at secondary stageRs. who passes class 8th and subsequently drops out for various socio-economic reasons. The proposed scheme is further intended to retain such girl children up to class 12th. In the year 2004-05Rs. the dropout rate of girls from classes 1st to 8th was about 50.8%. For classes 1st to 10th the dropout rate of girls was about 64% in the same year. HenceRs. only 36% of the country's girl students could be retained up to class 10th. This is the combined result of several socio-economic factorsRs. but a major contributor is no doubt the inability of the parents to afford the cost of education of the girl child.
benefits: - A sum of 3000/- would be deposited under term deposit/ fixed deposit in a public sector bank or in a post office in the name of every eligible girl child. - The term/ period of the deposit may be counted from the date of deposit to the date on which the girl child attains the age of 18 years. No premature withdrawal will be allowed.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl child.
2. The applicant should be from Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe SC/ST
3. The applicant should have passed class 8th from Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidhalayas (irrespective of whether they belong to Scheduled Castes or Tribes)
4. The applicant should have enrolled for class 9th in State/UT GovernmentRs. Government-aidedRs. or local body schools in the academic year 2008-09 onwards.

name: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
brief_description: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC)Rs. Department of Higher EducationRs. for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme are the single girl childRs. i.e. the only girl child in the family without having any brother or sister. A girl scholar who is one of the twin daughters/fraternal daughters is also eligible to apply for fellowship under the scheme. The number of slots for the fellowship will be decided every year on the basis of eligible applications complete in all respectsRs. received through online mode. **Objectives of the Scheme -** i. To support the higher education of single girl children in Social Sciences. ii. To recognize the value of observance of the small family norm. iii. To recognize the norm of single girl children in society. iv. To propagate the concept of single girl child norm. v. To promote single girls in society.
benefits:
**TENURE OF FELLOWSHIP:** The tenure of the fellowship is for five years and will be effective from 1st April of the selection year or the actual date of joining under the fellowship in the University/College/InstituteRs. whichever is later. Fellowship will be granted upto the date of submission of Ph.D. Thesis or 5 years of tenure whichever is earlier. No extension is permissible beyond the total period of five yearsRs. and the fellow ceases to be a UGC research fellow immediately after the expiry of the due date.
**FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE:** ***Fellowship:*** JRF @ 37Rs./- p.m. for initial two years (subject to satisfactory progress of research work) SRF @ 42Rs./- p.m. for remaining tenure (subject to satisfactory progress of research work) ***Contingency:*** For Humanities and Social Sciences: @ 10Rs./- p.a. for the initial two yearsRs. @ 20Rs./- p.a. for the remaining tenure. For ScienceRs. EngineeringRs. and Technology @ 12Rs./- p.a. for the initial two yearsRs. @ 25Rs./- p.a. for the remaining tenure. ***Escort Reader Assistance:*** @ 3Rs./- p.m. in the case of Divyang scholars.
**Note:** At the end of tenure/termination of fellowship/resignation of scholarRs. the booksRs. journalsRs. and equipment purchased out of the contingency grant shall become the property of the institution concerned.
**HRA:** (i) Hostel accommodation may be provided to the scholars by their institutions. In such casesRs. the scholar is eligible to draw only hostel fees excluding messRs. electricityRs. water chargesRs. etc. In caseRs. a scholar refuses the hostel accommodationRs. he/she shall not be eligible to draw HRA. (ii) In case of non-availability of hostel accommodationRs. the scholar may be provided with single accommodation by the host institution. In such casesRs. the rent paid by the scholar on an actual basis shall be reimbursedRs. subject to the ceiling of HRA as per Govt. of India norms. (iii) If the scholar makes her own arrangements of accommodationRs. he/she shall be entitled to draw HRA as per ceiling and categorization of cities by the Govt. of India. In caseRs. the scholar wishes to draw HRARs. he/she is required to submit a certificateRs. in the prescribed formatRs. to her institution.
**MEDICAL ASSISTANCE:** No separate/fixed medical assistance is provided. HoweverRs. the scholars may avail the medical facilities available in their Institutions concerned.
**LEAVE:** (i) ***Earned Leave*** for a maximum period of 30 days in a year in addition to public holidays may be taken by a scholar. HoweverRs. they are not entitled to any other vacationRs. such as summerRs. winterRs. and pooja vacationsRs. etc. (ii) ***Maternity/paternity leave*** as per the Govt. of India norms issued from time to time shall be available for female scholars at full rates of the fellowship once during the tenure of the fellowship. The period of leave without fellowshipRs. if anyRs. shall be counted towards the tenure. Besides thisRs. an ***Intermittent Break*** for a maximum total period of 1 year may also be permissible for women scholars. The break can be availed a maximum of 3 times during the entire period of the fellowship. HoweverRs. the total duration of the break shall not exceed one year. No fellowship shall be available for the period of such break(s). This period of intermittent breaks shall not be counted towards the tenure of the fellowshipRs. and thus effectively the total period of fellowship shall remain the same. (iii) ***Academic leave*** (without fellowship and other emoluments) shall be permissible only for one year throughout the tenure (for any kind of academic/teaching assignment/foreign visit in connection with research work). The period of leave without fellowship will be counted towards the tenure. Expenditure on foreign visits in connection to research work cannot be claimed from UGC. (iv) All kinds of leave shall be availed by the scholar only with due approval of the institution concerned.
eligibility: 1. Any single girl child of her parents pursuing Ph.D. in any stream/subject in recognised Universities/Colleges/ Institutes is eligible to apply under the scheme. 1. The scheme is applicable to such a single girl child who has registered herself in regularRs. full-time Ph. D. program. 1. Admission to Ph.D. Course in part-time/distance mode is not covered under the scheme. A scholar is not eligible for fellowship if the research is intended/pursued through open/ part-time distance education mode or part-time mode. 1. Girl students up to the age of 40 years for general category and 45 years for the reserved categories i.e. SC/ST/OBC and PWD (Persons with Disabilities) as on the last date of submission of online application are eligible. 1. Both the scholar receiving the fellowship and the institution concernedRs. where the scholar is pursuing her Ph.D are responsible to ensure that the terms and conditions of these schemes are followed properly and only the eligible candidates get the fellowship.

name: Advanced Vocational Training Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Advanced Vocational Training Scheme (AVTS)" has been launched by the Directorate General of Training (DGT)Rs. Ministry of Skill Development and EntrepreneurshipRs. Government of India. It aims to upgrade and update the skills of the industrial workforce through short-term modular training. Through this schemeRs. short-term training courses of 1 to 6 weeks are provided to industrial workersRs. techniciansRs. supervisorsRs. engineersRs. instructorsRs. and technical students for skill upgradation. The scheme is implemented by National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) under the Directorate General of Training (DGT)Rs. including NSTIs at MumbaiRs. KanpurRs. HowrahRs. Hyderabad (Vidyanagar)Rs. ChennaiRs. Hyderabad (Ramanthapur)Rs. LudhianaRs. DehradunRs. CalicutRs. BangaloreRs. JamshedpurRs. and other centres. The training is offered in selected skill areas through regular and tailor-made courses designed as per the requirements of industries and establishments. The institute is equipped with workshopsRs. laboratoriesRs. hostel facilitiesRs. and other infrastructure to support training. The scheme was launched in collaboration with UNDP/ILO and is delivered through modular courses to meet the training demands of industries and institutions. > **Mission:** - To continuously upgrade the skills of the industrial workforce for higher productivity - Bridging the gap between academics and industries for suitable placement for the young generation in technical fields > **Objective:** - To ensure a steady flow of skilled worker to the industries in different trades. - To raise the quality and quantity of the industrial production by systematic training of potential workers. - To enhance employability of educated youth for skilled and supervisory jobs through training. - To upgrade and update the skills of technical personnels of industriesRs. Govt. Departments and Organizations for diversification in production and keeping them abreast with the technological advancement. - To conduct need-based training Program for industriesRs. departments and organizations in the form of tailor-made programs. - Rendering consultancy in training/production techniques.
benefits: > **Short-Term Skill Training:** - Training duration ranges from 1 week to 6 weeks. - Courses are modular and industry-oriented. > **Industry-Relevant Courses:** - Training provided in emerging sectors such as: - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Cloud Computing - Cyber Security - CAD/CAM/CNC - Hydraulics and Pneumatics - Automobile Engineering - Welding Technology - Electronics and Electrical Systems - Solar Technology - Fashion Designing - Aeronautical Structure > **Tailor-Made Training Programs:** - Courses are designed according to the requirements of industries and establishments. > **Skill Upgradation:** - Helps industrial workersRs. engineersRs. and technicians update skills with the latest technologies. > **Infrastructure Support:** - Access to workshopsRs. laboratoriesRs. libraryRs. hostelRs. and training facilities. > **Affordable Fee Structure:** - Application Fee: 100/- per participant per course - Gymkhana Fee: 10/- per course - Tuition Fee (Per Week): - Government Departments: 1Rs./- (Regular)Rs. 2Rs./- (Tailor-made) - Medium/Large Industries: 2Rs./- (Regular)Rs. 4Rs./- (Tailor-made) - Small Scale Industries/Private Candidates: 1Rs./- - Technical Institutes: 1Rs./- (Regular)Rs. 2Rs./- (Tailor-made) - State Directorates: NIL > **Hostel Facility:** - Limited hostel available on a first-comeRs. first-served basis. - Charges: 100/- per day per participant. > **Mode of Disbursement:** Training services are provided directly through NSTIs at MumbaiRs. KanpurRs. HowrahRs. Hyderabad (Vidyanagar)Rs. ChennaiRs. Hyderabad (Ramanthapur)Rs. LudhianaRs. DehradunRs. CalicutRs. BangaloreRs. JamshedpurRs. and other centres.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should have a minimum qualification of ITIRs. DiplomaRs. or Engineering in the relevant trade or branch. 1. The applicant who is currently appearing in ITI/Diploma/Engineering may also apply. 1. The applicant may be an industrial workerRs. technicianRs. supervisorRs. or engineer. 1. The applicant from government departments or the private sector with a technical qualification can apply. 1. The applicant from the public sector or private industry personnel may apply. 1. The applicant with experience in the relevant field may also take admission.

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Minor Irrigation
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Minor Irrigation" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial assistance to farmers through loans intended for minor irrigation projects. It helps improve water availability for agricultureRs. enhancing crop productivity and supporting sustainable rural development.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** 65Rs./- to 1Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 11% to 11.75% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a farmer. - The beneficiary should be engaged in agriculture - The beneficiary should be in need of support for minor irrigation. - The beneficiary should be interested in availing of the loan for Minor Irrigation. - The beneficiary should have the intention to use the loan specifically for Minor Irrigation.

name: Issuance of Free House Sites
brief_description: The "Issuance of Free House Sites" scheme launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide free residential land sites to eligible individuals from the Backward Classes (BC)Rs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. and Denotified Communities (DNC) who do not own a house or landRs. helping them secure housing stability.
benefits: - Allocation of a free residential plot to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiary should belong to Backward Classes (BC)/ Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ and Denotified Communities (DNCs).
1. The beneficiary should not own any house or house site.
1. Annual income should not exceed 40Rs./- in rural areas and 60Rs./- in urban areas.

name: PM Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
brief_description: The scheme "PM Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)" by the Ministry of Housing and Urban AffairsRs. Government of India aims to formalize street vendors and enhance their economic opportunities through providing collateral-free working capital loansRs. interest subsidyRs. and digital transaction incentives to street vendors. It was launched on 1st June 2020 as a central sector scheme. The scheme supports vendors in restarting and expanding their businesses. It also promotes digital payments to increase financial inclusion. Street vendors include hawkersRs. thelewalaRs. rehriwalaRs. and others engaged in small-scale vending activities. The scheme aims to formalize the street vendors and open up new opportunities for this sector to move up the economic ladder. Street vendors represent a very important constituent of the urban informal economy and play a significant role in ensuring availability of the goods and services at affordable rates at the doorstep of the city dwellers. They are known as vendorsRs. hawkersRs. thelewalaRs. rehriwalaRs. theliphadwalaRs. etc. in different areas/ contexts. The goods supplied by them include vegetablesRs. fruitsRs. ready-to-eat street foodRs. teaRs. pakodasRs. breadRs. eggsRs. textileRs. apparelRs. footwearRs. artisan productsRs. books/ stationaryRs. etc. The services include barber shopsRs. cobblersRs. pan shopsRs. laundry servicesRs. etc.
benefits: > **Working Capital Loan:** - **1st Tranche:** Loan up to 15Rs./-; repayment within 12 months. - **2nd Tranche:** Loan up to 25Rs./-; repayment within 18 months. - **3rd Tranche:** Loan up to 50Rs./-; repayment within 36 months. - Next tranche available on timely or early repayment. - No prepayment penalty on early repayment. > **Interest Subsidy:** - Subsidy at 7% per annum on loan amount. - Credited quarterly to beneficiarys bank account. - Applicable only for standard (non-NPA) accounts. - Valid up to 31st March 2033. > **Digital Transaction Cashback:** - Cashback up to 100/- per month for digital transactions. > **Credit Guarantee Support:** - 31.87% guarantee cover for 1st tranche loan. - 8.25% guarantee cover for 2nd tranche loan. - 6% guarantee cover for 3rd tranche loan. - No charges for lending institutions. > **UPI Linked RuPay Credit Card:** - Initial credit limit of 10Rs./-; extendable up to 30Rs./-. - Validity of 5 years. - Available after successful repayment of 2nd tranche loan.
eligibility: - Street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs). - The vendorsRs. who have been identified in the survey but have not been issued Certificate of Vending / Identity Card. - Street Vendors left out of the ULB-led identification survey or who have started vending after completion of the survey and have been issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) to that effect by the ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC). - The vendors of surrounding development/ peri-urban/rural areas vending in the geographical limits of the ULBsRs. who have been issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) to that effect by the ULB / TVC.

name: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
brief_description:
**Objective** To provide facility to help visually challenged permanent teachers to achieve self-dependence by using various aids for teachingRs. learning and research.
**Purpose** The scheme has been formulated to help visually challenged permanent teachers to pursue teaching and research with the help of a Reader and by using teaching and learning aidsRs. by way of providing Reader's Allowance and funds for purchase of Braille booksRs. recorded materialsRs. and other related materials/equipment.
benefits: The scheme provides the following benefits to visually challenged permanent teachers: **1. Financial Support** An allowance of **Rs. 36Rs./- per annum** is provided to meet expenses related to teachingRs. learning and research. **2. Reader Support** Provision of funds for payment to a ReaderRs. enabling the teacher to carry out academic duties effectively. **3. Access to Learning Materials** Funds can be used for purchase of: - Braille Books/Material - Recorded Materials - Any other related/required material or equipment for researchRs. teaching and learning **4. Self-Dependence** The scheme enables visually challenged teachers to achieve self-dependence in their teaching and research activities.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent teacher in a college. TemporaryRs. contractualRs. or ad-hoc teachers are not covered under the scheme. 2. The scheme covers teachers with the following nature of blindness: - Fully Blind - Low Vision A certificate from a Government Hospital is mandatory to establish the nature of visual impairment. 3. The college where the teacher is employed must be recognized under: - Section 2(f) of the UGC Act - Section 12(B) of the UGC Act 4. The eligible teacher's details must be included in the consolidated list of visually challenged teachers submitted by the college to the UGC Regional Office/NRCB along with the Twelfth Plan General Development Grant proposal.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
brief_description: The scheme targets manufacturers of components / sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights and offers 46% incentive on incremental sales to boost localizationRs. reduce importsRs. and build a domestic supply chain. **Objective & Scope** The objective is to boost domestic manufacturingRs. reduce import dependenceRs. build a strong component ecosystem for white goodsRs. and position India in the global supply chain. The scheme targets companies that invest in manufacturing components or sub-assemblies for: - Air Conditioners (ACs) e.g. compressorsRs. copper tubesRs. heat exchangersRs. motorsRs. control assembliesRs. etc. - LED Lights e.g. LED chips & packagingRs. LED driversRs. LED enginesRs. light-management systemsRs. and other components in the LED-light value chain. **Implementation Period & Financial Outlay** - The scheme runs from FY 2021-22 to FY 2028-29 - Total approved outlay is Rs 6Rs. crore. - Incentives under the scheme are provided for a period of 5 years on incremental sales (after one / two year gestation period)Rs. over the base year.
benefits: 1. Eligible companies get financial incentives ranging from 4% to 6% on net incremental sales of goods manufactured in India under the scheme. 1. The goal is to significantly raise domestic value addition from existing ~1520% to ~7580%. 1. Large incremental production and exports of AC & LED components. 1. Creation of substantial employment (direct + indirect) across manufacturing ecosystem. 1. Development of a complete component-to-final-product ecosystemRs. reducing dependence on imports.
eligibility: 1. Incentive under the Scheme shall be provided to Companies making brown field or green field Investments for manufacturing in target segments in India. 1. Eligibility shall be subject to achievement of thresholds of net incremental sales of Eligible Products for the respective financial year over the base year or net incremental sales of eligible products over the base year or FY 2020-21Rs. whichever is higherRs. as the case may be and cumulative incremental investment in the preceding financial yearRs. which shall not be less than the threshold investment as detailed in Appendix-I or Appendix IA of the Scheme GuidelinesRs. as the case may be. 1. In case an applicant does not meet criteria of threshold investment and threshold net incremental sales for any given yearRs. the applicant shall not be eligible for disbursement of incentive for that particular financial year. HoweverRs. the applicant will not be restricted from claiming incentive for subsequent years during the tenure of the SchemeRs. provided eligibility criteria of cumulative committed investment and threshold net incremental sales are met for such subsequent financial years. 1. The incremental sales of eligible products should be commensurate with created production capacity from investments committed under the scheme. 1. For the purpose of determining eligibility of an applicant with respect to incremental investmentRs. the investment covered under any other PLI Scheme of Govt. of India of the Applicant shall not be considered for determining eligibility under this PLI Scheme and vice-versa. 1. In every financial year for which the incentive is claimedRs. the net sales turnover of eligible products of the selected applicant and its group companies shall not be less than the sum of their net sales turnover of eligible products manufactured in India in the base year for applicants meeting the pre-qualification criteria on the basis of financial attributes of base year and higher of net sales turnover of eligible products in the base year or FY 2020-21Rs. for applicants meeting the pre-qualification criteria on the basis of financial attributes of FY 2020-21; along with the corresponding threshold incremental net sales turnover of the selected applicant as detailed in Appendix-1 or Appendix-IA of the Scheme GuidelinesRs. as the case may be. 1. For applicants opting for initial investment period as 1st AprilRs. 2021 to 31st MarchRs. 2023Rs. the first and last year of achieving the required corresponding threshold incremental sales for availing the PLI shall be FY 2023-2024 and FY 2027-28 respectively as detailed in Appendix -IA of the Scheme Guidelines.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards
brief_description: Launched in the year 1977-78Rs. the scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians belong to one of the following categoriesRs. to pursue Pre-Matric education: TannersRs. FlayersRs. Waste Pickers and Persons who are either presently engaged in Manual Scavenging.
benefits: **Rate of Scholarship** 1. Day Scholars: Class 1st to 10th: 110/- per month for ten months. 1. Hostellers: Class 3rd to 10th: 700/- per month for ten months. **Ad-Hoc Grant** 1. 750/- per student per annum to all-day scholars. 1. 1000/- per student per annum to hostellers. **Additional Provisions for Students with Disabilities** 1. Reader Allowance of 100 per month for blind students in classes III and X. 1. Transport Allowance of 50 per month for disabled students not residing in the hostel located within the premises of the educational institution. 1. Special Pay of 100 per month would be admissible to any employee of the hostel willing to extend help to a severely orthopedically handicapped student residing in a hostel managed by the educational institution or by the State Government/Union Territory Administration who may need the assistance of a helper. 1. Escort Allowance of 50 per month for severely handicapped day scholar students with lower extremity disability. 1. Extra Coaching Allowance of 100 per month to mentally retarded and mentally ill students in classes III and X. **NOTE 1:** The students amongst target groups with disabilities covered under this scheme canRs. howeverRs. also get such additional benefits from other schemesRs. which are not covered in the above provision. **Duration and Course of Studies** 1. The scholarships may be given to students enrolled in class 1st or any subsequent class or pre-matric stage in the case of day scholars. 1. The scholarships may be given to students enrolled in class 3rd or any subsequent class of the pre-matric stage in the case of hostellers. 1. The scholarship will terminate at the end of class 10th. 1. The duration of the scholarship in an academic year is ten months. **Mode of Disbursal** 1. The scholarship amount will be payable from the date of joining to the date of leaving the schoolRs. excluding the period of vacationRs. which will be about 10 months in a year except in the cases where the student enters or leaves early in the midst of academic year. 1. In order to ensure timely and correct payment of the scholarship amount to the beneficiariesRs. State Governments/UT administrations will ensure payment of scholarship through their accounts in banks through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) as prescribed by the Govt. of India. All State government/UT Administrations will implement a computerized management system of scholarshipsRs. including 'e-payment' system.
eligibility: **Eligibility** The scholarship will be admissible to the children/wards of Indian Nationals whoRs. irrespective of their religion belong to one of the following categories: 1. Tanners & Flayers. 1. Waste Pickers. 1. Persons who are Manual Scavengers as defined under section 2(I) (g) of the Manual Scavengers Act 2013. 1. Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning as defined in Section 2(I) (d) of the Manual Scavengers Act 2013. Other Conditions 1. The students may not be allowed to take up employment or render help to parents in their work during the course of their studies. 1. The award will be discontinued if a student fails to secure annual promotion except in case of unavoidable reasons to be certified by the Head of the Institution in which the student is studying. 1. If a student violates school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scholarshipsRs. the scholarship may be suspended or even cancelledRs. subject to the satisfaction of the competent school authority. 1. Migration of students from one institution to another would not normally be allowed during the course of the academic year except under exceptional circumstances and in the interest of the student's academic career. 1. The scholar obtaining benefits under this scheme is not allowed to avail of benefits under any other pre-matric scholarship scheme. 1. The students should be regular in attendance for which the yardstick is to be decided by the competent authority of the school.

name: Prime Ministers Internship Scheme
brief_description: The Prime Ministers Internship SchemeRs. launched by the Ministry of Corporate AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide internship opportunities to one crore youth in top 500 companies over a period of five years. The scheme offers a 12-month internship to help youth gain exposure to real-life business environments across various professions. It is designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by enabling interns to acquire practical skills and work experience. The scheme operates independently of other skill development or internship programmes of the Central and State Governments. At least half of the internship duration is spent in an actual working environment rather than classroom training. Duration of the Internship shall be 12 months. At least half of the internship period must be spent in the actual working experience/ job environmentRs. and not in the classroom.
benefits: - **Internship Duration & Exposure:** 12 months of real-life work experience in top companies across India. - **Monthly Financial Assistance:** 4Rs./- per month by Government of India and 500 per month by the industry partner. - **One-time Grant:** 6Rs./- provided to interns for incidental expenses. - **Insurance Coverage:** Coverage under Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana provided by the Government of India. **Note 1:** Monthly assistance will be paid to the interns for the entire duration of 12 months of the internship. **Note 2:** A one-time grant will be disbursed to each intern by the government through Direct Benefit TransferRs. upon the intern's joining at the internship location.
eligibility: - The candidate belongs to Indian nationality. - The candidates age should be between 21 to 24 years (as on the last date for submission of the application). - The candidate should not be full-time employed. - The candidate should not be engaged in full-time education. - The candidate enrolled in online/distance learning programmes are eligible to apply. - The candidate should be completed High SchoolRs. Higher Secondary SchoolRs. possess a certificate from an ITIRs. hold a diploma from a Polytechnic InstituteRs. or are graduates with degrees such as BARs. B.ScRs. B.ComRs. BCARs. BBARs. B.PharmaRs. etc. - The candidate family income should not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students
brief_description: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) is implementing the "Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students" in StatisticsRs. EconomicsRs. DemographyRs. Operations ResearchRs. and related fields during 2023-24. The scheme aims to familiarize students with the Official Statistical System of IndiaRs. including data collectionRs. processingRs. analysisRs. publicationRs. and dissemination activities. It also seeks to create awareness about career opportunities in the Indian Statistical Service and the Subordinate Statistical Service.
benefits: > **Remuneration:** - **Internship Stipend:** A consolidated stipend of 10Rs. (5Rs. per month) is provided upon successful completion of the internship. - **Direct Benefit Transfer:** The stipend is transferred directly to the interns bank account through electronic payment modes such as APB/AEPS. - **Cashless Payment System:** No cash payment is made under the internship programme. - **Certificate of Completion:** A certificate is issued to interns after successful completion of the internship by the concerned office. - **Field Visit Allowance:** Interns attached to NSSO (FOD) Zonal/Regional Offices receive an additional 250 per day for field visitsRs. subject to a maximum of 10 days during the internship period. > **Facilities:** - **Logistics Support:** Internship centres may provide office spaceRs. intercomRs. computerRs. and internet facilities to interns during the internship period. - **Access to Study Material:** Interns will be allowed access to study materials and literature available in the office/library. - **Guidance & Mentorship:** Each intern will be assigned a guide/nodal officer for assistance and coordination during the internship. - **Interaction with Officials:** Interns may interact with concerned divisions/officers through the assigned guide for completion of their assignments. > **Notes:** - No Travelling Allowance or Daily allowance etc. will be paid by the Ministry for joining the place of internship allotted to them or after the completion of the internship. - The selected candidates have to make their own arrangements for their lodgingRs. boarding and transportRs. etc. - Interns may be required to bring their own laptopsRs. depending on the availability of facilities.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a citizen of India and; - He/She must be pursuing post-graduation/research from a recognized College/University/Research institute in Statistics/ Mathematical Statistics/Operational Research/Economics/Demography or any of the applied fields of Statistics. **Note:-** 1. The internship will be for a period of 2 months from the date of joining. 1. Each intern/student shall be required to submit report/paper (along with soft copy) at the end of the assignmentRs. including inter-aliaRs. his/her observations and suggestionsRs. if anyRs. regarding any possible improvement in the system.

name: National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme
brief_description: The "National Renewable Energy Internship (NREI) Scheme" by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) provides internship opportunities to facilitate students pursuing undergraduate/graduate/post-graduate degrees or research scholars enrolled in recognized institutes/universities within India or abroadRs. as Interns. The students of various EngineeringRs. ScienceRs. ManagementRs. law and other streams may undertake internships in the Ministry and in organizations under its aegis to understand various activities of the Ministry to become Researchers/Managers in the renewable energy area. These interns will be attached to the senior-level officers of the Ministry in various Programme Divisions. These interns can work for a period of two months to six months. The scheme also provides opportunities to personnel engaged in projects related to policy research/promotion/demonstration and deployment of renewable energy in national and international research/institutes and financial institutions to work as Interns in the Ministry /its organisations. > **Purpose** The "Interns" shall have an opportunity to learn about the Ministrys functioningRs. programmes and policyRs. and issues in Renewable Energy and contribute to generating inputs such as analysisRs. technical reports/ technology advancement/ project reports/policy papersRs. etc. for the furtherance of the objectives of this Ministry. > **Period** The internship is available twice a year based on the MNRE requirement. > **Number** A maximum of 20 interns per year. > **Duration** Will be from two to six months to be counted from the day of the start of the internship. No intern would be allowed to repeat or extend the internship.
benefits: - **Stipend:** A stipend amount of 15Rs./- per month will be provided for physical internships only. - **Certificate of Internship:** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internship and evaluation of their Report/Paper by the concerned.- **Logistic Support:** MNRE shall provide them with internet facilities and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads for physical internship. > **Notes:** - Interns will be required to have their own Laptops. They shall also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements. - For virtual internshipsRs. the stipend will not be provided.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be pursuing a graduate or post-graduate degree course in Engineering/ Management/ Law/ Science stream/Renewable Energy in a recognized University/institution within India or abroad. ORRs. - The applicant should be working in the Renewable Energy area in NationalRs. InternationalRs. and Non-Governmental Institutes/organisations.
> **NOTE:** MNRE will have the power to relax any of the above conditions mentionedRs. in respect of any deserving candidate.

name: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" is an umbrella scheme under "Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" and has been implemented by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)Rs. Ministry of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)Rs. Government of India. The scheme provides skill development training and support to artisans and workers in various traditional and modern industries under multiple sectors such as Wellness & CosmeticsRs. Handmade Leather & PlasticRs. Mineral-Based IndustryRs. Agro & Food ProcessingRs. Rural Engineering & New TechnologyRs. and Service Industry. The scheme focuses on practical training in specialized activities like Agarbatti makingRs. leather footwear manufacturingRs. potteryRs. beekeepingRs. wooden craftsRs. handmade paper and fiber productsRs. agro-food processingRs. and technical trades like electricianRs. plumberRs. and tea vending. Along with trainingRs. the scheme provides financial and material supportRs. including machineryRs. toolsRs. and equipment to the trained artisans and beneficiaries to help them start production or enhance their existing work.
benefits: ***Assistance provided under different components of Scheme:*** ***Agarbatti Programme under Wellness and Cosmetics Industries (WCI):*** - Training Programme in Agarbatti industry. - Distribution of Pedal operated / Automatic Agarbatti Machinery to trained artisans. ***Leather Footwear Activity under Handmade Paper Leather & Plastic Industry (HMPLPI):*** - Training on designing and manufacturing of footwear. - Distribution of machinery and tool kits to trained artisans. ***Pottery Activity under Mineral Based Industry (MBI):*** - Training on Wheel pottery. - Distribution of tools and equipment (Electric Potter WheelRs. Blunger) to trained artisans. ***Beekeeping Activity/Honey Mission Programme under Agro-Based & Food Processing Industries (ABFPI):*** - Beekeeping skill development training. - Distribution of 10 bee boxes with live bee colonies and One set of Tool kit (containing one KnifeRs. SmokerRs. hive tool and bee veil) to trained beneficiaries. ***Waste Wood / Turn Wood Craft /Wooden Toy/Products of Panchgavya under Rural Engineering and New Technology:*** - Training on Waste-WoodRs. Turn-Wood CraftRs. Wooden Toy and in Panchgavya based Products. - Distribution of tool kit to all trained artisans. ***Hand Made Paper and Fiber related activities under Hand Made PaperRs. Plastic and Leather Industry:*** - Training on Paper ConversionRs. Paper Plate & Dona(Bowl) makingRs. Paper MacheRs. Fibre Extraction and fancy article making and Ban making (Two ply). - Distribution of machinery and tool kits to trained artisans. ***Agro- Food Based Food Processing Industries:*** - Training on Palm GurRs. TamarindRs. Fruits & VegetablesRs. Village OilRs. Spices & CondimentsRs. Cane & Bamboo. - Distribution of machinery and tool kits to trained artisans. ***Service Industry:*** - Training to Electrician & PlumbersRs. and DigniTEA(Tea Vending on Bicycle). - Distribution of tool kits to trained beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Khadi artisan or Khadi Institution registered with KVIC or KVIB. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a valid Aadhaar card or government-issued ID. 1. One person per family is eligible under the scheme. 1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from any other government scheme for the same purpose. 1. Preference is given to SC/STRs. womenRs. unemployed youthRs. and BPL category applicants. 1. The beneficiaries may be identified by KVICRs. KVIBsRs. NGOsRs. DICsRs. FPOsRs. or Khadi Institutions.

name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
brief_description: The "Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)" has been launched by the North Eastern Council (NEC)Rs. Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region for the students of the North Eastern States undergoing studies in different disciplines at different levels in Institutions inside as well as outside the North-East but within the country as specified hereinafter. The scholarship under this scheme shall be disbursed only through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). The scholarship shall be admissible to students who get admission in DiplomaRs. DegreeRs. Post-graduate or registration in M.Phil. / Ph.D. courses of any institute recognised by the Government. The grant of scholarship for M.Phil and Ph.D. would be after the registration of the students with the University. The scholarship shall be admissible to the students whose parent/guardians annual income from all sources shall not exceed 8Rs./-.
benefits: > **Rates of Scholarships** ( per annum) for fresh and renewal cases (existing students): > The present rate of scholarship for related Subjects/Courses at different levels is as under: - Diploma: 20Rs./- - Degree: 22Rs./- - Postgraduate: 25Rs./- - M.Phil./Ph.D.: 30Rs./- > The number of Fresh Scholarships to be awarded every year to candidates of different NER states at different levels may be as given below - - State: Arunachal Pradesh; Diploma: 20; Degree: 130; PG Degree: 52; M.Phil / PhD: 7; Total: 209 - State: Assam; Diploma: 30; Degree: 200; PG Degree: 80; M.Phil / PhD: 10; Total: 320 - State: Manipur; Diploma: 18; Degree: 120; PG Degree: 48; M.Phil / PhD: 6; Total: 192 - State: Meghalaya; Diploma: 18; Degree: 120; PG Degree: 48; M.Phil / PhD: 6; Total: 192 - State: Mizoram; Diploma: 18; Degree: 120; PG Degree: 48; M.Phil / PhD: 6; Total: 192 - State: Nagaland; Diploma: 18; Degree: 120; PG Degree: 48; M.Phil / PhD: 6; Total: 192 - State: Tripura; Diploma: 18; Degree: 120; PG Degree: 48; M.Phil / PhD: 6; Total: 192 - State: Sikkim; Diploma: 10; Degree: 70; PG Degree: 28; M.Phil / PhD: 3; Total: 111 - TOTAL: Diploma: 150; Degree: 1000; PG Degree: 400; M.Phil / PhD: 50; Total: 1600 The above numbers are fixed as per the normative allocation accepted for the respective NE States. The number of scholarships for the renewal cases shall be as per actual for different NE statesRs. and the scholarship amount as per the accepted rates as mentioned above shall be utilised both for the fresh candidates and renewal cases (existing students selected for the NEC Scholarship). > **Notes** 1. The various courses of studies at different levels for which NEC's financial assistance is admissible would be those as decided by the NEC from time to timeRs. keeping in view the requirements of specialised manpower of the North Eastern Region. 1. NEC may increase or decrease the total number of scholarshipsRs. subject to the availability of funds/allocation of budget from time to time. HoweverRs. the numbers would be fixed as per the normative allocation accepted for different NE states. 1. Students selected for the grant ofthe NEC Scholarship will be entitled to receive the same from the date of admission/date of commencement (Date of registration in case of M.Phil / Ph.D.) whichever is later till completion of the courseRs. subject to maximum period as prescribed in Para 3.3 above. 1. In case of doubt/clarification regarding the above rulesRs. the matter shall be referred to: Director (HRD&E)Rs. North Eastern Council SecretariatRs. Shillong - 793003Rs. Contact No. 03642522674.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of any of the North-Eastern States. 1. The applicant must be admitted in DiplomaRs. DegreeRs. Post-graduate or registered in M.Phil. / PhD courses of any institute recognized by the Government. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents/guardian (from all sources) shall not exceed 8Rs./-. 1. The applicant must fulfill the following eligibility criteria in the previous qualifying examination: - Level: Diploma; Qualifying Examination: HSLC / HSSLC / Secondary School Leaving / Senior Secondary Leaving certificate examination from a recognized State/Central board with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate. - Level: Degree; Qualifying Examination: HSSLC/Senior Secondary Leaving certificate examination from a recognized State/Central board with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate. - Level: Post Graduate; Qualifying Examination: Degree level examination in any discipline (BA / BSc / BE / BTech / MBBS / LLB / BCA / BBA etc.) of any recognized Institute/ University with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate. - Level: M.Phil. / Ph.D.; Qualifying Examination: PG degree from any recognized University with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate. > **Notes:** 1. In case of a tieRs. preference shall be given to the candidate having a lesser family income. 1. There will not be any reservation/quota on the basis of category/religion/gender. 1. At the time of availing of the scholarshipRs. the applicant must not be in receipt of any other scholarship/financial assistance from any other source. 1. Once selectedRs. the scholarship shall be available to a selected student for the prescribed duration of a course subject to fulfillment of renewal conditions. 1. Extension of scholarship beyond the prescribed period of study will not be entertained. 1. Students enrolled in the integrated courses will be entitled to receive the scholarship for the full duration of the course as per the admissible rates. 1. The scholarship for M.Phil. will be available for 2 years and for the Ph.D. scholarship shall be for 3 years. > **SELECTION FOR SCHOLARSHIPS AND DISBURSAL:** 1. The merit lists will be drawn from among finally verified applications as per the scheme guidelines and after following the laid down procedure on the NSP. 1. Selection of students for M. Phil and Ph. D. will be made on the basis of the topic of research/Synopsis which has relevance to the problems/issues related to the NE Region. The Subjects/topics for M.Phil and Ph.D. should invariably be directlyRs. specificallyRs. and currently relevant to NE Region. Basic and theoretical research shall not be favored in general. 1. The scholarship is purely on a merit basis. The merit list will be prepared exclusively on the basis of marks obtained by the candidate in the qualifying exams and complying with the level-of-course-wise slots allotted to the states. 1. In case the allotted quota remains unfilled for want of eligible candidatesRs. the same may be distributed to remaining eligible students from the other NE StatesRs. as per their inte-rse merit list. 1. The scholarships will be disbursed to selected students by NEC directly in their provided and verified bank accounts using DBT mode as per the extant guidelines. > **RENEWAL OF SCHOLARSHIP:** 1. Every renewal of the scholarship is for a period of one academic year onlyRs. if not otherwise specified. 1. All existing and eligible beneficiaries of the scholarship are required to fill up the renewal form on NSP every year during their entire course period. 1. The student must upload a previous exam marks sheet/pass certificate during the renewal application. In the case of students studying for M.Phil / PhD.Rs. the renewal application shall be accompanied by the latest progress report from the guide countersigned by the Registrar of the Institute. 1. To draw a scholarship under the renewal categoryRs. the beneficiary must pass in the particular year or be promoted to the next semester/year. In case the student could not pass all papers but was promoted to next yearRs. as per extant rulesRs. he/she may be considered for renewal of scholarships subject to the condition that no additional backlogRs. from previous yearsRs. is pending against his/her name. 1. In case the student is not promoted to next year or has backlog papers pending against his/her name for more than one yearRs. he/she shall not receive a further scholarship for the remaining course period. It will be the responsibility of the Institute level verifying officer to ensure that the student has been promoted for a year or does not have pending backlog papers for more than a yearRs. before accepting the application on NSP for further processing. OtherwiseRs. such applications shall be rejected on NSP after recording reasons. 1. Any break in scholarshipRs. during the entire course periodRs. shall make the beneficiary non-eligible for further receipt of the scholarship for that specific course. The students shall not be provided with an option to make renewal applications in subsequent years. The student mayRs. howeverRs. apply as a fresh applicantRs. upon securing admission in any advanced courseRs. at a later stage. 1. A request for renewal of students who have changed their subject of study will not be entertained for renewal if the students have availed of the scholarship for the previous course or part of it. 1. A request for renewal of scholarship of such student beneficiaries who have changed their Institution of study will not be entertained for renewal. 1. There will be no merit list generation for renewal applications. 1. Renewal scholarship will be disbursed to all eligible and duly verified applications by NECRs. directly in their verified bank accounts using DBT mode as per the extant guidelines. 1. The request for renewal of scholarships of all existing applications belonging to Academic Year 2019-20 and before will be processed as per the prevailing procedure during Academic Year 2019-20Rs. where the respective State Government will be responsible for directly disbursing scholarships in the students bank accounts.

name: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
brief_description: The Department of Biotechnology has instituted a scheme known as the Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship. The scheme is aimed at Indian Nationals who are working overseas in various fields of biotechnology and life sciences and are interested in taking up scientific research positions in India. The Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellows would be able to work in any of the scientific Institutions/Universities in the country. The applicant should have a proven/outstanding track record as evidenced by research publications and recognitions. The duration of the fellowship will be for a period of three years. Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellows shall also be eligible for regular research grant through extramural and other research schemes of various S&T agencies of the Government of India. The scheme has been conceptualized with the aim of attracting highly skilled researchers (Indian Nationals) working overseas in various cutting-edge disciplines of any area of Life Sciences & BiotechnologyRs. Bio-engineeringRs. Healthcare (human and animal)Rs. Agriculture and Veterinary biotechnologyRs. Bio-energy and allied areas by providing them an attractive avenue to pursue their R&D interests in Indian universities/institutions.
benefits: **Strong research funding support:** - 10 lakh annually for the first two years - 7.5 lakh annually for the third and fourth years - 5 lakh for the fifth year 1. Attractive consolidated fellowship of 1 lakh per month. 1. Additional 18Rs. per month provided as HRA. 1. Annual institutional support of 50Rs. as overhead charges. 1. Eligibility to seek additional research grants from Government of India science & technology agencies. 1. Fellowship tenure of 5 years with the possibility of a 2-year extension in exceptional cases. 1. During the extension periodRs. fellows continue to receive fellowship and HRA benefits. 1. Encourages independent research while allowing collaboration with a regular faculty member as Co-PI.
eligibility:
1. The Indian working in any area of life sciences & biotechnologyRs. bio-engineeringRs. healthcare (human and animal)Rs. agriculture and veterinary biotechnologyRs. bio-energyRs. and allied areas will be eligible to apply.
1. The applicant should possess a Ph.D/MD degree or equivalent in life sciences/ agricultureRs. bioinformaticsRs. and allied areas or an M.Tech in engineering or technology/ medicineRs. etc. with at least three years of post-doctoral research experience in overseas research laboratories.
1. Those who have already returned to India within one year of the closing date of the advertisement (two years for women candidates) are also eligible to apply; howeverRs. if they have secured a permanent position in India within this period then they are not eligible to apply.
1. Applicants should have a proven/outstanding track record as evidenced by research publications and recognitions.
1. In case a fellow joins a permanent positionRs. the fellowship and HRA components of the scheme will be discontinuedRs. howeverRs. he/she can avail the research grant component of the fellowship for the remaining tenure of the fellowship.
1. The upper age limit for applying is 45 years.
1. Once a candidate is selected for the fellowshipRs. before the initiation of the fellowshipRs. he/she would need to submit a two-member advisory committee comprising one member from his/her host institute and one from another institute in India or abroad from the area of his/her research. The advisory committee will mentor the research work of the fellow and suggest course correctionRs. and their opinion/views regarding the progress of the fellow may also be sought by the committeeRs. whenever required.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Railway Protection Force

benefits:
