Passengers and Passenger Areas or those who died during election work. **Category (II):** Wards/Widows of ex-RPF/RPSF personnel who died while in service. **Category (III):** Wards of ex-RPF/RPSF (retired) personnel. **Category (IV):** Wards of serving RPF/RPSF personnel.

name: Establishment of Small Scale Poultry Unit (Layer) for livestock owner of Daman & Diu
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme "Establishment of Small Scale Poultry Unit (Layer) for livestock owners of Daman & Diu" has been launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. U.T. Administration of Daman & Diu. It aims Economic up-liftmen of the SC/STRs. SMFRs. and BPL Families. Financial assistance in the form of 50% subsidy is provided for the construction of a poultry shedRs. purchase of pullets (1821 weeks)Rs. poultry equipments and feed for 4 months. The scheme beneficiaries can avail the benefit for two years or till becoming self-sufficient. Units must be operated on scientific linesRs. and beneficiaries must supply surplus eggs to nearby schools under the Mid-Day Meals SchemeRs. with fortnightly payment made by the Extension Officer (Dairy) or Veterinary Officer (DP). > **Objectives** 1. Economic upliftment of the SC/STRs. SMFRs. and BPL Families. 1. To provide protein-rich food to the SC/STRs. SMFRs. and BPL through eggs. 1. To provide a regular supply of healthy eggs under the Scheme of Mid-Day Meals to nearby schools.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance In The Form Of Subsidy** 1. Financial assistance in the form of a subsidy shall be provided to the individual beneficiary on the following items: - Construction of poultry shed. - Purchase cost of reared pullets up to the age of 18-21 weeks old. - Poultry equipments. - Purchase cost of feed for the period of 4 months (till the beneficiary starts earning from the sale price of egg produce). 1. Each beneficiary will be provided 50% subsidy to the total cost of the unit (i.e.Rs. total cost of purchase of PulletsRs. poultry feedRs. poultry equipments and construction of poultry shedRs. etc.)Rs. limited to 30Rs./- per unit. 1. The beneficiary will be entitled to get the benefit of the scheme for a period of two years or till he becomes self-sufficient. 1. The financial assistance should be used only for the purpose for which it may be granted. > **Disbursement of Funds** 1. Subsidy will be paid directly to the individual or to the suppliers or to the body supplying goods or to an approved agency or institution. 1. The Veterinary OfficerRs. Daman & DiuRs. would disburse the assistance in the form of a subsidy after completion of the poultry unit in respect of the construction of a poultry shedRs. which should be of low-input technology. 1. Purchase of PulletsRs. feedRs. or equipment directly to the individual supplierRs. bodyRs. or an approved agency or institution. 1. The Extension Officer (Dairy) or Veterinary Officer (DP) will make a fortnightly payment to the beneficiary for the supply of eggs regularly. 1. Subsidy shall be disbursed after completion of the poultry unit. 1. The beneficiary will be entitled to get the benefit of the scheme for a period of two years or till he becomes self-sufficient.
eligibility: 1. The applicant shall belong to SC/STRs. SMFRs. and BPL Families. 1. The applicant must have the back ground of poultry farmingRs. or in other casesRs. the participants must undergo practical training. 1. The applicant must operate the units on the scientific lines as per the technical guidance and services provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant must operate the unit for at least for the minimum period of two years. 1. The applicant shall have to maintain the prescribed records and furnish the prescribed information to the Veterinary OfficerRs. Daman & DiuRs. from time to time. 1. The applicant shall have to follow the Instructions issued by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant shall have to execute a bond to the effect that the aforesaid terms and conditions are acceptable and he/it will abide by all of themRs. failing which he will be liable to be prosecuted as per the existing rules of the Administration. 1. The applicant has to compulsorily sale/supply the surplus eggs to the nearby school under the scheme of Mid-Day Meals.

name: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship
brief_description: The Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities (WISE-SCOPE) Fellowship Program was started by the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India to provide opportunities to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their Science & Technology knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society. This program promotes projects that directly deal with challenges at the grassroots level and address them through Science & Technology interventions. Projects under WISE-SCOPE (WISE-Societal Challenges with Opportunities) should provide Science & Technology solutions to our social problemsRs. livelihood generationRs. drudgery reductionRs. health and nutrition-related issuesRs. management of natural resourcesRs. sustainable agricultureRs. climate changeRs. disaster managementRs. etc. The project proposal should include the development of viable technology/technique with the possibility of lab-to-land transferRs. adaptation and scaling up for the benefit of society under the following identified broad thematic areas. 1. EnergyRs. Water and Waste Management (EWWM) 1. Engineering and Technology Development (ETD) 1. EnvironmentRs. Climate and Sustainable Development (ECSD) 1. Agriculture and Allied Sciences (AAS) 1. HealthRs. FoodRs. and Nutrition (HFN) > **Project Tenure:** The project tenure shall be up to 3 years.
benefits: - **Monthly Fellowship:** Eligible candidates will receive a fellowship amount of 55Rs./- per month along with HRA as per norms. - **Research Grant:** Selected fellows will be provided a research grant of 2.00 Lakhs per year for project-related activities. - **Field Demonstration Support:** Financial assistance of 1Rs./- will be provided for field demonstration during the project tenure. - **Equipment Assistance:** Support for the purchase of small equipment up to a maximum of 2Rs./- will be provided. - **Institutional Overhead Charges:** Institutional overhead charges will be given as per DST norms.
eligibility:
> **Employment:**


- Candidates in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-SCOPE.

**Note 01:** The women scientists who are temporarily employed in research or academics may apply to this program but they have to leave earlier assignmentsRs. ifRs. selected for the WISE-SCOPE program.
**Note 02:** The position of the applicant in any projectRs. as Post-Doctoral FellowRs. Research AssociateRs. etc. will be considered a temporary assignment.
> **Age:**


- The minimum age to apply is 27 years and the maximum is 60 years as of the date of submission.

> **Educational Qualification:**


- Women Scientists who have completed a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences or have equivalent degrees like MD/MS/MDS are eligible for the WISE-SCOPE fellowship.

name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
brief_description: The Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme supports young Indian researchers in gaining industrial exposure at German industries and industrial R&D institutions. The programme is implemented by IGSTCRs. established by the Department of Science and Technology (DST)Rs. Government of IndiaRs. and the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)Rs. Government of Germany. It encourages Ph.D. students and researchers in Science & Technology towards applied researchRs. innovationRs. and technology development. The fellowship aims to strengthen Indo-German industry-academia collaboration and provide opportunities for capacity building and networking with advanced industrial ecosystems in Germany. > **Duration of Fellowship:** - The duration of the Fellowship is 3-6 months. - Extension in duration of Fellowship shall not be entertained.
benefits:
**The financial support will be limited to:**

- The Fellowship amount is 1500 per month.
- Single round trip economy class airfare including visa fees and travel insurance: up to 1000.
- Health Insurance: As per actuals with a maximum limit of 100 per month.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an Indian citizen. - The maximum age limit of the applicant should be 30 years. - PhD students (science/engineering) enrolled in any research institutions/universities in India and completed at least one year of their PhD curriculum can apply for the fellowship. - Young researchers who have completed one year of their PhD course in Science/Engineering from India are eligible. - Young researchers with high-quality research projects that combine innovative approaches towards new concepts and technological development in chosen industrial research set up in Germany may be considered. **Note 1:** The applicant must define a detailed activity plan containing the objectiveRs. execution strategyRs. and expected outcome for the fellowship duration. **Note 2:** The Awardee will be hosted by the industry/industrial research organization for the duration of the Fellowship. Choice and acceptance from the industry/industrial research organization is the sole responsibility of the applicant. The applicant should ensure an endorsement/consent letter from the host industry/organization at the time of the application. **Note 3:** The applicant having institutional affiliation shall submit NOC from the Head of the institution at the time of application. **Note 4:** Applicants shall submit a recommendation letter from the mentor at the parent organization. **Note 5:** The awardee will abide by the conductRs. rules & regulations of the German host organization and the country. IGSTC will not be responsible for the violation of any Rules and regulations by the awardee. **Note 6:** IGSTC will disburse the grant to the Indian bank account of the awardee/parent institution in INR. **Note 7:** The awardee shall commence his/her visit within 3 months from the date of the result. **Note 8:** The awardee/host mentor must inform IGSTC through email/letter if the awardee discontinues the Fellowship before the completion of the tenure. **Note 9:** Within 4 weeks of completion of the FellowshipRs. the awardee must submit a detailed Fellowship completion report endorsed by the host mentor in the prescribed format along with representative photos to IGSTC. **Note 10:** The awardee must recognize and acknowledge IGSTC Industrial Fellowship in all online/print documentsRs. communicationRs. reportsRs. publicationsRs. PhD thesisRs. etc. on work resulting from the Fellowship.

name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship
brief_description: The "Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme" aims to support young Indian researchers by providing industrial exposure in German industries and industrial R&D institutions. The programme is jointly implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST)Rs. Government of IndiaRs. and the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)Rs. Government of Germany. It encourages postdoctoral researchers and fresh PhD holders in Science & Technology towards applied researchRs. innovationRs. and technology development. The fellowship also promotes Indo-German industry-academia and industry-industry collaboration through research networking and advanced industrial exposure.
benefits: **The financial support will be limited to:** - The fellowship amount is 2500 per month. - Single round trip economy class airfare including visa fees and travel insurance: up to 1000. - Health Insurance: As per actuals with a maximum limit of 100/month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen.
1. The maximum age limit of the applicant should be 35 years.
1. Postdoctoral researchers/fresh PhDs who have been awarded their PhD degree in science/engineering within 3 years of the application deadline by any Indian institution/university are eligible to apply.
1. Outstanding researchers not holding a permanent position or having a career break are eligible to apply.
1. Those who have submitted their PhD thesis are also eligible to apply.
1. The Fellowship is granted to work in any industrial research set up in Germany.

**Note 01:** The applicant must define a detailed activity plan containing the objectiveRs. execution strategyRs. and expected outcome for the fellowship duration.
**Note 02:** The Awardee will be hosted by the industry/industrial research organization for the duration of the Fellowship. Choice and acceptance from the industry/industrial research organization is the sole responsibility of the applicant. The applicant should ensure an endorsement/consent letter from the host industry/organization at the time of the application.
**Note 03:** The applicant having institutional affiliation shall submit NOC from the Head of the institution at the time of application.
**Note 04:** Applicants shall submit a recommendation letter from the mentor at the parent organization.
**Note 05:** The applicant not having affiliation with an institution may submit 2 letters of reference.
**Note 06:** The awardee will abide by the conductRs. rules & regulations of the German host organization and the country. IGSTC will not be responsible for the violation of any Rules and regulations by the awardee.
**Note 07:** IGSTC will disburse the grant to the Indian bank account of the awardee/parent institution in INR.
**Note 08:** The awardee shall commence his/her visit within 3 months from the date of the result.
**Note 09:** The awardee/host mentor must inform IGSTC through email/letter if the awardee discontinues the Fellowship before the completion of the tenure.
**Note 10:** Within 4 weeks of completion of the FellowshipRs. the awardee must submit a detailed Fellowship completion report endorsed by the host mentor in the prescribed format along with representative photos to IGSTC.
**Note 11:** The awardee must recognize and acknowledge IGSTC Industrial Fellowship in all online/print documentsRs. communicationRs. reportsRs. publicationsRs. PhD thesisRs. etc. on work resulting from the Fellowship.

name: Prime Ministers Fellowship for Doctoral Research
brief_description: The "Prime Ministers Fellowship for Doctoral Research" is an initiative of the Science and Engineering Research Board under the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India. The scheme supports young researchers to pursue industry-relevant Ph.D. research in reputed institutions across India. It aims to strengthen collaboration between industry and academia in the fields of ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. EngineeringRs. AgricultureRs. and Medicine. Selected fellows receive financial supportRs. industry exposureRs. and mentorship from academic and industry experts. The fellowship is implemented by Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry on behalf of SERB. > **Duration of Fellowship:** **As** per the provisions of the schemeRs. the scholarship is given for a maximum period of four years.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. full-time PhD scholars get double the JRF/SRF fellowship amountRs. as a scholarship.
1. The scheme has the provision to award up to 100 new scholarships every year. One-half of this scholarship comes from the government; the second half comes from a partner company that also works closely with the candidate on the research project.
eligibility: - The applicant should be Indian. - The applicant should be a full-time PhD scholar in any recognized Indian university/institute/research laboratory. - The scholars PhD registration date should not be more than 14 months from the date of submission of application i.e. the applicant should apply within 14 months of PhD admission/registration whichever date is earlier. - The applicant should have a valid industry partner who should be ready to support the research project financially as well as provide guidance and mentorship. - The mutually agreed topic of researchRs. between the applicant and the supporting companyRs. should be innovativeRs. have practical relevanceRs. and have industrial application. - The selected applicant should be willing to work with/in the supporting company as and when required during the project period. - The applicant should not draw any other fellowship after the selection.

name: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
brief_description: The National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities (NFPwD) is a fellowship scheme launched by the Government of India in 2012-13 to increase opportunities for students with disabilities to pursue higher education leading to degrees such as M. Phil. and Ph.D. The scheme is implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC) on behalf of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The NFPwD scheme provides financial assistance to students with disabilities who are pursuing M. Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in any university/institution recognized by the UGC. The fellowship is awarded on the basis of merit and the student's disability certificate
benefits: **The value of the fellowship is as follows:** 1. The fellowship provides financial assistance to students with disabilities to pursue M. Phil. and Ph.D. degrees. 1. The fellowship is awarded on the basis of merit and the student's disability certificate. 1. The value of the fellowship is 37Rs. per month for Junior Research Fellows (JRFs) and 42Rs. per month for Senior Research Fellows (SRFs). 1. The fellowship is awarded for a maximum period of five yearsRs. including the JRF and SRF periods.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a person with disability (PWD) as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016Rs. with at least 40% disability.
1. The applicant must have a valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority.
1. The applicant must have secured admission to an M. Phil. or Ph.D. program in a university/institution recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC).
1. The applicant must have a good academic record.

name: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
brief_description: A scholarship scheme by AICTERs. MoE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. A maximum of two girl children per family are eligible to avail of the benefits. The benefits are provided for a period of maximum of 4 years for first-year admitted students and a maximum of 3 years for second-year admitted students through lateral entry. This scheme is an attempt to give young women the opportunity to further their education and prepare for a successful future by empowering Women through knowledgeRs. skillRs. and self-confidence.
benefits: ** 50Rs./- per annum** for every year of studyRs. i.e. maximum of 4 years for first-year admitted students and a maximum of 3 years for second-year admitted studentsRs. through lateral entry as a lump sum amount towards payment of **college feesRs. purchase of computerRs. stationeriesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. software**Rs. etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a **Girl Student.**1. The applicant must be pursuing either **the First year of the degree course** OR **the Second year of the Degree course through lateral entry.**1. The **annual income of the family** (from all sources) must not be more than ** 8Rs./- per annum** during the current financial year.1. **All eligible girls** (who submit online scholarship form) **from the following 13 Union Territories and North Eastern States** i.e. Andaman and Nicobar Islands (UT)Rs. Jammu and Kashmir (UT)Rs. Ladakh (UT)Rs. Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu (UT)Rs. Lakshadweep (UT)Rs. Arunachal PradeshRs. AssamRs. ManipurRs. MeghalayaRs. MizoramRs. NagalandRs. Sikkim & Tripura will be given a scholarship by AICTE.

name: Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Labour & Employment
brief_description:
Through the Internship SchemeRs. the Ministry of Labour & Employment engage eligible students as Interns" to work for mutual benefit. The Interns shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Department Policy issues in the Government of India and contribute to the Policy/Legislation formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysisRs. briefing reportsRs. policy papersRs. etc.
> **Duration** The duration of the internship will be from two to six months at different points in time in the year.
> **Declaration of Secrecy** Interns will be required to furnish to the Ministry of Labour & Employment a declaration of secrecy before reporting for the internship.
> **Placement** Placement of Interns (total 5 maximum) will be carried out with the approval of the Secretary (L&E)Rs. after their engagementRs. keeping in view their suitability as well as a requirement in the concerned Wing/Division.
benefits:
> **Stipend** The Interns will be paid a stipend @ 8Rs./- per month for the period of internship on certification from the OfficerRs. which the Intern is attached to.
> **Logistic Support** Ministry of Labour & Employment shall provide them with working space and computer with internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads.
> **Certificate of Internship** Certificates will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of their internship and on submission of their Report/Paper and its evaluation by the concerned.
eligibility: - The applicant should be pursuing law [in the last two years of degree course] or Law Graduates or students pursuing Post Graduation in Law or Research Scholars in Law or pursuing MBA / MSW / MSc / MA enrolled in a recognized University/Institution within India or abroad.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme-2
brief_description:
The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) launched the **National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)** on 19th August 2016 to provide financial incentives to the establishments engaging apprentice under the Apprentices ActRs. 1961. **National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme-2 (NAPS-2)** aims to promote apprenticeship training in the countryRs. by providing partial stipend support to the apprentices engaged under the Apprentice ActRs. 1961Rs. undertaking capacity building of the apprenticeship ecosystemRs. and providing advocacy assistance to the stakeholders. It aims at improving ease of doing business by simplifying processes of apprenticeship engagement. NAPS-2 is a Central Sector Scheme (100% funded by the Central Government) and is one of the sub-components under the umbrella scheme of "**Skill India Programme**. The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is responsible for the overall regulationRs. managementRs. and monitoring of NAPS-2.
**Objectives of the NAPS-2 scheme:-**

1. To develop skilled workforce for the economy by promotion of on-the-job experiential training.
1. To encourage establishments to enroll apprentices by sharing partial stipend support to the apprentices.
1. To provide up-skilling opportunities for candidates who have undergone short-term skill training offered by various Central and State Government initiatives.
1. To encourage enrolment of apprentices in small establishments especially MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)Rs. and those located in the underserved areas such as aspirational districts and North-East Region.

**Anticipated outcome of the scheme:-**

1. MSDE aims to train 46 lakh apprentices from FY2022-23 to FY2025-26.
1. The scheme envisages greater promotion of apprenticeship in India and assisting stakeholders through various measures for accelerating the performance of Approved apprenticeship.

**Other important key facts:-**

1. To enhance and track the conversion of apprentices to employmentRs. apprenticesRs. on successful completion of their trainingRs. will be provided with a provision of quick registration on the National Career Service (NCS) portal of Ministry of Labour and Employment.
1. To boost apprenticeship engagement in the ever-growing infrastructure sectorRs. NAPS-2 will be linked to flagship Government infrastructure programs via platforms such as Gati Shakti.
1. Innovative models to preserve and upgrade existing apprenticeship systems in the informal economyRs. with a focus on craftsmanRs. artisansRs. traditional skillsRs. etc.Rs. will be taken up under NAPS-2.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. training will be imparted in Designated Trades (DT) and Optional Trades (OT). **A. Designated Trades (DT)** - Designated Trade means any trade or occupation or any subject field in engineering or non-engineering or technology or any vocational course which the Central Government. - Duration of apprenticeship training in DT for Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) pass-out candidates will ordinarily be one (1) year. - Duration of apprenticeship training in DT for fresher / non-ITI pass-out candidates will ordinarily be two (2) years. - In case of DTRs. notified through the GazetteRs. the duration of basic training will be as per the approved course. **B. Optional Trades (OT)** - Optional Trade means any trade or occupation or any subject field in engineering or non-engineering or technology or any vocational course as may be determined by the employer. - Duration of apprenticeship training for OT will be six (6) monthsRs. nine (9) monthsRs. and twelve (12) months. - In case of OTRs. basic training will be embedded in the course duration of apprenticeship. It will be of minimum two (2) weeks duration before the OJT and will focus on orientation/ induction into the establishment. **Other important facts:-** **1. Stipend Support** Partial stipend support by GoI under NAPS-2 will be limited to 25% of stipend paidRs. up to a maximum of 1Rs./- per monthRs. per apprentice during the training period through DBT to the apprentices bank account. **2. Fund flow mechanism** Establishments pay at least 75% of the stipend to apprentices and GoI pays 25% of the stipendRs. up to a maximum of 1Rs./- per month per apprentice. Partial stipend support by GoI will be transferred directly in the bank account of apprentice through DBT via PFMS. **3. Minimum Rate of Stipend Payable to Apprentices per Month** The minimum rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month as per Rule 11 of the Apprenticeship RulesRs. 1992 and Amendments (up to 2019) is as follows: - School pass-outs (Class 5th Class 9th) - 5Rs./- - School pass-outs (class 10th) - 6Rs./- - School pass-outs (class 12th) - 7Rs./- - National or State Certificate holder - 7Rs./- - Technician (vocational) apprentice or Vocational Certificate holder or Sandwich Course (Students from Diploma Institutions) - 7Rs./- - Technician apprentices or Diploma holder in any stream or Sandwich Course (Students from Degree Institutions) - 8Rs./- - Graduate apprentices or Degree apprentices or Degree in any stream - 9Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Minimum age for an apprentice is 14 yearsRs. and 18 years for designated trades related to hazardous industriesRs. as per Section 3(a) of the Apprentices ActRs. 1961.
1. Apprenticeship training is primarily a transition from academia to workplaceRs. and thereforeRs. to avail partial stipend support by the GovernmentRs. at the time of registration the upper age limit should be 35 years.
1. Candidates from skill development programmes such as Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDUGKY)Rs. National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM)Rs. Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)Rs. etc. will be encouraged to take up apprenticeship training to enhance their skills and employability.
1. Establishments will be able to issue a contract only to those candidates who have updated their Aadhaar numbers and completed e-KYC on the apprenticeship portal.

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana
brief_description:
**Mahila Samridhi Yojana (MSY)** is a scheme aimed to benefit women entrepreneurs from backward backgrounds or poor backgrounds. The scheme was launched as part of the National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. Under this schemeRs. the Corporation bears the training cost and stipend for training that is provided to groups of about 20 womenRs. in suitable craft activities. The group is formed into a SHG and after the trainingRs. micro-credit is provided. This scheme is being implemented by a wide range of channel partners nationwide. Targeted women beneficiaries are identified and given loans either directly or in the form of Self-Help Groups (SHGs). The two main targeted beneficiaries are:

1. **Self-help groups (SHGs):** It aims to strengthen and assist SHGsRs. particularly those that include women. These people make up the autonomousRs. economically disadvantaged category. 1. **Women belonging to economically and socially backward classes (targeted groups):** Women from the underprivileged classes are consideredRs. particularly those who fall under the SC or ST category.
**Objectives of Mahila Samridhi Yojana**

1. To encourage women belonging to minority groups from rural regions and underprivileged classes to adopt an entrepreneurial attitude.
1. To help these women meet their entrepreneurial goals by providing microfinance loans at lower interest rates.
1. To encourage women from scheduled castes or scheduled tribes or any other minority populations to pursue their aspirations.
1. To encourage women to overcome social stigma and gain financial independence.
1. To assist women who are unable to establish their own businesses or careers owing to a lack of financial assistance.
1. It is also a Micro Finance Scheme for women with rebate in interest.
benefits: 1. It is a microfinance scheme for women with a rebate in interest. Financial Assistance up to the cost of 1Rs./- is provided. 1. The repayment period is within 3.5 yearsRs. in quarterly installments from the date of each disbursement including the moratorium period. 1. On repayment of loans under MSYRs. through the concerned State Channelizing Agencies (SCA)Rs. the eligible beneficiaries can avail of any loan under the NSFDC scheme.
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be between 18 to 55 years of age.
1. Applicable to Women from low-income families or women who belong to SC/ST/OBC categories as notified by the Central/State Government and whose family income is less than Rupees three lakhs per annum.
1. Applicable to Women looking to start their own business or engage in income-generating activities.

name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
brief_description: The RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen is a welfare scheme designed to provide financial support to the families of ex-servicemen and widows who are taking care of a completely disabled child. The scheme is administered through the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund (AFFDF) under the supervision of the Kendriya Sainik Board functioning under the Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of Defence.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 3000/- per month (paid annually) per child is provided to eligible ex-servicemen or their widows. - The financial assistance is non-transferable and will cease automatically upon the death of the child.
eligibility: The following criteria must be fulfilled:- - Child must be a legitimate offspring of ESM/Widow. - ESM should be of the rank of JCO/equivalent of the Navy/Air Force and below. - The child should be 100% disabled. - Should not be in receipt of any disability benefit from any official agency. - Should be recommended by respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB).

name: Education Loan Scheme of NMDFC
brief_description: Under this scheme of NMDFCRs. loan is available for job oriented 'technical and professional courses' of durations not exceeding five years. Loan of upto 20Rs./- for domestic courses & 30Rs./- for courses abroad under Credit Line-1 and Credit line -2 is extended to beneficiaries belong to minority communities at 3% p.a. & 8% p.a respectively. FurtherRs. concession of 3% is extended to women beneficiaries under Credit Line-2.
benefits: - Concessional Credit to the beneficiaries among minority communities.
eligibility: a) The applicant must be Indian and belong to one of the six notified minority communities (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. ParsiRs. Jain). b) The annual family income limit is: Up to Rs. 3.00 lakh per annum under Credit Line-1. Up to Rs. 8.00 lakh per annum under Credit Line2. c) The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized institution in India or abroad through a merit-based selection or entrance test. d) The course must be technical or professionalRs. with a duration not exceeding 5 years. e) The applicant must not have availed financial support for the same course under any other Government scheme. f) The loan is admissible for tuition feesRs. hostel chargesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. and travel (for abroad studies). g) The applicant must have a co-borrower (parent/guardian) with a verified income certificate. h) Preference shall be given to female students and candidates from economically weaker sections.

name: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of NE ginger (Ha)
brief_description: The Promotion of Exportable Surplus of Identified Spices in the North East: Cultivation of GingerRs. implemented by the Spices BoardRs. Ministry of Commerce and IndustryRs. Government of IndiaRs. financial assistance is provided at 50% of the cost of planting materialRs. subject to a maximum of 30Rs. per hectare. The scheme is applicable to ginger growers in the North Eastern region with land holdings ranging from 0.10 ha to 8 haRs. including SikkimRs. Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West BengalRs. and other North Eastern states. Designated officials will conduct final inspections and recommend eligible cases.
benefits: - 50% of cost of planting material subject to maximum of 30Rs./- per Ha - Ginger growers of NE having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a ginger grower from SikkimRs. Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West BengalRs. or other North Eastern states. 1. Eligibility is subject to final inspection and recommendation by designated officials.

name: Quality Improvement Programme (QIP)
brief_description: The scheme "Quality Improvement Programme" was launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in the year 1970. One of its primary objectives is to enhance the expertise and capabilities of faculty members in degree and diploma-level institutions across the country. The program is overseen by the All India Council for Technical Education. In the "Quality Improvement ProgrammeRs." only sponsored teachers are eligible for admission to both Master's and Doctoral Degree Programs. The aim is to enable teachers to acquire Master's and Doctoral degrees and instil in them a culture of research and improved educational capabilities by exposing them to the environment of study institutions. > **Category** The Scheme covers the following categories of applicants: 1. Faculty Members of AICTE-approved Polytechnic Institutes (Diploma level) (with a valid Faculty ID of AICTE) for pursuing M.E./M.Tech. programs. 1. Faculty Members of AICTE-approved Degree Level Engineering/Management Institutes (with valid Faculty ID of AICTE) for pursuing Ph.D. programs. > **Duration** - The duration of the Scheme for pursuing Master Degree Programme shall be two (2) years. There is no provision for extension in the programme. - The duration of the scheme for pursuing PhD programme shall be for a period of three (3) Years. NormallyRs. no further extension will be granted. - A delay in joining for Ph.D programme after completion of Pre-Ph.D course workRs. for a maximum of six months can be permitted by the QIP Centre Coordinator. Any delay beyond six months should be reported to AICTE and the candidate should be admitted only after the approval from AICTE.
benefits: > **For Master of Engineering (ME) or Master of Technology (M.Tech) Programs** - Scholarship: 9Rs. per month. - Annual Contingency: 5Rs. per annum. > **For Ph.D. Programme** - Scholarship: 15Rs. per month. - Annual Contingency: 15Rs.. - Pre-Ph.D. Expenses: One-time lump sum amount. - Travel Allowance (TA): 15Rs.. - Daily Allowance (DA): 30Rs. for a Pre-Ph.D. duration of 60 days (no TA & DA if the parent institute and admitting institute are the same). Full Pre-Ph.D. grant for offline work. name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Upgradation of Merit of Scheduled Caste Students
brief_description: The scheme "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Upgradation of Merit of Scheduled Caste Students" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to upgrade the merit of Scheduled Caste students by providing them with facilities for all round development through education in residential or non-residential schoolsRs. addressing their educational deficiencies that prevent them from taking advantage of reservation quotas in technical and professional courses. The scheme provides remedial coaching to remove deficiencies in school subjects and special coaching to prepare students for competitive examinations for entry into professional courses like Engineering and Medical.
benefits: ##### ***Package Grant*** 1. ***25Rs./- per student per year with the following breakdown:*** _15Rs./- per student per year comprising -_ - Boarding and Lodging Charges: 900/- per month for 10 months = 9Rs./- (for residential school students only) - Pocket Money: 300/- per month for 10 months = 3Rs./- - Books and Stationery: 3Rs./- _10Rs./- per year per student -_ - For honorarium to PrincipalRs. Experts and other incidental charges. ##### ***Additional Benefits for Students with Disabilities*** - _Reader Allowance:_ 200/- per month for blind students in classes IX to XII.- _Transport Allowance:_ 100/- per month for disabled students not residing in hostel within educational institution premises.- _Special Pay:_ 200/- per month for hostel employees assisting severely orthopaedically handicapped students.- _Escort Allowance:_ 100/- per month for severely handicapped day scholar students with lower extremity disability.- _Allowance:_ 200/- per month towards extra coaching for mentally retarded and mentally ill students in classes IX to XII. ##### ***Conditions*** *Students must maintain regular attendance and academic performance as monitored by school authorities. *Students must complete the full coaching program from Class IX to XII to derive maximum benefit. *Compliance with the transparent selection and monitoring process established by State Governments.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Scheduled Caste student. - The applicant must be studying in classes IX to XII. - The applicant must be enrolled in schools selected by the State Government under the scheme. - The applicant may be enrolled in class X or XI if he/she has shown excellent performance in the previous examination and missed entry at class IX level for any reason. - The applicant must be from districts selected based on highest Scheduled Caste population and identified as Educationally Backward Districts (for new selections from 2014-15 onwards). ***Preference*** - Girls students are given equal preference with awards allocated in 50:50 ratio between boys and girls. - Unutilized awards by girls may be used by boys and vice-versa. - At least 3% representation for disabled Scheduled Caste students wherever possible.

name: Jute Design Resource Centre Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Jute Design Resource Centre" was launched by the National Jute BoardRs. Ministry of TextilesRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to foster innovation and product diversification in the Jute Diversified Products sector by establishing a centralized design development hub. The scheme provides continuous developmentRs. designingRs. and dissemination of market-worthy modernRs. innovativeRs. and trend-forecasting designsRs. including unit-specific product development on a cost-sharing or free basis.
benefits: - Provides up to 2 free designs per unit per quarterRs. with the cost of raw materials and accessories borne by the National Jute Board on an actual basis. - Offers an unlimited number of designs on a First-In-First-Out basis under the cost-sharing modelRs. where the design ideas and making charges are provided free of cost by the Jute Design Resource Centre. - Grants the exporter or manufacturer the exclusive right to market and sell the developed cost-shared design in the domestic and export market for a period of one year without disclosure to others. - Permits the manufacturer to have full rights to manufactureRs. marketRs. and export the product up to the registered trademark period if a trademark is obtained within the initial one-year confidentiality period. - Provides free technical specification sheets with required technical tips and showcases sample bags in display for reference. - Organises specific workshops or skill training programmes at Patsan Bhavan or at different National Jute Board specified centres without any charges. ##### ***Conditions*** - The exporter or manufacturer must bear the entire cost of trademark registration without claiming any financial assistance from the Jute Design Resource Centre or the National Jute Board. - The exporter or manufacturer must take up legal action with the concerned trademark authorities against impersonating units themselvesRs. as the National Jute Board is not responsible for the copying of trademarked products. - The entire raw material cost and accessories used for developing new jute samples under the cost-sharing basis must be borne by the exporterRs. artisanRs. or manufacturer.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Jute ArtisanRs. a Micro Small and Medium Enterprise unitRs. an ExporterRs. a Women Self Help GroupRs. or a Jute Raw Material Centre & Production Centre trained beneficiary. - The applicant must provide a formal request format for the sharing of jute bag designs developed and stored by the Jute Design Resource Centre. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must maintain confidentiality regarding the technical and design specification sheets provided for trademarked jute products. - The applicant must bear the full cost of trademark registration if they plan to obtain a trademark for the newly developed product. - The applicant must share the cost of raw materials and accessories used for developing the jute designer bags if applying under the cost-sharing basis.

name: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
brief_description: The scheme Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment in 1998-99. The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) to support continuation of their education. It focuses on students from ruralRs. remoteRs. and economically weaker families to help them pursue secondary and higher education. Priority is given to proposals for the construction of hostels for undergraduate students over those below undergraduate level.
benefits: ***1. The cost per hostel seat in different areas under the scheme are as follows:-*** - North Eastern Region: 3Rs./- per seat - Himalayan Regions: 3Rs./- per seat - Rest of country: 3Rs./- per seat **(OR)** as per the schedule of the rates for the concerned State GovernmentRs. whichever is lower. **2.** There will also be a one-time non-recurring grant of 2Rs./- per seat for providing furniture/equipment to the hostels constructed under the Scheme. **3. The funding pattern as per the guidelines are:** - The cost of construction of hostels for Boys has to be shared between the Centre and the State in 60:40 ratio. - There will be 90% central assistance to State Governments in case of Girls Hostels and 10% of cost will be borne by the State Governments. - In case of Union TerritoriesRs. the Central Assistance shall be 100% and for North Eastern States and 3 Himalayan States (Jammu and KashmirRs. Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand)Rs. it shall be 90%. - For Central Universities/InstitutesRs. the share will be 90% by Government of India and 10% by the Central University/Institute for both Boys and Girls Hostels. - The amount of grant will be released in 3 installments in 50:45:5 ratioRs. of which 5% grant will be released after completion of the work and occupation of the rooms by the OBC Boys and Girls. **Note:** The construction work of the Hostel has to be completed within eighteen months from award of work order or two years from the release of 1st installment of Central assistanceRs. whichever is earlier. In no case the time will be extended beyond 2 years. Any cost escalation due to delay in the project will be borne by the State/Institute. Proposals for 2nd installment must be received in this Ministry within one year from the date of release of 1st installment after completing construction work up to roof level.
eligibility:
***Agencies eligible for financial assistance under the Scheme will be as follows:***

1. State Governments and UT Administrations.
1. Institutions or organizations set up by the Central Government as autonomous bodies under a statute (e.g. Central UniversitiesRs. IITRs. NITRs. etc.).

***Location and Capacity of Hostels to be constructed under the Scheme:***
1. While sanctioning hostelsRs. priority will be given to:
(i) Regions/districts not covered so farRs. and
(ii) Districts/towns having a large number of educational institutions.
2. As far as possibleRs. hostels will be constructed in close vicinity of educational institutions.
***Eligibility criteria for students to be admitted to hostels under the Scheme:***
Students fulfilling the following eligibility criteria may be allotted seats in Hostels constructed under the Scheme:

1. Students whose castes are included in the Central/State/UT list of Other Backward Classes and who do not belong to the "creamy layer".
1. Hostels would be essentially for post matric students. HoweverRs. if there are vacant seatsRs. pre-matric studentsRs. especially of the secondary levelRs. would also be eligible to be accommodated.
1. Other thingsRs. being equal preference will be given to OBC students hailing from low-income families.
1. At least 5% of the total seats should be reserved for students with disabilities.

name: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
brief_description:
The PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBCRs. EBC and DNT Students is a sub-scheme under the umbrella scheme namely PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs and Others (PM YASASVI). This scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme which was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of India to provide educational assistance to the students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs)Rs. Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)Rs. and DenotifiedRs. Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is welfare and motivation to the children of these categories by providing financial assistance at the pre-matriculation or secondary stage.
> **Scope:**


- Scholarship under the Scheme will be available for studies in India only and will be awarded by the Government of the State/Union Territory to which the applicant belongs i.e. where he is domiciled.
- The scholarship will be provided for students studying in Government Schools only.
benefits:
> **Coverage Value of Scholarship:**


- The students shall be given a consolidated academic allowance of 4Rs./- per annum.

**Note:** The entire scholarship amount both from the State and Central Government will be paid directly into the account of the students or parents ONLY through DBT preferably through an Aadhaar Based Payment System (Aadhaar Payment Bridge-AePS).
eligibility:
1. The scholarships are open to Nationals of India only.
1. Scholarship award will be sanctioned in the case of students whose parents/guardians income from all sources does not exceed 2Rs./- per annum.
1. The students should be studying in Class IX and X on a full-time basis in Government Schools only.
1. They should belong to either of the OBCRs. EBCRs. or DNT (who are not covered under SCRs. STRs. or OBC) categories through a valid certificate.
1. A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other educational scholarship for the purpose of studying in Class IX and X. If awarded any other educational scholarship for studying in classes IX and XRs. the students can avail of either of the two scholarships as per his/her choice and should inform the awarding authority to the Head of the Institution about the option made.
1. Income Certificate is required to be taken once onlyRs. i.e. at the time of admission to courses.

**Note:** The condition stipulated in this Ministrys Notification No. 428 dated 16.02.2017 relating to provisions contained in Section 7 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and other SubsidiesRs. BenefitsRs. and Services) Act 2016 are to be followed with the further stipulation that ifRs. for any reasonRs. the authentication of Aadhaar fails in respect of any applicantRs. such an individual should be permitted to establish his/her identity by any other means so that genuine persons are not deprived of their benefits.
> **Other Conditions for Award:**


1. If a student violates school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scholarshipRs. the scholarship may be suspended or even cancelledRs. subject to the satisfaction of the competent school authority. The State Government/ Union Territory Administrations can also directly cancel the award if duly satisfied with the reasons for violation of these regulations governing the scheme.
1. Migration of students from one institution to another would not normally be allowed during the course of the academic year except under exceptional circumstances and in the interest of the student's academic career.
1. The scholar obtaining benefits under this scheme shall not be allowed to avail of benefits under any other pre-matric scholarship scheme.
1. Only two boys of the same parents/guardians will be entitled to receive scholarships. This restriction willRs. howeverRs. not apply to girls. AccordinglyRs. scholarships availed by girls of the same parents/guardian will not adversely affect the admissibility of availing scholarships upto two boys of the same parents/guardian.
1. A regular attendance record of not less than 75% in the previous year should be a prerequisite for availing scholarship.
1. At least 5% of students with disabilities should be covered for the grant of the scholarships. 30% of the beneficiaries should be reserved for girl students.
1. If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statementsRs. his/ her scholarship will be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the scholarship paid will be recoveredRs. at the discretion of the concerned State Government. The student concerned will be blacklisted and debarred for scholarship in any scheme forever.

> **Duration and Renewal of Scholarship:**


1. The scholarshipRs. once awardedRs. may be renewed during the next academic year also by the concerned State Government/ Union Territory Administration unless the competent authority of the school recommends to the State Government/Union Territory AdministrationRs. to discontinue the award with reference to the relevant clause of these regulations governing the scheme.
1. The award once made will be payable until the student passes Class XRs. subject to satisfactory academic performance and attendance of 75% in every academic year. The attendance will be verified through an Aadhaar-based attendance System.
1. If a scholar is unable to appear in the annual examination owing to illnessRs. the award may be renewed subject to the production of a medical certificate from a prescribed authority and acceptance of the same by the institution.
1. Scholarship for studying in any class will be available for only one year. If a student has to repeat a classRs. she/he will not get a scholarship for that class for a second (or subsequent) year.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for students with Disabilities - DNH & DD
brief_description: The scheme Scholarships for Students with Disabilities has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of IndiaRs. and aims to provide scholarship assistance and educational support to students with benchmark disabilities pursuing Post-Matric education. Through this schemeRs. financial assistanceRs. tuition fee supportRs. maintenance allowanceRs. and related benefits are provided to eligible students with disabilities studying from Class 11 up to Post-Graduate Degree or Diploma level.
benefits: 1. Scholarship support is available for studies from Class 11 up to Post-Graduate Degree or Diploma level. 1. Eligible courses should be approved by recognised bodies such as: - University Grants Commission (UGC) - National Medical Commission (NMC) - Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) - All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) - State Government or Union Territory Government > **Benefits for Employed/Intern Students:** - Employed or intern students whose combined income with parents/guardians does not exceed the prescribed income ceiling are eligible for all components of the Post-Matric Scholarship. > **Tuition Fee/Coaching Fee:** - Tuition fee or coaching fee is released to the Implementing Agency through a Central Nodal Agency (CNA). > **Maintenance Allowance and Disability Allowance:** - Maintenance allowance and disability allowance are released through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the Aadhaar-enabled bank account of the candidate. - A minimum of 70% monthly attendance is required for eligibility for stipendRs. maintenance allowanceRs. and disability allowance for a particular month. > **Book Allowance:** - Book allowance is released in advance to candidates meeting 50% attendance during the first 10 days. - Other eligible candidates receive the allowance with the first instalment of maintenance/disability allowanceRs. provided they continue with the course. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - Tuition fee/coaching fee is released through the Central Nodal Agency (CNA) to the Implementing Agency. - Stipend and admissible allowances are released through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). > **Frequency of Disbursement** > **Tuition Fee/Coaching Fee:** - First instalment: 50% advance release based on candidates meeting 50% attendance during the first 10 days. - Second instalment: Released on completion of the courseRs. considering candidates attending beyond the halfway mark. > **Book Allowance:** - Released in advance or with the first instalment of maintenance/disability allowance. > **Validity/Conditions:** - Minimum 70% monthly attendance is compulsory for stipend and allowance eligibility. - Aadhaar Number and Unique Disability ID (UDID) are mandatory. - Benefits are subject to scheme guidelines and verification procedures.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a student with a benchmark disability of 40% or more as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. 1. The applicant should possess a Unique Disability ID (UDID). 1. The applicant should possess an Aadhaar Card. 1. The applicant should pursue eligible Post-Matric educational courses covered under the scheme. 1. The applicant should satisfy the prescribed income ceiling criteria. 1. name: National Talent Scholarship Postgraduate
brief_description:
The National Talent Scholarship (NTS) is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) under the scheme "Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India". The scholarship is awarded to students pursuing a Master's degree programme in Agriculture and allied disciplines who are admitted through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) and enrolled in an eligible Agricultural University located outside their State of domicile.
The scholarship aims to promote quality higher agricultural education by providing financial assistance to meritorious students. It is awarded initially for one year and may be renewed for the remaining duration of the postgraduate programmeRs. subject to satisfactory academic performance and conduct.
benefits: 5Rs. per month scholarship for eligible postgraduate (Master's degree) students. > **Note:** No contingency grant is provided under the scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Master's degree programme in Agriculture or allied disciplines. 1. The applicant should have secured admission through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE). 1. The applicant should be enrolled in an Agricultural University located outside his/her State of domicile. 1. The applicant should be studying in an Agricultural University funded under the ICAR scheme "Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India". > **Conditions for Continuation of Scholarship** 1. The student must maintain merit and good conduct as certified by the Head of the College/University/Institution. 1. The student must attend studies on a full-time basis and not undertake any employment. 1. The student must not remain absent without prior permission or participate in strikes/agitations. 1. The student must not receive any other scholarship during the tenure of the programme. 1. The student must not leave the course within one month of admission. 1. The student must not change the discipline/subject for which the scholarship was awarded. 1. The student must not change the University during the tenure of the scholarship. 1. The student must secure a minimum OGPA/CGPA of 7.00 out of 10.00 (6.50 out of 10.00 for SC/ST students). 1. The student must clear all papers in every semester and appear in regular examinations.

name: Hari Om Ashram Prerit Senior Scientist Award
brief_description: The Hari Om Ashram Prerit Senior Scientist Award was established to commemorate the birth centenary of Pujya Shri MotaRs. the founder of the Hari Om AshramRs. Nadiad. It is awarded to an eminent Indian scientist for their innovative and outstanding contributions to the field of Science and Technology. The award comprises a silver plaqueRs. a citationRs. and a cash prize of 4Rs./-.
benefits: - Award Amount: 4Rs./- - Recognition: Silver Plaque and Citation
eligibility: - The nominee should be an Indian citizen. - The nominee should be a scientist. - The nominee's contributions must be in Science and Technology.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities, DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities" by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to support students with disabilities in pursuing educationRs. reducing drop-out ratesRs. and improving participation at the pre-matric level of education. Through this schemeRs. maintenance allowanceRs. book grantRs. and disability allowance are provided to eligible students with benchmark disabilities studying in Classes IX and X. The scheme is implemented in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu AdministrationRs. through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). The scholarship is available to regular full-time students studying in Government schools or schools recognised by the Government or a Central/State Board of Secondary Education. A total of 25Rs. scholarships are sanctioned annually under the scheme. The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Selection is based on merit and other criteria prescribed under the scheme guidelines. > **Objectives:** - To support students with disabilities in pursuing education and preparing themselves to earn their livelihood and find a dignified place in society despite physicalRs. financialRs. and psychological barriers. - To support students with disabilities in their studies so that the incidence of drop-outRs. especially during the transition from elementary education to higher educationRs. is minimised. - To improve the participation of students with disabilities in Classes IX and X and at the pre-matric stage of education.
benefits: 1. Maintenance allowance of 500/- per month for day scholars. 1. Maintenance allowance of 800/- per month for hostellers. 1. Disability allowance of 4Rs./- per annum for visually impaired/intellectual disability students. 1. Disability allowance of 2Rs./- per annum for other disabilities. 1. Book allowance of 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be a student with a benchmark disability and possess a valid Disability Certificate issued by the competent authority under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. 1. The applicant should be studying in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu or should be a bona fide resident of the Union Territory pursuing eligible studies. 1. The applicant's parent(s)/guardian(s) should have an annual income from all sources that does not exceed 2Rs.. 1. The applicant should be one of not more than two children with disabilities from the same parents receiving benefits under the scheme. 1. The applicant may be eligible if the second child is a twin and both twins have disabilities. 1. The applicant should have an active bank account linked to Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). 1. The applicant should not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend for the same purpose from any other source. 1. The applicant should be a regular full-time student and studying in Class IX or Class X. 1. The applicant should be studying in a Government school or a school recognised by the Government or a Central/State Board of Secondary Education.

name: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC students- DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students" launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to support the education of Scheduled Caste students studying at the pre-matric stageRs. reduce school drop-out ratesRs. and encourage continuation of education up to higher levels. name: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers Pre & Post-Matric
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers Pre & Post-Matric" was launched by the Ministry of Labour & EmploymentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide educational scholarships to the children of BeediRs. Iron OreRs. Manganese & Chrome OreRs. LimestoneRs. DolomiteRs. MicaRs. and Cine workers. benefits: ***Financial Assistance Rates*** - Class I to IV (for the purchase of dress/booksRs. etc.): 1Rs./- per annum. - Class V to VIII: 1Rs./- per annum. - Class IX: 2Rs./- per annum. - Class X: 2Rs./- per annum. - Class XI to XII: 3Rs./- per annum. - ITI: 6Rs./- per annum. - Polytechnic: 6Rs./- per annum. - Degree Courses (including B.Sc. Agriculture): 6Rs./- per annum. - Professional Courses: 25Rs./- per annum. ***Mode of Disbursement:*** The benefits under the scheme are transferred through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.
