Required Conditions:


- It is mandatory to link bank account with Aadhaar number.
- The applicant must have a digital caste certificate.
- The result of the student's class 10th examination should be more than 60 percent or 60 percent.

name: The Artist Welfare Fund Of Assam
brief_description:
The scheme "The Artist Welfare Fund of Assam" is a scheme of financial asssistance by the Assam State Film (Finance and Development) CorporationRs. Department of Cultural AffairsRs. Govt. of Assam. The scheme extednds to the whole of Assam.
The Major Objectives of the Fund are: 1. To help the Artists (or their dependents) who are in financial distress due to old age or otherwise handicapped from accident or disease. 2. Medical aid to such Artists and their dependents. 3. Education for such Artists and their dependents (to be limited up two children) 4. Assistance to such Artist in case of accidentsRs. medical emergency etc. 5. 'Dependent' means and includes: Spouse of a deceased Artist; Minor sons and daughters; Unmarried and non-earning daughters; Parents wholly dependent on the Artist.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be and artist in the field of art and culture of the State.
2. The applicant must be above the age of 20 years (in case of applicant being the artist).
3. The applicant should be in distress.
4. The applicant should have a made a mark or made some achievement in the field of art and culture.
5. The applicant should be able to provide artistic credentials supporting his/her achievement.

name: Cycle Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Cycle Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. In this schemeRs. bicycles are provided to the women workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a woman.
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should be a Registered Worker with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.
1. The applicant should not already have availed of the benefits of this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana
brief_description:
**Detailed** Mukhymantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana or MYSY Scholarship is a scholarship scheme that is offered to the economically weaker section students of Gujarat. All those students who wish to pursue higher education like diploma coursesRs. engineeringRs. pharmacy courseRs. medical courseRs. etc apply for MYSY scholarship every year.
**Objective** The main objective of the MYSY Scholarship Scheme is to help those students financially who are not being able to finance their education due to low family income. Through this scholarship schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided to those students so that they can continue their education without any problem.
**Types of Scholarship Under MYSY Scholarship** There are three types of scholarships that are offered under the MYSY Scholarship which are as follows:- 1. Tuition fee grant 1. Hostel grant 1. Book/instruments grant
**Features and Benefits of the MYSY Scholarship** 1. Under the MYSY scholarship schemeRs. non-reserve students will also get financial help for buying books and equipment. 1. Those students who are in Gujarat medical education research society and dental courses will get financial assistance of Rs 10 lakh over 5 years 1. For government jobsRs. there is an age relaxation given to all category students. This age relaxation is of 5 years 1. All those students who wish to appear in the competitive exam will be provided training under training centers. 1. The government will also provide assistance of Rs 1200 per month for 10 months if in that region there is no higher education facility or government hostel. 1. All the students who have passed class 10th and 12th with 80% and have opted for diploma courses will get Rs 25000 per year or 50% fees whichever is less. 1. Under the MYSY scholarship scheme free of cost outfitsRs. reading material etc will be provided by the government
eligibility: **Eligibility** 1. For scholarship in Diploma admissionsRs. the candidate should have passed the Std X from a recognized board from the state of Gujarat with a minimum 80 percentile in the board examination 1. For scholarship in Bachelor's degree programsRs. the candidates should have passed Std XII Science/ General stream from a recognized board from the state of Gujarat with a minimum 80 percentile in the board examination. 1. For Diploma to Degree studentsRs. the minimum eligibility criteria for availing the benefits of the scheme is a 65% mark at the Diploma level examination from a recognized university situated in the state of Gujarat. 1. The candidates whose parents annual income is not more than Rs. 6Rs./- per annum shall only be considered eligible for the said scheme. 1. The State Government has approved the validity of the income certificate for three financial years from the date of issue. AccordinglyRs. a candidate who has a valid income certificate need not have to issue it again for the next three years financial years.

name: Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance To The Cultural Group For Training With New Production
brief_description: Manipur is widely known for its varied traditions and culture belonging to different communities that have been passed on from generation to generation through practice and oral traditions. The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance to the Cultural Group for Training with New Production" by the Department of Art and CultureRs. Govt. of Manipur aims at providing financial assistance to registered cultural groups that have been relentlessly working on providing training to the younger generation with new products to enrich the traditionsRs. art formsRs. and culture.
eligibility:
***Only the residents/domiciles of the state of Manipur are eligible to apply to this scheme.***
> **Eligibility: (Category A)** 1. Registered Groups (for all categories mentioned above) should have already made a minimum of 15 remarkable productions in the last 25 years. 1. Registered Groups (for all categories mentioned above) should have given a performance/show in at least 3 or 4 National Festivals and participated in 3 or 4 State Level Programme. 1. The applicant group (for all categories mentioned above) should not receive any kind of assistance from any other sources for the same purpose.
> **Eligibility: (Category B)** 1. Registered Groups (for all categories mentioned above) should have already made a minimum production of their organization as below: 1. Minimum 5 remarkable productions for the registered group of 3 above 15 years. 1. Minimum 6-10 remarkable production for the registered group of 15 above 25 years. 1. Registered Groups (for all categories mentioned above) should have given performance/show in at least 3 or 4 State Level or National Level Programme 1. The applicant group (for all categories mentioned above) should not receive any kind of assistance from any other sources for the same purpose 1. For Visual ArtRs. Research & Book PublicationRs. and Instrument / Costume MakingRs. individual artists/artists/writers/artisans who have enough knowledge in their respective fields will be eligible. Research & Book Publication should be based on Manipuri culture and also the translation of (a) old manuscripts to modern Manipuri language only (b) the books of other languages on art & culture to Manipuri language which may be used as reference.
> **Method of Selection:** The selection of artists/groups will be done by a Screening / Selection Committee constituted by the Government.

name: Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides a pension of 1Rs./- per month to the registered beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accident.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be a Registered Worker with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accidents.

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief_description:
**Detailed** Under the MMKSY schemeRs. women farmers in Gujarat are provided with financial assistance and training to help them enhance their agricultural productivity and income. The scheme aims to provide a holistic approach towards the development of women farmersRs. including improving their access to inputsRs. creditRs. technologyRs. and market.
Some of the key components of the scheme include: 1. Providing financial assistance for farm activitiesRs. such as purchasing agricultural inputsRs. seedsRs. equipmentRs. etc. 1. Providing training and capacity building for women farmers to enhance their skills and knowledge. 1. Encouraging the formation of women farmer groups and providing support for their collective activities. 1. Providing access to credit for women farmers through various financial institutions. 1. Providing market linkages and support for marketing their produce.
The MMKSY scheme is aimed at promoting women's participation in agriculture and reducing the gender gap in agriculture-related activities. It is expected to benefit around 7 lakh women farmers in the state of Gujarat
eligibility: **Eligibility** 1. Women Farmers: Only women farmers are eligible to apply for the scheme. Women farmers who own or operate agricultural land are eligible to apply. 1. Resident of Gujarat: Only women farmers who are residents of Gujarat are eligible to apply. 1. Age Criteria: There is no specific age limit for the scheme. Women farmers of all age groups can apply. 1. Income Criteria: There is no specific income criteria for the scheme. HoweverRs. preference is given to women farmers who belong to economically weaker sections. 1. Land Holding: Women farmers who own or operate agricultural land are eligible to apply. The size of the landholding is not a criterion for eligibility. 1. Registration: Women farmers have to register themselves with the Department of Agriculture and Co-operation to apply for the scheme. 1. Group Formation: Women farmers can also form groups and apply for the scheme collectively..

name: LIDCOM Education Loan Scheme
brief_description: Being implemented since the year 2009Rs. the "Education Loan Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM)Rs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. finance of upto 20Rs. is provided for post graduate students in the 18-50 years age group from Charmakar Community for studies in India and in abroad. Only the citizens who are a permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply to this scheme. This is a Central Government Scheme and the funding for this scheme come from the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development CorporationRs. New Delhi (NSFDC). The main objective of LIDCOM is to implement various schemes to uplift lifestyle of Charmakars (DhorRs. ChambharRs. HolarRs. Mochi etc.) who are economically weak and below poverty line and with an intention to develop them educationallyRs. economically and socially so as to give them respectable place in Society.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State.
1. The applicant should be from Charmakar Community only (DhorRs. ChambharRs. HolarRs. Mochi etc.).
1. The applicant should be in the 18 to 50 years age group.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than or equal to Rs.3Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have a knowledge of the business for which s/he has applied for loan.

name: Scholarship To 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers Undergoing D.El.Ed Programme At DIETs And CTTC Sohra
brief_description:
The scheme Scholarship to 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers undergoing D.El.Ed Programme at DIETs and CTTC Sohra was launched by the Dept. of EducationRs. Govt. of Meghalaya in AprilRs. 2012. The admission under the scheme shall be made on merit on the basis of marks obtained in the qualifying examination and/or in the entrance test. The purpose of having the entrance test is to tap the interest of the candidates who wish to pursue his/her profession in teaching.
> **Objectives:**


1. To attract the best talent to take up teaching as a profession.
1. To provide high-quality education services to students in rural areas.
1. To ensure that specific areas of the workforce need to be addressed and contribute to enhancing students' learning outcomes.
1. To provide additional resources for DIETs in strengthening areas not covered by the Central Sponsored Scheme (CSS) for teacher education.

> **Structure of Entrance Test:** The entrance test shall consist of a written examination as per the structure below.


1. All questions will be Multiple Choice QuestionsRs. each carrying one mark.
1. There will be no negative marking for incorrect answers.
1. Questions will also test the aptitude of teachers towards the teaching profession.
benefits: This scheme offers a scholarship of 5000/- per month for 2 years (10 months per year) to attract the state's best talent to take up teaching as a profession.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant who wants to become a teacher may apply for the scheme.
1. The applicant should be Class XII passed or its equivalent examination from recognized Boards/Councils with 50% marks with 5% relaxation for ST/SC/OBC/PWD.
1. A candidate waiting for Class - XII results may also apply with the condition that they can produce their provisional/original documents at the time of counseling.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 27 years and age relaxation will be up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per the reservation policy of the government of Meghalaya.

**Note:** There will be block-wise allocation of seats to facilitate the availability of trained teachers locally in the respective blocks.
> **Reservation Policy:**


- As per the Meghalaya Government Reservation Policy for different communities of the state.
- 5% of the seats will be reserved for persons with disabilities.

> **Marks allotment for the counseling:**

Marks with 60 -79% 302Entrance test marks503Personality104Communication Skills105Aptitude & interest towards teaching 206General Knowledge107Maximum Marks150**Note 01:** Waiting list candidates should be selected equivalent to the intake capacity of the institute.
**Note 02:** The number of candidates for each counseling shall be decided by the respective DIETs.
**Note 03:** In case the number of selected candidates is less than the intake capacityRs. in such casesRs. the institution should give preference to the waiting list from other districts as well.
> **Allotment of seats:**

At least 30% of the seats are to be allotted to candidates having Science and Mathematics backgrounds at the Class XII level.

name: NAMO E-Tablet Scheme
brief_description:
**Detailed**

The scheme Stipends to Trainees in Industrial Training Institute was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Special AssistanceRs. Government of Maharashtra for Scheduled Caste students in Industrial Training Institute (ITI).

**Objectives** 1. Establishing an effective seed production chain. 1. Capacity building of state functionaries and livestock owners in forage productionRs. conservation and utilization. 1. name: Partial Travel Support Scheme
brief_description: The Himachal Pradesh Council for ScienceRs. Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE)Rs. has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in an academic or research institution located in Himachal Pradesh for participating in a National/ and International Conference/ Seminar/ Symposium/ Workshop held within India or abroad. The scheme does not provide assistance towards lodgingRs. boardingRs. maintenanceRs. registration feesRs. taxi fare and other costs
eligibility:
1. Educational Qualification: The applicant should have passed at least M.Sc./B.E./B.Tech/MBBS or an equivalent degree from a recognized University/Institute.
1. Age Limit: The applicant's age should not exceed 40 years on the date of commencement of the Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop.
1. Paper Acceptance: The applicant's paper should have been accepted for presentation. The application must include a copy of the full paperRs. an abstractRs. the schedule of the conferenceRs. and an acceptance letter from the organizer.
1. Previous Travel Support: Scientists and Research Scholars who have not received travel support under PATSS in the previous three years are eligible for consideration.
1. International Reputation: The Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop should have an international character and repute. Applications to attend annual meetings of professional societies will not be considered.
1. Publication Requirement: Scientists and Research Scholars must have published at least one paper in a refereed journal to be eligible for consideration.
1. Forwarding of Application: The applicationRs. along with all necessary documentsRs. should be forwarded through the proper channel from the Head of the Institution.
1. Application Deadline: Complete applications should reach the office one month before the event takes place.
1. Research Paper Reprint: The Scientist/Research scholar sanctioned travel grant under the scheme is required to provide one reprint of the research paper presented at the Conference/Seminar/Symposium/Workshop after its publication.
1. Notification of Selection: The applicants recommended by the Committee/Experts will be informed of their selection via email or postRs. using the email ID provided by the candidate.

name: Price Support Scheme
brief_description:
The Price Support Scheme (PSS) is being implemented by the Government of India in the state. Main crops of the state like BajraRs. JowarRs. MaizeRs. PaddyRs. CottonRs. TurRs. MoongRs. UradRs. GroundnutRs. Sesamum WheatRs. GramRs. MustardRs. and Sugarcane etc. are covered. The Department of Agriculture & Cooperation implements the PSS for procurement of oil seedsRs. pulses and cottonRs. through NAFED which is the Central nodal agencyRs. at the MSP declared by the government. NAFED undertakes procurement as and when prices fall below the MSP. Procurement under PSS is continued till prices stabilize at or above the MSP.
Assurance of a remunerative and stable price environment for growers/farmers is very important for increasing agricultural production and productivity. The market price for agricultural produce many times tends to be unstable and volatile which may result into undue losses to the growers and discourage adoption of the modern technology and required inputs.
The Governments price policy for agricultural commodities strives to ensure profitable prices to the growers with a vision of encouraging higher investment and production. This leads to safeguarding the consumer interest by making available supplies at reasonable prices with low cost of intermediation. MoreoverRs. the price policy aims at changing a balance and integrated price structure with respect to the overall needs of the economy. Let us take a look at the Price Support SchemeRs. an initiative taken by the Government to ensure a productive environment for farmers.
eligibility: 1) Farmers get the benefit of the scheme by selling their produce at support price in APMC centers opened by the Nodal procurement agency. 2) Farmers belong to Assam State. 3) Government employees are not allowed to apply to the scheme.

name: Film Finance Scheme
brief_description:
The Film Finance Scheme of Assam plays a crucial role in boosting the regional film industry by providing financial support to filmmakers. It aims to promote the creation of high-quality films that showcase the rich cultural heritage and talent of Assam. The scheme recognizes the importance of cinema as a powerful medium of storytelling and seeks to encourage local filmmakers to produce engaging and impactful content.
Through this schemeRs. filmmakers can access funds at different stages of film production. Financial assistance is provided for script developmentRs. which helps in nurturing creative ideas and developing strong storytelling elements. Funding is also available for pre-production activities like castingRs. location scoutingRs. and production design. Once the film enters the production stageRs. financial support covers various expensesRs. including equipment rentalRs. shootingRs. and production crew wages. Post-productionRs. marketingRs. and distribution costs are also eligible for funding under this scheme.
By offering financial aidRs. the Film Finance Scheme of Assam aims to create an enabling environment for filmmakers to realize their artistic visionRs. enhance the production quality of filmsRs. and promote the growth of the Assamese film industry. It not only supports established filmmakers but also encourages emerging talent to explore their creativity and contribute to the cinematic landscape of Assam.
benefits: Financial assistance at different stages of film productionRs. including script developmentRs. pre-productionRs. productionRs. post-productionRs. marketingRs. and distribution. Support for both feature films and documentaries. Access to professional guidance and expertise. Opportunities for exposure and recognition within the industry.
eligibility: Applicants must be Indian citizens and residents of Assam. The film project should be in the Assamese language or any other recognized regional language of Assam. Filmmakers must have a valid registration with the appropriate film bodies or associations. The applicant should have a bank account in a recognized Indian bank. The film project should have a well-developed script and a compelling storyline. The applicant must demonstrate the feasibility and commercial viability of the project. The project should have a clear budget and financial plan. Filmmakers may be required to fulfill specific reporting and documentation requirements as per the scheme's guidelines.

name: State Welfare Scheme For Purohits

The scheme State Welfare Scheme for Purohits was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural AffairsRs. West Bengal in September 2020 to benefit the financially distressed practicing temple /tribal purohit or priests of other communities like ChristiansRs. JainRs. and Buddhists.
The Purohits and priests of other communities like ChristiansRs. JainsRs. Buddhists & Parsis perform important socialRs. culturalRs. and community functions having wide public ramifications. Considering the very significant roles played by the Purohits and priests of other communities like ChristiansRs. JainsRs. Buddhists & Parsis in our society and in view of their financial conditionRs. the State Government has launched the scheme.

2. A grant of 1Rs./- will be provided to each poor Purohit/poor priest of other communities like Christians/ Jains/ Buddhists / Parsis for the construction of a dwelling house.

name: Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative
brief_description:
**Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative** is a scheme under the Mission Youth to provide financial assistance to youth of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir for establishing their business units with a special focus on high-growth entrepreneurship.
**Objectives:**

1. This scheme is based on the theme Youth Enterprise with Innovation (YouWiN)/ Champion for Innovation program for encouraging young entrepreneurs especially young women towards innovations in various enterprises.
1. Encourage innovation and job creation through creation of new businesses and expansion of existing businesses.
1. The scheme seeks to foster high-growth entrepreneurship through business plan competitions.
benefits:
1. Financial Assistance provided under this scheme shall be provided by J&K Bank as a start-up loan.
1. Assistance under the scheme shall be a minimum 2 Lakhs and a maximum of up to 20 Lakhs including the interest capitalized during the implementation period shall be provided as assistance.
1. There will be no margin money requirement to be paid by the applicant.
1. Selected applicants shall only have to repay the principal amount provided to them as assistance by Mission Youth.
1. Interest component subject to a maximum of 2 Lakh and subject to the condition that the applicant doesnt make any default in repayment of the principal amount shall be paid by Mission Youth.
1. The amount of assistance provided by Mission Youth (MY) has to be compulsorily utilized for the establishment of a Startup only.
1. The bank shall extend the loan facility as per their normal assessment procedure.
eligibility:
1. The scheme is eligible for all those youths whose age is between 18 to 40 years.
1. The applicant must have qualified/passed the XIIth standard or above. 1. Financial assistance shall be provided to youth proposing the creation of a new or expansion of an existing business venture within J&K.
1. Assistance shall be provided to meet the requirements of assets such as plant and machinery and working capital.
1. For candidates seeking assistance for new start-up unitsRs. the concerned youth shall be unemployed and registered with the concerned District Employment and Counseling Center.
1. For candidates seeking assistance for the expansion of existing businessRs. he/she should have an established business for at least 2 years.
1. Non-individual enterprises wherein at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake is held by one entrepreneur subject to the requirement that the entrepreneurs meet the criteria at i and ii of this rule.
1. One person can seek assistance under this scheme only once.
1. 25 percent of the cases to be sanctioned under this scheme in a particular financial year shall be reserved for women.
1. This sub-component of the scheme shall be implemented in collaboration/convergence with JKTPORs. SRLMRs. or any other government organization concerned with women's development as may be decided by CEO Mission Youth from time to time.
1. Sanction of cases under this component shall also be governed by provisions of this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojna
brief_description:
Even today there are many citizens in the country who are unable to get employment even after being educated. In such a situationRs. they have to face many financial difficulties.
In this situationRs. Allowance is provided by the Government of Bihar to the educated unemployed citizens under the Chief Minister Self Help Allowance SchemeRs. so that the citizens of the state do not have to face financial crisis.
benefits: The amount of self-help allowance will be paid to the eligible applicant at the rate of Rs.1000 per month for a maximum period of two years.
eligibility:
1. From the age group of 20 to 25 yearsRs. unemployed young men/women who are not studying and are looking for employment and whose educational qualification is inter (12th) passed from a government-recognized institution located in the state but Have not received higher education.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the district of Bihar stateRs. where he is submitting the application in the district registration centre.
1. The applicant should not have received any kind of allowance/scholarship/student credit card/education loan or any kind of assistance from any other source.
1. The applicant should not get any type of government or non-government employment (contract/permanent/ temporary).
1. The applicant should not be self-employed.
1. The day the applicant gets permanent/temporary employment or self-employmentRs. his eligibility for allowance given under this scheme will end and accordinglyRs. the payment of allowance will be stopped as soon as information is received from him.
1. Unemployed youth/women applying for the amount of self-help allowance will have to compulsorily get training in language communication and basic computer knowledge (skilled youth program) conducted by Labor Resources Department and they will get a total amount of self-help allowance for the last 5 months will not be released until they successfully surrender the certificate of the said training.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
brief_description: The scheme Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for General Category People was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State. Under the schemeRs. each beneficiary should purchase 10 female goats and 1 male goat and the beneficiary has to contribute 50% of the unit cost of the scheme for foodRs. waterRs. fodderRs. residenceRs. and concentrates expenses. **Terms and conditions of the scheme:-** - The beneficiary has to purchase goats unit within 90 days of pre-approval of the online application. If the beneficiary fails to establish the goat unit within the time limit or proves disabled then the approval order given to the beneficiary will be canceled and the approval order will be given to the beneficiary who is next in the waiting list. - The beneficiary has to give his/her photograph with the goats unit. - In general circumstancesRs. the unit should be run for 3 years. - Beneficiary has to note the record of milk production and has to give register and information during the visit of the department technical officer.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. each beneficiary should purchase 10 female goats and 1 male goat. 1 to 2 years old female goat and 2 to 3 years old buck should be bought.
2. Under this schemeRs. the subsidy will be given 50% of the unit cost of the scheme (Maximum 45Rs./-) for foodRs. waterRs. fodderRs. residenceRs. and concentrates expenses.
eligibility: 1. This scheme can be applicable only to the adult beneficiaries of the general category people of Gujarat State. 2. The benefit has provided to only one person per family. 3. The Beneficiary has to give his/her photograph with the goats unit. 4. In general circumstancesRs. the unit should be run for 3 years. **Note 01:** The beneficiary has to purchase goats unit within 90 days of pre-approval of the online application. If the beneficiary fails to establish the goat unit within the time limit or proves disabled then the approval order given to the beneficiary will be cancelled and the approval order will be given to the beneficiary who is next in the waiting list. **Note 02:** The Beneficiary has to note the record of milk production and has to give a register and information during the visit of the department technical officer.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh by merging three ongoing protection based Departmental schemes namely Sour BadhbandiRs. Anti-Hail Net Structure & Green House Renovation Scheme into a single scheme having a common objective.
**The three components of the scheme are as under:**
**1. Sour Badhbandi (Solar Fencing):** Monkey and wildlife menace causes huge losses to crops annually in the State. The present practice of crop protection by manual guarding did not ensure 100 percent crop protection. Now the scheme has been merged under the Scheme Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana in the name of Solar Fencing. Under this schemeRs. a subsidy of 85% is being provided if three or more farmers opt to install solar fencingRs. and if farmers opt to install solar fencing on individual land then an 80% subsidy is being provided. The fence is energized with the help of solar power. Current fences around the farms will be sufficient to keep away stray animalsRs. wild animalsRs. and monkeys from the farms.
**2. Anti-Hail Net Structure:** Hailstorms in Himachal Pradesh are one of the major natural calamities resulting in substantial economic loss to the farmers by damaging standing vegetable crops both quantitatively as well as qualitatively. In order to mitigate the losses caused by hail storms the new scheme Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana (Anti-Hail Net Structure) was started by the State Government in 2020-21 and implemented through the Department of Agriculture. Now the scheme has been merged under the Scheme Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojna in the name of Anti Hail Nets. The schemes will primarily benefit farmers helping them to substantiallyRs. reduce the quantitative and qualitative losses to their vegetable produce. Financial assistance maximum of up to 80% is being provided to the eligible farmer for an area coverage maximum of up to 5000 sqm. The monetary gains are expected to be approximately 15-20 crores annually with significant contributions to the state GDP.
**3. Green House Renovation Scheme:** Farmers of the state have demanded that there should be a scheme to replace the Poly sheets. ThereforeRs. the Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme Mukhya Mantri Green House Renovation Scheme in the year 2017-18. Now the scheme has been merged under the Scheme Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana as a component namely Green House Renovation. Under this schemeRs. 70% assistance is being provided to the farmers for the replacement of poly sheets after 5 years of setting up of polyhouse or damage due to natural calamities.
benefits:
1. **Sour Badhbandi (Solar Fencing):** Under this schemeRs. a subsidy of 85% is being provided if three or more farmers opt to install solar fencingRs. and if farmers opt to install solar fencing on individual land then an 80% subsidy is being provided.
2. **Anti-Hail Net Structure:** Financial assistance maximum of up to 80% is being provided to the eligible farmer for an area coverage maximum of up to 5000 Square Meters.
3. **Green House Renovation Scheme:** Under this schemeRs. 70% assistance is being provided to the farmers for the replacement of poly sheets after 5 years of setting up of polyhouse or damage due to natural calamities.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. All the farmers of the state of Himachal Pradesh.
1. Priority will be given to small and marginal farmers for giving benefits of the scheme.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
brief_description:
The scheme Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm for Schedule Caste was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat to provide supplementary income to Schedule Caste People of the society. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries will have to bring 100 low-input broiler birdsRs. poultry feedRs. and water & feed utensils. The subsidy will be given 75% (maximum 27000/- cash in direct bank account) to the eligible beneficiary.
**Terms and conditions of the scheme:-**

- The beneficiary should have taken poultry-keeping training.
- Eligible applications will be sanctioned by the Regional joint director.
- The beneficiary should have either its own land or he will have to take land for two years on a lease base.
- The beneficiary will have to prepare a poultry shed having a capacity of 100 Sq. feet.
- The birds will be given vaccination regularly.
- As and when birds get infectedRs. they should be given treatment immediately.
- As and when the Government officer visits the farm the beneficiary will have to show income and expenditure statement.
- In normal casesRs. the unit will have to maintain for two years.
- In all terms and conditionsRs. the final authority will be the Director of Animal HusbandryRs. Gujarat StateRs. Gandhinagar.
benefits:
1. Subsidy will be given 75% of the total unit cost (maximum 27000/-) to the beneficiary for the establishment of 100 Broiler birds' Unit.
2. The subsidy amount is directly credited into the bank account of the beneficiary.
3. The birds will be given vaccination regularly.
eligibility:
- The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of Schedule Caste people of the society of Gujarat State.
- The beneficiary will have to provide income proof and a caste certificate along with the application.
- Females and beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given priority.
- The beneficiary should have taken poultry-keeping training.
- The beneficiary should have either his/her own land or will have to take land for two years on a lease base.
- The beneficiary will have to prepare a poultry shed having a capacity of 100 Sq. feet.
- The beneficiary will have to bring 100 low-input broiler birdsRs. poultry feedRs. and water & feed utensils.
- As and when the Government officer visit the farm the beneficiary will have to show income and expenditure statement.
- In normal casesRs. the unit will have to maintain for two years.

name: Chief Minister Kanya Utthan Yojana
brief_description:
This scheme is to stop female feticideRs. encourage girl birthRs. encourage birth registrationRs. complete vaccination of 02-year-old girlsRs. increase the gender ratioRs. reduce girl child mortality rateRs. promote girl educationRs. Curb child marriageRs. reduce the total fertility rate and bring girls into the mainstream of society by making them self-reliantRs. as a result of which girls will contribute significantly to the development of family and society.
**The objective of the Scheme:**

1. Stopping female foeticide.
1. To encourage the birth of a girl child.
1. To increase the sex ratio.
1. To encourage birth registration.
1. Complete vaccination of 2-year-old girls.
1. To reduce the girl-child mortality rate.
1. Promotion of girl child education.
1. To curb child marriage.
1. Bringing down the total fertility rate and bringing the girl child into the mainstream of society by making her self-reliant.

**Management of scheme funds:**
Funds will be arranged for this scheme by the state governmentRs. under this the amount will be made available to the Assistant DirectorRs. District Child Protection Unit from the Directorate of Social Welfare. After which the amount will be transferred to the bank account of the beneficiary's parent/ guardian by the Assistant DirectorRs. District Child Protection Unit.
benefits:
**Target Group** 1. To the girl child born from the date of issue of notification. 1. Given only to two girl children of the family. 1. Payable to a family resident in Bihar.
**Nature of Grant:** 1. Rs. 2Rs./- will be transferred to the Parents/guardians of every girl child in the age group from 0 to 1 year. 1. After the completion of 1 year of the girl child and Aadhaar registrationRs. the amount of Rs. 1Rs./- will be payable again in the same account.
eligibility:
1. The girl children should be residents of Bihar.
1. The birth has been duly registered.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be payable to the girl child born from the date of issue of the notification.
1. This benefit will be given only to two girl children of a family.
1. On the first day of the date of the beneficiary application of the schemeRs. Rs. 2Rs. and for the second child of 1-2 yearsRs. Rs. 1Rs. will be payable to the mother/father/guardian of the girl child after fulfilling all the prescribed conditions.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana" was introduced by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. and aims to provide a grant at the time of marriage to girls from BPL and other economically disadvantaged familiesRs. to offer financial assistance to their families during the marriage. Under the schemeRs. girls are encouraged to complete their educationRs. and upon getting married at the appropriate ageRs. they receive financial assistance from the government. This initiative aims to raise awareness among the publicRs. thereby contributing to an increase in the literacy rate of Bihar. With the introduction of this schemeRs. the state government has also made a concerted effort to curb social evils like dowry and bring about a positive change in societal mindset.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. an amount of 5Rs./- will be given at the time of marriage of the girl child.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a girl who is 18 years of age or older at the time of application. 1. The applicant should be a native of Bihar. 1. The applicant's family should be Below Poverty Line (BPL) card holders. 1. The annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed 60Rs./-. 1. The applicant should be marrying a boy who is 21 years of age or older.

name: Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award
brief_description:
The scheme Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat on 30.10.1995. In the field of AgricultureRs. this scheme has been set up by the state government for the farmers of the state who produce good quality yield by their innovative idea and by their own courage as well as research new technique in the agriculture field. The scheme has been implemented by the State government to honour and appreciate farmers contribution to the development of agriculture to encourage and accelerate agricultural production. This award is given in five different categories/subjects.
**Different categories of the award are as below:**

- **SUB-1:** Develop a new variety by farmers' own innovative skill in all the main crops of Gujarat like CerealRs. Oilseed cropRs. pulseRs. cottonRs. sugarcaneRs. tobacco as well as Horticulture crops and spices and condimentsRs. etc.Rs. and introducing successfully new crops instead of traditional crops grown in the state. - **SUB-2:** Achievement in model agriculture by producing higher yield through modern irrigation methods with water management and utilization of irrigation water as well as raising the water table of well/tube well by recharging well/tube well with harvesting rainwater - **SUB-3:** Achievement for success in dry farming by developing techniques for drought - **SUB-4:** Develop new methods of Integrated Pest Management for different crops - **SUB-5:** Development of innovative farm equipment for different methodsRs. such as cultivationRs. inter-cultivationRs. weedingRs. spacingRs. harvestingRs. threshingRs. or other types of farming.
benefits:
- In this scheme every year 51000/- is awarded with the shawl and certificate to the farmer who gains the first position in each category and also first five farmers from each category are appreciated with the shawl & certificate.
- In addition to thisRs. farmers as in the form of encouragement are appreciated by giving shawls & certificates for the special work done in the field of beekeepingRs. poultry farmingRs. fisheriesRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The farmer should be a permanent resident of Gujarat State.
1. The farmers either Male or Female who possesses Agriculture land in Gujarat are eligible to apply for this scheme.

name: Leprosy Pension Scheme
brief_description:
Leprosy Pension Scheme has been started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Uttar Pradesh.
The main objective of the scheme is to provide a grant-in-aid for the maintenance of persons with disabilities and leprosyRs. whose family income is not sufficient for them.
benefits: The rate of grant per beneficiary per month will be Rs. 3000/- who became disabled due to Leprosy.
eligibility:
1. It is necessary to be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Disabled due to leprosy (with any percentage of disability).
1. Persons with disabilities due to leprosy may belong to any age group.
1. Must be below the poverty and should be under Rs. 56Rs./- per annum for urban and Rs. 46Rs./- per annum for rural areas.
1. Are not taking advantage of other pension schemes.

name: Divyang Pension Yojana
brief_description: The pension scheme has been started by the state government to provide some financial assistance per month to the disabled person. This will help them a lot in running their livelihoodRs. and the standard of living will be better. The pension amount given to them per month by the government is increased from time to time.
benefits: The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities provides a grant at the rate of Rs. 1Rs./- per month per beneficiary
eligibility:
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years or more.
1. Applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Should have a minimum of 40 percent disability.
1. The person getting pension/grant/assistance under the applicant's old age pensionRs. widow pensionRs. socialist pension or any other similar scheme and the person receiving free maintenance in government institutions/homes should not be eligible.
1. The annual income of the applicant or his family is within the definition of the poverty line (currently fixed at Rs. 46Rs./- in rural areas and Rs. 56Rs./- per family per year in urban areas) will be eligible for the grant.

name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana was launched by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/MinoritiesRs. Government of NCT of Delhi vide Cabinet Decision No.2526 Dated 12-12-2017.
**Objective:**
The objective of the scheme is to provide quality coaching for economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs) candidates to enable them to compete in Competitive examinations and succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in the Public/Private sector.
**The courses for which the Coaching will be imparted shall be as follows:**

- Group A and B examinations are conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)Rs. the Staff Selection Commission (SSC)Rs. various Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)Rs. and Judicial Services Examination.
- Group A and B examinations conducted by the State Public Service Commission;
- Officers Grade examinations conducted by BanksRs. Insurance CompaniesRs. and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
- Premier Entrance Examinations for admission in (a) engineering (e.g. IIT-JEE & AIEEE)Rs. (b) Medical (e.g. AIPMT)Rs. (c) professional courses like Management (e.g. CAT) and Law (e.g. CLAT) and (d) such other disciplinesRs. Government may decide from time to time.

**Quantum of Fee:** The admissible coaching fee in respect of various courses would be as under:-
S**l. No.****Name of course for which coaching to be provided****Duration of Coaching****Maximum ceiling of Coaching fee paid to institution (inclusive of both govt. as well as student share) per candidate (in )**1Civil Service (Preliminary)/State Civil Services (Preliminary)Minimum 5 Months40Rs.Civil Service (Mains)/State Civil Services (Mains)Minimum 4 Months40Rs.Entrance examinations for EngineeringRs. MedicalRs. MBARs. and other professional coursesMinimum 4 Months40Rs.Other Group A&B examinations conducted by UPSCRs. State Public Service Commissioners (SPSCs)Rs. Group B Examinations conducted by SSC and (SPSCs)Minimum 4 Months30Rs.Officers Grade examinations for recruitment in the BanksRs. LICRs. GICsRs. PSUsMinimum 4 Months30Rs.**The ratio of the Candidates:**
The ratio of students who have completed their studies from Govt. and Private Schools to be coached under the Scheme will be 75:25.
benefits:
1. A monthly stipend of 2500/- per student will be paid for local students for attending the coaching classes.
1. Under the schemeRs. 75% of the admissible coaching fee amount is to be provided by the Government and the remaining 25% is to be borne by the students.
1. In case of students having a total family income of up to 2.00 lacsRs. a full admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt.

**Note 01:** The institute would have to pay a stipend to each student on a monthly basis through PFMS/ ECS or cheque. Cash payment would not be allowed.
**Note 02:** Benefits under the scheme can be availed by a particular student not more than twiceRs. irrespective of the number of chances; he/she may be entitled to in a particular competitive examination. HoweverRs. only 50 % of the admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt. for students who avail of 2nd time coaching facility under the scheme. The coaching institution will also be required to take an undertaking from the students that they have not taken benefit more than twice under the scheme.
eligibility:
**Eligibility criteria for students:**

1. Only students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category residing in Delhi & who have passed 10th and 12th class (or studying in class XII) from the schools in DelhiRs. having a total family income of not more than 6.00 lakh per annum will be eligible under the scheme.
1. The students must have secured a prescribed percentage of marks in the qualifying examinations for which free coaching is proposed to be imparted under the scheme.

**Note 01:** Sponsoring Department may also nominate some needy students for coaching under the selected institutions.
**Note 02:** Income and Caste Certificates issued by the office of the concerned District Magistrate should be obtained from the Students by the selected institutes.
**Note 03:** Where examination is conducted in two stages viz. Preliminary and MainRs. the candidates will be entitled to free coaching for both examinations. They will be entitled to free coaching for both Preliminary and Main examinations at their convenience. HoweverRs. there will be no restriction on the number of chances for coaching for interviewRs. if the candidate is selected for interview.
**Note 04:** The selected students shall have to attend all classes. In the event of any student remaining absent for more than 15 daysRs. without any valid reasonRs. the benefits of free coaching to him/her shall be discontinued and another student shall be taken in his/her place.
**Eligibility criteria for applying for Empanelment of Coaching Institutions:**

1. The institute should be a registered body or run by any organization registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860/ Companies ActRs. 2013Rs. or any other relevant Act of the State/Union Territory.
1. The institute should have experience of at least 3 years as of the date of notification inviting applications from institutions for empanelment by the Department.
1. The institute should have been fully functional for a minimum period of 3 years at the time of applying under this scheme and having a minimum enrolment of 100 students in the courses each year for at least two yearsRs. immediately prior to the year in which selected for empanelment.
1. The institute must have the proper infrastructure to meet the entire requirement for providing quality coaching in the courses applied.

name: Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme For Women Farmers And Farmers
brief_description: The scheme Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme for Women Farmers and Farmers was started by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of Gujarat. This Scheme is sanctioned under a gender audit programme for more productive varieties and a training-n-education programme for farmers. NowadaysRs. women have become very sensitive in all developing fields. MoreoverRs. there is a significant role of women farmers in agricultural activities. SoRs. the Government of Gujarat sanctioned a programme of "Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme for Women Farmers in the year: 2012-13. Afterward in the year 2013-14Rs. the government sanctioned this programme jointly. Under this programmeRs. selected women farmersRs. male farmersRs. and youth have been trained-n-guided in agricultural and allied aspects of the scientific method. MoreoverRs. they have informed the developing scheme of the state and central levels. During the year 2018-19Rs. this scheme has sanctioned on Date: 11-04-2018. The training activities of the same programme are as under: **Training Activities :** - Pre-Seasonal Camp (Village Level) - Institutional Training Course (Four Days) - Training for Youth (Five Days) - Sharing Followup Camps (Village Level) - Krishimela (Krishi StallsRs. CompetitionRs. Seminar) - In State Educational Inspiration Study Tour (For 7 Days) - Out of the Educational Inspiration Study Tour (For 10 Days) - International Educational Inspiration Study Tour (For 10 Days) - State-Level Sharing Workshop
benefits:
1. Selected women farmersRs. male farmersRs. and youth have been trained-n-guided in agricultural and allied aspects of the scientific method.
1. The latest information on agricultural aspects will be provided to the selected applicant under this scheme.
1. The selected applicants have informed the developing scheme of the state and central levels.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Gujarat State.
1. The farm families of women farmersRs. male farmersRs. and youth are eligible to apply.

name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana
brief_description:
Women empowerment is the commitment of the state government. In view of the aboveRs. it has been decided by the state government to implement the "Kanya Sumangala Yojana".
The main objective of Kanya Sumangala Yojana is to end female feticideRs. establish an equal gender ratioRs. stop the malpractice of child marriageRs. and improve the health of girls. And to encourage educationRs. help in making girls self-reliantRs. to develop positive thinking in the society towards the birth of a girl child."
benefits: Kanya Sumangala Yojana will be applicable in six categories. The categories of beneficiary classification and distribution of funds for them are determined as follows:- First PhaseAt the birth of a girl child.Rs. 2Rs./- lump sumSecond PhaseAfter complete vaccination of the girl child up to one year. Rs. 1Rs./- lump sumThird PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in first classRs. 2Rs./- lump sumFourth PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in class VIRs. 2Rs./- lump sumFifth PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in class IXRs. 3Rs./- lump sumSixth PhaseSuch girls who have passed class 12th and have taken admission in graduation or diploma courses of 02 years or more duration.Rs. 5Rs./- lump sum
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary's family should be a resident of Uttar Pradesh and have a permanent residence certificateRs. in which Ration Card / Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / Electricity / Telephone bill will be valid.
1. The maximum annual family income of the beneficiary should be 3Rs./-.
1. Maximum of two girls in a family will be able to get the benefit of the scheme.
1. There should be a maximum of two children in the family.
1. If a woman has twins from the second deliveryRs. the benefit will also be admissible to the girl child as the third child. If a woman has a girl child from the first delivery and only two twin girls from the second deliveryRs. then only in such a situation the benefit will be admissible to all three girls.

name: Paternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Paternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 21Rs./- (i.e. 15Rs./- for proper care of the newborn baby and 6Rs./- for nutritious food for the wife) will be given to registered male construction workers as paternity benefits. FurtherRs. the paternity benefits under the scheme will be given to registered male workers on the birth of child up to two children but expandable up to the birth of three daughters irrespective of the order of their birth.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 21Rs./- (i.e. 15Rs./- for proper care of the newborn baby and 6Rs./- for nutritious food for the wife) will be given to a registered male construction worker whose wife has delivered a baby.
1. The paternity benefit is given to the male registered worker for up to two children but is expandable up to the birth of three daughters irrespective of the order of their birth.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a male construction worker.
1. The male worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one-year regular membership.
1. Only the registered worker whose wife has delivered a baby is eligible to avail of the benefits under the scheme.
1. The wife of the registered worker has not claimed the maternity benefit from any other employer.

**Note 01:** The benefits of the scheme will be given on the birth of child up to two children but expandable up to the birth of three daughters irrespective of the order of their birth.
**Note 02:** It is mandatory to submit all the documents to the competent authority within a period of one year from the date of delivery of the wife.
**Note 03:** After the birth of the childRs. it is necessary to attach the birth certificate along with the application.

name: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
brief_description:
The scheme Financial Assistance Scheme for Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination to Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward ClassesRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. the state government will provide financial assistance to the Scheduled Caste and Backward Classes boys/girls who are unable to avail of the coaching facilities for IAS and other higher services competitive examinations because of their weak financial position.
This scheme has been modified w.e.f 01.06.2009. Under the amended SchemeRs. a committee headed by the SecretaryRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes has been constituted which will determine the duration of coaching and quantum of fees for different examinations keeping in view the market rates. Under the schemeRs. earlier the financial assistance up to 10Rs./- was being given. The income ceiling under the scheme has also been enhanced from 1.00 lacs per annum to 2.50 lakhs per annum.
**Objectives:**

- The objective of the scheme is to enable Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes candidates to avail postal/class room coaching for civil services Examinations like IFSRs.IAS & Allied Services and any other services examinations conducted by the PSC/HPSC/LIC/GIC/ RRB/ BRB etc. and any other recruiting agency of State and Central Govt. in various private professional institutions. Beside thisRs. personalRs. postal coaching for pre- Entrance examination will be provided in PMT/PET and any other coaching for interview will also be got provided from private institutions.
- Finishing courses/job-oriented courses for employment in the private sector like ITRs. Bio-technology.

**Implementing Agencies:**
The scheme will be implemented through the reputed institutions situated in Haryana and other parts of India.
**Funding Pattern:**
The financial assistance will be released directly to the concerned institutions. The amount shall be released in two installments. First installment of 30% shall be released immediately after the joining of the candidate for coaching and second installment of 70% shall be released after the satisfactory completion of the course by the candidate.
**Quantum of Fee:**
The Committee will decide the fee structure for different examinations as well as duration of coaching after getting the market feedback every year. AccordinglyRs. it will vary from time to time.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. the Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes candidates will be entitled to free coaching for IAS and other higher services competitive examinations. 1. The Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes candidates can avail of postal/classroom coaching for civil services Examinations like IFSRs. IAS & Allied ServicesRs. and any other services examinations conducted by the UPSC/HPSC/LIC/GIC/ RRB/ BRBRs. etc.Rs. and any other recruiting agency of State and Central Govt. in various private professional institutions. 1. The personalRs. postal coaching for pre- Entrance examination will also be provided in PMT/PETRs. and any other coaching for interviews will also be got provided from private institutions. 1. Benefit under the scheme can be availed by a particular candidate two timesRs. irrespective of the number of chances he/she may be entitled to in a particular competitive examination.
eligibility: **Eligibility of students:** 1. The student should be a domicile of Haryana & must belong to a Scheduled caste/Backward Class. 1. The annual Income of the parents/guardians Should not exceed 2.50 lacs. 1. The candidate should possess all the requisite qualifications required for the examination. 1. The candidate will not be permitted to avail of more than two chances for a particular competitive examination. **Note 01:** The selected candidates shall have to attend all classes. In the event of any student remaining absent for more than 5 days at a time maximum of 15 days during the entire course without any valid reasonRs. benefits of free coaching to him/her shall be discontinued and another candidate shall be taken in his/her place. **Note 02:** Depending on the budget allocationRs. the total number of students should be fixed in advance and distributed among the agencies; it should not be left open-ended. **Note 03:** This scheme will be applicable and available for only those courses which are not covered by any other Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes run by other departments. **Selection of reputed institutions:** 1. The DirectorRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes DepartmentRs. Haryana will invite proposals from the implementing agencies directly every year. 1. The proposals received from the implementing agencies will be considered and finalized by a committee consisting of the following: - Chairman: Secretary to Govt. HaryanaRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes And Backward Classes Department. - Member-Secretary: DirectorRs. Welfare of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes DepartmentRs. Haryana - Member: Deputy DirectorRs. Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes DepartmentRs. Haryana - Member: District Welfare Officer (concerned District)

name: Beej Swalamban Yojna
brief_description:
The main objective of starting the Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana is to provide up to 50% subsidy by the Agriculture Department for providing seeds to the small and marginal general farmers of the state. Apart from thisRs. free mini kits are to be provided to the farmers living below the poverty line. So that the farmers of the state take steps towards prosperity and self-reliance by producing seeds in their fields. And they can be encouraged to produce seeds for use in their farm. By getting the benefit of this schemeRs. farmers will be able to produce good crops at low cost. Due to this their economic condition will also increase. This scheme of state funds was started as a pilot project in the KotaRs. BhilwaraRs. and Udaipur agriculture blocks of the state. By expanding the scheme from the year 2018-19Rs. the scheme is being implemented in all the blocks of the state.
Under the plan:- 1. **Selection of crop:**- Seed production program of notified varieties of jowarRs. soyabeanRs. groundnutRs. moongRs. mothRs. and urad in the Kharif season and wheatRs. barleyRs. and gram crops of less than 10 years duration in the Rabi season.1. **Formation of farmers group**:- Under the schemeRs. a group is formed by selecting farmers who are progressive and interested in the cultivation of a particular crop. Selection of 30 to 50 farmers in each groupRs. by whom the area sown of that crop would be generally 50 to 100 hectares.1. **Selection of seed producer members in the group:**- As per requirementRs. 2-4 seed-producing farmers are selected from the farmer group by the group itself. The rest of the group will be those farmers who will use the above-produced seeds for sowing in the coming year.1. **Free seed distribution**:- Provision to make available the desired base/certified seeds (Stage-I) free of cost to the seed-producing farmers of each farmer group.1. **Training and Rogging for seed production:**- There is a provision to spend Rs.30/- per farmer and a maximum of Rs.1500/- per training on one-day training of a group. Three one-day training programs are organized to give complete information about the seed production process to the farmers of the group. Payment to be made to farmers for Rogging (Rs.1000/- /Hect.) DBT/RTGS to the concerned seed producer is done on the account of the farmer.
benefits: - The seeds produced by the group of farmers will be used by the rest of the farmers for production in the next year.
eligibility: - FarmersRs. who are interested in progressive and crop-specific farming.

name: NIELIT Internship Programme
brief_description:
The Internship Programme by the National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology (NIELIT) is an opportunity for a student to secure first-hand and practical work experience under the guidance of qualified and experienced Supervisors/Mentors. It also aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation and putting into practice the knowledge acquired in the classrooms.
> **Duration** The minimum duration of the internship shall be as defined or prescribed in the curriculum and endorsed by the Sponsoring institution. Duration can be a maximum of 6 months and shall not be extendable beyond 6 months in any case. An intern can avail internship only once with NIELIT.
> **Number of Interns** A maximum of five (05) interns shall be engaged for the S&T section at NIELIT Haridwar in a financial year. A maximum of five (05) interns shall be engaged for non - the S&T section at NIELIT Haridwar in a financial year.
> **Confidentiality Protocol** The Intern shall follow the confidentiality protocol of NIELIT Haridwar and shall not reveal to any person or organization confidential information relating to NIELITRs. its work and its policies.
> **Placement** 1. Every batch of interns or individual internsRs. as the case may beRs. will have a Scientific/Technical Project Supervisor/Mentor to be appointed by the Wing/Section Head of NIELIT Haridwar. 1. The internship is neither an employment nor an assurance of employment.
> **Attendance** A minimum of 80% attendance is required to be maintained in a monthRs. failing which a Stipend and certificate of Internship shall not be given to the Intern.
benefits:
> **Stipend** 1. For S&T section/wing interns: 5Rs./- per month 1. For non-S&T section/wing interns: 3Rs./- per month The stipend shall be paid after the completion of the Internship on submission of a report duly accepted by NIELIT Haridwar. The stipend shall be paid in non-cash mode only via Cheque/NEFT/RTGS etc.
> **Certificate** Certificates will be issued by NIELIT Haridwar to the interns on completion of the Internship and submission of the Report duly countersigned by the supervisor/mentor and accepted by the Wing/Section Head.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized university in India/abroad. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks in the last degree or certificate examination. 1. The applicant should qualify as ANY ONE of the following - a) Completed or pursuing a Diploma. b) Completed or pursuing Graduation/Bachelors education/Engineering/ etc. c) Completed or pursuing an Integrated or Dual Degree/Master/Post Graduate degree/ etc.
**NOTE:** Merely possessing the minimum qualifications shall not guarantee an Internship at NIELIT.
> **Reservation / Preference / Priority** Candidates having exposure in the area of intended internship with good academic background and having higher qualificationsRs. based on need shall be given preference.

name: Palanhar Scheme
brief_description:
Palanhar Yojana has been started by the state government to benefit the orphan children of the state. Under the Palanhar YojanaRs. arrangements for the upbringingRs. educationRs. etc. of orphan children of the state or those whose parents have died will not be institutionalizedRs. but in the family of the closest relative/acquaintance of the boys and girls within the society. EducationRs. foodRs. clothesRs. and other necessary facilities will be made available by the state in a family environment by making an interested person a foster.
This scheme is for different categories of boys/girls with special care and protection from 0 to 18 years of the state by the Government of Rajasthan. Arrangements for the care and upbringing of the boys/girls coming under this are made by a close relative/acquaintance within the family. The caretaker of the boys/girls has been appointed guardian. The government ensures the economicRs. socialRs. and educational development of boys / girls and provides Monthly basis financial assistance.
benefits: 1. Orphan Category : For the age group (0 to 6 years) : Rs. 1500/- per month. For the age group (6 to 18 years) : Rs. 2500/- per month. 1. Other Category: For the age group (0 to 6 years) : Rs. 500/- per month. For the age group (6 to 18 years) : Rs. 1000/- per month. 1. For Books/Stationaries/Dress/Sweater/shoes etc: Rs. 2000/- per year.
eligibility:
1. Orphan boy/girl.
1. Children of parents sentenced to death/life imprisonment under judicial orders.
1. Children of a widowed mother receiving a pension (maximum 3 children at a time).
1. Children of remarried widowed mothers.
1. Children of HIV/AIDS affected mother/father.
1. Children of parents suffering from leprosy.
1. Children of related mothers (Maximum 3 children at a time).
1. Children of specially-abled parents.
1. Children of divorced/abandoned women receiving the pension.
1. Children of parents suffering from silicosis.
1. The age of the child should be less than 18 years.
1. If Child age is 18 and still studying/staying in 12th class or lower classRs. then in such a situation such children will be given an additional one year ( The benefit can be provided till the age of 19 years). The said benefit will not be payable after the child completes 19 years of age or passes 12th class.
1. The certificate that the guardian is a native of Rajasthan state or has been residing in the state for more than three years.
1. Guardian Family income should not be more than Rs. 1.20 Laks per annum.

name: Zero Budget Natural Farming
brief_description:
Zero Budget Natural Farming is natural farming based on cow-products (cow urineRs. dung) produced by indigenous cows. All agricultural inputs are prepared by the farmer from his own farmRs. no inputs are purchased from the market. ThereforeRs. he does not have to spend anything directly. Due to which it is called zero budget based farming. At presentRs. reducing the indiscriminate use of chemical fertilizersRs. pesticides and irrigation. To reduce the cost of agricultureRs. improve the quality of agricultural products and increase production per acre. Use of Beejamrit for treatment of seeds and Dravjeevamrit and Ghanjeevamrit etc. for nutrition. Use of NeemastraRs. Brahrastra and Aagnestra for the prevention of insects.
**Objective:-** 1. To promote environment-protected and climate-tolerant natural farming practices so that the fertility power of the land can be increased. 1. To reduce the cost of cultivation by less irrigationRs. sustainable and integrated organic methods so that farmers can get more income per unit area. 1. Production of chemical free and nutritious food for human health and wellness. 1. Protecting biodiversity and environment. 1. Empowering farmers for productionRs. processing and progress by developing them in the form of clusters / groups. 1. To make farmers entrepreneurs for marketing and by connecting directly with the national market.
benefits:
1. A subsidy of 50% provides to farmers to buy the farming items.
1. A large drum of 200 litresRs. a small drum of 50 litres capacityRs. a bucket of 20 litres capacityRs. a JugRs. filterRs. water sprayRs. sprayerRs. TrichodermaRs. cow-urineRs. dungRs. etc. Material and organic mulch material like leaves of treesRs. weed beddingRs. leaves of millet-sorghumRs. etc.Rs. groundnut peelsRs. and in the field for moisture conservation between the rowsRs. 50% of the total cost of available other waste material or a maximum of Rs.600/- per farmer will be given as subsidy by DBT.
1. Training and Farmers Tours.
1. Gram Panchayat level Training.
eligibility:
1. Interested farmers should be selected for the scheme who have a special interest in natural farming. Every farmer must have a minimum of one-acre land ownership or family account holder.
1. Interested farmers may be from the same villageRs. neighboring villagesRs. or different villages as far as possible.
1. Interested farmers will be selected by the Regional Assistant Agriculture Officer / Agriculture Supervisor.
1. Horticulture crops and animal husbandry should also be included in natural farming.
1. For the selection of farmersRs. priority should be given to SCRs. STRs. BPLRs. small and marginal farmers as much as possible. Youths up to 35 years should be included for natural farming so that their capacity can increase.
1. Necessary material like drumRs. bucketRs. jug etc. will be given on grant to the concerned farmer for setting up the input unit for natural farming.
1. Farmers selected under Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana should not be included in this scheme.

name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt/sbc Students Studying In High Schools
brief_description: The Government of Maharashtra introduced Tuition fees and Examination fees to Vimukta Jati Nomadic Tribes (VJNT)/ Special Backward Classes (SBC) students studying in High Schools scheme to improve the interest of VJNT/SBC students in High Schools. To help and encourage the VJNT/SBC parents/ guardians for their children's education. Govt. has introduced a scheme named Tuition Fee Exam. Fees to VJNT/SBC students studying in High SchoolsRs. irrespective of age and income vide Govt. Resolution No. EBC/1068/83567/J dated 24th December 1970 and G.R. No. EBC-1094/PK-91/ BCW-1 dated 29 October 1996. Tuition feesRs. Examination feesRs. library feeRs. laboratory feeRs. and playground fee is being paid.
benefits:
1. BPL students studying in Govt. approved aidedRs. non-aidedRs. permanent non-aided schools in 1st to 10th standard are being paid Rs.100/- to 200/- Education Fee as per Urban and Rural area.
1. Tuition feesRs. Examination feesRs. Laboratory feesRs. Library feesRs. etc. fees are sanctioned and paid to concerned Govt. approved aidedRs. non-aidedRs. permanent non-aided schools.
1. No other concessional benefit is admissible to such students.
eligibility:
1. He should be a student of a recognized High School.
1. No limit on age or income.
1. Students should belong to V.J.N.T. & S.B.C. category.
1. Once failure is eligible.
1. Twice failure is not eligible.

name: Disability Pension For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Disability Pension for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under the schemeRs. a monthly pension of 3000/- is given to the registered worker in case of disability due to any infectious disease or accident at the workplace. FurtherRs. it is necessary for the registered worker to have minimum three-year regular membership and is not taking a disability pension from any other Haryana Government Department/ Board/ Corporation.
benefits: 1. A pension of 3000/- per month is given to the worker in case of disability due to any infectious disease or accident at the workplace.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
1. The registered worker must have minimum three-year regular memberships.
1. The registered worker who has become disabled due to any infectious disease or accident at the workplace during the course of employment is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The percentage of permanent disability should be between 70% to 100%.
1. The worker must not be taking a disability pension from any other Haryana Government Department/ Board/ Corporation.

**Note 01:** It is necessary to upload the No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
**Note 02:** It is necessary to upload the declaration that the applicant is not receiving a pension from any other Government Department/Board/Corporation/institution while filling out the application form.
**Step 03:** It is mandatory for the beneficiary to upload the life certificate and deposit the prescribed contribution every year in the month of November.

name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
brief_description:
The National Green Tribunal provides opportunities to college students by holding Summer Internship Programs (MarchRs. AprilRs. May and July ordinarily) and Winter Internship Programs (NovemberRs. December and January ordinarily) Internship Programs for LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students.
> **Duration** 1. The duration of the Internship will be 4 Weeks ordinarily. 1. The duration and timing of the internship may be altered by the Competent Authority as and when necessary.
> **Number of Slots** 1. The maximum number of slots to be offered to the students shall be decided by the Competent Authority.
benefits:
> **Certificate** A certificate will be issued to the Intern at the end of her/his internship after evaluation of the research paper or assessment of the work done.
> **Guide** A guide will be assigned to each intern for their study during the internship.
> **Remuneration** The National Green Tribunal pays no remuneration/expenses.
eligibility: The applicant should be a student pursuing three-year and five-year law degree courses in environmental studies/law from any recognized College/Law School/University in India.

name: Internship Scheme Of Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
brief_description:
The Internship Scheme of Employees Provident Fund Organization invites applications for Internships from students for engagement as Interns with EPFO.
