The Interns shall have an opportunity to know about the EPFOs functioning and Departmental Policy issues in EPFO and Government of India and contribute to the Policy/Legislation formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysisRs. briefing reportsRs. policy papersRs. etc. HoweverRs. the internship is neither a job nor an assurance for a job in EPFO.
> **Objective** 1. To engage persons pursuing law [in the last two years of degree course] or Law Graduates or students pursing Post Graduation in Law or Research Scholars in Law or pursuing post-graduation courses like MBA/MSW/MSc/MA and are enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad as Interns with EPFO that shall be mutually beneficial for the individual as well as for EPFO. 1. The Interns shall have an opportunity to know about the EPFO functioning and Department Policy issues in EPFO and Government of India and contribute to the Policy/Legislation formulation by generating policy inputs such as empirical analysisRs. briefing reportsRs. policy papersRs. etc. 1. HoweverRs. the internship is neither a job nor any such assurance for a job in the EPFO.
> **Duration** Applications for internships are invited for a minimum period of 2 months and a maximum period of 6 months.
> **Engagement** Engagement of Interns (total 10 maximum) will be carried out with the approval of Central Provident Fund Commissioner.
> **Placement** After their engagementRs. the interns will be attached to an officer in a Division/Department/Wing as decided by the Central Provident fund CommissionerRs. keeping in view their suitability as well as requirement in concerned Wing/Division.
benefits:
> **Stipend** The interns selected will be paid stipend @ 8Rs./- per month for the period of internship on certification from the officer with whom the intern is attached.
> **Logistic Support** EPFO shall provide them with working space and computer with internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Divisional Head of the Division/Department/Wing to which the interns are attached.
> **Certificate of Internship** Certificate will be issued to the interns on satisfactory completion of the internship and on submission of their Report/Paper and its evaluation by the concerned Head of the Division.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should qualify as ANY ONE of the following -
a) Pursuing law [in the last two years of degree course] or Law Graduates.
b) Pursuing Post Graduation in Law or Research Scholars in Law.
c) Pursuing post-graduation courses like MBA/MSW/ MSC/MA/M.Com./MCA.
2. The applicant should be enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad.

name: Travel Concession To The Differently Abled Persons In State Owned Transport Corporation Buses
brief_description:
The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced Differently Abled Persons In Stated Owned Transport Corporation buses.
i) All visually impaired persons are given travel concession to travel up to 100 Km. to and fro without any condition and free of cost.
ii) Free-of-cost travel concession is allowed to intellectually disabled persons to travel with one escort.
iii) The speech and hearing impaired and locomotor differently-abled persons are given travel concession free of cost up to 100 Kms to go to schools/colleges/hospitals/training centers/work spots from their residence and return.
iv) Free travel concession is provided to children with disabilities to attend early intervention centers and pre-schools along with one escort/parent.
There is no income ceiling to avail concessions in (i) to (iv).
benefits:
i) All visually impaired persons are given travel concession to travel up to 100 Km. to and fro without any condition and free of cost.
ii) Free-of-cost travel concession is allowed to intellectually disabled persons to travel with one escort.
iii) The speech and hearing impaired and locomotor differently-abled persons are given travel concession free of cost up to 100 Kms to go to schools/colleges/hospitals/training centers/work spots from their residence and return.
iv) Free travel concession is provided to children with disabilities to attend early intervention centers and pre-schools along with one escort/parent.
There is no income ceiling to avail concessions in (i) to (iv).
eligibility: The Applicant should be a Differently abled person.

name: Mukhyamantri Aawasiye Bhu-Adhikaar Yojana
brief_description: Each family is entitled to live a dignified life with access to essential necessities. Those who are eligible for the housing schemes initiated by either the Central or State government can truly reap the benefits once they obtain a housing plot. Once the residential plot is securedRs. assistance can be availed for housing loans through government schemes and banks. In light of thisRs. the state government is launching the "Mukhyamantri Awasiya Bhu-Adhikar YojanaRs." aimed at granting eligible families residential plots on the 'populated areas' within each gram panchayat region in rural areas.
benefits: - Plot will be provided to all those families who do not have their own house.
eligibility:
1. The applicant family does not have a residence to live independently.
1. The applicant family has less than 5 acres of land.
1. The applicant family holds the eligibility slip for obtaining ration from the Public Distribution System (PDS) shop.
1. No member of the applicant family is income tax payer.
1. No member of the applicant family is in government service.
1. The name of the applicant is registered in the voter list till January 01Rs. 2021 in the village where he wants residential plot.

name: Meritorious Scholarships To Vjnt And Sbc Students Studying In Secondary Schools
brief_description:
The government of Maharashtra introduced the scheme of Meritorious Scholarships to VJNT and SBC students studying in Secondary Schools. To motivate Backward Class students for education.
The students will get 200/- for 5th to 7th and 400/- for 8th to 10th standard per annum.
benefits:
1. The students will get 200/- for 5th to 7th standard per annum.
1. The students will get 400/- for 8th to 10th standard per annum.
eligibility:
1. Students who secured more than 50 percent marks in the previous years annual examination and stood first or second in the class.
1. He should belong to VJNT / SBC category.
1. He should be studying in 5th to 10th standard.
1. There is no income limit for this scholarship.

name: Marriage Assistance To Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)
brief_description: The scheme Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II) was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. the Government of Kerala is providing marriage assistance of 30Rs./- to differently-abled girls who have completed 18 years of age for their marriage.
benefits: 1. A one-time assistance of 30Rs./- is provided to the eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.
1. The parents of differently abled girls or differently abled girls should be eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The girl who intends to be married should have completed 18 years of age.
1. The combined annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

**Note 01:** After receiving the financial aid as per these terms and conditionsRs. if the marriage has to be dissolved for any reason and the girl has to marry a second timeRs. the financial aid can be given for the second marriage.
**Note 02:** If the applicant with disabilities dies before the marriage of the daughtersRs. the said financial assistance can be given to the eldest member of the family or any other member of the family who is responsible for conducting the marriage.
**Note 03:** In case the applicant PWD dies after the marriage of his daughter but before receiving financial assistanceRs. the senior member of the family or the married member or the individual can be given financial assistance on a suitable bond.

name: Laadli Laxmi Scheme
brief_description: Laadli Laxmi Scheme was launched on 6th July 2012 as one of the flagship programmes of the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Goa with the intention to address the undesirable tendency of female foeticides and with an aim towards erasing the general perception that the birth of a girl in the family is the burden on her parents/guardian during her marriage. The objective of the scheme is to financially empower the girl child to meet educational and other expenses on becoming a major of age and to improve the female sex ratio in the State.
benefits:
> **For Unmarried Beneficiaries** (beneficiaries who attain the age of majority i.e. 18 years on or after 01-04-2012) 1. Financial Assistance of 1Rs. by means of a bank fixed depositRs. jointly in the name of the Director (DoWCD) and the applicant. 1. The fixed deposit shall be renewed annually automatically on maturityRs. along with the amount of interest accruedRs. till the date of claim by the applicant as per the scheme or until the age of 45 years whichever is earlier.
> **For Married Beneficiaries** ( beneficiaries who have already attained the age of 18 years before 01-04-2012 and are in the age group of 19 to 45 years prospectively from 1st AprilRs. 2016) 1. Financial Assistance of 1Rs..Rs. by means of cash payment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Girl. 1. The applicant should be born in the State of Goa OR should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years. 1. In caseRs. the applicant is a resident of Goa for the last fifteen yearsRs. she should have been educated in Goa for a minimum period of 7 years (continuous). 1. The parental income of the applicant does not exceed 3Rs. per annum. 1. The applicant should qualify for ANY ONE of the following three criteria: a) At least one of the parents of the applicant is born in Goa and is also a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years. b) One of the parents of the applicant is residing in Goa for the last twenty-five years.
**NOTE:** In case the applicant is an affected person of Tillari Irrigation Project (a joint venture of the Government of Goa and the government of Maharashtra) and was rehabilitated in the State of GoaRs. her application shall be sanctioned if she produces a certificate issued by the CollectorRs. North Goa District relaxing the condition of 10/15 years domicile in the State of Goa for various purposes for her family.

name: Msme Skill Training And Employment Scheme
brief_description: The scheme MSME Skill Training and Employment Scheme was launched by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium EnterprisesRs. Government of Tamil Nadu during the years 2021-22. The scheme is implemented by the Commissionerate of Industries and Commerce at the State levelRs. the Regional Joint Director of Industries and Commerce for Chennai districtRs. and General Managers of the District Industries Centre for other districts in Tamil Nadu. **Objective:** The objective of the scheme is to fulfill the skilled manpower requirement of MSMEs by imparting necessary on-the-job training by the MSMEs themselves and thereby creating employment. The scheme will assist the MSME sector by sharing the training cost which otherwise would be borne by the enterprises themselves. **Training provider:** MSMEs will have to give employment based job oriented on the job training which will lead to certification. It will be the responsibility of the MSMEs to ensure that for the proposed trainingRs. the relevant capacities are available to them.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the subsidy will be provided to the MSMEs for training; subject to a maximum of 2000/- per month per candidate for a maximum of 6 months.
1. Certificates will be provided by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)Rs. after the assessment of acquired skills by the trained candidates.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an MSME unit in the state who has the requisite infrastructure.
1. Only in respect of vocation/trade in which MSMEs have expertise will be encouragedRs. MSME units should have experienceRs. expertiseRs. and running business.
1. The trainees selected by the applicant (MSME) shall be between 18 to 25 years of age.
1. The trainees selected by the applicant shall have an engineering degreeRs. a polytechnic diplomaRs. or an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) certificateRs. or qualification as prescribed by the respective sector skill council.
1. The applicant shall provide the trainee with a stipend of 5000/- per monthRs. for a maximum of 6 months.
1. The applicantRs. MSME UnitRs. should not have been blacklisted at any point in time by any Government Norms/Rules/Acts.

**Note:** The scheme is funded by Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC)

name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS) was launched by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium EnterprisesRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The Government of Tamil Nadu noted that the share of persons from Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities who avail of various entrepreneurship promotion subsidies from the Government is very low. In order to promote the economic development of SC/ST entrepreneursRs. this scheme has been launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu. The new scheme will provide a 35% capital subsidy and offer a 6% interest subvention for loans to procure machinery and equipment.
This scheme shall be implemented by the MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises Department through the Industries Commissioner and Director of Industries & Commerce (ICDIC). The Industries Commissioner and Director of Industries and Commerce shall be assisted by FaMeTNRs. Entrepreneurship Development and Innovation InstituteRs. and StartupTN with manpower and other resources for implementing the Scheme.
A State Level Steering Committee for the scheme shall be constituted with the Secretaries of FinanceRs. MicroRs. Small and Medium EnterprisesRs. Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentsRs. Industries Commissioner and Director of Industries and CommerceRs. Commissioner of Adi Dravidar Welfare and Commissioner of Tribal Welfare. This Committee will review the scheme once a quarter and suggest necessary modificationsRs. if necessary.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the State Government will provide a 35% capital subsidy on the Eligible Project CostRs. not exceeding 1.5 Crore.
1. A 6% interest subvention will be given for loans sanctioned under this scheme.

**Note 01:** Interest subvention will be given to loans sanctioned by scheduled Commercial BanksRs. Co-Operatives BanksRs. Tamil Nadu Industrial Investment CorporationRs. and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) during the tenure of the loan not exceeding 10 years.
**Note 02:** The capital subsidy sanctioned will be provided frontend to the extent necessary to constitute margin money requirement for credit linkage.
**Note 03:** The working capital sanctioned for the project shall be eligible for interest subvention for a period not exceeding 2 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of the State of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiaries shall be persons belonging to SC/ST communities. Enterprises supported under the scheme shall be 100% owned by persons belonging to SC/STs. The enterprises may have any legal personality allowed to conduct business for profit as per prevailing laws which include sole proprietorshipRs. partnershipRs. and company.
1. The scheme can support both new enterprises and expansion of existing enterprises.
1. The eligible enterprises can be business enterprises in the areas of manufacturing and services. Trading-related projects which are above the threshold of assistance under the existing Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP) scheme will also be covered.
1. The age limit for beneficiaries will be 55 years.
1. There shall be no minimum educational qualification for beneficiaries.
1. There will be no bar on the beneficiary to claim additional capital subsidy from schemes operated by agencies not controlled by the Government of Tamil Nadu. This will include the Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS) of the Union GovernmentRs. schemes of Coir BoardRs. etc.Rs.
1. Entrepreneurship Development Training will be given to all beneficiaries by Entrepreneurship Development and Innovation InstituteRs. as done in the case of the New Entrepreneur-cum- Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS).

**Note 01:** The scheme will cover new entrepreneurs and existing entrepreneurs.
**Note 02:** Eligible Project Cost shall include all investments of a capital nature and will include landRs. plantRs. machineryRs. testing equipmentRs. and computing devicesRs. Cost of land may be taken into account for the purposes of calculating subsidy which should not exceed 20% of the total project cost. Vehicles shall be considered as part of project cost only in cases where the vehicle is integral to the business process as in the case of taxi and lorry businessRs. earth moving equipmentRs. bore well drillingRs. sanitary service equipment like Jet Roding machinesRs. etc.Rs.
**Note 03:** This training will be given even for prospective applicants or their wards where subsidy applications are under process. Convergence with existing training schemes of the GovernmentRs. including the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) will also be implemented for this purpose.

name: Udita Yojana
brief_description: The Project Udita program was started on November 1Rs. 2016Rs. under the Women and Child Development Projects of Madhya Pradesh Government. According to the concept of this schemeRs. Anganwadi workers and assistants will inform adolescent girls about the importance of proper hygiene during menstruation and sexually transmitted diseases due to negligence and provide them with sanitary napkins. If girls become aware of their health in their teenage yearsRs. then they all can remain healthy in future also.
benefits: - Distribution of sanitary napkinsRs. nutrition and health educationRs. training on menstrual hygiene and nutrition and health issues in adolescent girls are done through Udita Corner established in Anganwadi centers.
eligibility: - All adolescent girls and women aged 18 to 49 will be beneficiaries.

name: Assistance For Purchase Of Spectacles By A Differently Abled Person
brief_description:
The "Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles by A Differently Abled Persons" scheme in Tamil Nadu is a government initiative that aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled individuals.
A sum of Rs.500/- (Rupees Five hundred only) is paid as assistance towards the reimbursement of the cost of spectacles for differently-abled persons.
benefits: A sum of Rs.500/- (Rupees Five hundred only) is paid as an assistance towards the reimbursement of the cost of spectacles for differently-abled persons.
eligibility: Differently-abled persons holding identity cards issued by the welfare board for the differently abled.

name: Unemployment Allowance for the Educated Unemployed Youth Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Unemployment Allowance for the Educated Unemployed Youth Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of EmploymentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme was introduced on 01.11.1988 which provides monthly unemployment allowance to the educated unemployed youth registered with the Employment Exchanges in Haryana. Applicants who have passed the 10+2 examination or hold a 2-year certificate/diploma course after Matric receive 900/- per month. Those with a Graduate degree or aboveRs. or who have completed a 3-year certificate/diploma course after the 10+2 examinationRs. receive 1Rs./- per month. The scheme supports educated youth in their job search and reduces financial stress during unemployment.
benefits: **Sl. No.****Qualification****Rate of Unemployment Allowance**110+2 or equivalent900/- per month2Graduates/Post Graduates or equivalent1Rs./- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be domicile of Haryana.
1. Applicants are eligible if they have passed the 10+2 examinationRs. completed a 2-year certificate/diploma after Matric from a Haryana-recognized Board/UniversityRs. hold a Graduate degree or higherRs. or completed a 3-year certificate/diploma or above after the 10+2 examination.
1. The applicant should be registered with any Employment Exchange in the State continuously for a minimum period of 3 years or more as on 1st November of each year.
1. The annual family income from all sources including that of the spouse should not exceed 3Rs./- or the family should not have residential or commercial property exceeding 10.00 Lakhs in value or agriculture land in excess of 2 hectares.
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 21-35 years.
1. The applicant should not be a student/trainee/apprentice.
1. The applicant should not be employed/self-employed.
1. The applicant should not be a dismissed Government employee.
1. The applicant should not have been convicted of any offense resulting in imprisonment for a period of six months or more.
1. The applicant should not be registered in the Saksham Yuva Scheme of the Employment Department.

**Note:**

- Family means a group of individuals who share ties of bloodRs. marriageRs. or adoption; a group residing together and consisting of parentsRs. childrenRs. and other relatives by blood or marriage; a group of individuals residing together who have consented to an arrangement similar to ties of blood or marriage.
- Family Income means the gross annual income of the family where the eligible applicant is associated as a family member.
- In case of a married femaleRs. in-Laws ration card is mandatory (Joint and Separate).

name: Mandahasam Scheme To Provide Artificial Dentures To Senior Citizens
brief_description: The scheme Mandahasam Scheme to Provide Artificial Dentures to Senior Citizens was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. This scheme is started by the Government of Kerala for giving free tooth sets to senior citizens. The scheme aims to reduce nutritionalRs. physicalRs. and mental problems faced by elderly people after losing teeth. The Department of Social Justice would prepare a list of dental colleges and dental treatment centers from where the beneficiaries could avail treatment. It would also ensure the quality of artificial teeth and quality treatment by setting standards and norms.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. one beneficiary would get maximum financial assistance of 5Rs./- for fixing the tooth.

**Note:** The benefit of this scheme is not given for only partial replacement of teeth.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicants age has to be 60 years or above.
1. The applicants should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The persons who have completely lost their teeth or those who have partially lost their teeth and are in a position to have them extracted as they are unusable are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The persons who have been certified by a qualified dentist in the prescribed form as unfit for placing artificial teeth.

**Note:** The priority will be given to the oldest person under the scheme.

name: Thalolam Scheme
brief_description:
The Government of Kerala launched the Thalolam Scheme on 1st January 2010 under Kerala Social Security Mission by the Social Justice DepartmentRs. Kerala. The aim of the scheme is to provide free treatment to the children below age of 18Rs. who are suffering from Kidney diseasesRs. Cardiovascular diseasesRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Brittle Bone DiseaseRs. HemophiliaRs. ThalassemiaRs. Sickle Cell AnemiaRs. Orthopedic deformitiesRs. and other Neuro-Developmental DisabilitiesRs. Congenital anomalies (Endosulfan victims) and accident cases which needs surgery.
**Hospitals receiving free treatment:**

1. Govt. Medical College HospitalRs. Trivandrum
1. Govt. Medical College HospitalRs. Thrissur
1. Govt. Medical College HospitalRs. Alappuzha
1. S. A. T HospitalRs. Trivandrum
1. Govt. Medical College HospitalRs. Kottayam
1. IM C. HRs. Kozhikode
1. Govt. Medical CollegeRs. Kozhikode
1. I.C.H.M.C. Kottayam
1. Co-operative Medical CollegeRs. Kannur
1. Regional Cancer CenterRs. Thiruvananthapuram
1. District HospitalRs. AluvaRs. Ernakulam
1. Sree Chithira Thirunal HospitalRs. Thiruvananthapuram
benefits:
1. A patient will be eligible for initial assistance of 50Rs./- only under this scheme.
1. Under the schemeRs. free treatment will be provided to the children below age of 18Rs. who are suffering from Kidney diseasesRs. Cardiovascular diseasesRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Brittle Bone DiseaseRs. HemophiliaRs. ThalassemiaRs. Sickle Cell AnemiaRs. Orthopedic deformities and other Neuro-Developmental DisabilitiesRs. Congenital anomalies (Endosulfan victims) and accident cases which needs surgery.

**Note:** Additional financial assistance can be met based on the decision of the SuperintendentRs. Head of the concerned Department of SpecialtyRs. and Head of the Radiotherapy Department.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State and the scheme is applicable only to patients from Kerala.
1. The patient should be below 18 years of age.
1. The scheme is applicable to patients belonging to families too poor to afford treatment of the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. Under this schemeRs. assistance will be provided to the patient for diseases other than cancer which are lethal or fatal.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
brief_description:
Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been implemented in Madhya Pradesh with the objective of creating positive thinking in public towards the birth of girl childRs. improvement in sex ratioRs. improvement in educational levelRs. health condition of girls and laying the foundation stone for their good future.
Some families are financially weak and not able to give higher education to their daughters nor can they collect money for their marriage. The State government has started the Ladli Laxmi Yojana to provide financial assistance for the education and marriage of the daughter. This money can be used by the girl for her higher education or marriage and to promote the empowerment of women in the state.
benefits:
1. An assurance certificate of 1Rs./- is issued by the government in the name of the girl child.
1. From the time of registrationRs. 6Rs./- will be deposited in the **Madhya Pradesh Ladli Laxmi Yojana Fund** for five consecutive yearsRs. the total amount of 30Rs./- will be deposited in the name of the girl child. 1. To girl child taking admission in class 6th: 2Rs./-
1. To girl child taking admission in class 9th: 4Rs./-
1. To girl child taking admission in class 11th: 6Rs./-
1. To girl child taking admission in class 12th: 6Rs./-
1. An incentive amount of 25Rs./- in two equal installments in the first and last year of the course after taking admission to a graduate or professional course (course duration minimum two years) after class 12th.
1. Final payment of 1Rs./- on completion of 21 years of age of the girl childRs. on appearing in class 12th examination and on the marriage of the girl childRs. after completing the age prescribed by the government.
eligibility:
**For Normal Cases** 1. The girl child should be born on or after January 1Rs. 2006. 1. The girl child should be registered in the local Anganwadi center. 1. Parents should be natives of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Parents should not be income taxpayers. 1. Family planning has been adopted after the birth of the second child. 1. Parents who have two or less than two childrenRs. family planning has been adopted after the birth of the second child. 1. The girl child born from the first delivery will be given benefits without family planning but It is necessary for the mother/father to adopt family planning in order to get the benefit for the second girl child.
**For Special Cases** 1. In a family where there are maximum 02 children and the mother or father has diedRs. registration can be done till the girl child is 05 years old. But in this type of caseRs. if the woman/man gets married for the second time and already has 02 childrenRs. then the daughter born from the second marriage will not get the benefit of the scheme. 1. If there are 03 girls together born at the time of first deliveryRs. all three girls will get the benefit. 1. Girls born to women prisoners in jail will also be benefited under the scheme. 1. The benefit of the scheme will be given to a girl child born to a rape victim or a girl child. 1. The collector has been given the authority to approve the cases till 02 instead of 01 year in the cases where family planning has not been adopted due to health related reasons. 1. District collector will provide approval/rejection under special casesRs. after minutely examining the applications received late. 1. The application has to be made by the Superintendent of the Orphanage/Protection Home within 1 year of admission in the Orphanage and before the girl child attains the age of 5 years or within 1 year of adoption by the adoptive parents.

name: Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana
brief_description:
Madhya Pradesh government has started the 'Mukhyamantri Avivahit Pension Yojana ' under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities to help those women who have not married for some reason. Such women are alone and live their life. The government will provide a pension of 600 every monthRs. which will help them to run their lives easily. With thisRs. they will not be dependent on anyone else for their work and will be able to live happily.
With thisRs. women will be able to create a brighter future and improve their lives without any hassle. Under Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Married Women Pension SchemeRs. unmarried women above 50 years of age have been includedRs. so that they can improve their social status and economic status.
benefits: Pension amount: 600/- per month.
eligibility:
1. Applicants should be a native of Madhya Pradesh State.
1. The applicants should be Unmarried women.
1. Applicant's age should be 50 years or more
1. Applicants should not be income taxpayers.
1. Applicants should not be a government employee/officer (government employee/officer means state or central government or government-aided corporationRs. undertakingRs. is from the employees/officers working under the organization.)
1. Applicants should not be honorary employees working in government/non-government offices.

name: DEVELOPMENT OF HANDICRAFTS
brief_description:
The government of Puducherry takes the initiative to revive the vanishing crafts and restore the significance of traditional crafts. Objective: (i) To promote and develop the Handicrafts in the Union Territory of Puducherry. (ii) To revive the vanishing crafts and to restore the traditional Handicrafts /trades under the Viswakarma category. (iii) To develop the skills in order to create better employment opportunities and to boost the livelihood of rural poorRs. who have contributed a significant share to exports by the U.T. of Puducherry.
> Training Objective: (i) To revive the vanishing crafts and to restore the traditional Handicrafts. (ii) To develop the skills in order to create better employment opportunities and to boost the livelihood of rural poorRs. who have contributed a significant share to exports by the U.T. of Puducherry.
benefits:
> To revive the vanishing crafts and to restore the traditional Handicrafts.
> Financial Assistance:
- To the trainee (i) Stipend: Rs. 1Rs. /- per month/ per trainee. - To the trainer (i) Honorarium Rs. 300/-per month/ per trainee (maximum Rs.3Rs. 000/- per month). (ii) Compensation for wastage of raw materials Rs.150 /- per month/ per trainee (maximum Rs.1Rs./- per month).
Note:- Period of Training: 6 months
eligibility:
1. Residence -Should be the native of Puducherry Union Territory (or)Should be a continuous resident for the past three years.
1. Proof: Birth Certificate / Education Certificate/Residence Certificate.
1. Already trained candidates are not eligible to apply.

name: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
brief_description:
The Kerala State Young Scientist Awards by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council. The research carried out independently in Kerala by young scientists of Indian origin with Ph.D. in any branch of Science and technology who have been working in Kerala for the last three years will be taken into consideration for the award.
Candidates may be nominated by Vice-Chancellors of Universities in KeralaRs. Directors of R & D CentresRs. Heads of Institutions & departments and Fellows of Academies. Nominations will be valid for 3 years or the eligibility age whichever is earlier. Selection will be through a thorough review/evaluation by an expert committee.
benefits:
1. Each Awardee will be presented with a certificate and a cash prize of 50Rs./-.
1. The recipient may be considered by the Council for a research grant of 50 lakhs after due consideration of the research project with the help of an expert committee.
1. The AwardeeRs. within 3 years of the receipt of the awardRs. will be considered for a visit abroad to present the research work at a conference.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Ph.D. holder with 3 years Post-Doctoral experience.
1. The applicant should have working experience in any R&D/Academic institution in Kerala continuously for the last 3 years.
1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 37 years as on 31st December in the notifying year.

name: Mangalya Scheme For Widow Remarriage
brief_description: The Mangalya Scheme was launched by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is to be provided to eligible widows and divorced women for their remarriage. In KeralaRs. women not only outnumber men but also outlive themRs. so the marital status of women in Kerala is very important. It could influence the overall care and support they receive from their family and society. Statics show only 3.5% of the total male population in Kerala are widowers and the proportion of the widowed female population is 11.56%. This gender gap adversely affects women in every sphere of their life. It is in this contextRs. that the Government of Kerala envisages the scheme called Mangalya to encourage widow remarriage. The scheme imparts financial assistance for the widows/divorced to remarry.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 25000/- is provided to eligible widows and divorced women to remarry.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be a widow and a divorced woman.
1. Women belonging to the age group of 18 to 50 years who are legally divorced and widowed are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
brief_description: The scheme "Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers" by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of GoaRs. provides financial assistance in the form of a Gross Pension of 2Rs./- per month to the beneficiaries. The applicant should be a retired seaman. The age of the retired seaman should be 60 years or above.
benefits:
Financial Assistance in the form of a **Gross Pension of 2Rs./- per month.**
**NOTE:** If the applicant is in receipt of a monthly pension under the Dayanand Social Security Scheme / Griha Aadhaar Scheme / Kala Samman SchemeRs. the amount whereof is less than the Gross Pension available under these schemesRs. then he/she will be entitled to receive only the differenceRs. between the amounts of Gross Pension available under the above schemes.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a retired seamanRs. i.e. seaman who was employed on board the ship and retired.
1. The seaman invalidated from sea service on medical grounds before retirement are also eligible.
1. The age of the retired seaman should be 60 years or above.
1. The widow of a deceased Seaman can also be eligible on compassionate groundsRs. provided that she has been a resident of Goa for 15 years and that her annual income from all sources does not exceed 1Rs./-.
1. The beneficiary should be a bonafide resident of Goa by birth and if notRs. the said birth should have been registered in Goa or at least either of the parents of the beneficiary should have been born in Goa.
1. The retired seaman should have rendered a total of 120 months of actual service on board the ship. A break in service up to the period of 6 months shall be condoned while computing the total period of service.

**NOTE:** The limit of 120 months of actual service shall not apply to beneficiaries invalidated from sea service on medical grounds before retirement and the widow of a deceased beneficiary on compassionate grounds.

name: Disabled Person Pension Scheme - Punjab
brief_description: Disabled People often do not have any permanent source of income. Due to this they are not able to take care of their daily need expenses. Government of Punjab comes to the rescue of disabled people by starting Disability Pension Scheme in State. The main objective behind launching this scheme is to provide financial support to disabled people of Punjab. Social Security and Women & Child Development Department of Punjab Government is the nodal department of this scheme.
benefits: Amount : 1Rs./- per month
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be a Permanent Resident of Punjab.
1. Applicant should be Disabled and the Disability Percentage should be more than 50%.
1. The Annual Income of Family should not be more than Rs. 60Rs./- per Year.
1. People with mental disabilities are eligible regardless of their specific disability.

name: Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology
brief_description: The programme Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB) is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology. The scheme is implemented by Kerala Biotechnology CommissionRs. KSCSTE to provide quick research support to young scientists to pursue their bright ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology. Proposals can be submitted in any branch of biotechnology related to medicalRs. agricultureRs. veterinaryRs. environmentRs. marineRs. industrial or bio-resources. Post-doctoral students/Research Associates not having permanent positions can also be Principal Investigator provided a senior faculty/scientist holding permanent positions shall associate as Co-Principal Investigator. A maximum research grant of 30 lakh will be provided to the selected projects for a maximum duration of 3 years. Grants will be paid for specific projects to cover expenditure on manpowerRs. equipmentRs. consumablesRs. contingencies and travel.
benefits:
1. Young Scientists without fellowship/salary are eligible for a fellowship of 45Rs./- plus 10% HRA per monthRs. in addition to the support for travelRs. contingencyRs. consumablesRs. and minor equipment.
1. A Principal Investigator having a regular position can seek manpower.
1. Maximum support up to 30 lakhs (excluding overhead charges @ 10% of the project cost subject to a ceiling of 1.0 lakh) for a period not exceeding three years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should possess a Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences.
2. The applicant should possess three years of post-doctoral experience in Biotechnology.
3. The applicant should be less than 40 years of age.
**Note:** Five years of relaxation in age would be available to scientists belonging to SC/ST/OBCRs. WomenRs. and Physically Handicapped categories.

name: Kala Samman Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme "Kala Samman Scheme" is implemented by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of GoaRs. to grant financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contribution to the field of Art and culture.
> **Objectives** 1. To give financial support to the artists in indigent circumstances. 1. To grant monthly financial assistance to the artists who are in indigent conditions to meet their daily needs. 1. To recognize the contribution of artists in the field of Art and culture.
benefits:
1. Financial Assistance to the extent of 2Rs./- per month every year.
1. HoweverRs. the recipient of State Cultural Award shall be entitled for Financial Assistance to the extent of 3Rs./- per month every year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist who is in indigent condition.
1. The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years.
1. The applicant should have given a contribution to the field of Art and culture or should have worked in the field of Art and culture.
1. The income of the applicant should not exceed 48Rs./- per annum. (HoweverRs. this clause shall not be applicableRs. where the applicant is the recipient of the State Cultural Award').

**NOTE:** The number of cases to be sanctioned shall depend upon the availability of funds for every financial year.

name: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana - Chhattisgarh
brief_description: This scheme provide grant to farmers on tube well mining and pump installation. The main objective of the scheme is to increase the productivity and crop intensity by making proper use of available ground water through tube wells and providing irrigation facilities to the crops.
benefits:
**Mining Grant:** **S. No.****Farmer Category****Grant Eligibility**1GeneralActual Cost of mining (Including casing pipe) or Rs. 10Rs./- whichever is less2SC/ST Actual Cost of mining (Including casing pipe) or Rs. 18Rs./- whichever is less
**Subsidy on pump installation:** **S. No.****Farmer Category****Grant Eligibility**1GeneralCost of pump and accessories or Rs. 20Rs./- whichever is less.2SC/STCost of pump and accessories or Rs. 25Rs./- whichever is less.
eligibility:
1. Farmers of all categories of districts will be benefited.
1. Preference will be given to small and marginal farmers
1. The farmers who have received the benefit of tube well mining grant in the past under any other scheme run by the department or under this scheme will not be eligible.

name: Dai Didi Mobile Clinic Scheme
brief_description: Dai Didi Clinic Scheme is an important welfare scheme of the Government of Chhattisgarh. This scheme is to provide medical help to those women and girls living in rural areas who do not go to the doctor due to lack of time or many other reasonsRs. but now midwives provide them treatment facilitiesRs. through female friends and medical staff near home. And she can get her treatment done through female staff without humid.
benefits:
1. Free checkup.
1. Free treatment.
1. Free consultation.
1. Free medicine distribution.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. The beneficiary should be female.

name: Short Term Loan Scheme
brief_description:
"Short Term Loan Scheme" is a Loan Scheme by the Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance/ loan is provided as a credit to individuals from the Scheduled Tribe (ST) Community to meet the immediate expenses towards EducationRs. Medical and Business needs. The scheme aims to improve their standard of living and to bring them into the mainstream of society by fulfilling these needs.
> **Interest RateRs. Number of InstalmentsRs. and Moratorium Period** **For Education Purposes:** The loan shall be given at the interest rate of 2% per annum payable within 20 months in a maximum of 20 instalments with a moratorium period of 3 months. **For Business and Medical Purposes:** The loan shall be given at the interest rate of 2% per annum payable within 10 months in a maximum of 10 instalments with a moratorium period of 03 months.
> **Penal Interest** If the loan is overdueRs. 1% of penal interest will be charged on the amount of the overdue instalment.
> **Recovery** The entire loan along with interest will be recovered according to the rules in force.
benefits: Short Term Loan of up to 1Rs./- as an advance to meet the Financial requirement urgently for Business/ Education/ Medical Purposes.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an individual from the Scheduled Tribe (ST) Community of the State of Goa.
1. The applicant can reapply under the said scheme provided he has cleared earlier loans availed under the scheme.

name: Self Employment Scheme - Goa
brief_description: "Self Employment Scheme" is a Loan Scheme by the Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation LimitedRs. Department of Tribal WelfareRs. Government of Goa. Under this schemeRs. the financial support will be advanced up to a maximum 10Rs. to any individual person belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community to undertake any self-employment activities that will be approved by the Corporation from time to time. The Loan /Financial assistance will also be made available to the extent of 15Rs. to the Association / Societies / Partnership / Self-help groups (SHG) / Companies formed exclusively by the member of the Schedule Tribes Community.
benefits:
1. Financial Support up to a maximum of 10Rs. to individuals. 1. Loan/ Financial Assistance up to a maximum of 10Rs. to the Association / Societies / Partnership / Self-help groups (SHG) / Companies. 1. The beneficiary is required to contribute a 10% margin money towards the cost of the project. (The BOD may relax this condition considering the merit in each caseRs. but this relaxation shall not be applicable to the Association / Societies / Partnership / SHG / Company etc).
> **Insurance** 1. The life of the beneficiary and the business activity shall be insured from fireRs. theftRs. cyclone and other natural calamities with the agency identified by the Corporation and the said policy shall be endorsed in the name of the Corporation. 1. In the event of any calamityRs. the compensation received from the Insurance Company shall be adjusted against the loan outstanding in the Corporation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Individual / Association / Societies / Partnership / Self-help Group (SHG) / Company.
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) Community.
1. The family income of the applicant/beneficiary should not be more than 1Rs. per annum.
1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 55 years.
1. Financial support should only be given to undertake any self-employment activities.
1. The applicant will have to provide two guarantors / Surety who is having a sound financial status. One Guarantor should necessarily be a Government Servant.

**NOTE:** The eligibility criteria can be relaxed in deserving cases by the decision of the BOD.

name: Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana
brief_description:
Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Vishvakarma Durghatana Mrtyu Par Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Raashi Bhugataan Yojana" for labor workers. Under this schemeRs. benefits will be provided to the workers and their family members.
The main objective of starting the scheme is to provide financial help to the workers of the state. If any accident happens to a worker while workingRs. then he or his family members are provided financial assistance under this scheme.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance under following circumstances**

1. In the case of normal death 25Rs./- and Funeral assistance of 5Rs./-
1. In the case of accidental death: 1Rs./- and Funeral assistance of 5Rs./-
1. In case of permanent disability: 75Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Age should be between 18 to 60 years.
1. The construction worker should be registered as a beneficiary under Section 12 of the Act.
1. Payment of funeral assistance and ex-gratia is not provided in case of death caused by deliberate suicide or consumption of intoxicating substances or substances or death due to fighting with each other in violation of law in order to commit crime.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given only on the death of the registered worker and not on the death or accident of the family member.

name: Barbershop Renovation Grant
brief_description:
> **Introduction:**

The traditional barbers are one of the most backward communities in Kerala. In the transformed modern scenarioRs. this community faces challenges in their life related to the traditionally involved occupation of them. To keep up their survival in societyRs. it is needed to strengthen them by modernizing and renovating their work sites.
By keeping in view the above factsRs. the Backward Communities Development Department has formulated a new scheme to provide financial assistance to uplift the standard of traditional barbershops. The scheme envisages improving the working environment and materials of the traditional barbershop to alleviate the problems faced by traditional barbers.
> **Aims/Objectives:**


1. To uplift the dignity of the traditional Barber communities by modernizing their shops.
1. To improve the standard of living of the above-serving professionals.
1. To spread public awareness of the Government's concern and efforts to help the people who undertaking this profession.
1. To improve the Public health by providing hygienic infrastructure.

> **Monitoring of the Scheme:**

The implementation of the scheme will be monitored by the Regional Deputy Directors of the Department.
benefits:
1. The maximum grant that can be availed by a beneficiary under the scheme is 25Rs./-.
**Note 01:** The financial assistance will be transferred to the beneficiary account through the online fund transfer system.
**Note 02:** If the total cost of modernization is 10Rs./- or less (i.e. eligible assistance is 5Rs./- or less)Rs. the same will be disbursed in a single installment.
**Note 03:** If the total cost of modernization is more than 10Rs./-Rs. it will be disbursed in two installmentsRs. 60% of eligible assistance being paid as the first installment and the balance 40% being paid on completion of the work and due verification and certification by the authorized officer of the Department.
**Note 04:** Financial assistance will be 50% of the total project cost for modernization subject to a maximum of 25Rs./-.
**Note 05:** The grant may be used to purchase instruments and furniture.
**Note 06:** The grant may be used to purchase Germs killersRs. sterilizing instrumentsRs. and disposable towels.
**Note 07:** The grant may be used to ensure the hygiene of the existing shop.
eligibility:
1. The applicant will be a permanent resident of Kerala State.
2. The applicant should belong to the State Other Backward Communities.
3. The applicant should be a traditional barber.
4. The Barbershop must be in rural areas.
5. The annual family income of the applicant from all sources does not exceed 1Rs./-.
6. The applicant should have a minimum of ten years of work experience and also currently engaged in the profession at present.
7. The age limit of the applicant should not be more than 60 years.
**Note 01:** Preference shall be given to those who work in rural areas and are physically challenged.
**Note 02:** Preference shall be to those shops having a seating capacity of less than three.
**Note 03:** Preference shall be given to those registered under LSGDs.
**Note 04:** Preference shall be given to those applicants having two daughters.
**Note 05:** Preference shall be to those doing the service profession as self-employment.
**Note 06:** At least one beneficiary from one Panchayat will be selected.
**Note 07:** If there are more than 1000 eligible applications as per the Seniority list submitted by LSGD then the strength of beneficiaries shall be limited to 1000.
> **Parameters for the selection process:**

name: Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Futkar SabjiRs. Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu TarajuRs. Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 15 June 2016.. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance of Cycle or Torch .
benefits: > An amount of Rs 700/- (Rs seven hundred only) per beneficiary will be provided for scalesRs. weights and 02 baskets.
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker in any district of the state.
1. Applicant must have minimum age of 18 years.
1. Applicant should not have received the similar benefits from any other schemes.

name: Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 16 April 2018. The main objective of the scheme to provide the financial assistance to the person who are suffering from Silicosis disease.
benefits:
- Unorganized workers with silicosis will get 300Rs..
- If the worker diesRs. their family will get 100Rs. and the rest will be paid as a fixed deposit with monthly interest.
eligibility:
1. Workers registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board.
1. Workers who claim to be working in the organized sector but cannot prove itRs. or construction workers who are not eligible for registration with the Chhattisgarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. will also get the benefits.

name: E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana
brief_description: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "E-Rikshaw Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker in 20 December 2016. The main objective of the scheme to empower the unorganized worker through provide them financial assistance.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance**

1. Registered unorganized labor individuals will need to cover the expenses of 10Rs. for scheme execution.
1. A grant of 30Rs./- will be provided by the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Worker State Social Security Board.
1. The remaining sum will be extended to the Rikshaw/Auto Driver as a bank loanRs. with the beneficiary responsible for repaying it within a specified timeframe and at the interest rate determined by the bank.
1. The Board will only transfer its contribution to the beneficiary's account once all the necessary loan-related documents are submitted to the board.
eligibility:
1. Only auto/cycle rickshaw drivers who are registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers' State Social Security Board are eligible for this scheme.
1. Registered workers must be between 18 and 50 years old.
1. Registered workers must be registered with the RTO.
1. Registered workers must have a commercial vehicle driver's license.
1. Workers must have been registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers' State Social Security Board for at least 90 days.
1. Each beneficiary can only receive the benefits of this scheme once.
1. Beneficiaries who have already received benefits from any other equivalent scheme offered by the state government are not eligible for the benefits of this scheme.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors
brief_description:
"Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors" by the Directorate of Art and CultureRs. Government of GoaRs. has been designed to promote Goan publishers to provide them with financial support for the publication of books.
> **Objectives** 1. To support Goan publishersRs. by providing them with opportunities and encouraging them in publishing the books. 1. To give financial support to Goan publishers for publishing the books.
benefits:
1. Upto 300 books will be purchasedRs. subject to the condition that the total amount should not exceed 50Rs./-.

**NOTE:** The publisher shall give a minimum 15% discount on the price of the book.
eligibility:
1. Any Goan publisher is eligible for the scheme provided the writer of the book is Goan.
1. The applicant should have substantial experience in publication.
1. The applicant should publish a minimum of 500 copies of the book for which he wants to avail the financial assistance.
1. The book could be published by the author himself or published by any other publishing unit provided NOC is issued by the author to the publisher.
1. The book should contain 100% originality.
1. The printing and paper of the book should be of good quality & standard.

**NOTE:** The person who has lived in Goa for a minimum of 10 years of his creative lifespanRs. will be treated as Goan for the purpose of this scheme.

name: National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training
brief_description: "National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training" of the Department of Higher EducationRs. Ministry of Education is overseen by four Regional Boards of Apprenticeship/Practical (BOATs/BOPT) in MumbaiRs. KanpurRs. ChennaiRs. and Kolkata. The scheme offers practical training to graduate engineersRs. diploma holders (Technicians)Rs. and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs in approximately 10Rs. industrial establishments. This program operates in compliance with guidelines established by the Central Apprenticeship Council (CAC)Rs. a statutory body created under the Apprentices ActRs. 1961. The primary goal is to bridge the gap in practical experience for fresh Graduate EngineersRs. Diploma holdersRs. and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs. The apprentices undergo a one-year training periodRs. receiving a monthly stipend shared equally between the Central Government and the Employer.
benefits:
1. The apprentices undergo a one-year Apprenticeship Training period.
2. Apprentices receive a monthly stipend during their training.

- Engineering Graduate: 4Rs. per month
- Technicians: 3Rs. per month
- 10+2 Vocational pass-outs: 2Rs. per month

3. The stipend is shared equally between the Central Government and the employerRs. with the employer initially paying the full stipend and later claiming 50% reimbursement from the Central Government through the respective Boards of Apprenticeship/Practical (BOATs/BOPT).
eligibility:
The applicant should be one of the following -

- Graduate Engineers
- Diploma Holders (Technicians)
- 10+2 Vocational Passouts

name: Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Theka Shramik Evan Hamaal Shramik Baahy Rogi Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 August 2015. The main objective of the scheme to provide financial assistance for the medical treatment.
benefits: Financial Assistance : 2Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Applicant should be registered in any district of the state.
1. If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State GovernmentRs. then applicant is not eligible for this scheme.
1. Beneficiaries aged between 18 years to 60 years will be eligible under the scheme.

name: Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka ShramikRs. Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. The scheme provides the following benefits:

name: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
brief_description:
The scheme Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students was implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry to financially assist the Scheduled Caste parents for sending school their daughters who otherwise earn livelihood for the family engaging themselves in menial labour.
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to eliminate the Scheduled Caste girl child labour and encourage Scheduled Castes parents to send their girl children to educational institutions by paying opportunity cost in lieu of the income shortage suffered by them.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. 3Rs./- per academic year is payable to the Scheduled Caste parent for each daughter studying in classes VI to XII standard.

**Note 01:** The opportunity cost is payable to the parents of the Scheduled Caste girl in addition to the Pre-Matric Scholarship payable to the children.
**Note 02**: The opportunity cost is not payable in respect of girls re-admitted in a class for a second academic yearRs. owing to failure or discontinuance in the class previously.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a girl student studying in Class VI Standard to XII Standard of a Government or Government recognized educational institution in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
1. The students should belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
1. The girl student and her parent/guardian should be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry either by virtue of birth or by continuous residence for a period of not less than 3 years.
1. The annual income of the parents shall not be more than 24Rs./-.

**Note:** The opportunity cost is payable to the parents only if girl students have been promoted to the next higher class.

name: Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions
brief_description: The scheme Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions was implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support to Scheduled Tribe candidates/trainees who are undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. a stipend is paid at the rate of 170/- per month per trainee for the whole period of training.
eligibility:
1. The candidates/trainees who are undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The candidate should belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
1. There is no income limit to apply under the scheme.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
brief_description: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Barrier net is a traditional method of catching fish practiced by the fishermen residing near the bank of the river. Under this Scheme financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of barrier nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **For General Category**

Subsidy of 50%Rs. limited to 30Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

Subsidy of 60%Rs. limited to 36Rs. on a unit cost of 60Rs. (excluding GST).
**NOTE:** The beneficiary can avail of the scheme every 4 years.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
- The applicant should have purchased a Barrier Net and its Accessories.

name: Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
brief_description:
The Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna was launched by the Department of Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to enhance livelihood security in urban areas by providing 120 days of guaranteed wage employment to every household in a financial year. The scheme will be implemented in all the Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and Cantonment Boards (CBs) in Himachal Pradesh.
> **Goals of the Scheme:**


- To ensure livelihood security to urban households by providing guaranteed employment for 120 days.
- To facilitate skill enhancement of persons engaged in waged labour jobs to provide them with better livelihood opportunities and to set up their enterprises by imparting entrepreneurship training as well as subsidy-linked credit linkages.
- To strengthen urban infrastructure and provisioning of quality civic amenities in the Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
benefits:
> **Guaranteed Employment:**


- The scheme provides guaranteed 120 days of employment to eligible beneficiaries in urban local bodies to ensure livelihood security.
- The ULBs shall not employ an eligible beneficiary for more than 120 days in any financial year.
- Employment will be given to the eligible beneficiary within 15 days of registrationRs. failing which an unemployment allowance of 75 per day will be paid by the ULBs.

> **Maximum Period for Employment:**


- The maximum period for which employment will be provided to a household shall be 120 days.

> **Skill Training:**


- The eligible beneficiaries under this scheme will also be provided skill training under the Deen Dyal Antodaya-National Urban Livelihood Mission (DAY-NULM)Rs. to create further opportunities for better livelihood.
- The eligible beneficiary will be provided skill training with entitlement to minimum wage as notified by the government up to a maximum of four weeks only after doing wage employment of 30 days under MMSAGY.

> **Bank Linkage:**


- The eligible beneficiary so skilled under this scheme will be facilitated to apply for loans under DAY-NULM.
- The eligible beneficiary provided skill training aboveRs. willing to start their Enterprise will be linked to the banks under the Self Employment Programme (SEP) of DAY-NULM.

> **Payment of Wages:**


- Eligible beneficiaries under the scheme will be entitled to minimum wage notified by the State Government.
- Equal wages are to be paid to both male and female workers.
- Wages will be directly deposited in the bank account of eligible beneficiaries by the Urban Local Bodies on a fortnightly basis not later than 7 days after completion of 15 days of employment.
- The payment of wages as prescribed supra will be made after due verification of the attendance by the Junior Engineer or any other officer/official authorized by the Urban Local Body.
- The payment made above will be adjusted/deducted from the bills of the implementing agency before making its payment.
eligibility:
1. All adult members of the household who register under this scheme will be eligible to work. To register they have to be:

- Local resident of the Urban Local Body. (Meaning thereby they should be residing within the jurisdiction of the Urban Local Body either in their own house or on rent).
- Willing to do unskilled work at projects being executed or in Sanitation Services being provided by the Urban Local Bodies.

2. The household will comprise of husbandRs. wifeRs. and their minor children. HoweverRs. only adult members of the household shall be eligible to work.
3. The upper age limit for providing work shall be 65 years.
> **Permissible Activities:**

1. All eligible beneficiaries will be employed in the following permissible activities in ULBs:

- In any ongoing or new admissible work under any Govt. of H.P./Govt. of India scheme for which funds are available with ULB.
- In any admissible work under the 15th Finance Commission or 5ffi State Finance Commission for which grant-in-aid is provided to the ULBs.
- Sanitation Works/Services as admissible under Solid Waste Management RulesRs. 2016 and Swachh Bharat Mission. The sanitation works/services may include activities like street sweepingRs. garbage collectionRs. processing/removal of legacy wasteRs. waste segregationRs. cleaning of garbage from hill slopes or other litter pointsRs. cleaning and maintaining municipal parksRs. and cleaning of municipal parking.

2. The Urban Local Bodies shall not start any muster-roll linked work/activity under this scheme and shall get eligible beneficiaries employed only in the works specified above (a).
3. The Urban Local Bodies shall make enabling provisions in all new contracts to be awarded for engaging eligible beneficiaries under MMSAGY as unskilled workers by the implementing agency. For the works already awardedRs. the Urban Local Bodies will coordinate with the implementing agency to which the work has been awarded for engaging the registered eligible beneficiaries under MMSAGY.

name: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood
brief_description: Financial Assistance to Take up Value Addition to Seafood is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. individuals who have been residents of Goa for the last 15 yearsRs. and are interested in setting up a unit for value-added fisheries products are provided financial assistance as a subsidy of 50% of the cost for the Construction or Renovation of the Unit or for the Purchase of Equipment. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance for Construction or Renovation of the Unit**

50% subsidy of the costRs. limited to 5Rs. per unit.
> **Financial Assistance for Purchase of Equipment**

50% subsidy of the costRs. limited to 2Rs. per unit.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an individual interested in setting up a unit for value-added fisheries products.
- The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last 15 years.

> **Reservation/ Relaxation/ Preference/ Priority**

Preference will be given to self-help groupsRs. women entrepreneursRs. and youth (who have completed fishermen training courses/short-term training programs conducted by the Directorate of Fisheries).

name: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme
brief_description: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the amount equivalent to the actual VAT paid shall be reimbursed to the owner as a subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by the fishing vessel. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
- An amount equivalent to the actual Value Added Tax paid shall be reimbursed to the owner of the fishing vessel as a subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by the fishing vessel used for the purpose of fishing on a limited quotaRs. as decided by the government.
- The total quota of H.S.D. Oil for the purpose of this scheme shall be restricted to 20Rs. K.L. per financial year for the entire fishing industry.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have a registered fishing vessel under the M.S. Act.
2. The applicant should possess a valid Net Licence and Fishing Licence for the year.
3. The applicant should not be a defaulter of the Department of Fisheries.
4. The applicant should not be a violator of the GoaRs. Daman and Diu Marine Fishing Regulation ActRs. 1980 (3 of 1981) and rules framed thereunder.
5. The applicant should procure H.S.D. Oil from a Diesel Outlet run by the Registered Fisheries Co-operative Society or outlets approved by the Government of Goa.

name: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State
brief_description: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State is a scheme by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the active fishermen who contribute to the Fishermen Corpus Relief FundRs. whose fishing vessels are damaged or lost due to natural calamities. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits:
> **Death/Disability** - **Loss of Life/Total Disability While Fishing in Sea/River:** 5Rs. in Case of Loss of Life/Total Disability on Production of the Required Documents.
> **Loss/Damage to Fishing Canoe** - **Partial Damage of Fishing Canoe:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by an Authorized Marine SurveyorRs. is Limited to 1Rs..- **Total Loss/Damage of Canoe With OBM:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by an Authorized Marine SurveyorRs. is Limited to 2Rs..
> **Loss/Damage to Fishing Vessel** - **1 to 4-cylinder Fishing Vessel:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by an Authorized Marine SurveyorRs. is Limited to 7Rs..- **6 to 8-cylinder Fishing Vessel:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by an Authorized Marine SurveyorRs. is Limited to 10Rs..
> **Loss/Damage to Fishing Nets** - **Gill Nets:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by Authorized Fisheries Surveyor or Marine Surveyor or TalathiRs. is Limited to 50Rs./-- **Rampon Nets:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by Authorized Fisheries Surveyor or Marine Surveyor or TalathiRs. is Limited to 1Rs./-- **Trawl Net:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by Authorized Fisheries Surveyor or Marine Surveyor or TalathiRs. is Limited to 50Rs./-- **Purseine Net:** Actual ValueRs. as Assessed by Authorized Fisheries Surveyor or Marine Surveyor or TalathiRs. is Limited to 5Rs./-
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Fisherman.
- The applicant should have been contributing to the Fishermen Corpus Relief Fund.
- The applicant's non-motorized/motorized canoe and mechanized fishing vessel/trawler should be registered with the Department of Fisheries.
- The applicant's fishing vesselsRs. including enginesRs. motorsRs. and fishing vesselsRs. should have been damaged or lost due to natural calamities like floodsRs. cyclonesRs. tsunamisRs. and accidental fire.
- The applicant should not be a defaulter of the department.
- The applicant's loss or damage should be verified by the competent authority.

name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
brief_description:
The ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF) is a fellowship scheme initiated by the Department of Science & Technology (DST)Rs. Government of India. The scheme is launched as an initiative under the ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund (AISTDF) to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries (namely Brunei DarussalamRs. CambodiaRs. IndonesiaRs. Lao PDRRs. MalaysiaRs. MyanmarRs. PhilippinesRs. SingaporeRs. ThailandRs. and Vietnam) to carry out research at any of the Indian research/academic Institution.
> **Objectives:**

The AI-RTF scheme is a fellowship scheme with the following objectives:

- To promote the mobility of scientists and researchers from the ASEAN-Member Countries to India and provide them the opportunity to work at Indian R&D/ academic institutions to upgrade their research skills and expertise.
- To facilitate the exchange of information and contacts between the scientists and researchers of India and ASEAN Countries and create a network for building research collaborations.

As a spin-offRs. the Fellowship awardees may also have the opportunity to get co-supervisors from India for their research projects for Ph.D. or Masters degrees on their return to their home countries.
> **Number of fellowships:**

Fifty (50) fellowships per year shall be awarded to young scientists and researchers from ASEAN-Member States to get affiliated with Indian academic and R&D institutions.
> **Duration of fellowships:**

The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months. No request for extension \ reduction in the duration period shall be entertained after the award of the fellowship.
> **Management & execution:**

ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF) program shall be managed and coordinated by the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)Rs. New Delhi.
> **Areas in which fellowships are available-**

The area/topic of research for availing AI-RTF must be ASEAN-centric and must be aligned with the ASEAN Plan of Action on ScienceRs. TechnologyRs. and Innovation (APASTI). The fellowship is offered for working on research topics under any of the following broad disciplines:
Agricultural Sciences
Biological and Medical Sciences
Chemical Sciences & Engineering
Computer Science & Engineering
Physical Sciences and Mathematics
OceanRs. Earth & Atmospheric Sciences
Engineering Sciences
MaterialsRs. Minerals and Metallurgy
Science Policy/IPR Management/Technology Transfer & Commercialization
Other multi-disciplinary areas of ScienceRs. Technology and Innovation in alignment with APASTI.
**Note:** The fellowship is available in all fields of natural & engineering sciencesRs. including mathematics & statisticsRs. except humanities and behavioral sciences.
benefits:
1. Full financial assistance will be provided to the selected Fellows which includes the following:-
a) Round trip international airfare by lowest economy class and by the shortest route from the international airport in the home country of the applicant to the international airport nearest to the host institution in India; visa feesRs. overseas medical insuranceRs. etc.
b) A consolidated Fellowship amount of Indian Rupees (INR) 60Rs./- per month.
c) One-time grant of INR 40Rs./- as research contingency expensesRs. airport transfersRs. domestic travel for attending scientific /eventsRs. and field trips within India.
d) Institutional overhead charges @ INR 2Rs./- per month.
e) The allowance as in (a)Rs. (b) & (c) will be released to the host institution in India for disbursement to the Fellow. The host Institution will arrange appropriate accommodation for the Fellow on a payment basis.
2. The selected Fellow is advised to take an appropriate policy for health insurance coverage for the period of stay in India. The cost of obtaining an overseas insurance policy is covered and reimbursable under AISTDF.
3. Individual FellowRs. or his/ her government/institutionRs. is required to bear the following costs:
a) All expenses in the home country incidental to travel abroadRs. including expenditure incurred to obtain passport and visa and for medical examinations and vaccinations as may be required as well as other miscellaneous expenses such as internal travel to/ from the international airport of departure in the home country.
b) Salary and other related allowances in the home countryRs. if applicableRs. during the Fellowship period.
4. Neither the AISTDF nor the host institution in India will assume any responsibility whatsoever for the following expenditure of the Fellows during the tenure of the Fellowship:
a) Compensation in the event of deathRs. disabilityRs. or loss of personal belongings or compensation for damage caused by climatic or other conditions.
b) Travel and other costs incurred by the dependentsRs. who might accompany the Fellows.
eligibility:
1. Indian nationals are not eligible for the Fellowship.
1. Applicant must be holding the nationality of any of the ASEAN Member Countries.
1. Applicant should possess at least a Masters Degree in any Natural Sciences or an equivalent degree in Technology/Engineering/Medicine / allied disciplines.
1. Applicant should be working/studying and/or affiliated with any national R&D or academic institution in his/her home ASEAN Member Country.
1. The application should be endorsed by the Head of his/her institution confirming that if selectedRs. he/ she will be sanctioned leave for the Fellowship period and will join his/ her duties back in the institution on completion of the Fellowship in India.
1. The upper age limit for the applicant is 45 years as of the date of submission of the application.
1. The applicant should be fluent in the English language.
1. ASEAN applicants who have availed of any fellowship scheme of the Government of India during the last 3 years are not ELIGIBLE to apply.
1. The proposed research work in India must be linked/ connected and add value to any of the ongoing research projects/schemes of the Indian host Institute.
