_*The Agricultural Officers (Horticulture) shall conduct periodic field inspections to verify the progress of the cultivation in coordination with the Agricultural Officers of the respective Uzhavar Uthaviyagams._

name: State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture
brief_description:
The scheme State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Nagaland to provide educational assistance to students who are undergoing undergraduate (B.Sc. Agriculture) and post-graduate programme (M.Sc. Agriculture).
**Objectives:**

- To strengthen human resource development by upgrading technical expertise.
- To support the students/scholars undergoing graduate and post-graduate studies in Agriculture disciplines within and outside the state.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the eligible students will get the scholarship at the following rates:
**Sl. No.****Programme Name****Scholarship Amount**1B.Sc. Agriculture700/- per month2M.Sc. Agriculture900/- per month2. The State Department of Agriculture also provides book grants & reimbursements annually to the enrolled students under the programme.
eligibility:
A student should fulfill the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

1. State Agriculture Scholarship will be applicable for all the inhabitants of Nagaland pursuing for B.Sc. or M.Sc. Agriculture.
1. The applicant must be from an Institution which has a valid AISHE/UDISE code.
1. Students who have failed in their last examination (repeaters) are not eligible to apply.
1. Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme.

name: Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control
brief_description:
The scheme Soil Resource Management and Inputs Quality Control" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's WelfareRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the farmers can give their soil and water samples to the soil testing lab attached to the Office of the Additional Director of Agriculture (LUP & QC)Rs. ThatanchavadyRs. PuducherryRs. for analysis and recommendation at completely free of cost.
> **Objectives** - To monitor the soil fertility status effectively by intensive sampling and to build up a reliable database of Soil Resources for interpretation in relation to its production potential. - To maintain the soil health for sustaining the production potential and generating fertilizer recommendations for individual crops to meet the farmers requirement based on the soil database thus created. - To prevent further deterioration of soil productivityRs. fertility and sustainability.
benefits:
- The farmers from the Puducherry region can give their soil and water samples to the soil testing lab attached to this office for analysis and recommendation.
- The farmers of the Puducherry region are provided with soil health cards for their cultivable lands within a month.
- This office is also involved in analyzing the quality of the three most important inputs used by the farmers namely (i) Seeds (ii) fertilizers and (iii) Pesticides by trained analysis. Samples taken by the notified quality inspectors are analysed and the quality of the inputs is determined.
- If Farmers have doubts about the quality of important inputs like seedsRs. fertilizers and pesticides they may contact the agricultural officer (U.U.) concerned to assess the quality of these inputs by submitting the sample.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of Puducherry.
- The applicant should be a Farmer.

name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
brief_description: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension YojanaRs. under the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. the government of Madhya Pradesh. provides Pensions are sanctioned to provide social security to old destitute people. Under thisRs. such destitute elderly people who cannot support themselves are benefited.
benefits: > Pension amount: 600/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant age should be more than 60 years.
1. The name should be mentioned on the Samagra portal.

name: Agriculture Engineering (Mechanical) Scheme
brief_description: The Agriculture Engineering (Mechanical) Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to provide agricultural machinery such as power tillers/bulldozers/tractors etc. on hiring at subsidised rate.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Providing a 60% subsidy for the purchase of improved farm machinery and equipment (Proposed for Power Tiller and Diesel Water Pumpset).

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


- Subsidy for hiring of farm machinery and equipment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.

name: Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme
brief_description: The Basic Agriculture Training Centre Scheme is a State Plan SchemeRs. which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to provide short-term vocational training for rural educated unemployed youths in agriculture and allied sectors to develop entrepreneurship skills and employment generation.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Free short-term training to educated unemployed rural youths.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If Any):**


- Training and capacity building.
- Stipend @ 500/- per participant per month.
- Seed money @ 10Rs./- per participant.
eligibility:

1. The applicant should have passed Class X.

name: "Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development Of Handicrafts" Scheme
brief_description: The "Training in Handicrafts" Component of the "Development Of Handicrafts" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Government of PuducherryRs. aims to create better employment opportunities and enhance the livelihood of the rural poor. The training adopts a Gurukulam modelRs. emphasizing learning the craft within its environment.
benefits:
- Trainees will receive a stipend of 1Rs. per month. - Master craftspersons will be compensated with an honorarium of 300 per trainee (up to 3Rs. per month)Rs. and 150 per trainee per month for raw material wastage (up to 1Rs. per month). - The Training commences in December and is for a period of 6 months.

Paper MachineRs. Hand Printed TextileRs. Shell itemsRs. Palm Leaf articlesRs. Embroidery and applique worksRs. Mat WeavingRs. Batik PrintingRs. Pottery/Clay toys/CeramicRs. Dry flowersRs. Lampshade - Jute and paperRs. Wire craftRs. Fibre craft.

name: Exposure Tour for the Coir Artisans Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Exposure Tour For The Coir Artisans Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of Puducherry is introduced for acquiring the latest techniques and innovative ideas in various coir units located in other statesRs. the exposure tour will be conducted for the coir artisans.
benefits:
- The expenses relating to conveyanceRs. accommodationRs. fees to the visiting institutionRs. etc will be paid.
- The participant will be provided 150/- per person per day as Daily Allowance.

name: "Entrepreneurship Development Programme" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
brief_description: The "Entrepreneurship Development Programme" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to provide Entrepreneurship trainingRs. to encourage prospective entrepreneurs to start the coir industry. Awareness programmes will also be arranged for the existing coir industries about the modern technology and schemeRs. and incentives available under the State Grant.
benefits:
- Entrepreneurship training to prospective entrepreneurs to start the coir industry.
- Awareness programmes on modern technology and incentives under the state grant for existing coir industries.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a prospective entrepreneur willing to start a coir industry.
- The applicant should be an entrepreneur with a coir industry.

name: "Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension) Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to provide pension to artisans in their old ageRs. recognizing their contribution to traditional crafts. Under this schemeRs. eligible craftspersons receive a monthly grant of 2Rs./-.
benefits:
- A monthly grant of 2Rs./-. This financial assistance continues until the lifetime of the beneficiaryRs. subject to renewal every year.
- In the case of the craftsperson's deathRs. the living spouse is entitled to receive 1Rs./- per month.

- The family income from all sources should not exceed 40Rs. per annum.
- The applicant should not be a recipient of similar financial assistance from any other source.

name: "Conducting of Exhibitions" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
brief_description: The "Conducting of Exhibitions" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to enhance awareness of diverse coir products and promote their market presence. It extends financial supportRs. including a daily allowance of 150 per participant and travel reimbursementsRs. to both local and outstation participants. - Participants receive a daily allowance of 150 during the exhibition.

eligibility:

name: Insurance Scheme For Artisans Component of the Development of Handicrafts Scheme
brief_description: The "Insurance Scheme For Artisans" component of the "Development of Handicrafts" scheme by the Department of Industries and CommerceRs. Government of PuducherryRs. was introduced to provide an important welfare measure for handicraft artisans. Under this schemeRs. artisans are covered under Jana Shree Bima Yojana LIC or any other suitable policy. - Assistance in the case of Natural Death: 20Rs./-.

name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Old Age Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide financial assistance to senior citizens (Above 60 years of age) in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The aim of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to destituteRs. senior citizens who are without any means of subsistence and having no one to give financial support to them for their livelihood. As per the schemeRs. only those who are permanent residents of A&N Islands or having resided in this territory for not less than 10 years immediately preceding the date of applications are eligible for receiving financial assistance.
benefits:
1. The amount of assistance for persons in the age group 60-79 years shall be 2Rs./- per month.
1. The amount of assistance for persons aged 80 years & above shall be 3Rs./-.

**Note 01:** The scheme also included the beneficiaries of the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS).
**Note 02:** Payment of allowance shall be made through Bank Account on a monthly basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided in the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for more than 10 years at the time of making the application.
1. The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above.
1. The household income of the applicant does not exceed 4000/- per month.
1. The applicant should not be receiving any other financial assistanceRs. pensionRs. or grant from the government or any other source.

name: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizensRs. particularly those with disabilities. Launched in 2013 under the auspices of the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. this visionary scheme aims to extend crucial financial assistance to persons with disabilities (PwDs) across the state. It operates as a lifeline for individuals grappling with various disabilitiesRs. ensuring their financial security and enabling them to lead dignified lives. By providing a pension to eligible beneficiariesRs. MVSYS not only addresses the economic challenges faced by PwDs but also emphasizes inclusivity and equal opportunities. Through its implementationRs. the scheme not just disperses funds but fosters a culture of empathy and supportRs. reaffirming the government's commitment to uplifting marginalized communities. In essenceRs. MVSYS embodies the principles of social justice and empowermentRs. serving as a beacon of hope and resilience for individuals with disabilities in Rajasthan.
benefits: **The following monthly pension will be provided:** Age CriteriaAmount75 Years or Less1Rs./- per Month.75 Years or More1Rs./- per Month.Leprosy Free Patient2Rs./- per Month.Silicosis Disease Patient1Rs./- per Month.

1. Annual family income must not exceed 60Rs./-

name: Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana
brief_description: In 2 October 2021Rs. The "Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana" was started by the Labore department of Rajasthan. It will provide the benefits to old age people. name: Differently Abled Pension Scheme

name: Maternity Benefit (ANBOCWWB)

Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. - 1Rs./- per month.

- One free saree.

- 2kg/month to those who are taking nutritious meals.

name: Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Unemployed Young Professional Sportsperson
brief_description:
Launched on 9th February 2024Rs. the scheme "Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Unemployed Young Professional Sportsperson" was launched by the Directorate of Youth Affairs & SportsRs. name: Marriage Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Marriage Benefit is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers for their own marriage. 1. The financial assistance of 5Rs./- shall be given to the registered workers for their own marriage.

name: Medical Assistance (MBOCWWB)

1. The registered construction workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease are eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Free Bus Pass for Media Persons

Union Territory of PuducherryRs. aims to provide a free bus pass facility to media persons working in Puducherry in Puducherry Road Transport Corporation buses (except town buses) to undertake journeys for their professional requirements.
benefits:
Free bus pass (valid for one year) for professional travel needs.

**Time Limit for Renewal of the Expired Bus Pass:** Two days form the date of application.

name: Loans for Tools (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Loans for Tools scheme is implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. a onetime grant will be granted to all members of the fund for the purchase of tools subject to the conditions. The members of the fund who have completed 3 years of membership in the fund and those who remit contributions regularly will be eligible for this loan.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. registered building and construction workers will receive a one-time grant of up to 10Rs./- for the purchase of tools.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary who has completed 3 years of membership in the fund will be eligible for this loan.
1. The beneficiary who remits contributions regularly will be eligible for this loan.
1. The beneficiary should have completed 55 years.

**Note 01:** Operation and maintenance of the tool shall be the sole responsibility of the beneficiaryRs. and the Board shall not be responsible for any after-sales serviceRs. partsRs. or accessories.
**Note 02:** The grant shall be sanctioned subject to the production of a valid cash memo or voucher from an authorized dealer by the BOCW beneficiary and the tools shall be produced before an official of the Board for inspection & photograph.
**Note 03:** The Board shall emboss a mark (logo or serial No) onto the tool after production & inspection. A tool so marked cannot be produced again for any subsequent claim(s).
**Note 04:** A beneficiary is prohibited from selling the tools purchased and shall not be entitled to a second grant.
**Note 05:** The loan amount shall be recovered in not more than sixty installments.

name: Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the Board may sanction financial assistance to the Construction Workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease. The financial assistance shall be 500/- for the first 5 days and 50/- each for the remaining daysRs. subject to a maximum of 1Rs./-.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 500/- for initial minimum period of 5 days and thereafter 50/- per day upto maximum of 1500/- per monthRs. credited within 15 days through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
- The applicant should have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Maternity Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance during pregnancy to women construction workers and construction workers' wives registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and to provide social stability to construction workers.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 6Rs./- is provided to the wife of a registered construction worker for the first two deliveries.
1. Financial assistance of 37Rs./- is provided to a registered female construction worker for the first two deliveries.

**Note 01:** Financial assistance is disbursed directly from DBT to the beneficiary's account.
**Note 02:** The scheme also provides benefits in case of miscarriage.
**Note 03:** The application period is up to six months from the date of conception.
> **Rules and Conditions:**


1. 17Rs./- before maternity assistance in case of registered women construction workers should be applied in 06 (six) months along with a Surgeon/Gynecologist/Gynecology PHC-approved doctor's certificate/copy of a Mamta card (in case of registered women worker)/Doctor's certificate.
1. The application should be inwarded in the office before the completion of 06 months (six) counting the period from the date of inwarding of the application in the office of the board in the copy of the card.
1. In the case of female construction workers registered in the post-delivery applicationRs. post-delivery financial assistance of 20Rs./- and 6000/- in the case of the wife of a construction worker is provided.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The construction worker should have an active membership of the Board.
1. Financial assistance is provided for the first two births of both a registered female construction worker and the wife of a registered construction worker.

**Note:** Application should be made within 12 (twelve) months after delivery.

name: Natural Death Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Natural Death Benefit Scheme" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 70Rs./- is extended to the nominees/dependents of the deceased Construction WorkerRs. apart from the 70Rs./- extended through the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC). The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee/dependent. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
Financial Assistance: 70Rs./-.
Time of Disbursal: Within 1 month of the application.
Mode of Disbursal: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be the nominee/dependent of the deceased Construction Worker.
- The Construction Worker should have been a citizen of India.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have contributed regularly to the fund.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.

name: Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme
brief_description: The 'Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme' is a state scheme launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme objective is to supply sewing machines free of cost to increase the self-employment potential for rehabilitation of destitute women/widowsRs. deserted womenRs. differently abled men and womenRs. socially affected women and women from economically weaker sections.
benefits: Sewing machines and accessories are provided at free of cost.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 72Rs./-.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 20 to 40 years.
1. The applicant should have knowledge of tailoring.
1. The applicant should be ANY ONE of the following:


- Destitute Woman.
- Widow.
- Deserted Woman.
- Differently Abled Man.
- Differently Abled Woman.
- Socially Affected Woman.
- Woman From Economically Weaker Sections.

name: Integrated Farming in Micro Watershed Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Integrated Farming in Micro Watershed was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to promote integrated farming activities for improved livelihood in a complementary manner.
**Note:** _This availability of the above state plan scheme in any particular year is subject to the availability of funds and necessary sanction by the State Government. The continuation of any scheme in a particular year is also subject to the discretion of the State Government. Farmers are therefore advised to check the availability of any scheme with the respective District Agriculture Officers._
benefits:
> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement:**


- TrainingRs. Awareness programRs. ExtensionRs. Technology supportRs. and Subsidy on inputs.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
1. The applicant should possess their own land or leased land of at least 0.025 hectares or more.

name: Diwali Gift Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Diwali Gift Benefit" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the Board sanction sum of 2Rs./- to each beneficiary enrolled in the Board every year to celebrate the Diwali festival. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered construction worker. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: 2Rs./- credited as Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The Construction Worker should have been registered for at least six months with the 'Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board'.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.

name: Vishist Coaching Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Vishist Coaching Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. both the registration fee and coaching/tuition fees will be reimbursed/paid for the career development of the children of construction workers. The purpose of the scheme is to facilitate their pursuit of becoming Chartered Accountants and successfully passing the competitive examinations conducted by the Gujarat Public Service CommissionRs. Union Public Service CommissionRs. Gujarat Gaun Seva Selection BoardRs. and Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. the registration fee and coaching/tuition fees for the children of registered construction workers will be reimbursed/paid.
eligibility:
1. The children of construction workers registered with Gujarat Building and other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. The construction workers can apply under the scheme for their children who aspire to pursue a career as Chartered Accountants and pass the competitive examinations conducted by the Gujarat Public Service CommissionRs. Union Public Service CommissionRs. Gujarat Gaun Seva Selection BoardRs. and Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board.

> **Terms and Conditions:**


1. The registered construction worker has to apply in the prescribed format and within the prescribed time limit.
1. Application has to be made within six months of taking admission in each academic year.

name: Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram
brief_description:
The "Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram" under The Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government will provide subsidy to farmers on purchasing irrigation pipelines. So that farmers can get rid of the problem of irrigation. And their income can increase. There are many farmers in our country whose financial condition is weak and are unable to buy pipelinesRs. due to which their crops get ruined due to lack of water. To overcome the problem of irrigationRs. many types of schemes are also being run by the Central and State Governments. In this directionRs. considering the problems of farmers.
> **Feature :** 1. Farmers will be eligible for a grant only if they purchase BIS-marked pipes from a manufacturer or their authorized distributor/seller registered with the Agriculture DepartmentRs. either in cash or by taking a loan from a bankRs. and successfully install them on their farm. 1. Each pipe distributed on a grant basis must be embossed with the year of manufacture and the grant distribution year. The grant will be admissible only on pipes manufactured and sold in the eligible year. AdditionallyRs. the grant will be admissible on the remaining pipes from the previous year in the next financial year as well. 1. The concerned manufacturer will necessarily provide information about the remaining stock of the previous financial year to the Deputy Director and Assistant Director of Agriculture (Ext.) office in the district. The grant will not be admissible in the absence of information. 1. In the financial yearRs. the list of maximum retail price (MRP) of pipes will be sent by the pipe manufacturers to the Deputy Director and Assistant Director of Agriculture (Ext.) office through selected dealers in the district. The dealer will also submit an affidavit that no bill will be charged more than the MRP.
**Component****Component****Ice. Code****Description**PipelinePipe4984 /14151 Pt I & II : 199H.D.P.E. irrigation pipePipelinePipe4985 144 kg/cm2 &63 142-5 kg/cm2 &90 mm and above 12PVC for water supply. irrigation pipePipelinePipeIS 16190 : 2014 14 63 mm and above and 200 mm and above 12HDPE High Density Polyethylene Laminated Knitted Flat Tube Irrigation Pipe for Water Supply

> **The subsidy will be payable only on pipes of diameter 63 mm or more than 63 mm.**
benefits:
1. Cost of transporting water: 50% of the cost (capped at 1000/-).
1. Pipe material cost:

- HDPE pipe: 50 per meter (capped at 15Rs./- total).
- PVC pipe: 35 per meter (capped at 15Rs./- total).
- HDPE laminated flat tube pipe: 20 per meter (capped at 15Rs./- total).
eligibility:
1. The agricultural land should be owned by the applicant.
1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan.
1. This scheme applies to farmers who have a diesel engineRs. electric pumpRs. or tractor-driven pump set available on a borewell or well.
1. Applicants must own at least 2 bighas of cultivable agricultural land.
1. The farmer's bank account must be linked to an Aadhar card. AdditionallyRs. no farmer can apply again for the next 10 years after receiving the benefit.
1. Farmers must apply for the grant within 30 days of purchasing the pipe and after this timeframe will not be considered.

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Junior Artists in Contemporary Art Field
brief_description: The "Scheme for Giving Awards to Junior Artists in Contemporary Art Field" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage junior artists towards Painting & Sculpture arts by giving an award of 10Rs./- at the state-level contemporary art exhibition. The Traditional Art / Contemporary Art exhibitions are conducted by Oviya Nunkalai Kuzhu at the state level and awarded works will be on display for public view in the exhibition.
benefits: 10Rs./- award prize money for 30 Junior artists.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should be less than 30 years of age.

name: Shramik Parivahan Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. the registered construction workers will be provided a bus pass through the Municipal Corporation at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. registered construction workers will receive a bus pass at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace.
1. Under the schemeRs. the beneficiary is required to contribute 20% of the pass amountRs. while the board covers the remaining 80%.

**Note:** The pass shall be issued at a concessional rate monthly or quarterly or six-monthly or annually as per the demand of the registered construction worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in any Building or Other Construction Work.
1. The construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.

name: Drip Sanyantr
brief_description:
The Drip Sanyantr under the Agriculture Department Rajasthan government gives subsidies to farmers. Proper utilization of every drop of water by drip plantRs. 75-80 percent saving of water and increase in quality production through efficient technology. For the successful operation of a drip irrigation systemRs. it is necessary to calculate the correct water requirement because through this system only water is given equal to the requirement of the plants. The water requirement of plants varies seasonally and every month and the working hours of the system are balanced accordingly.
> **Important points** 1. After issuing administrative approval from the irrigation department. 1. The grant amount is transferred to the account of the farmer or the supplier manufacturer/dealer with the consent of the farmer.
benefits:
1. 70% subsidy is given to general farmers and 75% subsidy is given to smallRs. marginal Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. and women farmers.
1. All categories of farmers are given subsidies on drip plants up to a maximum area of 5 hectares.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The farmer should have at least 0.2 hectares of irrigated cultivable land.

name: Fawara Sanyantra
brief_description:
The Fawara Sanyantra under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government will give 70% to 75% subsidy to the farmers for installing sprinkler plants. Through this farmers can irrigate more land by getting sprinkler subsidy. The subsidy given by the state government to the farmers will be sent directly to their bank accounts through DBT. To avail of the benefit of the Rajasthan Fawara Sanyantra Subsidy YojanaRs. a farmer should have land up to 0.2 hectares. So that the fields can be irrigated by installing sprinkler plants. The income of farmers will improve through this scheme. Apart from thisRs. efficient utilization and production will also increase. BesidesRs. 50% to 55% of water can be saved by irrigating the fields through sprinklers.
> **Important points** - If the plant purchase bill for the fountain plant is of the same financial year in which the farmer has appliedRs. the grant will be payable to the eligible farmers. - If the sprinkler plant is found to be correct as per the criteria prescribed in the physical verificationRs. the grant amount will be transferred directly to the farmer's account.
benefits:
1. The grant amount is 70% of the unit cost for general farmers.
1. The grant amount is 75% of the unit cost for small and marginal farmersRs. Scheduled Caste/Tribe farmersRs. and women farmers.
1. The grant is payable up to a maximum area of 5 hectares.
eligibility:
1. The Applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The farmer should have at least 0.2 hectares of irrigated agricultural land.

name: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Sudarmani Award
brief_description: The "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Sudarmani Award" scheme by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance 10Rs./- and certificates of appreciation. The scheme is being implemented in all Districts of Tamil Nadu.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 10Rs./-.
- Certificate of Appreciation.
- A shawl worth 500/-.
- 5 eminent artists are awarded every year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 36 to 50 years.

name: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Go-Green Shramik Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to make the "GREEN INDIA MISSION" of the Government of India a realityRs. the construction workers will also become partners and become aware of the environment in them as well as with the good intention that they will have flexibility in commutingRs. save money and time and leave the slum area near the construction site and live in a clean residential area.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a One-time subsidy will be available to the extent of 50% of the price of the battery-operated Two-Wheeler or 30Rs./- whichever is less.
1. The assistance will also be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time for a new two-wheeler i.e. RTO Tax and Road Tax will be reimbursed.

**Note 01:** After deducting the amount of subsidy payable to the vehicle dealer from the ex-showroom price of the two-wheelerRs. the remaining amount will have to be paid by the construction contractor.
**Note 02:** This additional subsidy will be provided in addition to the subsidy available under the electric vehicle-related schemes of the government.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. Registration period for construction workers should be one year or more.
1. A registered construction worker should have purchased a lithium-ion battery high-speed vehicle in his own name.
1. The registered construction worker should have a license to drive two-wheelers.
1. The benefit of this scheme will be available once per registered construction worker.
1. A registered construction worker cannot sell the vehicle for three years after purchasing it.

name: Shramik Annapurna Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Shramik Annapurna Yojana is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. the registered construction worker is providing nutritious meals at concessional rates at the workplace or on Kadianaka. Registered construction workers and their family members can get the benefit.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. healthy and nutritious meals will be provided to the construction workers at a concessional rate of 5/- per meal.
eligibility: - The benefits of this scheme can be availed by construction workers registered with Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and their family members.

name: Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: One-Man Shows
brief_description: The "Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: One-Man Shows" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage talented artists in the field of paintingRs. and sculpture by granting 25Rs./- for conducting "one-man show" art exhibitions. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Oviya Nunkalai Kuzhu.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 25Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist.
1. The applicant should be a native of Tamil Nadu by continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
1. The applicant should have continuous involvement in his/her field of painting and sculpture.
1. The applicant should possess an adequate number of artworks for the conduct of his/her show.
1. Participation in National or State level Art Exhibitions and Artists Camps will be considered as an additional qualification.

name: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Go Green Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to encourage Labourers/Industrial Workers to purchase of battery-operated electric two-wheelers that reduce carbon emissions. It is also benefitted to Government of India's "Green India Mission.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. a subsidy will be provided to Labourers/Industrial Workers on the purchase of Battery-Operated Two-WheelersRs. 30% of the purchase price or 30Rs./- whichever is less.
1. In addition to thisRs. a one-time subsidy will also be provided on the RTO Registration Tax and Road Tax of the Two-Wheeler.
eligibility:
1. Labourers/Industrial Workers should be employed in a factory/institute in the state of Gujarat.
1. Labourers who have been regularly contributing to the Labour Welfare Fund will be eligible for this scheme.

**Other Instruction:**

1. Subsidy will be given to those models which have been empanelled with FAME-2 and GEDA both.
1. Vehicles manufactured in India under Make in India and Aatma Nirbhar Bharat
1. Two-wheeler with a lithium-ion battery that can run at least 50 km on a single chargeRs. does not require a separate charging stationRs. recognized under the Motor and Vehicle Act.
1. Labour has to pay the residual amount after deducting the amount of subsidy from the ex-showroom price.
1. After sellRs. the amount of subsidy will be credited directly to the dealer's account.
1. RTO Road Tax amount will be reimbursed to the dealer.

name: Khet Talai
brief_description:
Khet Talai Yojana under the Agriculture Department of Rajasthan GovernmentRs. The biggest problem for farmers in Rajasthan is water for irrigation. One solution to this problem is a farm pond or in other wordsRs. a farm pondRs. by which the farmer can collect rainwater and use it for irrigationRs. but all the farmers get it constructed. ThereforeRs. the state government gives a subsidy to the farmers on the construction of farm ponds so that the farmers can collect rainwater and irrigate their fields by making farm ponds in their fields.
> **Other important points** 1. After the applicationRs. administrative approval for the construction of the farm pond will be issued by the Agriculture Department. 1. Information about this will be received through mobile message/agriculture supervisor. 1. Spot verification will be done by the department before and after the construction of Khet Talai. 1. The grant amount will be deposited directly into the farmer's account.
benefits:
1. Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. smallRs. and marginal farmers will get 70 percent of the unit cost or a maximum of 73Rs./- on raw form pounds and 90 percent or 1Rs./- on plastic lining form pounds and other category farmers. 1. The subsidy is available on 60 percent of the cost or a maximum of 63Rs./- on raw form pounds and 80 percent or 1Rs./- on plastic lining form poundsRs. whichever is less.
> **The subsidy is payable only on farm ponds of a minimum 400 cubic meter capacity.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant farmer should have a minimum cultivable land of 0.3 hectares at one place in his name.
1. In the case of the joint account holderRs. the minimum land in one place should be 0.5 hectares.

name: Manav Garima Yojana

The scheme Manav Garima Yojana was launched by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was launched in the year 1995. 1. If the beneficiary or any family members of the beneficiary have already benefited from this schemeRs. they are not eligible to avail of its benefits again.

name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)
brief_description: "Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the academically meritorious wards of the Ex-Servicemen (ESM) / Widows of ESM who have secured the top three ranks in academics are provided with lump sum grants of upto 18Rs.. The application should be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the result of the respective exam.
benefits:
> **Grant as per the Merit and the Level of Education**

**10th (Central Board of Secondary Education / Metric / Secondary School Leaving Certificate)**

- 1st Rank: 15Rs..
- 2nd Rank: 13Rs..
- 3rd Rank: 11Rs..

**12th (Central Board of Secondary Education / Higher Secondary Certificate)**

- 1st Rank: 18Rs..
- 2nd Rank: 16Rs..
- 3rd Rank: 14Rs..

**Undergraduate / Postgraduate**

- University Gold Medal: 14Rs..
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Ward of an ESM / Ward of the Widow of an ESM.
- The applicant should have secured 1st/2nd/3rd Rank in Class 10th/12th in a Government-recognized InstitutionRs. or should have secured gold medal in Graduation/Postgraduation in a Government-recognized University.

name: Funeral Assistance (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Funeral Assistance (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. the nominee/dependant of the deceased worker is provided with financial assistance of 5Rs./-. The applications are accepted offline.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 5Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The deceased should have been a Worker.
- The deceased should have been between 18 to 60 years of age.
- The deceased should have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker.
- The deceased should have been registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be the nominee/dependant of the deceased.
- The nominee/dependant of the unregistered workers shall be eligible upon the production of a certificate from the builder or Inspector of the area stating that the deceased was a building worker.

name: Scheme of Conferring Kalaimamani Award
brief_description: The "Scheme of Conferring Kalaimamani Award - Tamil Nadu" was launched by the Art & Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The awards felicitate the famous artists who are serving in a commendable manner in the fields of EyalRs. IsaiRs. NatakamRs. NatyamRs. CinemaRs. Isai NatakamRs. Folk artsRs. Television & related arts given investiture gold pendant of three sovereign ponnadai and citation.
benefits:
The artist is provided with an Investiture Gold Pendant of three Sovereign Ponnadai and a Citation.
_*If the artist expires after the announcement of the award to him/her but before the investiture functionRs. the award will be given to his/her dependent._
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an Artist. 1. The artist should be popular and famous. 1. The artist should have professionally rendered yeomen services for the enrichment of the traditional arts. 1. The artist's performance should have had lasting contributionRs. popularityRs. and merit in the art disciplines of Tamil LiteratureRs. MusicRs. BharathanatyamRs. DramaRs. FilmRs. Folk artsRs. PaintingRs. SculpturesRs. VigadamRs. etc. 1. An artist who is popular in various art disciplines can be conferred the Kalaimamani Award for one discipline only. 1. If more than one artist is jointly engaged in artistic pursuit in any of the art disciplinesRs. the award will be given to them jointly. **NOTE 1:** This award is conferred regardless of casteRs. religionRs. race and age. **NOTE 2:** Individual works of art or a single achievement will not be considered for conferring this award.

name: Concession in Railway Travel
brief_description: The scheme "Concession in Railway Travel" was launched by the Department of Art and CultureRs. Tamil Nadu. Under the schemeRs. individual artists and troupes consisting of more than three artists are allowed to travel in the train on concession by the Railways. A concession certificate will be issued by the Mandram.
benefits:
- 75% concession in Second Class Fare.
- 50% concession in First Class Fare.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an individual artist or a troupe consisting of more than three artists.

name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Stipend to Scheduled Caste Lawyers
brief_description: The scheme Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Stipend to Scheduled Caste Lawyers was launched by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was launched in year 2000. Under the schemeRs. a monthly stipend is provided for three years to law graduates belonging to the scheduled caste categoryRs. as well as to the senior lawyer who trains such individuals. This support is extended due to their poor financial conditionRs. aiming to prevent mid-practice dropout.
benefits:
The stipend is given to law graduates for training in practice through senior lawyers as under:

1. 1Rs./- per month for First Year Training
1. 800/- per month for Second Year Training
1. 600/- per month for Third Year Training
1. 500/- per month as given to Senior Lawyer for giving training

**Note 04:** Training to lawyers should be given at the district headquarters. By amending itRs. this type of training can also be given at the taluka headquarters.

name: Plastic Mulching
brief_description:
The plastic Mulching scheme under the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government provided subsidies to farmers. Using plastic mulch helps prevent soil compaction and compaction. This material blocks moisture and heat and limits the loss of plant nutrients. Plastic mulch is the most restrictive of all the mulching materials available on the marketRs. so it is well-suited for drip irrigation. AdditionallyRs. the plastic layer prevents people and pets from walking in the areaRs. further strengthening the soil structure.
> **Other important points** 1. Plastic mulching can be constructed only after administrative approval is issued by the Horticulture Department. 1. Verification can be done by the committee formed after construction. 1. The payment of the grant amount will be transferred directly to the farmer's bank account.
benefits:
1. Small/marginal farmers can get a 25% subsidy on up to 2 hectares of land.
1. Other farmers can get a 50% subsidy on up to 2 hectares of land.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.

name: Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students- Gujarat
brief_description: The Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The scheme is implemented by the DirectorRs. Scheduled Caste Welfare in the state of Gujarat. The objective of the scheme is to appreciably increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education with a focus on those from the poorest householdsRs. by providing financial assistance at post-matriculation or postsecondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
benefits:
> **Academic allowance:**

**Sl. DiplomaRs. Certificate9500 65003Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under Group 1 & Group 2600030004Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses 40002500**Note 1:** 10% extra allowances shall be provided for Divyang students. (If the student is disabled then disability allowance is admissible.)

1. StudentsRs. who pursue their studies through correspondence/online coursesRs. are also eligible. The term correspondence includes distance and continuous education for courses in Central/ State Universities only. Non-refundable fees shall be paid and no academic allowance will be paid.

1. A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend.
1. If awarded any other scholarship/stipendRs. the student can exercise his/her option for either of the two scholarships/stipendsRs. whichever is more beneficial to him/herRs. and should inform the awarding authority through the Head of the Institution about the option made. No scholarship will be paid to the students under this scheme from the date he/she accepts another scholarship/stipend. The student canRs. howeverRs. accept free lodging or a grant or ad-hoc monetary help from the State Government or any other source for the purchase of booksRs. equipmentRs. or for meeting the expenses on board and lodging in addition to the scholarship amount paid under this scheme.

1. IfRs. according to the Regulations of a University/InstitutionRs. a student is promoted to the next higher class even though he/she may not have actually passed in the lower class and is required to take an examination of the junior class again after some timeRs. he/she will be entitled to scholarship for the class to which he/she is promoted if the student is otherwise eligible for scholarship. FurtherRs. in case a student fails in any class and then again joins the same class as a regular studentRs. he/she will be eligible for a scholarship for one additional year or the actual periodRs. whichever is lower.
