1. The child should be a visually impairedRs. hearing impairedRs. intellectual disabilityRs. and locomotor differently abled person.
1. A child's age should be 5 years and above.

name: Smart Phone for Hearing and Visually Impaired Persons
brief_description: The scheme 'Smart Phone for Hearing and Visually Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute smart phones to needy visually impaired and hearing impaired studentsRs. unemployed youthRs. self-employed and women.
benefits: - Free distribution of smart phones.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a visually impaired and hearing impaired person.
1. The beneficiary should be any one of the following:



- Students in Higher Education (Undergraduate).
- Unemployed Youth.
- Self-Employed.
- Women with Hearing Impairment/ Visual Impairment.

name: Calipers and Crutches - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The 'Calipers and Crutches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. calipers and crutches are given to the needy and deserving orthopedically differently-abled persons for their easy mobility. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of calipers and crutches.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an orthopedically differently abled person.
1. The applicant should be a resident of the district/area of Tamil Nadu.

name: Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
brief_description: The 'Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute goggles to needy visually impaired persons to enable them to protect themselves from sunlight and moisture. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of goggles to visually impaired persons.**
eligibility: - The applicant should be a visually impaired person.

name: Book Binder Training by Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
brief_description: The 'Book Binder Training by Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide imparted book binder training to visually impaired candidates at the government higher secondary schoolRs. poonamallee every year.
benefits: - Free book binding training every year is imparted in government higher secondary schools for the visually impaired.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a visually impaired person.
1. The beneficiary should have passed the 8th standard.
1. The beneficiary should be between 18 to 40 years age group.

name: Assistance for Purchase of House (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Purchase of House is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. interest free loan is provided to registered construction workersRs. who have minimum five years regular membershipRs. for purchase or construction of their houses. This facility is available once in lifetime.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. an interest-free loan of up to 2Rs./- is provided to registered construction workers for the purchase or construction of their houses.

**Note:** The Board will provide financial assistance in the shape of interest compensation upto 1Rs./- through banks to the construction workersRs. who are beneficiaries of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana for the construction of a house.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker should have regular membership for at least 5 years and 8 years are left to attain the age of 60 years.
1. The maximum age of the worker should be 52 years. So that he/she can repay the loan in the next 8 years.
1. This facility will be available once in a lifetime.
1. The application frequency is limited to once.

name: Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance for funeral expenses to the nominee or legal heir of a registered worker in the event of their death.
benefits: 1. In case of the death of a registered workerRs. an amount of 15Rs./- is payable as funeral assistance to his/her nominee/legal heirs.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered deceased worker should have held a regular membership with the Board.
1. The scheme allows for application only once.

name: Modular Functional Artificial Limbs
brief_description: The 'Modular Functional Artificial Limbs' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. modular functional artificial limbs are provided for orthopedically differently-abled studentsRs. employed or self-employed. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: - **Free distribution of modular functional artificial limbs.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an orthopedically differently-abled person.
1. The applicant should be a resident of the area/district of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should be any one of the following:



- Student.
- Employed.
- Self-Employed.

name: Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers
brief_description: The "Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. DelhiRs. is a welfare scheme that provides a pass of 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus to the registered workers for purchasing. All types of bus passes i.e. Conventional Bus Pass as well as e-Bus Pass can be made online.
benefits: - A pass of 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus is provided.
eligibility:
> **For Registration**


- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For Application**


- The applicant should be above 5 years of age.

name: Pashu Bima Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Pashu Bima Yojana" by the Directorate of Dairy DevelopmentRs. Government of Bihar aims to provide financial security to livestock owners against losses due to serious diseases like Lumpy Skin DiseaseRs. HSBQRs. and other causes of cattle death. Through this schemeRs. insurance coverage of up to 60Rs. per dairy cattle is provided to livestock owners of all categoriesRs. with the government providing a 75% subsidy on the premium amount. The scheme is implemented by the District Dairy Development Officers across all districts of Bihar.
benefits:
- The maximum price per milch cattle has been fixed at 60Rs./-.


- The total amount of insurance at the rate of 3.5 percent will be 2Rs./-.
- The insurance company will insure milch cattle for 01 year.
- The insurance company will fit the data ear tags in the milch cattle.

> **NOTE 1:** 75% amount of 1Rs./- will be paid by the state government as a grant and the remaining 25% amount of 525/- will be paid by the cattle farmers to the insurance company.

> **NOTE 2:** The responsibility for the safety of milch cattle will be on the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer of milch cattle.
1. The applicant should be a member of the "Milk Producer Cooperation Committee".
1. The milch cattle of the farmer should be healthy and certified by a veterinary doctor at the time of insurance.

name: Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana" under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aims to enhance milk productivity and per capita milk availability in Uttar Pradesh by encouraging the purchase of indigenous improved breed cows from outside the state. The scheme seeks to increase the number of indigenous improved breed cowsRs. improve their breedsRs. and provide employment opportunities in rural areas through animal husbandry. This scheme will be implemented in all the districts of the state.
benefits:
- Grants covering up to 40% of the total cost per unit (maximum 80Rs.)Rs. which includes purchasing cowsRs. transportationRs. insuranceRs. fodder cutting machineRs. and shed construction.

**Note 1:** One unit means 02 cows of indigenous improved breed per beneficiary and the unit cost is considered to be approximately 2 lakhs.
**Note 2:** The grant will be released directly into the bank account of the concerned beneficiary through DBT within a month by the State Program Management Unit.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years or above.
1. The milk producer/animal rearer should have adequate space/shed available for keeping the animals.
1. The milk producer/animal husbandry should not already have more than 02 cows of indigenous advanced breed like GirRs. SahiwalRs. HaryanaRs. Tharparkar and F-1 cow of hybrid breed.
1. The applicant should purchase an indigenous improved breed of cows from outside the state.
1. The applicant should purchase cows of indigenous improved breed of first or second calving.
1. The applicant should purchase disease-free and healthy cows.
1. The applicant should take animal insurance for all the cows purchased for 03 years.
1. The applicant should take the transit insurance for the cattle rearer to get for bringing the cows from the place of purchase/state to the place of establishment of the unit.

name: Himachal Pradesh Patrakar Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Himachal Pradesh Patrakar Kalyan Yojana" was launched by the Director of Information and Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh under the Himachal Pradesh Journalists Welfare Fund SchemeRs. 2006. The purpose of the Yojana shall be to provide financial assistance to the serving accreditated journalists and retired accreditated journalists in adverse situations as accidents and illness etc.
benefits:
**Financial assistance to serving accredited journalist:-** In case of permanent incapacitation for further service while performing field duties as a journalist 1Rs./-In case of death while performing field Duties 2Rs./-In case of death during attack or any untoward incidence of violence 3Rs./-In case of medical emergency or cancerUpto 50Rs./- (as per emergent need for major disease as kidney transplantRs. heart disease etc.)
**Financial assistance to retired accredited journalist:** In case of death 50Rs./-In case of medical emergency or cancerUpto 50Rs./- (as per emergent need for major disease as kidney transplantRs. heart disease etc.)
**Assistance in Adverse Situations:** Financial assistance of 25Rs./- only as immediate serving accredited journalists and retired accredited journalists or their dependents/legal heirs on production of documentary proof regarding death certificateRs. illness or accident etc. and subsequently its ex-post-facto approval would be obtained from the Committee.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a legal heir (spouseRs. his/her dependentRs. children) of the deceased journalist. 1. The deceased serving/retired accredited journalist is unmarried or single the financial assistance will be released in favour of his or her dependent father or mother. 1. The medical emergency or any other adverse situation assistance will be released to the serving/retired accredited journalists. 1. The serving/retired accredited journalist's family annual income is less than 1Rs./-. 1. The retired journalist should serve of at least twenty years as accredited journalist with the Government of Himachal Pradesh and not taken other gainful employment besides journalism. 1. The retired accredited journalist's age should be 58 years. **NOTE:** Himachal Pradesh Journalists Welfare Fund Scheme will be replaced by new H.P. Patrakar Kalyan YojanaRs. 2017 hence who are already subscribers of Himachal Pradesh Journalists Welfare Fund SchemeRs. 2006 will now be considered as member under this new Scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana
brief_description:
The "Mukhyamantri Pragatisheel Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana" is an initiative under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" for breed improvement in indigenous cows and an increase in milk productivity. Uttar Pradesh is the leading state in the country in milk production. This scheme will be applicable in all the districts of the state.
**Objective:**
(i) To encourage the trend of rearing indigenous breed of cows with high quality and productivity in the state.
(ii) To motivate cattle farmers for breed improvement of cowsRs. their better careRs. quality nutrition and health protection.
(iii) To increase the income of cattle farmers of the state by increasing milk productivity in the state.
(iv) To increase the per capita availability of milk in the state and bring it to the national level.
benefits: - **Cash awards ranging from 10Rs. to 15Rs. per cow for high productivity and improved breeds.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttar Pradesh. 1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years or above. 1. Only individual cattle farmers will be eligibleRs. but groupsRs. firmsRs. or organizations will not eligible. 1. Only indigenous breed of cows like GirRs. SahiwalRs. HaryanaRs. GangatiriRs. and Tharparkar species are eligible. 1. The cattle farmers of the state can avail the benefit of this incentive amount only once for a maximum of 02 cows. 1. The cattle farmers will be eligible to receive an incentive amount only once in the lifetime of the cow.

name: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Internship
brief_description:
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launched the "SECI Internship" program under Solar Energy Corporation of India Ltd. The Internship Program will serve as an opportunity for students to gain understanding about Renewable as a sector and SECI as an employer and help them evaluate future career opportunities. The Program will be structuredRs. short-termRs. supervised placements often focused around particular tasks or projects with defined timescales. The work should be meaningful and must be mutually beneficial for intern and the Corporation.
> **Area of Interest:** - Renewable Energy and Solar-Wind Hybrids. - Floating Solar. - Solar Manufacturing and Battery Energy Storage Systems. - Solar Park development. - Solar Rooftop projects and Off-grid Solar.
> **Duration:** - Engineering/M-Tech students: 3 & 6 months - CA/CA (Inter)Rs.CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)/CMA students: 6 months to 3 years - MBA students: 7 weeks to 6 months
benefits:
> **Stipend:** - For training periods less than 6 months: 8Rs./- per month - For training periods from 6 months to 3 years: 12Rs./- per month
> **Completion Certificate:** - HR issues a certificate upon successful completion of the internshipRs. confirming attendance and work supervision. **NOTE:** The internship program does not include compensation of any kindRs. boardingRs. lodgingRs. transportation etc.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should engage in research/pursue Engineering Graduate & Postgraduate Degrees/Ph.D. students in Renewable Energy/CA/CA(Inter)/CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)/CMA students/MBA students in HR/Finance/IT/CC from recognized institutions in India or abroad. 1. The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship. 1. The applicant must maintain a regular schedule and demonstrate professionalism. 1. The applicant must sign a non-disclosure agreement to protect SECI's data.
**NOTE:** SECI shall provide them with working spaceRs. internet facilityRs. and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Heads. HoweverRs. CA/CA(Inter)/CS/ICWA/ICWA(Inter)CMA/MBA interns may be provided the desktop as per the requirement.

name: Widow Pension (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Widow Pension is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension of 3Rs./- is given to the widow of a registered construction worker who is not receiving a similar benefit from any other Government/ Department/ Board/Corporation/PSU.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. 3Rs./- per month is given as a widow pension to the widow of the registered construction worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the widow of a deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have been a regular member of HBOCWWB for at least three years.
1. The widow should reside in Haryana.
1. The widow should not be employed by the Haryana GovernmentRs. any boardRs. corporationRs. or PSU.
1. The widow will not be eligible for the monthly pension if she remarries.
1. The widow should not be receiving a similar benefit from any other government entityRs. departmentRs. boardRs. corporationRs. or PSU.

name: Awarding of Tamil Mamani, Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna
brief_description: The Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry launched the "Awarding of Tamil MamaniRs. Telugu Ratna and Malayala Ratna" scheme aims to provide cash award of 75Rs. 000/- to the author/writer who has published books of high reputed in poetryRs. proseRs. and research articles in literature and grammar in their respective languages.
benefits:
> **Award amount:** - Cash award : 75Rs./-.
> **Number of Awards:** - Tamil Mamani - 6 awards. - Malayala Ratna - 4 awards. - Telugu Ratna - 4 awards.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an author/writer.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years or above.
1. The author/writer should have published books of high repute in poetryRs. proseRs. and research articles in literature and grammar in their respective languages.
1. The applicant should participate in literary and research.
1. The applicant should not have been given any such award by other Government and Organisations like Universities etc.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry or residence in Puducherry continuously for a period of 5 years.

name: Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani
brief_description: The "Award of Puduvai Kalaimamani" scheme was launched by the Arts and Culture DepartmentRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide prizes of 50Rs./- and 30 awards to artists or authors/writers in the fields of LiteratureRs. MusicRs. DanceRs. DramaRs. Painting and SculptureRs. and Folk arts. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the Director of Art and Culture Department.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance of 50Rs./-.
- No. of Awards: 30
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an artist or author/writer.
1. The applicant's age should be 30 years or above.
1. The applicant should be performed in the field of literatureRs. musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. painting and sculptureRs. and folk arts.
1. The author/writer should have published books of high repute in poetryRs. proseRs. and research articles in literature and grammar in their respective languages.
1. The applicant should participate in literary and research.
1. The applicant should not have been given any such award by other Government and Organisations like Universities etc.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry or residence in Puducherry continuously for a period of 5 years.

name: Purchase of Vehicle for Commercial Hiring Purpose for Persons with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme "Purchase of Vehicle for Commercial Hiring Purpose for Persons with Disabilities" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan NigamRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. loans are provided to differently-abled persons for commercial hiring purposes up to 10.00 lakhsRs. and for the purchase of special category vehicles like JCBsRs. trucksRs. road rollersRs. etc.Rs. loans up to 25.00 lakhs are available. Permanent residents of Haryana with a disability of 40% or more are eligible to avail the benefits under this scheme.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided to differently abled persons for commercial hiring up to 10Rs./- and for purchasing special category vehicles such as JCBRs. TrucksRs. Road rollersRs. etc.Rs. with loans up to 25Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.
1. The age of the applicant should be above 18 years. For persons with mental retardationRs. the age is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.
1. License is applicable as per the policy of the National Corporation.

name: Small Industries Unit for Persons with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme "Small Industries Unit for Persons with Disabilities" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan NigamRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. loan assistance of up to 25 lakhs is provided to persons with disabilities for establishing small industrial units focused on manufacturingRs. fabricationRs. and production. Permanent residents of HaryanaRs. aged 18 or olderRs. with a disability of 40% or moreRs. is eligible to avail the benefits under this scheme.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. loan assistance of up to 25Rs./- is provided to differently-abled persons for setting up manufacturingRs. fabricationRs. and production units.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.
1. The applicant should be over 18 years old. For persons with mental retardationRs. the age requirement is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.

name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing PiggeryRs. Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. an unemployed resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of livestockRs. provided they have taken a loan for establishing a 10+1 Piggery unit or a 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance under the Scheme:**

**Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:**

- 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit. A maximum amount of 25Rs./- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:**

- 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit. A maximum amount of 24Rs./- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

> **Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme:**


- Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year; otherwiseRs. the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant must be unemployed.
1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

name: Bihar State Journalist Insurance Scheme
brief_description:
The "Bihar State Journalist Insurance SchemeRs. 2014" was launched by the Information and Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to provide financial benefits of 5Rs./- & facilities under a group mediclaim & personal accident insurance scheme to working media representatives. Under this schemeRs. spouse and two dependent children of the media representative will be included in this Insurance Scheme.
> **Insurance Period:** This insurance is valid for one year with provisions for annual renewal.
benefits: - Personal accident insurance coverage up to 5Rs./- - Medical expense coverage up to 5Rs./- for the insured and their dependents. **NOTE:** Media representatives contribute 20% of the premiumRs. while the remaining 80% is covered by the government.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a journalist/media representative.
1. Independent journalists must hold a valid press accreditation card.
1. The applicant should have a minimum of 5 years of work experience in journalism.
1. The media representative's age is between 21-70 years.
1. The media representative should be residing and working in Bihar.
1. The media representative educational qualification should be matriculation or equivalent for the insurance.
1. The media representative should cover 50% of news or comments in journalists from newspapersRs. magazinesRs. news agenciesRs. electronic mediaRs. and independent journalists with valid press accreditation.
1. The media representative's spouse and two dependent children are included in this Insurance Scheme.
1. The media representative's son's age is up to 23 years (or 25 if studying any bonafide institutions)Rs. and the daughter will be covered until marriage.
1. A media representative affiliated with a private news channel must ensure that the channel's telecast reaches at least 20 districts in the state.

name: Chief Minister's Self Employment Scheme
brief_description: The "Chief Minister's Self Employment Scheme" was launched by the Department of PersonnelRs. and ReformsRs. TrainingRs. Public GrievancesRs. Government of Sikkim. The scheme aims to provide loan to unemployed youth who belong below the poverty line. The Chief Minister's Self Employment Scheme shall be a link program for all those unemployed youth who are trained in the Constituency wise Livelihood schools across the StateRs. irrespective of their educational qualification and age to start up self-employment ventures in businessRs. service and industrial activities.
benefits:
- Loans up to 3Rs./- per individual. - Loans are interest-free for 2 yearsRs. followed by a 6% simple interest rate.
**Note:** In case of the death of a loan recipientRs. the co-applicant shall be liable for a refund of the outstanding loan. The co-applicant is liable for a refund of only the principal amount to be paid within a period not exceeding one year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be unemployed. 1. The applicant's age should be between 22 to 35 years. 1. The applicant should have passed the 10th class. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. Only one member per family shall be considered for the benefitRs. except in the case of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

name: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana
brief_description: The Government of BiharRs. under the Directorate of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Social Welfare Department)Rs. is committed to the empowerment of persons with disabilities. "Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana" Umbrella SchemeRs. also known as the Sambal YojanaRs. aims to provide comprehensive support to the disabled community in Bihar. A significant component of this scheme involves the distribution of battery-operated tricycles to eligible beneficiaries to enhance their mobility and independence.
benefits: - **Free distribution of battery-operated tricycles.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a locomotor-disabled student/employee.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.
1. The applicant's minimum disability should be 60 percent.
1. The student or employee must reside at least distance of 3 kilometers or more from their respective place of education or work.

name: Micro Credit Finance (NSFDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Micro Credit Finance" is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided to individuals from the Scheduled Caste community for units costing up to 1Rs./-. The loans support income-generating activities such as running a betel leaf shopRs. bakeryRs. candle makingRs. cycle repairRs. goat rearingRs. beauty parlourRs. vegetable vendingRs. incense stick makingRs. fish vendingRs. milch animal rearingRs. papad manufacturingRs. pickle manufacturingRs. tea shopRs. and other similar viable activities.
benefits:
**Maximum Loan Limit:**

- NSFDC provides loans up to 90% of the Project Cost with the maximum amount of 1.25 lakhs.

**Rate of Interest:**

- The NSFDC shall charge interest @ 2.5% from the SCAs/CAsRs. which in turnRs. shall charge 6.5% from the Beneficiaries.

**Repayment Period:**

- The loan under the Scheme is to be repaid in quarterly instalments within a maximum period of three years from the date of disbursement including 3 months moratorium period.
eligibility:
1. The Individual applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste community.
2. The applicant's annual family income should be less than 3Rs./-Rs. both in rural and urban areas w.e.f. 08.03.2018.
3. The Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies are also eligible to apply under the scheme. HoweverRs. proposals submitted by Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies shall be considered subject to the following:
a) All the members of Partnership Firms/Co-operative Societies belong to Scheduled Caste community.
b) Annual family income of each member/applicant should not exceed 3Rs./-.
**Note:** The verification of eligibility criteria shall be the sole responsibility of the State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)/Channelizing Agencies (CAs). NSFDC shallRs. howeverRs. be entitled to re-verify the eligibility of the applicantsRs. if it so desires.

name: Internship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Internship is implemented by the Department of Forest and WildlifeRs. Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (GNCTD) provides internship training to students studying at recognized schoolsRs. institutionsRs. and universities. The aim of this scheme is to allow short-term exposure to youth working in the different sections of the Department of Forests and WildlifeRs. GNCTD as Interns. Interested students from ForestryRs. TechnologyRs. WildlifeRs. Social SciencesRs. ScienceRs. EconomicsRs. LawRs. ManagementRs. and Finance can apply for internships.
**Period of Internship:**

- Duration of the internship will be decided by the Department based on the domain selected by the candidate and shall not exceed more than 90 days in normal circumstances.
- Only in cases wherein a significant work has been done by an intern and can be taken to a logical conclusionRs. PCCF may give the extension of a maximum of one month
benefits:
**Experience Certificate:**

- At the end of the successful completion of the internshipRs. the interns will be awarded a "Certificate along with a grading based on the performance of the intern.

**Logistics & Support:**

- Facilities like transportation to the work siteRs. printing of study materialRs. etc. required for successful completion of the internship shall be provided by the Department.

**Stipend:**

- No stipend shall be paid.
eligibility:
1. The internship training is open only to students who are studying at recognized schoolsRs. institutionsRs. and universities.
1. Preference will be given to those with a clear Statement of Purpose of internship.
1. The student should have attained 18 years of age.

**Educational Qualifications: Students with the following qualifications will be considered on a merit basis:**
1. Pursuing ScienceRs. ForestryRs. EcologyRs. Computer ScienceRs. Electronic Engineering And Related Courses:

- Second year and above of Bachelor's Degree and Integrated 5-year Course in ScienceRs. ForestryRs. Ecology and Related Courses.
- Higher Secondary in Science Stream.

2. Pursuing CommerceRs. Economics And Management Courses as Under:

- BA/B. Sc /MA/M. Sc. (Eco.)
- Students of 5 Years Integrated Degree Programme in Economics.
- MBA

3. Pursuing Law as under:

- Second and third year of Bachelor's Degree in Law or
- Second year and above of the Integrated Five-Year Course in Law.
- LLM

4. Higher Secondary:

- Higher Secondary in Science and Commerce Stream.

**Note 1:** Interns must clearly indicate the area of interest.
**Note 2:** The interns shall have the option to apply in a maximum 3 (three) disciplines only.
**Note 3:** Applicants are required to submit a Statement of purpose (SoP) for applying for an internship in not more than 1000 words. The SoP should broadly cover reasons for interest in the fieldRs. the relevance of their skill set in the selected domainRs. and expected contribution in the domain selected by them.
**Note 4:** The final topic of internship and domain shall be decided as per requirement of the Department by Research Advisory Committee.
**Note 5:** The applicant shall be required to submit the supporting document of qualification and/or enrolment in Educational institutes. They may also submit document to support additional skill sets for supporting their application.
> **Terms and Conditions of Selection:**


1. The interns shall be required to write a paper/detailed account of work done on management of natural resources related themes/issues and of the relevance of their work to the Department.
1. The interns if required may be asked to participate in related activities like training and research in the Department.
1. The intern will submit a draft report of the assignment to the designated officer (Guide) before the conclusion of the internship.
1. The intern may be required to make a presentation before the Department at the end of the internshipRs. after clearance by the respective Guide.
1. The intern shall work within the premises of the Department and move outside only after due permission from the Guide during working hours. The Department shall provide all support to the intern as the case may be for the successful completion of the internship.
1. The final product of the internship shall be the intellectual property of the Department and the intern shall not use it without prior approval of the Department.
1. Interns shall be under the discipline of the Department during the period of internship.
1. It may be strictly observed that the conduct of the interns and their access to data shall be the sole responsibility of the concerned Guide only. Prior permission is required from the Guide before accessing any information from the Department.
1. The internship may be discontinued at any time if the performance of the intern is not found satisfactory.
1. The students will not have any claim for a job in the Department of Forests and WildlifeRs. GNCTD.

name: Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for sheep and goat
brief_description:
Launched in the Financial Year 2014-15Rs. the scheme "National Livestock Mission" by the Department of Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Ministry of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry and DairyingRs. aims towards employment generationRs. entrepreneurship developmentRs. increase in per animal productivity and thus targeting increased production of meatRs. goat milkRs. egg and wool. The excess production will help in the export earnings after meeting the domestic demands. The concept of the NLM Scheme is to develop the entrepreneur in order to create the forward and backward linkage for the produce available in the unorganized sector and to link with the organized sector.
**"Establishment of Regional Semen Production Laboratory and Semen Bank for Sheep and Goat (Genetic Improvement of Sheep and Goat Breeds)"** is a component of the "Sub-mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry" scheme of the National Livestock Mission. The objectives of this component are: - Genetic improvement of Indigenous descript breeds of sheep/goat through selective breeding - Genetic upgradation of non-descript sheep/goat breeds through cross-breeding with high genetic rams or bucks to increase productivity. - Reducing negative selection and inbreeding among sheep & goat breeds by propagation of superior male germplasm through artificial insemination and other developed assisted reproductive technologies.
The Central Government will provide assistance for the establishment of a Frozen Semen production laboratory for goat and a liquid semen production laboratory for sheep at regional level in a strategic location to cater the semen of elite animals to the nearby states in the said region. This Establishment of Regional Semen Station will be based on the Expression of Interest from the States in the said Region which can produce semen and supply semen for the states at the region. Also the regional semen station will work as regional semen bank for frozen semen for goat. The semen labs will need to adhere to the guidelines of Minimum standard protocols for semen processing while preparing the project proposals. The semen produced in this laboratory will be distributed to the neighbouring states.
benefits:
- The funding pattern will be 60:40 for all the states except NER & Himalayan States where it will be 90:10 and 100% for UTs.
- One-time grants-in-aid up to Rs. 4Rs. as Central Share will be provided to the concerned state eligible for the establishment of Regional Semen Station for construction of semen laboratoryRs. maintaining of breeding bucks and ramsRs. sourcing of locally available high genetic merit animals and processing of semen.
- Rs. 30Rs. will also be provided as a one-time expenditure towards procurement of consumablesRs. medicinesRs. chemicals etc. required for first-time processing of semen.
- The regional semen bank shall have to generate its own resources for running of the semen station. No recurring expenditure will be provided for running expenses of the semen station.
eligibility: Only the State Livestock Agencies are eligible.
