brief_description: The Maternity Benefit scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. OdishaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance in the form of maternity benefits to the female beneficiaries subject to a maximum of two children who are registered beneficiaries for a period of more than one year under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 8Rs./- to 10Rs./- per Child. - **For eligible beneficiaries under Mamata being implemented by W&CD Department:** 15Rs./- (10Rs./- under OB&OCWW Board and 5Rs./- under Mamata). > **Note:** Assistance shall be given for a maximum of two children.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


- The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be female.
- The applicant should be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be registered for a period of one year or more under the board.
- The applicant should be pregnant.

name: Skill Development Training - 15 Days Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Training Programme at Work Site
brief_description:
The "Skill Development Training - 15 Days Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Training Programme at Work Site" was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. LET&F (Labour) DepartmentRs. Telangana. The scheme offers a 15-day Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) training programme for registered construction workers. The programme aims to enhance the employability of workersRs. ensuring they meet industry standards and are better equipped for future opportunities.
> **Trades Offered:** - Masonry - Bar Bending - Plumbing & Sanitation - Electrical House Wiring - Painting - Welding - Drywall - False Ceiling - Building Carpentry - Formwork Carpentry
benefits:
> **Stipend:** - 35/- per hour per trainee.
> **Duration:** - 120 hours spread over 15 days.
eligibility:
1. The worker must be registered with the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker's age should be between 18-45 years old.
1. The worker should have knowledge of TeluguRs. HindiRs. and English language.
1. The worker should be engaged in the respective trades: MasonryRs. Bar BendingRs. Plumbing & SanitationRs. Electrical House WiringRs. PaintingRs. WeldingRs. Dry wall & False ceilingRs. Building CarpentryRs. and Formwork carpentry.

name: Leave Travelling Concession Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Leave Travelling Concession Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide a certain amount as leave travel concession to the registered construction workers for journeys to religious/ historical places in India or visiting their hometown.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount of 2000/- as Leave Travelling Concession (LTC). > **Note:** - The benefit of L.T.C shall be granted after the return from the journey on submitting Self-declaration/ proof online through the Labour Inspector/Labour Enforcement Officer of the area or through the nearest Suvidha Kendra. - In the event of any incident during the journeyRs. he will not be entitled to any compensation under this scheme.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The applicant shall be eligible for L.T.C. for journeys of religious/ historical places in India or visiting home town within the last two years.

name: Tool Kit Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Tool Kit Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide reimbursement for the purchase of tools related to their profession to registered construction workers who have completed training under the Skill Upgradation or Recognition of Prior Learning scheme of the Board.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** Upto 5Rs./-.
> **Note:**


- A construction worker can get the benefit of the tool kit scheme after every three years.
- The financial benefit under the scheme shall be reimbursed after the beneficiary has purchased the tools.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The applicant should be paying the contribution regularly.
- The applicant should have received training under the Skill Upgradation or Recognition of Prior Learning scheme of the Board.
- Purchased tools should be relevant to their profession.

name: Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana" scheme was launched by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to give economic freedom to women in the state age group of 21 to 65 yearsRs. improving their health and nutrition and strengthening their decisive role in the family. The women will get a financial benefit of 1Rs./- through direct benefit transfer (DBT).
benefits: - **Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a female.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra state.
1. The applicant's age should be between 21-65 years.
1. The applicant should have their bank account with an Aadhaar link.
1. The annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. Outsourced employeesRs. voluntary workersRs. and contract workers with income up to 2Rs./- are eligible.
1. The applicant should be any one of the following:



- Married Woman
- Widowed
- Divorced Woman
- Abandoned and Destitute Women
- One Unmarried Woman in the family

name: Chief Minister Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Chief Minister Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. in the financial year 2018-19. The scheme targets senior citizensRs. widowsRs. and abandoned women listed on the basis of the survey list of SocialRs. Economic and Caste Census 2011. This scheme will be an additional scheme of the current Central and State Pension Scheme.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a pension of 500/- per month.

**Note:** The pension amount will be directly transferred to the applicant's bank account and will be paid during the first week of each month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be a senior citizenRs. widowRs. or abandoned woman.
1. Senior citizens should be 60 years of age or older.
1. Widow or abandoned woman should be 18 years of age or older.
1. In urban areasRs. the name of the applicant should be listed in the survey list of Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011.
1. In rural areasRs. the name of the applicant should be in the list of households having at least one deprivation index in the automatically included index or deprivation index of the survey list of Socio-Economic and Caste CensusRs. 2011.
1. The applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other central or state government pension scheme.

name: Accident Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Accident Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this SchemeRs. every registered construction worker who meets with an accident during the course of employment shall be compensated by the employer under the provisions of the Employees Compensation ActRs. along with a compensation from the Board.
benefits: - **Death Benefit:** 5Rs./- granted (50% in Fixed DepositRs. 50% via cheque/DBT) to the first living nominee.- **Permanent Total Disablement Benefit:** 2Rs./- granted (50% in Fixed DepositRs. 50% via cheque/DBT).- **Permanent Partial Disablement Benefit:** 1Rs./- granted proportionally (50% in Fixed DepositRs. 50% via cheque/DBT).
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.
- The accident must occur either during the course of employment or outside of work.

name: Santwana Scheme - Karnataka
brief_description: The "Santwana Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to support people belonging to religious minorities whose housesRs. and shops have been destroyed due to natural calamity and communal violence. Under this schemeRs. a loan amount of 5Rs./- max per unit cost will be provided of which 50% loan and 50% subsidy.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** Up to 5Rs./- per unit cost.- **Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the loan amount is provided as a subsidyRs. and the remaining 50% is a repayable loan.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the religious minority category of the Karnataka state.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the state.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 55 years.
1. The family income from all sources should not exceed more than 8Rs./-
1. The applicant's family members should not be employees in the Central or State Government.
1. The applicant or his/her family should not have availed a loan facility from Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation (EXCEPT ARIVU EDUCATION LOAN SCHEME ) in the last five years.

name: Funeral and Ex-Gratia (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Funeral and Ex-Gratia'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this SchemeRs. the Board provides financial assistance to the nominee on the event of the death of a registered construction worker. The scheme also provides an ex-gratia payment to help mitigate the financial burden caused by the sudden demise of the worker.
benefits: - **Funeral Assistance:** 4Rs./- to cover funeral expenses. - **Ex-Gratia Payment:** 71Rs./- to provide financial support to the nominee of the deceased.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The beneficiary should be a nominee of a deceased registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme- Bihar
brief_description:
The scheme "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a monthly pension is provided to elderly people (women/men) aged 60 years or above belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support them financially. This scheme is centrally sponsored.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the elderly people of the poor family of the society by providing them financial assistance.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive monthly pension as follows:

- Beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 years: 400/- per month
- Beneficiaries aged 80 years or above: 500/- per month

**Note:** The pension amount is being paid to the beneficiaries under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process. In this processRs. the pension amount is paid directly into the accounts of the beneficiaries through PFMS from the state level on the basis of the account number provided by the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant (Woman/Man) should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a senior citizen.
1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older.
1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.

name: Financial Assistance to Traditional Artisans (Panchavrutthi Scheme)
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance to Traditional Artisans (Panchavrutthi Scheme)" was launched by the Department of Backward Class WelfareRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. to provide financial assistance to traditional artisans (Panchavrutthi) of the Vishwakarma community in Karnataka. The scheme aims to help these artisans purchase modern tools and upgrade their technological skills to enhance their trade and craftsmanship. The Karnataka Vishwakarma Communities Development Corporation (KVCDC) facilitates this scheme.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** Up to 80Rs./- at an interest rate of 4% per annum.- **Subsidy Amount:** Up to 20Rs./-.- **Total Assistance:** 1Rs./- (Loan + Subsidy).- **Repayment Period:** The loan is repayable in 34 equal installments over three yearsRs. with a grace period of 2 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Vishwakarma community.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Karnataka.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 55 years.
1. The applicant must be engaged in one of the traditional Vishwakarma occupationsRs. including Gold & Silver workRs. SculptureRs. BlacksmithRs. Woodwork & HandicraftsRs. or Metallurgy.
1. The applicant or their family members should not have availed of any loan facility from the KVCDC in the previous years.

name: Scheme for Adolescent Girls- Bihar
brief_description:
The scheme "Scheme for Adolescent Girls" has been implemented in Bihar since 2011 through the Anganwadi centers under the Integrated Child Development Project (ICDS). Under this schemeRs. adolescent girls aged 11 to 14 years who are not attending school receive a monthly take-home ration along with skill development training. It is a centrally sponsored scheme with a funding ratio of 50:50 between the Central and State governments.
The main objective of the scheme is to improve the level of healthRs. nutritionRs. and education by providing support to adolescent girls so that they can become self-reliant and aware. The objective of this scheme is as follows:-

- To assist in self-development and empowerment of adolescent girls.
- To improve their nutrition and health status.
- To raise awareness about healthRs. hygieneRs. and nutrition.
- To reintegrate out-of-school adolescent girls into the formal education system or develop alternative education/skills.
- To develop their home-based skills and life skills.
- To provide information and guidance about available public services such as Primary Health CentresRs. Rural Hospitals/Community Health CentresRs. Post OfficesRs. BanksRs. Police StationsRs. etc.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries receive a monthly take-home ration (THR) along with skill development training.
2. The following benefits are provided to beneficiaries under both nutritional and non-nutritional items:

- **Nutritional items:** RiceRs. eggsRs. and soybeans are provided as THR to adolescent girls. Nutritious items are provided for 25 days each month. - **Non-nutritional items:** These include Iron Folic Acid supplementsRs. comprehensive health check-ups and referral servicesRs. health and nutrition educationRs. reintegration of out-of-school adolescent girls into the formal education system or mainstreaming through alternative education/skills developmentRs. life skills educationRs. home management trainingRs. and counseling/guidance for accessing public services.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The beneficiary should be an adolescent girl aged between 11 and 14 years.
1. The beneficiary should not be currently attending school.

name: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana" is initiated by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. an incentive amount is provided to minority students who pass the Intermediate/Matriculation/Fauquania/Maulvi examinations with first-class marks from the Bihar School Examination Board/Bihar Madrasa Education Board. The incentive amount is transferred directly to the students' bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. eligible students receive the following incentive amounts:

- Minority students who pass the Matriculation/Fauquania exam with first division from the Bihar School Examination Board/Bihar Madrasa Education Board are awarded 10Rs./-.
- Minority (Muslim) girl students who pass the Intermediate/Maulvi exam with first-class marks from the Bihar School Examination Board/Bihar Madrasa Education Board are awarded 15Rs./-.
- Bengali-speaking students who pass the Matriculation exam with first division from the Bihar School Examination Board are awarded 10Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
2. The applicant should be a student.
3. The student should belong to a minority community.
4. The student should meet one of the following educational qualifications:

- The student has passed the Matriculation/Fauquania exam with a first division from the Bihar School Examination Board or the Bihar Madrasa Education Board.
- A Muslim girl student has passed the Intermediate/Maulvi exam with first class from the Bihar School Examination Board or the Bihar Madrasa Education Board.
- A Bengali-speaking student has passed the Matriculation exam with a first division from the Bihar School Examination Board.

name: Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment
brief_description: The Distribution of Manually Operated Plant Protection Equipment scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides financial assistance to farmers by offering a subsidy for manually operated plant protection equipment. Farmers who raise seed farms with pulse crops are eligible to receive this subsidy.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** A subsidy of 50% on the cost of equipment or 800/- whichever is less.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should raise seed farms with Pulses crop.

name: Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds
brief_description: The Distribution of Gypsum-Oil Seeds scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides financial assistance to farmers by subsidizing 50% of the cost of gypsum material and transportation costs. The subsidy is available to farmers who produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department of Agriculture.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 50% of the cost of material plus transport limited to 750/- per ha whichever is less.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be engaged in seed production.
- The beneficiary should produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department.

name: Organizing Block Demonstration
brief_description: The Organizing Block Demonstration scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides subsidy to promote best agricultural practices to farmers who cultivate seed farms with Pulses crops. The subsidy covers 50% of the input costs or 2Rs./- per demonstrationRs. whichever is less.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** A subsidy of 50% on the cost of inputs required to layout the demonstration of 5 hectare each or 2Rs./- whichever is less.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should cultivate seed farms with Pulses crops.

name: Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU
brief_description: The scheme Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil Nadu is designed to promote maize cultivation through block demonstrations conducted by the Department of Agriculture and Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU). Farmers in select districts of Tamil Nadu can participate. It provides 4Rs./- per demonstration for 1-hectare plots. Special focus is given to smallRs. marginalRs. SC/STRs. and women farmers.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 4Rs./- per demonstration of 1 Hectare plot each.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a Farmer. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should grow maize in the following districts: CoimbatoreRs. DindigulRs. ErodeRs. DharmapuriRs. KrishnagiriRs. NamakkalRs. PerambalurRs. VirudhunagarRs. TheniRs. VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. TirunelveliRs. and Thoothukudi.

name: Alpsankhyak Muslim Parityaqta/Talaqshuda Mahila Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Alpsankhyak Muslim Parityakta/Talaqshuda Mahila Sahayata Yojana" has been operated by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. since the financial year 2006-07. The objective of this scheme is to strengthen the economic condition of minority Muslim abandoned/divorced women and make them self-dependent by providing financial assistance.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. the state government provides financial assistance of 25Rs./- to minority Muslim abandoned/divorced women to strengthen their economic condition and make them self-reliant.

**Note:** The grant amount will be directly transferred to the beneficiarys bank accounts through RTGS/DBT.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
2. The applicant should be a Muslim woman from a minority community.
3. The Muslim woman should fall under one of the following categories:
Divorced
Abandoned by her husband for more than 2 years
Husband is completely mentally handicapped
4. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 50 years.
5. The applicant's annual family income should be less than 4Rs./-.
6. The woman should not have remarried.
7. The benefits of this scheme are available only once in a lifetime.
8. Widow is not eligible for this scheme.

name: Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus
brief_description: The Distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides subsidies for the distribution of Nuclear Poly Hedrosis Virus (NPV) to farmers raising seed farms with Pulses crops.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 50% cost of input limited to 250/- per hectare.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should raise seed farms with Pulses crops.

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Incentive/Award of Prizes
brief_description: The scheme Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Incentive/Award of Prizes by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides district-level prizes to students based on their performance in the 10th and 12th standard examinations. The incentives are given to one Boy and one Girl each from Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity who have secured the highest mark.
benefits: - **10+2 Examination:** 3Rs./-. - **10th Std. First Prize:** 1Rs./-. - **10th Std. Second Prize:** 5Rs./-. - **10th Std. Third Prize:** 3Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar (converted to Christianity) community.
- The beneficiary should have secured the highest marks in 10th or 12th standard exams within the district.

name: Grant for Purchase of Bicycle (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Grant for Purchase of Bicycle" scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 3Rs./- is provided to registered construction workers who have been members of the Board for at least one yearRs. for purchasing a bicycle. The assistance will be provided to workers upon submission of the receipt for the bicycle purchase.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 3Rs./- is provided to registered construction workers for purchasing a bicycle.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The worker should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one year of continuous membership.
1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board should be active at the time of application.

Note: Assistance will be provided to workers upon submission of the receipt for the bicycle purchase.

name: Training to Farmers
brief_description: The Training to Farmers scheme by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. offers training to maize-growing farmers in 18 selected districts of the State. The program covers the costs of the training for up to two daysRs. with financial assistance of 300/- per farmer. The training helps farmers adopt better practices to improve yield and farm sustainability.
benefits:
- Financial Assistance: 300/- for attending a two-day training session.
- Training Program: Training covers modern maize cultivation techniquesRs. improving crop yield and reducing input costs.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of any of the following districts of Tamil Nadu: CoimbatoreRs. DindigulRs. ErodeRs. DharmapuriRs. KrishnagiriRs. NamakkalRs. PerambalurRs. VirudhunagarRs. TheniRs. VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. TirunelveliRs. and Thoothukudi.
- The beneficiary should grow maize.

name: Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers
brief_description: The "Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers" welfare scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Department. The scheme provides scholarships to children of registered workers who are not enrolled under Chandranna Bima. This scheme is aimed at supporting the education of construction workers' children in addition to any other government scholarships.
benefits: - **9****th** **to 12****th** **Grade or ITI: 1Rs./- per year**- **Professional Courses at the Graduation Level: 5Rs./- per year**
eligibility:
1. The worker should be registered with the AP Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The children of workers not enrolled under Chandranna Bima are eligible.
1. The student should have enrolled in 9th to 12th grade or ITI/ Professional Courses (Graduation Level).
1. Each family can receive scholarships for a maximum of two children.

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Incentive/Award of Prizes-For Each Subjects
brief_description: The scheme Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Incentive/Award of Prizes-For Each Subjects by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides financial incentives to promote academic achievement among students from underprivileged communities. One Student each from Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravider converted to Christianity for each subject is selected for the awards.
benefits: - **For plus 2 Examination:** 2Rs./-. - **For 10th Examination:** 1Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity community.
- The beneficiary must have passed the 10th or Plus 2 examination.

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Public Examination Fee for 10th and 12th Std.
brief_description: The scheme Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Public Examination Fee for 10th and 12th Std. by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support students from the Adi DravidarRs. TribalRs. and Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities. Under this schemeRs. the government reimburses the public examination fees for 10th and 12th-standard students directly to the Directorate of Government Examinations. There is no income limit for eligibility under this scheme.
benefits: - **Reimbursement:** Full reimbursement on Public Examination fee for 10th and 12th Std. students.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity community.
- The beneficiary must be appearing for public examinations of 10th/12th Std.

name: Financial Assistance to dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers(JKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers is administered by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. In this schemeRs. a financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to the dependents in case of death of the worker registered with the Board.
benefits: A financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased should have been registered with the "Jammu and Kashmir Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
1. The deceased should have held an active membership with the Board.
1. The scheme can be applied only once.

name: Scheme for Meritorious Students to Pursue Higher Secondary Education in the Best Schools of Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The "Scheme for Meritorious Students to Pursue Higher Secondary Education in the Best Schools of Tamil Nadu" scheme launched by the Backward ClassesRs. Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to support academic excellence by offering financial aid to 10 students from each district who have secured the highest marks in the 10th public examination. Eligible students can attend top private schools in Tamil Nadu for their higher secondary educationRs. ensuring they receive the best resources and opportunities to further their studies.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Full financial assistance for pursuing higher secondary education in reputed private schools.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a student.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should belong to the Backward Classes (BC)/ Most Backward Classes (MBC)/ Denotified Communities (DNC).
- The beneficiary should have secured the highest marks in 10th Public examination.
- The beneficiary should be among the Top 10 meritorious students from each district.
- The beneficiary should be studying in Government/ Government Aided/ Private School.
- The beneficiary's parental annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Jewel Loan
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: For Jewel Loan" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. allows citizens to obtain loans by pledging their gold and jewelry. The maximum loan amount is 1Rs./- with an interest rate of 12%Rs. subject to changes as per bank policies.
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 1Rs./-.- **Interest Rate:** 12% (subject to change).
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- Loans should be applicable only for Jewel.

name: Workers In Case Of Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
brief_description: The "Workers In Case of Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & KashmirRs. under the MUHAFIZ Scheme (PMJJBY: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima YojanaRs. PMSBY: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana) from 01.01.2018Rs. provides 2Rs. to registered BOC workers in the case of permanent disablement.
benefits: > Under the schemeRs. 2Rs. is provided to registered BOC workers in case of partial permanent disablement.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


1. The worker must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOC) Welfare Board.
1. The scheme applies to workers who suffer from permanent disablement.

name: Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
brief_description: The "Workers In Case of Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & KashmirRs. under the MUHAFIZ Scheme (PMJJBY: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima YojanaRs. PMSBY: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana) from 01.01.2018Rs. provides Rs. 1Rs. to registered BOC workers in the case of partial permanent disablement.
benefits: > Under the schemeRs. Rs. 1Rs. is provided to registered BOC workers in case of partial permanent disablement.
eligibility:
> **For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**


1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


1. The worker must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOC) Welfare Board.
1. The scheme applies to workers who suffer from partial permanent disablement.

name: Maternity Benefit For Female Workers- JKBOCWWB
brief_description: The "Maternity Benefit for Female Workers" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & KashmirRs. provides financial assistance to registered female workers during maternity. Under this schemeRs. female beneficiaries are eligible to receive 5Rs. (for up to two children)Rs. provided they have been engaged in building or construction work for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. maternity benefits for female workers amount to 5Rs. for up to two children. Note: The benefit is allowed only twice in the beneficiary's lifetime.
eligibility:
**For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**

1. The applicant should be a resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

**For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**

1. The applicant should be a registered female member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Jammu & Kashmir.
1. The applicant should be pregnant.
1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.

name: Registered Construction Worker in case of his/her Natural Death (JKBOCWWB)
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2018Rs. the scheme "Registered Construction Worker in Case of His/Her Natural Death" is a Welfare Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu & Kashmir. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided to the nominee or dependents in the event of natural death of a registered BOC worker. The applications are accepted online as well as offline.
benefits: 2Rs./- is provided to the nominee/dependent of the deceased construction worker.
eligibility: The applicant should be a nominee/dependent of a registered member/worker who has deceased due to natural causes.

name: Direct Loan Scheme Karnataka
brief_description: The "Direct Loan Scheme" was implemented by Karnataka Leather Industries Development Corporation LtdRs. Department of Social WelfareRs. Govt of Karnataka. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to unemployed scheduled caste individuals from the leather artisan community to start small businesses and empower artisans and improve their livelihoods by providing access to capital to start or expand small-scale enterprises.
benefits:
- Financial assistance with a 50% subsidy and 50% loan.
- Total unit cost is 1Rs./-.
- Loan repayment in 24 equal installments with a 4% interest rate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be leather artisans.
1. The applicant should belongs to sub-castes ArundathiyarRs. ChammadiyaRs. ChamarRs. ChambarRs. ChamagarRs. MadarRs. MadigRs. MadigaRs. Mini MadigRs. JambavaluRs. HaralayyaRs. MachigarRs. MochigarRs. MochiRs. muchiRs. Telugu MochiRs. kamaati mochaRs. RohidasRs. DhorRs. kakkayyaRs. KankayyaRs. SamagaraRs. SamagarRs. Aadhi AnddraRs. Aadhi DravidaRs. Aadhi Karnataka among scheduled castes.
1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 30Rs./- in rural areas and 25Rs./- in urban areas.
1. The applicant or their family members must not have received benefits from other schemesRs. except training programs.
1. The applicant's family members should not be employed in government or semi-government organizations.

name: Production of Certified Seeds of Maize
brief_description: The scheme Production of Certified Seeds of Maize by the Agriculture-Farmers Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. is designed to support maize farmers in specific districts of Tamil Nadu. By offering a subsidy of 1Rs./- per quintalRs. the scheme encourages farmers to produce certified maize seedsRs. ensuring a steady supply of high-quality seeds.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Rs./- per quintal.
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a Farmer. - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a maize-growing farmer. - The beneficiary should belong to any of the following district of Tamil Nadu: CoimbatoreRs. DindigulRs. ErodeRs. DharmapuriRs. KrishnagiriRs. NamakkalRs. PerambalurRs. VirudhunagarRs. TheniRs. VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi.

name: First Self Marriage Expenses
brief_description: The "First Self Marriage Expenses" scheme was implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare BoardRs. Labour Department Government of Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 30Rs./- towards the first self-marriage expenses to the registered worker.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 30Rs./- provided to registered construction worker for first marriage expenses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The applicant should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Financial Assistance to 75% or Permanent Disability
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to 75% or Permanent Disability was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labor Department Maharashtra. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- to the registered worker in case of 75 % or more permanent disability (the benefit can be availed only after 26th July 2014 as the benefit is covered under the Mediclaim & Personal Accident Insurance scheme).
benefits: - Financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided by the Board to the registered worker for 75% or more permanent disability.
eligibility: 1. The worker must be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The worker should be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW). 1. The worker should have a 75% or permanent disability.

name: District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: Small Road Transport Operators Loan (SRTO Loan)
brief_description: The "District Central Cooperative Banks and through its Branches: Small Road Transport Operators Loan (SRTO Loan)" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. provides loans up to 10Rs./- for small road transport operations. The interest rate for this loan is 13% (subject to change).
benefits: - **Access to Loan:** Up to 10Rs./-. - **Interest Rate:** 13% (subject to change).
eligibility: - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu. - The beneficiary should be a Small Road Transport Operator.

name: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students
brief_description: The scheme "Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students" by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa aims to improve the educational status of handicapped children studying in standards 1st to 10th by providing financial assistance. Through this schemeRs. monthly stipends ranging from 200 to 300 are provided to parents who are unable to send their children to school due to economic reasons. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The scheme is being implemented by Chief Minister Scholarship PortalRs. Government of Goa.
benefits:
**Monthly Stipend Rates**

- Standards 1 to 4: 200 per month
- Standards 5 to 8: 200 per month
- Standards 9 to 12: 300 per month

**Duration:** 11 months (full academic year)
**Disbursement:** Two installments (September and January)
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a bonafide resident of the State of Goa
- The applicant must be a regular student of a recognized school
- The applicant's parents/guardian's combined annual income should not exceed 25Rs.
- The applicant must be physically handicapped as specified under Rule 4 read with Rule 5
- The applicant should not be a repeater in the current standard (one failure can be condoned at Director's discretion)
- The applicant should not be residing in or receiving maintenance from any government institutionsRs. local bodiesRs. or grant-receiving private organizations
- The applicant should not be receiving any other stipend or scholarship
- Multiple handicapped children from the same family are eligible if other conditions are met

name: Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students
brief_description: "Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students" by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa aims to motivate students by providing merit-based awards and financial incentives to high-performing students who are economically weak. Through this schemeRs. monetary scholarships ranging from 5Rs. to 20Rs. are provided to Dhangar students based on their academic performance in SSC and HSSC board examinations. The applications for this scheme are accepted online. The scheme is being implemented by the Chief Minister Scholarship PortalRs. Government of Goa.
benefits:
**Financial Award** - First 5 Rank Holders from SSC: 20Rs. each - First 5 Rank Holders from HSSC (Science Stream): 20Rs./- each - First 5 Rank Holders from HSSC (Commerce Stream): 20Rs./- each - First 5 Rank Holders from HSSC (Arts Stream): 20Rs./- each - First 5 Rank Holders from HSSC (Vocational Stream): 20Rs./- each - Certificate of Appreciation - Felicitation in a Public Ceremony
**Mode of Disbursement** The amount of Financial Award is disbursed through Electronic Bank Transfer.
**Merit-based Awards** - Marks between 50% to 59.99%: 5Rs./- - Marks between 60% to 69.99%: 8Rs./- - Marks between 70% to 74.9%: 10Rs./- - Marks 75% and above: 15Rs./-
eligibility:
**For Rank Holders Category**

- The applicant must belong to the Dhangar community.
- The applicant must be among the top 5 rank holders in their respective examination (SSC or HSSC).
- The applicant has no income ceiling restrictions.

**For Merit-based Awards**

- The applicant must belong to the Dhangar community.
- The applicant's annual family income should be less than 2Rs./-.
- The applicant must achieve the minimum qualifying percentage as per the benefit slabs.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (Maharashtra)
brief_description: The scheme "National Family Benefit Scheme (Maharashtra)" is a social welfare scheme by the Social Justice & Special Assistance DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. Under this schemeRs. in the event of the death of the primary breadwinner of a BPL familyRs. the family is provided with a one-time lump sum financial assistance of 20Rs./-.
benefits: Financial assistance of 20Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased breadwinner (an earning member of the family on whom the family primarily depended for income).
1. The family should be living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).
1. The deceased should have been between 18 and 59 years old.

name: Financial Assistance for Widow or Widower of Registered Construction Worker
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Widow or Widower of Registered Construction Worker scheme was implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 24Rs./- p.a. up to 5 years to the widow or widower in case of death of a registered worker during the course of employment.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 24Rs./- per annum up to 5 years to the widow or widower.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the widow or widower of a deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased worker must have been registered with the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Vasantrao Naik Tanda / Basti Development Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Vasantrao Naik Tanda/Basti Development" is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Government of Maharashtra. The scheme provides essential amenities to the Tandas and Bastis of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes. The scheme focuses on improving access to drinking waterRs. electrificationRs. latrinesRs. drainage systemsRs. and approach roads for these communities.
benefits:
**Admissible Grant based on the Population of the VJNT Community -**

- VJNT Population: 51 to 100; Admissible Grant: 4 Lakhs.
- VJNT Population: 101 to 150; Admissible Grant: 6 Lakhs.
- VJNT Population: Above 151; Admissible Grant: 10 Lakhs.
eligibility:
1. The Tanda or Basti should have a population of at least 51 residents who belong to the Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) category.
1. The area must be lacking basic infrastructure amenities like waterRs. sanitationRs. or electrification.
1. The Tanda or Basti must be located in Maharashtra.

name: Fal Podharopan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Fal Podharopan Yojana" by the Horticulture and Food Processing DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. provides targeted support to farmers for fruit cultivationRs. taking into account land conditionsRs. climateRs. and irrigation availability. Under this schemeRs. farmers receive a subsidy of 40% to 50% of the unit costRs. disbursed over three yearsRs. in the ratio of 60:20:20Rs. for planting fruit saplings on areas ranging from 0.25 to 4 hectares. Eligible fruits include mangoRs. guavaRs. orangeRs. sweet limeRs. custard appleRs. plumRs. sapotaRs. grapesRs. pomegranateRs. strawberryRs. tissue-cultured bananaRs. hybrid-seed papayaRs. mungaRs. and lemon. The subsidy applies to both standard and high-density plantationsRs. with or without drip irrigationRs. to support sustainable and high-yield fruit farming.
benefits:
40% to 50% of grant-in-aid is payable in the ratio of 60:20:20 in three years.
Sr. No.ConstituentPercentage of grant-in-aidPer Hectare Unit Cost for Dripless IrrigationGrant-in-Aid for Driplessrrigation (60:20:20)Per Hectare Unit Cost for Drip IrrigationGrant-in-Aid for for Drip Irrigation (60:20:20)1.Normal Distance40% to 50%60Rs..High Density40%1Rs..Ultra High Density40%1Rs.(Amount in )
eligibility:
1. The applicant should own private land.
1. The land area should be at least 0.25 hectares.
1. The land area should not exceed 4 hectares.
1. The applicant should have adequate means of irrigation to support fruit plantation.
1. The applicant should be interested in growing fruit crops.
1. The applicant should have a strong interest in plantation activities.
1. The applicant should be from one of the following social categories - GeneralRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Scheduled Caste.

name: Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons
brief_description:
The Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons scheme was launched by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram. Under this schemeRs. provide vocational courses for specially-abled individualsRs. funded by the Government of Mizoram. The centers provide courses in tailoring for females and tailoring/shoemaking for malesRs. with a monthly stipend of 250 for the training period.
**Training Centers:** There are three training centersRs. including residential centers in Aizawl for both genders and a non-residential center in Lunglei.
benefits:
- One year of vocational training in tailoring and shoemaking.
- A monthly stipend of 250/- is given to the trainees.
- Hand sewing machine/Treadle sewing machine/Cobbler tools are given to them upon completion of the course.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Mizoram. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant should be from the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

name: Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course
brief_description: The Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW)Rs. Labour Department Maharashtra. The scheme offers reimbursement of the MS-CIT (Maharashtra State Certificate in Information Technology) course fees for up to two children of registered construction workers.
benefits: - Reimbursement of the MS-CIT (Maharashtra State Certificate in Information Technology) course fees for up to two children of registered construction workers.
eligibility: 1. The children's parents/guardians should be registered construction workers. 1. The construction worker should be registered under the MBOCWW. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government-recognized MS-CIT course.

name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (Maharashtra)
brief_description: The "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana" scheme is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance DepartmentRs. Government of Maharashtra. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme is aimed at providing insurance and scholarship benefits to landless laborers in rural areasRs. aged 18 to 59 years. The annual premium for each member is 200/-Rs. with 50% of the premium subsidized by the State and Central Governments. The scheme covers all categories of beneficiaries and focuses on providing financial security through insurance and educational scholarships.
benefits: - **Natural Death Benefit:** 30Rs. is payable to the nominee in case of natural death before the terminal date.- **Accidental Death Benefit:** 75Rs. is payable to the nominee in case of death due to an accident.- **Permanent Total Disability (Accident):** 75Rs. is provided in case of permanent total disability caused by an accident.- **Loss of Two Eyes or Two Limbs (Accident):** 75Rs. is payable in case of loss of two eyes or two limbs in an accident.- **Loss of One Eye or One Limb (Accident):** 37Rs. is payable in case of loss of one eye or one limb in an accident.- **Scholarship Benefit:** 100 per month is given as a scholarship to children of the insured studying in 9th to 12th standards. The scholarship is available for a maximum of two children per family.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 59 years.
1. The applicant must be a landless labourer.
1. The applicant should be residing in a rural area.
1. The applicant's family should not own any agricultural land.
1. The applicant should not be covered under any other similar insurance scheme.

name: Swarnima
benefits:
- Financial assistance of up to 5Rs./- per Self-Help Group (SHG) projectRs. with 25Rs. allocated per beneficiary (up to 20 members per SHG).
- Funding shares include 95% from the Central Corporation and 5% from the State Corporation.
- No beneficiary contribution is required.
- Low interest rate of 5% per annum.
- Repayment period of up to 3 years to ease financial planning.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from the Other Backward Class (OBC) category.
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Maharashtra.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 50 years.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should be -


- Rural areas: Less than or equal to 98Rs..
- Urban areas: Less than or equal to 1Rs..

name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: Jewel Loans
brief_description: The "Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: Jewel Loans" scheme launched by the Co-operationRs. Food and Consumer Protection DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to provide financial assistance to farmers through jewel loans. The loan amount can be up to 2Rs./-Rs. with an interest rate of 11.5% (subject to change).
benefits: **Access to Loan:** Up to 2Rs./- based on the value of the pledged jewels. **Interest Rate:** 11.5% (subject to change).
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The beneficiary should be a farmer.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in agricultural activities.

name: Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2018Rs. the "Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme" offers financial assistance to construction workers registered under the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. helping them purchase tools and equipment related to their work. To be eligibleRs. workers must possess a valid identity card from the MandalRs. and they can receive a subsidy of up to 10% of the loan taken for the tool kitRs. or 5Rs. whichever is lessRs. within 3 months of the equipment purchase date.
benefits: The benefit is 10% of the loan or 5Rs. whichever is lower.
eligibility:
**For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:**

1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually.

**For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**

1. The applicant should be registered Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The worker should possess a valid identity card issued by the Mandal.
1. The worker should be up to 60 years of age.
1. The subsidy should be available once in a lifetime for the worker.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)- Mega Skill Centre
brief_description:
The Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kaushal Kendra (DDUKK)Mega Skill Centre is a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojna launched by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training and Skill DevelopmentRs. Jharkhand. The schemeRs. operational since October 2017Rs. focuses on longer-duration courses with on-job training (OJT) for youth. It aims to train 60Rs. candidates in various sectors during 2023-24.
**Course Duration** The training under this scheme is a minimum of 576 hours of which 160 hours are dedicated to IT and Soft Skills
benefits: - **Comprehensive Training:** Combines technical skills with soft skills and IT training.- **Residential Facility:** Training is fully residentialRs. ensuring a focused learning environment.- **On Job Training (OJT):** Hands-on industry exposure for candidates to become job-ready.- **Multi-sector Opportunities:** Tourism & HospitalityRs. TelecomRs. SecurityRs. RetailRs. PlumbingRs. LogisticsRs. IT/ITESRs. ElectronicsRs. Domestic WorkerRs. ConstructionRs. Capital GoodsRs. BFSIRs. Beauty & WellnessRs. AutomotiveRs. ApparelRs. and AgricultureRs. Food ProcessingRs. HealthcareRs. Iron & SteelRs. Mining
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant's age should be 18-35 years.
1. The applicant must belong to one of the priority groups (SC/STRs. womenRs. PwDRs. transgender).

name: Mukhyamantri Vyavsayik Pathyakram Margdarshan Evam Utpreran Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Vyavsayik Pathyakram Margdarshan Evam Utpreran Yojana" was launched by the Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. aims to provide free pre-examination coaching to BC and EBC students. This initiative supports students aiming for competitive exams such as NETRs. GATERs. JRFRs. and Ph.D. Programs. Coaching is offered at select universities and career guidance centers.
benefits: - **Free Coaching:** Free coaching in the renowned [Career Guidance Centers(Page 26)](https://state.bihar.gov.in/cache/41/Department%20Info/Schemes/varsik2025s.pdf). **Note:****** There is no hostel provision in the centers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC) categories.
1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-.
1. The applicant must meet the minimum educational qualifications required for the chosen competitive examination.

**Note:**

- Applicants will appear for competitive exams under their respective courses. Selection will be based on a multiple-choice written test following the prescribed syllabus.

name: State Scholarship of Class 6th to 10th (Scheduled Caste)
brief_description: Launched in 1966-67Rs. the "State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th" is a welfare scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste studentsRs. offering 200 per year for boys and 600 per year for girlsRs. to support their education. The scholarship is provided until 31st October each year. The aim is to encourage students from the Scheduled Caste category to pursue their education and reduce financial barriers.
benefits: **Scholarship amount:** Boy - 200/- Rs.Girl -600/- (for 10 months)
eligibility:
1. The student should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The student should be enrolled in classes 6th to 10th in a recognized educational institution..
1. The student should apply for the scholarship before the 31st of October.

name: Nariwal Paudha Vitaran Yojana
brief_description: The Nariwal Paudha Vitaran YojanaRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. BiharRs. is designed to distribute coconut saplings to farmers and individuals willing to plant on their land. The main objective of this scheme is to plant coconut saplings in non-traditional coconut areas in the state.
benefits: - **Subsidy Support:** 75% subsidy i.e. 63.75/- will be payable on the unit cost of 85/- per sapling. - **Distribution of Saplings:** A minimum of 5 and a maximum of 712 saplings (178 saplings per hectare) will be provided to beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be interested in planting coconut saplings. 1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:** - General Category: 78.56%. - Scheduled Castes: 20%. - Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%. - Women Participation: 30%. > **Note 2:** The benefit of the scheme will generally be given to the farmer family. Farmer family means husband-wife and minor child. > **Note 3:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The Anjeer Vikas Yojana a component of the umbrella scheme Mukhyamantri Bagwani MissionRs. launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote the commercial cultivation of horticultural crops in the state of Bihar. This component promotes fig cultivation across all districts in Bihar by providing financial assistance and high quality plants. It ensures inclusivity with reserved quotas for SCRs. STRs. and women beneficiaries. Payments are processed through DBTRs. and only ryot farmers are eligible to apply for this scheme.
benefits: > **Financial Support:** - **First year:** 30Rs./- per hectare. - **Second and third year:** 10Rs./- per hectare (per year). > **Plant Distribution:** - Supply of high-quality plants.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a ryot farmer.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and a maximum of 10 acres (4 ha).
1. The applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.

> **Note 1: Beneficiary allocation:**



- General Category: 78.56%.
- Scheduled Castes: 20%.
- Scheduled Tribes: 1.44%.
- Women Participation: 30%.


> **Note 2:** Beneficiaries will be selected on first come first serve basis.

name: National Family Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: Launched on 15th August 1995Rs. the "National Family Benefit Scheme" is a welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- to ensure social security for bereaved families living below the poverty line in case of the death of their breadwinner.
benefits: A one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a family member or a dependent of the deceased person.
1. The deceased person should have been the primary breadwinner (an earning member of the family) on whom the family primarily depended for income.
1. The family of the deceased should be living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).

name: Saksham Jharkhand Kaushal Vikas Yojana

name: Vandan Matru Yojana

name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" by the Haryana Livestock Development BoardRs. Department of Animal Husbandry and DairyingRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock ownersRs. including Scheduled Caste (SC) and Below Poverty Line (BPL) beneficiariesRs. with subsidised premium rates.
benefits:
**Financial Protection**

- Coverage for livestock loss due to deathRs. providing financial security to farmers.
- Sum insured is determined based on the market value of livestock and milk yield.
- Maximum coverage is up to five large animals or equivalent small animals per household.

**Subsidized Premiums**

- APL beneficiaries pay 100/200/300 per large animal per year based on milk yield or 25/- per small animal.
- BPL beneficiaries receive additional subsidiesRs. and SC beneficiaries have their entire premium covered by the state and central government.

**Mode and Frequency of Disbursement**

- Claims are settled through direct bank transfers to beneficiaries.
- Accidental death claims are covered immediately; non-accidental death claims are covered after a 21-day waiting period.

**Expected Time of Disbursement**
Insurance companies are required to settle claims within 15 days of document submission. Delays incur a penalty of 12% compound interest per annum.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a livestock owner.
- The applicant should be above 18 years of age.
- The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP)Rs. issued by the state of Haryana.

**Preference and Relaxations**

- Applicants from Scheduled Caste and Below Poverty Line categories will be given priority.
- Scheduled Caste beneficiaries are exempt from paying premiums; the state and central governments fully subsidize their insurance.

name: Valmiki Chhatravritti Yojana

name: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme
