Fund Allocation: - Funds are allocated by the District Panchayat Raj Officers to each Panchayat Secretariat. - Funds must be used with the approval of the Panchayat Samiti and should be linked to an e-voucher-based monitoring system. 1. Utilization Guidelines: - Expenditure should be approved for activities like reconciliation of bank accountsRs. purchase of consumablesRs. repair of computers/equipmentRs. electricityRs. and water bills. - Panchayat Secretariats must maintain proper records of expenses. 1. Service and Support Centers: - Panchayat Bhavans will host service centers such as Common Service CentresRs. Post OfficesRs. Bank BranchesRs. ATM servicesRs. and Sub-Registrar offices. - These centers will improve public service delivery in rural areas. 1. Sanitation and Infrastructure: - CleanlinessRs. drinking waterRs. seating arrangementsRs. and cleanliness-related provisions to be maintained using allocated funds. 1. Safety Measures: - Installation of CCTV camerasRs. lightingRs. and other safety equipment is encouraged. 1. Digital and Internet Facilities: - Internet recharge and maintenance for seamless online services are covered under this scheme. 1. Electricity and Fuel: - Provision for electricity/fuel for operating Panchayat facilities is also included. 1. Miscellaneous: - Expenditure on new items or costs beyond the allocated amount requires prior approval from competent authorities. - Annual usage will be monitoredRs. and excess expenditure (if any) must be split 50-50 between the Panchayat Secretary and Mukhia.
benefits:
- A monthly grant of 15Rs. per Gram Panchayat for operational expenses.
**NOTE:** Electronic fund transfer mechanism for timely disbursement every quarter.
eligibility: 1. The Gram Panchayats must within the state of Jharkhand. 1. The Gram Panchayat must have an operational Panchayat Secretariat in place to receive and utilize the grant. 1. The Gram Panchayat must maintain proper recordsRs. documentationRs. and reconciliation of expenditures to continue receiving support under the scheme.

name: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme for the Students Who Attain First Position in CBSE Annual Exams in the State
brief_description: The scheme "Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme" by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to encourage meritorious students who attain top positions in CBSE annual exams by providing them with financial incentives. Selected students receive an annual incentive covering their school/college fees up to the completion of their graduation. The objective of the scheme is to encourage academic excellence among students by providing financial incentives to CBSE toppers.; support students in pursuing higher education without financial constraints; and reward merit and performance in CBSE Class 10th and 12th board examinations.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance**
The entire tuition fee is coveredRs. up to a maximum limit.
**Incentives for 10th Class Toppers**
Up to 25Rs./- per year till 10+2 level and up to 1Rs./- per year till graduation.
**Incentives for 12th Class Toppers**
Up to 1Rs./- per year till graduation.
**Mode of Disbursement**
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) from 2021-22 onwards.
**Frequency of Disbursement**
AnnuallyRs. based on academic progression.
**Validity**
The incentive continues until the completion of graduation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be the top-ranked boy or girl in the CBSE 10th or 12th annual exams at the state level.
1. The applicant should be continuing his/her education as a regular student.
1. The applicant should have passed from a school in Haryana.
1. For 10th ClassRs. the applicant should have secured 92% or above in EnglishRs. Science & TechnologyRs. MathematicsRs. Social ScienceRs. and the best one of the remaining subjects.
1. For the 12th ClassRs. the applicant should have secured 90% or above in English and the four best subjects in Science (Medical & Non-Medical)Rs. CommerceRs. or Humanities.

name: Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: "Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme" by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh provides financial assistance for the education and training of differently-abled childrenRs. who are regular students in a school or college. The application needs to be submitted in prescribed format to the District OfficeRs. Panchayat and Social Welfare / Janpad Panchayat Office through the Head of the Institution.
benefits:
- 150/- per month for the Students of 1st to 5th Standard
- 170/- per month for the Students of 6th to 8th Standard
- 190/- per month for the Students of 9th to 12th Standard
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
- The applicant should be a Student.
- The applicant should be differently-abled.
- The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.
- The applicant should be a regular student in a college/technical school.

name: Transport Loan Scheme
brief_description: "Transport Loan Scheme" by the Delhi Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. Minorities & Safai Karamchari Finance and Development Corporation (DSFDC)Rs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. aims to promote self-employment among beneficiaries of the target groups by providing term loans for the purchase of Light Motor Vehicles (LMVs). The scheme offers financial assistance up to 5Rs./- to eligible applicants. The target groups include Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Safai Karamcharis.
benefits:
The scheme provides **term loans up to 5Rs./-** for the purchase of Light Motor Vehicles (LMVs).
_*The loan is recovered in 60 monthly installments over a period of five yearsRs. with six months as a moratorium period._
_*Loans are disbursed subject to the completion of pre and post-sanction formalities._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CastesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Safai Karamcharis.
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Delhi.
- The applicants age should be between 18 to 45 years.
- The annual family income of the applicants (under Scheduled CasteRs. Other Backward Classes & Minority category) from all sources should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum.
- For the creamy layer of the Minority categoryRs. the maximum income ceiling is 6Rs./- per annum.
- There is no income limit prescribed under the Safai Karamchari category.
- Bonafide valid commercial driving licence & badge required (Light Motor Vehicle).
- The applicant should have not been declared as a defaulter under any scheme of DSFDCRs. Nationalized BankRs. Financial InstitutionRs. or Co-operative Bank etc.

name: Composite Loan Scheme
brief_description: The "Composite Loan Scheme" is managed by the Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Handicapped Financial & Development CorporationRs. Government of NCT of Delhi. The scheme aims to provide need-based financial support to individuals from Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Persons with Disabilities to help them pursue various income-generating activities. The scheme encourages self-employment and entrepreneurshipRs. promoting economic independence and social inclusion for the targeted groups.
benefits:
**Maximum Permissible Loan Amount**

- For the SC categoryRs. the need-based loan is up to 3Rs./-.
- For OBCRs. Minority and PwD categoriesRs. the need-based loan amount is up to 1Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be from one of the following target groups - Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. MinorityRs. Persons with Disability.
- The applicant should be a resident of Delhi.
- The applicant's age should be between 18 to 50 years.
- The annual family income of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed 1Rs./-.
- The applicant should be willing to pursue one of the [income-generating activities](https://dsfdc.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/cls_schem_details.pdf) given in the scheme guidelines.- The applicant must have a proper workplaceRs. for starting the proposed activityRs. either owned or rented.
- The applicant should not have been declared a defaulter under any of the schemes being implemented by DSFDC.

name: Goa Mediclaim Scheme
brief_description: Goa Mediclaim Scheme was launched by the Health Services DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme applies to every permanent resident residing in Goa for 15 years. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to avail super-speciality treatments that are not available in the Government Hospitals of GoaRs. such as dialysisRs. plastic surgeryRs. ICU careRs. angiography and angioplastyRs. open-heart surgeryRs. kidney transplantationRs. neurosurgeryRs. radiotherapy and chemotherapy for cancerRs. cochlear implantsRs. and bone marrow transplants.
benefits:
**The Nature of Sickness along with its Permitted Ceiling Limit for the Super-Specialty Treatment is given below -**

- Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD) Treatment: 15Rs./- per month
- Dialysis: 15Rs./- per month @ 1Rs./- per dialysis for 12 dialysis
- Plastic Surgery: 1Rs./-
- Intensive Care Unit (ICU)Rs. Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)Rs. Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU)Rs. Trauma Care: 1Rs./-
- Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG) / Percutaneous Transluminal Coronary Angioplasty (PTCA) (Angiography & Angioplasty) : 1Rs./-
- Open Heart Surgery (Valve replacementRs. Mitral Valve Replacement (MVR)Rs. Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD)Rs. Atrial Septal Defect (ASD): 3Rs./-
- Kidney Transplantation: 3Rs./-
- Neuro Surgery: 3Rs./-
- Radiotherapy / Chemotherapy (Cancer): 5Rs./-
- Cochlear Implant: 1Rs./-
- Spastic ChildRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Skeletal Deformities: 1Rs./-
- Bone Marrow Transplant: 8Rs./-

_*The list of the hospitals recognized under this schemeRs. and the medical treatment covered under each hospital are provided in the scheme guidelines._
_*Either the Permitted Ceiling Limit Treatment or the Actual Expense of TreatmentRs. whichever is the least will be considered._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Goa.
- The applicant should be residing in Goa for 15 yearsRs. figuring in the voters' list and holding a permanent ration card.
- The income of the applicant should be less than 1Rs./- per annum. HoweverRs. retired state government employees are eligible irrespective of their income.
- The applicant should require a facility that is not available in a Government Hospital of Goa (including Goa Medical CollegeRs. Bambolim and District Hospitals). HoweverRs. for NICURs. Ventilatory Support and Kidney DialysisRs. the patient may opt for any empanelled hospital even if the facilities are available in a Government hospital.
- The applicant should be suffering from a sickness/ailment that requires one of the following treatments - Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD)Rs. DialysisRs. Plastic SurgeryRs. Intensive Care Unit (ICU)Rs. Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)Rs. Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU)Rs. Trauma CareRs. Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG) / Percutaneous Transluminal Coronary Angioplasty (PTCA) (Angiography & Angioplasty)Rs. Open Heart Surgery (Valve ReplacementRs. Mitral Valve Replacement (MVR)Rs. Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD)Rs. Atrial Septal Defect (ASD))Rs. Kidney TransplantationRs. Neuro SurgeryRs. Radiotherapy / Chemotherapy (Cancer)Rs. Cochlear ImplantRs. Spastic ChildRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Skeletal DeformitiesRs. and Bone Marrow Transplant.

name: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
brief_description:
The scheme Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education was launched by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of HaryanaRs. on 1st JulyRs. 2008Rs. with the aim of attracting Scheduled Caste (SC) students towards higher education. Under this schemeRs. SC students studying in Government Colleges will receive a stipend of 1Rs. per month. The scheme will be implemented in all Government Colleges of HaryanaRs. and the stipend will be disbursed bi-monthlyRs. subject to a minimum 60% attendance in classes.
This stipend will be treated as monetary help to meet the sundry charges of higher education so that the beneficiaries may not become ineligible for the Post Matric Scholarship awarded by the Government of India.
benefits:
1. **Stipend Amount:** Eligible SC students receive 1Rs./- per month.1. **Hostel Stipend:** Additional 500/- per month for 12 months for students availing hostel facilities.
**Mode of Disbursement:**

1. The stipend is disbursed bi-monthly in SeptemberRs. NovemberRs. JanuaryRs. and March.
1. The amount for January to June is disbursed in March due to the financial year closure.
1. Payments are transferred directly to students' Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS).

**Frequency of Disbursement:**

1. **Stipend:** Four bimonthly instalments per year.1. **Hostel Stipend:** Two half-yearly instalments (July-DecemberRs. January-June).
**Expected Time of Disbursement:**

1. **Stipend:** First week of the disbursement month (SeptemberRs. NovemberRs. JanuaryRs. March).1. **Hostel Stipend:** November and January.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government college in Haryana.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous academic year examination.
1. The applicant should maintain at least 60% attendance to receive the stipend.

name: Paternity Benefit Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Paternity Benefit Scheme" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare BoardRs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides 6Rs./- per childbirth to the male workersRs. provided that their wife is not registered with the Board.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 6Rs./- per childbirth for upto two childbirths.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a worker.
- The applicant should be a male.


- The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
- The applicant should be registered with the "Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
- The applicant's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
- The applicant should have at least one year of membership with the Board.
- The wife of the applicant should not be registered with the Board.
- The benefits will be applicable for the first two childbirths.

name: e-Adhigam Scheme - Free Tablet
brief_description:
The scheme e-Adhigam (Advance Digital Haryana Initiative of Government with Adaptive Modules) scheme was launched by the School Education DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. with the objective of promoting digital education & providing online education to the children belonging to poor & needy families is proving to be a boon for them. Under this schemeRs. free tablets are provided to studentsRs. enabling access to state-of-the-art software & learning materials.
This tablet is equipped with a Learning Management SystemRs. which is based on Personalized Adaptive Learning; so that children can access mock testsRs. complete their syllabus with a comprehensive approach/information related to their subjects. The device includes the vast content such as booksRs. PDFRs. video/audio and other digital material. Along with thisRs. assessment and testing tools have also been made available in it. This device has test material and apps like e-PathshalaRs. NORERRs. NCERT solutionRs. free solution of NCERT subjects etc. to prepare for various competitive exams.
> **Free Android Tablets are the Property of Government:**

The tablet devices would be distributed along the lines of the library scheme. This means that all Android tablets will remain the property of the state government. The device will be issued to the govt. Upon passing Class 12Rs. students will have to return it for online education.
> **Expected Time of Disbursement:**


1. In Phase 1Rs. 5 lakh tablets were distributed to Class 10 and 12 students.
1. Tablets for Class 11 students are distributed after Class 10 board exams.
1. Tablets for Classes 8 and 9 will be provided in a phased manner.
benefits:
**Tangible Benefits:**

1. **Free Android Tablets** Provided to students in Classes 8 to 12.1. **Pre-loaded Content** Tablets come with pre-loaded educational contentRs. personalized adaptive learning (PAL) platformRs. and study materials.1. **2GB Free Data Per Month** Enables students to access online study resources.
> **Mode of Disbursement:**


- Tablets are distributed in government schools under the Haryana Free Tablet Scheme.

> **Frequency of Disbursement:**


- Tablets are distributed once to eligible students.
- Free 2GB of data is provided every month.

> **Validity of Benefits:**


- The tablets remain the property of the Haryana Government.
- Students must return the tablets after completing Class 12.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student of a government school in Haryana.
1. The applicant must be studying in Class 8Rs. 9Rs. 10Rs. 11Rs. or 12.
1. The applicant must be part of the phased distribution plan as per the Haryana Governments rollout strategy.
1. Class 11 students will receive tablets only after clearing the Class 10 board exams.

name: Mahila Swayamsiddha Yojana Rajasthan
brief_description:
The "Mahila Swayamsiddha Yojana" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide skill training and self-employment opportunities to widowedRs. abandonedRs. and destitute women. Under this schemeRs. free vocational training is offered in Nariniketan buildingsRs. operated via voluntary organizations.
> ***Objective:*** - Free vocational training for skill development in various trades. - Accommodation and food provisions for enrolled women and their children. - Financial assistance to NGOs operating training centers. - The training period ranges from 3 months to 1 year. - Assistance in securing employment or availing loans for self-employment. - Monthly stipend for participating women.
> ***Women should belong to one of the following categories:*** - WidowedRs. abandonedRs. or destitute women facing social neglect. - Women released from imprisonment without family support. - Women affected by natural disastersRs. lacking social and financial assistance. - Women rescued from exploitationRs. traffickingRs. or forced labor. - Women affected by terrorism or extremist activities. - Women suffering from mental illnessRs. except those requiring institutional psychiatric care. - Women living with HIV/AIDS who are abandoned by their families. - Other women facing extreme social and economic distress.

1. The applicant should be a registered voluntary organizationRs. trustRs. or NGO.

name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fee and Transport Facility to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Technical Institutions in Haryana
brief_description: The scheme "Reimbursement of Tuition Fee and Transport Facility to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Technical Institutions in Haryana" was launched by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Government of Haryana. It aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Castes students pursuing AICTE-approved technical coursesRs. such as Diplomas from PolytechnicsRs. D-PharmacyRs. B-PharmacyRs. B.Tech.Rs. M.E.Rs. M.Tech.Rs. Ph.D. in Engineering subjectsRs. MBARs. and MCA. The scheme is applicable only to students enrolled in regular mode at governmentRs. privateRs. or aided technical institutions approved by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Haryana. Under this schemeRs. eligible students receive reimbursement of tuition fees along with transport facility benefits.
benefits:
**Tuition Fee Reimbursement:**

- The reimbursement covers the actual tuition fee of 20Rs./- for diploma courses and 40Rs./- for degree coursesRs. whichever is lower.

**Transport Facility Reimbursement:**

- The reimbursement covers the actual amount of state transport facilities (train pass/bus pass).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste student of Haryana.
1. The student should be enrolled in an AICTE-approved DiplomaRs. UndergraduateRs. or Postgraduate technical courseRs. including Diploma from PolytechnicsRs. D-PharmacyRs. B-PharmacyRs. B.Tech.Rs. M.E.Rs. M.Tech.Rs. Ph.D. in Engineering subjectsRs. MBARs. or MCA.
1. The applicant should be pursuing an AICTE-approved course in a governmentRs. privateRs. or aided technical institution approved by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Haryana.
1. The applicant should be admitted through centralized counselling.
1. The applicants annual parental income should be between 2.5 lakh and 3.5 lakh for tuition fee reimbursement.
1. The applicant should not be residing in a campus hostel to be eligible for transport facility reimbursement.

name: Vivah Sahayata Yojana (Labor Welfare Board Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: The "Vivah Sahayata Yojana" was launched on 17th September 2021Rs. under the Labor Welfare BoardRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. 15Rs. is provided per case for the marriage of a daughter (above 18 years of age) of workers/employees working in institutions covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund ActRs. 1982Rs. or to a female worker herself.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 15Rs./- per case for the marriage of a worker's daughter.
eligibility: **For Registration** 1. The applicant should be working in an industrial establishment covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Fund Act 1982. 1. The applicant should be employed in the establishment for at least one year. 1. The applicant should be from an establishment that regularly contributes to the Board. 1. The applicant should be submitting the application form 15 days before or within 60 days after the wedding. 1. The bride should be at least 18 years oldRs. and the groom should be at least 21 years old. 1. The applicant should not have availed marriage assistance under any other scheme. **For Application** 1. The applicant should be a daughter of a worker/employee in a covered institution. 1. The applicant daughter should be above 18 years of age. 1. The worker or institution should be covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund ActRs. 1982.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to students of all sections & castes of Rajasthan who are pursuing higher education in nationally recognized institutions. Under this schemeRs. 50% of the non-refundable institutional fees are reimbursed to eligible students studying in IITsRs. IIMsRs. and other premier institutions.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- Students receive 50% reimbursement of their non-refundable institutional fees (such as tuitionRs. libraryRs. medicalRs. and examination fees).

**Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):******

- The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student's bank account.

**Annual Disbursement:**

- The scholarship is disbursed annually throughout the duration of the course.

**Covers Multiple Institutions:**

- Includes IITsRs. IIMsRs. NITsRs. AIIMSRs. and other national institutions listed in the [scheme guidelines](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The annual income of the parent/guardian of the student/applicant from all sources (including the applicants own incomeRs. if any) should be less than 5Rs./-.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in IITsRs. IIMsRs. NITsRs. AIIMSRs. or other [national institutions listed](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198) under the scheme.1. The applicant should not be availing of any other government scholarship for the same course.
1. The applicant should maintain academic performance as required for renewal of the scholarship.
1. An employee pursuing full-time studies while on leave without pay for the entire duration of the course will also be eligible for the scholarship.
1. The student studying outside Rajasthan in the [listed national institutions](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198) are eligible.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Financial Assistance for Studying Bisexual Children
brief_description: The scheme "Transgender Utthan Kosh - Financial Assistance for Studying Bisexual Children" was implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide financial assistance for education and upliftment of transgender individuals. Under this schemeRs. transgender students from class 6th and higher classes receive a monthly stipend to cover accommodation and daily expenses if they live away from their homes for education.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 6Rs./- per month for up to 12 months to support transgender students living away from their homes for education.

**NOTE:**

- Assistance is provided directly to the student's bank account.
- Students must submit a rental receipt each month to continue receiving assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to transgender community.
1. The applicant should be studying in class 6th or higher class.
1. The applicant should be residing away from their home for study purpose.
1. The gross annual income of applicant should be up to 8.00 lakh.

name: Academic Scholarship Scheme (Labor Welfare Board Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: The Academic Scholarship Scheme is implemented under the Labour Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. up to two children of workers employed in industrial institutions/establishments covered under the Board are eligible for scholarship benefits. The scholarship is provided to students from Class 5th to 12th and higher educationRs. who have passed their previous class and are studying in Madhya Pradesh. The benefits are granted once a yearRs. provided the applicant does not receive a scholarship from any other department and applies in the prescribed format.
benefits:
**Class-wise Scholarship Amount:**

- Class 5th to 8th 2Rs./-
- Class 9th & 10th 4Rs./-
- Class 11th & 12th 4Rs./-
- ITI (Certificate Course) 5Rs./-
- Polytechnic (Diploma Course) 5Rs./-
- General Graduate (BARs. B.ComRs. B.ScRs. BBA) 7Rs./-
- Engineering (BE/B.Tech) 10Rs./-
- MBBS/BDS 12Rs./-
- PharmacyRs. AyurvedicRs. Homeopathic (UGRs. PGRs. Diploma)Rs. ParamedicalRs. Nursing Courses 9Rs./-
- Law Courses 10Rs./-
- General PG Courses (MARs. M.ComRs. M.ScRs. MBA) 7Rs./-
- ME/M.Tech 11Rs./-
- PGDM & Other Management Diplomas 7Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a child of a worker employed in an industrial institution/establishment covered under the M.P. Labour Welfare Fund Act 1982.
1. The applicant should be studying as a regular student in an educational institution in Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous class.
1. The applicant should not be receiving a scholarship from any other department.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 5th to 12thRs. ITIRs. PolytechnicRs. General GraduateRs. EngineeringRs. MBBSRs. BDSRs. PharmacyRs. ParamedicalRs. NursingRs. LawRs. PG CoursesRs. M.E./M.TechRs. PGDMRs. or other management diploma courses.

name: Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams
brief_description: The scheme "Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support non-reserved category students in pursuing professional courses in medical and engineering fields by providing financial aid for coaching. Students who have secured 70% or more marks in Class 10th/ 11th/ 12th standard and are enrolled in coaching institutes with at least three years of experience can benefit from this scheme. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 20Rs./- per year per student or actual feeRs. whichever is lower.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a non-reserved category.
1. The applicant must have obtained 70% or more marks in Class 10th/ 11th/ 12th.
1. The applicant must be from Science stream.
1. The applicant must be pursuing coaching for JEERs. GUJCETRs. or NEET.
1. The coaching institute must have at least 3 years of experience.
1. The annual family income of the applicant should be 4Rs./- or less.

name: Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations
brief_description: The "Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations" scheme introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support students from the non-reserved category in preparing for competitive exams such as UPSCRs. GPSC (Class 1Rs. 2Rs. and 3)Rs. Subordinate Services Selection BoardRs. Panchayat Services Selection BoardRs. and recruitment exams for RailwaysRs. BanksRs. and other government institutions. The scheme is being implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 20Rs./- per student or the actual fee payableRs. whichever is less.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category. 1. The applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard. 1. The applicant must be undergoing training in a recognized/selected coaching institution for recruitment examinations conducted in UPSCRs. GPSC Class-1Rs. Class-2 and Class-3Rs. Subordinate Services Selection BoardRs. Panchayat Services Selection Board and Government of India RailwaysRs. Banks etc. 1. The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed 4Rs./-.

name: Uchch Shiksha Puraskar Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2012-13Rs. the scheme "Uchch Shiksha Puraskar Yojana" by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur aims to encourage and motivate talented students from weaver families to pursue higher education. The scheme provides financial incentives to students from weaver families who secure admission to professional courses in government colleges. It specifically targets students who are children of members of Primary Weaver Cooperative Societies affiliated with the State Handloom Union. The scheme is implemented by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur to create awareness and competitive spirit among children of weavers engaged in handloom weaving industry mostly established in rural areas.
benefits:
- A financial incentive of 20Rs./- is provided as an encouragement award to eligible students.
- The financial assistance is provided only for the first year of the course.
eligibility:

name: Arka Vertical Garden
brief_description: The scheme "Arka Vertical Garden" by the State Horticulture Mission-Kerala aims to popularize user-friendly vertical garden structures designed and developed by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) - Indian Institute of Horticultural ResearchRs. Bengalaru under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY). The scheme helps in attaining self-sufficiency in the production of safe-to-eat vegetables ensuring food and nutritional security for families. It is open to residents of Kerala State who can apply for a single unit of Arka Vertical Garden structure. The scheme is implemented by the State Horticulture Mission-Kerala.
benefits:
**Total Cost of One Unit of Arka Vertical Garden:** 22Rs./-.
**Subsidy Amount per Unit:** 15Rs./-.
**Beneficiary Contribution:** 6Rs./- per unit.
The beneficiaries are also provided with the following -

eligibility:

name: Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant
brief_description:
The Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant is a program initiated by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)Rs. under the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India. It aims to assist researchers to initiate their research career in a new institution with a flexible budget and progressive initiatives for ease of doing research.
**Objectives:**

- To empower and support the early career researchers in their pursuit of research excellenceRs. providing them with an enabling environment to effectively conduct research with ease and flexibility.
- To contribute in positioning the country as a global leader in science and technology as well as creating a vibrant research ecosystem.
- To produce research of the highest qualityRs. bringing in new skillsRs. breakthrough ideas and the zest to explore new frontiersRs. thereby expanding the boundaries of knowledge.
benefits:
***Nature & duration of support:***

- Research rant up to 60 lakh plus overheads for a period of three years.
- The measures for ease of doing research include flexibility to utilize resources under recurring head; flexibility in manpower recruitment; enhanced travelRs. contingency and overhead charges; and support for expenses related to open access publications and patent filing charges.
- International travel for project related activities is also permitted.
- Maximum of 700 grants would be awarded per year across all subject areas.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen.
1. Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) or Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) working as regular employees in any publicly funded and recognized R&D laboratories/institutions in India are eligible to apply as Principal Investigator (PI)Rs. in collaboration with an Indian Co-PIRs. provided they meet the eligibility criteria specified by ANRF (ANRF Funding Guidelines for PIO/OCI).
1. The applicant should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering or an MD/MS/MDS/MVSc degree.
1. The applicant should be in a regular academic/research position at a recognized academic institutionRs. national laboratoryRs. or any other recognized R&D institution.
1. The applicant is eligible to apply within two years of joining the institution.
1. The upper age limit is 42 yearsRs. with a relaxation of three years for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged and women candidates.
1. The applicant should not have received funding under YSSRs. ECRRs. SRGRs. CRG (erstwhile EMR)Rs. EMEQRs. or any other project grant from the erstwhile SERB or ANRF.

***Other conditions***

- An applicant is eligible to apply only one proposal during a call.
- Only a one-time career grant will be provided.
- Extension of the project tenure is not permitted under this programme.

***Termination and transfer of the project:***

1. If any Principal Investigator (PI) wishes to terminate the projectRs. they shall inform ANRF immediately with proper justifications. The implementing institute should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the project or the date of resignation of the PI. The institute must also arrange for the submission of relevant documents.
1. ANRF reserves the right to terminate the project at any stage if it is convinced that (i) appropriate progress is not being made (ii) the grant has not been utilized properly (iii) furnishing of false information or suppression of factual information.
1. Projects sanctioned under this programme cannot be transferred to any other person/s.
1. Transfer of approved/sanctioned PM ECRG project to another institution will be considered only in the following cases: (i) From private/public/government institution to any other public/government institution (ii) General administrative transfers in government or public funded institutions. Change of institute will not be considered in any other cases.

name: Scheme of Providing Assistance to Encourage Farmers for Adoption of Organic Farming
brief_description: The "Scheme of Providing Assistance to Encourage Farmers for Adoption of Organic Farming" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to encourage farmers to adopt organic farming by offering financial incentives for certificationRs. registrationRs. and input costs. GujaratRs. aims to provides financial assistance to farmers for constructing crop storage structures on their farms. brief_description: The scheme "Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age" was introduced by the Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Union Territory of LakshadweepRs. aims to provide monthly financial assistance to senior citizens in the UT. The scheme covers persons above 60 years of age who do not have any source of income. name: To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation
brief_description: The scheme "To Assist the Farmers for Construction of Community Base Water Tank/Storage Structure for Efficient Use of Water Through Drip Irrigation" introduced by the AgricultureRs. name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations - Goa
brief_description: The "Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. name: Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University

name: Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category

name: Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students
brief_description:
The "Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students" scheme under e-VidyaBharati Network ProjectRs. launched by the Ministry of External Affairs in October 2019Rs. aims to provide 1000 scholarships annually to Afghan students for pursuing various UGC-approved online Undergraduate and Postgraduate programs from Indian universities. ArtsRs. and more.

benefits:
The scholarship amount covers the entire degree programme fee including:

- Admission feesRs.
- Examination feesRs.
- E-content chargesRs.
- Other charges like registration feeRs. re-examinationRs. and award of degreeRs. etc.

- Students who have already obtained a degree under e-VB project (at the time of announcement of the new academic session) and willing to avail scholarship under e-VB project for pursuing another degreeRs. may also apply afresh through iLearn portal to process their application

name: Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement, after the Death of the Agitator
brief_description: The "Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State AgitatorsRs. Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement" scheme is implemented by the Police Department under the Department of HomeRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to the dependents (husband/wife) of such identified state agitators who do not fall under the category of agitators jailed for 7 days or injured during the movementRs. and who were neither receiving agitator pension or any other government pensionRs. nor employed in government service.
benefits: **Pension Amount:** 4Rs./- per month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be the dependent (husband/wife) of a deceased identified state agitator. 1. The deceased agitator must not fall under the category of those who went to jail for 7 days or were injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The deceased agitator must not have been receiving agitator pension or any other pension from a government sourceRs. nor employed in government service.

name: Tiatr Competition
brief_description: The "Tiatr Competition" is organised annually by the Kala Academy under the Department of Art and CultureRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage and promote the unique Goan theatre form of Tiatr. Participation in this scheme is open to Goan institutions registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860 (with renewed registration). Entries are invited through press notes in local dailies. The institutions fulfilling the schemes requirements and submitting entries within the stipulated date are allowed to stage their Tiatr performances as per the sequence finalised by Kala Academy.
benefits:
- Free auditorium with permissible infrastructure (extra facilities chargeable). - Hire charges paid for two vehicles for transportation of artistes and stage materials (as per Kala Academy norms). - 80% of gate collection from ticket sales is given to the participating institution. - Prizes awarded based on recommendations from a panel of judges.

name: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
brief_description: The "Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to promote value addition in agriculture by helping farmers invest in machinery and equipment. This initiative seeks to improve the profitability of farming by supporting post-harvest processing and mechanization.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 50% of the machinery cost or 10Rs./-Rs. whichever is less.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be involved in agriculture-related activities. 1. The applicant must intend to purchase machinery for value addition.

name: Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
brief_description:
The scheme "Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates" was launched by the Tribal Area Development DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saheria Project Area to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme. Under this schemeRs. monthly fellowships and contingency grants are provided to tribal research scholars enrolled in Ph.D. programmes at recognized universities across India. The scheme is implemented by the M.L. Verma Tribal Research & Training InstituteRs. Udaipur.
***Area's Cover:***
Banswara Rs. ChittorgarhRs. Dungarpur Rs. PaliRs. SirohiRs. UdaipurRs. BaranRs. RajsamandRs. Pratapgarh.
benefits:
***Financial Assistance:***

- The selected scholar shall be paid @ 15Rs./- per month.
- A contingency grant of 40Rs./- shall be given to the candidate for meeting the recurring expenditure viz. books/ Journals/Traveling/Stationery etc.

***Tenure:***
The tenure of the scholarship shall be for a period of maximum five years from the date of sanction from the Tribal Research Institute or completion of Ph.D. whichever is earlier.
***Extension of Fellowship Term & Final Payments:***
The scholarship term shall not be extended under any circumstances. IfRs. per chanceRs. the candidate fails to complete his/her Ph.D work within the period of five yearsRs. the final installment of scholarship (equivalent to six month and last installment of contingency) shall be withheld until the Ph.D. is awarded to the candidate.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Scheduled Area of Rajasthan or a resident of Shahbad and Kishanganj tehsils of Baran district (Saheria Project Area).
1. The applicant should have completed Post-graduation with at least 50% marks from a recognized university.
1. The applicant should be registered in a recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University in India for pursuing a Ph.D. programme.

name: Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme "Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana" was launched by the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support for the marriage of daughters of registered construction workers through organized group marriage events. The scheme is implemented by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Uttarakhand.
benefits: - 61Rs./- will be provided as financial assistance to registered construction workers for the marriage of their daughters. - 10Rs./- per couple will be paid to the organizer to cover expenses incurred in organizing the mass marriage. - 5Rs./- will be provided to each bride and groom for purchasing their wedding attire.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker. 1. In the case of a mass marriageRs. registration must be completed at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage.

name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students
brief_description: The scheme Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are studying in Sanskrit schools from Class 6 to Class 12 in Uttarakhand by providing financial scholarships to support their education.
benefits: **Scholarship Amount:** - Students from Class 6 to Class 12 will be provided 3Rs./- per yearRs. at the rate of 251/- per month.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in Uttarakhand. 1. The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. A total of 200 students studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The student must possess a valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority.

name: Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to invite scholars from any state in India to submit research manuscripts on Sanskrit literatureRs. as well as socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand.
benefits: For the research paperRs. the author receives an honorarium of 151/- per pageRs. and 25 copies of the published book are provided free of cost.
eligibility: 1. Authentic and socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand are invited for publication. 1. Scholars from any state of the country (who write research papers within the scope of research methodology) will be eligible.
