name: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Boy Students
brief_description:
The 'Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Boy Students' schemeRs. administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. provides financial assistance to deserving boy students from Scheduled Castes (SC). Eligibility is extended to those who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSSLC examination. The scheme's objective is to motivate and encourage SC boy students to pursue higher educationRs. thereby fostering their academic parity with the broader population through a substantial incentive. Assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation. An incentive of 5Rs./- will be disbursed to students as approved by the Selection Committee.
**The applications will be accepted through the myScheme platform from 04/07/2025 to 31/10/2025.** ***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
benefits: A financial incentive of 5Rs./- will be provided.
eligibility: - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must be male. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed 5Rs./-. _*In instances where multiple applicants achieve an identical percentage in the HSSLC examinationRs. preference will be given to those with a higher percentage in the HSLC examination._

name: Financial Assistance to OBC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC
brief_description:
The 'Financial Assistance to OBC students appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC' schemeRs. administered by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward ClassesRs. Government of AssamRs. is designed to provide financial grants to Other Backward Classes (OBC) students who qualify for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Mains Examination. Each eligible beneficiary will receive an amount of up to 50Rs./-Rs. subject to budgetary provisions. The disbursement of assistance is contingent upon the applicant satisfying the stipulated eligibility criteria and the successful submission of required documentation.
***A DigiLocker account is required for application. Please refer to the Application Process section for details.***
benefits: An amount of up to 50Rs./- will be provided to each beneficiaryRs. subject to budget provision.
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to a Other Backward Class (OBC) community of Assam.


- The applicant must have recently qualified for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Preliminary Examination held in 2025.
- The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed 5Rs./-.

name: Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Kavi Sammelan
brief_description: The scheme Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Kavi Sammelan is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to promote and popularize the Sanskrit language and literature by encouraging poets who compose and recite poetry in Sanskrit.
benefits: An honorarium of 2501/- is given to each invited poet.
eligibility: 1. The fifteen Sanskrit poets from Uttarakhand and other statesRs. who compose and recite poetry in SanskritRs. are invited.

name: Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita
brief_description: The scheme Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity for personnel from various government departments of the state to participate annually in the All-India level competitions in various sportsRs. organized by the Ministry of PersonnelRs. Public Grievances and PensionsRs. Government of India.
benefits: There is a provision to provide travel allowanceRs. accommodation allowanceRs. food allowanceRs. sports kitsRs. and other necessary support to all players and team members participating in the 'Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita'Rs. in accordance with departmental standards.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an employee of a government department in Uttarakhand.

name: Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP)
brief_description: The scheme "Harit Kaushal Vikas Karyakram" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE)Rs. aims to promote sustainable and eco-friendly livelihoods through nature-based skill development. Through this schemeRs. free skill training is provided to farmersRs. studentsRs. and youth to support self-employment and prepare them for government-backed programs as master trainers. It covers subjects like ornithologyRs. wildlife conservationRs. natural interpretationRs. and biodiversity communication. The program is aligned with the Green Skill Development Program (GSDP) and is accessible through online applications via the official portal.
benefits: - **Skill Development Training:** Free-of-cost training in environment-related fields such as bird identificationRs. wildlife conservationRs. biodiversity interpretationRs. and eco-tourism education. - **Self-Employment Opportunities:** Empowers youth and farmers to pursue independent livelihood avenues through knowledge-based interventions. - **Government Scheme Readiness:** Makes candidates eligible for roles under various central/state schemes and government-supported training projects.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should have completed at least 10th standard.
- The applicant should be a farmer/ youth or individual seeking self-employment.
- The applicant should be below 55 years of age at the time of application.
- The applicant should have an interest in environmental and ecological training topics such as wildlifeRs. biodiversityRs. or natural resource interpretation.

name: Skill Development
brief_description: The scheme "Skill Development" implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology aims to enhance the practical knowledge and research capabilities of students pursuing Earth Science and allied subjects. Through this schemeRs. specialised summer and winter training programmes are offered to postgraduate and integrated postgraduate students in disciplines such as geochemistryRs. sedimentologyRs. tectonicsRs. geomorphologyRs. environmental geoscienceRs. and paleontology.
benefits: - **Research Experience:** Provides opportunities for self-sponsored research workRs. allowing students to gain practical experience in Earth Sciences. - **Seasonal Training:** Offers valuable summer and winter training programsRs. enhancing practical skills and knowledge in specialized geological disciplines. - **Exposure to Diverse Fields:** Exposes students to a wide array of sub-disciplines within Earth SciencesRs. such as structural geologyRs. geochemistryRs. glaciologyRs. engineering geologyRs. palaeontologyRs. and environmental geology.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must possess a postgraduate degree in any discipline of GeosciencesRs. Earth SciencesRs. or allied fields.
1. The applicant may also be pursuing an integrated postgraduate degree course and should be in the fourth or fifth year of the curriculum.
1. The applicant must be from fields such as geophysicsRs. geochemistryRs. structural geologyRs. sedimentologyRs. paleontologyRs. environmental geoscienceRs. and related disciplines.

name: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. both vehicle items (ordinary busRs. taxiRs. maxRs. electric bus) and non-vehicle items (hotel/paying guest schemeRs. construction of motor garage/workshopRs. establishment of fast food centresRs. establishment of Sadhna Kutir Yoga Meditation centresRs. adventure activitiesRs. establishment of modern tourist information centres with P.C.O. facilityRs. development of tented residential facilitiesRs. establishment of sales centres for local handicrafts and symbolic itemsRs. establishment of bakeryRs. establishment of laundryRs. purchase of equipment for terrain bikesRs. star gazing and bird watching for tourismRs. herbal tourismRs. purchase and operation of kayaking/boatsRs. caravan/motor home tourismRs. purchase of angling equipmentRs. construction of museums containing memorabilia and establishment of memorabilia/souvenir centresRs. construction of floating hotelsRs. and establishment of centres for providing trekking equipmentRs. suitsRs. jacketsRs. etc. on rent) are included. Apart from the aboveRs. applicants can also submit any innovative project based on the attractions and characteristics of their particular area. **The following grants/subsidies are provided under the scheme:** (a) **Non-vehicle items:** A grant of up to 33% of the project costRs. with a maximum of 33.00 lakh in hilly areasRs. and up to 25% of the project costRs. with a maximum of 25.00 lakh in plain areas. (b) **Vehicle items:** A grant of up to 25% of the project costRs. with a maximum of 10.00 lakh in both hilly and plain areas. For specific buses/electric busespushback 30 and 42 seater (2*2)Rs. pushback 2628 seaterRs. and 42 seater (2*2) electric/air-conditioned busesa grant of 50% of the project costRs. up to a maximum of 20.00 lakhRs. is provided. This provision applies only to buses/electric buses meeting the prescribed criteriaRs. with a maximum of 50 buses/electric buses eligible per financial year. ***To avail the subsidy under the schemeRs. the applicant must contribute 12.5% of the total project cost as Margin Money.***
eligibility: 1. To avail the benefits of this schemeRs. the applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. If land is required for implementing the schemeRs. the applicant must either be the owner of the land orRs. if the land is in the name of a close relativeRs. the mortgage of the land will be acceptable as priority security. If the landowner becomes a partner with the applicant as a co-borrower or guarantorRs. the grant amount will be payable only to the applicant. 1. The applicant can also avail the benefits of the scheme on leased landRs. provided the lease period exceeds the loan repayment period and the applicant is not a defaulter of any bank or financial institution. 1. Definition of Unemployed - an unemployed person is one who is not currently engaged in any businessRs. enterpriseRs. or profession.

name: Student Program Under AcSIR
brief_description: The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR)Rs. Government of India aims to promote high-quality interdisciplinary research by enrolling eligible postgraduate candidates into PhD programmes. Through this schemeRs. students receive fellowshipsRs. trainingRs. and research opportunities in Earth SciencesRs. with the broader goal of preparing future leaders in the geoscience domain of the Himalayas.
benefits: - **Advanced Research Opportunities:** The program provides opportunities for conducting high-qualityRs. interdisciplinary research in various fields of Himalayan Geo-science. - **Leadership Development:** The scheme aims to develop leaders in the field of Himalayan Geo-science through the PhD program. - **Career Advancement:** Successful completion of the PhD program leads to a postgraduate degreeRs. enhancing career prospects in the field.
eligibility:
- The applicant must have a postgraduate degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) in any discipline of Earth Sciences.
- The applicant must hold a valid national-level fellowship such as:


1. NET-JRF (UGC/CSIR).
1. INSPIRE Fellowship.
1. Any other equivalent national fellowship.

name: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
brief_description: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" implemented by the Renewable Energy DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to promote renewable energy usage and reduce dependence on conventional heating methods by providing financial subsidies to encourage the installation of solar water heating systems in the domestic sector. It also seeks to reduce electricity and fuel bills and promote environmentally sustainable solutions for households.
benefits: - **Subsidy :** 10Rs./- per 100 LPD (Maximum 30Rs./-) for FPC system and 3Rs./- per 100 LPD (Maximum 9Rs./-) is being provided.
eligibility: 1. Any resident family of Haryana. 1. Government employees of Haryana residing in Chandigarh.

name: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.
benefits: - A research scholarship of 40Rs./- per year is awarded to 20 students registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at universities across Uttarakhand. - The scholarship is provided for a period of three years at 40Rs./- per year and must be renewed by submitting an application each year/semester.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at any university in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the GeneralRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. and Economically Weaker Section. 1. A total of 20 research scholars are eligible for the scholarshipRs. including 10 from the General categoryRs. 5 from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled TribesRs. and 5 from Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate holders. 1. Selection will be based on the highest marks obtained in the NET examination.

name: Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief_description: The scheme Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote inclusive education by financially supporting students from economically weaker sections pursuing technical and vocational education after SSC. The initiative offers a stipend of 400 per month to aid the academic progress and reduce the dropout rate among underprivileged youth. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It specifically benefits those enrolled in professional or Government ITI courses and belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding 6Rs./-.
benefits: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of 400/- is given to Minority Caste students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Minority Caste. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicants individual and family income should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.

name: Braille Equipment Provision
brief_description: The "Braille Equipment Provision" scheme aims to facilitate the independent functioning of visually impaired individuals by providing them with Braille equipment for writingRs. computingRs. entertainmentRs. and mobility. Through this schemeRs. Braille devices are manufactured and distributed at subsidized rates to persons with visual disabilities and institutions like special schools. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual DisabilitiesRs. DehradunRs.
benefits: - **Subsidized Access of Braille Appliances:** Makes Braille equipment affordable by providing it at subsidized rates to visually impaired personsRs. special schoolsRs. and institutions.
eligibility: - A person with visual impairment/ a Special School/ Organisation serving visually impaired persons shall be eligible under this scheme.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacityRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Eligible beneficiaries must undertake to keep the unit operationalRs. cover maintenance and post-construction costsRs. and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
benefits:
- The project cost is 40Rs./-

> **Subsidy Distribution :**


1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR agreeing to bear all operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction costs.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice plant/cold storage remains continuously operational.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
1. The applicant must either own the land or have it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years.
1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on actual costsRs. within the overall ceiling limits specified under PMMSY sub-components.
1. The applicant must understand thatRs. upon approvalRs. the subsidy will be disbursed as per the procedure laid out under PMMSY.

name: Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna
brief_description: The scheme "Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna" by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to senior citizens for pilgrimage travel. The scheme covers travel expenses through authorized agents and ensures comfortable pilgrimage arrangements. To be eligibleRs. the applicant must be a senior citizen of Gujarat and registered under the scheme through an authorized travel agent or organizer. The scheme is implemented by the Government of GujaratRs. and applications are accepted offline.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance for Pilgrimage Travel Expenses**

- Upto 5Rs./- per person for travel by State Transport (ST) buses.
- Upto 7Rs./- per person for travel by Private Buses.

_*The financial assistance provided is subject to actual travel cost or the above-mentioned amountRs. whichever is lower._
_*Only group travel is allowed (minimum 20 pilgrims required)._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a senior citizen aged 60 years or above.
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must not have availed of the benefit previously under this scheme.
- The applicant must be physically fit to undertake the journey.
- The pilgrimage must be booked through an authorized travel agent/organizer.

name: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
brief_description: The "Insulated Vehicle" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote efficient and hygienic fish transportation systems. Under this schemeRs. a financial grant is provided to the beneficiaries for purchasing insulated (reefer) vehicles used in fish transportation. It seeks to minimize post-harvest lossesRs. improve fish value chainsRs. and enhance earnings of fish farmers by enabling cold-chain logistics.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** - Financial grant of up to 20Rs./- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. **Grant Limits:** - 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. > **Note** - Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. - Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. - The applicant should agree that any losses in procurementRs. operationRs. or maintenance are their own responsibilityRs. and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 20-ton capacityRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide the subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage unitsRs. supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR agreeing to keep the unit operationalRs. cover all post-construction costsRs. and supply ice to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
benefits:
- The project cost is 80Rs./-

> **Subsidy Distribution :**


1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR to bear all operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction management costsRs. and to ensure the continuous functioning of the ice plant/cold storage.
1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided as per the actual costRs. subject to the ceiling limits under relevant PMMSY sub-components.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price.
1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible.

name: Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
brief_description: Launched on 7th September 2015Rs. the scheme "Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana" by the Commissioner of Cottage and Rural IndustriesRs. Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote rural entrepreneurship by providing financial assistance (margin money subsidy) for setting up new village industries in areas with 24x3-phase electricity supply. The scheme targets individual artisansRs. entrepreneursRs. and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with project costs ranging from 1Rs./- to 25Rs./-. It offers 2530% margin money subsidy (higher for SC/ST/women/PH candidates) to incentivize production-oriented ventures. Applications are submitted offline through District Industries Centres (DICs)Rs. and subsidies are disbursed after a 2-year successful project run.
benefits:
> **Margin Money Subsidy** **For General Category** - 25% for projects up to 10Rs./-. - 25% on first 10Rs./- + 10% on remaining cost (up to 25Rs./-). **For SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped** - 30% for projects up to 10Rs./-. - 30% on first 10Rs./- + 10% on remaining cost (up to 25Rs./-).
> **Project Cost Coverage** - Includes machineryRs. raw materialsRs. and working capital (max 10% of total cost). - Excludes land/building expenses. > **Disbursement** The subsidy is credited to the beneficiarys account after 2 years of successful operation (upon verification by DIC).
eligibility:
- The applicant must be aged between 25 to 50 years.
- The applicant must have passed at least Class 10 from a recognized educational board.
- The applicant must possess at least one year of experience in the proposed business activity or relevant training from a recognized institution.
- The applicant must be either an individual artisan/entrepreneur or part of a Grade-II active Self Help Group engaged in small-scale production. The applicant's proposed project must be located in a rural area with a population not exceeding 20Rs..
- The applicant must not represent a partnership firmRs. private limited companyRs. joint ventureRs. HUFRs. or similar commercial entity.
- For SC/STRs. womenRs. and physically handicapped applicantsRs. additional benefits are provided as specified in the benefits section.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief_description: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity Rs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tonsRs. supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY. The aim is to reduce post-harvest losses and improve fish quality. This is a Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. funded in the ratio of: 50% by the Central GovernmentRs. and 50% by the State Government. The beneficiary must operate and maintain the plant and ensure supply of ice to fishers at affordable prices.
benefits:
- The project cost is 150Rs./-

**** **Subsidy Distribution:**

1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
1. A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking within the DPR/SCPRs. accepting full responsibility for operating and maintaining the unit.
1. The applicant must provide ice at affordable prices to fishers.
1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines.
1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in ice plant or cold storage operation and maintenance.
1. The applicant must ensure the land is free from legal issues and must provide a valid land title.

name: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
brief_description: The "Large Fish Feed Mill with Production Capacity of 20 Ton/Per Day" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of India under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. it aims to strengthen post-harvest infrastructure and enhance fish feed production to support sustainable aquaculture. Under this schemeRs. a grant is provided to beneficiaries for setting up a large fish feed millRs. with 40% subsidy for general category and 60% for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries.
benefits: **Monetary Assistance:** - Grant of 20Rs./- per unit for establishing a fish feed mill with 20-ton/day capacity. **Subsidy Provisions:** - 40% subsidy on unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% subsidy on unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The Beneficiaries will submit an undertaking in the DPR to the effect that all operationalRs. maintenance and post construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them and the Fish Feed Plant will be kept in operational condition. 1. Central assistance for Fish Feed Mill will be as per actual cost within the overall ceiling indicated in the respective sub-components/activities under PMMSY. 1. The Beneficiary will ensure supply of feed produced from the government assisted Fish Feed Plant to the fishers and fish farmers at affordable price. 1. The projects having land on long term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. HoweverRs. the registered lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day
brief_description: The Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. aims to promote fish feed self-sufficiency and affordability among fish farmers. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for setting up medium-sized fish feed mills with a production capacity of 8 tons per dayRs. benefiting entrepreneurs and fish farmers.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits:** - Financial assistance for setting up a fish feed mill of 8 tons/day capacity. - Unit cost is 1Rs./- per unit. - 40% subsidy of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries (up to 40Rs./-). - 60% subsidy of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries (up to 60Rs./-).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should ensure that the medium fish feed mill is in working condition. 1. The applicant should ensure the feed produced from the unit is supplied at affordable price to fishers and farmers. 1. The fish feed mill should be on land owned by the applicant or on a long-term registered lease (minimum of 10 years).

name: Gaurav Puraskar Award
brief_description: The scheme "Gaurav Puraskar Award" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and encourage individuals who have demonstrated excellence in the fields of musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. and folk art through a combination of financial and honorary benefits. The scheme confers a cash award of 1Rs./-Rs. a trophyRs. and a letter of appreciation to 12 deserving artistes every year. It also facilitates opportunities for awardees to contribute to state-sponsored cultural events and festivals in various expert capacities. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Sangeet Natak Academy.
benefits: > **Cash Prize:** - Each awardee receives a cash prize of 1Rs./-. > **Honorary Recognition:** - Awardees are presented with a trophy and a letter of appreciation. > **Post-Award Engagement:** - Awardees may be included as members in committees of the Academy. - Awardees can offer their services as adjudicators or experts in state cultural programs such as Rajya-level Navratri festivalsRs. KalamahakumbhRs. and other events.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have made a significant contribution or demonstrated excellence in the fields of musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. or folk art.

name: New Swarnima Yojana for Women (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "New Swarnima Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote economic upliftment of women from Thakor and Koli communities living below poverty line by supporting them in self-employment ventures. Under this schemeRs. 100% financial assistance up to 1Rs./- is provided to eligible women for starting a business or trade of their choice.
benefits: - **Loan Amount:** Up to 1Rs. for eligible business/trade activities.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum.- **Loan Coverage:** 100% of the approved project/business cost.- **Repayment Term:** 60 equal monthly installments (5 years)Rs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicant should be between 21 and 50 years of age on the date of application. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The woman applicant should have experience related to the proposed business/trade. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total credit is reserved for applicants from families with income up to 1Rs./- annually.

name: Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Micro Finance Scheme" is implemented by the Gujarat Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Development Corporation (GNDTDC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among individuals from the Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities by providing financial assistance to start a small-scale business/enterprise. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries can avail loans at concessional interest rates to purchase equipmentRs. raw materialsRs. or working capital.
benefits: **Loan Amount Details:** - **Loan Amount:** Up to 1Rs./-.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum. - **Loan Contribution:** 90% will be from the National CorporationRs. 5% from the State GovernmentRs. 5% from the beneficiary.- **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installmentsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant should have experience & technical skill in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount under this scheme will be specifically allocated to families with an annual income of up to 1Rs./-.

name: Swayam Saksham Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
brief_description: The scheme "Swayam Saksham Scheme" by the Social Justice & Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to instill a sense of self-reliance among the youth pursuing vocational education/training. For Doctor (Clinic)Rs. Physiotherapy ClinicRs. Biomedical LaboratoryRs. Lawyer OfficeRs. Engineering UnitRs. Chemist ShopRs. Architect OfficeRs. Chartered AccountantRs. Financial Consulting Level OfficeRs. etc. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam.
benefits:
1. The scheme provides 95% of the loan amount to eligible youthRs. up to a maximum limit of 5Rs./-. 1. The loan carries an interest rate of 6% per annum.
> **Note:** Beneficiaries are required to contribute 5% of the project cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backward classes. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 35 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
brief_description: The scheme "Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide Microfinance for individual women entrepreneurs to create self-employment for women and make them self-reliant. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided on an individual basis to women beneficiaries to start a business of their choice. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam.
benefits: 1. The scheme provides 100% of the loan amount to eligible women beneficiariesRs. up to a maximum limit of 1Rs./-. 1. The loan carries an interest rate of 4% per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
brief_description: The Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. aims to strengthen inland aquaculture infrastructure by promoting the establishment of small-scale fish feed mills. Under this schemeRs. financial assistanceRs. in form of subsidyRs. is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed millsRs. ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.
benefits: **Tangible Benefits:** - Project Cost: 30Rs./- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant/beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. All operationalRs. maintenanceRs. and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by the beneficiary. 1. The beneficiary should ensure that the Fish Feed Mill remains in functional condition. 1. The beneficiary should supply the feed produced from the government-assisted Fish Feed Mill/Plant to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant should either own the land or have it on a registered lease agreement valid for a minimum of 10 years.

name: Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women
brief_description: The scheme "Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority WidowsRs. Divorcees / Abandoned Women" was introduced by the State Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Kerala. The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Through this schemeRs. government financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widowsRs. divorced womenRs. and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the Kerala State Minority Development Finance Corporation.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of up to 1Rs./- as a government subsidy. - Maximum loan amount of 5Rs./-. - The interest rate on the loan amount (excluding subsidy) is 6%.
> **Conditions/Criteria Associated with Benefits:** A 20% subsidy (maximum 1Rs./-) is provided on the loan amount. - For a loan amount of 1Rs./-Rs. the subsidy is 20Rs./-. - For a loan amount of 2Rs./-Rs. the subsidy is 40Rs./-. - For a loan amount of 3Rs./-Rs. the subsidy is 60Rs./-. - For a loan amount of 4Rs./-Rs. the subsidy is 80Rs.. - For a loan amount of 5Rs./-Rs. the subsidy is 1Rs./-. _*At each stage of disbursementRs. photos and bills must be submitted._ _*Direct inspection will be conducted at each stage of disbursement._ _*An additional interest of 6% will be charged for misuse of funds._
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. SikhRs. ParsiRs. Jain). - The applicant should be a widowRs. divorced womanRs. or abandoned woman. - The applicant's age should be between 20 and 60 years. - The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed 2Rs./-. > **Preference/Priority** - Priority will be given to mothers of children below 18 years of age. - Priority will be given to widows from families identified through the extreme poverty identification survey.

name: Mother Teresa Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Mother Teresa Scholarship (MTS)" by the Department of Minority WelfareRs. Government of KeralaRs. aims to support the higher education of students belonging to minority communities. Through this schemeRs. an amount per annum is provided to students from minority religious communities domiciled in Kerala who are pursuing a diploma in nursing and paramedical courses from governmentRs. government-aidedRs. and government-recognised private institutions. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Minority WelfareRs. Kerala.
benefits: - The selected candidates will receive a scholarship of 15Rs./- per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be domiciled in Kerala. 1. The applicant must belong to the MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. ParsiRs. or Jain communities. 1. The applicant must have received seats in nursing or paramedical courses on a merit basis (including in GovernmentRs. Aided colleges and merit quota in Self-financing colleges). 1. The applicant must have secured 45% marks or more in the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant must have an annual family income less than 8Rs./- from all sources if belonging to the Above Poverty Line (APL) category. 1. For students belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) categoryRs. there is no income criteria.

name: CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship" by the Kerala State Minority Welfare Department aims to provide scholarships to students from minority religious communities studying Chartered Accounts/Cost & Management Accounts/Company Secretaryship courses. Through this schemeRs. a scholarship amount is provided to eligible students. The scheme is implemented by the Kerala State Minority Welfare Department.
benefits: 1. The scholarship amount of 15Rs./- is provided. 1. The scholarship is provided to students from minority religious communities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala. 1. The applicant must belong to MuslimRs. ChristianRs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. ParsiRs. or Jain religious communities. 1. The applicant's annual family income should be below 8Rs./-. 1. The applicant must be appearing for intermediate or final year examinations of Chartered AccountsRs. Cost & Management AccountsRs. or Company Secretaryship courses. 1. The applicant must have secured 60% marks in Plus Two/B.Com or other degrees. 1. The applicant should have an account in any nationalised bank in their own name.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - Preference will be given to applicants belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. - In the absence of BPL applicantsRs. applicants from minority religious communities with an annual income up to 8Rs./- in the Above Poverty Line (APL) category will be considered. - Selection will be based on merit and income.

name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
brief_description: The Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance is a scheme component under the Intensive Fisheries Development ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing the financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage. Under this schemeRs. a 50% subsidy is provided on the insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insuranceRs. helping them mitigate potential crop losses.
benefits: - 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a farmer and involved in shrimp farming. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.

name: Education Loan Scheme: Haryana Women Development Corporation
brief_description: The scheme "Education Loan Scheme" by the Haryana Women Development CorporationRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to encourage women and girls from Haryana to pursue higher education at graduateRs. postgraduateRs. doctoralRs. and post-doctoral levelsRs. both within the country and abroadRs. while reducing the interest burden on students and guardians. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance and a 5% interest subsidy per annum are provided to female students. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation. > **Objectives:** 1. To encourage women/girls belong to Haryana State to pursue higher education at Graduate/Post Graduate/Doctoral/Post Doctoral level in the country and abroad. 1. To reduce the interest burden on the student / Guardian.
benefits: 1. **Financial Assistance:** Provided to female students under a Bank tie-up Education Scheme.1. **Interest Subsidy:** The Corporation will provide an interest subsidy of 5% per annum to the banks.1. **Reduced Interest Burden:** The scheme aims to reduce the interest burden on the student/guardian.1. **Specific Interest Subsidy Condition:** The Haryana Women Development Corporation (HWDC) will pay up to 5% interest subsidy on Education Loans to those female students who have availed the Education Loan from SBI Group and whose parents are employees of these banks and are being provided Education Loan at a lesser interest rate than the rate of interest for the general public. HenceRs. only the difference in interest of the subsidy will be paid by HWDC.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a Haryana domicile girl. 1. The applicant can be a child of a Haryana Government employee. 1. The applicant can pursue higher educationRs. professional/technical diploma/graduate/postgraduateRs. doctoral/post-doctoral level in the country and abroad. 1. There are no preconditions for income. 1. There are no preconditions of caste. 1. There are no preconditions for religion. 1. The scheme is applicable for studies in India and abroad.

name: Assistance for Exhibitions Abroad and Out of State
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Exhibitions Abroad and Out of State" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to encourage and promote artists originally from Gujarat in the field of fine artssuch as paintingRs. sculptureRs. graphic artsRs. and photographyby offering financial assistance to organize exhibitions abroad and outside the state. The scheme ensures support for artists with a record of conducting prior solo or group exhibitionsRs. helping them to gain national and international exposure through structured financial aid. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Fine Arts Academy.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 1Rs./- for organizing exhibitions abroad. ParticularsMaximum Allowable AmountGallery rent and decoration15Rs./-Transportation of artworks10Rs./-Publication of catalogues or printed materials related to the exhibition25Rs./-FramingRs. mountingRs. and display preparation of artworks20Rs./-Inaugural ceremonyRs. publicityRs. and advertisement costs15Rs./-Artists accommodationRs. travelRs. foodRs. local transportRs. and miscellaneous15Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an artist originally from Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have organized either: - Individual Artists: Artists practicing in fields of visual arts (paintingRs. sculptureRs. printmakingRs. etc.) who wish to participate in or organize exhibitions outside Gujarat or internationally. - Registered Art Organizations or Groups: Art societiesRs. academiesRs. educational institutionsRs. or cultural organizations that promote visual arts and are organizing such exhibitions. 1. Applicants must exhibit a minimum of 30 original artworks at the exhibition for which financial assistance is being sought 1. The exhibition must be: - Outside the State (interstate exhibitions)Rs. or - Outside the Country (international exhibitions abroad)Rs. and - Must be art-relatedRs. such as showcasing paintingsRs. sculpturesRs. mixed mediaRs. or visual art forms.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Large RAS Culture System Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with the component of the Establishment of Large RAS (with 8 tanks of minimum 90 m3/ tank capacity 40 tonnes/ crop) Culture SystemRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for various inland fisheries activitiesRs. including the establishment of large Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
Assistance is provided for the establishment of a Large Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) with 8 tanks of a minimum 90 m3/tank capacityRs. targeting 40 tonnes/crop production. - The unit cost for this component is 50Rs./- per unit. - For the General CategoryRs. the scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. - For WomenRs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribes (ST) categoriesRs. the scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 60% of the actual costRs. whichever is less.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** 60% of the government contribution is from the Government of IndiaRs. and 40% is from the State Government. > **Frequency of Disbursement**: The minimum time limit for reclaiming benefits is specified as "Once in a lifetime".
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Medium RAS Culture System Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland)" with a component Establishment of Medium RAS (with 6 tanks of minimum 30m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) Culture SystemRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to individuals and entities for the establishment of Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) based medium-scale fish tanks using limited land and water resources. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
The scheme provides assistance for the establishment of a Medium Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) with 6 tanks of a minimum 30m3/tank capacity (10t/crop). > **Financial Assistance:** - The unit cost for this component is 25Rs./- per unit. - General Category: 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. is paid as subsidy. - Female/Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) Category: 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. is paid as subsidy.
> **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit for the establishment of a Medium RAS (with 6 tanks of minimum 30m3/tank capacity 10t/crop) culture system (PMMSY) can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Back-Yard Mini RAS Unit Gujarat

Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by promoting inland fisheries and creating employment opportunities through rearing fish in reservoirs. benefits:

eligibility:

The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Sub mission on Seeds and Planting Material
brief_description:
The scheme "Sub-mission on Seeds and Planting Material" by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to achieve several key objectives. Through this schemeRs. assistance for seed distributionRs. strengthening of seed quality control laboratoriesRs. and creation of seed infrastructure facilities are provided to all categories of farmersRs. State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)Rs. Farmers' Producer Organisations (FPOs)Rs. Co-operative enterprisesRs. and Government enterprises.
> **Objective of Scheme:** - Increasing production of certified/quality seed - Strengthening Seed Testing Laboratories - Assisting Seed Producing Institutes for the adoption of new technologiesRs. ensuring farmers get quality seeds at the right time and at reasonable prices - Development of infrastructure for seed industries - Improving seed quality - Enhancing capacity building for seed production - Creation of a Seed Bank for adverse natural calamities
benefits: > **Seed Village Programme:** - Assistance will be provided for the distribution of foundation and certified seed required for a 1-acre area for cereal crops; the assistance covers 50% of the costRs. and for pulseRs. oilseedsRs. green manure & fodder cropsRs. the assistance covers 60% of the cost. - Validity: The maximum time limit for reclaiming benefits is 2 years. > **Strengthening of Seed Quality Control Laboratories:** - Assistance is provided on a project basis. - Intended Use: For State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)Rs. Farmers' Producer Organisations (FPOs)Rs. Co-operative enterprisesRs. and Government enterprises. - Frequency of Disbursement: One time. > **Creation of Seed Infrastructure Facility (SPP):** - Assistance is provided on a project basis.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: all categories of farmersRs. State Agricultural Universities (SAUs)Rs. Farmers' Producer Organisations (FPOs)Rs. Co-operative enterprisesRs. or Government enterprises. 1. The applicant must attach land records along with the application form. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account.

name: Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)
brief_description: The scheme "Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to ensure the holistic development of horticulture by providing financial assistance and technical support to farmers for the cultivation of fruitsRs. vegetablesRs. spicesRs. flowersRs. and other horticultural cropsRs. along with promoting modern technologiesRs. post-harvest managementRs. and value addition. The scheme promotes cluster plantingRs. renovation of old gardensRs. use of advanced technologies such as protected cultivationRs. integrated pest and nutrient managementRs. and horticultural mechanization to enhance production and sustainability in alignment with regional agro-climatic conditions.
benefits: - **Crop Development and Production:** Support programs are provided for planting and increasing the production of diverse horticultural cropsRs. including fruitsRs. vegetablesRs. pepperRs. spicesRs. and flower cropsRs. tailored to different regions and agro-climates within the state. - **Technological Promotion:** The scheme promotes and extends the use of modern technology in horticulture. - **Propagation Support:** Support programs are available for grafting and stem raisingRs. contributing to better crop propagation. - **Post-Harvest Management and Value Addition:** Assistance is provided for post-harvest management processes and value addition initiativesRs. ensuring better returns for produce. - **Market System Development:** Financial assistance is extended to individuals and the private sector for the development of collection and market systemsRs. aiming for comprehensive growth in horticulture. - **Specific Component Inclusion:** The scheme primarily includes components such as- Cluster planting of new fruitRs. flowerRs. vegetableRs. aromaticRs. and spice crops; Renovation of old gardens; Horticultural mechanization; Integrated fertilizer pest control management; Protected cultivation for horticultural crops; Mulching and the use of bird netsRs. etc.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should intend to cultivate horticultural crops or undertake related activities.

name: Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles in the transport sector to promote self-employment among the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). Through this schemeRs. a loan is provided to unemployed individuals for purchasing vehicles like auto-rickshawsRs. loading vehiclesRs. etc. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backward Classes Development Corporation (GBCDC).
benefits: 1. The applicant can avail a loan of up to 2Rs./- for purchasing vehicles such as auto-rickshawsRs. loading vehiclesRs. and other transport vehicles.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) category. 1. The applicant can be of any gender. 1. The applicant should be unemployed. 1. The applicant should have any level of education. 1. The applicant should have an individual and family annual income up to 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should hold a valid Driving Licence for the type of vehicle intended for purchase (specifically for passenger vehicles).

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY Inland)" with the component of Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture (Including Composite Fish CultureRs. ScampiRs. PagasiusRs. Tilapia) introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits: 1. The unit cost of the project for Inputs for Freshwater Aquaculture (Including Composite Fish CultureRs. ScampiRs. PangasiusRs. and Tilapia) is 4Rs./-. 1. Beneficiaries in the general category receive 40% of the unit cost as assistance. 1. WomenRs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribe (ST) beneficiaries receive 60% of the unit cost as assistance. 1. The subsidy is jointly funded: 60% by the Government of India and 40% by the Government of Gujarat. > **Mode of Disbursement:** Assistance is paid with a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Governments (specificallyRs. the Government of Gujarat as mentioned in the provided text). > **Validity:** A minimum time limit of 1 year is set for reclaiming benefits.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Economically Backward Class
brief_description: The "Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Economically Backward Class" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to school-going students from economically backward sections to reduce the dropout rate and promote education from class 1st to 10th. Under this schemeRs. monetary scholarships are provided to boys and girls studying in government and aided primary schools from Standard 1st to 10thRs. based on class and gender.
benefits: > **Scholarship Amounts:** - Boys (Std. 1st to 8th): 750/- per annum.- Boys (Std. 9th to 10th): 1Rs./- per annum.- Girls (Std. 1st to 5th): 500/- per annum.- Girls (Std. 6th to 10th): 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or aided primary/secondary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to an Economically Backward Class (EBC). 1. The applicant must be studying in classes 1st to 10th.1. There is no income limit for students of classes 1st to 10th.1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./- for classes 9th to 10th.

name: Rock Climbing Adventure Training Course
brief_description: The scheme "Rock Climbing Adventure Training Course" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to develop a spirit of adventureRs. encourage physical enduranceRs. and boost confidence and discipline among children belonging to Scheduled Tribes through a structured training program. The scheme provides selected students with an opportunity to participate in a 6-day residential rock climbing adventure course conducted at either Mount Abu or Junagadh. It focuses on holistic development by engaging youth in outdoor sports activitiesRs. thereby fostering physical and mental growth.
benefits: - **Training:** A 6-day rock climbing adventure course for 100 children aged 9 to 12 yearsRs. conducted at Mount Abu or Junagadh Center.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be between 9 and 12 years. - The applicant must be physically fit.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: 100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidiesRs. etcRs.. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to assist Adivasi and Scheduled Tribe farmers in tribal and non-tribal areas to achieve higher agricultural production and improve their livelihoods. Through this schemeRs. subsidies are provided on items such as seeds of more productive/hybrid varietiesRs. fertilizersRs. plant protection equipmentRs. tarpaulinsRs. micronutrientsRs. water carrying pipelinesRs. and pump sets.
benefits:
> **100% Soluble Chemical Fertilizer/Nano Fertilizer:** - 100% soluble chemical fertilizers/nano-fertilizers of FCO-approved grade subject to 75% of the purchase price or 750/- per hectareRs. will be eligible for subsidy. (subject to a maximum of four hectares per account)
> **Remark:** As per conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of [Appendix-1](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx). (Refer Scheme No. 35). > **Frequency:** Every year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.

name: Distribution of Seeds of more productions varieties/ Hybrids varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidies etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area: Plant protection pesticides Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Distribution of Seeds of more productive varieties / Hybrid varieties Seeds and fertilizer at subsidiesRs. etc. to Adivasi farmers in Tribal Area (TASP)" with a component "Plant protection pesticides" is introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to help Scheduled Tribe farmers and tribal cultivators residing outside tribal areas achieve higher agricultural crop production and improve their livelihood. Through this schemeRs. assistance is provided for various componentsRs. including plant protection pesticidesRs. whichRs. when used according to scientific recommendationsRs. can significantly increase crop production.
benefits:
1. 75% of the purchase price or 750/- per hectareRs. whichever is lower (subject to a maximum of two hectares per account)
> **Remarks**: According to conditions No. 5Rs. 16Rs. 17Rs. 19 and 22 of Appendix-1Rs. crop protection drugs included under Pesticides Act-1968 have to be given. > Biological/herbal medicines are to be preferred. > **Frequency:****** Every year. > **Note:** **For** [**Appendix-1**](https://mariyojana.gujarat.gov.in/Schemeatoz.aspx)**. (Refer to Scheme No. 35)**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be located in tribal areas OR be a tribal cultivator residing outside tribal areas. 1. The scheme excludes farmers from Dang district.

name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
brief_description: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children is implemented by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. this certificate provides 5% horizontal reservation in Government/Non-Government services for affected childrenRs. including those whose both biological or adoptive parents have died within 21 years from the childs birth. also applicable to those orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state.
benefits: Through this certificateRs. a 5% horizontal reservation is provided in Government/Non-Government services to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children whose both biological or adoptive parents have died within 21 years from the childs birth are eligible for reservation. 1. Orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state are also eligible for reservation.

name: Assistance for Establishment of On farm Storage for Sorting-Grading
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Establishment of On-Farm Storage for Sorting-Grading" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to reduce post-harvest losses in horticultural crops and improve value addition by providing financial assistance to farmers for establishing on-farm infrastructureRs. including sortingRs. gradingRs. packingRs. and primary value addition. The support includes both construction-related infrastructure and modern equipment/machinery for on-farm operations.
benefits: - **For Construction of On-Farm Infrastructure:** Financial aid will be 50% of the unit cost or 1Rs./- per unitRs. whichever is lower.- **For Machinery or Equipment Purchase:** Financial aid of 50% of the actual costRs. subject to a maximum of 50Rs./- per unitRs. whichever is less.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer.

name: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support vegetable farmers in enhancing their cultivation areas using hybrid seeds and to promote natural farming practices. The financial assistance provided under the scheme helps reduce input costs and encourages environmentally sustainable agricultural methods among the farming community.
benefits: - **Subsidy Assistance for Area Expansion Using Hybrid Seeds:** 40% of unit cost or up to 20Rs./- per hectareRs. whichever is less.- **Promotion of Natural Farming in Vegetable Crops:** Maximum Assistance: 20Rs./- per hectare.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be engaged in vegetable crop cultivation.

name: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
brief_description: The scheme "Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote the participation of tribal farmers in formal agricultural markets by reimbursing transportation costs incurred while bringing agricultural goods to market committees. The primary objective is to reduce the financial burden of logistics on tribal farmers and thereby enhance their income through better market access and fair price realization.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 500/- per tonne of agricultural produce transported. Assistance is available for up to 10 tonnes per farmerRs. which amounts to a maximum of 5Rs./-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a tribal farmer. 1. The applicant should be residing in a tribal area of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should bring their agricultural produce to a registered market committee (APMC) located in the tribal area. 1. The applicant should be the owner or cultivator of the agricultural goods transported.

name: Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award
brief_description: The "Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award" scheme is implemented by the Secondary Education Department under the Department of EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among schools and students by providing cash awards to the best-performing schools at the high school and intermediate levels at the state levelRs. as well as to students securing top positions in the Uttarakhand Board High School and Intermediate Examinations.
benefits: > **For Schools:** The 3 schools giving the best results at the state level are awarded prizes of: - 10Rs./-Rs. 5Rs./-Rs. and 3Rs./- at the Intermediate level. - 8Rs./-Rs. 4Rs./-Rs. and 2Rs./- at the High School level. > **For Students (Intermediate Level):** - Students securing 1stRs. 2ndRs. and 3rd positions: 21Rs./-Rs. 15Rs./-Rs. and 11Rs./- respectively. - Students securing 4th to 10th positions: 5Rs./- each. > **For Students (High School Level):** - Students securing 1stRs. 2ndRs. and 3rd positions: 15Rs./-Rs. 11Rs./-Rs. and 8Rs./- respectively. - Students securing 4th to 10th positions: 5Rs./- each.
eligibility: > **For School:** 1. The applicant school must be among the 3 best-performing schools at the Uttarakhand Board high school or intermediate level school at the state level. > **For Student:** 1. The applicant student must be among the top 10 rank holders in the Uttarakhand Board Council Examination at High School or Intermediate level examination.

name: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Trible Area)
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies (Tribal Area)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase farm productivity by offering financial support to irrigation co-operative societies formed by tribal area farmers. The scheme focuses on forming such societies and facilitating water distribution by setting up electric pumps and motors on wells and agar creeks.
benefits: - **Monetary Support:** Financial help is provided for the installation of electric motors and pumps on wells and agar creeks to enhance irrigation facilities.
eligibility: - Cooperative irrigation societies formed by small and marginal farmersRs. or any other farmersRs. are eligible under this scheme. - The society should be located within the state of Gujarat. - The Scheme is applicable to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.

name: National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)
brief_description: The scheme "National Mission For Sustainable Agriculture-Parmparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (NMSA-PKVY)" is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme that aims to promote traditional and sustainable organic farming practices among farmers by providing financial support and infrastructure assistance. The scheme extends financial assistance for a maximum of 2 hectares per farmer for organic farming inputsRs. infrastructure development for on-farm organic input productionRs. and related activities.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Assistance is provided for a maximum of 2 hectares per farmer for inputs for organic farmingRs. on-farm input production infrastructureRs. etc.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Whale Shark Conservation Programme
brief_description: Launched in 2004Rs. the "Whale Shark Conservation Programme" by the Forests and Environment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to tackle the problem of incidental catch and conserve the magnificent Whale Shark speciesRs. ensuring its protection along the Gujarat coast. The scheme provides full legal protection to Whale SharksRs. listing them under Schedule-I of the Wildlife (Protection) ActRs. 1972 since May 28Rs. 2001Rs. marking it as the first fish protected by Indian law. It also features a compensation scheme for fishermen whose nets are damaged during rescue operationsRs. and introduced a self-documentation process for claims in 2012. The fishermen must actively participate in rescue operations by reporting trapped Whale Sharks and assisting in their release. The scheme is implemented by the Forests and Environment Department. Applications for compensation under this scheme are accepted through reporting incidents to the forest range office or by self-documentation.
benefits: > **Compensation for Damaged Nets** Fishermen are paid compensation not exceeding 25Rs./- (twenty-five thousand rupees) in lieu of nets that are damaged or cut during rescue operations involving trapped Whale Sharks. > **Conditions for Benefit Availment/Disbursement** - The rescue operation must be documented through videography or photography for compensation to be paid. - The fishermen must take photographs of trapped Whale SharksRs. release them on the spotRs. and then submit this information and photographs after returning to the coast to receive their compensation.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a fishermanRs. particularly from the Kharva and Koli communities residing in the coastal talukas of VeravalRs.
