SutrapadaRs. and Mangrol in Junagadh district. - The applicant's fishing net must incur damage or require cutting during an operation to rescue a trapped Whale Shark. - The applicantRs. or the rescue team involvedRs. must ensure the rescue operation is thoroughly documented through either videography or photography. - The applicantRs. under the self-documentation schemeRs. must photograph the trapped Whale SharkRs. release it on the spotRs. and then submit these photographs along with incident details to the Forests and Environment Department after returning to the sea coast.

name: Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad
brief_description: The "Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to tribal students who wish to pursue higher education in foreign universities. Through this schemeRs. eligible Scheduled Tribe (ST) students can avail a loan at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum.
benefits: **Monetary Benefit:** - Loan of up to 15Rs. or the actual cost of study/training abroadRs. whichever is lower. **Interest Rate:** - 4% per annum. **Penalty Interest:** - 2.5% per annum for late repayment. **Beneficiary Contribution:** - No contribution is required from the beneficiary. **Repayment Terms:** - Repayment to be made in 60 monthly installments. - Repayment starts 6 months after completion of studies. - Early repayment is permitted.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have secured special merit in MatriculationRs. Higher SecondaryRs. Indian School CertificateRs. or its equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized foreign university for higher education. 1. The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination.

name: Loan For Commercial Pilot Training
brief_description: The "Loan For Commercial Pilot Training" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in pursuing professional pilot training by providing affordable loans. Under this schemeRs. tribal students can avail a loan at a concessional interest rateRs. enabling them to secure high-quality training and good employment opportunities.
benefits: **Monetary Benefit** - Loan of up to 25Rs. or the actual cost of trainingRs. whichever is lower. **Interest Rate** - 4% per annum. **Penalty Interest** - 2.5% per annum on delayed repayments. **Beneficiary Contribution** - No contribution is required from the applicant. **Repayment Terms** - Repayment begins 1 year after the loan disbursement date. - Repayment period is 144 monthly installments (12 years). - Includes 10 years for principal repayment and 2 years for interest repayment. - Early repayment is permitted.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have passed MatriculationRs. Higher SecondaryRs. Indian School CertificateRs. or an equivalent examination. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized commercial pilot training institute. 1. The applicant should have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC).

name: Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home
brief_description: The scheme Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home is implemented by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide support to women above 18 years of age who are orphansRs. destituteRs. abandonedRs. found on roadsRs. or mentally and physically disabled. Such women are provided with clothingRs. foodRs. accommodationRs. medical careRs. counsellingRs. entertainmentRs. and training facilities free of cost.
benefits: Women above 18 years of age who are mentally and physically disabledRs. or destitute womenRs. are provided with clothingRs. foodRs. accommodationRs. medical careRs. counselingRs. entertainmentRs. and training facilities free of cost.
eligibility: Women above 18 years of age who are orphansRs. destituteRs. abandonedRs. found on roadsRs. mentally or physically disabledRs. or involved in immoral trafficking are eligible.

name: Project Sankalp
brief_description: The scheme "Project Sankalp" was launched on 15th July 2020 by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission (GSDM)Rs. Labour and Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to revolutionize vocational skillingRs. making India the global skill capital with globally competitive skills and competencies. The scheme provides an industry-led vocational skilling programRs. enabling the industry to fulfill its demand for skilled manpower and providing youth with sustainable employment opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Skill Development Mission. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the GSDM portal.
benefits: > **Training Cost Reimbursement** The Industry Partner will receive reimbursement for training costs per candidate per hour: - NSQF Category 1 Job Roles: 49. - NSQF Category 2 Job Roles: 42. - NSQF Category 3 Job Roles: 35.10. - GCVT Job Roles and Company-Specific Job Roles: 36.75 (which is 75% of the Category 1 NSQF job role training cost). _*The training cost for NSQF Job Roles is subject to amendments as per MSDE notificationRs. and the cost for GCVT and Company-specific job roles will also change accordingly._ > ***Assessment Cost Reimbursement*** GSDM will reimburse the assessment cost directly to the respective Sector Skill Council (SSC)Rs. Gujarat Council of Vocational Training (GCVT)Rs. or Kaushalya Skill University (KSU) for both fresher trainees and existing employees. _*Any re-assessment cost for candidates who were absent or failed the first assessmentRs. or for existing workers/employeesRs. must be borne by the Industry Partner._ > ***No Training Fee for Youth/Beneficiaries*** No fee of any kind will be charged from the youth or beneficiaries for the training.
eligibility: - The Fresher Trainees must have a domicile of Gujarat. - The age of Fresher Trainees must be between 18 and 35 years. - The Existing Employees could be from Pan-India. - The age of Existing Employees must be between 18 and 55 years. > **Relaxations & Preferences** - The scheme focuses on the inclusion of Special Groups such as WomenRs. Persons with Disability (PwD)Rs. Below Poverty Line (BPL)Rs. Scheduled Caste (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribe (ST). - A relaxation of ten years may be given to WomenRs. PwDRs. BPLRs. SCRs. and ST candidates for fresher trainees.

name: Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy
brief_description: The "Gujarat State Electric Vehicle Policy 2021" by the Ports and Transport DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to transition the state's transportation sector towards electric mobilityRs. make Gujarat a manufacturing hub for electric vehicles and ancillary equipmentRs. encourage start-ups and investment in the field of electric mobilityRs. and improve environmental quality by reducing air pollution. The policy provides capital subsidies up to 10Rs./- per kilowatt hour for electric vehicle purchases and 25% capital subsidy on equipment for charging infrastructure limited up to 10Rs./- per station for the first 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging stations. The policy is implemented by the Ports and Transport Department as the nodal department with Energy and Petrochemicals Department handling charging station subsidies.
benefits: > ***Electric Vehicle Purchase Incentives*** - 2-Wheeler: 10Rs./- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price 1Rs./-) - 3-Wheeler: 10Rs./- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price 5Rs./-) - 4-Wheeler: 10Rs./- per kilowatt hour (maximum ex-factory price 15Rs./-) > ***Charging Infrastructure Incentives*** - Capital Subsidy: 25% on equipment/machinery limited up to 10Rs./- per station - Electricity Duty Exemption: 100% exemption for electric vehicle charging stations during policy period - Eligibility: First 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging stations > ***Manufacturing Benefits*** All provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 applicable to electric vehicle manufacturing sector Support for setting up or upgrading facilities for electric vehicle manufacturing > ***Conditions*** _*The beneficiary can avail subsidy under only one state government scheme and cannot claim subsidy under multiple schemes._ _*Maximum subsidy amount is limited to maximum battery capacity of the vehicle._ _*Maximum subsidy should not exceed 40% of ex-factory price of the vehicle._ _*The amount whichever is less will be given as subsidy to the beneficiary._ _*Charging stations must adhere to Ministry of Power guidelines and standards dated 01.10.2019._ _*Charging station subsidy available only to those who have not availed subsidies under any other Government of India schemes._
eligibility: ##### ***Electric Vehicle Purchase Subsidy*** - The applicant must purchase electric vehicles that have taken subsidy under Government of India's Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles in India Scheme dated 8th March 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must ensure the vehicle's ex-factory price falls within the prescribed threshold limits for each segment. - The applicant must not have claimed subsidy under any other state government scheme run by different departments. - The applicant must authenticate documents for vehicle purchase to receive Direct Benefit Transfer. ##### ***Charging Infrastructure Subsidy*** - The applicant must set up commercial public electric vehicle charging stations for 2-wheelersRs. 3-wheelersRs. and 4-wheelers. - The applicant must not have availed subsidies under any other promotional schemes under Government of India policies or schemes. - The applicant must ensure charging stations meet guidelines and standards of Ministry of Power Circular dated 1st October 2019 and any amendments thereafter. - The applicant must be among the first 250 commercial public electric vehicle charging station developers. ##### ***Manufacturing Incentives*** - The applicant must be involved in manufacturing electric vehicles and their components. - The applicant must comply with provisions of Gujarat Industrial Policy-2020 and subsequent applicable policies.

name: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers" by the Climate Change DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to encourage the use of clean energy vehicles among the youth by offering financial support to students from Class 9th to 12thRs. as well as college studentsRs. for purchasing battery-operated two-wheelers of their choice from GEDA-authorized manufacturers through their dealers. The scheme is designed to reduce pollutionRs. promote renewable energy adoptionRs. and create awareness about sustainable transport among the younger generation.
benefits: - **Subsidy Assistance:** Each eligible student receives a subsidy of 12Rs./- for the purchase of a battery-operated two-wheeler.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in the state or be a college student. 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated two-wheeler only from GEDA-authorized manufacturers through registered dealers.

name: Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers
brief_description: The scheme "Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-wheelers" by the Climate Change DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage the use of clean energy-based vehicles for the transportation of passengers and goodsRs. thereby reducing dependency on petrol and mitigating pollution. BeneficiariesRs. including rickshaw driversRs. women entrepreneursRs. startupsRs. unemployed youthRs. educational institutionsRs. cooperativesRs. NGOsRs. local bodiesRs. and yatrasRs. can avail a subsidy on a reimbursement basis after purchasing battery-operated three-wheelers from Gujarat Energy Development Agency (GEDA) authorized manufacturers and dealers.
benefits: - **Subsidy Assistance:** Subsidy of 48Rs./- after the purchase of a battery-operated three-wheeler from GEDA-authorized manufacturers/dealers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be an individual (such as rickshaw driversRs. women entrepreneursRs. startupsRs. educated unemployed individuals) or an institution (such as cooperativesRs. NGOsRs. educational institutionsRs. local bodiesRs. yatras). 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated three-wheeler from a GEDA-authorized manufacturer or dealer. 1. The applicant must apply through authorized dealers linked with GEDA.

name: High Altitude Guide Course
brief_description: The scheme High Altitude Guide Course is implemented by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board under the Department of TourismRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to train and certify youth of Uttarakhand as professional high-altitude guides who have already completed a Low Altitude Guide Course from a recognized institution.
benefits: The beneficiary will become a certified high-altitude guide upon completing the course.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a youth from Uttarakhand. - The applicant must have completed a Low Altitude Guide Course from a recognized institution. > The total number of 41 beneficiaries will be selected.

name: Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana" by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to select 30Rs. brilliant students who have completed their Class 5 education consecutively in governmentRs. aidedRs. or RTE-approved schools and provide them with scholarships to study in selected governmentRs. aidedRs. or private schools from Class 6th to Class 12th. The selection is done through a Common Entrance Test conducted by the State Examination BoardRs. Gandhinagar.
benefits: > **Government Schools and Government -aided Schools (Approved by Education Department):** - For Class 6th to 8th: 5Rs./- per year. - For Class 9th to 10th: 6Rs./- per year. - For Class 11th to 12th: 7Rs./- per year. > **Private (Selected) Schools:** - For Class 6th to 8th: 20Rs./- per year. - For Class 9th to 10th: 22Rs./- per year. - For Class 11th to 12th: 25Rs./- per year. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** - Disbursed annually in two installments; the first 50% is given after confirmation of at least 80% attendance in the first semester.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must have studied Classes 1st to 5th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed the Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by the State Examination Board and be listed in the merit list. 1. The applicant must have taken admission in Class 6th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat.

name: Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing" was launched by the Tiatr Academy of GoaRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote Konkani songs by presenting them with choreography and dancingRs. attracting youth towards Konkani 'kantar' and improving the presentation quality of Konkani cultural performances. The scheme provides cash prizes ranging from 2Rs./- to 7Rs./- for winners along with mementos and certificatesRs. and traveling allowances between 1Rs./- to 2Rs./- based on distance traveled by participating groups. The applicant must form a group of 6 to 10 participants and submit a recording of one selected Konkani song at the time of application. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: ##### ***Cash Prizes for Performance*** - First Prize: 7Rs./- plus memento and certificate. - Second Prize: 5Rs./- plus memento and certificate. - Third Prize: 3Rs./- plus memento and certificate. - Special Prize for Best Choreographer: 2Rs./- plus memento and certificate. ##### ***Traveling Allowance*** - Groups traveling up to 10 kilometers radius: 1Rs./-. - Groups traveling within 10-20 kilometers radius: 1Rs./-. - Groups traveling 20 kilometers or more: 2Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must form a group consisting of 6 to 10 participants. - The applicant must submit a recording of one selected Konkani song at the time of application. - The applicant must not perform fusion of songs as it will result in automatic disqualification. - The applicant must abide by all rules and regulations of the competition organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must accept that the decision of the judges will be final and binding.

name: Financial Assistance to Troupes Going to Mumbai/Poona and Other Parts of the Country & Vice Versa
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Troupes Going to Mumbai/Poona and Other Parts of the Country & Vice Versa" by the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG)Rs. GoaRs. aims to compensate Goan dramatic troupes towards their transportation costsRs. recognizing that staging Tiatrs in MumbaiRs. PoonaRs. and other parts of the country is not always financially viable. The scheme provides financial support to cover transport expenses for Goan troupes staging a minimum of five shows of the same Tiatr in Mumbai/PoonaRs. or for Mumbai/Poona troupes staging five shows in Goa. Benefits can also be availed for only one show staged in other locations such as KolkataRs. DelhiRs. GujaratRs. NagpurRs. BangaloreRs. or Udaipur. Applications for this scheme are accepted one month in advance of the performance dateRs. on a 'First Come First Serve' basisRs. and are subject to the availability of funds.
benefits:
- The scheme provides financial support to compensate for transportation expenses incurred while staging TiatrsRs. thereby promoting Goan Tiatr. - The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
> ***Conditions*** _*The Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) may appoint a representative to witness the performanceRs. and payments will be released based on their report._ _*A compulsory announcement stating This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) must be made both before the commencement of the Tiatr and again during the interval._ _*No adverse remarks must be madeRs. either in written or verbal formRs. against any GovernmentsRs. IndividualsRs. InstitutionsRs. or on the basis of casteRs. creedRs. or religion within the scriptsRs. song lyricsRs. performancesRs. or speeches. If such remarks are provenRs. the Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) reserves the right to disqualify the performance and either withhold payment or recall any payment already made to the applicant._ _*For performances at Mandd SobhannRs. MangaloreRs. the payment will only be made after a certificate of performance is issued by the Mandd Sobhann._
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be the writer or director of the Tiatr. 2. The applicant must stage the Tiatr as per its traditional format. 3. The applicant's Tiatr must have 6 or 7 acts (podddde). 4. The applicant's Tiatr must include the following - - At least 4 cantos and comedy linked to the story of the play. - At least 10 Kantaram. 5. The applicant's 'Kantaram' must include the following - - At Least 2 Duets. - At Least 1 Duo. - At Least 1 Trio. - At Least 1 Quartet/quintet. - At Least 1 Choral Song and Solos. 6. The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any form (written or verbal) against any GovernmentsRs. IndividualsRs. InstitutionsRs. or anything against casteRs. creedRs. and religion in the scriptsRs. lyrics of songsRs. performancesRs. speechesRs. etc.Rs. which may hurt the sentiments of anybody. 7. All advertisementsRs. press notesRs. bannersRs. ticketsRs. and handbills must explicitly state that This Tiatr is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG). 8. The applicant's troupe must stage a minimum of 5 shows of the same Tiatr in Mumbai/Poona (if a Goan troupe) or 5 shows in Goa (if a Mumbai/Poona troupe) to qualify for transport support. 9. The applicant's troupe can avail benefit even if only one show is staged in other places like KolkataRs. DelhiRs. GujaratRs. NagpurRs. BangaloreRs. UdaipurRs. etc. 10. The applicant can avail the scheme only twice in a financial year for two different Tiatrs.
> ***Earmarking*** 1. For performances at Mandd Sobhann at MangaloreRs. financial assistance is extended to two troupes from Goa. 2. Of these two Tiatrs for Mandd SobhannRs. one should be from Commercial Troupes and one from a prize-winning Troupe of Goa Kala Academy A Tiatr Competition.

name: Namo Laxmi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Namo Laxmi Yojana" by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage girls studying in governmentRs. aidedRs. and private schools in Gujarat to complete their education from Class 9th to 12th by providing direct financial assistance. Each eligible girl will receive a total financial support of 50Rs./- on completion of classes 9th to 12th under this scheme.
benefits:
> ***Total Financial Assistance:*** - Each eligible girl will receive a total financial support of 50Rs./- on completion of classes 9th to 12th in governmentRs. aidedRs. and private schools.
> **Class 9th-10th Benefit:** - 10Rs./- per annum (500/- per month based on attendance 10) and the remaining 50% will be credited via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) after passing the Class 10th board examination.
> **Class 11th-12th Benefit:** - 15Rs./- per annum (750/- per month based on attendance 10) and the remaining 50% will be credited via DBT after passing the Class 12th board examination.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a girl. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in any GovernmentRs. Government-aidedRs. or private secondary/higher secondary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have an annual family income of less than or equal to 6Rs./-. 1. The applicant must maintain regular attendance to be eligible for monthly assistance.

name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
brief_description: The scheme "Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to project patriotismRs. nationalismRs. and communal harmony through tiatrsRs. songs and musicRs. addressing the need to promote these values through cultural performances and artistic expression. The scheme provides remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa to successful applicants and covers actual charges of hall/auditorium or pays a lump sum amount for performances held in makeshift pandalsRs. along with video recording of the activity with one Digital Video Disc copy provided to the applicant. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to the applicant. - Reimbursement of actual charges of the hall/auditorium or payment of lump sum amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa if performance is held in makeshift pandal. - Video recording of the activity/programme will be done by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - One copy of the Digital Video Disc will be provided to the applicant. - Maximum of 4 shows of the programme will be staged by Tiatr Academy of Goa at various places. - One banner will be provided by Tiatr Academy of Goa for compulsory display.
> ***Conditions*** - All shows must be shown to public free of charge. - Duration of the musical programme or tiatr should be not less than two hours. - In all advertisementsRs. oralRs. print or electronic mediaRs. bannersRs. the following must be inserted/published/announced: 'This programme is promoted by Tiatr Academy of Goa'. - A few seats should be reserved by the organizer(s) for the representatives of Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The Tiatr Academy of Goa banner should be compulsorily displayed at one of the two front side wings of the stage and returned after all shows. - The organizing institution/individual will have to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an individual/organization/educational institution/club. - The applicant must propose an activity that is a tiatr/musical programme on the theme of patriotism/national integration/communal harmony. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the musical programme or tiatr is not less than two hours. - The applicant must submit the application along with typed script/lyrics at least 30 days before the date of staging the programme. - The applicant must attach No Objection Certificate from the lyricist/writer/director concerned if they are not the lyricist/writer/director of the proposed activity. - The applicant must ensure scripts/lyrics do not contain any adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against casteRs. creed and religion.

name: Training Program for A-HELP Women Workers - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
brief_description: The scheme Training Program for A-HELP Women Workers is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide community-service-based skill development and employment opportunities for women in the field of animal husbandry.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. community-service-based job creation or job filling is carried out between the Animal Husbandry Department and Animal Husbandry by A-HELP workers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a woman member of a self-help group formed under the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission. 1. The applicant must have a minimum educational qualification of eighth pass. 1. The applicant must have completed 7 days of Pashu Sakhi training.

name: National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
brief_description: The scheme Entrepreneurship Development SchemeRs. a sub-component of the National Livestock MissionRs. is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminantsRs. poultryRs. piggeryRs. and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminantsRs. poultryRs. piggeryRs. and the fodder sector.
eligibility: The applicant must belong to one of the following eligible categories: - Individual Entrepreneur - Self Help Group (SHG) - Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) - Farmers Cooperative (FCO) - Joint Liability Group (JLG) - Section 8 Company

name: Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields
brief_description: The scheme Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote scientific awareness among studentsRs. teachersRs. and the general public by conducting outreach programmes and activities in various fields of science through both online and offline modesRs. thereby making science education and research more accessible across the state.
benefits: In order to make the benefits of science education and research accessible to every individual in the stateRs. information regarding the development of scientific consciousness and the dissemination of scientific knowledge among studentsRs. teachersRs. and the general public through online and offline mediums is disseminated through various social media sitesRs. USERC Science Awareness Centres (currently 200 in the state)Rs. and USERC Nodal Officers working in higher education.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student or a person (general public) from Uttarakhand.

name: Information, Monitoring, Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA): Evaluation and Studies
brief_description: The scheme "InformationRs. MonitoringRs. Evaluation and Social Audit (I-MESA)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Govt. of India. The "Evaluation and Studies" component of the scheme aims to establish institutionalized mechanisms for achieving transparency and accountabilityRs. generating lessons learned for real-time program improvementRs. and ensuring effective knowledge dissemination among stakeholders and targeted beneficiaries. The scheme provides for evaluation studies to be undertaken at regular intervalsRs. preferably every two yearsRs. by reputed Agencies/Organizations or other Institutes.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance/Funding*** Funds are sanctioned by the Ministry for approved evaluation projects covering a specified period. > ***Items Covered under Funds (Costs met by the Ministry)*** - Salaries and allowances of the project staff of the study and honorarium for the Project Director. - Travel expenses undertaken in relation to the project. - Consultancy charges. - Printing costs. - Equipment and books. - Computer and tabulation costs. - Contingency and Overhead charges (Overhead charges are calculated up to 5% of the total cost of PersonnelRs. TravelRs. PrintingRs. Equipment and booksRs. Computer and machine tabulation costsRs. and Contingency). ##### ***Fund Disbursal Installments*** The funds are released in three installments - **First Installment:** 20% (released after the receipt of Performance Security).- **Second Installment:** 50% (released on submission and presentation of the draft report).- **Third Installment:** 30% (released after acceptance of the report by the DepartmentRs. along with submission of 8 copies of the final reportRs. 20 copies of the summary report and its soft versionRs. audited Statement of AccountsRs. and Utilization Certificate). ##### ***Conditions*** - The successful bidder must submit a Performance Bank Guarantee issued by any scheduled commercial bank for 8% of the contract value. - The Organization must execute a bond in favor of the President of India to abide by the terms and conditions attached to the funds. - The Organization must maintain separate accounts for this fundRs. which will remain open to inspection by representatives of the Government of IndiaRs. including the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. - The Organization must refund any unspent balance out of the fund within 30 days from the date of completion of the Project. - Any unspent balance not refunded within 30 daysRs. or funds required to be refunded due to failure to abide by conditionsRs. will attract a penal interest of 15% per annum thereon.
eligibility: ##### ***For the Organization/Agency/Institute*** - The applicant must have requisite qualifications to undertake evaluation studies of schemes and programmes of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment. - The applicant must not have been blacklisted. - The applicant must accept all the terms and conditions of the Notice Inviting TenderRs. including commercial and general terms and conditions. - The applicant must be willing to undertake the assignment in the given timeframe. ##### ***For the Project Director/In-charge of the Project*** - The applicant should have the necessary experience in the use of statistical tools. - The applicant should have experience in the social sector. - The applicant should have at least 5 years experience of evaluation of studies on the social sector.

name: Super-100 Programme - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Super-100 Programme is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to identify and support the brightest Class 12 Science stream students by providing them with high-quality coaching and guidance for engineering and medical entrance examinations. The programme is a unique state-level initiative approved by the Government of India.
benefits: Under this programmeRs. 100 Science students were prepared for engineering and medical entrance examinations in 202324. Faculty members were selected from reputed coaching institutes based on their interviews and experience.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a Class 12 Science stream student studying in Uttarakhand. 1. One top-performing student from each blockRs. along with the highest-scoring students from the SCRs. STRs. and OBC categoriesRs. will be considered eligible under this programme. 1. A total of 100 Class 12 Science stream students will be selected for the programme.

name: Government of Mizoram Incentive Cash Award Scheme To Successful Candidates for Central and All India Service Examination
brief_description: The scheme "Government of Mizoram Incentive Cash Award Scheme To Successful Candidates for Central and All India Service Examination" was launched by the Higher and Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of Mizoram. The scheme aims to encourage educated youth among the citizens of India and bonafide residents of Mizoram who aspire to succeed entry to Central and All India ServicesRs. addressing the issue of Mizo educated youths lagging behind and becoming increasingly marginalized in examinations conducted by the Union Public Service Commission. The scheme provides an incentive cash award of 1Rs./- to successful candidates and reimbursement of coaching and hostel fees.
benefits: **Incentive Cash Award:** 1Rs./- (one-time payment) for clearance of any eligible examination. **Coaching Fee Reimbursement:** Actual fees paid to coaching institution or 20Rs./-Rs. whichever is less (only onceRs. not granted on second attempt). **Hostel/Mess Fee Reimbursement:** 2Rs./- per month for maximum 6 months (only onceRs. not granted on second attempt). *Payment made through E-Payment by SecretaryRs. Mizoram Scholarship Board. *Only one examination can be claimed at a time. _*Claims must be submitted within 3 months from date of result declaration._
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a bonafide citizen of the State of Mizoram. - The applicant should be a citizen of India and bonafide resident of Mizoram. - The applicant should have successfully cleared examinations conducted by Union Public Service Commission. ***Examination Categories*** - Civil Service Examination. - Combined Defence Service (Officers Training Academy) Examination. - National Defence Academy and Naval Academic Examination. - TCombined Medical Examination. - Central Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination. - Indian Economic/Indian Statistical Service Examination. - Combined Geo-Scientist Examination. - Section Officers (20% Direct recruitment by Union Public Service Commission) Examination.
_*The applicant shall be entitled to two chances i.e. clearance of preliminary exam twice and mains exam twice._ _*The applicant shall be entitled to claim for only one examination at a time._ _*The applicant shall submit his claim in the prescribed form within a period of 3 months from the date of declaration of results._

name: Konkani Song & Music Awards (Tiatr Kantaram)
brief_description: The scheme "Konkani Song & Music Awards (Tiatr Kantaram)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the ArtRs. Culture and Museums DepartmentRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage producersRs. lyricistsRs. singersRs. and musicians who invest significant amounts of money to produce Konkani Audio Compact Disc/Video Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/Digital Albums of Konkani Tiatr songsRs. with the ultimate goal of encouraging qualitative album production to enrich Konkani 'kantar'. The scheme provides cash awards ranging from 5Rs./- to 30Rs./- across twelve different categories including solo singersRs. group performancesRs. lyricistsRs. music composersRs. and best album awardsRs. with specific requirements for interactive lyrics in group categories and minimum composition requirements for album eligibility.
benefits: - Male singer of the year (Solo): 10Rs./- - Female singer of the year (Solo): 10Rs./- - Child Male Singer of the year (Solo): 5Rs./- - Child Female Singer of the year (Solo): 5Rs./- - Duet of the year (Nature of lyrics should be interactive): 10Rs./- - Duo of the year (Nature of lyrics should be interactive): 10Rs./- - Trio of the year (Nature of lyrics should be interactive): 15Rs./- - Quartet of the year (Nature of lyrics should be interactive): 20Rs./- - Choral Song of the year: 20Rs./- - Lyricist of the year: 10Rs./- - Music composer of the year: 10Rs./- - Best Konkani kantaram audio album of the year: 30Rs./- ****Awards are presented every year by Tiatr Academy of Goa.***
eligibility: - The applicant must produce Konkani Audio Compact Disc/Video Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/Digital Albums between 1st January and 31st December of the year identified by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must ensure the music director is compulsorily a Goan or of Goan origin. - The applicant must ensure singers in the Album are Goans whose mother tongue is Konkani. - The applicant must ensure the Album contains songs only in Konkani language and not in other languages like EnglishRs. HindiRs. Portuguese etc. - The applicant must ensure the songs in the Album are not old songs or remix of old songs. - The applicant must ensure the Audio Compact Disc/Video Compact Disc/Digital Versatile Disc/Digital Albums consists of minimum 8 Konkani kantaram. - The applicant must ensure there are no adverse remarks in any form against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or against casteRs. creed and religion in the lyrics of songs/performances/speeches. ***Competition Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure there are minimum three entries in each category to participate in that particular category competition. - The applicant must ensure for Best Album awardRs. the album has at least 5 kantaram from specified categories: one soloRs. one duet (interactive lyrics)Rs. one duo (interactive lyrics)Rs. one trio (interactive lyrics)Rs. one quartet/quintet (interactive lyrics)Rs. one choral song. ***Child Singer Category*** - The applicant must ensure child singers have not completed 16 years of age on or before 31st December of the year identified by Tiatr Academy of Goa.

name: Margadeepam Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Margadeepam Scholarship" was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Kerala. The scheme aims to provide educational financial assistance to minority community students studying in government and government-aided schools from Class 1st to Class 8thRs. addressing the educational needs of HinduRs. Christian (all denominations)Rs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. and Parsi students in proportion to their population. The scheme provides a one-time annual scholarship amount of 1Rs./- and targets permanent residents of Kerala from minority religious communities.
benefits: > ***Financial Assistance*** - Scholarship amount of 1Rs./- per student per academic year. - One-time Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in the name of selected students. > ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must maintain an active Aadhaar-linked bank account with a nationalized or scheduled bank in their own name for Direct Benefit Transfer. - The beneficiary must provide accurate banking details to the institutional head for successful fund transfer. - The beneficiary must not receive any other scholarship benefits under other schemes simultaneously while availing this scholarship. - The beneficiary must apply fresh each academic year if they wish to continue receiving the scholarship in subsequent years. - The beneficiary must cooperate with institutional verification processes and provide original documents when requested by authorities. - The beneficiary must immediately inform the institutional head of any change in circumstances that may affect eligibility. - The beneficiary must return the entire scholarship amount if found guilty of providing false declarations or fraudulent information.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala. - The applicant must be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th. - The applicant must be studying in a Government or Government-aided school. - The applicant must belong to a minority religious community (HinduRs. Christian (all denominations)Rs. SikhRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. or Parsi). - The applicant's family annual income must not exceed 2Rs./-. _*If adequate applicants are not available in one categoryRs. students from other categories may be considered._ ##### **Earmarking** - 30% scholarships are reserved for female students. - The applicant (male students) may be considered for female-reserved positions if adequate female applications are not received. ##### ***Additional Merit Consideration*** - **PwD:** The applicant should provide disability certificate if having 40% and above physical/mental disability.- **Orphan:** The applicant should provide death certificate if orphaned (father/mother/both parents deceased). ##### ***Merit Point Calculation System*** Family Income: Formula = (2Rs. - Actual Income)/25Rs. (Maximum 10 points). Academic Grades: Maximum 12 points (A+ Grade = 12Rs. A Grade = 11Rs. B+ Grade = 10Rs. B Grade = 9Rs. C+ Grade = 8Rs. C Grade = 7Rs. D+ Grade = 6Rs. D Grade = 5). Orphaned Students: 4 points maximum (Both parents deceased = 4Rs. Single parent deceased = 2). Physical/Mental Disability: 4 points (40% and above disability and category 2 disability). Total Maximum Points: 30. _*Academic excellence for Class 2nd to Class 8th students will be determined based on grade points received in academic year._ _*Class 1st students will not be evaluated on academic marks but on income eligibility criteria._ ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must reapply fresh each academic year to continue receiving benefits. - The applicant must maintain eligibility criteria throughout the benefit period. - The applicant must not provide false declarations as it will result in immediate scholarship cancellation and recovery of disbursed amount.

name: Financial Assistance To Dairy Farmers Belonging To Scheduled Tribes And Scheduled Caste For Purchase Of Basic Dairy Equipments
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dairy Farmers Belonging to Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste for Purchase of Basic Dairy Equipments" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide assistance to the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste communities for the purchase of basic dairy equipments needed to run a small scale dairy farmingRs. and to encourage the tribal population to adopt Animal Husbandry activitiesRs. especially Dairy Development Schemes. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through the local Veterinary Officer or Assistant Director.
benefits: ##### ***Maximum Financial Assistance*** - 100% subsidy shall be provided for dairy items of general use. - The subsidy is subject to a maximum amount of 30Rs./- or the actual cost of the itemsRs. whichever is lower. - The subsidy is a one-time assistance per family. ##### ***Maximum Permissible Subsidy per Item*** - Stainless Steel Cans (Twenty liters Capacity): 3Rs./- (for 2 permissible units). - 500 Liters Water Tanks: 3Rs./- (for 1 permissible unit). - Calf Nipple Bucket: 1Rs./- (for 1 permissible unit). - Spray Pump 15 Liters Capacity: 2Rs./- (for 1 permissible unit). - Steel Buckets: 2Rs./- (for 2 permissible units). - 0.5 Horsepower water Pump: 5Rs./- (for 1 permissible unit). - Ceiling Fans: 4Rs./- (for 2 permissible units). - Steel Vessels 5 Liters Capacity: 900/- (for 2 permissible units). - Spade: 250/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Grooming Brush: 400/- (for 2 permissible units). - Gamelas: 500/- (for 2 permissible units). - Nylon Rope: 400/- (for 2.5 kilograms). - Sickle: 250/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Pickaxe: 300/- (for 1 permissible unit). - Rubber mat: 5Rs./- (for 2 permissible units). ##### ***Benefit Disbursal*** - Subsidy shall be directly credited to the beneficiarys bank account. - In case of limited purchase of dairy itemsRs. proportionate subsidy shall be released. - The Department will release the subsidy within 60 days of receiving the documents completed in all respects. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must use the dairy equipments purchased for the development of their dairy unit. - The beneficiary shall abide by the provision of the said schemeRs. and undertake to comply with the Pattern of Assistance of the scheme as contained in the scheme. - The beneficiary must use the dairy equipments for a minimum period of 3 (three) years from the date of purchaseRs. subject to normal wear and tear. - The beneficiary solemnly undertakes to refund the cost of the items if the items are found misutilised or missing. - In case of breach of any clauseRs. the Government is free to recover the subsidy released through any due benefits under other eligible schemes of the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services and/or under the land revenue code.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Goa for at least five preceding years. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe or Scheduled Caste Community. - The applicant must be a Dairy Farmer. - The applicant must have at least two milch animals. - The two milch animals must be Local CowsRs. Indigenous cowsRs. Cross Bred cowsRs. Local BuffaloesRs. or Improved Buffaloes.

name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Boys Residential Hostel Scheme (Classes 1 to 8)
brief_description: The Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential School Scheme for Boys (Class 1-8) is a centrally sponsored scheme launched in 2017-18. It targets vulnerable children like orphansRs. child laborersRs. street dwellersRs. and those with single parentsRs. offering them free residential facilities to complete their primary education and reduce the male-female gap in education. The scheme operates in 52 districts with 100-bed hostels. Benefits include free stayRs. foodRs. medicalRs. booksRs. uniformsRs. and daily necessities. Application is by approaching the District Project Coordinator/Warden.
benefits: 1. These hostels admit orphansRs. homeless childrenRs. single parentsRs. destitute child laborersRs. rag pickersRs. children living on railway station platforms and bus stands and provide them with residential facilities to complete their primary education. 1. Provide educational opportunities to children from educationally disadvantaged groups through residential schools. 1. Bridging the educational gap between boys and girls. 1. Provide residential school facilities to provide children with primary education.
eligibility: 1. Boys who have dropped out of school because a middle school is not available within a 3 km radius or a high school/higher secondary school is not available within a 5 km radius of their village. 1. Boys who are identified as (Classes 1-8): - School Dropouts - Out-of-School/Non-enrolled - Destitute/Homeless - Orphans - Single-Parent Children - Divyang (Physically disabled/Orthopedically handicapped) 1. Boys identified as school dropouts and out-of-school shall be admitted to the Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel. 1. Children from Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) Ashram Schools that are at the primary level may also be admitted to the hostel. 1. Local resident boys shall not be admitted to the hostel.

name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes BaigaRs. Bharia & Sahariya)" scheme is launched by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to improve the economic statusRs. nutritionRs. and income of special backward tribal communities by promoting livestock rearing. The beneficiaries from the BaigaRs. BhariaRs. and Sahariya tribes receive two high-yielding dairy cows or Murrah buffaloes at a 90% subsidyRs. with 10% contribution by the beneficiary. > **Selected Districts:** The scheme targets specific districts including DindoriRs. UmariaRs. ShahdolRs. AnuppurRs. MandlaRs. BalaghatRs. ChhindwaraRs. GwaliorRs. DatiaRs. ShivpuriRs. GunaRs. AshoknagarRs. SheopurkalaRs. MorenaRs. and Bhind.
benefits: - Provision of 2 Dairy Animals (cow or Murrah buffalo) per beneficiary at 90% subsidy. - Animals sourced from certified breeding tractsRs. progressive farmersRs. or NABARD-approved marketsRs. ensuring quality and health. - Minimum milk yield requirement: cows 7 liters/day; buffaloes 8 liters/day. - Animal age limit: calves must be under 2 months. - Disease-freeRs. healthy animals with mandatory tagging. - Training and guidance on dairy management provided before distribution. - Milk route establishment and cluster development support provided.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must belong to special backward tribes: BaigaRs. BhariaRs. or Sahariya. 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer residing in the designated districts. 1. The applicants selected animals must comply with minimum milk yield and age requirements. 1. The applicant must participate in pre-distribution training and follow cluster/milk route arrangements.

name: Establishment of Digital Learning Platform
brief_description: The scheme Establishment of Digital Learning Platform is implemented by the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) under the Department of Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to establish Digital Learning Platform to provide training and career counseling on various subjectsRs. including ICT orientationRs. emerging technologiesRs. and moreRs. through both online and offline modes for students of secondary schools across the state.
benefits: Under the Digital Learning PlatformRs. students of secondary schools are provided with training and career counseling on various subjectsRs. such as ICT orientationRs. emerging technologiesRs. and moreRs. through both online and offline modes.
eligibility: 1. All students studying in secondary schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.

name: Yatra Anudan
brief_description: The scheme Yatra Anudan is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support researchers and scientists in attending international scientific workshops and other similar programs by providing eligible applicants with travel grants covering up to 50% of the expenses (maximum 25Rs./-).
benefits: - The Council provides travel grants to researchers and scientists to participate in international scientific workshops and other similar programs. - Under this schemeRs. 50% of the travel expenses (up to a maximum of 25Rs./-) are provided to researchers and scientists of the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a researcher or scientist.

name: Tour Program of Modern Laboratories
brief_description: The scheme Tour Program of Modern Laboratories is implemented by the Uttarakhand Council for Biotechnology under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote biotechnology education and research by providing studentsRs. researchersRs. and farmers with exposure to modern laboratoriesRs. advanced research activitiesRs. and innovative technologies.
benefits: Under this tour programRs. eligible individuals visit modern biotechnology laboratories to learn about new research works.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student from a government or private schoolRs. collegeRs. or universityRs. a researcherRs. or a member of a farmers group or self-help group.

name: Nandi Shala Yojana
brief_description: The "Nandi Shala Yojana (Provision of Breeding Indigenous Bulls on Subsidy)" is launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to improve the breeds of local non-descript and graded cattle in rural areas through natural insemination services. The progressive livestock owners at the Gram Panchayat level are provided high-quality indigenous breeding bulls of recognized breeds such as SahiwalRs. TharparkarRs. HaryanaRs. GirRs. GaolaoRs. MalviRs. NimariRs. and Kenkatha at a subsidized cost. > **Objectives** - To provide indigenous breeding bulls on subsidy for natural insemination services. - To improve the productivity of local cattle breeds in rural areas. - To support progressive livestock farmers in rural Gram Panchayats.
benefits: > **Cost and Subsidy** - For bulls procured from outside Madhya Pradesh: 25Rs./- per unit. - For bulls procured from within Madhya Pradesh: 18Rs./- per unit. - Subsidy: 75% of the cost. - Beneficiary contribution: 25% of the cost.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a livestock farmer. 1. The applicant should be residing in a rural area of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have a minimum of 5 cattle along with sufficient agricultural land. 1. If the applicant does not have agricultural landRs. they should have at least 20 cattle. 1. The applicant should be willing to maintain and use the distributed bull for community natural insemination purposes.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Compensation Towards Natural Calamities" component of the scheme aims to financially assist the Goan artists to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their houses damaged due to natural calamities. The maximum financial assistance provided under this component is 25Rs./- or the valuation done by the concerned Taluka MamlatdarRs. whichever is less. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: - Financial assistance shall be provided to meet expenses towards the repair or construction of a house damaged due to natural calamities. - The quantum of financial assistance shall be a maximum of 25Rs./- or as per the valuation done by the concerned Taluka MamlatdarRs. whichever is less.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a GoanRs. i.e.Rs. born and brought up in Goa. - The applicant must be recognized as an artist by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must be in need of funds to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their house damaged due to natural calamities.

name: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for use of Soil Conditioner
brief_description: The scheme Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Assistance for use of Soil Conditioner" component of the scheme aims to amend the soil based on soil test reportsRs. address pH and nutrient deficiencies in fertilization practicesRs. and address important soil deficiencies like micronutrients that affect crop productivity. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
benefits: ***Assistance for the use of Soil Conditioner*** - The soil conditioners like Rock phosphateRs. agricultural limeRs. dolomiteRs. etc.Rs. would be provided a 75% subsidy limited to Rs. 6Rs./- per ha for all categories of farmers and a maximum of 4 ha per farmer. - The soil conditioner shall be purchased and used by the farmerRs. and the subsidy shall be released after the use of the same in the field.
eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - The farmer should be cultivating a minimum of 0.1 ha in general. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme. - Farmer should possess a Soil Health Card not older than a 2-year period for availing assistance for Soil Conditioners and MicronutrientsRs. or a certificate to that extent may be furnished by the Assistant Chemist of Soil Testing Laboratory (North/South).

name: Namami Gange Yojana- Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Namami Gange Yojana is implemented by the Uttarakhand Organic Commodity Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organic farming practices among farmers residing in villages along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. farmers are provided assistance to adopt organic farming through the formation of clusters.
eligibility: 1. Farmers residing in villages located along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries in Uttarakhand are eligible for assistance under this scheme.

name: Allotment of Canteens
brief_description: The scheme Allotment of Canteens is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote trade and entrepreneurship by allotting canteens for selling tea and other food items to eligible residents of Uttarakhand through a fair and transparent tender process.
benefits: The scheme facilitates the promotion of trade in tea and other food items by allotting canteens to eligible residents of Uttarakhand.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Madhya Pradesh Fasal Vividhikaran (Crop Diversification) Encouragement Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Madhya Pradesh Fasal Vividhikaran (Crop Diversification) Encouragement Scheme" was launched by the Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide encouragement for crop diversification in Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides support primarily for Human Resources (Manav Sansadhan) deployed for area overlap and Marketing (Vipanan)Rs. and necessary inputs provided to farmers to motivate diversification. The applicant must be an eligible CompanyRs. FirmRs. or Institution that fulfills certain conditionsRs. such as maintaining recordsRs. advising farmers on Agriculture Practices (Krishi Karyapranali)Rs. and arranging for the purchase of the crops. The scheme is implemented under the overall supervision of the DirectorRs. Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department. The applications for this scheme are accepted by presenting the Detailed Project Report (DPR) to the DirectorRs. Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department.
benefits:
- The scheme permits the costs incurred for necessary inputs provided to farmers to inspire them towards diversification. - The scheme primarily sanctions costs related to Human Resources (Manav Sansadhan) deployed for area overlap and Marketing (Vipanan). - The scheme generally does not sanction Capital (Poonji) expenditure. - Capital expenditure may be sanctioned only in special circumstances for Critical Equipment. - Assistance from the State Government is provided for a minimum period of 3 years. - The period of assistance may be extended based on specific needs. - The applicant organizationRs. if eligible for other Central Government or State Government schemes for capital investmentRs. will be facilitated to receive such assistance.
***Conditions*** - _The implementation and monitoring of the scheme must ensure that work is carried out according to the determined directions and guidelines of the State Level Project Screening Committee (SLPSC)._ - _The proposal submitted by the applicant must detail the viability (Vyavsayata) and provide justification (Aparikshan) for the Proposed Expenditures (Prastavit Vyay)._ - _If the applicant CompanyRs. FirmRs. or Institution violates the conditions of the sanctionRs. especially the terms of the Detailed Project Report (DPR)Rs. provision will be made for regulatory action or recovery of funds._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a CompanyRs. FirmRs. or Institution. - The applicant must maintain all records and qualifications as a qualifying CompanyRs. FirmRs. or Institution. - The applicant must advise the farmer regarding the sowing of the 'Eligible Crop' and the associated Agriculture Practice (Krishi Karyapranali). - The applicant must confirm the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'. - The applicant must execute the crop diversification work. - The applicant must make a mandatory tie-up with another CompanyRs. FirmRs. or Institution for the purchase of the 'Eligible Crop'. - The applicant must ensure they themselves do not purchase the crop. - The Eligible Crop must be any cropRs. excluding wheat (Gehun) and paddy (Dhan)Rs. that is sown in place of wheat and paddy. - The Eligible Crop must not be covered under Minimum Support Price (MSP). - Horticultural crops must also be included in the Eligible Crops.

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Electricity Duty
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy on Electricity Duty component of the scheme offers eligible Cold Chain Units a 100% reimbursement of the electricity duty paid on High Tension electricity connectionsRs. subject to an annual ceiling of 5Rs./- per unit. The applicant must be operating a Cold Chain Unit and must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of the Logistics And Warehousing PolicyRs. 2023Rs.. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate Of IndustriesRs. TradeRs. And Commerce (DITC). The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa online single-window system.
benefits: - Reimbursement equivalent to 100% of the electricity duty paid on High Tension electricity connections procured from the State's power distribution department. - This reimbursement is subject to a ceiling of 5Rs./- (Indian Rupees Five Lakhs) per unit per year. ##### ***Disbursal*** - The reimbursement pertains exclusively to the electricity duty component paid within the total electricity bill for the stipulated billing period and does not extend to other charges imposed by the States power distribution department. - Reimbursement is restricted to the total electricity duty paid over the course of the most recent 12 consecutive months. - The billing period must fall after the notification date of the Logistics And Warehousing PolicyRs. 2023. - Electricity duty paid for residential and colony power consumptionRs. as well as open access powerRs. shall not be considered for reimbursement under this policy. - Each entity is entitled to benefit from this scheme once per year. ##### ***Conditions*** - The entity must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The entity must provide a minimum of 40% local employment. (The quantum of benefits will be defined by the proportion of Goan employees on payrolls: 60% or above results in 100% benefit quantum; more than 40% but less than 60% results in 80% benefit quantum; less than 40% results in ineligibility). - The entity must allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate Of IndustriesRs. TradeRs. And Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilization of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government. - The entity must submit all necessary reportsRs. information and documents specified under the scheme or as required or directed by the Directorate Of IndustriesRs. TradeRs. And Commerce. - The entity shall pay back the financial incentives received if it is found that the information or documents submitted are incorrectRs. or if the benefit was obtained by misrepresenting facts.
eligibility: - The applicant must be operating a Cold Chain Unit. - The applicant must be seeking reimbursement for electricity duty paid on High Tension (HT) electricity connections procured from the State's power distribution department. - The applicant must be applicable only for non-mega industries. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics And Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics And Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN) and should regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be a new or existing entity that involves expansion or diversificationRs. contingent upon compliance with all other conditions specified in this policy. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics And Warehousing PolicyRs. 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses (electricity duty paid) post the date of launch of the Logistics And Warehousing PolicyRs. 2023Rs.. - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). ****The benefits under this scheme are subject to first come first serve basis subject to availability of funds in a particular fiscal year.***

name: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Charges
brief_description: The Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. The Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Charges component of the scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing Stamp Duty and Registration Charges paid by prospective developers engaged in the establishment of Logistics and Warehousing projects. The scheme provides 100% reimbursementRs. capped at 10Rs./- for Stamp Duty and 10Rs./- for Registration ChargesRs. available one time per componentRs. applicable on eligible purchases or leases of landRs. buildingsRs. or sheds. The scheme is implemented by The Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce (DITC). The applications for this scheme are accepted through the Goa Online Single-Window System.
benefits: **Stamp Duty Reimbursement:** 100% subject to a maximum of 10Rs./-. **Registration Charges Reimbursement:** 100% subject to a maximum of 10Rs./-. - The reimbursement is applicable on the purchase of land meant for use in logistics and warehousing. - The subsidy covers Stamp duty for the lease of Land/Shed/Building paid for a year. - Stamp duty is reimbursed in respect of bonds or mortgage deeds executed in favour of Economic Development Corporation Limited (EDC Ltd.) and scheduled commercial banks. - Stamp duty is reimbursed for lease deed documents in respect of allotment of plots and sheds by Goa Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC). - The reimbursement is applicable to all eligible New Entities and expansion/Diversification projectsRs. regardless of whether the land paid for is Private land or Government land. - The reimbursement is available one time for Stamp Duty and one time for Registration Charges. - Eligible Entities must submit their claims in the prescribed application form (ANNEXURE-VIII) through the designated Goa Online Portal. - Entities should only apply for the subsidy after the completion of construction of the project and the commencement of commercial operations.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an eligible Entity providing Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must be a non-mega industryRs. meaning projects with investment less than 1Rs./- and/or employment generation less than 1000 Goans. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses for Stamp Duty and Registration Charges after the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have provided a minimum of 40% local employment (Goan employees). - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of the State or Central Government. - The applicant must apply for the subsidy only after the completion of construction of the project. - The applicant must apply for the subsidy only after the commencement of commercial operations. - The applicant must be a prospective developer engaged in the establishment of Logistics and Warehousing projectsRs. as delineated in [Table 6.1](https://goaprintingpress.gov.in/downloads/2526/2526-27-SI-OG.pdf).- The applicant must seek reimbursement for Stamp Duty and Registration Charges that have been duly paid to the State Registrar. ##### ***Preference/Priority*** - The benefits under this scheme are subject to first come first serve basisRs. contingent upon the availability of funds in a particular fiscal year. - The applicant is eligible for 100% of the benefit amount if the quantum of Goan employment on payrolls is 60% or above. - The applicant is eligible for 80% of the benefit amount if the quantum of Goan employment on payrolls is more than 40% but less than 60%.

name: Development of Manures & Fertilizers: Assistance for construction/Installation of Organic Manure Units
brief_description: The scheme Development of Manures & Fertilizers" was launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Assistance for Construction/Installation of Organic Manure Units" component of the scheme aims to aid in the conversion of available on-farm organic waste into chemical-free organic manureRs. providing quality organic farming inputs for sustainable agriculture. The payment of the sanctioned subsidy is through the Electronic Clearance System (ECS). The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via the Zonal Agriculture Officer.
benefits: - Construction/Installation of organic manure units would be provided 75% subsidy limited to Rs. 1950/- per cu.mt. for Organic manure unit for all categories of farmer. - The standard cost for Organic manure unit would be Rs. 2600/- per cu. mt which includes 90% cost on construction/installation including mason cost and 10% on cultureRs. decomposing materialRs. etc. - The unit can have one or more pits with or without internal chambers and preferably be above ground levelRs. of bricksRs. laterite stonesRs. cement blocksRs. shahabadi/kadappa or RCC cement rings with clean internal side walls and should have adequate protection from sun and rain. - The portable organic manure unit of HDPE material and laid on prepared surface free from sharp objects and should be protected from rodentsRs. maximum of 3 units would also be considered for subsidy @90% subsidy on the standard cost fixed and maximum amount of Rs. 7Rs./- per farmer.
eligibility: - Any farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State of Goa and having a Krishi card. - Institutions and private limited companies involved in agricultural activities and having a Krishi card will also be assisted under this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana" was launched by the Public Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial support to parents or couples who have only daughters. The scheme provides a recurring monthly pension amount of 500/- (Rupees 500) to the eligible recipient or couple. The applicant must be a resident of the stateRs. and one member of the applying couple or the single individual must have a minimum age of 60 years. The scheme is implemented by the appropriate government departmentRs. and applications are primarily accepted via the official portal at www.mpedistrict.gov.in or via designated offline channels.
benefits: - A monthly pension amount of 500/- (Rupees 500) is provided. - The benefit is provided monthly. - The funds are deposited into the joint savings account of the applicant couple or the single applicant's account maintained at a nationalized bank or Post Office. _*The beneficiary must continue to fulfill the established eligibility criteria as defined in the rules so that the benefits are not recalled._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradeah. - The applicant couple or the single applicant must have a minimum age of 60 years for at least one person at the time of application. - The applicant couple or the single applicant must have only daughters. - The applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line category.

name: Manav Garima Yojna SCW (EBC)
brief_description: The Manav Garima Yojna SCW (EBC)" scheme is launched by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to help economically backward class (EBC) people live with dignityRs. become self-employed in small businessesRs. and achieve financial self-sufficiency. Through this schemeRs. various business tool-kits are provided to members of the economically backward class so they can start income-generating activities and reduce dependence on wage labour.
benefits: 1. The primary benefit is the provision of various business tool-kits to eligible beneficiaries so that they can engage in small business activities and become self-employed and financially self-sufficient. 1. The tool kits are given under the scheme targeted at the Economically Backward Class (EBC).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Economically Backward Class (EBC). 1. The applicants annual individual and family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Mukhya Mantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana was launched by the Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to incentivize farmers based on the cost of cultivationRs. increase in productivityRs. and the Fair Average Quality (FAQ) of their agricultural produce. The scheme provides varying financial incentives per quintal for registered farmers who sell specific crops during designated marketing seasonsRs. including 265/- per quintal for wheat and 100/- per quintal for gramRs. lentilRs. and mustard in Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18Rs. and 200/- per quintal for paddy (Kharif 2016) and wheat (Rabi 2016-17). The applicant must be a registered farmer who has sold their eligible produce during the designated period and whose bank account details have been authenticated for receiving the incentive amount. The scheme is implemented by the Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development DepartmentRs. Madhya Pradesh Government. The applications for this scheme are accepted based on prior registration under the e-Upajan Scheme and verified sales data recorded through Agricultural Produce Market Committees (Mandis) or procurement centers.
benefits:
- An incentive amount of 200/- per quintal is provided for Paddy cultivated during Kharif 2016. - An incentive amount of 200/- per quintal is provided for Wheat cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2016-17. - An incentive amount of 265/- per quintal is provided for Wheat cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18. - An incentive amount of 100/- per quintal is provided for GramRs. Lentil (Masur)Rs. and Mustard (Sarson) cultivated during Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18.
***ModeRs. FrequencyRs. and Time of Disbursal*** - **Mode of Disbursal:** Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) or National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT).- **Frequency:** One-time payment per eligible season/crop (Implied).- **Time of Disbursal:** Actions for depositing the incentive amounts for Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 crops (WheatRs. GramRs. LentilRs. Mustard) must be completed by 10 June 2018.
***Conditions*** - The incentive amount is granted for Wheat sold by registered farmers in the Agricultural Produce Market Committee (Mandi) or through procurement between 15 March 2018 and 26 May 2018. - The incentive amount is granted for GramRs. LentilRs. or Mustard sold by registered farmers in the Agricultural Produce Market Committee (Mandi) or through procurement between 10 April 2018 and 9 June 2018. - The benefit is paid regardless of whether the produce was sold at the Agricultural Produce Market Committee below the Minimum Support Price or above the Minimum Support Price. - The bank account of the beneficiary farmer must be authenticated and verified by the relevant authorities.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a registered farmer. - The applicant must have registered for the e-Upajan Yojana. - The applicant must be registered in the e-Upajan system within the specified period (e.g.Rs. between 28 March and 26 May for Wheat eligibility in Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18). - The applicant must have cultivated and sold the eligible crops (PaddyRs. WheatRs. GramRs. LentilRs. or Mustard) during the specified marketing season. - The applicant must sell the produce up to the limit of their registration/productivity/production capacity. - The applicant must have sold Wheat during the Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 between 15 March 2018 and 26 May 2018 to receive the 265/- per quintal incentive. - The applicant must have sold GramRs. LentilRs. or Mustard during the Rabi Marketing Season 2017-18 between 10 April 2018 and 9 June 2018 to receive the 100/- per quintal incentive.

name: Deendayal Upadhyay Gram Jyoti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Deendayal Upadhyay Gram Jyoti Yojana launched by the Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. aims to improve rural power supply through feeder separationRs. meteringRs. system strengtheningRs. and electrification works by providing free electricity connections to below-poverty-line households.
