benefits: - **Free Electricity Connection:** Free electricity connections are provided to 3Rs. beneficiaries living below the poverty line. - **Intensive Village Electrification:** A total of 17Rs. villages are covered under the scheme for comprehensive electrification. - **Strengthening of Power Infrastructure:** Feeder separationRs. meteringRs. and distribution system strengthening works are carried out to ensure a reliable power supply.
eligibility: - The applicant should be residing in a rural area. - The applicant should belong to the Below the Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Weekly Iron Folic Acid Tablets Free Distribution - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Weekly Iron Folic Acid Tablets Free Distribution is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The initiative aims to improve the health and nutritional status of school-going children by preventing and reducing iron deficiency anemia.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. teachers distribute free iron and folic acid tablets every Monday to all students enrolled in government and government-aided schools across the state.
eligibility: 1. All students enrolled in government and government-aided schools in Uttarakhand are eligible under this scheme.

name: Rural Business Incubators - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Rural Business Incubators was introduced by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment in Uttarakhand by providing aspiring and existing entrepreneurs with free of cost technicalRs. businessRs. legalRs. marketingRs. and mentorship.
benefits: This is an innovative initiative of the Rural Development DepartmentRs. under which entrepreneurs are provided with free of cost technicalRs. businessRs. and legal adviceRs. marketing supportRs. and mentorship through the incubator.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand and interested in starting or expanding a business in the state. - The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. - The applicant may belong to any of the following categories: - A member of a self-help group (SHG) in the state who wishes to start a business. - An individual already running a business and seeking to expand it. - An individual seeking technical or vocational training. - An individual requiring assistance in preparing a business plan. - An individual seeking guidance on legal procedures related to business. - An individual aiming to enhance the market reach of their products or services.

name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Mazdoor Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Majdoor Yojana" was launched by the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide various benefits to workers engaged in the unorganized sector within the state. The scheme provides increased remuneration for Tendu leaf pluckersRs. seasonal bonusesRs. freezing of old electricity billsRs. subsidized flat-rate electricityRs. and e-rickshaws for cycle rickshaw drivers. The applicant must be a workerRs. must not be in any type of government serviceRs. must not be a taxpayerRs. and must not possess agricultural land. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline at Gram Panchayat Secretary offices in rural areas and Nagar Panchayat/Municipality offices in urban areas.
benefits: - The old electricity bills of the laborers will be frozen. - Electricity will be available to them at a flat rate of 200/- per month. - E-rickshaws will be provided to cycle rickshaw drivers. - The remuneration for laborers engaged in Tendu leaf plucking work will be increased from 1Rs./- per standard sack to 2Rs./- per standard sack. - A seasonal bonus will be given to Tendu leaf pluckers.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an unorganised worker. - The applicant must not be in any type of government service. - The applicant must not be a taxpayer. - The applicant must not possess agricultural land.

name: Grant of Stipend to Junior Advocates Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Grant of Stipend to Junior Advocates Scheme" was launched by the Law DepartmentRs. UT of Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide for monthly financial assistance to 25 numbers of young Junior Advocates in the Union territory of PuducherryRs. every year. The scheme provides monthly financial assistance of 5Rs./-Rs. payable to the eligible Junior Advocates for a period of two years or till starting independent practiceRs. whichever is earlier. The scheme is implemented by the Law Department of the UT of Puducherry. The applications for this scheme are accepted in the month of April every year.
benefits: - The scheme provides a stipend of 5Rs./- per month with effect from 01.04.2019. - The previous stipend amount was 3Rs./- per month from 01.01.2018 to 31.03.2019. - The stipend is provided to 25 eligible Junior Advocates every year. ##### ***Benefit Disbursal*** - **Duration Limit:** The assistance is provided for a period of two years or till starting independent practiceRs. whichever is earlierRs. calculated from the date of passing the All India Bar Examination.- **Mode:** The stipend amount shall be released by Direct Benefit Transfer method.- **Review:** The performance of Junior Advocates shall be reviewed once in six months before further extending the stipend period.- **Undertaking Required:** Disbursement is made only after obtaining an Undertaking from the beneficiary. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary must comply with Rule 6 of these rules during the period of financial assistance. - The Junior Advocate must regularly attend the Free legal aid camps conducted by the Union territory of Puducherry Legal Services Authority. - The Junior Advocate must conduct the legal aid cases allotted to him/her by the Legal Aid Committee and the respective Courts. - The Junior Advocate must assist the Courts as an Intern. - The Junior Advocate must regularly attend the Chamber of the Senior Advocate with whom he is attached. - The Junior Advocate must obtain a regular practice certificate every three months from the President/Secretary of the Bar Association concerned. - The Junior Advocate must assist on rotation basisRs. the Government Pleader / Public Prosecutor or Additional Government Pleader / Additional Public Prosecutor or Assistant Government Pleader or Assistant Public Prosecutor within the concerned area of practice at least for a period of three months. - The beneficiary must undertake to refund the entire stipend receivedRs. along with 6% Simple Interest to the GovernmentRs. in the event they leave the profession within a period of five years from the date of his/her enrolmentRs. unless they have entered Government service.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a native by birth or resident of the Union territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of five years. - The applicant must have pursued a Law degree in any Government Law College. - The applicant must be a Law Graduate. - The applicant must have enrolled in the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. - The applicant must have passed the All India Bar Examination conducted by the Bar Council of India. - The applicant's family income must not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must not be above 30 years of age. - The applicant must comply with the rules of the [scheme guidelines](https://law.py.gov.in/docs/Stipend.pdf) during the period of financial assistance. ##### ***PreferenceRs. PriorityRs. ReservationRs. RelaxationRs. EarmarkingRs. etc.*** - **Reservation:** The Rule of reservation notified by the UT of Puducherry for Government employment shall be followed.- **Earmarking:** One-third of the beneficiaries shall be women.- **Selection Criteria (Merit):** Selection will be based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination (Bachelor's Degree in Law).- **Selection Criteria (Merit):** Selection will be based on the marks secured in the 12th Standard Board examination.- **Selection Criteria (Merit):** Negative marks will be applied for additional attempts in the qualifying examination.

name: Union Home Ministers Medal for Excellence in Police Training
brief_description: The scheme "Union Home Ministers Medal for Excellence in Police Training" was launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to recognize the importance of training and the trainers in police organizations and make training a respectable assignmentRs. in addition to promoting the quality of training in police training institutes in the country. The scheme provides recognition through the award of a MedalRs. a Certificate (Scroll) signed by the Union Home MinisterRs. and a one-time cash award of 25Rs./-. The applications for this scheme are accepted via nominations called by the Bureau of Police Research & Development from StatesRs. Union TerritoriesRs. Central Police OrganizationsRs. and Central Armed Police Forces.
benefits: - The MedalRs. named the "Union Home Ministers Medal for Excellence in Police Training". - A Certificate (Scroll) signed by the Union Home Minister. - A one-time cash award of 25Rs./- will be awarded to each winner along with the medal. - The names of such medal Awardees shall also be published in the Gazette of India. ##### ***Tally and Categories of Medals*** - A total of 167 medals will be awarded under various categories (based on sanctioned strength as on 01.01.2013). - The number of Medals will be reviewed after every 3 years or whenever there is a major change in the strength of the force. - Medals are divided into three categories to ensure representation of everyone involved in police training: **Indoor Trainers:** This covers all trainers who impart classroom trainingRs. including practical classes (e.g.Rs. LawRs. InvestigationRs. Forensic Science). **Outdoor Trainers:** This covers trainers who impart field training (e.g.Rs. Physical TrainingRs. DrillRs. WeaponsRs. Field Craft). **Others:** This covers all those assisting in the process of successful running of the training programmesRs. such as supervisorsRs. plannersRs. ministerial staffRs. and other support staff (e.g.Rs. help in practical classesRs. manning of training cellRs. hostelRs. mess). - The quota of Medals for StatesRs. Union TerritoriesRs. and Central Police Organizations under each category is: Indoor40%Rs. Outdoor40%Rs. and Others20%. - The quota of Medals for Central Armed Police Forces under each category is: Indoor30%Rs. Outdoor50%Rs. and Others20%. - The number of Gazetted Officers (GOs) to be awarded Medals will not be more than 50% of the total number of Medals awarded over a 10 year block commencing from the year 2014-2015. - Wherever only indoor training is being providedRs. the quota for outdoor medals will be merged with indoor Medals. ##### ***Conditions*** - The Union Home Minister is competent to withdraw the medal if the holder is found guilty of disloyalty. - The Union Home Minister is competent to withdraw the medal if the holder brings the force to disreputeRs. such as removalRs. major penaltyRs. or criminal offence. - The Union Home Minister is competent to withdraw the medal if the holder exhibits any conduct found unbecoming in the opinion of the Government of the State or the Union.
eligibility: - The nominee must have completed a minimum of five years of service in the police department. - The officer must have completed a minimum of two years of service in the training institute continuously as on the 1st of April of the year of consideration. - The total length of service in training institutes (same or more number of institutes) must not be less than three years. - No Judicial Proceedings must have been in pendency against the recommendee at the time of considering his/her name for the Medal. - No Departmental Enquiry must have been in pendency against the recommendee at the time of considering his/her name for the Medal. - The period of punishment must not be in currency against the recommendee at the time of considering his/her name for the Medal. - The recommendee must not have been given any major penalty in the last five years. - The recommendee must not have been given any minor penalty in the last five years. - The recommendee must not have been awarded the Home Ministers Medal for Excellence in Training on previous occasions. - The Annual Confidential Report grading of the nominee should be Outstanding or Very Good in three years out of the last five years. - The Annual Confidential Report grading of the nominee should be Good in the remaining two years. - There should not be any adverse entry in the last five years. ##### ***Withdrawal/Recalling Conditions*** - The Union Home Minister is competent to withdraw the medal if the holder is found guilty of disloyalty or brings the force to disreputeRs. such as removalRs. major penaltyRs. or criminal offence. - The Union Home Minister is competent to withdraw the medal if the holder exhibits any conduct found unbecoming in the opinion of the Government of the State or the Union.

name: Nashamukt Gram Panchayat Puraskar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Nashamukt Gram Panchayat Puraskar Yojana Rules 2018" was launched by the Government of Madhya PradeshRs. effective from February 16Rs. 2018. The scheme aims to provide encouragement toward making the state drug-freeRs. by annually awarding the "Nashamukt Gram Panchayat Puraskar" to one Gram Panchayat in each district that performs excellent work toward de-addictionRs. where resident youthRs. elderlyRs. and women are living a drug-free life. The applications for this scheme are accepted by the Collector of the respective district.
benefits: - **Cash Award:** 1Rs./- per district per Panchayat.- **Certificate of Appreciation:** A certificate detailing the Gram Panchayat's outstanding work.- **Travel Expenses:** Coverage of coming and going travel expenses for the related Sarpanch (Head of the Gram Panchayat). ##### ***Disbursement Conditions*** - **Mode and Time:** The (Cash Award) must be provided to the related Sarpanch (Head of the Gram Panchayat) for the Gram Panchayat within one month of being selected for the award.- **Mode:** The award amount must be given via Cheque or Bank Draft or Real Time Gross Settlement (R.T.G.S.).- **Deposit:** The cash award must be deposited into the Gram Panchayat's bank account.- **Certificate Presentation:** The certificate of appreciation must be presented at a ceremony organized on Republic Day.- **Travel Reimbursement:** Travel expenses must be paid by the Collector to the related Sarpanch (Head of the Gram Panchayat) upon attending the Republic Day ceremony at the District Headquarters.
eligibility: - The applicant must represent a Gram Panchayat of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must submit their application based on work performed and achievements realized in the previous year. - The Gram Panchayat must have one hundred percent (100%) of its population living a drug-free life after giving up intoxication. - The Gram Panchayat must include all villages under its jurisdiction. - The Gram Panchayat must have taken action under the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and CommerceRs. ProductionRs. Supply and Distribution) Act 2003. - The Gram Panchayat must have provided treatment for habitual addicts by admitting them for medical care in De-addiction cum Rehabilitation Centers. - The Gram Panchayat must ensure that students studying in all schools operating within the Panchayat area are motivated against and resolved not to consume intoxicants. - A news item should have been published about the drug-free Gram Panchayat in daily newspapers or magazines.

name: Award Scheme to Encourage Entrepreneurs - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Award Scheme to Encourage Entrepreneurs is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Department under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to recognize exceptional craftsmanship among registered artisans and weavers in Uttarakhand by encouraging innovationRs. creativityRs. and excellence in the handicrafts and handloom sectors through state and district-level awards.
benefits: ***Nature of the Award:*** ***1. State Level Award*** **For the best artisans in the handicraft sector:** - First Prize: 15Rs./- - Second Prize: 10Rs./- - Third Prize: 7Rs./- ***For the best weavers in the handloom (cotton and woolen) sector:*** - First Prize: 15Rs./- - Second Prize: 10Rs./- - Third Prize: 7Rs./- ***2. District Level Award*** **For the best artisans in the handicraft sector:** - First Prize: 6Rs./- - Second Prize: 4Rs./- ***For the best weavers in the handloom (cotton and woolen) sector:*** - First Prize: 6Rs./- - Second Prize: 4Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered artisan or weaverRs. or an industry registered as Handloom Weaver/Handicraftsman under the Directorate of IndustriesRs. UttarakhandRs. or the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts/Handloom)Rs. Government of India. 1. The applicant must be an individual artisan or weaver belonging to a registered handicraft or handloom cooperative societyRs. or a registered non-governmental organization (NGO) within the state of Uttarakhand to be eligible for the award. 1. The artisans/weavers cooperative society or institution must not be a loan defaulter with any department or bank. 1. An artisan/weaver who has already received an award cannot apply again for the next three consecutive years.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Purchase of Tourist Taxi
brief_description: The Purchase of Tourist Taxi component forms part of the umbrella scheme Tribals Development PlanRs. launched by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa. This sub-scheme aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) families by providing financial assistance to purchase tourist taxis for self-employment in Goas growing tourism industry. It supports tribal households in transitioning from traditional occupations to sustainable livelihood opportunities through the transport sector. Eligible beneficiaries receive a subsidy of 15Rs./- from the Directorate of Social Welfare (DSW) in addition to any applicable assistance under the Central Governments Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY). The component is implemented through the District Rural Development Agencies (DRDAs) and the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. and applications are accepted offline at district and taluka-level offices.
benefits: - **For BPL families:** A total subsidy of 25Rs./-Rs. comprising 10Rs./- from the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) under the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) and 15Rs./- from the Directorate of Social Welfare (DSW).- **For non-BPL tribal families** (with annual income < 1Rs./-): A subsidy of 15Rs./- from DSW.- The subsidy is a one-time financial assistance towards the cost of purchasing a tourist taxi for livelihood use. - **Target Beneficiaries per Year:** 50 tribal households. _*The vehicle must be registered and operated as a tourist taxi under applicable transport regulations._ _*The vehicle must be used solely for livelihood/self-employment by the beneficiary._ _*The subsidy is non-recurring and can be availed only once per household._ _*Misuse or transfer of vehicle ownership within the benefit period may lead to withdrawal or recall of the assistance._
eligibility: - The applicant must belong to one of the Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities of GoaGawdaRs. VelipRs. or Kunbi. - The applicant must be a resident of Goa. - The applicants annual family income must be less than 1Rs./-. - The applicant must be part of a tribal household identified under the Tribals Development Plan. - The applicants family must fall under either: (a) the Below Poverty Line (BPL) categoryRs. or (b) the non-BPL category with annual income < 1Rs./-. - The applicant must intend to use the vehicle for self-employment in the tourism/transport sector. - The applicant must possess or obtain a valid driving licence and vehicle registration documents prior to benefit disbursal.

name: Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Lakhpati Didi Yojana is implemented by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme was launched by the Honorable Prime Minister of India with the primary objective of improving the economic status of women and enabling them to become Lakhpatis. Under this initiativeRs. the Honorable Chief Minister of Uttarakhand has committed to enabling 1.5 lakh women members to achieve the status of Lakhpati Didis by 2025. As part of the schemeRs. the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission has already recognized 40Rs. women associated with self-help groups as Lakhpati Didis in 2022-23 and 52Rs. women in 2023-24.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. to brand and market the products manufactured by self-help groupsRs. the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission has established 17 Saras CentersRs. 2 state-level Uttara outletsRs. 24 Growth CentersRs. and 7 Millet Bakeries. AdditionallyRs. the groups products are sold at various Saras MelasRs. helping to increase their income and improve their livelihoods.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a woman associated with a self-help group. 1. Women beneficiaries from hilly and plain areasRs. aged between 18 and 65 yearsRs. are eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme.

name: Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations
brief_description: The Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to honor and support soldiers and ex-servicemen who have been conferred with gallantry awards for their acts of bravery and distinguished service.
benefits: **One-Time Grant Assistance:** - Depending on the category of the gallantry awardRs. a one-time grant ranging from 20Rs. to 12Rs. is provided to the awardee. **Monthly Allowance:** - Soldiers or ex-servicemen receive a monthly allowance between 5Rs. and 1Rs. based on the class of gallantry decoration received.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a serving or retired soldier/ex-serviceman who has received a Gallantry Award recognized by the Presidents Secretariat.

name: Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand scheme is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI)Rs. mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districtsRs. Scheduled Castes/TribesRs. and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories. **(Note: At presentRs. all willing farmers are being benefited under this scheme.)**
benefits: - To encourage the cultivation of herbsRs. a 50% government subsidy will be provided on herbal plantation materialsRs. inputsRs. and related items. - By distributing seeds/saplings of medicinal plants such as AtisRs. KutkiRs. KuthRs. JatamansiRs. ChiraytaRs. Van KakriRs. PyrethrumRs. TaggarRs. ManjithRs. ColeusRs. SarpagandhaRs. ShatavarRs. SilybumRs. PippaliRs. Mandukparni/BrahmiRs. AmymesusRs. SteviaRs. and Tilpushpi up to 3 naliRs. and seeds or saplings of medicinal and aromatic plants such as FeranRs. Black CuminRs. Large CardamomRs. RosemaryRs. GeraniumRs. LemongrassRs. ChamomileRs. Bay LeafRs. and Amymesus up to 5 nali free of costRs. farmers are encouraged to cultivate medicinal and aromatic plants and are motivated towards self-employment. - To extend the subsidy facilities provided by the State and Central Governments to farmersRs. ensure the availability of technical informationRs. provide training facilitiesRs. offer the benefits of processing systemsRs. and prepare documentation and a database of cultivation activities.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and must have legally measured land in their name. 1. The applicant must be interested in the cultivation of herbs.

name: Training Classes In Veda/Devaram
brief_description: The scheme "Training Classes in Veda/Devaram" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme offers specialized training classes in VedaRs. DevaramRs. and Nalayira Divya Prabantham. These subjects are required for divine worship/Poojas. The classes are conducted in various Saivaite and Vainavaite temples in the Puducherry region to provide instruction to eligible candidates. The instructing pandits (teachers) are provided an honorarium of 1Rs./- per month. Applications are collected by receiving them from some of the important temples of the Puducherry region.
benefits: - Provision of training classes in VedaRs. DevaramRs. and Nalayira Divya PrabanthamRs. which are required for divine worship/Poojas. - Instructing pandits are provided an honorarium of 1Rs./- per month. - The honorarium is given once every three months. - The honorarium is disbursed upon the pandits furnishing attendance particulars of the students who attended the Veda classes.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an eligible candidate to receive the training. - The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry. - The applicant must know how to readRs. writeRs. and speak Tamil fluently. - The applicant must be interested in receiving specialized training classes in VedaRs. DevaramRs. and Nalayira Divya Prabantham.

name: E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana was launched by the Cooperative DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among unemployed youth in the state by providing affordable loans for the purchase of e-rickshawsRs. thereby enhancing their livelihoods.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. loans are provided to unemployed youth for the purchase of e-rickshaws at an annual interest rate of 9%. AdditionallyRs. under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima YojanaRs. savings account holders receive an insurance cover of 2.00 lakh for an annual premium of 12/-. - Beneficiaries aged between 18 and 50 can also avail benefits under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana by paying a premium of 330/- through their savings accounts.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant should be currently unemployed. - The applicant must possess a valid driving license. - The applicant must not be more than 55 years of age.

name: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to revive the traditional Goan cottage industry of clay idol making and motivate local artisans by providing financial support through subsidies. It addresses the decline of this art form due to competition from cheaper alternatives such as Plaster of Paris and polyfibre. The scheme provides a subsidy of 100/- per idol and grants up to 15Rs./- per artisan annually. The applicant must be a traditional clay idol maker registered with the Goa HandicraftsRs. Rural and Small Scale Industries Development Corporation Limited (GHRSSIDC) and must produce idols within Goa. The scheme is implemented through GHRSSIDCRs. and applications are accepted offline.
benefits: - Subsidy of 100/- per clay idol made by registered artisansRs. with minimum idol size of 1 foot. - Maximum subsidy limit: 15Rs./- per artisan per year. - Applicable only for idols actually produced and sold within the State of Goa. **Disbursement:** Cheque in favour of the artisan after fund receipt from Government. **Availment:** Beneficiaries must maintain sale records and provide proof of production and sale as prescribed.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a traditional clay idol maker or artisan from the State of Goa. - The applicant must be registered with GHRSSIDC as a clay idol manufacturer. - The applicant must personally manufacture idols within Goa; imported or traded idols are not eligible. - The applicant must have a workshop or production unit within Goa for manufacturing idols such as GaneshRs. DurgaRs. SaraswatiRs. or Mother Mary. - The subsidy is applicable only for idols used for religious purposes (e.g.Rs. Ganesh ChaturthiRs. Christmas) and not for decorative items. - The applicant must maintain records of idols produced and soldRs. including sizeRs. priceRs. buyer detailsRs. and sale date. - The applicant must comply with physical inspection by GHRSSIDC officials.

name: Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers
brief_description: The "Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers" was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to develop the Dairy sector and make Goa self-sufficient in milk production by encouraging farmers to engage in dairy businessRs. thereby making it more lucrative and increasing local milk production. The applications for this scheme are accepted through the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital via the registered cooperative society/groupRs. which submits monthly reports for payment processing.
benefits: - A composite subsidy amounting to 40% (forty percent) of the proceeds of milk supplied to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group. - Incentive on milk: 32.28% (thirty-two point two eight percent). - Incentive on cattle feed: 7.72% (seven point seven two percent). - The scheme is linked to the cattle feed subsidy scheme. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Monthly disbursement of benefits to beneficiary's Bank account via Electronic Clearing System (ECS). - The beneficiary must have a Bank account in any Bank having a core banking system/Electronic Clearing System (ECS). ##### ***Mandatory Obligations*** - The beneficiary must produce their own milk at their Dairy Farm. - The beneficiary must not procure milk from others and pour it to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group in their name. - The quantity of milk supplied and the number of milch animals reared by the farmers will be checked by the departmental area officer in addition to the supervisor/officials from the concerned organization. - In case of any fraud or malpractice regarding milk supply or animal countRs. the Department shall stop the composite subsidy (incentive on milk and feed) forthwith. - If fraud or malpractice occursRs. the benefit of all schemes will be withdrawn. - In matters of fraud or malpracticeRs. the decision of the Director will be final and binding on the party.
eligibility: The applicant must be a farmer from Goa. The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Goa for at least the preceding five years. The applicant must be a member of the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group registered with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services. The applicant must register their Dairy Farm with the Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital. The applicant must own a cattle shed with milch animals. The applicant must produce their own milk (and not procure milk from others then pour it to the group/society in their name). The applicant must be mandatorily registered with the Agricultural DepartmentRs. as an Agriculturist under the Agricultural Database.

name: National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana - Pink Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana Pink Ration Card) is implemented by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies & Consumer AffairsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. each Pink Ration Card holder receives 35 kg of food grains (13.30 kg of wheat at 2.00 per kg and 21.70 kg of rice at 3.00 per kg) along with 1 kg of sugar at 13.50 per kg. At presentRs. from 1 January 2023Rs. food grains are being distributed free of cost to all ration card holders in the state.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must belong to the Antyodaya category of the state. 1. The following families/persons are eligible under the Antyodaya category: - Families in which any member is eligible for a disability pension and the total monthly family income is less than 4Rs./-. - BPL families. - Individuals infected with HIV.

name: Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for new enterprises to establish MicroRs. SmallRs. or Medium units and for expansionRs. modernizationRs. or diversification by existing units. The scheme provides financial assistance for acquiring fixed assets such as purchasing landRs. constructing buildingsRs. and procuring machineryRs. equipmentRs. electricalsRs. and miscellaneous fixed assets. The scheme is implemented by PIPDICRs. and applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance (Term Loan) up to a maximum of 10Rs./- per project. - Loan proceeds may be used for acquiring fixed assetsRs. including the purchase of landRs. construction of buildingsRs. and procurement of machineryRs. equipmentRs. electricalsRs. and miscellaneous fixed assets. - The maximum repayment period is 8 yearsRs. which includes a maximum moratorium period of 2 years. ##### ***Benefit Disbursement Criteria*** - The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) must be 3:1 for loans up to 25Rs./-. - The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) must be 2:1 for loans above 25Rs./-. ##### ***Conditions*** - Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered as per the lending policy of the corporation. - The valuation of properties offered as security must be assessed by engaging Chartered Engineers or valuers from the approved panel of the Corporation. - In respect of immovable property situated in the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. the value of the property offered must be not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned. - In respect of immovable property situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. the value of land with building offered must be not less than 150% of the loan amount. - If the property offered outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only landRs. its value must be not less than 200% of the loan amount. - For units promoted by WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. or Differently Abled personsRs. the value of the property to be offered as collateral security is fixed at 50% of the loan amount.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to the Small Scale or Medium Scale sector. 2. The applicant organization must be one of the following forms: - Proprietary Concern - Partnership Firm - Co-operative Society - Private Limited Company - Public Limited Company 3. The loan application purpose must be for one of the following purposes: - Setting-up New Small-Scale Units - Setting-up New Medium Scale Units - Expansion of Existing Units - Modernization of Existing Units - Diversification of Existing Units - Any other activities eligible for assistance under the scheme. 4. The total project cost ceiling must not exceed 20Rs./-.

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Self-Employment Programme Uttarakhand
brief_description: The "Self-Employment Programme" is an initiative under the Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)Rs. implemented by the Nagar Nigam Dehradun under the Department of Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable livelihoods and economic empowerment of the urban poor by providing financial support and guidance for establishing self-employment venturesRs. strengthening their familys economyRs. and generating new employment opportunities.
benefits: - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**Rs. the beneficiary in urban areas enhances their livelihood while strengthening their own and their familys economic condition. - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**Rs. the beneficiary is provided a loan of up to 2.00 lakh through the bank. - There is a provision for interest subsidy under the **Self-Employment Programme**Rs. where 7% of the interest is borne by the beneficiary and the remaining is shared by the Government of India and the State Government. - **Under the Self-Employment Programme**Rs. the beneficiary can generate new employment and also expand existing employment opportunities.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary is eligible for this scheme under the municipal body area. 1. The annual income of the beneficiary's family must be less than 3.00 lakhRs. as per the standards of the Government of India.

name: Aawasiy Suvidha 1 Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing)
brief_description: The scheme Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing) is implemented by the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority under the Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration process and lottery-based allotment.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. residential facilities are provided to homeless families.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees" was launched by the Hindu Religious Institutions and Wakf DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme aims to grant financial assistance to the family of the temple employee who expires while in service. The scheme provides an amount of 5Rs./- under the Group Insurance Scheme and an amount of 20Rs./- under the Chief Ministers Welfare Fund. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits: **Financial Benefit:** An amount of 5Rs./- is granted under the Group Insurance Scheme. **Financial Benefit:** An amount of 20Rs./- is granted under the Chief Ministers Welfare Fund. **Intended Use of Benefit:** The amounts are granted to the family of the temple employee who expire while in service.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a family member of the deceased employee of the temple. - The temple employee must have died while in service.

name: Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme" was launched by the Department of IndustriesRs. Trade & CommerceRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage industrial units and eligible service providing units/institutions operating in the State of Goa to obtain National and International CertificationRs. maintain requisite standards of qualityRs. promote technological up-gradationRs. and encourage the registration of Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) to enhance competitive strength and protect innovation. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for actual expenditure incurred in acquiring recognized certifications and covers professional and registry fees related to IPR registrationRs. subject to specific monetary ceilings for the entire validity period.
benefits: - Reimbursement of charges to the extent of 100% of actual expenditure per certification. Subject to a combined ceiling of 8Rs./- only for the entire period of the scheme. - Reimbursement of 50% of the professional fees for registration and fees paid to the registry for registration of Intellectual Property Rights. Subject to a maximum ceiling of 15Rs./- for the entire period of the scheme. ##### ***Conditions for Disbursement*** - _The reimbursement for certification will include eligible charges incurred to obtain the certificate._ - _The reimbursement for certification will not include charges of lodging/boardingRs. refreshmentRs. and travel._ - _If the applicant has availed reimbursement under any other similar scheme of the Central Government for a particular certificationRs. the reimbursement under this scheme is restricted only to the balance amount after deducting the Central Government assistance already availed._ - _The benefits under this scheme are subject to budgetary allocation._ ##### ***Post-Disbursal Obligations*** - The beneficiary shall allow and/or grant free access to any official authorized by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade & Commerce for conducting inspection/supervision of the unit or the registers or holding discussions with the employed employees for ensuring proper utilisation of the financial incentives/subsidies granted by the State Government.
eligibility: - The applicant must be one of the following - (a) An Industrial Unit in all Categories operating in Goa. (b) A Hospital recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. (c) An Educational Institution recognized by the Government of Goa and operating in Goa. - The applicant must have obtained Certification from Indian Standard Institute (ISI)Rs. International Standard Organization (ISO) or any other recognised National/International Certification for quality standards and/or Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) as accepted by the Task Force Committee. - The applicant must not have claimed this benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa. - The applicant must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information TechnologyRs. Government of Goa.

name: Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI)Rs. mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to facilitate the lawful export of endangered and CITES-listed medicinal plant species such as KuthRs. KutkiRs. etc. by issuing Legal Production Certificates (LPC) to cultivators who legally grow these species on their own measured land.
benefits: There is a ban on the export of products of certain endangered and CITES speciesRs. but the objective of this policy is to facilitate the export of endangered species like KuthRs. KutkiRs. etc. produced legally in the measured land.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be legally cultivating endangered plants such as KuthaRs. KutkiRs. etc.Rs. on their own measured land.

name: Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Registration of Herb Cultivators is implemented by the Herbal Research and Development Institute (HRDI)Rs. mandal gopeshwar chamoli under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plantsRs. make the process of using their cultivated herbs easierRs. and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests.
benefits: Registration of farmers cultivating medicinal and aromatic plantsRs. simplification of the extraction process for cultivated herbsRs. and prevention of illegal exploitation of herbal resources from forest areas.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a cultivator of medicinal and aromatic plants. 1. The applicant must either have their own resources on their measured land or be a cultivator encouraged by the Herbal Research and Development InstituteRs. or a cultivator beneficiary supported by any other organizationRs. instituteRs. departmentRs. or voluntary organization.

name: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputsRs. trainingRs. and support for marketingRs. thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided: - Pasteurized compost is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total costRs. up to a maximum of 50 quintals per beneficiary. SimilarlyRs. mushroom spawn (seed) is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total costRs. up to a maximum of 25 kg per beneficiary. No cash is given; the pasteurized compost and spawn are provided directly by the department. - Seven-day training for mushroom growers is provided (1Rs./- per beneficiary)Rs. of which 700/- is transferred to the beneficiarys account through DBTRs. and 350/- is used for training materials and related expenses. - Farmers/mushroom growers who produce mushrooms under the scheme can sell their produce in local markets or mandis.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom cultivation.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial supportRs. including an investment subsidy of 80Rs./- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable EnergyRs. Govt. of IndiaRs. specifically for Companies or Societies. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Investment subsidy of 80Rs./- is provided. - The subsidy is provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy SourcesRs. Government of India. - This investment subsidy is specifically provided only for Companies or Societies. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The applicant must provide a Promoters Contribution of 10% on the cost of the vehicle._ - _The collateral security required in the form of immovable propertyRs. if situated in the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. shall be valued at not less than the amount of the term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property used as collateral security is situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. its value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with a buildingRs. or not less than 200% of the loan amount if the property offered is only land._ - _If the unit is promoted by Women / Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Differently abled personsRs. the value of the property to be offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Puducherry.

name: Scheme Of Assistance To Good Borrowers: A Category
brief_description: The Scheme Of Assistance To Good Borrowers: A Category was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist existing units that are classified as 'A' Category Good BorrowersRs. who are existing assisted units of Medium Scale Industry and Small Scale IndustryRs. to acquire fixed assets and undertake expansionRs. modernizationRs. or replacement of machinery. The scheme provides loan limits ranging from a minimum of 5Rs./- to a maximum of 150Rs./-. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial assistance is available for a minimum amount of 5Rs./- and a maximum amount of 150Rs.. - An interest concession of 1% less than the normal rate is provided for 'A' Category borrowers. - The loan funds are intended to be used to acquire fixed assets for setting up of new units. - The loan funds are intended for expansionRs. modernizationRs. purchase of balancing equipmentRs. and replacement of machinery or equipment of existing units. - The repayment period is 3 to 5 yearsRs. excluding the moratorium period. ##### ***Conditions*** - _Fixed assets in existing units assisted by other institutions or banks must be free from encumbrance._ - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property must be offered as per the lending policy of the Corporation._ - _The value of immovable property situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry to be offered shall be not less than the amount of term loan sanctioned._ - _If the immovable property is situated outside the Union Territory of PuducherryRs. the value must be not less than 150% of the loan amount in the case of land with building._ - _If the immovable property situated outside the Union Territory of Puducherry is only landRs. the value of the same shall be not less than 200% of the loan amount._
eligibility: - The applicant must be an existing assisted unit classified as A Category. - The applicant must be an existing assisted unit of Medium Scale Industry or Small Scale Industry classified as A Category. - The existing assisted unit must be in operation for more than 3 years. - The existing assisted unit must be regular in repayment. - The existing assisted unit must be regular in repayment without availing re-schedulement. - The applicant can be an existing assisted unit by other institutions or Banks which satisfies the criteria under Good BorrowersRs. and its fixed assets must be free from encumbrance. - The applicant can be an existing transport loanee who has settled the loan promptly.

name: Scheme Of Assistance To Women Entrepreneurs (Mahalir Udavi)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme Of Assistance To Women Entrepreneurs (Mahalir Udavi)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to new or existing Micro Enterprises promoted exclusively by women entrepreneurs or consisting of a majority of women entrepreneurs. The scheme provides a loan for acquiring fixed assets and/or meeting the working capital requirement for setting up new Small Scale Industry Units or Micro EnterprisesRs. with financial assistance considered up to a maximum of 75% of the project costRs. provided the total project cost does not exceed 20Rs./-. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial assistance shall be considered up to a maximum of 75% of the project cost. - The loan is provided for acquiring fixed assets. - The loan is provided to meet the working capital requirement. - A concessional rate of interest of 0.5% less than the normal rate is charged for units promoted by Women. - A 50% concession is provided on the investigation fee. - The maximum term loan repayment period is 10 years. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The project cost shall not exceed 20Rs./-._ - _The Promoters contribution must be 25% of the project cost._ - _The Debt Equity Ratio (DER) shall be 3:1._ - _Repayment period is a maximum of 10 yearsRs. which includes a moratorium period of a maximum of 2 yearsRs. depending upon the period of implementation._ - _Collateral security in the form of immovable property shall be offered as per the lending policy of the Corporation._ - _Apart from collateral securityRs. proposed fixed assets must be covered by mortgage and/or hypothecation._ - _For units promoted by women entrepreneursRs. the value of the immovable property to be offered as collateral security is reduced and fixed at 50% of the loan amount._
eligibility: All existing and new SSI/Tiny units promoted exclusively by women entrepreneurs / consisting of majority of women entrepreneurs.

name: Scheme of Assistance to SC/ST Entrepreneurs
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme of Assistance to SC/ST Entrepreneurs" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to SC/ST Entrepreneurs for setting up new Micro Enterprises or for expansion of existing units. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: Loan of upto 2Rs./-.
eligibility: New and existing Micro EnterprisesRs. promoted by Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs.

name: Scheme for Marketing Organisations
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Marketing Organisations was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist the Individuals / Partnership Concerns / Private Limited / Public Limited Companies for setting up new sales outlets or undertaking renovation/expansion of existing outlets of marketing Village & Small Industries (VSI) products. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.
benefits: - Financial assistance is provided for the purpose of setting up new sales outlets or undertaking renovation and expansion of existing outlets for marketing Village and Small Industries (VSI) Products. - The maximum total cost of the project that can be considered under this scheme must not exceed 25Rs./-. - A down payment of at least 50% of the Value of goods purchased is mandatory.
eligibility: Individuals / Partnership Concerns / Private Limited / Public Limited Companies experienced in marketing of Village & Small Industries (VSI) products are eligible.

name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana" has been launched by the Department of EducationRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. Through this schemeRs. scholarship amounts ranging from 600/- to 2Rs./- are provided annually to eligible NCC cadets at group and unit levels. Annual cash scholarships are awarded at both group and unit levels to junior and senior division NCC cadets. The scheme is implemented by designated Group Headquarters and Unit Offices under the administrative control of the State Directorate of NCC.
benefits:
> **Group Level:**



- For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: 2Rs./-.
- For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: 1Rs./-.


> **Unit Level:**



- For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: 1Rs./-.
- For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: 600/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an NCC cadet.
1. The applicant must have passed the 10th or 12th class or an equivalent examination in the previous academic session.
1. The applicant must have completed two years of NCC training.
1. The applicant must have maintained a minimum of 80% attendance in each year of NCC training.
1. The applicant must be currently pursuing higher education.
1. The applicant must not be receiving any other general or special scholarship from the State Government.

name: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anchal Amrit Yojana" has been launched by the Department of Women Empowerment & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to improve the health of children between 3 to 6 years of age by providing them fortified and flavored milk containing Vitamins A and DRs. four days a weekRs. at Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. children between 3 to 6 years of age are provided fortified and flavored milk enriched with Vitamins A and DRs. four days a week.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a child between 3 and 6 years of age.

name: Integrated Toll Free 104 Helpline
brief_description: The scheme Integrated Toll Free 104 Helpline is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM)Rs. implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide the general public with round-the-clock (247365) access to reliable health information and medical advice through the toll-free number 104.
benefits: Under the National Health Mission (NHM)Rs. the Integrated Toll-Free 104 Helpline is being operated 247365day. Through this helplineRs. health-related advice and information can be obtained.
eligibility: 1. The general public of Uttarakhand is eligible to avail the benefits.

name: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana
brief_description: The Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schoolsRs. as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled TribesRs. and boys from the General category who fall under the Below Poverty Line category.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. two sets of uniforms per student are provided through DBT/SMC to students studying in classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schoolsRs. covering all girlsRs. all boys belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categoriesRs. and boys from the General category belonging to BPL families.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either a girl studentRs. or a boy student belonging to the Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. or General Category BPL family. 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 8.

name: Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita
brief_description: The scheme Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita is implemented by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit AcademyRs. HaridwarRs. under the Department of Sanskrit EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions. Under this schemeRs. Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories. A total of six competitions are conducted in each categoryRs. namely Sanskrit DramaRs. Sanskrit Group SongRs. Sanskrit Group DanceRs. Sanskrit DebateRs. Sanskrit Auspicious SpeechRs. and Sanskrit Shlokacharan.
benefits: Separate six Sanskrit competitions for junior and senior categories are organized at every level. The prize distribution is as follows: **Development Block Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of 300/- and maximum prize of 800/-- **Individual Competition:** Minimum prize of 300/- and maximum prize of 500/- **District Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of 400/- and maximum prize of 2Rs./-- **Individual Competition**: Minimum prize of 400/- and maximum prize of 800/- **State Level** - **Team Events:** Minimum prize of 6Rs./- and maximum prize of 25Rs./-- **Individual Competition:** Minimum prize of 2Rs./- and maximum prize of 4Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The institutional students studying in the junior classes (Class 6 to 10) and senior classes (Class 11 to post-graduation) of any governmentRs. privateRs. or non-governmental school/college in Uttarakhand are eligible to participate. 1. The students pursuing B.Ed.Rs. Ph.D.Rs. or Diploma courses are not eligible for participation.

name: Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages was introduced by the Department of Culture and EndowmentsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar YatraRs. irrespective of their religion or caste.
benefits: The Uttarakhand State Government provides financial assistance of 50Rs./- to permanent residents of the stateRs. irrespective of religion or casteRs. who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India. 1. The applicant must have undertaken the journey through the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam.

name: Paalna Ghar (Creche)
brief_description: The scheme Paalna Ghar (Creche) is implemented by the Women Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide day care facilities for children aged 6 months to 6 years of working couples.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. a creche is run for the children of working couplesRs. providing day care facilities for children in the age group of 6 months to 6 years. The following fees are applicable under the scheme: - For BPL families: 20/- per child per month - For families with an income less than 12Rs./-: 100/- per child per month - For families with an income above 12Rs./-: 200/- per child per month
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 6 years.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes)
brief_description: The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribe)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote sustainable self-employment and income generation among Scheduled Tribe individuals by supporting viable livelihood projects. Under this schemeRs. financial assistanceRs. including a bank loan is provided to the beneficiaries for setting up income-generating units with a total project cost between 50Rs. and 2Rs..
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - Project Cost: Between 50Rs./- and 2Rs./-. - Bank Loan: 60% of the project cost - Margin Money: 30% of the project costRs. repayable at 7% annual interest in 60 monthly installments - Grant: Up to 50Rs./-. > **Beneficiary Contribution:** - No contribution for project cost up to 1Rs./- - 10% contribution for project cost between 1Rs./- and 2Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 50 years.
1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 2Rs./-.

name: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
brief_description: The Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10 was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.
benefits: At presentRs. the State Government provides the following **monthly scholarships** for students from Class 1 to 10: - **Class 1 to 5:** 50/-- **Class 6 to 8:** 80/-- **Class 9 to 10:** 120/-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. ParsiRs. BuddhistRs. or Jain). 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 10. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized government/non-government educational institution in the state of Uttarakhand.

name: Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals
brief_description: The "Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals" scheme was launched by the Department of Culture and EndowmentsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals whose livelihood depends on traditional arts by providing them with essential musical instruments and costumes.
benefits: - Persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled TribesRs. whose source of income is through their traditional artRs. and who do not possess musical instruments or costumesRs. are provided with traditional musical instruments (such as DholRs. DamaunRs. MasakbeenRs. RansinghaRs. TrumpetRs. NagadaRs. ShieldRs. SwordRs. etc.) and costumes free of cost to help them sustain their livelihood. - The instruments are provided only once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a folk artist. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant's monthly income must not exceed 2Rs./-. 1. Only one set of musical instruments is provided per artist in a family under this scheme.

name: Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services
brief_description: The scheme Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of UttarakhandRs. who have represented the state in international and national gamesRs. by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. medal-winning players from Uttarakhand who have represented the state in International or National Games are provided out-of-turn employment on Gazetted and Non-Gazetted posts (from Level-3 to Level-10) across various government departments.
eligibility: 1. State players/sportspersons who have won goldRs. silverRs. or bronze medals in international or national gamesRs. such as the Olympic/Paralympic GamesRs. World Cup/World ChampionshipRs. Asian GamesRs. Commonwealth GamesRs. Asian ChampionshipRs. Commonwealth ChampionshipRs. SAF GamesRs. and National GamesRs. are eligible under the scheme. 1. Players/sportspersons participating in any of the following sports will be considered eligible: AthleticsRs. ArcheryRs. BadmintonRs. BasketballRs. BoxingRs. Canoeing & KayakingRs. CyclingRs. DivingRs. EquestrianRs. FencingRs. FootballRs. GolfRs. HandballRs. HockeyRs. JudoRs. Lawn TennisRs. ShootingRs. RowingRs. SailingRs. SwimmingRs. Table TennisRs. TaekwondoRs. VolleyballRs. WeightliftingRs. WrestlingRs. BaseballRs. ChessRs. CricketRs. KabaddiRs. KarateRs. Kho-KhoRs. and Mallakhamb. 1. The player/sportsperson must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The player/sportsperson must have represented the state of Uttarakhand in the National Games in the year and competition for which they are applying for employment.

name: Dr. V.N. Mathur Award (M.Sc. Mathematics)
brief_description: The Dr. V.N. Mathur Award (M.Sc. Mathematics) scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support and encourage meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in MathematicsRs. thereby assisting them and reducing their financial burden.
benefits: **Award Amount:** 20Rs./- per year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in an M.Sc. Mathematics course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar. 1. The financial assistance is awarded for a duration of one year only.

name: Swanath Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The Swanath Scholarship Scheme is implemented by the Department of Technical EducationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to diploma and graduate-level students who are orphansRs. whose parents or either parent has died due to COVID-19Rs. or who are dependents of martyrs from the military or central armed forces.
benefits: Eligible students at the diploma or graduation level will receive financial assistance of 50Rs./- per annum.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an orphanRs. have lost one or both parents due to COVID-19Rs. or be a dependent of a martyr from the military or central armed forces. 1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 8Rs./-.

name: Research Assistantship
brief_description: The Research Assistantship scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote higher education and research through providing research assistantship to undergraduate and postgraduate research scholars.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to undergraduate and postgraduate researchers in the form of research assistantships.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a graduate or postgraduate research scholar pursuing research at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. Pantnagar.

name: Samaaveshit Shiksha
brief_description: The scheme Samaaveshit Shiksha is an initiative under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. has been implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.
benefits: - Escort facilityRs. home-based educationRs. sports activitiesRs. exposure visitsRs. stipend for girlsRs. and free equipment are provided to all children with special needs studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12. - Marking and equipment distribution camps are also organized for such childrenRs. where assistive devices are provided free of cost as per the requirement of disabled children.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a child with a disabilityRs. aged 6 to 18 yearsRs. eligible for all facilities approved by the Government of India under the Samaveshit Shiksha scheme. 1. The applicant must be studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.

name: Sponsorship for Employment
brief_description: The scheme "Sponsorship for Employment" is implemented by Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited (UPNL) under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts. Under this schemeRs. eligible candidates are sponsored for various departmental positions based on demand and their qualifications.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. employment opportunities are provided to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts through outsourcing.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman (ArmyRs. NavyRs. or Air Force)Rs. their legal dependentRs. or a widow of an ex-serviceman (Veer Nari).

name: Allotment of Commercial Shops
brief_description: The scheme Allotment of Commercial Shops is implemented by the Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote ease of doing business for licensed traders by providing them with well-located commercial shops in market yards (mandis).
benefits: The scheme facilitates ease of doing business for traders by allotting them with commercial shops.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must hold a valid traders license issued by the Mandi Committee.

name: Son/Daughter Education Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Son/Daughter Education Assistance scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered building and construction workers pursuing education from Class I up to higher education or professional courses.
benefits: **Financial assistance for education will be provided to the children of construction workers at the following rates:** **Sl. No.****Class/Course****Financial Assistance (Yearly)**1Class 1 to 51Rs./-2Class 6 to 102Rs./-3Class 11 to 123Rs./-4Graduation/Post Graduation or its equivalent10Rs./-5ITIRs. Polytechnic courses or higher educationThe course fee will be payable to the Government Institutions / College.
eligibility: 1. The two (2) children of a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to avail benefits under this scheme. Applications must be submitted between November of the same financial year in which admission is taken (from Class 1 to Post Graduation) and June of the next academic session. Applications received after this period will not be considered by the Board. > **Financial assistance for education is provided on an annual basis.**

name: Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav
brief_description: The scheme Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and Technology DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide students from classes 6 to 12 of government/non-government schools in the remote and border districts of the state an opportunity to participate in various science competitions and promote scientific awareness in these areas.
benefits: Under thisRs. special opportunities are provided to child scientists from the border hill districts to participate in various state-level science competitions and to promote scientific awareness through activities in remote border areas.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student from classes 6 to 12Rs. studying in a government or non-government school in any of the six border districts of the state: UttarkashiRs. ChamoliRs. RudraprayagRs. ChampawatRs. BageshwarRs. or Pithoragarh.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme- On Completion Of 65 Years (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Old Age Pension Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to registered construction workers who have completed 65 years of age.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 1Rs./- Per Month
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The applicant must have attained the age of 65 years.

name: Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card
brief_description: The Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card facilities is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. Under this schemeRs. a labour card is issued to workers engaged in constructionRs. repairRs. maintenanceRs. and other construction works such as bridgesRs. roadsRs. airstripsRs. etc.
benefits: - The labour card is mandatory to avail the benefits of all schemes offered by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. - The labour card also be used as an identification document for building and construction workers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a worker engaged in constructionRs. repairRs. maintenanceRs. or related activities involving government and non-government buildingsRs. as well as other construction works such as bridgesRs. roadsRs. airstripsRs. irrigation projectsRs. water drainage systemsRs. embankmentsRs. tunnelsRs. flood control structuresRs. power generationRs. transmission and distributionRs. water worksRs. oil and gas installationsRs. damsRs. canalsRs. reservoirsRs. pipelinesRs. towersRs. television towersRs. mobile/telephone towersRs. etc. 1. The workers under MNREGA (such as labourersRs. masonsRs. electriciansRs. plumbersRs. etc.) and other construction workers are also eligible. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must possess a certificate confirming that they have worked as a construction or other related worker for at least 90 days in the previous year.

name: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Motorcycle Taxi Yojana was introduced by the Cooperative DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxisRs. thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.
benefits: - The applicant will be provided an interest-free loan for a period of 2 years to purchase scooters or motorcycles for transporting tourists/travelers from one place to another at major tourist destinations. - The loan will cover 75% of the total cost or 1.75 lakh per scooter/motorcycleRs. whichever is lower. The remaining 25% of the amount must be arranged by the applicant. - An applicant can purchase a maximum of 10 scooters/motorcycles.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years old and not more than 55 years old. 1. The applicant must possess a valid license issued by the Transport Department. 1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any financial or cooperative institution. 1. The applicant must have a minimum CIBIL (Credit Information Bureau India Limited) score of 700 or above.

name: Procedure for Making Medical Certificate (for Certifying Disability)
brief_description: The Procedure for Making Medical Certificate is implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to ensure that persons with disabilities can easily obtain authentic medical certification required to avail benefits under various social welfare schemes.
benefits: This certificate is essential to verify a persons disability and to enable them to avail the benefits of various social welfare schemes such as pensionsRs. scholarshipsRs. and reservations in employment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a person with disabilities.

name: Akhil Bharatiya Samanvit Anusandhan Pariyojana - Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry
brief_description: The Akhil Bharatiya Samanvit Anusandhan Pariyojana is implemented by the Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand.
