It aims to conduct research and improve important horticultural and forestry speciesRs. conserve their germplasmRs. provide improved seeds and saplingsRs. and train farmers in using better techniques to enhance productivity.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. research is conducted on selected speciesRs. including their conservation and germplasm preservationRs. studying possibilities for species improvementRs. quality testingRs. distribution of plantsRs. and providing training.
eligibility: 1. All farmers in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive the benefits.

name: Agricultural Investment Grant (in Case of Crop Damage of 33% or More)
brief_description: The scheme Agricultural Investment Subsidy (in Case of Crop Damage of 33% or More) is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers who suffer crop losses of 33% or more due to natural calamities such as floodsRs. heavy rainfallRs. droughtRs. hailstormsRs. or other notified disasters.
benefits: Under this scheme: - 8Rs./- per hectare is provided for AgricultureRs. HorticultureRs. and Annual Crops in unirrigated areas. A minimum of 1Rs./- is payable. - 17Rs./- per hectare is provided for Areas with Assured Irrigation. The minimum amount of assistance payable to any farmer will be 2Rs./-. - For Evergreen Crops - 22Rs./- per hectare is admissible for all types of evergreen crops. The minimum amount payable is 2Rs./-. - 6Rs./- per hectare is payable to Sericulture Farmers. - 7Rs./- per hectare is payable for eriRs. mulberry and tussar crops. - A minimum assistance of 1Rs./- is payable for Munga crops.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.

name: Financial Assistance for Natural Disaster
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Natural Disaster was introduced by the Department of RevenueRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals and families affected by natural calamitiesRs. helping them recover from losses to lifeRs. propertyRs. and livelihood.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. in case of any loss due to a natural calamityRs. financial assistance of up to 10Rs./- is sanctioned by the TehsildarRs. up to 50Rs./- by the Sub-Divisional MagistrateRs. and above 50Rs./- by the District Magistrate.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant or their family must have been affected by a natural disaster.

name: Bhesaj Krishi Vikas Yojana (Herbal Cultivation Programme)
brief_description: The scheme Bhesaj Krishi Vikas Yojana is implemented by the Bhesaj Vikas IkaiRs. UttarakhandRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote the cultivation of medicinal and herbal plants (Jadi-Buti) among local farmers and unemployed youthRs. providing sustainable employment and improving their economic well-being.
benefits: ***From the cultivation of medicinal plantsRs. the following estimated profits can be earned:*** - **Kuth species:** 1Rs./- per nali per year- **Kutki species:** 660/- per nali per year- **Big Cardamom species:** 1Rs./- per nali per year (from the fourth year onwards)- **Sarpagandha species:** 1Rs./- per nali per year- **Tejpata species:** 1Rs./- per nali per year (after ten years) ***This cultivation provides additional employment to farmers and strengthens their economic condition.***
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicant must have at least five Nali of land available. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar card. 1. The applicant must be interested in obtaining employment opportunities through herbal cultivation.

name: Spice Area Expansion
brief_description: The Spice Area Expansion scheme is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote and expand the cultivation of high-value spices such as gingerRs. chiliRs. turmericRs. and garlic among farmers by providing quality seeds and tubers at a subsidized rateRs. thereby increasing spice production and enhancing farmers income in Uttarakhand.
benefits: - To promote spice cultivation among farmersRs. spice seeds and tubers (gingerRs. chiliRs. turmericRs. and garlic) are provided at a 50% subsidy on the total costRs. up to 15Rs./- per hectare. These seeds are available for a maximum of 4 hectares of land. - For exampleRs. if 1 kg of ginger costs 200/-Rs. the farmer pays 100/- to the concerned Horticulture Mobile team CenterRs. while the government bears the remaining 100/- as a subsidyRs. allowing the farmer to obtain the tuber for 100/-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.

name: Vegetable Area Expansion
brief_description: The Vegetable Area Expansion scheme is implemented by the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote and expand vegetable cultivation across the state by providing seasonal vegetable seeds to farmers at a 50% subsidy.
benefits: - To promote vegetable productionRs. seasonal vegetable seeds are provided to farmers at a 50% subsidy. Farmers are required to apply approximately two months before planting seasonal vegetables. - For exampleRs. if a packet of bottle gourd seeds costs 200/-Rs. the farmer pays 100/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team CentreRs. while the government bears the remaining 100/- as a subsidyRs. allowing the farmer to receive the seeds for 100/-.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card. 1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease. 1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 2 hectares.

name: Maternity Financial Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Maternity Financial Assistance scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered women construction workers during the maternity period. This assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.
benefits: 6Rs./- per child (limited to a maximum of two children).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a woman construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Financial assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region
brief_description: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Education and the University Grants Commission. Taking special interest with regard to the promotion of higher education in the NERRs. i.e. for improving the GERRs. promoting higher educationRs. and encouraging children belonging to the economically weaker sections of the NE regionRs. the UGC has decided to launch Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region from the academic session 2014-15. Before launching the scheme the UGC undertook wide-ranging consultations with State Governments and Central & State Universities of the NE regionRs. the Ministry ofRs. the Ministry of Development of North Eastern RegionRs. the North Eastern CouncilRs. ShillongRs. and other stakeholders. The scholar would be awarded from the date of joining the courseRs. as certified by the University/Institution/ College. > **Objectives:** - To provide equal opportunities for higher studies in the NE Region. - To increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in the NE Region. - To focus more on professional education in the NE Region. - Optimum utilisation of NER Budgetary Allocation. > **Scope:** Ten thousand (10Rs.) fresh scholarships every year for general degree coursesRs. and technical and professional coursesRs. including medical and paramedical courses as certified by the Registrar/ Principal/ Director of University/ College/ Institute.
benefits: 1. UGC will award 10Rs. (ten thousand) fresh scholarships per year. 1. 5Rs./- per month for general degree courses and 7Rs./- per month for technical/medical/professional/paramedical courses. 1. The scholar would be awarded from the date of joining the courseRs. as certified by the University/Institution/ College. 1. Scholarship (as certified by the institutions identified under this scheme) will be paid to the selected students by the UGC through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) Mode and will be transferred to the Bank account of the beneficiaries. This procedure will be completed through the PFMS.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a domicile of NER. 1. The parental annual income of the applicant should not exceed 4Rs./- per annum from all sources. 1. The applicant should have passed Class 12th or equivalent in the preceding year of study for applications called for the present year. 1. The applicant should have secured admission in the first year of any degree courseRs. either a general degree course of 1. The scholarship shall only be provided for general degree coursesRs. and technical and professional coursesRs. including medical and paramedical coursesRs. as certified by the Registrar/ Principal/ Director of University/ College/ Institute in any of the following universities/colleges/institutes: - Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under Section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act. - Deemed to be Universities included under Section 3 of the UGC ActRs. 1956 and eligible to receive grants-in-aid from UGC. - Universities/Institutions/Colleges funded by the Central / State Government. - Institutes of National Importance. - Institutions recognised by other Statutory councils within as well as outside. - The admission should have been made to a University/ Institution/ College with the AISHE code. > **Renewals:** - Scholarship granted under the scheme will be renewed during the period of the first degree courseRs. subject to good conduct and maintenance of prescribed attendance. - The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of an annual progress report to be granted by the administrative head of the University/ Institution/College.(E.g. Registrar of a University/ Director of the Institution/ Principal of the College or any other officer designated by them). - Students failing to get promoted to the next class/ level would forfeit the scholarship. - Change in course of study will not be permitted. If the awardee changes the course of studyRs. the scholarship will stand forfeited from the date of such a change. - The Scheme will be implemented and monitored by the UGC. - The awardees of previous years will continue to follow the UGC pattern of assistance through the designated bank branches of Canara Bank. > **Note:** - For students of integrated degree coursesRs. the scholarship will be tenable for the complete duration of the course. - For dual degree coursesRs. the scholarship will only be tenable for the tenure of the first degree. - Transgender candidates are eligible to apply under the scheme. The reservation shall be followed as per the Government of India norms. - Distribution of slots amongst the states of NER will be done on the basis of population census(last). - If slots in a particular state remain vacant due to the non-availability of eligible candidatesRs. the unfilled slots will be distributed equitably amongst other states. - Reservation for Persons with Disability (PwD) will be made as per the Government of India norms.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: The Scheme Prime Ministers Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) was introduced from the Academic year 2006-07 by the Department of Ex-servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India. The scheme is being implemented to encourage technical and post-graduate education for the widows and wards of the deceased/ex-service personnel of Armed Forces. The scheme is funded out of National Defence Fund administered by Prime Ministers Office. Scholarships are available for education at various technical institutions (medicalRs. dentalRs. veterinaryRs. engineeringRs. MBARs. MCA and other equivalent technical institutions having AICTE/UGC approval). The Scheme is managed by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB).
benefits: ***Amount of Scholarship (Paid annually):*** - 2Rs./- per month (For Boys) - 3000/- per month (For Girls) ***Notes:*** 1. A total number of 5500 wards/ widows of Ex-servicemen are selected for scholarship in each academic year. 1. Scholarships are equally divided amongst boys and girls i.e. 2750 each. 1. Scholarships are paid for a period of two to five years as per the duration of the courses approved by the concerned government regulatory bodies. 1. Scholarship amount is paid annually to the selected students. 1. The payment is made through ECS into the bank account of the selected students.
eligibility: 1. Students who have taken admission in 1st year i.e. current financial year (except Lateral Entry) are only eligible to apply for PMSS. 1. Students should have scored 60% and above in Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/ Diploma/ Graduation. 1. Students who are Dependent Wards/ Widows of Ex-servicemen & Ex-Coast Guard personnel are eligible to apply under the scheme. 1. Master Degree Courses are not eligible for PMSS except MBA / MCA Courses. 1. Scholarship can be availed by student for One Course only. ***Priority for Grant of Scholarship:*** - **Category 1** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel killed in action. - **Category 2** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel disabled in action and boarded out of service with disability attributable to Military/ Coast Guard service. - **Category 3** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel who died while in service for causes attributable to Military / Coast Guard Service. - **Category 4** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel disabled in service with disability attributable to Military/ Coast Guard Service. - **Category 5** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel in receipt of gallantry awards. - **Category 6** - Wards / Widows of ESM/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel (PBOR Only). ***Eligible Courses:*** The Eligibility Criteria for[ PMSS Courses](https://ksb.gov.in/writereaddata/DownLoad/List_of_Authorised_professional_degree_courses_under_PMSS.pdf) are as follows: - First Professional Degree Courses including integrated degree courses as per PMSS approved list of courses like BERs. B.TechRs. BDSRs. MBBSRs. B.EdRs. BBARs. BCARs. B PharmaRs. BA.LLBRs. etc. duly recognized by the respective Government Regulatory BodiesRs. such as the All India Council for Technical EducationRs. National Medical CommissionRs. UGC etc. ***Scholarship for Integrated Courses:*** Selection of candidates seeking PMSS for pursuing dual degree integrated courses will be governed by under mentioned parameters: - Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) will be 10+2. - For Integrated courses scholarship will be paid for the full duration of the course except internship period as per PMSS approved list of courses. ***Minimum Eligible Marks in MEQ:*** - Minimum Educational Qualification (MEQ) for entry to various professional courses differs e.g. for MBBS it is 10+2 whereas for BE/B Tech it is 10+2 / DiplomaRs. for B.Ed and MBA it is graduation qualification. - A candidate must have minimum 60% marks in MEQ to apply for PM Scholarship Scheme. All subjects will be taken for calculation of 60% marks including optional subjects also and not out of best subjects. - Wherein both marks and CGPA are mentioned in the mark sheetRs. then the marks is being taken for calculation of percentage. - Wherein only CGPA/grade points are mentioned in the mark sheetRs. in such cases the student is required to upload the university issued percentage conversion formula along with mark sheet.

name: Refinance Scheme for Acquisition of ISO 9000 Certification for SSI Unit (ISO 9000)
brief_description: The "Refinance Scheme for Acquisition of ISO 9000 Certification for SSI Unit (ISO 9000)" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist the existing industrial concerns in the SSI sector for the expenses on consultancyRs. documentationRs. auditRs. certification feesRs. equipmentRs. and calibrating instruments required would be taken into account for determining the loan requirement. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: The need-based loan under the scheme would be provided for meeting the expenditure on ConsultancyRs. DocumentationRs. AuditRs. Certification FeesRs. Equipment and Calibrating Instruments.
eligibility: - The scheme is applicable to the existing industrial concerns in the SSI sector. - The concern must have a good record of past performance and sound financial position. - The concern should have been in operation for a period of atleast four years. - The concern should have earned profit and / or declared dividend during the preceding two financial years. - The concern should not be in default to institution / banks in payment of their dues and - The concern should have been exporting their products directly or indirectly or have plans to manufacture products for exports.

name: Financial Assistance for Setting Up of Cold Storage
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance for Setting Up of Cold Storage" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist the Proprietary/Partnership ConcernsRs. Public/Private Limited CompaniesRs. Co-operative SocietiesRs. Market CommitteesRs. BoardsRs. and Agro Industries Corporations. The assistance is provided for setting up of Cold Storage facilities. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** Minimum of 2Rs./- and maximum as applicable to term loans. **Loan Purpose:** For setting up of Cold Storage facilities. **Repayment:** 8 years including moratorium period of 2 years.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to the Proprietary/Partnership ConcernsRs. Public/Private Limited CompaniesRs. Co-operative SocietiesRs. Market CommitteesRs. BoardsRs. and Agro Industries Corporations.

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Purna Aahaara for Children (6 months - 5 years)
brief_description: The Purna Aahaara for Children (6 month - 5 years) scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. implemented by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme follows a community-based approach for the management of acute malnutrition and aims to provide nutritional support to Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) children. Purna Aahaara is an initiative erstwhile Community Management of Acute Malnutrition (CMAM) programme.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per monthRs. along with 30 eggs per monthRs. for a duration of 112 days from the date of enrollment. **Note:** Parents and caregivers are requested to have their children's growth monitored at Anganwadi Centre (AWCs) and take special care of them.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 5 years. 1. The child must be identified as Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) by an Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

name: Ashirbad: Scheme for Specially Cared Children
brief_description: The scheme Ashirbad: Scheme for Specially Cared Children has been launched by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to provide a safety cover and ensure welfare for children who lost both parents or the primary bread earner in their family during the COVID-19 pandemic. The Government of Odisha is committed for the welfare of these specially cared children. To provide a safety cover to these childrenRs. Govt has taken various initiatives in the pastRs. particularly support under Biju Sishu Surkshya YojanaRs. Juvenile Justice Fund and Child protection scheme. The present scheme reinforces the commitment of the Govt to bring positive development in their life. Ashirbad scheme aims for in-situ rehabilitation and continuation of their life in similar family based non-institutional socio-cultural environmentRs. where ever feasible and in the best interest of the childRs. and to ensure that care givers and other kith and kins are encouraged to provide best of the care to these children.
benefits: > **Categories of Beneficiaries:** - **Category 2(A):** Children who have lost both parents on or after 1 April 2020.- **Category 2(B):** Children who have lost a single parent (including cases where the death of the other parent occurred earlier).- **Category 2(C):** Children who have lost one parent who was the primary bread earner and continue to live with the remaining parent. 1. **Children under Kith and Kin Care (Category 2(A) & 2(B)):** 2Rs./- per month till the child attains 18 years of age or till adoptionRs. whichever is earlier. The amount is electronically transferred to the bank account of the caregiver's family towards the maintenanceRs. healthRs. and education of the child.1. **Children in Institutional Care (Category 2(A) & 2(B)):** 1Rs./- per month till the child attains 18 years of age or till adoptionRs. whichever is earlier. The amount is deposited as a recurring deposit in the bank account of the childRs. in addition to free care and protection under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) ActRs. 2015.1. **Children Living with Remaining Parent (Category 2(C)):** 1Rs./- per month till the child attains 18 years of age. The amount is transferred electronically to the bank account of the remaining parent or child towards maintenanceRs. healthRs. and education. (The financial support discontinues if the child is surrendered and placed for adoption.) > **Additional Benefits:** - Coverage under Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (State Health Assurance Scheme). - Entitlement under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or the State Food Security Scheme. - The child will be facilitated to continue his/her study free of cost in the same school where he/she was going before the death of the second parent. In case the child is shifted to another place where the kith and kin are living. The child will be admitted to a similarly placed school as far as possible. If requiredRs. the child will be assisted for admission in OAVRs. KV or any other Govt school within their criteria. - For higher educationRs. linkage with the Green Passage Scheme of the Department of Higher Education. - Eligibility for benefits under Biju Shishu Surakshya YojanaRs. Juvenile Justice FundRs. and other Government schemesRs. if eligible. - Caregiver families receive priority assistance under Pradhan Mantri Awas YojanaRs. Biju Pakka Ghara YojanaRs. or other relevant schemes if eligible. - Protection of the childs assets and properties is ensured by the Child Welfare Committee (CWC) in coordination with DCPURs. TahasildarRs. and Police. - Personalised attention and regular follow-up by DCPU to ensure proper care and protection.
eligibility: The beneficiaries must be children requiring special care who have faced difficulties due to the demiseRs. on or after 1st April 2020Rs. of: A. Both parents; B. A single parent (including cases where the death of the other parent occurred earlier); or C. One parent who was the primary breadwinnerRs. where the child continues to live with the surviving parent.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Stocking - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Fish Seed Stocking is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Under this schemeRs. 100% financial assistance for fish seed stockingRs. including transportation costsRs. is provided to beneficiaries from Scheduled Tribes involved in inland fisheries. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: The 100% assistance is provided to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries for the cost of fish seed including transportation under the Fish Seed Stocking component. > **Validity:** Minimum 1 year required before reclaiming benefits under this component again.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private unitsRs. etc.Rs. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribes. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary fisherman must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.

name: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Fish Seed Rearing - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Fish Seed Rearing is a component under the To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas schemeRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for fish seed rearing to Scheduled Tribe fishermenRs. individualsRs. and other eligible inland fisheries units. > **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in fresh water bodies. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in ponds and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribe fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: - **Rearing from spawn to fry:** The beneficiary will receive 90/- per 1Rs. numbers. with a minimum 30% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 3Rs. spawnRs. and the rearing time will be 30 days.- **Rearing from fry to fingerlings:** The beneficiary will receive 260/- per 1Rs. numbers. with a minimum 35% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 2Rs. fryRs. and the rearing time will be 60 days.- **Rearing from spawn to fingerlings:** The beneficiary will receive 460/- per 1Rs. numbers. with a minimum 12% recovery. Each beneficiary will be allocated 5Rs. spawnRs. and the rearing time will be 90 days. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefits can be reclaimed after a minimum of 1 year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be Individuals/societies/self-help groups/associations/reservoir monopolies/private unitsRs. etc.Rs. involved in inland fisheries activities can avail the benefits of inland schemes. 1. The applicant must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years. 1. The beneficiary must have his/her own bank account. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.

name: Scheme for Purchase of 4 Wheeler for Own Use
brief_description: The "Scheme for Purchase of 4 Wheeler for Own Use" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC)Rs. Department of Industries & CommerceRs. Puducherry. The scheme aims to assist Qualified Personnel in MedicineRs. ManagementRs. AccountancyRs. EngineeringRs. ArchitectureRs. etc. and Good Borrowers of the Corporation (Industrial Units) for purchase of New Four Wheeler Vehicle (Air Conditioned or Non-air-conditioned) for own use. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.
benefits: **Loan Limit:** Upto 75% of the cost of vehicle. **Interest Concession:** 1% for Good Borrowers of A category and 0.5% for B category.
eligibility: The scheme is applicable to Qualified Personnel in MedicineRs. ManagementRs. AccountancyRs. EngineeringRs. ArchitectureRs. etc. and Good Borrowers of the Corporation (Industrial Units).

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (6 months - 3 years)
brief_description: The Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (6 months 3 years) scheme is a component under the "Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana (MSPY)" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomesRs. with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 6 months and 3 years.
benefits: - **Monthly entitlements for SUW & MAM children in the 6 months to 3 years category for a period of 75 days will be as follows:** **Sl. No.****Type of Take Home Ration (THR)****Quantity**1Type of Chhatua to be decidedQuantity to be finalised2Besan-Atta Premix500 gram3Banana10 pieces4Eggs16 pieces - **Date of delivery:** Modified Chhatua & Besan Atta Premix will be provided to the beneficiaries at the Anganwadi Centre (AWC) on the 1st of every month. - **Other services:** Growth monitoring at AWCsRs. home visits of Anganwadi Workers (AWWs) counselling sessions will also be provided. - **Duration of coverage:** 75 days from the date of enrollment. After graduating to normal categoryRs. the child will continue to get Take Home Ration under the Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP) programme. - During this period (i.e.) from the day of enrolmentRs. regular SNP entitlements will be discontinued. - Regular growth monitoring and medical examination of all SUW & MAM children will be undertaken monthly during the VHSND by Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) and on the event of any medical complications child needs to be referred to the Community Health Centre (CH). - If the child has not graduated to normal category or cured even after 75 days of enrolmentRs. the child may be referred to the nearest CHC and based on the suggestion from the doctorRs. the child can be again enrolled under MSPY for one more cycle only.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 3 years. 1. The child must be identified as Severely Underweight (SUW) or Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) by the Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of Heritage Hotel where the Heritage Assets are obtained from Tourism Department on Lease
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of Heritage Hotel where the Heritage Assets are obtained from Tourism Department on Lease" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage private investment in the conservation and operationalization of heritage properties owned by the government by converting them into heritage hotels. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% against fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./-. The applicant must invest a minimum capital expenditure of 10Rs./- in the project approved by the department. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the State Government's Invest Portal.
benefits: - The scheme provides a capital subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment made in the project. - The maximum ceiling for the capital subsidy is 5Rs./-. - SC/ST category entrepreneurs who establish the tourism project under 100% ownership shall be entitled for an additional 5% capital investment subsidy. - Projects established in distant and ulterior areas are entitled to an additional 5% Capital Investment Subsidy. ##### ***Disbursal Conditions*** - _The unit must operate continuously for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The unit must submit a self-declaration on or before the 15th of April every year regarding the continuous operation of the unit._ - _If the unit closes within 1 year of receiving the subsidyRs. 80% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 2 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 60% of the amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 3 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 50% of the amount must be refunded._ - _Any unit claiming Investment Promotion Assistance (for Large/Mega projects) shall not be entitled to capital subsidy under this scheme._ - _If the unit is entitled to a grant/subsidy in more than one categoryRs. the applicant must choose only one category._
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a Heritage Hotel project. - The applicant must have obtained the Heritage Assets from the Tourism Department on a lease basis. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 10Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must be a private investorRs. which may include a proprietary concernRs. partnership firmRs. companyRs. or other legal entity. - The applicant must have obtained the heritage asset through the open bidding process conducted by the Empowered Committee. - The applicant must execute and operate the entire project in one goRs. or the capital expenditure incurred up to a maximum of 05 years prior to the commencement of the unit will be considered for the calculation of the capital grant. - The applicant must ensure the project is certified as a heritage hotel by the Tourism Department based on the framed rules and procedures.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of New Hotel or Mini Resort of Standard Category
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy for Establishment of New Hotel or Mini Resort of Standard Category" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% against fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 50Rs./-. The applicant must invest a minimum capital expenditure of 2Rs./- and ensure the availability of a minimum of air-conditioned lettable rooms (25 for hotels or 10 for resorts). The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted within one year from the date of commencement of operation.
benefits: - The scheme offers a Capital Investment Subsidy of 15% against the fixed Capital Investment. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 50Rs./-. ***Conditions*** - It is mandatory for the unit to run for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy. - The unit must submit a self-declaration on or before the 15th of April every year regarding the continuous operation of the unit. - If the unit closes within 1 year from the date of receipt of subsidyRs. 80% of the subsidy amount must be refunded. - If the unit closes within 2 years from the date of receipt of subsidyRs. 60% of the subsidy amount must be refunded. - If the unit closes within 3 years from the date of receipt of subsidyRs. 50% of the subsidy amount must be refunded.
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a new Hotel or Mini Resort of Standard category. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 2Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the Hotel has a minimum of 25 air-conditioned lettable rooms. - The applicant must ensure the Resort has a minimum of 10 air-conditioned lettable rooms. - The applicant must mandatorily provide employment to 70% residents of Madhya Pradesh for new Standard hotels. - The applicant must submit the application for subsidy within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must ensure the investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation is not included in the capital subsidy calculation.

name: Mukhya Mantri Vidyarthi Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Vidyarthi Kalyan Yojana is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to school and college students in the form of scholarships. The scheme provides scholarships of upto 2Rs./- per month to the students from IRDP/BPL Families bonafide in Himachal PradeshRs. and pursuing their study in Government / Government Aided Institutions in Himachal Pradesh.
benefits: > **Rates of Scholarship (per annum)** - Class 9th & 10th: Boys: 300/-Rs. Girls: 600/-. - Class 11th & 12th: Boys: 800/-Rs. Girls: 800/-. - College/University (Day Scholar): Boys: 1Rs./-Rs. Girls: 1Rs./-. - College/University (Hostelers): Boys: 2Rs./-Rs. Girls: 2Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant should be a bonafide of Himachal Pradesh. - The applicant should be a Student. - The applicant should belong to an Integrated Rural Development Program (IRDP) Family. - The applicant should be studying at the 9th to University Level. - The applicant should be pursuing their study in Government / Government Aided Institutions in Himachal Pradesh. - The applicant should have a Bank Account.

name: Banishree Scholarship
brief_description: A Scheme of Scholarship for Students with special needs in the name of "**Banishree Scheme**" has been introduced by the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities DepartmentRs. Government of OdishaRs. to assist and encourage students to study as well as acquire technical/ professional/ vocational training. This scheme aims to offer some special allowances to disabled children so that they can pursue their education without any financial crunch.
benefits:
**Rates of Scholarship**
**A. Inside the State:**

1. Primary (Standard I to V): 400/-
1. Middle and High School (Standard VI to VIII and IX to XI) (Not covered by the Government of India Scholarship) : 500/-
1. College (+2 & +3) (Not covered by the Government of India Scholarship) : 600/-
1. College (P.G.) (Not covered by the Government of India Scholarship) : 700/-
1. Technical and vocational training (Not covered by Govt. of India Scholarship) : 700/-

**B. Outside the State:**

1. Students prosecuting normal course of study or technical/vocational/professional education/training not available in the State and not covered by Govt. of India Scholarship shall get 250 per month.
1. In case of visually challenged candidatesRs. Readers Allowance shall be paid at 200 per month for primary classes and 300 per month for middle and high school classes and 400 per month for other studiesRs. if it is certified by the head of the institution that the candidate has continuously employed a reader during the period of studyRs. subject to the condition that such assistance is not availed of from Govt. of India.
1. In case of orthopedically handicapped student who has 75% or above disabilities requiring special arrangements for transportRs. an additional monthly allowance of 200 per month may be sanctioned for transportRs. if it is not covered by the scheme of integrated education.
eligibility: **The scheme shall apply to students:** 1. Pursuing primary education (Std. I to V). 1. Reading in middle & high schools (std. VI to X)Rs. 1. Not covered by Govt. of India Scholarship. 1. Reading in colleges/universitiesRs. not covered by Government of India Scholarship. 1. Reading in special schools registered under PWDRs. Act 1995Rs. but not receiving grant-in-aid from State/ Central Govt. 1. Pursuing distance education through recognized universities/Govt. institutes. 1. Pursuing technical/ vocational/ professional education in any of the recognized institutes. **For the purpose of award of scholarship under the schemeRs. applications can be submitted subject to fulfilling the following conditions:** 1. The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Odisha. 1. The applicant should be a regular student of an educational institution. 1. The parental/family income of the applicant is not more than 60Rs./- per annum. 1. The applicant is not receiving any financial assistance/stipend/scholarship from State Government/ Central Government under any other scheme. 1. The student will continue to get the scholarship if he enrolls and regularly attends any recognized institution irrespective of whether he has passed or not in a particular year.

name: Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation of Infrastructure Along With Installation of Equipment To Establish Film Studio, Film Making, Museum, Aquarium, Theme Park
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation of Infrastructure Along With Installation of Equipment To Establish Film StudioRs. Film MakingRs. MuseumRs. AquariumRs. Theme Park" was launched by the Tourism DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of 15% on fixed capital investmentRs. subject to a maximum ceiling of 5Rs./-Rs. to encourage the establishment of niche tourism projects. The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- as approved by the department to be eligible for this specific subsidy. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism BoardRs. and applications for this scheme are accepted online through the state's investment portal.
benefits: - The beneficiary will receive a subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment approved by the department. - The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is 5Rs./-. ##### ***Conditions*** - _It is mandatory for the unit to operate for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit on or before the 15th of April every year._ - _If the unit closes within 1 year of receiving the subsidyRs. 80% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 2 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 60% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._ - _If the unit closes within 3 years of receiving the subsidyRs. 50% of the subsidy amount must be refunded._ - _Any unit claiming Investment Promotion Assistance is not entitled to capital subsidy under this policy._
eligibility: - The applicant must establish a new project in one of the following categories: Film StudioRs. Film MakingRs. MuseumRs. AquariumRs. or Theme Park. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of 1Rs./- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project falls within the definition of "Tourism Projects" as determined by the Tourism Department. - The applicant must be a legal entity such as a Public/Private Limited CompanyRs. Partnership FirmRs. Proprietary ConcernRs. or other registered legal entity. - The applicant must submit the application for the capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must maintain the investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation for calculating the capital subsidy. - The applicant must not have claimed capital subsidy/investment promotion assistance for the same project from any other category under the policy.

name: Capital Subsidy to Existing Hotels for Renovation/Modernization & Upgradation
brief_description: The scheme "Capital Subsidy to Existing Hotels for Renovation/Modernization & Upgradation" was launched by the Department of TourismRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to encourage the renovationRs. modernizationRs. and upgradation of existing hotels and resorts into Deluxe or higher category hotels through private investment. The scheme provides a capital subsidy calculated as per the tourism policy guidelines for the respective categoryRs. subject to specific investment and capacity milestones. The applicant must be an existing hotel or resort unit making a minimum capital investment of 10Rs./- or 25Rs./- depending on the upgradation category. The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Madhya Pradesh Government's Invest Portal.
benefits: ##### **Subsidy For Upgradation To Deluxe Hotels** Existing standard hotels (minimum 50 rooms) and mini resorts (minimum 20 rooms) upgrading to Deluxe Hotels/Resorts are eligible for capital subsidy as per the tourism policy under such category. ##### **Subsidy For Upgradation To 4-Star or Higher** Existing Deluxe hotels and resorts upgrading to 4-star or higher category Hotels (minimum 75 rooms) or Resorts (minimum 25 rooms) are eligible for capital subsidy as per the tourism policy under such category. ##### **Additional Subsidy** An additional 5% Capital Investment Subsidy shall be given to tourism projects established in distant and ulterior areas. ##### **Conditions** - _It will be mandatory for all unitsRs. who have availed subsidy to run the units at least for three years from the date of availing the subsidy._ - _Such units will submit a self-declaration on or before 15th of April every year regarding continuous operation of the unit._ - _On non-compliance regarding the closure of the unitRs. the investor shall have to return the subsidy amount as follows:_ - _Closure of unit within 1 year from the date of receipt of subsidy: 80% amount of subsidy has to be refunded._ - _Closure of unit within 2 years from the date of receipt of subsidy: 60% amount of subsidy to be refunded._ - _Closure of unit within 3 years from the date of receipt of subsidy: 50% amount of subsidy to be refunded._
eligibility: - The applicant must be an existing Standard Hotel or Mini Resort to apply for Category A upgradation. - The applicant must ensure the upgraded facility meets the criteria for Deluxe Hotels (minimum 50 rooms) or Resorts (minimum 20 rooms) under Category A. - The applicant must make a minimum investment of 10Rs./- to be eligible for the subsidy under Category A. - The applicant must be an existing Deluxe Hotel or Resort to apply for Category B upgradation. - The applicant must ensure the upgraded facility meets the criteria for 4-star or higher category Hotels (minimum 75 rooms) or Resorts (minimum 25 rooms) under Category B. - The applicant must make a minimum investment of 25Rs./- to be eligible for the subsidy under Category B. - The applicant must claim subsidy only on capital investment made after the enforcement of this Policy. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within 1 year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must not claim Investment Promotion Assistance if they are claiming capital subsidy under this policy.

name: Dulari Kanya
brief_description: Announced on 15th August 2016 by the Honble Chief Minister of Arunachal PradeshRs. Dulari Kanya is a scheme for the girl child by the Directorate of Family WelfareRs. Department of Health & Family Welfare of the Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to end the preference between male and female childRs. encouragement of institutional deliveryRs. immunization of childrenRs. to end child marriage and overall empowerment of females in all spheres of their life. An amount of 20Rs./- shall be deposited in the fixed deposit Bank Account (Minor Account) of the girl child born in any Government Hospital or Government recognised private hospital. Maturity amount can be withdrawn by the beneficiary on attaining the age of 18 yearsRs. which would be subject to verification by the concerned DMO of the respective districts.
benefits:
1. An amount of 20Rs./- shall be deposited in the fixed deposit Bank Account (Minor Account) of the girl child born in any Government Hospital or Government recognised private hospital.
1. Maturity amount can be withdrawn by the beneficiary on attaining the age of 18 yearsRs. which would be subject to verification by the concerned DMO of the respective districts.
eligibility:
1. The girl child should be born in a Government Hospital or Government recognized private hospital in the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The father/guardian should belong to a schedule tribe Arunachal Pradesh or a domicile resident of Arunachal Pradesh or possess a household residential certificate.
1. The scope of the scheme is restricted to a maximum of first two live girl child.

name: Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana" is a Financial Assistance Scheme launched by the Higher Education Dept.Rs. Govt. of Odisha. The scheme was launched as an endeavor to make higher education inclusive and to increase the gross enrollment ratio. The scheme aims to further widen the access to higher education to the students belonging to under privileged sections of societyRs. which in turn shall benefit immensely the students of said strata of society. The objective of the scheme is to extend financial assistance to the students of under privileged sections for pursuing Graduation and Post-Graduation courses in the State of Odisha on an annual basis. It is anticipated that the scheme will lead to their access to higher education. The assistance will be offered on means basis to GeneralRs. OBCRs. SC/STRs. SEBC/EBC category students. The selected students will receive financial assistance of 20Rs. per annum.
benefits:
1. The annual Financial assistance will be 20Rs./- for pursuing both Graduate and Post Graduate courses.
1. The student can avail of financial assistance under this scheme even if the student is in receipt of financial assistance under other schemes.
1. The financial assistance shall be limited to the normal duration of the course and will be given each year till the completion of the course.
eligibility:
1) The student should belong to any of the following categories of families:
a) HIV/AIDS-affected family (either father or mother or both).
b) Households Without Shelter.
c) Destitute / Living on Alms.
d) Manual Scavengers.
c) Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
f) Legally released Bonded Labourers.
g) Single Mother Family (a mother who has a dependent child or dependent children and who is widowedRs. divorcedRs. or unmarried).
2) He/ She should be a Permanent Resident of Odisha.
3) The student should have been enrolled for graduate/postgraduate courses ((Non-Technical/Technical/Professional) on a regular mode from the Colleges/ Institutes/ Universities in the State of Odisha recognized by the State Government.
4) The income of the household from all sources should be less than 10Rs./- per month.

name: Mukhya Mantri Gyandeep Yojna
brief_description:
The scheme **Mukhya Mantri Gyandeep Yojna** was launched by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh for all those students of the State for availing of educational loans from any Bank for pursuing professional/technical courses and higher education courses from recognized Institutions in India. The scheme shall be applicable for educational loans disbursed from the academic year 2016-17 starting from 1st April 2016 irrespective of the date of sanction of the education loan.
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support in the form of interest subsidy on Educational Loans availed from Banks by Himachali Students for pursuing Higher Education in India and Abroad.
benefits:
1. Under this SchemeRs. Interest subsidy is admissible from any bank on an education loan availed up to the maximum of 10 lakhs.
1. Interest subsidy to the extent of 4% per annum on education loans will be allowed.

**Note:** Interest subsidy will be provided on interest charged on eligible education loan accounts during the repayment/ holiday/ moratorium period i.e. course period plus moratorium period of a maximum of one year.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a Bonafide Himachali.
1. The students of the State who avail of educational loans from any Bank for pursuing professional/technical courses and higher education courses from recognized Institutions in India are eligible to apply under this scheme.
1. The interest subsidy shall be available to eligible students only if no other interest subsidy on education Loans is availed under any other scheme of the State Government/Government of India.

name: Thakur Sen Negi Utkrisht Chatravriti Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Thakur Sen Negi Utkrisht Chatravriti Yojana"Rs. is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh. In this schemeRs. a scholarship of 11Rs./-per annum is awarded to the top 100 Girls and top 100 Boys students belonging to the Tribal Community of Himachal PradeshRs. declared as such in the result of the Matric Examination conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School EducationRs. Dharamshala. The renewal in the 12th Class/2nd Year of the course will be subject to satisfactory performance in internal examinations of the 11th Class/1st Year Course.
benefits: A total of 100 girls and 100 boys will receive 11Rs. per annum for two years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a bona fide of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes Category.
1. The applicant should have passed Class 10th.
1. The applicant should be in the top 100 Girls or top 100 Boys studentsRs. as declared in the result of the Matric Examination conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education.
1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized (including Professional / Technical) institution within or outside the State.
1. The applicant should have a Bank Account.

**NOTE:** The renewal in the 10+2 Class / 2nd Year of course will be subject to satisfactory performance in internal examinations of the 10+1 Class / 1st Year Course.

name: Distance Education ScholarshipScholarship For Disabled Students Pursuing Degree, PG Courses
brief_description: The scheme Distance Education ScholarshipScholarship for Disabled Students Pursuing DegreeRs. PG Courses was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. differently abled students pursuing DegreesRs. and PG courses through Open UniversitiesRs. distance educationRs. or Private registration (Universities inside Kerala) are eligible to apply for scholarships. The scholarship is being provided for meeting the expenses of Registration feeRs. Course feeRs. Tuition feeRs. Exam feeRs. Purchase of booksRs. study materialsRs. etc. FurtherRs. financial assistance will be granted only for the duration of the course concerned.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the scholarship is given to eligible students for meeting the expenses of Registration feesRs. Course feesRs. Tuition feesRs. Exam feesRs. Purchase of booksRs. study materialsRs. etc.
1. The amount of assistance is provided up to a maximum of 10Rs./-.

**Note:** Financial assistance will be granted only for the duration of the course concerned.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.
1. The applicant should be a differently abled student.
1. The differently abled students pursuing DegreesRs. PG courses through Open universitiesRs. Distance educationRs. or through Private registration (Universities inside Kerala) are eligible to apply for scholarships.
1. The annual family income of the student should not exceed 1Rs./-.
1. Only those students who are appearing for the exam each year will be eligible for further financial assistance.

**Note 01:** The grant of scholarship in further subjects will be based on the assessment of the student's academic progress during the course concerned. If the course is stopped midwayRs. the eligibility for financial assistance will be lost.
**Note 02:** If there are more applicantsRs. priority will be given based on qualifying marks.

name: Financial Assistance To Visually Impaired Advocates
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to visually impaired Advocates was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided to visually impaired Advocates who are practicing in any one or more Courts in Kerala. The applicant under this scheme shall be eligible for an exgratia non-recurring grant for the purchase of booksRs. provisional suitsRs. etc.Rs. and they are being paid a reader's allowance for a period of 10 years.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the Visually Impaired Advocates shall be eligible for an exgratia non-recurring grant of 3500/- for the purchase of booksRs. provisional suitsRs. etc.
1. The Visually Impaired Advocates are also being paid a reader's allowance @ 5000/- per month for a period of 10 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
2. The applicant should be a visually impaired Advocate.
3. The applicant should be an advocate practicing in any one or more Courts in Kerala.
4. The combined annual income of the applicant and his/her family from all sources shall not exceed 1Rs./-.
**Note:** A person who becomes a reading assistant to advocates should at least pass the S.S.L.C. examination.

name: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II
brief_description:
The scheme Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-II (SPYTiS-II) is constituted for the purpose of providing financial and technical assistance to talented young students who have innovative ideas in scientific/technological pursuits. Under the schemeRs. students from polytechnic colleges and those admitted to undergraduate-level courses in colleges will be selected every year to do a science project. The selected students will be provided financial support for successfully completing the project.
The grant will be released to the Head of the institution in which the students are enrolled after successful completion of the workRs. subject to submission of signed terms and conditionsRs. final project reportRs. Statement of Expenditure (SERs.) and Utilization Certificate (UC). The grant shall be utilized only for the purpose for which it has been sanctioned. The awardees shall be requested to participate in a Science Talent FairRs. Children Science CongressRs. or Kerala Science Congress organized by the Kerala State Council for ScienceRs. Technology & Environment (KSCSTE)to present their projects/findings.
benefits:
- Students who have innovative ideas in science & technology are enrolled in polytechnic colleges and undergraduate courses in colleges will be provided financial assistance up to 10Rs./- for conducting projects.
- Financial assistance will be provided to the host institution and the students have to work under the guidance/supervision of a teacher.
- Awardees are encouraged to participate in the Science Talent FairRs. National Childrens Science CongressRs. or Kerala Science Congress organized by KSCSTE to present their projects/findings.
- The duration of the project is one year.
- Under the schemeRs. no major equipment for research will be granted. Minor equipmentRs. if found necessaryRs. will be granted only to an institution in the State. In such a caseRs. the budget for minor equipment shall be limited to 30% of the maximum eligible amount. FurtherRs. all permanent assets evolved from the project shall be the assets of the institution.
eligibility:
1. The students (maximum of 5 students per group) who are enrolled in polytechnic colleges and undergraduate level courses in colleges/universities (BSc level) of Kerala State can apply under the scheme.

**Note:** The maximum number of proposals to be forwarded from an institution shall be limited as follows:
10 from a college
4 from a college/university department
2 from a Principal Investigator from college

name: Snehasanthwanam
brief_description: The Government of Kerala has launched the Snehasanthwanam scheme under the Kerala Social Security Mission. The scheme acts as a relief measure for the Endosulfan victims in the state of Kerala. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance has been granted from December 2010 onwards to the Endosulfan victims. This scheme also aims to provide educational assistance to the Children of Endosulfan-affected families. In addition to thisRs. Kerala Social Security Mission is now providing monthly assistance of 700/- per month to the caregivers of Endosulfan victims who are fully bedridden or mentally retarded under the special Aswasakiranam scheme.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2200/- is given to the bedridden Endosulfan victims.
1. Financial assistance of 1700/- is given to such bedridden Endosulfan victims who are getting 300/- per month as a disability pension.
1. All other Endosulfan victims are given 1200/- based on the list furnished by the District Collector.
1. In addition to thisRs. monthly assistance of 700/- is given to the caregivers of Endosulfan victims who are fully bedridden or mentally retarded under the special Aswasakiranam scheme.
1. Educational assistance will be provided to the Children of Endosulfan affected families as under:

a) Children studying in buds school 2000/-.
b) Children studying in Class 1st to 7th 2000/-.
c) Children studying in Class 8th to 10th 3000/-.
d) Children studying in Plus One and Plus Two 4000/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be an Endosulfan victim.

name: NEC Stipend And Book Grant Scheme
brief_description: The Directorate of Higher EducationRs. Government of NagalandRs. offers the NEC Stipend and Book Grant Scheme for Nagaland domiciled students pursuing higher professional courses. The scheme is open to Scheduled Tribe and General category students. The number of stipends awarded each year depends on fund availability. The scheme aims to promote national integrationRs. global understandingRs. social responsibilityRs. and encourage scientificRs. imaginativeRs. and innovative thinking among students.
benefits: - The selection of the students will mainly depend upon their academic performance and the need for the scholarship. - The selected students will receive stipends and book grants for studies in India only.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Nagaland State. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST) or General category. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 60% marks in the last qualifying examination if belonging to the ST category. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 75% marks in the last qualifying examination if belonging to the General category. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Higher Professional course approved by the North Eastern Council (NEC).

name: Snehapoorvam Scheme
brief_description:
Kerala Government has launched a noble initiative Snehapoorvam Scheme to provide financial assistance to orphans who are living in the familyRs. with their relativesRs. friendsRs. or the support of the community under the Social Welfare Department implemented through Social Security Mission. The mission has initiated this scheme that aims at bringing these children to the mainstream of society.
The statistics reveal that in KeralaRs. around 75Rs. children below 18 years are living in orphanages. Around 1500 orphanages are functioning in Kerala. Almost 80- 90% of the children in orphanages have families and relatives. Many orphans and vulnerable children slip further into poverty once the familys main breadwinner stops working or dies. There is nothing more traumatic for a child than to see a parent die. Added to this tragedy is the loss of adult guidance and protection. Children without proper adult care are more likely to be abused & exploited.
Children in this category include orphansRs. abandoned childrenRs. children who have lost their parents in warRs. communal riotsRs. natural disastersRs. accidentsRs. etc. They are not properly fed; they have no shelterRs. nutritious foodRs. health careRs. educationRs. or any recreation. Most of them are facing economic and social exploitation. They are deprived of the love and affection of the family and are often unwanted by family members.
**Objectives of the Scheme:**

1. To identify the orphaned children in the community.
1. To assess and prioritize children in the greatest need.
1. To provide social protection to highly vulnerable groups of orphans by strengthening traditional family and community systems for protecting and absorbing orphans.
1. To improve the basic educationRs. social integrationRs. and nutrition of the most vulnerable groups of orphans towards the levels of other children in the community.
1. To encourage families to live their children within the family setup rather than sending them to orphanages.
1. To extend a helping hand to these orphan families by way of providing financial assistance for the education of children.
benefits: **Sl. No.****Class/Degree/Course****Amount of Assistance**1Children below 5 years and Class I to V300/- per month2Class VI to Class X 500/- per month3Class XI and Class XII750/- per month4Degree Courses / Professional Degree1000/- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The child who has lost either father or mother or both.
1. The applicant should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The students from the first standard to degree classes are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. For children belonging to Above Poverty Line (APL) categoryRs. annual income should be below 20Rs. in rural areas (Local body/Grama Panchayat) and 22Rs. in urban areas (Corporation/ Municipality).

**Note:** Candidate children below 5 years of age can be directly eligible.

name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
brief_description: The scheme Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students- AICTE has been started by the All India Council for Technical EducationRs. Government of India. AICTE in order to ensure the development of technical education in India awards Post Graduate Scholarship of 12Rs./- per month to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE approved post-graduate programs in AICTE approved Institutions/ University Departments as per AICTE approved intake.
benefits:
> **Amount of Scholarship:**


1. The Scholarship under the scheme is 12Rs./- per month per student.

> **Other Entitlements: Students are eligible for the following leaves-**


1. Casual leave: 15 days in an academic year
1. Medical leave: Maximum of one month (30 days) in an academic year
1. Maternity leave: Candidates are eligible for maternity/ Paternity leave as per Govt. of India norms issued from time to time at full rates of scholarship etc. once during the tenure of their award. However maximum duration of the scholarship will not be extended in any circumstances.

> **Duration:**


1. The Scholarship is tenable for 24 months or for the duration of the course i.e. from the date of commencement of classes till the date of completion of the classes whichever is lower and is not extendable under any circumstances.
1. Students of final years of dual degree integrated programmes would also be entitled to a PG Scholarship from the 9th semester onwards i.e. only for one year in the final year.

**Note 01:** All kinds of leave should be approved at the level of the University/College/Institute. Prior approval of the University/Institution/College is mandatory for all types of leaves.
**Note 02:** It will be obligatory for every post-graduate student to undertake 8 to 10 hours (per week) of work related to teaching and research activities as assigned to him /her by the Institute. This could include tutorialsRs. laboratory classesRs. development and maintenance of laboratoriesRs. assistance in research and development activities undertaken by faculty membersRs. maintenance and operation of Computers and other central facilitiesRs. assistance in libraryRs. etc.
eligibility:
Post Graduate Scholarship is entitled only to those students:

1. Having a valid GATE/CEED score at the time of admission.
1. Must be admitted as a full-time scholar.
1. Students of final years of dual degree integrated programmes would also be entitled to a PG Scholarship from the 9th semester onwards i.e. only for one year in the final year.
1. Admitted in AICTE approved Institutions/University Departments & AICTE approved programs viz. Master of EngineeringRs. Master of TechnologyRs. and Master of Design.
1. Number of PG scholarships is limited to the AICTE-approved intake in the programme in that year. HoweverRs. in addition to the approved intakeRs. AICTE will provide a PG scholarship to the additional 10% of candidates over and above the approved intake of that course from the EWS categoryRs. if the university/ institute has admitted students from Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) as per MHRD OM F.No.12-4/2019-U1 dated 17th January 2019.

name: Attendance Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students with Disabilities of Rural Areas
brief_description: The scheme Attendance Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students with Disabilities of Rural Areas was launched by the Department of Social Security and Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Punjab. The objective of this scheme is to uplift the status of the girls with disabilities in rural areas & also to make them reliant by paying incentives in the form of Attendance Scholarship to these girls. The scheme encourages the girl students with disabilities in rural areas to continue their studies and reduce dropouts.
benefits:
**Rate of Scholarship:**
1. 2Rs./- per annum to the girl students up to 10th standard.
2. 3Rs./- per annum to the girl students from 10+1 onwards upto higher education.
**Note:** The Directorate shall credit the scholarship online in the bank account of the student.
eligibility:
1. All rural girl students of Punjab having 40 % and above disability (In any disability contained in the schedule of RPwD Act 2016).
1. The monthly income of the family/guardians of the girl student should not exceed 5Rs./- per month.
1. The minimum attendance of the girl students should be 70%.
1. The scholarship will be provided to the girl students from 1st Standard onwards up to higher education.

name: Stipend Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Stipend Scheme'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme that provides financial support in the form of stipends for the education of the children of registered construction workersRs. including hostel fees. This assistance is also available for beneficiaries pursuing their own education in evening classes.
