name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar State Award To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBCRs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. invites applications for the Dr. B. R. Ambedkar State Award to SC/ST/OBC/Minorities StudentsRs. Delhi 2021 from students pursuing graduation in recognized colleges and institutions. The objective of this scholarship is to recognize and reward meritorious students from these communities. Under the schemeRs. selected toppers in each discipline at the graduation level will receive a cash award of 25Rs..
benefits: - A cash award of 25Rs. will be provided to students who secure the top position among SC/ST/OBC/Minority students in each discipline of a professional or technical degree course.
eligibility: 1. The student must have passed his/her 10th and 12th class from Delhi. 1. The award is given to a studentRs. who tops among the SC/ST/OBC in each discipline of the professional/Technical degree course. 1. In support thereof must produce SC/ST/OBC caste certificate issued by the competent authority of Delhi. 1. The topper student is awarded only once after passing out of the final examination of the course. 1. The award is conferred among the toppers of all professional/technical courses. Being a merit based awardRs. no family income limit has been laid down.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
brief_description: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community" was launched by the Mizoram Scholarship BoardRs. Government of Mizoram. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes pursuing post-matriculation recognized courses in recognized institutions. The scheme covers professionalRs. technical as well as non-professional and non-technical courses at various levels and the scheme also includes correspondence courses including distance and continuing education.
benefits: Financial assistance is provided to the students. _*The scheme is funded by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Government of Mizoram in 90:10 ratio._
eligibility: - The applicant must be permanently settled in Mizoram. - The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste. - The income of the parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant's ongoing educational qualification must be between 11th Standard and Post-Doctoral Fellowship.

name: Combined Merit Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "Combined Merit Scholarship" by the Higher Education DepartmentRs. Government of AssamRs. aims to provide financial assistance to students of Assam studying in first semester degree courses and master's degree courses in any recognized colleges or universities in the state and other states of the countryRs. focusing on students with uniformly good academic records and at least 60% marks in last qualifying examinations. The scheme provides access to poor students of the state and helps them achieve the benefits of higher education through merit-based scholarship support for undergraduate and postgraduate studies. The applicant must be selected and admitted in degree or master's degree courses in any recognized universities or colleges and must be domiciled in Assam. The scheme is implemented by Higher Education Department. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance** - For Degree Courses: 300/- per month. - For Master Degree Courses: 500/- per month. - The scheme provides 200 scholarships for degree students (three years duration) and 100 scholarships for master degree students (two years duration). **Selection:** Based on merit and budget allocation. **Coverage:** Students pursuing general degree and master degree courses in ArtsRs. ScienceRs. and Commerce disciplines. > **Mode of Disbursement** **Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer system. **Conditions:** Subject to selection by the selection committee and financial sanction approval. > **Conditions for Availment** - The applicant must maintain enrollment in the respective degree or master's degree course throughout the scholarship period. - Academic performance standards must be maintained as per institutional and scheme requirements. - Regular attendance and compliance with all institutional rules and regulations. - Bank account must remain active and updated for Direct Benefit Transfer disbursement.
eligibility: - The applicant must be pursuing general degree or master's degree courses in ArtsRs. ScienceRs. or Commerce discipline in any recognized institution. - The applicant must be domiciled in Assam (Permanent Resident Certificate document mandatory). - The applicant must have obtained minimum 60% marks in Higher Secondary examination for those applying for Combined Merit Degree Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must have obtained minimum 60% marks in General Degree (Three Year Degree Course) examination for those applying for Combined Merit Master Degree Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must possess relevant qualification from any recognized institution. - The applicant must have a valid bank account in their name (preferably in State Bank of India).

name: Chief Minister BC & EBC Chhatravas Anudan Yojana
brief_description: The "Chief Minister BC & EBC Chhatravas Anudan Yojana"Rs. implemented by the Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. aims to support students belonging to Backward Classes (BC) and Extremely Backward Classes (EBC) residing in government hostels by providing them a financial grant to cover their essential needs.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- per month for students residing in government hostels.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the BC or EBC category.
1. The annual family income should be less than 3Rs./-.
1. The student must be residing in a government hostel.

name: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
brief_description:
**Detailed**
The aim of the scheme is to help the poor students by providing them financial assistance for purchase of stationery so that their parents do not feel any burden in sending their children to schools. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance for purchase of stationery is given to those SC/ST/OBC/Minorities studentsRs. who are studying in Central Govt. / Govt. of Delhi / Aided / Recognized Local Bodies Schools etc. through the principal of the respective school and whose parental income does not exceed Rs. 2.00 Lakh per annum and attendance should not be less than 70% in the preceding year.
benefits: **The amount of financial assistance is as followed:** 1. I to VIII class Rs. 1000/- P.A. 1. IX to XII class Rs. 2000/- P.A.
eligibility: 1. Applicant should belong to SC/ST/OBC/Minorities and in support thereof they are required to upload SC/ST/OBC/Minorities certificate issued by concerned district office Delhi. 1. Application should be resident of Delhi and in support thereof he/she is required to upload a supporting document (Domicile). 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1 to 12 in a government/aided/recognized public school. 1. Student may not opt any centrally sponsored scholarship scheme with the state funded scheme. 1. Have an annual family income not exceeding INR 2 lakh.

name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura to provide financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities in the form of a monthly pension of 2Rs./-.
benefits:
A pension amount of 2000/- per monthRs. transferred directly to the bank account of the applicant.
**NOTE:** The list of beneficiaries will be made available on the [official website](https://socialwelfare.tripura.gov.in/) of the Social Welfare & Social Education DepartmentRs. Govt. of Tripura.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. 1. The applicant should be a Person with Disability. 1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./- 1. The age of the applicant should be 10 years and above. 1. If the family has children in the age group of 6 to 14 yearsRs. those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura. 1. The disability of the applicant should be one of the following: _BlindnessRs. Low-VisionRs. Leprosy-cured personsRs. Hearing Impairment (deaf & Hard of hearing)Rs. Locomotor DisabilityRs. DwarfismRs. Intellectual DisabilityRs. Mental IllnessRs. Autism Spectrum DisorderRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Muscular DystrophyRs. Chronic Neurological ConditionRs. Specific Learning DisabilitiesRs. Multiple SclerosisRs. Speech and Language disabilityRs. ThalassemiaRs. HemophiliaRs. Sickle Cell DiseaseRs. Multiple Disabilities including deaf-blindnessRs. Acid attack VictimRs. Parkinson's Disease._

Fulfillment of any exclusion criteria during the lifetime of a beneficiaryRs. such as - Remarriage of a widow. - A member of the family of the beneficiary getting a Government Job. - The annual family income of the beneficiary exceeds 1Rs./-Rs. etc.

name: Reimbursement of Tution Fee for SC/ST/OBC/Min students in Public Schools in Class I to XII
brief_description: The scheme "Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for SC/ST/OBC Categories Students Studying in Class I to XII" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/MinoritiesRs. Government of NCT of Delhi aims to provide financial assistance by reimbursing tuition and other compulsory fees for eligible students from SC/ST/OBC categories studying in recognized public schools in Delhi. The scheme ensures that students with a family income below 3Rs./- per annum receive reimbursement for tuitionRs. labRs. and library feesRs. subject to academic performance and attendance criteria. Eligible students must be enrolled in classes 1st to 12th in schools recognized by the Department of EducationRs. Govt. of NCT of DelhiRs. or municipal local bodies of Delhi.
benefits:
**Reimbursement Amount:** Maximum reimbursement of 48Rs./- or actual paid fees (whichever is less) covering tuitionRs. labRs. and library fees.
**Conditions for Disbursement**

- Student must score 50% and above marks in the preceding year.
- Student must have at least 70% attendance in the preceding year.

**Mode of Disbursement:** Direct transfer to the students bank account (joint account with parent/guardian allowed).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to 12th.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a school recognized/affiliated with the Dept. of EducationRs. GNCTD or Municipal Local Bodies of Delhi.
1. The applicant should have scored 50% or above in the previous academic year.
1. The applicant should have at least 80% attendance in the preceding year.
1. The applicant should not be repeating the same class.
1. The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 2Rs./-.

name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Old and Infirm
brief_description: The scheme Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Old and Infirm" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social EducationRs. Government of Tripura. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to poor people of Tripura who are old and infirmRs. such as senior citizens who are 60 years and above in age.
benefits:
The pension amount of 2000/- per month will be transferred directly to the bank account of the applicant.
**NOTE:** The list of beneficiaries will be made available on the [official website](https://socialwelfare.tripura.gov.in/) of the Social Welfare & Social Education DepartmentRs. Govt. of Tripura.
eligibility: **For Old Applicants** - The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. - The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./- - The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above. - If the family has children in the age group of 6 to 14 yearsRs. those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura. **For Infirm Applicants** - The applicant should be a resident of Tripura. - The annual income of the family of the applicant should not exceed 1Rs./- - The applicant should be affected by Cancer/ AIDS/ Leprosy. - If the family has children in the age group of 6 to 14 yearsRs. those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura. **NOTE:** The assistance under this scheme will be stopped immediately in the following cases: 1. Death of Beneficiary. 2. Fulfillment of any exclusion criteria during the lifetime of a beneficiary: - Remarriage of a widow. - A member of the family of the beneficiary getting a Government Job. - The annual family income of the beneficiary exceeds 1Rs./-.

name: Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman - DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The PM POSHAN SchemeRs. launched nationwide in 2021 by the Ministry of Education (MoE)Rs. Government of IndiaRs. is implemented in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu through the Department of Education. The scheme continues the earlier Mid-Day Meal ProgrammeRs. aiming to provide hotRs. cookedRs. nutritious meals to children enrolled in government and government-aided schools. It seeks to enhance child nutritionRs. promote regular school attendanceRs. and support overall academic performance. Under the schemeRs. eligible children from BalvatikaRs. Primary (IV)Rs. and Upper Primary (VIVIII) receive freshly prepared meals on all school working days. The meals are designed to meet prescribed nutritional normsRs. ensuring adequate calorie intake and essential nutrients for healthy growth. PM POSHAN also includes provisions for food safetyRs. quality monitoringRs. kitchen devicesRs. infrastructure strengtheningRs. and community participation to ensure effective implementation. The scheme particularly benefits children from economically and socially disadvantaged familiesRs. helping reduce classroom hunger and improve retention. In DNH&DDRs. the Directorate of Education oversees planningRs. fund allocationRs. meal preparation standardsRs. and monitoring through school-level committees (SMCs). Through its holistic approachRs. PM POSHAN aims to boost childrens healthRs. reduce malnutritionRs. and create an enabling environment for better learning outcomes.
benefits: 1) HotRs. cookedRs. nutritious meals provided to students on all school working days. 2) Ensures adequate calorie and protein intake as per national nutritional norms. 3) Improves health and nutrition levels of school-going children. 4) Enhances school attendanceRs. retentionRs. and reduces classroom hunger. 5) Supports better concentration and learning outcomes among students. 6) Provides essential micronutrients to address anaemia and malnutrition. 7) Encourages enrollment in Government and Government Aided schools. 8) Strengthens social equity by serving all children without discrimination. 9) Includes food safety and hygiene measures for quality assurance. 10) Provides support for kitchen devices and infrastructure improvement.
eligibility: 1) The applicant must be a school-going child enrolled in a Government (BalvatikaVIII)Rs. Government-aided (VIVIII) or Local Body (BalvatikaVIII) school. 2) The child should be studying in BalvatikaRs. Primary classes IVRs. or Upper Primary classes VIVIII. 3) No income criteria are applicable; all enrolled children are eligible. 4) Children studying in Special Training Centres (STCs) under the RTE Act and CwSN enrolled under Home based Education are also eligible.

name: Scheduled Caste Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme "Scheduled Caste Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11)" has been implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their educationRs. including tuition fees and other academic expenses.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Gratuity Assistance in case of Death
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Gratuity Assistance in case of Death scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide social security and welfare support to registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors. Under this schemeRs. gratuity assistance for funeral and last rites is provided to the family in case of death due to an accident. The scheme covers both the registered beneficiary and eligible family members.
benefits: > **Gratuity Assistance in Case of Death** - A one-time gratuity assistance of 2Rs. is provided for funeral and last rites. - The assistance is payable in case of accidental death of the registered driver or conductor and the family members. . > **Mode of Disbursement** - The assistance amount is disbursed immediately by the local body. - The local body later claims reimbursement from the Social Justice Department.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor under the scheme. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The death should have occurred due to an accident. 1. The applicant should not be a government employee. 1. The applicants family member should fall under the defined [family category](https://transport.mp.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/yojna_20150001.pdf) (**Page No. 3**) of the scheme.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Training and Rehabilitation in Case of Permanent Disability due to Accident
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Training and Rehabilitation in Case of Permanent Disability due to Accident scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. aims to ensure the welfare and rehabilitation of registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors. The scheme aims to provide training and rehabilitation support to drivers and conductors who suffer permanent disability due to accidentsRs. enabling them to regain livelihood opportunities.
benefits: **Nature of Benefit** - Skill development training for alternative employment. - Rehabilitation support based on aptitude and interest assessment. - Training services are provided through Skill Development Missionapproved institutions.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should have suffered permanent disability due to an accident.

name: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme)
brief_description: Research Study/Seminar (Grant-in-Aid Scheme) has been launched by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MOSPI)Rs. Government of India. The scheme aims to promote Research Studies and Seminars in official statistics by way of providing financial assistance and data support under the Grant-in-Aid component of the Scheme Capacity Development. The scheme is implemented by the Central Statistics Office (CSO)Rs. Ministry of Statistics and Programme ImplementationRs. Government of India. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the Additional Director GeneralRs. Training DivisionRs. Central Statistical Organisation.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance for Research Studies/Surveys would be up to a maximum of 50Rs./-. - In exceptional casesRs. the limit for Research Studies/Surveys could be enhanced up to 1Rs./- with the approval of the SecretaryRs. Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI). - The quantum of financial assistance for National Seminars/Workshops/Conferences will be maximum 10Rs./-. - The quantum of financial assistance for International Seminars/Workshops/Conferences will be maximum 20Rs./-. - Financial assistance is provided towards the travel cost and related expenditures for presentation of accepted research papers in Theoretical/Applied Statistics in International Conferences/Seminars/WorkshopsRs. etc.Rs. held outside India. Such assistance includes airfareRs. registration feeRs. airport taxRs. visa feeRs. and per diemRs. as per the Government rules in force. ##### ***Conditions*** - Research Studies/Surveys: The assistance will be released in three installments in the proportion of 40:40:20. - Seminars/Workshops/Conferences: The amount will be released in two installments: the First installment of 50% before/during the Seminars/Workshops/Conferences after approvalRs. and the remaining 50% based on actual expenditure as reimbursement. - Travel Grants Assistance: The return air ticket (to and from) of a national carrierRs. i.e.Rs. Air IndiaRs. will be provided by the shortest air route for the economy class. Financial assistance towards travel cost will cover all expenditures on travel between the place of work or place of residence and the airport in IndiaRs. and between the airport abroad and the venue of the conference. _*Release of assistance is linked to specific milestones to be achieved as per the time schedule indicated in the proposal and is aligned to the duration of the project._
eligibility: ##### ***For Professional/Research Institutions/Organizations (Grant-in-Aid for Research Studies/Seminars)*** - The applicant must be a professional/research institution/organization. - The applicant must be engaged in the field of official statistics for a minimum period of three (3) years. - The applicant must possess qualified statisticiansRs. economistsRs. and social scientists. - The applicant must fall into one of the following categories: a) Government institutions including Directorates of Economics and Statistics of States/Union Territories. b) Institutions/organizations receiving annual recurring grants from the Central or State Government Agencies including Indian Statistical InstituteRs. Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)Rs. University Grants Commission (UGC)Rs. etc.. c) Institutions/organizations registered as a society under the Societies Registration Act. d) Institutions/organizations registered as 'Trusts' under Trusteeship Act. e) Institutions/organizations incorporated under the Companies Act. - The applicant institution/organization shall be "not-for-profit" to be eligible for assistance under the Scheme for National and International Seminars/Conferences/Workshops etc. on official statistics. ##### ***For Officials (Travel Grants Assistance - TGA)*** - The applicant must be an official of the Central Government/Central autonomous institutions/university. - The applicant's visit must relate to the area of work of the officer. - The applicant's technical paper should have been submitted through proper official channel in such event and not out of the officer's own volition. - The applicant must have an official invitation from the host organization to the administrative Ministry/Department/Organization. - The applicant must have appropriate documentary evidence of acceptance of the paper for presentation by the agencies organizing the international statistical conferences/seminar/workshopRs. etc.. - The applicant must have obtained all necessary clearancesRs. including political clearance from the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)Rs. and Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA) clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) (wherever required). - The applicant must not have had more than one proposal recommended for travel grants during the financial year for presenting their paper abroad.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Sarathi Shri Award
brief_description: The "Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Sarathi Shri Award" has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. one of the state's best drivers will be honored with the "Sarathi Shri" awardRs. which includes a cash prizeRs. a certificate of appreciationRs. and a trophy. The state government will present this award at a special ceremony.
benefits: **Award Components** - Cash Prize: 1Rs./- - Appreciation Certificate - Trophy
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license or conductor's license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should be actively engaged or registered as a transport driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should not be a government employee.

name: Auto Rickshaw Regulation Scheme
brief_description: The Auto Rickshaw Regulation Scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to regulate the operation of auto rickshaws to ensure road safetyRs. uniformityRs. and compliance with motor vehicle laws by enforcing regulatory provisions such as vehicle age limitsRs. permit validityRs. speed controlRs. vehicle tracking devicesRs. and route rationalization for all operatorsRs. including those with disabilities.
benefits: > **Benefits:** - Regulated operation of auto rickshaws across Madhya Pradesh. - Improved road safety through speed governors limited to 40 kilometers per hour. - A mandatory vehicle tracking device is integrated with the Transport Departments central server. - Uniform permit system with defined validity periods. - Organized route allocation and auto stand identification. - Inclusive applicability to all eligible operatorsRs. including persons with disabilities. > **Validity:** - Permanent permits are valid for 5 years - Temporary permits are valid for up to 4 months
eligibility: **General Eligibility** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be an auto rickshaw owner or operator. 1. The applicant should possess a valid driving license suitable for operating an auto rickshaw. 1. The applicants auto rickshaw should not be more than 10 years old from the manufacturing year if petrol or diesel operated. 1. The applicant should apply for a permit or renewal under the Madhya Pradesh Motor Vehicle RulesRs. 1994. 1. The applicant should comply with prescribed safetyRs. speedRs. and tracking requirements. 1. The applicant may be a person with disabilityRs. provided all statutory driving and vehicle fitness conditions are fulfilled. 1. The applicant must not have any major traffic violations or criminal offences under motor vehicle laws in the previous year. **For Auto Rickshaw / E-Cart / E-Rickshaw Owners:** 1. The vehicle must adhere to color-coding regulations as prescribed by the Regional Transport Authority. 1. The vehicle must have the route number and auto-stand details clearly displayed on a visible white circular background with red letters. 1. The owner must ensure the vehicle carries all valid documentsRs. including registration certificateRs. fitness certificateRs. insuranceRs. permitRs. pollution control certificateRs. and motor vehicle tax receipt. 1. The owner must ensure the vehicle is not modifiedRs. including installation of music systems or unauthorized alterations; violation may result in permit cancellation. 1. The owner is responsible for compliance with all conditions imposed on the permit by the authorities. **For Drivers:** 1. The driver must wear the prescribed uniform while operating the vehicle. 1. The driver must have no repeated traffic violationsRs. such as jumping red lightsRs. violating lane disciplineRs. overspeedingRs. or committing offenses under motor vehicle laws. 1. The driver must not operate the vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs. 1. The driver must not use a mobile phone or smoke while driving. 1. The driver must not overload the vehicle beyond the permitted passenger capacity; violations will result in fines of 1Rs. for the first offense and permit cancellation for repeated offenses. 1. The driver must carry all vehicle documents while drivingRs. as required by law.

name: Assam Tea Plantations Provident Fund Scheme
brief_description: The "Assam Tea Plantations Provident Fund Scheme" is a Social Security Scheme for the Plantation Workers in Assam. The scheme was launched by the Assam Tea Employees Provident Fund OrganizationRs. Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide compulsory savings and social security to tea garden workers and employees in Assam against contingencies like old ageRs. deathRs. and invalidity. The scheme provides a provident fund where both the employee and employer contribute 12% of wagesRs. which accumulates interest at a rate declared by the Board. The applicant must be a daily wage worker or an employee of a plantation or tea factory earning up to 6Rs./- per month. The scheme is implemented by the Assam Tea Employees Provident Fund Organization and administered by a Board of Trustees. The applications for claims are accepted through the employer or garden management.
benefits: **Provident Fund Accumulation:** Members receive credit for their own contribution of 12% of wages and an equal 12% contribution from the employer. **Interest:** The accumulated deposits earn interest at a rate declared by the Board every year. **Final Settlement:** The total credit balance with interest is paid to the member or nominee upon retirementRs. resignationRs. deathRs. or invalidity. **Refundable Advances:** Members can avail advances up to 25% of the balance or nine months' pay (whichever is less) for marriageRs. death ceremoniesRs. medical treatmentRs. or children's higher education. **Housing Advance:** A non-refundable advance is available for constructing or purchasing a dwelling houseRs. equal to 24 months' wageRs. total contributionRs. or housing costRs. whichever is less. **Hardship Relief:** A non-refundable advance is granted in cases of hardship due to natural calamities or the closure of a plantation.
eligibility: - The applicant must be employed in a tea plantation or a tea factory in Assam. - The applicant must receive a monthly salary of up to 6Rs./-. - The applicant must be a daily wage worker (eligible from the first day of work).

name: Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Small Scale Goat / Sheep Farming (10+1 Capacity)
brief_description: The scheme "Small Scale Goat / Sheep Farming (10+1 Capacity)" was launched by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to provide livelihood support to interested small and marginal farmers and landless labourersRs. and to improve the livelihoods of the weaker sectionsRs. especially those belonging to ST & SC categories. Through this schemeRs. a back-ended subsidy is provided to eligible individual beneficiaries for setting up a goat or sheep farming unit comprising 10 female and 1 male animal. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary ServicesRs. OdishaRs. through the Chief District Veterinary Officers (CDVOs)Rs. Deputy Directors (DDs)Rs. and Block Veterinary Officers (BVOs) across all districts of the stateRs. under Sub-Scheme 3860 Small Animal Development under the Umbrella Scheme "Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana." > **Objectives** 1. To provide livelihood support to the interested smallRs. marginal farmers and landless labourers. 1. To improve the livelihoods of the weaker sectionsRs. especially belonging to the ST & SC categories.
benefits: **1. Cost of one Goat / Sheep Unit (10+1):** **Sl. No.****Component****Cost (in )**1.Construction of a shed of 180 sq ft for 10 femalesRs. 10 Kids & one male @ 200/sq. ft 36Rs./-2.Cost of animals along with transportation cost - Female (5 - 6 months) @ 5000/- & Male one (6-7 months) @ 6000/- 56Rs./-3.Insurance Premium @ 7% for 11 animals for one year. 8Rs./-4.Other miscellaneous expenses like utensilsRs. medicinesRs. Nutritional supplementsRs. Deworming etc. 2Rs./-**Total**** 1Rs./-**> **NB: Fund Expenditure under Components 3 & 4 may be interchangeable as per actual need.** **2. Subsidy pattern to be released with & without shed construction as follows:** **Sl. TransgenderRs. differently-abledRs. etc.60 % ( 61Rs./-) 61Rs./- 39Rs./-2.General50 % ( 51Rs./-) 51Rs./- 33Rs./-> **NB: In case of non-construction of the shedRs. the unspent subsidy amount may be utilised to cover more no of beneficiaries from the waiting list.** **Modalities of Implementation:** - The SCRs. STRs. WomenRs. TransgenderRs. differently-abled categories beneficiaries will be provided with 60% subsidy of 61Rs./- per Goatery / Sheepery unit & General (Male) beneficiary will be provided with 50% subsidy of 51Rs./- per Goatery / Sheepery unit. The remaining amount will be arranged by the individual either through a bank loan or self-financing. - To ensure transparencyRs. beneficiaries must make online payments (RTGS/NEFT/UPI) for any item costing 20Rs./- or more. For such itemsRs. submission of the online transaction receipt is mandatory for subsidy release. - The selection of the beneficiary shall be made in a transparent manner by the BLITRs. which will be scrutinised by CDVOs. Identification of beneficiaries must be made with Aadhar linking at the time of submission of the application. - The subsidy amount shall be released to the Aadhar-linked bank account of the beneficiary through DBT mode in two instalments. - No additional manpower or Consultants shall be engaged for the implementation of the scheme. This scheme shall be implemented with existing field staff. - Those beneficiaries who have availed subsidies in similar types of schemes of the Govt. of India or the State Government or through WSHGs previously shall not be included under this scheme again. - CDVO/ DD/ BVORs. in consultation with the Lead District Manager (LDM) of the concerned districtRs. shall take steps to arrange a bank loan to the individuals for the successful implementation of the scheme. - Quality checking of goats procured by the beneficiaries shall be ensured by the concerned BVOs. > **Disbursement of Funds:** 1. TransgenderRs. differently-abled categoriesRs. and 50% of the unit cost only for Generals (Male) categories: - First phase (40%) after completion of the shed. - Second phase (60%) after stocking of animals. 1. The subsidy amount shall be released to the Aadhar-linked bank account of the beneficiary through DBT mode in two instalments. 1. The CDVO may directly pay the amount towards the insurance premium as per the guidelines to the Insurance Company.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be interested in smallRs. marginal farmers and landless labourers. 1. The applicant must be willing to establish a new Goat/Sheep Unit (10+1 capacity) in individual mode. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhaar linked at the time of submission of the application. 1. The applicant must have a suitable proposed site for the establishment of the goat/sheep unitRs. verified by the Block Level Inspection Team (BLIT). 1. The applicant proposal must be for a new project only (as verified by BLIT at the time of initial verification). 1. The applicant must haveRs. or be willing to arrangeRs. the remaining cost (after subsidy) through a bank loan or self-finance. > **Preference / Priority / Reservation:** - Priority is given to SCRs. STRs. WomenRs. TransgenderRs. and Differently-Abled categoriesRs. who are eligible for 60% subsidy. - General (Male) category applicants are eligible for 50% subsidy. - The total target is 1Rs. units for SCRs. STRs. and General (including WomenRs. TransgenderRs. and Differently-Abled) beneficiaries. - In case of non-availability of beneficiaries from a particular reserved category (SC or ST)Rs. the target may be interchanged among the reserved categories. If no beneficiary is available from any reserved categoryRs. the target may be allotted to the General category. - District-wise targets are specified in [Annexure-VI](https://fard.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-12/Small%20scale%20goat%20sheep%20farming%2010%2C%201%20capacity.pdf) of the scheme guidelines.

name: Sukhad Sahara Yojana
brief_description: The "Sukhad Sahara Yojana" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance are provided to the widows and deserted women who are living below poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive financial assistance of 500/- per month.

**Note:** The amount of assistance will be directly transferred to the applicant's bank account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be either a widow or a deserted woman.
1. The age of the widow should be between 18 and 39 years.
1. The age of the deserted woman should be 18 years or older.
1. The applicant's name should be included in the list of families living Below Poverty Line.
1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme.

name: Cluster Development Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2003-04Rs. the scheme "Cluster Development Scheme" by the Industries & Mines DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to enhance the productivity and competitiveness of artisans in the handloom and handicraft sector through cluster-based development approachRs. addressing common issues faced by Micro and Small Enterprises such as improvement of technologyRs. skillsRs. qualityRs. market accessRs. and access to capital. The scheme provides various types of assistance like Diagnostic SurveyRs. design DevelopmentRs. TrainingRs. Common Facility CentreRs. margin moneyRs. managerial subsidyRs. publicityRs. exportRs. and Marketing Facility to clusters of minimum 25 artisans or more who work and produce goods at one place. The applicant must be part of a cluster with minimum 25 artisans and must be engaged in handloom and handicraft activities in Gujarat state. The scheme is implemented by Boards and Corporations working under Cottage Commissionerate and reputed institutions such as National Institute of DesignRs. National Institute of Fashion TechnologyRs. etc.
benefits:
> **Types of Assistance Provided** - **Diagnostic Survey:** Assessment and analysis of cluster needs and potential.- **Design Development:** Support for product design and innovation.- **Training:** Skill development and capacity building programs for artisans.- **Common Facility Centre:** Establishment of shared infrastructure and facilities.- **Margin Money:** Financial assistance for working capital requirements.- **Managerial Subsidy:** Support for management and administrative costs.- **Publicity:** Marketing and promotional support for cluster products.- **Export Assistance:** Support for international market access.- **Marketing Facility:** Domestic and international marketing support.
> **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Cluster must maintain minimum 25 artisans working and producing goods at one place. - Beneficiaries must continue to be engaged in handloom and handicraft activities. - Compliance with scheme guidelines and periodic reporting requirements. - Participation in training programs and skill development initiatives as mandated.
eligibility: - The applicant must be part of a cluster with minimum 25 artisans or more who work and produce goods at one place. - The applicant must be engaged in handloom and handicraft sector activities. - The applicant must be working and producing goods at a common or designated location within Gujarat. - The applicant must be involved in artisan-based activities in handloom and handicraft sector. - The applicant must be classified as Micro or Small Enterprise. - The applicant must be willing to participate in collective cluster activities.
