name: Prime Small Enterprise Empowerment and Development(SEED) Scheme
brief_description: The **SEED Prime Small Enterprise Empowerment and Development (SEED) SchemeRs.** under the Chief Ministers ELEVATE Program and implemented by the Planning DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. aims to empower youth and promote inclusive entrepreneurship across the state. The scheme provides financial support for setting up or expanding small business ventures. It primarily targets the unorganized sector and underserved business activities that contribute significantly to the local economy but have historically lacked institutional support.
benefits: 1. 50% of total project cost supported as upfront subsidy by Government of Meghalaya (50Rs. max) 1. 5% of total project cost to be contributed by entrepreneur as own share 1. Remaining 45% of project cost eligible for bank loan 1. Loan tenure of 2 years with a 3-month moratorium period before EMI begins 1. Financial support strictly for asset creation (machineryRs. equipment)Rs. operational or working capital expenses not allowed 1. Opportunity to access scheme through single online portal under CM-ELEVATE initiative 1. Cash Credit loan option available for eligible beneficiaries 1. Support to entrepreneurs from unorganized and underserved sectors with emphasis on creating local employment
eligibility: **For Individuals:** 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must provide proof of relevant experience in the field related to the proposed project. 1. The applicant must substantiate experience through past projectsRs. portfoliosRs. certificationsRs. or testimonials from the village headman. 1. The applicant shall not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. 1. The applicant without demonstrated relevant experience will not be considered. **For Unregistered Entities:** 1. The unregistered entity must be based in Meghalaya. 1. The unregistered entity may include village organizationsRs. self-help groupsRs. traditional communitiesRs. or similar groups. 1. The unregistered entity must provide proof of relevant experience in the field related to the proposed project. 1. The unregistered entity must substantiate experience through past projectsRs. portfoliosRs. certificationsRs. or testimonials from the village headman. 1. The unregistered entity shall not be a credit defaulter with any bank or financial institution. 1. The unregistered entity without demonstrated relevant experience will not be considered.

name: Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Spice Crops" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for the area expansion of spice cropsRs. including seed and rhizomatic spicesRs. to enhance spice production in Gujarat.
benefits: - Maximum assistance up to 12Rs./- per hectare at 40% of the unit cost of 30Rs./- per hectare.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The applicant must be engaged in the cultivation of spice cropsRs. such as seed spices or rhizomatic spices.

name: Sheep Rearing Scheme (HSFDC)
brief_description:
The "Sheep Rearing Scheme" scheme is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the bank tie-up schemes. The HSFDC is a company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly Government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India.
Under this schemeRs. the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) familiesRs. whose annual family income does not exceed 1Rs./-Rs. in both rural and urban areas for self-employment income-generating activities such as sheep rearing. The scheme provides a subsidy of 50% of the total project costRs. with a maximum subsidy amount of 10Rs./-.
benefits:
**Project Cost Ceiling:**

- Up to 1Rs. /-.

**Subsidy:**

- Subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum amount of subsidy is 10Rs./-)

**Bank Loan:**

- Besides subsidyRs. the composite loan i.e. subsidyRs. and the balance amount of the bank loan is provided by the banks to the seller of the assets on behalf of the beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category.
1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./- in rural areas and urban areas.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed the BPL limit.
1. The applicant's name should be included in the BPL Survey List.

**Note:** The eligibility of the applicant is verified by the field staff before sponsoring the same to the bank for sanction.

name: PMMSY: Insulated vehicles - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) with the component of "Insulated vehicles"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish healthRs. uplift fishermenRs. and enhance value chain efficiency. Through this schemeRs. financial support is provided to fishermen and related beneficiaries for constructing ice plants or storage units with a minimum capacity of 30 tonnesRs. ensuring hygienic fish storage and better returns. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% contribution from the State Government.
> **Objective of the scheme** - Marine production in the Gujarat state is one of the leading in the country. The state lags behind in exports due to non-norms. So cold storage/ice plant modernization is necessary to keep the fish in healthy condition. - Insulated vehicleRs. three wheeler with ice box including e-rickshawRs. and live fish vending center to deliver the fish in hygienic condition to the consumerRs. so that the consumer (customer) can get fresh and clean fish from the local area and get good returns to the sellers. - Around 27Rs. small and large boats are operating in the state. To strengthen the safety and security of the fishermen and increase the income of the boat ownerRs. replacement of the existing boats is necessary to increase the sea growth of the existing boats.
benefits:
1. The unit cost is 20Rs./-. 40% assistanceRs. i.e. 8Rs./- for the general category and 60% i.e. assistance up to 12Rs./- for women and ST/SC category beneficiaries. 1. The benefit will be available as per the target (category) allocated by the Government of India.
> **Remarks:** 60% contribution from Government of India and 40% contribution from State Governments is paid. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** Once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state. 1. The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software. 1. The applicant should hold a fishing license. 1. The applicant should complete the online registration on the [iKhedut Portal](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/site/).1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan. 1. The applicant should have his/her own bank account. > **Preference/Reservation/Relaxation:** - WomenRs. SCRs. and ST beneficiaries are eligible for 60% assistance of the unit cost. - General category beneficiaries are eligible for 40% assistance of the unit cost.

name: Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil
brief_description: The "Scheme on Promotion of Use of Liquid Fermented Organic Manure (LFOM) for Increasing Organic Carbon in Soil" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to encourage farmers to adopt eco-friendly agricultural practices. The scheme provides financial assistance of 4Rs. per acre to farmers who utilize LFOM or Fermented Organic Manure (FOM) in their farming operations.
benefits: - An amount of 4Rs./- per acre for using LFOM or FOM.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must be engaged in agricultural activities.
- The applicant must be willing to adopt LFOM/FOM on their farm.

name: Micro Finance (GBCDC)
brief_description: The scheme "Micro Finance (GBCDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to create self-employment for men from the backwards classes. Through this schemeRs. low interest rates and financial help are provided to the backwards class men. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Backwards Classes Development Corporation.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to 1Rs./-. 1. The interest rate in these schemes is 5 percent per annum. 1. In these schemesRs. 90 per cent of the unit cost will be provided as a loanRs. with 90 per cent from the national corporationRs. 5 per cent from the state governmentRs. and 5 per cent from the beneficiary contribution. 1. This loan is to be repaid in 48 equal monthly instalmentsRs. including interest.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to a socially and educationally backwards class. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years as on the date of application. 1. The applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.

name: Assistance Program for Expansion of Fruit Crop Cultivation
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance Program for Expansion of Fruit Crop Cultivation" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to encourage and support farmers in the state to adopt intensive farming practices and increase the cultivation of fruits such as mangoRs. guavaRs. pomegranateRs. lemonRs. banana (tissue culture)Rs. and papaya.
benefits:
> **For Intensive and Ultra-Intensive Farming of MangoRs. GuavaRs. PomegranateRs. LemonRs. etc.:** - Assistance of 30Rs./- to 40Rs./- per hectare. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary.
> **For New Plantation of Banana Tissue Culture Crop:** - 40% of the incurred cost or maximum 50Rs./- per hectare. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary.
> **For New Plantation of Papaya Crop:** - 50% of the incurred cost or maximum 30Rs./- per hectare. - Paid in two installments. - Maximum up to 4 hectares per beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant must be engaged in horticultural or fruit crop cultivation.

name: Scheme for Awarding Fellowships for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Students
brief_description: The "Scheme for Awarding Fellowships for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Students" launched by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide monthly financial assistance to qualified undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. and Ph.D. students at Anand Agricultural University.
benefits: - **Undergraduate Students:** 500/- per month for 12 months. - **Postgraduate Students:** 1Rs./- per month for 12 months. - **Ph.D. Student:** 2Rs./- per month for 12 months.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a regular fulltime student enrolled in an undergraduate/ postgraduate or Ph.D. program at Anand Agricultural University.
- The student should not avail any other Scholarship/ Fellowship concurrently with this one.
- The family income of the student should not exceed 6Rs./- per year.

name: Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme
brief_description: The "Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme" launched by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial aid to farmers for the purchase of various modern farm implements and machinery. The scheme promotes mechanized farming and ensures timely agricultural operations for better yield and efficiency.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount between 1Rs./- to 11Rs./- for purchasing various farm implements.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person
brief_description: The "Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote mobility and independence for orthopedically disabled individuals in Gujarat by offering a financial subsidy. The beneficiary can purchase an electric scooter through an agency approved by JEDA. After verificationRs. the financial assistance amounting to 25Rs. (or 50% of the scooter and kit costRs. whichever is lower) will be directly deposited into the beneficiary's bank account.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to the limit of 50% of the basic cost of the electric scooter + 50% of the disability kit or 25Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must be between 18 to 50 years of age.
- The applicant must have an orthopedic disability of 40% or moreRs. certified by a civil surgeon.
- The applicant must possess a Disability Identity Card issued by the Social Security Department.
- The applicant must be listed in the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category with a score of 0 to 20.
- The applicant must not have already availed benefits under this scheme in the last five yearsRs. unless the previously allotted electric scooter is damaged and the applicant remains otherwise eligible.
- The applicant must purchase the electric scooter from an agency approved by JEDA at the government-approved price.

**Note:** The applicant will be given priority if their name appears in the SECC-2011 (Socio-Economic Caste Census) data.

name: Uniform Assistance for Scheduled Tribe Students
brief_description: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Scheduled Tribe Students" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support students from the Scheduled Tribe category by reducing the burden of education-related expenses and promoting school attendance. The scheme ensures that eligible students from Classes 1st to 8th studying in government and aided schools receive 900/- for three pairs of school uniforms annuallyRs. enhancing their dignity and inclusion in the school environment.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 900/- is provided to each eligible student for the purchase of three pairs of school uniforms.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a student.
- The applicant should belong to the state of Gujarat.
- The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 8th.
- The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided primary school.
- The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.

name: Scholarship to Disabled Students
brief_description: The scheme "Scholarship to Disabled Students" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to support the educational needs of students with benchmark disabilities of more than 40%Rs. as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. Through this schemeRs. annual scholarships ranging from 1Rs./- to 4Rs./- are provided to students with disabilities studying from Class 1 onwardsRs. depending on the level of education. The scheme is implemented by the Social Defense Division of the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. The objective is to encourage continued education among students with disabilities by providing financial assistanceRs. especially for those who have achieved at least 40% marks in their last annual examination and possess a valid disability identity card.
benefits:
**Scholarship Assistance:**

- 1Rs./- per year for students with disabilities studying in Class 1st to 8th.
- 2Rs./- to 4Rs. per year for students studying in Class 9th and above.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a student. - The applicant must have at least 40% of any of the 21 benchmark disabilities listed under the [Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/15939/1/the_rights_of_persons_with_disabilities_act%2C_2016.pdf). - The applicant should have passed the last annual examination with a minimum of 40% marks. - The applicant should possess a valid PH (Person with Disability) Identity Card. - The applicant should be currently studying in a recognized educational institution.

name: Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana
brief_description: "Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana" is a welfare initiative by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Gujarat. The scheme aims to support economically disadvantaged individuals from the Rabari and Bharwad communities through financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans up to 1Rs./- for animal husbandry activities.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** Loan up to 1Rs./- for animal husbandry.
> **Note:**


- **Loan Amount:** 95%- **Beneficiary Contribution:** 5%
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the Rabari or Bharwad casteRs. classified under socially and educationally backward classes (SC).
- The applicant must be between 21 and 45 years of age.
- The applicant must have a family annual income not exceeding 3Rs./-.
- The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- The applicant must be engaged in or intending to undertake animal husbandry activities.

name: New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan) (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan)" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support for higher technical and professional education to students belonging to Thakor and Koli communities. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided at subsidized interest rates to students for pursuing graduate and postgraduate studies in fields such as engineeringRs. medicalRs. MBARs. and MCA.
benefits: > **Education Loan Details:** ***Loan Amount:*** Up to 15Rs./-. ***Interest Rate:*** 4% per annum for male students and 3.5% per annum for female students. ***Coverage Includes:*** - Admission fees and tuition fees - BooksRs. writing materialsRs. necessary equipment and examination fees required for the course - Accommodation & food expenses - Travel and insurance premiums ***Contribution:*** - 90% by Central Corporation - 5% by State Government - 5% by the Beneficiary ***Repayment Terms:*** - Repayment Period: 60 equal monthly installments (5 years) - Start of Repayment: Within 6 months from course completion or employmentRs. whichever is earlier.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Thakor or Koli caste/community. 1. The family's annual income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should have secured admission in a recognized institution for: - MBA or equivalent (approved by AICTE) - MCA (Master of Computer Applications or equivalent) - Undergraduate Engineering programs (approved by AICTE/IITs) - MBBS or equivalent (approved by Medical Council of India) **Note:** At least 50% of the total sanctioned loan amount will be reserved for applicants from families earning up to 1Rs. annually.

name: Scheme to Encourage the Children of Sanitation Workers Who have Passed the Class 10/12 Examination (GSKVN)
brief_description: The "Scheme to Encourage the Children of Sanitation Workers Who Have Passed the Class 10/12 Examination" is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. This scheme has been in operation since the year 2012-13. The objective of the scheme is to promote and encourage the academic excellence of children of sanitation workers who have passed the Class 10 or Class 12 board examinations with top ranks. Under this schemeRs. students securing firstRs. secondRs. or third rank in the board examinations (General and Science streams) across the state are awarded cash prizes and certificates of appreciation.
benefits: > **Cash Prize Details:** **Rank****10th Class****12th Class (Science Stream/General Stream)**First Rank 41Rs./- 31Rs./-Second Rank 21Rs./- 21Rs./-Third Rank 11Rs./- 11Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be a child of a sanitation worker engaged in scavenging activities. 1. The applicant should have passed the SSC (Class 10) or HSC (Class 12) board examinations conducted during the current academic year to be eligible under this scheme. 1. There is no annual income limit to avail the benefits of this scheme. > **Note:** Applicants who secure the firstRs. secondRs. or third rank among the online applications received will be eligible for benefits under this scheme.

name: Pashu Palan Yojana (GSKVN)
brief_description: The scheme 'Pashu Palan Yojana' is implemented by the Gujarat Safai Kamdar Vikas Nigam (GSKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide loans to sanitation workers and their dependents to promote self-employment through animal husbandry and related activities.
benefits: - Loan up to 1Rs./- is provided at an interest rate of 6% to sanitation workers or their dependents for initiating animal husbandry as a business or occupation.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a sanitation worker or a dependent of a sanitation worker. 1. The age of the applicant (sanitation worker or dependent) should be between 18 and 50 years as on the date of application. 1. Only applicant who has not previously availed any loan under any scheme of this Corporation or the GovernmentRs. including their family membersRs. are eligible to apply under this scheme. 1. Priority will be given to applicants who are BPL (Below Poverty Line)Rs. widowedRs. abandonedRs. or persons with disabilities. 1. The applicant should intend to start a self-employment venture in animal husbandry or related activities.

name: Mobile Food Court Van (DAADC)
brief_description: The "Mobile Food Court Van" scheme is implemented by the Dr. Ambedkar Antyodaya Development Corporation (DAADC) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to generate self-employment opportunities in the food and beverage sector by providing loan assistance to unemployed scheduled caste individuals belonging to Antyodaya families. Under this schemeRs. loan is provided to the eligible beneficiaries at a concessional interest rate.
benefits: **Loan Amount:** Up to 6Rs./- **Interest Rate:** 6% per annum **Contribution:** - State Government Contribution: 95 % - Beneficiary Contribution: 5% **Possible Installment Amount:** - 11Rs./- per month (for 5 years) - 9Rs./- per month (for 6 years) - 8Rs./- per month (for 7 years)
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should belong to an Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) family. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant should provide two guarantors to get the loan.

name: Food Bill Assistance for Medical & Engineering Students of Nomadic Tribes & Denotified Tribes
brief_description: The Food Bill Assistance for Medical and Engineering Students of Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to reduce the burden of living expenses for students belonging to the Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes (NTDNT) communities who are pursuing full-time Medical or Engineering courses within the state. Under this schemeRs. eligible students receive a monthly food allowance of 1Rs./- for up to 10 months each academic year to help cover mess or canteen expenses.
benefits: - Monthly assistance up to 1Rs./- for 10 months per academic year.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to a Notified Tribe or DeNotified Tribe (NTDNT) community of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Medical or Engineering degree course within the state of Gujarat. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Pashu Palan Yojana (GTKVN)
brief_description: The "Pashu Palan Yojana" is implemented by the Gujarat Thakor and Koli Vikas Nigam (GTKVN) under the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to strengthen the livelihoods of the Thakor and Koli communities by providing financial support for animal husbandry activitiesRs. such as dairy farming with cows and buffaloes. Under this schemeRs. loans are offered to purchase milch animals like cows and buffaloesRs. thereby promoting sustainable self-employment in agriculture-related sectors.
benefits: - The maximum loan limit under this scheme is up to 1Rs./-. - The loan is provided for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farmingRs. boosting rural self-employment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years. 1. The applicant should intend to purchase cowsRs. buffaloesRs. or related dairy equipment for selfemployment.

name: Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals belonging to Scheduled Caste category suffering from incurable and serious diseases. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients diagnosed with life-threatening conditions such as Tuberculosis (TB)Rs. LeukemiaRs. and other critical illnesses.
benefits: - Medical Assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients for treatment of incurable and critical diseases like TBRs. LeukemiaRs. and other serious conditions.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be suffering from an incurable or critical disease such as TB or LeukemiaRs. as certified by a civil surgeon. 1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed 6Rs./- per annum.

name: Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in LandRs. Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to promote adventure sports among the youth of Gujarat by encouraging their participation in training programsRs. workshopsRs. expeditionsRs. and competitions organized within and outside the state. The scheme offers financial support to cover expenses such as feesRs. equipmentRs. insuranceRs. transportationRs. and other relevant costs.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 30Rs./- or 75% of the actual expenditure (whichever is lower).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be up to 45 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicant should have participated in or completed a training programRs. workshopRs. expeditionRs. or competition related to landRs. seaRs. or air adventure sports.

name: Private Tuition Assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying in Science Stream of Class 11 & 12
brief_description: The "Private Tuition Assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying in Science Stream of Class 11 & 12" scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance for private tuition to socially and educationally backward class (SEBC) students pursuing science education in higher secondary classes. Under this schemeRs. a total of 15Rs. is granted to each class of 11th and 12th to cover private tuition fees.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 15Rs. for Class 11th- Financial assistance of 15Rs. for Class 12th
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). 1. The applicant must be studying in the science stream in Class 11th or Class 12th in a recognized higher secondary school.1. The applicant must be availing of private tuition during the academic year. 1. The applicants annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Direct Finance Scheme by NSFDC (GSCDC)
brief_description: The Direct Finance Scheme by NSFDC (GSCDC) scheme was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide concessional credit facilities to Scheduled Caste persons for self-employment opportunities. Under this schemeRs. loans are provided at subsidized rates of interest ranging from 1% to 5%Rs. enabling beneficiaries to start their own income-generating ventures.
benefits: - Provide a loan for self-employment to a scheduled caste person at a low interest rate of just 1% to 5%.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 3Rs..

name: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (SEED)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJE)Rs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)Rs. Government of India. The scheme aims to provide comprehensive empowerment to De-notifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities who are the most neglectedRs. marginalized and economically and socially deprived communitiesRs. addressing their educationalRs. healthRs. livelihood and housing needs through an umbrella approach with an approximate cost of 20Rs./- to be spent over a period of 5 years. The "Educational Empowerment" component provides free coaching of good quality for De-notifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations and monthly stipend support ranging from 1Rs./- to 3Rs./- along with special allowances for students with disabilities. The applicant must belong to De-notifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities and have total family income from all sources of 2Rs./- or less per annum. The scheme is implemented by the Development and Welfare Board for De-NotifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities. The applications for this scheme are accepted Online.
benefits: ##### ***Financial Assistance*** - ***Free Coaching Fees:*** Actual course fee of the institute or the prescribed course fee by the Ministry as per AnnexureRs. whichever is lessRs. subject to the limits for fees and duration laid down in the Annexure.- ***Monthly Stipend for Local Students:*** 1Rs./- per month for students attending coaching within their locality.- ***Monthly Stipend for Outstation Students:*** 3Rs./- per month for students attending coaching outside their locality.- ***Special Allowance for Students with Disabilities:*** 2Rs./- per month towards reader allowanceRs. escort allowanceRs. helper allowance for students having valid disability certificate with 40% or more disability. ##### ***Coaching Coverage*** - Union Public Service Commission Group A and B examinations. - Staff Selection Commission examinations. - Railway Recruitment Boards examinations. - State Public Service Commission Group A and B examinations. - Officers Grade examinations conducted by BanksRs. Insurance Companies and Public Sector Undertakings. - Premier Entrance Examinations for Engineering (Indian Institute of Technology Joint Entrance Examination)Rs. Medical (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)Rs. Management (Common Admission Test)Rs. Law (Common Law Admission Test). - Eligibility tests like Scholastic Assessment TestRs. Graduate Record ExaminationRs. Graduate Management Admission Test and Test of English as a Foreign Language. - Combined Pilot Licence coursesRs. National Defense Academy and Combined Defense Services entrance examinations. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Direct Benefit Transfer mode into beneficiary's bank account linked with Aadhaar. - Course fee released in two installments (50% each)Rs. Monthly stipend and special allowances paid monthly. - Stipend paid till duration of course or for one yearRs. whichever is less. - Benefits available to a student maximum twice in their lifetime. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The candidate must join the selected course within 6 months of receiving the first installment._ - _The candidate must deposit the first installment amount to the selected coaching institute._ - _The candidate must join an institute empanelled by the Ministry under Free Coaching Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Other Backward Classes students._ - _If first installment is not paid to selected institute within 6 monthsRs. amount must be returned to Government and second installment will not be provided._ - _The candidate must submit affidavit that they will take admission in coaching institute within six months of receiving first installment._ - _The candidate must provide admission confirmation from the coaching institute on the online portal._
eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to De-notifiedRs. Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities. - The applicant must have total family income from all sources of 2Rs./- or less per annum. - The applicant must not be availing any such benefits from similar Scheme of Centre Government or the State Government. - The applicant must have secured minimum marks in the qualifying examination of the competitive exam for which coaching is soughtRs. as prescribed in guidelines of the said competitive exam. - The applicant must have passed Class 12th or be studying in Class 12th for competitive exams requiring Class 12th qualification. - The applicant must have completed bachelor level course or be studying in final year of bachelor degree course for competitive exams requiring graduation qualification. ##### ***Priority*** - The applicant will receive priority in selection if they have qualified preliminary examination at least once for examinations conducted in two parts (Preliminary and Mains). - The applicant will be selected based on decreasing order of marks obtained in qualifying exams when eligible applications exceed available slots. ##### ***Special Provisions*** - The applicant with disabilities having valid disability certificate (equal to or more than 40% disability) is eligible for Special Allowance. - The applicant is entitled for free coaching up to two times each for Preliminary and Main examinations for competitive examinations conducted in two stages. - The applicant has no restriction in number of chances for coaching for Interview if selected for interview.
_*The applicant can avail benefits under the scheme maximum twice in their lifetimeRs. irrespective of number of chances entitled for a particular competitive examination._

name: Meghalaya Cinema Theatre Scheme
brief_description: The **Meghalaya Cinema Theatre Scheme** is a component of the CM-ELEVATE Program launched by the Planning Department of the Government of Meghalaya. It aims to employRs. engageRs. and empower the youth of Meghalaya by promoting entrepreneurship and providing easy access to credit through partnerships with various banks. The scheme offers financial support for establishing new cinema theatres or upgrading existing ones across the state. This initiative is designed to preserve and promote the cultural heritage of Meghalaya through film and cinemaRs. while also serving as community hubs for artistic expression and entertainment. AdditionallyRs. it supports value-added facilities such as food courtsRs. gaming zonesRs. childcare servicesRs. and retail spaces to ensure the long-term viability and sustainability of theatre establishments.
benefits: > A maximum project cost of 1.5 Crores for a 100-seater cinema theatre and INR 3 Crores for a 200-seater cinema theatre will be accepted under this scheme.
eligibility: **Individual** 1. The applicants must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicants must be permanent residents of Meghalaya. 1. The applicants must have ownership of the land on which the theatre is proposed or have leased land. 1. The applicants shall not be credit defaulters of any bank. **Registered Entity** 1. The applicant must possess landRs. either self-owned or on leaseRs. duly verified by the competent authority. 1. The applicant shall not be a credit defaulter of any bank.

name: Divisional Tripartite Competition
brief_description: The scheme "Divisional Tripartite Competition" was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote theatrical arts and drama performances across the state by organizing competitive events at divisional and state levelsRs. encouraging cultural participation and excellence in dramatic arts among youth and theatre organizations. The scheme is implemented by the Department of SportsRs. Youth and Cultural ActivitiesRs. Government of Gujarat. The applications for this scheme are accepted Online.
benefits: - The first prize winner of the drama competition will receive a cash prize of 3Rs./-. - The second prize winner will receive a cash prize of 2Rs./-. - The third prize winner will receive a cash prize of 2Rs./-. - The participating organization will receive cash prizes based on their ranking. - The first prize winning organization will receive 10Rs./-. - The second prize winning organization will receive 7Rs./-. - The third prize winning organization will receive 5Rs./-. _*The first and second prize winners of the divisional tri-series drama competition also become eligible to participate at the state level competition._ _*The mode and frequency of benefit disbursement details are not specified in the provided reference material._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.

name: Trekking in Forest Area (Scheduled Tribes)
brief_description: The scheme "Trekking in Forest Area (Scheduled Tribes)" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to instill a deep love for natureRs. pristine landscapesRs. wild animals and birdsRs. treesRs. mountainsRs. springsRs. and ravines among the Scheduled Tribes youth of the state by directly engaging them in a forest trekking experience. Under this initiativeRs. a forest area rotation program is conducted for 100 selected young men and womenRs. giving them immersive exposure to natural surroundings and biodiversity.
benefits: - **Nature Immersion Experience:** The selected beneficiaries will have the opportunity to participate in a guided forest trekking program designed to foster a love for nature and environmental awareness. - **Exposure to Biodiversity:** Participants will get firsthand experience of pristine natural sitesRs. including forestsRs. wildlifeRs. birdsRs. treesRs. springsRs. mountainsRs. and ravines.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. - The applicant should be between 15 and 35 years of age.

name: SERB - POWER Research Grants
brief_description:
The SERB - POWER Research Grants is a program category under the SERB-POWER (Promoting Opportunities For Women in Exploratory Research) ProgramRs. launched by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB)Rs. Ministry of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India. SERB - POWER (Promoting Opportunities For Women in Exploratory Research) program is formulated to mitigate gender disparity in science and engineering research funding in various S&T programs in Indian academic institutions and R&D Laboratories. SERB-POWER is specially designed to provide structured effort toward enhanced diversity in research to ensure equal access and weighted opportunities for Indian women scientists engaged in research and development activities.
The aim of the **SERB - POWER Research Grants** is to encourage emerging and eminent women researchers for an individual-centric and competitive mode of research funding to undertake R&D activities in frontier areas of science and engineering.
benefits:
**Nature and Duration of Support :**
POWER Grants will empower women researchers by funding them under the following two categories:

- **Level I:** The scale of funding up to 60 lakhs for three years. - **Level II:** The scale of funding up to 30 lakhs for three years. - The POWER Grant is provided for equipmentRs. manpowerRs. consumablesRs. travelRs. and contingency. "Overheads" is also being provided to the implementing institution as per prevailing norms of SERB.

**Note:** POWER Grant will be regulated through terms of reference conforming to SERB-CRG guidelines.
eligibility:
1. Applicants [Principal Investigator (PI) and Co-Principal Investigator(s) (Co-PI(s))] should be Indian citizens.
1. The Applicant(s) must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized academic institution or national laboratory or in any other recognized R&D institution in India.
1. Applicants from IITsRs. IISERsRs. IIScRs. NITsRs. Central UniversitiesRs. and National Labs of Central Government Institutions will be considered under the Level I categoryRs. whereas applicants from State Universities/Colleges and Private Academic Institutions should apply under the Level II category.
1. Faculties recruited through the UGC-Faculty Recharge Program are eligible to apply. INSPIRE FacultyRs. RamanujanRs. and Ramalingaswamy Fellows are also eligible to apply provided they have at least three and half years of tenure remaining at the time of submission of application.
1. There is a mandatory requirement for female CO-PI from the same institute.
1. Male CO-PI is not allowed in the POWER Grant Research Scheme.
1. PhD guide cannot be CO-PI.
1. PIs who have already got a POWER GrantRs. are not allowed to apply again in POWER Grant Scheme.
1. JC Bose fellows and the PIs who have already completed two CRG are not allowed to apply for the POWER Grant Research Scheme.
1. The number of CO-PIs should not exceed two per project.

**Note 01:** Women Scientists cannot hold POWER Fellowship and POWER Grant at the same time.
**Note 02:** POWER Grant will be regulated through terms of reference confirming SERB-CRG guidelines.
**Note 03:** SERB POWER grant will be regulated through terms of reference conforming to SERB CRG guidelines except sharing of 50 % non-recurring cost by National Laboratories and Research Institutions.
**Note 04:** The budget under the equipment head is limited to not more than 14 lakhs for Tier II institutions (30 lakhs limit).

name: Gharaunda-Group Home for Adults Scheme
brief_description:
"Gharaunda-Group Home for Adults scheme"Rs. launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. aims at setting up Gharaunda Centres or Registered Organisations (RO) for for all Adult PwDs covered under the National Trust Act with adequate and quality care service with acceptable living standards including provision of basic medical care from professional doctors.
The objective of Gharaunda scheme is to provide an assured home and minimum quality of care services throughout the life of the person with AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities and ensure the following for them: Facilitate establishment of requisite infrastructure for the assured care system throughout the country Encourage assisted living with independence and dignity Provide care services on a sustainable basis
benefits: 1. An assured home and minimum quality of care services throughout the life of the PwD. 1. Adequate and quality care service with acceptable living standards including provision of basic medical care from professional doctors. 1. Vocational activitiesRs. pre-vocational activities and assistance for further training.
eligibility: **Eligibility criteria for the PwD:** 1. PwD should be more than 18 years of age. 1. PwD should have one of the disabilities under the [National Trust ActRs. 1999](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3300891a62162b960cf02ce3827bb363c/uploads/2024/09/20240918793880368.pdf)Rs. which are AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities. **Eligibility criteria for Registered Organization:** 1. Applicant should be registered with the National Trust. 1. Applicant should have a valid registration under the PwD Act 1995Rs. at the time of enrolment. 1. The group home land should either be owned by RO or should have lease of at least 10 years with provision of renewal. 1. RO should have minimum 2 years of experience of working with Persons with Disabilities (PwD) with at least one year experience in one of the four disabilities under the National Trust Act. 1. RO should not be blacklisted by the National Trust or any other Government Organization on the date of submission of scheme enrolment form.

name: SERB - POWER Fellowship
brief_description:
SERB - POWER (Promoting Opportunities For Women in Exploratory Research) Fellowship was launched by the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India to mitigate gender disparity in science and engineering research funding in various S&T programs in Indian academic institutions and R&D Laboratories. The fellowship is aimed to enhance diversity in research to ensure equal access and weighted opportunities for Indian women scientists engaged in research and development activities.
> **Objectives:**

The fellowship is designed to identify and reward excellent women researchers in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratoriesRs. holding Ph.D. degrees in any branch of science and engineering.
> **Duration of Fellowship:**


- Fellowship duration will be fixed for three yearsRs. without the possibility of extension.
- Successful POWER Fellows cannot be re-nominated for the second time.
benefits:
1. Fellowship of 15Rs./- per month in addition to regular income.
1. Research grant of 10 Lakhs per annum. Research grants can be used for minor equipmentRs. research personnelRs. consumablesRs. contingenciesRs. and domestic travel.
1. Overheads for the host institute.
eligibility:
1. The nominee should be an active woman scientist with an excellent record of research performance as an independent investigator.
1. The nominee should be an outstanding woman researcher and innovator working in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratoriesRs. holding Ph.D. degrees in any branch of science and engineering.
1. The nominee should be in regular service throughout the duration of the Fellowship.
1. The nominee should be an Indian citizen between 35-55 years of age working in institutions in India.
1. The nominee should not be receiving any other fellowships from Government sources during the tenure.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to select States/UTs for Skill Development in Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) sector
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Select States/UTs for Skill Development in ESDM Sector" has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. It aims at enhancing the skilling capacities in the ESDM sector through the public and private sectors for students/unemployed youth belonging to other disciplines by utilising the existing human resources who are undergoing studies in schools (IX standard onwards)/ITIs/Polytechnics/UG Colleges (non-engineering) and the school dropouts/unemployed youth by providing them with additional skills that are recognised by industry for employment in the ESDM sectorRs. Encouraging new investments in training in the ESDM sector by the industryRs. Facilitating the evolution of processes/norms for: Certification of various courses; Providing opportunities for moving up the value chain; and Recognition of institutions for conducting such coursesRs. as per the requirements of the industry in the ESDM sector > **Objectives:** - To provide financial assistance for facilitating skill development for 90Rs. persons in the ESDM sector by involving select States/UTs for improving the employability of the students/unemployed youth.
benefits:
1. Assistance of 75% of the course fee for students. 25% of the course fee is to be paid by the student. 1. Assistance of 100% of the course fee for students belonging to SC/STRs. Economically weaker sections (criteria based). 40% seats would be reserved for the students belonging to these categories. 1. name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme (NEBPS) has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. It aims to create employment opportunities for youth and promote investment in the Information Technology (IT) and Information Technology Enabled Services (ITeS) sector by establishing BPO/ITeS operations in the North-Eastern region of India. Through this schemeRs. financial support in the form of Viability Gap Funding (VGF) is provided to eligible companies establishing BPO/ITeS operations. The scheme is implemented by Software Technology Parks of India under the Digital India Programme. The scheme seeks to incentivise the establishment of 5Rs. BPO/ITeS seats in the North-Eastern statesRs. thereby strengthening infrastructureRs. developing skilled manpowerRs. and promoting balanced regional growth in the IT/ITeS sector.
benefits: 1. Financial support [Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) and/or Operational Expenditure (OPEX)] of up to 50% of expenditure per seatRs. with an upper limit of 1 Lakh/seat. 1. Special incentives for: - 7.5% incentive for employing 75% Women (only in NEBPS) - 2% incentive for employing 4% differently abled persons - Up to 10% incentive for generating employment beyond the approved target. - 5% incentive for local entrepreneurs. > This scheme has the potential to create employment opportunities of around 15000 direct jobsRs. considering three shift operations. It may also create a good number of indirect jobs.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be registered in India under the Companies ActRs. 1956 or the Companies ActRs. 2013Rs. or registered under the Limited Liability Partnership ActRs. 2008Rs. as applicable. 1. The applicant should be willing to establish Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) or Information Technology Enabled Services (ITeS) operations with a minimum capacity of 25 seats at one location (city/town). 1. The applicant may quote for a maximum of 1Rs. seatsRs. either: - At one locationRs. or - At multiple locations in the North-Eastern Region (NER). - Arunachal Pradesh - Manipur - Meghalaya - Mizoram - Nagaland - Sikkim - Tripura - Assam 1. The applicant should commit to operate the BPO/ITeS unit for at least 3 years. 1. The applicant should furnish an undertaking to either: - Lease appropriate premises for at least 3 yearsRs. or - Provide proof of ownership of premises for setting up the BPO/ITeS unit. 1. The premises should have a minimum space of 4Rs. square feet for 100 seatsRs. calculated at 40 square feet per seatRs. including utilities. 1. The applicant should have achieved the minimum average annual turnover during the last 3 financial yearsRs. depending on the number of seats applied for: - Number Of Seats 25 50: 1Rs. (Minimum Average Annual Turnover) - Number Of Seats 51 100: 2Rs. (Minimum Average Annual Turnover) - Number Of Seats 101 500: 5Rs. (Minimum Average Annual Turnover) - Number Of Seats 501 1Rs.: 10Rs. (Minimum Average Annual Turnover) - Number Of Seats 1Rs. 1Rs.: 15Rs. (Minimum Average Annual Turnover) 1. The applicant should commit to employing at least 1.5 times the number of approved seats as the employment target for a minimum period of 3 years. 1. The applicant should have a positive net worthRs. certified by a Chartered AccountantRs. as on 31-03-2018 or the last audited financial year. 1. The applicant should not be declared ineligible due to corrupt or fraudulent practices and should not be blacklisted by any Government agency. A self-declaration signed by an authorised signatory should be provided. > **Consortium Eligibility:** 1. The applicant may form a consortium with an Indian company meeting the financial eligibility criteria. 1. The eligible entity in the consortium should maintain at least 26% equity shareholding for a minimum of 3 years from the commencement of operations.

name: Scheme for Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India
brief_description: The scheme "Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India" has been implemented by the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. It aims to provide skill development training to 3Rs. candidates in the Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) sector. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance for training (75% for General category and 100% for Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. and Economically Weaker Section candidates) and 100% reimbursement of certification fees are provided to studentsRs. unemployed youthRs. and school dropouts. The scheme is implemented by Key Implementing AgenciesRs. including National Institute of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Electronics Sector Skills Council of IndiaRs. and Telecom Sector Skill Council. > **Objectives:** - To provide financial assistance for skill development in the ESDM sector across all States and Union Territories. - To facilitate skill development of students and unemployed youth through National Skills Qualifications Framework-compliant courses from Level 1 to Level 5. - To increase the availability of skilled manpower for the electronics industry to support the Digital India initiative.
benefits: **1. Financial Assistance for Course Fee:** - General Category: - 75% of course fee reimbursed by MeitY after certification and placement. - Remaining 25% payable by the candidate (may be shared/borne by the Training Partner). - Reserved Category (SC/ST/EWS): - 100% of the course fee reimbursed by MeitY. **2. Course Fee Structure (Upper Ceiling):** LevelManufacturing Courses ()Service Courses ()Max HoursL1-L29Rs./-8Rs./-200hrsL314Rs./-12Rs./-300hrsL417Rs./-14Rs./-350hrsL519Rs./-16Rs./-400hrs - Base Cost: - 41.90/hour (Service Sector) - 48.90/hour (Manufacturing Sector) **3. Registration-cum-Certification Fee (RCCF)** - Range: 762/- to 1Rs./- (depending on level) - Paid upfront by the candidate - Refund (one time only) after successful certification: - General: 75% reimbursed - Reserved: 100% reimbursed **4. Reimbursement Structure** - 80% on successful certification - 20% on successful placement **5. Placement-Linked Benefit** - Minimum 70% placement required for full reimbursement - Placement tracking is mandatory for 3 months
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 9 or Class 10 onwards; or the applicant should be a school dropout from 8th pass onwards; or the applicant should be an ITI certificate holderRs. a diploma holderRs. an undergraduateRs. a graduateRs. or registered in employment exchanges. 1. The applicant should be eligible to enrol in any of the 5 NSQF levels (Level 1 to Level 5)Rs. subject to meeting the minimum eligibility criteria of the respective course. 1. The applicant should have a valid Aadhaar NumberRs. or an Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID) may also be considered. 1. The applicant should provide consent for Aadhaar authentication or the e-KYC process. 1. The applicant should not have been a beneficiary of any Government of India-aided skilling course in the ESDM fieldRs. sponsored by the Central or State Government. 1. The applicant should submit an undertaking declaring non-availment of any such scheme at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant should have attained a minimum age of 17 years at the time of registration/enrolment. 1. The applicant should be willing to get employed or self-employed and submit an undertaking to this effect at the time of enrolment. 1. The applicant should undergo training for the prescribed duration and appear for an assessment conducted by the respective Key Implementing Agency (KIA). 1. The applicant should maintain at least 70% attendance to be eligible to appear for the assessment. 1. The applicant can avail the benefit under the scheme only once; howeverRs. for manufacturing job rolesRs. the applicant may be allowed to undergo two courses at successive NSQF levels. > **Reservation / Preference:** - 60% seats: General Category - 40% seats: Reserved Categories - SC: 15% - ST: 7.5% - EWS: 17.5% - EWS Criteria: - The applicants family income should not exceed 2Rs./- annually.

name: MeritcumMeans Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects
brief_description:
The "Merit-cum-Means Scholarships for Undergraduate Studies in Agriculture and Animal Science" is a prestigious scheme introduced by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs. Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE). The objective of this scholarship is to attract meritorious students to pursue undergraduate studies in AgricultureRs. Agricultural EngineeringRs. Home ScienceRs. DairyRs. and Animal Husbandry.
The scholarship is awarded annually based on merit-cum-means criteria. To be eligibleRs. students must meet the 'Means Test' condition and secure at least 60% marks or equivalent grade points in the qualifying examination. Each selected student will receive 1Rs. per monthRs. and the scholarship will be tenable for the entire duration of the degree course in the relevant subject.
benefits: The value of the scholarships for undergraduate studies in Agriculture (including Agricultural Engineering & Home Science) and Animal Science subjects will be 1Rs./- per month per student. The scholarship will be tenable for the full duration of the degree course in the concerned subject.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have domiciled in India. 1. The applicant should be a student who meets the Means Test condition as defined in the scheme guidelines. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks or equivalent grade points in the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant should be considered on inter-se merit in case of a tieRs. with preference given to those with higher marks in science subjects. 1. The applicant should pursue undergraduate studies in AgricultureRs. Agricultural EngineeringRs. Home ScienceRs. DairyRs. or Animal Husbandry.
**MEANS TEST** 1. The applicant should be from a family whose parents' annual income does not exceed 1Rs. to be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The applicant should note that there is no provision for a half scholarship under this scheme. 1. The applicant should be aware that if their parents' income exceeds 1Rs. per annumRs. they will not be eligible for the scholarship but may receive a national prize of 500 and a certificate of merit.

name: Scheme of Internship of Students to DRDO Labs/Estts for Project Training
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme of Internship of Students to DRDO Labs/Estts for Project Training" has been launched by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)Rs. Ministry of Defence. It aims to provide an opportunity and exposure to prospective graduates and postgraduates in Engineering and General Sciences to the research and development activities carried out by DRDO in state-of-the-art technology fields relevant to the defense sector.
benefits:
1. Internship Training is provided in the areas relevant to DRDO.
1. Provide opportunity to interns to be associated with projects.

**Note:** DRDO shall not be liable for any compensation in case of personal injury resulting from an accident occurring during the students' attachment to DRDO Labs/Establishments.
***Duration of Training:***

- The period of training generally is 4 weeks to 6 Months.

**Note:** The duration of training will depend on the type of course and is subject to the discretion of the Lab Director.
eligibility:
1. Students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in Engineering or General Sciences are eligible.
1. Interns will be permitted access only to UNCLASSIFIED areas of DRDO Labs/Establishments.

**Note 1:** The provisions of the Apprentices ActRs. 1961Rs. do not apply to this scheme.
**Note 2:** DRDO is under no obligation to offer employment to students upon completion of their training.

name: GEN-NEXT Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS)
brief_description: The scheme "Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS)" has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)Rs. Government of India. It aims to discoverRs. supportRs. grow and accelerate successful startups in Tier-2 and Tier-3 citiesRs. with emphasis on collaborative engagement among startupsRs. governmentRs. and corporates for promoting digitisation based on the principles of inclusivityRs. accessibilityRs. and affordabilityRs. leading to growth in employment and economic outputs. Through this schemeRs. funding support (for Pilot/Proof-of-ConceptRs. InvestmentRs. Early-stageRs. and Deep-tech categories)Rs. capacity-buildingRs. mentorshipRs. ecosystem linkagesRs. and community-building initiatives are provided to studentsRs. facultyRs. academic institutionsRs. budding entrepreneursRs. startup companiesRs. incubatorsRs. Centres of Excellence (CoEs)Rs. acceleratorsRs. mentorsRs. investorsRs. and corporates engaged in innovation-based growth. The scheme is implemented by MeitY Startup Hub (MSH) through approximately 50 Implementing Agencies (IAs)Rs. preferably from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities of the country. The total budget outlay for the scheme is 4Rs./- (490 Crore) for a duration of 5 years. The programme envisages impacting and consolidating 10Rs.+ tech startups over the course of the next 5 years to pave the road for an inclusive startup ecosystem. > **Objectives:** - Consolidation of all the existing schemes and assets of MeitY to provide greater efficiency in asset utilisationRs. increased return from scheme expenditureRs. and overall enhanced support for startups. - Building Tier-II and Tier-III focused funding to critically support Pilot/InvestmentRs. Early-stage and deep-tech startups. Implementation partners and the startups selection under the GENESIS Scheme will be done by experts based on a defined and structured selection process. - Community Building initiativesRs. including workshopsRs. boot campsRs. conferencesRs. etc.Rs. to strengthen the ecosystem and build brand and recognition of MeitY Startups-related Initiatives. All the activities under GENESIS will be aligned to MeitY's major initiativesRs. including India AIRs. ISMRs. and India StackRs. etc.
benefits: > **The scheme provides support across 4 components:** 1. **Investment Support:** - Private-sector matching funding at 1:1 for the investment component of the scheme. - Average funding of 40Rs./- (40 Lakhs)Rs. up to a maximum of 50Rs./- (50 Lakhs) per startup. - Matching fund requirement: Yes (1:1 private sector match). 1. **Pilot (Proof-of-Concept) Support:** - Pilot funding to startups with average funding of 40Rs./- (40 Lakhs)Rs. up to 50Rs./- (50 Lakhs). - Matching fund requirement: None. 1. **Ideation Support (Entrepreneur in Residence EiR:** - Supports early-stage startups with funding of up to 10Rs./- (10 Lakhs). - Matching fund requirement: None. 1. **Deep-tech Startup Support:** - Provision to support select Deep-tech startups with funding support of an upper ceiling of 1Rs./- (1 Crore) per startup. - Matching fund requirement: None. 1. **Non-Monetary Benefits:** - GENESIS Startup Platform: A single-window solution for all startup-centric schemes of MeitYRs. programmesRs. and initiatives targeted towards Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and towns. - Challenges Execution: SourcingRs. executingRs. monitoringRs. and reporting on challenges and supporting startups. - Corporate and Institutional Partnerships: Building linkages with global startup ecosystems and aggregating resources from global and local industriesRs. institutionsRs. and agencies for the benefit of startups. - Capacity Building and Performance Optimisation: Optimising and enhancing the performance of MeitY assetsRs. programmesRs. and schemes via capacity-building programmes. - Building a self-sustaining "community of communities": Creating awareness and engagement of a larger number of startups via effective and pervasive media and marketing programmes.
eligibility: > **Eligibility for Implementing Agencies (IAs):** The applicant Implementing Agency must be a legal entity and must fall under one of the following categories: 1. The applicant should be an entity registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act; OR 1. The applicant should be a society registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860; OR 1. The applicant should be a trust registered under the Indian Trusts ActRs. 1882; OR 1. The applicant should be a statutory body created through an Act of the legislature. 1. The applicant may also be an IncubatorRs. AcceleratorRs. or Educational Institute recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) / All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)Rs. or formed under a Central/State Act. 1. The applicant should be an entity engaged in supporting startups as part of the startup ecosystem. > **Eligibility for Startups:** 1. The applicant should be a beneficiary of MeitY Schemes or should be registered with MeitY Startup Hub (MSH). 1. The applicant should be a startup registered with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). 1. The shareholding by Indian promoters in the applicant startup should be at least 51% at the time of application to the incubator for the schemeRs. as per the Companies ActRs. 2013. 1. The applicant startup should have a full-time Chief Executive Officer (CEO). 1. The applicant startup should have market-ready products and should be seeking funds for business development and commercialisation (applicable in certain categories).

name: National Geoscience Awards
brief_description: The National Mineral Awards Scheme was instituted in the year 1966 by the Ministry of MinesRs. Government of India. The scope of the awards has been expanded and the name changed to National Geoscience Awards (NGA) from 2009. The objective of the scheme is to honour individuals and teams for extraordinary achievements and outstanding contributions in the field of mineral discovery & explorationRs. fundamental / applied geosciencesRs. mining and allied areas. **Broad Disciplines:-** 1) Mineal Discovery & Exploration 2) Mining TechnologyRs. Mineral Beneficiation & Sustainable Mineral Development 3) Basic Geosciences 4) Applied Geosciences **No. of Awardees** 1) National Geoscience Award for Lifetime Achievement - 1 2) National Geoscience Award - 10 (Individual/ Team) 3) National Young Geoscientist Award - 1 **There are three categories of awards under the National Geoscience Awards:** (i) National Geoscience Award for Lifetime Achievement (ii) National Geoscience Award and (iii) National Young Geoscientist Award
benefits: > **The awardees are presented with certificate and a plaque.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an Indian citizen and a professionally qualified geoscientistRs. engineerRs. technologistRs. or academician with significant contributions in relevant fields. 1. The applicants work should primarily be carried out in India within the last ten yearsRs. except for the Lifetime Achievement Award. 1. A team nomination can include a maximum of four membersRs. with limited team awards available. 1. The applicant for the Young Geoscientist Award should be below 35 years of age as of 31st December of the preceding year. 1. The applicant can receive an award only once in a particular field but may apply in other fields. 1. Recipients of the Lifetime Achievement Award are not eligible to apply for any other awards. 1. A certificate from the head of institution or department confirming the nominees work is desirable but not mandatory.

name: National Award for Individual Excellence
brief_description: The National Award for Individual Excellence under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to recognize and encourage individuals who are working towards the empowerment of persons with disabilitiesRs. including those covered under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. **Number of Awardees:** 1. Sarvashreshth Divyangjan (Most Outstanding Persons with Disabilities): 6 awards (3 male and 3 female) 1. Shreshth Divyangjan (Outstanding Persons with Disabilities): 10 awards (5 male and 5 female) 1. Shreshth Srijansheel Divyang Bal/Balika (Outstanding Creative Child with Disabilities): 2 awards (1 male and 1 female) 1. Sarvashreshth Vyakti working for empowerment of Persons with Disabilities: 1 award 1. Most Outstanding Rehabilitation Professional/Personnel in the field of disability: 1 award 1. Most Outstanding Research/Innovation/Product Development in the field of disability: 1 award
benefits: 1. **Sarvashreshth Divyangjan (Most Outstanding Persons with Disabilities):** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 2.00 lakh for each awardee.1. **Shreshth Divyangjan (Outstanding Persons with Disabilities):** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 1.00 lakh for each awardee.1. **Shreshth Srijansheel Divyang Bal/Balika (Outstanding Creative Child with Disabilities):** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 1.00 lakh for each awardee.1. **Most Outstanding Person working for the empowerment of Persons with Disabilities:** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 1.00 lakh.1. **Most Outstanding Rehabilitation Professional/Personnel in the field of disability:** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 1.00 lakh.1. **Most Outstanding Research/Innovation/Product Development in the field of disability:** CertificateRs. medalRs. and cash award of 1.00 lakh.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an individual with a benchmark disability of 40% or more as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016 (for specified categories). 1. The applicant can self-nominate or be nominated by another person for only one category of award. 1. The applicant should not have received any National Award from the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in the past 5 years. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age for Most Outstanding and Outstanding Persons with Disabilities categories. 1. For the Creative Child with Disabilities categoryRs. the applicant should be up to 18 years of age. 1. Eligible disability categories include locomotor disabilityRs. visual impairmentRs. hearing impairmentRs. intellectual disabilityRs. and other specified disabilities. 1. For other categories (empowermentRs. rehabilitationRs. research/innovation)Rs. any individual (with or without disability) can apply or be nominatedRs. subject to eligibility conditions.

name: Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak
brief_description: The "Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak" scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to recognize excellent workRs. promote high professional standardsRs. and boost the morale of personnel serving in police forcesRs. security organizationsRs. intelligence unitsRs. and forensic science institutions across India.
benefits: - Medal awarded to selected officials/officers. - Certificate (Scroll) signed by the Union Home Minister. - National recognition through publication in the Gazette of India (except Intelligence cases). - Recording of additional achievements through Bars for repeated acts.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a member of Police ForcesRs. Security OrganizationsRs. Intelligence WingsRs. or Forensic Science Institutions. 1. The applicant should demonstrate excellence in Special OperationRs. InvestigationRs. IntelligenceRs. or Forensic Science. 1. The applicant should not have any pending judicial proceedings or departmental enquiry. 1. The applicant should not have received any major penalty in the last 5 years. 1. The applicant should be recommended by the concerned authority. 1. The applicant should not be recommended for multiple fields for the same operation. 1. The applicant should meet specific criteria for the respective field (operationRs. investigationRs. intelligenceRs. or forensic work).

name: Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Chief Minister Small and Marginal Farmers Older Pension Scheme" implemented by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide financial assistance to elderly small and marginal farmers for their social and economic well-being.
benefits: - **Pension of 1250/- per month.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to a small and marginal farmer family. 1. The minimum age requirement is: - 55 years or above for women. - 58 years or above for men.
**NOTE:** Small and marginal farmer as per the definition under the National Food Security OrdinanceRs. 2013Rs. and as per the Rajasthan Government's Food and Civil Supplies Department circular dated 31.8.2013.

name: National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) Internship Programme
brief_description: The scheme "National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) Internship Programme" by the National AIDS Control OrganisationRs. Ministry of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of India aims to provide internship exposure through stipend support to students to understand policy-making and implementation under HIV/AIDS programmes. The internship is offered on varied priority areas such as secondary data analysis of ICTC and PPTCT programmeRs. MSM interventionsRs. EID programmeRs. primary research and data analysis on community perceptions of the HIV/AIDS ActRs. 2017 and Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) BillRs. 2018. The interns are expected to follow the standard schedule of activitiesRs. observe the functioning of the divisionsRs. participate in activitiesRs. conduct data analysis & researchRs. write reportsRs. undertake field visitsRs. and any other task assigned/entrusted to them by the HOD / Reporting Officer.
benefits: - **Stipend:** 8Rs./- per month provided after successful completion and report approval. - **Certificate:** Issued upon successful completion of the internship and acceptance of the report. - **Logistic Support:** WorkspaceRs. stationeryRs. and photocopying facilities are provided during the internship. - **Duration:** The internship would be for a minimum duration of 6 weeks and max. duration of 3 monthsRs. as per the prerequisites of the study programme. There shall be no bar for candidates to apply for a second internship with NACO. **NOTE 1:** The internship programme is neither a job nor any such assurance for a job in the National AIDS Control Organisation or any other Ministry/ Department in the Government of India. **NOTE 2:** Students who discontinue the internship would not be awarded any certificate by NACO. **NOTE 3:** Interns will need to have their own laptop computers and internet connectivity. **NOTE 4:**Interns coming from outside Delhi / New Delhi have to make their own arrangements for stay/ accommodation at their own expense.
eligibility: - The applicant must be pursuing undergraduateRs. postgraduateRs. M.PhilRs. or PhD courses. - The applicant must be studying in disciplines such as Public HealthRs. Preventive & Social MedicineRs. Health ManagementRs. StatisticsRs. Social SciencesRs. or related fields. - The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized university or institution. > **Reservation / Preference / Priority:** - Preference will be given to applicants having an excellent academic track record and to research scholarsRs. and candidates bringing project work relevant to NACOs activities or concomitant with NACP. - There shall be no bar for candidates to apply for a second internship with NACO. > **Number of Interns:** The number of interns can vary depending on the applications and requirements of NACO. HoweverRs. at any point in timeRs. the number of interns shall not be more than 10. > **Placement:** The Interns will be placed in selected programme divisions within NACO or rotated through different divisions based on the prerequisites of the study programme.

name: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana Gujarat
brief_description: The "Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana" was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to families of Scheduled Tribe (ST) girls at the time of their marriage. Under this schemeRs. a financial benefit per couple is provided to ensure economic support to families and to encourage social welfare.
benefits: Financial assistance of 12Rs./- per couple is provided during the marriage.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a native of the Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant's annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The benefits under this scheme are eligible for till the occasion of the marriage of two (2) adult girls of the family. 1. The bride's age must be 18 years at the time of marriage. 1. The groom's age must be 21 years at the time of marriage.

name: Assistance for Purchase of Educational Instruments for Medical, Engineering and Technical Diploma Courses
brief_description: The "Assistance for Purchase of Educational Instruments for MedicalRs. Engineering and Technical Diploma Courses" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students to purchase necessary educational instruments to pursue higher education in medicalRs. engineeringRs. and technical diploma courses.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance Amounts:** - Medical Students: 15Rs. annually. - Engineering Students: 10Rs. annually. - Diploma Students: 5Rs. annually.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized medicalRs. engineeringRs. or technical diploma course. 1. The applicants annual family income should not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Advocate Graduate Stipend Gujarat
brief_description: The Advocate Graduate Stipend scheme was launched by the Tribal Development DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat.
