PM SVANidhiRs. MudraRs. in the past 5 years. - The registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
brief_description: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of EducationRs. implemented by AICTERs. aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young studentRs. who is otherwise specially abledRs. the opportunity to study further and prepare for a successful future through technical education/ knowledge. 50Rs./- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college feeRs. purchase of computerRs. stationeriesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. softwareRs. etc. The candidate should be admitted to the First year of the Diploma level course OR the Second year of the Diploma level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year. Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the current financial year.
benefits:
1. 50Rs./- per annum for every year of study i.e. maximum 3 years for the first year admitted students and maximum 2 years for the second year admitted students through lateral entry as lump sum amount towards payment of college feeRs. purchase of computerRs. stationeriesRs. booksRs. equipmentRs. softwareRs. etc.
1. After selectionRs. the awardee will be paid a scholarship through DBT mode on annual basis.
1. The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of renewal through National Scholarship Portal by submitting a passing certificate/ mark sheet along with a letter from the Head of the Institution on the online portal
eligibility: 1. The candidate should be admitted to the first year of the diploma-level course or the second year of the diploma-level course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE-approved institutions of the respective year. 1. Specially-abled students have a disability of not less than 40%. 1. Family income from all sources should not be more than 8Rs./- per annum during the current financial year. A valid income certificate issued by the state/UT government needs to be enclosed.

name: Biotechnology Career Advancement And Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme For Women Scientists
brief_description: Biotechnology Career Advancement and Re-orientation (BioCARe) ProgrammeRs. a special scheme of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT)Rs. Ministry of Science & TechnologyRs. the government of India aims to enhance the participation of women scientists in India towards research in Biotechnology and allied area. The program is mainly for the career development of unemployed female scientists for whom it will be the first sanctioned extramural research funding. Through this endeavor of the DepartmentRs. a concerted effort would be made to give women scientists a strong foothold into the scientific professionRs. to help them re-enter the mainstreamRs. and to provide a launch pad for further forays into the field of science and technology. AccordinglyRs. applications are invited from Indian female scientists to apply to the program. On the behalf of Department of BiotechnologyRs. this program is being managed by the Processing and Management Unit (PMU) established at International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB)Rs. New Delhi.
benefits: > **Date of Commencement of Project & its Duration** 1. The duration of the project is of three (3) years and is specified in the sanction order. 1. The project starting date will be effective from the date on which the candidate joins the Institution but within 45 days from the date of issuance of the sanction order. The date of receipt of the grant should be intimated by the Institution authorities/Mentor and Nodal officer to this Department. It willRs. in no case be later than 15 days after the receipt of the grant by the Institute. 1. The successful candidates have to join their host institution within 45 days from the date of issuance of the sanction orderRs. or else it would be withdrawn. > **Project Cost & Fellowship to Project Investigator** Project Cost & Fellowship: Based on the applicant's qualifying degreeRs. the budget support is provided in the following two categories: **Category:** Category-I **Qualifying Degree:** Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences or allied areas or interdisciplinary sciences /MD/MDS/M.V.Sc. **Research Grant:** Restricted up to 60Rs. (includes consolidated Fellowship of 68Rs./month). **Category:** Category-II **Qualifying Degree:** M.Tech. in Biotechnology or allied areas / MPharma/ equivalent degree. **Research Grant:** Restricted up to 40Rs. (Includes consolidated Fellowship of 50Rs./month).
eligibility: > **Eligible Areas for Financial Support** 1. Animal and Marine Biotechnology or allied areas. 2. Bioengineering and Biomaterials or allied areas. 3. Medical Biotechnology or allied areas. 4. Environmental Biotechnology and Bioenergy or allied areas. 5. Plant and Agriculture Biotechnology or allied areas. **1. Employment:** a) Candidates in regular or permanent employment are not eligible to apply for BioCARe. b) Women scientists who are working in any temporary positions in research or academics may apply for the scheme but they have to leave their earlier assignment if a project is approved for them under BioCARe program. c) Candidates who have already received any extramural funding as Principal Investigator for research from any Govt. Funding Agency/Government-supported funding agency is not eligible to apply under this program as it should be their first sanctioned and independent project for research. **2. Age:** The woman scientist should be upto/below 45 yearsRs. as of the last date of the submission of the application. **3. Educational Qualification:** a) **Category-I:** Women Scientists who have completed a Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences or allied areas/interdisciplinary sciences/MD/MDS/ M.V.Sc. b) **Category-II:** Women Scientists who have completed M.Tech in Biotechnology or in allied areas/MPharma/ -Degree holders **NOTE:** Candidates who are registered in Ph.D. and receiving any fellowships are not eligible to apply. > **For the Mentor** 1. She/he should be a permanent employee at the Host Institute and should not be a spouse or relative of the applicant. 1. He/She will be the person in whose laboratory & under whose supervision the applicant intends to carry out the project under the BioCARe program. 1. The proposal submitted under the BioCARe scheme should be the applicants initiative and should not be an extension of the Mentors research. 1. The proposed research is expected to complement and benefit from the Mentors research interests and expertise. 1. The Mentor must have at least 5 years of service remaining. 1. The Mentor must guarantee the applicant access to laboratory space and resources required for the projectRs. and provide relevant scientific guidance and career advice for the tenure of the project. 1. The Mentor must have at least three ongoing and/or four successfully completed extramural research projects in the last five yearsRs. funded by government/government-supported agencies as PI. > **For the Institution** 1. An applicant can submit his application for a research grant from a government-supported/government funded (such as central universitiesRs. state universitiesRs. autonomous institutionsRs. Private Universities/Institutes etc.) or an Indian non-profit Institution. 1. The Institution will be required to adhere to the guidelines & conditions outlined by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT)Rs. Government of India.

name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
brief_description: The Internship Program by the Indian Patent Office recognizes the abundance of creative and innovative energies that flow in IndiaRs. and the need to tap into and channelize these energies. The program aims to work towards the fulfilment of the objectives of the National IPR Policy. > **Objectives** This internship program aims to work towards the fulfilment of the following objectives of the National IPR Policy 2016: 1. **IPR Awareness: Outreach and Promotion** To create public awareness about the economicRs. social and cultural benefits of IPRs among all sections of society. 1. **Generation of IPRs** - To stimulate the generation of IPRs. 1. **Human Capital Development** - To strengthen and expand human resourcesRs. institutions and capacities for teachingRs. trainingRs. research and skill building in IPRs. > **Number of Interns** The number of interns to be taken every year by the office of CGPDTM will be decided by the office every year depending upon the requirementRs. infrastructure and other facilities of the office. > **Duration** The duration of the internship shall be as per the requirement of the course curriculum. > **Place of Internship** The place of internship can be at the IP Office in DelhiRs. MumbaiRs. KolkataRs. Chennai and RGNIIPMRs. Nagpur.
benefits: > **Certificate** Upon successful completion of the internshipRs. a certificate shall be issued by the Head of Office where the intern has interned. > **Honorarium** No honorarium of any sort shall be paid to the intern. > **Leave** A leave of three days per monthRs. excluding medical leaveRs. will be provided to the intern.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
2. The applicant should be pursuing or has completed one of the following programs from a University established under law in the territory of India.
a) Post-Graduation / Doctoral Studies in Science.
b) Graduation / Post-Graduation / Doctoral Studies in Engineering or Technology.
c) Graduation / Post-Graduation / Doctoral Studies in Law.
3. In the case of candidates pursuing graduation / post-graduation / doctoral studiesRs. the internship should be a requirement specified under their course curriculum.
4. The graduation / post-graduation / doctoral studies of the applicant should be from a government-recognized institute.

name: SAHAKAR MITRA: NCDCs Scheme on Internship Programme
brief_description: The "SAHAKAR MITRA Scheme on Internship Programme (SIP)" was launched by the National Cooperative Development Corporation to provide practical learning experience to professional graduates in the cooperative sector. The scheme offers short-term internship opportunities of up to four months in the areas related to the functioning of NCDC and cooperatives. It helps interns understand the cooperative business modelRs. project preparationRs. and organizational working. The programme also encourages young professionals to support cooperativesRs. FPOsRs. and start-up cooperatives through leadership and entrepreneurship development.
benefits: **Financial Support from NCDC:** The intern will be offered the following financial benefits during the course of SIP (4 months):- **Sl. No.****Details****Amount**1.Consolidated monthly amount of 10Rs./- for 4 months towards partly meeting his/her out-of-pocket expenses40Rs./-2.Expenses related to report preparation (lumpsum amount towards data collectionRs. analysisRs. and preparation of a report)5Rs./-3.Total45Rs./-***Note:*** **The last months consolidated amount of 10Rs./- shall be paid upon successful completion of the internship which includes submission of reportsRs. etc.** > **Tenure:** The internship duration does not exceed four monthsRs. adhering to the NCDC guidelines.
eligibility:
**1. A person with any of the following qualifications will be eligible for consideration:-**

- Professional graduates with minimum qualification as Bachelors degree in Agri/ Dairy/ Animal Husbandry/ Veterinary Sciences/ Fisheries/Horticulture/ Textiles/ Handloom / IT duly recommended by the Head of the Department of the UGC / AICTE / ICAR recognized Universities / Institutions as applicable.
- Professionals (pursuing or completed) MBA Agri Business / MBA Coop / M.Com / MCA / MBA Finance / MBA International Trade/MBA Forestry/MBA Rural Dev / MBA Project Management / Inter ICAI / Inter ICWA qualification duly recommended by the Head of the Department of the UGC / AICTE / ICAR recognized Universities / Institutions as applicable.

2. A person cannot be taken as an intern more than once.
> **Number of Interns and Location:**

NCDC limits interns to 60 overallRs. spanning Regional OfficesRs. LINACRs. and Head Office annually.
Each Regional Office can host a maximum of two interns simultaneouslyRs. as per NCDC guidelines.
A maximum of two interns per year is allowed from a specific institutionRs. following NCDC guidelines.

name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
brief_description: The scheme Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for Writing Original Books in Hindi has been launched by the Department of Official LanguageRs. Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. to encourage writing original books in Hindi and to promote the official language. Under the schemeRs. the citizens of India will be awarded as follows: - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing an original book in Hindi on EngineeringRs. ElectronicsRs. Computer ScienceRs. PhysicsRs. BiologyRs. EnergyRs. Space ScienceRs. MedicineRs. ChemistryRs. Information TechnologyRs. ManagementRs. Psychology and contemporary topics like LiberalisationRs. GlobalisationRs. ConsumerismRs. Human RightsRs. Pollution. - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original books in Hindi on the subjects of Law and Police ResearchRs. Forensic ScienceRs. criminologyRs. police administrationRs. etc. - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing an original book in Hindi on subjects related to CultureRs. ReligionRs. Arts and HeritageRs. etc. - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original books in Hindi by the author of the 'C' region (on the subjects of all the above categories). - Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for books translated in Hindi - For translated books on classics and subjects related to cultureRs. artRs. and heritage. > **Objective:** (A) In various ministries/departments/offices/undertakings/banksRs. etc. of the central governmentRs. official work is also undertaken on technical subjects. Due to a lack of books on subjects like technicalRs. scienceRs. judicial scienceRs. policeRs. criminology researchRs. police administrationRs. cultureRs. religionRs. artsRs. heritageRs. etc.Rs. and lawRs. there is a difficulty in increasing the use of Hindi in official work. In additionRs. due to being less familiar with or not familiar with the Hindi vocabulary of these subjectsRs. personnel face difficulties in doing official work in Hindi. (B) A new category is being included to encourage original writing in Hindi by authors of the 'C' region. (C) In additionRs. translation is an important means of disseminating knowledge and literature in English and scheduled Indian languages to the Hindi-speaking community. In the past yearsRs. many good translated books have also been receivedRs. which could not be included due to not having an award in this category. The vision of the Honourable Home Minister is to increase coordination between Indian languages and Hindi. HenceRs. a new category of books translated from English and other Indian languages into Hindi is being included under these awards. ThusRs. with the objective of promoting original book writing and excellent translated works in Hindi on the above subjectsRs. the Department of Official Language has initiated this scheme. (D) Only the Department of Official Language has been made the nodal department for different award schemes related to Hindi at the national level by various Ministries / Departments of the Central Government. It shall be mandatory to consult the Department of Official LanguageRs. Ministry of Home AffairsRs. before launching any other award scheme related to Hindi by any Ministry / Department in future so that repetition of the award scheme may be avoided.
benefits: **Award Scheme Summary:** > **A. Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar writing original book in Hindi on EngineeringRs. ElectronicsRs. Computer ScienceRs. PhysicsRs. BiologyRs. EnergyRs. Space ScienceRs. MedicineRs. ChemistryRs. Information TechnologyRs. ManagementRs. Psychology and contemporary topics like LiberalisationRs. GlobalizationRs. ConsumerismRs. Human RightsRs. name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF)
brief_description: The Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) is a component of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and ITRs. implemented by the Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information TechnologyRs. Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to promote R&DRs. create an innovative ecosystemRs. and enhance Indias competitiveness in the knowledge-intensive sectors of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications and recognitions. Support is provisioned for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of one yearRs. to encourage specialized research in emerging areas.
benefits: ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** 1.08 Lakh/Month - **Contingency Grant:** 1 Lakh for 1 year (on re-imbursement and pro-rata basis depending on the period spent under the award). The claim would be submitted by the awardee through respective institution to PhD Cell in prescribed format. - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institutions. - Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipmentRs. consumables and similar items relevant to the research work. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for the PDF fellow. - There is no provision for providing research personnel support under the scheme. The fellow is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the fellowship. - PDF is a full-time assignment. The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - Post-doctoral positions are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution at which PDF seat is allocated and the fellow is enrolled. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignmentRs. and is tenable for a period of 1 year.
eligibility:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting PDF seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD SchemeRs. DICRs. MeitY.
1. The call for proposal for PDF seats will be notified by PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/ and/or email. 2. Proposals for allotment of PDF seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of PDF fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines. 3. The institution may design/have its own application form for advertisement of PDF; howeverRs. the guidelines for PDF are to be followed which must include the following:
1. The PDF applicant should be an Indian citizen. 1. The PDF applicant must have obtained PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of gradesRs. etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. 1. The eligible participating institution must ensure that the PDF applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application to the institution. 1. The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application to the eligible participating institution. 1. A suitable Mentor/Guide under whom the proposed research would be carried outRs. must be identified by the institution. 1. Mentor/Guide of PDF fellow must hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized institution in India. He/she should hold a Ph.D. degree in Science or Engineering. 1. Preference would be given to the PDF applicants who have active industry linkages and their research proposal is directed towards industry specific problems. 1. The research proposal of the PDF applicantRs. to be submitted to the institutionRs. should define clear objectivesRs. outcomes and deliverables against the award. 1. PDF applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. HoweverRs. scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions would be considered howeverRs. they would be required to relinquish their current roles if selected for the fellowship. 1. PDF applicants should not have completed their PhD at the same institution where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded. 1. The applicant must have a proven track record as evident from their research publications and recognitions. 1. The applicant should not be availing any other fellowship. ***Discontinuation of the Fellowship*** 1. If any fellow wishes to discontinue the fellowshipRs. the institution should inform PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY immediately. One months notice is to be given by the institution before the date of discontinuation. 1. The implementing institution should not incur any expenditure from the date of termination of the award/project or the date of resignation of the fellow. The institution will responsible for submission of work report and other requisite documents. 1. In case the post-doctoral fellow undertakes any full/part-time assignmentRs. his/her PDF award under the scheme would be discontinued. 1. PhD CellRs. DIC; MeitY reserves the right to hold/ stop/ discontinue the fellowship at any stageRs. if - Appropriate progress is not being made. - The grant is not being utilized properly. - Violation/ Non-compliance of guidelines. - Any other reasonRs. which is deemed appropriate by PhD CellRs. DICRs. MeitY.

name: National Agriculture Market
brief_description: The "e-National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)" is a pan-India electronic trading platform launched on 14th April 2016 to integrate APMC mandis across the country under the One Nation One Market initiative. Implemented by the Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers WelfareRs. the platform provides online trading facilities for agricultural commodities. It offers services such as commodity arrival informationRs. quality assayingRs. e-biddingRs. and direct e-payment to farmers through a single-window system. The scheme aims to improve transparencyRs. efficiencyRs. and better price discovery in agricultural marketing. In Jammu & KashmirRs. 11 mandis have been integrated with the e-NAM platform since May 2020.
benefits: > **For Farmers:** - Access to Pan-India Markets through a digital trading platform. - Real-time Price Discovery based on demand and supply. - Transparency in auction and payment processes. - Better Prices through wider buyer participation. - Online Payment directly to farmers' bank accounts. - Free Quality Testing (Assaying) of produce in markets. - Reduced Information Asymmetryfarmers can see prices and make informed decisions. > **For Markets (APMCs/RMCs):** - One-time Grant of up to 30 lakh per market for hardwareRs. internetRs. assaying labsRs. etc. - Free e-NAM Software is provided with customization for each state. - Support Staff (1 person per market) provided for 1 year at no cost. - Provision to use Cold Storages & Warehouses as market sub-yards. - Infrastructure Support for setting up: 1. e-auction halls. 1. assaying labs. 1. electronic weighbridges. 1. training facilities. > **For State Governments / UTs:** - Eligibility for Central Funding upon adopting key APMC Act reforms: 1. Single trading license for the state. 1. Single-point market fee. 1. Legal provision for e-trading. - Support for Soil Testing Labs (STLs) under related schemes (NMSA/RKVY). - TrainingRs. Dispute Resolution MechanismRs. and linking more markets to e-NAM.
eligibility: 1. The applicant State/UT must allow a single trading license valid across the StateRs. issued through suitable legislation or executive orders. - The process should be liberalRs. without barriers like high depositsRs. quantity restrictionsRs. or mandatory purchase centers. 1. The applicant State/UT must ensure single-point levy of market feeRs. applicable only at the first wholesale transaction. - No additional charges should be levied on subsequent wholesale transactions of the same produce. 1. The applicant State/UT must provide legal and infrastructural support for e-auction/e-tradingRs. through relevant amendments or executive provisions. - The applicant must submit proposals in the prescribed format and fulfill all three core reforms above to be eligible for the one-time grant for infrastructure setup (hardwareRs. internetRs. assaying equipmentRs. etc.). 1. The applicant must commit to: - Trading 100% of selected commodities through e-NAM in the proposed markets. - Providing or linking markets to Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs). - Covering extra implementation costs beyond the sanctioned amount. - Bearing costs of software maintenance after 5 years. - Registering the implementing agency on the PFMS portal and submitting necessary bank details to the Department. 1. The applicant State/UTRs. if lacking an APMC Act or not enforcing itRs. must: - Identify an appropriate institution/organization. - Frame enforceable guidelines to enable e-tradingRs. including trader registrationRs. transaction normsRs. and infrastructure provisioning. 1. The applicant private marketRs. if applyingRs. must: - Be recommended by the concerned authority. - Provide all necessary infrastructure and services (e.g.Rs. analystRs. assaying facilities) at its own expense.

name: Research and Development Programme in Water Sector
brief_description: The scheme "Research and Development Programme in Water Sector" was launched by the Ministry of Water ResourcesRs. River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation. The scheme aims to provide solutions to the problems related to the water sector through effective research and development for achieving sustainable development and self-reliance. The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for basic researchRs. applied researchRs. and action researchRs. detailing key provisions such as remuneration for research personnelRs. travel expensesRs. infrastructure costsRs. experimental chargesRs. and overhead charges. The applicant must submit a well-written research proposal clearly stating a synopsis of the work already doneRs. objectivesRs. methodologyRs. estimated costRs. duration of the schemeRs. milestonesRs. and the phasing of physical and financial progress. The scheme is implemented by the Indian National Committees and the Research and Development Division of the Ministry of Water ResourcesRs. and the applications for this scheme are accepted offline by submitting physical copies to the concerned committee.
benefits: - The scheme provides Grants-in-Aid for Basic ResearchRs. Applied ResearchRs. and Action Research. - The scheme provides remuneration and emoluments for research personnel assisting the investigators. - The revised monthly emoluments are 25Rs./- for a Junior Research FellowRs. 28Rs./- for a Senior Research FellowRs. and 36Rs./- to 40Rs./- for Research Associates across different levels. - The grant funds the cost of conducting experimentsRs. including consumablesRs. wages for full-time non-research personnelRs. and third-party services like typing and lab analysis. - The grant provides travel expenses connected with the researchRs. including one long-distance journey by one person once a year for attending a research and development session or committee meeting. - The scheme provides infrastructure funding for the purchase of equipment of a permanent natureRs. softwareRs. and necessary meteorological or satellite data. - The scheme provides overhead charges to the host institute for facilities like infrastructureRs. staffRs. waterRs. electricityRs. and communication. - For projects costing up to 1Rs./-Rs. overhead charges are provided at 10% of the total cost for educational institutions and Non-Governmental OrganizationsRs. and at 8% for laboratories and institutions under Central Government Departments. - The scheme provides a contingency budget provision up to 5% of the total cost or 1Rs./- (whichever is less) for unforeseen situations. - Funds are provided by direct transfer of money into the bank account of the appropriate authority in the institute. - The funds are released in installments commensurate with the progress of the work and actual requirements during the financial year. ##### ***Conditions*** - The beneficiary institute must provide full infrastructural facilities by way of accommodationRs. waterRs. electricityRs. and communication for the smooth implementation of the project. - Non-Governmental Organizations and Private Institutions must bear 50% of the equipment cost from their own resources. - The overhead expenses shall actually be paid to the institute by the Ministry Of Water Resources only after the completion of the research scheme and the acceptance of the final report. - The Principal Investigator must submit an annual progress report indicating milestones achieved and a utilization certificate to the concerned Indian National Committee on or before the 30th of June every year to receive further installments. - The Principal Investigator must refund any unspent balance or unused funds along with interest accrued to the Pay and Accounts Office via a crossed demand draft after the completion of the scheme.
eligibility: - The applicant must be an academician or expert working in Indian Institutes of TechnologyRs. recognized universitiesRs. recognized engineering and agricultural collegesRs. or Water and Land Management Institutes. - The applicant must be an expert from an organization under the Ministry Of Water Resources or from a research and development institute or laboratory of the Central or State Government. - The applicant must be from an Indian Non-Governmental Organization registered under the relevant Society Act. - The applicant must be from a non-profit making recognized Indian Private Research and Development Institution registered with the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research. - The applicant must propose a research topic that falls within the subject domain or priority areas related to the respective Indian National Committee. - The applicant must ensure the proposed research has not been done elsewhere to avoid duplication. - The applicant must identify the probable users of the new technology and end-users of the results of the proposed research. - The applicant must not seek funding for foreign travelRs. salaries of regular employees of the instituteRs. or honorariums for investigators. - The applicant must not utilize the grant for the constructionRs. maintenanceRs. or repair of buildingsRs. or the purchase of vehicles and air conditioners. - The applicant must complete any previous ongoing research projects funded by the Ministry of Water Resources before a new research proposal can be considered. - The applicant must be an Indian citizen to be eligible for research fellowships and associateships. - The applicant must ensure the upper age limit for Junior Research FellowRs. Senior Research FellowRs. and Research Associate is 28Rs. 32Rs. and 35 years respectively on the day of application. ##### ***Desirable Criteria*** The applicant should associate a Co-Principal Investigator in the research scheme. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** - The applicant must execute a bond with two sureties to the President of India if applying as a Non-Governmental Organization. - The applicant must maintain a separate audited account and register for permanent or semi-permanent assets acquired solely out of the project grant. - The applicant must publish research papers emerging out of the research scheme in leading journals with prior approval of the Ministry of Water Resources. - The applicant must acknowledge the assistance received from the funding agency in all publications and patent findings. ##### ***Relaxation*** The applicant should note that the upper age limit for fellowships is relaxable for Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassesRs. WomenRs. and physically handicapped candidates.

name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme For Award To Distinguished Artistes
brief_description: The scheme "Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) - Scheme for Award to Distinguished Artistes" is a scheme by the Dept. of Art & CultureRs. Govt. of ManipurRs. to encourage and felicitate the artistes (in the field of culture) belonging to different fields for their achievements such as winning National Awards namely Padma AwardsRs. Sangeet Natak AkademiRs. Sahitya AkademiRs. Lalit Kala Akademi Awards including Young AwardeesRs. National Film Award winners and on winning any national level competitionsRs. and International Awards in the field of Art & Culture.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Manipur. 1. The applicant should be National Award winners viz Padma AwardeeRs. Sangeet Natak Akademi AwardeeRs. Sahitya Akademi AwardeeRs. Lalit Kala Akademi AwardeeRs. and Zonal Cultural Centres Award including Young AwardeesRs. National Level CompetitionRs. and National Film Awards for individuals and groups. 1. The award winners whose age is below 40 will come under the Young / Junior category and those above 40 will come under Senior Category.
**Note 1:** The scheme will cover those awards announced or received during the current financial year and current calendar year. **Note 2:** The selection of artistes for Awards / Felicitation will be done by a Screening / Selection Committee constituted by the Government.

name: Financial Support Scheme
brief_description: The Department of Distance & EducationRs. School of Open LearningRs. Campus of Open Learning (DDCE/SOL/COL)Rs. in the spirit of facilitating financially weak students as per guidelines decided by the University of DelhiRs. has announced the Financial Support Scheme for DDCE/SOL/COL students. This scheme is reflected through a fee waiver/refund for the students enrolled in DDCE/SOL/COL and having their family income below the poverty line. The fee waiver/refund includes all components of the fee paid by students except the examination fee and the university fee.

name: Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law" was launched by the Legislative DepartmentRs. Government Of India. The scheme aims to propagate and develop literature in the field of law in Hindi and other regional languages. The scheme provides financial assistance covering up to 85% of the anticipated net expenditure for producing legal literatureRs. such as commentariesRs. treatisesRs. and law journals. The applicant must be a voluntary organisation undertaking activities conducive to the enrichment and use of Official Languages in the legal field. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry Of Law And Justice. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline via submission to the Official Languages Wing at Shastri BhawanRs. New Delhi.
benefits: - Financial assistance in the form of a grant not exceeding 85% of the anticipated net expenditure involved in the implementation of the project or activity. - The grants are paid in installments depending on the nature of activities to be undertaken and the progress of the work. ##### ***Conditions*** - _The organisation must bear the balance of the estimated expenditure on the scheme or project._ - _All assets created out of the grant must not be transferred to any person or institution without the prior concurrence of the Government of India._ - _If the organisation ceases to existRs. the equipment purchased out of the central grant will revert to the Government of India._ - _The accounts of the organisation must be properly maintained and submitted as required for checking by the Legislative Department or Indian Audit And Accounts Department._ - _The organisation must exercise the utmost economy in its working._ - _The grant must be utilized strictly for the purpose for which it was sanctioned._ - _Progress reports about the project must be furnished at regular intervals._ - _An audited statement of expenditure and a report on the work done must be furnished immediately after the completion of the project or before drawing a subsequent installment._ - _The organisation must submit a Utilisation Certificate in respect of the grant received during the preceding year._ - _Such number of copiesRs. not exceeding fiveRs. of all publications brought out with central assistance must be supplied to the Legislative Department free of cost._ - _The organisation must maintain an audited record of the assets acquired or created wholly or substantially with the help of the grant in the prescribed proforma._ - _The author of a published book must use the Hindi legal terms occurring in the authoritative texts of the Central ActsRs. State ActsRs. or the Legal Glossary published by the Official Languages Wing._ - _The organisation must give an undertaking to complete the project within a reasonable time fixed by the Government._
eligibility: - The applicant must be a voluntary organisation or institution. - The applicant must propose a project or activity for the development and propagation of literature in the field of law in Hindi or other regional languages. - The applicant must undertake activities such as proposing commentariesRs. treatisesRs. booksRs. law journalsRs. compendiumsRs. or other relevant publications. - The applicant must agree to bear the balance of the estimated expenditure for the proposed project.

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
brief_description: The "INSPIRE FACULTY FELLOWSHIP" component provides opportunities to 100 persons every year with Ph.D. qualifications in the age group of 27-32 years for 5 years to carry out research in both basic and applied science areas including engineeringRs. medicineRs. agricultureRs. and veterinary sciences for establishing themselves as independent researchers. It grants an attractive fellowship for a duration of 5 years. The objective of the scheme is to encourage young researchers to continue research in areas of S&TRs. MedicineRs. AgricultureRs. PharmacyRs. and Veterinary Sciences. Purpose 1. To provide attractive opportunities for young achievers for developing independent scientific profiles and launch them toward fulfilling long-term careers. 2. To augment high-quality scientific manpower in scientific and educational institutionsRs. especially the Central and State universities. 3. While vertical migration from the other INSPIRE components would be encouragedRs. the faculty fellowship component also provides the opportunity to meritorious candidates for lateral entry into INSPIRE scheme. 4. INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship provides an opportunity to post-doctoral fellows for carrying out independent research however does not guarantee a regular position after 5 years.
benefits: > **Amount** 1. Each selected INSPIRE Faculty Fellow will be eligible to receive a consolidated amount of 1Rs./- per month as a fellowship with an annual increment of 2Rs./-. 1. In additionRs. a Research Grant of 7Rs. every year for 5 years will also be provided to each successful candidate including the carry-forward amountRs. if anyRs. from the previous year. 1. The consolidated amount of 1Rs./- per month is an all-inclusive fellowship and taxable as per the Indian IT Act. > **Duration** 1. The INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship is for a maximum period of 5 (five) years.
eligibility: > **Essential** 1. Indian citizens and People of Indian origin with PIO status having Ph.D. degrees (in scienceRs. mathematicsRs. engineeringRs. pharmacyRs. medicineRs. and agriculture-related subjects) from any recognized university in the world. 1. Candidates should possess a minimum of 60% (or equivalent CGPA) marks throughout their academic profile starting from the Senior Secondary Examination (Class 12 onwards). 1. Those that have submitted their Ph.D. theses and are awaiting the award of their degree shall also be eligible. HoweverRs. selection for the Fellowship will be confirmed only after the Ph.D. degree is awarded. 1. The upper age limit as of 1st January of the respective year of advertisementRs. is 32 years for General Category. HoweverRs. for SCRs. STRs. and Women candidatesRs. the upper age limit will be 37 years. For persons with benchmark disabilities (Divyangjan with not less than 40 percent of a specified disability)Rs. the upper age limit will be 42 years. 1. Publication(s) in highly reputed journals demonstrating the outstanding research potential of the candidate. 1. Candidates who are employed in regular/contractual positions within India may also apply for INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship for improvement and enhancement in their career prospects butRs. upon selectionRs. the candidates will need to resign (no lien or deputation or any type of leave would be accepted) from the current job and organization before taking up the INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship. 1. CandidatesRs. who get selected for regular positions in any institute/university after submission of the IFF applicationRs. would be entitled to receive the Research Grant only as INSPIRE Faculty Fellows. > **Desirable** 1. Candidates who are within the top 1% in Class 12 examinationRs. IIT-JEE rank holdersRs. 1st rank holders either in graduation or post-graduation level university examinations.

name: NAMO Shree Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2024Rs. the scheme "NAMO Shree Scheme" by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to ensure that every pregnant woman and lactating mother of the state gets proper nutritional support and also encourages them to have institutional deliveries for women's empowerment and improving maternal health. The scheme provides financial assistance of 12Rs./- to eligible women beneficiaries and covers expenses from conception to delivery of the child. The applicant must be Gujarat's pregnant woman or a lactating motherRs. whose family income is not more than 8Rs./- per yearRs. and must deliver a child in any government or private hospital. The scheme is implemented by the Women and Child Development Department of the Gujarat GovernmentRs. and registration under this scheme is done at the time of the first antenatal check-up through an Accredited Social Health Activist or Auxiliary Nurse Midwife Worker at the nearest Anganwadi Centre.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance Amount** Eligible women beneficiaries receive 12Rs./- from conception to delivery of the child for their first two live childrenRs. distributed in phases.
> **Disbursal for First Pregnancy** - 5Rs./- at the time of registration (2Rs./- from State Government and 3Rs./- from Central Government) - 2Rs./- after six months of pregnancy (from the State Government) - 3Rs./- immediately after institutional delivery (from the State Government) - 2Rs./- after the 14-week vaccination (from the Central Government)
> **Disbursal for Second Pregnancy** - 2Rs./- at the time of registration - 3Rs./- after six months of pregnancy - 6Rs./- after institutional delivery (amount given by the Central Government if the newborn is a girl and by the State Government if the newborn is a boy) - 1Rs./- from the State Government after the 14-week vaccination
**Mode of Disbursement:** The Amount is transferred directly into the beneficiary woman's bank account through installments. **Additional Benefits:** Beneficiary women are also eligible to avail the benefits of other Central Government schemes like Pradhan Mantri Matritva Vandana Yojana and Janani Suraksha Yojana.
**Conditions for Availment** A certificate from the Medical Institution of Delivery is required for the last installment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be from Gujarat. 2. The applicant must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother. 3. The applicant must belong to one of the following categories: - Scheduled Tribe - Scheduled Caste - Beneficiary of the National Food Security Act - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana Beneficiary - Below Poverty Line families - E Shram Card holder women beneficiary - Women who are farmers - Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act beneficiary 4. The applicant's family income must not be more than 8Rs./- per year. 5. The applicant must deliver the child in any government or private hospital. 6. The applicant must register at the time of the first antenatal check-up.

name: Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)
brief_description: The scheme "Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)" was launched by the Ministry of EnvironmentRs. Forest and Climate ChangeRs. Government of India. The scheme provides an "Ecomark" label for products that meet specified environmental criteria with respect to resource consumption and environmental impactsRs. enabling consumers to make informed purchase decisions. The applicant must submit an application for the grant of Ecomark to the Central Pollution Control Board in Form 1. The scheme is implemented by the Central Pollution Control Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the Ecomark web portal.
benefits: - The scheme grants an Ecomark label to the product. - The Ecomark granted to the product shall be valid for a period of three years or until a change in the Ecomark criteria for the productRs. whichever is earlier. ##### ***Conditions*** - Every holder of Ecomark shall submit an annual report to the Central Pollution Control Board online through the web portal on or before the 31st May of every year. - Every person who has been granted an Ecomark in respect of a product shall affix on such product an Ecomark label granted under these rules. - The holder of Ecomark shall allow the Central Pollution Control Board or the registered agencies to undertake such inspection and verification as may be considered necessary for ensuring compliance. - The holder of the Ecomark shall grant access to the premises in which the product concerned is produced or kept to the Central Pollution Control Board and the registered agency.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a producerRs. manufacturerRs. exporterRs. or importer of products specified under the First Schedule of the rules. - The applicant must have a license or a certificate of conformity of Indian Standards granted under the Bureau of Indian Standards ActRs. 2016. - The applicant must comply with the mandate of the Quality Control Orders issued by the Central GovernmentRs. if applicable. - The applicant must fulfill the criteria for the grant of Ecomark specified under the corresponding entries of the First Schedule.

name: NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)" is one of the five sub-schemes of the National Social Assistance ProgrammeRs. Ministry of Rural Development. Under this schemeRs. persons belonging to BPL households and 60 years or above in age are eligible to apply. This program is being implemented in rural areas as well as urban areas. The Government of IndiaRs. on 15th August 1995Rs. introduced the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) as a fully funded Centrally Sponsored Scheme targeting the destituteRs. defined as any person who has little or no regular means of subsistence from his/her own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources. > **The NSAP at present includes five sub-schemes as its components-** a) Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) b) Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) c) Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) d) National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) e) Annapurna Scheme > **Objectives of NSAP-** 1. Provides social assistance benefits to poor households in the case of deathRs. maternityRs. or old age of the breadwinner. 2. Ensure minimum national standardsRs. in addition to the benefits that the states are currently providing or might provide in the future. 3. Ensure uniform social protection for the beneficiaries across the country without interruption. > **Expansion to cover all eligible BPL persons-** In 2007Rs. the scheme was expanded to cover all eligible persons Below Poverty Line (BPL).
benefits: - 200 per month for beneficiaries aged 6079 years. - 500 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above. > **Note:** At present old age beneficiaries are getting anywhere between 200/- to 1000/- depending on the State Contribution.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household. 1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or above.

name: Buti Foundation Award
brief_description: The Buti Foundation AwardRs. established in 2007 by the Buti FoundationRs. New DelhiRs. is a biennial award recognizing innovative and outstanding research in the field of Plasma Science & Technology. The award aims to honor a Scientist/Engineer under the age of 45 years for their significant contributions to this field. The award includes a medal and a cash prize.
benefits: - **Award Amount:** 50Rs./-- **Award Recognition:** Medal
eligibility: - The applicant should be a Scientist/Engineer. - The applicants age should be under 45 years as of 1st January 2021 (born on or after 02.01.1976). - The applicant should have conducted innovative and outstanding research in the field of Plasma Science & Technology in India.

name: Scheme of Cash Incentive to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches
brief_description: The "Scheme of Cash Incentives to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches"Rs. implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports under the Department of SportsRs. Government of IndiaRs. was introduced in 1986 to reward outstanding sportspersons for their achievements on the global stage. Over the yearsRs. the scheme has been revised to enhance its effectiveness. The latest amendment aims to streamline eligibility criteriaRs. improve the disbursement processRs. incentivise higher achievementsRs. and motivate athletes to serve as inspiring role models for the younger generation to take up sports.
benefits:
> For all international events except the OlympicsRs. ParalympicsRs. Asian GamesRs. Para-Asian GamesRs. and Commonwealth GamesRs. cash incentives will be paid based on the number of participating countries.

Amount of IncentiveIn a team event In an individual eventFullThe number of participating countries shall be at least 12 or the maximum permissible number of participantsRs. whichever is lower.The number of participating countries shall be at least 16 or the maximum permissible number of participantsRs. whichever is lower. HalfThe number of participating countries is in the range of 6 to 11.The number of participating countries is in the range of 8 to15.One-thirdThe number of participating countries shall be between 4 and 5.The number of participating countries shall range from 4 to 7.
Note: No cash incentive shall be given if the number of teams in any event is less than 4.
eligibility: The cash incentive shall be awarded exclusively for the sports disciplines specified.

name: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services)
brief_description: The scheme Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services and Child Welfare Services) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to strengthen child protection mechanisms and ensure the careRs. protectionRs. developmentRs. and well-being of children. It promotes family- and community-based careRs. institutional support servicesRs. counsellingRs. and emergency outreach for children in need. The scheme also focuses on safeguarding children from abuseRs. neglectRs. exploitationRs. and vulnerabilities through coordinated efforts at nationalRs. stateRs. districtRs. and community levels. It encourages awareness generationRs. capacity buildingRs. and participation of local bodies and communities for effective child welfare and protection services.
benefits: > **Financial Support for Vulnerable Children:** - Children living with biological parents or extended families receive financial assistance to meet their educationRs. nutritionRs. and healthcare needsRs. helping prevent separation from families. > **Family-Based Foster Care Support:** - Children without parental care are placed with biologically unrelated foster familiesRs. ensuring a nurturing home environment. Foster parents receive financial assistance to support the childs careRs. protectionRs. and rehabilitation. > **Legal and Safe Adoption Opportunities:** - Children declared legally free for adoption are placed in permanent family settings through Specialised Adoption Agencies (SAAs)Rs. ensuring their long-term emotional and social well-being. > **After-Care Support for Independent Living:** - Children exiting Child Care Institutions at the age of 18 are provided financial assistance up to 21 yearsRs. extendable to 23 yearsRs. to support educationRs. skill developmentRs. employmentRs. and smooth reintegration into society. > **Monthly Financial Assistance:** - A monthly grant of 4Rs. per child is provided to State Governments under SponsorshipRs. Foster CareRs. or After-Care to ensure sustained support. > **Strengthened Child Protection Systems:** - State Governments are encouraged to provide additional grants and proactively identify children in need of care and protection with the support of Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) and Urban Local Bodies. > **Transparent Approval and Monitoring Mechanism:** - Every district establishes a Sponsorship and Foster Care Approval Committee (SFCAC) to reviewRs. approveRs. and sanction assistanceRs. ensuring accountability and timely support. > **Compliance with Legal Framework:** - All non-institutional care interventions are implemented in accordance with the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act and RulesRs. ensuring legalityRs. safetyRs. and child-centric care.
eligibility: 1. The applicant child must be below 18 years of age for SponsorshipRs. Foster CareRs. and Adoption. 1. The applicant child must be 18 years or above for After-Care support (up to 21 yearsRs. extendable to 23 years). 1. The applicant caregiver family shall be eligible for financial support if the annual family income is below 8 lakh per annum or as prescribed by the Ministry of WCD from time to time. 1. The applicant child must be willing to stay with the foster family.

name: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Government Affordable Rental Housing Development Support
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief_description: The scheme Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0) implemented through verticals "***Incentivising government departmentsRs. PSUsRs. autonomous bodies to either use their vacant residential complexes for stay of urban poor by renting them out on outsourcing model or construction of such new SPARSH 2.0 housing complexes on vacant land under their ownership***" by the Labour & Employment DepartmentRs. UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu aims to expand affordable rental housing stock through government participation and institutional support. Through this schemeRs. land identificationRs. housing development supportRs. and conversion of existing vacant government housing are provided for affordable rental housing purposes. The scheme is implemented by MunicipalitiesRs. District PanchayatsRs. Public Sector UndertakingsRs. Autonomous BodiesRs. and other government agencies in coordination with the Department of Labour & Employment. The scheme promotes the creation of at least 1 SPARSH 2.0 housing complex by each participating authority. Existing government housing stock may also be converted into affordable rental housing complexes. Construction may be carried out through own funds or through Grant-in-Aid support. The scheme contributes towards the creation of long-term affordable housing infrastructure. > **Objectives:** - To address the vision of Aatma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyan by creating a sustainable ecosystem of affordable rental housing solutions for workers in industriesRs. construction sitesRs. and other weaker sections. - To achieve the objective of Housing for All by promoting affordable rental housing for workers and labourers. - To create a conducive environment by incentivising public and private entities to invest in affordable rental housing stock. - To increase the productivity of industries by improving the health and well-being of workers. - To reduce the financial burden on workers due to treatment costs and wage loss. - To increase the happiness and quality of life of workers. - To harmonize the Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC) Scheme guidelines with the SPARSH Scheme.
benefits: 1. All municipalitiesRs. District PanchayatsRs. PSUsRs. and Autonomous bodies within UT of DNH-DD shall be obliged to identify lands in their respective jurisdictions with the help of concerned revenue departmentsRs. and to construct at least one SPARSH 2.0 housing or to run at least one SPARSH 2.0 housing on houses already under their possession in their respective jurisdictions 1. Such municipalitiesRs. District PanchayatsRs. PSUsRs. and Autonomous bodies within UT of DNH-DD shall do so either through their own fundsRs. or if the same is not viableRs. through Grant in Aid allotted to them. 1. In order to be eligible under SPARSH 2.0Rs. the units constructed under this vertical shall follow the same norms as mentioned in Vertical 2.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Dadra And Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant should be the owner or authorised representative of the housing complex. 1. The housing complex should fulfil SPARSH 2.0 infrastructure norms. 1. The housing complex should possess a valid construction permission and/or occupancy certificate. 1. The applicant should agree to reserve at least 66% dwelling units for Economically Weaker Section beneficiaries. 1. The applicant should agree to maintain the housing complex and waste management systems.

name: PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS)
brief_description: The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) launched by the Department of SpaceRs. Ministry of Science and Technology is aimed at providing financial support to highly motivated young PhD holders to conduct advanced research in fundamental sciences with societal implications. The fellowship is designed to foster innovative and cutting-edge research in areas pursued by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL)Rs. aligned with the vision of Prof. Vikram Sarabhai.
benefits: - **Number of VISHWAS Fellowships:** 3- ***Scholarship Amount:*** Scholars receive 1Rs./- per month with HRA and other facilities as per PRL/DOS rules.- ***Duration:*** Maximum of 2 years (subject to successful annual reviews). It may be extended for 1 additional year based on justification and approval.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an Indian national.
1. PhD should have been awarded within the last four years (from the application deadline).
1. The applicant's age should be 35 years or below on the last date of application.
1. The applicant should have a first-class academic record throughout their academic career.
1. The applicant should submit a strong research proposal aligned with PRLs research areas.

name: AFFDF-Financial Assistance For Treatment Of Serious Diseases To Non Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)/Widows
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Treatment of Serious Diseases to Non-Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (ESM) (All Ranks)/Widows" is implemented by the Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India to provide financial assistance for the treatment of approved serious diseases to non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen and widows. The scheme supports expenditure incurred on hospitalizationRs. medicinesRs. and medical treatment for specified serious diseases. Assistance is provided subject to prescribed limits and eligibility conditions. Applications are processed through the Zila Sainik Board and approved by the Kendriya Sainik Board. The approved amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account through Electronic Clearance Service (ECS).
benefits: > **For Non-Pensioner Officers/Widows:** - **Medical Treatment Assistance:** Financial assistance of 75% of the total expenditure incurred on medical treatmentRs. hospitalizationRs. medicinesRs. and related expenses.- **Maximum Assistance Limit:** Maximum financial assistance of 1Rs./- (one-time) for approved serious diseases.- **Cancer Treatment and Dialysis Assistance:** Financial assistance of up to 75Rs./- per annum for cancer treatment and dialysis. > **For Non-Pensioner Other Ranks/Widows:** - **Medical Treatment Assistance:** Financial assistance of 90% of the total expenditure incurred on medical treatmentRs. hospitalizationRs. medicinesRs. and related expenses.- **Maximum Assistance Limit:** Maximum financial assistance of 1Rs./- (one-time) for approved serious diseases.- **Cancer Treatment and Dialysis Assistance:** Financial assistance of up to 75Rs./- per annum for cancer treatment and dialysis. > **List of the serious diseases are covered under this scheme:-** 1. Angiography & Angioplasty 1. CABG. (l) Dialysis 1. Open heart surgery 1. Valve replacement 1. Pacemaker Implant 1. Cerebral stroke 1. Prostrate surgery 1. Joint replacement 1. Renal failure 1. Cancer > **Treatment of other Diseases:** - In case the treatment of a serious disease which is not listed in this scheme-documentRs. such application will be referred to DGAFMS for comment/recommendation to consider it for financial assistance for treatment of that diseaseRs. to ESM under this scheme. > **Note:** - Expenditure must be incurred at an approved govt hospital at the rates applicable under CGHS / ECHS.
eligibility: - Applicant must be a non-pensioner ESM or his widow. - Should not be a member of ECHS (Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme) or availing AFMS (Armed Forces Medical Services) facilities. - Should be recommended by respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB). - Expenditure must be incurred at a approved govt hospital at the rates applicable under CGHS (Central Government Health Scheme) / ECHS.

name: ICAR Emeritus Scientist Scheme
brief_description: The "ICAR Emeritus Scientist" scheme is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs. Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare to utilize the services of outstanding superannuated scientists for completing nationally important research work and contributing to agricultural education and development. The scheme supports retired scientists in continuing ongoing research projects of national importance and participating in specialized teaching programmes. It also promotes the development of instructional materials and addresses policy issues related to agriculture and allied sciences. The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of honorariumRs. contingency grantsRs. and support for research personnel. The appointment is granted for a fixed tenure of 3 years without extension.
benefits: > **Honorarium:** - 50Rs./- per month honorarium in addition to pension. - Subject to provisions of the Income Tax Act. > **Contingency Grant:** - Up to 2Rs./- per annum per scientist. - Used for chemicalsRs. glasswareRs. booksRs. stationeryRs. laboratory assistanceRs. and ministerial help. - May be enhanced with approval based on the nature of research work. - Can be used for domestic travel related to researchRs. data collectionRs. scientific meetingsRs. conferencesRs. and ICAR review meetings. - Includes economy-class airfareRs. eligible daily allowanceRs. and road mileage within India. > **Research Personnel Support:** - Financial assistance for engagement of: - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Research Associate (RA) - Appointment remains valid until completion of the project. > **Leave Benefits:** - 1 month leave with honorarium for each completed year of tenure. - Leave on a pro-rata basis for any fraction of a year. - Up to 3 months leave without honorarium may be granted on health grounds with a medical certificate. > **Research and Academic Support:** - Opportunity to complete ongoing nationally important research. - Opportunity to teach specialized courses in universities and institutions. - Opportunity to develop instructional and multimedia educational materials.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a scientist of repute from the National Agricultural Research System (NARS). - The applicant must hold or have held the position of Principal ScientistRs. ProfessorRs. or above in an eligible institution. - The applicant must be retiring within the next 12 months or must have retired within 1 year from the last working day of the notification month. - The applicant must not be more than 65 years of age at the time of application. - The applicant must have at least 5 research papers published in refereed journals during the last 5 yearsRs. or must have received a national/international award or recognition. - In the case of teachersRs. the applicant must have received a teaching excellence award or appreciation for outstanding teaching performance. - The applicant must submit a project of national importance that is a continuation of his/her previous work. - The applicant must demonstrate that an equally competent regular scientist is not available in the institution to undertake the proposed work. - The applicant must be willing to devote full time to the approved project and must not accept any other remunerative employment during the tenure. - The applicant must not receive financial assistance for the same work from any other source while availing benefits under this scheme.

name: ICAR Emeritus Professor
brief_description: The "ICAR Emeritus Professor Scheme" is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)Rs. Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers WelfareRs. to utilise the expertise and services of outstanding superannuated teachers and scientists from the National Agricultural Research and Education System (NARES). The scheme provides an opportunity to retired professionals to undertake teachingRs. trainingRs. student research guidanceRs. and other academic activities in agricultural universities and institutions. It supports the development of instructional materialsRs. textbooksRs. and e-learning resources for use in national agricultural education programmes and distance education. The scheme aims to address shortages in faculty positionsRs. strengthen agricultural educationRs. and leverage the experience of retired experts in addressing nationally important academic and policy issues. It also encourages retired teachers and scientists to contribute to higher agricultural educationRs. particularly in economically and ecologically underprivileged regions.
benefits: > **Honorarium:** - Honorarium of 50Rs./- per month is provided to the Emeritus Professor. > **Contingency Grant:** - A non-lapsable contingency grant of 1Rs./- per annum is provided. - The grant may be used for secretarial assistanceRs. stationeryRs. postageRs. consumablesRs. booksRs. journalsRs. and travel related to the approved assignment. - The grant may also be used for attending one scientific meeting or conference within India per year. - Economy-class airfareRs. admissible daily allowanceRs. and road mileage are allowed from the contingency grant. - No separate Travel Allowance (TA) or Daily Allowance (DA) is provided. - The grant is released based on requisition and actual utilization of the previous year's grant. - Books and journals purchased from the grant become the property of the concerned university or college. - The contingency grant may be enhanced with the concurrence of the Financial Adviser (Department of Agricultural Research and Education)Rs. depending on the assignment. > **Academic and Institutional Support:** - The Emeritus Professor is entitled to medical and other facilities available to university faculty members. - The Emeritus Professor remains attached to an Agricultural UniversityRs. ICAR Deemed UniversityRs. or another eligible institution that provides the required facilities. > **Research and Professional Engagement** - The Emeritus Professor is provided an opportunity to continue approved academicRs. researchRs. and professional activities in agriculture and allied sciences.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an outstanding superannuated teacher/Scientist with a good record of published work and teaching/ training experience of a minimum of 5 years. - The maximum age limit for applying for ICAR Emeritus Professor will be 65 years. - The ICAR Emeritus Professor can work under this scheme up to the age of 70 years or up to three yearsRs. whichever is earlier. - The teacher/Professor who is to retire in the next 12 months time is eligible to apply. - The application should be submitted through the Executive Authority where the Emeritus Professor proposes to work in the prescribed Proforma to the Deputy Director General (Education)Rs. ICAR. > **Note:** - Preference will be given to applicants superannuated within one year from the date of notification. The notification for filling up vacant slots will be issued depending upon the vacancies from time to time. The applications received within the period specified in the circular will only be entertained.

name: Skill Loan Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Skill Loan Scheme" by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)Rs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to support youth who wish to undergo skill training programmes in the country and ensure access to institutional credit for pursuing skill courses. Through this schemeRs. collateral-free loans without third-party guarantee and credit guarantee support are provided to eligible borrowers for undertaking skill training coursesRs. including higher-endRs. fee-based skilling courses for new-age skills. The scheme is implemented through eligible lending institutionsRs. including Scheduled BanksRs. Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)Rs. and Non-Banking Finance Company Micro Finance Institutions (NBFC-MFIs). **Objectives:** - To support youth seeking skill training opportunities in the country. - To ensure access to institutional credit for pursuing skill courses.
benefits: 1. The maximum loan limit under the Scheme has been enhanced from 1Rs. to 7Rs.. 1. The minimum and maximum loan limit under the Scheme are 5Rs. and 7Rs. respectively. 1. The loan is provided without any collateral security and/or third-party guarantee. 1. Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) and Non-Banking Finance Company Micro Finance Institutions (NBFC-MFIs) have been included as eligible lending institutions in addition to Scheduled Banks under the Scheme. 1. The interest rate charged by Member Lending Institutions should not be more than: - 1.5% per annum over External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR) for Scheduled Banks. - 21% per annum for NBFC/NBFC-MFIs. 1. The Scheme provides guarantee cover to the extent of 70% to 75% of the amount in default. 1. The claim payout to an eligible Lending Institution during the initial years is capped at 20% of the total disbursement made by the institution under the Scheme during a year. 1. No processing fee is charged by Banks. > **Repayment Tenure:** **Amount of Loan****Tenure**Loan up to 50Rs.Up to 3 yearsLoan between 50Rs. to 1Rs.Up to 5 yearsLoan above 1Rs.Up to 7 years
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an Indian national. 1. The applicant should have secured admission to a skill training course. 1. The applicant should meet the minimum qualification criteria required to undergo the skill training course. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF) aligned courses and/or Non-NSQF-aligned courses offered by training entities onboarded on the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurships Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) platform. 1. The applicant should be admitted to a course run by: - Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs). - Polytechnics. - Schools recognised by Central or State Education Boards. - Colleges affiliated with recognised universities. - Training partners affiliated with the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). - Sector Skill Councils. - State Skill Mission. - State Skill Corporation.

name: Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer
brief_description: The Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer-2021Rs. effective from January 27Rs. 2022Rs. is a crucial initiative led by the Ministry of Labour & EmploymentRs. Government of India that addresses eradicating bonded labour in India. It introduces varying rehabilitation assistance amounts based on beneficiary categoriesRs. such as adultsRs. childrenRs. womenRs. and extreme casesRs. with provisions for annuity schemes and Direct Benefit Transfer. The scheme also facilitates surveysRs. awareness programsRs. and evaluatory studies to combat bonded labourRs. with financial support. It emphasizes skill developmentRs. socio-economic assistanceRs. and monitoring mechanismsRs. all aimed at offering comprehensive support to eradicate the bonded labour system in the country.
benefits:
> **For Adult Male Beneficiaries** - The rehabilitation assistance shall be 1Rs./- per adult male beneficiary. - Beneficiaries have the option to deposit the assistance in an annuity scheme or receive it as a cash grant. - The District Administration will assess the cash requirement of the beneficiary andRs. with their consentRs. place the money in an annuity scheme.
> **Special Category Beneficiaries (ChildrenRs. Women)** - Rehabilitation assistance for special category beneficiariesRs. such as childrenRs. including orphansRs. or those rescued from forced labourRs. and womenRs. shall be 2Rs./-. - At least 1Rs./- shall be deposited in an annuity scheme in each beneficiary's name. - The remaining amount shall be transferred to the beneficiary's account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
> **Extreme Cases of Bonded or Forced Labor** - In cases of extreme deprivationRs. such as transgender individualsRs. womenRs. and children rescued from sexual exploitationRs. or traffickingRs. the rehabilitation assistance shall be 3Rs./-. - At least 2Rs./- shall be deposited in an annuity scheme in each beneficiary's name. - 1Rs./- shall be transferred to the beneficiary's account via DBT.
> **Bonded Labour Rehabilitation Fund** - Each state shall create a Bonded Labour Rehabilitation Fund at the district level with a permanent corpus of at least 10Rs. (Ten Lakhs Rupees) at the disposal of the District Magistrate. - Penalties recovered from convicted perpetrators of bonded labour may be deposited in this corpus.
> **Immediate Financial Assistance** - The District Administration shall provide immediate financial assistance up to 30Rs./- to rescued individuals from the District Bonded Labour Rehabilitation Fund. - The District Magistrate may disburse higher amounts if required but limited to the maximum entitlement prescribed under this scheme.
> **State Government Responsibilities** - Providing a safe and secure environment for capacity building of child-bonded labourers. - Addressing the special needs of female freed bonded labourersRs. including financial support for marriage. - Offering special care for disabled individualsRs. in line with the national policy for disabled people. - Providing employable skill development training for adult bonded labourers who do not fall into the above categories.
eligibility: The beneficiary should be a rescued bonded labour.

name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
brief_description: The RMEWF Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Ex-Servicemen scheme is implemented by the Department of Ex-Servicemen WelfareRs. Ministry of DefenceRs. Government of India.All the pensioners of Armed Forces have been provided medical cover compulsorily under ECHS wef 01 Apr 2008. HoweverRs. non-pensioner ESM who were sent out of services early in their life due to organizational constraints or discharged at their own request have no such medical cover. With ever increasing costs of health careRs. it becomes extremely difficult for non-pensioner ESM to combat diseases especially in old age. At such ageRs. medical expenses push such ESM into a state of poverty and loss of dignity. The scheme to provide financial assistance to non-pensionersRs. who are without any other sources of income and in state of penuryRs.was started in year 1981 with an amount depending upon nature and gravity of ailment. This was last revised in August 2023 with onetime grant of Rs 50Rs./-. **Aim** The aim of this aid gratis is to provide financial assistance to non-pensioner ESM or their widow to meet routine medical expenses during the year.
benefits: A Financial assistance up to a maximum of 30Rs./- per year per eligible Ex-Servicemen/widow is provided in a financial year.
eligibility: **The following criteria must be fulfilled:-** - Applicant must be a non-pensioner ESM or his widow. - Should be of rank Havildar/equivalent and below. - Should be recommended by respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB). - Expenditure must be incurred at recognized government hospitals at rates approved under CGHS/ ECHS.

name: Vikramaditya Yojna
brief_description: The "Vikramaditya Yojana" is a scholarship scheme offered by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. This scheme is presented by the Department of Higher EducationRs. which means it is intended to help students who are pursuing further education after successfully completing Class 12. These scholarship opportunities are available only for candidates belonging to the General categoryRs. which is one of the most important aspects of this scheme.
benefits: - Annual financial assistance of a maximum of 2Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to the General category.
1. He/she must have scored at least 60% or more marks in the Class 12 examination.
1. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 1Rs. (for higher education) and INR 54Rs. (for graduation).

name: Ladli Beti Scheme
brief_description:
A social assistance scheme sponsored by the Jammu & Kashmir Government for newborn girl child of the Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh born on or after 01/04/2015. The objective of the scheme is to arrest the declining female sex ratio. The scheme further intends to ensure that the girl child does not become a burden for the parent or guardian at the time of her marriage. The scheme is a hybrid deposit plan having two phases:
