Phase I: A recurring deposit for 14 years having a date of completion as one month after the last installment received in the account. Phase II: A Cumulative Term Deposit (CCR) for 7 years.
After the maturity of Phase I (recurring deposit account) the account will graduate to Phase II (Cumulative Term Deposit account). The monthly contribution of 1000/- in Phase-I is made by the J&K Govt. The annual income of the parents from all sources should be less than 75Rs.. The required documents are the Application FormRs. KYC Norms of the Parent/ GuardianRs. and the sanction letter from the CDPO (Child Development Project Officer).
eligibility:
1. The girl child should have been born on or after 01/04/2015.
1. The annual income of the parents of the girl child from all sources should be less than 75Rs..
1. The girl child and her family should be residents of Jammu & Kashmir.

name: Self Employment Scheme For Rehabilitation Of Manual Scavengers
brief_description: The Self Employment Scheme for Rehabilitation of Manual Scavengers (SRMS) was introduced in January 2017 by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. to assist the identified manual scavengers and their dependants in rehabilitation in alternative occupations. SRMS was revised in November 2013 in consonance with the provision of the Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation ActRs. 2013 (MS ActRs. 2013).
benefits:
1. Identified manual scavengersRs. one from each familyRs. are provided one-time cash assistance of 40Rs..
1. The identified manual scavengers and their dependents are provided project-based upfront capital subsidy up to 5Rs. and concessional loans for undertaking self-employment ventures.
1. Sanitation workers and their dependants are provided assistance for the procurement of sanitation-related projects on the same scale as admissible to manual scavengers for general tasks.
1. The group of the target beneficiaries is eligible for projects costing up to 50Rs..
1. Beneficiaries are also provided training for skill development for up to two yearsRs. during which a stipend of 3Rs. per month is also provided.
1. Manual Scavengers and their family members are also eligible for Health Insurance coverage of 5Rs. under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PMJAY)
1. Upskilling/RPL training is provided to sanitation workers.
1. Workshops are organized with the officersRs. supervisorsRs. and sanitation workers on Hazardous Cleaning of Sewers and Septic Tanks.

***Credit Linked upfront Capital Subsidy -***
**Range of Project Cost () (for Individuals):** Upto 5Rs.
**Rate of Subsidy:** 50% of project cost
**Range of Project Cost () (for Individuals):** 5Rs. to 15Rs.
**Rate of Subsidy:** 2.5 lakh + 25% of remaining project cost
**Range of Project Cost () (for Group Projects):** Upto 10Rs. lakh per beneficiary maximum project cost upto 50Rs.
**Rate of Subsidy:** Same as admissible to individuals subject to a maximum 3.75 lakh per beneficiary
***The rate of interest chargeable from the beneficiaries will be as follows:-***
**Range of Projects:** up to 1Rs./-
**Rate of Subsidy:** 5% per annum (4% per annum for women beneficiaries)
**Range of Projects:** above 1Rs./-
**Rate of Subsidy:** 6% per annum
The period of repayment of the loanRs. including the moratorium period will be five years for projects upto 5Rs./- and 7 years for projects above 5Rs./- with a moratorium period to start the repayment of the loan will be upto 6 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged or employed as a Manual Scavenger by an individual or a local authority or an agency or a contractor (as identified during the survey conducted by State Governments & allotted MS-ID/Receipt No. and their dependents).
1. Sanitation Workers and their dependents are eligible only for assistance for sanitation-related self-employment projects.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana
brief_description: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojna is a scheme launched by the Rajasthan Government to promote the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections of society. Under this schemeRs. the government provides financial assistance to eligible families for the marriage of their daughters. The scheme aims to empower girls and their families by providing financial support for their marriage and ensuring that they do not face any financial burden. The scheme provides an assistance amount of 40Rs. to the eligible families to cover the expenses related to the marriageRs. including jewelryRs. clothesRs. and other related expenses. To be eligible for the schemeRs. the bride's family must be a resident of RajasthanRs. and the bride should be 18 years of age or older. The family's annual income should be less than 2.5 lakhRs. and they should not have any other source of income. The bride should also have completed her 10th-standard education. OverallRs. Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojna aims to promote the welfare of girls from economically weaker sections of society and ensure that they are not deprived of their right to marry due to financial constraints.
benefits:
- The implementation of this scheme will be reviewed at the district level and a committee meeting will be held every 3 months.
- The state government will provide financial assistance of 31Rs. to 41Rs. to the eligible beneficiaries at the time of the girl's marriage.
- Under this schemeRs. a provision of savings of about 24 crore has been approved.
- If the girls of the state pass 10th then the government will provide an amount of 41 thousand at the time of their marriage.
- If the girls of the state pass 12th then the government will provide an amount of 51 thousand at the time of their marriage.
eligibility:
**This scheme is specifically for Divyang and Women that belong to following :**

1. BPL family belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category
1. Minority category BPL families
1. Specially Qualified Individuals (Not Income Tax Payers)
1. A female player (if self-married) who fulfills the prescribed criteria as per the circulars issued by the Personnel Department. Self or parents are not income taxpayers.
1. Beneficiary in Palanhar Yojana.

name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance
brief_description: Launched in April 1999Rs. "Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance" is a scheme by the Chief Minister's SecretariatRs. Govt. of Rajasthan. In case of death due to accidentRs. 1Rs. is provided to the dependent of the deceased. In case of serious injuryRs. assistance should be approved up to 20Rs. keeping in view the seriousness of the injury to the ordinary injured. A revolving fund of 20Rs. each has been made available to all district collectors. The assistance is "one-time full-support" and is sanctioned by the concerned District Collector. For assistanceRs. one has to apply either to the Tehsil/District Collector's Office or to the Chief Minister's Office.
eligibility:
1. The victim should be a resident of the state of Rajasthan.
1. The victim should have suffered serious injury / death.
1. In case of deathRs. the assistance is payable only to the dependent parents/husband-wife/son-daughter of the deceased in the accident.
1. Under special circumstancesRs. assistance can be given to grandparents/dependent siblings with the consent of the Chief Minister's Office.
1. In cases of murder and rapeRs. action should be taken to give compensation under the Rajasthan Victim Compensation (Amended) Scheme-2015 under the provision of providing assistance in cases of murder and rape.
1. The applicant must apply within a maximum period of 6 months from the date of accident.

name: Chief Minister Housing Assistance Programme
brief_description:
The scheme "Chief Ministers Housing Assistance Programme" by the Housing DepartmentRs. Government of MeghalayaRs. aims to assist economically weaker and low-income families by providing durable housing support. Through this schemeRs. roofing materials or dwelling houses are provided to Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) families residing in Meghalaya.
> **Objectives:** - To provide durable roofing materials to improve existing houses for the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) families. - To provide dwelling houses to the low-income group (LIG) families living in the State.
benefits: 1. Three bundles of 9-foot-long GCI sheets (roofing material) for EWS households as an outright grant. 1. Construction of a durable house with a carpet area of a minimum of 19.20 sqm (207 sq. ft) with at least 2 rooms for LIG households as a credit-linked subsidy. 1. Financial assistance up to 75Rs. under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for LIG houses. 1. Additional cost to be borne by beneficiary through own resourcesRs. MGNREGSRs. SRWPRs. or bank loan. 1. Houses to be constructed as per government-approved model (Annexure-A). 1. Land ownership and geo-tagging are mandatory for the beneficiary. > **Note:** > In case of Credit Linked SubsidyRs. funds are disbursed in installments through bank/post office account based on progress certified by the Housing Selection and Monitoring Committee.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a bona fide resident of the State of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (annual income up to 1Rs.) or the Low Income Group (income between 1Rs. and 2Rs.). 1. The applicant should be 18 years of age or above. 1. The applicant should not have any other member from the same family living under the same roof as a beneficiary under the same scheme. 1. The applicant should not own a pucca house in their or any family member's name. 1. The applicant should possess their own land (for construction in case of a dwelling house). 1. The applicant should submit the EPIC (Electors' Photo Identity Card) or any other valid document as proof of residence. 1. The applicant should not have received any previous housing loan or financial aid from any other government source in their or their spouses name. 1. The applicant should construct the house personally and not through a contractor.

name: Vivah Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: "Vivah Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides financial assistance of 30Rs./- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) rupees for the marriage of two children / female members of the family.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a Worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be engaged in construction work such as masonsRs. carpentersRs. electriciansRs. portersRs. paintersRs. etc.
1. The registered worker should have made continuous contributions for five years.
1. The bride should be at least 18 years of age.
1. The groom should be at least 21 years of age.
1. The scheme is applicable for up to two children / female members of the family.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme - Sikkim
brief_description: The scheme National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) was launched in 2016 by the Department of Women & Child WelfareRs. Govt. of Sikkim. Under this schemeRs. a lump sum amount of 30Rs./- as financial assistance is provided to the bereaved household in the event of the death of the "Primary breadwinner" belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) Category. The one-time grant amount consists of Central and State Government Share. (i.e. 20Rs./- as Central Share and 10Rs./- as State Share)
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of the state of Sikkim. 1. The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. In the event of the death of the breadwinner of a familyRs. the family will become eligible to apply for the scheme. 1. The financial assistance will be paid to the household (includes spouseRs. minor childrenRs. unmarried daughtersRs. and dependent parents) of the deceased person. 1. The applicant should have opened the Bank Account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.
**Note:** A woman in the familyRs. who is a homemakerRs. is also considered as a "Breadwinner".

name: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme For BPL Families Belonging To Scheduled Caste (SC) Category
brief_description:
The scheme **Maintenance of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme for BPL families belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) category** had been launched by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh with the aim to provides a 50% subsidy on a balanced ration for pregnant cows or buffalo during the last trimester of pregnancy. Under this schemeRs. balanced ration @ 3kg/day/cow or buffalo for maximum of two animals for three months during the last trimester of pregnancy at 50% subsidy of BPL families belonging to the Scheduled Caste category may be provided.
**Objectives:**

1. Increase in milk production thereby providing more economic gains to the farmers.
1. To reduce the inter-calving period which will ultimately result in more calves and higher milk production.
1. To improve the health of pregnant cows & buffaloes so that their full milk production potential can be realized after parturition.
1. To ensure the birth of healthy calves free of diseases and malnutrition so that they grow to become higher-producing animals.
1. As the incentive is being given to Desi/Indigenous cows and buffaloesRs. the farmers can be motivated to rear such animals.

**Assumptions:**

- A balanced ration will be provided @ 3kg/day/cow for three months (last trimester of pregnancy).
- The cost will be shared by the Government and beneficiary on a 50:50 basis.
- The cost of feed will depend upon the tender/approved rates.
benefits: 1. **Ration:** 3 kg of balanced ration per day for a maximum of two animals for three months. 1. **Milk production:** Milk production increases by 2 liters per day after feeding the ration. 1. **Income:** If the farmer sells the milk at 30 rupees per liter during the 300-day lactation periodRs. their income may increase by approximately 18Rs. rupees per year.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. Livestock owners belonging to BPL of Scheduled Caste category families rearing Desi/Indigenous/crossbred cows or buffaloes are eligible under the scheme.
1. The subsidy will be provided to each BPL of Scheduled Caste category families for a maximum of up to two Desi/Indigenous cows/their crosses or buffaloes.

name: Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana
brief_description: Under this schemeRs. while expanding the definition of a farmerRs. along with the Khatauni registered account holder / co-account holderRs. such earning members of their family whose main source of livelihood is agricultural income from the land registered in the name of the account holder / co-account holder and such landless persons. Those who do agricultural work on the land obtained on lease or on share and whose main means of livelihood is agriculture on the land taken on such lease or share have also been included.
benefits:
In this schemeRs. the Uttar Pradesh government will provide the following amount / financial assistance or compensation amount to the farmers if they are victims of the accident 1. Compensation for loss of both hands and legs of the farmer Rs 5 lakh. 1. In case of loss of 1 hand and 1 foot Rs.5 lakh. 1. In case of disability of one leg and one hand financial assistance ranges from 2 to 3 lakhs. 1. In case of the death of a farmer in an accident a compensation amount of up to Rs.5 lakh will be given. 1. In the case of disability which is more than 25% but less than 50% assistance is between 1 to 2 lakhs. 1. In case of loss of an eye due to the accident assistance up to Rs.5 lakh.
**Assistance will be given to the victims of these accidents :** Farmers have to apply to get profit compensation under the scheme. Under the schemeRs. the government will provide benefits to the victims of these accidents 1. On damage and/or death due to falling tree 1. due to landslide. 1. travel incident. 1. struck by lightning. 1. being swept away by a flood. 1. animal bite. 1. due to electrocution. 1. burning in fire. 1. house collapse. 1. terrorist attack. 1. accident in a fight. 1. falling into the chamber. 1. murder in robbery.
eligibility:
1. After September 14Rs. 2019Rs. the families of the farmers who were victims of the accident can also get the benefit of the scheme.
1. The age of the applicant farmer should be between 18 to 70 years.
1. After the death of the applicant farmer in the accidentRs. the parentsRs. wifeRs. daughter-in-lawRs. sonRs. daughterRs. grandson and granddaughter of his family will be provided financial assistance by the government.
1. Those farmers of the state who do not have their own agricultural land and do the work of farming on share or rent.
1. The benefit of UP Chief Minister Farmer Accident Welfare Scheme will be given to the farmer suffering from 60 percent or more disability.

name: KALIA Scholarship
brief_description:
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to extend financial assistance to the children of the beneficiaries under KALIA for pursuing Professional/Technical courses in the State of Odisha. It will lead to better access to Higher Education for children of Small and marginal farmers (SF/MF)Rs. Actual cultivators (sharecroppers)Rs. and Landless Agricultural households (LAH). KALIA Scholarship will support SF/MF & LAH in empowering their families.
> **Key features of the KALIA Scholarship:**

In order to ensure proper higher education for their childrenRs. support will be provided in the form of a KALIA Scholarship. The scholarship will be given purely on a merit basis to those who are studying professional/technical courses like MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. Agriculture and Allied NursingRs. DiplomaRs. and different trades in ITI in Government Institutions of the State.
benefits:
1. The tuition feesRs. annual feesRs. one-time feesRs. hostel chargesRs. and any other fees deposited by the student in the colleges/universities/institutions except the caution money/any other refundable money as admissible shall be released to the concerned student Account directly through DBT.
1. The mess /hostel charges of 1200/- per month & 1000/- per month for ten months shall be provided to the Degree & Diploma/Polytechnic/ITI students respectively as per the guideline of ST & SC DevelopmentRs. Minorities and BCW Department.

**Note 01:** For the refund and penalties in different situationsRs. the institution shall follow the guidelines/modalities of the concerned Department/Institution. Any refundable security deposit shall not be part of the scholarship and needs to be paid by the student.
**Note 02:** The scholarship sanctioned in favour of a student shall be liable for cancellation if he/she is found to have obtained the scholarship by false statementsRs. discontinue his/her studiesRs. or is in receipt of any other scholarship.
eligibility:
> **Eligibility criteria for KALIA Scholarship:**


1. The children of all the eligible beneficiaries under the KALIA scheme under the two different componentsRs. namely Support to Cultivators for Cultivation and Livelihood Support to Landless Agricultural Households are eligible for the scholarship.
1. The parent of the student must be eligible under KALIA during verification at the Chief District Agriculture Officer (CDAO) level.
1. The student must have obtained admission in a Government institution of the State on a merit basis.
1. The student will not be eligible to get any other scholarship or if he/she is in receipt of another scholarshipRs. he/she will need to shift from the existing scholarship scheme to the KALIA ScholarshipRs. if they so choose. Only one scholarship can be availed.
1. The students can get KALIA scholarship for one professional course only & shall not be eligible for getting the scholarship for a second professional course.

**Note:** Government Institutions means an organization set up by the State Government to execute its programme is called Government Institution. The institutions set up by the Central Government and Private Institutions or the State Govt. aided Private Institutions shall not come under the Government Institutions.
> **Subjects & Courses eligible for the KALIA Scholarship**


1. The Professional or Technical graduation courses like M.B.B.SRs. BDSRs. BHMSRs. BAMSRs. B.PharmaRs. B.Sc. (Nursing)Rs. PBBScRs. B.Sc (Agriculture)Rs. BVSc & AHRs. B.Sc (Horticulture)Rs. B.Sc. (Forestry)Rs. B.Sc (Fisheries Science)Rs. B.Sc. (Community Science)Rs. B.Tech (Agril. Engg)Rs. B.Tech/B.E in Government Institutes of the State is included under the KALIA Scholarship.
1. SimilarlyRs. Diploma courses like D. PharmaRs. DMLTRs. DMRTRs. Ophthalmic Assistance/Surgical OPTH AssistanceRs. GNMRs. ANMRs. Psychiatric NursingRs. Polytechnic & Agri Polytechnic in Government Institutes of the State are included under the KALIA Scholarship.
1. FurtherRs. courses of different trades in Government ITI's are included under the KALIA Scholarship scheme.

**Note:** The list of courses may be modified if needed by Government approval.

name: Tripura Lynching/Mob Violence Victim Compensation Scheme
brief_description:
The Tripura Lynching/Mob Violence Victim Compensation Scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Tripura on 14th August 2018 for providing fund for the purpose of compensation to the victim or his dependents who have suffered loss or injury as a result of lynching/mob violence and who require rehabilitation. This scheme was formulated in pursuance of the order issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court on 17.07.2018 in disposing of Writ Petition (Civil) No.754 of 2016.
> **Objective:**


- To effectively implement this scheme notified under the provisions of Section 357A of Cr. P.C. and continue financial support to the victims under the lynching/mob violence Victim Compensation SchemeRs. 2018.

> **Victim Compensation Fund:**


- There shall be constituted a fund namely "Victim Compensation Fund for Lynching/Mob Violence" from which the amount of compensation under this scheme shall be paid to the victim or his dependents who have suffered loss or injury as a result of lynching/mob violence.
- The scheme shall be implemented through the District Magistrate & Collectors of the State.
benefits:
> **Minimum amount of compensation for the victims of lynching/mob violence:**

**Sl. No.****Description of injuries/loss****Quantum of compensation**1Death4 Lakhs2Permanent Disability (80% or more)2 Lakhs3Partial disability (40% to 80%)1 Lakh4Fully damaged/destroyed house95Rs./-5(i) Pucca House/ Shop/Commercial Establishment.95Rs./ -6(ii) Kutcha House / Shop/Commercial Establishment50Rs./-7Partially damaged/ destroyed house5Rs./-8(i) Pucca House/ Shop/ Commercial Establishment. 5Rs./-9(ii) Kutcha House/ Shop/ Commercial Establishment.3Rs./-10Damaged/destroyed Huts4Rs./- per Hut (Hut means a temporaryRs. makeshift unitRs. inferior to Kutcha HouseRs. made of thatchRs. mudRs. plastic sheetsRs. etc. traditionally recognized as a hut by the State / District Authorities> **Quantum of compensation:**


1. The quantum of compensation to be awarded to the victim or his dependents based on the loss caused to the victimRs. medical expenses to be incurred on treatmentRs. minimum sustenance amount required for rehabilitation including such incidental charges as funeral expensesRs. etc. subject to the limit as per schedule. The compensation may vary from case to case depending on the facts of each caseRs. but shall not exceed the amount specified in the schedule.
1. In case of death/permanent disability/loss of property and interim relief is to be provided to the victim or the next of kin within a period of 30 days of the incident of mob violence/lynching.
1. Compensation received by the victim or dependent from the State in relation to the crime in questionRs. namelyRs. insuranceRs. ex-gratiaRs. and/or payment received under any other Act or State-run schemeRs. shall be considered as part of the compensation amount under this scheme and if the eligible compensation amount exceeds the payments received by the victim from collateral sources mentioned aboveRs. the balance amount shall be paid out of Fund.
1. To alleviate the suffering of the victimRs. first aid facility or medical treatment is to be made available free of cost provided a maximum limit of 1.00 lakh on the certificate of the Police officer not below the rank of the Officer-in-Charge of the Police Station or Magistrate of the area concernedRs. or any other interim relief as deem fit.
eligibility:
1. The victim should be a resident of Tripura.
1. The victim or his dependents who have suffered loss or injury as a result of lynching/mob violence and who require rehabilitation are eligible for the grant of compensation.
1. Victim shall be eligible for the grant of compensation if ordered by the Court.
1. Victim shall be eligible for the grant of compensation if:


- The offender is not traced or identifiedRs. but the victim is identified and the victim has to incur a lot of expenses on physical and mental rehabilitation.
- The victim or claimant must report the crime to the Officer-in-Charge of the local Police Station under whose jurisdiction the offense was committed or to the Judicial Magistrate having jurisdiction before claiming compensation;
- The victim or claimant (in the case of the death of the victim) cooperates with the Police and prosecution during the investigation and trial of the case. Turning hostileRs. refusing to deposeRs. or turning up during trial shall be considered to be non-cooperation.
- The death or permanent incapacitation of the victim was not the result of the victim's wrongdoing or substantial provocation.
- The victim suffers substantial loss of income as a result of the crime or is unable to take care of expenses of medical treatment for injury caused on account of the crime.
- Due to the death of the victim as a result of the crimeRs. dependents may claim compensation if the family becomes destitute and there is no earning member in the family who will support the dependents.
- The compensation would be admissible to the victim in the event of loss of property and the event of death or permanent incapacitation of the victim because of the act of crime.
- Perpetrators of crime or his/her dependents will not be eligible for any compensation under the Scheme.

name: "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
brief_description: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" is a Sub-Component under the scheme "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme". The scheme is extended to all the regions of the Union territory of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.
benefits:
1Rs. in two installments of 50Rs. eachRs. as immediate relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
> **Disbursal** - InitiallyRs. 50% will be extended within 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the family (legal heir). - The family (legal heir) should approach this department for the release of the balance 50% of the relief which will be deposited in the bank in a joint account in the name of kin (legal heir) and the competent authority concerned. - If no further information is received about the missing personRs. the balance amount will be released in favour of the next of kin (legal heir)Rs. after the prescribed period of 9 months from the date of release of 1st part of lump sum. ****In case of the return of the missing fishermenRs. the amount extended as compensation either 50Rs. or 1Rs. as the case may beRs. will be recovered by invoking an insurance bond.***
eligibility:
- The applicant should be the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
- The missing fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
- The missing fisherman must have lost his/her life while fishing.
- The missing fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years.
- The missing fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.
- The missing fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.

name: Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons
brief_description: The scheme Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry was introduced to encourage and support marriages between differently-abled individuals and those without disabilities. Through this schemeRs. an incentive of 1Rs./- is providedRs. comprising 20Rs. in cash and 80Rs./- in the form of National Savings Certificate (NSC).
benefits: - An incentive of 1Rs./- (20Rs. in cash and 80Rs./- in NSC).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
1. The applicant should have an annual income not exceeding 75Rs./- per annum.
1. The bride should be above 18 years of age.
1. The bridegroom should be above 21 years of age.
1. The disability of the applicant should be 40% and above.
1. The marriage should be the first marriage between the bride and the groom.
1. The marriage should have been registered.
1. The application should be submitted within 120 days after marriage.

name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana
slug: gopinath munde shetkari apghat suraksha sanugrah audhan yojana
brief_description:
1. Farmers are prone to various accidents while performing farming business. Due to death/ disability of earning head of family the family members of farmers have to face critical financial situation.
1. The said scheme will be applicable for 24 hours of every day during the prescribed period.
1. Farmers who are registered account holders and any 1 member of farmer's family who is not registered as registered account holder shall remain eligible for benefits under the scheme even if any of these persons suffer an accident or disability.
1. There is no relevance of this scheme to any other such scheme which is implemented by any other institution or individual farmers. The benefit of this scheme is completely independent.
1. To get the benefit of this scheme there is no need to submit any other documents than prescribed in the Government Resolution (G.R.).
benefits:
The benefits in the form of compensation provided:
I)Death - Rs. 2 lakhs II) Disablement - Rs. 1 lakh /- or 2 lakhs a) Loss of one limb or one Eye - Rs. 1 Lakhs b) Loss of two limbs or two Eyes- Rs. 2 lakhs c) Loss of one limb and one Eye - Rs. 2 lakhs
eligibility: 1) Registered farmer in the age group of 10 -75 years. 2) Person registered as farmer in Maharashtra as evidenced by 7/12 extract. 3) All 1.52 crore farmers of the state and one family member from their family.

name: Shubhshakti Yojana
brief_description: The Shubshakti Yojana has been initiated by the Rajasthan government with the aim of providing financial assistance to regular construction workersRs. unmarried laborersRs. and their daughters. The primary objective of this scheme to support and strengthen the daughters of labour families in Rajasthan state.
benefits:
- Receives a financial assistance of 55Rs./-.
- The amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
- The funds can be used for various purposesRs. including:

1. Higher education
1. Vocational training
1. Starting a business
1. Skill development training
1. Marriage expenses
eligibility:
1. One parent (either father or mother or both) must be registered as a beneficiary/construction worker for at least one year in the board.
1. A maximum of two daughters of the beneficiary or the female beneficiary and her one daughter will be given the incentive amount.
1. The female beneficiary must be unmarried or the beneficiary's daughter must be at least 18 years old and unmarried.
1. The daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary must have passed at least the 8th standard.
1. There should be a savings bank account in the name of the daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary.
1. If the beneficiary has his own houseRs. there should be a toilet in the house.
1. The beneficiary must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the year before the application date.
1. The incentive amount will be payable only after physical verification of the beneficiary being a construction workerRs. which can be done by various authorities.
1. The incentive amount can be used by the female beneficiary/daughter for further educationRs. vocational trainingRs. starting her own businessRs. or for her own marriageRs. with proper counseling.
1. The application for the scheme must be submitted in the prescribed form by the beneficiary after completing one year as a registered beneficiaryRs. and the beneficiary's identity card must be valid/active at the time of application.
1. Girls who have already received assistance under the Board's Marriage Assistance Scheme earlier will not be eligible for assistance under this scheme.

name: Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Medical Assistance was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. medical assistance shall be provided to the Building & Other Construction WorkersRs. who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization because of an accident or illness.
benefits:
1. Medical assistance will be provided to the beneficiaries @ 200/- per day for the first 5 days of hospitalization and 100 per day for the remaining days subject to a maximum of 5Rs./-.
1. The beneficiary shall be entitled to 1Rs./- in the event of medical referred cases to the Mainland of the beneficiary or his/her dependents to the Mainland by the Govt. Medical Authorities for treatment.
1. Subject to production of a referral letter from competent authority 1Rs./- for Beneficiary or their "Family" in case of emergency treatment in a hospital operating in Andaman & Nicobar Islands (once in a year).
1. Subject to the production of referral remarks by Govt. Hospital/PHC in outer Islands 600/- per day for the period of their stay in Port Blair subject to a maximum of 15Rs./- (Medical referral cases from outer Islands of Andaman & Nicobar Islands to Port Blair).
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in a building or other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
1. To avail medical assistance under the schemeRs. either the beneficiary or their dependent should be hospitalized due to an accident or illness.

**Note 01:** The beneficiaries are required to produce a medical certificate
**Note 02:** The beneficiaries are required to produce a referral letter from the competent authority.

name: Death Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Death Benefit was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to the nominees or dependents of workers engaged in Building or Other Construction Works in Andaman & Nicobar Islands in the event of their natural or accidental death.
benefits:
1. **Natural Death:**

- 1Rs./- shall be sanctioned to the nominee or dependent of a registered beneficiary.

1. **Accidental Death (During Employment):**

- 2Rs./- may be given to the nominee or dependent of the beneficiary.

1. **Accidental Death (Non-registered Construction Workers):**

- 50Rs./- may be providedRs. subject to a certificate from the concerned Tehsildar confirming the deceased was a construction worker.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The financial assistance shall be given to the nominees or dependents of deceased registered workers in the event of their natural or accidental death.
1. The financial assistance shall be given to the nominees or dependents of non-registered construction workers in case of accidental death only.

name: Shiksha Protsaahan Puraskaar yojana
brief_description: The Shiksha Protsahan Puraskar Yojana (Shram Kalyan Mandal) is a scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government to provide financial assistance to the children of registered workers of the Madhya Pradesh Shram Kalyan Mandal for their higher education.
benefits:
1. General Graduate (B.A.Rs. B.ComRs. B.Sc.Rs. B.B.A.) : 10Rs./-
1. Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) : 15Rs./-
1. M.B.B.S./ B.D.S. : 25Rs./-
1. PharmacyRs. AyurvedicRs. Homeopathic (U.G.Rs. P.G. Diploma) : 12Rs./-
1. Law Courses : 10Rs./-
1. General P.G. Courses (M.ARs. M.ComRs. M.ScRs. MBA) : 10Rs./-
1. M.E/M.Tech : 11Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The worker must be employed in an industrial unit or establishment located within the jurisdiction of the Madhya Pradesh Shram Kalyan Mandal. 1. Up to two children of such workers who have studied in educational institutions of Madhya Pradesh are eligible for the award. 1. The children must have secured at least 70% marks in their graduationRs. post-graduationRs. and BE examinations. 1. For MBBS studentsRs. the minimum required marks is 60% in their previous year's examination.

name: Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. In urban areasRs. where EWS/LIG houses have been allotted by the Local Self-Government Organization/Urban Development Authority and Gujarat Housing Board under the Chief Minister/Prime Minister Awas YojanaRs. the benefit of this scheme is given once per family to the construction worker registered in the board.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to registered construction workers.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. A house is allotted jointly to a registered construction worker husband or wife and either of the husband or wife is a registered construction worker will be eligible for the benefit of this scheme.
1. No land/property or building should be in the name of the registered construction worker husband or wife or any of their family members.
1. The benefit of this scheme is given once per family to the registered construction worker.

**Note 01:** The construction worker should be registered in this scheme for at least 2 years.
**Note 02:** Application for this scheme has to be made after one year of house allotment.

name: Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The "Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to the families of registered workers who die while in service. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased workers and help them meet their immediate needs.
benefits: Financial Assistance : 1Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Workers should be working in an establishment registered under the Factories ActRs. 1948.
1. The monthly salary of the worker (basic salary + dearness allowance) should not exceed 15Rs./-.
1. It is mandatory to apply within one year from the date of death of the worker.
1. Financial assistance will be payable to the worker's spouse or dependent (son/unmarried daughter)Rs. mother/father in case the worker is unmarried.

name: Assistance for Marriage
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance for Marriage" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled PersonsRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this schemeRs. a sum of 2Rs./- is given to meet the marriage expenses of the differently abled person or his son or daughter. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
**Eligibility for differently abled person:**

1. The applicant should be a differently abled person.
1. The differently abled person shall have attained the age as prescribed by law for marriage.

**Eligibility for son or daughter:**

1. The children of differently-abled person should be holding identity card.

name: Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided for coaching classes for admission of children of registered workers in professional/technical courses like Degree/Diploma in MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. ManagementRs. MCARs. LawRs. Fashion designRs. etc.Rs. and 1Rs./- for preparation of Main Examination on passing Preliminary Examination of UPSC/HPSSC.
benefits:
1. Financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided for coaching classes for admission of children of registered workers in professional/technical courses like Degree/Diploma in MedicalRs. EngineeringRs. ManagementRs. MCARs. LawRs. Fashion DesigningRs. etc.
1. Upon passing the Preliminary Examination of UPSC/HPSSCRs. individuals are eligible for 1Rs./- to prepare for the Main Examination.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one years regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. The son/daughter of the worker should be receiving coaching for admission in professional/technical courses from an institute.
1. The worker should not have applied again for financial assistance for the coaching of his/her child. The assistance will be provided only once.
1. The spouse of the worker should not have received any financial assistance for coaching classes of his/her child from any government department/board/corporate institutionRs. nor should they have applied for such assistance.
1. Financial assistance for coaching will be given up to three children.

name: Fare for Visiting Home Town (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Fare for Visiting Home Town is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a free traveling facility to visit the home town once in a year for a family not exceeding 5 members is provided to the registered construction workers who have a minimum two years regular membership of the Board. The payment of expenditure incurred by the beneficiary is paid at the rate prescribed by the Haryana Roadways (Ordinary fare) from time to time or actual railway fare (2nd Class)Rs. as the case may be.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. a free traveling facility to visit the home town once in a year for a family not exceeding 5 members is provided to the registered construction worker of the Board.
1. The payment of expenditure incurred by the beneficiary is paid at the rate prescribed by the Haryana Roadways (Ordinary fare) from time to time or actual railway fare (2nd Class)Rs. as the case may be.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of two years regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. Five members of a family including registered construction workers are eligible to avail of benefits under the scheme on a visit to their home town once in a year.

name: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 51Rs./- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the marriage of their daughters and for the self-marriage of the working women workers as Kanyadaan. From 23.02.2015Rs. the benefit of the said scheme is being extended from 02 girls to 03 girls for marriage and from 15.01.2019Rs. the amount of kanyadaan will be provided three days before the date of solemnization of marriage. With the implementation of this schemeRs. the girl child will not be considered a burden in society and the boy-girl discrimination will also be reduced to some extent. This assistance will have no effect on the financial assistance received by the workers from other sources.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 51Rs./- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana state for the marriage of their daughters and to the working female workers for their own marriage in the form of Kanyadan.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the applicant should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The applicant must have a minimum of three years of regular membership of the Board till the Marriage date.
1. The applicant should apply within six months after the marriage date.
1. The benefits are provided to workers for the marriage of up to three daughters and for the self-marriage of female workers.

**Note:** The worker will give an undertaking that he will clearly explain to the Board whether he/she has availed the benefits of the Kanyadaan Scheme for the first timeRs. second time or third time or never before.

name: Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 10Rs./- is provided to female workers and wives of male workers working in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana for the delivery of up to two children. From 23.02.2015Rs. the benefit of the maternity scheme of up to three girls is being provided to female workers and wives of male workers in the said scheme.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 10Rs./- is provided to women workers and wives of male workers working in industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana state for the delivery of up to two children (three girls or two boys).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
- The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
- The monthly salary of the applicant should not exceed 25Rs./-.
- The service period of the workers is fixed for one year.
- Application has to be made within 1 year from the date of birth of the child.
- The benefit is provided to women workers and wives of male workers for the delivery of up to two children (three girls or two boys).

name: Scholarship Scheme for Worker's Children- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Scholarship Scheme for Worker's Children is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to children of workers and workers employed in industrial and commercial institutions of Haryana state to continue their studies. The amount of scholarship is given to workers and children of workers (3 girls and 2 boys) on passing the examination and continuing their studies in the next grade.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following scholarship amounts are provided for different classes:
**Sl. No.****Class/Course (For Continuing Education)****Scholarship Amount (Per Year)**19th to 10th Class10Rs./-2ITI Diploma10Rs./-311th to 12th Class12Rs./-4All Types of Bachelor's Degrees15Rs./-5Polytechnic DiplomaRs. C.A.D. PharmacyRs. A.N.M.Rs. G.N.M. and Other Undergraduate Diploma Courses15Rs./-6All types of Engineering DegreesRs. B. Pharmacy20Rs./-7All Types of Post Graduate Degrees Diplomas/B.Sc Nursing20Rs./-8All Types of Medical Degrees (MBBSRs. BDSRs. BAMSRs. etc.) 21Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for one year.
1. The worker or the worker's children studying in 9th grade or above are eligible for the scheme's benefits.
1. The scheme benefits are available to three girls and two boys per worker.

**Note 01:** The last date for submission of the application form for the benefit of this scheme has been fixed as 31st December. Application submitted on a date after December 31 will not be considered.
**Note 02:** If the child of the worker is taking a scholarship from any other institutionRs. then he/she can also avail the benefit of the scheme.
**Note 03:** If a student receives a scholarship by giving a false certificateRs. he/she will never be given a scholarship in the future and the amount of the scholarship given will be taken back.
**Note 04:** The children of workers who drop out for some reason and continue their studies again will also get the benefit of this scheme. The children of workers who are continuing their education outside the state of Haryana will also be given the benefit of this scheme.

name: Assistance on Death- Haryana Silicosis Board
brief_description: The "Assistance on Death" schemeRs. implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare BoardRs. Government of HaryanaRs. provides financial assistance of 1Rs./- in the event of the death of a Silicosis victim. If the deceased was marriedRs. the assistance will be payable to the widow or widower. If the deceased was unmarriedRs. the amount will be given to their nominee.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. in the event of the death of a Silicosis victimRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- will be provided.

**Note 1:** If the deceased was marriedRs. the assistance will be payable to the widow or widower.
**Note 2:** If the deceased was unmarriedRs. the financial assistance will be given to the nominee.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the widow/widower/nominee of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. Haryana.
1. The deceased worker should have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.

name: Funeral Assistance- Haryana Silicosis Board
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare BoardRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 15Rs./- is given to the dependent/nominee of a deceased workerRs. who was confirmed to have Silicosis by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. HaryanaRs. for performing the funerary rituals.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 15Rs./- is given to the dependent/nominee of the deceased worker for performing the funerary rituals.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the dependent/nominee of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. Haryana.
1. The worker should have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.

name: Mukhyamantri Nikah Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Nikah Yojana" was started by the Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh in the year 2012. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to needy girlsRs. widowsRs. and abandoned women from destitute or poor Muslim families in the state at the time of their marriage (In case of mass marriage).
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided:

- Each eligible bride (including girlsRs. widowsRs. or abandoned women) participating in the mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony will receive a total of 49Rs./- through an Account Payee Cheque.
- The organizing body that conducts the mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony will receive 6Rs./- per beneficiary.

**Note:** A total of 55Rs./- is provided per beneficiary under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The parents of the bride and groom should be natives of Madhya Pradesh.
1. Financial assistance will be provided to needy girlsRs. widowsRs. and abandoned women from destitute or poor Muslim families in the state at the time of their marriage.
1. The bride and groom should belong to Muslim families.
1. The bride should be at least 18 years oldRs. and the groom must be at least 21 years old.
1. There are no income restrictions for receiving assistance under the scheme.
1. The bride and groom should participate in the mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony organized on the prescribed dates.
1. The benefit of this scheme will not be available for single marriage (Nikah) ceremonies.

**Note 1:** Abandoned women who have been legally divorced are only eligible under the scheme.
**Note 2:** If the groom is from outside the stateRs. the bride will still be eligible for the benefits of the scheme. HoweverRs. if the parents of either the bride or groom are not natives of the stateRs. the benefits under the scheme will not be available.
**Note 3:** The bride should not have been previously married. This means that the marriage of the bride and groom must take place solely during a mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony organized under the schemeRs. and they should not have been married through a single or any other mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony before.
**Note 4:** A mass marriage (Nikah) ceremony will be organized only if applications are received from a minimum of 5 couples.

name: Shagun Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Shagun Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance for the marriage of up to two daughters of registered workmenRs. including daughters who are registered beneficiaries. It's applicable only once per daughterRs. excluding second marriages. If the girl is herself registered memberRs. she can also avail Shagun for her own marriage under this scheme
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** 31Rs./- on the marriage of each daughter.
> **Note:**


- The assistance shall be applicable only once on the occasion of the marriage of two daughters (upto two daughters marriage).
- It shall not be applicable in the case of a second marriage.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member/female member (for self-marriage) of the Punjab Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or an unmarried daughter of the member.
- It should be the first marriage of the daughter/ self.
- The scheme applies only to the marriage of up to two daughters.
- The applicant must submit an application within 3 months after the marriage date.

name: General Surgery Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "General Surgery Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board shall provide financial assistance for general surgery of the beneficiary and his family members.
benefits: - **Financial Coverage:** 50Rs./- or actual expensesRs. whichever is less.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or should be a family member of the worker.
- The member should be depositing his contribution to the Board regularly.
- The applicant should have undergone general surgery for himself or any member of his family.

name: Cycle Scheme for the Children of Construction Workers (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Cycle Scheme for the Children of Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide free cycles to the children of registered construction workers once during the period they study in 9th to 12th class in the State of Punjab.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** One(1) cycle to the children of registered construction workers.

> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***

- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The beneficiary should be a child of a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The beneficiary should be studying in any class between 9th to 12th in the State of Punjab.
- The beneficiary should not have received any bicycle from the State Government under Mai Bhago Cycle Scheme.

name: Urban Health Kiosk Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Urban Health Kiosk Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this SchemeRs. primary health facilities are provided to the construction workers & their families in urban health kiosks run by Punjab Health Society in slum areas.
benefits: - Health Facilities: Primary Health Facilities are provided to the construction workers & their families in Urban Health Kiosks in slum areas.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
