- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or should be a family member of the worker.
- The applicant should be suffering from any primary disease.

name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana
brief_description: The Department of WomenRs. Child Development & Social Security launched the "Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana" scheme aims to enhance the financial security and well-being of women across the state by providing financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month to women beneficiaries. The payments are directly deposited into their bank accounts by the 15th of every month.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance 1Rs./- per month.**
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Jharkhand. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21-49 years.

name: Antarjatiye Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
brief_description: The "Antarjatiye Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana" is a sub-scheme of the "Mukhyamantri Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana"Rs. initiated by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The objective of this scheme is to end the caste system in the state and encourage inter-caste marriages by providing financial assistance to couples. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries will receive a one-time grant of 1Rs./-.

**Note:** The grant will be provided to the bride.
eligibility:
1. The bride and groom should be residents of Bihar.
1. The marriage should be an inter-caste marriage.
1. At the time of marriageRs. the bride should be at least 18 years oldRs. and the groom should be at least 21 years old.
1. The bride and groom should belong to poor families.

name: Kabir Anthyesthi Anudan Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Kabir Antyesthi Anudan Yojana" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a one-time grant of 3Rs./- is given to the family/dependent of the deceased to cover funeral expenses. The grant is provided for the death of any person of any age from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. This scheme is fully funded by the State Government.
**Objective:**
The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the dependent of a deceased member of a poor family in the state for funeral expenses.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. a one-time grant of 3Rs./- is provided to the family or dependents of the deceased person to cover funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased person.
1. The deceased should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.

**Note:** The grant is provided to cover funeral expenses for the death of any person of any age from a BPL family.

name: Annal Gandhi Memorial Award
brief_description: The Annal Gandhi Memorial AwardRs. introduced on May 7Rs. 2012Rs. by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Tamil NaduRs. aims to encourage academic excellence among students from the Hindu Adi Dravidar community. The scheme helps students pursue higher education through providing financial assistance.
benefits: - **In first year:** 2Rs./-. - **For the succeeding five years:** 1Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
- The beneficiary should belong to the SC/ST (Hindu Adi Dravidar) community.
- The beneficiary must have secured the first rank in plus 2 Public Examinations in their district.

name: Pension to the Beneficiary Building Worker Who Has Completed 60 Years
brief_description: The "Pension to the Beneficiary Building Worker Who Has Completed 60 Years" scheme was implemented by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to construction workers who have completed 5 years of service as a registered beneficiary and reached the age of 60.
benefits: - **Pension of 500/- per month with an increase of 10/- for each additional year of service beyond the initial 5 years.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board.
1. The registered applicant should be working as a building worker for not less than 5 years.
1. The applicant's age should be 60 years or above.

name: Natural Death Relief (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Natural Death Relief" scheme launched by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance of 30Rs./- to the kith and kin of a registered building worker in the event of the worker's natural death. This amount is paid as a one-time relief.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 30Rs./- is provided for natural death as a free additional benefit (FREE ADD).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the nomineeRs. dependentRs. or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased construction worker should be registered with the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board.
1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to natural death.

name: Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Pension SchemeRs." launched by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) under the Government of Himachal PradeshRs. provides financial support to registered construction workers. Once they reach the age of 60Rs. beneficiaries are entitled to a monthly pensionRs. with a guaranteed minimum amount of 1Rs./-.
benefits: Pension amount 1Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
***For Registration as a Building/Construction Worker:*** 1. The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a Building or Construction Worker. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration must be renewed annually.
**Eligibility Criteria for Pension Scheme:** 1. The worker should be registered as a Building or Construction worker with the "Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board". 1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active. 1. The worker should be 60 years of age or older. 1. The beneficiary should have been a continuous member of the Board for three years before attaining the age of 60 years.

name: Funeral Support Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Funeral Support SchemeRs." launched by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) under the Government of Himachal PradeshRs. provides financial assistance of 20Rs./- (twenty thousand) to the nominees or dependents of a registered beneficiary in the event of the worker's death.
benefits: 20Rs./- is provided for a registered worker's death.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the "Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
1. The membership of the deceased worker with the Welfare Board must be active.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Education of Children
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Education of Children by the Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. offers one-time financial aid to beneficiaries to ease the cost of their children's (maximum two) education. The scheme is structured to provide assistance based on the level of education.
benefits: - **Higher Secondary/ Diploma:** 4Rs./-. - **Graduation/ Diploma:** 6Rs./-. - **Post-Graduation:** 10Rs./-. - **Engineering/ Medical:** 30Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment.
1. The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses.
1. The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use.

name: Mentally Retarded Children Benefit Scheme (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: In the scheme "Mentally Retarded Children Benefit" by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Government of Himachal PradeshRs. an amount of 20Rs./- per annum is provided to the registered workers to take care of their mentally retarded/disabled children.
benefits: 20Rs./- per annum
eligibility:
***For Registration***

1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a Building or Construction Worker.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months.

_*The registration should be renewed annually._
***For Application***

1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker should be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The worker's membership with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board must be active.
1. The child of the worker should be mentally retarded/disabled and dependent on the registered worker.

name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Shramik Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Shramik Yojana" scheme by the Urban Development & Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Jharkhand aims to provide guaranteed employment to unskilled workers residing in urban areas. Under this schemeRs. eligible beneficiaries receive up to 100 days of employment per financial year in various urban development projects.
benefits:
- Guaranteed wage employment for a maximum of 100 days per financial year. - Improvement in living standards of urban poor families. - Employment opportunities in urban development projects like housingRs. sanitationRs. and road construction. - Ensuring social security for urban workers. - Contribution to urban cleanliness and green city initiatives.
***Job Card Issuance:*** - Job cards can be obtained onlineRs. through community resource personsRs. urban local body officesRs. or ward-level camps. - Job card valid for 3 years with provisions for member addition/removal.
***Job Allocation Process:*** - Workers can demand work online or through community resource persons. - Employment is assigned within 15 working days. - Job allocation details are sent via SMS and can be accessed on the portal.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be an unskilled worker willing to work in urban areas.
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand and living in an urban local body (own/rented/slum) since before April 1Rs. 2015.
1. The applicant should be 18 years or older.
1. The disabled personRs. women in special circumstancesRs. and senior citizens above 65 years are also eligible to apply.

name: Family Pension (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme "Family Pension" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides pension to the dependent of the deceased pensioner of the Board.
benefits: 50% of the pension amount or 100/-Rs. whichever is higher.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a dependent of a deceased worker.
- The workerRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been registered with the "Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
- The workerRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been in receipt of regular pension from the Board.

name: Death Assistance Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Death Assistance" schemeRs. implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB) under the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides financial assistance to the legal heir in the case of natural death or accidental death of the registered worker. If the death occurs during a disaster and a grant has already been given by Disaster ManagementRs. only 1Rs./- will be payable by the Board.
benefits:
- 2Rs./- in the case of natural death.
- 4Rs./- in the case of accidental death.
- 1Rs./- if disaster aid is already received.
eligibility:
1. The deceased construction worker should have been registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB).
1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of death.
1. The only person who is a legal heir/dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
brief_description:
The "Birsa Harit Gram Yojana" by the Rural Development DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to promote afforestation and provide sustainable livelihood opportunities for marginalized communities. Under this schemeRs. block and linear plantation activities are conducted on common and private landsRs. benefiting Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. landless familiesRs. and other economically weaker sections. The scheme is implemented by the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) framework.
***Objective:*** The objectives include improving green coverRs. generating rural employmentRs. and ensuring environmental sustainability through a structured three-phase plantation model.
benefits: 1. Plantation of fruit-bearing and fodder trees on common land and private land. 1. Sustainable livelihood generation for marginalized families. 1. Employment guarantee of 100 days under MGNREGA. 1. Usufruct rights over the plantation for beneficiaries.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST)Rs. Primitive TribesRs. or be a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a woman-headed householdRs. a person with disabilitiesRs. or a beneficiary of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY). 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer. 1. The applicant should possess a MGNREGA job card. 1. The applicant's livelihood should primarily depend on agriculture.

name: Financial Assistance for Cremation (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides financial assistance of 5Rs./-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 5Rs./- is provided for the cremation of the deceased construction worker.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased construction worker.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have been registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The deceasedRs. in his/her lifetimeRs. should have maintained regular membership with the Board.

name: Bunkar Parivar Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2013-14Rs. the scheme "Bunkar Parivar Sahayata Yojana" by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur aims to provide financial security to families of weavers working in primary weaver cooperative societies. The scheme provides immediate financial assistance to family members of weavers in case of their untimely death. Eligible beneficiaries include working weaver members of primary weaver cooperative societies affiliated with the State Handloom Union. The scheme is implemented by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided to the heir of the working weaver in case of death.
- The assistance is meant to address the immediate financial crisis faced by family members of weavers upon their untimely death.
eligibility:
The scheme applies to the families of working weaver members of primary weaver cooperative societies affiliated with the Chhattisgarh State Handloom UnionRs. Raipur.
_*Weaver family refers to husbandRs. wifeRs. and their children._

name: Incentive for Inter-Caste Marriage Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive for Inter Caste Marriage" by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/MinoritiesRs. Government of NCT of DelhiRs. aims to promote marriages between non-SCs and SCs as an effective instrument to combat casteism. Under the schemeRs. an incentive of 50Rs./- is provided to couples where one spouse belongs to the SC community and the other to a non-SC community. The scheme mandates marriage registration and requires applicants to apply within two years of marriage. The Secretary (DSCST) is the competent authority to authorize the concerned DC to disburse the incentive.
benefits:
**Financial Incentive:** One-time payment of 50Rs./- per eligible couple.
**Mode of Disbursement:** Through the concerned Deputy Commissioner (DC) as authorized by the Secretary (DSCST).
**Conditions for Disbursement:** The couple should provide proof of living together at the time of disbursement of benefits.
eligibility:
- The couple should have married legally.
- The couple should have had their marriage registered at the Office of the RegistrarRs. Marriages.
- The marriage should have been between a Scheduled Caste (SC) and a Non-SC spouse.
- At least one of the spouses should be a permanent resident of NCT of Delhi.
- If the non-SC spouse belongs to another stateRs. their parents must have resided in NCT of Delhi for at least five years.
- The non-SC spouse should provide proof that their caste is not listed under untouchability in their home state and that they follow the Hindu religion.
- After marriageRs. the couple should be residing in the NCT of Delhi.
- The couple should provide proof of living together at the time of fund disbursement.

_*A widow of up to 35 years of age with no children can avail of the incentive upon inter-caste remarriage._

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana" was launched by the Social Justice & Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. in 1997. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 50Rs./- per couple is provided. AdditionallyRs. 20Rs./- is given as event expenses to organizations that organize marriage events for specially-abled individuals. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Specially-Abled Persons in the state.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 50Rs./- per couple is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a specially-abled individual (male or female).
1. The applicant should possess a disability certificate with 40% or more disabilityRs. issued by a Medical Officer or Medical Board.
1. The groom should be at least 21 years oldRs. and the bride should be at least 18 years old.
1. The applicants family income from all sources should not exceed 2Rs./- per year.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana" was launched by the Department of FoodRs. Civil Supplies & Consumer AffairsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support poor families holding Antyodaya (pink) ration cards in the state by reducing their household fuel expenses.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. Antyodaya ration card (pink card) holders in the state are entitled to receive 03 free gas cylinder refills every year.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must hold an Antyodaya (pink card) ration card issued by the state.

name: Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)
brief_description: The scheme "Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)" by the Renewable Energy DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana aims to provide reliableRs. cleanRs. and affordable electricity to rural households and promote the use of renewable energy across the state. The scheme primarily benefits families with a valid Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP)Rs. offering them subsidized solar home lighting systems to reduce their dependence on conventional electricity sources and promote environmental sustainability.
benefits: - **Subsidy for General Category:** A subsidy of 15Rs./- per solar home system is provided to eligible families under the general category. - **Subsidy under SCSP:** A subsidy covering 90% of the cost is provided to Scheduled Caste families under SCSP component.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP).

name: Solar Inverter Charger
brief_description: The "Solar Inverter Charger" by the Renewable Energy DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to promote sustainable energy practicesRs. reduce the dependency on grid electricityRs. and provide financial support for the installation of solar inverter chargers in domestic households. This initiative targets families with existing inverters who have not yet adopted solar technologyRs. thereby enabling energy-efficient solutions and reducing carbon footprint.
benefits: - **For 320-watt Solar Inverter Charger System:** A subsidy of 6Rs./- is provided. - **For 640-watt Solar Inverter Charger System:** A subsidy of 10Rs./- is provided.
eligibility: 1. Any resident family of Haryana with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP) to apply. 1. All the households who have domestic inverter and not installed solar inverter charger on his/her existing inverter. 1. Applicants who have not installed Solar Inverter Charger in past 5 years under the Department Scheme.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme - Gujarat
brief_description: The National Family Benefit Scheme is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented in Gujarat by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide social security to households living below the poverty line by offering financial assistance in the event of the death of the primary breadwinner. Under the schemeRs. a one-time lump sum assistance of 20Rs. is provided to the widow or unmarried daughter of the deceasedRs. if the primary breadwinnerRs. aged between 18 and 59 yearsRs. passes away.
benefits: 1. A one-time assistance payment of 20Rs./- is provided to the family of the deceasedRs. whether the death was natural or accidental. ***Notes:*** - The payment is intended for the familyRs. specifically going to the widow or unmarried daughter. - The assistance would be given to every case of death of breadwinner in a family. - Payment of the assistance is made through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the beneficiarys post or bank account. - This is a one-time assistance payment.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a family member of the deceased. 1. The family should be listed in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list as determined by the Government of India. 1. The deceased (male or female) should have been the primary income earner of the family. 1. The death of the primary income earner should have occurred due to natural or accidental causes. 1. The age of the deceased at the time of death should have been between 18 and 60 years. 1. The application should be submitted within two years from the date of death to be eligible under the scheme.

name: Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme
brief_description: The "Shahidvir Kinariwaala Student Security Group Insurance Scheme" was launched by the Education DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme provides financial protection in case of accidental death or permanent disability to students or their guardians/heirs to help reduce the burden during unforeseen tragedies. The scheme covers students at universitiesRs. Government and Non-Government collegesRs. Gram Vidyapeeth GBTC collegesRs. and technical education institutes across the state.
benefits: - Maximum financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided in case of accidental death or permanent disability. - Coverage includes accidental deathRs. permanent total disabilityRs. loss of two limbs or two eyesRs. or one limb and one eye (100% coverage). - Partial disability such as loss of one limb or one eye may also be covered at 50%.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a studentRs. guardian or heir of the student. 1. The applicant must be studying in any universityRs. government collegeRs. non-government collegeRs. Gram Vidyapeeth GBTC collegeRs. or technical education institute within Gujarat. 1. The student should have died in an accident or permanent disable. 1. The death must have been due to natural cause or suicide.

name: Rental Housing Scheme
brief_description: The "Rental Housing Scheme" was launched by the Department of Housing and Urban AffairsRs. Government of Assam on 14th October 1977. The scheme aims to provide rental housing to individuals and families from lower and middle-income groupsRs. address housing shortagesRs. prevent unauthorized settlementsRs. and promote orderly urban development in high-demand areas across AssamRs. with a significant presence in urban areas. The scheme provides rental housing particularly in urban and semi-urban areas and offers accommodation for Grade Third and Grade Fourth government or semi-government employeesRs. while also benefiting eligible non-government individuals without property in the area.
benefits: - **Rental Housing Provision:** Provides rental housing to needy peopleRs. particularly in urban and semi-urban areas.- **Employment-based Accommodation:** Offers accommodation specifically for Grade Third and Grade Fourth government or semi-government employees.- **Non-government Eligibility:** Benefits eligible non-government individuals without property in the area.- **Urban Development:** Helps reduce unauthorized settlements by offering planned housing.- **Transparent Allocation:** Ensures transparent allotment through a draw-of-lots system as per Honourable Gauhati High Court directions.- **Geographic Coverage:** Supports urban and semi-urban housing needs across Assam with 2Rs. rental flats constructedRs. of which 1Rs. are located in greater Guwahati.- **Urban Planning Support:** Contributes to urban planning and stability by managing migration and housing demand.- **Housing Categories:** Housing types include Middle Income GroupRs. Lower Income GroupRs. and Economically Weaker Section categories. ***Conditions*** - Payment of rent and security deposit as per allotment order. - Compliance with all terms and conditions outlined under Section 15(1) of the Assam State Housing Board RulesRs. 1976.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Grade Third or Grade Fourth government or semi-government employee under Section 15(1) of Assam State Housing Board RulesRs. 1976. - The applicant must be a non-government individual meeting the conditions under Section 15(2) of Assam State Housing Board RulesRs. 1976. - The applicant must not own any landed property in the location where the rental housing is situated. - The applicant must fulfill all terms and conditions outlined under Section 15(1) of the Assam State Housing Board RulesRs. 1976. - The applicant must be between 18 years and 60 years of age.

name: Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Incentive to Beneficiaries
brief_description: The scheme Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Incentive to Beneficiaries has been launched by the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to encourage the timely completion of houses constructed under government rural housing schemes. Through this schemeRs. incentives of prescribed amounts are paid to beneficiaries of Antyodaya Gruha YojanaRs. Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (Gramin)Rs. PM-JANMANRs. or any other government-funded rural housing scheme who complete their pucca house construction within specified timelines. The scheme is implemented by the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha.
benefits: 1. **20Rs.**/- to beneficiaries who complete house construction within **4** months from the date of receipt of the first instalment. 1. **10Rs.**/- to beneficiaries who complete house construction within **6** months from the date of receipt of the first instalment. > **Disbursement of Funds** 1. Incentive amounts are credited to the beneficiarys account from the State Nodal Account through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. 1. The incentive payment is tied to the timeline of house construction completion to the beneficiary (within 4 or 6 months from the first instalment).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Odisha. 1. The applicant must be a beneficiary of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (Gramin)Rs. PM-JANMANRs. or any other Government-funded rural housing scheme. 1. The applicant household must be residing in rural Odisha and must be houseless or living in a kutcha house.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Medical Assistance
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Medical Assistance scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide medical assistance benefits to registered driversRs. conductorsRs. and their eligible family members to reduce the financial burden arising from illness. It also enables beneficiaries to receive assistance for high-cost treatments in case of severe diseases.
benefits: - Medical treatment benefits are provided under [Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana](https://www.mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/getphoto.aspx?ViewCircular=eVTeefDvS1Q=) through the Public Health and Family Welfare Department.- Financial assistance for serious or life-threatening diseases may be provided under the State Illness Assistance FundRs. subject to eligibility and approval. - The benefit covers the registered driver or conductor and their eligible family members as defined under the scheme.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should hold a valid commercial driver or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor under the scheme. 1. The applicant or eligible family member should require medical treatment as per scheme provisions.

name: Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Construction of New House
brief_description: The scheme Antyodaya Gruha Yojana: Construction of New House has been implemented by the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. It aims to provide pucca houses to eligible rural households who are houseless or living in kutcha houses. Through this componentRs. financial assistance is provided to rural families for the construction of a new pucca house with a minimum carpet area of 25 square metres. The component is implemented by Panchayat Samities under the supervision of Zilla Parishads and the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided for the construction of a new pucca house. 1. The house must have a minimum carpet area of 25 square metresRs. including a hygienic cooking space and excluding the toilet area. > **Instalment-wise Disbursement:** - **First Instalment:** 10Rs./-Rs. released along with the issuance of the work order.- **Second Instalment:** 65Rs./-Rs. released upon reaching roof level.- **Third Instalment:** 15Rs./-Rs. released upon completion of the house. > **Timeline:** - The house is ordinarily required to be completed within 12 months from the credit of the first instalment. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - The construction assistance is credited directly to the beneficiarys bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer from the State Nodal Account. > **Convergence:** - The beneficiaries constructing new houses are entitled upto 90/95 person days of unskilled labour during house construction out of MGNREGS in addition to the unit assistance. - The beneficiaries can also avail support under relevant schemes of rural sanitationRs. drinking waterRs. rural electrificationRs. etc.Rs. if found eligible and not availed earlier. - BDO should endeavour to construct houses on a cluster basis wherever feasible. The required common infrastructureRs. like CC roadRs. street lightRs. drainageRs. community sanitation complexRs. community compost pitRs. etc.Rs. shall also be provided in convergence mode from the relevant schemes of Central & State Government.
eligibility: 1. The applicant household must be residing in rural Odisha and must be houseless or living in a kutcha house. 1. The applicant household should belong to at least one of the following categories: - Forest Rights ActRs. 2006 (FRA) beneficiaries. - Households where the main earning member is a Person with a disability with at least **40**% disability. - Lower-income households that are eligible but left out of existing Government rural housing schemes. 1. The households coming under the following categories will be eligible forsanction of a new houseRs. notwithstanding previous allotment of a house under any Government Housing Schemes and staying in a pucca house: - Households whose houses have been fully / severely damaged by natural/ manmade calamities like fireRs. floodRs. cycloneRs. earthquakeRs. elephant menaceRs. communal violenceRs. LWE violenceRs. major law and order problemRs. etc. - Victims ofriver / sea inundation who need relocation/shifting. - Households that are rehabilitated/relocated for setting up any Government projectsRs. such as highwaysRs. irrigation projectsRs. etc. - Households staying in sanctuary / reserve forest areas need relocation.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana
brief_description: The Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana Card Issuance scheme has been launched by the Public Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide free treatment access to Below Poverty Line families within a guaranteed time limit. A Deendayal Antyodaya Treatment Card is issued free of cost to eligible familiesRs. including persons with disabilitiesRs. to avail government health benefits.
benefits: **Card Benefits** - Free issuance of the Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana Card. - Enables access to government-funded medical treatment schemes. - Inclusive coverage for persons with disabilities belonging to BPL families. - No administrative fee is charged by the department. **Mode of Disbursement** - Physical card issued through designated health officers or Lok Seva Kendra. - Card issued within 7 working days from receipt of complete application. - One-time card issuance per eligible family.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to a below-poverty-line family. 1. The applicant should be a resident of the same district or area where the application is submitted. 1. The applicant should be the head of the family. 1. The applicants family may include persons with disabilitiesRs. without exclusion.

name: Zupda Vijlikaran Yojana
brief_description: The Zupda Vijlikaran Yojana was launched by the Energy and Petro Chemicals DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide access to electricity for Below Poverty Line (BPL) and low-income families across the state. Under this schemeRs. free household electricity connections are provided to eligible families.
benefits: - Free electricity household connection is provided to BPL/Lower income group beneficiary.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) or low-income family. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Rainfed Area Development
brief_description:
Rainfed Area Development (RAD) scheme was launched in 2014-15 to mainstream development of rainfed areas in a sustainable manner. It adopts an area-based approachRs. focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability. Under this systemRs. crops/ cropping system is integrated with activities like horticultureRs. livestockRs. fisheryRs. agro-forestryRs. apiculture etc. to enable farmers not only in maximizing farm returns for sustaining livelihoodRs. but also to mitigate the impacts of droughtRs. flood or other extreme weather events with the income opportunity from allied activities during crop damage.
Programmatic interventions as per land capability and conducive to climatic parameters for ensuring integrated development through dissemination and adoption of rainfed technologies with greater reach in disadvantaged areas & location specific planning by way of coordinationRs. convergence and leveraging investments from other Schemes/Missions like MGNREGARs. PMKSY-WDCRs. RKVYRs. National Food Security Mission(NFSM)Rs. Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)Rs. Sub Mission on Agricultural Extension (SMAE)Rs. etc.
It lays emphasis on integrating various components of agriculture such as agricultureRs. horticultureRs. fisheryRs. animal husbandryRs. apicultureRs. agro forestryRs. mushroomsRs. vermi compostingRs. etc. to increase farm production by promoting synergies and reduce impact of adverse climatic conditions. Sustainable agricultural practices such as soil testing based nutrient managementRs. resource conservationRs. use of indigenous seeds and crop selection based on agro climatic conditions are promoted.
A financial assistance of up to Rs. 30Rs./- per family can be given for adoption of integrated farming systems.
A cluster of 100 hectare or more (contiguous or non-contiguous in difficult terrain with close proximity in a village/adjoining villages) may be adopted to derive noticeable impact of convergence and encourage local participation and for future replication of the model in larger areas.
Supplementary support from this component will be admissible for gap-filling resource conservation activities under converging programmes. RAD clusters should have soil analysis/soil health card/soil survey maps to justify the interventions proposed and at least 25% of the farming system area will have to be covered under On Farm Water Management. Farming Systems recommended by ICARs Contingency Plans and successful findings of NICRA projects shall also be considered in development of integrated project plan. BesidesRs. creation and development of common property resources/assets/utilities like extensive livestock systemsRs. protective irrigation infrastructureRs. grain bankRs. biomass shreddersRs. fodder bankRs. group marketing etc. will be encouraged under this component.
The key objectives of the Mission are as follows:
To undertake location specific and landscape-based approach to dry-land areas to ensure natural resources conservation and sustainable useRs. strengthening of agriculture production systems and livelihood development through integration/convergence of schemes in an area-based approach.
To make agriculture more productiveRs. sustainableRs. remunerative and climate resilient by promoting location specific Integrated/Composite Farming Systems.
To conserve natural resources through appropriate soil and moisture conservation measures.
To develop capacity of farmers and stakeholders in conjunction with other ongoing Missions such as National Food and Nutrition Security MissionRs. National Initiative for Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) etc.Rs. in the domain of climate change adaptation measures.
To improve the productivity of rainfed farming by mainstreaming rainfed technologies refined under All India Coordinated Research Project on Dry land Agriculture (AICRPDA-NICRA) and by leveraging resources/provisions made under other Schemes/Missions like Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)Rs. PMKSY-WDCRs. NFNSMRs. RKVYRs. Krishonnati YojanaRs. SMAERs. National Mission on Natural Farming etc.
benefits: The scheme targets to provide following benefits: 1) Enhanced agriculture productivity and overall remuneration in the rainfed areas. 2) Risk mitigation against climatic stress such as droughts and heat stress and crop failure. 3) Conservation of natural resources by soil fertility conservationRs. rainwater managementRs. increasedRs. etc. 4) Capacity building of farmers in the domain of improved agronomic practices & climate change mitigation. 5) Extensive support for Extensive Livestock Systems (health careRs. breedingRs. drinking waterRs. fodder in commonsRs. etc.) 6) Integrated value chain support systems to realize growth potential in pulsesRs. millets and oilseeds-based farming production systems including infrastructure and processing facilities focus on local markets. 7) Monetary support of 30Rs./- per family for adoption of integrated farming systems.
eligibility: All farmers are eligible under the scheme.

name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
brief_description: The scheme "Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group (CLSS for MIG)" by the Ministry of Housing and Urban AffairsRs. Government of India aims to provide interest subsidy on housing loans to Middle Income Group families. CLSS for MIG will be implemented initially in 2017 for a period of one-year w.e.f. 01 January 2017. This will also be implemented as a Central Sector Scheme. Under the SchemeRs. beneficiaries of the Middle-Income Group (MIG) can seek housing loans from BanksRs. Housing Finance CompaniesRs. and other such institutions for the acquisition/ construction of houses (including re-purchase).
benefits: 1. Scheme will support the acquisition/construction of houses (including repurchase) of 160 sq. mts. (For MIG I) and 200 sq. mts. (For MIG II) carpet area as per income eligibility with basic civic infrastructure like waterRs. toiletRs. sanitationRs. sewerageRs. roadRs. electricityRs. etc. 1. Beneficiaries of MIG will be eligible for an interest subsidy with the following features: **Particulars****MIG I****MIG II**Household Income ( per annum)6Rs./- - 12Rs./-12Rs./- - 18Rs./-Interest Subsidy (% per annum)4%3%Maximum loan tenure (in years)2020Eligible housing loan amount for interest subsidy ()9Rs./-12Rs./-Dwelling Unit Carpet Area160 sq. mts. 200 sq. mts. eligibility: - The beneficiary family should not own a pucca house (an all-weather dwelling unit) either in his/her name or in the name of any member of his/her family in any part of India. In in case of a married coupleRs. either of the spouses or both together in joint ownership will be eligible for a single houseRs. subject to the income eligibility of the household under the Scheme. - A beneficiary family should not have availed of central assistance under any housing scheme from the Government of India. - Middle Income Group-I (MIG-I) - annual household income exceeding 6 lakhs and up to 12 lakhs seeking housing loans from BanksRs. name: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)" by the Ministry of Tribal AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to enhance the livelihood of tribal communities through providing support for value additionRs. processingRs. and marketing of Minor Forest Produce and tribal products to the tribal beneficiaries. It integrates earlier initiatives related to MSP for MFP and tribal product marketing. The scheme promotes the formation of Self Help Groups and Van Dhan Vikas Kendras for aggregation and enterprise development. It supports infrastructureRs. capacity buildingRs. and market linkages. The implementation is carried out through agencies like TRIFED and State Implementing Agencies.
benefits: - **Livelihood Support:** Provides support for income generation through value addition and processing of Minor Forest Produce. - **Formation of SHGs and VDVKs:** Supports creation of Van Dhan Self Help Groups (up to 20 members) and Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (around 300 members). - **Infrastructure Support:** Provides assistance for setting up processing unitsRs. storage facilitiesRs. and haat bazaars. - **Market Linkages:** Facilitates marketing of tribal products through TRIFED and other platforms. - **Capacity Building:** Offers training and skill development for tribal beneficiaries.
eligibility: - **MSP Support:** Fixation and procurement of non-nationalisedRs. non-timber Minor Forest Produce (MFPs) to ensure a fair price to tribal gatherers. - **Infrastructure Development:** Creation and development of Haat BazarsRs. storage godownsRs. and other facilitiesRs. including special projects for tribal trade and storage. - **Value Addition:** Support for processing and value addition to various MFPsRs. non-MFPsRs. and other tribal produce/products to enhance income. - **Enterprise Creation:** Establishment of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) and Van Dhan Producer Enterprises (VDPEs) for organised tribal business activities. - **Marketing Support:** Facilitation of sale and purchase of products made by VDVKs/VDPEs and other tribal products such as handloom and handicrafts. - **Branding & Promotion:** AdvertisementRs. brandingRs. and promotion of tribal products through participation in festivalsRs. exhibitionsRs. tribal artisan melasRs. and Mahotsavas. - **Skill & Entrepreneurship Development:** Training and capacity building for tribal beneficiaries to develop skills and entrepreneurial capabilities. - **Geo-Tagging of Assets:** Geo-tagging of VDVKsRs. VDPEsRs. and other assets created under the scheme for better monitoring and tracking. - **Geographical Indication Support:** Promotion and support for Geographical Indication (GI) tagging of tribal produce/products. - **IT & E-Commerce Development:** Building and upgradation of IT infrastructureRs. e-commerce platformsRs. and digitisation of operations. - **Beneficiary Survey:** Conducting surveys for the identificationRs. assessmentRs. and monitoring of beneficiaries. - **Research & Development:** Support for research and development activities to improve tribal products and processes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
brief_description:
Launch on 1st April 2016Rs. Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G) is centre's flagship mission by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)Rs. implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). PMAY-G aims at providing a pucca houseRs. with basic amenitiesRs. to all houseless households and those households living in kutcha and dilapidated house. PMAY-G addresses the rural housing shortage and bridges the housing deficit in rural areas of IndiaRs. contributing significantly to the mission of "Housing for All". The minimum size of the houses under PMAY-G is 25 sq m including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking. As of 27th Sept 2022Rs. 2.00 crore houses have been constructed out of the total target of 2.72 crores. The beneficiaries are identified using the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) parameters and verified by the Gram Sabhas. The amount is transferred directly to the Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account / Post-Office Account of the beneficiary. PMAY-G has been extended for another two yearsRs. i.e. till 31st March 2024.
> **Aim and Objective:**

PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated house in rural areas by 2024. The immediate objective is to cover 1.00 Crore households in rural areasRs. that are houseless or living in kutcha / dilapidated houseRs. in three years from 2016-17 to 2018-19 and enable construction of quality houses by the beneficiaries using local materialsRs. designs and trained masons. For houses to become homesRs. adoption of a habitat approach through convergence is proposed.
benefits: 1. Financial Assistance of 1Rs. per unit for plain areas; and 1Rs. per unit for hilly areasRs. difficult areasRs. and IAP districts (Himalayan statesRs. North-Eastern statesRs. and Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir). 1. A willing beneficiary can avail of institutional finance (loan) of up to 70Rs. at 3% lower interest rateRs. to build a permanent house. The maximum principal amount for which subsidy can be sought is 2Rs.. 1. The minimum size of the house shall be is 25 sq m including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking. 1. In convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin (SBM-G)Rs. the beneficiaries get financial assistance of up to 12Rs. for the construction of toilets. 1. In convergence with MGNREGARs. the beneficiary is entitled to employment as unskilled labor (Rural Mason Training) at 90.95 per day for 95 days. 1. In convergence with Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala YojanaRs. one LPG connection per house is provided. 1. Convergence with different government programmes for piped drinking waterRs. electricity connectionRs. clean & efficient cooking fuelRs. treatment of social and liquid wasteRs. etc. 1. Payments are made electronically directly to bank accounts or post office accounts that are linked to Aadhaar. **Note:** Beneficiaries are identified using the "Housing Deprivation Parameters" from the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011Rs. further verified by the Gram Sabhas.
eligibility:
The universe of eligible beneficiaries under PMAY-G will include all the houseless households living in zeroRs. oneRs. or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs (as per SECC dataRs. and subject to the exclusion process).
> **Criteria for Automatic/Compulsory Inclusion -**

1. Households without shelter
2. Destitute/ living on alms
3. Manual scavengers
4. Primitive Tribal Groups
5. Legally released bonded laborer
> **Prioritisation within the Universe**

i. There will be multilayered prioritization within the universe of eligible PMAY-G beneficiaries. Priority will first be assigned on the basis of parameters reflecting housing deprivation in each category viz.Rs. SC/STRs. MinoritiesRs. and Others.
ii. To begin withRs. households will be prioritized based on houselessness followed by the number of rooms; zeroRs. oneRs. and two roomsRs. in that order.
iii. In a particular social category viz.Rs. SC/STRs. MinoritiesRs. and OthersRs. households that are houseless or living in houses with a lower number of rooms shall not be ranked below households living in houses with a higher number of rooms.
Within the above priority groupsRs. households that fulfill the criteria of "compulsory inclusion"Rs. will be further elevated. Automatically included households shall not rank lower than other households within a priority group. Inter-se priority within the two subgroups viz. households which are automatically included and otherwise will be determined based on their cumulative deprivation scores.
The scores will be calculated from the socio-economic parameters given below with each having equal weight:
i. Households with no adult member between ages 16 to 59
ii. Female-headed households with no adult male member between ages 16 to 59
iii. Households with no literate adult above 25 years
iv. Households with any disabled member and no able-bodied adult member
v. Landless Households deriving the major part of their income from manual casual labor
vi. Households with higher deprivation scores will be ranked higher within the subgroups.
**Note:** _To ensure that assistance is targeted at those who are genuinely deprived and that the selection is objective and verifiableRs. the housing deprivation parameters in the SECC data will be used for identifying households and then verified by the Gram Sabhas._
> ***Earmarking of Targets -***

**For SC/ST:**
60% of the target allocated to each State/ UT should be earmarked for SC/STsRs. subject to the availability of eligible beneficiaries. Within earmarked targetsRs. the proportion of SC and ST is to be decided from time to time by the respective States/UTs. FurtherRs. the States/ UTs would be allowed to interchange targets between SC and ST if there are no eligible beneficiaries from either of the category and it is certified as such. In case all eligible SC and ST households are coveredRs. the State/ UT targets would be allocated to beneficiaries from the 'Other' categories included in the Permanent Wait List drawn from SECC 2011.
**For Minorities:**
FurtherRs. as far as possibleRs. 15% of the total fund would be earmarked for Minorities at the National Level for households. The allocation of targets for Minorities among the States/UTs will be on the basis of the proportionate rural population of Minorities in the respective State/UT as per Census 2011 data. Minorities notified under Section 2(c) of the National Commission for Minorities ActRs. 1992 are to be considered eligible for receiving benefits against Minority earmarks.
**For PwDs:**
AccordinglyRs. in the scheme of PMAY-GRs. while deciding the inter-se priority among the beneficiaries who are to be provided assistanceRs. households with any disabled member and no able-bodied adult member have been accorded additional deprivation score so that such households are given priority while allotting the houses. Keeping in view the provisions of the Persons with Disabilities ActRs. of 1995Rs. the States to the extent possibleRs. may ensure that 3% of beneficiaries at the State Level are from among persons with disabilities.
> **Tie Breaker**

In case there is a tie with more than one household within a subgroup having the same deprivation scoreRs. the households will be ranked according to priority on the basis of the following parameters:
i. Households with widows and next-of-kin of members of defence/paramilitary/police forces killed in action.
ii. Households where a member is suffering from leprosy or cancer and People living with HIV (PLHIV).
iii. Households with a single girl child.
iv. Beneficiary families of the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) ActRs. 2006Rs. commonly known as the Forest Rights Act.
v. Transgender persons.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)" has been launched by the Department of Food and Public DistributionRs. Ministry of Consumer AffairsRs. Food and Public DistributionRs. Government of IndiaRs. and aims to ensure food security for the poor and vulnerable sections of the country by providing free food foodgrains. It was announced on 26 March 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and is operated by the Department of Food and Public Distribution under the Ministry of Consumer AffairsRs. Food and Public Distribution. Through this schemeRs. free foodgrains (rice or wheatRs. depending on the State) are provided to eligible ration card holders covered under the National Food Security ActRs. 2013Rs. namely Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households and Priority Households (PHH). From 1 January 2023Rs. the scheme was integrated into the food security frameworkRs. and foodgrains earlier given at the highly subsidised rates of 1Rs. 2Rs. and 3 per kilogram for coarse cerealsRs. wheatRs. and riceRs. respectivelyRs. are now provided free of cost. The scheme has been extended by the Union Cabinet for 5 years starting from 1 January 2024 and is approved for continuation till 31 December 2028Rs. with a total financial outlay of 11.80 lakh crore (11Rs. crore). The scheme is implemented through the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) by the state governments and Union Territory AdministrationsRs. with foodgrain allocation by the Government of India.
benefits: 1. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families receive 35 kilograms of foodgrains per family per month. 1. Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries receive 5 kilograms of foodgrains per person per month. 1. The foodgrains are provided as rice or wheatRs. depending on the stateRs. with fortified rice distributed nationwide. 1. Since January 2023Rs. the foodgrains have been provided completely free of cost (at zero cost) to the beneficiaries. 1. Through One Nation One Ration CardRs. beneficiaries can collect their ration from any fair price shop anywhere in India.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a household belonging to the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) category or the Priority Households (PHH) category. 1. Priority Households (PHH) are to be identified by the state governments/union territory administrations as per the criteria evolved by them. 1. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families are to be identified by the States / Union Territories as per the criteria prescribed by the Central GovernmentRs. as listed below. > **Criteria for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Families:** 1. The applicant should be a household headed by a widowRs. a terminally ill personRs. a disabled personRs. or a person aged 60 years or moreRs. with no assured means of subsistence or societal support. 1. The applicant should be a widowRs. a terminally ill personRs. a disabled personRs. a person aged 60 years or moreRs. a single womanRs. or a single manRs. with no family or societal supportRs. and with no assured means of subsistence. 1. The applicant should belong to a primitive tribal household. 1. The applicant should be a landless agricultural laborerRs. a marginal farmerRs. or a rural artisan or craftsman (such as a potterRs. tannerRs. weaverRs. blacksmithRs. or carpenter); a slum dweller; or a person earning a livelihood on a daily basis in the informal sector (such as a porterRs. coolieRs. rickshaw pullerRs. handcart pullerRs. fruit and flower sellerRs. snake charmerRs. rag pickerRs. cobblerRs. or destitute person); or a person in other similar categories in both rural and urban areas. 1. The applicant should belong to an eligible Below Poverty Line (BPL) family of a human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive person.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
brief_description:
In May 2016Rs. the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG)Rs. introduced the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) as a flagship scheme with an objective to make clean cooking fuel such as LPG available to the rural and deprived households which were otherwise using traditional cooking fuels such as firewoodRs. coalRs. cow-dung cakes etc. Usage of traditional cooking fuels had detrimental impacts on the health of rural women as well as on the environment.
The scheme was launched on 1st May 2016 in BalliaRs. Uttar Pradesh by Honble Prime Minister of IndiaRs. Shri. Narendra Modi


- The target under the scheme was to release 8 Crore LPG Connections to the deprived households by March 2020.
- On 7th September 2019Rs. Honble Prime Minister of India handed over the 8th Crore LPG connection in AurangabadRs. Maharashtra.
- The release of 8 Crore LPG connections under the scheme has also helped in increasing the LPG coverage from 62% on 1st May 2016 to 99.8% as on 1st April 2021.
- Under the Union Budget for FY 21-22Rs. provision for release of additional 1 Crore LPG connections under the PMUY scheme has been made. In this phaseRs. special facility has been given to migrant families.
benefits:
1. Rs. 1600 for a connection 14.2kg cylinder or Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder. 1. AdditionallyRs. All PMUY beneficiaries will be provided with first LPG refill and Stove (hot plate) both free of cost along with their deposit free connection.
#### Note: Priority would be given to the states which have lower LPG coverage (Compared to the national average) as on 1st Jan 2016.
eligibility:
An adult woman belonging to a poor household and not having an LPG connection in her household will be eligible under UJJWALA 2.0. The beneficiaries should belong to any of the following categories:

1. Eligible as per SECC 2011 list
1. Belongs to SC/ST householdsRs. be a beneficiary of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)Rs. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)Rs. Forest dwellersRs. Most Backward Classes (MBC)Rs. Tea and Ex-Tea Garden TribesRs. People residing in river islands (Beneficiary will submit supporting document)
1. If she is not falling in the above 2 categoriesRs. then she can stake her claim to be a beneficiary under Poor household by submitting 14-point declaration (as per prescribed format)

name: Tripura Scheme For Incentive To Girl Child
brief_description: The scheme "The Tripura Scheme for Incentive to Girl Child-2009" by the Education (SW & SE) DepartmentRs. Government of TripuraRs. aims to provide an incentive to girl children born on or after 01/06/2009 to the parents who are cardholders of listed BPL households. The incentive will be provided per head per month up to the month the girl child attains the age of 15 years. The incentive amount will be paid to the mother of the girl childRs. preferably to the bank/post office account. Up to two girl children in a family will be covered by the scheme. The scheme is implemented by the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of the concerned AMC/Nagar Panchayat/RD Block.
benefits: > **Rate of Incentive** - At the rate of 300/- per head per month up to the month the girl child attains the age of 15 years. The incentive amount will be paid to the mother of the girl childRs. preferably to the bank/post office account.
eligibility:
1. The girl child must be born on or after June 1Rs. 2009. 1. The parents of the girl child must be BPL (Below Poverty Line) cardholders or belong to listed BPL households. 1. The incentive amount will be paid to the mother of the girl child. 1. In case the mother of the girl child dies before the girl attains 15 years of ageRs. the nearest legal guardian will become the applicant under the scheme. 1. Up to two girl children in a family will be covered by the scheme.
> **Note**: - This criterion was modified on October 17Rs. 2020. As per the modificationRs. any girl child born on or after June 1Rs. 2009Rs. to parents having less than 1Rs./- of family income per annum is eligible.)

name: Janta Juth Accidental Insurance Scheme
brief_description: "Janta Juth" is a Farmer's Accidental Insurance Scheme launched by the Govt. of Gujarat on 26th January 1996 to provide economic assistance of upto 2Rs. to Farmers in case of Death or Disability. It is a 100% state-sponsored scheme. The main objective is to assist the successor of the farmer in case of death or disability due to an accident. In this schemeRs. insurance premium is paid by the State Government for all farmers. This scheme is implemented under the Gujarat Community Group-Janta Accidental Insurance Scheme from 01/04/08 through Director of InsuranceRs. Gandhinagar. In case of accidental death or permanent disabilityRs. all registered farmersRs. any child (son/daughter) of the farmer and husband/wife of the farmer having age of 5 to 70 years are beneficiaries for the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The Deceased or the Person with Permanent Disability Should Be a Registered Farmer (Have Individual or Joint Name Land) or Child of a Registered Farmer (Son or Daughter) or the Husband/ Wife. 1. The Death or Permanent Disability Must Be Due to an Accident. 1. The Deceased or the Person with Permanent Disability should be between the age of 5 to 70 years. 1. The Application Should Be Made Within 150 Days to the Office of the Concerned District Agriculture Officer.
**The sequence of the beneficiary under the scheme in chronological order:** 1. Husband/Wife: In his/her absence 1. Children Son/Daughter: In their absence 1. Parent Father/Mother: In their absence 1. Grandson/Grandaughter: In the absence of 1Rs. 2Rs. 3 1. Unmarried/ Widow/ Exiled Sister who is dependent and living with the beneficiary 1. Any heirs declared under the Heirs Act applied to the beneficiary involved in other than above mentioned cases and controversial case
**Note:** Suicide or Natural Death Are Not Covered in This Scheme.

name: Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme
brief_description: The guidelines of the "Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme" were approved by the Dept. of Social WelfareRs. Govt. of Manipur on 6th July 2021. The COVID-19 Pandemic and the resulting economic dislocations have severely affected the livelihood of a large percentage of the populationRs. especially vulnerable groups including daily wage earnersRs. those without a regular source of incomeRs. and without sufficient savings to fall back upon. There is a need to have additional direct income support for these vulnerable groups. The beneficiary will be those domiciled in ManipurRs. whose livelihood has been adversely affected by the COVID-19 Pandemic leading to an inability to maintain a basic minimum standard of living. There can be only one beneficiary per family. This beneficiary must be the main bread earner and should be employed in the informal sector.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be domiciled in the state of Manipur. 1. The livelihood of the applicant should have been adversely affected by the COVID-19 pandemicRs. leading to an inability to maintain a basic minimum standard of living. 1. The applicant should be the only applicant from the family. 1. The applicant should be the main bread earner. 1. The applicant should be employed in the informal sector.

The applicants will includeRs. but not be limitedRs. to the following occupations: (a) Street Vendor. (b) Farmer (includes AgricultureRs. FisheriesRs. HorticultureRs. and Animal Husbandry). (c) Daily-Wage Worker and Labourer. (d) Construction-Site Worker. (e) Public Transport Driver (AutoRs. WingerRs. BusRs. RickshawRs. etc). (f) School Van Driver. (g) Shop Assistant. (h) Artisan. (i) Weaver. (j) Performing Artist (k) Home-Based Business etc.
Inclusion Criteria (subject to exclusion criteria fulfillment): (a) Ration Card Holder. (b) MGNREGA Card Holder. (c) PM-KISAN Beneficiary. (d) CMHT/ PMJAY Beneficiary. (e) PMUY Beneficiary. (f) PM SVANidhi Beneficiary. (g) CMST/ CMAT Beneficiary. (h) PMAY (G) or PMAY (U) Beneficiary. (i) SBM (G) or SBM (U) Beneficiary. (j) Person in Vendor List of Municipalities or District Councils. (k) Person with a permit for public transport/ school van in Municipalities or District Councils.

name: Silpi Pension Scheme - Assam
brief_description:
Silpi Pension Scheme is a Welfare Scheme provided by the Government of Assam to support the Artists of Assam. Artiste/Family pension along with Barxik Silpi Sanman (One-time financial assistance) of the Govt. of Assam will be offered to the person having outstanding contributions in the field of Art and Culture in the State and Special Family Pension will also be offered to indigent families of Artistes who had made a spectacular contribution in the States Cultural sphere and have unfortunately passed away. There are 4 types of Schemes under the Silpi Pension Scheme:
1. Artist Pension Scheme 2. Family Pension Scheme 3. Barxik Silpi Sanman (Ex-Gratia Grant) Scheme 4. One-time Special Financial Assistance to Families of deceased artist Scheme
The main objective of the Scheme is to support the artist and needy families of Artists who made contributions to the field of Art and Culture in the State of Assam. It also aims to provide Financial assistance to the artist and their families in different schemes. It provides pensions to families and artists monthly for better livelihood and gives recognition to the Art and Culture of Assam through this platform. The financial assistance schemes are expected to encourage artists and technicians to engage in their creative pursuits with renewed vigour.
For Divyang and Bed-ridden artistsRs. the Cultural Development Officers or the Junior Assistants of Cultural Centres under the Directorate of Cultural Affairs from their respective districts will visit the homes of those applicants for applying through an online process. The names and contact numbers of concerned Cultural Development Officers/Junior Assistants will be available on the official website.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a permanent resident of the State of Assam.
- An artistRs. who has made outstanding contributions in the field of MusicRs. DanceRs. Fine ArtsRs. PuppetryRs. Musk makingRs. and also covering artists and technicians associated with Mobile Theatre and Amateur Theatre and FilmsRs. is eligible under this scheme.
- Indigent families of artists who have made outstanding contributions in the field of MusicRs. DanceRs. Fine ArtsRs. PuppetryRs. Musk makingRs. etc. are eligible under this scheme.
- The applicant must have a recognition proof certificate.

name: Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides 50% of the pension amount or a maximum of 500/- to the family members of the deceased pensioner.
benefits: The scheme provides 50% of the pension amount or a maximum of 500/- to the family members of the deceased pensioner.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased pensioner.
1. The deceased pensioner should have been a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The deceased pensioner should have been receiving a pension from the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board at the time of their death.

name: Mamta Taruni Abhiyan
brief_description: **Details** Under this programRs. free medical check-upsRs. iron and folic acid supplementsRs. and deworming medication were provided to adolescent girls between the ages of 10 and 19 yearsRs. and pregnant women. The program also aimed to create awareness about menstrual hygieneRs. family planningRs. and nutrition among adolescent girls and pregnant women. The program was implemented through a network of health workersRs. including Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs)Rs. Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs)Rs. and Anganwadi workers. The Mamta Taruni Abhiyan was seen as a significant step towards improving maternal and child health in rural areas of Gujarat.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. Adolescent Girls: The scheme is open to all adolescent girls between the ages of 10 and 19 years who are residents of Gujarat.
1. Pregnant Women: The scheme is open to all pregnant women who are residents of Gujarat.
1. BPL Families: The scheme gives priority to women and girls belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

name: NIJASHAREE HOUSING SCHEME
brief_description: The Government of West Bengal is determined to provide a `Basha (house) to all the people belonging to the Lower Income Group (LIG) and the Middle Income Group (MIG). There is a growing demand for housing amongst families belonging to the low and middle-income categories. In order to cater to the housing needs of the Lower Income Group and the Middle Income GroupRs. the Housing Department felt the need to make provisions for affordable housingRs. and decided to introduce a new Housing SchemeRs. namely "NIJASHREE HOUSING SCHEME". Salient Features of The Scheme: - The scheme envisages the construction of dwelling units of a minimum of 16 flats in a block of G + 3 buildings on the government landsRs. lands of local bodiesRs. and other parastatals. - 1BHK flatsRs. with a minimum built-up area of 35.15 square meters (378 sq. ft.)Rs. will be constructed for the LIG categoryRs. and 2BHK flatsRs. having a minimum built-up area of 50.96 square meters (559 sq. ft.)Rs. will be constructed for the MIG category. - The unit cost will be determined on the basis of the actual cost of construction of the superstructureRs. substructureRs. and internal infrastructure including sanitary and plumbingRs. internal electrificationRs. etc.Rs. incidental therein. - No cost of land shall be taken into account while computing the unit cost. This freehold land will be treated as a subsidy to the beneficiary. - The unit cost and standard built-up area may varyRs. depending on the location and quantum of the land availableRs. as well as the land development cost and the schedule of rates applicable to the areaRs. at the time of construction. - Off-site infrastructure like the construction of internal roadsRs. boundary wallRs. outside electrificationRs. making of a drainage systemRs. installation of lights in the campus and water supply shall not be added to the cost of the housing development scheme NIJASHREERs. i.e.Rs. the purchaser will not have to pay for such infrastructure. - Credit-linked subsidies to the eligible beneficiaries will be facilitated by the Housing DepartmentRs. as per the existing scheme.
eligibility:
1. Monthly family income should be 15Rs. or less for the Lower Income Group (LIG). 1. Monthly family income should be 30Rs. or less for the Middle Income Group (MIG). 1. The beneficiary should not have any pucca house/flat in his/her nameRs. or in the name of any family (family includes spouseRs. unmarried sons or daughters) member in the state. 1. The applicant must be an inhabitant of the same district in which the project is to be implemented. 1. One applicant can apply for one flat only for his/her family. Any person allotted with a flat in the scheme cannot apply for the same scheme in another project in his/her district.
**Note 01:** The selection of beneficiaries and allotment of flats will be done through a transparent lottery in the respective district/sub-division. **Note 02:** The waiting list of the eligible applicantsRs. consisting of 20% of the total flats under each category (i.e. LIG and MIG)Rs. will be prepared in case the number of applicants is more than the number of flats in a particular project.

name: Death Benefit Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Death Benefit Scheme was started by the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for registered workers of the Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB). The state government has proposed and implemented this scheme through the APB&OCWWB for those families who suffer due to economic loss caused by the demise of the bread earner of the house and have registered their names in the Labour Welfare Board. **Objective:** - To mitigate such economic lossRs. the govt. has introduced the death benefit scheme for normal death and death due to accidents.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh. 2. The applicant should be a family member of a deceased worker who was employed in the Building and Other Construction works. 3. The deceased worker should be registered with Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB). 4. The deceased worker should have an active membership at the time of death. 5. The name of the nominee/ dependent should be recorded on his/her registration card before death.

name: Funeral Financial Assistant (APB&OCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Financial Assistant was started by the Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB). The state government has proposed and implemented this scheme through the APB&OCWWB for providing financial assistance to the families upon the death of the registered worker for his/her funeral.
benefits: 1. Cash assistance of 1000/- only to the nominee of the deceased worker at the time of sanctioning the death benefit amount.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. The applicant should be a family member of a deceased worker who was employed in the Building and Other Construction works.
3. The deceased worker should be registered with Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
4. The deceased worker should have an active membership at the time of death.
5. The name of the nominee/ dependent should be recorded on his/her registration card before death.

name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana
brief_description:
**Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY)** is a scheme under the Department of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Odisha aims to provide universal health coverageRs. with special emphasis on the health protection of vulnerable families and women. Its primary objective is to provide financial protection and improve access to healthcare services for the people of OdishaRs. particularly targeting economically disadvantaged families. To achieve its objectivesRs. the BSKY has two components:-

1. State Government will bear full cost of all health services delivered to all patients (irrespective of incomeRs. status or residence) in all State Government health care facilities starting from Sub center level to District Head Quarter and Government Medical College Hospital and Blood Bank level.
1. State Government will bear the cost of healthcare provided in empaneled private hospitals for over 96.5 lakh economically vulnerable families in the StateRs. amounting to Annual Health coverage of Rs. 5 lakh per family and additional Rs. 5lakh for the women members of the family after exhaust of initial limit.

At all empaneled private hospitals families having BSKY Smart Health Card can avail cashless treatment at any empaneled private hospital under BSKY within or outside the State. Card holder families can avail facilities such as registrationRs. consultationRs. medical testsRs. pathologiesRs. treatmentRs. IPD and follow-up consultation under BSKY at any empaneled private hospitalsRs. for which State Government will bear the cost upto the annual coverage amount. The State Government will collect direct Feedback from beneficiaries and Hospitals in respect of this scheme. The citizens can share their feedback on **14545.** Grievance Redressal Helpline Number is **155369** (6 AM to 10 PM) & 104 (24 x 7).
benefits:
Families having BSKY Smart Health Card/ NFSA/ SFSS card can avail of cashless IPD and Day care treatment for the procedures for which the hospital is empaneled under BSKY within or outside the State up to the annual amount covered. The scheme provides cashless health coverage of 5Rs. per annum per family and an additional 5Rs. for women members of the family after exhaustion of the initial limit at empaneled private hospitals within and outside Odisha.

- **PACKAGES**

The updated package list under BSKYRs. as modified from time to time is available on the website www.bsky.odisha.gov.in. About 3% of the total packages are reserved for Government health institutions. About 10% of the packages are under the referral categoryRs. which can be availed only on referral by the appropriate authority.
**1. Reserved Packages**
Treatment under these packages is only available in Govt. healthcare facilities.
