Treatment for minor ailmentsRs. and diseases under National Health Programs such as Management of superficial burnsRs. minor injuriesRs. MalariaRs. Typhoid feverRs. GastroenteritisRs. DiarrheaRs. DysenteryRs. TuberculosisRs. Urinary Tract InfectionRs. Heat strokeRs. and surgeries for hydroceleRs. Abscess drainageRs. Lipoma and cyst excision and procedures like Dilatation and Curettage and MTP are reserved for Government facilities.
**2. Referral Package**
The updated list of referral packages is available on the website www.bsky.odisha.gov.in.
**3. Open Packages**
Any beneficiary can directly walk into any empaneled private hospital and avail of the treatment under this category of packages if he is found suitable for that package by the treating doctor of the empaneled hospital.
eligibility:
All BSKY Smart Health Card/ National Food Security Act (NFSA)/ State Food Security Scheme (SFSS) card holders are eligible.
**For the referral of the patient to the empaneled private hospital for treatment:**

1. The referral will be done if the particular package/ procedure cannot be provided by a Government facility in the district.
1. Cases will be referred if there is a long waiting time to undertake the procedure at a Government facility in the district.
1. Where there is an emergency case that requires immediate referral.
1. Referral process under BSKY is decentralized up to the Sub-Divisional Hospital level. The following authorities have been designated to issue referrals to beneficiaries under BSKY.


- **District Headquarter Hospital:** CDM & PHO/ District Medical Officer-cum Superintendent & concerned Specialist. - **Sub-divisional Hospital:** Superintendent & concerned Specialist. - **All Govt. Medical College & Hospitals:** Superintendent & HoDs of concerned Department of the Medical College & Hospitals

name: Death Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Death Assistance for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- will be given to the nominee/legal heir/dependent family members of the registered worker on his natural death.
benefits: 1. The financial assistance of 2Rs./- will be given to the nominee/legal heir/dependent family members of the registered worker on his natural death.
eligibility:
1. The deceased construction worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
1. The deceased construction worker should have held an active regular membership.
1. The only person who is a legal heir/dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply under the scheme.

name: Self-Employment Scheme For Dependents Of Prisoners
brief_description: The scheme Self-Employment Scheme for Dependents of Prisoners was launched by the Department of Social JusticeRs. Government of Kerala. The scheme is intended to rehabilitate the dependents of the indigent convicts. It aims to assist/encourage resource less wivesRs. unemployed and unmarried sonsRs. daughters etc. This scheme mainly includes children if they are students and women having children. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance shall be given only once for the dependents of a prisoner for the purpose and dependents are eligible for the assistance only during the period of imprisonment of the convict.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. the maximum amount of financial assistance to a family will be 30Rs./- at a time. **Note:** Financial assistance shall be given only once for the dependents of a prisoner for the purpose.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicants should belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. Families of such convicts who had undergone imprisonment for a period of 5 years or above are eligible for financial assistance.
1. The families are eligible for the assistance only during the period of imprisonment of the convict.
1. The financial assistance will be provided to those eligible persons who have not availed the amount for the same purpose previously.

**Note 01:** Priority must be given to dependents (Husband/WifeRs. UnemployedRs. and Unmarried Son/Daughter).
**Note 02**: Other category of dependents includes daughters who are widowed/Legally divorced/abandoned by husbandRs. Father/Mother below 55 years of age.

name: Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps
brief_description:
On 4th July 2018Rs. the Government of India approved clubbing eight schemes under the Umbrella Scheme Relief and Rehabilitation of
Migrants and Repatriates. Out of the 8 schemesRs. the scheme "Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps" is implemented by the Freedom Fighters & Rehabilitation Division of the Department of HomeRs. Ministry of Home Affairs.
The scheme provides relief materialsRs. which among other things include Feeding ChargesRs. Subsidized RiceRs. Clothing MaterialsRs. UtensilsRs. Transportation Charges (on arrival)Rs. Porterage and Transport (on repatriation)Rs. Cash DolesRs. Infrastructure Facilities (at the camps)Rs. Electricity and Drinking WaterRs. Vehicles and Petrol to the Sri Lankan Refugees.
The entire expenditure is incurred by the State Government and is subsequently reimbursed by GoI. GoI's approach is to grant relief on humanitarian grounds with the ultimate objective of repatriating them back to Sri Lanka. Relief is given pending such repatriation. An amount of 1Rs. crore (approximately) has been spent by GoI for providing relief and accommodation to these refugees during the period between July 1983 to March 2022.
benefits:
> **(a) Food for Temporary Stay in Different Camps** 1. In Quarantine Camp refugees are provided cooked food @ 45/- per day per adultRs. and @ 30/- per day per child. 1. Refugees in Special Camps are provided cooked food @ 70/- per day per adult. 1. Clothing material is also provided.
> **(b) Rice at a Subsidized Rate:** 1. Family Members: 01 Adults; Age: Above 8 years; Quantity of Rice: 400 grams daily 1. Family Members: 02 Children; Age: Below 8 years; Quantity of Rice: 200 grams daily
> **(c) Free Clothing Materials** 1. Gender: Male; Category: Adult; Items: Dhoti (2); Vests (2) 1. Gender: Male; Category: Child; Items: Half Trousers (2); Inner Garments (Vests) (1); Half Sleeve Shirt (1) 1. Gender: Female; Category: Adult; Items: Sari (2); Blouse (2); Skirt (1) 1. Gender: Female; Category: Child; Items: Skirt (1); Blouse (1); Frock/Gown (1) 1. Category: Every Family; Items: Towels (2) 1. Category: Every Adult; Items: Mat (1) 1. Category: Every Adult (Once in 2 years); Items: Blanket (1)
**NOTE:** The above-listed materials are provided every year to all the refugees/refugee families in the camps free of cost except the blankets which are given once in two years.
> **(d) Aluminum Utensils** 1. Rice boiling utensils (5 ltr. Capacity ): 1 1. SambarRs. Curry Utensils (2 ltr. Capacity): 1 1. Large spoon: 2; Dining Plates: 2; Tumblers: 2 > **(e) Transportation Charges (on arrival) as per Approved Rates.**
> **(f) Porterage & Transport (on repatriation) as per Approved Rates.**
> **(g) Medical Assistance** 1. Refugees are given health check-ups & assistance upon arrival in Transit Camp. 1. Medical assistance is rendered by Primary Health Centres/Government Hospitals (in Refugee Camps by the Government of Tamil Nadu). 1. After an appropriate medical check-upRs. preventive medicine like inoculation for measles is administeredRs. free of cost.
> **(h) Cash Dole Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in Camps** 1. Family Members: Head of the Family; Cash doles at Present (): 400.00 1. Family Members: Other Adults; Cash doles at Present (): 288.00 1. Family Members: First Child; Cash doles at Present (): 180.00 1. Family Members: Other Children; Cash doles at Present (): 90.00
> **(i) Infrastructure Facilities at the Camps including Internal RoadsRs. Electricity and Drinking Water.** Temporary huts were constructed and remodelled to the size of 10x10 sq feet with the provision of basic amenities.
> **(j) Vehicles and Petrol** Four vehicles have been approved by MHA from time to time. Expenditure on petrol for these vehicles is also reimbursed by MHA.
> **(k) Exit Permits** The refugeesRs. who are willing to go back to Sri Lanka or to any other country of their choice at their own costRs. are issued with "Exit Permits" by the respective District Collectors.
> **(l) Cooked Food** While the refugees are in the quarantine camps under the supervision of the police departmentRs. cooked food is provided to the refugees every day (three times) at the rate of Rs 45/- per adult per day and Rs 30/- per child per day.
> **(m) Security** Multi-Colour Identity Cards are issued to every refugee above the age of 12 years to ensure their welfare and security.
> **(n) Pregnancy Care** 1. Pregnant Sri Lankan Tamil women are given Rs.1Rs./- per month during the eighthRs. ninth and tenth months of pregnancy and for the first three months after the deliveryRs. totalling Rs. 6Rs./- under Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Financial Assistance Scheme of the Government of Tamil Nadu. 1. When the Sri Lankan Tamil refugee women are pregnantRs. they are administered tetanus injections by the nurses from the concerned Primary Health Centers (PHCs)Rs. after appropriate medical check-ups. 1. Required medical counselling is provided to pregnant women every monthRs. after appropriate medical check-ups. 1. Pregnant women are provided with required vitamin tabletsRs. milkRs. fruits and bread under the Integrated Child Development Scheme (ICDS). 1. Pregnant mothers can be admitted to the nearby PHC or hospitalRs. free of costRs. for child delivery. 1. Following child deliveryRs. the childs birth certificate can be obtained through the hospital. 1. Following the birth of a childRs. the details are furnished to the Village Administrative Officer and Special Revenue Inspector to record the same in the family card through which they can receive the cash doles immediately. 1. Following the birth of a childRs. the nurses of the PHCs should continue to monitor the growth of the child and the mothers health. 1. The required nutritious foodRs. vitamin tabletsRs. milkRs. and fruits are given free of cost under the ICDS. 1. Timely administration of polio dropsRs. free of costRs. to children is provided.
> **(o) Education** The refugee students studying upto 12th class in Government and Government-Aided schools are given free educationRs. free notebooksRs. textbooksRs. free uniformsRs. free noon meals and a free bus pass to commute from the camp to the school. Students studying 11th class are given free bicycles.
> **(p) Employment** With a view to facilitating the refugees to earn their livelihoodRs. they are permitted to leave the camps between 6.00 a.m. and 6.00 p.m. in search of jobs commensurate with their skills /qualifications (subject to the laws in force in this regard).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of Sri Lanka.
1. The applicant should be a victim of the upsurge of ethnic violence in Sri Lanka.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam
brief_description: The scheme "Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam" was launched in 2014 by the Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of TelanganaRs. aims to alleviate financial distress in SC/ST and minority families by providing financial assistance to unmarried girls at the time of marriage. this schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance of 1Rs. (1Rs. for disabled girls) is provided to eligible girls at the time of marriage.
benefits: 1. One-time financial assistance of 1Rs./- for unmarried SC/ST and minority girls at the time of marriage. 1. One-time financial assistance of 1Rs./- for disabled girlsRs. irrespective of casteRs. under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016. 1. The amount is directly credited to the brides bank account. 1. Only one-time assistance is allowed in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be an unmarried girl belonging to the SC/ST/BC/EBC community. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Telangana. 1. The applicant should be 18 years of age at the time of marriage. 1. The applicant's marriage should be scheduled on or after October 2Rs. 2014. 1. The applicants parental income should not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. > **Note:** Enhanced financial support is available for disabled girls under Section 24(1) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016.

name: Lean Season Assistance under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
brief_description: The scheme "Lean Season Assistance" is a Sub-Component under the scheme "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme". The scheme is extended to all the regions of the Union territory of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective to assist fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periodsRs. and to conserve the fishery wealth in sea during breeding season.
benefits: 5kg of free rice and one set of clothing consisting of one quality saree with one blouse bitRs. one lunghieRs. and one towel per fishermen's familyRs. during natural calamities every year.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
- The applicant should be a fisherman.
- The applicant should belong to a group designated to be "Below Poverty Line".
- *Beneficiary shall also be considered based on the decisions taken periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society.
- The applicant should not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamityRs. lean seasonRs. or ban on the fishing period for which relief assistance is issued.
- The beneficiary or any other members of the ration card should not be in regular service in the Government/Quasi Government/Government undertakings/Retired Government Pensioner.

*** The benefit under this scheme shall not be denied only on the ground that the head of the family or family member is a recipient of Old Age Pension (OAP);**
*** The benefit under this scheme shall not be restricted on the ground that the fisherman has mechanized or motorized or traditional fishing boats or does not have the said fishing boats.**

name: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana was launched by the Information & Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. It is a health insurance scheme that covers the medical expenses of the journalists and their eligible family members. The scheme provides insurance to Working Journalists of Odisha and their family for indoor and outdoor treatments.
benefits:
***The scheme provides health insurance coverage to all the working Journalists of the state and their families:***

1. 4Rs./- is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death.
1. 2Rs./- in case of permanent incapacitation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Journalist.
1. The applicant should be an Odisha-based journalist working either in Odisha or New Delhi for an Odisha-based newspaper.
1. The Journalist should be working for a media house registered with the I&PR departmentRs. OdishaRs. New Delhi.
1. A newspaper hawker also eligible to apply for this scheme.

name: Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person
brief_description: The scheme Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry was introduced to encourage and support marriages between differently-abled individuals. Through this schemeRs. an incentive of 2Rs./- is providedRs. comprising 40Rs. in cash and 1Rs./- in the form of National Savings Certificate (NSC). The selection is periodical and depends on the availability of funds.
benefits: An Incentive of 2Rs./- ( 40Rs. in cash and 1Rs./- in the form of NSC).
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
- The applicant should have an annual income not exceeding 75Rs./- per annum.
- The bride should be above 18 years of age.
- The bridegroom should be above 21 years of age.
- The disability of the bride and the bridegroom should be 40% and above.
- The marriage should be the first marriage between the bride and the groom.
- The marriage should have been registered.
- The application should be submitted within 120 days after marriage.

name: Financial Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Funeral Rites
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Funeral Rites was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Scheduled Caste family for performing funeral rites of their deceased family member in order to get rid of the immediate hardship.
benefits: Financial assistance of 10Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The deceased should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
- The applicant should be a close relative of the deceased.
- The annual family income should be less than 2Rs./-.
- The family members of the deceased should belong to the Union Territory of Puducherry by virtue of nativity or continuous residence of 3 years.

name: Tea Development Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Tea Development Scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers WelfareRs. Government of Meghalaya to continue the experimental plantation of tea and to find the possibility of growing tea economically as well as on a commercial scale. FurtherRs. seedlings are raised in the experimental station and distributed free to farmers.
benefits:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


1. Seedlings are offered for sale at the rate 1/- per tea seedling and one-time financial assistance at the rate 10Rs./- per hectare.
1. PP chemicalsRs. equipmentRs. brush cuttersRs. tea harvestersRs. etc. on sale at the rate of 50% subsidy.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**

**Sl. No.****Entitlement****Owantum of Assistance**1Training programme to the Tea Growers at Village100% assistance2To promote tea plantation by providing tea seedlings to the growers at the District level/ Tea Development Centre.1/- per seedling sale to the growers3Sale of Bio fertilizersRs. Bio pesticidesRs. Bio fungicidesRs. equipmentRs. etc. to the tea growers by Tea Development Centre situated at UmsningRs. RongramRs. Riangdo.50% subsidy sale to the growers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/farmer should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in AgricultureRs. possessing own or leased land of not exceeding 2 Ha/family.

**Note:** The applicant farmer can avail of the benefits of the scheme on a first come first serve basis.

name: Funeral Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to the nominees or dependents of deceased workers who were registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. towards their funeral expenses.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. an amount of 5Rs./- may be given to the nominees/dependents of deceased registered workersRs. towards funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered under the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership with the Board.

name: Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The Rajasthan Prasuti Sahayata Yojana offers a lifeline to pregnant women from registered construction worker families in the state. Launched by the governmentRs. the scheme provides crucial financial support at a critical junctureRs. aiming to improve the well-being of both mother and child. This assistance empowers women to prioritize their health throughout pregnancy and ensure proper care for their newborns.
benefits:
- The birth of a daughter: 21Rs./-
- The birth of a son : 20Rs./-
- In case of not receiving cash benefits under Janani Suraksha YojanaRs. 1Rs./- additional assistance will be payable.
eligibility:
1. The female worker must be holding a beneficiary identity card under Section 13 of the Maternity Benefit Act.
1. The age of the female beneficiary should not be less than 20 years at the time of delivery.
1. Maternity benefits will be payable for a maximum of two deliveries only. If the beneficiary has two or more children before registrationRs. assistance will not be provided. In case of having one child before registrationRs. assistance will be provided for only one delivery.
1. Construction worker beneficiaries who fail to make their monthly contributions to the Board's fund will not be eligible for the Maternity Assistance Scheme.
1. If the beneficiary rectifies the default by making the required monthly paymentsRs. they will become eligible for the Maternity Assistance Scheme.
1. Maternity benefits under the scheme will be provided only for institutional deliveries.

name: Marriage Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Marriage Assistance was started by the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ANBOCWWB)Rs. Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Andaman & Nicobar Administration. Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers will receive a financial allowance to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. registered construction workers will receive financial assistance of 20Rs./- to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
1. The beneficiary should be engaged in any building & other construction work.
1. The beneficiary should be registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
1. The assistance shall be given to meet the marriage expenses of the worker or his/her two dependent children.

**Note:** Marriage assistance is limited for two children only.

name: Khiladi Protsahan Yojana
brief_description: The Khilaadee Protsaahan YojanaRs. a scheme of the Madhya Pradesh Building Department under the Labor DepartmentRs. provides financial assistance to registered construction workers or their family members under the MP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have excelled in sports.
benefits: - On selection at various levelsRs. incentive amount is payable as follows:- Levels(Category A) Incentive amount on getting selected in district/divisional/state level sports.(Category B) Incentive amount given by the Board for being winner in District/Divisional/State level game.At District Level10Rs./-5Rs./-At Division Level25Rs./-15Rs./-At State Level25Rs./-30Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. Family members registered under MP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The applicant should be a bank account.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Marriage Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 7Rs./- is provided to the registered construction workers of the Board for the marriage of their children. The benefits can be availed for the marriage of up to two children of the worker. Interested and eligible applicants should apply within six months from the date of marriage. A female member is also eligible for this assistance for her own marriage. The amount of the financial assistance is credited to the bank account of the beneficiary through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits:
Financial Assistance of 7Rs./-.
*The benefits can be availed for the marriage of up to two children of the worker.
*A female worker can avail of this assistance for her own marriage.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should have completed the age of 18 years.
- The applicant should not have completed the age of 60 years during the preceding 12 months in the construction work.
- The beneficiary should be contributing to the Board's Fund.
- The applicant should not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.

name: Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana
brief_description: The "Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana" scheme was launched by the Director of Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of GujaratRs. in the year 2000. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to scheduled caste families at the time of the death of a family member to cover funeral expensesRs. due to their poor economic conditions.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. scheduled caste families receive financial assistance of 5Rs./- at the time of a family member's death to cover funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The deceased person as well as the applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The deceased person as well as the applicant applying should belong to Scheduled Castes only.
1. The annual income limit of the applicant should be more than 6Rs./- for rural areas and 6Rs./- for urban areas.
1. The application must be made within a time limit of six months of the death.
1. The death registration certificate of the deceased person must be produced.
1. Only one person in the family of the deceased can take the benefit at that time.

name: Karma Sathi Prakalpa
brief_description: The scheme "Karma Sathi Prakalpa" by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises and TextilesRs. Government of West BengalRs. aims to help young entrepreneurs in the state set up new manufacturing enterprises and small businessesRs. including services and trading. The scheme provides soft loans and subsidies for new income-generating projects. This assistance is intended for young and enthusiastic entrepreneurs in both rural and urban areas of the stateRs. helping them become self-reliant and create gainful self-employment opportunities. The scheme is implemented by the State-owned Cooperative BankRs. which provides the loans on soft terms. It is monitored at the district level by an Additional District Magistrate and at the state level by the Director of MSME. > **Objectives:** 1. To facilitate young entrepreneurs of the state in setting up new manufacturing enterprises and small businessesRs. including services and trading. 1. To create gainful self-employment opportunities in both rural and urban areas of the state.
benefits:
The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a soft loan and subsidies for new income-generating projects in manufacturingRs. serviceRs. and trading/business sectors. The total financial assistance available is up to 2Rs./-. 1. **Project Subsidy:** A subsidy of 15% of the project cost is providedRs. with a maximum ceiling of 25Rs./-.1. **Interest Subsidy:** This subsidy is paid to the entrepreneur on the annual interest they pay to the Cooperative Bank. - 50% of the interest is subsidised for timely repayment for a maximum period of 3 years. - 40% of the interest is subsidised for all other cases for a maximum period of 3 years.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** > **Bank Loan:** The State-owned Cooperative Bank disburses 95% or 90% of the loan amount as Cash Credit in two installments. - The first installmentRs. which is 50% of the loan amountRs. is disbursed and linked to the applicant's Cash Credit Account. - The second installment is disbursed after the bank receives a certificate confirming the utilization of the first installment. > **Subsidies:** - **Project Subsidy:** Cooperative Banks submit claims for the project subsidy to the District MSME Facilitation Centre (MFC) on a quarterly basis. The MFC then sends a requisition to the DepartmentRs. which releases the total subsidy amount to the West Bengal State Cooperative Bank Limited.- **Interest Subsidy:** The Chief Executive Officer of the West Bengal State Cooperative Bank submits a requisition for the interest subsidy on a half-yearly basis. The subsidy is then credited to the sanctioned and disbursed loan's Cash Credit account.- Disbursement for both subsidies happens through the portalRs. which is linked to the Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS). > **Validity:** - The interest subsidy is provided for a maximum period of three years. If the bank agrees to a longer loan repayment period (e.g.Rs. 5 years)Rs. the government's interest subsidy will still be limited to 50% of the interest paid in the first three years.
eligibility: 1. Any intending orRs. prospective entrepreneur fulfilling the conditions below can apply. Only one member of a family shall be eligible to apply under this SchemeRs. where "family" means parents and spouse. - **Age:** Any intending or prospective entrepreneur in the age group 18 - 50 years(from the date of notificationRs. September 2020).- **Educational Qualification:** Minimum Class VIII passed. Preference will be given to intending entrepreneurs who are registered with the Employment Bank.- Any new income-generating activity taken up for self-employment in manufacturingRs. servicesRs. and trading will be eligible for assistance under the scheme.

name: Incentives for Meritorious Children (Students) of Workers (10th and 12th Class) (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Incentives for Meritorious Children (Students) of Workers (10th and 12th Class) is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a scholarship (prize money) in the form of a fixed deposit will be provided to meritorious children of construction workers who have achieved academic excellence in the Class X/XII examination. Registered workers with a one-year regular membership are eligible to apply for benefits for up to three of their children.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the scholarship (prize money) in the form of a fixed deposit will be provided to meritorious children of construction workers who have achieved academic excellence in the Class X/XII examination as per the following:
**Sl. No.****Marks Obtained in 10th/12th Examination****Amount**190% and above 51Rs./-280% and above 41Rs./-370% and above 31Rs./-460% and above 21Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one year of regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. The scholarship (prize money) will be provided to meritorious children of construction workers who have achieved academic excellence in the Class X/XII examination.
1. The incentive amount will be payable for up to three children.

name: Marriage Assistance - Folk Artist
brief_description: The scheme "Marriage Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme provides financial assistance of 2Rs./- for the marriage of registered folk artistsRs. or their son or daughter. The assistance aims to support the cultural community by helping with marriage expenses.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance of 2Rs./-.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a registered folk artist.
1. The registered folk artist must have no dues payable to the Board.
1. The registered folk artist can apply for financial assistance for their marriage or adult children (son or daughter).
1. The registered folk artist and the person getting married must attain the age prescribed by law for marriage.
1. If both husband and wife are registered folk artistsRs. only one of them is eligible for this assistance per marriage.
1. The family of a registered folk artiste can avail of this assistance only twice.

name: Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance to Workers with a VisuallyRs. Physically or Mentally Disabled Child is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the disabled (blindRs. mentally retardedRs. mute and deaf) children of registered workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana.
benefits:
1. Financial assistance of 20Rs./- per year is provided on disability of the children from 70 to 90%.
1. Financial assistance of 30Rs./- per year is provided on disability of the children from 91 to 100%.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The benefit is provided to the disabled (blindRs. mentally retardedRs. muteRs. and deaf) children with a disability ranging from 70% to 100% who are dependents of registered workers.
1. There is no maximum limit set for the monthly salary of the worker.
1. There is no fixed service period requirement for the worker.
1. The dependent child's name should be listed in the worker's ESI Card/Ration Card.
1. The dependent child should not have any source of income and should not be married.
1. The worker should not have already availed of the benefit of this scheme for his/her dependent child in the relevant financial year.

**Note:** The worker is required to submit the living certificates of his/her dependent beneficiary child every yearRs. indicating that the dependent child has no source of income and is unmarried.

name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Cultural Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Cultural Activities is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board to the children of the workers working in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for participating in cultural competitions so that the children of the workers can also become good artists.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided as per the following table to the children of the workers for participating in cultural competitions:
**Sl. No.****Cultural competitions****District-level competition amount****Division-level competition amount****State-level competition amount****National-level competition amount****International-level competition amount**1On participating in group cultural competitions such as danceRs. musicRs. etc.2Rs./-3Rs./-4Rs./-5Rs./-11Rs./-2On securing 1stRs. 2nd and 3rd position in group cultural competitions such as danceRs. musicRs. etc.2Rs./-3Rs./-4Rs./-5Rs./-21Rs./-3On participating in solo cultural competitions such as danceRs. musicRs. etc.3Rs./-5Rs./-7Rs./-9Rs./-21Rs./-4On securing 1stRs. 2nd and 3rd position in solo dance competition3Rs./-5Rs./-7Rs./-9Rs./-31Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The applicant's monthly salary should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. Benefits are provided to children of registered workers for participating in group or solo cultural competitionsRs. and also for securing 1stRs. 2ndRs. or 3rd position in these competitions.
1. There is no limit on the number of workers' children eligible under this scheme.
1. There is no minimum service period requirement for the worker.

**Note:** It is mandatory to apply within one year from the date of issue of certificate for participation in cultural competitions.

name: Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal
brief_description: "Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal" is a social welfare scheme launched by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises and TextilesRs. Government of West Bengal on 7th MarchRs. 2024Rs. and shall remain in force for a period of five years. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the family of the deceased weaver /artisan.
benefits: 2Rs./- only per deceased Weaver/ Artisan.
eligibility:
- The age of the deceased artisan/weaver was between 18 to 60 years on the date of death.
- The artisan/weaver has expired on or after the Date of Notification (7th MarchRs. 2024).
- The claimant should have not availed any other death benefit scheme by the State Government.

name: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for artificial limbs up to the rates fixed by Saket HospitalRs. Chandimandir (Panchkula). This assistance is available to workers employed in industrial and commercial units in HaryanaRs. as well as their dependentsRs. who become disabled due to the loss of vital organs in an accident.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance up to the rates fixed by the Saket Hospital Chandimandir (Panchkula) will be provided to the workers/dependents if they lose important limbs.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 20Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for one year.
1. The application is to be submitted within one year from the date of purchase of artificial limbs.
1. The assistance is available to workers and their dependentsRs. who become disabled due to the loss of vital organs in an accident.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- will be provided to the widows/dependents of workers employed in industrial and commercial institutions in HaryanaRs. in the event of the worker's death while working at the workplace. The assistance is provided in the event of the death of both unregistered and registered workers with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- will be provided to the widows/dependents of workers in the event of the worker's death while working at the workplace.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the widow/dependent of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. There is no fixed service period required for the worker.
1. There is no fixed monthly salary requirement for the worker.
1. Applications must be submitted within two years from the date of the worker's death.
1. Financial assistance is provided under this scheme for the death of a worker primarily caused by workplace incidents within the organization's premises or on the way to the hospital for treatment. This also covers deaths resulting from other causes such as natural disastersRs. heart attacksRs. snake or other poisonous creature bitesRs. fireRs. or building collapses within the organization.
1. Assistance is also provided to widows/dependents of unregistered workers who die or become disabled due to incidents like fireRs. building collapseRs. etc. within the establishment.

name: Family Pension- Haryana Silicosis Board
brief_description: The "Family Pension" scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare BoardRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. after the death of the worker due to SilicosisRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month is provided to the spouse of the worker until he/she remains alive. In the case of an unmarried workerRs. the financial assistance is provided to his/her living parents.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- per month will be given after the death of the worker due to Silicosis.

**Note 1:** If the deceased worker was marriedRs. assistance will be given to the widow or widower until he/she remains alive.
**Note 2:** If the deceased worker was unmarriedRs. financial assistance will be given to his/her living parents.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be either the spouse or one of the living parents of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. Haryana.
1. The death of the worker should have been due to silicosis.
1. The deceased worker should have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.

name: Financial Assistance for Coaching- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description:
The "Financial Assistance for Coaching" scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This scheme was launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board on 15.01.2019 with the objective to provide financial assistance up to 20Rs./- for coaching of entrance examinations for professional courses and 1Rs./- to the children of workers for preparing for the main examination after passing the preliminary examination of UPSC and HPSC.
Students seek coaching from private coaching institutes to get admission to professional coursesRs. incurring substantial expenses for the workers. ThereforeRs. as per the announcement of the Hon'ble Chief MinisterRs. the proposal to provide financial assistance to the children of workers for coachingRs. apart from the existing scholarship schemeRs. was approved by the Board so that the children of poor workers can also brighten their future by getting good coaching in coaching centers and get admission in good professional courses.
benefits:
1. An amount of 20Rs./- or 75% of the coaching fee (whichever is less) will be payable to the children of workers for coaching in entrance examinations in professional courses.
1. An amount of 1Rs./- will be provided to the children of workers for coaching to prepare for the main examination on passing the Preliminary Examination of UPSC and HPSC.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The applicant's monthly salary must not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The applicant must have a minimum of one year of service.
1. Benefits are provided to children of registered workers who are receiving coaching for entrance examinations in professional coursesRs. as well as for those preparing for the main examination after passing the preliminary examination of UPSC and HPSC.
1. The child/candidate should have scored at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination.
1. The benefits of this scheme are available to three girls and two boys of the workers.
1. The child of the worker will not be covered under this scheme if he/she is self-employed or employed.
1. If a worker's child is receiving a scholarship from the Haryana Labour Welfare BoardRs. he/she can also avail the benefits of this scheme.

> **Conditions prescribed for coaching institutes regarding the coaching being taken by students:**


- The coaching institute must have been providing coaching for at least three years.
- The institute should have provided coaching to a minimum of 300 students.
- The institute should have been paying service tax (GST) to the government for running coaching classes or a coaching institute for at least three years.
- The institute should have paid the Labour Welfare Fund due to the Board and must be registered under the Shop & Commercial Establishment ActRs. 1958.

name: Relief to the Unregistered Workers
brief_description: The "Relief to the Unregistered Workers" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the dependents of unregistered building and construction workers who die in accidents at construction sites and also offers compensation for unregistered workers who suffer permanent disabilities due to accidents. This initiative supports the welfare of construction workers and their familiesRs. even if the workers were not registered at the time of the incident.
benefits:
> **Compensation for Deceased Workers:** - Financial Assistance of 50Rs./- to the dependents of unregistered workers who die in accidents at construction sites or related projects.
> **Relief for Permanent Disabilities:** - 20Rs./- is provided for cases of permanent disability where the disability is 50% or above. - 10Rs./- is provided for cases of permanent partial disability where the disability is below 50%.
eligibility:
> **Eligibility for Accidental Death of Unregistered Worker:** 1. The applicant should be dependent on the deceased unregistered worker. 1. The worker must be unregistered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The worker must have died in an accident at a construction site or related project during the course of employment.
> **Eligibility for Permanent Disability:** 1. The worker should have a permanent disability due to accidents at construction sites. 1. The worker should have a disability of 50% or above. > **Eligibility for Permanent Partial Disability:** 1. The worker should have a permanent partial**** disability due to accidents at construction sites.1. The worker should have a disability of 50% or below.

name: Denture, Spectacles & Hearing Aid Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "DentureRs. Spectacles & Hearing Aid Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide financial aid to the registered beneficiary Construction Workers and their family members for spectaclesRs. dentures and hearing aids.
benefits:
- **Spectacle:** .800/-.- **Denture:** 5Rs./-.- **Hearing Aid:** 6Rs./-.
> **Note:**


- Financial assistance under this scheme shall be granted on the recommendation of Govt. medical officer/Incharge of the E.S.I Dispensary.
- Under this schemeRs. the beneficiary or his family members shall get benefit only once.
- The beneficiary shall get the amount of actual expenditure or amount of financial assistanceRs. whichever is lessRs. on the basis of actual bills produced by him.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab or should be a family member of the worker.
- The applicant should be paying the contribution regularly.

name: Family/ Widow Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Family/ Widow Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide financial assistance in the form of pension to the spouse of the registered construction worker in the event of his/ her death.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 1Rs./- as family pension until remarriage. Note: - If both spouses are Board beneficiariesRs. the surviving spouse does not receive family pension. - But if the husband/wifeRs. either remarried or he/she gets an old age pension from the Government then they shall not be eligible for family pension. - If both the husband and wife are the beneficiaries of the Board and both are getting pension then in the event of the death of one of themRs. the other one shall not be eligible for family pension. - If only one spouse receives a pensionRs. then on the eve of death of the pensionerRs. the surviving spouse receives family pension until they become eligible for their own pension from the BoardRs. at which point the family pension stops.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a spouse of a deceased registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The deceased worker should have completed 1 year of membership with the Board.

name: Marriage Gift Scheme (APBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Marriage Gift Scheme" was launched by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers LET&F (Labour) Department for registered unmarried women workers and the two daughters of registered construction workers. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance on the occasion of their marriage. The scheme helps to alleviate the financial burden for families involved in the construction sector.
benefits: - **Financial assistance for marriage: 20Rs./-.**
eligibility:
> **For construction workers themselves (Women only)** 1. Construction worker should be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Construction worker should be a woman. 1. Construction worker should be unmarried.
> **For daughters of construction workers** 1. A construction worker can receive the scheme benefits for up to two daughters. 1. The daughter(s) should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.

name: Medical Assistance (NBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance" scheme launched by the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to registered beneficiaries and their family members for hospitalization. 1Rs./- per day is provided for the first five days of hospitalizationRs. followed by 500/- per day for up to 10 more days.
benefits:
- 1Rs./- per day for the first five days of hospitalization.
- 500/- per day for the next 10 days (up to 15 days total).
eligibility:
1. The construction worker should be registered under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board.
1. The spouse and children of the construction worker are also eligible for financial assistance.
1. The applicant should be hospitalized for at least five continuous days for assistance.

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Medical Benefit for Major Ailments
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Medical Benefit for Major Ailments by the Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. is designed to alleviate the financial burden of medical expenses for individuals and families dealing with severe health conditions. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance up-to 20Rs./- is provided for the treatment of beneficiaries or their family members suffering from major ailments CancerRs. LeprosyRs. T.BRs. brain strokeRs. cardiac problemsRs. malfunctioning of kidney(s)Rs. AIDSRs. Eye AilmentsRs. Vericosis of VeinRs. or Thalassemia requiring hospitalisation and treatment. In cases of major surgeryRs. additional relief up to 60Rs./-may be allowed.
benefits: - **Assistance for Major Ailments:** Up-to 20Rs./-. - **Assistance for Surgery:** Up-to 60Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment.
- The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses.
- The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use.

name: Award for Success in State Public Service Commission, Union Public Service Commission Examination (MPBOCWWB)
brief_description: Under the" State Public Service Commission and Union Public Service Commission Examination Success Award Scheme" by the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya PradeshRs. the sons and daughters of registered construction workers who are selected at various levels in the State Public Service Commission or Union Public Service Commission examinationsRs. are provided incentives ranging from 15Rs./- to 50Rs./-.
benefits:
**Incentives Upon Selection in "Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission" Exam**

- Preliminary Exam: 15Rs./-
- Main Exam: 25Rs./-

**Incentives Upon Selection in "Union Public Service Commission" Exam**

- Preliminary Exam: 25Rs./-
- Main Exam: 50Rs./-
eligibility:
**For Registration**

1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.

**For Application**

1. The applicant should be a son or daughter of a registered Building/ Construction Worker.
1. The applicant should be up to 45 years of age.
1. The applicant should be in possession of a valid identity card issued by the Labour Department.
1. The applicant should be selected at Preliminary or Main Level of either the "State Public Service Commission Examination" or the "Union Public Service Commission Examination".

name: West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Funeral Expenses
brief_description: The West Bengal Transport Workers Social Security Scheme: Funeral Expenses by the Labour DepartmentRs. West BengalRs. offers monetary support to help cover funeral costs in the unfortunate event of a beneficiary's demise. Beneficiaries can avail of this assistance by submitting an application alongside the relief request for accidental or natural death compensation.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 3Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment.
- The applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehiclesRs. such as carsRs. taxisRs. luxury taxisRs. light commercial vehiclesRs. vansRs. auto-rickshawsRs. temposRs. lorriesRs. trucksRs. or buses.
- The applicants vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use.

name: Jharkhand International Migrant Workers Grant Scheme
brief_description:
The "Chief Minister Jharkhand International Migrant Worker Grant Scheme" was launched by the Department of LabourRs. Employment & TrainingRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims aims to provide financial assistance of 5Rs./- to the dependents of Jharkhand residents who pass away while working abroad. This scheme ensures timely support to families affected by unforeseen tragedies during overseas employment.
> ***Objective:*** - Covers accidental deathsRs. acts of violenceRs. or natural causes. - Assistance includes cases of deaths caused by animal attacksRs. road accidentsRs. and terrorism. - Coverage extends to nuclear radiation and war-related deaths.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 5Rs./- to dependents of deceased workers.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased workers.
1. The deceased must be a Jharkhand resident and an Indian citizen.
1. The familys annual income should not exceed 72Rs./-.
1. The deceased age should be between 15 to 65 years.
1. Eligible dependents include spousesRs. childrenRs. parentsRs. or legal heirs.
1. Death must be certified by the Ministry of External AffairsRs. Government of India.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU)
brief_description:
The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU) was launched by the Planning DepartmentRs. Haryana Government during the financial year 2023-24. This scheme provides financial assistance in the event of death (natural or accidental) or permanent disability (caused by an accident) of a family member whose annual income is less than 1.80 lakhRs. as verified in the Family Information Data Repository (FIDR) database. The scheme became effective from 1st April 2023.
The assistance offered under this scheme will vary depending on the age of the individual at the time of death or permanent disabilityRs. with eligibility for individuals above the age of 6 years and up to 60 years. The scheme covers only death or permanent disability resulting from an accident. The implementing agency for this scheme will be Haryana Parivar Suraksha Nyas (HPSN)Rs. Government of Haryana.
**Objective:**
To provide socio-financial security to eligible residents of the State.
benefits:
**The scheme will provide the below mentioned assistance which would vary depending on the age of the beneficiary:**
**Sl. No.****Age****Compensation Amount**1Above 6 years and up to 12 years 1 lakh2Above 12 years and up to 18 years 2 lakh3Above 18 years and up to 25 years 3 lakh4Above 25 years and up to 45 years 5 lakh5Above 45 years and up to 60 years 3 lakh**Note: For beneficiaries enrolled under Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) & Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)Rs. assistance paid under DAYALU will be adjusted considering the compensation received from PMJJBY or PMSBY:**
**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The assistance amount will be paid directly into the bank account registered in the PPP database or linked to the Aadhaar number of the Head of the family.
- In case of permanent disabilityRs. the assistance amount shall be paid to the beneficiary in his bank account registered in the PPP database or bank account linked to the Aadhaar number.

**Frequency of Disbursement:**
One-time financial assistance.
**Expected Time of Disbursement:**
The claim must be filed within three months of death or permanent disability.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana.
2. The applicant refers to either:
The beneficiary (in case of permanent disability)Rs. or
An eligible relative (in case of death) applying for financial assistance under this scheme.
3. The family income of the beneficiary must be less than 1.80 lakh per annumRs. as verified in the Family Information Data Repository (FIDR) database.
4. The beneficiary must possess a Family ID/Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP) number.
5. The beneficiary must be above 6 years and up to 60 years of age.
6. The scheme is effective from 1st April 2023. Claims for deaths or disabilities occurring before this date will not be entertained by the Trust.
7. Financial assistance will be provided only in cases of:
Death (natural or accidental)Rs. or
Permanent disability (caused by an accident).
8. Permanent disability is defined as 70% or more disability resulting from an accidentRs. as certified by the Medical Authority.
**Other Terms & Conditions:**
All registered Construction workersRs. Industrial LaboursRs. Other laboursRs. Private Sector EmployeeRs. Private contractual workersRs. Unorganised workers etc. registered under Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB) and Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCW) having annual family income below Rs. 1.80 lakh will be given compensation by HLWB/HBOCW and in case the Labour department rejects the particular claim then the compensation will be given under DAYALU scheme as per their eligibility.
**In case of deathRs. the assistance amount shall be paid:**
1. In case Member of family is deceased then assistance will be given to the Head of the Family.
2. In case Head of Family is deceased then assistance will be given-
Eldest of the family below the age of 60 years.
In case no elder family member is below the age of 60 years then the family member immediate above the age of 60 years.
3. In case no family member is alive after the death in the family then no assistance will be paid.
4. In case the alive family members are below the age of 18 years then the assistance will be paid only at the time of any member attaining the age above 18 yearsRs. subject to para 5 below.
5. In case the applications for compensation received after 1st JanuaryRs. 2024 where the age of the beneficiary is above 25 years and upto 45 years and there is a minor girl child in the family then out of the compensation of 5 lakhRs. 2.5 lakh will be given to the minor girl child in her bank account linked with her Aadhaar numberRs. if existsRs. and the balance of the compensation will be given as per the scheme.

name: Noni Suraksha Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2014Rs. the scheme "Noni Suraksha Yojana" by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Chhattisgarh GovernmentRs. aims to address the declining child sex ratio and foster a positive societal attitude towards girls. The scheme provides financial assistance of 1Rs./- upon fulfilling certain conditions and invests 25Rs./- in the name of the beneficiary girl child through the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). The applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh and belong to a family living below the poverty line. The scheme is implemented by the Life Insurance Corporation of India. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 1Rs./- will be provided by a financial institution upon the girl's 18th birthdayRs. provided she is unmarried and has completed 12th standard education. The amount shall not be less than 1Rs./-.
- 5Rs./- per yearRs. totalling 25Rs./- over 5 yearsRs. will be invested in the name of the eligible girl through the Life Insurance Corporation of India.
- An additional corpus/contribution of 10% of the amount given to LIC will be provided to ensure the maturity amount is not less than 1Rs./- and to account for potential devaluation of the Rupee.
- The Life Insurance Corporation of India will handle all formalities from application receipt to payment.
- The beneficiary girl/family will also be eligible for benefits under other social security schemes operated by the Life Insurance Corporation of IndiaRs. as per the rules.

**Mode of Disbursement:** Through a bank account opened in the beneficiary girl's name at the time of payment.
**Disbursement Conditions:** The beneficiary girl must provide her 12th-grade mark sheetRs. an affidavit of being unmarried until 18 years of age (verified by the Child Development Project Officer or authorised officer)Rs. and her bank account details.
If the girl dies before the age of 18Rs. the amount will be forfeited.
eligibility:
- The girl must have been born on or after April 1Rs. 2014. - The girl's parents must be permanent residents of Chhattisgarh. - The girl must belong to a family living below the poverty line. The name of the family's head must be present in the current poverty line survey list of the Rural Development Department (currentlyRs. the 2002 survey list for rural areas and the 2007 survey list for urban areas is valid). - The benefit under the scheme is limited to two daughters. If there are two sonsRs. a third daughter is not eligible for the benefit. - In the case of the second girl childRs. it is mandatory for the mother or father to have adopted a permanent family planning method before applying. - All girls born as twins or more than one child in the first/second delivery will receive the benefit of the scheme. - If a third girl child is born after the benefit has been given to twin girls born in the first deliveryRs. the third girl child will not receive the benefit of the scheme. - If the family has legally adopted a girlRs. she will be considered eligible and given the benefit of the scheme if she meets the other criteria. - The girl must not marry before the age of 18Rs. and she must complete her 12th standard education to be eligible for benefits under the scheme. _*The decision to determine eligibility and approve/disapprove cases rests entirely with the concerned District Collector._
**Special Inclusion:** Girls born to HIV-affected couples (including A.P.L. families) after April 1Rs. 2016Rs. will also be given the benefit of the scheme for the first two girls.

name: Assistance for Damage to Agricultural Land and Other Losses
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for Damage to Agricultural Land and Other Losses is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Disaster Management Authority under the Department of Disaster ManagementRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial relief to farmers whose agricultural land has been damaged due to natural disasters such as floodsRs. landslidesRs. avalanchesRs. or river diversions.

name: Grant-in-aid (TB)
brief_description:
The Grant-in-Aid (TB) Scheme of the Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. MizoramRs. was introduced to provide financial assistance to indigent persons suffering from serious diseases. In order to regulate the grant of such assistanceRs. the State Government framed a set of rules known as the Mizoram Health & Family Welfare (Grant-in-Aid to Indigent Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes Patients Suffering from Serious Diseases) RulesRs. 1997Rs. which came into force from the date of their publication in the Mizoram Gazette.
Under these rulesRs. Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes persons who are permanent residents of the State of MizoramRs. whose family members are not employed under the GovernmentRs. Public Sector UndertakingsRs. or local bodiesRs. and whose total family income from all sources does not exceed 2Rs. per monthRs. are eligible to receive the Grant-in-AidRs. provided they are suffering from serious diseases.
benefits: 1. The grant-in-aid shall be given in cash or by means of a Bank Draft. 1. The grant-in-aid shall be made subject to the availability of found and cannot be claimed as a matter of right. 1. The amount of grant-in-aid shall be limited to the actual cost of treatment and fare as per the cheapest route available subject to the maximum of 2500/- per head.
eligibility: 1. Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes persons permanently residing within the State of Mizoram 1. None of whose family members are Government employees and whose family income from all sources does not exceed 2000/- per month and who suffering from fell diseases are eligible to receive the grant.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana implemented by the National Health Authority (NHA) under Ministry of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide cashless hospitalisation coverage of 5Rs. per family per year to poor and vulnerable families for secondary and tertiary healthcare services. It was launched on 23rd September 2018 in RanchiRs. JharkhandRs. by the Honble Prime Minister of India. "Ayushman Bharat" is an attempt to move from a sectoral and segmented approach to health service delivery to a comprehensive need-based health care service. This scheme aims to undertake path-breaking interventions to holistically address the healthcare system (covering preventionRs. promotionRs. and ambulatory care) at the primaryRs. secondaryRs. and tertiary levels. Ayushman Bharat adopts a continuum of care approachRs. comprising two interrelated componentsRs. which are - - **Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs):** The scheme aims to provide comprehensive primary healthcare servicesRs. including maternal and child healthRs. non-communicable disease careRs. free essential drugsRs. and diagnosticsRs. close to peoples homes. The centres promote preventive healthcare and healthy behaviours to reduce the risk of chronic diseases. - **Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY):** The second component under Ayushman Bharat is the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna or PM-JAY as it is popularly known. It aims to provide cashless health insurance coverage of up to 5Rs. per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: > **Financial Health Insurance Cover:** - **Annual Hospitalization Coverage:** Cashless coverage up to 5Rs./- per family per year.- **Comprehensive Treatment Costs:** Covers consultationRs. medicinesRs. diagnosticsRs. surgeryRs. ICURs. implantsRs. accommodationRs. and food.- **Pre and Post Hospitalization Support:** Covers 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses.- **Treatment Complication Coverage:** Covers complications arising during treatment. > **Coverage Features:** - **Pre-Existing Disease Coverage:** Covers all pre-existing diseases from day one.- **No Family Size Limit:** No restriction on ageRs. genderRs. or family size.- **Nationwide Portability:** Benefits available across India in empanelled hospitals.- **Wide Procedure Coverage:** Covers approximately 1Rs. medical procedures.

name: Scheme for Containing Population Decline of Small Minority Communities
brief_description: The population of Parsis (Zoroastrians)Rs. a notified minority community under the National Commission of Minorities Act 1992Rs. has declined from 1Rs. in 1941 to 57Rs. in 2011 as per Census data. In order to arrest the decline in population and reverse the trendRs. the Government of India through the Ministry of Minority Affairs (MoMA) formulated the Jiyo Parsi scheme in September 2013. The scheme has three components: i) Medical Assistance to provide financial assistance for medical treatment under standard medical protocol; ii) Health of Community to provide financial assistance to Parsi couples towards childcare and assistance to dependent elderly; and iii) Advocacy to create awareness among the younger generation of marriageable age and young couples to make efforts to contain the population decline of the community and to seek early diagnosis and treatment where necessary.

eligibility: - The scheme is meant for the notified minority communityRs. i.e.Rs. Parsi/Zoroastrians residing in India.
