eligibility: 1. Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers) identified Manual Scavengers and their dependents. 1. Registered co-operative societies of Safai Karamcharis. 1. Legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target groupRs. and 1. All those who produce a certificate from the local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/Railway OfficerRs. Head of the Government. Departments (i.e. SchoolsRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted OfficerRs. Elected Members of Municipal Body & Pradhan of Gram PanchayatsRs. Regional Managers of Regional Rural Banks(RRBs)/Nationalised Banks. 1. HoweverRs. under the MS ActRs. 2013Rs. a person identified as a Manual Scavenger in a survey need not provide any certificate once his/her name appears in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State Governments/Union Territory Administration. ([https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/content/home/ms-survey-2018](https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/content/home/ms-survey-2018)Rs. [https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/node/79798](https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/node/79798)). 1. No income limit is fixed for availing financial assistance. HoweverRs. other things being equalRs. NSKFDC accords priority to economic development and rehabilitation of - Scavengers and amongst scavengers those scavengers whose income is below double the poverty line; - Women from among the target group and - Disabled persons among the target group.

name: Revised Education Scheme For Children Of Artisans/Weavers Of Handicrafts And Handloom Departments
brief_description: A scholarship scheme by the Industries and Commerce Dept.Rs. Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir to provide financial support to the children of Artisans/Weavers of Handicrafts and Handloom Depts. in completion of education. The scholarship shall be provided to a maximum of two children of Weaver/Artisan. The payment shall be made on Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student. 1500 per year up to primary education; 2000 per year for Classes 6th to 10th; 3000 per year for Classes 11th and 12th; As per actual course fee fixed by the Government for Technical/Professional Courses.
eligibility:
1. The parent of the applicant should be a Weaver/Artisan.
1. The parent should be registered with the Handicrafts and Handloom Departments having valid registration car/certificate.
1. The applicant should not have availed benefits under the following schemes being implemented by the departments: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme; Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme; Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme; Any other scheme. The applicant shall seek NOC from the concerned Zonal Educational Officer and Tehsil Social Welfare Officer.
1. The applicant should fulfill one of the following conditions:


- The applicant should have a Below Poverty Line (BPL) CardRs. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Ration CardRs. Priority Household (PHH) Card.
- The applicant should have Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Certificate.
- The total annual income of the parents of the applicant should be less than or equal to 90Rs.. The Income Certificate should be issued by 1st Class Magistrate/Tehsildar concerned.

name: Award Of Incentive For Marriage Between Persons With Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person
brief_description: "**Award of Incentive for Marriage between Persons with Benchmark Disabilities & Other Person"** is a scheme introduced in 2018 by the Department of Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with DisabilitiesRs. Government of Odisha. The scheme's goal is to help people with disabilities live normal and dignified lives and to encourage others to marry people with disabilities. The government introduced this scheme to facilitate and fulfill mandates under Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016 and the National Trust for the Welfare of Persons with AutismRs. Cerebral PalsyRs. Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities ActRs. 1999.
benefits:
1. The amount of incentive is fixed at 2Rs./- and shall be disbursed to the couple through IFMS.
1. The amount of incentive shall be locked in for 3 years.
1. Withdrawal is allowed in three phases with the withdrawal of 10% of the funds after 6 monthsRs. the next 10% after one yearRs. and the balance of 80% of the funds after the successful completion of 3 years of the marriage.
1. The couple can withdraw under the joint signature.
eligibility:
1. The bridegroom and the bride must have completed 21 years and 18 years of age respectively at the time of the marriage.
1. Both of the spouses should be residents of Odisha State.
1. The cash incentive award can be given to either of the spouses with a benchmark disability if another person marries a Person with a Benchmark Disability (Disability Percentage of 40% or above).
1. The said marriage should be dowry free.
1. Neither of the spouses should have availed of the incentive award under this scheme earlier.
1. The beneficiary qualifying for the incentive of both the Departments i.e. ST & SC DevelopmentRs. MinoritiesRs. and Backward Class Welfare DepartmentRs. and the Department of SSEPD will be left to opt to avail the benefit under one Department to avoid duplication.

name: Bhagyalaxmi Scheme
brief_description:
**Detail** The Karnataka state government will give female children financial aid under the Karnataka Bhagya Lakshmi Scheme. The payment of this support is to be made through the motherRs. fatherRs. or legal guardian provided that all requirements are met.
**The objective of this scheme** - To promote the birth of girl children among families identified as below the poverty line. - To increase the status of girl child thereby raising the status of the society. - To Promote the birth of girl child in economically weaker families and to raise their status within the family and society. - To provide Financial assistance to the girl child through her mother/father/natural guardian subject to the fulfilment of certain conditions
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. A girls birth must be registered within a year after her birth date.
1. Girls shouldnt engage in child labour.
1. Benefits from the Bhagyalakshmi scheme are available to BPL families with up to 2 female children.
1. Girls should have been immunized correctly in the health departments program.
1. Girl children must be born after 31 March 2006 in a BPL family.
1. A girl must have completed the eighth grade to be eligible for the maturity amount
1. She cannot have been married off before turning 18 years old.

name: Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana
brief_description: **Details** The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for marriageable daughters of beneficiary registered labourers and registered women construction labourers working in the building and other construction processes and to encourage legal arrangements like adult marriage to prevent illegal practices to control. All those registered construction workers will be eligible under this schemeRs. who are the latest duly registered members of the boardRs. as well as the daughter of such registered construction worker or the registered female worker herself should not be less than the age as decided by the government from time to time. Under this schemeRs. such updated registered construction workers who have completed at least 01 years (365 days) board membership period after registration can apply for the benefit. Within one year of the completion of the marriageRs. an application will have to be made from the website of the Public Service Center / Board along with all necessary recordsRs. but in case of mass marriageRs. the application can be made 15 days before the date fixed for the marriage. It will be mandatory to attach the required documents with the application form.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. After the registration by the construction workerRs. the membership period of the board should have been completed for at least 365 days.
1. Provision has been made for application within 1 year of marriage and 15 days before in case of mass marriage.
1. Aadhaar authentication of the daughter of the beneficiary labor has been made mandatory.
1. The benefit is limited subject to the limit of 2 children.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be admissible after the daughter and the proposed bridegroom complete the prescribed age of 18 years and 21 years respectively.

name: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi Indigenous Cows Ration For BPL Families
brief_description:
The Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh had introduced a scheme named "**Maintenance of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cows Ration for BPL families of all Categories of livestock farmers**" with the help of which a balanced ration of 3 kg per day for up to two cows or buffaloes for three months during the last trimester of pregnancy to BPL families shall be provided. The government and beneficiary share the cost of the ration on a 50:50 basisRs. and the cost of feed depends on approved rates. This scheme may serve about 6.5 Lakh cows and buffaloes become pregnant every year in the state. This scheme may help BPL families and all categories of livestock farmers in the state to maintain a balanced and nutritious diet for pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows in the State. Maintaining a proper and balanced ration for pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows is crucial for the health of cows and the growth and development of calves. Providing a nutritious and balanced diet can also help reduce the risk of health complications during and after pregnancy.
**Objectives:**

1. Increase in milk production thereby providing more economic gains to the farmers.
1. To reduce the inter-calving period which will ultimately result in more calves and higher milk production.
1. To improve the health of pregnant cows so that their full milk production potential can be realized after parturition.
1. To ensure the birth of healthy calves free of diseases and malnutrition so that they grow to become higher-producing animals.
1. As the incentive is being given to Desi/Indigenous cows the farmers can be motivated to rear such animals.
benefits:
**Benefits:**
The scheme for maintenance of pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows ration for BPL families of all categories of livestock farmers in Himachal Pradesh can have a significant impact on the health and livelihoods of farmersRs. as well as the overall development of the region. This scheme in _Himachal Pradesh can have several benefitsRs._****** such as:

1. **Improved cow health:** A balanced and nutritious diet for pregnant cows can improve their health and reduce the risk of health complications during and after pregnancy. 1. **Improved calf growth and development:** A well-fed pregnant cow can provide better nutrition to the growing calfRs. leading to better growth and development. 1. **Increased milk production:** Adequate nutrition can improve the milk production of the cowRs. leading to increased income for the farmer. 1. **Better breed quality:** The scheme can also include provisions for breed improvementRs. leading to better quality Desi/Indigenous cows that can provide better milk yield and meat quality. 1. **Employment generation:** The scheme can create employment opportunities in the feed and fodder development sectorRs. leading to better livelihoods for farmers. 1. **Reduced poverty:** The scheme can help BPL families and all categories of livestock farmers to improve their income and reduce poverty. 1. **Improved food security:** Improved milk production and better quality meat can contribute to better food security in the region.
**Expected Outcome:**

1. After feeding a balanced ration during the last trimester of pregnancyRs. milk production increased by 2 ltr/day.
1. With the assumption that during lactation of 300 daysRs. the farmer will market this milk at @ 30/ltrRs. his income will increase by Rs.18000/year (Approx.).
eligibility:
1. Livestock owners belonging to BPL families of all categories rearing Desi/Indigenous/crossbred cows.
1. The subsidy will be provided to each BPL family of all categories maximum upto two Desi/Indigenous cows and their crosses.

name: Panchayat Kalyan Kosh
brief_description: The "Panchayat Kalyan Kosh" scheme was introduced by the Panchayati Raj DepartmentRs. Government of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram PradhansRs. Kshetra Panchayat PramukhsRs. Zila Panchayat PresidentsRs. and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the peopleRs. in the event of their death while in office (excluding cases of suicide or involvement in criminal acts).
benefits:
In the event of the death of a Panchayat Representative while in officeRs. the following amounts will be provided to their families or dependents:

- Pradhan of Gram PanchayatRs. Pramukh of Kshetra PanchayatRs. and Zila Panchayat President: 10Rs./-
- Member of Zila Panchayat: 5Rs./-
- Member of Kshetra Panchayat: 3Rs./-
- Member of Gram Panchayat: 2Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of a deceased Panchayat Representative.
1. Assistance is provided in the event of the death of a Panchayat Representative (Pradhan of Gram PanchayatRs. Pramukh of Kshetra PanchayatRs. Zila Panchayat PresidentRs. or members of Zila PanchayatRs. Kshetra PanchayatRs. and Gram Panchayat) while serving in office.
1. Assistance will not be provided in cases of suicide or involvement in criminal acts by the Panchayat Representative.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme - Uttar Pradesh
brief_description:
**Detailed** The NFBS also known as Rashtriya Parivarik Labh Yojana was started by the UP government on in January 2016. Under this schemeRs. the families who have lost their lead earners will get a lump sum amount of money as compensation. To claim the compensation one must have applied to register under the scheme. The entire application process is available only online. There is no provision of offline application for the scheme.****
**Key Features** 1. The NFBS scheme is for below-poverty-line families. If the lead earner of the family has lost his/ her lifeRs. the next head of the family will get financial assistance from the state government of Uttar Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be aged between 18 years to 60 years. If the applicant is below 18 i.e. minor or above 60 that is oldRs. then the applicant might not get the compensation amount. 1. The amount of the compensation is fixed at Rs. 30Rs. 000/- which has increased from the earlier amount of compensation which is Rs. 20Rs. 000/-. To apply for the scheme one must use the online process. The scheme does not have any offline mode of registration. 1. To avail the schemeRs. the yearly income of the family should not be more than Rs. 56Rs. 450/- in urban areas and Rs. 46Rs. 080/- in rural areas. The amount of compensation will be provided to the families only after the death of the lead earner or the only earning member of the family.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. To apply for the scheme one must be living under the poverty line.
1. The applicant should not be aged less than 18 years or above 60 years.
1. The family income of the applicant should not be more than Rs. 56Rs. 450/- if the family is from the urban area and Rs. 46Rs. 080/- if the family is from the rural area.
1. Support will be provided to the family after the death of the only earner of the family.

name: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana - Delhi
brief_description: **Details** Any resident of the national capital aged 60 or above can avail of the scheme after acquiring a certificate from a local MLARs. stating that he lives in the legislators constituency. One attendant aged 21 or more can accompany each traveller. The government bears the expenses for the attendant too. The pilgrimage scheme had been halted due to COVID-19Rs. but now it will be resuming. The Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojna was approved by the Delhi Cabinet on January 9Rs. 2018. All expenses related to travelRs. food and accommodation are borne by the Delhi government. A total of 1Rs. residents per assembly constituency can avail this facility in a year subject to the cap of total 77Rs. residents per year. Since its formal launchRs. 38Rs. beneficiaries (senior citizens) have travelled under the schemeRs. the statement added. Delhi Govt Tirth Yatra Online Registration form can be filled through e-district portal and anyone must not submit any manual application. For Delhi Govt Tirth Yatra YojnaRs. counters of SDM officeRs. office of Tirth Vikas Samiti and MLA offices would serve as facilitation counters. Interested candidates can now apply online for Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana 2023 at the official website for 1st trip to pilgrims.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The applicant/spouse must be a resident of the territorial jurisdiction of the NCT of Delhi.
1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age (As of 1st January of the year in which the Application for availing the Yojana is submitted).
1. The applicant/spouse must NOT be employed with Central/State Government or Local/Autonomous bodies.
1. The applicant/spouse must NOT have ever availed of the scheme in the past.
1. The age of the attendant must be more than 21 years(In case opting for attendant).

name: Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana
brief_description:
The Government of India introduced the Bunkar Bima Yojana in December 2003 which was a combination of Janshree Bima Yojana and the Add-on Group Insurance Scheme being implemented in collaboration with the Life Insurance Corporation of India. SinceRs. 2005-06 this scheme has been implemented by the HandloomsRs. Textiles & Handicrafts Department of the Government of Odisha with the revised title **Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Yojana**.
The basic objective is:

1. to provide enhanced insurance coverage to the handloom weavers in the case of natural as well as accidental death and in cases of total or partial disability.
1. The concerned handloom authority in the state will finalize the insurance coverageRs. as the Life Insurance Corporation of India administers the scheme.

The State Governments and the State Handloom Corporations/Apex/Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies/Unions/ Associations shall be actively associated in the implementation of the scheme by way of sensitizing the handloom weavers to join the scheme through advertisements through print and other media.
**Premium Insurance Coverage:**
The annual total premium of 330/- per member will be shared as under:

1. GOI contribution: 150/-
1. Weavers contribution: 80/-
1. LICs contribution: 100/-

**Operational Modalities:**

1. The scheme is renewable every year and continuation of coverage is ensured only on payment of premium on the due date of renewal every year.
1. The premium amount shall be paid by the beneficiary only one-time for the whole year to the Life Insurance Corporation of India.
1. The premiumRs. once paidRs. shall not be refunded.
1. Maximum number of renewals shall be effected each year.
1. The insurance coverage is ordinarily effective only after receipt of the entire amount of premium i.e. both the Governments as well as beneficiarys share.
1. In an unlikely situation where the Governments share of the premium is not readyRs. the LIC shall accept the share of the beneficiary and affect the coverage accordingly.
1. The office of the State Director-in-charge of Handlooms & Textiles and its subordinate offices in the field shall be the Nodal agencies for implementation of the scheme.
1. Nodal agency will act for and on behalf of the insured members in all matters relating to the insurance cover.
1. LIC will get in touch with State Directors In-charge of Handlooms for identification of beneficiariesRs. furnishing formsRs. instructions etc. for maximum coverage of weavers under the scheme.

**Release of Funds:**

1. For release of fundsRs. LIC and the Authority In-charge of Handlooms in the State shall identify the weavers to be covered under the MGBBY.
1. The Central Government share of the premium will be released directly to the LIC.

**Monitoring And Evaluation:**

1. Monitoring and evaluation of the progress of the Scheme will be done by the State GovernmentsRs. which will submit quarterly physical and financial progress reports to the Development Commissioner for Handlooms.
benefits:
This scheme provide insurance coverage to handloom weavers as under:

1. In the event of the natural death of the weaverRs. a Sum Assured of 60Rs. will become payable to the nominee.
1. In the cause of Accidental Death or Total Permanent DisabilityRs. a Sum Assured of 1Rs./- will become payable to the nominee.
1. In case of Partial DisabilityRs. a Sum Assured of 75Rs./- will become payable.
1. The scheme also provides scholarship to the children of parents who are covered under it under Shiksha Sahyog Yojana.
1. A scholarship of 600/- per six month per child is to be paid to students studying is standard IX to XII for a maximum period of four years or till they complete XII standardRs. whichever event occurs earlier.
eligibility:
1. The weaver should be earning at least 50% of his income from handloom weaving.
1. All weaversRs. whether male or femaleRs. between the age group of 18 and 59 years are eligible to be covered under the schemeRs. including minoritiesRs. women weaversRs. and weavers belonging to NER.
1. The weavers belonging to the State Handloom Development Corporations/Apex/ Primary Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies will be covered under the Scheme.
1. Weavers outside co-operative can also be covered under the scheme on a certificate from the State Directorate of Handlooms that they are fulfilling the eligibility conditions.
1. The children of weavers who are covered under Shiksha Sahyog Yojana will also be eligible for scholarship and the benefit of scholarship is restricted to two children of the member covered. Both the children irrespective of gender based discrimination will be covered for scholarship.

**NOTE:**

1. It will be the responsibility of the State Director in charge of Handlooms to verify the eligibility of the weavers who are proposed to be covered under the scheme.

name: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE
brief_description:
**Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme-HIMCARE** is a health insurance scheme under the Department of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide cashless treatment coverage up to 5Rs./- per year per family provided in the empanelled hospitals. In case of more than five membersRs. the remaining members are enrolled as a separate unit subject to the capping of five members for each such additional unit. This scheme is being implemented on a co-payment basis. Hospitals empanelled under Ayushman Bharat within the State are also empanelled for HIMCARE and are providing cashless treatment to the beneficiaries by making online entries through Transaction Management System. The claims are being reimbursed through the host-to-host payment system directly in the bank account of the concerned hospital after checking the complete claim papers submitted by these institutions through the online system.
1. For target groups covering below categories have the Zero Premium amount. - BPL (Not covered under Ayushman Bharat)Rs. - Registered Street Vendors (Not covered under Ayushman Bharat)Rs. - MNREGA worker who have worked minimum 50 days under MNREGA during previous financial year or current financial year. - Children living in Orphanages. 1. For target groups covering below categories have the premium rate 365/- per year. - Ekal NaarisRs. - Disabled >40%Rs. - Mid-Day meal workersRs. - Daily Wage Workers (Govt.Rs. Autonomous BodiesRs. SocietiesRs. Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government)Rs. - Part Time Workers (Govt.Rs. Autonomous BodiesRs. SocietiesRs. Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government) - Contractual Employees (Govt.Rs. Autonomous BodiesRs. SocietiesRs. Boards & Corporations etc. under the control of State Government) - Outsource Employees. 1. Beneficiaries not covered under category-I and category-II or who are not Govt. servants/pensioners or their dependent family membersRs. having the premium amount 1Rs./- per year.
benefits:
1. Cashless Treatment: The scheme provides cashless treatment coverageRs. allowing beneficiaries to receive medical services without upfront payment at empanelled hospitals.
1. Comprehensive Coverage: HIMCARE offers coverage up to 5Rs./- per year per familyRs. ensuring that families have access to quality healthcare services without financial burden.
1. Inclusion of Previously Uncovered Families: The scheme targets families who were not covered under the Ayushman Bharat schemeRs. extending health insurance benefits to a broader population.
1. Categorization for Differential Premium Rates: Beneficiaries are categorized into different groups based on their occupation or socioeconomic statusRs. with corresponding premium rates to make healthcare more affordable for all eligible individuals.
1. Wide Range of Eligible Beneficiaries: The scheme covers various groups such as BPL familiesRs. registered street vendorsRs. MNREGA workersRs. senior citizens above 70 yearsRs. children living in orphanagesRs. disabled individualsRs. Anganwari workersRs. ASHA workersRs. and more.
1. Easy Enrollment Process: Enrollment can be done online through the official website or at Lok Mitra Kendra/Common Service CentersRs. making it convenient for beneficiaries to apply and upload necessary documents.
1. Empanelled Hospital Network: Beneficiaries can receive cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals within Himachal PradeshRs. including prestigious institutions like PGIMER Chandigarh and GMCH Sector 32 ChandigarhRs. ensuring access to quality healthcare facilities.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. Families not covered under the Ayushman Bharat Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) are eligible to apply for the HIMCARE scheme.
1. Applicant should be HIMCARE card holder.
1. The scheme is available to Below Poverty Line (BPL) familiesRs. Above Poverty Line (APL) familiesRs. Senior citizens and daily wage earnersRs. widowsRs. single womenRs. and persons with disabilities.

name: Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2006Rs. the scheme Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme is a flagship social-security scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Haryana. Through this schemeRs. the eligible family receives benefits for 15 years after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age. A sum of 2Rs./- per month per family is provided to the families who have solely girl child/children. The parent(s) should be either domicile of Haryana or should be working for the Government of Haryana.
benefits:
2Rs./- per month for 15 yearsRs. after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age.
**NOTE 1:** The benefit will be paid to the mother. In case the mother is deceasedRs. the benefit will be paid to the father.
**NOTE 2:** After 60 years the scheme will be converted to "Old Age Samman Allowance" scheme.
eligibility:
- The biological single parent/parents of the family should be domiciled in Haryana or should be working for the Government of Haryana.
- The family should have no sonRs. whether biological or adopted.
- The family should have one or more girl children.
- The gross annual income of the familyRs. from all sourcesRs. should not exceed 2Rs./-.

**NOTE:** The benefit will be paid to the mother. In case the mother is deceasedRs. the benefit will be paid to the father.

name: Safai Karmakaar Putr/Putri Cycle sahayata yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Safai Karmakaar Putr/Putree Cycle Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 August 2015. The main objective of the scheme to empower the unorganized worker son/daughter worker through provide them free cycle.
benefits: > A free of cost cycle will be provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's father/mother must be a registered sanitation worker in the state of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant must be studying in a recognized school or college.
1. The applicant must not have received bicycle assistance under any other government scheme earlier.
1. Benefits will be provided only for two children.

name: Shaadi Mubarak Scheme
brief_description:
In order to prevent child marriages and support the marriage expense of financially distressed familiesRs. on 02nd October 2014Rs. Government of Telangana introduced a welfare scheme called Shaadi MubarakRs. providing financial assistance for marriages of minority community girls.
The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the newly wedding brides who belong to minority families. Under this scheme at the time of marriage of the bride financial aid will be transferred into the bank account of the mother. This scheme will prevent early marriages and will also increase the literacy rate among girls as only those girls who have attained 18 years of age or more can apply for this scheme. Through the implementation of this schemeRs. many benefits will be availed for the brides who are about to get married in Telangana state. Incentives such as financial funds will be provided to the bank account of the brides mother so that the marriage of the bride can take place smoothly and without any disturbance because of the property.
benefits:
1. Under the SchemeRs. one-time financial assistance of 1Rs. /- at the time of marriage shall be granted to every unmarried girl belonging to the minority community with effect from October 2Rs. 2014 subject to the eligibility condition.
1. The financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to the parents of disabled girls.

**Note:** The "Shaadi Mubarak" is only a one-time financial assistance and can be availed only once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The unmarried girl should belong to the minority community.
2. The unmarried girl should be a resident of Telangana state.
3. The unmarried girl should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
4. The wedding of the minority community girl should be on or after October 2Rs. 2014.
5. The combined income of the Parents shall not exceed 2Rs./- per annum.

name: "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
brief_description: The scheme "Fishing Ban Period Assistance" is a Sub-Component under the scheme "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme". The scheme is extended to all the regions of the Union territory of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective to assist fishermen families who are deprived of income during natural calamities and fishing ban periodsRs. and to conserve the fishery wealth in sea during breeding season.
benefits: 100 kgs. of rice and a cash dole at 750/- per fishermen's family during the period of ban on fishing during the year.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
- The applicant should be a fisherman.
- The applicant should belong to a group designated to be "Below Poverty Line".
- *Beneficiary shall also be considered based on the decisions taken periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society.
- The applicant should not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamityRs. lean seasonRs. or ban on the fishing period for which relief assistance is issued.
- The beneficiary or any other members of the ration card should not be in regular service in the Government/Quasi Government/Government undertakings/Retired Government Pensioner.

*** The benefit under this scheme shall not be denied only on the ground that the head of the family or family member is a recipient of Old Age Pension (OAP);**
*** The benefit under this scheme shall not be restricted on the ground that the fisherman is in possession of mechanized or motorized or traditional fishing boats or is not in possession of the said fishing boats.**

name: Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning
brief_description: The scheme "Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning" is a financial assistance scheme by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Puducherry. This scheme aims to create awareness among parents about the desirability of the girl child and elevate the status of the girl child in the family. The scheme provides an amount of 30Rs./- deposited in the name of the girl childRs. and in the case of two girl childrenRs. 15Rs./- is deposited in the name of each. The maturity value is given to the girl child/children when she attains the age of 18 years.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 30Rs./- for one girl childRs. and 15Rs./- for each of two girl children.
- The incentive amount is deposited in the name of the girl child/children and matures when the child reaches 18 years of age.
eligibility:
1. The parents should be citizens of India.
1. Either of the parents should be a native of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years.
1. The annual income of the applicant should not exceed 75Rs./- per annum.
1. The age of the parents should not be below 21 years for the father and 18 years for the mother at the time of their marriage.
1. Either of the parents should have undergone Family Planning in a Central/State Government Hospital/ Private (Registered).
1. The parents should have only one girl child/two girl children.
1. The marriage of the applicant should be registered in the Registration Department/Municipality/Commune Panchayat.

name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section
brief_description: The scheme Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of PondicherryRs. was introduced to provide Financial Assistance of 2Rs./- to the Bridegroom from Weaker Section. The application for this scheme should be submitted 15 days before the date of marriage.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 2Rs./-.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The bridegroom should be above 21 years of age.
- The bride should be above 18 years of age.
- The bridegroom should be a native of the UT of Pondicherry.
- The annual income of the bridegroom and his parents should be less than 24Rs./.
- The application should be submitted 15 days before the date of marriage.

name: Family Counseling" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board
brief_description: The sub-scheme Family Counseling" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board" was launched by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. the residents of Puducherry are provided with counsellingRs. rehabilitative and referral services.
benefits:
- CounsellingRs. rehabilitative and referral services are provided in the centres for the victims of social problems.
- PsychologicalRs. SocialRs. Educational and Economic issues of the individuals are also dealt with.
eligibility: The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry.

name: Vivah Sahayata Yojana - Madhya Pradesh
brief_description: Labor department of Madhya Pradesh State initiated the "Vivah Sahayata Yojana" was started in 2018 for the financial assistance for marriage. The objective of scheme to reduce the financial burden and provide some financial help from the construction worker. This scheme provides marriage assistance to: - The registered female worker's own marriage or remarriage. - Up to two daughters of the registered worker.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the beneficiary will receive a total assistance of 55Rs..
1. This amount is divided into:

1. 11Rs./- as cash.
1. 38Rs./- worth of household goods.
1. 6Rs./- provided to the organizer of the mass marriage program (if applicable).
eligibility:
1. The industrial establishment/institution must be covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Fund Act 1982 and the Board must be receiving regular contributions from the establishment.
1. The application form in the prescribed format must be submitted either 15 days before the wedding date or 60 days after the wedding date.
1. Bride and groom age should be 18 and 21 respectively.
1. The applicant must have been working in the establishment for at least one year.
1. If the applicant has availed the benefit of marriage assistance under any other schemeRs. he/she will be ineligible for this scheme.

name: Family Pension (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Family Pension is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. in the event of the death of a pensioner who was receiving a pension from the BoardRs. a family pension shall be given to the surviving spouse by the Board.
benefits:
- In the event of the death of the pensionerRs. a family pension shall be given to the surviving spouse.
- The amount of pension will be 50% of the pension received by the pensioner or 100/- whichever is higher.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The deceased individual/worker should have been receiving a pension from the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. In the event of the death of the pensionerRs. the surviving spouse shall be eligible for the family pension.
1. The spouse of the pensioner should not be receiving any pension from the Government/Semi-Government/Private Organization.
1. The spouse of the pensioner should not be receiving any salary from the Government/Semi-Government/Private Organization.

name: Education Assistance/Ph.D Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Education Assistance/Ph.D Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided once a year to any two children of a construction worker for the career development of bright and needy construction worker students seeking admission in the higher education courses of the state and for the purpose that the child of the construction worker may progress in education and become doctor/engineer.
benefits:
Under the schemeRs. the following benefits are provided to students from Standard 1 to 12Rs. as well as for those pursuing Graduation and Postgraduate studies:

1. The financial assistance will be provided once a year to two children of a construction worker.

1. Board assistance is not admissible if any registered construction worker's child is admitted through the Right to Education/studying in an Open University/studying externally or receiving any similar assistance from other departments.

name: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to the legal heirs of the deceased construction workersRs. registered or unregistered with the BoardRs. in case of accidental death or permanent disability during ongoing work at the construction site.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- shall be given to the legal heirs of the deceased construction workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal heir of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The financial assistance shall be provided to the legal heirs of construction workersRs. whether registered or unregistered with the BoardRs. in the event of accidental death or permanent disability occurring during ongoing work at the construction site.

name: Chief Ministers Girl Child Protection Scheme-I
brief_description: The 'Chief Ministers Girl Child Protection Scheme-I' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to girl children of poor families as well as to promote girl child educationRs. small family normsRs. increase the child sex ratioRs. discourage the preference for male child & eradicate female infanticide.
benefits:
- A fixed deposit (FD) of 50Rs./- in the name of the girl child (A copy of the FD receipt is given to the family).
- Renewal of FD after five years.
- An annual incentive of 1Rs./- from the 6th year of the FD.
- The amount deposited along with accrued interest is given to the girl child when she attains 18 years of age.

**NOTE:** The matured amount will be given to the girl child only if she appears for the 10th standard public exam.
eligibility:
- The assistance is provided only for one girl child of the family.
- The annual income of the parents of the girl child should not exceed 72Rs./-.
- One of the parents must have undergone sterilization before turning 40 years old.
- The family should have only one female child and no male child. In the futureRs. no male child should be adopted.
- The parents/grandparents should be a native of Tamil Nadu by birth or continuous residence of not less than ten years at the time of applying to this scheme.
- The scheme is also applicable to the girl children of Sri Lankan Tamil Refugees in the Refugee Camps in Tamil Nadu.

name: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare BoardRs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the family members of workers (Shramyogis) in the event of their death due to an accident during their course of employment. This assistance aims to help the worker's family cope with the sudden calamity. HoweverRs. post-sickness and natural death of workers will not be admissible under the scheme.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. families of workers (Shramyogis) will receive financial assistance of 2Rs./- in the event of the worker's death due to an accident during their course of employment.
eligibility:
1. In case of the death of a worker due to an accidentRs. the family of the worker will be eligible for assistance under the scheme.
1. Only those workers (Shramyogis) whose factory/company/organization has regularly paid their Labour Welfare Fund will be eligible for the benefit of this scheme.

**Note 01:** The benefit of the scheme will be given from the day after the worker joins the job.
**Note 02:** Application should be made within 2 years from the date of death of the worker (Shramyogi). The application received after the time limit will be processed at the office.
**Note 03:** Under this schemeRs. in case of the death of a worker due to an accident in the factoryRs. the DirectorRs. Office of Industrial Safety and Health has to submit an accident report. AlsoRs. in case of accidental death outside the factory/company/organizationRs. an affidavit has to be produced from the owner/manager of the factory/company/organization concerned.
**Note 04:** The final decision regarding assistance will be with the Welfare CommissionerRs. with jurisdiction in Ahmedabad.

name: Dhanvantari Arogya Rath Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Dhanvantari Arogya Rath Yojana was launched by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme has been implemented to ensure that construction workers and their families get primary medical treatment at their doorstepsRs. prevent serious diseasesRs. and maintain their health at places including construction sitesRs. labour coloniesRs. and Kadianaka. The scheme is implemented by EMRI Green Health Services Gujarat (GVK-108) through making a tripartite MoU with the Health Department and EMRI Green Health Services Gujarat.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. treatment of primary injuries including common diseases like feverRs. diarrheaRs. vomitingRs. skin diseases and laboratory tests like urineRs. bloodRs. blood sugarRs. malariaRs. and various diagnoses including primary care of women and children of their family and primary care of pregnant women during pregnancy done on the spot. Along with thisRs. they are also given free medicines on the spot.
eligibility: - The benefits of this scheme can be availed by construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and their family members.

name: Distress Relief Scheme
brief_description: The "Distress Relief Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to provide financial assistance of 20Rs./- to the BPL households on the death of their primary breadwinner (male or female).
benefits: Financial Assistance of 20Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the legal heir of the deceased primary breadwinner.
2. The family of the applicant should be solely dependent on agriculture (agricultural labourers/ small and marginal farmers).
OR
The annual income of the family should not exceed 24Rs./-.
3. The family should be from the "Below Poverty Line" category.

name: Accident Relief Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Accident Relief Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of 20Rs./- to the legal heirs of the household below poverty line on the death of a Primary breadwinner (male or female) due to an accident in respect of 44 occupational categories of notified employment as per [G.O.Ms.No.471](https://www.tn.gov.in/scheme/data_view/3258)Rs. Finance (CMPRF) Department dated.23.05.1989.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 20Rs./- is given to the legal heirs of the household below poverty line.

**NOTE:** Depending upon the nature of the injury sustained and the degree of physical impairmentRs. relief of 5Rs. to 15Rs. is given.
eligibility:
1. The breadwinner of the familyRs. whether male or femaleRs. must be an earning member.
1. The breadwinner's death was caused by an accident.
1. The family should belong to the BPL category.
1. Legal heirs of the deceased primary breadwinner of the family.
1. The family members engaged in the [44 categories (Page No. 139)](https://www.tn.gov.in/rti/proactive/swnmp/citizen_social_welfare.pdf) of notified employment.

name: Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist Who Was Receiving Financial Assistance
brief_description: The "Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist who was Receiving Financial Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance of 3Rs./- is given to the eligible legal heir (wife/husband) of the deceased artist.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 3Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be the legal heir (wife/husband) of the deceased.
- The deceased should have been an artist.
- The deceased should have been receiving financial assistance through the scheme " Scheme of Financial Assistance to Indigent Artistes" by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.
- The deceased should have been 58 years or older.
- The benefit of the scheme will be given only on the death of the indigent artist.
- The deceased should have professionally served for the enrichment of any one of the art disciplines or more such as musicRs. danceRs. dramaRs. filmRs. folk artsRs. etc.
- The annual income of the deceased artist or their legal spouse should not have exceeded 12Rs./-.

name: Scheme of Extending Family Maintenance Grant to the Families of the Deceased Famous Artists
brief_description: "Scheme of Extending Family Maintenance Grant to the Families of the Deceased Famous Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The objective of the scheme is to provide a one-time maintenance grant of 25Rs./- to the families of deceased famous artists of the art disciplines of musicRs. dramaRs. danceRs. filmRs. and folk arts.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 25Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The deceased should have been a famous artist in the art disciplines of music/ drama/ dance/ film/ folk arts.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given only on the death of the famous artist.
1. The applicant should be the legal heir of the deceased.

name: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana
brief_description: The scheme Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana is implemented by the Director Scheduled Caste WelfareRs. Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme was launched in the year 1991. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance is provided on the occasion of the marriage of two adult girls belonging to the Scheduled Caste category.
benefits:
1. Scheduled caste girls who marry after 01/04/2021 will receive financial assistance of 12Rs./- under the scheme.
1. Scheduled caste girls who marry before 01/04/2021 will receive financial assistance of 10Rs./- under the scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes Category.
1. The annual income limit in this scheme is 6Rs./- in rural areas and 6Rs./- in urban areas.
1. Benefit under this scheme till the marriage of two (2) adult girls of the family.
1. In case of remarriage the benefit under this scheme will not be available.
1. The age limit of the girl at the time of marriage should be 18 years and the age of the boy should be 21 years.
1. The application for assistance must be made within two years of marriage.
1. The assistance of the scheme will be available to girls from the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana.
1. Beneficiary girls participating in group marriages will be eligible for benefits under both schemes if they fulfill all the conditions of the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana and Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana.

name: Mukhya Mantri Shramyogi Prathibhavan Vidyarthi Yojana (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Mukhya Mantri Shramyogi Prathibhavan Vidyarthi Yojana is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The main objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance for full tuition feesRs. hostel feesRs. booksRs. stationery and laptop/computer for higher education to meritorious children of registered construction workers who have secured 85% marks in senior secondary (10+2) board examination or 75% or more in Bachelor's degree course and admitted as regular students in the first year of undergraduateRs. postgraduate/professional courses.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. children of registered construction workers receive assistance for various purposes:

1. An amount of 5Rs./- per year per student will be payable for purchasing books and stationery.
1. An amount of 49Rs./- per student will be payable only once during the course for purchasing a laptop/computer.
1. Up to 72Rs./- per student will be payable for hostel fees.
1. Reimbursement of tuition fees.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work.
1. The applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one years regular membership.
1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board.
1. The worker's child must have scored 85% in the senior secondary (10+2) board examination or 75% or more in the bachelor's degree course and is continuing studies as a regular student in the next class or course.
1. For students pursuing commercial pilot training courses and type renting coursesRs. all institutions approved by the Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) are also eligible for reimbursement under the scheme.
1. Applicants under this Scheme will not be eligible for benefits under already approved financial assistanceRs. higher educationRs. technical and professional coursesRs. or any other similar scheme of the Board.
1. This financial assistance will be payable up to the first three children of the worker.
1. The worker has neither applied again for the same class of his/her son/daughter nor received similar benefits/financial assistance from any other government department/board/corporationRs. nor have they made any application for the same.

**Note 01:** Under this scheme all IIMs/IITs/IIITs/AIIMS/NITs/NIFT/NID/Indian Institute of Hotel ManagementRs. National Law UniversityRs. and other institutions of Central GovernmentRs. approved by statutory bodies i.e. UGCRs. AICTERs. PCIRs. MCI etc. Institutions/Universities are eligible to participate in this scheme.
**Note 02:** Only institutions established within India are eligible to participate in this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana
brief_description: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh introduced the "Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana" on March 1Rs. 2023Rs. through the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." Under this schemeRs. free coaching assistance will be provided to the children of registered workers. Only the first two children of the worker will be eligible for this scheme.
benefits:
- Free coaching assistance will be provided to the children of registered workers.
**Note:** Construction workers and their children registered under the Board are allowed to appear for competitive examinations as per educational qualification like PSC (Public Service Commission)Rs. CG VYAPAM (Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board)Rs. SSC (Staff Selection Commission)Rs. IBPS (Banking)Rs. RAILWAY (Railway). )Rs. There is a provision to provide free coaching through selected coaching institutes for POLICE ENTRANCE (Police Recruitment Examination).
eligibility:
- The worker should be registered under The Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The registered worker should have at least one year of regular membership.
- The first two children of the worker are eligible for the scheme.

name: Financial Assistance of Hearing Machine/Hearing Aid to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance of Hearing Machine/Hearing Aid to Workers and their Dependents is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- or the actual cost of the hearing aidRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided to workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana and their dependents for the purchase of hearing aid machine in case they lose their hearing power in an accident or for any other reason. The benefit of this scheme is provided to the worker or his/her dependents after every five years.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- or the actual cost of the hearing aidRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided to workers and their dependents for the purchase of hearing aids machine.

**Note:** The worker will be provided with a one-time financial assistance in a block of 5 years to purchase hearing aids.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for one year.
1. The worker will get the benefit after every five years in the whole service period.
1. Workers and their dependents are eligible to receive assistance if they lose their hearing due to an accident or any other reason.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II
brief_description: The scheme "Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide assistance of 50Rs./- to poor parents in getting their daughters married and to promote the educational status of poor girls. The bride should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 50Rs./-.
- One sovereign (4gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.

**NOTE:** The benefit will be given in the bride's mother or father's name. In case of the death of the parentsRs. it will be given to the bride.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The bride should be 18 years or above at the time of marriage.
1. The bride should be a degree holder from a regular collegeRs. Distance Education / Government recognized Open University Or diploma holder should have qualified from Institutions recognized by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.
1. The bride's family income should not exceed 24Rs./- per annum.
1. The assistance is given to only one girl in a family.

name: Child Adoption - Tamil Nadu
brief_description: The scheme "Child Adoption - Tamil Nadu" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a family for orphanedRs. abandonedRs. destitute and neglected children. According to Central Adoption Resource Authority (CARA)Rs. adoption is a process by which a child who is abandoned / separated from biological parentsRs. becomes the legitimate child of a new set of parents referred to as adoptive parentsRs. with all the rightsRs. privileges and responsibilities that are attached to this relationship.
benefits:
- AccommodationRs. foodRs. and health care to the babies till they are given in adoption.
- A family to the destitute child and a child to childless parents.

> **Special concessions are given to female government employees to adopt children:**


- Special adoption leave of 270 days is extended to female government servants of the state government who adopt a child below one year. The leave is eligible only from the date of legalization of adoption.
eligibility: 1. The parents must have at least two years of a stable marital relationship. 1. The single prospective adoptive parents should be between 30-55 years of age. 1. An unmarried/single male persons are not eligible to adopt a girl child. 1. The parents should have adequate financial resources to upbring the child. 1. Age Criteria: - **For a child up to 4 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 90 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 yearsRs. maximum age 45 years. - **For a child above 4 years up to 8 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 100 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 yearsRs. maximum age 50 years. - **For a child above 8 years up to 18 years old:** 1. Maximum composite age of the Prospective Adoptive Parents: 110 years. 1. For a single Prospective Adoptive Parent: Minimum age 25 yearsRs. maximum age 55 years.

name: Natural Death Relief - Telangana
brief_description: The "Natural Death Relief - TBOCWWB" scheme was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. LET&F (Labour) Department Telangana. The scheme aims to provide relief amount to the nomineeRs. dependentsRs. or legal heirs of a deceased worker 1Rs./- in case of natural death. The scheme is effective from 01.05.2018 and aims to support the families of deceased workers with financial assistance to help cover funeral expenses and provide additional relief.
benefits: - **The relief amount 1Rs./- provided to the nomineeRs. dependantsRs. or legal heirs.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the nomineeRs. dependentRs. or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased should be a registered building and other construction workers with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to natural death.

name: Permanent Disability Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Permanent Disability Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide financial assistance in the form of pension to the registered beneficiary with at least 1 year of membership with the Board for becoming fully (100%) disabled. The beneficiaries shall be given pension from the date of disablement.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 2Rs./- Per Month.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The applicant should have completed at least 1 year of membership with the Board.
- The worker should be a fully (100%) disabled person/ Person with Disabilities (PwD).

name: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. PunjabRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this schemeRs. the Board will provide full course feesRs. boarding and lodging assistance to the children of registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions such as ITIs/ Polytechnic colleges etc.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- Full course fee for admission fee/ coaching fee.
- Full course fee for hostel boarding/ lodging.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a resident of Punjab.
- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
- The applicant should have a monthly income of 15Rs./- or below.
- The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
- The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
- The applicant should not be an income tax payer.

> ***For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:***


- The applicant should be a child of a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
- The applicant should have acquired skill training from technical institutions such as ITIs/ Polytechnic colleges etc.

name: National Family Assistance Scheme- Chhattisgarh
brief_description: The scheme "National Family Assistance Scheme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the bereaved household in the case of the naturalRs. unnaturalRs. or accidental death of the primary breadwinner of a family living Below the Poverty Line (BPL). This scheme is centrally sponsored.
benefits: - Under this schemeRs. the eligible family will receive a lump sum amount of 20Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be a family member of the deceased person.
1. The deceased person should have been the primary breadwinner on whom the family primarily depended for income.
1. The family should have lost the primary breadwinner due to naturalRs. unnaturalRs. or accidental death.
1. The family of the deceased primary breadwinner should be living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
1. At the time of deathRs. the deceased primary breadwinner should have been between 18 and 59 years old.

**Note 1:** The term "family" includes the husbandRs. wifeRs. minor childrenRs. unmarried daughtersRs. and dependent parents.
**Note 2:** If there is more than one earning member in the familyRs. assistance will be provided only upon the death of the member whose income contributes the most to the family.

name: Marriage Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The "Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare BoardRs. Department of LabourRs. KarnatakaRs. is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this SchemeRs. financial support shall be provided to registered construction workers who have one (1) year of membership with the Board before the marriageRs. to cover expenses for either their own marriage or their two (2) dependent children's marriages.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 60Rs./- for the worker's own marriage or their two (2) dependent children's marriages. > **Note:** The family of a registered construction worker can avail this assistance only twiceRs. HoweverRs. there shall be only one claim in respect of a given marriage irrespective of the number of registered construction workers in the family.
eligibility:
> ***For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:***


- The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
- The applicant should be a minimum of 18 years of age.
- The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.

> **For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:**


- The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka or a dependent child of the worker.
- The membership with the Board should be at least one (1) year before the marriage.
- The family can avail of this assistance only twice.
- The son or daughter must be of legal age for marriage.

name: Incentive for the Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Caste Community
brief_description: The Karnataka Social Welfare Department provides an incentive to promote intra-caste marriages within different sub-castes of Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST). The scheme offers 2Rs./- for such marriagesRs. with an option for 1Rs./- if the simple marriage grant is availed. This initiative aims to reduce casteism and foster unity within SC/ST communities in Karnataka.
benefits: **Incentive Amount:** - 2Rs./- if an SC/ST boy or girl marries a person from a different SC/ST sub-caste. - 1Rs./- if the couple has availed of the simple marriage grant. **Subsidy Disbursement:** The incentive is provided in two installments: - 50% in cash. - 50% as a fixed deposit with a minimum term of 3 years.
eligibility:
1. The couple should belong to different sub caste of SC.
1. The bride and groom should be residing in Karnataka.
1. The family income of the applicant should not exceed 2Rs./-.
1. The age of the bride should be between 18 to 42 years at the time of marriage.
1. The age of the groom should be between 21 to 45 years at the time of marriage.

name: Financial Assistance for Studies (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Financial Assistance for Studies" scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. under the Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. educational financial support is provided to the children of registered workers who have been members of the Board for at least one year. It covers full tuition fees for students admitted to prestigious government institutes like IITRs. IIMRs. and AIIMS. AdditionallyRs. the scheme offers one-time financial assistance for pursuing B.Tech or equivalent coursesRs. Polytechnic/Nursing diplomasRs. or ITI courses in government institutions.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following financial assistance is provided to the children of registered building and construction workers:

1. Full tuition fees are covered for admission to prestigious government institutes like IITRs. IIMRs. AIIMSRs. etc.
1. A one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided upon admission to a B.Tech. or equivalent course in a government institution.
1. A one-time financial assistance of 10Rs./- is provided for pursuing a PolytechnicRs. NursingRs. or equivalent diploma course in a government institution.
1. A one-time financial assistance of 5Rs./- is provided for pursuing an ITI or equivalent course in a government institution.
eligibility:
1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
2. The worker should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
3. The registered worker should have a minimum of one year of continuous membership.
4. The worker's membership should be active at the time of application.
5. The children of registered workers should be pursuing or have been admitted to one of the following regular technical or professional courses:
Admission to prestigious government institutes like IITRs. IIMRs. AIIMSRs. etc.
Admission to a B.Tech or equivalent course in a government institution.
Pursuing a PolytechnicRs. NursingRs. or equivalent diploma course in a government institution.
Pursuing an ITI or equivalent course in a government institution

name: Scheme for the Funeral Expenses
brief_description: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "Scheme for the Funeral Expenses". The scheme provides financial support to the family of a registered building and construction worker in the event of their deathRs. whether due to natural causes or an accident. This scheme aims to ease the financial burden associated with funeral expenses and ensure proper transportation of the bodyRs. if requiredRs. within the state.
benefits: - **Financial assistance of 20Rs./- for funeral expenses.**
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be the nomineeRs. dependentRs. or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
1. The deceased should be a registered construction worker under the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The death of the deceased worker must be due to accidental or natural death.

name: Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses (JKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour DepartmentRs. Jammu and KashmirRs. is a welfare program for registered workers. Under this schemeRs. 5Rs./- is provided as funeral assistance to the nominee or legal heir upon the death of the registered worker.
benefits: 5Rs./- is provided as funeral assistance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be the nominee or legal heir of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker must have been registered with the Jammu and Kashmir Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker must have been an active member of the Board at the time of death.
1. The scheme can be applied for only once.

name: Jharkhand Rajya Patrakar Swasth Bima Yojna Niyamawali 2021
brief_description: The Jharkhand Rajya Patrakar Swasth Bima Yojna Niyamawali 2021 was launched by the Information and Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide health insurance to the journalists and their families by covering medical expensesRs. including hospitalization. It provides comprehensive health coverage to ensure financial security during medical emergencies.
benefits:
- Health insurance coverage up to 5Rs./- per year for accredited journalists. - Coverage for selfRs. spouseRs. and dependent children (up to 2). - Includes expenses for hospitalizationRs. surgeriesRs. medicinesRs. and treatments. - Cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals.
> **Note-1:** The Jharkhand State Journalist Health Insurance Scheme is valid for one yearRs. with renewal formalities required before its expiry. > **Note-2:** Media representatives must deposit 20% of the annual premium via bankers cheque/cheque/demand draft for health insurance coverage up to 5Rs./- to the designated account of the DirectorRs. Information & Public Relations DirectorateRs. Jharkhand GovernmentRs. by the specified date. The remaining 80% of the annual premium will be covered by the Department.
> **Claim Process:** - The insured media representative must provide complete details of dependents (spouse and two children) and nominate a beneficiary for claim settlement in the application form to receive medical reimbursement from the insurance company. - In case of treatment or an accidentRs. it is mandatory to inform the insurance company's district office and the Information and Public Relations DepartmentRs. RanchiRs. within a maximum of seven days.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must reside in Jharkhand and their work area should be within the state.
1. The applicant should be an accredited journalist in Jharkhand.
1. The media representatives must be from newspapersRs. magazinesRs. news agenciesRs. electronic mediaRs. or news-based electronic media.
1. The applicant must be regularly or contractually employed by the respective media organization.
1. The applicant must possess an accreditation certificate issued by the state government.
1. The journalist's age should be between 21 to 60 years.
1. Freelance journalists must present valid press credentials issued by the Information and Public Relations Department at the time of applying.
1. The insurance coverage will include the media representative's spouse and two unmarried and dependent children up to the age of 21 years.

name: Payment of Death Benefit ( HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Payment of Death Benefit" schemeRs. introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) under the Government of Himachal PradeshRs. provides 4Rs. (four lakhs) to the nominees or dependents of a registered member in the event of accidental deathRs. and 2Rs. (two lakhs) in case of natural death.
benefits:
- 4Rs. in the event of accidental death.
- 2Rs. in the event of natural death.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the "Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
1. The membership of the deceased worker with the Welfare Board must be active.

name: Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries (HPBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries" schemeRs. launched by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) under the Government of Himachal PradeshRs. offers registered beneficiaries and their dependents annual financial support for medical expensesRs. including 50Rs. for outdoor treatmentRs. 1Rs. for indoor medical reimbursementRs. and 5Rs. for critical illnessesRs. provided they submit valid medical bills from government hospitals or government-approved facilities.
benefits:
- 50Rs. is provided annually for outdoor medical treatment.
- 1Rs. is available each year for indoor medical expenses.
- 5Rs. is granted yearly for critical illness treatment for the registered beneficiary and dependentsRs. with valid medical bills.
eligibility:
**For Registration** 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be aged between 18 and 60 years. 1. The worker should have completed at least 90 days of building and other construction work in the last 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.
**For Application** 1. The applicant must be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The applicant must be registered under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB). 1. The workers membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.

name: Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters
brief_description: Launched in 2010-11Rs. the scheme "Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters" by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to honour the third-generation descendants of freedom fighters by providing financial assistance for higher education. Through this schemeRs. eligible students receive a monthly stipend and an annual allowance for books to support their education. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Higher EducationRs. Haryana. The stipend is available for students pursuing non-professional courses in government and government-aided colleges and universities within the state. The assistance is provided on a merit basis and is subject to attendance and good conduct requirements.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance**
Eligible students receive 1Rs. per month as a stipend for 12 months and 2Rs. per year as an allowance for books.
**Coverage**
The scheme applies to students pursuing non-professional courses in government and government-aided colleges and universities in Haryana.
**Good Conduct Requirement**
Scholarship installments are released only upon obtaining a good conduct and attendance certificate from the principal/head of the institution.
**Reinstatement Condition**
If a student drops out but re-joins and attends at least 50% of classes in three monthsRs. both the previously due installment and the current quarters installment are released.
**Mode of Disbursement**

- Payment is made via electronic transaction to the students bank account.
- In exceptional casesRs. payment may be made through a demand draft.

**Frequency of Disbursement**
The stipend is paid in four instalments per year:

- September: For July & August
- November: For September & October
- January: For November & December
- March: For January to June
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a grandchild (third generation) of a freedom fighter.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be enrolled in a government or government-aided college/university in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a non-professional course.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous examination based on which admission was granted.
