1. The applicant should maintain satisfactory attendance and conduct.
1. The applicant should not have failed the previous years university examination.

**Reinstatement Criteria:**
If a student drops out but re-joins classes and maintains at least 50% attendance for three monthsRs. the previous and current quarters stipend is released.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana" was implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide financial assistance for the upbringing and education of children of specially-abled parents. Under this schemeRs. children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistanceRs. the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.
benefits:
1. Financial assistance of 500/- per month for children aged 0-6 years.
1. Financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month for children aged 6-18 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. Only children aged 0 to 18 years of specially-abled parents are eligible for assistance.
1. The child must be between 2 to 5 years of age and enrolled in an Anganwadi or school.
1. Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution.
1. The family's annual income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana
brief_description:
The scheme "Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana" was introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Rajasthan. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided in three instalments to Gadiya Lohar families in Rajasthan for the construction of permanent houses and ensuring their settlement.
***Objectives:***

- To provide permanent houses to the Gadiya Lohar families.
- To provide financial assistance in three installments for house construction.
- To promote the social and economic integration of Gadiya Lohars community.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:**

- 1Rs./- is provided to each eligible beneficiary.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- First Installment: 40Rs./- is provided after verification of land ownership and submission of required documents.
- Second Installment: 40Rs./- is disbursed after verification of construction progress.
- Third Installment: 40Rs./- is given upon completion of construction and submission of utilization proof.

**Frequency & Validity:**

- This is a one-time financial grant.
- The entire house construction must be completed within one year from the approval of the first installment.

***Note:***

- If a beneficiary misuses the grantRs. legal action will be takenRs. and the amount will be recovered.
- The constructed house cannot be sold or transferred for 20 years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Gadiya Lohar community.
1. The applicant should own a plot for house construction.
1. The applicant or their family should not own any other house within the district or anywhere in Rajasthan.

name: Aastha Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Aastha Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Rajasthan. It aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with multiple specially-abled members. Under this schemeRs. eligible families receive free medical treatmentRs. ration suppliesRs. and other welfare benefits. To avail of the benefitsRs. a family must possess an Aastha CardRs. and their annual income should not exceed 1.20 lakh.
benefits:
- Aastha cardholder families receive benefits similar to BPL familiesRs. including free medical treatment and ration supplies.

**Note:** Aastha cardholders are entitled to benefits from all BPL-related schemes run by different state government departments.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The two or more members should be specially abled from the same family.
1. The applicant must have a disability of 40%.
1. The annual family income should not exceed 1Rs./-.

name: Assistance for Daughter's Marriage
brief_description: The "Assistance for Daughter's Marriage" schemeRs. introduced by the Department of Sainik WelfareRs. Government of RajasthanRs. aims to provide financial support to widows of ex-servicemen for their daughters' marriages. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 25Rs./- per daughter is provided for a maximum of two marriageable daughters of widows of ex-servicemen up to the rank of HavaldarRs. who are not receiving the Marriage Grant from the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB). The financial assistanceRs. drawn from the Amalgamated FundRs. is payable to the beneficiary upon applying within one year from the date of marriage.
benefits: - Financial assistance of 25Rs./- per daughter (up to two daughters) is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be the widow of an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below.
1. The assistance is available for a maximum of two daughters of the widow of an ex-serviceman.
1. The daughter should be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
1. The daughters name should be duly recorded in the ex-servicemans discharge book or Part-2 order.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the respective District Sainik Welfare Office.
1. The applicant should not have received marriage assistance for the same purpose from the Kendriya Sainik Board.
1. The application should be submitted within one year from the date of marriage to be eligible for assistance under this scheme.
1. Widows of ex-servicemen who are classified as Battle Casualties or Physical Casualties (attributable cases) are not eligible under this schemeRs. as marriage assistance in such cases is provided by the Army Headquarters.
1. If the applicant is eligible for the Daughter Marriage Assistance Scheme run by the Kendriya Sainik Board for ex-servicemenRs. then financial aid from the Amalgamated Fund shall not be granted.
1. The benefit shall be extended only to the widow of an ex-serviceman who meets the definition of an ex-serviceman as prescribed by the Government of India.

name: Family Pension Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Family Pension Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the spouse of a registered construction worker in the event of the workers deathRs. if the deceased was a pensioner.
benefits: - **Pension Amount:** 500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pensionRs. whichever is higher.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be the spouse (husband/wife) of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been receiving a pension from the Board at the time of death.

name: Financial Assistance for funeral and other activities in case of death of a worker's - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Funeral and Other Activities in Case of Death of a Worker" is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to provide financial support to the family or dependent of a deceased worker to cover funeral and related expenses. Under this schemeRs. an assistance amount of 15Rs./- is provided to the dependent/family of the deceased worker.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 15Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be fully dependent on the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at the time of death.
1. The applicant should not have previously availed benefits under this scheme.
1. There is no minimum service period or ceiling required under this scheme.
1. The application should be submitted within two years from the date of the workers death.

name: Family Planning Indemnity Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Family Planning Indemnity Scheme" was launched by the Directorate of Health ServicesRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to provide compensation for deathRs. failureRs. or complications following sterilization operationsRs. addressing the financial burden and risks associated with family planning procedures. The scheme provides compensation ranging from 60Rs./- for sterilization failure to 4Rs./- for death following sterilizationRs. along with coverage for treatment costs up to 50Rs./- for complications arising within 60 days post-operation.
benefits: **Section A:** Death following sterilization (inclusive of death during sterilization operation) in hospital or within 7 days from discharge - 4Rs./-. **Section B:** Death following sterilization within 8-30 days from discharge - 1Rs./-. **Section C:** Failure of sterilization - 60Rs./-. **Section D:** Cost of treatment in hospital and up to 60 days arising out of complications following sterilization operation - Actual cost not exceeding 50Rs./-. > ***Conditions*** _*The claimant must accept the compensation amount as full settlement with no further claim rights._ _*The claimant must warrant the truth of all particulars providedRs. with forfeiture of compensation for false statements._ _*The claimant must agree that the compensation covers all aspects of the claim with no additional benefits._
eligibility: ##### ***For Beneficiary (Person who underwent Sterilization)*** - The applicant must be a person who has undergone sterilization operation under family planning program. - The applicant must have undergone sterilization operation at an authorized health facility. - The applicant must be able to provide documentary evidence of the sterilization procedure. ##### ***For Claimant (Family Member or Legal Representative)*** - The applicant must be a legal claimant or family member of the person who underwent sterilization (in case of death or incapacitation). - The applicant should have legal authority to represent the beneficiary in case of death or inability to claim. > ***Conditions*** _*The applicant must report complicationsRs. failureRs. or death within the specified timeframes as per scheme guidelines._ _*The applicant must submit the claim through proper medical channels with certification from authorized medical officers._

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Financial Assistance for Funeral of the Artist" component of the scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased Goan artists by assisting them in meeting funeral expensesRs. thereby acknowledging the contributions of artists and supporting their families during difficult times. The component provides financial assistance of up to 10Rs./- to cover expenses related to the funeral of a recognized Goan artist. The applicant must be a family member of the deceased artist. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: - Financial assistance of up to a maximum of 10Rs./- shall be sanctioned to meet expenses in connection with the funeral of the Goan artist. - The benefit is provided as a one-time lump sum grant. - The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible member of artist's family in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a family member of the deceased artist. - The deceased artist must have been born and brought up in Goa. - The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The family income of the deceased artist (from all sources) must not exceed 2Rs./- per annum. - The applicant must not have claimed or received funeral assistance benefits from any other government source for the same purpose.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
brief_description: The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. The "Lumpsum Grant" component of the scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum 20Rs./-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
benefits: - Financial Assistance in the form of a lumpsum grantRs. maximum of 20Rs./- shall be provided. - The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. > ***Conditions*** - The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant. - In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artistRs. the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio.
eligibility: - The deceased artist must have been GoanRs. i.e.Rs. born and brought up in Goa. - The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & CultureRs. Government of Goa. - The deceased artist must not have been less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must be the dependent family member of the deceased artist. - The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant. - In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artistRs. the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio. - The annual income of the family of the deceased artist (from all the sources) must be less than 25Rs./- per annum.

name: Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services
brief_description: The Incentive Honorarium to Parents of Permanent Residents of Madhya Pradesh who enroll their Daughter in Defence Services scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. a monetary incentive per year is provided to the parents of daughters who are serving or have served in the defense services.
benefits: **Annual Honorarium:** - 20Rs. per year is granted to the parents whose daughters are serving or have retired from the defense services. **Mode of Disbursement:** - The sanctioned amount is directly credited to the beneficiarys bank account through the District Sainik Welfare Office.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be the mother or father of a daughter serving or retired from any recognized defense service (ArmyRs. NavyRs. or Air Force). 1. The applicants daughter must be serving in a recognized defense unit or retired not more than five years ago.

name: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
brief_description: The scheme "Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of UPNL Employees During Service" is implemented by Uttarakhand Purv Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited (UPNL) under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employees death during their service period.
benefits: A one-time ex-gratia payment of 1Rs./- shall be made from the UPNL fund to the family/legal dependents of a UPNL employee in the event of the employees death during the service period.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a legal dependent of the deceased UPNL employee. 1. The deceased employee must have been a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have been nominated during the service period of the deceased employee to receive the ex-gratia amount.

name: Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan
brief_description: The scheme "Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan" is implemented by the State Sainik Board under the Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide financial assistance to the widows/dependents of soldiers and paramilitary personnel who were martyred in warsRs. border clashesRs. or internal security operations. Under this schemeRs. a one-time lump sum grant of 10 lakh is providedRs. subject to eligibility criteria based on the martyrs family status.
benefits: - **One-Time Grant:** 10Rs./- per martyr
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a widow or dependent of a soldier or paramilitary force personnel martyred in a warRs. border conflictRs. or internal security operation. > **Distribution Criteria:** (a) In case the martyr was married: - Widow (Veer Nari) 60% of the grant amount - Parents 40% of the grant amount (b) If the parents are not aliveRs. then the full prescribed amount shall be given to the widow (Veer Nari) and where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive then 40% of the prescribed amount shall be given to the parents and 60% shall be distributed equally among all the dependent children. (c) In a situation where the parents and the widow (Veer Nari) are not aliveRs. the prescribed amount shall be divided equally among all the dependent children. (d) In a situation where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive and has no childrenRs. the entire prescribed amount will be given to the parents.(e) In a situation where the martyr is unmarried or widowerRs. the prescribed amount will be given to the parents.

name: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered construction workers for building toilets. The financial assistance is disbursed in two installments.
benefits: > Under the schemeRs. registered construction workers receive financial assistance of 12Rs./- in two installments for the construction of toilets. - **First Installment:** 8Rs./- - **Second Installment:** 4Rs./-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Maternity Assistance scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this schemeRs. financial support during childbirth is provided to eligible women drivers or the wives of registered male drivers and conductors to ensure income security during maternity and paternity periods.
benefits: - Financial assistance equivalent to 45 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided to the registered woman driver or conductor. - In case the registered beneficiary is maleRs. financial assistance equivalent to 45 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided to his wife. - An additional amount equivalent to 15 days of wages at the Collector Rate is provided as paternity leave compensation to the father of the child. - A cash assistance of 1Rs. is provided towards delivery-related expenses under the Janani Suraksha Yojana.
eligibility: > **General Eligibility:** 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should hold a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. > **Maternity-Specific Eligibility:** 1. The applicant should be a registered female driver or conductor or the wife of a registered male driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should be applying for maternity assistance for not more than 2 deliveries. 1. The applicant should comply with the norms prescribed under the Janani Suraksha Yojana for delivery-related benefits.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Scholarship
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Scholarship scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme supports the educational advancement of registered driversRs. conductorsRs. and their dependents by providing scholarshipsRs. based on prevailing government normsRs. to eligible students from Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. and economically weaker general category families.
benefits: - The scholarship amount is provided to eligible students for education. - The scholarship was provided as per the norms of the concerned department. - Categories covered include Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. and the economically weaker general category.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled CasteRs. Scheduled TribeRs. Other Backward ClassRs. or economically weaker general category. 1. The applicant should meet educational and income criteria prescribed under the relevant scholarship scheme.

name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance
brief_description: The Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Marriage Assistance scheme has been launched by the Transport DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of daughters of registered transport vehicle drivers and conductors belonging to the unorganized sector to reduce the financial burden on low-income families.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance for the marriage of daughters of registered transport vehicle drivers or conductors. 1. Assistance is provided as per the prevailing rates and conditions of the "[Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana](https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/schemes/view/SWhoak9tZGNSMnpISG9jbndQckN4UT09)". - Under this schemeRs. the following assistance is provided: - Each eligible bride (including girlsRs. widowsRs. or abandoned women) participating in the mass marriage ceremony will receive a total of 49Rs./- through an Account Payee ChequeRs. on the day of the mass marriage ceremony.The organizing body that conducts the mass marriage ceremony will receive 6Rs./- per beneficiary. > **NOTE:** - A total of 55Rs./- is provided per beneficiary under the scheme. - The monetary amount is as notified by the Social Justice Department under the Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana and may change from time to time.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license or conductor's license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants name should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicants daughter should be unmarried at the time of application. 1. The marriage should be conducted as per the conditions of the Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana. 1. The applicant should not be a government employee.

name: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
brief_description: The Kaidi Sahay YojanaRs. initiated by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial relief to families of prisoners who are undergoing sentences in jails and are the main or sole earners of their households. Under this schemeRs. a one-time financial assistance of 25Rs./- is granted to the prisoners familyRs. ensuring that they can sustain themselves through self-employment during the imprisonment period.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** A one-time assistance of 25Rs./-.
eligibility: - Applicant must be a family member of a prisoner currently serving sentence in a state jail in Gujarat. - The prisoner should be the sole or main earner of the family. - The prisoner's family must be economically dependent on the prisoner. - The total family income should not exceed 1Rs./- per annum. - The family should not be fragmented (i.e.Rs. should be living together and dependent on the prisoner).

name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)
brief_description: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)" is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. Under this schemeRs. eligible applicants from the Nomadic Tribe (NT) and Denotified Tribe (DNT) are given up to 1Rs./- for constructing a house. Priority is given to individuals from BPL families.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 1Rs./- for house construction.
eligibility:
- Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
- Applicant must belong to the [Nomadic Tribe (NT)/ Denotified Tribe (DNT)](https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Draft%20List%20of%20Denotified%20Tribes%20for%20Mail.pdf). - Applicants annual family income must not exceed 6Rs./-.

name: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana
brief_description: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana (SUMAN) is a maternity benefit initiative launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The scheme aims to provide affordableRs. high-quality healthcare solutions to pregnant women and newborns. Under this schemeRs. ensuring assuredRs. dignifiedRs. respectfulRs. and quality healthcare services at zero cost for all pregnant womenRs. mothersRs. and newborns visiting public health facilities. **Objectives of the SUMAN scheme:** - To achieve zero preventable maternal and newborn deaths. - To ensure assuredRs. freeRs. and quality healthcare services for every pregnant woman and newborn. - To provide dignified and respectful careRs. maintaining privacy and confidentiality. - To enforce zero tolerance for denial of services at public health facilities. - To ensure comprehensive maternal and newborn careRs. including antenatalRs. deliveryRs. and postnatal services.
benefits: > **Under SUMANRs. beneficiaries are entitled to the following free and cashless services at designated public health facilities:** **Maternal Health Services** - Minimum 4 Antenatal Care (ANC) check-upsRs. including one in the first trimester - At least one check-up under Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) - Free and cashless normal delivery and Caesarean section (C-section) - Management of pregnancy-related complications **Newborn & Infant Care** - Free care for sick newborns and infants - Zero-dose vaccinations (as per the government schedule) - 6 Home-Based Newborn Care (HBNC) visits - Early initiation and support for breastfeeding **Transport & Logistics** - Free transport from home to the health facility - Inter-facility referral transport - Drop-back facility after discharge **Other Entitlements** - Free drugsRs. diagnosticsRs. and blood services - Postnatal care and counselingRs. including family planning - Respectful maternity careRs. ensuring dignityRs. privacyRs. and choice - Zero out-of-pocket expenditure for all entitled services
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant must be a mother (post-delivery) seeking services at a public health facility. 1. Newborns aged 0 to 6 months old will be able to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. After deliveryRs. lactating mothers up to 6 months from delivery are also eligible for this scheme.

name: Central Assistance For One Time Settlement Of Displaced Families From PoK And Chhamb Under Prime Minister's Development Package
brief_description: The scheme "Central Assistance for One Time Settlement of Displaced Families from PoK and Chhamb under Prime Minister's Development Package" has been launched by the Ministry of Home AffairsRs. Government of IndiaRs. and provides one-time financial assistance to displaced families of PoK and Chhamb settled in Jammu & Kashmir. aims to provide supplementary financial assistance so as to enable the families to run small business or to undertake scientific farmingRs. livestock or other land-based activitiesRs. which can provide the displaced families some assured and sustained earning. The amount of assistance can also be invested in any annuity schemeRs. which can give an assured monthly income on a sustainable basis. The scheme will have a State share of 308 and a Central share of 5Rs. per familyRs. amounting to 5Rs. per displaced family.
benefits: 1. The applicant is provided with one-time financial assistance of 5Rs. per displaced family. 1. The assistance consists of: - Central Government share: 5Rs. per family. - State Government share: 308 per family. 1. The financial assistance can be used by displaced families for: - Running small businesses. - Undertaking scientific farming. - Undertaking livestock activities. - Undertaking other land-based activities for assured and sustained earnings. 1. The assistance amount may also be invested in an annuity scheme to provide assured monthly income on a sustainable basis. > **Mode of Disbursement:** - The Central Assistance of 5Rs. per family is transferred directly to eligible beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Central Government. - The State Government's share of 308 per family is transferred to beneficiaries through DBT.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be the Claimant/Head of the Displaced Person (DP) family or his/her successor or heir residing within the State of Jammu & Kashmir. 1. The applicant should belong to the overall category of 36Rs. displaced families. 1. The applicant should belong to any of the following categories: - Pakistan Occupied Jammu & Kashmir 1947 Displaced Persons. - Chhamb 1965 and 1971 (camp/non-camp) Displaced Persons.

name: Orunodoi 3.0
brief_description:
OrunodoiRs. described as the 'foremost bead' among the Ashtadash Mukutar Unnoyonee MaalaRs. was announced by the then Hon'ble Finance Minister in his Budget Speech 2020-21. The scheme envisages women's empowermentRs. poverty alleviationRs. and socio-economic inclusion of financially vulnerable women of the state through sustained financial assistance on a monthly basis so that they are assured of minimum monthly cash flow. Since substantial time has elapsedRs. it is essential to update information and implement the scheme with improved standards and procedures. It is necessary to phase out Orunodoi 1.0 and Orunodoi 2.0Rs. without transferring any legacy dataRs. to effectively launch Orunodoi 3.0. HoweverRs. while selecting the beneficiaries of Orunodoi 3.0Rs. the district administration will take utmost care that the eligible beneficiaries of Orunodoi 1.0 and Orunodoi 2.0 are not removed/deleted from the scheme whimsicallyRs. unless they now do not conform to the Orunodoi 3.0 guidelines.
The basic precondition to become a beneficiary for Orunodoi 3.0 is that the individual must be enrolled under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) as a beneficiary. For the purpose of implementation of this schemeRs. the definitions of householdRs. familyRs. income criterionRs. etc.Rs. will be as per extant NFSA guidelines. This new phase of Orunodoi will have the provision of automatic AADHAAR seeding of beneficiariesRs. a proven method for efficiently disbursing benefits to Antyodaya across the countryRs. as in AssamRs. almost every NFSA beneficiary are already AADHAAR seeded.
benefits:
1) The Assam govt. runs this scheme for those women who belong to the low-income groups of society to support them financially.
2) Each beneficiary will get 1250 rupees per month on the very first date of every month. The Orunodoi 3.0 Scheme covers the expenses for medicines for taking care of health needsRs. which is 400 rupees per family; Rs. 200 per family is given to provide a 50% subsidy for the 4 kg of pulses of a family; 80 rupees are given as the 50% subsidy for 4 kg of sugar; 150 rupees are given for the fruits & vegetables; Rs. 150 are given for the essential needs; Rs. 170 for covid-19 expenses; and Rs. 250 for a subsidy for 50 units of electricity. And this amount is consolidated to Rs. 1250 per month for a family.
3) Orunodoi Scheme 3.0 will provide financial assistance of Rs. 1250 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility: If any of the following criteria is observed in case of an applicantRs. it will be sufficient for inclusion under the scheme. 1. WidowRs. unmarried (above the age of 45 yrs) 2. Transgender 3. Person with disabilityRs. as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities ActRs. 2016Rs. irrespective of gender 4. Old/Infirm woman including those residing in Government registered old age home 5. Women of the HouseholdRs. where earning members are either disabled or aged (more than sixty years of age) 6. Woman in householdRs. where any member is suffering from HIV/ Thalassemia/ Haemophilia/ Cerebral Palsy/ Leprosy/ Autism spectrum disorder 7. Woman in household without shelter 8. Destitute woman living on alms 9. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) woman beneficiary 10. Women in the householdRs. composite income of which is less than Rs.2 lacs per annum.

name: Sneha Sparsha
brief_description: Launched on 30th December 2021Rs. the "Sneha Sparsha" is a healthcare scheme by the Dept. of Health & Family WelfareRs. Govt. of Assam. In this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided for specialized treatment of children below 12 years of age affected with some serious ailments. Families with annual income less than 2Rs. shall be eligible for availing benefits under the schemeRs. while priority shall be given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
benefits:
> **Permitted procedure and the maximum amount admissible:**
**Bone Marrow Transplant:** Leukemia (Blood Cancer) and other conditions like ThalassemiaRs. in which Bone Marrow Transplant may be considered as a mode of treatmentRs. financial assistance up to 10Rs. per case for referral of such cases to 'leading Hospitals outside the state equipped with facilities for such treatment.
**Cochlear Implant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to 5Rs. per case to BPL beneficiaries and 3Rs. per case to APL beneficiaries for referral of such cases to a Hospital outside the stateRs. if necessary.
**Liver Transplant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to 16Rs. per case to BPL beneficiaries and 10Rs. per case to APL beneficiaries. Necessary arrangements shall be made for referral of such cases to leading Hospitals outside the state with state-of-the-art facilities for such treatment.
**Kidney Transplant:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to 3Rs. per case to BPL beneficiaries and 2Rs. per case to APL beneficiaries for referral of such cases to Hospitals outside the stateRs. if necessary. **Artificial Limb:** The scheme will offer financial assistance of up to 1Rs. for Cosmetic Limbs and up to 2Rs. if a Motorized Artificial Limb is considered necessary.
**Blood Cancer:** For treatment of Blood Cancer in children with ChemotherapyRs. financial assistance of up to 1Rs. per case will be given.
**Specialized Eye Surgery:** like Retinal Surgery or Posterior Segment ProceduresRs. an amount of 15Rs. will be given as assistance.
**Tumors:** Solid tumors needing costly investigations and treatment with Chemotherapy and Radiotherapy will be given financial assistance of up to 25Rs.. Children in need of cancer-related surgery will be given financial assistance of up to 50Rs..
**Neurological Anomalies:** Hydrocephalus and Spina Bifida will be given assistance up to 50Rs. for investigationRs. surgical treatmentRs. and rehabilitation.
**Thalassemia:** Financial assistance of 1Rs. will be provided to children suffering from ThalassemiaRs. who are not fit for Bone Marrow Transplant but require specialized treatment like splenectomyRs. blood transfusionRs. and associated medicines.
**NOTE 1:** The rates notified are indicative and the actual admissible amount shall be fixed through a transparent process. **NOTE 2:** Out of theseRs. the first five points shall be considered for referral outside the StateRs. and the rest of the procedures (6 to 10) treatment is available in the Medical College Hospitals and other Hospitals inside the state.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a child below 12 years of age.
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of the state of Assam.
1. The beneficiary should be affected by some serious ailment(s).
1. The annual income of the family of the beneficiary should be less than 5Rs. while priority shall be given to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

name: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
brief_description:
Financial help on death of family head scheme was launched by Rajasthan state government under tribal area development on 20/08/2008. 10Rs./- to the wife of the deceased on the premature death of the head of the family of Saharia primitive tribe. Financial assistance is provided so that the family does not face financial burden immediately after the death of the head of the family and his family can be helped.
Scheme Delivery Time :180 Days Designated Officer of Scheme :ADDITIONAL DISTRICT MAGISTRATE FINANCIAL HELP ON DEATH OF FAMILY HEAD is implemented in the following District :Baran
eligibility: 1. The person must be from Sahariya Tribe (ST)

name: Incentive For The Devadasi Childrens Marriage
brief_description:
Under this schemeRs. the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Karnataka will give incentives to the Devadasi's Children's Married Couple. To avail this schemeRs. both bride and groom should belong to SC Community. The incentive will be provided only to those who have submitted applications within 1.5 years (18 months) of marriage. The couple who are married on or after 01-04-2018 are eligible for a revised rate of incentive (i.e. 3.00 lakh for menRs. 5.00 lakh for women) The annual family income of the applicant should be below Rs.5Rs./-
The following are the eligibility criteria for this scheme - Applicant should be a resident of Karnataka state. - Applicant should belong to the SC community. - Family income from all sources should be within Rs. 5 lakhs per annum. - The scheme is applicable within 18 months of marriage. The following documents are required while applying for this scheme - Aadhaar - RD Number of Caste Certificate - RD Number of Income Certificate - Copy of the Bank Passbook - Marriage Registration Certificate - Marriage Photo - Mobile Number - Devadasi Registration Certificate
eligibility: - Applicant should be a resident of Karnataka state. - Applicant should belong to the SC community. - Family income from all sources should be within Rs. 5 lakh per annum. - The scheme is applicable within 18 months of marriage.

name: Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana
brief_description:
Launched on 15th August 2018Rs. "Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana" is a flagship program of the Department of Health and Family WelfareRs. Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to accord quality and cashless healthcare services to the indigenous people of the state and government employees and reduce out-of-pocket (OOP) expenses during major illness and hospitalizationRs. thereby envisaging universal healthcare for all sections of society.
> **Objectives**


- To reduce the financial hardship on people in the state due to disease and hospitalization.
- To equitably ensure assured access to quality health care for all bonafide citizens of the state.
- To provide quality health care benefits for state government employees and their dependents.
- To make the public health system efficientRs. effectiveRs. and self-reliant by receipt of claim refunds into the individual government hospital accounts.
- To fulfill the secondary and tertiary health care gap in the state.
benefits:
1. Coverage of up to 5Rs. per family per year.
2. Cashless treatments during hospitalization.
3. Pre-existing diseases are inclusively covered.
4. The scheme encompasses expenses for pre-hospitalization for up to 3 days.
5. Post-hospitalization expenses for up to 10 days are covered.
6. Hospitalization expenses include:

- Registration ChargesRs. Bed Charges (General Ward)Rs. Nursing and Boarding ChargesRs. SurgeonsRs. AnaesthetistsRs. Medical PractitionersRs. Consultants FeesRs. etc..
- AnaesthesiaRs. Blood TransfusionRs. OxygenRs. Operating Theatre (OT) ChargesRs. Cost of Surgical AppliancesRs. etc.Rs. Medicines and DrugsRs. Cost of Prosthetic DevicesRs. ImplantsRs. etc.Rs. Pathology and Radiology Tests: Radiology to Include but Not Be Limited to X-rayRs. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)Rs. Computed Tomography (CT) ScanRs. etc.Rs. Diagnosis and TestsRs. etc.Rs. Food for the Patient.

7. Pre and Post-hospitalization expenses encompass costs incurred for consultationRs. diagnostic testsRs. and medicines before the patient's admission to the hospital. AdditionallyRs. it covers the cost of diagnostic tests and medicines up to 10 days post-discharge for the same ailment/surgery.
8. All other expenses related to the patient's treatment within the hospital are also covered.
**NOTE:** In the case the applicant has employment with the state governmentRs. the insurance programs benefits are also available to their dependents.
eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to one of the tribal communities that are recognized by the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
- The applicant should be legally residing in the ChanglangRs. LohitRs. or Namsai Districts of Arunachal Pradesh.
- The applicant should be a member of one of the backward communities.
- The people who are enrolled in the Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) are directly eligible.
- In the case the applicant has employment with the state governmentRs. the insurance programs benefits are also available to their dependents.

name: Sishu Saathi
brief_description: The 'Sishu Saathi' scheme is a healthcare initiative launched by the Health and Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of West BengalRs. that aims to provide free treatment to children needing heart surgeries. Partnering with both government and private hospitalsRs. the scheme ensures that children up to the age of 12Rs. diagnosed with heart conditionsRs. receive free surgery and related care.
benefits: - **Health Screening in Schools:** Free health check-ups in government schools to detect heart ailments at an early stage among children. - **Free Cardiac Surgeries:** Completely free cardiac surgeries for children up to 12 years of age who are diagnosed with heart ailmentsRs. ensuring no financial burden on families.
eligibility:
- All children from 0 to 18 years are eligible.
- Applicable to children residing in both rural and urban areas of West Bengal.
- There is no income criterion; the scheme is open to all children regardless of their family's financial capacity.
- The child must be diagnosed with a cardiac ailment requiring surgical intervention.

name: Su-Swastha Yojana
brief_description: Launched in April 2021Rs. the scheme "Su-Swastha Yojna" by the Department of Health & Family WelfareRs. Government of Sikkim aims to provide comprehensive and affordable healthcare coverage to the employees of the Government of Sikkim and their families. Through this schemeRs. cashless hospitalization at top-tier hospitals across India is provided to the eligible beneficiaries. The scheme covers regular employees in service of the Government of Sikkim and dependent family members up to a maximum of 5 dependents in a scheme that provides 10 lacs of cover to the family per year.
benefits:
**Cashless Convenience:** Cashless admission and discharge across network hospitals eliminate the burden of arranging funds during hospitalization.
**Access to Top-Tier Healthcare:** Beneficiaries gain access to best-in-class healthcare by leveraging a network of top-tier hospitals and institutes across India.
**Quality Assurance:** The Su-Swastha Facilitation Center ensures quality of care by overseeing medical services provided to beneficiaries.
**Transparent Billing:** Standardized tariffs with hospitals based on infrastructure and quality of care promote transparency in billing.
**Patient-Centric Approach:** Communication with patients and their families is maintained throughout the care journey.
**Wide Network Coverage:** Beneficiaries can avail of the scheme's benefits at over 400+ empanelled hospitals within the Su-Swastha Yojna network.
**Comprehensive Coverage:**

- Base Cover - 10 lacs base cover.
- Critical Care Coverage - 10 lacs additional critical care coverage for the entire familyRs. regardless of the number of dependents.

**In-Patient Treatment:** Covers hospitalization expenses exceeding 24 hours.
**Road Ambulance Assistance:** Covers road ambulance expenses up to 3500 per hospitalizationRs. with a maximum of 3 claims per year.
**Pre-existing Disease Coverage:** Covers all pre-existing diseases from the first day of enrollment.
**Post-Hospitalization Care:** Covers medical expenses incurred within 30 days of hospital discharge.
**Specialized Coverage:** Includes coverage for special conditionsRs. treatmentsRs. implantsRs. vehicular accidentsRs. and trauma.
**Maternity Benefits:** Covers delivery expenses up to 50Rs. including newborn baby cover.
**Dental and Ophthalmic Care:** Covers daycare dental and ophthalmic treatmentsRs. including implants.
**Organ Donor Expenses:** Covers expenses incurred for organ transplantation from a donor to a Su-Swastha beneficiaryRs. subject to claim eligibility criteria.
eligibility: The applicant should be a regular employee in service of the Government of Sikkim or the dependent family members of such employee (spouse; brother and/or sister; children (own or legally adopted); parents of self or spouse) (up to a maximum of 5 dependents).

name: Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana
brief_description: A large number of households are pushed into poverty as a result of the high costs of household spending on health care. The Below Poverty Line (BPL) population is especially vulnerable to catastrophic health risks. To address this key vulnerability faced by the BPL population in GujaratRs. the State Government has launched a medical care scheme called Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA) Yojana. The objective of the scheme is to improve access of BPL families to quality medical and surgical care for the treatment of identified diseases involving hospitalizationRs. surgeries and therapies through an em panel network of health care providers.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance** - Each family is eligible for health insurance coverage of up to 5Rs./- annually. - Members of eligible families can avail benefits from any empanelled hospital.
> **Key medical procedures covered:** 1. Eye surgeries 1. EarRs. noseRs. and throat treatments 1. Kidney transplants 1. Cancer treatments 1. Critical accident-related treatments 1. Cardiac surgeries and joint replacements.
> **Surgeries Covered in this Scheme** 1. Cardiovascular Surgeries (a total 153 Benefit Packages) 1. Neurosurgery (a total 49 Benefit Packages) 1. Burns (a total 12 Benefit Packages) 1. Poly Trauma (Not covered by Motor Vehicle Insurance) (a total 8 Benefit Packages) 1. Cancer (Malignancies) (Surgical OncologyRs. Chemotherapy & Radiation Oncology) (a total 210 Benefit Packages) 1. Renal (Kidney) (a total 21 Benefit Packages) 1. Neonatal (newborn) diseases (a total 23 Benefit Packages) Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana provides quality medical and surgical care for catastrophic illnesses involving hospitalizationRs. surgeries and therapies through an em panel network of hospitals to the BPL families.
eligibility:
The individuals and families listed in the BPL list by the State Government are eligible under the MA Yojana. FurthermoreRs. each family member should be present when enrolled under the scheme. HoweverRs. families that belong marginally above the poverty line can be under the MA Vatsalya Yojana if they follow these criteria

1. The annual income of the family is up to 4Rs./-
1. Any member(s) who are Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) workers
1. Any member(s) who have accredited reporters
1. Class-3 and Class-4 employees employed on a fixed payroll by the State Government
1. Senior Citizens with families of a total annual income of up to 6Rs./-

name: Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia
brief_description: "Farmer Suicide Ex-Gratia" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Agriculture & Cooperation Dept. of the Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance of 7Rs. to the family members of the deceased farmers/tenant farmersRs. who commit suicide due to agrarian reasons as a rehabilitation package to support the families of the farmers. The reasons for committing such suicides may be the Failure of Bore wellsRs. Raising of Commercial crops with the high cost of cultivationRs. Non-Remunerative PricesRs. etc.
eligibility:
1. The deceased farmer should have been a resident/domicile of the state of Andhra Pradesh.
1. The cause of death of the farmer should be suicide.
1. The reason for the suicide should be an agrarian reasonRs. such as Failure of Bore wellsRs. Raising of Commercial crops with a high cost of cultivationRs. Non-Remunerative PricesRs. Oral tenancyRs. and ineligibility to avail of Bank LoansRs. Private lending with higher interest ratesRs. Adverse seasonal conditionsRs. Heavy expenditure incurred towards Children educationRs. ill healthRs. and marriages.
1. The term farmer shall include every person who derives substantial livelihood from farmingRs. not limited to those with title to landRs. but including tenant farmers and women farmers.
1. The beneficiary of the financial assistance should be a family member of the deceased farmer.

name: Annath Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
brief_description: "Annath Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of LabourRs. EmploymentRs. Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. In case of the death of the pensionerRs. the pension will be payable at the rate of the family pension and will be evenly divided among orphans below 18 years of age.
eligibility:
1. The deceased should have been domiciled in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The deceased should have been a Registered Worker with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The deceased should have been receiving a pension from the board.
1. The applicant should be a child of the deceased.
1. The applicant should have been orphaned after the death of the pensioner.
1. The applicant should be less than 18 years of age.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Gramin Bhoomihin Krishi Majdoor Nyay Yojana
brief_description:
The objective of the scheme:-

1. To identify landless agricultural laborer families in Gram Panchayat and Nagar Panchayat and provide financial grants to landless agricultural laborer families on an annual basis.
1. To increase the net income of landless agricultural labor families through financial grants.
eligibility:
1. Original residents of Chhattisgarh.
1. Landless agricultural laborer families residing in Gram Panchayat and Nagar Panchayat areas
1. Under the landless agricultural laborer families of Gram Panchayat / Nagar Panchayat areaRs. such as shepherdRs. carpenterRs. blacksmithRs. cobblerRs. barberRs. washermanRs. priest - families associated with Pauni - Pasari systemRs. forest produce collectors and other categories will also be eligibleRs. if that family does not have agricultural land.
1. Persons who worship in the places of worship of tribals in rural and urban areas of Scheduled AreasRs. who are known by the names of Pujari / Baiga / Guniya / Manjhi etc. Baja Moharia will be eligible under the scheme despite holding agricultural land. But those families of this class who are receiving periodic allowance/financial assistance from the government in other schemes will not be eligible.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme
brief_description: The "Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special AssistanceRs. Govt. of Maharashtra. In this schemeRs. financial assistance of 600/- per month is given if there is only one beneficiary in the eligible familyRs. and 900/- per month if there is more than one beneficiary in a family. In order to be eligible for this schemeRs. the name should be in the list of BPL families or the annual income of the family should be less than or equal to 21Rs./-. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a domicile / permanent resident of the state of Maharashtra.
1. The name of the applicant should be in the list of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families OR the annual income of the family should be less than or equal to 21Rs./-.
1. The applicant should be one of the following:

name: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2019Rs. the scheme "Krishak Bandhu Scheme" by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of West BengalRs. aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for agricultural sustainability and risk mitigation. The scheme offers 5Rs./- per acre per year as direct income support and 2Rs./- as death benefit to the family of deceased farmers. Eligible beneficiaries include small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 acres of land and all farmer families in case of death or disability. The scheme is implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of West BengalRs. and applications are accepted both online and offline.
benefits:
**Direct Income Support**

- Farmers with one acre or more of cultivable land receive 10Rs./- per annumRs. payable in two equal installments of 5Rs./- each (one for Kharif and one for Rabi season).
- Farmers with less than one acre of cultivable land receive assistance on a pro-rata basisRs. subject to a minimum of 4Rs./- per annumRs. paid in two equal installments.

**Death/Disability Benefit**

- In the event of the death of a farmer between the ages of 18 and 60 yearsRs. a one-time lump sum grant of 2Rs./- is provided to the legal heirs of the deceased. The farmer must have been enrolled under the Krishak Bandhu scheme at the time of death.


- A one-time lump sum grant of 2Rs./- for permanent disability of the farmer due to accident.

**Disbursement Conditions**

- Income support is linked to land ownership records.
- Death benefit requires submission of legal heir certificates.
- Disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary&#39;s bank account.
eligibility:
**For Income Support**

- The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
- The applicant must own cultivable land (up to 2 acres).
- The applicant must be actively engaged in farming.

**For Death/Disability Benefit**

- The deceased/disabled person must have been a farmer aged 1860 years.
- The applicant must be the legal heir (for death benefit).

name: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: In 2022Rs. Chhattisgarh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana" for the girl child of the family. With this schemeRs. daughters of workers will be able to get educationRs. employment and self-employment.
benefits: Financial Benefits: 20Rs./- only first two girl child.
eligibility:
1. The girl's father or mother or both should be registered as a construction worker in the Board for a period of at least one year.
1. The daughter for whom application has been made should not be registered in any division under the Labor Department.
1. Only two daughters of registered construction workers will be eligible for incentive amount.
1. The age of the daughter should be at least 18 years and should not be more than 21 years.
1. Daughter should be unmarried.
1. The daughter must have passed at least 10th class.
1. There should be a running bank account in the name of the daughter
1. The Parents of the daughter must have been working as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the period of one year preceding the date of application.
1. For payment of incentive amountRs. self-declaration form will be mandatory regarding verification of the beneficiary being a construction worker and the information given by the applicant in the application.
1. Those girls beneficiaries who have already received assistance under Minimata Kanya Vivah Yojana/Rajmata Vijayaraje Kanya Vivah Assistance Yojana operated under the BoardRs. will be not eligible for this scheme.

name: Nirmaan Shramik ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana
benefits:
Incentive amount will be provided to the children who perform excellently at the district / division / state / national level in all recognized sports as follows -

1. Amount at divisional level: 2Rs./-
1. Amount at state level: 5Rs./-
1. Amount at National level : 50Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Benefits will only be provided to children of construction workers who are registered in any district within the state

name: Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana
brief_description:
Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana" for Construction Workers on 09 December 2022. name: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Theka ShramikRs. Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. name: "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
brief_description: The scheme "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" is a Sub-Component under the scheme "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme". The scheme is extended to all the regions of the Union territory of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the sudden demise of the breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.
benefits: 1Rs. as immediate death relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the deceased fishermanRs. received within 15 days to 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the affected family.
eligibility:

- The deceased fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
- The deceased fisherman must have lost his/her life while fishing.
- The deceased fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years.
- The deceased fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.
- The deceased fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.

name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard
brief_description: The scheme "Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard" is a welfare scheme by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Puducherry. This scheme was introduced to promote small family normsRs. uplift the welfare of girl childrenRs. and ease the financial burden on parents during their daughter's marriage. The scheme provides 25Rs./- financial assistance for single girl children studying in 8th to 10th standard.
benefits:
- 25Rs./- will be deposited in a fixed deposit in the Post Office in the form of a National Savings Certificate in the name of the Girl Child.
- The maturity amount will be released when the girl child attains the age of eighteen years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years.
1. The applicant should have an annual income not exceeding 75Rs./-.
1. The applicant should have only one living girl child and no other issue.

name: Funeral Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be given to the nominees/dependents of a deceased registered workerRs. towards funeral expenses.
benefits: 1. The financial assistance of 5Rs./- shall be given to the nominees/dependents of a deceased registered workerRs. towards funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Assam.
1. The applicant should be a nominee/dependent of deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building and other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership with the Board.

name: Death Benefit (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief_description: The scheme Death Benefit was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)Rs. Labour Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Assam. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be given to the nominees/dependents of a registered worker towards death benefitRs. in case of normal death or due to an accident during the course of employment.
benefits:

1. The financial assistance of 3Rs./- shall be given to the nominee/dependents of a registered construction workerRs. in case the death is due to an accident during the course of employment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Assam.
1. The applicant should be a nominee/dependent of deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building and other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The deceased worker should have had an active membership with the Board.

name: Nirmaan Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayta Yojana
brief_description: The Nirman Kamgar Mrtyu Va Divyangta Sahayata Yojana Uttar Pradesh is a crucial scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government for the welfare of registered construction workers in the state. It provides financial assistance to the families of construction workers in case of death or disability due to accident or illness.
benefits:
> **Death Benefits for register construction worker who die due to an accident:** - Total amount will be 5Rs./-. 1. To dependents of a registered construction worker who dies due to an accident : 5Rs./- as approximately 9Rs./- per month for 5 years (as per interest rate). 1. For funeral expenses: 25Rs./- lump sum.
> **Death Benefits for register construction worker who die due to natural causes:** - Total amount will be 2Rs./-. 1. To dependents of a registered construction worker who dies due to an accident : 2Rs./- as approximately 8Rs./- per month for 2 years (as per interest rate). 1. For funeral expenses: 25Rs./- lump sum.
> **Death Benefits for register construction worker who die due at the work place:** - Total amount: 1Rs./- lump sum.
> **Disability Benefits for register construction worker who suffer 100% permanent disability due to an accident or illness** - Total amount will be 4Rs./-. 1. Beneficiary will get approximately 9Rs./- per month for 4 years (as per interest rate).
> **Disability Benefits for registered construction workers with permanent disabilities between 50% and 99% due to accidents or illness.** - Total amount will be 3Rs./-. 1. Beneficiary will get approximately 8Rs./- per month for 3 years (as per interest rate).
> **Disability Benefits for registered construction workers with permanent disabilities between 26% and 49% due to accidents or illness.** - Total amount will be 2Rs./-. 1. Beneficiary will get approximately 8Rs./- per month for 2 years (as per interest rate).
eligibility:
1. Applicant/Beneficiary must be registered with labor department.
1. Only family member will able to get the death benefits:

- Depended parents.
- Spouse (Husband/Wife).
- Daughter.
- Son ( Only If below 21 years old)

1. Death benefit will not be applicable in the case of suicide.
1. Deaths due to murderRs. snakebiteRs. lightningRs. childbirth and other natural calamities will be considered as normal deaths and benefits will be admissible accordingly.
1. In death benefit claim of a construction workerRs. Aadhaar authentication of the dependent will be required if the dependent applies.

name: Death Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Death Benefit is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers in the event of their natural or accidental death during the course of employment.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. an amount of 2Rs./- shall be given to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers towards death benefitRs. in case of natural death.
1. If the death is due to an accident during the course of employmentRs. the nominee or dependent of registered construction workers shall be given 3Rs./- towards death benefit.
1. The amount of 2Rs./- for Natural Death & 5Rs./- for Accidental Death shall be given to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers who are not covered under any insurance scheme.
1. There shall be no bar for the nominee to claim any other death or accidental death benefit under any insurance scheme covering the beneficiaries (i.e. PMJJBY/PMSBY/etc.).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of the Meghalaya.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The financial assistance shall be given to the nominees or dependents of deceased registered workers in the event of their natural or accidental death during their course of employment.

name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-II
brief_description: The 'Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to abolish caste and community discrimination by encouraging inter-caste marriage by giving financial assistance to newly married couples of whom one spouse is from other community (Forward Community) and the other from the Backward Class / Most Backward Class Community.
benefits:
- Financial assistance of 50Rs. given to the newly married couple.
- 1 Sovereign (8 gm) 22-carat gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.

> **Mode of Disbursal:**

30Rs. through Electronic Clearing Service and 20Rs. in the form of National Savings Certificate.
eligibility:
1. The couple should belong to a backward class / most backward class community.
1. The bride should have passed the 10th standard.
1. The bride should have studied up to Vth standard in the case of the scheduled tribe.
1. The age of the bride should be above 18 years at the time of marriage.
1. The bride should have a degree passed from regular collegesRs. distance education/government-recognized open university.
1. The applicant should have a diploma holder passed from the Institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical EducationRs. Government of Tamil Nadu.

name: Kushal Shramik Sahay Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Kushal Shramik Sahay Yojana is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. Under the schemeRs. assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers and their children for career development. By advancing in skill educationRs. the children of construction workers can also progress and avail employment opportunities.
benefits:
1. Under the schemeRs. the full course fee will be reimbursed.
1. If the course will be of less than 1 year durationRs. all fees of the course will be reimbursed.
1. If the course is for more than one year all fees will be reimbursed annually.
eligibility:
1. The construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and any two of their children will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
1. This assistance will be admissible only in relation to the son/daughter of a construction worker who has been taken admission in various courses of study run by the Skill University or an institution affiliated with it.
1. The age limit for children of construction workers to get assistance should be a maximum of 30 years. If the son or daughter is handicapped then there will be no age limit.

**Note:** Assistance will be limited to the first Trial in the academic year. A person who fails in the same standard/class will not be eligible for second aid for the same standard/class.

name: Funeral Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Funeral Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB)Rs. LabourRs. Skill Development & Employment DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the heir of a deceased construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board in case of death during the ongoing membership.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 10Rs./- shall be given to the legal heirs of the deceased construction workers.
eligibility:

1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. Financial assistance is provided to the legal heir of the deceased worker in the event of their death during the ongoing membership.

name: Family Pension (GBOCWWB)

- The applicant should be the Spouse of the Pensioner.
- The Pensioner should be deceased.
- The deceased PensionerRs. in their lifetimeRs. should have been registered as a Worker with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform
brief_description: "Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform" by the Goa Labour Welfare BoardRs. Department of Labour and EmploymentRs. GoaRs. aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of one set of uniform to school-going children of industrial workers/employees studying in 1st to 4th standard. - The child of the applicant should be enrolled in a recognizedRs. aidedRs. or private school.
- Preference is given to workers with no more than two children.

name: Solar Energy Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Solar Energy Assistance Scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide solar energy plates/panels to the families of registered construction workers.

eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: Free Travelling Facility (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Free Travelling Facility is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. the amount spent by registered workers and 4 family members for visiting famous religious/historical places once in four years will be paid at the rates prescribed by Haryana Roadways (ordinary fare) or actual railway fare (Second Class).

1. Registered construction workersRs. along with four family membersRs. are eligible to avail benefits under the scheme on a visit to religious or historical places once every four years.

name: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists
brief_description: The Tamil DevelopmentRs. Religious EndowmentsRs. and Information Department scheme was launched by the "Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists". Under this schemeRs. financial assistance was provided to four Journalists for medical treatment and to the daughter of a journalist for surgery. The total financial assistance extended under the scheme was 50Rs./-.
benefits: - Medical Assistant of 50Rs./-.

1. The petitioner should have work experience of at least 5 years.
1. The petitioner must apply within three months of undergoing medical treatment.
