1. The treatment must be conducted in hospitals recognized by the Tamil Nadu State Hospital Organization.
1. The retired journalist receiving government pension are eligible to apply but they will receive 50% of the financial assistance.

name: Journalists Family Benefit Fund
brief_description: The Tamil DevelopmentRs. Religious EndowmentsRs. and Information Department scheme was launched by the "Journalists Family Benefit Fund". Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to families of journalists who died in harness with a minimum of twenty years of service as editorRs. sub-editorRs. reporterRs. photographerRs. and proofreader. This assistance is given from the Honble Chief Ministers Public Relief Fund.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:**


- 50Rs./- for 5 years of service.
- 1Rs./- for 10 years of service.
- 1Rs./- for 15 years of service.
- 2Rs./- for 20 years of service.
eligibility:
1. The deceased should have been an editor/sub-editor/reporter/photographer and proofreader.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be given only on the death of the journalist while working in Journalism.
1. The editorRs. sub-editorRs. journalistRs. and photographer should have worked full-time in a newspaper or daily periodicals published in Tamil Nadu.
1. In case of sudden death due to an accident or fatal diseaseRs. five years of service is mandatory.

name: Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 7Rs./- or the actual priceRs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided to workers and their dependents employed in industrial and commercial units of Haryana for purchasing a tricycle if they lose their legs in an accident or due to any other reason. The benefit of this scheme is provided to the worker or his/her dependents after every five years.
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 7Rs./- or the actual priceRs. whichever is lessRs. will be provided to workers and their dependents for purchasing a tricycle.

**Note:** The worker will be provided with a one-time financial assistance in a block of 5 years to purchase a Try Cycle.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for one year.
1. The worker will get the benefit after every five years in the whole service period.
1. Workers or their dependents are eligible to receive benefits under this scheme if they suffer the loss of their legs due to an accident or any other reason.

name: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers was started by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana on 15.01.2019. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 21Rs./- will be provided as Shagun for the marriage of workers' sons and unmarried male workers themselves. The benefit of the schemes will be given to the worker equally as there is a lot of financial pressure on the worker during the worker's own marriage or the son's marriage. The financial pressure on the worker will be reduced by giving the amount of Shagun by the board.
benefits: 1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 21Rs./- will be provided as Shagun for the marriage of workers' sons and unmarried male workers themselves.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
1. The monthly salary of the applicant should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The applicant must have a minimum of three years of regular membership of the Board till the Marriage date.
1. The applicant should apply within six months after the marriage date.
1. The benefits are provided to workers for the marriage of up to two sons and for the self-marriage of male workers.

**Note 01:** The workers will give this undertaking in which they will clearly explain to the board about not taking the benefit of the Shagun scheme for the firstRs. secondRs. or third time or never before.
**Note 02:** If a worker wants to avail the benefit of this scheme 03 days before the marriageRs. then the organization will certify the date of organizing the marriage of the worker's children or unmarried worker and will keep the necessary documents related to organizing the marriage of the workers in its records. The undertaking will be given that within 06 months after the date of marriageRs. the managers will present the marriage registration certificate before the BoardRs. and if they do not present the said registration certificate before the Board within six monthsRs. then they will have to deposit the amount provided to the worker under the said scheme in the board.

name: Rehabilitation Assistance- Haryana Silicosis Board
brief_description:
The scheme Rehabilitation Assistance is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare BoardRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. a one-time assistance of 5Rs./- will be given to silicosis-affected workers upon confirmation by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board. In the event of the worker's death before receiving the rehabilitation assistance after confirmation of silicosisRs. the assistance shall be payable to the widow or widower if the worker was marriedRs. or to one of the living parents if the worker was unmarried.
**Note:** SilicosisRs. an incurable lung disease prevalent in workplaces like stone crushers and minesRs. is a notifiable disease in Haryana under the Factories ActRs. of 1948Rs. and the Building and Other Construction Workers (RE & CS) ActRs. of 1996. Upon confirmation by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. affected workers are swiftly referred to hospitals for treatment; those under the Employee State Insurance ActRs. 1948 receive care at ESI hospitalsRs. while others are provided free treatment at district hospitals and medical colleges by the Health DepartmentRs. with the option for reimbursement for necessary resources unavailable locallyRs. facilitated by the Labour Department.
**Symptoms of Silicosis**

- Associated with T.B
- Shortness of breath
- Fatigue
- Loss of appetite (Anorexia).
- Chest pain; dry with non-productive cough (Whooping Cough).
- Respiratory failure
- Eventually leads to death
benefits:
1. Under this schemeRs. a one-time assistance of 5Rs./- will be given to silicosis-affected workers upon confirmation by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board.
1. In case of the death of a worker before receiving the rehabilitation assistance after confirmation of SilicosisRs. the assistance shall be payable to:


- Widow/ widower if the worker was married or
- To one of the living parents if the worker was unmarried
eligibility:
1. Any worker confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis BoardRs. Haryana as suffering from silicosis shall be eligible for assistance under the scheme.
1. If the worker dies before receiving the rehabilitation assistance after confirmation of silicosisRs. the assistance shall be payable to the widow or widower if the worker was marriedRs. or to one of the living parents if the worker was unmarried.
1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board.
1. The worker should be employed in a factory or at a construction site.

**Note:** Any worker suffering from Silicosis and confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board shall be issued an Identity Card by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

name: Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children
brief_description: The "Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children" was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The scheme aims to support 5Rs. beneficiaries annuallyRs. with the potential for higher numbers based on State/UT identification. name: Supplementary Nutrition Programme- Bihar
brief_description: The "Supplementary Nutrition Programme" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. across all districts of the state under the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) Scheme (Mission Mode). The programme aims to enhance the nutritional level of normal/malnourished/severely malnourished children aged 6 months to 6 yearsRs. as well as pregnant women and lactating mothersRs. through Anganwadi centers. The nutritional standards in the state are set in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of IndiaRs. New Delhi. This programme is centrally sponsored with a funding ratio of 50:50 between the Central and State governments.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. hot cooked meals and Take-Home Rations (THR) are provided to children aged 6 months to 3 yearsRs. as well as pregnant women and lactating mothers enrolled at Anganwadi centers.

- **Hot Cooked Meals:** Children attending Anganwadi centers for pre-school educationRs. aged 3 to 6 yearsRs. receive Khichdi three days a weekRs. Pulao one dayRs. Rasiyav one dayRs. and Semolina pudding one day. Hot cooked food is provided uniformly across Anganwadi centers in all districts for a total of 25 days each month. On Wednesdays and FridaysRs. children who consume eggs receive a boiled egg for breakfastRs. while non-egg eaters are given sprouted gram and jaggery. - **Take-Home Rations (THR):** Dry rations are distributed once a monthRs. covering 25 daysRs. to pregnant womenRs. lactating mothersRs. and normalRs. malnourishedRs. and severely malnourished children aged 6 months to 3 years. Pregnant and lactating mothers who consume eggs are provided with a boiled egg every Wednesday and Friday (seven times a month) at the Anganwadi centerRs. while non-egg eaters receive soybean. Children aged 6 months to 3 years who consume eggs are also given a boiled egg on Wednesdays and FridaysRs. with soybean provided for non-egg eaters. - **Morning Snacks:** If the district-level price fixation committee increases the price of any itemRs. the additional cost is covered by the morning snack budget. Any savings from other items are used to provide sprouted gram-jaggeryRs. jaggery-churaRs. or similar items for breakfast.
**Note:** Every WednesdayRs. 18 grams of milk powder (mixed in 150 ml of warm water) is provided to each child aged 3 to 6 years at 25 Anganwadi centers in 5 districts (GayaRs. SaranRs. SiwanRs. GopalganjRs. and Vaishali) under a pilot projectRs. which has since been expanded across the state.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Bihar.
1. All children aged 6 months to 6 yearsRs. as well as pregnant women and lactating mothers enrolled in Anganwadi centers across the stateRs. are eligible to receive benefits under the programme.

name: Parwarish Yojana
brief_description:
The "Parwarish Yojana" is an initiative by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. Under this schemeRs. a monthly financial assistance of 1Rs./- is provided to orphans and destitute childrenRs. children suffering from HIV/AIDS/Visible Deformities (Grade II)Rs. or children of parents suffering from these conditionsRs. who are between the ages of 0 and 18 years. The amount is transferred to a joint account opened with the children's parents through RTGS. The entire amount is covered by the state government.
**Objective:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide social security through grants for the better upbringing of orphaned and destitute childrenRs. children suffering from incurable diseases (HIV/AIDS and leprosy)Rs. and children of parents suffering from disability due to these diseases.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 1Rs./- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.

**Note:** The amount is transferred directly every month to a joint savings accountRs. opened with the parents of the childrenRs. through RTGS.
eligibility:
The following categories of childrenRs. aged 0-18 yearsRs. are eligible for the benefits of this scheme:

1. Orphaned and destitute childrenRs. or orphaned children living with their next of kin or relativesRs. whose annual income is less than 60Rs./- or who are below the poverty line.
1. Children will also be considered orphaned and destitute if their mother or father has either passed away or become incapable of raising them due to mental disabilityRs. imprisonmentRs. or any other judicial order. HoweverRs. their eligibility will automatically end once the compelling situation is resolved.
1. Children suffering from HIV(+)Rs. AIDSRs. Visible Deformities Grade-II (Leprosy)Rs. or children of parents suffering from these diseases.

**Note:** The benefits of this scheme will be granted for one year for the above categories of children aged 0-18 yearsRs. and will be automatically renewed each year until the child turns 18Rs. provided no adverse report is received.

brief_description: The Marriage Grant to Daughter/Sister of Personnel Killed/ Disabled in War/ Action/Terrorist Attack/Naxalite Attack/IS Duty scheme was launched by the Home DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to honor and support the families of soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the nation. Under this schemeRs. a monetary assistance is provided as a wedding gift to the sister or daughter of a martyred officer/soldier.
benefits: A gift amount of 51Rs. is provided for the marriage of the sister or daughter of a martyred soldier/officer.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a dependent (sister or daughter) of a martyred officer or soldier. 1. The deceased officer/soldier must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The martyrdom must have occurred during warRs. military operationRs. Naxalite attackRs. terrorist attackRs. or internal security duty.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme- Uttarakhand
brief_description: The "National Family Benefit Scheme" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families upon the death of the primary breadwinner (main earning member of the family)Rs. helping them cope with immediate financial hardships.
benefits: A one-time financial assistance of 20Rs./- is provided to the family in the event of the death of the primary earning member.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a family member of the deceased primary breadwinner. 1. The deceased primary breadwinner must have been a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The family must be classified under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The deceased must have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death.

name: Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage (UKBOCWWB)
brief_description: The Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support for the marriage of registered construction workers and their daughters.
benefits: - An amount of 51Rs./- for each marriage is provided. > **Note:** Assistance is provided for the marriage of up to two daughters of the registered worker as well as for the workers own marriage.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Financial assistance is available for the workers own marriage and for the marriage of up to two daughters.

name: Antyeshthi Sahay Yojana
brief_description: The "Antyeshthi Sahay Yojana" is a welfare scheme and has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support the families of deceased senior citizens who were beneficiaries of old-age assistance. Upon the death of such a senior citizenRs. a one-time financial aid is provided to the legal heir to help cover funeral and related expenses.
benefits: A one-time financial assistance of 5Rs./- is provided to the heirs of a senior citizen who was receiving old-age assistance at the time of their death. This assistance is intended to help with funeral expenses.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be the heir of a deceased senior citizen. 1. The deceased must have been a beneficiary of old-age assistance.

name: Green Passage Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2016-17Rs. the "Green Passage Scheme" Scheme by the Higher Education Dept.Rs. Govt. of Odisha provides free higher education to children without biological or adoptive parents. After the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemicRs. the scheme was revised to as well cover children who lost their both parents or single parent during the COVID-19 pandemic. Under this schemeRs. the fees like application feesRs. admission/readmission feesRs. tuition feesRs. examination feesRs. hostel admission feesRs. laboratory feesRs. library feesRs. college development feesRs. etc. will be exempted for eligible students. The institutions will also provide free accommodation and food to such students.
benefits: > **Exemption of Fees:** 1. The fees like application feesRs. admission/readmission feesRs. tuition feesRs. examination feesRs. hostel admission feesRs. laboratory feesRs. library feesRs. college development feesRs. etc. will be exempted. 1. The institutions will also provide free accommodation and food to such students. 1. In the case of Government InstitutionsRs. fees will be exempted at the time of admission on submission of required documents by the student. 1. In the case of Non-Government Aided CollegesRs. fees will be exempted at the time of admission and would be reimbursed by Government on submission of required documents/vouchers by the institution to Government in Higher Education Department. 1. In the case of Non-Government Un-aided InstitutionsRs. the student will take admission by arranging funds on his/her own and then seek reimbursement from the Government on submission of required documents/vouchers to the Government in the Higher Education Department. Such reimbursement will be limited to 5Rs. maximum for the entire duration of the course.
eligibility: 1. The child must qualify as any one of the following: a) The child should be without biological/adoptive parents OR b) The child should have lost both parents OR c) The child should have lost a single bread-earning parent OR d) The child should be residing in a Child Care InstitutionRs. OR under foster care OR the care of a guardian OR any fit person/ surviving parent. 2. The annual income of the guardian/ fit person/ surviving parent (from all sources) does not exceed 8Rs./-. 3. The student should be pursuing higher education in any Government or Non-Government Higher Education Institution (i.e.Rs. College & University). HereRs. "higher education" would mean general/professional/ technical education of at least 1 year's duration after Class-12.

name: Beti Hai Anmol Yojana
brief_description:
Beti Hai Anmol is the prominent scheme of the Himachal Pradesh Government and it was launched on July 2010. This scheme is a welfare scheme to provide financial assistance to girl children of BPL Families but only up to two girls in a family. The government will deposit 21Rs./- per girl child to the post office or bank account. The motive is to make girls self-reliant for necessary financial assistance and education. The annual scholarship will also be provided ranging from 450/- to 5000/- per year from Class 1st to Graduation for books/dressesRs. etc.
**Objective** - To change the negative narrative of family/community respect to the girl child birth. - To stop child marriage of girls. - Admission to schools and to continue the study of girls. - Assistance to girls for taking up income generating activities. - Empowering girls and making them self-reliant. - Financial support to the girls of Himachal Pradesh. - Girls can study through scholarships that provide dress or books
benefits: The following financial assistance will be provided under Himachal Pradesh Beti Hai Anmol Yojana :- StagesAmountAt the time of Birth 21Rs./-From Class 1st to 3rd450/- per yearIn Class 4th 750/- per yearIn Class 5th 900/- per yearFrom Class 6th to 7th1050/- per yearIn Class 8th1200/- per yearFrom Class 9th to 10th1500/- per yearFrom Class 11th to 12th 2250/- per yearB.ARs. B.ComRs. B.ScRs. etc 5000/- each yearB.ERs. B.TechRs. MBBSRs. LLBRs. B.EdRs. etc5000/- each year
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The candidate must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh
1. To the girls who are below the poverty line (BPL).
1. From each BPL familyRs. only two girl children are eligible.
1. All BPL girls who are born after July 5Rs. 2010Rs. can get the benefits of studying till class 12.
1. A beneficiary girl should not get married before completing 18 years.
1. The girl who was born after July 5Rs. 2010Rs. will get benefit from this scheme.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
benefits: - **Construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHLs):** Financial support of 12Rs./- for APL and BPL rural households for toilet construction. - **Retrofitting of Toilets:** Addressing and fixing technological issues in existing toilets to improve functionality. - **Construction of Community Sanitary Complexes (CSCs):** At least one CSC in ODF-plus villages with over 100 householdsRs. prioritizing SC/ST areas and locations frequented by migrant workers. - **Solid Waste Management:** Establishment of compost pits and waste segregation systems in villages. - **Liquid Waste Management:** Installation of soak pits for greywater and stormwater management. - **Faecal Sludge Management (FSM):** Implementation of FSM through various means in peri-urban or densely populated areas. - **Operation and Maintenance:** Decentralised operation and maintenance of community sanitation assets in rural areas by Gram Panchayats. **Other Activities:** 1. IEC and special campaigns 1. Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav (AKAM) 1. Das ka Dam Swachhata har dam 1. Swachhata Filmon ka Amrit Mahotsav 1. Start-up Grand Challenge 1. Swachh Survekshan Grameen (SSG) Phase-II 1. Capacity Building Initiatives 1. Swachhata Action Plan (SAP) 1. Swachh Iconic Places (SIP).
eligibility:
1. Only those households (BPLRs. SCsRs. STsRs. households with physically disabled personRs. landless labourers with homesteadRs. small and marginal farmersRs. and women headed households) in villages which do not have toilets and have not received any benefit for toilet construction under any other Government programme earlierRs. are eligible to apply for incentive for construction of toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen).

**Note 1:** The applications will be verified to ascertain the eligibility of the applicant household by the concerned block/district authorities and will be approved or rejected accordingly.
**Note 2:** Only after approval of the applicationRs. the applicant will be eligible for receiving the incentive under the programme.
**Note 3:** While selecting eligible households for providing incentive under the SBM(G)Rs. the following order of preference shall be ensured:
A. Below Poverty Line (BPL)
B. Above Poverty Line (APL)
(i) SC/ST
(ii) Persons with disability (divyangjan friendly toilet to be ensured)
(iii) Landless labourers with homestead
(iv) Small farmers
(v) Marginal farmers
(vi) Women-headed households.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0
brief_description:
A sanitation scheme for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) for urban households. The Mission has the following components:

1. Household toiletsRs. including conversion of insanitary latrines into pour-flush latrines.
1. Community toilets
1. Public toilets
1. Solid waste management
1. IEC & Public Awareness
1. Capacity building and Administrative & Office Expenses (A&OE)
benefits: A Financial support of minimum 1. Rs - 6667 (in Andhra Pradesh Rs.BiharRs. Chhattisgarh Rs.GoaRs. GujaratRs. HaryanaRs. JharkhandRs. Karnataka Rs.KeralaRs. Madhya PradeshRs. Maharashtra Rs.OdishaRs. PunjabRs. RajasthanRs. Tamil NaduRs. TelanganaRs. Uttar PradeshRs. West Bengal)Rs. 1. Rs - 12Rs. (in UttarakhandRs. Himachal PradeshRs. Arunachal PradeshRs. ManipurRs. MeghalayaRs. MizoramRs. NagalandRs. SikkimRs. TripuraRs. Assam) 1. Rs - 5333 (in Union Territories) is provided for Toilet Construction
eligibility: Any household that does not have access to an individual household toilet ( **80% of urban households engaging in open defecation**) or has an insanitary toilet.

name: Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme
brief_description: The "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the FoodRs. Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide financial relief to economically disadvantaged families by offering a petrol subsidy for their two-wheelers. Under this schemeRs. beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme receive 25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly.
benefits:
***Subsidy Amount*** - 25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly (250/month).
***Mode of Disbursement:*** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility:
> ***General Eligibility:*** 1. The applicant should possess a valid ration card under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme. 1. All family members listed in the ration card must have Aadhaar numbers linked and verified. 1. The applicant's Aadhaar should be linked to a valid bank account and an updated mobile number.
> ***Vehicle Eligibility:*** 1. The applicant's two-wheeler must be registered in their name and in the state of Jharkhand. 1. The applicant must possess a valid driving license.

name: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
brief_description: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th AugustRs. 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide monthly assistance of Rs. 3000/- is paid to the close relativeRs. guardian or relative who is taking care of the orphaned children who are studying and whose mother and father are both deceased or whose father is deceased and the mother has remarried. This assistance is paid through DBT.
benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 3Rs./- per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a close relativeRs. guardianRs. or foster parent taking care of the child.
- The applicant must be caring for a child aged between 0 to 18 years.
- The applicant must be taking care of a child whose both parents are deceasedRs. or whose father is deceased and mother has remarried.
- The applicant must ensure that the child between 3 to 6 years is enrolled in an Anganwadi center.
- The applicant must ensure that the child above 6 years is enrolled in a school for compulsory education.
- The applicant must submit a certificate from the school or institution every year confirming the childs ongoing education.
- The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding 27Rs./- in rural areas.
- The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding 36Rs./- in urban areas.

name: Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana
brief_description: The Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana was launched by the Energy and Petro Chemicals DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The main objective of this scheme is to provide good service to the consumers by providing quality power supply by replacing existing oldRs. dilapidated power wires/conductors and related goods of the agricultural feeders and if necessaryRs. by dividing the agricultural feeders.
benefits: - Replacement of old and dilapidated agricultural feeder wires and conductors. - Improvement in quality of electricity supply to farmers.
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be connected to agricultural electricity feeders.

name: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)" by the Ministry Of Tribal AffairsRs. Government Of IndiaRs. aims to transform villages with high Scheduled Tribe population into model villages through providing financial assistance for infrastructure gap filling and socio-economic development to the tribal communities. The scheme focuses on villages having at least 50% ST population. It supports the preparation and implementation of Village Development Plans. Funds are utilized for critical infrastructure gaps not covered under other schemes. Convergence with other Central and State schemes is encouraged for holistic development.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 20Rs./- per village for infrastructure gap filling and development activities. - **Infrastructure Development:** Support for roadsRs. drinking waterRs. sanitationRs. educationRs. healthRs. and livelihood infrastructure. - **Village Development Plan (VDP):** Preparation and execution of need-based development plans for selected villages. - **Convergence Support:** Integration with existing Central and State schemes to maximize development impact. - **Awards And Incentives:** 5Rs./- per village at State level for best performing villages and 10Rs./- per village at National level for top selected villages.
eligibility: > **General Eligibility** - The village must have at least 50% Scheduled Tribe (ST) population. - The village must have a population of at least 500 in plain areas; 250 in hilly/tribal areas. - The village must be selected by the State/UT Government based on criteria defined in the guidelines. > **Preference / Priority** - Preference is given to villages with higher ST population concentration. - Priority is given to villages with significant infrastructure gaps.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
brief_description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)" implemented by the Department of AgricultureRs. Cooperation & Farmers WelfareRs. Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers WelfareRs. aims to supplement the financial needs of all landholding farmers families by procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yieldsRs. commensurate with the anticipated farm income as well as for domestic needs. Under the schemeRs. an amount of 6Rs./- per year is released by the Central Government online directly into the bank accounts of the eligible farmers under the Direct Benefit Transfer modeRs. subject to certain exclusions.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount of 6Rs./- per year in 3 equal installments of 2Rs./- every four months is provided to each eligible family.
eligibility: - All landholding farmers' familiesRs. which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

name: Rashtriya Parivar Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Under the National Social Assistance Program (NFBS) by the Government of IndiaRs. Ministry of Rural DevelopmentRs. Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. such members of the families living below the poverty line whose natural/unnatural deathRs. for the purpose of providing social security to the victim's family Financial aid is provided.
benefits: - Eligible applicants are entitled to a lump sum grant of 30Rs./
eligibility: 1. The scheme is applicable in case of the death of the primary earning head of the family (male or female). 1. The deceased earning member should be above 18 years and below 60 years of age at the time of death. 1. The annual family income should not exceed 46Rs. in rural areas. 1. The annual family income should not exceed 56Rs. in urban areas. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
eligibility: This scheme is applicable to all households in rural India.

name: One Nation One Ration Card
brief_description:
The "**One Nation One Ration Card"** (ONORC) Scheme was launched by the Department of Food & Supplies and Consumer AffairsRs. Ministry of Consumer AffairsRs. Food & Public Distribution in 2018. It is a national Ration Card portability scheme to ensure food security for all including internal migrants within India. It enables migrant workers and their family members to access PDS benefits from any Fair Price Shop anywhere in the countryRs. thus ensuring the food security through the inter-state portability of ration cards under the National Food Security ActRs. 2013 (NFSA). A Fair Price Shop (FPS) is a public ration store licensed under Section 3 of the Essential Commodities Act of 1955. Ration card details and entitlements are available online on any ePoS device in the country. It includes both inter-State and intra-State (inter-district/intra-district) portability of ration cards.
Assam is the 36th State to implement the One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme. The ONORC plan has successfully been implemented in all 36 States/UTs making food security portable throughout the country. The government has launched a mobile appRs. namely **MERA RATION** for acquiring the maximum benefit of the ONORC plan. The mobile app shall provide the user with real-time information. It is available in 13 languages. As per the official website of [**National Food Security Portal**](https://nfsa.gov.in/)Rs. there are more than 20 crores Ration Cards issued through more than 4.5 lakh POS enabled Fair Price Shops.
benefits:
- It will benefit approximately 81 crores beneficiaries by digitizing Ration Cards.
- This system allows all NFSA beneficiariesRs. particularly migrant beneficiariesRs. to claim either full or part food grains from any Fair Price Shop (FPS) in the country through an existing ration card with biometric/Aadhaar authentication in a seamless manner.
- With the ONORCRs. all the beneficiaries in one state can get the same fair rations in other states where the ration card was issued.
- The scheme will ensure food security of migrant laborers who move to other states to seek better job opportunities.
- It will improve the mechanism to identify fake/duplicate ration cards. It seeks to provide universal access to PDS food grains for migrant workers.
- Ration card portability will be achieved by implementing an IT-driven system that installs ePoS devices in each Fair Price Shop (FPS).
- The **ONORC** will also help achieve the target set under **SDG 2**: Ending hunger by 2030.
eligibility: - The scheme is eligible to all ration cardholders or beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA)Rs. 2013 with Aadhaar Card numbers seeded.

name: Dalit Bandhu
brief_description:
_The Dalit Bandhu Scheme is a unique initiative launched by the government of Telangana to promote the economic development of families belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. The scheme provides financial assistance of Rs. 10 lakhs to eligible SC families to start their own businesses or entrepreneurial venturesRs. thereby creating opportunities for them to become self-reliant and improve their standard of living._
As a part of a multi-pronged approachRs. in addition to existing entitlements like food securityRs. educationRs. and social securityRs. a different strategy with a new initiative "Telangana Dalit Bandhu" is introduced to intensify the level of financial assistance to SC households for the establishment of suitable income generating economic support schemes as the delivery of credit by banks in the form of loans has become a constraint.
Under the schemeRs. eligible families will receive financial assistance of Rs. 10 lakhs eachRs. in the form of a grantRs. to start a small business or entrepreneurial venture. The scheme is expected to benefit over 20 lakh families in the state over the next few years. One-time capital assistance of Rs.10 lakhs per SC family is provided for all SC families as a 100% grant/subsidy to establish suitable income-generating schemes as per their choice (without bank loan linkage).
The main objective of the scheme is to reduce poverty and promote entrepreneurship among the SC communityRs. which has historically been marginalized and faced discrimination in society. The scheme is also expected to promote inclusive growth and social development in the state.
The Telangana government has allocated Rs. 1Rs. crores for the implementation of the scheme in the first year. The scheme is expected to be implemented in a phased mannerRs. with eligible families being identified and selected based on a set of criteria such as income levelRs. educational qualificationRs. and entrepreneurial skills.
***OverallRs. the Dalit Bandhu Scheme is a path-breaking initiative that aims to uplift the socio-economic status of the SC community in Telangana. The scheme provides a much-needed boost to entrepreneurship and economic development among the marginalized sections of societyRs. thereby promoting inclusive growth and social development in the state.***
eligibility:
**Here are the eligibility criteria for the scheme:**
1. _The scheme is applicable only to families belonging to the SC community._ 1. _The applicant must be a resident of Telangana._ 1. _The family should have an annual income of less than Rs. 2.5 lakh._ 1. _The family should not own more than 3 acres of agricultural land or more than one residential house._ 1. _The applicant should not have availed of any other government loan or subsidy._ 1. _The applicant should have a viable business plan or entrepreneurial idea that can be supported by the grant._ 1. _The applicant should be willing to contribute 10% of the project cost._ 1. _The applicant should have a bank account._ 1. _The applicant should have a digital identityRs. such as an Aadhaar card._ 1. _The applicant should be between the ages of 25 and 50._ 1. _The applicant should have passed at least the 10th standard._ 1. _The applicant should not have a criminal record or have been convicted of a crime._
These eligibility criteria have been put in place to ensure that the scheme benefits those who are most in need of financial assistance to start their own businesses or entrepreneurial ventures. By targeting eligible SC families who meet these criteriaRs. the government aims to ensure that the benefits of the scheme reach the intended beneficiaries and help to reduce economic disparities in the state.
**The eligibility criteria for the Dalit Bandhu scheme in Telangana are based on the socio-economic conditions of the Dalit families. According to the Telangana Chief MinisterRs. K. Chandrasekhar RaoRs. the following parameters will be considered in the eligibility survey:**
- ***Land holdings*** - ***Annual income*** - ***Savings*** - ***Liabilities*** - ***Education*** - ***Skills*** - ***Employment status***
The eligibility survey will be conducted by a dedicated agencyRs. the Telangana Dalit Bandhu CorporationRs. which will also provide capacity-building and training programsRs. as well as support for marketing and access to credit. It is worth noting that the scheme is not based on caste certificatesRs. but on the socio-economic conditions of the families. Eligible Dalit families will receive financial assistance of Rs. 10 lakhs in a phased manner to start their own businesses or ventures.

name: Shagun Yojana
brief_description:
Launched in 2021Rs. the scheme "Shagun Yojna" by the Department of Social Justice & EmpowermentRs. Government of Himachal PradeshRs. aims to provide financial assistance to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families for the marriage of their daughters. Under this schemeRs. a marriage grant is provided to parentsRs. guardiansRs. or the girl herself if her parents are not alive or traceable. The scheme is implemented by the District Programme Officer through the Child Development Project Officer.
***Objectives:***

- To support BPL families with financial assistance for the marriage of girls above 18 years of age.
- To ensure that eligible girls receive aid even if marrying outside Himachal Pradesh.
benefits:
- A one-time financial grant of 31Rs. is provided for the marriage of BPL girls/women.

**NOTE:**

- The grant is given to parents/guardians or the girl herself (if her parents are not alive/traceable).
- The grant can be disbursed up to 2 months before the proposed date of marriage.
- If the marriage has already taken placeRs. the grant may be claimed within 6 months of the marriage date.
eligibility:
1. The girl applicant must be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The girl must be 18 years of age or above at the time of marriage.
1. The marriage grant will be given even if the girl from Himachal Pradesh is marrying a boy from outside the state of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The family of the applicant girl must be living below the poverty line (BPL).
1. If the parents of the girl are not alive or traceableRs. the girl herself can apply.
1. The groom must be above 21 years of age.
1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna or any other similar departmental marriage grant scheme.
1. Those destitute left out women who are not financially able to perform their re-marriage can also apply.

name: Arundhati Gold Scheme
brief_description:
Many parts of our country are plagued with social evils surrounding the girl childRs. like child marriageRs. female foeticideRs. dowry etc. But the Assamese societyRs. from time immemorialRs. is fortunate to be free from such evils. Though there is no dowry system prevalent in AssamRs. the parent of every girl desires to give something to the girl during her marriage. The parentsRs. irrespective of their social and economic status dream to bestow their children with loveRs. blessings and gifts. But for manyRs. these dreams remain unfulfilled due to their economic weakness.
Gold is always considered auspicious and an asset. The parents believe that a gift of gold ornament would enhance their daughters social and economic status. Objective: The Government of Assam has decided to introduce a New Scheme ARUNDHATI from the financial year 2019-20.
The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the parents of the girl child who are economically not very soundRs. but like all parents desire to give some gold which is considered auspicious to their as gift daughters on her marriage. The Government desires to share the joy of such parents who are getting their daughters married by way of providing Rs. 40Rs./- as a blessing to the daughters of these parents for purchasing Gold.
eligibility:
**Eligibility**

1. The bride and groom should have attained the legal age of 18 years and 21 years respectively at the time of registration of the marriage.
1. The marriage of the applicant should be registered under the Special Marriage ActRs. of 1954.
1. The applicant should have solemnised her marriage on or after the 1st of DecemberRs. 2019.
1. The applicant should have registered her marriage on or after the 1st of January 2020.
1. The applicant girl should apply for the benefit under Arundhati Gold Scheme on the same day that she applies for marriage registration.
1. The total income of the parents of the applicant girl should be below Rs 5.00 Lakh per annum.
1. The applicant girl can avail of this benefit for her first marriage only.
1. Both the bride and the groom must have passed at least HSLC or equivalent Except Tea Tribe including Adivasi communities of the State.
1. No minimum educational qualification is required in the case of Tea Tribe including Adivasi communities for the next five yearsRs. as most of the Tea Gardens in the State of Assam do not have High School facility

name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
slug: marriage of daughter of sc widow
brief_description:
This programRs. under the Department of Social WelfareRs. Women & Child DevelopmentRs. ChandigarhRs. aims to uplift widows belonging to the Scheduled Caste community. WidowsRs. particularly from marginalized groupsRs. often face financial struggles and social isolation. By providing financial aid for their daughters' weddingsRs. the program helps alleviate these burdens and promotes their overall well-being.
The initiative empowers these widows by supporting their daughters' marriages. Marriage expenses can be substantialRs. and this assistance enables them to fulfill their parental duties and ensure a respectable marriage for their daughters.
benefits: > **Financial grant : 20Rs./- for the marriage of daughters.**
eligibility:
1. The bride's mother must belong to a Scheduled Caste community.
1. Financial help is available for the marriage of up to two daughters in a family.
1. The bride must be at least 18 years old on the date of marriage.
1. This assistance is only for the first marriage of each daughter.
1. Your family's monthly income cannot be more than 2Rs./-. (Verified by the Tehsildar).
1. Applicant must have lived in Chandigarh for at least 3 years.
1. If both the bride's parents are deceasedRs. her legal guardian can apply for this help.

name: Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojana
brief_description:
The Yojana aims to free women of Himachal Pradesh from the indoor pollution by providing free LPG connections to families with no gas connection.
The objective of launching the Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojna was to provide free gas connections to those families who were not covered under the Centre's Ujjwala scheme. The state government started this scheme on the lines of PMUY. The Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojana of the State Government have proved to be a boon for the women of Himachal.
As a result of Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha YojnaRs. the dependence on wood for fuel has reduced. Besides thisRs. the adverse effect of smoke on the health of women has also been relieved and improved the standard of living of women.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should not have an LPG connection in their name or in the name of any member of their household.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other LPG connection under any other government scheme

name: Pedalandariki Illu
brief_description: Launched by the Honble Chief Minister of Andhra PradeshRs. the "Pedalandariki Illu" is a Housing Scheme by the Revenue DepartmentRs. Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. 25 lakh House Site Pattas have been announced for distribution to all the eligible beneficiaries residing in Rural & Urban areas on Saturation Mode irrespective of CasteRs. CreedRs. or Religion to facilitate the construction of houses for the homeless poor. The process of issue of House Site Pattas will be taken up on mission mode and distribution to all eligible houseless poor will be taken up. This scheme is also known as the "YSR Housing Scheme" and "YSR Awaas Yojana".
benefits:
> **Rural Area:** 1. One House Site Patta shall be issued for an extent of 1.5 Cents to an eligible household in the name of the woman beneficiary of the house. The patta shall be handed over to the beneficiary on the day of UgadiRs. 2020. 1. The Housing Department shall issue sanctions for the construction of Individual Housing Units to the eligible beneficiary under the available schemes in a phased manner.
> **Urban Area:** 1. Housing Units shall be constructed following the G+3 pattern at the rate of about 100 units in an extent of Ac.1.00cts. 1. House Site Patta shall be issued as an Undivided Land Share for an extent of about 1.0 Cent to an eligible beneficiary in the name of the woman of the house. The patta shall be handed over to the beneficiary on the day of UgadiRs. 2020. 1. Housing Units will be constructed and handed over to the beneficiaries by APTIDCO/ ULB/ other government agencies under available schemes.
**NOTE 1:** House Site Pattas shall be issued with the conditions laid down in BSO-21 & in terms of the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfer) ActRs. 1977 (As amended from time to time). **NOTE 2:** All individual plots shall be given a Unique Number similar to the 11-digit Bhoodhar Number.
eligibility:
> **A) Rural Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall belong to the identified Below Poverty Line (BPL) category household. 2. The beneficiary shall not have their own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 3. The Beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 4. The Beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land.
> **B) Urban Area:** 1. The beneficiary shall not have an Own House/House Site anywhere in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 2. The beneficiary shall not have been covered in any previous Housing Scheme of the State/Central Government. 3. The beneficiary shall not have more than 2.5 acres of Wet Land or 5.00 acres of Dry Land. 4. The Annual Income (from all the sources) of the Household should not exceed Rs.3Rs./- (Rupees three lakhs only).

name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
brief_description: The Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a social security scheme launched by the Ministry of Labour & EmploymentRs. Government of IndiaRs. and implemented through LIC. It provides death and disability coverage to members of 48 specific occupational/vocational groupsRs. rural landless householdsRs. and unorganized workers. Beneficiaries aged 1859 years pay subsidized annual premiums of 200 for insurance coverage. AdditionallyRs. scholarships are granted for children studying in grades 912Rs. ensuring holistic family welfare.
benefits:
> **Life Insurance Coverage:** - Natural death: 30Rs./- - Death due to accident: 75Rs./- > **Disability Benefits:** - Total permanent disability (loss of two eyes or two limbs) due to accident: 75Rs./- - Partial permanent disability (loss of one eye or one limb) due to accident: 37Rs./- **Scholarship:** - Two children of the beneficiary studying between 9th to 12th Standard shall receive 100/- per month (for each child half yearly on 1st July and on 1st JanuaryRs. each year).
> **Annual Premium Amount:** 200/- per member. - **Subsidy from Social Security Fund (SSF):** 50% of the total premium (100/-) is subsidized by the Government of India through the Social Security Fund (SSF). - **Premium Payment for Rural Landless Households (RLH):** The remaining 50% of the premium (100/-) is paid by the respective State Government or Union Territory. - **Premium Payment for Other Occupational Groups:** The remaining 50% of the premium (100/-) is covered by a combination of contributions from the Nodal AgencyRs. the MemberRs. and/or the State Government/Union Territory.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be aged between 18 and 59 years.
- The applicant should normally be the head of the family or an earning member.
- The applicants family should be categorized as below the poverty line (BPL) or marginally above the poverty line.
- The applicant should belong to an identified occupational or vocational group.
- The applicant should be part of a rural landless household.

name: Vahli Dikri Yojana
brief_description: The Vahli Dikri YojanaRs. launched by the Women and Child Development Department under the Government of GujaratRs. aims to empower girl children by providing financial assistance to their parents. This scheme encourages families to educate and nurture their daughters by offering cash incentivesRs. free educationRs. and insurance coverage. By reducing the school dropout rate among girls and promoting higher educationRs. the initiative seeks to foster gender equality and ensure a brighter future for young girls.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance at Different Stages:**

- 4Rs./- at the time of admission in 1st standard.
- 6Rs./- at the time of admission in 9th standard.
- 1Rs./- at the age of 18 years for higher education or marriage.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have a bank account.
1. The applicant should be one of the first two girl children of the family.
1. The annual family income should not exceed 2 lakh.
1. Girls born on or after 02-08-2019 should be eligible for financial assistance.

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
brief_description: The Government of Rajasthan has always been in the forefront in making various innovations to provide health services to the citizens of the state. Rajasthan has also successfully operated free medicines and free tests in the state in the pastRs. due to which the general public is getting the benefit of free medicines and tests in the government hospitals of the state. This scheme has been brought with the commitment of providing good health to all the citizens of the state by freeing them from the huge expenditure on medical treatment so that there is no compulsion of money in the treatment of suffering and serious diseases.
benefits:
1. Cashless treatment facility up to Rs. 25Rs./- will be provided to each family of Rajasthan.
1. National Food Security ActRs. the insurance premium of families eligible for Socio-Economic CensusRs. small and marginal farmers and contract workers will be borne by the state government.
1. Other families will have to pay a premium of Rs. 850/- per year.
eligibility:
Under the schemeRs. eligible families have been divided into two categories-

1. **Category receiving free benefits:-** 100 percent of the premium of the eligible families of such category determined by the state government is paid by the government. Presently eligible families under Food Security ActRs. eligible families of Socio-Economic Census (SECC) 2011Rs. contract workers working in state government departments/boards/corporations/government companiesRs. small marginal farmers and those who received Covid-19 ex-gratia last year destitute and helpless families are included in the free category. 1. **Category receiving benefits by paying Rs.850/- per family per year:-** The families of the state who do not come under the category of free eligible families and are not government employees/pensioners and are not taking benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules They can avail the benefits of the scheme by paying 50% of the fixed premium Rs. 850/- per family per year. The remaining 50 percent of the premium will be borne by the government. 1. **All EWS** families are also proposed to be given the benefit of Chiranjeevi Yojana free of cost.

name: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme
brief_description: Launched on 1st April 2006Rs. the scheme Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. financial assistance of 1250/- per month per family member is provided for five years to the Kashmiri families which have migrated from Jammu & Kashmir to Haryana and are living in various parts of the State. The financial assistance is subject to a maximum of 6Rs./- per family.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 1Rs./- per month per family member for 5 yearsRs. subject to a maximum of 6Rs./- per family per monthRs. provided for re-settlement.
eligibility:
- The applicant family should have been displaced from Jammu & Kashmir.
- The applicant family should have migrated to Haryana from Jammu & Kashmir.
- The applicant family should be residing in Haryana.
- The annual income of the familyRs. from all sourcesRs. should not exceed 2Rs./-.


- The term Family would mean 'the family of the applicant at the time of displacement from Jammu & Kashmir'.

name: Assistance On Death Of The Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Assistance on Death of the Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB) was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Department Haryana. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided by the Board to the legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of 2Rs./- is provided by the Board to the legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in an accident at the workplace.
1. The applicant should have a copy of the FIR in regard to the accident.
1. The applicant should have a post-mortem report of the death of an unregistered worker.
1. The applicant should have the certificate of being nominated/legal heir of the unregistered worker.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief_description:
In 2012Rs. Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas Evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.
The objective of the scheme is to enable the laborers of Chhattisgarh state to get more new skills in their work and more employment opportunities and with the skill development programs that generate new employment opportunities for the local people are also included.
benefits:
1. Registered construction workers will be given training for skill upgradation.
1. Registered construction workers will be provided certificates of their work trade.
1. Family members of registered construction workers will be given training in various trades as per their interest.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. It is necessary for construction workers to be registered with the board.
1. Age limit should be between 18 to 50 years.
1. If a person parallelly getting the benefits from state GovernmentRs. that will not be eligible for this scheme benefits.

name: Safai Karmakar Ke Bachche Hetu Chhatravrtti Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Safai Karmakar Ke Bachche Hetu Chhatravrtti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to provides financial assistance to the children of sanitation workers in India for higher education.
benefits:
- Financial assistance provided according to the below table

1. If such a student is eligible to receive scholarship amount under any scheme of any other government department/institutionRs. then he/she can choose any one scheme which is beneficial for him/her.

name: Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana
brief_description: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to provide financial assistance for free coaching.
benefits: > The fee for special coaching for admission in engineeringRs. medicalRs. CA and MBA or other professional education to the son/daughter (two children) studying in class 10th and above will be paid by the board.
eligibility:
1. Children of registered sanitation workers will qualify for benefits.
1. If a student is eligible for assistance from multiple government departments or institutionsRs. they may choose the program that is most beneficial to themRs. but they cannot receive benefits from two programs simultaneously.

name: Financial Assistance under Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
brief_description: The scheme Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme was launched by the Information & Public Relations DepartmentRs. Government of Odisha. Under the SchemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her deathRs. and in case of permanent incapacitation. In the event of death of a working journalistRs. a fixed sum of money may be paid to the widowRs. and in the event of the deceased not being survived by his widowRs. equally to the minor children. In the eventRs. the deceased was not married or is not survived by his widow or childrenRs. such ex-gratia payment may be sanctioned in favour of his father or mother. The eligible applicantRs. in such caseRs. can apply online for financial assistance from the Information & Public Relations Department.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. an ex-gratia of 4Rs./- is provided to the legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death and 2Rs./- in case of permanent incapacitation.
eligibility:
1. Journalist should be working in Odisha.
1. The Journalist should be working for a media house registered with the I&PR departmentRs. Odisha.
1. The applicant should be a legal heir of the working journalist in case of his/her death or in case of permanent incapacitation.

**Note:** "Permanent Incapacitation" means incapacitation on account of accidentRs. diseaseRs. or any other reason which renders the working Journalist wholly unfit for working as such.

name: Kanyadaan Scheme (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Kanyadaan Scheme was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance will be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the eve of the marriage of his/her daughter and self-marriage of female registered workers.
benefits: 1. Financial Assistance of 21Rs./- will be granted to registered workers on the eve of the marriage of his/her daughter and self-marriage of female registered workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/beneficiary should be working in the EstablishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contribution towards the labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
2. The applicant shall be eligible to avail the benefit of the scheme only after 06 months of becoming a member of the Board.
3. The beneficiary hasnt claimed/availed of such kind of benefits prevailing under the Central/State Govt. Schemes. If both the father and daughter are working in the same establishmentRs. the benefit shall be granted to one of them.
4. This benefit will be given only on the production of a Marriage Registration Certificate.
5. The benefit of the scheme shall be given for two daughters only.
6. The applicant should apply for the Kanyadaan Scheme within three months from the date of marriage.
7. Female registered workers can avail the benefit of this scheme on the eve of their self-marriage.

name: Funeral Assistance (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Assistance was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance shall be given to the legal heirsRs. in case of death of registered workers under the CBOCWWB.
benefits: Financial assistance of 5000/- shall be given to the legal heirsRs. in case of death of registered beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The deceased worker should have been working at the establishmentRs. registered under Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contributions to the labour welfare fund should have been regularly received by the board.
1. Any legal heirs of the deceased worker would be eligible to avail the benefit of this scheme only if the deceased worker was a member of the Board for at least the last six months.
1. The financial assistance will be given on the production of the death certificate issued by the competent authority.
1. The applicant should apply for Funeral Assistance within three months from the date of death.

name: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
brief_description: The scheme Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People by the Department of Women & Child DevelopmentRs. Government of PondicherryRs. was introduced to provide 10 kg of free rice through fair-price shops during natural calamities and on two important festive occasions every year. The beneficiaries are identified based on the data from the Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department in PuducherryRs. utilizing the cross-referencing functionality in UDH.
benefits: 10 kg of free rice is supplied through fair-price shops during natural calamities and on two important festive occasions every year.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
- The applicant should belong to the 'Below Poverty Line' category.

name: Incentive Award to Inter-Caste Married Couples
brief_description: The scheme Incentive Award to Inter-Caste Married Couples was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to reduce the effect of untouchability and as a step towards bringing about a casteless society.
benefits: An award with a value of 50Rs./- ( 20Rs./ - in cashRs. and 30Rs./- in the form of a National Saving Certificate).
eligibility:
- The bride and groom should be citizens of India.
- The marriage should be performed between Scheduled Caste and other communities.
- The marriage should be registered.
- The marriage should be taking place for the first time between the bride and groom.
- Both bride and groom or either of them should be a native of Puducherry.
- The application should be submitted within 60 days from the date of performance of marriage.

name: Financial Assistance on Death/Disablement of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance on Death/Disablement of Beneficiary was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Chandigarh. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance will be provided to registered construction workers with full or 50% disability due to an accident. The financial assistance will also be provided to the widowed dependents of registered male construction workers for any reason of death.
benefits: **Sl. No.****Grant Type****Amount**1Ex- gratia grant to widow dependent of employee (for any reason of death)50Rs./-2Grant to employee for full disability due to accident25Rs./-3Grant to employee for 50% disability due to accident15Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be working in the EstablishmentRs. registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund ActRs. 1965 and his contribution towards the labour welfare fund should regularly been received by the Board.
1. In case of the death of a registered male construction workerRs. his dependent widow should apply for this scheme within one year from the date of death.
1. Registered construction workers with full or 50% disability due to an accident are eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The beneficiary has not availed any financial assistance from any other Government body.

name: Funeral Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Funeral Benefit is a social security schemeRs. implemented by the Meghalaya Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Meghalaya. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance shall be provided to nominees or dependents of deceased registered construction workersRs. towards funeral expenses.
benefits: 1. Under the schemeRs. financial assistance of 5Rs./- shall be given to nominees or dependents of deceased registered construction workersRs. towards funeral expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a legal nominee or dependent of deceased worker.
1. The deceased worker should have been a resident of Meghalaya.
1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work.
1. The deceased worker should have been registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
1. The financial assistance shall be given to nominees or dependents of deceased registered workersRs. towards funeral expenses.

name: Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana
brief_description: The Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana (SKSPTYY) is a commendable initiative launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022. Recognizing the significant contribution of construction workers to the state's infrastructureRs. the scheme aims to ease their financial burden and offer them a chance to experience holy pilgrimages. By providing a one-time grantRs. the SKSPTYY empowers registered construction worker families to embark on religious journeys. This financial support proves invaluableRs. allowing these families to experience the spiritual significance of pilgrimagesRs. a tradition often cherished in India.
benefits: - A maximum lump sum assistance of 12Rs./- will be provided for the travel expenses.
eligibility:
1. The worker must be working in an establishment registered under the Factories ActRs. 1948.
1. The monthly salary (basic salary + dearness allowance) of the worker should not exceed 15Rs./-.
1. The worker must have completed at least six months of continuous service in the establishment/factory and must be in service at the time of application.
1. Where both the worker and his wife are working as workers in factories/establishmentsRs. then only one of them will be eligible for this facility.
1. The worker and his dependents (dependents include wifeRs. maximum 2 unmarried childrenRs. parents of the workerRs. mother-in-law and father-in-law in case of female worker) but the total number of members including the worker will be maximum 6. Only two children of the worker's family and dependent mother/father can be included.
1. The worker will be able to avail this facility once in his entire service period.
1. In case more application forms are received than the budget provisioned in the financial year under the schemeRs. the workers with the maximum age will be selected for the benefit on the basis of priority.
1. The last date for receiving applications in each financial year will be 30th September of the respective year.

name: Raja Harishachandra Shramik Mratak Antyeshti Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: The "Raja Harishchandra Shramik Mrityu Antim Sanskar Sahayata Yojana" (RHSMASSSY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to the families of registered workers who die while in service. The scheme's purpose is to alleviate the financial burden on these families during a difficult time and help them with the final rites of the deceased worker.
benefits: Financial Assistance : 10Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Workers should be working in an establishment registered under the Factories ActRs. 1948.
1. The monthly salary of the worker (basic salary + dearness allowance) should not exceed 15Rs./-.
1. It is mandatory to apply within one year from the date of death of the worker.
1. Financial assistance will be payable to the worker's spouse or dependent (son/unmarried daughter)Rs. mother/father in case the worker is unmarried.

name: Jyotiba Phule Shramik Kanyadan Yojana
brief_description: The Jyotiba Phule Shramik Kanyadan Yojana (JPSKPY) stands as a beacon of support for registered workers in Uttar Pradesh. Recognizing the financial strain that a daughter's wedding can causeRs. the government has established this scheme to provide much-needed assistance. JPSKPY aims to empower these workers by easing their financial burden and promoting the social well-being of their families. This initiative fosters a sense of security and dignity among workersRs. knowing that the government is invested in the well-being of their families. FurthermoreRs. JPSKPY promotes gender equality by ensuring that financial limitations don't hinder a daughter's right to a proper wedding ceremony. UltimatelyRs. the Jyotiba Phule Shramik Kanyadan Yojana serves a dual purpose: it strengthens the social fabric of worker families and demonstrates the government's commitment to social progress in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Financial Assistance; 51Rs./-
eligibility:
1. Workers should be working in an establishment registered under the Factories ActRs. 1948.
1. The monthly salary of the worker (basic salary + dearness allowance) should not exceed 15Rs./-.
1. Application can be made 3 months before or after 1 year from the scheduled date of marriage of the girl.
1. The benefit of the said scheme will be payable only for the marriage of a worker or two daughters.
1. The age of the girl should not be less than 18 years on the date of her marriage.

name: Spectacles Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The Spectacles Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 1Rs./- is provided to workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the purchase of spectacles in case of visual impairment. The benefit of this scheme is provided to the worker or his/her dependents after every five years.

1. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of up to 1Rs./- is provided to worker or his/her dependents for the purchase of spectacles in case of visual impairment. AdditionallyRs. if the price of the spectacles is less than 1Rs./-Rs. then the actual price of the spectacles will be provided.

**Note:** The worker will be provided with a one-time financial assistance in a block of 5 years to purchase spectacles.

1. The applicant should be a worker employed in industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.

7. The benefit of this scheme will be available only once for each beneficiary.

name: Dental Care Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Dental Care Scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance of 4Rs./- or the actual cost of dental careRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided for dental care to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana. FurthermoreRs. financial assistance of 10Rs./- or the actual cost of the jawRs. whichever is lessRs. is provided to the workers for getting full denture fitted.

1. Under this schemeRs. workers and their dependents are entitled to receive financial assistance of up to 4Rs./- or the actual expenditureRs. whichever is lessRs. for dental care.

1. The applicant should be a worker employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.

1. The monthly income/salary of the worker should not exceed 25Rs./-.
1. The service period of the worker is fixed for one year.
1. The application should be submitted within three months of the date of the dentist's prescription or bill for dental care or jaw implants.
1. The beneficiary should not have availed of the benefit of this scheme earlier.

name: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Purchasing School UniformsRs. Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. one-time financial assistance is provided to the children (2 boys & 3 girls) of workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana at the time of admission to continue their studies. The Board provides assistance for the sons and daughters of registered workers for the purchase of school uniformsRs. booksRs. stationeryRs. and other educational materialsRs. enabling them to continue their studies from 1st to 12th standard.
benefits:
Under this schemeRs. the following amounts of assistance are provided:
**Sl. No.****Class****Amount of Financial Assistance**1On Continuing Studies from Class I to Class IV3Rs./- 2On Continuing Studies from Class V to Class XII4Rs./-

1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.

name: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)
brief_description: The scheme Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)Rs. Labour DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board. Under this schemeRs. the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board in the following manner:
**Sl. No.****Professional/Technical Courses****Amount to be paid**1Degree/Diploma viz. MedicineRs. EngineeringRs. ManagementRs. MCARs. LawRs. Fashion DesigningRs. etc. in all Government/Private Institutions/ Colleges/Universities etc. The board will bear all the educational expenses of the students studying in government institutions i.e. admission feesRs. tuition feesRs. examination feesRs. etc. In additionRs. the board will also bear all educational expenses of students studying in private institutions equal to the educational expenses charged by the state government institutions having the highest fee structure in that stream.Note: The financial assistance will be given directly to the Government/Government-recognized Private Institute/ College/ University/ IIT/IIM /AIIMS etc. and the reimbursement of the admission expenses will be given to the candidate on the production of the attested copy of the original receipt.

name: Education Assistance - Folk Artist
brief_description: The "Education Assistance - Folk Artist" scheme was launched by the Art and Culture DepartmentRs. Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme provides financial assistance for the education of the children of registered folk artists. The assistance aims to support the educational pursuits of their children from school to higher educationRs. including vocational and professional courses.

name: Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities- Haryana
brief_description: The scheme Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities is implemented by the Directorate of Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward ClassesRs. Government of Haryana. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance ranging from 85Rs./- to 8Rs./- is provided to the members of Scheduled Caste who becomes victims of atrocity by Non-Scheduled Caste persons for various acts like damage and loss of propertiesRs. grievous hurtRs. temporary/permanent incapacitationRs. benefits:
