name: "Capital Investment Subsidy: SC/ST/Women Entrepreneurs" Component of the "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries" Scheme
brief_description: The "Capital Investment Subsidy: SC/ST/Women Entrepreneurs" is a Component of the "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries" Scheme by the Department of Industrial Development (Industries and Commerce)Rs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The department extends subsidies for the investments made on landRs. buildingsRs. plants & machinery @ 25% by the Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Women Entrepreneurs. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available on the Official Website of the Department.
benefits:
> **For Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Women Entrepreneurs** Subsidy for the investments made on landRs. buildingRs. plant & machinery @ 25% thereof subject to a maximum of 25Rs./-. > **For Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs** Subsidy at the rate of 25% on the landRs. building and plant & machinery subject to a cumulative maximum of 50Rs./-.
> **Number of Installments** The subsidy shall be disbursed in a single instalment. **NOTE:** Where due to paucity of funds in a particular financial year or for such other reasons as the case may beRs. single instalment disbursement is not possibleRs. such disbursement will be made in instalments.
> **Mode of Disbursement** **In the case of Units Financed by Financial Institutions/BanksRs.** the subsidy amount shall be disbursed through the financial institutions/banks onlyRs. towards the adjustment against the loan availed by the entrepreneurs or for the creation of additional fixed assets or working capital purposes. **In the case of Self-financed UnitsRs.** the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the entrepreneurs.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Woman Entrepreneur.
- In the case of indigenous second-hand machineryRs. the initial purchase value with depreciationRs. or the second-hand purchase valueRs. or value assessed by the Chartered EngineerRs. whichever is lessRs. will be taken as an investment.
- If two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same person as proprietorRs. common partnersRs. or common board of directors/shareholdersRs. such units are eligible for subsidy as separate entities provided the locationRs. products and licences/clearances/registrations are obtained separately.

> **For Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/ Women Entrepreneurs**


- The subsidy for the investments made on landRs. buildingRs. plant & machinery will be applicable for the small and micro manufacturing enterprises which started production on or after 27-3-2002.

> **For Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs**


- The subsidy to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs on the landRs. building and plant & machinery will be applicable on the investment made on or after 24-8-2011. The unit should commence production/complete expansion as the case may be on or after 24-8-2011.
- Second-hand machinery shall be eligible provided it is imported by the unit directly or through an agentRs. and the claim is supported with required import documents.

name: "Generator Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives"
brief_description: "Generator Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives" is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce DepartmentRs. Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme came into force with effect from 1st April 2017 and is in operation in the whole of the UT of Puducherry. Through this schemeRs. 50% subsidy is provided to the industrial units of the microRs. smallRs. medium and large industries for the purchase and installation of generators. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available on the Official Website of the Department.
benefits:
- **Subsidy:** 50%.- **Purpose:** For the purchase and installation of the Generator purchased on or after 1st April 2017.- **Ceiling:** 5Rs./- per annum per industrial unit.- **Number of Installments:** In single or multiple instalmentsRs. depending on the availability of funds.- **Mode of Disbursement:** The subsidy amount shall be disbursed through the financial institutions/banks onlyRs. if the unit is financed by themRs. towards the adjustment against the loan availed by the entrepreneurs or for the creation of additional fixed assets or for the working capital purposes. In case of self-financed unitsRs. the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the entrepreneur/unit.
_*The financial institution shall mean and include PIPDIC or any other Government CorporationRs. Scheduled Banks including Co-operative Banks._
eligibility:
- All the MicroRs. SmallRs. Medium and Large Industries are eligible.
- The Unit should have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017.
- The unit should provide at least 60% of employment to the people of the Union territory of Puducherry of the total employment strength of the industrial units. This 60% of the local employment will have to be maintained by the industrial unit during the period specified in the Affidavit.
- The generator should have been purchased on or after 1st April 2017.
- The industrial unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset including plant and machinery in any manner till the completion of 5 years from the date of submitting the application/disbursement of the subsidy whichever is later.
- The additional investments made by the new/existing industrial units after availing the first claim are also eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.

_*The date of commencement as admitted by the entrepreneurs shall be reckoned after due verification by the officials of the Industries Department._
> **Special Cases**

IfRs. two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same person as proprietorRs. common partnersRs. common Board of Directors/shareholdersRs. such units are eligible for subsidy as separate entity provided the location of the unit are different and licenses /clearances/ registrations are obtained separately for the enterprises.

name: Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: Group Shows

name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2)
brief_description: The scheme Assistance for ToolsRs. EquipmentRs. Shorting/Grading EquipmentRs. PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2) is implemented by the Directorate of HorticultureRs. name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)
brief_description:
The scheme Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS) is a sub-scheme under the Banglashree for MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises scheme. It was launched on 1st April 2020 by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises and TextilesRs. Government of West BengalRs. and shall remain in force till 31st March 2025.
> **Objectives of the "Banglashree for MSME Scheme:**

The objective of the scheme is to extend fiscal incentives to encourage entrepreneurs to set up MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises with a view to focusing on the balanced development of MSMEs across the State and creating a sustainable ecosystem in the MSME sector which can maximize the utilization of resourceRs. generate new employment and widen the area of operation to make the State emerge as the MSME leader in the country.
> **Objectives of the Interest Subsidy on Term Loan Scheme:**

Through this incentiveRs. an eligible microRs. small or medium enterprise will be entitled to Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Commercial Bank/ Cooperative Bank/ Scheduled Banks approved by RBI/ RRBs/ Financial Institution (Central and State) for implementation of the approved project.
benefits:
**Pattern Of Assistance:** An eligible microRs. small or medium enterprise will be entitled to Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability for 5 years on the Term Loan borrowed from a Commercial Bank/ Cooperative Bank/ Scheduled Banks approved by RBI/ RRBs/ Financial Institution (Central and State) for implementation of the approved project as follows:-
> **Micro & Small Enterprise:**


- Zone A & B - 55% ; Zone CRs. D & E 70%.

> ***Medium Enterprise:***


- Zone BRs. CRs. D & E: - 25% subject to a ceiling of 1Rs./- per year.
eligibility: - The business/organization should be a Micro/ Small/ Medium Enterprise. - The business/organization should belong to the manufacturing sector. - The business/organization should have started production on or after 1st April 2019. - The business/organization should be in the private sector/ cooperative sector/ joint sector undertaking or should be a company/ undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or the Industrial SHGs. - The Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) should be between 1st April 2020 to 31st March 2025.

name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS)
brief_description:
The scheme State Capital Investment Subsidy is a sub-scheme under the Banglashree for MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises scheme. It was launched on 1st April 2020 by the Department of MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises and TextilesRs. Government of West BengalRs. and shall remain in force till 31st March 2025.
> **Objectives of the "Banglashree for MSME Scheme:**

eligibility: 1. The business/organization should be a Micro/ Small/ Medium Enterprise. 1. The business/organization should belong to the manufacturing sector. 1. The business/organization should have started production on or after 1st April 2019. 1. The business/organization should be in the private sector/ cooperative sector/ joint sector undertaking or should be a company/ undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or the Industrial SHGs. 1. The Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) should be between 1st April 2020 to 31st March 2025.

name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive on Generation of Employment
brief_description:
Additional Incentive on Generation of Employment is a sub scheme under The West Bengal Incentive Scheme 2021. It was launched on 22nd FebruaryRs. 2021Rs. by the Department of TourismRs. Government of West BengalRs. and shall remain valid upto 31st DecemberRs. 2025.

The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance and help enthusiastic intending or prospective entrepreneurs to start their own business as a self-employed youth who will become an employer in upcoming days and generate more employment.

Through this incentiveRs. an eligible unit will be entitled to an additional incentive for employment generation for paying its contribution towards Employees State Insurance (ESI) and Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Scheme.

OrRs.

benefits: - 50% up to a maximum amount of 1Rs./-. > **Note:** Subsidy shall be provided of all charges on the amount after deducting the assistance received from Government of India for ZED Certification.

name: Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana
brief_description:
The "Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana" was launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. under Seven Nishchay-2Rs. aims to develop undeveloped and unutilized private land in Bihar for fish-based integrated aquaculture. benefits:
> **Beneficiary-based subsidy:**

name: The Tripura Tribal Folk Arts & Cultural (Financial Assistance) Rules, 2022
brief_description: The "Tripura Tribal Folk Arts & Cultural (Financial Assistance) SchemeRs. 2022" was launched by the Tribal Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Tripura. name: Student Housing Scheme for Students with Disabilities
brief_description: The scheme "Student Housing Scheme for Students with Disabilities" was launched by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Chhattisgarh. benefits:
1. Free facility of accommodation to 01 or more than 01 (group of maximum 05 children) within the fixed rate of rent at the rate prescribed by the Rent Control Authority.

name: Distribution of Certified Seeds of Maize

VillupuramRs. VelloreRs. SalemRs. PudukkottaiRs. MaduraiRs. SivagangaiRs. TrichyRs. TirunelveliRs. and Thoothukudi.

name: Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities
brief_description: The "Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities" was launched by the Minorities Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of KarnatakaRs. and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost or a maximum of 2Rs./- to the self-help groups of the minority community to engage in various types of self-employment activities and make them economically self-reliantRs. on the loans obtained from various financial institutions recognized by the Nationalized/Scheduled Bank/RBI. An SHG is to make fixed savings and provide internal lending to the members of the group as per requirement from the savings amount of the SHG.
benefits:
- **Subsidy Amount:** 50% of the unit cost or a maximum of 2Rs./- to the self-help groups.
**NOTE:** - The subsidy will be adjusted against the repayment of the loan taken by the SHG from recognized financial institutions. - SHGs focusing on good internal loan repayment will be given higher priority for the subsidy.
eligibility: 1. The women in the Self-Help Groups (SHGs) should belong to the minority community. 1. All SHG members must be permanent residents of Karnataka. 1. The number of women in the Self-Help Group should be between 10 and 20. 1. Only one member per family is allowed in a womens Self-Help Group. 1. The family income of the members of the womens Self-Help Group should not exceed 6Rs./-. 1. The age of the members of the womens Self-Help Group should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The womens Self-Help Group must be registered with the Deputy Registrar. 1. Members of the Self-Help Group or their family members should not be employees of the State/Central Government. 1. Members of the Self-Help Group or their family members should not have availed of any loan or subsidy from the corporation in the last 5 yearsRs. except for the Arivu or foreign education loan schemes. 1. Members of Self-Help Groups should not be receiving support from the corporation. 1. The womens Self-Help Group should hold regular meetingsRs. with at least one meeting per month. 1. Self-Help Groups must be operational for at least 6 months to qualify for a corporation subsidy. 1. Self-Help Groups should maintain adequate bookkeeping records.

name: Grant for the Repair of House (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Grant for the Repair of House" scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB)Rs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. eligibility:

1. The worker should be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

1. The workers who have already received financial assistance for house constructionRs. bicyclesRs. or tools are not eligible for this benefit.
1. The assistance will be provided only once to a worker.

name: Danveer Bhamashah Honors- Chhattisgarh
brief_description:
The scheme "Danveer Bhamashah Honors" is implemented by the Social Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to encourage the spirit of charityRs. harmonyRs. patriotismRs. sacrificeRs. and cultural devotion among all sections of the society in the state. The state government has decided to give it to encourage the contributions of outstanding individuals/organizations that provide charityRs. hospitalityRs. and exemplary assistance in the state of Chhattisgarh.
**Objectives:**
The purpose of this honor is to encourage patriotismRs. sacrificeRs. and cultural devotion in the state through the spirit of charity and harmony among all sections of the society. Along with thisRs. public participation has to be promoted in permanent social service works so that a good environment of social consciousness can develop in the state. This honor will be given to an outstanding person/organization for such remarkable work.
benefits:
- An award amount of 1Rs./- along with a certificate of appreciation will be granted to the recipient.

**Note:** The person/officer of the organization selected for the award will be eligible to receive a traveling allowance equivalent to a Grade-A level officer of the government along with an assistant to attend the function.
eligibility:
1. The applicant/organization should be a resident of/established in Chhattisgarh.
1. There should be a long-term involvement in permanent works of charityRs. patriotismRs. and social service within the state.
1. The past work of the individual/organization should be outstanding and continuously active at present in that area. Result-oriented continuity is essential.
1. The contribution of the individual/organization should reflect a wider impact in the respective field of work. It should be clearly reflected to what extent and how intensively innovationRs. i.e. new methods and new areas have been adopted by moving away from the traditional methods.
1. The entry of an organization or individual whose official is a member of that year's award jury will not be considered.
1. An organization or individual who has received an award in the field of charity in the last 5 years will also be eligible for this award.
1. The assessment for the award will consider both the past and present work of the individual/organization.
1. Government/semi-government institutions or their employees will not be eligible for the honor.
1. Only continuous upliftment workRs. free from conflicts and supported by proper evidenceRs. will be considered.

**Note 1:** If the government or the jury receives the proposal through any other meansRs. the decision for the award can be taken after obtaining an opinion from the concerned district as per requirement.
**Note 2:** In case the entry received by any organization/person is not selectedRs. the original entry can be returned to the concerned organization/person through the district administration.
**Note 3:** NormallyRs. only one person or organization will be selected for the award. HoweverRs. if the jury deems it necessaryRs. two persons or organizations may be selectedRs. and the prize money will be divided equally between them.
**Note 4:** Not being selected once will not mean that the work of the concerned person/organization is not award-worthy. Individuals/institutions fulfilling the prescribed criteria will be able to submit entries again in subsequent years.

name: Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses
brief_description: The Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses aims to provide financial assistance to the children of teachers/lecturers working in government and aided primaryRs. secondaryRs. graduateRs. and post-graduate institutions. name: Maternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)

name: Cluster Mei Bagwani Ki Yojana-II

name: Reservoir Fisheries Development Scheme

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Reimbursement of SGST Paid on Capital Goods
brief_description: The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Patent Registration
brief_description:
The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. The component "Assistance for Patent Registration"Rs. provides financial support for individuals and legal entities to obtain patent registration for their developed products or processes. - 75% of the cost incurred for patent applications.
- Maximum assistance of 25Rs./- per applicant/enterprise.


> **Eligible Expenditures:**



- Fees for patent attorneyRs. patent service centerRs. and patent registration.

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Financial Support to MSMEs in ZED Certification

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: Net SGST Reimbursement
brief_description:

It aims to empower the state's dynamic large-industry sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from October 5Rs. 2022Rs. to October 4Rs. 2027Rs. this initiative supports growthRs. investmentsRs. and the vision of "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat" and "Aatmanirbhar Bharat."
The component "Net SGST Reimbursement" is designed to incentivize large industrial undertakings by reimbursing a portion of their SGST for a specific period (10 years)Rs. based on the category of their taluka and sector.
benefits:
**Category of Taluka****General****Thrust**Category 1100% of net SGST for 10 years upto 7.5% of eFCl p.a. 100% of net SGST for 10 years upto 8% of eFCl p.a. Category 290% of net SGST for 10 years upto 6.5% of eFCl p.a. 90% of net SGST for 10 years upto 7% of eFCl p.a. eligibility:

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: EPF Reimbursement
brief_description:
The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic mega-industry sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from October 5Rs. 2022Rs. to October 4Rs. 2032Rs. this initiative supports growthRs. investmentsRs. and the vision of "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat" and "Aatmanirbhar Bharat."
The component "EPF Reimbursement" offers financial support to eligible Mega Industrial Units in Gujarat by reimbursing the employer's contribution to the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) for new employees.
benefits: - **Reimbursement:** 100% reimbursement of employers statutory EPF contribution.- **Incentive Ceiling:** 12% of basic salary + DA or 1800/- per monthRs. whichever is lower.
eligibility:
1. The mega industry must operate as a manufacturing unit.
1. The unit must have a minimum investment of 2Rs./- crore in plant and machinery.
1. The unit must provide direct employment to at least 2Rs. persons.
1. The unit must belong to one of the thrust sectors as defined in the [Guidelines](https://cmogujarat.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-01/AatmaNirbhar-Gujarat_Industrial-Policy_0.pdf) (Refer Page No. 9). 1. Only new employees who do not have a Universal Account Number (UAN) before joining the unit are eligible.
1. The reimbursement is only for incremental employee count post-expansion.

name: Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities: Assistance to R&D Institutions/ Laboratories set up by the State Government or by Government of India
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative promotes sustainable industrial growth by supporting industries in adopting eco-friendly practices and ensuring compliance with environmental norms.
The component "Assistance to R&D Institutions/ Laboratories set up by the State Government or by Government of India" supports the establishment of new laboratories and the modernization or strengthening of existing facilities to enhance their capabilities in research and innovation.
benefits: - **Setting Up New Facilities:** Assistance to R&D institutions/ laboratories set up by the State Government or Government of India including setting up of new R&D institutions / laboratories shall be provided as per requirement.
eligibility:
> **Eligible institution:** - All Research and Development Institutions recognized by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) / Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR) and set up by the Government of Gujarat (GoG) / Government of India (Gol).
> **Eligible Activities:** - Setting up of new laboratory as well as strengthening of existing laboratory. - StrengtheningRs. modernizationRs. and addition / up-gradation of existing facilities of the eligible Institutions.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Skill Up-gradation Centers (SUCs)
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to bridge the industrys skill gapRs. boost employmentRs. and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.
The component Skill Up-gradation Centers (SUCs) aims to establish modernRs. well-equipped training centers in GIDC EstatesRs. Other Registered EstatesRs. Industrial ParksRs. SEZsRs. and Investment Regions. These centers will focus on need-based skill enhancementRs. ensuring employment opportunities for trained candidates.
benefits:
> **Quantum of Assistance:** Support for the acquisition of machinery/equipment/ tools/ furniture & fixtures costing upto 1Rs./- will be extended to each SUC in the following manner:


- 100% for GIDC Estates or Other Registered Estates.
- 75% for Industrial Parks/ SEZs/ Investment Regions.
- The machinery & equipment/tools/ furniture & fixtures will be purchased by the CED from the Industries Commissionerate and supplied to SUCs. The cost of transportation/ erection/ electrification etc.Rs. will be provided by the CED.
- Procurement of machinery & equipment/tools/ furniture & fixtures costing below 1Rs./- per course.

&gt; **Additional Assistance:**


- **Awareness Programs & Seminars:** A maximum support of 1Rs./- per training center per year will be provided for awareness programs and seminars.

- **Other Expenditures:** SLEC/IC/CED can approve the expenditure on any studyRs. renovation/refurbishing of existing skill centers/instituteRs. remuneration to third party evaluation of schemeRs. monitoring/audit expensesRs. assessment agencyRs. etc.

- **Trainee Transportation Reimbursement:** Trainees who complete skill upgradation training under any scheme will be eligible for reimbursement of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) bus passes for travel between their residence and training center as per the following rates:

1. **For BPL candidatesRs. Physically HandicappedRs. SCRs. STRs. SEBCRs. and Women:** 100% 1. **For Other candidates:** 75%
eligibility:
- Organizations such as Industrial ParksRs. SEZsRs. GIDC EstatesRs. Investment RegionsRs. and other registered estates can apply.
- The applying entity must provide the land/building for the SUC.
- The training partner must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in skill training.
- The center must ensure the training of at least 180 candidates per year.
- Employment placement of trainees must meet the set percentage criteria (60% in the first two years and 75% in the last three years).

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Interest Subsidy
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobsRs. fostering competitionRs. and introducing next-gen solutions.
The component "Interest Subsidy" provides financial support to startups with innovative ideas across various sectors. Startups approved under this scheme are eligible for an additional interest subsidy of 1%Rs. up to a maximum of 9%Rs. on term loans for MSME assistance.
benefits: - **Financial Support:** Interest subsidy of 1%Rs. maximum up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of scheme for assistance to MSMEs.
eligibility:
- Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or conceptRs. recommended by an approved Nodal InstitutionRs. is eligible.
- The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of scienceRs. technologyRs. engineeringRs. agricultureRs. healthcareRs. etc.Rs. making it sector-agnostic.

> **Note:** Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Pre- Series A Funding
brief_description: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobsRs. fostering competitionRs. and introducing next-gen solutions. The component "Pre-Series A Funding"Rs. bridges the financial gap known as the "valley of death" in a startup's lifecycle. This phase occurs after commercializationRs. when startups begin generating revenue but have not yet gained significant market traction. Under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL)Rs. a special fund is created to provide mid-level Pre-Series A funding to startupsRs. particularly those that have received seed support under various government schemes.
benefits: - **Bridges Funding Gap:** Provides financial support during the critical "valley of death" phase.
eligibility:
- Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or conceptRs. recommended by an approved Nodal InstitutionRs. is eligible.
- The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of scienceRs. technologyRs. engineeringRs. agricultureRs. healthcareRs. etc.Rs. making it sector-agnostic.

**Note:** Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.

name: Scheme for assistance for Research & Development Activities: Assistance to Establish Research & Development/Product Development Centre
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative promotes sustainable industrial growth by supporting industries in adopting eco-friendly practices and ensuring compliance with environmental norms.
The component "Assistance to Establish Research & Development/Product Development Centre" provides financial support to eligible institutions for establishing R&D or product development centers. It aims to promote innovationRs. technological advancementsRs. and product design improvements.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to 30% of the investment in machineryRs. equipmentRs. hardwareRs. softwareRs. and related assets (excluding land and building costs) subject to a maximum up to 5Rs./- for one or more activities.
eligibility:
> **Eligible institution:** - Institution/ Industrial Association / Professional Bodies which are recognized by CSIR / DSIR and legal entity such as companyRs. partnership firm including LLPRs. societyRs. trustRs. industrial co-operative societyRs. or proprietary concern engaged or about to be engaged in the manufactureRs. productionRs. processing or job work of articles.
> **Eligible Activities:** - Setting up / establishing an R&D Centre with the sole objective of undertaking scientificRs. industrialRs. and/or technological research and development. - Setting up / establishing a Product Development Centre with the objective to improve the designsRs. processRs. working operationsRs. etc.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Skill Development to MSME Sector
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to bridge the industrys skill gapRs. boost employmentRs. and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.
The component Scheme of Financial Assistance for Skill Development to MSME Sector aims to provide financial support to MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) for the skill upgradation of their workforce. Under this schemeRs. MSMEs can sponsor employees with at least one year of experience for training programs.
benefits:
- **Financial Assistance:** 100% reimbursement of course feesRs. up to 10Rs./- per trainee. - **Skill Enhancement:** Employees receive skill upgradationRs. improving efficiency and productivity. - **Recognized Training:** Programs are conducted by institutions approved by Anchor InstitutesRs. MESRs. NCVTRs. GCVTRs. and Sector Skill Councils. - **Third-Party Assessment:** Ensures quality training through post-course skill assessment.
&gt; **Additional Assistance:**


- **Awareness Programs & Seminars:** A maximum support of 1Rs./- per training center per year will be provided for awareness programs and seminars.

- **Other Expenditures:** SLEC/IC/CED can approve the expenditure on any studyRs. renovation/refurbishing of existing skill centers/instituteRs. remuneration to third party evaluation of schemeRs. monitoring/audit expensesRs. assessment agencyRs. etc.

- **Trainee Transportation Reimbursement:** Trainees who complete skill upgradation training under any scheme will be eligible for reimbursement of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) bus passes for travel between their residence and training center as per the following rates:

1. **For BPL candidatesRs. Physically HandicappedRs. SCRs. STRs. SEBCRs. and Women:** 100% 1. **For Other candidates:** 75%
eligibility: - The applicant unit should belong to the MSME sector. - The MSME must sponsor a candidate from its workforce. - The candidate must have at least one year of experience in the MSME. - The training partner/organization must have at least 10 years of experience.

name: Feed Based Fisheries Scheme
brief_description: The "Feed Based Fisheries Scheme" by the AgricultureRs. Animal Husbandry & Cooperation DepartmentRs. Government of Jharkhand aims to enhance fish production through feed-based fisheries. Under this schemeRs. financial support in the form of grants for floating fish feed is provided to fish farmers to increase fish production in various districts like RanchiRs. RamgarhRs. KodermaRs. BokaroRs. DhanbadRs. and Seraikela.
benefits:
**Floating Fish Feed Subsidy:**
Fish farmers receive a grant of 50% of the cost or a maximum of 22 per kg for fish feed with a minimum 24% protein content.
**Support for Cage Fish Farmers:**
Fish farmers using cage systemsRs. Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS)Rs. or Biofloc tanks are eligible for feed subsidies.
**Support for Biofloc Pond Farmers:**
Farmers utilizing Biofloc ponds receive subsidies for fish feedRs. with a maximum of 2000 kg per pond.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a fisherman.
1. The applicant must be an active fish farmer involved in cage fish farmingRs. Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS)Rs. or Biofloc systems.
1. The applicant should have at least one year of previous crop records.
1. The applicant should not be enrolled in other overlapping schemes for the same purpose.

name: Grant-In-Aid to Voluntary Organizations Working In The Area of Disabled Welfare
brief_description: Launched in 2018Rs. the scheme "Grant-in-aid to Voluntary Organizations Working in the Area of Disabled Welfare" by the Department of Social WelfareRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to support institutions working for the welfare of disabled individuals. Through this schemeRs. grants for free educationRs. trainingRs. residential arrangementsRs. and rehabilitation are provided to disabled immigrants. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Social Welfare. AdditionallyRs. grants cover salariesRs. ambulance servicesRs. building rentRs. and office expenses. The scheme also promotes activities such as drug de-addiction and managing institutions under the Juvenile Act and Old Age Homes.
benefits:
**Grant Support:** Financial assistance is provided for free educationRs. trainingRs. residential arrangementsRs. and rehabilitation of disabled individuals.
**Operational Expenses:****** 70% of office expenses coveredRs. up to a maximum of 2Rs./-.
**Teaching & Training:****** 70% of the expenditureRs. up to a maximum of 1Rs./-.
**Building Rent:****** 70% of the total expense is covered.
**Maintenance & Rehabilitation:****** 600/- per inmate per month for careRs. rehabilitationRs. and treatment.
**Employee Salaries:****** 100% salary coverage as per the Collector-approved rates.
eligibility: Institutions that are registered and accredited by the Department and have a work experience of at least three years.

name: Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions
brief_description: The "Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions" scheme by the Directorate of Secondary EducationRs. Department of School Education and LiteracyRs. Jharkhand Government aims to strengthen the infrastructure and ensure the holistic development of approved unaided secondary schoolsRs. permanent intermediate collegesRs. madrasasRs. and Sanskrit schools. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to these institutions for their structural and educational development.
benefits: - **Infrastructure Development Grants:** Financial assistance for classroomsRs. laboratoriesRs. toiletsRs. drinking waterRs. and essential facilities.- **Educational Resources:** Support for procuring teaching and learning materials.- **Staffing Assistance:** Salaries for qualified teaching and non-teaching staff as per norms.
eligibility:
***For Secondary Schools:*** 1. The applicant should be an institution approved by the State Government. 1. The school should be operated by a registered society or trust under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860. 1. The managing committee should be duly constituted and approved by Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC). 1. The institution must have a student strength meeting the prescribed norms. 1. The schools examination pass rate should be at least 41%. 1. Utilization certificates for previously received grants must be submitted.
***For Madrasas/Sanskrit Schools:*** 1. The applicant should be a recognized and registered madrasa or Sanskrit school in Jharkhand. 1. The managing committee should be duly constituted. 1. The institution must meet student strength norms. 1. The pass percentage should not be below 41%.
***For Intermediate Colleges:*** 1. The applicant should be a permanently approved institution under Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC). 1. The college must be operated by a registered society or trust under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860. 1. The institution must comply with JAC and Government rules.

name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
brief_description:
The scheme "Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative supports SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEsRs. making them globally competitive.
The component "Assistance in Rent to MSEs" provides financial assistance to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) engaged in manufacturing activities that operate from rented or leased sheds. Under this schemeRs. eligible enterprises can receive reimbursement of up to 70% of their rentRs. with a maximum limit of 1Rs./- per annum.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 70 % of rent paid by the enterprise with a maximum limit of 1Rs./- per annum for 5 years.
eligibility:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
1. The applicant must be a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) engaged in manufacturing activities.
1. The enterprise must be operating from a legally rented/leased shed.
1. The rented/leased sheds owner must have legal ownership and possession of the property.
1. The manufacturing unit must be consuming electricity/power for production activities.

> **Note****:**


- **SC/ST Enterprise:** SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.

name: Annual Medical Assistance Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief_description: The "Annual Medical Assistance Scheme" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare BoardRs. Labour Resources DepartmentRs. Government of BiharRs. provides a yearly financial assistance of 3Rs./- to the construction workers who are registered with the Board.
benefits: Financial Assistance of 3Rs./- per annum.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a worker.
- The worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
- The worker should be registered with the "Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
- The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
- The worker should have at least one year of membership with the Board.

name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Power Tariff Subsidy
brief_description:
The "Gujarat Textile Policy" is an umbrella scheme introduced by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aimed at augmenting investments in the textile sector and strengthening the textile value chain across each sub-sectorRs. while also focusing on strengthening the garments and apparel as well as technical textiles industry. Effective from October 1stRs. 2024 to September 29thRs. 2029Rs. this initiative focuses on reducing the carbon footprint and promoting green growthRs. thereby making the sector globally competitive and environmentally sustainable.
The component "Power Tariff Subsidy" is aimed at reducing electricity costs for eligible industrial units. This subsidy provides financial relief on power tariffs for industries availing electricity either from DISCOM (Distribution Companies) or through renewable power sources under open access.
benefits: **Activity****Power Tariff Subsidy**Activity-1INR 1/unit (kWh) Availing power either from DISCOM or Renewable Power through open-access for period of 5 years from DoCP Activity-2INR 1/unit (kWh) Availing power either from DISCOM or Renewable Power through open-access for period of 5 years from DoCP
eligibility:
1. New industrial units are eligible for the Power Tariff Subsidy.
1. Existing industrial units undergoing expansionRs. diversificationRs. or modernization are eligible.
1. The industrial unit must submit electricity bills in its name.
1. The unit must apply within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).

**Note:** In the case of expansion/diversification/modernizationRs. the subsidy applies only to additional power consumption beyond the previous years average.
> **Eligible Activities:**

**Activity 1:**

- GarmentsRs. Apparel & Made-upsRs. Technical Textiles Activity (including Composite Unit)

**Activity 2:**

- Weaving (with or without preparatory)Rs. KnittingRs. Dyeing & ProcessingRs. TexturisingRs. TwistingRs. Embroidery and MMF Spinning to manufacture yarn from Polyester Staple Fiber (PSF) / Viscose Staple Fiber (VSF) (excluding Spinning activity of Cotton and Synthetic Filament Yarn).

name: Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme, 2008
brief_description: Launched in 2008Rs. the scheme "Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed SchemeRs. 2008" by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and CommerceRs. Government of Goa aimed to encourage local youthsRs. preferably of Goan originRs. to start income-generating activities by providing share capital contribution for industrial and self-employment opportunities. The scheme offered financial support up to 2Rs./- per individual (3Rs./- for those with professional qualifications) and up to 10Rs./- for groupsRs. covering 50% of the project cost. Eligible applicants included individuals or groups of individuals who were residents of Goa for at least 15 yearsRs. with preference given to womenRs. disabled personsRs. and those from Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Other Backward Classes. The scheme was implemented by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and CommerceRs. GoaRs. and remained in force until 31st March 2011.
benefits:
- **Capital Contribution**


- 2Rs./- per individualRs. covering 50% of the total project cost.
- 3Rs./- per individual for those with professional qualificationsRs. provided the business activity was linked to their qualifications.
- 10Rs./- maximum for groupsRs. with no restriction on the number of members.

**Interest-Free Loan:** The capital contribution was interest-free.
**Repayment:** Repayment was to be made in equal monthly installments within 10 yearsRs. with a moratorium period not exceeding one year.
**Insurance Cover:** Special insurance cover was providedRs. absolving the beneficiary of outstanding dues in case of death or permanent disability. The insurance premium was 200 perRs./- or part thereofRs. to be paid once before disbursal.
**Disbursement**

- Disbursement of capital contribution was made upon approval of the application by the Task Force Committee.
- The last date for disbursement was 31st January for claims filed between January and JuneRs. and 31st July for claims filed between July and December.
eligibility:
- The applicant could be Individuals or groups of individuals could apply. Individuals born and resident in Goa for 15 years were given preference.
- The applicant had to be below 40 years of age. For womenRs. disabled personsRs. Scheduled CastesRs. Scheduled TribesRs. and Other Backward ClassesRs. the age limit was relaxed by 5 years.
- The applicant had to have passed at least the 8th standard. This requirement could be relaxed in deserving cases by the Director of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce.
- The income of the applicant along with their spouse should not exceed 80Rs./- per annum.
- The applicants who had availed more than 15% subsidy under any other scheme were not eligible.
- The applicants who were covered under the Kamdhenu Scheme (except for dairy/dhilling units) were not eligible.

**Preference/Priority**

- Priority was given to women entrepreneursRs. self-help groups of womenRs. and disabled persons.
- 30% of the budgeted outlay was reserved for women entrepreneurs.

_*The Director of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce could relax any provision of the scheme with government approval if needed._

name: One Time Settlement (O.T.S.) Scheme
brief_description: Launched in 2009Rs. the scheme "One Time Settlement (O.T.S.) Scheme" by the Electricity DepartmentRs. Government of Goa aims to facilitate the quick recovery of outstanding electricity dues from defaulting consumers with accumulated arrears of up to 20Rs./- as of 31-3-2008. The scheme offers a waiver of delayed payment chargesRs. including 18% interestRs. allowing consumers to pay only the principal amount in a lump sum. It is applicable to consumers in categories such as LIG (Low-Income Group)Rs. DomesticRs. AgricultureRs. Small CommercialRs. and LTP (Motive Power)Rs. whose installations are temporarily or permanently disconnected. The scheme is implemented by the Sub-Divisional Officers of the Electricity Department and is valid for three months from the date of notification.
benefits:
- All delayed payment chargesRs. including 18% interestRs. will be waived off for consumers whose cases are referred to the Revenue Recovery Court (R.R.C.) from the date of referring the case till the date of realization of outstanding dues.
- Consumers will have to pay only the principal amount in a lump sum.
- The 100/- deposited along with the application will be adjusted against the energy bill to be settled under the scheme.

_*If the consumer backs out or fails to pay the finalized amount within the specified periodRs. the 100/- will be forfeited._
eligibility:
- The scheme is applicable to defaulting consumers in the categories of LIG (Low-Income Group)Rs. DomesticRs. AgricultureRs. Small CommercialRs. and LTP (Motive Power).
- Consumers with accumulated arrears of up to 20Rs./- as of 31-3-2008 are eligible.
- The scheme is applicable to consumers whose installations are temporarily or permanently disconnected as of 31-3-2008 for non-payment of outstanding arrears.
- Consumers whose cases have been referred to the Revenue Recovery Court (R.R.C.) are also eligible.

name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance for Quality Certification
brief_description:
The "Gujarat Textile Policy" is an umbrella scheme introduced by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aimed at augmenting investments in the textile sector and strengthening the textile value chain across each sub-sectorRs. while also focusing on strengthening the garments and apparel as well as technical textiles industry. Effective from October 1stRs. 2024 to September 29thRs. 2029Rs. this initiative focuses on reducing the carbon footprint and promoting green growthRs. thereby making the sector globally competitive and environmentally sustainable.
The component "Assistance for Quality Certification" provides financial support to industrial units for obtaining National and International quality certifications (such as BISRs. ISIRs. WHO-GMPRs. HallmarkRs. etc.).
benefits:
- **Financial Support:** Reimbursement of 50% of certification fees and 50% of testing equipment/machinery costs up to 10Rs./-. - **Eligible Certifications:** Includes BISRs. ISIRs. WHO-GMPRs. HallmarkRs. and other recognized National/International certifications. - **Covered Expenses:**



1. Fees charged by certification agencies (excluding travelRs. hotel & surveillance charges).
1. Cost of required testing equipment/machinery.
1. Calibration charges for testing equipment.
eligibility:
- The certification must be from a recognized national or international body.
- The unit should have incurred actual expenses for certification and testing equipment.
- The application must be submitted within one year from the date of certification.

name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Power Connection Charges
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Assistance to MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative supports entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEsRs. making them globally competitive.
The component "Assistance for Power Connection Charges" provides financial assistance to MSMEs (MicroRs. Small & Medium Enterprises) that are located outside GIDC (Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation) or other approved industrial parks.
benefits: - **Quantum of Assistance:** 35% of charges paid to distribution licenses for LT (Low Tension)/HT(High Tension) service lineRs. maximum limit up to 5Rs./-.
eligibility:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise.
1. The unit must be located outside GIDC or an approved industrial park.
1. The applicant must have paid power connection charges to the distribution licensee during the scheme's operative period.
1. The application for reimbursement must be submitted within one year of payment.

name: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2008
brief_description: Launched in 2008Rs. the scheme "Interest Subsidy SchemeRs. 2008" by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and CommerceRs. Government of Goa aimed to boost economic growth in the state by providing interest subsidies to Micro and Small Enterprises. The scheme offered financial incentives to new enterprisesRs. making their operations more viable and promoting industrial growth. Eligible units included those that had commenced commercial production after the scheme's launch and were registered with the Directorate. The scheme remained in force until 31st MarchRs. 2011.
benefits:
- Incentives were given to eligible units to the extent of 1% of the total net turnover or 30% of the interest paid by the unitsRs. whichever was lessRs. subject to a ceiling of 5Rs./- per annum.
- The benefit under this Scheme was for a period of 5 years (20 quarters) from the quarter of applicability.
eligibility:
- Only new Micro and Small Enterprises which went into commercial production after the commencement of this Scheme were eligible to avail facilities under this Scheme.
- Only those units permanently registered with Entrepreneur Memorandum II by the Directorate of IndustriesRs. Trade and Commerce were eligible under this Scheme.
- Units were eligible for the benefit for the period of 5 years (20 quarters) subsequent to the quarter in which the commercial production had commenced.
- This Scheme was applicable to industries covered under the Green list and specified Orange List (The units covered under Orange IIRs. II B were not entitled to avail benefit under this Scheme).
- This Scheme was not applicable to units under revival plan as defined under sick unit revival policy.
- The Scheme was applicable to the units which had availed loan as term loan and working capital from nationalized banks or scheduled bank or Co-operative Bank or Economic Development Corporation Ltd. or any other Financial Institution notified by the Government of Goa.

name: Promoting to Farmer for Post Harvesting & Management (Value Addition)

name: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Tribe Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming
brief_description: The scheme "Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Tribe Farmers to Increase the AreaRs. Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to support Scheduled Tribe farmers by providing cash incentives for high-quality seedsRs. modern farming techniquesRs. and agricultural mechanization. name: Varishtha Bunkar Samman Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2007-08Rs. the scheme "Varishtha Bunkar Samman Yojana" by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur aims to encourage and honor senior weavers in the handloom sector. The scheme provides financial assistance of 11Rs./- to senior weavers who are 60 years or older and have produced the highest amount of cloth in their district. The eligible weavers must be active members of primary weaver cooperative societies affiliated with the State Handloom Union. The scheme is implemented by the Chhattisgarh State Handloom Development and Marketing Cooperative Union LimitedRs. Raipur.
benefits: Financial assistance of 11Rs./- is provided.

- The weaver should not be a defaulter with the society.

name: Kisan Vriksha Mitra Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Kisan Vriksha Mitra Yojana" by the Department of ForestRs. EnvironmentRs. and Climate ChangeRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to promote commercial tree plantation on private lands of farmers and other stakeholders. The scheme seeks to increase farmers' incomeRs. reduce the financial burden on the governmentRs. and generate employment opportunities. Eligible beneficiaries include farmersRs. private educational institutionsRs. private trustsRs. panchayatsRs. and leased landholders. The scheme is implemented by the Department of ForestRs. EnvironmentRs. and Climate Change in collaboration with private companies and supportive organizations.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance**


- 100% financial assistance for plantation on up to 5 acres of land (maximum 5Rs. plants).
- 50% financial assistance for plantation on more than 5 acres of land (maximum 1Rs. plants per acre).
- 50% financial assistance for private educational institutionsRs. private trustsRs. panchayatsRs. and leased landholders.

> **Buyback Assurance**

The government ensures buyback of produce like eucalyptusRs. bambooRs. and other economically beneficial trees at a predetermined support price. The scheme also involves private companies and supportive organizations for financial collaboration and buyback assurance.
> **Employment Generation**

The scheme aims to create employment opportunities through plantation activities.
> **Mode of Disbursement**

Financial assistance is disbursed directly to the beneficiaries' accounts after verification of plantation work.
> **Frequency of Disbursement**

Assistance is provided over three yearsRs. with yearly disbursements based on the survival rate of plants.
eligibility:
The following are eligible -

- Farmers with private land.
- Private educational institutions.
- Private trusts.
- Panchayats.
- Leased landholders.

_*Priority is given to farmers and stakeholders who are willing to plant commercially viable tree species like eucalyptusRs. bambooRs. and others._

name: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Construction of Retail Outlets/ Agricultural Malls in State Market Committees
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme to Provide Assistance for Construction of Retail Outlets/ Agricultural Malls in State Market Committees" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to provide financial assistance to market committees in Gujarats "C" and "D" category areas to set up retail outlets/agricultural malls. These establishments help farmers sell their produce directlyRs. eliminating middlemen and ensuring fair prices.
benefits: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance**For Retail Outlet /Krishi MallAny one market committee of the "C" and "D" category of the state will be eligible for assistance to the extent of 90% of the total project cost and a maximum of 2Rs./-
eligibility: - Market Committees of all Areas of C and D Class of Gujarat State shall be eligible for this scheme.

name: COP-5 Financial Assistance to Agricultural Credit Co-operative Banks (PACS/LAMPS) for Reconstruction and Reestablishment (General/Tribal Area)
brief_description: The scheme "COP-5 Financial Assistance to Agricultural Credit Co-operative Banks (PACS/LAMPS) for Reconstruction and Reestablishment (General/Tribal Area)" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to make economically weak but functionally efficient PACS/LAMPS financially viable. These societies play a foundational role in the three-tier cooperative credit systemRs. and their performance impacts District and State Cooperative Banks. The scheme incentivizes societies based on their growth in credit disbursementRs. loan recoveryRs. and deposit mobilization over the past three years (two years for LAMPS).
benefits:
**Incentive admissible over and above the average amount of the last three years****Percentage of the grant of incentive on the excess amount**For growth from 10% to 15% 1 %For growth above 15% and up to 20% 1.5 %For growth above 20% 2% or a maximum of .50Rs./- whichever is less (on deposits up to a 2Rs./- whichever is less)
> **Note:** The benefit of the scheme is available only once in a financial year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a registered Agricultural Co-operative Credit SocietyRs. either a Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS) or a Large-sized Adivasi Multi-Purpose Society (LAMPS).
1. The society must have been operational and performing for the required duration:

- Improvement in loan recovery rates.
- Increase in deposit collection.

name: Managerial Assistance Scheme for Appointment of Veterinarian
brief_description: The "Managerial Assistance Scheme for Appointment of Veterinarian" launched by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare & Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage Panjrapols to maintain animal health by appointing veterinarians who will provide medical servicesRs. artificial insemination (AI)Rs. and vaccinations. The scheme also promotes scientific guidance and technical record maintenance.
benefits: **Component** **Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Constituent Benefits**Managerial assistance to appoint VeterinarianThe Beneficiary Panjarapol Institute will pay 45Rs./- per month to the appointed Veterinarian of which 75% will be paid to the Beneficiary Institute as a maximum of 33Rs./- per month as subsidy.3 Year
eligibility:
1. Panjrapol must be registered under the Charity Act.
1. The Panjrapol must be maintaining more than 2000 animals.

name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)
brief_description: the scheme Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal) by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat aims to enhance the competitiveness of agricultural produce markets affected by globalization and liberalization by enabling infrastructure developmentRs. modernizationRs. and improved facilities through financial support to Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). The scheme seeks to create an environment conducive to direct purchaseRs. contract farmingRs. and private market participation to benefit farmers and stakeholders. **Objectives of the Scheme:** - To strengthen infrastructure facilities in APMCs in tribal areas. - To modernize and develop competitive and efficient agricultural markets. - To support market committees in coping with the changes brought by private sector participation and e-market integration.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance for Modernization:** The scheme provides financial help for the modernization of Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). - **Support for Basic Facility Creation:** Assistance is offered for the creation of essential and modern facilities within these market committees.
eligibility: - Co-operative Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMC) shall be eligible under this scheme. - The applicant APMC must be located in designated tribal areas within Gujarat.

name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
brief_description: The scheme "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to strengthen the infrastructure of agricultural markets in light of the increased competition resulting from globalizationRs. liberalizationRs. and the entry of private players into the agricultural sector. It supports Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) in upgrading facilities such as auction platformsRs. parking areasRs. sanitation amenitiesRs. and storage systems to facilitate efficient marketing of agricultural productsRs. thereby benefiting both producers and consumers. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Agricultural Marketing Board. **Objectives of the Scheme:** - To upgrade APMCs with infrastructure like auction shedsRs. cold storageRs. roadsRs. and weigh-bridges. - To support the establishment of farmer-consumer markets with adequate facilities. - To raise awareness among farmers about modern agricultural practices through agricultural camps. - To assist APMCs in acquiring solid waste management equipment for better sanitation and hygiene. - To encourage direct selling by farmers and reduce intermediaries in the market chain.
benefits: - **Financial Support for Market Committees:** Allocates significant funds (25% for 'A' and 'B' classRs. 50% for 'C' and 'D' class) to support the development and functioning of various market committees. - **Post-Harvest Management:** Includes crucial facilities such as cleaning and grading facilitiesRs. cold storageRs. and ripening chambers to minimize post-harvest losses and improve produce quality. - **Farmer Education and Empowerment:** Establishes farmers' training centers and organizes agricultural camps to educate farmers on modern agricultural practicesRs. including the proper use of seedsRs. fertilizersRs. and pesticides. - **Improved Hygiene and Waste Management:** Provides sanitation facilities and offers assistance to market committees for purchasing solid waste management equipmentRs. promoting cleaner market environments.
eligibility: - The applicant should be an Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) operating in the state of Gujarat. - The applicant APMC should belong to either Class 'A'Rs. 'B'Rs. 'C'Rs. or 'D' as categorized by the government. - The applicant APMC must be engaged in facilitating agricultural produce marketing and must require infrastructure support for modernization. - The applicant must submit a proposal for the development of specific facilities as per the scheme's focus areas.

name: Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General)
brief_description: The scheme "Facilitation of Large Size Godowns in APMC and Taluka-District Purchase Sale Union (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to financially strengthen district and taluka-level cooperative purchase and sale unions across the state. The scheme is designed to help such unions undertake critical infrastructure projectsRs. including purchasingRs. processingRs. gradingRs. cleaningRs. packagingRs. storageRs. brandingRs. and marketing of agricultural produceRs. which ultimately benefits the farmers with improved services and higher financial returns.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Provides crucial capital assistance for the construction of large-sized godowns. - **Infrastructure Development:** Supports the development of essential infrastructure for agricultural activities like processingRs. gradingRs. cleaningRs. washingRs. shorteningRs. packagingRs. and branding. - **Enhanced Marketing Capabilities:** Enables unions to strengthen their marketing and selling capabilitiesRs. potentially leading to better prices for farmers' produce. - **Increased Financial Strength for Unions:** Aims to make District and Taluka Purchase-Sale Unions more financially robust and self-reliant. - **Improved Services for Farmers:** Facilitates the provision of better quality services to farmers through stronger unions and improved facilities.
eligibility: - Cooperative institutions operating at the taluka or district level within the state of Gujarat are eligible under this scheme. - The institution should be registered under the appropriate cooperative society laws. - The institution should have plans for setting up or expanding facilities like storage godownsRs. processing unitsRs. grading and packaging infrastructureRs. or branding and marketing systems.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir - Gujarat
brief_description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland) with the component of the Stocking of fingerlings in reservoir (1000 fingerlings/ha) (3.0 lakh / 1 lakh fingerlingsRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. Through this schemeRs. various forms of assistance are provided for inland fisheries activities to individualsRs. societiesRs. self-help groupsRs. and other private entities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat.
> **Objective:** - Increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities. - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits:
Stocking of fingerlings in reservoirs: Assistance is provided for stocking 1Rs. fingerlings per hectare. The unit cost of the fingerling is 3.00/- per piece. - Assistance of 40% of the unit cost is given for the General category. - Assistance of 60% of the unit cost is given for WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries.
> **Mode of Disbursement:** The assistance is paid through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from the State Government. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit of this component can be availed once in a lifetime.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish Collection Cum Patrolling Boat Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Fish Collection Cum Patrolling Boat" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production in reservoirs and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals engaged in inland fisheries. Through this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided for purchasing fish collection cum patrolling boatsRs. thereby supporting SC leaseholders involved in reservoir-based fisheries. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of FisheriesRs. Government of Gujarat. **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits:
1. The unit cost to Scheduled Caste Leaseholders is 5Rs./-. Assistance is provided at 75% of the unit costRs. which is 3Rs./-Rs. or 75% of the purchase priceRs. whichever is less. 1. The Unit cost for a four-wheel vehicle for the transport of fish to a Scheduled Caste lessee is 6Rs./-. The Unit cost for a Three-wheel vehicle for the transport of fish to a Scheduled Caste lessee is 2Rs./-. eligibility:

The applicant can be an individualRs. a societyRs. a self-help groupRs. an associationRs. a reservoir monopolyRs. or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.

name: ECCE (Early Childhood Care and Education)
brief_description: The scheme ECCE (Early Childhood Care and Education) is an initiative under the Samagra Shiksha ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide quality early childhood developmentRs. careRs. and pre-primary education to children between the ages of 3 to 6 years. TLMRs. and child-friendly facilities in co-located Anganwadi centres operating within the premises of government schools in the state.

name: Breed Multiplication Farms - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
brief_description: The scheme Breed Multiplication Farms is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. benefits: Under this schemeRs. a maximum subsidy of 50 lakh is provided by the Department of Animal Husbandry and DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. for a project cost of 1 crore under the Rashtriya Gokul Mission.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmerRs. a farmer producer companyRs. a registered company under Section 8Rs. or a self-help group based in Uttarakhand.

name: Uttarakhand Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Policy - 2023
brief_description: The Uttarakhand MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises Policy - 2023 is implemented by the MicroRs. SmallRs. and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) under the Department of IndustriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote investment and employment in the state by supporting the establishmentRs. expansionRs. and diversification of microRs. smallRs. and medium enterprises through financial incentives and a favourable ecosystem.
benefits: ***Assistance Provided under the MSME Policy:*** - **DPR Assistance:** 75% reimbursement of expenditure incurred on the preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR). - **Stamp Duty Reimbursement:** 50% to 100%Rs. depending on the category of the enterprise. - **Capital Goods Assistance:** 20% to 50% of the total fixed capital investment in workshop buildingRs. plantRs. and machineryRs. up to a maximum reimbursement of 4 croreRs. as per the district and category of enterprise. - **Interest Subsidy Reimbursement:** 2% to 4% per annumRs. within the prescribed maximum limitRs. as per the district and category of enterprise. - **Electricity Duty Reimbursement:** 100% reimbursement for load up to 500 KW. - **Market Fee Reimbursement:** 50% reimbursementRs. subject to a maximum annual limit. - **Quality Certification Incentive Assistance:** 75% reimbursementRs. up to a maximum of 1 lakh. - **Incentive for Cluster Development:** Financial incentive of 70% of the project costRs. up to a maximum of 5 crore per project.
eligibility: 1. MicroRs. smallRs. and medium manufacturing enterprises in UttarakhandRs. excluding those in the restricted categories under the policyRs. will be eligible. 1. The benefits of the policy will be applicable only if there is a minimum of 25% additional capital investment in the existing enterprise along with at least a 25% increase in capacity. 1. Under the Uttarakhand Enterprise Single Window Facilitation and Licensing ActRs. 2012Rs. enterprises must obtain in-principle approval from the District/State Empowered Committee before commencing commercial production by applying through the CAF (Common Application Form) via the single-window portal. 1. Financial incentives will be provided based on the category of the enterprise (MicroRs. SmallRs. Medium) and the classification of the district/area (Category ARs. BRs. CRs. D). 1. For new units or substantial expansion of existing enterprisesRs. commercial production must commence during the policys period of operationRs. starting from 01.08.2023.

name: Incentives by MSME Department for Setting Up of Aromatic Industries in Aroma Park located at SIIDCUL, Kashipur - Centre for Aromatic Plants
brief_description: The Incentives by MSME Department for Setting Up of Aromatic Industries in Aroma Park located at SIIDCULRs. Kashipur scheme is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP)Rs. SelaquiRs. DehradunRs. under the Department of HorticultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. Kashipur by providing financial incentivesRs. concessional facilitiesRs. and technical support to entrepreneursRs. thereby fostering industrial development and economic growth in the region.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan Yojana (PM-KUSUM) - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan Yojana (PM-KUSUM) is implemented by the Department of Minor IrrigationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote clean and affordable irrigation by replacing diesel pump sets with solar-powered pump setsRs. reducing farmers irrigation costsRs. enhancing energy securityRs. and increasing farmers income through sustainable and efficient use of solar energy. The scheme follows a funding pattern of 50% Central shareRs. 30% State shareRs. and 20% farmer share.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. farmers receive an 80% subsidy on the cost of a solar pump set from the Government of India and the State GovernmentRs. while the remaining 20% of the cost is borne by the farmer. The scheme allows individual farmers to convert their diesel pump sets into solar pump sets of up to 7.5 HP capacityRs. which helps reduce expenditure on diesel and lowers production costsRs. thereby increasing farmers income.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. As per the guidelines of MNRERs. Government of India: - The farmer must agree to contribute 20% of the cost of the solar pump set as the farmers share. - The farmer must have his own borewell. - The farmer should currently be using a diesel pump set for irrigation. - A farmer who wishes to install a USPC along with the solar pump set must agree to make 100% payment for the said work.

name: Hamara School Hamara Vriksh
brief_description: The scheme Hamara School Hamara Vriksh has been launched by the Department of ForestRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The aim of the scheme is to encourage tree plantation and environmental awareness among students by providing free saplings to all government and non-government schools for planting within their premises.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. free saplings are provided for tree plantation in all government and non-government schoolsRs. and after the plantationRs. certificates are issued to the schools by the Forest Department.
eligibility: 1. All government and non-government schools in Uttarakhand are eligible to avail the benefits under the scheme.

name: State Integrated Cooperative Development Project - Fisheries Sector
brief_description: The State Integrated Cooperative Development Project was introduced by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote sustainable fisheries development in Uttarakhand by facilitating the establishment and expansion of cooperative-based fisheries projects in both mountainous and plain regions.
