name: Mukhyamantri Madad Yojana
brief_description:
The "Mukhyamantri Madad Yojana" schemeRs. launched by the Tribal Affairs DepartmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh on 02.10.2019Rs. aims to provide ration-related assistance to Scheduled Tribe families on the birth of a child and the death of a family member. Under this schemeRs. a Scheduled Tribe family receives 50kg of wheat or rice and cooking utensils from the Panchayat upon the birth of a child. In the event of a family member's deathRs. the family is provided with 1 quintal of wheat or rice. AdditionallyRs. 25Rs./- is allocated to each villageRs. deposited in the bank account of the Gram Panchayat SecretaryRs. for purchasing utensils.
The scheme covers 20 identified tribal districts of Madhya Pradesh. Rice is provided in six tribal districts: MandlaRs. DindoriRs. BalaghatRs. ShahdolRs. AnuppurRs. and Umaria. Wheat is provided in the remaining 14 districts: JhabuaRs. AlirajpurRs. BarwaniRs. RatlamRs. HoshangabadRs. BetulRs. SidhiRs. SeoniRs. ChhindwaraRs. DharRs. KhargoneRs. KhandwaRs. BurhanpurRs. and Sheopur.
benefits:
The scheme offers the following assistance to Scheduled Tribe families:

- **Birth of a Child:** Upon the birth of a boy or girlRs. the family will receive 50 kg of wheat and riceRs. along with cooking utensilsRs. provided at the panchayat level. - **Death of a Family Member:** In the event of a family member's deathRs. the family will receive 1 quintal (100 kg) of either wheat or rice.
**Note:** The food grains are provided to the beneficiaries free of cost.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The beneficiary should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The beneficiary should reside in a rural area.
1. No family member should be employed in government service (Class 1/2/3) or hold a high-ranking post.
1. The beneficiary must reside in one of the 20 identified tribal districts of Madhya Pradesh: MandlaRs. DindoriRs. BalaghatRs. ShahdolRs. AnuppurRs. UmariaRs. JhabuaRs. AlirajpurRs. BarwaniRs. RatlamRs. HoshangabadRs. BetulRs. SidhiRs. SeoniRs. ChhindwaraRs. DharRs. KhargoneRs. KhandwaRs. BurhanpurRs. and Sheopur.

**Note:** Benefits under the scheme are provided for the birth of the first or second child of the couple.

name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to CAPF Personnel
brief_description: The scheme "Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to CAPF Personnel" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. Under the schemeRs. ex-gratia grant will be given to those personnel of the CAPF hailing from Haryana who get disabled for life and are boarded out of service due to disability declared as in war/operationRs. in operational areaRs. terrorist activities and natural calamities etc. The grant is given depending on the percentage of disability suffered in the first instance during life.
benefits:
**Ex-gratia grant to disabled CAPF Personnel as per their percentage of disability:**
**Disability 75% and above:** 35Rs./-
**Disability 50% to 74%:** 25Rs./-
**Disability 25% to 49%:** 15Rs./-
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should be a disabled CAPF Personnel who became permanently disabled due to war/operationRs. operational areasRs. terrorist activitiesRs. natural calamitiesRs. etc.
1. The applicant should have been discharged from service due to the disability.
1. The applicant should apply within three years of the disability; otherwiseRs. the application will be considered time-barred.

name: Kalyanamastu Pathakam Scheme - Andhra Pradesh
brief_description: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (APBWC) is announcing the launch of Kalyanamastu PathakamRs. to encourage Vedic Culture. Nowadays most Brahmin girls are not willing to marry the Brahmin boys who are in the professions of PourohityamRs. Veda ParayanamRs. and Archakatam. To encourage the girls marrying the boys who are getting their livelihood through VaidikamRs. a one-time Financial Assistance of 75Rs./- will be granted.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of 75Rs./-.
eligibility:
> **Bride:** 1. The applicant (Bride) should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage. 1. The bride and her parents should belong to the Brahmin community. 1. The bride should be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS).
> **Bridegroom:** 1. The bridegroom should have completed 21 years at the time of marriage. 1. The bridegroom should be a Brahmin resident of Andhra Pradesh and his livelihood should come from Pourohityam or Veda Parayanam or Archakatvam. 1. The bridegroom should not be a full-time employee/businessman/professional in other professions or an Industrialist.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana" scheme was launched by the Minority Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Bihar. The objective of this scheme is to provide loans of up to 5Rs./- at a simple annual interest rate of 5% to youths from minority communities (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. and Parsi) for generating employment. The loan must be repaid in 20 quarterly installments over a period of 5 years. This is a state-sponsored scheme and is implemented by the Bihar State Minorities Financial Corporation Limited.
benefits:
- Under this schemeRs. loans of up to 5Rs./- are provided to youth from minority communities at a simple annual interest rate of 5% for the purpose of generating employment.

**Note 1:** After issuing the Sanction OrderRs. the loan amount is transferred to the beneficiary's account via RTGS.
**Note 2:** If the sanctioned amount is:

- **More than 1Rs./- (per unit of equipment or machinesRs. etc.):** The amount is transferred to the vendors account after receiving a quotation or proforma invoice. - **Less than 1Rs./-:** The amount is transferred directly to the applicant's account.
> **Loan Recovery:**


- **Interest:** A simple interest of 5% will be levied on the loan amount after a 3-month moratorium period. - **EMI:** The loan must be repaid in 20 equal quarterly installments. - **Processing Charge:** A 0.5% processing fee of the sanctioned amount will be deducted before the RTGS payment. - **Rebate:** A 0.5% rebate on the outstanding interest will be given if the full loan amount is repaid on time. - **Penalty:** Failure to pay EMIs on time will result in compounded interest being recovered at the end of the financial year. - **Post-dated Cheques:** The applicant is required to submit 10 to 20 post-dated cheques.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should apply for the scheme benefits in their district of permanent residence.
1. The applicant should belong to a minority community (MuslimRs. SikhRs. ChristianRs. BuddhistRs. JainRs. or Parsi).
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 50 years.
1. The applicant should not be a government or semi-government employee.
1. The applicants annual family income should be less than 4Rs./-.

**Note 1:** The loan must be used exclusively for employment and income-generation activities.
**Note 2:** Applicants from all minority communitiesRs. except MuslimsRs. must submit a religious belief certificate issued by a recognized religious body.
> **Priority Criteria:**

1. Former beneficiaries who have fully repaid their loans on time are exempt from the selection and site inspection process.
2. Preference will be given to applicants who meet one or more of the following criteria:

- Have an educational qualification or are trained under a skill development scheme
- Reside in a rural area
- Are womenRs. disabledRs. abandonedRs. or widowed
- Aged between 18 to 35 years
- Members of a government-registered cooperative institutionRs. federationRs. or self-help group (SHG)
- Experienced applicants or shopkeepers

> **Guarantor:**


- **Upto 1Rs./-:** Self guarantee/guarantee by a person who has/ whose either parent has a rent receipt/ other related document for guarantee. - **More than 1Rs./-:** A govt/semi-govt/bank/ autonomous body employee (at least 5 years of service remaining)Rs. income tax payeeRs. Anganbadi workersRs. teachers from Registered MadarsasRs. permanent teachers or mutawalli from registered waqf who has immoveable properties of equitable mortgage.

name: Home Nursing Scholarship Scheme
brief_description: "Home Nursing Scholarship" is a scholarship scheme by the Directorate of Social WelfareRs. Government of Goa. Through this schemeRs. scholarships are provided to the students from Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes / Other Backward Class / Minorities and also to the Students with Disability. The scholarships are provided to pursue Home Nursing courses from institutions recognized by the State/Central Goverment. The scholarship covers Course FeesRs. Maintenance AllowanceRs. and expenditure to be incurred on BooksRs. UniformRs. Stationery etc.
benefits:
##### **COURSE FEES** - For Certificate Courses of Duration of at Least Six Months: 3Rs./- or Actual Whichever is Less. - For Diploma Courses of Duration of One Year or More: 5Rs./-or Actual Whichever is Less. - For Degree in Nursing of Duration of Three Years: 10Rs./- or Actual Whichever is Less. - For Health Worker Course of Duration of One Year or More: 3Rs./- or Actual Whichever is Less.
##### **MAINTENANCE ALLOWANCE (PER MONTH)** ***For Day Scholars*** - 500/- for Scheduled Caste Students - 300/- for Other Students ***For Hostellers*** - 800/- for Scheduled Caste Students - 600/- for Other Students
##### **ADDITIONAL ONE-TIME AMOUNT** _(towards the Expenditure to be incurred on BooksRs. UniformRs. Stationery etc)_ - 1Rs./- for Certificate Courses of Duration of at Least Six Months - 2Rs./- for Diploma Courses of Duration of One Year or More - 3Rs./- for Degree in Nursing of Duration of Three Years - 2Rs./- for Health Worker Course of Duration of One Year or More
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Student.
2. The applicant should have either been born in Goa or should have resided in Goa for continuously at least 15 years.
3. The applicant should have secured admission to an institution recognized by the State/Central Goverment.
4. The applicant should be pursuing one of the following courses:

- Certificate Course in Home of Duration of at Least Six Months.
- Diploma in Home Nursing of Duration of One Year or More.
- Degree in Nursing of Duration of Three Years.
- Health Worker Course of Duration of One Year or More.

5. The annual income of the parent or guardian of the applicant (from all sources) shall not exceed 1Rs./-.
6. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Other Backward Class / Minority or be differently-abled.
**NOTE:** A scholarship holder under this scheme shall not avail of any other scholarship/stipend to pursue the same course.

name: Gaushala Vikas Yojana
brief_description: The "Gaushala Vikas Yojana" launched on 26th December 2019Rs. by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. RajasthanRs. aims to support registered gaushalas with ownership or long-term leased land (minimum 20 years) to develop permanent infrastructure. Eligible gaushalas must have maintained at least 100 cattle consistently for the past two years and should not have any financial irregularities under review.
benefits: - Financial aid of up to 10Rs./- for infrastructure development.
eligibility:
1. Gaushalas with ownership or leased land (minimum of 20 years) approved by a competent authority are eligible.
1. Gaushalas must have consistently maintained at least 100 cows for the past two years to qualify for infrastructure construction.
1. Gaushalas should not have any pending cases of financial irregularity or embezzlement.
1. Gaushalas committed to developing their own resources to achieve self-reliance and self-sufficiency are encouraged to apply.
1. Gaushalas willing to share information and cooperate on relevant initiatives are eligible.
1. Basic infrastructure required under the scheme should not have been previously constructed in the Gaushala. HoweverRs. if existing infrastructure is insufficient based on the number of cattleRs. the Gaushala will be eligible for additional construction work as per requirements.
1. Gaushalas registered under the Rajasthan Gaushala ActRs. 1960Rs. Rajasthan Society Registration ActRs. 1958Rs. or Lalsamay Pravat Law are eligible.
1. Institutions recommended or approved by the District-Level Gaushala Committee in exceptional circumstances are also eligible.

name: Adivasi Sanskriti Evam Kala Kendra/Majhi Bhavan, Manki Munda Bhavan, Parha Bhavan, Pargana Bhavan, Dumkuria Bhavan Evam Gosade Nirman Tatha Majhi Than Shed Nirman Yojana
brief_description: The "Adivasi Sanskriti Evam Kala Kendra/Majhi BhavanRs. Manki Munda BhavanRs. Parha BhavanRs. Pargana BhavanRs. Dumkuria Bhavan Evam Gosade Nirman Tatha Majhi Than Shed Nirman Yojana" by the Scheduled TribesRs. Scheduled CastesRs. MinoritiesRs. and Backward Classes Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of Jharkhand aims to preserveRs. protectRs. and develop tribal culture and traditions. Under this schemeRs. essential infrastructureRs. including community centersRs. cultural hubsRs. and traditional venuesRs. are built to serve the tribal population as focal points for cultural and social activities.
benefits: - **Grants and Allocations:** Financial assistance of 25Rs./- to 5Rs./- per projectRs. based on the scope of work and infrastructure required.- **Construction of Cultural Hubs:** Dedicated centers for tribal cultural preservation such as Majhi BhavansRs. Dumkuria BhavansRs. and Pargana Bhavans.- **Basic Infrastructure Development:** Facilities include boundary wallsRs. multipurpose hallsRs. drinking water arrangementsRs. seating spacesRs. drivewaysRs. and parking.- **Beautification and Cultural Representation:** Tribal-themed landscapingRs. wall paintingsRs. and decor to showcase tribal traditions.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should represent a village with a significant tribal population.
1. The applicant village must have recognized traditional tribal leadersRs. such as MankiRs. MundaRs. or Pahan.
1. The applicant committee must be formed under the leadership of tribal leaders with 7-11 tribal members.
1. The applicant village must have government-approved land for the construction of the infrastructure.

name: Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH
brief_description: The Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH by the Department of Animal Husbandry and FisheriesRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to support fishermen cooperatives and enhance fish production in the state. Under this schemeRs. financial aidRs. technical supportRs. and welfare measures are provided to fishermen cooperatives to strengthen their operations and improve their socio-economic status.
benefits: - **Financial Aid:** 48Rs./- allocated as grants to assist cooperative societies.- **Administrative Support:** Funds for machineryRs. equipmentRs. seminarsRs. publicityRs. and office expenses.- **Infrastructure Development:** 5Rs./- for maintenance and renovation of facilities.- **Marketing Support:** Assists in providing fair prices for fish and improving marketing strategies.- **Fishermen Welfare:** Welfare programs designed to enhance the socio-economic status of fishermen.- **New Vehicle Purchase:** 6Rs./- for purchasing new vehicles for operational use.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a member of a registered fishermen cooperative society.
1. The cooperative society must be affiliated with JHASCOFISH.
1. The society should actively participate in fish production or related activities.
1. Societies with pending legal cases or misuse of prior funds are not eligible.

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Technology Acquisition
brief_description:
The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from October 5Rs. 2022Rs. to October 4Rs. 2027Rs. this initiative supports growthRs. investmentsRs. and the vision of "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat" and "Aatmanirbhar Bharat."
The component "Assistance for Technology Acquisition" supports enterprises in acquiring appropriate technology for their product or processRs. covering up to 85% of the cost including royalty payments for the first 2 years.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** - Covers 65% of the technology acquisition cost. - Maximum assistance of 50Rs./-Rs. including royalty payments for two years. > **Eligibility for Prior Costs:** - Enterprises opting for this scheme are eligible for assistance on expenses incurred under the previous scheme during the operative period.
eligibility:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise.
1. The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)Rs. as applicable.
1. New manufacturing enterprises or existing ones undertaking expansion or diversification are eligible.
1. The enterprise must commence commercial production during the scheme's operative period.

name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: EPF Reimbursement
brief_description:
The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic large-industry sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from October 5Rs. 2022Rs. to October 4Rs. 2027Rs. this initiative supports growthRs. investmentsRs. and the vision of "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat" and "Aatmanirbhar Bharat."
The component "EPF Reimbursement" offers financial assistance to eligible large industrial undertakings in Gujarat for the employers contribution to the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) for new employees. This assistance is available for a maximum period of 10 years from the date of commencement of commercial production.
benefits: - **Full reimbursement of employers contribution:** 100% of the employers statutory EPF contribution will be reimbursed for eligible new employees. - **Financial ceiling per employee:** The reimbursement amount is limited to 12% of the employees basic salary plus Dearness Allowance (DA) and retaining allowanceRs. or 1800/- per monthRs. whichever is lower. - **Long-term support:** The reimbursement is available for a period of up to 10 years from the date of commencement of commercial production.
eligibility:
1. A new large industrial undertakingRs. or an existing one that undertakes expansion and/or diversificationRs. is eligible for this scheme.
1. The large industrial undertaking must have obtained acknowledgment/registrationRs. as the case may be from DPIIT.
1. The industry should commence commercial production during the scheme&#39;s operative period.
1. Must have new employees (those who do not have a Universal Account Number or UAN prior to joining the undertaking).
1. Must not have availed EPF reimbursement under any other central or state government schemes for the same period.

name: Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme
brief_description:
The "Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme" by the Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide financial support for purchasing bicycles to Scheduled Caste (SC) students studying in Class 8th. Through this schemeRs. 3000 is directly transferred to the bank accounts of eligible students via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
> ***Objective:*** - Promotes education by ensuring better accessibility to schools for students. - Available to both Below Poverty Line (BPL) and Above Poverty Line (APL) students.
benefits:
- Monetary assistance of 3000 per student for purchasing bicycles.
> **Note****:** - The amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiarys bank account via DBT. - Ensures purchase of new bicycles conforming to ISI/ISO standards.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 8th.1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicants family should either belong to the BPL or APL category.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Integrated Logistics and Logistics Park Policy. Effective from August 2ndRs. 2021 to August 1stRs. 2026Rs. this initiative aims to provide financial assistance to the private developer for developing Logistics Facilities and Logistics Park with all required infrastructure and logistic services.
The component "Reimbursement of Stamp Duty"Rs. provides financial relief to developers who have paid Stamp Duty on the purchase of land required for a new unit/project. The scheme is aimed at promoting new developments by reducing the financial burden on eligible projects during their establishment phase.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Developers can recover the Stamp Duty paid on the purchase of land for the project. - **Project-Specific Support:** Reimbursement is tied to the completion of specific project milestones (e.g.Rs. purchasing all required land and completing at least 40% of construction).
eligibility:
- Only new units/projects are eligible for this reimbursement.
- Developer is eligible for reimbursement of the Stamp Duty paid on the purchase of required land for the project during the operative period of the scheme.

name: Kishori Balika Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
brief_description: The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" by the Department of Women and Child DevelopmentRs. Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide vocationalRs. healthRs. and hygiene training to adolescent girls. Through this schemeRs. girls from each Anganwadi center are selected and trained by master trainersRs. who in turn provide training at the Gram Panchayat level. The scheme is implemented by Anganwadi Workers and includes Two-day Master Trainer Training Programs provided at monthly intervals.
benefits:
- Each Anganwadi center selects 2 adolescent girlsRs. 1 Anganwadi workerRs. and 1 Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) for a two-day master trainer training at monthly intervals.
- Master trainers provide vocationalRs. healthRs. and hygiene training at the Gram Panchayat level.
- A two-day master trainer training program is provided at monthly intervals.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should be a girl.
1. The applicant should be aged between 11 and 18 years.
1. The applicant should be from one of the following categories: GeneralRs. Other Backward Class (OBC)Rs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. Scheduled Tribes (ST).

name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Infrastructure Facilities
brief_description:
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistanceRs. modern technologiesRs. and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
The component "Infrastructure Facilities"Rs. is designed to encourage the development of Industrial Parks by reimbursing a portion of eligible fixed capital investments.
benefits: - **Comprehensive Support:** Development of critical infrastructure like roadsRs. powerRs. waterRs. and communication for industrial operations. - **Support for Residential Facilities:** Up to 25% of the cost of constructing hostels or dormitories for domiciled workersRs. with a maximum limit of 20Rs./-.
eligibility: - Industries Association / any enterprise registered under the Societies ActRs. Partnership ActRs. Trust ActRs. Companies Act or SPV constituted for setting up of Industrial Park shall be eligible to develop Industrial Park under this scheme.

name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)
brief_description:
The scheme "Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative supports SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEsRs. making them globally competitive.
The component "Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)" provides an interest subsidy on the term loan to support micro-enterprises in the service sector.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance:** **Category of Taluka** **Quantum of Incentive** [Category I](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf)8% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 35Rs./- per annum for a period of 7 years[Category II](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf)7% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 30Rs./- per annum for a period of 6 years [Category III](https://indextb.com/files/2020/11/a34fc914-6cdd-4fd6-8773-502017da4334_taluka%20category.pdf) & Municipal Corporation Areas6% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 25Rs./- per annum for a period of 5 years> **Additional Subsidy:** 1% extra interest subsidy for registered startups in the service sector with Udyam/MSME Registration.
eligibility:
- The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
- The enterprise must be a manufacturing enterprise.
- Only new MSMEs in the service sector (as per [Annexure A and B](https://ic.gujarat.gov.in/documents/commondoc/2020/2-GR_02092020.pdf)) are eligible. - The enterprise must have a term loan sanctioned for new machineryRs. equipmentRs. or furniture/fixtures.
- The loan should be sanctioned within one year before the commencement of commercial production.
- Enterprises must have proper tax and business registrations.

> **Note:**

SC/ST Enterprise: SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.

name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to GIDC for Developing Multi-Storied Shed in Estates
brief_description:
The scheme "Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative supports SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEsRs. making them globally competitive.
The component "Assistance to GIDC for Developing Multi-Storied Shed in Estates" provides assistance for constructing multi-storied industrial sheds to support SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


1. SC/ST entrepreneurs can receive up to 70% of the allotment price as a subsidy.
1. Entrepreneurs need to pay only 30% of the allotment price to take possession of the shed.
eligibility:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
1. The applicant must apply for a shed in a Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC) multi-storied complex.
1. The enterprise should be engaged in manufacturing or service activities (trading activities are not eligible).
1. The business must commence production within the time limit fixed by GIDC.

&gt; **Note****:**


- **SC/ST Enterprise:** SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting-up of Specialized Skill Development Centers at Industry
brief_description: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. it aims to bridge the industrys skill gapRs. boost employmentRs. and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs. The component Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting-up of Specialized Skill Development Centers at Industryis designed to support industries in establishing advanced training centers. These centers will focus on specialized skill development in fields such as marine engineeringRs. miningRs. specialized pipe layingRs. aerospaceRs. defense productionRs. automobilesRs. machine learningRs. roboticsRs. artificial intelligenceRs. renewable energyRs. and other high-tech or management domains as determined by the State Level Empowered Committee.
benefits:
> **Quantum of Assistance:**


- Assistance to the extent of 50% of the project costRs. maximum of 2Rs./- covering construction of new building or refurbishing of existing buildingRs. equipment and machinery including installation costRs. electrificationRs. furniture and other related investmentRs. except of land costRs. will be provided.

&gt; **Additional Assistance:**


- **Awareness Programs & Seminars:** A maximum support of 1Rs./- per training center per year will be provided for awareness programs and seminars.

- **Other Expenditures:** SLEC/IC/CED can approve the expenditure on any studyRs. renovation/refurbishing of existing skill centers/instituteRs. remuneration to third party evaluation of schemeRs. monitoring/audit expensesRs. assessment agencyRs. etc.

- **Trainee Transportation Reimbursement:** Trainees who complete skill upgradation training under any scheme will be eligible for reimbursement of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) bus passes for travel between their residence and training center as per the following rates:

1. **For BPL candidatesRs. Physically HandicappedRs. SCRs. STRs. SEBCRs. and Women:** 100% 1. **For Other candidates:** 75%
eligibility:
- Industry Partner must be an industry/association with at least 10 years of experience in skill development.
- Both entities must be legally registered under Societies ActRs. Trust ActRs. or Companies Act.
- Courses should be aligned with NSDCRs. NCVTRs. GCVTRs. or Sector Skill Council guidelines.
- A minimum of 25% of course intake must be industry-sponsored.
- At least 75% of industry-sponsored trainees must be provided employment.
- The training center must be operational for at least 5 years.

name: Fish Marketing Scheme
brief_description: The scheme "Fish Marketing Scheme" by the Fisheries DivisionRs. Department of AgricultureRs. Animal Husbandry & CooperationRs. Government of JharkhandRs. aims to provide financial assistance for fish marketing and transportation. Through this schemeRs. subsidies are provided to fisheries cooperative societies and their members for purchasing four-wheeler transport vans and setting up aquarium shops. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of FisheriesRs. Jharkhand.
benefits:
- A 60% subsidy or up to 3Rs./- for purchasing four-wheeler transport vans for fisheries cooperative societies. - Up to 1Rs./- subsidy for setting up aquarium shops with necessary equipment.
**NOTE:** Assistance provided through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) into the beneficiary's Escrow Account.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a member of a registered fisheries cooperative society.
1. The applicant should be involved in fish marketing or seed transportation.
1. The applicant should contribute their share of the vehicle cost.
1. For aquarium shop setupRs. the applicant should be trained in ornamental fish farming.
1. Preference is given to women trained under fishery research and training programs.
1. Persons with disabilities (PwD) trained in ornamental fish farming receive top priority.

name: The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme was launched by the Finance DepartmentRs. Government Mizoram and came into force on 1st SeptemberRs. 2024. It is a savings scheme laid out to allow the members to make defined contributions towards planned savings thereby securing the future in the form of a pension. This scheme aims to provide a solution to the problem of providing adequate retirement income. The scheme offers structured options for partial and exit withdrawals under specific conditionsRs. along with nominee options to ensure the savings reach designated family members or legal heirs.
**Salient Features:**

- There will be no matching contribution from the employer.
- It is a centralized Model. All the activities related system will be carried out by the Nodal Office.
- The prescribed minimum contribution per month is 5% of total amount of wages. The concerned Provisional Employees shall have to make a contribution which shall be deducted from his wages bill every month by the Drawing & Disbursing Officer concerned.
- A Member or a subscriber shall exit from the scheme on his/her regularizationRs. retirementRs. removalRs. resignation or death.
- The benefits from the Savings fund shall be calculated at the rate prescribed by the Fund Manager in consultation with Government of Mizoram from time to time.
- All members of the scheme shall open a dedicated Savings Account in the Fund Manager.
benefits:
- **Long-Term Financial Security:** The scheme allows provisional employees to make defined contributions towards planned savingsRs. ensuring future security through a pension. - **Flexible Withdrawal Options:** Allows partial withdrawals for essential expenses such as higher educationRs. marriageRs. housingRs. and medical emergencies. - **Nomination Facility:** Nominees are designated to receive funds in case of the employee's untimely demise. - Centralized Management: Streamlined fund management by the Nodal Office ensures effective fund utilization and accountability.
- **Monthly Contributions:** The DDO deducts contributions (5% of wages) from monthly salaries and remits these to the Fund Manager.
**Note:** Withdrawals are permitted only for educationRs. marriageRs. house purchaseRs. or medical emergencies.
eligibility:
1. The provisional employees whose engagement is duly approved by the Department of Personnel & Administrative Reforms (DP&AR) and the Finance DepartmentRs. Government of MizoramRs. are eligible.
1. The provisional employees should be registered under the Mizoram Employee Provident Scheme.
1. The employees with family members should nominate them as beneficiaries.

**Note:** No Contribution shall be affected from the month of joining. Contribution shall start from the wages of the month following the month in which the Provisional Employee joins service.
**Condition for Partial withdrawal:**

1. Partial withdrawal is permissible whereby a member can withdraw certain amount of his contribution subject to certain conditions as laid down in the succeeding paras.
1. Withdrawal is permissible to each Member not exceeding to 1/4th of his/her balance available in his/her account at the time of application and a maximum of 2 times is permissible during the entire service.
1. Withdrawal shall be permissible to those members who have been subscribing to or joining the Scheme for not less than 5 (five) years.
1. Withdrawal is permissible only against the specified reasons such as


- Higher education of children.
- Marriage of self/children.
- Purchase/construction of residential house.
- Treatment of illnesses of self/family members.

**Condition for Exit Withdrawal:**
The following exit categories are permissible:

1. **Upon Superannuation/Regularization:** The accumulated savings wealth shall be paid in lump sum to the member. 1. **Pre-mature Exit:** Exit before superannuation age such as removalRs. resignationRs. etc. from service are treated as Pre-mature Exit. The accumulated savings shall be paid in lump sum to the member. 1. **Exit upon Death:** In case of death of memberRs. the accumulated savings shall be paid in lump sum to the nominee(s)Rs. failing which the accumulated savings shall be paid in lump sum to the legal heir(s).

brief_description:

**Objectives:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations that perform the last rites (cremation) of any unclaimed or destitute person of any age/caste/class who has died either naturally or due to an accident within the state's jurisdiction.
benefits: A one-time grant of 5Rs. is provided to voluntary organizations for conducting the last rites of unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

name: Alpshankhyak Vikas Nidhi
brief_description: The scheme "Alpsankhyak Vikas Nidhi" by the Social Welfare (Minorities) DepartmentRs. Government of UttarakhandRs. aims to address developmental gaps for religious and linguistic minoritiesRs. including MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. and JainsRs. as well as UrduRs. BengaliRs. and Punjabi linguistic groups. The fundRs. with an initial corpus of 4Rs./-Rs. focuses on socio-economic and educational upliftmentRs. supplementing central schemes like MSDP (Multi-Sectoral Development Programme). It operates under a committee chaired by the Principal SecretaryRs. Social Welfare.
benefits:
> **1. Financial Support for Community Development** **Fund Corpus:** - Initial allocation of 4Rs./- (revised periodically). - Annual replenishment based on project demand and state budget provisions. **Project-Specific Grants:** - Education: Up to 10Rs./- per institution for infrastructure (e.g.Rs. classroomsRs. libraries). - Livelihoods: 5Rs./- max for vocational training centers (e.g.Rs. sewingRs. computer courses). - Healthcare: 3Rs./- for mobile clinics or health camps in minority-concentrated districts.
> **2. Targeted Group Coverage** **Eligible Communities:** - Religious Minorities: MuslimsRs. SikhsRs. ChristiansRs. BuddhistsRs. Jains (constituting ~15.4% of UPs population per 2001 census). - Linguistic Minorities: UrduRs. BengaliRs. and Punjabi speakers. **Priority Districts:** GhaziabadRs. SaharanpurRs. and other regions with >25% minority population.
> **3. Empowerment Through Education** **Scholarships:** Pre-Matric: 1Rs./month for school students (grades 18). Post-Matric: 5Rs./year for higher education (grades 912). **Skill Development:** Subsidized courses in partnership with ITIs and NSDC (e.g.Rs. 2Rs. stipend per trainee).
> **4. Infrastructure and Welfare Initiatives** **Community Infrastructure:** Grants for: - Construction of community halls (20Rs./- max). - Renovation of religious institutions (5Rs./-Rs. excluding places of worship). **Basic Amenities:** Funding for water supplyRs. sanitationRs. and electricity in minority-dominated slums.
> **5. Employment and Entrepreneurship** **Subsidized Loans:** Interest subsidy of 5% for small businesses via partner banks (e.g.Rs. 2Rs./- loan at 7% instead of 12%). **Self-Help Groups (SHGs):** Seed money of 50Rs. per SHG for handicraftsRs. agro-based businesses.
> **6. Healthcare Access** **Mobile Health Units:** Free check-ups and medicines in remote areas (5 Rs./unit annually). **Awareness Camps:** Subsidized camps for maternal healthRs. TBRs. and diabetes (1Rs./camp).
> **7. Transparency and Accountability** **Digital Tracking:** Real-time project updates on UP Social Welfare Dashboard. **Third-Party Audits:** Mandatory CA-certified utilization reports for funds >5Rs./-.
> **8. Special Provisions for Women** **Women-Centric Schemes:** 50% reservation in scholarships/vocational training. 25Rs. grants for home-based enterprises (e.g.Rs. embroideryRs. food processing).
> **9. Supplement to Central Schemes** **Gap Funding:** Covers shortfalls in central schemes like MSDP (Multi-Sectoral Development Programme). **Example:** Additional 2Rs./- for a school building if MSDP allocates 8Rs./- against a 10Rs./- estimate.
> **10. Long-Term Impact** **Social Inclusion:** Bridges disparities in literacy (e.g.Rs. Urdu-speaking womens literacy rate improved by 12% in pilot districts). Economic Upliftment: 1Rs.+ minority-owned startups supported since 2015.
eligibility: - The project must benefit notified religious/linguistic minority communities in Uttarakhand. - The project must address critical gaps in educationRs. livelihoodsRs. or social welfare. _*Priority given to districts with high minority populations (e.g.Rs. GhaziabadRs. Saharanpur)._

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish seed rearing - Gujarat
