The following beneficiaries are eligible under this scheme:

- Arunachal State Rural Livelihoods Mission (ArSRLM) promoted Self-Help Groups (SHGs)Rs. individualsRs. Farmers' ClubsRs. Registered Cooperative SocietiesRs. and Dairy Cooperative Societies (DCS) will be eligible.
- Individuals should belong to the Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) category and be unemployed.

name: Nalanda Award
brief_description: The "Nalanda Award" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. GujaratRs. aims to honor organizations that have significantly contributed to the upliftment of socially and educationally backward communities. This state-level recognition encourages continued efforts in the field of social welfare and highlights best practices that can be replicated across the state.
benefits: - Financial assistance to the selected organization.
eligibility: - The organization must have made outstanding contributions in the field of social welfare. - The welfare work should benefit socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC).

name: Construction of Sports Infrastructure Facilities (Badminton, Table Tennis, Squash, Indoor Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Football, Hockey, and Swimming) in Private Sector
brief_description: The scheme Construction of Sports Infrastructure Facilities was launched by the Department of SportsRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide grants for the construction of sports infrastructure facilitiesRs. including BadmintonRs. Table TennisRs. SquashRs. Indoor CricketRs. BasketballRs. VolleyballRs. FootballRs. HockeyRs. and SwimmingRs. in the private sector.
benefits: Under this schemeRs. 25% of the total cost of the infrastructureRs. or up to a maximum of 50.00 lakhRs. is provided as a grant.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Quality Certification Assistance Scheme
brief_description:
The Quality Certification Assistance SchemeRs. launched by the Industries and Commerce DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. is designed to help MSMEs in the state meet global quality standards. In today's competitive environmentRs. adopting quality management systems is essential to improving productivityRs. market reachRs. and credibility. This scheme supports enterprises by reimbursing a part of the expenditure incurred in acquiring nationally and internationally recognized certifications.
The scheme is applicable to MSMEs operating anywhere in Haryana that are in commercial production and registered with the District Industries Centre. Eligible units must submit an online application within three months from the date of obtaining the certification.
benefits: The scheme offers 75% reimbursement of the costRs. up to a maximum of 1Rs./- for certifications approved by the Quality Council of India. These include ISORs. HACCPRs. BSIRs. WHO-GMPRs. ZEDRs. TSRs. and Hallmark certifications. The financial assistance is over and above the support already provided by the Government of India.
eligibility:
1. The unit should not have been placed in the restrictive list as notified by the State government from time to time.
1. The unit should have obtained NOC/CLU from competent Authority if applicable.
1. The unit should be in commercial production.
1. The unit should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the subsidy shall not be released to the closed unit.

name: Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector
brief_description: Launched on 13th December 2016Rs. the "Incentive Scheme for Establishment of New Super Specialty Hospital in Private Sector" by the Health & Family Welfare DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to address the shortage of high-end medical facilities in remote areas by incentivizing private and non-governmental organizations to establish super specialty hospitals. The scheme provides 10% capital subsidy on medical equipment loans (up to 10 crore)Rs. 4% interest subvention (max 40 crore loan) for 7 yearsRs. and reimbursement of electricity duty for 5 years. Eligible entities include registered doctorsRs. firmsRs. trustsRs. and corporations.
benefits: > **Capital Subsidy** - 10% of bank loans for medical equipment (max 10 crore). - Disbursed post-hospital operationalization. > **Interest Subvention** - 4% interest relief on loans up to 40 crore for 7 years. - Paid in 6 annual installments after a 1-year grace period. > **Electricity Duty Reimbursement** 100% reimbursement for 5 years (quarterly claims). > **Employment Generation** Mandates hiring qualified medical/paramedical staff. > **Disbursement** - **Capital Subsidy:** After Equipment Installation and Hospital Launch.- **Interest Subvention:** Annual Installments Post 1-Year Grace Period.- **Electricity Reimbursement:** Quarterly Claims.
eligibility: > **The Following Entities Are Eligible** - Registered Doctors (Gujarat Medical Council). - Partnership FirmsRs. CompaniesRs. TrustsRs. SocietiesRs. Cooperatives. > **Hospital Requirements** - 50+ Total BedsRs.including 10+ Super Specialty Beds. - Covers Specialties Like CardiologyRs. NeurologyRs. OncologyRs. etc. (List Expandable by Government). > **Loan Conditions** - Only Loans for Construction/Equipment (Excludes Land/Working Capital).

name: COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union
brief_description: The scheme "COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union" by the Department of AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operationRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to strengthen the financial base of cooperative buying and selling unions in talukas and districts by providing 50% capital assistance with a maximum limit of 20Rs./- for a wide range of agricultural projects. These projects include procurement of inputs like fertilizers and seedsRs. as well as infrastructure and service improvements such as processingRs. gradingRs. cleaningRs. washingRs. shortingRs. packagingRs. brandingRs. storageRs. and marketing of agricultural produce. By empowering these cooperative institutionsRs. the scheme seeks to ensure better quality services and economic benefits for farmers and primary agricultural credit societies.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Provides a 50% capital subsidy to cooperative unionsRs. with a maximum limit of 20Rs./-. - **Improved Services for Farmers:** Enables unions to offer better and more diverse services to farmersRs. such as providing quality agricultural inputsRs. procuring produce at support pricesRs. and offering modern processing and storage facilities. - **Enhanced Infrastructure:** Supports the development of infrastructure like storage godownsRs. processing unitsRs. and marketing channelsRs. which benefits the entire agricultural supply chain. - **Increased Market Access:** Helps unions establish better marketing and branding of agricultural produceRs. potentially leading to better prices for farmers' products.
eligibility: 1. Taluka or District Cooperative Purchase and Sale Associations are eligible under this scheme. 1. Taluka and District Purchase and Sale Associations should have their own land.

name: Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and ComputerFurniture to the Society
brief_description: The scheme Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and ComputerFurniture to the Society by the Agriculture and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to promote the financial inclusion and operational efficiency of Scheduled Caste Savings and Credit Co-operative Societies by offering managerial support and necessary infrastructure. These societiesRs. formed to serve members of the Scheduled Castes through loan and credit servicesRs. often lack resources to appoint qualified managers or procure essential office furniture and computer systems. Through this schemeRs. the government offers financial assistance to help societies pay managerial salaries and purchase basic office infrastructure.
benefits: - **Managerial Assistance:** A maximum of 8Rs./- per month is provided for an employee's salaryRs. totaling Rs. 0.96 lakh per society on an annual basis.- **Computer and Furniture Assistance:** A maximum of Rs. 0.62 lakh per society is provided for the purchase of computers and furniture.
eligibility: - The society must be registered under the Co-operative Act. - The society must be a Scheduled Caste Savings and Credit Co-operative Society. - The society should be formed exclusively by members belonging to the Scheduled Castes. - The applicant society must be registered within the last three financial years prior to the application year.

name: Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)" by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Cooperation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to encourage establishment of agro and food processing units in the general areas of Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) to increase farmers incomeRs. reduce post-harvest lossesRs. generate employment opportunitiesRs. and improve supply chain efficiencies. The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of capital subsidy to co-operatives institutions that set up processing units.
benefits: - **Variable Grant Amount:** The grant percentage is tailored to the needs of different market committeesRs. offering 25% for 'A' and 'B' class committees and 50% for 'C' and 'D' class committees.- **Maximum Assistance:** The maximum financial assistance provided under the scheme is capped at 1Rs./-Rs. ensuring substantial support for eligible projects.
eligibility: - Co-operative institutions are eligible under this scheme. - The institutions must set up a processing unit in the general area of an APMC.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Fish Seed Stocking - Gujarat
brief_description:
The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries" with the component of "Fish seed Stocking"Rs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. Through this schemeRs. 100% assistance for the cost of fish seed and transportation is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers and fishermen to boost fish farming and fishing activities in freshwater bodies. The scheme is implemented for the benefit of Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of FisheriesRs. Government of Gujarat.
> **Objectives:** - To increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to scheduled caste (SC) people involved in inland fisheries activities. - To boost fish farming or fishing activities in freshwater bodies by scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - Fishing in reservoirsRs. aquaculture in pondsRs. and catch from rivers increase fish production and boost inland fisheries through scheduled caste (SC) fish farmers and fishermen. - The main objective is to provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste fishermen in the state and increase fish production.
benefits: - 100% assistance is given to Scheduled Castes for the cost of fish seed and the total costRs. including transportation. > **Note:** Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits: 1 Year
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant can be an individualRs. a societyRs. a self-help groupRs. an associationRs. a reservoir monopolyRs. or a private unit. 1. The applicant must have a bank account in their own name. 1. The applicant must have an Aadhar Card/Voter ID/Ration Card/Passport as proof of identity.
> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Boat Net Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries"Rs. with the component of Boat NetRs. introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and providing employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals involved in inland fisheries. benefits: 1. **Tin Boat-Net Unit:** 50% of unit cost or 7Rs./- (Boat: 5Rs./-; Net: 2Rs./-)Rs. whichever is less.1. **F.R.P. (Fibre-Reinforced Plastic) Boat-Net Unit:** 50% of unit cost or 15Rs./- (Boat: 12Rs./-; Net: 2Rs./-)Rs. whichever is less. > **Conditions/Aspects/Criteria Associated:****** Benefit amount is calculated based on 50% of the unit cost or the fixed maximum amount mentioned aboveRs. whichever is less. > **Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits:** 6 Years
eligibility:

> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.

name: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Scheme For Fish Sale Equipment - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries with the component scheme for Fish Sale EquipmentsRs. Gujarat" introduced by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. aims to increase fish production and provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals engaged in inland fisheries. benefits:

> **Preference/Reservation:** The scheme specifically benefits Scheduled Caste fishermen under the inland fisheries scheme.

name: Akhil Bhartiya Kisan Mela and Krishi Udyog Pradarshani
brief_description: The Akhil Bhartiya Kisan Mela and Krishi Udyog Pradarshani scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and TechnologyRs. PantnagarRs. under the Department of AgricultureRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide a platform for farmersRs. agri-entrepreneursRs. and stakeholders to accessRs. learn aboutRs. and showcase the latest agricultural innovationsRs. technologiesRs. and practices.
benefits: The Fair/Exhibition is organized twice a year on the university campus.
eligibility: 1. Participants should be farmersRs. farmer entrepreneursRs. or agriculture-related firms interested in showcasing and promoting the latest agricultural technologies.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to IHMs/FCIs/IITTM/ICI/NCHMCT/PSUs
brief_description: The scheme "Scheme of Financial Assistance to IHMs/FCIs/IITTM/ICI/NCHMCT/PSUs" was launched by the Ministry of TourismRs. Government of India. The scheme aims to extend Central Financial Assistance for various developmental projects related to tourismRs. hospitalityRs. and allied sectors. The scheme provides Central Financial Assistance for setting up new Institutes of Hotel Management (IHMs)Rs. Food Craft Institutes (FCIs)Rs. and new Centres/branches of Indian Institute of Tourism & Travel Management (IITTM)Rs. Indian Culinary Institute (ICI)Rs. and National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology (NCHMCT). It also covers expansionRs. additionRs. alteration of buildingsRs. and replacement/upgradation of equipment for existing institutions like Central IHMsRs. Centres of IITTMRs. NCHMCTRs. and ICI Centres.
benefits:
##### ***A. Financial Ceilings for Projects*** **Setting up a new State Institute of Hotel Management (SIHM):** Maximum Central Financial Assistance ceiling is 12Rs./-. Construction ceiling is 10Rs./-. Equipment purchase ceiling is 2Rs./-. Additional financial assistance for construction of Hostel Block is up to 4Rs./-. **** **Setting up a SIHM in an existing Building:** Central Financial Assistance (CFA) for the academic block construction is limited to 6Rs./- or 75% of the construction costRs. whichever is less. Maximum financial assistance for construction of a hostel is 2Rs./-. Maximum financial assistance for purchase of equipment is 2Rs./-. **** **Setting up a new Food Craft Institute (FCI) by State Government/Union Territory Administration:** Over-all ceiling is 5Rs./-. Construction of building ceiling is 4Rs./-. Equipment ceiling is 1Rs./-. Additional financial assistance for hostel facilities is up to 2Rs./-. **** **Setting up a FCI in an existing Building:** Central Financial Assistance for the construction of the academic block is limited to 2Rs./- or 75% of the construction costRs. whichever is less. Financial assistance for purchase of equipment is up to 1Rs./-. **** **Applied Training Centre (ATC) attached to Central IHMs:** Assistance is up to a maximum of 5Rs./- for construction. **** **Promotional Initiatives (Broad-basing for Public Sector Undertaking - PSU):** One-time Central Financial Assistance is not to exceed 2Rs./-. CFA for civil works is limited to 60Rs./-. CFA for Heavy & Small EquipmentRs. Furniture & Fixtures is limited to 1Rs./-.
##### ***B. Adjustment and Flexibility*** Inter-component adjustments of assistance ceilings (for construction of academic blockRs. hostelsRs. and purchase of equipment) are allowed subject to a maximum of 10%. Such adjustments are allowed only on a case-to-case basis as a pre-sanction dispensationRs. and no flexibility is allowed after the project is sanctioned.
##### ***C. Fund Disbursement and Conditions*** Funds will be released via the Central Nodal Agency (CNA)Rs. which is the National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology (NCHMCT). The CNA maintains a bank account in State Bank of India (SBI). The Implementing Agency (sub-agency) opens a zero-balance account in SBI and draws funds to the extent of authorization given by the Ministry on a real-time basis. Maximum Central Financial Assistance up to 10Rs./- shall be provided immediately upon sanction of the project to meet expenditure for preparatory activities. **First Installment:** The first installment of fundRs. equaling 40% of the sanctioned amountRs. would be released after adjusting the preparatory fund of 10Rs./-Rs. once the tender process is completed. Subsequent Installments: The balance amount would be released in different tranches of 40% and 15%. **Final Installment:** The final installment of 5% would be released only after the completion of all civil works and submission of required documents like the completion certificate and display of credit to the Ministry. **Release:** The first installment of grant will be released only after the land is transferred in the name of the society (as stipulated) and the contract is awarded by the implementing agency. Subsequent installments will be released only after a Utilization Certificate (UC) for at least 75% of the previous installment(s) is furnished. **Renewal/Continuation:** Fresh requests for Central Financial Assistance for major maintenance/renovation (where the estimated expenditure is above 20Rs./-) will only be entertained after a period of five years from the date of sanctioning of the previous grant for that purpose.
eligibility:
The applicant must be a Society formed by the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. or Union Territory Administration. The applicant must be registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860. The applicant may be an autonomous society formed by the Central GovernmentRs. such as the Indian Institute of Tourism & Travel Management (IITTM)Rs. National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology (NCHMCT)Rs. or Indian Culinary Institute (ICI).
##### ***A. Criteria for Setting up a New State Institute of Hotel Management (SIHM)*** The applicant must ensure the Institute of Hotel Management (IHM) Society is registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860 by the Central GovernmentRs. State GovernmentRs. or Union Territory Administration. The applicant must propose the Institute of Hotel Management be run only by the State Government Society or Union Territory Administration Society. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has transferred a piece of developed landRs. free from all encumbrancesRs. necessary for the purpose. The applicant must ensure the transferred land measures not less than five acres. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has committed to providing basic services/utilities like electricityRs. water supplyRs. and provision of sewerage. The applicant must submit land transfer documents in the name of the IHM Society. The applicantRs. if land transfer to the Society is not possibleRs. must ensure the land is clearly demarcated for the IHM and is at least in the possession of the State Government/Union Territory Administration concernedRs. in the name of the Tourism Department. The applicant must ensure that reasons for difficulties in transferring the land to the Society are recorded in writing and are acceptable to the Central Government. PreferenceRs. PriorityRs. ReservationRs. Relaxation The applicant who proposes the setting up of a SIHM in hilly areas or in the six classified large Urban Agglomeration cities (MumbaiRs. BengaluruRs. HyderabadRs. ChennaiRs. KolkataRs. and Delhi) must ensure the developed land measures not less than two acres. The applicant must adhere strictly to the norms of affiliation related to academic and equipment infrastructureRs. including the covered areasRs. if utilizing the special dispensation for land size in specific areas. The applicant must ensure priority will be given to those states which do not have adequate numbers of institutions in the Tourism and Hospitality Education while deciding the site.
##### ***B. Criteria for Setting up a SIHM in an Existing Building*** The applicant must propose setting up a SIHM in an existing building provided by the State Government/Union Territory Administration. The applicant must ensure the building is suitable for housing the IHM. The applicant must satisfy the other general conditions stipulated for setting up a new IHM (detailed in Section A(I)).
##### ***C. Criteria for Upgradation of Existing Food Craft Institute (FCI) into SIHM*** The applicant must submit a proposal for upgradation that is justified and found feasible by the Central Government. The State Government must dissolve the existing FCI Society. The State Government must form a new Society in the name of SIHM and register the same under the Societies Registration Act 1860. The applicant must ensure the grant of Central Financial Assistance is subject to the other conditions stipulated for setting up a new IHM (detailed in Section A(I)).
##### ***D. Criteria for Setting up a New Food Craft Institute (FCI)*** The applicant's proposal for setting up a FCI will only be considered after registration of the FCI Society under the Societies Registration Act 1860 by the State Government. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has transferred a piece of developed landRs. free from all encumbrancesRs. necessary for the purpose. The applicant must ensure the transferred land measures not less than three acresRs. in the name of the FCI Society. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has committed to providing basic services/utilities like electricityRs. water supplyRs. and provision of sewerage. The applicant must provide land transfer documents in favor of the FCI Society. PreferenceRs. PriorityRs. ReservationRs. Relaxation The applicant who proposes the setting up of a FCI in hilly areas or in the six classified large Urban Agglomeration cities must ensure the developed land measures not less than one acre. The applicant must adhere strictly to the norms of affiliation related to academic and equipment infrastructuresRs. including the covered areasRs. if utilizing this special dispensation.
##### ***E. Criteria for Setting up FCI in an Existing Building*** The applicant must ensure the existing building is offered free-of-cost by the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned. The applicant must ensure the building is suitable for housing the FCI. The applicant must ensure the proposal is otherwise feasible.
##### ***F. Criteria for Setting up New Centres of Indian Institute of Tourism & Travel Management (IITTM)Rs. Indian Culinary Institute (ICI)Rs. National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology (NCHMCT)*** The applicant can be the State GovernmentRs. the Ministry of TourismRs. or the Institute. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has transferred a piece of developed landRs. free from all encumbrancesRs. necessary for the purpose. The applicant must ensure the transferred land measures not less than five acres. The applicant must ensure the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned has committed to providing basic services/utilities like electricityRs. water supplyRs. and provision of sewerage. The applicant must ensure adequate land is already available in the possession of the Societies of the Central Government Institution. PreferenceRs. PriorityRs. ReservationRs. Relaxation The applicant must ensure that if the setting up of a Centre is in hilly areas or in the six classified large Urban Agglomeration citiesRs. the developed land measures not less than two acres. The applicant must adhere strictly to the norms of affiliation related to academic and equipment infrastructureRs. including the covered areasRs. if utilizing this special dispensation.
##### ***G. Criteria for Applied Training Centre (ATC) attached to Central IHMs*** The applicant must be a Central Institute of Hotel Management. The applicant must have two acres of surplus land already available with the Institute or must ensure the State Government has provided the additional land required for the purpose. The applicant must ensure there are no Hotels within a distance of two kilometers from the proposed site.
> ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must ensure Institutes of Hotel Management/Food Craft Institutes follow the academic/admission norms prescribed by the National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology. The State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned must give an undertaking to follow the academic/admission norms before funds are sanctioned for setting up an IHM. The applicant must ensure admissions to Institutes of Hotel Management are based on a joint entrance examination. The applicant must ensure that if a State Institute of Hotel Management (SIHM) set up with Central Financial Assistance is under the aegis of a universityRs. the curriculum must match the National Council for Hotel Management & Catering Technology/Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) syllabus. The applicant must ensure that if the SIHM is under a universityRs. the university must be recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC). The applicant must ensure that if the cost of the project exceeds the amount of assistance granted by the MinistryRs. the remaining expenditure shall be met by the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned.

name: Establishment of Cow Shelters
brief_description: The scheme "Establishment of Cow Shelters" was introduced by the Department of Animal HusbandryRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide proper shelter and care to unprofitableRs. abandonedRs. or roaming cattle by supporting eligible organizations in establishing and maintaining cow shelters with financial assistance from the state government.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. to provide proper shelter to unprofitable livestock abandoned by cattle rearers and roaming freelyRs. the applicant organization will be eligible for a government grant of up to 90% of the total expenditure on non-recurring itemsRs. such as the construction of the main cowshed buildingRs. storage roomsRs. compound wallsRs. drinking water systemsRs. establishment of a plant for producing cow urine extractRs. biogas plantsRs. and veterinary dispensaries. The maximum limit of the government grant is 25.00 lakh.
eligibility: For the establishment of cow sheltersRs. applications will be accepted from the following non-governmental voluntary organizations registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860: - A charitable institution registered for the welfare of cattle and other animalsRs. a charitable institution formed for the welfare of cattle without any profit motiveRs. or a public trust not registered under any law. - Preference will be given to organizations with a minimum of 3 years of work experience and proven capacity. - Preference will also be given to applicant institutions that own land or have taken land on lease for at least 30 years. - For eligibility for the maintenance grantRs. the cowshed must shelter a minimum of 25 destituteRs. non-profitable bovine animals in hilly areas and a minimum of 50 in plain areas.

name: Youth and Eco Club
brief_description: The scheme Youth and Eco Club is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Programme by the Secondary Education DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote environmental awareness and sustainable practices among students by organizing programmes and activities such as plastic reduction initiativesRs. kitchen gardeningRs. etc. along with various competitions to engage and empower students in protecting the environment.
benefits: Under the Youth and Eco Club in schoolsRs. awareness programmesRs. competitionsRs. and activities were organized on plastic reductionRs. kitchen gardeningRs. tree plantationRs. environmental protectionRs. waste managementRs. cleanlinessRs. and water conservationRs. etc. - Bagless Day and Environment Friendly Awareness. - Awareness Through Skits and Plays. - Poster makingsRs. PaintingsRs. Slogan writing etc. Competition and "Say No" to Single Use plastic. - Cleaning Drives of the School and Surrounding and Keeping Toilets Usable. - Composting Food Waste in the School. - Planting of Trees in Schools.

name: Establishment of Cell for SC/ST
brief_description: The scheme Establishment of Cell for SC/ST is implemented by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST) under the Science and TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to establish a dedicated cell to empower the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities of Uttarakhand by addressing their fundamental challenges through scientific and technological interventionsRs. promoting sustainable developmentRs. enhancing traditional knowledgeRs. and providing skill development and entrepreneurship opportunities for inclusive growth.
benefits: The project Establishment of Cell for SC/ST is being implemented by UCOST in collaboration with the Department of Science & TechnologyRs. Government of India. Benefits- - To address the basic problems of all Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities living in the 13 districts of Uttarakhand through scientific applications. - To promote sustainable development among Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes through various scientific applicationsRs. guiding them towards proper development. - To enhance the traditional knowledge system through innovation by providing skill development and entrepreneurship training. - To establish a database of technologies and map the basic resources of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiaries must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community residing in any of the 13 districts of the Kumaon and Garhwal divisions of Uttarakhand. (Mainly: more than 50% of the population)

name: The Wired Internet Scheme for Information and Communication Technology Laboratory in Schools in the State of Goa
brief_description: The scheme "The Wired Internet Scheme for Information and Communication Technology Laboratory in Schools in the State of Goa" was launched by the Directorate of EducationRs. Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promulgate enhanced learning by providing internet services to the schools' Information and Communication Technology laboratories. The scheme provides a monthly rental reimbursement of up to 2Rs./- to the Head of the Government and Government-Aided Schools in the State of Goa to avail internet service to their respective schools' Information and Communication Technology Laboratory. Priority would be given to remote/rural schoolsRs. and the internet service must offer 50 Megabits per second upload and download speeds at a 1:10 contention ratio with unlimited data through Optical Fibre Connection.
benefits: - Monthly rental reimbursement of up to 2Rs./-. - The benefit is intended to avail internet service to the respective school's Information and Communication Technology Laboratory. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Financial support will be released to the Head of Government and Government-Aided Schools through the Directorate of Education. - The Deputy Director Education of each Educational Zone shall draw and disburse the financial support on receipt of the sanction orderRs. based on the selection procedure. ##### ***Conditions*** - The school shall maintain proper records/register. - The financial support shall be utilized for the purpose for which it is sanctioned and shall not be utilized or diverted for any other purposes. - Any portion of financial support which is not utilized or is not ultimately required for the purpose for which it is sanctionedRs. shall be remitted to the Government Treasury. - The accounts/registers and other records of this scheme shall be open to check by the Director of Education or his authorized representatives.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a Government School or Government-Aided School in Goa. - The applicant must have a dedicated Information and Communication Technology Laboratory. - The applicant must have at least 03 working Computer Systems in the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Laboratory. - The school must have a minimum student enrolment as prescribed by the Directorate of Education. - The school Information and Communication Technology Laboratory must not have availed of any internet services through any other schemes of the State or Central Government agencies or bodies. ##### ***Required Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor Conditions*** - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide 50 Megabits per second upload and download speeds at a 1:10 contention ratio and unlimited data through Optical Fibre Connection. - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide a Service Level Agreement for rectification time after a complaint is logged in the Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor provided portal: Minor Fault (Last mile issueRs. device issueRs. etc.) rectification time must be 04 to 08 hours. - The Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor must provide a Service Level Agreement for rectification time after a complaint is logged in the Internet Service Provider/Internet Vendor provided portal: Major Fault (Major Links DownRs. Underground cable cutRs. etc.) rectification time must be 24-48 hours. - The link uptime should be not less than 97.5%. ##### ***Preference*** Priority would be given to remote/rural schools.

name: House of Himalayas
brief_description: The scheme "House of Himalayas" has been launched by the Department of Rural DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to provide a new identity to local Himalayan products of Uttarakhand by improving their brandingRs. marketingRs. quality and packagingRs. and supporting them to reach national and international markets.
benefits: - **New Recognition for Local Products:** Under the House of the Himalayas bannerRs. various products from Uttarakhand are gaining recognition at both national and international levels. This initiative will help establish local brands on the global stage. - **Women's Empowerment:** Women associated with self-help groups (SHGs) across all districts of the state are becoming economically empowered. This initiative provides them with employment opportunities and financial independence. - **Market Access and Expansion:** The House of Himalayas focuses on brandingRs. marketingRs. quality improvementRs. and packaging of its products. This enables local products to reach larger markets. - **Quality Control:** Quality Control: Plans have been made to ensure quality control through Self-Help Groups (SHGs)Rs. Livelihood Collectives (LCs)Rs. and Cluster Level Federations (CLFs).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a Self-Help Group (SHG)Rs. a Community-Based Organization (CBO)Rs. a woman entrepreneurRs. a Local Collective (LC)Rs. or a Cluster Level Federation (CLF) formed under any scheme run by the various departments of the Government of Uttarakhand.

name: IT Incubation Centre - Information Technology Development Agency
brief_description: The scheme IT Incubation Centre is implemented by the Information Technology Development Agency (ITDA) under Department of Information TechnologyRs. Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to promote entrepreneurship and innovation in the fields of Information TechnologyRs. Medical TechnologyRs. ElectronicsRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. BiotechnologyRs. and related sectors by providing a supportive ecosystem for startups.
benefits: - The Incubation Center provides support to new startups in developing their businesses and solving related problems. The Center supports startups in the ITRs. medicalRs. and electronics sectors in developing their innovative ideas and ventures. - The Incubation Center provides startups with workspace and provides them with internet accessRs. selected medical equipmentRs. and infrastructure. The Center's mission is to support new startups and their needsRs. helping them grow and increase their productivity. - The IT Incubation Center provides business and technical servicesRs. especially in the early stagesRs. to startup companies by offering laboratory facilitiesRs. mentorshipRs. networkingRs. and other necessary services. - Incubation centers help startups reduce risks and improve their chances of success.
eligibility: 1. Startups registered in UttarakhandRs. along with IT and medical students (especially those involved in Skill DevelopmentRs. IT & AIRs. Travel & TourismRs. HealthcareRs. TechnologyRs. and Bio-Robotics)Rs. are eligible to avail the benefits offered by the Incubation Centre.

name: Affordable Housing Component in Partnership of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) under Uttarakhand Housing Policy Rules, 2024
brief_description: The Affordable Housing Component in Partnership is a scheme component of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) under Uttarakhand Housing Policy RulesRs. 2024Rs. implemented by the Housing DepartmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide affordable pucca housing with basic amenities to lower-income groups individuals in Uttarakhand through a partnership model under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban).
benefits: Under the Pradhan Mantri Awas YojanaRs. assistance is provided for constructing housing in four ways: 1. In-situ Slum Redevelopment 1. Credit-Linked Subsidy 1. Affordable Housing in Partnership 1. Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction or Enhancement ***The benefitsRs. eligibilityRs. and process for the above-mentioned point (3) Affordable Housing Component in Partnership are as follows:*** Under this schemeRs. individuals belonging to the lower-income group residing in the state are provided with a pucca house with a carpet area of up to 30 sq. m. along with basic amenities such as electricityRs. drinking waterRs. etc. CurrentlyRs. the Housing Department has proposed the construction of 15Rs. EWS (Economically Weaker Section) houses under approximately 20 projects across various cities in the state. For the ongoing projectsRs. the sale price per housing unit has been fixed at 6.00 lakhRs. of which 1.50 lakh will be provided by the Central GovernmentRs. 1.50 lakh by the State GovernmentRs. and the remaining 3.00 lakh per unit will be borne by the beneficiary. In additionRs. to ensure timely completion of the projectsRs. the State Government has also provided VGF (Viability Gap Funding) of 50Rs. per unit.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must have an annual income of less than 3 lakh. 1. The beneficiary must be a citizen of India. 1. The beneficiary must have been residing in Uttarakhand prior to 17.06.2015 (residence certificate must be provided). 1. The beneficiary must not own a house anywhere in India. 1. Registration must be completed on the portal of the Ministry of Housing and Urban AffairsRs. Government of India: [https://pmaymis.gov.in/](https://pmaymis.gov.in/). 1. Registration can be done through the concerned Municipal Corporation officeRs. Urban Development OfficeRs. or through Project Developers/Authorities. 1. As per the Uttarakhand Housing PolicyRs. only individuals whose registration has been completed on the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) portal and who have been issued a Unique Identification Number are eligible for house allotment under this scheme.

name: Construction of NABARD-Funded Minor Irrigation Projects - Uttarakhand
brief_description: The scheme Construction of NABARD-Funded Minor Irrigation Projects is implemented by the Department of Minor IrrigationRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide farmers with free and reliable irrigation facilities by constructing NABARD-funded minor irrigation projectsRs. so that water availability improves and farming becomes easier and more productive.
benefits: Under the schemeRs. farmers will be provided free irrigation facilities. The following works will be undertaken to provide irrigation facilities to the farmers under the scheme: - Solar Pump Irrigation Scheme - Pipeline / Water Channel (Gool) - Water Storage Tank / Geo-lined Tank - Construction of Check Dam (Hilly Areas) - Small Gated Weir (Plains Areas)
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. Under the schemeRs. collective irrigation projects are constructed. 1. Projects that are beneficial and essentialRs. with a cost of 4.00 lakh per hectare and a benefit-cost ratio of more than 1.0Rs. are included. 1. Check dams are constructed at suitable locations based on the proposals received and the survey conducted.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban: Individual House Construction Component - Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) Uttarakhand
brief_description: The Individual House Construction Component Beneficiary Led Construction scheme is a component of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)Rs. implemented by the Nagar Nigam Dehradun under the Department of Urban DevelopmentRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible urban families for constructing a pucca house on their own land or for improving their existing kutcha or weak houses.
benefits: - Under the schemeRs. a grant of 2 lakh is provided to approved beneficiaries in installmentsRs. based on the progress of housing construction. Of this amountRs. 50Rs./- is provided by the State Government and 1Rs./- by the Government of India. - As per Honble Chief Ministers Announcement No. 458/2022Rs. beneficiaries of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) are provided an additional incentive of 5Rs./- for home decoration upon completion of the house.
eligibility: The following are the eligibility criteria to avail the benefits of the scheme: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have been residing in the city from which he/she wishes to receive the benefit on or before 17th June 2015. 1. The applicantRs. or any member of their familyRs. must not own a house in their name anywhere in India. (HereRs. a house refers to a habitable unit suitable for all-weather living.) 1. The annual family income must not exceed 3 lakh. 1. The applicant must not have received any benefit for residential housing under any other CentralRs. StateRs. or externally aided scheme. 1. The applicant must have a legally owned plot of land or an existing kutcha/weak residential structure on which they wish to construct a pucca house.

name: Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas
brief_description: The Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas was introduced by the Department of FisheriesRs. Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to encourage individuals and groups to construct fish ponds by providing financial assistance and to promote sustainable fish farming while enhancing livelihood opportunities in the hilly regions of the state.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clusters (a minimum of 10 ponds must be built at one location) are created to better utilize water resources in mountainous areasRs. individuals of all castes are eligible to receive a 50% grant for pond construction and the first years investmentRs. including fish hatchery and feed. A single individual can construct up to 10 pondsRs. or a group of individuals may construct them collectively. - Free technical assistance is provided for rearing fish species with high growth rates. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible for a grant for pond construction up to 500 cubic metersRs. with a maximum grant amount of 2.5 lakh. - For a societyRs. groupRs. federationRs. or mangal dalRs. a maximum grant of 5 lakh is provided for pond construction up to 1000 cubic meters. - Beneficiaries are required to contribute the remaining 50% of the cost from their own resources or through a bank loan.
eligibility: 1. All caste categoriesRs. both women and men from the hilly areas of Uttarakhand who are interested in or engaged in fish productionRs. are eligible under this scheme. 1. The beneficiary must have land or leased land and an available water supply source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit is a component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland) schemeRs. implemented by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote the rearing of ornamental fish and accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. also increasing inland fish production. The scheme also employs people involved in inland fisheries activities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. > **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up a Backyard Ornamental Fish Rearing UnitRs. with a project cost of 3Rs./- per unit. - **For the General Category:** the scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. - **For WomenRs. Scheduled Castes (SC)Rs. and Scheduled Tribes (ST) categories:** the scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 60% of the actual costRs. whichever is less. **Mode of Disbursement:** 60% of the government contribution is from the Government of IndiaRs. and 40% is from the State Government. **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be availed once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Large Biofloc Establishment Culture System - Gujarat
brief_description: The scheme Large Biofloc Establishment (50 tanks 4-meter diameter and 1.5-meter height) Culture System is a component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland) schemeRs. implemented by the AgricultureRs. Farmers Welfare and Co-operation DepartmentRs. Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirsRs. provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activitiesRs. accelerate inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. and boost inland fisheries. Under this schemeRs. subsidies for establishing Biofloc and Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) are provided to individualsRs. societiesRs. self-help groupsRs. associationsRs. reservoir lease holdersRs. and private entities involved in inland fisheries activities. The scheme is implemented by the Commissioner of Fisheries of the State GovernmentsRs. with 60% contribution from the Government of India and 40% from the Government of Gujarat. > **Objective:** - Assistance is provided for accelerating inland fish farming activities in freshwater bodiesRs. increasing inland fish production and boosting inland fisheries. - Except for water bodies or pondsRs. in less landRs. less waterRs. Biofloc with source as wellRs. Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). By creating fish tanks with this methodRs. more fish production can be obtained in less land and less water. If more beneficiaries get the benefit of the subsidy of this schemeRs. more fish production can be achieved with less water sources and less land. - Inland fish production capacity can be increased by the establishment of freshwater hatcheries.
benefits: The scheme provides financial assistance for the establishment of a Large Biofloc Establishment (50 tanksRs. 4 meter diameter and 1.5 meter height) culture system. The unit cost is 50Rs./- per unit. 1. **For General Category:** The scale of assistance is 40% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. paid as a subsidy.1. **For Women/Scheduled Caste (S.C.) and Scheduled Tribe (ST):** The scale of assistance is 60% of the unit cost or 40% of the actual costRs. whichever is lessRs. paid as a subsidy. > **Mode of Disbursement:** Assistance is paid through a 60% contribution from the Government of India and a 40% contribution from State Governments. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** The benefit can be reclaimed once in a lifetime.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an individualRs. societyRs. self-help groupRs. associationRs. reservoir lease holderRs. or private entity involved in inland fisheries activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have their own bank account. 1. The applicant must have their own private land or a minimum 10-year lease agreement for land to avail construction-related assistance on land. In case of co-ownersRs. the consent form of the co-owners must be submitted. 1. The applicant must have a Voter ID/Ration Card/Aadhaar Card/Passport as proof of identity. > **Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation:** - All categories (GeneralRs. WomenRs. Scheduled CasteRs. and Scheduled Tribe) will receive benefits under the Inland Schemes. - Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries are required to have a Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate to avail benefits under the inland components.

name: Bharat Steel Awards
brief_description: The scheme Bharat Steel Awards has been implemented by the Ministry of SteelRs. Government of India. It aims to honour organisations and individuals for exemplary performance and significant contributions to the Indian steel sector. Through this schemeRs. recognition in the form of awards and incentives is provided to steel companiesRs. industry teamsRs. and individuals contributing to sectoral growth and transformation.
benefits: 1. Each award is provided in the form of a CertificateRs. a trophyRs. and a Cash Prize. - **Efficiency Award:** 1Rs./-Rs. applicable only to Secondary Steel Producers. - **Innovation Through Research and Development Award:** 1Rs./-Rs. applicable only to Secondary Steel Producers. - **Exceptional Contribution in Steel Sector Award (Individual Category):** 3Rs./- per award. 1. The cash prize is applicable only to awardees under the Small Scale Industry (SSI) category and the Individual category. The cash prize is not applicable to Integrated Steel Producers (ISPs). > **Number of Awardees**: 12
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an Indian steel companyRs. teamRs. or individualRs. as applicable under the award category. > **Eligibility for Company and Team Categories:** > (Applicable for Efficiency AwardRs. Export AwardRs. Sustainability AwardRs. Indigenization AwardRs. Innovation Through Research and Development AwardRs. and Safety Award) 1. The applicant must be an Indian Steel Company or TeamRs. whether a Public Sector Undertaking or a Private Sector. 1. The applicant must fall under one of the following production categories based on crude steel production capacity: - Large Scale Producers: Production capacity greater than 1 Million Tonnes Per Annum. - Secondary Steel Producers: Production capacity less than 1 Million Tonnes Per Annum. > **Exceptional Contribution Award:** 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant must possess a Bachelors degree in Metallurgical EngineeringRs. Materials ScienceRs. or equivalent qualification. 1. The applicant must have made an exceptional and transformative contribution to the Indian steel sector. 1. The contribution may include pioneering researchRs. technological developmentRs. policy advocacyRs. industry leadershipRs. or lifetime service. 1. The contribution must have a demonstrable impact in the past 10 years. 1. The applicant's age must be 25-60 years.

name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana
brief_description: The scheme "Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana" by the Ministry of AyushRs. Government of India aims to ensure the safetyRs. efficacyRs. and quality of Ayush medicines through providing financial assistance for upgrading pharmaciesRs. laboratoriesRs. and regulatory frameworks to the intended beneficiariesRs. including government and private Ayush drug manufacturers and testing units.
benefits: > **Financial Assistance for Infrastructure and Technology:** **1. State Government / UT Government ASU&H Pharmacies and ASU&H Public Sector Units (PSUs):** Funding Support: Up to 6Rs./- per unit. **2. State Government / UT Government ASU&H Drug Testing Laboratories and Government Research Council Laboratories:** Funding Support: Up to 3Rs./- per laboratory. **3. Private ASU&H Pharmacies:** Funding Support: 50% of the project costRs. limited to 3Rs./-. **4. Private ASU&H Drug Testing Laboratories / In-house Quality Control Laboratories of GMP-Certified Manufacturing Units:** Funding Support: 50% of the project costRs. limited to 1Rs./-. > **Pharmacovigilance Support:** - Support for pharmacovigilance activities and surveillance of misleading advertisements. > **Regulatory Strengthening:** - **Ayush vertical in CDSCO:** Professional chargesRs. Capacity building and training programs (5.00 lakh per programRs. maximum 3 programs)Rs. DocumentationRs. publicationRs. and dissemination of quality control materialsRs. Upgradation of drug regulatory portal/website.- **State Ayush Directorate/State Drug Controller of Ayush Drugs:** Maximum funding: 15.00 lakh per State/UT per year. - Reimbursable expenditure includes: - Online portal maintenance and developmentRs. Collection and testing of statutory/survey drug samplesRs. Training of technical staff at PCIM&H/NABLRs. Awareness and IEC activities. > **Standards Development:** - Organizations engaged in developing standards for Ayush materials are eligible for funding up to 20Rs./- per year.
eligibility: > **Component A (Pharmacies/Labs):** - The applicant should be a State Government ASU&H (AyurvedaRs. SiddhaRs. UnaniRs. and Homoeopathy) PharmacyRs. CooperativeRs. or Public Sector Undertaking. - The applicant should be a private ASU&H manufacturing unit that is GMP compliant and has been functional for at least 3 years. - The applicant should be a licensed Drug Testing Laboratory in the Government or Research Council sector. - The applicant must have a functional ASU&H Pharmacy in their State/UT to be eligible for Drug Testing Laboratory funding. > **Component B (Pharmacovigilance):** - The applicant should be a National InstituteRs. UniversityRs. or Hospital under the Ministry of Ayush or State Government. > **Component C (Regulatory):** - The applicant should be a State Drug Regulatory Authority or State Licensing Authority. - Component D (Standards): - The applicant should be a medicalRs. scientificRs. or standards development institution in the Government or Private Sector.

name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: Up-gradation of Facilities to Centre of Excellence (CoE)
brief_description: The scheme-component "AYUSH and Public Health" under the "Ayurswasthya Yojana" by the Ministry of AyushRs. Government of IndiaRs. provides financial assistance to reputed AYUSH and allied institutions to develop advanced facilitiesRs. research capacityRs. and specialized healthcare services. The scheme promotes innovationRs. education technologyRs. and international collaboration in AYUSH systems. It also seeks to enhance infrastructure and professional competencies to promote AYUSH at national and international levels. > **Main activities under the scheme:** - Up-gradation of facilities and infrastructure in AYUSH hospitals. - Development of research and development activities in AYUSH medicines and therapeutics. - Provision of specialized AYUSH healthcare services to patients. - Professional competency development of AYUSH professionals. - Development and sharing of AYUSH activity data with the Ministry of AYUSH. - Implementation of specialized AYUSH projects and innovations.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** Financial assistance of up to 10Rs./- for a period of 3 years is provided to eligible institutions for establishing and upgrading Centres of Excellence. - **Release of Installment-Based Fund:** Funds are released in 3 installments of 40%Rs. 40%Rs. and 20% of the total sanctioned amountRs. ensuring phased and performance-linked financial support. - **Performance-Linked Disbursement:** The second and third installments are released only after expenditure of at least 75% of the released amount and submission and acceptance of the Utilization Certificate and satisfactory performance report. - **Construction Cost Limit:** Expenditure on the construction of buildings is capped at 30% of the approved project budget. > **Note:** Purchase of land /vehicleRs. **except ambulance** and foreign travelRs. is not allowed from the grant.
eligibility: > **Eligible Organisation:** - Ayush teaching institutions recognised under the [IMCC ActRs. 1970](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19303/1/a1970-48_0.pdf)Rs. and the [HCC ActRs. 1973](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19294/1/homoeopathy_central_council_act%2C_1973.pdf)Rs.- Other Central/ State Govt. institutesRs. - Government-aided InstitutionsRs. - Undertaking/ Universities/ Research Councils/ Autonomous OrganisationsRs. - Nonprofit Non-Governmental organisations engaged in one or more specialisations in AYUSHRs. - Reputed tertiary care hospitals with at least 250 beds aiming to establish AYUSH tertiary healthcare and research facilities. - Non-AYUSH reputed research and educational institutes willing to undertake AYUSH projects. > **Eligibility Criteria:** - The organisation should furnish the necessary evidence for its potential in having achieved a level of eminence in the respective field at state levelRs. and further potential to become a Centre of Excellence at the National levelRs. as per the illustrative list placed at Annexure D of the scheme guidelines. - The organisation should be registered under the Societies Registration Act / Trust / Companies Act or any other Act. - The applicant should have a competent core staff in the field in which the Centre of Excellence is proposed. - The applicant should have a credible and transparent governing body and management committee consisting of reputed persons. - Applicant shall have to make information available regarding any assistance if ever taken from the GovernmentRs. along with the details of Utilization Certificate (UC) status of the previous grant availed. - The institute should have a valid NABH/NAAC or other relevant accreditation/certification.

name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary and other Organizations Working for Scheduled Castes
brief_description: The prime objective of the "Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary and other Organizations Working for Scheduled Castes" by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. is to enhance the reach of development interventions of the Government and fill the gaps in service-deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in sectors such as educationRs. healthRs. vocational trainingRs. etc.Rs. through the efforts of voluntary organizations and other organizations. This aims to provide an environment for the socio-economic upliftment and overall development of the Scheduled Castes (SCs). Any other innovative activity with a direct impact on the socio-economic development or livelihood generation of SCs may also be considered through voluntary efforts.
benefits: 1. **Educational Initiatives:** Opening of Hostels and Residential SchoolsRs. ITIsRs. Arts and Craft CentersRs. or Any Other Income Generating Scheme.1. **Tuition Fee Support:** Meeting the Cost of Tuition Fees for Training in Information Technology at Institutions of Repute Selected by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.1. **Childcare Services:** Organizing Balwadies and Bal KendrasRs. i.e.Rs. CrechesRs. to Look After the Deprived Children of Scheduled Castes.1. **Healthcare Facilities:** Providing Medical Facilities to Scheduled Castes through the Establishment of Hospitals or Mobile Dispensaries. For a ten-bed hospitalRs. a visiting specialist (paediatrician/gynaecologist) is recommended. The maximum expenditure per month for this purpose will be restricted to 10Rs. subject to payment of 1Rs. per visit/day.1. **Awareness and Support:** Creating Awareness Regarding Government Programs and FacilitiesRs. and Providing Assistance and Guidance in Accessing Various Government Facilities like Legal AidRs. ScholarshipsRs. LoansRs. Various GrantsRs. and Client Services.1. **Grievance Redressal:** Providing Assistance for Grievance Redressal at Appropriate Judicial/Administrative Fora.1. **Coaching and Advocacy:** Coaching Centers for Various Entrance Examinations and Tests and Other Service-Related Competitive ExaminationsRs. which are not covered in the Coaching Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Classes. Addressing Human Rights IssuesRs. Environmental IssuesRs. and Issues Related to the Protection of Consumers' Rights.1. **NGO Capacity Building:** Training of Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) in AccountsRs. ManagementRs. and Application ProceduresRs. etc.1. **Related Activities:** All Such and Related Activities that are in Harmony with the Objectives Listed Above.1. **Accountancy Support:** Accountancy for Maintenance of Accounts in MGNREGA and More.
eligibility:
> **For the Organization** 1. Registered under the Societies Registration ActRs. 1860 (XXI of 1860) or any relevant State/Union Territory Act. 1. A public trust registered under the applicable law. 1. A charitable company licensed under Section 25 of the Companies ActRs. 1956. 1. Indian Red Cross Society or its branches. 1. Any other public body or institution with legal status. 1. Voluntary organizations should have been registered for at least three years when applying for a grant under the scheme. HoweverRs. the SecretaryRs. of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment can waive this requirement in exceptional cases with written reasons. 1. The number of Scheduled Caste beneficiaries should be at least 60% in the case of voluntary organizations. 1. Other organizations or training institutions approved by the SecretaryRs. Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. - Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)/Voluntary Organizations (VOs) must have maintained and operated a bank account in the name of NGOs/VOs for the last three years. - It should not operate for profit for any individual or body of individualsRs. except in the case of training institutions of repute.
> **The following criteria would be kept in view while selecting the new VOs/NGOs** 1. Experience of at least two years in the relevant field. 1. Aptitude and experience in welfare work pertaining to weaker sections. 1. The location of the Residential and non-residential School Projects proposed by the organization should be in: - Educationally Backward Blocks (EBBs); or - Service Deficient blocks with 40% SC population; or - Backward Districts identified by the Planning Commission or - Integrated Action Plan Districts identified by the Govt. of India. 1. The Educationally Backward Blocks (EBBs). 2. Financial viability of the organization to contribute its share and ability to continue the work for limited periods in the absence of assistance from the Ministry. 3. Good reputation and credentials. 4. Capability to mobilize the community. 5. Networking with other institutions for optimum utilization of resources allocated and assets created.

name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)
brief_description:
The "Scheme for Assistance to MicroRs. Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines DepartmentRs. Gujarat. It aims to empower the state's dynamic MSME sectorRs. which significantly contributes to employmentRs. GDPRs. and exports. Effective from August 7thRs. 2020 to August 6thRs. 2025Rs. this initiative supports entrepreneurs and strengthens MSMEsRs. making them globally competitive.
The component "Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)" provides interest subsidies on term loans for new MSMEs in the service sector. The subsidy applies to new machineryRs. equipmentRs. and furniture/fixtures (excluding land and buildings).
benefits:
**Financial Assistance:** **Category of Taluka** **Quantum of Incentive** Category I8% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 35Rs./- per annum for a period of 7 yearsCategory II7% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 30Rs./- per annum for a period of 6 years Category III & Municipal Corporation Areas6% on Term Loan with a maximum amount of 25Rs./- per annum for a period of 5 years
**Additional Subsidy:** 1% extra interest subsidy for registered startups in the service sector with Udyam/MSME Registration.
eligibility:
1. The firm must be a new Micro/Small/Medium enterprise.
1. The enterprise must be in the service sector (listed in [Annexure A & B](https://ic.gujarat.gov.in/documents/commondoc/2020/3-GR_02092020.pdf)) are eligible. 1. The term loan must be sanctioned by a recognized Bank/Financial Institution.
1. The enterprise must apply within one year of loan disbursement or before the commercial production starts.
1. The enterprise must remain operational for at least 7 years post-subsidy approval.
1. The enterprise must comply with pollution control measures.
1. Only one type of investment (Forward IntegrationRs. Backward IntegrationRs. DiversificationRs. or Expansion) will be eligible for subsidy.

name: Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC- Haryana
brief_description:
The scheme "Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC" is implemented by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (HSFDC) in collaboration with the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC). The HSFDC is a Company registered under the Companies ActRs. 1956 on 02.01.1971. It is a wholly government-owned Corporation with a 51% share of the State Government and a 49% share of the Government of India.
This scheme offers educational loans of up to 10 lakhs for studies within India and up to 30 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized courses in India or abroad.
> **Objective of the Scheme:**


- To extend loans to the eligible scheduled caste students for pursuing full time professional /technical education.

> **The Education Loan is meant to cover:**


- Admission fees & Tuition Fees.
- BooksRs. StationeryRs. and other instruments required for the course.
- Examinations fees.
- Boarding and lodging expenses.
- Insurance premium for policy for insuring loanees against the loan in case of death or permanent disability.
- Travel Expenses/passage money for studying abroad.
- Caution MoneyRs. development fundRs. etc.

The educational loan shall be provided through the state channelizing agencies to concerned Government Recognized Educational Institutions where the students have secured admission. In the case of Foreign countriesRs. only those institutions shall be considered which are duly recognized by the concerned authorities
> **Professional/Technical Courses Covered:**

A regular full time recognized courses in engineeringRs. (Diploma/B.Tech/B.E.Rs. M.Tech/M.E.)Rs. Architecture (B.Arch/ M.Arch)Rs. Medical (MBBS/ MD/MS)Rs. Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Clinical Technology (Diploma/ Degree)Rs. Pharmacy (B.Pharma/ M.Pharma)Rs. Dental (BDSRs.MDS)Rs. Physiotherapy (B.SC./ M.SC.)Rs. Pathology (B.SC./ M.SC.)Rs. Nursing (B.SC/ M.SC)Rs. Information Technology (BCA/MCA)Rs. Management (BBA/MBA)Rs. Hotel Management (BBA/MBA)Rs. Hotel Management & catering Technology (Diploma/ Graduation/ Post Graduation)Rs. Law (LLBRs.LLM)Rs. Education (CT/NTT/ B.Ed/M.Ed)Rs. Physical Education (C.PED/B.PED/ M.PED)Rs. journalism & Mass Communication (Graduation/Post Graduation)Rs. Geriatric care (Diploma/Post Graduation Diploma)Rs. Midwifery (Diploma)Rs. Laboratory Technician ( Diploma)Rs. Chartered Accountancy (CA)Rs. Cost Accountancy (ICWA)Rs. Company Secretary Ship(CS)Rs. Actuarial Sciences (Graduation/Post Graduation/FIA)Rs. Associate Member of Institute of Engineers (AMIE) and Institute of Electronics & Telecommunication and Higher education like Doctoral Studies leading to M.Phil/PHD from recognized institutions.
benefits:
> **Maximum Loan Limit:**


- For studies within India: **Up to 10Rs./-** - For studies abroad: **Up to 30Rs./-**
> **Recovery:**


- Recovery (Principal & Interest) will commence after 6 months of completion of the course or getting employmentRs. whichever is earlier. The loan will be repaid in 20 quarterly installments in 5 years from the date of first disbursement.
- There would be a tag/maker on the Diploma/Degree of the student indicating his repayment liabilities.

**Note:** The Educational LoanRs. shallRs. howeverRs. be restricted to cover the admissible expenses for the remaining years of study on a pro-rate basis. FurtherRs. all Educational Loans shall be sanctioned & disbursed on a case-to-case basis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Community.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 45 years.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed 3Rs./-.
1. These loans are available to students pursuing regular full-time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad.
1. The education loan for a particular student shall be made admissible only once either at Diploma/Graduation or Post Graduation Diploma/Post Graduation level. HoweverRs. an Educational Loan shall be offered to a student who secures admission in any integrated course of a longer duration covering both levels.

**Note 1:** 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income up to 1Rs./- and balance 50% of the beneficiaries have annual family income above 1Rs./- and upto 3Rs./-.
**Note 2:** NSFDC`s Educational Loan shall also be admissible for students of the target group who have secured admission to technical /professional courses prior to 1.12.2009 subject to the condition that they have not availed Educational Loan from any other institution.

name: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) - "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation"
brief_description: The "National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE)" scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. Government of India. The component "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation" aims to establish professionalRs. well-trainedRs. motivated and adequately equipped workforce for maintenance and management of sewers and septic tanksRs. addressing the critical need to eliminate fatalities resulting from workers entering sewers and septic tanks without proper safety measures. The component provides establishment of Emergency Response Sanitation Units in all Municipal Corporations and district headquartersRs. equipped with trained manpowerRs. requisite safety equipment and citizen helpline number 14420 for emergency sanitation services.
benefits: ##### ***Institutional Setup Benefits*** - Establishment of Emergency Response Sanitation Unit in all Municipal CorporationsRs. Water and Sewer Boards in capital citiesRs. and district headquarters. - Coverage area of 75 kilometers radius from each Emergency Response Sanitation Unit to serve smaller towns within the cluster. ##### ***Equipment and Safety Provisions*** - Provision of safety devices including Air compressor for blowerRs. Air purified gas maskRs. breath maskRs. breathing apparatusRs. emergency medical oxygen kitRs. gas motorRs. full body wader suitRs. fishing wader suit attached with bootsRs. head lampRs. helmetRs. safety beltRs. safety body clothingRs. safety body harnessRs. safety gogglesRs. Tripod with safety belt. - Financial assistance up to 2Rs./- per Emergency Response Sanitation Unit for safety devices on reimbursement basis. - Personal Protective Equipment provision for deep cleaning sanitation workers undertaking manual cleaning in emergency conditions. ##### ***Operational Support*** - Establishment of citizen helpline number 14420 for emergency sanitation service requests. - Trained manpower deployment with requisite safety equipment availability. - Professional workforce equipped with Personal Protective Equipment and safety devices for confined space entry. ##### ***Training and Capacity Building*** - Specific training provision for Sewer Entry Professionals and Emergency Response Sanitation Unit staff for cleaning of sewers and septic tanks in emergency conditions. - Competency-based training approach matching global standards for all Emergency Response Sanitation Unit staff. - Simulation and video-based training with practical assessments and certification. > ***Conditions*** - _Safety device reimbursement of 2Rs./- disbursed only after completion of appointment of Responsible Sanitation Authority._ - _Financial assistance released only after establishment of functional helpline number 14420._ - _Reimbursement processed only after completion of profiling of all Sewer and Septic Tank Workers in the jurisdiction._ - _Safety equipment funding disbursed only after completion of occupational training of identified sanitation workers._ - _Funds released through Public Financial Management System mechanism only._ - _Utilisation Certificate submission mandatory for receiving reimbursement._ - _Compliance with Government e-Marketplace procurement procedures required for equipment purchase._
eligibility: ##### ***For Urban Local Bodies/Administrative Authorities*** - The applicant must be a Municipal Corporation seeking to establish Emergency Response Sanitation Unit. - The applicant must be a Water and Sewer Board located in capital cities of States or Union Territories. - The applicant must be district headquarters administration requiring emergency sanitation response capabilities. - The applicant must designate a Responsible Sanitation Authority as District Magistrate or Municipal Commissioner for their respective jurisdiction. - The applicant must establish and maintain functional helpline number 14420 for citizen emergency sanitation service requests. - The applicant must complete profiling of all Sewer and Septic Tank Workers within their jurisdiction through organised profiling camps. ##### ***Operational Requirements*** - The applicant should demonstrate capability to serve emergency cleaning operations within 75 kilometers radius including smaller clustered towns. - The applicant should ensure availability of trained manpower for Emergency Response Sanitation Unit operations. - The applicant should maintain requisite safety equipment and devices for confined space entry operations. ##### ***Training and Compliance Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure completion of occupational training of all identified Sewer and Septic Tank Workers before seeking reimbursement. - The applicant should designate and train Sewer Entry Professionals for emergency manual cleaning operations. - The applicant must comply with provisions of Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers and their Rehabilitation ActRs. 2013 and Rules framed thereunder. ##### ***For Sanitation Workers*** - The beneficiary must be a Sewer and Septic Tank Worker engaged in cleaning and maintenance of sewers and septic tanks. - The beneficiary should be employed by Urban Local BodiesRs. parastatal agenciesRs. or Private Sanitation Service Organisations. - The beneficiary must be above 18 years of age for availing training and safety equipment benefits. - The beneficiary should participate in profiling camps organised by Urban Local Bodies for database creation. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** -
