name: Male Pig Distribution Scheme
brief_description:
The "Male Pig Distribution Scheme"Rs. implemented by the Animal Husbandry DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. provides financial assistance to beneficiaries from the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories for purchasing one male pig of an improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire).
The beneficiary can purchase one breeding male pig of Middle White Yorkshire breedRs. aged 6 months to 1 yearRs. from a government pig rearing project or locally.
benefits: 90% of the unit cost (purchase price) or a maximum subsidy of 3Rs./-Rs. whichever is lower (for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) category).
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe category.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. The beneficiary should purchase a male pig of the improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire).
1. The pig should be between the 6th months the 1st year of age.
1. The purchase should be made from a Government-rearing project or a local authorized source.

name: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan
brief_description:
The scheme was launched on December 26Rs. 2014Rs. The Paddy Transplanter Machine Se Dhan Ropayee Par AnudanRs. under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology DepartmentRs. Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to promote paddy transplantation using advanced technologyRs. expand the area under transplantationRs. and improve efficiency in rice cultivation.
The scheme is applicable across the entire stateRs. benefiting farmers by providing financial assistance for land preparation. A grant of 3Rs. per acre will be given for activities such as ploughing and weedingRs. up to a maximum limit of 2 hectares. This assistance covers the preparation of a mat-type nursery and the transplantation of paddy using a paddy transplanter machineRs. ensuring improved efficiency and higher yields.
benefits: **(A) Field Preparation Expenditure per Hectare:** - Field Ploughing (5 hours @ 700 per hour): 3Rs./- - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ 700 per hour): 4Rs./- - Total Field Preparation Cost: 7Rs./- **(B) Expenditure for Seedling Preparation per Hectare:** - Plastic Sheet for Nursery (15 Kg @ 100 per Kg): 1Rs./- - Field Weeding (6 hours with Rotavator @ 500 per hour): 3Rs./- - Other Expenses (SoilRs. ManureRs. SandRs. Water - arranged by the farmer): Not Included - Additional Contingencies: 500/- - Total Seedling Preparation Cost: 5Rs./- **Total Expenditure per Hectare:** - Field Preparation (A) + Seedling Preparation (B): 7Rs. + 5Rs. = 12Rs./- per hectare - Cost per Acre: 5Rs./- **Subsidy Details:** - Subsidy Amount: 75% of the cost - Maximum Subsidy Limit: 3Rs./- per acre
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a farmer residing in the Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should be engaged in paddy cultivation.
1. The applicant should be willing to use a paddy transplanter machine for transplantation.
1. The applicant should be preparing a mat-type nursery for paddy transplantation.
1. The applicant should have suitable land for ploughing and weeding.
1. The applicant should have a cultivable area of up to 2 hectares to be eligible for the grant.

name: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Entrepreneurship Programme
brief_description:
The scheme "Entrepreneurship Programme" is a Suo-Moto Sub-Scheme of the Ministry of Tourism under the Umbrella Scheme of "Capacity Building for Service Providers (CBSP)". In this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to the institutes (given below) to conduct entrepreneurship development programmes - 1. Government-Sponsored Tourism & Hospitality Institutes 2. Kerala Institute of Tourism & Travel Studies (KITTS) 3. India Tourism Development Corporation (ITDC)
The target group are the citizens who have passed Class 8th and who are above the age of 18 years. The programme has 150 Hours of courses in the following five trades - (i) Cook - Tandoor (ii) Barman (iii) Baker (iv) Homestay (Multi-Skilled Caretaker) and (v) Halwai - Indian Sweets.
benefits:
> **Benefits for the Trainees -**
**COURSES** The following 150 Hours courses will be offered in the following five trades - i) Cook TandoorRs. ii) BarmanRs. iii) BakerRs. iv) Homestay (Multi-Skilled Caretaker)Rs. v) Halwai Indian Sweets Each course will also have a built-in emphasis on improving the trainees in hygieneRs. sanitationRs. behaviorRs. and attitudes in order to enhance their market acceptability.
**STIPEND** A trainee with a minimum attendance of 80% will be paid a uniform **lump-sum stipend of 1Rs./-** in respect of all five courses. This amount would be payable in two equal installments: 1. The first installment would be paid after the completion of 75 hours of training. 2. The second installment would be paid only after the certified trainee submits his/her feedback on the quality of the course and his/her self-employment status to the Implementing Agency.
**CERTIFICATION** The trainees with a minimum attendance of 80 % will be required to appear at the end of the course test and those who pass it successfully will be awarded a **certificate** by the implementing agency under the joint signature of the Principal/Director/Institutional Head and the Programme Coordinator.
**EMPLOYMENT FACILITATION** The Implementing Agency will make conscious efforts to facilitate self-employment of the pass-outs of this Programme by assisting them in obtaining loans (e.g. Mudra)Rs. licenses/registrationsRs. etc. Possibilities will also be explored for their deployment at Mega Tourist Destinations/circuits. The Implementing Agency will also sensitize the pass-outs about LMIS and SDMS.
**Transfer of Funds** The amount paid as Stipend to the successful trainee shall be transferred only to the individual beneficiarys Aadhar-linked bank account through the PFMS. The Implementing Agency would also render a true audited account of the expenditure incurred separately on each component to the Ministry of Tourism.
> **Funding to the Institute -** The Programme will be funded under the MoTs Scheme of Capacity Building for Service Providers under Suo Motu Initiatives. The detailed Type-wise breakup of costs for the courses for BakerRs. Halwai (Indian Sweets)Rs. Cook (Tandoor)Rs. Homestay (Multi-Skilled Caretaker) & Barman would be as follows -
**Component and the Cost (in /-):** 1. Training feeRs. i.e. Material Cost + Trainer Cost = 5Rs.. 2. Course Material (Handouts) = 500. 3. Certification fee (Certificate + Evaluation charges) = 1Rs.. 4. Apron = 300. 5. Lunch (@ Rs.100 for 30 days) = 3Rs.. 6. Stipend = 1Rs.. Total = 10Rs.. Administrative Expenses (5% of 10Rs./-) = 540. Grand Total = 11Rs..
Over and above the costs listed aboveRs. 1. Advertisements in the local papers will be reimbursed on an actual basis subject to the lowest/DAVP rates. 2. **Boarding & Lodging Costs** at the rate of 2000/- per trainee in respect of all outstation candidates for the entire duration of the course.
**Funds would be released to the Implementing Agencies in two installments as per the following schedule:** 1. First Instalment Percentage of Total Cost: 30% Output Parameters: On commencement of Training Batch against validated candidates
2. Final Installment Percentage of Total Cost: 70% Output Parameters: On successful certification of the trainees and submission of Utilization Certificate and consolidated accounts
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have passed Class 8th. 2. The applicant should be above the age of 18 years.
**Note 1:** A class will have a minimum of 10 trainees and a maximum of 30.
**Note 2:** In case the number of eligible candidates exceeds the requirement of a batch and there is a requirement of additional batchesRs. the Implementing Agency will concurrently or in phases run more batches depending on its institutional capacity.
**Note 3:** In case of phasingRs. the scheduling of candidates between batches will be on first-cum-first-admitted basis. The Implementing Agency will maintain a register of applications which will also indicate the date of receipt of each.

name: Inter-state Border Areas Development Programme
brief_description:
The aims and objectives of the Inter-State Border Areas Development Programme ISBADP are to provide facilities for the socioeconomic development of the people living along the Inter-State boundary with Assam. Projects taken up under this program are to ensure sustainability and provide value addition to any given product. As far as possibleRs. a cluster approach is encouraged.
ISBADP covers the villages within 0-10 km crow fly distance from the Inter-State boundary with Assam. Those villages located 0-5 km to the Inter-State boundary get first priority.
ISBADP funds are ordinarily used to bridge critical gaps and meet the immediate needs of the people residing near the Inter-State boundary. Planning and implementation of ISBADP schemes is done on a participatory and decentralized basis through the Deputy Commissioners/ Line Departments/ Village Councils.
The implementation of the ISBADP is taken up through the concerned Deputy Commissioners who hold regular meetings with line departments of their respective districts such as PowerRs. Rural DevelopmentRs. Roads & BuildingsRs. Water SupplyRs. Social WelfareRs. Public DistributionRs. Civil SuppliesRs. etc. in order to ensure the implementation of the ISBADP schemes in the identified Inter-State border villages.
benefits:
1. Infrastructure Development: The ISBADP may focus on improving infrastructure such as roadsRs. bridgesRs. railwaysRs. and connectivity in the border areas. This can enhance accessibilityRs. tradeRs. and transportation in these regions.
1. Socio-economic Development: The scheme may aim to uplift the socio-economic conditions of the border areas by implementing various development projects. It can include initiatives related to educationRs. healthcareRs. skill developmentRs. employment generationRs. and poverty alleviation.
1. Border Security Enhancement: Development programs in border areas can contribute to strengthening border security. By improving infrastructureRs. communication networksRs. and surveillance systemsRs. the scheme can enhance the overall security apparatus in these regions.
1. Tourism Promotion: The ISBADP might support the development of tourism infrastructure and attractions in the border areas to promote tourism. This can lead to increased tourist inflowRs. job creationRs. and economic growth in these regions.
1. Cultural Exchange and Integration: Development programs can foster cultural exchange and integration between border communities. The scheme may include initiatives to preserve and promote local cultureRs. heritageRs. and traditional practicesRs. fostering harmony and mutual understanding.
1. Environmental Conservation: The ISBADP may incorporate initiatives to protect and conserve the natural resources and environment of the border areas. This can include measures for forest conservationRs. wildlife protectionRs. and sustainable development practices.
eligibility: 1. The scheme is applicable to the residents of the state of Meghalaya living in remote and inaccessible areas situated near the international border.

name: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
slug: chief minister sustainable agriculture irrigation scheme
brief_description:
Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme-Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond) has been launched by Ministry of AgricultureRs. Animal HusbandryRs. Dairy Development & Fishries DepartmentRs. Maharashtra State in the year 2022-23 (vide G.R. Dated 29 th JuneRs. 2022) Under this scheme subsidy payable to individual farmer is minimum Rs.14433/- and maximum Rs.75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond.
Out of total areaRs. 82 percent area of agriculture land in the state is rainfed and is dependent on rainfall. Water stress due to uneven distribution of rains and periodic interruptions in rains leads to large reduction in crop production. Sometimes crops are also destroyed. Farm pondsRs. in such situation plays an important role in providing protective irrigation and reduces crop losses substantially. Considering this matterRs. Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme-Individual Farm Pond has been sanctioned by the Maharashtra State Govt. vide G.R. Dated 29th JuneRs.. The scheme is implemented in all districts of the state. Under this scheme the subsidy payable to individual farmer is minimum Rs 14433/- and maximum Rs 75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond. Farmers should hold at least 0.20 ha land in Kokan regionRs. while it is 0.40 ha limit for rest of the Maharashtra. Online applications are invited from farmers under Maha-DBT portal. The scheme is implemented by selecting the beneficiaries online through Maha-DBT portal. After completion of the farm pondRs. the subsidy payable under the scheme is credited through the PFMS system to theAadhaar number linked bank account of the farmer. The farm ponds are of two types one being with inlet outlet and the other without inlet and outlet type. The implementation of the component "Magel TyalaShettale" under Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme was approved videGovernment Circular dated April 25Rs.. The name Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Krishi Yojana" was given vide GR. dated 18th October 2023.
benefits:
1) Financial Assistance is given to farmers.
2)The subsidy payable to an individual farmer minimum Rs.14433/- and maximum Rs.75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond.
eligibility:
1) Farmer should hold at least (Minimum) 0.20 ha. land and Kokan regionRs. while it is 0.40 ha. limit for rest of Maharashtra.
2) The applicant farmers land will have to be technically suitable for digging farm pond. So that the runoff rainwater can be stored in the farm pond through natural flow and recharge will be possible. In case of farm ponds without inlet and outlet there should be a natural source from where extra runoff during rainy season can be lifted and stored in farm pond.
3) Before applying for farm pondRs. the applicant farmers should not have availed the subsidy for farm pondRs. community tank or bodi in paddy bunding or any Government Scheme.

name: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme
brief_description:
The Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) is a certificate savings scheme that was launched by the Government of India on 1st April 1988. The scheme provided a facility of unlimited investment by way of purchase of certificates from post offices in various denominations. The maturity period of the scheme when launched was 5 12 years and the money invested doubled on maturity.
HoweverRs. the scheme Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme was relaunched in the year 2014 by the Department of Economic AffairsRs. Ministry Of FinanceRs. Government of India in view of the popular demand and to revitalize Small Savings. The amountt invested in Kisan Vikas Patra (KYP) doubles in 115 months at the present rate. The certificates can be purchased by an adult for himself/herself or on behalf of a minor or to a minor. It can also be purchased jointly by two adults.
A certificate may be transferred from one person to another with consent in writing to an officer of the Post Office or Bank. Under the schemeRs. the transferee has to be eligible to purchase the certificate. The certificate may be prematurely encashed any time after two years and a half from the date of purchaseRs. in the event of the death of the holder or any holder in case of the joint holderRs. on the order of a court of Law and forfeiture by a pledge.
**Type of Certificates and issue thereof:** The Certificates shall be of the following typesRs. namely:

- **Single Holder Type Account:** This type of account may be opened by an adult for himselfRs. or on behalf of a minor or a person of unsound mind of whom he is the guardianRs. or by a minor who has attained the age of ten years; - **J****oint A- Type Account:** This type of account may be opened jointly in the names of upto three adults payable to all the account holders jointly or to the survivors; - **Joint B-Type Account:** This type of account may be opened jointly in the name of upto three adults payable to any of the account holders or to the survivor or survivors
benefits:
1. The scheme offers an interest rate of 7.5 % compounded annually on investment.
1. Amount Invested doubles in 115 months (9 years & 7 months).
1. No maximum deposit limit.
1. Accounts can be opened in Post offices and in authorized banks.
1. KVP can be transferred from one person to another and from one post office to another.
1. KVP can be encashed after 2 and half years from the date of investment at the specified rates.
eligibility:
1. Any individual who is a resident of India can avail of the benefits under the scheme.
1. A parent/guardian may invest on behalf of a minor or person of unsound mind.
1. The minimum age of minors should be 10 years.

> **Deposits:**


- A minimum of 1000/- and any sum in multiples of 100/-Rs. may be deposited in an account.
- There shall be no maximum limit for deposits in an account or in accounts held by an account holder.
- An individual may open any number of accounts.

> **Payment on maturity:**


- The maturity period of an account opened between 12th December 2019 to 31st March 2020 (both days inclusive) shall be 9 years and five months. Deposit made in the account shall double on maturity and the amount of maturity may be repaid to the account holder.
- The maturity period of an account opened on or after the first day of April 2020 shall be 10 years and four months. Deposit made in the account shall double on maturity.
- The maturity period of the deposit under this Scheme shall be determined by the rate of interest applicable at the time of opening the account.

name: Punjabi Language Scholarship Scheme
brief_description:
The scheme Punjabi Language Scholarship Scheme was introduced during the year 2005-2006 by the Department of EducationRs. Government of Haryana under the Education Encouragement for Excellence (EEE) Scholarships for High/Senior Secondary School Students. Under this schemeRs. scholarships are awarded to students on the basis of merit in Punjabi subject in 8th class and 10th Class examinations conducted by Haryana Board of School Education and continuing study Punjabi subject in the 9th Class and 11th Class. These scholarships are renewed in next classes on satisfactory performance.
**Objectives:**
To encourage students to excel education.
To promote the Punjabi Language in the State.
benefits:
**Scholarship Amount:**

1. 50/- per month for students of Class IX & X.
1. 75/- per month for students of Class XI & XII.

> **Mode of Disbursement:**

> Scholarships are directly transferred to the student's bank account.

> **Frequency of Disbursement:**

> Scholarships are disbursed monthly.

> **Validity:**

> Scholarships are renewed in the next classes based on satisfactory performance.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have secured merit in Punjabi subject in 8th Class or 10th Class examination conducted by Haryana Board of School EducationRs. Bhiwani.
1. The applicant should continue studying Punjabi subject in 9th Class and 11th Class.

name: Mukhya Mantri Matritva Sahayata Yojana
brief_description: Launched on 8th MarchRs. 2022Rs. the scheme "Mukhya Mantri Matritva Sahayata Yojana" by the Women and Child Development DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to offer partial compensation for wage loss to promote adequate rest before and after childbirthRs. and to encourage health-seeking behaviour among pregnant and lactating women. This initiative particularly targets women delivering their second child (boy) and intends to promote institutional delivery and immunization adherence. The benefit of 5Rs./- is disbursed through direct benefit transfer (DBT) into the beneficiaries accounts. The is provided after the fulfillment of specified conditions including child registration and first immunization cycle.
benefits: - **Monetary Benefit:** A cash incentive of 5Rs./- is provided in one instalment after the birth of a second child (boy).
eligibility:
> **The following are eligible to apply for the scheme:**


- Women belonging to the Scheduled Castes(SC) and the Scheduled Tribes (ST).
- Women who are partially (40%) or fully disabled (Divyang Jan).
- Women holding of BPL ration card.
- Women beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (PMJAY) under Ayushman Bharat.
- Women holding E-shram card.
- Women farmers who are beneficiaries under Kishan Samman Nidhi.
- Women holding MGNREGA job card.
- Women whose net family income is less than Rs. 8 lakh per annum.
- Pregnant and Lactating AWWs/ AWHs/ ASHAs.
- Any other category as may be prescribed by the Central Government.

> **Conditions for Disbursement:**


- The child born on or after 08.03.2022 in any family in state of Haryana.
- Child birth is registered.
- Child has received first cycle of BCGRs. OPVRs. DPT and Hepatitis-B or its equivalent/substitute.

name: Foreign Study Loan Scheme (GUEEDC)
brief_description: The scheme provides **financial loan assistance** to students from the **unreserved category** to pursue **higher education abroad.** Loans up to **15 lakh** are granted at simple interest of **4% per annum**Rs. with flexible repayment options. Security and repayment conditions depend on the loan amount. This scheme aims to support meritoriousRs. economically weaker students for global education opportunities.
benefits:
**Loan Amount:** Up to 15.00 lakh **Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum **Collateral:** **Up to 7.50 lakh:** Property valued at 1.5 times the loan amount **Above 7.50 lakh:** Property equal to the loan amount **Loan Repayment:** **Up to 5 lakh:** repay in 5 years after 1-year moratorium **Above 5 lakh**: repay in 6 years after 1-year moratorium
**Borrower can pre-pay without penalty**
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a **citizen of India** and a **resident of Gujarat.**1. The applicant must belong to the **Unreserved category**.1. The applicant must have passed **Class 12 with 60% or more marks**.1. The applicant must be seeking admission to **MBBSRs. MastersRs. PG DiplomaRs. or equivalent programs abroad.**1. The applicants annual family income must be **6.00 lakh or less.**

name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles
brief_description: The "Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles" is a scheme component under the Intensive Fisheries Development ProgrammeRs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to strengthen the fisheries value chain by providing transportation support to fish farmers. Under this schemeRs. eligible fish farmers receive a subsidy of 25% of the actual cost on the purchase of a commercial four-wheeler vehicle used for fisheries-related activities.
benefits: - Subsidy under the scheme is provided at the rate of 25% of the actual cost of the four-wheeler (9 lakh) or 2.25 lakhRs. whichever is lower.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles Haryana
brief_description: The Refrigerated Vehicles is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)Rs. implemented by the Fisheries DepartmentRs. Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored SchemeRs. aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure and ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this schemeRs. financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness and quality of fish during post-harvest handling and transportation.
benefits:
**Financial Assistance provided under the scheme:**

- Project Cost: 25Rs./- per unit
- Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries.
- Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra.
1. The applicant should ensure that the refrigerated vehicle remains operational for fish transportation.
1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only one refrigerated vehicle.
1. The applicant should utilize the refrigerated vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities.
1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchaseRs. operationRs. maintenanceRs. and management of fish transport facilities.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for Translation of Scholarly Works
brief_description: The "Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for Translation of Scholarly Works" by the SportsRs. Youth and Cultural Activities DepartmentRs. Government of GujaratRs. promotes the translation of significant literaryRs. culturalRs. and scholarly works to and from the Gujarati language to foster national integration and cross-cultural dialogue. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Sahitya Academy and offers financial support to individuals and institutions for translating original works from other Indian languages into Gujarati or vice versa. The scheme covers a wide range of genresRs. including novelsRs. dramasRs. storiesRs. essaysRs. one-act playsRs. poetryRs. criticismRs. and research-based works.
benefits:
> **Financial Assistance:**


- **For books up to 112 pages:** Up to 10Rs./-.- **For books exceeding 112 pages:** Up to 15Rs./-.
> **Printing Size Guidelines:**


- **For Demy size:** 2Rs./- (paperback).- **For Double Crown size:** 2Rs./- (paperback)Rs. 2Rs./- (hardcover).
> **Note:** Reimbursement is capped at the lower of actual cost or ceiling.
eligibility:
- An individual translator or a translation-handling institution is eligible under this scheme.
- The translation must be from one Indian language into GujaratiRs. or from Gujarati into another Indian language.
- The original authors or publishers written permission for translation must be obtained and attached.
- The manuscript must be unpublished and originally translated by the applicant.
- Only one application per financial year is allowed.
- Applicants who have received financial assistance five times or more under Sahitya Academy schemes are ineligible.

name: MICRO FINANCE (Gopalak Nigam)
brief_description:
This **microfinance scheme** aims to empower small entrepreneurs from the **Rabari and Bharwad castes** by offering **affordable loans** with minimal beneficiary contribution. Designed to support income-generating activitiesRs. the scheme helps beneficiaries fund small businesses with **95%** of the project cost covered by the corporationRs. while only **5%** is required as their own contribution.
The maximum loan offered under the scheme is **1.25 lakh**Rs. with a subsidized interest rate of **5% per annum**. The scheme is intended to improve economic participation and entrepreneurship among socially and educationally backward communities in Gujarat.
benefits:
- **Loan assistance up to 1.25 lakh** for small businesses- **Interest rate fixed at 5% per annum**
- **95% loan coverage** by the corporation- **Only 5% contribution** needed from the applicant- Promotes economic independence and small-scale entrepreneurship
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a **permanent resident of Gujarat.**1. The applicant must be a woman or man belonging to the **Rabari or Bharwad caste.**1. The applicant must belong to a **socially and educationally backward class** as recognized by the Gujarat government.1. The applicant must be between **21 and 45 years of age.**1. The applicants annual family income must **not exceed 3.00 lakh.**1. The applicant must be planning to **start or expand a small business.**

name: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets
brief_description:
The **Pay and Use Community Toilets Scheme** was**** launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and EmpowermentRs. aims to empower Safai Karamcharis and their dependents through livelihood-linked sanitation entrepreneurship. It is a Loan Based Scheme implemented by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The Loans are extended through Channelizing Agencies (CAs) i.e. State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)Rs. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Public Sector Banks (PSBs) to the target group. The key objective of this scheme is to promote entrepreneurship among Safai KaramcharisRs. manual scavengersRs. and their dependents by providing financial assistance to set up pay and use community toilets.
**Purpose:**

1. Provision of easy accessibility of the community latrines to the households (not having any such facilities in their houses) and for floating population in public places with high footfall e.g. bus standsRs. railway stationsRs. markets etc.
1. To ensure proper maintenance of the facilities.
1. To prevent the necessity of manual scavenging.

**Key Features:**

1. **Loan for Construction & Operation:** Financial assistance is provided to build and operate 10-seater community toilet units on a pay-and-use basis. 1. **Maximum Loan Amount:** Up to 25 lakh for one unit. 1. **Interest Rates:** 4% per annum; 3% for women beneficiaries; 2.5% for timely repayment. 1. **Repayment Period:** Up to 10 yearsRs. including 6 months moratorium on principal repayment.
benefits: 1. **Livelihood:** Enables Safai Karamcharis to shift from manual scavenging to a respectableRs. income-generating sanitation business. 1. **Collateral-FreeRs. Low-Interest Loan:** Offers up to 25 lakh without collateralRs. at just 4% interest (even lower for women and timely repayment). 1. **Moratorium period:** Six Months in addition to implementation period of six months. 1. **Repayment period:** 10 Years after implementation period of 180 days and moratorium of 180 days 1. **Entrepreneurship Opportunity:** Encourages self-employment by allowing beneficiaries to construct and operate public Pay and Use toilet units.
eligibility:
Indian citizens aged 18 years or above are eligible belonging to the category of: 1. Safai Karamcharis 1. Manual scavengers 1. Dependents of the above groups Individual beneficiaries/ self-help groups from the target group of NSKFDCRs. through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)Rs. in collaboration with reputed organizations are eligible to apply for the scheme.
**Note:** 1. Scavenger/Safai Karamchari and their dependents duly identified under the National Scheme for Liberation & Rehabilitation of Scavengers (NSLRS) in a survey/registered co-operative societies of Safai Karamcharis/legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target group and also all those who produce a certificate from local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/Railway OfficerRs. Head of the Govt. Departments (i.e. SchoolsRs. CollegesRs. ForestRs. HealthRs. EducationRs. Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted OfficerRs. Elected Members of Municipal Body & Pradhan of Gram Panchayats for which the State Govt. is required to issue necessary notificationRs. Regional Managers of the Regional Rural Banks/Nationalised Banks. 1. HoweverRs. under the MS ActRs. 2013Rs. a person identified as Manual Scavenger in a survey need not to provide any certificate once his/her name appeared in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State/UT Governments.

name: GROUP WORKSHED SCHEME
brief_description:
The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the establishment of worksheds for shuttleless looms in an existing or new clusterRs. which will provide the required scale of economy for business operations.
To organize powerloom units in a cluster and to provide improved working conditions in terms of more spaceRs. work environmentRs. improve work efficiency to enhance their competitiveness in the global market.
**ELIGIBLE BENEFICIARIES**

- State Government (or) its agency.
- A registered Co-operative society.
- A Company set-up under the Companies ActRs. 1956 as amended (or) a firm set-up under the Limited Liability Partnership ActRs. 2008 as amendedRs. by a group of powerloom owners (minimum of four beneficiaries).
- The local powerloom association.
benefits:
MAXIMUM ADMISSIBLE AREA Shuttleless Looms : 400 Sq.ft / Loom Weaving Preparatory : 40% of Loomage area Dormitory : 125 Sq.ft / Person
SUBSIDY CHART S.No.CategoryEligible Subsidy on the unit cost of construction Cap on Subsidy per Sq.ft 1General40% 4002SC75% 7503ST90% 900
eligibility:
1. The group will consist of at least 4 weavers/entrepreneurs having separate legal entities.
1. At least 24 nos. of shuttleless looms of width up to 230 cms (or) 16 nos. of shuttleless looms of wider width i.e. 230 cms and above must be installed.
1. Each beneficiary should have at least 4 looms.
1. Only TUFS-compatible machineries are to be installed.

name: Sanction of Laptops - Andhra Pradesh
brief_description: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens launched the "Sanction of Laptops" scheme to distribute free laptops to visually challengedRs. hearing impairmentsRs. speech impairmentsRs. and orthopedic challenges students pursuing professional courses. The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation proposes to procure 200 laptops at 30Rs./- each.
benefits:
**Distribution of Laptops.**

- Category I: Parent/guardian income up to 15Rs./- per month - Full cost covered.
- Category II: Parent/guardian income from 15Rs./- to 20Rs./- per month - Half of the cost covered.
- Category III: Parent/guardian income above 20Rs./- per month - Full cost to be paid by the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The student should be a native of Andhra Pradesh.
1. The student should be visually challengedRs. hearing challengedRs. speech impairedRs. and orthopedically challenged.
1. The student should be pursuing postgraduate or professional courses.
1. The laptop is sanctioned once in the lifetime of the student.

name: Mukhyamantri Kishori Swasthya Yojna
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Kishori Swasthya Yojna"Rs. launched by the Education DepartmentRs. BiharRs. addresses the issue of increased school dropout rates among girls during puberty due to a lack of access to sanitary hygiene products. Under this schemeRs. the State Government distributes free sanitary napkins to adolescent girls in secondary schoolsRs. encouraging them to continue their education while promoting awareness of menstrual health and hygiene.
benefits: - Free sanitary napkins for adolescent girls in secondary schools.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be a girl.
- The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized secondary school.

name: Arunachal Pradesh Entrepreneurship Challenge
brief_description:
The "Arunachal Pradesh Entrepreneurship Development Programme (APEDP)" was launched by Hon'ble Chief Minister Pema Khandu. The APEDP is aimed at catalyzing an inclusive solution to the motley local challenges by developing a vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem in the state and facilitating aspiring entrepreneurs with comprehensive support and nurturingRs. the DIPR informed in a release. The objective of APEDP is to formulate an inclusive solution to the motley local challenges faced by aspiring entrepreneurs through the development of a vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem and side-by-side facilitating their entrepreneurial endeavours with comprehensive support and nurturing.
The Arunachal Pradesh Entrepreneurship Challenge (APEC) was unveiled by the Department of FinanceRs. Investment and Planning as the first part of the APEDP on the eve of the 74th Independence Day. The APEC will identifyRs. promoteRs. supportRs. and nurture sustainable and locally relevant business ideas and entrepreneurs. After a thorough evaluation and screening of applicationsRs. 50 top entrepreneurs will be selected for the Incubation and Pre-Incubation programmes facilitated by the IIM Calcutta Innovation Park. Out of theseRs. the top 10 entrepreneurs will be awarded up to 5Rs. and the next 40 entrepreneurs will be awarded up to 4Rs..
benefits: 1. **Financial:** Top 50 entrepreneurs will be selected for the Incubation and Pre-Incubation programs facilitated by the IIM Calcutta Innovation Park. Out of theseRs. the top 10 entrepreneurs will be awarded up to Rs. 5 lakhs and the next 40 entrepreneurs will be awarded up to Rs. 4 lakhs.1. **Government Support:** Eligibility to avail of various Government Support SchemesRs. GrantsRs. Soft Loans & Pilot Opportunities.1. **Training & Mentorship:** Training & Mentorship through pre-incubationRs. incubation supportRs. and funding programs conducted by IIM Calcutta Innovation Park (IIMCP).
eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Arunachal Pradesh above 18 years of age with principal business units or should have a proposal to set up branches in Arunachal Pradesh or an Arunachali currently working or residing outside the stateRs. but wishes to return back to the state & become an Entrepreneur. 2. The applicant should be promised an idea and plan or prototype/working model. 3. The applicant should be an Entrepreneur with good communication skills. 4. The applicant should be an early-stage venture set up on or after 15 August 2015. 5. The applicant should be MSME-registered enterprises. 6. The applicant should be an existing entrepreneur in your district. 7. The applicant should be a College graduate. 8. The applicant should be Self-employed people in innovative businesses. 9. The applicant should belong to organized producer groups.

name: Bima Yojana - Direct Benefit to Artisan
brief_description:
Launched on 15th August 2022Rs. the scheme "Bima Yojana - Direct Benefit to Artisan (BYDBTA)" is a Social Welfare Scheme by the Ministry of TextilesRs. Government of India.
This scheme aims to provide financial assistance of up to 8Rs. per month to senior and award-winning artisansRs. thereby ensuring their financial security and supporting the handicraft sector.
The applications are accepted offline through the nearest Handicrafts Service Centre.
The scheme is being implemented by the Office of Development Commissioner (Handicrafts)Rs. Ministry of Textiles.
benefits: Assistance from the government may be either in the form of monthly allowanceRs. or lump sum grant or both. In no case however shall the assistance exceed 8Rs./- (Rs. Eight thousand only) per month.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a master craftsperson who has received Shilp Guru AwardsRs. National AwardsRs. Merit CertificatesRs. or similar honours.
- The applicant should be aged 60 years or above (relaxation is available for artisans with disabilities).
- The applicants annual income should not exceed 1Rs..
- The applicant should not be receiving similar financial assistance from other sources.
- The applicant should submit an income certificate and an affidavit annuallyRs. countersigned by a 1st Class Magistrate.

name: Khadya Suraksha Yojana
brief_description: The "Rashtriya Khadya Suraksha Yojana" started on 02-10-2013 by the Food and Civil Supplies Department of Rajasthan. This scheme aim is to provide adequate quality food grains at reasonable prices to the people so that they can lead a dignified life. The Act provides for coverage of 75% of the rural population and 50% of the urban population to receive subsidized food grains under the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) which covers about two-thirds of the population.
benefits:
1. Antyodaya families are provided with 35 kg of wheat per family.
1. Other eligible beneficiaries receive 5 kg of wheat per unit per month.
1. Ration card holders categorized under Antyodaya and Below Poverty Line (BPL) in the state are entitled to wheat at a subsidized rate of 1 per kg.
1. Other eligible families categorized as Priority Household receive food security at 2 per kg per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be of Antyodaya/ BPL families/Annapurna.
1. The applicant should have a ration card.

name: Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged Speech Impaired
brief_description: The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance CorporationRs. Andhra PradeshRs. "Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged Speech Impaired" under its action Plan 2017-18Rs. aims to provide touch phones to hearing challenged speech impaired individuals who know sign language. The touch phones are distributed by the Assistant DirectorsRs. Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior CitizensRs. and District ManagersRs. A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.
benefits:
> **Distribution of Touch Phones.**


- Category I: Parent/Guardian income up to 15Rs./- per month full cost covered.
- Category II: Parent/Guardian income from 15Rs. to 20Rs./- per month half of the cost covered.
- Category III: Parent/Guardian income above 20Rs./- per month full cost to be borne by the beneficiary.
eligibility:
1. The applicant's age should be 18 years and above.
1. The applicant should be hearing challenged and speech impaired.
1. The applicant should know the sign language (can communicate directly with each other i.e.Rs. two persons).
1. The applicant must be able to use video relay service (VRS) to facilitate communication with non-signing individualsRs. with an interpreter at VRS acting as the intermediary.
1. The applicant should be any one of the following:



- Student.
- Self-Employed
- Un-Employed.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna" was introduced to promote girls' education and reduce the dropout rate among female students transitioning to secondary school. Under this schemeRs. eligible girls are given financial assistance to purchase a bicycleRs. enabling them to travel to school conveniently and safely. This initiative encourages educationRs. reduces gender disparityRs. and supports overall empowerment of young girls.
benefits: - Financial assistance is provided to purchase a bicycle.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be a girl student.
- The applicant must be enrolled in a government or government-recognized secondary school.
- The applicant should have successfully completed Class VIII and be transitioning to Class IX or higher.
- The scheme applies only to girls from economically weaker sections or as specified by the government.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Intermediate Pass)
brief_description: The "Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana"Rs. a component of the "Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana"Rs. launched by the Education DepartmentRs. BiharRs. focuses on the socio-economic upliftment of girls in Bihar. The scheme provides monetary incentives to unmarried girls who have cleared their intermediate examinations from recognized schools or madrasas within Bihar.
benefits: - **Financial Assistance:** 10Rs./- for girls passing intermediate in 2021; 25Rs./- in 2022 and later.
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be an unmarried girl.
- She must have passed the intermediate examination from a recognized schoolRs. madrasaRs. or institution in Bihar.
- The examination must have been conducted in 2021 or later.
- The applicant must have a valid bank account.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Matriculation)
brief_description: "Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana"Rs. launched by the Education DepartmentRs. BiharRs. aims to promote education among girls and encourage academic excellence. The scheme rewards girls who secure a first division in their matriculation examination with a one-time financial incentive of 10Rs./-.
benefits: - **Financial Incentive:** 10Rs./-.
eligibility: - The applicant must be a resident of the respective state. - The applicant must be a girl student. - She must have secured a first division in her matriculation examination.

name: Chhattisgarh Yuva Suchna Kranti Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2013Rs. the scheme "Chhattisgarh Yuva Suchna Kranti Yojana" by the Technical Education DepartmentRs. Government of ChhattisgarhRs. aims to provide free laptops and tablets to eligible students in higher education institutions. The scheme intends to facilitate the use of new technologies among the state's youthRs. thereby fostering their economic and social development. It also seeks to enhance the knowledge and career prospects of young individuals through technology. The scheme is implemented by the Chhattisgarh Infotech and Biotech Promotion Society (CHIPS).
benefits:
- Free laptops are provided to eligible final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students of engineering collegesRs. medical collegesRs. and other identified technical higher education institutions.
- Free tablets are provided to eligible final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students in universitiesRs. collegesRs. and higher education institutionsRs. specifically those in commerceRs. artsRs. and science streams.
- The distribution occurs in each academic session.
- Each eligible student will receive either a tablet or a laptop only once during their academic life in any college/institution within the state.

_*CHIPS will determine the specifications of the laptops and tablets._
_*CHIPS will purchase laptops/tablets according to the specified procurement process and specifications and deliver them to the Department of Technical Education and the Department of Higher Education for distribution. The Department of Technical Education and the Department of Higher Education will inform CHIPS about the receipt and distribution locations of the laptops/tablets each year._
eligibility:
- The applicant must be a student.
- The applicant must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh.
- The applicant must be studying in the final year of a graduate or postgraduate degree program.
- The applicant must be pursuing the program from an institution in Chhattisgarh.
- For laptopRs. the applicant must be studying in a recognised engineering collegeRs. medical collegeRs. or other identified technical higher education institution in Chhattisgarh.
- For tabletRs. the applicant must be studying in a recognised universityRs. collegeRs. or higher education institution in ChhattisgarhRs. in a commerceRs. artsRs. or science stream.

name: Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana
brief_description: Launched in 2017Rs. the "Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee Durghtana Sahayta Yojana" is a state-level welfare scheme of the Government of Haryana under the Social Justice and Empowerment Department. It provides financial assistance of 1Rs./- to individuals between 18 and 70 years of age who have suffered accidental death or disability and are not registered under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY). The scheme is applicable only to permanent residents of Haryana residing in the state. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department.
benefits:
> **Monetary Benefit:** 1Rs./- is provided in case of:


- Accidental death.
- Total and permanent loss of both eyes.
- Loss of both hands or both feet.
- Loss of one eye and one hand or one foot.
eligibility:
- The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
- The applicant should currently be residing in Haryana.
- The applicant should be between 18 and 70 years.
- The applicant should have met with an accident resulting in death or disability.

**Note:**

1. In case of disabilityRs. the claimant must be the disabled person themselves.
1. In case of deathRs. the claimants shall be:


- The spouse (if not remarried).
- All unmarried children with equal share.
- Mother
- Father
- No other claimant is eligible beyond the above.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme for BPL Families
brief_description: The scheme "National Family Benefit Scheme for BPL Families" by the Social Justice and Empowerment DepartmentRs. Government of HaryanaRs. aims to provide financial relief of 20Rs. to low-income families who lose their main earning memberRs. thereby offering socio-economic stability in times of crisis. It targets families below the poverty line or categorized as destituteRs. whose deceased member was between the ages of 18 to 59 years and had no other source of income or government support. The financial benefit is granted to the new head of the family post-verification. The scheme excludes families with high-income children or members holding high-ranking positions or professional occupations. Application must be made within one year of the death of the breadwinner.
benefits: - **Monetary Benefit:** 20Rs./- (one-time assistance).
eligibility: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. - The applicant's name should be registered in the BPL list or classified as destitute. - The applicant should be between 18 and 59 years of age. - The applicant should not have any other source of income. - If eligibleRs. both husband and wife are entitled to receive the benefit individually. - The applicant should not be receiving assistance or pension under any other government scheme. - The application must be submitted within one year from the date of death of the breadwinner. - The applicant must be the head of the family or a surviving family member considered the head after investigation. > **Note:** - Benefit will be given to such surviving members in the family of the deceasedRs. who after investigationRs. will be considered as the head of the family. - The word family means husband/wife/minor children/unmarried daughters and dependent parents. - If any woman's parents are also living in house of her daughter and son-in-lawRs. then that too will be considered part of the family.

name: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
brief_description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc Culture SystemRs. introduced by the Ministry Of FisheriesRs. Animal Husbandry & DairyingRs. Government of IndiaRs. aims to provide capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems. These models promote high-density fish production in controlled environmentsRs. significantly reducing land and water usage. It is a centrally funded scheme with a 50:50 cost-sharing pattern between the Central and State Governments.

- For RAS: Minimum 6 tanks of 30 m3 each (10 tons/crop)- For Biofloc: 25 tanks of 4 m diameter and 1 m height
benefits:
- The project cost is 25Rs./-

> **** **Subsidy Distribution:**


1. 40% subsidy for General Category beneficiaries.
1. 60% subsidy for SC and Women category beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must have access to own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from any legal and financial encumbrances.
1. The applicant must have access to a reliable water source such as a canalRs. tube wellRs. riverRs. or similar.
1. The applicant must provide a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture.
1. The applicant must agree to manage and maintain the system at their own cost after setup.
1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP).
1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Department of Fisheries to avail benefits under the scheme.

name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme
brief_description: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) responsible for the implementation of ComSeC Scheme part of MTCTE. This involves development of Indian Telecom Security Assurance StandardsRs. Security Test labs recognition and Security certification of telecom equipment and associated processes. This mandate is of significant importance considering the looming telecom/network/cyber threats globally and the threat these vulnerabilities pose to National Security and Privacy to people of the Nation. NCCS work in security domain to strengthen the security standardization eco-system in India is highly specialized in nature and unique in its mandate. It also needs to interact with multilateral agencies like 3GPPRs. ITURs. APTRs. IEEERs. IETFRs. NIST and ETSI and other national/ international standardization bodies for active collaboration & development of country specific telecom security standards for India. It develops expertise to imbibe latest technologies and provides technical support/ policy inputs to DOT to advice other ministries in respects of Telecom Security Domain. **Positions** 1. The number of positions available depends upon the vacancies. Please refer to the RA Notification for vacancy details. 1. The total number of RAs at NCCS at any point of time can not be more than 18. 1. NCCS reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the positionsRs. if it so desires. **Period of engagement** Initially for a period of 2 yearsRs. extendable by one more yearRs. on the recommendations of Performance Appraisal Committee. **Brief Description of Work and Responsibilities** 1. The RAs will be primarily engaged for in-depth studyRs. formulationRs. operationalization and assessment of various security standards ITSARs preparationRs. TSTPs preparation/programmes/ projects/ policies evaluation of test reports/DUTs etc. related to emerging ICT areas such as TelecomRs. Network and Cyber SecurityRs. 4G/5G NetworksRs. Virtualisation Function & Operating Systems ExpertiseRs. Cloud SecurityRs. Source Code AnalysisRs. CryptographyRs. Internet of ThingsRs. Smart NetworksRs. Artificial IntelligenceRs. Machine LearningRs. new developments in the fields of Mobile Technologies and any associated field deemed fit by NCCS. They will also be associated in preparation of contributions for various international standardization organizations such as International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Study GroupsRs. APTRs. IEEERs. IEC etc. FurtherRs. they will also be engaged in various works emerging from ComSec SchemeRs. new National Digital Communication Policy (NDCP) - 2018 1. The RAs would The RA would be attached with one of the Divisions of the NCCS and required to provide high quality work. Depending on the requirements of NCCS and candidates personal skillsRs. RAs can be rotated to other divisions within NCCS. **Place of posting** The place of posting will be NCCSRs. City Telephone ExchangeRs. Sampangirama NagarRs. Bengaluru 560027.
benefits: > Remuneration 1. A consolidated amount of 75Rs./- per month on pro rata basisRs. all-inclusive (including taxes)Rs. will be paid to every RA. There shall be an annual increase of 7Rs./- subject to satisfactory performance. 1. RA shall submit execute bond as prescribed in the Advertisement.
eligibility: 1. The candidate must have a Bachelors Degree in Electronics / Communications / Telecommunications / Information Technology / Computers / Electrical Engineering or a related field with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. 1. The age limit is up to 28 years for Graduates (BE/BTech)Rs. 30 years for Postgraduates (MTech/MS)Rs. and 35 years for PhD candidates. 1. The applicant must be an Indian National. 1. The preference will be given to candidates having a valid GATE scoreRs. postgraduate degree with minimum 60% marksRs. PhD in a relevant fieldRs. work experience of one year or moreRs. or an internship of six months or more with NCCS/TEC. 1. The candidates who decline the job offer after selection will be barred from applying for the next two NCCS notifications. **Note :** A candidate who declines to join after the offer of appointment is issued by NCCS shall be debarred from appointment in 2 subsequent notifications issued by NCCS.

name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
Shrama Shakthi Scheme
